11 September 1922 Revolution.headline: Revolucija 11. septembra 1922
paragraphs: Revolucija 11. septembra 1922 (grško: Επανάσταση της 11ης Σεπτεμβρίου 1922) je bila vstaja grške kopenske vojske in mornarice proti vladi v Atenah; uporniki so namesto nje postavili »revolucionarni odbor«. Vstaja se je zgodila 24. septembra 1922, vendar je bil to po julijanskem koledarju, ki je v Grčiji tedaj še veljal, »11. september«.

source.title: 11 September 1922 Revolution
paragraphs: The 11 September 1922 Revolution (Greek: Επανάσταση της 11ης Σεπτεμβρίου 1922) was an uprising by the Greek Army and Navy against the government in Athens, which installed a "Revolutionary Committee" in its place. The uprising took place on 24 September 1922, although the date was "11 September" on the Julian calendar still in use at the time in Greece.

13 Vendémiaire.headline: 13. vendémiaire
paragraphs: 13. vendémiaire leta IV po francoskem republikanskem koledarju (5. oktobra 1795 po gregorijanskem koledarju) je bil spopad med francoskimi revolucionarnimi enotami in rojalističnimi silami na pariških ulicah. Spopad je bil del vzpostavljanja nove oblike vlade, direktorija, in je močno pospešil kariero republikanskega generala Napoleona Bonaparta.
notes: Year 4 of the Republican calendar is written in Roman numerals (leta IV), as is usual in Slovenian.

source.title: 13 Vendémiaire
paragraphs: 13 Vendémiaire, Year 4 in the French Republican Calendar (5 October 1795 in the Gregorian calendar), was a battle between the French Revolutionary troops and Royalist forces in the streets of Paris. This battle was part of the establishing of a new form of government, the Directory, and it was a major factor in the rapid advancement of Republican General Napoleon Bonaparte's career.

Medvladje in nasledstvena vojna sta se v Kraljevini Portugalski začela leta 1383, ko je kralj Ferdinand I. umrl brez sinov, in končala, ko je bil leta 1385 po zmagi v bitki pri Aljubarroti kronan kralj Ivan I.
Portugalci to obdobje razumejo kot svoje prvo narodno gibanje upora proti kastiljskemu vmešavanju, Robert Durand pa ga ima za »veliko razkritje narodne zavesti«.

Meščanstvo in plemstvo sta skupaj trdno postavila dinastijo Avis, vejo portugalske burgundske hiše, na neodvisen prestol. To je bilo v nasprotju z dolgimi državljanskimi vojnami v Franciji (stoletna vojna) in Angliji (vojna rož), v katerih so se aristokratske frakcije silovito bojevale proti centralizirani monarhiji.

source.title: 1383–1385 Portuguese interregnum
paragraphs: An interregnum and a war of succession began in the Kingdom of Portugal in 1383 when King Ferdinand I died leaving no sons and ended when King John I was crowned in 1385 after his victory during the Battle of Aljubarrota.
The Portuguese interpret the era as their earliest national resistance movement to counter Castilian intervention, and Robert Durand considers it as the "great revealer of national consciousness".

The bourgeoisie and the nobility worked together to establish the Avis dynasty, a branch of the Portuguese House of Burgundy, securely on an independent throne. That contrasted with the lengthy civil wars in France (Hundred Years' War) and England (War of the Roses), which had aristocratic factions fighting powerfully against a centralised monarchy.

1886 Bulgarian coup d'état.headline: Bolgarski državni udar leta 1886
paragraphs: Bolgarski državni udar leta 1886, znan tudi kot državni udar 9. avgusta (bolgarsko: Деветоавгустовски преврат), je bil poskus odstavitve kneza Aleksandra Battenberga v Kneževini Bolgariji, izveden 9. avgusta 1886. Udar ni uspel, a je vseeno pripeljal do abdikacije Aleksandra Battenberga.

source.title: 1886 Bulgarian coup d'état
paragraphs: The Bulgarian coup d'état of 1886, also known as the 9 August coup d'état (Bulgarian: Деветоавгустовски преврат, Devetoavgustovski prevrat) was an attempted dethronement of Knyaz Alexander Battenberg in Principality of Bulgaria, carried out on 9 August 1886. Although unsuccessful, the event led to the abdication of Alexander Battenberg.

1923 Bulgarian coup d'état.headline: Bolgarski državni udar leta 1923
paragraphs: Bolgarski državni udar leta 1923, znan tudi kot državni udar 9. junija (bolgarsko: Деветоюнски преврат), je bil državni udar v Bolgariji, ki so ga zvečer 9. junija 1923 izvedle oborožene sile Vojaške lige generala Ivana Valkova. Bolgarski car Boris III. ga je z odlokom obotavljivo legitimiral. Udar je strmoglavil izvoljeno vlado Aleksandra Stambolijskega iz Bolgarske kmečke narodne zveze in jo nadomestil z vlado Aleksandra Cankova.

source.title: 1923 Bulgarian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1923 Bulgarian coup d'état, also known as the 9 June coup d'état (Bulgarian: Деветоюнски преврат, Devetoyunski prevrat), was a coup d'état in Bulgaria implemented by armed forces under General Ivan Valkov's Military League on the evening of 9 June 1923. Hestitantly legitimized by a decree of Tsar Boris III of Bulgaria, the coup overthrew the elected government headed by Aleksandar Stamboliyski of the Bulgarian Agrarian National Union (BANU), and replaced it with one under Aleksandar Tsankov.

1926 Slavery Convention.headline: Konvencija o suženjstvu (1926)
paragraphs: Konvencija o suženjstvu iz leta 1926 ali Konvencija o odpravi trgovine s sužnji in suženjstva je mednarodna pogodba, ki je nastala pod okriljem Društva narodov in je bila prvič podpisana 25. septembra 1926. V zbirko pogodb Društva narodov je bila vpisana 9. marca 1927, na dan, ko je začela veljati. Cilj konvencije je potrditi in pospešiti odpravo suženjstva in trgovine s sužnji, leta 1956 pa jo je pod okriljem Združenih narodov razširila Dopolnilna konvencija o odpravi suženjstva.

source.title: 1926 Slavery Convention
paragraphs: The 1926 Slavery Convention or the Convention to Suppress the Slave Trade and Slavery is an international treaty created under the auspices of the League of Nations and first signed on 25 September 1926. It was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 9 March 1927, the same day it went into effect. The objective of the convention is to confirm and advance the suppression of slavery and the slave trade and was extended in 1956 with the Supplementary Convention on the Abolition of Slavery, under the auspices of the United Nations.

1932 Lausanne Conference.headline: Konferenca v Lausanni (1932)
paragraphs: Konferenca v Lausanni leta 1932, ki je potekala od 16. junija do 9. julija 1932 v Lausanni v Švici, je bila srečanje predstavnikov Združenega kraljestva, Francije, Italije, Belgije, Japonske in Nemčije, na katerem so se dogovorili, da zmanjšajo nemške reparacijske obveznosti iz prve svetovne vojne, ki sta jih določila versajska pogodba in Youngov načrt iz leta 1929. Zmanjšanje za približno 90 % je bilo posledica težkih gospodarskih razmer v veliki gospodarski krizi. Lausannska pogodba ni nikoli začela veljati, ker je bila odvisna od dogovora z Združenimi državami o vračilu posojil, ki so jih te med prvo svetovno vojno dale zavezniškim silam, do tega dogovora pa ni nikoli prišlo. Konferenca v Lausanni je dejansko pomenila konec nemških reparacijskih plačil vse do obdobja po drugi svetovni vojni.

source.title: 1932 Lausanne Conference
paragraphs: The Lausanne Conference of 1932, held from 16 June to 9 July 1932 in Lausanne, Switzerland, was a meeting of representatives from the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Belgium, Japan and Germany that resulted in an agreement to lower Germany's World War I reparations obligations as imposed by the Treaty of Versailles and the 1929 Young Plan. The reduction of approximately 90 per cent was made as a result of the difficult economic circumstances during the Great Depression. The Lausanne Treaty never came into effect because it was dependent on an agreement with the United States on the repayment of the loans it had made to the Allied powers during World War I, and that agreement was never reached. The Lausanne Conference marked the de facto end of Germany's reparations payments until after World War II.

1940–1944 insurgency in Chechnya.headline: Upor v Čečeniji 1940–1944
paragraphs: Upor v Čečeniji v letih 1940–1944 (rusko: Восстание Хасана Исраилова) je bil samostojen upor proti sovjetski oblasti v Čečensko-inguški avtonomni sovjetski socialistični republiki. Začel se je v začetku leta 1940 pod vodstvom Hasana Israilova, vrhunec je dosegel leta 1942 med nemškim vdorom na Severni Kavkaz, končal pa se je v začetku leta 1944 z množičnim zbiranjem in deportacijo vajnaških ljudstev (Čečenov in Ingušev) z njihove domače zemlje in iz krajev po vsej ZSSR; umrlo je najmanj 144.000 civilistov. Razpršen odpor v gorah se je kljub temu nadaljeval še leta.

source.title: 1940–1944 insurgency in Chechnya
paragraphs: The 1940–1944 insurgency in Chechnya (Russian: Восстание Хасана Исраилова) was an autonomous revolt against the Soviet authorities in the Chechen-Ingush Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic. Beginning in early 1940 under Hasan Israilov, it peaked in 1942 during the German invasion of North Caucasus and ended in the beginning of 1944 with the wholesale concentration and deportation of the Vainakh peoples (Chechens and Ingushes) from their native lands as well as from the locations across the USSR, resulting in the death of at least 144,000 civilians. However, scattered resistance in the mountains continued for years.

1944 Bulgarian coup d'état.headline: Bolgarski državni udar leta 1944
paragraphs: Bolgarski državni udar leta 1944, znan tudi kot državni udar 9. septembra (bolgarsko: Деветосептемврийски преврат), je bil udar, ki je v noči na 9. september 1944 strmoglavil vlado Kraljevine Bolgarije. V komunističnem obdobju ga je uradna propaganda imenovala ljudska vstaja 9. septembra, ker so ga spremljali obsežni nemiri, in socialistična revolucija, ker je bil politična prelomnica in začetek korenitih reform v smeri sovjetskega socializma.

source.title: 1944 Bulgarian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1944 Bulgarian coup d'état, also known as the 9 September coup d'état (Bulgarian: Деветосептемврийски преврат, romanized: Devetoseptemvriyski prevrat), was a coup that overthrew the government of Kingdom of Bulgaria on the eve of 9 September 1944. During the Communist era, official propaganda called the coup the People's Uprising of 9 September on the grounds of the broad unrest and the Socialist Revolution as it was a turning point politically and the beginning of radical reforms towards Soviet-style socialism.

Ženevska konferenca, ki se je je udeležilo več držav, naj bi razrešila odprta vprašanja po korejski vojni in prvi indokitajski vojni. Potekala je v Ženevi v Švici od 26. aprila do 21. julija 1954. Del konference o korejskem vprašanju se je končal brez sprejetih izjav ali predlogov, zato navadno velja za manj pomembnega. Ženevski sporazumi, ki so obravnavali razgradnjo Francoske Indokine, pa so imeli dolgotrajne posledice.

source.title: 1954 Geneva Conference
paragraphs: The Geneva Conference was intended to settle outstanding issues resulting from the Korean War and the First Indochina War and involved several nations. It took place in Geneva, Switzerland, from 26 April to 21 July 1954. The part of the conference on the Korean question ended without adopting any declarations or proposals and so is generally considered less relevant. On the other hand, the Geneva Accords that dealt with the dismantling of French Indochina proved to have long-lasting repercussions.

1981 Spanish coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Španiji leta 1981
paragraphs: Februarja 1981 so desničarski, frankistični pripadniki civilne garde in španske vojske v Španiji poskusili z državnim udarom. Neuspeh udara je pomenil zadnji resen poskus, da bi Španijo vrnili v frankistično državo, in je utrdil španski proces demokratizacije. Kralj Juan Carlos I. je imel pri preprečitvi udara pomembno vlogo, monarhija pa je zato pridobila novo legitimnost.

source.title: 1981 Spanish coup attempt
paragraphs: A coup d'état was attempted in Spain in February 1981 by right-wing, Francoist elements of the Civil Guard and the Spanish military. The failure of the coup marked the last serious attempt to revert Spain to a Francoist state and served to consolidate Spain's democratization process. King Juan Carlos I played a major role in foiling the coup, and the monarchy emerged with renewed legitimacy as a result.

Sovjetski sistem zgodnjega opozarjanja na jedrski napad Oko je 26. septembra 1983, med hladno vojno, sporočil, da so iz Združenih držav izstrelili eno medcelinsko balistično raketo, za njo pa še štiri. Stanislav Petrov (1939–2017), inženir sovjetske protizračne obrambe, ki je bil dežuren v poveljniškem središču sistema, je posumil, da gre za lažne alarme. Namesto da bi opozorilo takoj sporočil višje po poveljniški verigi, se je odločil počakati na potrditev, ki je ni bilo. Velja, da je s to odločitvijo preprečil povračilni jedrski napad na Združene države in njihove zaveznice v Natu, ki bi verjetno sprožil vsesplošno jedrsko vojno. Preiskava satelitskega opozorilnega sistema je pozneje ugotovila, da je sistem res odpovedal.
notes: The English opens without a definition sentence; kept as in the source.

source.title: 1983 Soviet nuclear false alarm incident
paragraphs: On 26 September 1983, during the Cold War, the Soviet nuclear early warning system Oko reported the launch of one intercontinental ballistic missile with four more missiles behind it, from the United States. These missile attack warnings were suspected to be false alarms by Stanislav Petrov (1939–2017), an engineer of the Soviet Air Defence Forces on duty at the command center of the early-warning system. He decided to wait for corroborating evidence—of which none arrived—rather than immediately relaying the warning up the chain of command. This decision is seen as having prevented a retaliatory nuclear strike against the United States and its NATO allies, which would likely have resulted in a full-scale nuclear war. Investigation of the satellite warning system later determined that the system had indeed malfunctioned.

1991 Paris Peace Agreements.headline: Pariški mirovni sporazumi (1991)
paragraphs: Pariški mirovni sporazumi (kmersko: សន្ធិសញ្ញាសន្តិភាពទីក្រុងប៉ារីស ឆ្នាំ១៩៩១; francosko: Accords de paix de Paris), uradno Celoviti kamboški mirovni sporazumi, so bili podpisani 23. oktobra 1991 in so uradno končali kamboško-vietnamsko vojno in tretjo indokitajsko vojno. Na njihovi podlagi je bila napotena prva mirovna misija OZN po hladni vojni (prehodna oblast Združenih narodov v Kambodži), Združeni narodi pa so prvič prevzeli vlogo vlade neke države. Sporazum je podpisalo devetnajst držav.
Pariški mirovni sporazumi so obsegali več konvencij in pogodb.
Med njimi je bil sklepni akt pariške konference o Kambodži.
notes: The English excerpt is the start of a list ("the following conventions and treaties:" / "The Final Act …"); the Slovenian turns it into two complete sentences.

source.title: 1991 Paris Peace Agreements
paragraphs: The Paris Peace Agreements (Khmer: សន្ធិសញ្ញាសន្តិភាពទីក្រុងប៉ារីស ឆ្នាំ១៩៩១; French: Accords de paix de Paris), officially the Comprehensive Cambodian Peace Agreements, was signed on 23 October 1991 and marked the official end of the Cambodian–Vietnamese War and the Third Indochina War. The agreement led to the deployment of the first UN peacekeeping mission (the United Nations Transitional Authority in Cambodia) since the Cold War and the first occasion in which the United Nations took over as the government of a state. The agreement was signed by nineteen countries.
The Paris Peace Agreements were the following conventions and treaties:
The Final Act of the Paris Conference on Cambodia

1992 Yugoslav People's Army column incid.headline: Incident s kolono JLA v Sarajevu leta 1992
paragraphs: Incident s kolono Jugoslovanske ljudske armade v Sarajevu se je zgodil 3. maja 1992 na Dobrovoljački ulici v Sarajevu, ko so pripadniki Armade Republike Bosne in Hercegovine (ARBiH) napadli konvoj vojakov Jugoslovanske ljudske armade (JLA), ki so v skladu s sporazumom o umiku zapuščali mesto.
notes: JNA is given by its Slovenian abbreviation JLA.

source.title: 1992 Yugoslav People's Army column incident in Sarajevo
paragraphs: The 1992 Yugoslav People's Army column incident in Sarajevo occurred on 3 May 1992 in Dobrovoljačka Street, Sarajevo, when members of the Bosnian Army (ARBiH) attacked a convoy of the Yugoslav Army (JNA) troops that were exiting the city of Sarajevo according to the withdrawal agreement.

Ruska ustavna kriza leta 1993 je izbruhnila septembra in oktobra 1993 v Ruski federaciji zaradi spora med tedanjim ruskim predsednikom Borisom Jelcinom in parlamentom. Jelcin je izvedel samoudar, razpustil parlament in uvedel vladanje z dekreti. Kriza se je končala, ko je Jelcin z vojaško silo napadel moskovski Dom sovjetov in dal aretirati poslance. V Rusiji so dogodki znani kot »oktobrski puč« (rusko: Октябрьский путч) ali »črni oktober« (Чëрный октябрь).

source.title: 1993 Russian constitutional crisis
paragraphs: In September and October 1993, a constitutional crisis arose in the Russian Federation from a conflict between the then Russian president Boris Yeltsin and the country's parliament. Yeltsin performed a self-coup, dissolving parliament and instituting a presidential rule by decree system. The crisis ended with Yeltsin using military force to attack Moscow's House of Soviets and arrest the lawmakers. In Russia, the events are known as the "October Coup" (Russian: Октябрьский путч, romanized: Oktyabr'skiy putch) or "Black October" (Чëрный октябрь, Chornyi Oktyabr').

1994 Serb J-21 Jastreb shootdown.headline: Sestrelitev srbskih letal J-21 Jastreb leta 1994
paragraphs: Dva para lovcev F-16C Fighting Falcon družbe General Dynamics iz sil Organizacije Severnoatlantske pogodbe (Nato) sta 28. februarja 1994 v zračnem prostoru Bosne in Hercegovine sestrelila pet enosedežnih lahkih jurišnih letal J-21 Jastreb s piloti Republike Srbske (RS) ali Republike Srbske Krajine (RSK), potem ko so ta med bosansko vojno bombardirala tovarno orožja v Novem Travniku. Prestrezanje je bilo del Natove operacije Deny Flight, sestrelitev pa je bila prvo bojno dejanje v zgodovini zavezništva.

source.title: 1994 Serb J-21 Jastreb shootdown
paragraphs: On 28 February 1994, two pairs of North Atlantic Treaty Organisation (NATO) General Dynamics F-16C Fighting Falcon aircraft shot down five J-21 Jastreb single-seat light attack jets–piloted by Republika Srpska (RS) or Republic of Serbian Krajina (RSK) personnel–in Bosnia and Herzegovina airspace after they had bombed an armaments factory at Novi Travnik during the Bosnian War. The interception was part of NATO's Operation Deny Flight, with the shootdown constituting the first combat action in the alliance's history.

1998 Gali clashes.headline: Spopadi v Galiju leta 1998
paragraphs: Spopadi v Galiju leta 1998 so potekali v okraju Gali v Abhaziji, potem ko so etnični Gruzijci začeli upor proti abhaški separatistični vladi. Spopad včasih imenujejo šestdnevna vojna v Abhaziji, vendar to ime zajema le abhaško ofenzivo, ki je trajala od 20. do 26. maja 1998, sovražnosti in napadi upornikov pa so se zgodili že prej.

source.title: 1998 Gali clashes
paragraphs: The 1998 Gali clashes took place in the Gali district of Abkhazia, after ethnic Georgians launched an insurgency against the Abkhazian separatist government. The conflict is sometimes referred to as the Six-Day War of Abkhazia; however, this name only takes into account the Abkhazian offensive that lasted from 20 to 26 May 1998, while hostilities and insurgent attacks had already occurred before that date.

Invazija Dagestana ali vojna v Dagestanu leta 1999, znana tudi kot vpadi v Dagestan (rusko: Война в Дагестане), je bila oborožen spopad, ki se je začel, ko je islamistična skupina Mednarodna islamska mirovna brigada (IIPB) s sedežem v Ičkeriji, ki so jo vodili Šamil Basajev, Ibn al-Hatab, Ramzan Ahmadov in Arbi Barajev, 7. avgusta 1999 vdrla v sosednjo rusko republiko Dagestan. To je storila v podporo separatističnim upornikom Šure Dagestana.

Vojna se je končala z veliko zmago Ruske federacije in Republike Dagestan ter umikom IIPB. Vdor v Dagestan je bil skupaj z vrsto bombnih napadov na stanovanjske bloke septembra 1999 glavni povod (casus belli) za drugo čečensko vojno.

source.title: 1999 war in Dagestan
paragraphs: The 1999 war in Dagestan, also known as the Dagestan incursions (Russian: Война в Дагестане), was an armed conflict that began when the Ichkerian-based Islamic International Peacekeeping Brigade (IIPB), an Islamist group led by Shamil Basayev, Ibn al-Khattab, Ramzan Akhmadov and Arbi Barayev, invaded the neighboring Russian republic of Dagestan on 7 August 1999. They did so in support of the Shura of Dagestan separatist rebels.

The war ended with a major victory for the Russian Federation and the Republic of Dagestan, and the retreat of the IIPB. The invasion of Dagestan, alongside a series of apartment bombings in September 1999, served as the main casus belli for the Second Chechen War.

2001 insurgency in Macedonia.headline: Upor v Makedoniji leta 2001
paragraphs: Upor v Makedoniji leta 2001 je bil oborožen spopad v Republiki Makedoniji, ki se je začel, ko je etnično albanska uporniška skupina Narodnoosvobodilna vojska (NLA), ki so jo sestavljali veterani vojne na Kosovu in upora v Preševski dolini, konec januarja 2001 napadla makedonske varnostne sile. Končal se je z Ohridskim sporazumom, podpisanim 13. avgusta istega leta. Pojavljale so se tudi trditve, da je NLA na koncu želela odcepitev območij z albansko večino, kar so visoki člani skupine zanikali. Spopad je trajal večji del leta, vendar so bile žrtve po virih obeh strani omejene na nekaj deset ljudi na vsaki strani. Z njim so jugoslovanske vojne zajele tudi Makedonijo, ki se je leta 1991 mirno osamosvojila od Jugoslavije.

source.title: 2001 insurgency in Macedonia
paragraphs: An armed conflict began in the Republic of Macedonia in 2001 when the ethnic Albanian National Liberation Army (NLA) insurgent group, formed from veterans of the Kosovo War and insurgency in the Preševo Valley, attacked Macedonian security forces at the end of January 2001, and ended with the Ohrid Agreement, signed on 13 August of that same year. There were also claims that the NLA ultimately wished to see Albanian-majority areas secede from the country, though high-ranking members of the group have denied this. The conflict lasted throughout most of the year, although overall casualties remained limited to several dozen individuals on either side, according to sources from both sides of the conflict. With it, the Yugoslav Wars had reached Macedonia, which had achieved peaceful independence from Yugoslavia in 1991.

2013 Brussels Agreement.headline: Bruseljski sporazum (2013)
paragraphs: Prvi sporazum o načelih normalizacije odnosov, neuradno znan kot bruseljski sporazum (srbsko: Бриселски споразум / Briselski sporazum, albansko: Marrëveshja e Brukselit), je sporazum o normalizaciji odnosov med vladama Srbije in Kosova. Sporazum, izpogajan in sklenjen v Bruslju pod okriljem Evropske unije, je bil podpisan 19. aprila 2013. Pogajanja sta vodila srbski predsednik vlade Ivica Dačić in kosovski predsednik vlade Hashim Thaçi, posredovala pa je visoka predstavnica EU Catherine Ashton. Srbska vlada Kosova ne priznava kot suverene države, a je zaradi sporazuma začela normalizirati odnose s kosovsko vlado. V Beogradu so ga protestniki kritizirali kot potrditev kosovske neodvisnosti.

source.title: 2013 Brussels Agreement
paragraphs: The First Agreement of Principles Governing the Normalisation of Relations, informally known as the Brussels Agreement (Serbian: Бриселски споразум / Briselski sporazum, Albanian: Marrëveshja e Brukselit), is an agreement to normalize relations between the governments of Serbia and Kosovo. The agreement, negotiated and concluded in Brussels under the auspices of the European Union, was signed on 19 April 2013. Negotiations were led by Serbian prime minister Ivica Dačić and Kosovo prime minister Hashim Thaçi, mediated by EU High Representative Catherine Ashton. The government of Serbia does not recognise Kosovo as a sovereign state, but began normalising relations with the government of Kosovo as a result of the agreement. In Belgrade, the agreement was criticized by protestors as a convalidation of Kosovo independence.

Proruski protesti v Ukrajini leta 2014 so se začeli konec februarja 2014, po evromajdanu in revoluciji dostojanstva, ki sta pripeljala do odstavitve proruskega ukrajinskega predsednika Viktorja Janukoviča. Na Krimu ter v Donecku, Lugansku, Harkovu in Odesi so tedaj potekale demonstracije skupin, ki jih je podpirala Rusija, proruskih in protivladnih skupin (pa tudi demonstracije v podporo vladi). Nemiri, ki so jih podpirale ruska vojska in obveščevalne službe, sodijo v zgodnjo fazo rusko-ukrajinske vojne.

source.title: 2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine
paragraphs: From the end of February 2014, in the aftermath of the Euromaidan and the Revolution of Dignity, which resulted in the ousting of Russian-leaning Ukrainian president Viktor Yanukovych, demonstrations by Russian-backed, pro-Russian, and anti-government groups (as well as pro-government demonstrations) took place in Crimea, Donetsk, Luhansk, Kharkiv, and Odesa. The unrest, which was supported by the Russian military and intelligence services, belongs to the early stages of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

28 May 1926 coup d'état.headline: Državni udar 28. maja 1926
paragraphs: Državni udar 28. maja 1926, včasih imenovan revolucija 28. maja ali v času korporativističnega režima Estado Novo (»nova država«) narodna revolucija (portugalsko: Revolução Nacional), je bil vojaški udar nacionalističnega izvora, ki je končal nestabilno prvo portugalsko republiko in začel 48 let korporativistične in nacionalistične vladavine na Portugalskem. Režim, ki je neposredno nastal z udarom, Ditadura Nacional (narodna diktatura), se je pozneje preoblikoval v Estado Novo, ta pa je trajal do revolucije nageljnov leta 1974.

source.title: 28 May 1926 coup d'état
paragraphs: The 28 May 1926 coup d'état, sometimes called 28 May Revolution or, during the period of the corporatist Estado Novo (English: New State), the National Revolution (Portuguese: Revolução Nacional), was a military coup of a nationalist origin, that put an end to the unstable Portuguese First Republic and initiated 48 years of corporatist and nationalist rule within Portugal. The regime that immediately resulted from the coup, the Ditadura Nacional (National Dictatorship), would be later refashioned into the Estado Novo, which in turn lasted until the Carnation Revolution in 1974.

3 September 1843 Revolution.headline: Revolucija 3. septembra 1843
paragraphs: Revolucija 3. septembra 1843 (grško: Επανάσταση της 3ης Σεπτεμβρίου 1843; po novem koledarju 15. septembra) je bila vstaja helenske vojske v Atenah, ki so jo podprli široki sloji ljudstva, proti samodržni vladavini kralja Otona. Uporniki pod vodstvom veteranov grške osamosvojitvene vojne so zahtevali ustavo in odhod bavarskih uradnikov, ki so obvladovali vlado. Revolucija je uspela: začelo se je obdobje ustavne monarhije (po ustavi iz leta 1844) in splošne volilne pravice za moške v Grčiji.

source.title: 3 September 1843 Revolution
paragraphs: The 3 September 1843 Revolution (Greek: Επανάσταση της 3ης Σεπτεμβρίου 1843; N.S. 15 September) was an uprising by the Hellenic Army in Athens, supported by large sections of the people, against the autocratic rule of King Otto. The rebels, led by veterans of the Greek War of Independence, demanded the granting of a constitution and the departure of the Bavarian officials that dominated the government. The revolution succeeded, ushering in the period of constitutional monarchy (under the 1844 constitution) and universal manhood suffrage in Greece.

Aachen Treaty.headline: Aachenska pogodba
paragraphs: Aachenska pogodba, uradno Pogodba o francosko-nemškem sodelovanju in povezovanju (nemško: Aachener Vertrag, Vertrag von Aachen, francosko: Traité d'Aix-la-Chapelle), je dvostranski sporazum med Nemčijo in Francijo o medsebojnem sodelovanju na glavnih področjih, ki je začel veljati 22. januarja 2020, leto po podpisu. Podpisala sta ga zvezna kanclerka Angela Merkel in predsednik Emmanuel Macron 22. januarja 2019 v kronanjski dvorani aachenske mestne hiše.

source.title: Aachen Treaty
paragraphs: The Aachen Treaty, formally Treaty on Franco-German Cooperation and Integration, and also known as the Treaty of Aachen (German: Aachener Vertrag, Vertrag von Aachen, French: Traité d'Aix-la-Chapelle), is a bilateral agreement between Germany and France concerning mutual cooperation across major subjects, which entered into force on 22 January 2020, a year after it was signed. It was signed by Federal Chancellor Angela Merkel and President Emmanuel Macron in the coronation hall of the Aachen City Hall on 22 January 2019.

Abolition of Forced Labour Convention.headline: Konvencija o odpravi prisilnega dela
paragraphs: Konvencija o odpravi prisilnega dela iz leta 1957, s polnim naslovom Konvencija o odpravi prisilnega dela, 1957 (št. 105), je ena od osmih temeljnih konvencij Mednarodne organizacije dela (MOD), ki odpravlja nekatere oblike prisilnega dela, ki jih je Konvencija o prisilnem delu iz leta 1930 še dovoljevala, na primer kazen za stavke in kazen za določena politična prepričanja.
Za izvajanje Konvencije o prisilnem delu iz leta 1930 in Konvencije o odpravi prisilnega dela iz leta 1957 so ustanovili Posebni akcijski program za boj proti prisilnemu delu.

source.title: Abolition of Forced Labour Convention
paragraphs: Abolition of Forced Labour Convention, 1957, the full title of which is Convention concerning the Abolition of Forced Labour, 1957 (No. 105), is one of the eight ILO fundamental conventions of the International Labour Organization, which cancels certain forms of forced labour still allowed under the Forced Labour Convention of 1930, such as punishment for strikes and as a punishment for holding certain political views.
In order to implement the 1930 Forced Labour Convention and the 1957 Abolition of Forced Labour Convention, the Special Action Programme to Combat Forced Labour was set up.

Agreement on the Conservation of African.headline: Sporazum o ohranjanju afriško-evrazijskih selitvenih vodnih ptic
paragraphs: Sporazum o ohranjanju afriško-evrazijskih selitvenih vodnih ptic ali Afriško-evrazijski sporazum o vodnih pticah (AEWA) je samostojna mednarodna pogodba, pripravljena pod okriljem Konvencije o selitvenih vrstah Programa Združenih narodov za okolje.

source.title: Agreement on the Conservation of African-Eurasian Migratory Waterbirds
paragraphs: The Agreement on the Conservation of African-Eurasian Migratory Waterbirds, or African-Eurasian Waterbird Agreement (AEWA), is an independent international treaty developed under the auspices of the United Nations Environment Programme's Convention on Migratory Species.

Albanian principalities.headline: Albanske kneževine
paragraphs: Izraz albanske kneževine označuje več kneževin (čeprav so delovale bolj kot vrsta kraljestev), ki so v srednjem veku nastale v Albaniji in sosednjih pokrajinah zahodnega Balkana in jim je vladalo albansko plemstvo. Prva med njimi, Kneževina Arbanon, je nastala v 12. stoletju. Okrepile pa so se šele v drugi polovici 14. stoletja, zlasti po razpadu Srbskega cesarstva po letu 1355. Nekatere so se leta 1444 povezale v vojaško zavezništvo, imenovano Lješka liga, ki je do leta 1480 obstajalo in Osmansko cesarstvo premagalo v več kot 28 bitkah. Kneževine so obsegale današnjo Albanijo, zahodni in osrednji Kosovo, Epir, ozemlja vse do Korinta, zahodno Severno Makedonijo in južno Črno goro. Med njihovimi vladarji so bili nekateri najvidnejši balkanski veljaki 14. in 15. stoletja, na primer Gjin Bua Shpata, Andrea II. Muzaka, Gjon Zenebishi, Karl Topia, Andrea Gropa, rodbina Balša, Gjergj Arianiti, Gjon Kastrioti, Skenderbeg, rodbina Dukagjini in Lek Dukagjini.
notes: League of Lezhë: Lješka liga (after Lješ, the Slavic name of Lezhë); not in the glossary.

source.title: Albanian principalities
paragraphs: The term Albanian Principalities refers to a number of principalities (although they functioned more like a series of kingdoms) created in the Middle Ages in Albania and the surrounding regions in the western Balkans that were ruled by Albanian nobility. The 12th century marked the first Albanian principality, the Principality of Arbanon. It was later, however, in the 2nd half of the 14th century that these principalities became stronger, especially with the fall of the Serbian Empire after 1355. Some of these principalities were notably united in 1444 under the military alliance called League of Lezhë up to 1480 which defeated the Ottoman Empire in more than 28 battles. They covered modern day Albania, western and central Kosovo, Epirus, areas up to Corinth, western North Macedonia, southern Montenegro. The leaders of these principalities were some of the most noted Balkan figures in the 14th and 15th centuries such as Gjin Bua Shpata, Andrea II Muzaka, Gjon Zenebishi, Karl Topia, Andrea Gropa, Balsha family, Gjergj Arianiti, Gjon Kastrioti, Skanderbeg, Dukagjini family and Lek Dukagjini.

Albanski upor leta 1912 (albansko: Kryengritja e vitit 1912, »vstaja leta 1912«) je bil zadnji upor proti osmanski oblasti v Albaniji in je trajal od januarja do avgusta 1912. Končal se je, ko je osmanska vlada 4. septembra 1912 privolila v izpolnitev zahtev upornikov. Proti Osmanom, ki jih je tedaj vodil Odbor za edinstvo in napredek, so se večinoma borili muslimanski Albanci. Upor je podpirala Kraljevina Srbija, ki ga je želela izkoristiti za oslabitev Osmanskega cesarstva. Srbija je upornikom pomembno pomagala, tako vojaško kot finančno.
notes: The English dates the revolt January to August 1912 and its end 4 September 1912; kept as in the source.

source.title: Albanian revolt of 1912
paragraphs: The Albanian revolt of 1912 (Albanian: Kryengritja e vitit 1912, "Uprising of 1912") was the last revolt against the Ottoman Empire's rule in Albania and lasted from January until August 1912. The revolt ended when the Ottoman government agreed to fulfill the rebels' demands on 4 September 1912. Generally, Muslim Albanians fought against the Ottomans then governed by the Committee of Union and Progress. The Albanian revolt was supported by Kingdom of Serbia, which sought to exploit the revolt in order to weaken the Ottoman Empire. Serbia played an important role in aiding the rebels, both military and financially.

Albanian–Venetian War.headline: Albansko-beneška vojna
paragraphs: Albansko-beneška vojna v letih 1447–1448 (albansko: Lufta Shqiptaro-Veneciane) je bila vojna, v kateri so se beneške in osmanske sile bojevale proti Albancem pod vodstvom Gjergja Kastriotija Skenderbega. Vojna je bila posledica spora med Beneško republiko in rodbino Dukagjini o posesti trdnjave Dagnum. Skenderbeg, tedaj zaveznik Dukagjinijev, se je odpravil nad več beneških mest na albanski obali, da bi Benečane prisilil k vrnitvi Dagnuma. Republika je v odgovor poslala krajevne sile na pomoč oblegani trdnjavi Dagnum in Osmansko cesarstvo pozvala, naj v Albanijo pošlje odpravo. Osmani so tedaj že oblegali trdnjavo Svetigrad, kar je Skenderbegove sile še bolj razpršilo.

source.title: Albanian–Venetian War
paragraphs: The Albanian–Venetian War of 1447–48 (Albanian: Lufta Shqiptaro-Veneciane) was waged between Venetian and Ottoman forces against the Albanians under George Kastrioti Skanderbeg. The war was the result of a dispute between the Republic of Venice and the Dukagjini family over the possession of the Dagnum fortress. Skanderbeg, then ally of the Dukagjini family, moved against several Venetian held towns along the Albanian coastline, in order to pressure the Venetians into restoring Dagnum. In response, the Republic sent a local force to relieve the besieged fortress of Dagnum, and urged the Ottoman Empire to send an expeditionary force into Albania. At that time the Ottomans were already besieging the fortress of Svetigrad, stretching Skanderbeg's efforts thin.

Alvor Agreement.headline: Sporazum iz Alvorja
paragraphs: Sporazum iz Alvorja, podpisan 15. januarja 1975 v Alvorju na Portugalskem, je Angoli podelil neodvisnost od Portugalske, ki je začela veljati 11. novembra, in formalno končal 13 let trajajočo angolsko vojno za neodvisnost.

Sporazum so podpisali portugalska vlada, Ljudsko gibanje za osvoboditev Angole (MPLA), Narodna fronta za osvoboditev Angole (FNLA) in Narodna zveza za popolno neodvisnost Angole (UNITA), z njim pa je bila ustanovljena prehodna vlada iz predstavnikov teh štirih strani. Fronta za osvoboditev enklave Cabinda (FLEC) in Vzhodni upor ga nista podpisala, ker so ju druge strani izključile iz pogajanj. Prehodna vlada je kmalu razpadla, saj je vsaka od nacionalističnih frakcij, nezaupljiva do drugih in nepripravljena deliti oblast, skušala s silo prevzeti nadzor nad državo. Tako se je začela angolska državljanska vojna. Sporazum je dobil ime po vasi Alvor v južni portugalski pokrajini Algarve, kjer so ga podpisali.

source.title: Alvor Agreement
paragraphs: The Alvor Agreement, signed on 15 January 1975 in Alvor, Portugal, granted Angola independence from Portugal on 11 November and formally ended the 13-year-long Angolan War of Independence.

The agreement was signed by the Portuguese government, the People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA), the National Liberation Front of Angola (FNLA), National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA), and it established a transitional government composed of representatives of those four parties. It was not signed by the Front for the Liberation of the Enclave of Cabinda (FLEC) or the Eastern Revolt as the other parties excluded them from negotiations. The transitional government soon fell apart, with each of the nationalist factions, distrustful of the others and unwilling to share power, attempting to take control of the country by force. This initiated the Angolan Civil War. The name of the agreement comes from the village of Alvor, in the southern Portuguese region of Algarve, where it was signed.

Ambioriksov upor je bil upor plemena Eburonov, ki so se uprli, ko je del Cezarjeve vojske zasedel njihovo ozemlje. Vstaja je potekala pozimi 54–53 pr. n. št. in je del Cezarjevih galskih vojn. Pleme je za poveljevanje bojevnikom med vstajo imenovalo dva vojna voditelja, Ambioriksa in Katuvolka. Upor je pozneje dobil ime po Ambioriksu, ki je imel v njem vidnejšo vlogo.

Nezadovoljstvo med podjarmljenimi Galci je pozimi 54–53 pr. n. št. sprožilo veliko vstajo Belgov proti Juliju Cezarju, ko so se uprli Eburoni na severovzhodu Galije. Pri Atuatuki (današnjem Tongerenu v Belgiji) je bilo uničenih petnajst rimskih kohort, posadka pod poveljstvom Kvinta Tulija Cicerona pa je komaj preživela, ker jo je Cezar v zadnjem trenutku osvobodil. Preostanek leta 53 pr. n. št. je minil v kazenskem pohodu proti Eburonom in njihovim zaveznikom, ki naj bi jih Rimljani skoraj iztrebili.

source.title: Ambiorix's revolt
paragraphs: Ambiorix's revolt was a rebellion of the Eburones tribe, triggered by the occupation of their territory by a part of Caesar's army. The uprising took place in the winter of 54–53 BCE and is part of Caesar's Gallic Wars. The tribe had appointed two war-leaders to command their warriors during their insurrection: Ambiorix and Catuvolcus. The revolt was afterwards named after Ambiorix, who played a more prominent role in the rebellion.

Discontent among the subjugated Gauls prompted a major uprising amongst the Belgae against Julius Caesar in the winter of 54–53 BCE, when the Eburones of north-eastern Gaul rose in rebellion. Fifteen Roman cohorts were wiped out at Atuatuca (modern Tongeren in Belgium) and a garrison commanded by Quintus Tullius Cicero narrowly survived after being relieved by Caesar in the nick of time. The rest of 53 BCE was occupied with a punitive campaign against the Eburones and their allies, who were said to have been all but exterminated by the Romans.

Angevin.headline: Angevin
paragraphs: Izraz Angevin ali hiša Anžu se lahko nanaša na:
grofijo Anžu ali vojvodino Anžu, zgodovinsko grofijo in pozneje vojvodino v Franciji;
anžujščino, tradicionalni jezik langue d'oïl, ki so ga govorili v Anžuju.
notes: The record links to an English disambiguation page, so the summary is a list fragment; the data link is worth fixing (for example to the County of Anjou or the Angevin Empire).

source.title: Angevin
paragraphs: Angevin or House of Anjou may refer to:
County of Anjou or Duchy of Anjou, a historical county, and later Duchy, in France
Angevin (language), the traditional langue d'oïl spoken in Anjou

Angles.headline: Angli
paragraphs: Izraz Angles se najpogosteje nanaša na:
Angle (pleme), germansko govoreče ljudstvo, ki je ime dobilo po kulturni pokrajini Angeln v Nemčiji;
kot, geometrijski lik, ki ga tvorita poltraka s skupnim izhodiščem.
notes: The record links to an English disambiguation page, so the summary is a list fragment (one entry is the geometric angle); the data link should point to Angles (tribe).

source.title: Angles
paragraphs: Angles most commonly refers to:
Angles (tribe), a Germanic-speaking people that took their name from the Angeln cultural region in Germany
Angle, a geometric figure formed by two rays meeting at a common point

Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824.headline: Angleško-nizozemska pogodba iz leta 1824
paragraphs: Angleško-nizozemska pogodba iz leta 1824, znana tudi kot londonska pogodba (nizozemsko: Verdrag van Londen), je bila pogodba med Združenim kraljestvom in Nizozemsko, sklenjena 17. marca 1824 v Londonu. Razrešila naj bi spore, ki so nastali pri izvajanju angleško-nizozemske pogodbe iz leta 1814. Za Nizozemsko sta jo podpisala Hendrik Fagel in Anton Reinhard Falck, za Britanijo pa George Canning in Charles Williams-Wynn.

source.title: Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824
paragraphs: The Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824, also known as the Treaty of London (Dutch: Verdrag van Londen), was a treaty between the United Kingdom and the Netherlands in London on 17 March 1824. The treaty was to resolve disputes arising from the execution of the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814. For the Dutch, it was signed by Hendrik Fagel and Anton Reinhard Falck, and for the British, George Canning and Charles Williams-Wynn.

Anglo-Egyptian treaty of 1936.headline: Angleško-egiptovska pogodba iz leta 1936
paragraphs: Angleško-egiptovska pogodba iz leta 1936 (uradno Pogodba o zavezništvu med njegovim veličanstvom v imenu Združenega kraljestva in njegovim veličanstvom egiptovskim kraljem) je bila pogodba med Združenim kraljestvom in Kraljevino Egipt. Precej je zmanjšala britanski vpliv na egiptovsko notranjo politiko, a je Britanija ohranila velik vpliv na egiptovsko zunanjo politiko in obrambo, zlasti na Sueški prekop.

Po pogodbi je moralo Združeno kraljestvo iz Egipta umakniti vse svoje enote razen tistih, ki so bile potrebne za zaščito Sueškega prekopa in njegove okolice, to je 10.000 vojakov s pomožnim osebjem. Združeno kraljestvo je poleg tega moralo oskrbovati in uriti egiptovsko vojsko ter Egiptu v primeru vojne pomagati pri obrambi. Pogodba naj bi veljala 20 let; pogajanja so potekala v palači Zaafarana, podpisana je bila 26. avgusta 1936 v Londonu, ratificirana pa 22. decembra. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov je bila registrirana 6. januarja 1937.

source.title: Anglo-Egyptian treaty of 1936
paragraphs: The Anglo-Egyptian Treaty of 1936 (officially, The Treaty of Alliance Between His Majesty, in Respect of the United Kingdom, and His Majesty, the King of Egypt) was a treaty signed between the United Kingdom and the Kingdom of Egypt. The treaty significantly reduced Britain's influence in Egypt's domestic policy but Britain still had significant influence in Egypt's foreign policy and defence, especially the Suez Canal.

Under the terms of the treaty, the United Kingdom was required to withdraw all its troops from Egypt, except those necessary to protect the Suez Canal and its surroundings, numbering 10,000 troops plus auxiliary personnel. Additionally, the United Kingdom would supply and train Egypt's army and assist in its defence in case of war. The treaty was to last for 20 years; it was negotiated in the Zaafarana palace, signed in London on 26 August 1936 and ratified on 22 December. It was registered in the League of Nations Treaty Series on 6 January 1937.

Anglo-German Naval Agreement.headline: Angleško-nemški pomorski sporazum
paragraphs: Angleško-nemški pomorski sporazum (AGNA) z dne 18. junija 1935 je bil pomorski sporazum med Združenim kraljestvom in Nemčijo, ki je določal velikost Kriegsmarine v razmerju do Kraljeve vojne mornarice.

Sporazum je trajno določil razmerje, po katerem naj bi skupna tonaža Kriegsmarine znašala 35 % skupne tonaže Kraljeve vojne mornarice. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov je bil registriran 12. julija 1935. Adolf Hitler ga je razveljavil 28. aprila 1939.

source.title: Anglo-German Naval Agreement
paragraphs: The Anglo-German Naval Agreement (AGNA) of 18 June 1935 was a naval agreement between the United Kingdom and Germany that regulated the size of the Kriegsmarine in relation to the Royal Navy.

The Anglo-German Naval Agreement fixed a ratio whereby the total tonnage of the Kriegsmarine was to be 35% of the total tonnage of the Royal Navy on a permanent basis. It was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 12 July 1935. The agreement was abrogated by Adolf Hitler on 28 April 1939.

Anglo-irski sporazum je bil pogodba med Združenim kraljestvom in Republiko Irsko iz leta 1985, ki naj bi pomagala končati nemire (The Troubles) na Severnem Irskem. Pogodba je irski vladi dala svetovalno vlogo pri upravljanju Severne Irske, hkrati pa je potrdila, da se ustavni položaj Severne Irske ne bo spremenil, razen če bi se večina njenih prebivalcev strinjala s pridružitvijo republiki. Določila je tudi pogoje za ustanovitev decentralizirane vlade soglasja v regiji.
Sporazum sta 15. novembra 1985 na gradu Hillsborough podpisala britanska predsednica vlade Margaret Thatcher in irski taoiseach (predsednik vlade) Garret FitzGerald.

source.title: Anglo-Irish Agreement
paragraphs: The Anglo-Irish Agreement was a 1985 treaty between the United Kingdom and the Republic of Ireland which aimed to help bring an end to the Troubles in Northern Ireland. The treaty gave the Irish government an advisory role in Northern Ireland's government while confirming that there would be no change in the constitutional position of Northern Ireland unless a majority of its citizens agreed to join the Republic. It also set out conditions for the establishment of a devolved consensus government in the region.
The Agreement was signed on 15 November 1985, at Hillsborough Castle, by British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher and Irish Taoiseach (prime minister) Garret FitzGerald.

Anglo-irska pogodba iz leta 1921 (irsko: An Conradh Angla-Éireannach), na Irskem splošno znana kot Pogodba, uradno pa Členi sporazuma o pogodbi med Veliko Britanijo in Irsko, je bila sporazum med vlado Združenega kraljestva Velike Britanije in Irske ter vlado Irske republike, s katerim se je končala irska osamosvojitvena vojna. Predvidela je, da bo v enem letu ustanovljena Irska svobodna država kot samoupraven dominion v »skupnosti narodov, znani kot Britanski imperij«, s statusom, »enakim statusu dominiona Kanada«. Severni Irski, ki je nastala z zakonom o vladi Irske iz leta 1920, je dala tudi možnost izstopa iz Irske svobodne države (12. člen), ki jo je parlament Severne Irske izkoristil.

source.title: Anglo-Irish Treaty
paragraphs: The 1921 Anglo-Irish Treaty (Irish: An Conradh Angla-Éireannach), commonly known in Ireland as The Treaty and officially the Articles of Agreement for a Treaty Between Great Britain and Ireland, was an agreement between the government of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland and the government of the Irish Republic that concluded the Irish War of Independence. It provided for the establishment of the Irish Free State within a year as a self-governing dominion within the "community of nations known as the British Empire", a status "the same as that of the Dominion of Canada". It also provided Northern Ireland, which had been created by the Government of Ireland Act 1920, an option to opt out of the Irish Free State (Article 12), which was exercised by the Parliament of Northern Ireland.

Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland.headline: Anglonormanska invazija na Irsko
paragraphs: Anglonormanska invazija na Irsko je potekala konec 12. stoletja, ko so Anglonormani postopoma osvojili in pridobili obsežna ozemlja na Irskem, nad katerimi so nato suverenost zahtevali angleški kralji. Anglonormani so trdili, da je invazijo odobrila papeška bula Laudabiliter. V času invazije je bila gelska Irska razdeljena na več kraljestev, pri čemer je veliki kralj zahteval nadoblast nad večino drugih kraljev. Anglonormanska invazija je bila prelomnica v irski zgodovini, saj se je z njo začelo več kot 800 let britanske navzočnosti na Irskem.

Maja 1169 so se na Irskem izkrcali anglonormanski najemniki na prošnjo Diarmaita mac Murchade (Dermota MacMurragha), odstavljenega kralja Leinstra, ki je z njihovo pomočjo želel znova dobiti kraljevsko oblast. To jim je uspelo v nekaj tednih, nato pa so plenili po sosednjih kraljestvih. Vojaško posredovanje je odobril angleški kralj Henrik II. Diarmait je Henriku v zameno prisegel zvestobo in Normanom obljubil zemljo.

source.title: Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland
paragraphs: The Anglo-Norman invasion of Ireland took place during the late 12th century, when Anglo-Normans gradually conquered and acquired large swathes of land in Ireland over which the kings of England then claimed sovereignty. The Anglo-Normans claimed the invasion was sanctioned by the papal bull Laudabiliter. At the time of the invasion, Gaelic Ireland consisted of several kingdoms, with a High King claiming lordship over most of the other kings. The Anglo-Norman invasion was a watershed in Ireland's history, marking the beginning of over 800 years of British presence in Ireland.

In May 1169, Anglo-Norman mercenaries landed in Ireland at the request of Diarmait mac Murchada (Dermot MacMurragh), the deposed King of Leinster, who sought their help in regaining his kingship. They achieved this within weeks and raided neighbouring kingdoms. This military intervention was sanctioned by King Henry II of England. In return, Diarmait had sworn loyalty to Henry and promised land to the Normans.

Anglo-Polish alliance.headline: Angleško-poljsko zavezništvo
paragraphs: Vojaško zavezništvo med Združenim kraljestvom in Poljsko sta državi formalizirali z angleško-poljskim sporazumom 31. marca 1939, s poznejšima dodatkoma iz let 1940 in 1944, za medsebojno pomoč v primeru vojaškega napada nacistične Nemčije, kot je določal tajni protokol.

source.title: Anglo-Polish alliance
paragraphs: The military alliance between the United Kingdom and Poland was formalised by the Anglo-Polish Agreement on 31 March 1939, with subsequent addenda of 1940 and 1944, for mutual assistance in case of a military invasion from Nazi Germany, as specified in a secret protocol.

Anglo-Russian Convention.headline: Angleško-ruska konvencija
paragraphs: Angleško-ruska konvencija iz leta 1907 je bila pogodba, ki sta jo Združeno kraljestvo in Ruski imperij podpisala 31. avgusta 1907 v Sankt Peterburgu. Z njo se je končala »velika igra« v Srednji Aziji, kjer sta dolgo tekmovala evropska kolonialna imperija. Pogodba je tudi okrepila angleško-ruski interes, da bi obšli Nemško cesarstvo, ki je grozilo z gradnjo železnice od Berlina do Bagdada in s povezovanjem z oslabljenim Osmanskim cesarstvom.

Konvencija je končala dolg spor obeh strani glede Perzije. Združeno kraljestvo je obljubilo, da se ne bo vmešavalo v severno Perzijo, Rusija pa je priznala južno Perzijo za del britanskega vplivnega območja. Rusija je obljubila tudi, da se ne bo vmešavala v Tibet in Afganistan. London ji je v zameno dal posojila in nekaj politične podpore. Konvencija je majave britansko-ruske odnose postavila v ospredje, saj je utrdila meje, ki so določale nadzor obeh strani v Perziji, Afganistanu in Tibetu. Sporazum je sčasoma postal sestavni del trojne antante.

source.title: Anglo-Russian Convention
paragraphs: The Anglo-Russian Convention of 1907 was a treaty signed between United Kingdom and the Russian Empire on 31 August 1907 in Saint Petersburg. It marked the end of the "Great Game" in Central Asia, where a longstanding rivalry had ensued between the two European colonial empires. The treaty also furthered the Anglo-Russian interest to outflank the German Empire, which was threatening to establish a railroad from Berlin to Baghdad and align with the weakened Ottoman Empire.

The Convention ended the long dispute over Persia between the two parties. The United Kingdom promised to stay out of northern Persia, and Russia recognized southern Persia as part of the British sphere of influence. Russia also promised to stay out of Tibet and Afghanistan. In exchange, London extended loans and some political support. The convention brought shaky British–Russian relations to the forefront by solidifying boundaries that identified respective control in Persia, Afghanistan, and Tibet. This agreement would eventually form a component of the Triple Entente.

Angleško-španska vojna v letih 1654–1660 je potekala med Angleško republiko in Habsburško Španijo. Gnalo jo je gospodarsko in versko tekmovanje med državama, pri čemer je vsaka stran na različne načine, denimo s kaperstvom in pomorskimi odpravami, napadala trgovske in kolonialne interese druge.

Leta 1655 je angleška amfibijska odprava vdrla na špansko ozemlje na Karibih in nazadnje zavzela otok Jamajko. Leta 1657 je Anglija sklenila zavezništvo s Francijo, s čimer se je angleško-španska vojna združila s širšo francosko-špansko vojno; glavni kopenski spopadi so potekali v Španski Nizozemski.

Vojna se je sicer končala po restavraciji angleškega kralja Karla II. leta 1660, toda napetosti na Karibih zaradi angleške posesti Jamajke so spopad s presledki ohranjale še več kot deset let. Med drugim je znani kaper Henry Morgan napadal špansko ozemlje. Vojna se je uradno končala z mirovnima pogodbama, podpisanima v Madridu v letih 1667 in 1670.

source.title: Anglo-Spanish War (1654–1660)
paragraphs: The Anglo-Spanish War of 1654–1660 was fought between the Commonwealth of England and Habsburg Spain. It was driven by the economic and religious rivalry between the two countries, with each side attacking the other's commercial and colonial interests in various ways, such as privateering and naval expeditions.

In 1655, an English amphibious expedition invaded Spanish territory in the Caribbean, eventually capturing the island of Jamaica. In 1657, England formed an alliance with France, merging the Anglo-Spanish war with the larger Franco-Spanish War, with major land actions that took place in the Spanish Netherlands.

Although the war was terminated after the Restoration of King Charles II of England in 1660, tensions in the Caribbean with regard to the English possession of Jamaica kept the conflict going intermittently for over ten years. This included raids on Spanish territory by notable Privateer Henry Morgan. The war officially ended with two peace treaties, which were signed at Madrid in 1667 and 1670.

Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty.headline: Pogodba o protibalističnih raketah
paragraphs: Pogodba o protibalističnih raketah (angleška kratica ABM ali ABMT) je bila pogodba o nadzoru oborožitve iz leta 1972 med Združenimi državami in Sovjetsko zvezo o omejitvi protibalističnih raketnih sistemov (ABM), s katerimi se branijo območja pred strateškimi balističnimi raketami za prenos jedrskega orožja. Njen namen je bil zmanjšati pritisk na gradnjo novega jedrskega orožja za ohranjanje odvračanja. Podpisana leta 1972 je veljala naslednjih 30 let. Združene države so se pod administracijo Georgea W. Busha junija 2002 enostransko umaknile iz pogodbe z utemeljitvijo, da jim domnevno grozi jedrsko izsiljevanje odpadniških držav, in pogodba je prenehala veljati. Za obrambo pred medcelinskimi balističnimi raketami ZDA odtlej uporabljajo kopenski sistem Ground-Based Midcourse Defense na Aljaski in v Kaliforniji ter pomorski sistem Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense. Rusija vzdržuje protiraketni sistem A-135 okoli Moskve in je razvila raketni sistem S-500.

source.title: Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty
paragraphs: The Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty, also known as the ABM Treaty or ABMT, was a 1972 arms control treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union on the limitation of the anti-ballistic missile (ABM) systems used in defending areas against strategic ballistic missiles, which are used to deliver nuclear weapons It was intended to reduce pressures to build more nuclear weapons to maintain deterrence. Signed in 1972, it was in force for the next 30 years. Citing purported risks of nuclear blackmail from a rogue state, the United States under the George W. Bush administration unilaterally withdrew from the treaty in June 2002, leading to its termination. In ICBM defense, the US has subsequently operated the Ground-Based Midcourse Defense ABM system based in Alaska and California, as well as the sea-based Aegis Ballistic Missile Defense System. Russia maintains the A-135 ABM system around Moscow, and has developed the S-500 missile system.

Antikominternski pakt, uradno Sporazum proti Komunistični internacionali, je bil protikomunistični pakt, ki sta ga 25. novembra 1936 sklenili nacistična Nemčija in Japonsko cesarstvo in je bil usmerjen proti Komunistični internacionali (Kominterni). Podpisala sta ga nemški veleposlanik s posebnimi pooblastili Joachim von Ribbentrop in japonski veleposlanik v Nemčiji Kintomo Mušanokodži. Italija se je pridružila leta 1937 (pred tem je podpisala italijansko-sovjetski pakt, delno usmerjen proti Hitlerju), a je bila po pogojih pristopa pravno priznana kot prvotna podpisnica. Španija in Madžarska sta se pridružili leta 1939. Druge države so pristopile med drugo svetovno vojno.

Japonski podpisniki so upali, da bo antikominternski pakt dejansko zavezništvo proti Sovjetski zvezi, in tako so ga razumeli tudi Sovjeti. Obstajal je tudi tajni dodatni protokol, ki je določal skupno nemško-japonsko politiko, usmerjeno posebej proti Sovjetski zvezi.

source.title: Anti-Comintern Pact
paragraphs: The Anti-Comintern Pact, officially the Agreement against the Communist International, was an anti-communist pact concluded between Nazi Germany and the Empire of Japan on 25 November 1936 and directed against the Communist International (Comintern). It was signed by the German ambassador-at-large Joachim von Ribbentrop and the Japanese ambassador to Germany Kintomo Mushanokōji. Italy joined in 1937 (earlier it had signed the Italo-Soviet Pact, directed partly against Hitler), but it was legally recognized as an original signatory by the terms of its entry. Spain and Hungary joined in 1939. Other countries joined during World War II.

The Japanese signatories had hoped that the Anti-Comintern Pact would effectively be an alliance against the Soviet Union, which was how the Soviets perceived it. There was also a secret additional protocol which specified a joint German-Japanese policy specifically aimed against the Soviet Union.

April Uprising of 1876.headline: Aprilska vstaja
paragraphs: Aprilska vstaja (bolgarsko: Априлско въстание) je bila vstaja, ki so jo Bolgari v Osmanskem cesarstvu organizirali aprila in maja 1876. Zatrle so jo neregularne osmanske enote bašibozukov, ki so brez razlikovanja pobijale upornike in civiliste (gl. pokol v Bataku).

Ameriška skupnost okoli Robert Collegea v Carigradu, protestantski misijon v Plovdivu pod vodstvom J. F. Clarka ter še dva Američana, novinar Januarius MacGahan in diplomat Eugene Schuyler, so imeli nepogrešljivo vlogo pri tem, da je za osmanska grozodejstva izvedela širša evropska javnost.

Njihova poročila o dogodkih, ki jih je tisk poimenoval bolgarske grozote in zločin stoletja, so po vsej Evropi sprožila val ogorčenja ter tako preproste ljudi kot slavne izobražence spodbudila, da so zahtevali reformo neuspešnega osmanskega načina upravljanja bolgarskih dežel.

source.title: April Uprising of 1876
paragraphs: The April Uprising (Bulgarian: Априлско въстание, romanized: Aprilsko vastanie) was an insurrection organised by the Bulgarians in the Ottoman Empire from April to May 1876. The rebellion was suppressed by irregular Ottoman bashi-bazouk units that engaged in indiscriminate slaughter of both rebels and non-combatants (see Batak massacre).

The American community around Robert College in Istanbul, the Protestant mission in Plovdiv headed by J.F. Clarke as well as two other Americans, journalist Januarius MacGahan and diplomat Eugene Schuyler, were indispensable in bringing knowledge of Ottoman atrocities to the wider European public.

Their reports of the events, which came to be known in the press as the Bulgarian Horrors and the Crime of the Century, caused a public outcry across Europe and mobilised both common folks and famous intellectuals to demand a reform of the failed Ottoman model of governance of the Bulgarian lands.

Arab raid against Rome.headline: Arabski napad na Rim
paragraphs: Leta 846 so arabski napadalci oplenili okolico mesta Rim in izropali staro baziliko svetega Petra ter baziliko svetega Pavla zunaj obzidja, vanj pa jih ni spustilo Avrelijanovo obzidje.

source.title: Arab raid against Rome
paragraphs: In 846, Arab raiders plundered the outskirts of the city of Rome, sacking the basilicas of Old St Peter's and St Paul's-Outside-the-Walls, but were prevented from entering the city itself by the Aurelian Walls.

Aragon Offensive.headline: Aragonska ofenziva
paragraphs: Aragonska ofenziva je bila pomemben vojaški pohod v španski državljanski vojni, ki se je začel po bitki pri Teruelu. Ofenziva, ki je trajala od 7. marca do 19. aprila 1938, je strla republikanske sile, preplavila Aragonijo ter osvojila dele Katalonije in Levanta.

source.title: Aragon Offensive
paragraphs: The Aragon Offensive was an important military campaign during the Spanish Civil War, which began after the Battle of Teruel. The offensive, which ran from March 7, 1938, to April 19, 1938, smashed the Republican forces, overran Aragon, and conquered parts of Catalonia and the Levante.

Armagnaško-burgundska državljanska vojna je bila spopad med dvema stranskima vejama francoske kraljeve rodbine, rodbino Orléans (armagnaška stranka) in rodbino Burgundija (burgundska stranka), od leta 1407 do 1435. Začela se je med zatišjem stoletne vojne proti Angležem in se prekrivala z zahodnim cerkvenim razkolom.

source.title: Armagnac–Burgundian Civil War
paragraphs: The Armagnac–Burgundian Civil War was a conflict between two cadet branches of the French royal family: the House of Orléans (Armagnac faction) and the House of Burgundy (Burgundian faction) from 1407 to 1435. It began during a lull in the Hundred Years' War against the English and overlapped with the Western Schism of the papacy.

Armistice of Belgrade.headline: Beograjsko premirje
paragraphs: Beograjsko premirje je bilo sporazum o koncu sovražnosti prve svetovne vojne med zavezniškimi in pridruženimi silami ter Kraljevino Madžarsko, sklenjen v Beogradu 13. novembra 1918. Večinoma sta ga 7. novembra izpogajala general Louis Franchet d'Espèrey kot poveljnik zavezniške Vzhodne armade in madžarski predsednik vlade Mihály Károlyi. Podpisali so ga general Paul Prosper Henrys in vojvoda Živojin Mišić kot predstavnika zaveznikov ter nekdanji madžarski vojni minister Béla Linder.

source.title: Armistice of Belgrade
paragraphs: The armistice of Belgrade was an agreement on the termination of World War I hostilities between the Allied and Associated Powers and the Kingdom of Hungary concluded in Belgrade on 13 November 1918. It was largely negotiated by General Louis Franchet d'Espèrey, as the commanding officer of the Allied Army of the Orient, and Hungarian Prime Minister Mihály Károlyi, on 7 November. It was signed by General Paul Prosper Henrys and vojvoda Živojin Mišić, as representatives of the Allies, and by the former Hungarian Minister of War, Béla Linder.

Armistice of Mudros.headline: Premirje v Mudrosu
paragraphs: Premirje v Mudrosu (osmansko turško: موندروس متارکه‌نامه‌سی; turško: Mondros Mütarekesi) je končalo sovražnosti na bližnjevzhodnem bojišču med Osmanskim cesarstvom in zavezniki v prvi svetovni vojni. Podpisala sta ga 30. oktobra 1918 osmanski minister za mornarico Rauf Orbay in britanski admiral Somerset Arthur Gough-Calthorpe, vrhovni poveljnik britanske sredozemske flote, na krovu ladje HMS Agamemnon (1906) v pristanišču Mudros na grškem otoku Lemnos. Veljati je začelo naslednji dan opoldne. Miza, na kateri so ga podpisali, je zdaj na krovu ladje HMS Belfast ob London Bridgeu, vendar javnosti ni dostopna.

source.title: Armistice of Mudros
paragraphs: The Armistice of Mudros (Ottoman Turkish: موندروس متارکه‌نامه‌سی; Turkish: Mondros Mütarekesi) ended hostilities in the Middle Eastern theatre between Ottoman Empire and the Allies of World War I. It was signed on 30 October 1918 by the Ottoman Minister of Marine Affairs Rauf Orbay and British Admiral Somerset Arthur Gough-Calthorpe, Commander-in-Chief of the British Mediterranean Fleet, on board HMS Agamemnon (1906) in Moudros harbor on the Greek island of Lemnos. It took effect at noon the next day. The table it was signed on is now on board HMS Belfast in London Bridge, though it is not accessible to the public.

Armistice of Villa Giusti.headline: Premirje v vili Giusti
paragraphs: Premirje v vili Giusti ali padovansko premirje, premirna konvencija z Avstro-Ogrsko, je dejansko končalo bojevanje med zavezniki in pridruženimi silami ter Avstro-Ogrsko v prvi svetovni vojni. Italija je zastopala zaveznike in pridružene sile. Protokol o premirju in dopolnilni protokol so podpisali 3. novembra 1918 v vili Giusti pri Padovi v Venetu v severni Italiji, premirje pa je začelo veljati 24 ur pozneje. Veljalo je le za Avstrijo, ker je Madžarska pozneje podpisala ločeno beograjsko premirje.

source.title: Armistice of Villa Giusti
paragraphs: The Armistice of Villa Giusti or Padua Armistice was an armistice convention with Austria-Hungary which de facto ended warfare between Allies and Associated Powers and Austria-Hungary during World War I. Italy represented the Allies and Associated Powers. The armistice protocol, together with a supplementary protocol, was signed on 3 November 1918 in the Villa Giusti, outside Padua in the Veneto, Northern Italy, and took effect 24 hours later. This armistice applied only to Austria because Hungary later signed the separate Belgrade armistice.
Premirje v Villafranci, ki sta ga 11. julija 1859 sklenila francoski cesar Napoleon III. in avstrijski cesar Franc Jožef I., je pripravilo pot h koncu druge italijanske vojne za neodvisnost.

Bilo je posledica enostranske odločitve Francije, ki se je skupaj s Kraljevino Sardinijo bojevala proti Avstriji in je morala skleniti mir zaradi nevarnosti, da bi se spopad razširil v srednjo Evropo.

Premirje v Villafranci je povzročilo odstop piemontskega predsednika vlade Cavourja, ki je v njem videl kršitev sardinsko-francoske zavezniške pogodbe. Ta je predvidevala odstop celotne Lombardsko-beneške kraljevine Piemontu, za razliko od pogojev premirja, ki so določali odstop same Lombardije (v sedanjem obsegu, razen province Mantova).

source.title: Armistice of Villafranca
paragraphs: The Armistice of Villafranca, concluded by Napoleon III of France and Franz Joseph I of Austria on July 11, 1859, set the stage for the end of the Second Italian War of Independence.

It was the consequence of a unilateral decision by France, which, at war alongside the Kingdom of Sardinia against Austria, needed to conclude peace because of the danger of the conflict spreading to Central Europe.

The armistice of Villafranca caused the resignation of Piedmontese Prime Minister Cavour, who considered it a violation of the Sardinian-French treaty of alliance. The latter provided for the cession of the entire Kingdom of Lombardy-Venetia to Piedmont, unlike the terms of the armistice, which stipulated the cession of Lombardy alone (in its current extent except the Province of Mantua).

Od ruske invazije na Ukrajino 24. februarja 2022 je bilo v celinski Rusiji zaradi rusko-ukrajinske vojne več napadov. Glavni cilji so bili vojska, orožarska industrija in naftna industrija. Mnogi napadi so bili napadi z droni, požigi in sabotaže na železnici. Ukrajinske obveščevalne službe so priznale, da so izvedle nekatere od teh napadov, druge so izvedli protivojni aktivisti v Rusiji. Prišlo je tudi do čezmejnega obstreljevanja, raketnih napadov in prikritih vpadov iz Ukrajine, predvsem v Belgorodski, Kurski in Brjanski oblasti. Paravojaške enote s sedežem v Ukrajini so večkrat vdrle v Rusijo, zavzele obmejne vasi in se bojevale z rusko vojsko. Te enote so večinoma sestavljali ruski emigranti. Ukrajina je kopenske vpade podpirala, neposredno vpletenost pa je zanikala.
notes: The glossary headline (Napad v zahodni Rusiji v letih 2022–2023) is narrower than the English article, which covers attacks in Russia from 2022 on.

source.title: Attacks in Russia during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)
paragraphs: There have been attacks in mainland Russia as a result of the Russo-Ukrainian war since its invasion of Ukraine on 24 February 2022. The main targets have been the military, the arms industry and the oil industry. Many of the attacks have been drone strikes, firebombing, and rail sabotage. The Ukrainian intelligence services have acknowledged carrying out some of these attacks. Others have been carried out by anti-war activists in Russia. There have also been cross-border shelling, missile strikes, and covert raids from Ukraine, mainly in Belgorod, Kursk, and Bryansk oblasts. Several times, Ukrainian-based paramilitaries launched incursions into Russia, captured border villages and battled the Russian military. These were carried out by units made up mainly of Russian emigrants. While Ukraine supported these ground incursions, it denied direct involvement.

Pohod za vzpostavitev avstro-ogrske oblasti v Bosni in Hercegovini je trajal od 29. julija do 20. oktobra 1878. Naperjen je bil proti krajevnim upornikom, muslimanom in pravoslavnim Srbom, ki so jih neuradno podpirale čete Osmanskega cesarstva. Avstro-ogrska vojska je v pokrajino vkorakala v dveh velikih smereh: ena s severa v Bosno, druga z juga v Hercegovino. Vrsta avgustovskih bitk se je končala s padcem Sarajeva 19. avgusta, po dnevu uličnih bojev. Na hribovitem podeželju se je gverilsko bojevanje nadaljevalo, dokler po zajetju voditelja upornikov ni padlo njihovo zadnje oporišče.

source.title: Austro-Hungarian campaign in Bosnia and Herzegovina in 1878
paragraphs: The campaign to establish Austro-Hungarian rule in Bosnia and Herzegovina lasted from 29 July to 20 October 1878 against the local resistance fighters, Muslims and Orthodox Serbs, supported unofficially by troops of the Ottoman Empire. The Austro-Hungarian Army entered the province in two large movements: one from the north into Bosnia, and another from the south into Herzegovina. A series of battles in August culminated in the fall of Sarajevo on the 19 August after a day of street-to-street fighting. In the hilly countryside a guerrilla campaign continued until the last rebel stronghold fell after their leader was captured.

Avstrijsko-poljska ali poljsko-avstrijska vojna je bila del vojne pete koalicije leta 1809 (koalicije Avstrijskega cesarstva in Združenega kraljestva proti Napoleonovemu Francoskemu cesarstvu in njegovim zaveznicam). V tej vojni so se poljske sile Varšavskega vojvodstva, Napoleonovega zaveznika, ob pomoči sil Kraljevine Saške bojevale proti Avstrijskemu cesarstvu. Junija se je proti Avstriji pridružilo Rusko cesarstvo. Poljske čete so zdržale avstrijski napad na Varšavo in Avstrijce premagale pri Raszynu, nato pa zapustile Varšavo, da bi znova osvojile dele Poljske pred delitvijo, med njimi Krakov in Lvov, s čimer so prisilile Avstrijce, da so v jalovem zasledovanju zapustili Varšavo.
notes: The glossary had a typo (Poljsko-avatrijska vojna); an override now gives Poljsko-avstrijska vojna.

source.title: Austro-Polish War
paragraphs: The Austro-Polish War or Polish-Austrian War was a part of the War of the Fifth Coalition in 1809 (a coalition of the Austrian Empire and the United Kingdom against Napoleon's French Empire and allied states). In this war, Polish forces of the Napoleon-allied Duchy of Warsaw and assisted by forces of the Kingdom of Saxony, fought against the Austrian Empire. In June, the Russian Empire joined against Austria. Polish troops withstood the Austrian attack on Warsaw defeating them at Raszyn, then abandoned Warsaw in order to reconquer parts of pre-partition Poland including Kraków and Lwów, forcing the Austrians to abandon Warsaw in futile pursuit.

Šesta avstrijsko-turška vojna, znana tudi kot avstrijsko-turška vojna 1663–1664, je bila kratka vojna med habsburško monarhijo in Osmanskim cesarstvom. Osmani so hoteli nadaljevati prodor v srednjo Evropo, osvojiti Dunaj in podjarmiti Avstrijo. Osmanom je uspelo zavzeti ključne utrdbe, habsburška vojska pod vodstvom Raimonda Montecuccolija pa je osmansko vojsko ustavila v bitki pri Monoštru (Szentgotthárd).

source.title: Austro-Turkish War (1663–1664)
paragraphs: The Sixth Austro-Turkish War, also known as the Austro-Turkish War of 1663–1664, was a short war between the Habsburg monarchy and the Ottoman Empire. The Ottoman aim was to resume the advance in central Europe, conquer Vienna and subdue Austria. The Ottomans managed to capture key strongholds, however, the Habsburg army under Raimondo Montecuccoli succeeded in halting the Ottoman army in the Battle of Saint Gotthard.
Auvergne (okcitansko: Auvèrnhe ali Auvèrnha) je kulturna pokrajina v osrednji Franciji. Danes je večinoma del upravne regije Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes.
Auvergne navadno velja za ozemlje zgodovinske province Auvergne, ki je bila razpuščena leta 1790, in nekdanje upravne regije Auvergne, ki je obstajala od leta 1956 do 2015.

V pokrajini je veriga ognjenikov, skupaj znanih kot »chaîne des Puys«. Ognjeniki so začeli nastajati pred približno 70.000 leti, večina je erodirala, ostali pa so čepi strjene magme, ki tvorijo zaobljene vrhove, imenovane puys. Zadnji potrjeni izbruh je bil okoli leta 4040 pr. n. št.
notes: The French pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Auvergne
paragraphs: Auvergne (French: [ovɛʁɲ]; Occitan: Auvèrnhe or Auvèrnha) is a cultural region in central France. It is now largely part of the Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes administrative region.

Auvergne is generally regarded as conterminous with the land area of the historical Province of Auvergne, which was dissolved in 1790, and with the now-defunct administrative region of Auvergne, which existed from 1956 to 2015.

The region is home to a chain of volcanoes known collectively as the "chaîne des Puys". The volcanoes began forming about 70,000 years ago, and most have eroded, leaving plugs of hardened magma that form rounded hilltops known as puys. The last confirmed eruption occurred around 4040 BCE.

Azov campaigns (1695–1696).headline: Azovska pohoda (1695–1696)
paragraphs: Azovska pohoda v letih 1695–1696 (rusko: Азо́вские похо́ды) sta bila ruska vojaška pohoda med rusko-turško vojno 1686–1700, ki ju je vodil Peter Veliki; njun cilj je bil zavzeti turško trdnjavo Azov (s posadko 7000 mož) in tako nadzorovati južno ustje Dona ter pridobiti dostop do Azovskega morja in vhod v Črno morje. Rusi pod vodstvom generala Šeremetjeva so po neuspelem obleganju leta 1695 kljub trdovratnemu odporu in hudim izgubam ob podpori pomorskih sil julija 1696 trdnjavo zavzeli; to je bila prva velika ruska zmaga nad Turki.

source.title: Azov campaigns (1695–1696)
paragraphs: The Azov campaigns of 1695–1696 (Russian: Азо́вские похо́ды, romanized: Azovskiye Pokhody) were two Russian military campaigns during the Russo-Turkish War of 1686–1700, led by Peter the Great and aimed at capturing the Turkish fortress of Azov (garrison – 7,000 men) with the aim of controlling the southern mouth of the Don River gaining access to the Sea of Azov and entrance to the Black Sea. Despite stubborn resistance and heavy casualties, the Russians under General Sheremetev after a failed siege in 1695 managed to capture the fort, accompanied by a naval force, in July 1696, marking the first major Russian victory against the Turks.

Balkanska kampanja druge svetovne vojne se je začela z italijansko invazijo na Grčijo 28. oktobra 1940. V prvih mesecih leta 1941 je italijanska ofenziva zastala, grška protiofenziva pa je prodrla v Albanijo. Nemčija je Italiji želela pomagati, zato je čete namestila v Romuniji in Bolgariji ter Grčijo napadla z vzhoda. Medtem so Britanci izkrcali vojake in letala, da bi okrepili grško obrambo. Po državnem udaru v Jugoslaviji 27. marca je Adolf Hitler ukazal osvojitev te države.

Nemška in italijanska invazija na Jugoslavijo se je začela 6. aprila 1941, hkrati z obnovljenim napadom na Grčijo; 11. aprila se je invaziji na Jugoslavijo pridružila Madžarska. Jugoslovani so do 17. aprila podpisali premirje, do 30. aprila pa je bila vsa celinska Grčija pod nemškim ali italijanskim nadzorom. Nemčija je 20. maja z zraka napadla Kreto in do 1. junija so se vse preostale grške in britanske sile na otoku predale. Bolgarija v aprilskih napadih ni sodelovala, a je kmalu zatem zasedla dele Jugoslavije in Grčije ter jih obdržala do konca vojne na Balkanu.

source.title: Balkans campaign (World War II)
paragraphs: The Balkans campaign of World War II began with the Italian invasion of Greece on 28 October 1940. In the early months of 1941, Italy's offensive had stalled and a Greek counter-offensive pushed into Albania. Germany sought to aid Italy by deploying troops to Romania and Bulgaria and attacking Greece from the east. Meanwhile, the British landed troops and aircraft to shore up Greek defences. A coup d'état in Yugoslavia on 27 March caused Adolf Hitler to order the conquest of that country.

The invasion of Yugoslavia by Germany and Italy began on 6 April 1941, simultaneously with the renewed invasion of Greece; on 11 April, Hungary joined the invasion of Yugoslavia. By 17 April the Yugoslavs had signed an armistice, and by 30 April all of mainland Greece was under German or Italian control. On 20 May Germany invaded Crete by air, and by 1 June all remaining Greek and British forces on the island had surrendered. Although it had not participated in the attacks in April, Bulgaria occupied parts of both Yugoslavia and Greece shortly thereafter for the remainder of the war in the Balkans.

Baltic Entente.headline: Baltska antanta
paragraphs: Baltska antanta je temeljila na pogodbi o dobrem razumevanju in sodelovanju, ki so jo Litva, Latvija in Estonija podpisale 12. septembra 1934 v Ženevi. Glavni cilj sporazuma je bil skupno delovanje v zunanji politiki. Vključeval je tudi zaveze o medsebojni politični podpori in diplomatski podpori v mednarodnih stikih. Prizadevanje je bilo nazadnje neuspešno, saj so bile skupna moč treh držav in njihove izjave o nevtralnosti nepomembne v primerjavi z ogromnimi vojskami Poljske, Nemčije in Sovjetske zveze.

Načrti za razdelitev nadzora nad evropskimi deželami med silama, določeni v nacistično-sovjetskem paktu avgusta 1939, so baltske države dodelili sovjetski »vplivni sferi«.
