Junija 1940 je stalinistična Sovjetska zveza vdrla v vse tri države in jih zasedla, avgusta 1940 pa jih je formalno priključila ZSSR.

source.title: Baltic Entente
paragraphs: The Baltic Entente was based on Treaty of Good-Understanding and Co-operation signed between Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia on 12 September 1934 in Geneva. The main objective of the agreement was joint action in foreign policy. It also included commitments to support one another politically and to give diplomatic support in international communication. The endeavour was ultimately unsuccessful, as the combined strength of the three nations and their statements of neutrality were insubstantial in the face of the massive armies of Poland, Germany and the Soviet Union.

The plans for division of control of European lands located between the two powers laid out in the August 1939 Nazi-Soviet Pact assigned the Baltic countries into Soviet "sphere of influence". In June 1940 all three countries were invaded and occupied by the Stalinist Soviet Union, and formally annexed into the USSR in August 1940.

Baranovichi offensive.headline: Baranoviška ofenziva
paragraphs: Baranoviška ofenziva je bila bitka na vzhodni fronti prve svetovne vojne med rusko armado ter silami Nemčije in Avstro-Ogrske julija 1916.

source.title: Baranovichi offensive
paragraphs: The Baranovichi offensive was a battle fought on the Eastern Front during World War I between an army of Russia and the forces of Germany and Austria-Hungary in July 1916.

Barcelona Convention.headline: Barcelonska konvencija
paragraphs: Konvencija o varstvu morskega okolja in obalnega območja Sredozemlja, prvotno Konvencija o varstvu Sredozemskega morja pred onesnaževanjem, pogosto imenovana kar Barcelonska konvencija, je regionalna konvencija, sprejeta leta 1976, katere namen je preprečevati in zmanjševati onesnaževanje Sredozemskega morja z ladij, iz zrakoplovov in s kopnega. To med drugim vključuje odmetavanje, odtekanje in izpuste. Podpisnice so se zavezale k sodelovanju in medsebojni pomoči pri ukrepanju ob onesnaženjih, spremljanju in znanstvenem raziskovanju. Konvencija je bila sprejeta 16. februarja 1976 in spremenjena 10. junija 1995.

Barcelonska konvencija in njeni protokoli tvorijo pravni okvir Sredozemskega akcijskega načrta (sprejetega leta 1975), ki je nastal v okviru Programa za regionalna morja Programa Združenih narodov za okolje (UNEP).

source.title: Barcelona Convention
paragraphs: The Convention for the Protection of the Marine Environment and the Coastal Region of the Mediterranean, originally the Convention for Protection of the Mediterranean Sea against Pollution, and often simply referred to as the Barcelona Convention, is a regional convention adopted in 1976 to prevent and abate pollution from ships, aircraft and land based sources in the Mediterranean Sea. This includes but is not limited to dumping, run-off and discharges. Signers agreed to cooperate and assist in dealing with pollution emergencies, monitoring and scientific research. The convention was adopted on 16 February 1976 and amended on 10 June 1995.

The Barcelona Convention and its protocols form the legal framework of the Mediterranean Action Plan (approved in 1975), developed under the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) Regional Seas Programme.

Barents Region.headline: Barentsova regija
paragraphs: Barentsova regija je ime, ki so ga zagovorniki mednarodnega sodelovanja po razpadu Sovjetske zveze dali ozemlju ob obali Barentsovega morja, od okrožja Nordland na Norveškem do polotoka Kola v Rusiji in naprej vse do Urala in Nove Zemlje, na jugu pa do Botnijskega zaliva v Baltskem morju ter velikih jezer Ladoga in Onega. Med projekti je Barentsova cesta od Bodøja na Norveškem prek Haparande na Švedskem in Finske do Murmanska v Rusiji. Regija ima šest milijonov prebivalcev na 1,75 milijona km²; Rusiji pripadajo tri četrtine obojega.

source.title: Barents Region
paragraphs: The Barents Region is a name given, by advocates of establishing international cooperation after the fall of the Soviet Union, to the land along the coast of the Barents Sea, from Nordland county in Norway to the Kola Peninsula in Russia and beyond all the way to the Ural Mountains and Novaya Zemlya, and south to the Gulf of Bothnia of the Baltic Sea and the great lakes Ladoga and Onega. Among the projects is the Barents Road from Bodø in Norway through Haparanda in Sweden and Finland to Murmansk in Russia. The region has six million inhabitants on 1.75 million km2; three quarters of both belong to Russia.

Temeljna pogodba (nemško: Grundlagenvertrag) je kratko ime za Pogodbo o temeljih odnosov med Zvezno republiko Nemčijo in Nemško demokratično republiko (nemško: Vertrag über die Grundlagen der Beziehungen zwischen der Bundesrepublik Deutschland und der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik). Zvezna republika Nemčija in Nemška demokratična republika (NDR) sta se z njo prvič priznali kot suvereni državi, Zahodna Nemčija pa je opustila Hallsteinovo doktrino v korist vzhodne politike (Ostpolitik).

Po začetku veljavnosti štiristranskega sporazuma iz leta 1971 sta nemški državi začeli pogajanja o temeljni pogodbi. Kot pri tranzitnem sporazumu iz leta 1972 sta pogovore vodila državna podsekretarja Egon Bahr (za Zvezno republiko Nemčijo) in Michael Kohl (za Nemško demokratično republiko). Pogodba je bila v okviru vzhodne politike kanclerja Willyja Brandta podpisana 21. decembra 1972 v Vzhodnem Berlinu.
notes: The German pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Basic Treaty, 1972
paragraphs: The Basic Treaty (German: Grundlagenvertrag, pronounced [ˈɡʁʊntlaːɡn̩fɛɐ̯ˌtʁaːk] ) is the shorthand name for the Treaty concerning the basis of relations between the Federal Republic of Germany and the German Democratic Republic (German: Vertrag über die Grundlagen der Beziehungen zwischen der Bundesrepublik Deutschland und der Deutschen Demokratischen Republik). The Federal Republic of Germany and German Democratic Republic (GDR) recognized each other as sovereign states for the first time, an abandonment of West Germany's Hallstein Doctrine in favor of Ostpolitik.

After the entry into force of the Four-Power Agreement from 1971, the two German states began negotiations over a Basic Treaty. As for the Transit Agreement of 1972, the discussions were led by the Under-Secretaries of State Egon Bahr (for the Federal Republic of Germany) and Michael Kohl (for the German Democratic Republic). As part of the Ostpolitik of Chancellor Willy Brandt, the treaty was signed on 21 December 1972 in East Berlin.

Basina of Thuringia.headline: Bazina Turinška
paragraphs: Bazina ali Basine (ok. 438–477) je bila po spominu poznejših avtorjev, predvsem Gregorja iz Toursa, sredi 5. stoletja kraljica Turingije. Ker pa je Gregor kraljestvo Turingijo njene družine opisal kot ležeče na galski ali zahodni strani Rena, nekateri menijo, da gre za Civitas Tungrorum na ozemlju današnje Belgije.
notes: A state record linked to the article on a person (Queen Basina); the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Basina of Thuringia
paragraphs: Basina or Basine (c. 438 – 477) was remembered as a queen of Thuringia in the middle of the fifth century, by much later authors such as especially Gregory of Tours. However, because Gregory described her family's kingdom of Thuringia as being on the Gaulish or western side of the river Rhine, it is sometimes thought to be the Civitas Tungrorum, which is now Belgium.

Battle for Brest.headline: Bitka za Brest
paragraphs: Bitka za Brest je potekala avgusta in septembra 1944 na zahodni fronti med drugo svetovno vojno. Širša bitka za Bretanjo in zavezniški načrt invazije na celinsko Evropo sta zahtevala zavzetje pristanišč, da bi lahko pravočasno dostavljali ogromne količine vojaškega materiala za oskrbo zavezniških invazijskih sil. Ocenjevali so, da bo 37 zavezniških divizij, ki naj bi bile septembra 1944 na celini, vsak dan potrebovalo 26.000 ton zalog. Glavno pristanišče, ki so ga zavezniki upali zavzeti in uporabiti zase, je bil Brest na severozahodu Francije.

source.title: Battle for Brest
paragraphs: The Battle for Brest was fought in August and September 1944 on the Western Front during World War II. Part of the overall Battle for Brittany and the Allied plan for the invasion of mainland Europe called for the capture of port facilities, in order to ensure the timely delivery of the enormous amount of war materiel required to supply the invading Allied forces. It was estimated that the 37 Allied divisions to be on the continent by September 1944 would need 26,000 tons of supplies each day. The main port the Allied forces hoped to seize and put into their service was Brest, in northwestern France.

Bitka za Caen (od junija do avgusta 1944) je bila vojaški spopad med britansko 2. armado in nemško Panzergruppe West v drugi svetovni vojni za nadzor nad mestom Caen in njegovo okolico med bitko za Normandijo. Caen leži približno 14 km od obale Calvadosa v notranjosti, ob reki Orne in kanalu Caen, na križišču več cest in železnic. Zaradi prometnih povezav je bil pomemben operativni cilj za obe strani. Caen in območje južno od njega sta bolj ravna in odprta kot pokrajina bocage v zahodni Normandiji, zato so poveljniki zavezniških letalskih sil želeli območje hitro zavzeti in na njem zgraditi letališča, da bi lahko več letal namestili v samo Francijo.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle for Caen
paragraphs: The Battle for Caen (June to August 1944) was a military engagement between the British Second Army and the German Panzergruppe West in the Second World War for control of the city of Caen and its vicinity during the Battle of Normandy. Caen is about 9 mi (14 km) inland from the Calvados coast astride the Orne River and Caen Canal, at the junction of several roads and railways. The communication links made it an important operational objective for both sides. Caen and the area to its south are flatter and more open when compared to the bocage country of western Normandy, and Allied air force commanders wanted the area captured quickly in order to construct airfields to base more aircraft in France proper.

Battle for Height 776.headline: Bitka za višino 776
paragraphs: Bitka za višino 776, del širše bitke pri Ulus-Kertu, je bila spopad v drugi čečenski vojni med boji za nadzor nad sotesko reke Argun v visokogorskem Šatojskem okraju v osrednji Čečeniji, med vasema Ulus-Kert in Selmentauzen.

source.title: Battle for Height 776
paragraphs: The Battle for Height 776, part of the larger Battle of Ulus-Kert, was an engagement in the Second Chechen War that took place during fighting for control of the Argun River gorge in the highland Shatoysky District of central Chechnya, between the villages of Ulus-Kert and Selmentauzen.

Bitka za Aachen je potekala med 12. septembrom in 21. oktobrom 1944 v drugi svetovni vojni: ameriške in nemške sile so se bojevale v Aachnu v Nemčiji in okoli njega. Mesto je bilo vključeno v Siegfriedovo linijo, glavni obrambni sistem na zahodni meji Nemčije; zavezniki so ga upali hitro zavzeti in prodreti v industrijsko Porurje. Čeprav so večino civilnega prebivalstva Aachna evakuirali pred začetkom bitke, je bil velik del mesta uničen, obe strani pa sta v bitki utrpeli hude izgube.

Bila je ena največjih uličnih bitk ameriških sil v drugi svetovni vojni in velja za enega najtežjih uličnih spopadov v vsej vojni. Tako je Aachen postal prvo mesto na mednarodno priznanih nemških tleh, ki so ga zavzeli zavezniki. Čeprav so se Nemci nazadnje predali, je bila njihova obramba mesta trdna in je močno zmotila zavezniške načrte za nadaljnji prodor v državo.

source.title: Battle of Aachen
paragraphs: The Battle of Aachen was a battle of World War II, fought by American and German forces in and around Aachen, Germany, between 12 September and 21 October 1944. The city had been incorporated into the Siegfried Line, the main defensive network on Germany's western border; the Allies had hoped to capture it quickly and advance into the industrialized Ruhr basin. Although most of Aachen's civilian population was evacuated before the battle began, much of the city was destroyed and both sides suffered heavy losses during the battle.

It was one of the largest urban battles fought by U.S. forces in World War II, and is considered one of the toughest urban encounters in the entire war. As a result, Aachen became the first city on internationally recognized German soil to be captured by the Allies. Despite their eventual surrender, German defence of the city was robust and significantly disrupted Allied plans for further advance into the country.

Battle of Abensberg.headline: Bitka pri Abensbergu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Abensbergu je potekala 20. aprila 1809 med francosko-nemškimi silami pod poveljstvom francoskega cesarja Napoleona I. in okrepljenim avstrijskim korpusom, ki ga je vodil podmaršal nadvojvoda Ludvik Avstrijski. Čez dan je prispel podmaršal Johann von Hiller z okrepitvami in prevzel poveljstvo nad tremi korpusi, ki so sestavljali avstrijsko levo krilo. Spopad se je končal s popolno francosko-nemško zmago. Bojišče je ležalo jugovzhodno od Abensberga, spopadi pa so potekali tudi pri Offenstettnu, Biburg-Siegenburgu, Rohru na Spodnjem Bavarskem in Rottenburgu ob Laaberju. Istega dne je kapitulirala francoska posadka v Regensburgu.

source.title: Battle of Abensberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Abensberg took place on 20 April 1809 between a Franco-German force under the command of Emperor Napoleon I of France and a reinforced Austrian corps led by Feldmarschall-Leutnant Archduke Louis of Austria. As the day wore on, Feldmarschall-Leutnant Johann von Hiller arrived with reinforcements to take command of the three corps that formed the Austrian left wing. The action ended in a complete Franco-German victory. The battlefield was southeast of Abensberg and included clashes at Offenstetten, Biburg-Siegenburg, Rohr in Niederbayern, and Rottenburg an der Laaber. On the same day, the French garrison of Regensburg capitulated.

Battle of Abritus.headline: Bitka pri Abritu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Abritu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Forum Terebronii, je potekala poleti leta 251 blizu Abrita (današnji Razgrad) v rimski provinci Spodnja Mezija. V njej so se Rimljani spopadli z zvezo gotskih in skitskih plemen pod vodstvom gotskega kralja Kniva.

Rimska vojska je bila hudo poražena, v bitki pa sta padla cesarja Decij in njegov sin Herenij Etrusk. Šlo je za enega najhujših porazov Rimskega cesarstva proti germanskim plemenom; rimski zgodovinar Amijan Marcelin ga je postavil ob bok bitki v Tevtoburškem gozdu leta 9, markomanskemu vpadu v rimsko Italijo leta 170 in bitki pri Odrinu leta 378.
Smrt cesarjev je povečala politično nestabilnost v Rimu, izguba vojske pa je v naslednjih dveh desetletjih omogočila ponavljajoče se barbarske vpade v regijo.

source.title: Battle of Abritus
paragraphs: The Battle of Abritus also known as the Battle of Forum Terebronii occurred near Abritus (modern Razgrad) in the Roman province of Moesia Inferior in the summer of 251. It was fought between the Romans and a federation of Gothic and Scythian tribesmen under the Gothic king Cniva.

The Roman army was soundly defeated, and Roman emperors Decius and Herennius Etruscus, his son, were both killed in battle. It was one of the worst defeats suffered by the Roman Empire against the Germanic tribes, rated by the Roman historian Ammianus Marcellinus as on par with the Battle of the Teutoburg Forest in 9, the Marcomannic invasion of Roman Italy in 170, and the Battle of Adrianople in 378.
The emperors' deaths led to more political instability at Rome; and the loss of the army allowed repeated barbarian incursions in the region for the next two decades.

Battle of Ager Falernus.headline: Bitka na Falernskem polju
paragraphs: Bitka na Falernskem polju (Ager Falernus) je bila manjši spopad med vojskama Rima in Kartagine v drugi punski vojni. Po zmagi v bitki na Trasimenskem jezeru v Italiji leta 217 pr. n. št. je Hanibalova vojska odkorakala proti jugu in dosegla Kampanijo. Kartažani so se nazadnje premaknili v okrožje Falernum, rodovitno rečno dolino, obdano z gorami.

Kvint Fabij Maksim Verukoz, ki so ga po katastrofalnem porazu pri Trasimenskem jezeru izvolili za rimskega diktatorja in poveljnika rimskih poljskih sil, je Hanibala neprestano zasledoval in se držal strategije, da se bo boril le v ugodnih razmerah. Zdaj je zasedel vse rečne prehode in gorske prelaze, ki vodijo iz doline, in tako Kartažane ujel vanjo.

Potem ko je območje opustošil in mu pobral žito, živino in druge zaloge, je Hanibal z briljantno taktiko poskušal rimsko stražo zvabiti z enega od prelazov. Kljub protestom svojih častnikov se Fabij, ki je s svojimi glavnimi silami taboril blizu prelaza, ni hotel spopasti s kartažansko vojsko, ta pa je pasti ušla nepoškodovana.

source.title: Battle of Ager Falernus
paragraphs: The Battle of Ager Falernus was a skirmish during the Second Punic War between the armies of Rome and Carthage. After winning the Battle of Lake Trasimene in Italy in 217 BC, the army commanded by Hannibal marched south and reached Campania. The Carthaginians ultimately moved into the district of Falernum, a fertile river valley surrounded by mountains.

Quintus Fabius Maximus Verrucosus, who had been elected Roman dictator and commander of the Roman field forces after the disastrous defeat at Lake Trasimene, had dogged Hannibal and stuck to a strategy to fight only under favourable conditions. He now occupied all the river crossings and mountain passes leading out of the valley, thus blocking the Carthaginians inside.

After stripping the area of grain, cattle, and other supplies, Hannibal displayed brilliant tactics to provoke the Roman guard to leave one of the passes. Despite the protests of his staff officers, Fabius, who was camped near the pass with his main forces, refused to attack the Carthaginian army and it escaped the trap unscathed.

Battle of Agnadello.headline: Bitka pri Agnadellu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Agnadellu, znana tudi kot Vailà, je potekala 14. maja 1509 med vojsko francoskega kralja Ludvika XII. in beneškimi zaščitnimi enotami pod poveljstvom Bartolomea d'Alviana. Po triurnem spopadu in potem ko je Bartolomeo ugotovil, da ga je del njegove vojske zapustil, so bili Benečani poraženi, z izgubami več kot 4000 mož. Ludvik je nato zasedel preostalo Lombardijo.

Bila je eden najpomembnejših spopadov vojne cambraiske lige in prelomna epizoda v širšem okviru italijanskih vojn; Machiavelli jo je opisal kot dan, ko so Benetke v enem samem dnevu izgubile ozemeljske pridobitve osmih stoletij.

source.title: Battle of Agnadello
paragraphs: The Battle of Agnadello, also known as Vailà, was fought on 14 May 1509 between the army of King Louis XII of France and the Venetian rear-guard elements commanded by Bartolomeo d'Alviano. After a three hour struggle, and after Bartolomeo found himself abandoned by a part of his army, the Venetians were defeated with losses in excess of 4,000 men. Louis then occupied the rest of Lombardy.

It was one of the most significant engagements of the War of the League of Cambrai and a pivotal episode in the broader context of the Italian Wars, with Machiavelli describing it as Venice losing in a single day the territorial gains of eight centuries.

Battle of Agrigentum.headline: Bitka pri Agrigentu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Agrigentu (Sicilija, 262 pr. n. št.) je bila prva odprta bitka prve punske vojne in prvi velik vojaški spopad med Kartagino in Rimsko republiko. Bitka je sledila dolgemu obleganju, ki se je začelo leta 262 pr. n. št., in se je končala z rimsko zmago ter začetkom rimskega nadzora nad Sicilijo.

source.title: Battle of Agrigentum
paragraphs: The Battle of Agrigentum (Sicily, 262 BC) was the first pitched battle of the First Punic War and the first large-scale military confrontation between Carthage and the Roman Republic. The battle was fought after a long siege which started in 262 BC and resulted both in a Roman victory and the beginning of Roman control of Sicily.

Battle of Alarcos.headline: Bitka pri Alarcosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Alarcosu (18. julija 1195) je potekala med Almohadi pod vodstvom Abu Jusufa Jakuba al Mansurja in kastiljskim kraljem Alfonzom VIII. Končala se je s porazom kastiljskih sil in njihovim umikom v Toledo, Almohadi pa so znova osvojili Trujillo, Montánchez in Talavero.

source.title: Battle of Alarcos
paragraphs: Battle of Alarcos (July 18, 1195) was fought between the Almohads led by Abu Yusuf Ya'qub al-Mansur and King Alfonso VIII of Castile. It resulted in the defeat of the Castilian forces and their subsequent retreat to Toledo, whereas the Almohads reconquered Trujillo, Montánchez, and Talavera.

Battle of Albert (1914).headline: Bitka pri Albertu (1914)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Albertu (znana tudi kot prva bitka pri Albertu) se je začela 25. septembra 1914 v okviru tako imenovane »dirke do morja« med prvo svetovno vojno. Sledila je prvi bitki na Aisni, ko sta se obe strani pomikali proti severu in skušali obiti severno krilo nasprotnika. Druga armada (Noël de Castelnau) se je sredi septembra začela zbirati v Amiensu, general Joseph Joffre, vrhovni poveljnik francoske vojske, pa ji je ukazal napasti pri Albertu.

source.title: Battle of Albert (1914)
paragraphs: The Battle of Albert (also known as the First Battle of Albert) began on 25 September 1914, in what became known as the "Race to the Sea", during the First World War. It followed the First Battle of the Aisne as both sides moved northwards, trying to turn the northern flank of their opponent. The Second Army (Noël de Castelnau), began to assemble at Amiens in mid-September and was directed by General Joseph Joffre, the Generalissimo of the French Army, to attack near Albert.

Battle of Albuera.headline: Bitka pri Albueri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Albueri (16. maja 1811) je bila bitka polotoške vojne. Mešani britanski, španski in portugalski korpus se je spopadel z deli francoske Armée du Midi (Južne armade) pri majhni španski vasi Albuera, približno 20 kilometrov južno od obmejnega utrjenega mesta Badajoz v Španiji.
notes: The miles conversion (12 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Albuera
paragraphs: The Battle of Albuera (16 May 1811) was a battle during the Peninsular War. A mixed British, Spanish and Portuguese corps engaged elements of the French armée du Midi (Army of the South) at the small Spanish village of Albuera, about 20 kilometres (12 mi) south of the frontier fortress-town of Badajoz, Spain.

Battle of Albulena.headline: Bitka pri Albuleni
paragraphs: Bitka pri Albuleni (albansko: Beteja e Albulenës), znana tudi kot bitka pri Ujëbardhi, je potekala 2. septembra 1457 med albanskimi silami pod vodstvom Skenderbega in osmansko vojsko pod poveljstvom Evrenosoğluja İsa-beja in Skenderbegovega nečaka Hamze Kastriotija.

Skenderbeg je bil takrat že več kot desetletje voditelj Albancev in je osmanske vojske večkrat premagal. Po neuspešnem obleganju Berata leta 1455 pa so ga izdali nekateri najzaupnejši častniki, med njimi Moisi Arianit Golemi. Golemi se je naslednje leto vrnil na čelu osmanskih sil, a so ga v bitki pri Oraniku premagali, nato pa se je spet pridružil Skenderbegovi vojski. Pozneje je Skenderbega izdal še nezadovoljni nečak Hamza Kastrioti, ki so mu skupaj z İsa-bejem ponudili poveljstvo nad drugo osmansko invazijsko vojsko.

source.title: Battle of Albulena
paragraphs: The Battle of Albulena (Albanian: Beteja e Albulenës), also known as the Battle of Ujëbardha, was fought on 2 September 1457 between Albanian forces led by Skanderbeg and an Ottoman army under Evrenosoğlu İsa Bey and Skanderbeg's nephew, Hamza Kastrioti.

Skanderbeg had been the leader of the Albanians for over a decade and had seen many victories over the Ottoman armies. However, after his unsuccessful Siege of Berat in 1455, Skanderbeg was betrayed by some of his most trusted officers, among them Moisi Arianit Golemi. Golemi returned the next year with an Ottoman force under his command, but was defeated at the Battle of Oranik and later re-joined Skanderbeg's army. Later, Skanderbeg's dissatisfied nephew, Hamza Kastrioti, betrayed Skanderbeg and was offered joint-command with İsa Bey over a second Ottoman invasion force.

Bitka pri Aljubarroti je potekala 14. avgusta 1385 med Kraljevino Portugalsko in Kastiljsko krono. Sile portugalskega kralja Ivana I. in njegovega konetabla Nuna Álvaresa Pereire so se z angleškimi zavezniki pri São Jorgeju, med mestoma Leiria in Alcobaça v osrednji Portugalski, spopadle z vojsko kastiljskega kralja Ivana I., njenimi aragonskimi in francoskimi zavezniki ter genovskimi najemniki. Portugalci so odločilno zmagali, s čimer so končali kastiljske težnje po portugalskem prestolu in krizo v letih 1383–1385 ter utrdili Ivanov položaj portugalskega kralja.

Portugalska neodvisnost je bila zavarovana in nastala je nova dinastija Avis. Posamezni obmejni spopadi s kastiljskimi enotami so se nadaljevali do smrti kastiljskega kralja Ivana I. leta 1390, a za novo dinastijo niso pomenili prave nevarnosti.

source.title: Battle of Aljubarrota
paragraphs: The Battle of Aljubarrota was fought between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Crown of Castile on 14 August 1385. Forces commanded by King John I of Portugal and his Constable Nuno Álvares Pereira, with the support of English allies, opposed the army of King John I of Castile with its Aragonese and French allies, as well as Genoese mercenaries at São Jorge, between the towns of Leiria and Alcobaça, in central Portugal. The result was a decisive victory for the Portuguese, ruling out Castilian ambitions to the Portuguese throne, ending the 1383–85 Crisis and assuring John's position as King of Portugal.

Portuguese independence was safeguarded and a new dynasty, the House of Aviz, was established. Scattered border confrontations with Castilian troops would persist until the death of John I of Castile in 1390, but these posed no real threat to the new dynasty.

Bitka pri Almansi je potekala 25. aprila 1707 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo. V njej sta se spopadli vojska, zvesta španskemu kralju Filipu V., burbonskemu pretendentu za španski prestol, in vojska, ki je podpirala njegovega habsburškega tekmeca, nadvojvodo Karla Avstrijskega. Burbonci so odločilno zmagali in Filipu znova pridobili večino vzhodne Španije.

Burbonsko vojsko je vodil vojvoda Berwick, nezakonski sin angleškega kralja Jakoba II., habsburške sile pa Henri de Massue, grof Galway, izgnani francoski hugenot. Zato je to »verjetno edina bitka v zgodovini, v kateri je angleškim silam poveljeval Francoz, francoskim pa Anglež«.

source.title: Battle of Almansa
paragraphs: The Battle of Almansa took place on 25 April 1707, during the War of the Spanish Succession. It was fought between an army loyal to Philip V of Spain, Bourbon claimant to the Spanish throne, and one supporting his Habsburg rival, Archduke Charles of Austria. The result was a decisive Bourbon victory that reclaimed most of eastern Spain for Philip.

The Bourbon army was commanded by the Duke of Berwick, illegitimate son of James II of England, while Habsburg forces were led by Henri de Massue, Earl of Galway, an exiled French Huguenot. This makes it "probably the only battle in history in which the English forces were commanded by a Frenchman, the French by an Englishman."

Battle of Almenar.headline: Bitka pri Almenaru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Almenaru je potekala 27. julija 1710 blizu Balaguerja v Kataloniji, v vojni za špansko nasledstvo.

Junija 1710 je burbonsko-španska vojska Filipa V. vstopila v Katalonijo, da bi zavzela Balaguer; zavezniške britanske, portugalske, nizozemske in avstrijske enote, ki so podpirale nadvojvodo Karla, so tem premikom nasprotovale in vojski sta se popoldne 27. julija spopadli tik severno od Lleide. Filipova vojska je bila poražena in se je morala umakniti za reko Ebro, a je ostala cela.

source.title: Battle of Almenar
paragraphs: The Battle of Almenar took place near Balaguer in Catalonia, on 27 July 1710, during the War of the Spanish Succession.

In June 1710, the Bourbon-Spanish army of Phillip V crossed into Catalonia in an attempt to capture Balaguer; an Allied force of British, Portuguese, Dutch and Austrian troops supporting Archduke Charles countered these moves and the two armies met in battle just to the north of Lleida on the afternoon of 27 July. Philip's army was defeated and forced to withdraw behind the Ebro but remained intact.

Battle of Amiens (1870).headline: Bitka pri Amiensu (1870)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Amiensu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Villers-Bretonneuxu, je potekala 27. novembra 1870 med francoskimi in pruskimi silami v francosko-pruski vojni (1870–1871). Končala se je s prusko zmago: Francozi so se morali umakniti, Prusi pa so zavzeli Amiens.

source.title: Battle of Amiens (1870)
paragraphs: The Battle of Amiens, also known as the Battle of Villers-Bretonneux, was fought on 27 November 1870 between French and Prussian forces during the Franco-Prussian War (1870–1871). It ended in a Prussian victory, forcing the French to retreat and allowing the Prussians to capture Amiens, France.

Battle of Amiens (1918).headline: Bitka pri Amiensu (1918)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Amiensu, znana tudi kot tretja bitka v Pikardiji, je bila začetna faza zavezniške ofenzive, ki se je začela 8. avgusta 1918, pozneje pa je postala znana kot stodnevna ofenziva in je nazadnje privedla do konca prve svetovne vojne. Zavezniške sile so prvi dan napredovale več kot 11 kilometrov, kar je bil eden največjih prodorov v vojni. Odločilno vlogo sta imeli britanska 4. armada generala Henryja Rawlinsona, v kateri sta devet od njenih 19 divizij prispevala hitro premikajoči se avstralski korpus generalpodpolkovnika Johna Monasha in kanadski korpus generalpodpolkovnika Arthurja Currieja, ter francoska 1. armada generala Marie Eugèna Debeneyja. Bitka je pomembna tudi zaradi vpliva na moralo obeh strani in velikega števila nemških vojakov, ki so se predali. Erich Ludendorff je zato pozneje prvi dan bitke opisal kot »črni dan nemške vojske«. Amiens je bil ena prvih velikih bitk z oklepnim bojevanjem.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Amiens (1918)
paragraphs: The Battle of Amiens, also known as the Third Battle of Picardy, was the opening phase of the Allied offensive which began on 8 August 1918, later known as the Hundred Days Offensive, which ultimately led to the end of World War I. Allied forces advanced over 11 kilometres (7 mi) on the first day, one of the greatest advances of the war, with Gen Henry Rawlinson's British Fourth Army, with nine of its 19 divisions supplied by the fast-moving Australian Corps of Lt General John Monash and Canadian Corps of Lt General Arthur Currie, and Gen Marie Eugène Debeney's French First Army playing a decisive role. The battle is also notable for its effects on both sides' morale and the large number of surrendering German forces. This led Erich Ludendorff to later describe the first day of the battle as "the black day of the German Army". Amiens was one of the first major battles involving armoured warfare.

Battle of Amphipolis.headline: Bitka pri Amfipolu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Amfipolu je potekala leta 422 pr. n. št. v peloponeški vojni med Atenami in Šparto. Bila je vrhunec dogodkov, ki so se začeli leta 424 pr. n. št., ko so Špartanci zavzeli Amfipol.

source.title: Battle of Amphipolis
paragraphs: The Battle of Amphipolis was fought in 422 BC during the Peloponnesian War between Athens and Sparta. It was the culmination of events that began in 424 BC with the capture of Amphipolis by the Spartans.

Battle of Anchialus (763).headline: Bitka pri Anhialu (763)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Anhialu (bolgarsko: Битката при Анхиало) je potekala leta 763 blizu mesta Pomorie na bolgarski črnomorski obali. Zmagali so Bizantinci.

source.title: Battle of Anchialus (763)
paragraphs: The battle of Anchialus (Bulgarian: Битката при Анхиало) occurred in 763, near the town of Pomorie on the Bulgarian Black Sea Coast. The result was a Byzantine victory.

Battle of Ancona.headline: Bitka za Ancono
paragraphs: Bitka za Ancono je potekala med poljskimi silami v sestavi britanske vojske in nemškimi silami od 16. junija do 18. julija 1944 v italijanski kampanji druge svetovne vojne. Bitka je bila posledica zavezniškega načrta, da bi zavzeli mesto Ancona v Italiji in tako dobili pristanišče, ki je bližje bojiščem, kar bi jim skrajšalo oskrbovalne poti. Poljski 2. korpus, ki je nalogo zavzeti mesto dobil 16. junija 1944, jo je opravil mesec dni pozneje, 18. julija 1944.

source.title: Battle of Ancona
paragraphs: The Battle of Ancona was fought between forces from Poland serving as part of the British Army and German forces that took place from 16 June–18 July 1944 during the Italian campaign in World War II. The battle was the result of an Allied plan to capture the city of Ancona in Italy in order to gain possession of a seaport closer to the fighting so that they could shorten their lines of communication. The Polish 2nd Corps, tasked with capture of the city on 16 June 1944, accomplished the objective a month later on 18 July 1944.

Battle of Andernach (939).headline: Bitka pri Andernachu (939)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Andernachu med privrženci in nasprotniki nemškega kralja Otona I. je potekala 2. oktobra 939 v Andernachu ob Renu in se končala z odločilnim porazom upornikov in smrtjo njihovih voditeljev.

source.title: Battle of Andernach (939)
paragraphs: The Battle of Andernach, between the followers and the opponents of King Otto I of Germany, took place on 2 October 939 in Andernach on the Rhine river and ended with a decisive defeat of the rebels and the death of their leaders.

Battle of Andros (246 BC).headline: Bitka pri Androsu (246 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Androsu je bila malo znana pomorska bitka v tretji sirski vojni. Egipčansko ladjevje, ki mu je najverjetneje poveljeval Sofron iz Efeza, je kljub številčni premoči izgubilo bitko z makedonskim ladjevjem pod vodstvom Antigona II. Gonata. Egipčanski poveljnik Ptolemaj Andromahov, nezakonski polbrat faraona, je izgubil ladjo in posadko ter komaj ušel v Efez.
Datum bitke ni zanesljiv, splošno pa velja leto 246/245 pr. n. št. Po bitki je egipčanski kralj Ptolemaj III. Everget izgubil prevlado nad Nesiotsko zvezo v korist Antigona Gonata.

source.title: Battle of Andros (246 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Andros was an obscure naval battle during the Third Syrian War. Despite its numerical superiority, the Egyptian fleet, probably commanded by Sophron of Ephesus, lost to a Macedonian fleet led by Antigonus II Gonatas. The Egyptian captain Ptolemy Andromachou, an illegitimate half-brother of the Pharaoh, lost his ship and crew, barely escaping to Ephesus.

The date of the battle is uncertain, but generally the year 246/245 BC is accepted. Following the battle, the Egyptian king Ptolemy III Euergetes lost the dominion of the Nesiotic League to Antigonus Gonatas.

Bitka za Anzio je bila bitka italijanske kampanje druge svetovne vojne, ki se je začela 22. januarja 1944. Začela se je z zavezniškim izkrcanjem z morja, znanim kot operacija Shingle, in se končala 4. junija 1944 z osvoboditvijo Rima. Operaciji so nasprotovale nemške in italijanske sile Italijanske socialne republike (RSI) na območju Anzia in Nettuna.

Zavezniška izkrcanja na italijanskem kopnem so se začela septembra 1943, po počasnih pridobitvah proti nemškemu odporu pa je napredovanje decembra 1943 ustavila nemška obrambna Gustavova linija južno od Rima.
Operacijo je sprva poveljeval generalmajor John P. Lucas iz ameriške vojske, ki je poveljeval ameriškemu 6. korpusu, z namenom, da bi obšel nemške sile na zimski liniji in omogočil napad na Rim.

source.title: Battle of Anzio
paragraphs: The Battle of Anzio was a battle of the Italian Campaign of World War II that commenced 22 January 1944. The battle began with the Allied amphibious landing known as Operation Shingle, and ended on 4 June 1944, with the liberation of Rome. The operation was opposed by German and by Italian Repubblica Sociale Italiana (RSI) forces in the area of Anzio and Nettuno.

Allied landings on the Italian mainland began in September 1943, and after slow gains against German resistance, the progress was stopped in December 1943 at the German defensive Gustav Line, south of Rome.

The operation was initially commanded by Major General John P. Lucas, of the U.S. Army, commanding U.S. VI Corps with the intent to outflank German forces at the Winter Line and enable an attack on Rome.

Battle of Aquae Sextiae.headline: Bitka pri Aquae Sextiae
paragraphs: Bitka pri Aquae Sextiae (Aix-en-Provence) je potekala leta 102 pr. n. št. Po vrsti rimskih porazov v bitki pri Noreji, bitki pri Burdigali in predvsem v bitki pri Arausiu so Rimljani pod vodstvom Gaja Marija nazadnje premagali Tevtone in Ambrone, ko so ti skušali prek Alp prodreti v Italijo. Lokalno izročilo ime gore Mont Sainte-Victoire povezuje z rimsko zmago v bitki pri Aquae Sextiae, a so Frédéric Mistral in drugi raziskovalci to razlago ovrgli.

source.title: Battle of Aquae Sextiae
paragraphs: The Battle of Aquae Sextiae (Aix-en-Provence) took place in 102 BC. After a series of Roman defeats at the Battle of Noreia, the Battle of Burdigala, and most notably at the Battle of Arausio, the Romans under Gaius Marius finally defeated the Teutons and Ambrones as they attempted to advance through the Alps into Italy. Local lore associates the name of the mountain, Mont St. Victoire, with the Roman victory at the battle of Aquae Sextiae, but Frédéric Mistral and other scholars have debunked this theory.

Battle of Arachova.headline: Bitka pri Arahovi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arahovi (grško: Μάχη της Αράχωβας) je potekala od 18. do 24. novembra 1826 (po novem koledarju). Spopadle so se osmanske sile pod poveljstvom Mustafa-beja in grški uporniki pod vodstvom Georgiosa Karaiskakisa. Ko je Karaiskakis izvedel za premike osmanske vojske, je pripravil presenetljiv napad v okolici vasi Arahova v osrednji Grčiji. Mustafa-bejevih 2000 osmanskih vojakov je bilo 18. novembra obkoljenih v Arahovi. Tri dni pozneje je spodletel poskus 800 mož, da bi branilce rešili.

Mustafa-bej je bil 22. novembra smrtno ranjen in morala Osmanov je strmoglavila, saj so lačne branilce pestila mraz in močno deževje. Opoldne 24. novembra so Osmani poskusili prodor, ki se je končal katastrofalno. Večina jih je padla v bojih ali umrla zaradi mraza. Grška zmaga pri Arahovi je upornikom pridobila dragocen čas, preden so jim leto pozneje na pomoč priskočile velesile.

source.title: Battle of Arachova
paragraphs: The Battle of Arachova (Greek: Μάχη της Αράχωβας), took place between 18 and 24 November 1826 (N.S.). It was fought between an Ottoman Empire force under the command of Mustafa Bey and Greek rebels under Georgios Karaiskakis. After receiving intelligence of the Ottoman army's maneuvers, Karaiskakis prepared a surprise attack in vicinity of the village of Arachova, in central Greece. On 18 November, Mustafa Bey's 2,000 Ottoman troops were blockaded in Arachova. An 800-man force that attempted to relieve the defenders three days later failed.

On 22 November Mustafa Bey was mortally wounded and Ottoman morale plunged, as cold weather and heavy rainfall plagued the hunger-stricken defenders. At midday on 24 November the Ottomans made a disastrous attempt at breaking out. Most were killed in the fighting or perished from the cold. The Greek victory at Arachova gained the rebels valuable time before the Great Powers came to their assistance a year later.

Battle of Arausio.headline: Bitka pri Arausiu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arausiu je potekala 6. oktobra 105 pr. n. št. med mestom Arausio (danes Orange v departmaju Vaucluse) in reko Rono. Dve rimski vojski pod poveljstvom prokonzula Kvinta Servilija Cepiona in konzula Gneja Malija Maksima sta tam doživeli hud poraz proti selečima se plemenoma Kimbrov in Tevtonov, ki sta ju vodila Bojoriks oziroma Tevtobod.

source.title: Battle of Arausio
paragraphs: The Battle of Arausio took place on 6 October 105 BC, at a site between the town of Arausio, now Orange, Vaucluse, and the Rhône river, when two Roman armies, commanded by proconsul Quintus Servilius Caepio and consul Gnaeus Mallius Maximus, suffered a major defeat at the hands of the Cimbri and Teuton migratory tribes who were led by Boiorix and Teutobod respectively.

Battle of Arbedo.headline: Bitka pri Arbedu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arbedu je potekala 30. junija 1422 med Milansko vojvodino in švicarsko konfederacijo in se končala z milansko zmago.

Leta 1419 sta švicarska kantona Uri in Unterwalden od rodbine Sax kupila utrjeno mesto Bellinzona, a ga nista mogla ustrezno braniti. Ko sta leta 1422 zavrnila milanski predlog za odkup Bellinzone, so milanske sile pod poveljstvom kondotjera Francesca Bussoneja da Carmagnole napadle in porazile švicarsko posadko ter zasedle mesto. Švicarski poskus, da bi Bellinzono ob podpori drugih kantonov, med njimi Luzerna in Zuga, znova zavzeli, je privedel do bitke pri vasi Arbedo, 3 km severno od mesta.

Švicarji so bili oboroženi predvsem s helebardami in so sprva uspešno odbili dva juriša milanske konjenice. Carmagnola je nato na švicarske boke pripeljal samostrelce in svojim oklepnim konjenikom ukazal, naj razjahajo in se bojujejo peš s sulicami, ki so bile daljše od helebard.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Arbedo
paragraphs: The Battle of Arbedo was fought on 30 June 1422 between the Duchy of Milan and the Swiss Confederation, and ended with a Milanese victory.

In 1419, the Swiss cantons of Uri and Unterwalden bought the fortified town of Bellinzona from the House of Sax but were unable to defend it adequately. When they rejected a Milanese proposal to purchase Bellinzona in 1422, a Milanese force under the command of the condottiero Francesco Bussone da Carmagnola attacked and defeated the Swiss garrison and occupied the town. A Swiss attempt to recapture Bellinzona with the support of other cantons including Lucerne and Zug led to the battle at the village of Arbedo, 3 km (1.9 mi) north of the town.

The Swiss were mainly equipped with halberds and were initially successful in repelling two Milanese cavalry charges. Carmagnola then brought up his crossbowmen on the Swiss flanks and ordered his men-at-arms to dismount and fight on foot with their lances, which outreached the halberds.

Battle of Arcis-sur-Aube.headline: Bitka pri Arcis-sur-Aubu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arcis-sur-Aubu (20.–21. marca 1814) je bila spopad, v katerem se je francoska cesarska vojska pod Napoleonovim poveljstvom med vojno šeste koalicije spoprijela z veliko večjo zavezniško vojsko pod vodstvom Karla Philippa, kneza Schwarzenberga. Drugi dan bojev je cesar Napoleon nazadnje spoznal, da se je zmotno zapletel v bitko z daleč številčnejšim nasprotnikom, in takoj ukazal prikrit umik. Ko je avstrijski feldmaršal Schwarzenberg spoznal, da se Napoleon umika, se je večina Francozov že odlepila od nasprotnika, zavezniki pa s poznejšim zasledovanjem niso preprečili, da se preostala francoska vojska varno umakne proti severu. To je bila Napoleonova predzadnja bitka pred odstopom in izgnanstvom na Elbo; zadnja je bila bitka pri Saint-Dizierju.

source.title: Battle of Arcis-sur-Aube
paragraphs: The Battle of Arcis-sur-Aube (20–21 March 1814) saw an Imperial French army under Napoleon face a much larger Allied army led by Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg during the War of the Sixth Coalition. On the second day of fighting, Emperor Napoleon finally realized he had blundered into battle as he was massively outnumbered, and immediately ordered a masked retreat. By the time the Austrian Field Marshal Schwarzenberg realized Napoleon was retreating, most of the French had already disengaged and the Allied pursuit afterwards failed to prevent the remaining French army from safely withdrawing to the north. This was Napoleon's penultimate battle before his abdication and exile to Elba, the last being the Battle of Saint-Dizier.

Bitka pri Arcolu ali bitka pri Arcoli (15.–17. novembra 1796) (francosko: Bataille du pont d'Arcole, nemško: Schlacht bei Arcole) je potekala med francoskimi in avstrijskimi silami 25 kilometrov jugovzhodno od Verone v vojni prve koalicije, delu francoskih revolucionarnih vojn. V bitki je Napoleon Bonaparte s francosko italijansko armado drzno obšel avstrijsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Józsefa Alvinczija in ji odrezal pot umika. Francoska zmaga se je izkazala za zelo pomembno v tretjem avstrijskem poskusu, da bi prekinili obleganje Mantove. Alvinczi je načrtoval dvostransko ofenzivo proti Bonapartovi vojski. Avstrijski poveljnik je ukazal Paulu Davidovichu, naj s korpusom napreduje proti jugu po dolini reke Adige, medtem ko bo Alvinczi z glavno vojsko napredoval z vzhoda. Avstrijci so upali, da bodo prekinili obleganje Mantove, kjer je bil z močno posadko ujet Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser. Če bi se obe avstrijski koloni povezali in bi bile Wurmserjeve čete osvobojene, bi bile francoske možnosti klavrne.

source.title: Battle of Arcole
paragraphs: The Battle of Arcole or Battle of Arcola (15–17 November 1796) (French: Bataille du pont d'Arcole, German: Schlacht bei Arcole) was fought between French and Austrian forces 25 kilometres (16 mi) southeast of Verona during the War of the First Coalition, a part of the French Revolutionary Wars. The battle saw a bold maneuver by Napoleon Bonaparte's French Army of Italy to outflank the Austrian army led by József Alvinczi and cut off its line of retreat. The French victory proved to be a highly significant event during the third Austrian attempt to lift the siege of Mantua. Alvinczi planned to execute a two-pronged offensive against Bonaparte's army. The Austrian commander ordered Paul Davidovich to advance south along the Adige River valley with one corps while Alvinczi led the main army in an advance from the east. The Austrians hoped to raise the siege of Mantua where Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser was trapped with a large garrison. If the two Austrian columns linked up and if Wurmser's troops were released, French prospects were grim.

Battle of Arnemuiden.headline: Bitka pri Arnemuidnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arnemuidnu je bila pomorska bitka 23. septembra 1338 na začetku stoletne vojne med Anglijo in Francijo. Bila je prva pomorska bitka stoletne vojne in prva zabeležena evropska pomorska bitka, v kateri so uporabili topništvo: angleška ladja Christopher je imela tri topove in eno ročno puško.

V bitki se je velika francoska flota pod poveljstvom admiralov Huguesa Quiéreta in Nicolasa Béhucheta spopadla z majhno eskadro petih velikih angleških kog, ki so v Antwerpen vozile ogromen tovor volne; angleški kralj Edvard III. ga je tam nameraval prodati, da bi lahko plačal podpore svojim zaveznikom. Bitka je potekala blizu Arnemuidna, pristanišča na otoku Walcheren (danes na Nizozemskem, tedaj pa v grofiji Flandriji, ki je formalno spadala h Kraljevini Franciji). Poveljnik eskadre John Kingston se je po dnevu boja vdal, saj ga je premagala številčna premoč, del posadke pa je bil še na kopnem.
Francozi so zaplenili bogati tovor, pet kog vključili v svojo floto in pobili angleške ujetnike. O tem poročajo tudi kronike.
notes: The English excerpt ends with "The chronicles write:" before a quotation that is not included; the Slovenian closes the paragraph with a full stop.

source.title: Battle of Arnemuiden
paragraphs: The Battle of Arnemuiden was a naval battle fought on 23 September 1338 at the start of the Hundred Years' War between England and France. It was the first naval battle of the Hundred Years' War and the first recorded European naval battle using artillery, as the English ship Christopher had three cannons and one handgun.

The battle featured a vast French fleet under admirals Hugues Quiéret and Nicolas Béhuchet against a small squadron of five great English cogs transporting an enormous cargo of wool to Antwerp, where Edward III of England was hoping to sell it, in order to be able to pay subsidies to his allies. It occurred near Arnemuiden, the port of the island of Walcheren (now in the Netherlands, but then part of the County of Flanders, formally part of the Kingdom of France). Overwhelmed by the superior numbers and with some of their crew still on shore, John Kingston, the commander of the squadron, surrendered after a day's fighting.
The French captured the rich cargo, took the five cogs into their fleet and massacred the English prisoners. The chronicles write:

Battle of Arnhem.headline: Bitka pri Arnhemu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arnhemu je potekala med drugo svetovno vojno v okviru zavezniške operacije Market Garden, od 17. do 26. septembra 1944 okoli nizozemskega mesta Arnhem. Zavezniki so avgusta 1944 po bitki za Normandijo hitro prodrli prek Francije in Belgije. Operacija Market Garden je temeljila na manjši operaciji Comet, ki so jo prehiteli dogodki. Načrt je podprl feldmaršal sir Bernard Montgomery, ki se je zavzemal za en sam prodor proti severu prek rokavov Spodnjega Rena, s katerim bi britanska 2. armada obšla Siegfriedovo linijo in napadla pomembno industrijsko območje Porurja.

Prva zavezniška zračnoprevozna armada naj bi zavzela mostove in zavarovala pot 2. armadi: ameriške, britanske in poljske zračnoprevozne enote naj bi odvrgli na Nizozemsko vzdolž smeri kopenskega prodora, nato pa naj bi jih razbremenil britanski XXX. korpus. Najbolj severno je pri Arnhemu pristala britanska 1. zračnoprevozna divizija, da bi zavzela mostove čez Nederrijn (Spodnji Ren), za njo pa naj bi prišla še 1. poljska padalska brigada. XXX. korpus naj bi Arnhem dosegel v dveh do treh dneh.
notes: The English sentence on Montgomery has no main verb ("Field Marshal Sir Bernard Montgomery, who favoured …"); the Slovenian makes it a full sentence (he backed the plan).

source.title: Battle of Arnhem
paragraphs: The Battle of Arnhem was fought during the Second World War, as part of the Allied Operation Market Garden. It took place around the Dutch city of Arnhem from 17 to 26 September 1944. The Allies had swept through France and Belgium in August 1944, after the Battle of Normandy. Market Garden was based upon the smaller Operation Comet that had been overtaken by events. Field Marshal Sir Bernard Montgomery, who favoured a single push northwards over the branches of the Lower Rhine River, allowing the British Second Army to bypass the Siegfried Line and attack the important Ruhr industrial area.

The First Allied Airborne Army was to capture the bridges to secure a route for the Second Army with US, British and Polish airborne troops dropped in the Netherlands along the line of the ground advance, being relieved by the British XXX Corps. Farthest north, the British 1st Airborne Division landed at Arnhem to capture bridges across the Nederrijn (Lower Rhine), with the 1st Polish Parachute Brigade following on. XXX Corps was expected to reach Arnhem in two to three days.

Battle of Arras (1914).headline: Bitka pri Arrasu (1914)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arrasu (znana tudi kot prva bitka pri Arrasu, 1.–4. oktobra 1914) je bila poskus francoske vojske, da bi obšla nemško vojsko, ki je med »dirko do morja« skušala storiti isto; z vzajemnimi poskusi sta strani hoteli izkoristiti razmere, ki so nastale v prvi bitki na Aisni. V prvi bitki v Pikardiji (22.–26. septembra) sta obe strani napadli v pričakovanju, da bosta prodrli okoli odprtega severnega krila, a sta namesto tega ugotovili, da so z juga prispele nove čete in krilo podaljšale proti severu.

source.title: Battle of Arras (1914)
paragraphs: The Battle of Arras (also known as the First Battle of Arras, 1–4 October 1914), was an attempt by the French Army to outflank the German Army, which was attempting to do the same thing during the "Race to the Sea", their reciprocal attempts to exploit conditions created during the First Battle of the Aisne. At the First Battle of Picardy (22–26 September) each side had attacked expecting to advance round an open northern flank and found instead that troops had arrived from further south and extended the flank northwards.

Bitka pri Arrasu, znana tudi kot druga bitka pri Arrasu, je bila britanska ofenziva na zahodni fronti med prvo svetovno vojno. Britanske čete so od 9. aprila do 16. maja 1917 napadale nemške obrambne položaje pri francoskem mestu Arras. Britanci so dosegli najdaljši prodor, odkar se je začelo rovovsko bojevanje, in presegli rekord, ki ga je francoska 6. armada postavila 1. julija 1916, prvi dan bitke na Sommi. V naslednjih dneh se je britansko napredovanje upočasnilo, nemška obramba pa se je opomogla. Bitka se je za obe strani sprevrgla v drag pat: do njenega konca sta britanska 3. in 1. armada utrpeli okoli 160.000 izgub, nemška 6. armada pa okoli 125.000.

source.title: Battle of Arras (1917)
paragraphs: The Battle of Arras, also known as the Second Battle of Arras, was a British offensive on the Western Front during the First World War. From 9 April to 16 May 1917, British troops attacked German defences near the French city of Arras on the Western Front. The British achieved the longest advance since trench warfare had begun, surpassing the record set by the French Sixth Army on 1 July 1916 in the First day on the Somme. The British advance slowed in the next few days and the German defence recovered. The battle became a costly stalemate for both sides and by the end of the battle, the British Third Army and the First Army had suffered about 160,000 casualties and the German 6th Army about 125,000.

Battle of Arras (1940).headline: Bitka pri Arrasu (1940)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arrasu je potekala 21. maja 1940 med bitko za Francijo v drugi svetovni vojni. Po nemški invaziji na Nizke dežele 10. maja so francoske in britanske sile prodrle v Belgijo. Nemški načrt pohoda Fall Gelb (primer Rumeno) se je razvil v slepilno operacijo na Nizozemskem in v Belgiji, glavni udar pa je šel prek Ardenov. Nemške enote so v bitki pri Sedanu prečkale Mozo, ne da bi čakale na okrepitve. Namesto da bi utrdili mostišča na zahodnem bregu Moze, so Nemci začeli prodirati po dolini reke Somme proti Rokavskemu prelivu.

Zavezniki so zapadli v zmedo, njihovi poskusi, da bi odrezali konice tankovskih klinov, pa so se sprevrgli v občasne, neusklajene protinapade, ki nikoli niso zbrali dovolj sil za uspeh, saj so bile glavne zavezniške vojske v Belgiji. Ofenzivo pri Arrasu so Britanci in Francozi načrtovali, da bi razbremenili britansko posadko v mestu Arras, a je niso uskladili z napadom Francozov z juga nemškega tankovskega koridorja.

source.title: Battle of Arras (1940)
paragraphs: The Battle of Arras took place on 21 May 1940, during the Battle of France in the Second World War. Following the German invasion of the Low Countries on 10 May, French and British forces advanced into Belgium. The German campaign plan Fall Gelb (Case Yellow) had evolved into a decoy operation in the Netherlands and Belgium, with the main effort through the Ardennes. German units crossed the Meuse without waiting for reinforcements at the Battle of Sedan. Instead of consolidating bridgeheads on the west bank of the Meuse, the Germans began an advance down the Somme river valley towards the English Channel.

The Allies were thrown into confusion and their attempts to cut off the panzer spearheads degenerated into sporadic, un-coordinated counter-attacks which never achieved sufficient concentration to succeed as the main Allied armies were in Belgium. The offensive at Arras was planned by the British and French to relieve the pressure on the British garrison in the town of Arras and was not coordinated with an attack by the French from the south of the German panzer corridor.

Battle of Arretium.headline: Bitka pri Arretiumu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Arretiumu, ki je verjetno potekala leta 284 pr. n. št., je slabo dokumentiran dogodek iz zgodovine Rimske republike, ker se je zgodila v obdobju, za katero so nekatere knjige Livijeve Rimske zgodovine, najpodrobnejšega antičnega zgodovinarja zgodnjega Rima, izgubljene. Bitka je izrecno omenjena le v besedilu Polibija, antičnega grškega zgodovinarja, ki ne navaja veliko podrobnosti in jo postavlja v okvir drugih dogodkov. O teh dogodkih govori tudi besedilo Apijana, a bitke pri Arretiumu izrecno ne omenja. Bitka je bila med Rimljani in Galci iz severne Italije, ki so bili morda iz plemena Senonov.

Po Polibiju so neimenovani Galci oblegali mesto Arretium (Arezzo na severovzhodu Toskane) in porazili rimsko vojsko, ki je mestu prišla na pomoč. Njihov poveljnik, pretor Lucij Cecilij Metel Denter, je v bitki padel. Zato bi bitka spadala v leto 283 pr. n. št., ker je bil Denter konzul leta 284 pr. n. št.

source.title: Battle of Arretium
paragraphs: The Battle of Arretium, which was probably fought in 284 BC, is a poorly documented event in the history of the Roman Republic because it occurred in a period for which some of the books of the History of Rome by Livy, the most thorough ancient historian for early Rome, have been lost. The battle is only explicitly referred to in a text by Polybius, the ancient Greek historian, which does not give much detail and puts it in the context of other events. A text by Appian talks about these events, but does not make any explicit reference to the Battle of Arretium. It was fought between the Romans and the Gauls of northern Italy, who may have been from the Senone tribe.

According to Polybius, unspecified Gauls besieged the city of Arretium (Arezzo, in northeastern Tuscany) and defeated a Roman force which had come to the aid of the city. Their commander, the praetor Lucius Caecilius Metellus Denter, died in the battle. This would place the battle in 283 BC because Denter was a consul in 284 BC.

Battle of Artemisium.headline: Bitka pri Artemiziju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Artemiziju ali Artemizionu je bila vrsta pomorskih spopadov v treh dneh med drugo perzijsko invazijo na Grčijo. Potekala je hkrati s kopensko bitko pri Termopilah, avgusta ali septembra 480 pr. n. št., ob obali Evbeje; v njej se je zavezništvo grških mestnih držav, med njimi Šparte, Aten, Korinta in drugih, spopadlo s Perzijskim cesarstvom Kserksa I.

Perzijska invazija je bila zapozneli odziv na poraz prve perzijske invazije na Grčijo, ki se je končala z atensko zmago v bitki na Maratonskem polju. Kralj Kserks je zbral ogromno vojsko in ladjevje ter se odpravil osvojit vso Grčijo. Atenski vojskovodja Temistoklej je predlagal, naj zavezniški Grki perzijski vojski zaprejo pot pri prelazu Termopile in hkrati perzijskemu ladjevju v ožini pri Artemiziju. Zato so poslali zavezniško ladjevje z 271 triremami, da počaka na prihod Perzijcev.

source.title: Battle of Artemisium
paragraphs: The Battle of Artemisium or Artemision was a series of naval engagements over three days during the second Persian invasion of Greece. The battle took place simultaneously with the land battle at Thermopylae, in August or September 480 BC, off the coast of Euboea and was fought between an alliance of Greek city-states, including Sparta, Athens, Corinth and others, and the Persian Empire of Xerxes I.

The Persian invasion was a delayed response to the defeat of the first Persian invasion of Greece, which had been ended by the Athenian victory at the Battle of Marathon. King Xerxes had amassed a huge army and navy, and set out to conquer all of Greece. The Athenian general Themistocles proposed that the Allied Greeks block the advance of the Persian army at the pass of Thermopylae and simultaneously block the Persian navy at the Straits of Artemisium. An Allied naval force of 271 triremes was thus dispatched to await the arrival of the Persians.

Bitka pri Askulu je bila bitka, ki je potekala blizu Askula (današnji Ascoli Satriano) leta 279 pr. n. št. in je po mnenju nekaterih trajala en dan, po mnenju drugih dva. Na eni strani je bila Rimska republika pod poveljstvom konzulov Publija Decija Musa (ki je po nekaterih virih umrl že pred bitko) in Publija Sulpicija Saverriona, na drugi pa vojska epirskega kralja Pira. Bitka je potekala v Pirovi vojni, po bitki pri Heraklei leta 280 pr. n. št., prvi bitki te vojne. Obstajajo samo poročila treh antičnih zgodovinarjev, Dionizija Halikarnaškega, Plutarha in Kasija Diona, čeprav ti sami navajajo druge zgodovinarje, katerih dela so danes izgubljena. Askul je bil na ozemlju Lukancev v južni Italiji.

source.title: Battle of Asculum
paragraphs: The Battle of Asculum was a battle that took place near Asculum (modern Ascoli Satriano) in 279 BC, and was thought to have lasted either one or two days, between the Roman Republic under the command of the consuls Publius Decius Mus (who by some accounts died before the battle) and Publius Sulpicius Saverrio, and the forces of King Pyrrhus of Epirus. The battle took place during the Pyrrhic War, after the Battle of Heraclea of 280 BC, which was the first battle of the war. There currently exist accounts of this battle only by three ancient historians: Dionysius of Halicarnassus, Plutarch, and Cassius Dio, although these historians in turn reference other historians whose work is now lost. Asculum was in Lucanian territory, in southern Italy.

Battle of Asfeld.headline: Bitka pri Asfeldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Asfeldu je potekala leta 552 med Langobardi in Gepidi. Zmagali so Langobardi pod vodstvom kralja Avdoina (ki mu je pomagal svak Amalafrid), v bitki pa je padel Turismod, sin kralja Torisinda.

source.title: Battle of Asfeld
paragraphs: The Battle of Asfeld was fought in 552 between the Lombards and the Gepids. The Lombards, led by King Audoin (with the help of his brother-in-law Amalafrid), were victorious, and, Turismod, the son of King Thorisind, was slain in the battle.

Battle of Ashdown.headline: Bitka pri Ashdownu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ashdownu je bila zmaga Zahodnih Sasov nad dansko vikinško vojsko okoli 8. januarja 871. Kraj Ashdown ni znan, morda pa je to Kingstanding Hill v Berkshiru. Drugi pisci postavljajo bitko blizu Starvealla, malo severno od vasi Aldworth in jugovzhodno od Lowbury Hilla.

Zahodne Sase sta vodila kralj Æthelred in njegov mlajši brat, poznejši kralj Alfred Veliki, vikinška poveljnika pa sta bila Bagsecg in Halfdan. Bitko opisujeta Anglosaška kronika in Asserjevo delo Življenje kralja Alfreda.

source.title: Battle of Ashdown
paragraphs: The Battle of Ashdown was a West Saxon victory over a Danish Viking army on about 8 January 871. The location of Ashdown is not known, but may be Kingstanding Hill in Berkshire. Other writers place the battle near Starveall, a short distance north of the village of Aldworth and south east of Lowbury Hill.

The West Saxons were led by King Æthelred and his younger brother, the future King Alfred the Great, while the Viking commanders were Bagsecg and Halfdan. The battle is described in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle and Asser's Life of King Alfred.

Battle of Asiago.headline: Bitka pri Asiagu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Asiagu, znana tudi kot južnotirolska ofenziva ali bitka za planote (italijansko: Battaglia degli Altipiani), po krivem imenovana tudi Strafexpedition (nemško »kaznovalna odprava«; to ime ni zapisano v uradni avstrijski dokumentaciji tistega časa in velja za ljudskega izvora), se je začela z veliko ofenzivo, ki so jo 15. maja 1916 sprožili Avstro-Ogri na območju Vicentinskih Alp na italijanski fronti prve svetovne vojne. Ofenziva je bila »nepričakovan« napad na planoti Asiago (provinca Vicenza, severovzhodna Italija, tedaj na meji med Kraljevino Italijo in Avstro-Ogrsko) po peti soški bitki (marca 1916). Avstro-ogrski ofenzivi, sprva uspešni, je sledila italijanska protiofenziva, ki je ponovno osvojila velik del izgubljenega ozemlja in Asiago.
Spomin na to bitko in v prvi svetovni vojni padle vojake ohranja Vojni spomenik v Asiagu (provinca Vicenza, Veneto, severovzhodna Italija).

source.title: Battle of Asiago
paragraphs: The Battle of Asiago, also known as Südtirol Offensive or Battle of the Plateaux (in Italian: Battaglia degli Altipiani), wrongly nicknamed Strafexpedition (German for "punitive expedition"; this name has no reference in official Austrian documentation of the time and it is considered to be of popular origin), began with a major offensive launched on 15 May 1916 by the Austro-Hungarians on the territory of Vicentine Alps in the Italian Front of World War I. It was an "unexpected" attack that took place in the Asiago plateau (province of Vicenza, in northeast Italy, then at the border between the Kingdom of Italy and Austria-Hungary) after the Fifth Battle of the Isonzo (March 1916). The Austro-Hungarian offensive, initially successful, was followed by an Italian counter-offensive reconquering much of the lost ground and Asiago.
Commemorating this battle and the soldiers killed in World War I is the Asiago War Memorial (province of Vicenza, Veneto, northeast Italy).

Battle of Aspern–Essling.headline: Bitka pri Aspernu in Esslingu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Aspernu in Esslingu je potekala 21. in 22. maja 1809: Napoleon je prečkal Donavo blizu Dunaja, Avstrijci pod vodstvom nadvojvode Karla pa so Francoze in njihove zaveznike napadli in jih potisnili nazaj čez reko. Napoleon je bil prvič osebno poražen v veliki bitki; to je bil tudi njegov prvi poraz v bitki po 10 letih, od obleganja Akre, in prvi poraz v bitki kot voditelja države, čeprav je taktične poraze utrpel že v bitki pri Caldieru in v drugi bitki pri Bassanu. Nadvojvoda Karel je Francoze pregnal, a njihove vojske ni uničil. Francozi so izgubili približno 23.000 mož, med njimi enega Napoleonovih najsposobnejših poveljnikov in najbližjih prijateljev, maršala Jeana Lannesa.

source.title: Battle of Aspern–Essling
paragraphs: In the Battle of Aspern–Essling (21–22 May 1809), Napoleon crossed the Danube near Vienna, but the French and their allies were attacked and forced back across the river by the Austrians under Archduke Charles. It was the first time Napoleon had been personally defeated in a major battle, as well as his first battle defeat in 10 years since the siege of Acre, and his first battle defeat as head of state, although he did suffer a tactical defeat in the Battle of Caldiero and in the Second Battle of Bassano. Archduke Charles drove out the French but fell short of destroying their army. The French lost approximately 23,000 men, including one of Napoleon's ablest field commanders and closest friends, Marshal Jean Lannes.

Battle of Assandun.headline: Bitka pri Assandunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Assandunu (ali Ashingdonu) je potekala 18. oktobra 1016 med dansko in angleško vojsko. Ni soglasja, ali je Assandun Ashdon blizu Saffron Waldna v severnem Essexu v Angliji ali, kot so dolgo domnevali, Ashingdon blizu Rochforda v jugovzhodnem Essexu. Končala se je z zmago Dancev pod kraljem Knutom, ki je premagal angleško vojsko kralja Edmunda Železnega. Bitki je sledila pogodba, ki je Anglijo razdelila med Knuta in Edmunda, a je Edmund kmalu umrl in Knut je, kot je bilo dogovorjeno, postal nesporni kralj.

source.title: Battle of Assandun
paragraphs: The Battle of Assandun (or Ashingdon) was fought between Danish and English armies on 18 October 1016. There is disagreement whether Assandun may be Ashdon near Saffron Walden in north Essex, England, or, as long supposed, Ashingdon near Rochford in south-east Essex. It ended in victory for the Danes, led by King Cnut, who triumphed over an English army led by King Edmund Ironside. The battle was followed by a treaty dividing England between Cnut and Edmund, but Edmund died shortly afterwards and Cnut then became undisputed king as had been agreed.

Battle of Assietta.headline: Bitka pri Assietti
paragraphs: Bitka pri Assietti je bila pomemben spopad avstrijske nasledstvene vojne, v katerem se je številčno močnejša francoska vojska 25.000–40.000 mož pod poveljstvom Louisa Fouqueta, viteza de Belle-Isle, spopadla s sardinsko vojsko 7000–15.000 mož pod vodstvom Giovannija di Bricherasia. Francozi so bili odločno poraženi, njihov poveljnik Belle-Isle pa je med bitko padel. Spopad je bil del italijanske kampanje avstrijske nasledstvene vojne, v kateri sta se Habsburžani in Burboni borila za premoč nad severno Italijo in različnimi italijanskimi državami. Kraljevina Sardinija se je vojni leta 1742 pridružila na strani pragmatičnih zaveznikov in se zavzela za Marijo Terezijo. Skrbelo jo je tudi naraščanje francoskega vpliva na njenih ozemljih. Vojna v Italiji je takrat trajala že sedem let, sardinska vojska pa je na bojišču že utrpela več porazov, zato se je odločila za bolj obrambni pristop. Francozi so med vojno vodili več odprav v Italiji in svoje sile združevali s španskimi Burboni, da bi dosegli svoje politične cilje.
notes: The English calls the battle a siege in its third sentence; the Slovenian says spopad.

source.title: Battle of Assietta
paragraphs: The Battle of Assietta was a significant engagement of the War of the Austrian Succession and pitted a numerically superior French force of 25,000–40,000 men under the command of Louis Fouquet, Chevalier de Belle-Isle against a Sardinian army of 7,000–15,000 men led by Giovanni di Bricherasio. The French were soundly defeated and their commander, Belle-Isle, killed during the course of the battle. The siege was part of the Italian campaign of the War of the Austrian Succession, in which Habsburgs and Bourbons contested for domination over Northern Italy and the various Italian states. The Kingdom of Sardinia joined the war on the side of the Pragmatic Allies in 1742 and rallied itself to Maria Theresa's cause. There were also concerns about growing French influence in its territories. The war in Italy had already been going on for seven years, and the Sardinian army had already suffered several defeats in the field, leading to them opting for a more defensive approach. The French led several expeditions in Italy during the war, combining their forces with the Spanish Bourbons to accomplish their political aims.

Battle of Athos.headline: Bitka pri Atosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Atosu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Monte Santu ali bitka pri Lemnosu) je potekala 1. in 2. julija 1807 po novem koledarju v napoleonskih vojnah, med rusko-turško vojno 1806–1812. Ruska eskadra pod poveljstvom viceadmirala Dmitrija Senjavina je premagala osmansko eskadro kapudan paše Sejdi Alija.

source.title: Battle of Athos
paragraphs: The Battle of Athos (also known as the Battle of Monte Sancto or the Battle of Lemnos) took place on 1–2 July 1807New Style as a part of the Napoleonic Wars during the Russo-Turkish War of 1806–1812. The Russian squadron under Vice Admiral Dmitry Senyavin defeated Kapudan Pasha Seydi Ali's Ottoman Turkish squadron.

Battle of Atoleiros.headline: Bitka pri Atoleirosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Atoleirosu je potekala 6. aprila 1384 med portugalskimi silami in kazensko odpravo, ki jo je iz Kastilije poslal Ivan I. Bitka se je odvila blizu kraja Fronteira v Alenteju in je bila prva večja bitka krize v letih 1383–1385.

Nuno Álvares Pereira je bil izbran za obrambo meje na tem območju, saj so se bali, da bi kastiljska vojska lahko tu vdrla na Portugalsko. Iz Lizbone je odšel s 1000 pešci in na poti v Atoleiros okrepil svoje sile. Kastiljsko vojsko je sestavljalo okoli 5000 mož, večinoma konjenikov, ki so oblegali vas Fronteira. Ko se je Pereira približal, so mu Kastiljci poslali odposlanca, ki naj bi ga prepričal, da se umakne. Pereira je zavrnil, Kastiljci pa so prekinili obleganje in mu šli naproti. Portugalci so se postavili v obrambni kvadrat. V kratki bitki, ki je sledila, kastiljska konjenica portugalske formacije ni mogla prebiti in je utrpela hude izgube. Portugalci izgub niso imeli, Kastiljci pa so se umaknili.
notes: The Portuguese pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Atoleiros
paragraphs: The Battle of Atoleiros (Portuguese pronunciation: [ɐtuˈlɐjɾuʃ]) took place on 6 April 1384, between a Portuguese force and a punitive expedition from Castile sent by John I. The battle took place near the population centre of Fronteira in Alentejo. It was the first major battle of the 1383–1385 Crisis.

Nuno Álvares Pereira had been chosen to protect the frontier in this area, amid fear that a Castilian force could enter Portugal here. He left Lisbon with 1,000 infantry, adding to the strength of his forces on his way to Atoleiros. The Castilian army consisted of some 5,000 men, mostly cavalry, which was besieging the village of Fronteira. As Pereira approached, the Castilians sent an emissary to him, attempting to persuade him to retire. He refused, and the Castilians advanced to meet him, lifting the siege. The Portuguese formed a defensive square. In the short battle that followed, the Castilian cavalry was unable to break the Portuguese formation, suffering heavy losses. The Portuguese suffered none, and the Castilians withdrew.

Battle of Auberoche.headline: Bitka pri Auberochu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Auberochu je potekala 21. oktobra 1345 med gaskonjskim pohodom leta 1345: anglo-gaskonjska vojska 1200 mož pod poveljstvom Henrika, grofa Derbyja, se je spopadla s francosko vojsko 7000 mož, ki ji je poveljeval Ludvik Poitierski. Bojevali so se pri vasi Auberoche blizu Périgueuxa v severni Akvitaniji. Gaskonja je bila tedaj ozemlje angleške krone in v »angleški« vojski je bilo veliko domačih Gaskonjcev. Bitka se je končala s hudim porazom Francozov, ki so utrpeli zelo velike izgube, njihovi poveljniki pa so padli ali bili ujeti.

Bitka je potekala v zgodnji fazi stoletne vojne. Skupaj z bitko pri Bergeracu nekoliko prej istega leta je spremenila vojaško razmerje moči v pokrajini, saj se je francoski položaj nato sesul. Bila je ena v vrsti zmag, zaradi katerih je sodobni kronist Henrika Lancastrskega imenoval »enega najboljših bojevnikov na svetu«.

source.title: Battle of Auberoche
paragraphs: The Battle of Auberoche was fought on 21 October 1345 during the Gascon campaign of 1345 between an Anglo-Gascon force of 1,200 men under Henry, Earl of Derby, and a French army of 7,000 commanded by Louis of Poitiers. It was fought at the village of Auberoche near Périgueux in northern Aquitaine. At the time, Gascony was a territory of the English Crown and the "English" army included a large proportion of native Gascons. The battle resulted in a heavy defeat for the French, who suffered very high casualties, with their leaders killed or captured.

The battle took place during the early stages of the Hundred Years' War. Along with the Battle of Bergerac earlier in the year, it marked a change in the military balance of power in the region as the French position subsequently collapsed. It was one of a series of victories which would lead to Henry of Lancaster being called "one of the best warriors in the world" by a contemporary chronicler.

Battle of Augusta.headline: Bitka pri Augusti
paragraphs: Bitka pri Augusti je potekala blizu Auguste na Siciliji 22. aprila 1676 v francosko-nizozemski vojni. Nastopilo je francosko ladjevje pod Abrahamom Duquesnom ter združeno nizozemsko-špansko ladjevje pod skupnim poveljstvom Francisca de la Cerde.

Večino bitke je bil udeležen le del vsakega ladjevja in kljub hudim izgubam in težkim poškodbam nobena stran ni izgubila nobene ladje. Končala se je, ko je nizozemski admiral Michiel de Ruyter svojo eskadro rešil pred napadom premočnih francoskih sil, vendar je bil pri tem smrtno ranjen. Ladjevji sta se naslednji dan ločili brez nadaljevanja bitke, izid pa je ostal neodločen.

source.title: Battle of Augusta
paragraphs: The Battle of Augusta took place near Augusta, Sicily on 22 April 1676 during the Franco-Dutch War. It featured a French fleet under Abraham Duquesne, and a combined Dutch-Spanish fleet, under the overall command of Francisco de la Cerda.

For much of the battle, only part of each fleet was engaged, and despite heavy casualties and severe damage, neither side lost any ships. It ended when the Dutch admiral, Michiel de Ruyter, extracted his squadron from being attacked by superior French numbers, although he was mortally wounded in doing so. The fleets separated next day without resuming the battle, and the result was inconclusive.

Battle of Auray.headline: Bitka pri Aurayju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Aurayju (29. septembra 1364) pri mestu Auray v Bretanji je bila odločilni spopad bretonske nasledstvene vojne, ki je bila del stoletne vojne.

V bitki, ki se je začela kot obleganje, se je bretonska vojska vojvode Ivana Montforta, ki so ji pomagale angleške sile pod poveljstvom Johna Chandosa, spopadla z bretonsko vojsko njegovega tekmeca Karla Bloiškega, ki so ji pomagale francoske sile pod vodstvom Bertranda du Guesclina.

source.title: Battle of Auray
paragraphs: The Battle of Auray (29 September 1364) at the Breton-French town of Auray was the decisive confrontation of the Breton War of Succession, a part of the Hundred Years' War.

In the battle, which began as a siege, a Breton army, led by Duke John de Montfort, assisted by English forces commanded by John Chandos, opposed a Breton army led by his rival Charles of Blois and assisted by French forces led by Bertrand du Guesclin.

Bitka za Avdijivko je bila velika bitka med ruskimi in ukrajinskimi oboroženimi silami za nadzor nad Avdijivko, mestom v Doneški oblasti, med rusko-ukrajinsko vojno (od leta 2022). Po več kot letu in pol občasnih bojev na obrobju mesta so ruske sile 10. oktobra 2023 začele ofenzivo za zavzetje Avdijivke, ki je veljala za eno najbolj krvavih in najsrditejših bitk vojne.

Avdijivka je bila eno najbolj utrjenih naselij v Ukrajini in so jo opisovali kot »vrata« do bližnjega pokrajinskega središča Doneck. Ukrajinski nadzor nad Avdijivko je ruskim silam preprečeval, da bi Doneck in njegove vire uporabljale kot komunikacijsko vozlišče, in onemogočal ruske preboje na tej smeri.

Vrhovni poveljnik Oleksandr Sirski je 17. februarja 2024, ko so bile zadnje ukrajinske oskrbovalne poti v mesto resno ogrožene, sporočil, da ukrajinske sile umikajo iz mesta, »da bi se izognili obkolitvi ter ohranili življenje in zdravje vojakov«.

source.title: Battle of Avdiivka (2023–2024)
paragraphs: The Battle of Avdiivka was a major battle between the Russian and Ukrainian Armed Forces for control of Avdiivka, a city in Donetsk Oblast, during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present). After more than a year and a half of intermittent fighting along the city's outskirts, Russian forces launched an offensive to capture Avdiivka on 10 October 2023, resulting in what was considered one of the bloodiest and fiercest battles of the war.

Avdiivka was one of the most fortified settlements in Ukraine and had been described as a "gateway" to the nearby provincial capital of Donetsk. Ukraine's control of Avdiivka had prevented Russian forces from using Donetsk and its resources as a communications hub and prevented Russian breakthroughs on this axis.

On 17 February 2024, with the last Ukrainian supply routes into the city under serious threat, commander-in-chief Oleksandr Syrskyi announced that Ukrainian forces were being withdrawn from the city "to avoid encirclement and preserve the lives and health of service personnel."

Battle of Badajoz (1936).headline: Bitka za Badajoz (1936)
paragraphs: Bitka za Badajoz je bila eden prvih večjih spopadov španske državljanske vojne in se je končala s taktično in strateško zmago nacionalistov, ki pa jih je stala precej časa in vojakov.
