Po več dneh obstreljevanja in bombardiranja so nacionalisti 14. avgusta 1936 naskočili utrjeno obmejno mesto Badajoz, s čimer so Špansko republiko odrezali od sosednje Portugalske in povezali severno in južno območje pod nacionalističnim nadzorom (čeprav so dejanski stik s severnimi enotami generala Emilia Mole vzpostavili šele 8. septembra).

source.title: Battle of Badajoz (1936)
paragraphs: The Battle of Badajoz was one of the first major engagements of the Spanish Civil War, resulting in a tactical and strategic Nationalist victory, however at a significant cost in time and troops. After several days of shelling and bombardment, Nationalists stormed the fortified border city of Badajoz on August 14, 1936, cutting off the Spanish Republic from neighbouring Portugal and linking the northern and southern zones of Nationalist control (although actual contact with General Emilio Mola's northern troops was not established until September 8).

Battle of Badon.headline: Bitka pri Badonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Badonu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Mons Badonicus, naj bi v porimski Britaniji v začetku 6. stoletja potekala med Briti in Anglosasi. Pripisujejo ji veliko zmago Britov, ki je za nekaj časa ustavila širjenje anglosaških kraljestev proti zahodu.

Najzgodnejšo znano omembo bitke je okoli let 543–547 zapisal britanski klerik Gildas. Danes je bitka znana predvsem po udeležbi moža, ki so se ga pozneje spominjali kot legendarnega kralja Arturja. Njegovo ime ni znano, ime v obliki »Artur« pa se prvič pojavi v Historii Brittonum iz 9. stoletja, kjer je omenjen kot vojskovodja, ki se je bitke udeležil skupaj z britonskimi kralji, sam pa ni opisan kot kralj. Ker je virov malo, o datumu, kraju in poteku bojev ni gotovosti, razen da so zmagali Briti.

source.title: Battle of Badon
paragraphs: The Battle of Badon, also known as the Battle of Mons Badonicus, was purportedly fought between Britons and Anglo-Saxons in Post-Roman Britain during the early 6th century. It was credited as a major victory for the Britons, stopping the westward encroachment of the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms for a period.

The earliest known references to the battle, by the British cleric Gildas, was written c. 543–547. It is chiefly known today for the involvement of the man who would later be remembered as the legendary King Arthur. His name is not known, although the name under the form "Arthur" first appears in the 9th-century Historia Brittonum, where he is mentioned as having participated in the battle alongside the Brittonic kings as a war commander, though is not described as a king himself. Because of the limited number of sources, there is no certainty about the date, location, or details of the fighting apart from the result being a victory for the Britons.

Battle of Baecula.headline: Bitka pri Baeculi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Baeculi je bila velika bitka na Iberskem polotoku v drugi punski vojni. Rimske republikanske sile in iberske pomožne enote pod poveljstvom Scipiona Afriškega so pognale v beg kartažansko vojsko Hasdrubala Barke.

source.title: Battle of Baecula
paragraphs: The Battle of Baecula was a major field battle in Iberia during the Second Punic War. Roman Republican and Iberian auxiliary forces under the command of Scipio Africanus routed the Carthaginian army of Hasdrubal Barca.

Battle of Bakhmach.headline: Bitka pri Bahmaču
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bahmaču (češko: Bitva u Bachmače) je bila ena zadnjih bitk na vzhodni fronti prve svetovne vojne; češkoslovaška legija, ki jo je podpirala antanta, in sovjetska Rusija sta se v njej spopadli s centralnimi silami, ki so po brestlitovskem miru zasedale Ukrajino. Trajala je od 8. do 13. marca 1918, boji pa so se vrteli okoli mesta Bahmač; za Sovjete je bil to zadnji spopad v prvi svetovni vojni. Po zmagi legije so se Nemci pogajali za premirje.

source.title: Battle of Bakhmach
paragraphs: Battle of Bakhmach (Bitva u Bachmače in Czech), was one of the last battles on the Eastern Front in World War I between the Entente-backed Czechoslovak Legion, Soviet Russia and the Central Powers occupying Ukraine after the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk. The battle lasted from March 8 to March 13, 1918, over the city of Bakhmach and was the last engagement in World War I for the Soviets. Following a Legion victory, the Germans negotiated a truce.

Bitka za Bahmut je bila velika bitka med ruskimi in ukrajinskimi oboroženimi silami za nadzor nad mestom Bahmut na vzhodni fronti, bojišču rusko-ukrajinske vojne. Nekateri vojaški analitiki menijo, da je bila to najbolj krvava bitka po drugi svetovni vojni.

Obstreljevanje Bahmuta se je začelo maja 2022, ruske ofenzive na oddaljenih dostopih do mesta pa v začetku julija. Glavni napad na samo mesto se je začel, ko so ruske sile po umiku Ukrajincev s te fronte napredovale iz smeri Popasne. Glavnino napadalnih sil so sestavljali najemniki ruske paravojaške organizacije Wagner, podpirale pa so jih redne ruske čete in po poročilih tudi enote milice Doneške ljudske republike.

source.title: Battle of Bakhmut
paragraphs: The Battle of Bakhmut was a major battle between the Russian Armed Forces and the Ukrainian Armed Forces for control of the city of Bakhmut, during the eastern front, a theatre of the Russo-Ukrainian war. It is regarded by some military analysts to be the bloodiest battle since World War II.

The shelling of Bakhmut began in May 2022, and Russian offensives on the distant approaches to the city began in early July. The main assault towards the city itself started after Russian forces advanced from the direction of Popasna following a Ukrainian withdrawal from that front. The main assault force consisted primarily of mercenaries from the Russian paramilitary organization Wagner Group, supported by regular Russian troops and reportedly Donetsk People's Republic militia elements.

Battle of Bannockburn.headline: Bitka pri Bannockburnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bannockburnu (škotsko gelsko: Blàr Allt nam Bànag ali Blàr Allt a' Bhonnaich) je potekala 23. in 24. junija 1314 med vojsko škotskega kralja Roberta Brucea in vojsko angleškega kralja Edvarda II. v prvi škotski osamosvojitveni vojni. Robert Bruce je odločilno zmagal in bitka je pomenila veliko prelomnico vojne, ki se je 14 let pozneje končala z de iure obnovitvijo škotske neodvisnosti z edinburško-northamptonsko pogodbo. Zato bitko pri Bannockburnu splošno štejejo za mejnik škotske zgodovine.

source.title: Battle of Bannockburn
paragraphs: The Battle of Bannockburn (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Allt nam Bànag or Blàr Allt a' Bhonnaich) was fought on 23–24 June 1314, between the army of Robert the Bruce, King of Scots, and the army of King Edward II of England, during the First War of Scottish Independence. It was a decisive victory for Robert Bruce and formed a major turning point in the war, which ended 14 years later with the de jure restoration of Scottish independence under the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton. For this reason, the Battle of Bannockburn is widely considered a landmark moment in Scottish history.

Battle of Barnet.headline: Bitka pri Barnetu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Barnetu je bila odločilna zmaga Yorkov v vojni rož, dinastičnem spopadu v Angliji 15. stoletja. Skupaj s poznejšo bitko pri Tewkesburyju je Edvardu IV. zagotovila prestol.

V nedeljo, 14. aprila 1471, na veliko noč, je Edvard blizu Barneta, tedaj majhnega mesta v Hertfordshiru severno od Londona, vodil yorško hišo v boj proti lancastrski, ki je podpirala Henrika VI. Lancastrsko vojsko je vodil Richard Neville, grof Warwick, ki je odločilno vplival na usodo obeh kraljev. Zgodovinarji bitko štejejo za enega najpomembnejših spopadov vojne rož, saj je usodo obeh rodbin odločilno obrnila. Edvardovi zmagi je sledilo 14 let yorške vladavine v Angliji.

source.title: Battle of Barnet
paragraphs: The Battle of Barnet was a decisive Yorkist victory in the Wars of the Roses, a dynastic conflict of 15th-century England. The military action, along with the subsequent Battle of Tewkesbury, secured the throne for Edward IV.

On Sunday 14 April 1471, Easter Day, near Barnet, then a small Hertfordshire town north of London, Edward led the House of York in a fight against the House of Lancaster, which backed Henry VI for the throne. Leading the Lancastrian army was Richard Neville, Earl of Warwick, who played a crucial role in the fate of each king. Historians regard the battle as one of the most important clashes in the Wars of the Roses, since it brought about a decisive turn in the fortunes of the two houses. Edward's victory was followed by 14 years of Yorkist rule over England.

Battle of Baugé.headline: Bitka pri Baugéju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Baugéju je bila hud poraz Angležev v stoletni vojni: 22. marca 1421 so se pri Baugéju vzhodno od Angersa v Franciji spopadli s francosko-škotsko vojsko. Francosko-škotsko vojsko s 5000 možmi sta vodila John Stewart, grof Buchana, in francoski maršal Gilbert Motier de La Fayette, angleško vojsko s 4000 možmi (od katerih jih je bilo v boj poslanih le 1500) pa kraljev brat Tomaž, vojvoda Clarence, ki je v boju padel.

source.title: Battle of Baugé
paragraphs: The Battle of Baugé, fought between the English and a Franco-Scots army on 22 March 1421 at Baugé, France, east of Angers, was a major defeat for the English in the Hundred Years' War. The Franco-Scots, 5,000 strong, were led by both John Stewart, Earl of Buchan, and Gilbert Motier de La Fayette, the Marshal of France, while the 4,000 strong English army (of which only 1,500 were deployed) was led by the king's brother Thomas, Duke of Clarence, who was killed in the action.

Battle of Bautzen (1813).headline: Bitka pri Bautznu (1813)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bautznu (20.–21. maja 1813) je bila spopad, v katerem je Napoleon potisnil nazaj združeno prusko-rusko vojsko, ki se je po porazu pri Lützenu umikala in bila v veliki manjšini, a se je ta izognila uničenju. Nekateri viri trdijo, da maršal Michel Ney ni zaprl njene poti za umik. Pruse je vodil general Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher, Ruse pa general Peter Wittgenstein.

source.title: Battle of Bautzen (1813)
paragraphs: In the Battle of Bautzen (20–21 May 1813), a combined Prusso-Russian army, retreating after their defeat at Lützen and massively outnumbered, was pushed back by Napoleon but escaped destruction. Some sources claim that Marshal Michel Ney failed to block their retreat. The Prussians were led by General Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher, and the Russians by General Peter Wittgenstein.

Battle of Bautzen (1945).headline: Bitka pri Bautznu (1945)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bautznu (ali bitka pri Budziszynu, april 1945) je bila ena zadnjih bitk na vzhodni fronti druge svetovne vojne v Evropi. Potekala je na skrajnem južnem krilu ofenzive Spremberg–Torgau: več dni so potekali srditi ulični boji med silami poljske 2. armade skupaj z enotami sovjetske 52. armade in 5. gardne armade na eni strani ter enotami nemške armadne skupine Center, ostanki 4. tankovske in 17. armade, na drugi.
notes: The footnote marker [a] after 5th Guards Army is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Bautzen (1945)
paragraphs: The Battle of Bautzen (or Battle of Budziszyn, April 1945) was one of the last battles of the Eastern Front during World War II in Europe. It was fought on the extreme southern flank of the Spremberg-Torgau Offensive, seeing days of pitched street fighting between forces of the Polish Second Army under elements of the Soviet 52nd Army and 5th Guards Army[a] on one side and elements of German Army Group Center in the form of the remnants of the 4th Panzer and 17th armies on the other.

Battle of Bazeilles.headline: Bitka pri Bazeillesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bazeillesu je potekala 1. septembra 1870 med francosko-prusko vojno kot del večje bitke pri Sedanu in je bila ena prvih bitk s sodobno taktiko uličnega bojevanja. Bojevali so se v Bazeillesu, majhni vasi v departmaju Ardennes blizu Sedana v Franciji, kjer so se bavarski vojaki spopadli s francoskimi marinci in partizani.

Bitka je bila pravzaprav zaseda, ki jo je Bavarcem (zaveznikom Prusov) pripravil majhen odred »modre divizije« Troupes de marine (imenovanih tudi marsouins) pod poveljstvom Élieja de Vassoigna. Ostrostrelci marsouins so skupaj z domačimi gverilci na bavarske čete streljali s hitrostrelnimi zadnjepolnilnimi puškami chassepot.

Čeprav so bili Francozi deset proti enemu v manjšini, so vas držali, dokler jim Napoleon III. ni ukazal umika. Majhna skupina pod poveljstvom Arsèna Lamberta je ostala v zadnji hiši ob cesti proti Sedanu, gostilni Auberge Bourgerie, in se do zadnjega naboja borila, da bi krila umik.

source.title: Battle of Bazeilles
paragraphs: The Battle of Bazeilles was fought on 1 September 1870 during the Franco-Prussian War as a portion of the larger Battle of Sedan and was one of the first battles to feature modern urban warfare tactics. It took place in Bazeilles, France, a small village in the department of Ardennes near Sedan, and involved a force of Bavarian soldiers battling against French marines and partisans.

The battle was, in effect, an ambush of the Bavarians (who were allies of the Prussians), by a small detachment of the "Blue Division" Troupes de marine (known also as marsouins), under the command of Élie de Vassoigne. Marsouin snipers, along with local guerrillas, fired on the Bavarian troops using quick-firing Chassepot breech-loading rifles.

Although outnumbered ten to one, the French held the village until Napoleon III gave orders to withdraw. A small group under commander Arsène Lambert remained in the last house on the road to Sedan, the Auberge Bourgerie, fighting to the last bullet in order to cover the retreat.

Bitka pri Beachy Head, znana tudi kot bitka pri Béveziersu, je bila pomorska bitka 10. julija 1690 v devetletni vojni. Bila je najpomembnejša francoska pomorska zmaga nad nasprotniki iz velike alianse v tej vojni. Nizozemci so izgubili sedem linijskih ladij in tri ladje požigalke, njihovi angleški zavezniki eno linijsko ladjo, Francozi pa niti ene. Nadzor nad Rokavskim prelivom je začasno prešel v francoske roke, vendar francoski viceadmiral Anne Hilarion de Tourville angleško-nizozemskega ladjevja ni zasledoval dovolj odločno, zato se je to lahko umaknilo na Temzo.

Tourvilla so kritizirali, ker zmage ni izkoristil, in ga razrešili poveljstva. Angleškemu admiralu Arthurju Herbertu, 1. grofu Torringtonu, ki je odsvetoval spopad z močnejšim francoskim ladjevjem, a so ga preglasili kraljica Marija II. in njeni ministri, so zaradi ravnanja v bitki sodili pred vojaškim sodiščem. Čeprav je bil oproščen, ga je kralj Viljem III. odpustil iz službe.

source.title: Battle of Beachy Head (1690)
paragraphs: The Battle of Beachy Head, also known as the Battle of Béveziers, was a fleet action fought on 10 July 1690 during the Nine Years' War. The battle was the most significant French naval victory over their Grand Alliance opponents during the war. The Dutch lost seven ships of the line and three fire ships. Their English allies also lost one ship of the line, whereas the French did not lose a single vessel. Control of the English Channel temporarily fell into French hands but French Vice-Admiral Anne Hilarion de Tourville failed to pursue the Anglo-Dutch fleet with sufficient vigour, allowing it to fall back to the Thames.

Tourville was criticised for not following up his victory and was relieved of his command. English Admiral Arthur Herbert, 1st Earl of Torrington, who had advised against engaging the superior French fleet but had been overruled by Queen Mary II and her ministers, was court-martialled for his performance during the battle. Although he was acquitted, King William III dismissed him from the service.

Bitka pri Beaugencyju je potekala 16. in 17. junija 1429 in je bila ena od bitk Ivane Orleanske. Kmalu po tem, ko so francoske sile prekinile obleganje Orléansa, so znova zavzele sosednje okrožje ob reki Loari.

source.title: Battle of Beaugency (1429)
paragraphs: The Battle of Beaugency took place on 16 and 17 June 1429. It was one of Joan of Arc's battles. Shortly after relieving the siege at Orléans, French forces recaptured the neighboring district along the Loire river.

Battle of Beaumont.headline: Bitka pri Beaumontu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Beaumontu je potekala 30. avgusta 1870 v francosko-pruski vojni, zmagala pa je Prusija.

V njej se je francoski V. korpus pod poveljstvom generala Pierra Louisa Charlesa de Faillyja spopadel s IV. korpusom generala Constantina von Alvenslebna, XII. korpusom saškega princa Georga in I. kraljevim bavarskim korpusom generala Ludwiga Freiherra von der Tanna. Francoze so presenetili v njihovih nastanitvah in jih potisnili nazaj proti Mouzonu; izgubili so 7500 mož in 42 topov, Nemci pa 3400 mož.

source.title: Battle of Beaumont
paragraphs: The Battle of Beaumont on 30 August 1870 was won by Prussia during the Franco-Prussian War.

It was fought between the French V Corps under general Pierre Louis Charles de Failly, and IV Corps under general Constantin von Alvensleben, XII Corps under Prince Georg of Saxony along with the I Royal Bavarian Corps under general Ludwig Freiherr von der Tann. The French were surprised in their cantonments and driven back upon Mouzon, with losses of 7,500 men and 42 guns to the Germans' 3,400.

Battle of Beaune-la-Rolande.headline: Bitka pri Beaune-la-Rolandu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Beaune-la-Rolandu je potekala 28. novembra 1870 v francosko-pruski vojni, zmagala pa je Prusija. Francoski XX. korpus generala Crouzata je v poskusu, da bi prekinil obleganje Pariza, napadel tri pruske brigade, ki so počivale v Beaune-la-Rolandu. Brigade so pripadale pruskemu X. korpusu, ki je imel nalogo varovati boke in zaledje sil, ki so oblegale Pariz, ter pravočasno opozoriti na morebitne francoske protinapade. Francozi so v boj poslali 60.000 mož, večinoma nabornikov mobilne garde (Garde Mobile), in 140 topov proti 9000 pruskim možem in 70 topom, večinoma iz rednih enot, vojaški zgodovinar Gaston Bodart pa je njihovo moč ocenil na 40.000 mož in 174 topov. Kljub številčni premoči francoski napad vasi ni zavzel, pruske okrepitve pa so Francoze nazadnje prisilile k umiku.

source.title: Battle of Beaune-la-Rolande
paragraphs: The Battle of Beaune-la-Rolande on 28 November 1870 took place during the Franco-Prussian War, which was won by Prussia. In an attempt to relieve the Siege of Paris, French General Crouzat's XX Corps launched an attack against three Prussian brigades resting in Beaune-la-Rolande. These brigades were from the Prussian X Corps which was detailed to guard the flanks and rear of the force besieging Paris and provide early warning of any French counter-attacks. The French committed a force of 60,000 men, largely conscripts of the Garde Mobile, and 140 guns against the Prussians' 9,000 men and 70 guns, mostly drawn from regular troops, although military historian Gaston Bodart estimated their strength at 40,000 men and 174 guns. Despite the superiority of numbers the French attack failed to take the village and was ultimately forced to retreat by Prussian reinforcements.

Battle of Bedriacum.headline: Bitka pri Bedriacumu
paragraphs: Izraz bitka pri Bedriacumu označuje dve bitki, ki sta potekali v letu štirih cesarjev (69 po Kr.) blizu vasi Bedriacum (danes Calvatone), približno 35 kilometrov od mesta Cremona v severni Italiji. Bojevanje je pravzaprav potekalo med Bedriacumom in Cremono, bitkama pa včasih rečejo tudi »prva bitka pri Cremoni« in »druga bitka pri Cremoni«.

source.title: Battle of Bedriacum
paragraphs: The Battle of Bedriacum refers to two battles fought during the Year of the Four Emperors (AD 69) near the village of Bedriacum (now Calvatone), about 35 kilometers (22 mi) from the town of Cremona in northern Italy. The fighting in fact took place between Bedriacum and Cremona, and the battles are sometimes called "First Cremona" and "Second Cremona".

Battle of Belchite (1937).headline: Bitka pri Belchiteju (1937)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Belchiteju je ime za vrsto vojaških operacij, ki so med 24. avgustom in 7. septembrom 1937 potekale v mestu Belchite in okolici (leta 1936 je imelo skoraj 4000 prebivalcev, med bitko pa zaradi represije in razseljevanja v prvem letu vojne okoli 2600) v Aragoniji med špansko državljansko vojno, v okviru precej večje ofenzive za zavzetje Zaragoze, ki je trajala do začetka novembra 1937.

Ker je ofenziva na Zaragozo spodletela, so jo republikanci iz propagandnih razlogov začeli imenovati bitka pri Belchiteju, da bi bila videti kot zmaga, k spremembi imena pa so pripomogli tudi novinarji, ki so prišli poročat o zmagi, med njimi Ernest Hemingway. Nacionalisti so zmedo nadaljevali, saj so tudi sami propagandno izkoriščali »numantinsko« obrambo mesta, da bi z njo popravili slabo podobo bombardiranja Guernice.

source.title: Battle of Belchite (1937)
paragraphs: The Battle of Belchite refers to a series of military operations that took place between 24 August and 7 September 1937, in and around the town of Belchite (almost 4,000 inhabitants in 1936, decreasing to around 2,600 during the battle, from the repression and displacement of the first year), in Aragon during the Spanish Civil War, as part of a much bigger offensive to take Zaragoza, that continued until the beginning of November 1937.

Since the Offensive of Zaragoza failed, the Republicans started calling it Battle of Belchite for propaganda reasons instead, so that it would look like a victory, the journalists that came to report the victory, including Ernest Hemingway, contributed to this change of names. The Nationalists continued the confusion, since they exploited the "Numantine" defense of the town for propaganda too, to counteract the bad image of the bombing of Guernica.

Battle of Belleau Wood.headline: Bitka v gozdu Belleau
paragraphs: Bitka v gozdu Belleau (1.–26. junija 1918) je bila velika bitka med nemško pomladansko ofenzivo v prvi svetovni vojni blizu reke Marne v Franciji. Ameriška 2. divizija (pod poveljstvom generalmajorja Omarja Bundyja) in 3. divizija sta se skupaj s francoskimi in britanskimi silami bojevali proti raznim nemškim enotam, med drugim delom 237., 10., 197., 87. in 28. divizije.

Po izročilu ameriškega marinskega korpusa, ki sega v čas bitke, je takrat nastal vzdevek Teufel Hunden (»hudičevi psi«). Šlo pa je za izmišljeno besedno zvezo ameriškega vojnega dopisnika: noben Nemec marincev ni nikoli tako imenoval, niti s kakšno različico tega imena.

source.title: Battle of Belleau Wood
paragraphs: The Battle of Belleau Wood (1–26 June 1918) was a major battle that occurred during the German spring offensive in World War I, near the Marne River in France. The battle was fought by the U.S. 2nd (under the command of Major General Omar Bundy) and 3rd Divisions along with French and British forces against an assortment of German units including elements from the 237th, 10th, 197th, 87th, and 28th Divisions.

In United States Marines Corps lore dating back to the battle, the nickname Teufel Hunden ("Devil Dogs") originated. It was a made-up phrase from an American war correspondent, however, and no German ever called Marines that name or any variation of that name.

Battle of Benevento.headline: Bitka pri Beneventu leta 1266
paragraphs: Bitka pri Beneventu je bila velika srednjeveška bitka, ki je potekala 26. februarja 1266 blizu Beneventa v današnji južni Italiji med silami Karla I. Anžujskega in silami sicilskega kralja Manfreda. Manfredov poraz in smrt sta pripeljala do Karlovega osvajanja Kraljevine Sicilije, s čimer se je dejansko končala vladavina Štaufovcev na Apeninskem polotoku, začel pa se je vzpon kraljevih kapetinških Anžujcev. Spopad je bil del spora, v katerem so se zoperstavljali gvelfi in gibelini.

source.title: Battle of Benevento
paragraphs: The Battle of Benevento was a major medieval battle fought on 26 February 1266, near Benevento in present-day Southern Italy, between the forces of Charles I of Anjou and those of King Manfred of Sicily. Manfred's defeat and death resulted in Charles' conquest of the Kingdom of Sicily, effectively ending the rule of the Hohenstaufen dynasty in the Italian Peninsula and marking the rise of the royal Capetian House of Anjou. The engagement was part of the conflict which pitted Guelphs against Ghibellines.

Battle of Beneventum (214 BC).headline: Bitka pri Beneventu leta 214 pr. n. št.
paragraphs: Bitka pri Beneventu je potekala leta 214 pr. n. št. blizu današnjega Beneventa v drugi punski vojni. Rimske legije pod Tiberijem Sempronijem Grakhom so porazile kartažanske sile pod Hanonom in Hanibalu preprečile okrepitve. Livij bitko na kratko opisuje; bila je del rimske kampanje za podreditev južnoitalijanskih mestnih držav, ki so se po bitki pri Kanah pridružile Hanibalu.

source.title: Battle of Beneventum (214 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Beneventum was fought in 214 BC near modern Benevento during the Second Punic War. Roman legions under Tiberius Sempronius Gracchus defeated Hanno's Carthaginian forces, denying Hannibal reinforcements. Livy gives a brief description of the battle, which was part of the Roman campaign to subdue the southern Italian city-states that had joined Hannibal after the Battle of Cannae.

Bitka pri Beneventu (275 pr. n. št.) je bila zadnja bitka Pirove vojne. Potekala je blizu Beneventuma v južni Italiji med silami Pira, kralja Epira v Grčiji, in Rimljani pod poveljstvom konzula Manija Kurija Dentata. Izid je bil strateška rimska zmaga, Pir pa se je moral vrniti v Tarent in pozneje v Epir.

source.title: Battle of Beneventum (275 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Beneventum (275 BC) was the last battle of the Pyrrhic War. It was fought near Beneventum, in southern Italy, between the forces of Pyrrhus, king of Epirus in Greece, and the Romans, led by consul Manius Curius Dentatus. The result was a strategic Roman victory and Pyrrhus was forced to return to Tarentum, and later to Epirus.

Battle of Berezina.headline: Bitka na Berezini
paragraphs: Bitka na Berezini je potekala od 26. do 29. novembra 1812 med Napoleonovo veliko armado in rusko cesarsko vojsko pod vodstvom feldmaršala Wittgensteina in admirala Čičagova. Napoleon se je po spodleteli zasedbi Moskve v kaosu umikal proti Poljski in skušal pri Borisovu prečkati reko Berezino. Izid bitke je bil neodločen, saj je Napoleonu kljub hudim izgubam uspelo prečkati reko in nadaljevati umik s preživelimi ostanki vojske.

source.title: Battle of Berezina
paragraphs: The Battle of (the) Berezina (or Beresina) took place from 26 to 29 November 1812, between Napoleon's Grande Armée and the Imperial Russian Army under Field Marshal Wittgenstein and Admiral Chichagov. Napoleon was retreating toward Poland in chaos after the aborted occupation of Moscow and trying to cross the Berezina River at Borisov. The outcome of the battle was inconclusive as, despite heavy losses, Napoleon managed to cross the river and continue his retreat with the surviving remnants of his army.

Battle of Bergen (1759).headline: Bitka pri Bergnu (1759)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bergnu je potekala 13. aprila 1759 med sedemletno vojno blizu Frankfurta ob Majni: francoska vojska pod vodstvom de Broglieja je zdržala napad zavezniške britanske, hannovrske, hessenske in brunšviške vojske pod vodstvom princa Ferdinanda Brunšviškega.

source.title: Battle of Bergen (1759)
paragraphs: The Battle of Bergen on 13 April 1759 saw the French army under de Broglie withstand an allied British, Hanoverian, Hessian, Brunswick army under Prince Ferdinand of Brunswick near Frankfurt-am-Main during the Seven Years' War.

Battle of Beroia.headline: Bitka pri Beroji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Beroji (današnja Stara Zagora) je potekala leta 1122 na ozemlju današnje Bolgarije med Pečenegi in Bizantinskim cesarstvom pod cesarjem Janezom II. Komnenom (vladal 1118–1143). Zmagala je bizantinska vojska, Pečenegi pa so nato izginili kot samostojno ljudstvo.

source.title: Battle of Beroia
paragraphs: The Battle of Beroia (modern Stara Zagora) was fought in 1122 between the Pechenegs and the Byzantine Empire under Emperor John II Komnenos (r. 1118–1143) in what is now Bulgaria. The Byzantine army won the battle, resulting in the disappearance of the Pechenegs as a distinct, independent people.

Battle of Bezzecca.headline: Bitka pri Bezzecci
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bezzecci je potekala 21. julija 1866 med Italijo in Avstrijo v tretji italijanski vojni za neodvisnost. Bila je zmaga italijanskih prostovoljcev, Corpo Truppe Volontarie pod vodstvom Giuseppeja Garibaldija, nad avstrijskimi silami in je potekala med italijanskim vdorom v Trentino (ki se je začel konec junija).

source.title: Battle of Bezzecca
paragraphs: The Battle of Bezzecca was fought on 21 July 1866 between Italy and Austria during the Third Italian War of Independence. It was a victory of Italian volunteers, the Corpo Truppe Volontarie led by Giuseppe Garibaldi, against Austrian forces and occurred during an Italian invasion of Trentino (began in late June).

Battle of Białystok–Minsk.headline: Bitka za Białystok in Minsk
paragraphs: Bitka za Białystok in Minsk je bila nemška strateška operacija armadne skupine Center Wehrmachta pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Fedorja von Bocka med prodorom v sovjetsko obmejno območje v začetni fazi operacije Barbarossa; trajala je od 22. junija do 9. julija 1941.

Tankovski skupini armadne skupine, 2. pod poveljstvom generalpolkovnika Heinza Guderiana in 3. pod poveljstvom generalpolkovnika Hermanna Hotha, sta zdesetkali sovjetsko obmejno obrambo, odbili vse sovjetske protinapade in do 30. junija pri Białystoku in Minsku obkolili štiri sovjetske armade Zahodne fronte Rdeče armade. V obroču je bila večina Zahodne fronte, žepi pa so bili uničeni do 9. julija. Rdeča armada je izgubila od 420.000 do 474.000 mož, izgube Wehrmachta pa ocenjujejo na 12.157 do 67.244.
Nemci so sovjetsko Zahodno fronto uničili v 18 dneh in prodrli 460 kilometrov globoko v Sovjetsko zvezo, zato so mnogi verjeli, da so Nemci vojno proti Sovjetski zvezi tako rekoč že dobili.

source.title: Battle of Białystok–Minsk
paragraphs: The Battle of Białystok–Minsk was a German strategic operation conducted by the Wehrmacht's Army Group Center under Field Marshal Fedor von Bock during the penetration of the Soviet border region in the opening stage of Operation Barbarossa, lasting from 22 June to 9 July 1941.

The Army Group's 2nd Panzer Group under Colonel General Heinz Guderian and the 3rd Panzer Group under Colonel General Hermann Hoth decimated the Soviet frontier defenses, defeated all Soviet counter-attacks and encircled four Soviet Armies of the Red Army's Western Front near Białystok and Minsk by 30 June. The majority of the Western Front was enclosed within, and the pockets were destroyed by 9 July. The Red Army lost from 420,000 to 474,000 men, against Wehrmacht casualties estimated between 12,157 and 67,244.

The Germans destroyed the Soviet Western Front in 18 days and advanced 460 kilometers into the Soviet Union, causing many to believe that the Germans had effectively won the war against the Soviet Union.
Bitka pri Bibractu je bila spopad med galsko zvezo s središčem okoli Helvečanov in rimsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Gaja Julija Cezarja. Bila je prva velika bitka galskih vojn.

source.title: Battle of Bibracte
paragraphs: The Battle of Bibracte was fought between a Gallic confederation centred around the Helvetii and a Roman army under the command of Gaius Julius Caesar. It was the first major battle of the Gallic Wars.

Battle of Bicocca.headline: Bitka pri Bicocci
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bicocci ali La Bicocca (italijansko: Battaglia della Bicocca) je potekala 27. aprila 1522 v italijanski vojni 1521–1526. Združena francoska in beneška vojska pod Odetom de Foixom, vikontom de Lautrecom, je bila odločilno poražena od cesarsko-španske in papeške vojske pod skupnim poveljstvom Prospera Colonne. Lautrec se je nato umaknil iz Lombardije in Milansko vojvodino prepustil cesarskim silam.

source.title: Battle of Bicocca
paragraphs: The Battle of Bicocca or La Bicocca (Italian: Battaglia della Bicocca) was fought on 27 April 1522, during the Italian War of 1521–26. A combined French and Venetian force under Odet de Foix, Vicomte de Lautrec, was decisively defeated by an Imperial–Spanish and Papal army under the overall command of Prospero Colonna. Lautrec then withdrew from Lombardy, leaving the Duchy of Milan in Imperial hands.

Battle of Bitonto.headline: Bitka pri Bitontu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bitontu (25. maja 1734) je bila španska zmaga nad avstrijskimi silami blizu Bitonta v Neapeljskem kraljestvu (v južni Italiji) v poljski nasledstveni vojni. Z njo se je končal organizirani avstrijski odpor v kraljestvu zunaj maloštevilnih trdnjav.

source.title: Battle of Bitonto
paragraphs: The Battle of Bitonto (25 May 1734) was a Spanish victory over Austrian forces near Bitonto in the Kingdom of Naples (in southern Italy) in the War of Polish Succession. The battle ended organized Austrian resistance outside a small number of fortresses in the kingdom.

Battle of Bizani.headline: Bitka pri Bizaniju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bizaniju (grško: Μάχη του Μπιζανίου; turško: Bizani Muharebesi) je potekala v Epiru od 4. do 6. marca [19.–21. februarja po starem koledarju] 1913. Spopadle so se grške in osmanske sile v zadnji fazi prve balkanske vojne, boji pa so se vrteli okoli utrdb Bizani, ki so varovale dostope do Joanine, največjega mesta v regiji.

source.title: Battle of Bizani
paragraphs: The Battle of Bizani (Greek: Μάχη του Μπιζανίου, Máchi tou Bizaníou; Turkish: Bizani Muharebesi) took place in Epirus on 4–6 March [O.S. 19–21 February] 1913. The battle was fought between Greek and Ottoman forces during the last stages of the First Balkan War, and revolved around the forts of Bizani, which covered the approaches to Ioannina, the largest city in the region.

Battle of Blanchetaque.headline: Bitka pri Blanchetaquu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Blanchetaquu je potekala 24. avgusta 1346 med angleško vojsko pod vodstvom kralja Edvarda III. in francoskimi silami, ki jim je poveljeval Godemar du Fay. Bila je del crécyjskega pohoda v zgodnji fazi stoletne vojne. Angleška vojska se je 12. julija izkrcala na polotoku Cotentin in skozi nekatere najbogatejše francoske pokrajine pustošila vse do 32 km od Pariza, pri tem pa oplenila več mest. Nato so Angleži krenili proti severu v upanju, da se bodo združili z zavezniško flamsko vojsko, ki je vdrla iz Flandrije. Francoski kralj Filip VI. jih je prelisičil: zasedel je vse mostove in brode čez reko Somme in Angležem sledil s svojo vojsko. Francozi so pred tem z območja odnesli zaloge hrane, zato so bili Angleži tako rekoč ujeti.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Blanchetaque
paragraphs: The Battle of Blanchetaque was fought on 24 August 1346 between an English army under King Edward III and a French force commanded by Godemar du Fay. The battle was part of the Crécy campaign, which took place during the early stages of the Hundred Years' War. After landing in the Cotentin Peninsula on 12 July, the English army had burnt a path of destruction through some of the richest lands in France to within 20 miles (32 km) of Paris, sacking a number of towns on the way. The English then marched north, hoping to link up with an allied Flemish army which had invaded from Flanders. They were outmanoeuvred by the French king, Philip VI, who garrisoned all of the bridges and fords over the River Somme and followed the English with his own field army. The area had previously been stripped of food stocks by the French, and the English were essentially trapped.

Battle of Blore Heath.headline: Bitka pri Blore Heathu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Blore Heathu je potekala 23. septembra 1459 v angleški vojni rož pri Blore Heathu v Staffordshiru. Blore Heath je redko naseljeno območje kmetijskih zemljišč dve milji (približno tri kilometre) vzhodno od mesta Market Drayton v Shropshiru, blizu vasi Loggerheads v Staffordshiru.

source.title: Battle of Blore Heath
paragraphs: The Battle of Blore Heath took place during the English Wars of the Roses on 23 September 1459, at Blore Heath, Staffordshire. Blore Heath is a sparsely populated area of farmland two miles east of the town of Market Drayton in Shropshire, and close to the village of Loggerheads, Staffordshire.

Battle of Blue Waters.headline: Bitka pri Modrih vodah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Modrih vodah je potekala nekega dne jeseni 1362 ali 1363 na bregovih reke Sinjuha, levega pritoka Južnega Buga; vojski Velike kneževine Litve in Kneževine Moldavije sta se v njej spopadli z Zlato hordo. Litovci so dosegli odločilno zmago in dokončali osvojitev Kijevske kneževine, Moldavci pa so se otresli odvisnosti od Zlate horde.

source.title: Battle of Blue Waters
paragraphs: The Battle of Blue Waters was fought at some time in the autumn of 1362 or 1363 on the banks of the Syniukha River, a left tributary of the Southern Bug, between the armies of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and Principality of Moldavia against the Golden Horde. The Lithuanians won a decisive victory and finalized their conquest of the Principality of Kiev, while the Moldavians managed to end their dependence on the Golden Horde.

Battle of Blumenau.headline: Bitka pri Blumenauu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Blumenauu ali bitka pri Lamaču je bila zadnja bitka avstrijsko-pruske vojne; potekala je 22. julija 1866 (na dan sklenitve miru), Avstrijci pa so se v njej branili pred prusko vojsko.

source.title: Battle of Blumenau
paragraphs: The Battle of Blumenau or Battle of Lamač was the last battle fought in the Austro-Prussian War, on 22 July 1866 (on the day of the conclusion of peace), with the Austrians defending against the Prussian army.

Battle of Bornhöved (1227).headline: Bitka pri Bornhövedu (1227)
paragraphs: (Druga) bitka pri Bornhövedu je potekala 22. julija 1227 blizu Bornhöveda v Holsteinu. Grof Adolf IV. Schauenburški in Holsteinski je z vojsko, ki so jo sestavljale čete mest Lübeck in Hamburg, Dithmarschna, Holsteina in različnih severnonemških plemičev, premagal danskega kralja Valdemarja II. in Velfa Otona Otroka.

source.title: Battle of Bornhöved (1227)
paragraphs: The (second) Battle of Bornhöved took place on 22 July 1227 near Bornhöved in Holstein. Count Adolf IV of Schauenburg and Holstein — leading an army consisting of troops from the cities of Lübeck and Hamburg, Dithmarschen, Holstein, and various Northern German nobles, defeated King Valdemar II of Denmark and the Welf Otto the Child.

Battle of Borny–Colombey.headline: Bitka pri Borny-Colombeyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Borny-Colombeyju ali bitka pri Colombey-Nouillyju je potekala 14. avgusta 1870 v francosko-pruski vojni. Med bitko so francoski vojski pod poveljstvom Françoisa Bazaina zaprli pot za umik, ko je naletela na 1. armado pod poveljstvom von Steinmetza. Bitka sama se je končala s francosko zmago, saj so se Francozi lahko umaknili v Metz, čeprav so jih zadržali za 12 ur.

Kot večine zgodnjih bitk v vojni tudi bitke pri Bornyju ni načrtovala ali želela nobena stran. Za Francoze je imela hude posledice: niso izkoristili številčne premoči, da bi si izsilili prehod, umik vojske iz Metza pa se je zavlekel za dvanajst dragocenih ur. Prusi so tako dobili čas, da so pripeljali svojo 2. armado pod poveljstvom princa Friderika Karla, in zagotovili, da je bila po bitkah v naslednjih dneh (Mars-la-Tour in Gravelotte) glavna francoska vojska ujeta v Metzu.

source.title: Battle of Borny–Colombey
paragraphs: The Battle of Borny–Colombey or the Battle of Colombey-Nouilly took place on 14 August 1870 as part of the Franco-Prussian War. During the battle the escape route of the French army under François Bazaine was blocked when the French encountered the First Army under von Steinmetz. The outcome of the battle itself was a French victory as the French were able to escape to Metz, although they were delayed for 12 hours.

Like most of the early battles of the war, Borny was one that neither side had planned or wanted. For the French, the battle had dire consequences as they neglected to use their numerical superiority to force a passage and it delayed the Army's retreat out of Metz for twelve precious hours. This gave the Prussians the time to bring up their Second army under Prince Frederick Charles and assured that after the battles fought in the following days (Mars-la-Tour and Gravelotte) France's premier army would be trapped at Metz.

Battle of Borovo Selo.headline: Bitka v Borovem Selu
paragraphs: Bitka v Borovem Selu 2. maja 1991, na Hrvaškem znana kot pokol v Borovem Selu (hrvaško: Pokolj u Borovom Selu), v Srbiji pa kot incident v Borovem Selu (srbsko: Инцидент у Боровом Селу), je bila eden prvih oboroženih spopadov v konfliktu, ki je postal znan kot hrvaška osamosvojitvena vojna. Spopadu so botrovali meseci naraščajočih etničnih napetosti, nasilja in oboroženih spopadov v Pakracu in marca na Plitvičkih jezerih. Neposredni povod za spopad v pretežno srbski vasi Borovo Selo severno od Vukovarja je bil spodleteli poskus, da bi v vasi jugoslovansko zastavo zamenjali s hrvaško. Ta nedovoljeni poskus štirih hrvaških policistov se je končal tako, da je milica hrvaških Srbov dva od njih zajela. Hrvaške oblasti so za njuno rešitev poslale dodatne policiste, ki so zapeljali v zasedo. Padlo je dvanajst hrvaških policistov in en srbski paravojak, preden je posredovala Jugoslovanska ljudska armada (JLA) in boje končala.

source.title: Battle of Borovo Selo
paragraphs: The Battle of Borovo Selo of 2 May 1991, known in Croatia as the Borovo Selo massacre (Croatian: Pokolj u Borovom Selu) and in Serbia as the Borovo Selo incident (Serbian: Инцидент у Боровом Селу), was one of the first armed clashes in the conflict which became known as the Croatian War of Independence. The clash was precipitated by months of rising ethnic tensions, violence, and armed combat in Pakrac and at the Plitvice Lakes in March. The immediate cause for the confrontation in the heavily ethnic Serb village of Borovo Selo, just north of Vukovar, was a failed attempt to replace the Yugoslav flag in the village with the flag of Croatia. The unauthorised effort by four Croatian policemen resulted in the capture of two by a Croatian Serb militia. To rescue the captives, the Croatian authorities deployed additional police, who drove into an ambush. Twelve Croatian policemen and one Serb paramilitary were killed before the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) intervened and put an end to the clashes.

Battle of Boulogne.headline: Bitka za Boulogne (1940)
paragraphs: Bitka za Boulogne leta 1940 je bila obramba pristanišča Boulogne-sur-Mer, ki so ga v bitki za Francijo med drugo svetovno vojno branile francoske, britanske in belgijske enote. Potekala je hkrati z obleganjem Calaisa, tik pred operacijo Dynamo, evakuacijo britanske ekspedicijske sile (BEF) iz Dunkerqua. Po francosko-britanskem protinapadu v bitki pri Arrasu 21. maja so bile nemške enote pripravljene, da bi 22. maja odbile morebitno ponovitev napada. General tankovskih enot (generalpodpolkovnik) Heinz Guderian, poveljnik XIX. korpusa, je protestiral, ker je hotel hitro prodreti na sever ob obali Rokavskega preliva in zavzeti Boulogne, Calais in Dunkerque. Napad dela XIX. korpusa je bil ukazan šele 22. maja ob 12.40, ko je zavezniške enote v mestu iz Anglije že okrepila večina 20. gardne brigade.

source.title: Battle of Boulogne
paragraphs: The Battle of Boulogne in 1940 was the defence of the port of Boulogne-sur-Mer by French, British and Belgian troops in the Battle of France during the Second World War. The battle was fought at the same time as the Siege of Calais, just before Operation Dynamo, the evacuation of the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) from Dunkirk. After the Franco-British counter-attack at the Battle of Arras on 21 May, German units were held ready to resist a resumption of the attack on 22 May. General der Panzertruppe (Lieutenant-General) Heinz Guderian, the commander of XIX Corps, protested that he wanted to rush north up the Channel coast to capture Boulogne, Calais and Dunkirk. An attack by part of XIX Corps was not ordered until 12:40 p.m. on 22 May, by which time the Allied troops at Boulogne had been reinforced from England by most of the 20th Guards Brigade.

Bitka pri Bouvinesu je potekala 27. julija 1214 blizu mesta Bouvines v grofiji Flandriji. Bila je sklepna bitka anglo-francoske vojne v letih 1213–1214. Ocene o številu vojakov se med sodobnimi zgodovinarji močno razlikujejo, gotovo pa je, da je pri Bouvinesu francoska vojska pod poveljstvom kralja Filipa Avgusta razbila večjo zavezniško vojsko cesarja Svetega rimskega cesarstva Otona IV. v eni redkih bitk na odprtem polju v visokem srednjem veku in enem najodločilnejših srednjeveških spopadov.

V začetku leta 1214 se je proti francoskemu kralju Filipu Avgustu oblikovala koalicija, ki so jo sestavljali Oton IV., angleški kralj Ivan, flandrijski grof Ferrand, boulognski grof Renaud, brabantski vojvoda Henrik I., holandski grof Viljem I., lorenski vojvoda Tibald I. in limburški vojvoda Henrik III. Njen cilj je bil izničiti osvojitve, ki jih je Filip dosegel v prejšnjih letih svoje vladavine.

source.title: Battle of Bouvines
paragraphs: The Battle of Bouvines took place on 27 July 1214 near the town of Bouvines in the County of Flanders. It was the concluding battle of the Anglo-French War of 1213–1214. Although estimates on the number of troops vary considerably among modern historians, at Bouvines, a French army commanded by King Philip Augustus routed a larger allied army led by Holy Roman Emperor Otto IV in one of the rare pitched battles of the High Middle Ages and one of the most decisive medieval engagements.

In early 1214, a coalition was assembled against King Philip Augustus of France, consisting of Otto IV, King John of England, Count Ferrand of Flanders, Count Renaud of Boulogne, Duke Henry I of Brabant, Count William I of Holland, Duke Theobald I of Lorraine, and Duke Henry III of Limburg. Its objective was to reverse the conquests made by Philip earlier in his reign.

Battle of Bovianum.headline: Bitka pri Bovianumu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bovianumu je potekala leta 305 pr. n. št. med Rimljani in Samniti.

source.title: Battle of Bovianum
paragraphs: The Battle of Bovianum was fought in 305 BC between the Romans and the Samnites.

Battle of Bregalnica.headline: Bitka na Bregalnici
paragraphs: Bitka na Bregalnici je potekala od 30. junija do 8. julija med vojskama Kraljevine Bolgarije in Kraljevine Srbije v drugi balkanski vojni. Bila je največja bitka te vojne.
notes: The English gives no year (the Second Balkan War was in 1913); kept as in the source.

source.title: Battle of Bregalnica
paragraphs: The Battle of Bregalnica was fought between the armies of the Kingdom of Bulgaria and the Kingdom of Serbia during the Second Balkan War from 30 June to 8 July. It was the largest battle of the war.

Battle of Breitenfeld (1642).headline: Druga bitka pri Breitenfeldu
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Breitenfeldu, znana tudi kot prva bitka pri Leipzigu, je potekala med tridesetletno vojno 2. novembra 1642 pri Breitenfeldu severovzhodno od Leipziga v Nemčiji. Švedska vojska pod poveljstvom Lennarta Torstenssona je premagala cesarsko vojsko pod vodstvom nadvojvode Leopolda Viljema Avstrijskega in njegovega namestnika Ottavia Piccolominija.

Zmaga je Švedom omogočila, da so zasedli Leipzig, drugo najpomembnejše mesto Saške volilne kneževine, in si v njem uredili varno oporišče. Čeprav je bila cesarska vojska zaradi poraza močno oslabljena in prisiljena v obrambo, je Švedom preprečila, da bi zmago v celoti izkoristili, saškega volilnega kneza Ivana Jurija I. pa je odvrnila od sklenitve miru s Švedsko.

source.title: Battle of Breitenfeld (1642)
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Breitenfeld, also known as the First Battle of Leipzig, took place during the Thirty Years' War on 2 November 1642 at Breitenfeld, north-east of Leipzig in Germany. A Swedish Army commanded by Lennart Torstensson defeated an Imperial Army under Archduke Leopold Wilhelm of Austria and his deputy Ottavio Piccolomini.

Victory allowed the Swedes to occupy and establish a secure base in Leipzig, the second most important town in the Electorate of Saxony. Although significantly weakened by the defeat and forced onto the defensive, the Imperial Army prevented them from fully exploiting their victory and kept John George I, Elector of Saxony from making peace with Sweden.

Battle of Brémule.headline: Bitka pri Brémulu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brémulu je potekala 20. avgusta 1119 med angleškim kraljem Henrikom I. in francoskim kraljem Ludvikom VI. Debelim. Henrik I. je moral svoje posesti v Normandiji večkrat braniti, z zmago v tej bitki pa je odbil francosko invazijo.

Francoski poraz pri Brémulu je dejansko strl upor baronov in kralja Ludvika prisilil, da je Viljema Adelina priznal za normandijskega vojvodo. Viljem je vojvodino uradno prejel leta 1120, čeprav je kralj Ludvik še naprej podpiral zahtevo Viljema Clitona po tem naslovu.
Bitka je bila posledica naključnega srečanja sosedov, ki sta vsak na svoji meji vzdrževala red, saj meje njunih kraljestev v Vexinu in v dolini Sene še niso bile natančno določene.

source.title: Battle of Brémule
paragraphs: The Battle of Brémule was fought on 20 August 1119 between Henry I of England and Louis VI the Fat of France. Henry I had to defend his holdings in Normandy several times and his victory at this battle repelled a French invasion.

The French defeat at Brémule effectively crippled the barons' rebellion and led to King Louis' having to accept William Adelin as Duke of Normandy. William was officially invested with the duchy in 1120, even though King Louis continued to support William Clito's claim to the honour.

This battle is the result of a fortuitous encounter between the two neighbours who were engaged in a lawkeeping operation on their respective borders, the limits of their kingdoms being still imprecise in the Vexin and in the valley of the Seine.

Battle of Breslau (1757).headline: Bitka pri Vroclavu (1757)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vroclavu (znana tudi kot bitka ob Lohe) je potekala 22. novembra 1757 v Breslauu (danes Vroclav na Poljskem) med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne). Pruska vojska z 28.000 možmi se je spopadla z avstrijsko vojsko s 60.000 možmi. Prusi so odbili avstrijski napad in izgubili 6000 mož, Avstrijci pa 5000. Dan pozneje pa so se Prusi umaknili. Posadka Breslaua se je predala 25. novembra 1757.

source.title: Battle of Breslau (1757)
paragraphs: The Battle of Breslau (also known as the Battle on the Lohe) was fought on 22 November 1757 in Breslau (now Wrocław, Poland) during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). A Prussian army of 28,000 men fought an Austrian army of 60,000 men. The Prussians held off the Austrian attack, losing 6,000 men to the Austrians' 5,000 men. But one day later the Prussians beat a retreat. Breslau's garrison surrendered on 25 November 1757.

Bitka za Brienne (29. januarja 1814) je bila spopad, v katerem je francoska cesarska vojska pod vodstvom cesarja Napoleona napadla pruske in ruske sile pod poveljstvom pruskega feldmaršala Gebharda Leberechta von Blücherja. Po hudih bojih, ki so trajali v noč, so Francozi zavzeli dvorec in skoraj ujeli Blücherja, Rusov pa niso mogli pregnati iz mesta Brienne-le-Château. Tudi sam Napoleon, ki se je takrat leta 1814 prvič pojavil na bojišču, je bil skoraj ujet. Naslednje jutro so Blücherjeve čete zelo zgodaj tiho zapustile mesto, se umaknile proti jugu in bojišče prepustile Francozom.

source.title: Battle of Brienne
paragraphs: The Battle of Brienne (29 January 1814) saw an Imperial French army led by Emperor Napoleon attack Prussian and Russian forces commanded by Prussian Field Marshal Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher. After heavy fighting that went on into the night, the French seized a château, nearly capturing Blücher. However, the French were unable to dislodge the Russians from the town of Brienne-le-Château. Napoleon himself, making his first appearance on a battlefield in 1814, was also nearly captured. Very early the next morning, Blücher's troops quietly abandoned the town and retreated to the south, conceding the field to the French.

Battle of Brihuega.headline: Bitka pri Brihuegi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brihuegi je potekala 8. decembra 1710 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo, med zavezniškim umikom iz Madrida proti Barceloni. Zaledno stražo britanske vojske pod vodstvom Jamesa Stanhopa, 1. grofa Stanhopa, je v mestu Brihuega odrezala, obkolila in nazadnje strla francosko-španska vojska pod poveljstvom Louisa Josepha, vojvode Vendômskega. Bitka je skupaj z drugimi dogodki končala britansko sodelovanje v vojni.

source.title: Battle of Brihuega
paragraphs: The Battle of Brihuega took place on 8 December 1710 in the War of the Spanish Succession, during the Allied retreat from Madrid to Barcelona. A British Army rearguard led by James Stanhope, 1st Earl Stanhope was cut off and trapped within the town of Brihuega before being overwhelmed by a Franco-Spanish army under the command of Louis Joseph, Duke of Vendôme. The battle, along with other events, brought an end to British participation in the war.

Battle of Brody (1941).headline: Bitka pri Brodih (1941)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brodih (imenovana tudi bitka pri Dubnu, bitka pri Rovnem ali bitka pri Rovnem in Brodih) je bila tankovska bitka med III. armadnim korpusom in XLVIII. (motoriziranim) armadnim korpusom 1. tankovske skupine ter petimi mehaniziranimi korpusi sovjetske 5. in 6. armade v trikotniku med mesti Dubno, Luck in Brodi od 23. do 30. junija 1941. Bila je ena najsrditejših oklepnih bitk v začetni fazi operacije Barbarossa, nekateri pa trdijo, da je morda presegla celo bolj znano bitko pri Prohorovki. V njej je sodelovalo daleč največ tankov (bitko pri Prohorovki, del bitke pri Kursku, napačno štejejo za največjo tankovsko bitko). V sovjetskem zgodovinopisju je znana kot ena od »obmejnih obrambnih bitk«. Enote Rdeče armade so Nemcem prizadejale hude izgube, vendar so jih Nemci izmanevrirali in so izgubile ogromno tankov. Slaba sovjetska logistika, nemška zračna premoč in popoln zlom poveljevanja v Rdeči armadi so Wehrmachtu kljub veliki številčni in tehnični premoči Rdeče armade zagotovili zmago.
notes: Dubna and Dubno are two English spellings of one name; the Slovenian gives it once.

source.title: Battle of Brody (1941)
paragraphs: The Battle of Brody (other names in use include Battle of Dubna, Battle of Dubno, Battle of Rovne, Battle of Rovne-Brody) was a tank battle fought between the 1st Panzer Group's III Army Corps and XLVIII Army Corps (Motorized) and five mechanized corps of the Soviet 5th Army and 6th Army in the triangle formed by the towns of Dubno, Lutsk and Brody between 23 and 30 June 1941. It was one of the most intense armored engagements in the opening phase of Operation Barbarossa, and some say that it may surpass the more famous Battle of Prokhorovka. It is by far the battle with the largest number of tanks participating (incorrectly, the Battle of Prokhorovka, part of the Battle of Kursk, is seen as the biggest tank battle). It is known in Soviet historiography as one of the "border defensive battles". Although the Red Army formations inflicted heavy losses on the German forces, they were outmanoeuvred and suffered enormous losses in tanks. Poor Soviet logistics, German air supremacy and a total breakdown in Red Army command and control ensured victory for the Wehrmacht despite overwhelming Red Army numerical and technological superiority.

Battle of Brovary.headline: Bitka za Brovari
paragraphs: Med rusko invazijo na Ukrajino je prišlo do spopada v Brovarih, vzhodnem predmestju ukrajinske prestolnice Kijeva. Ruske sile so napredovale proti zahodu z juga Černigovske oblasti, kjer so se spopadle z ukrajinskimi silami. Z območja so se umaknile do 1. ali 2. aprila 2022.
notes: The English opens without a definition sentence; kept as in the source.

source.title: Battle of Brovary
paragraphs: During the Russian invasion of Ukraine, a military engagement took place at Brovary, an eastern suburb of Kyiv, the capital city of Ukraine. Russian forces advanced west from southern Chernihiv Oblast and were engaged by Ukrainian forces. Russian forces withdrew from the area by 1-2 April 2022.

Battle of Brunanburh.headline: Bitka pri Brunanburhu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brunanburhu je potekala leta 937 med angleškim kraljem Æthelstanom in zavezništvom dublinskega kralja Olafa Guthfrithsona, škotskega kralja Konstantina II. in strathclydskega kralja Owaina. Bitko včasih navajajo kot izvor angleške narodne identitete: zgodovinarji, kot je Michael Livingston, trdijo, da so »možje, ki so se na tem polju bojevali in umirali, skovali politični zemljevid prihodnosti, ki je ostal, zato je bitka pri Brunanburhu morda ena najpomembnejših bitk v dolgi zgodovini ne le Anglije, temveč vseh Britanskih otokov«.

source.title: Battle of Brunanburh
paragraphs: The Battle of Brunanburh was fought in 937 between Æthelstan, King of England, and an alliance of Olaf Guthfrithson, King of Dublin; Constantine II, King of Scotland; and Owain, King of Strathclyde. The battle is sometimes cited as the point of origin for English national identity: historians such as Michael Livingston argue that "the men who fought and died on that field forged a political map of the future that remains, arguably making the Battle of Brunanburh one of the most significant battles in the long history not just of England, but of the whole of the British Isles."

Battle of Brunete.headline: Bitka pri Brunetu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brunetu (6.–25. julija 1937), ki je potekala 24 kilometrov zahodno od Madrida, je bila republikanski poskus, da bi v španski državljanski vojni zmanjšali pritisk nacionalistov na prestolnico in na sever. Republikanci so bili sprva uspešni, a so se morali po protinapadih nacionalistov z Bruneta umakniti in so v bitki utrpeli uničujoče izgube.
notes: The miles conversion (15 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Brunete
paragraphs: The Battle of Brunete (6–25 July 1937), fought 24 kilometres (15 mi) west of Madrid, was a Republican attempt to alleviate the pressure exerted by the Nationalists on the capital and on the north during the Spanish Civil War. Although initially successful, the Republicans were forced to retreat from Brunete after Nationalist counterattacks, and suffered devastating casualties from the battle.

Battle of Bryansk.headline: Bitka pri Brjansku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brjansku (30. septembra – 21. oktobra 1941) je bila bitka druge svetovne vojne v Brjanski oblasti, del širšega moskovskega pohoda. Heinz Guderian je po vrnitvi iz kijevske operacije napadel v nepričakovani smeri, z majhnimi izgubami zavzel Brjansk in Orjol ter obkolil dve sovjetski armadi, 13. in 3. armado. Tretjo sovjetsko armado, 50., je severno od Brjanska obkolila pehota nemške 2. armade. Obkoljene enote Rdeče armade so se kljub temu bojevale naprej in pohod na Moskvo zadržale za dva tedna. Ta zamuda in izgube, ki jih je Wehrmacht utrpel pri uničevanju obkoljenih žepov, sta prispevali k nemškemu zlomu pred vrati Moskve. Gl. tudi: obkolitvi pri Vjazmi in Brjansku. Po tej bitki so Nemci Brjansk zasedali, dokler jih 17. septembra 1943 v okviru smolenske ofenzive ni pregnala Rdeča armada.

source.title: Battle of Bryansk
paragraphs: The Battle of Bryansk (30 September – 21 October 1941) was a battle during World War II conducted in the Bryansk Oblast as a part of the overall Moscow campaign. Returning from the Kiev operation, Heinz Guderian attacked in an unexpected direction capturing Bryansk and Oryol with few casualties thereby encircling two Soviet formations, the 13th Army and 3rd Army. A third Soviet formation, the 50th Army was encircled by infantry of the German 2nd Army north of Bryansk. However the encircled Red Army units continued fighting, delaying the drive on Moscow for two weeks. This delay, as well as the casualties taken by the Wehrmacht liquidating the pockets contributed to the German collapse at the gates of Moscow. See also: Vyazma and Bryansk pockets. As a result of this battle, the Germans occupied Bryansk until they were expelled by the Red Army on 17 September 1943 as a part of the Smolensk campaign.

Battle of Brześć Litewski.headline: Bitka pri Brześću Litewskem
paragraphs: Bitka pri Brześću Litewskem (znana tudi kot obleganje Brześća, bitka pri Brest-Litovsku ali preprosto bitka pri Brześću) je bila bitka druge svetovne vojne med nemškimi in poljskimi silami od 14. do 17. septembra 1939 blizu mesta Brześć Litewski na Poljskem (danes Brest v Belorusiji). Po treh dneh hudih bojev za utrdbo v mestu so Nemci trdnjavo zavzeli, Poljaki pa so se umaknili.

source.title: Battle of Brześć Litewski
paragraphs: The Battle of Brześć Litewski (also known as the siege of Brześć, the battle of Brest-Litovsk or simply the battle of Brześć) was a World War II battle involving German and Polish forces that took place between 14 and 17 September 1939, near the town of Brześć Litewski, Poland (now Brest, Belarus). After three days of heavy fights for the stronghold in the town of Brześć, the Germans captured the fortress and the Poles withdrew.

Bitka za Bučo je bila del kijevske ofenzive v ruski invaziji na Ukrajino, boj za nadzor nad mestom Buča. Spopadle so se enote ruskih oboroženih sil in ukrajinske kopenske vojske. Bitka je trajala od 27. februarja do 31. marca 2022 in se končala z umikom ruskih sil. Bila je del širše taktike obkolitve Kijeva, ukrajinske prestolnice.

Ukrajinske oborožene sile so se ruskemu napredovanju upirale v zahodnih predmestjih prestolnice, Irpinu, Buči in Hostomelu. Kijevska oblastna državna uprava je Bučo navedla med najnevarnejšimi kraji v Kijevski oblasti. Ko so se ruske sile iz Buče umaknile in so ukrajinske sile spet prevzele nadzor nad mestom, so odkrita grozodejstva ruske vojske, znana kot pokol v Buči, pritegnila mednarodno pozornost.

source.title: Battle of Bucha
paragraphs: The Battle of Bucha was part of the Kyiv offensive in the Russian invasion of Ukraine for control of the city of Bucha. The combatants were elements of the Russian Armed Forces and Ukrainian Ground Forces. The battle lasted from 27 February to 31 March 2022 and ended with the withdrawal of Russian forces. The battle was part of a larger tactic to encircle Kyiv, the capital city of Ukraine.

The armed forces of Ukraine resisted the Russian advance in the capital's western suburbs of Irpin, Bucha, and Hostomel. Bucha was among the locations that the Kyiv Oblast State Administration named as the most dangerous places in the Kyiv Oblast. After Russian forces withdrew from Bucha and Ukrainian forces regain the city's control, the uncovered atrocities committed by the Russian military, known as Bucha massacre, attracted international attention.

Battle of Bucharest.headline: Bitka za Bukarešto
paragraphs: Bitka za Bukarešto, v Romuniji znana tudi kot obrambna operacija Argeş–Neajlov, je bila zadnja bitka romunske kampanje leta 1916 v prvi svetovni vojni. Vojske centralnih sil pod vodstvom generala Ericha von Falkenhayna so v njej zasedle romunsko prestolnico ter romunsko vlado in ostanke romunske vojske prisilile k umiku v Moldavijo, kjer je vlada prestolnico znova vzpostavila v Iaşiju.

Bitka je bila obrambne narave, saj se je romunski vojski pridružil del ruske cesarske vojske. Romunska vojska pod vodstvom generala Constantina Prezana pred tem ni mogla ustaviti nemškega protinapada v Munteniji. Sile protinapada so bile večinoma nemške; dve skupini sta napadli koncentrično, ena iz Oltenije, druga z ozemlja južno od Donave. Zaradi samega števila vojakov in velikega območja operacij velja za eno najbolj zapletenih bitk, ki so jih med vojno bojevali na romunskih tleh.

source.title: Battle of Bucharest
paragraphs: The Battle of Bucharest, also known as the Argeş–Neajlov Defensive Operation in Romania, was the last battle of the Romanian Campaign of 1916 in World War I, in which the Central Powers' combatants, led by General Erich von Falkenhayn, occupied the Romanian capital and forced the Romanian Government, as well as the remnants of the Romanian Army to retreat to Moldavia and re-establish its capital at Iaşi.

The battle was of defensive nature, as the Romanian Army was joined by a part of the Imperial Russian army. The Romanian Army, led by General Constantin Prezan, had previously been unable to stop the German counterattack in Muntenia. The forces comprising the German counterattack were largely German; two groups attacked in concentric fashion, one from Oltenia and the other from south of the Danube. The sheer number of troops involved, as well as the large area of operations, make it one of the most complex battles fought on Romanian soil during the war.

Battle of Burdigala.headline: Bitka pri Burdigali
paragraphs: Bitka pri Burdigali (rimsko ime za Bordeaux) je potekala med kimbrsko vojno leta 107 pr. n. št. V njej sta se spopadli združena keltsko-germanska vojska, v kateri so bili tudi helvetski Tigurini pod poveljstvom Divikona, in vojska rimske republike pod poveljstvom Lucija Kasija Longina, Lucija Cezonina in Gaja Popilija Laenata. Longin in Cezonin sta v bojih padla, bitka pa se je končala z zmago keltsko-germanskih plemen.

source.title: Battle of Burdigala
paragraphs: The Battle of Burdigala (the Roman name for Bordeaux) took place during the Cimbrian War in 107 BC. The battle was fought between a combined Celtic-Germanic army including the Helvetian Tigurini under the command of Divico, and the forces of the Roman Republic under the command of Lucius Cassius Longinus, Lucius Caesoninus, and Gaius Popillius Laenas. Longinus and Caesoninus were killed in the fighting and the battle resulted in a victory for the Celtic-Germanic tribes.

Battle of Burkersdorf (1762).headline: Bitka pri Burkersdorfu (1762)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Burkersdorfu je potekala 21. julija 1762 med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne). Pruska vojska s 23.000 možmi se je spopadla z avstrijsko vojsko s približno 20.000 možmi.

Po smrti ruske carice Elizabete je prestol zasedel njen nečak Peter III. Peter je bil velik občudovalec Friderika Velikega in vsega pruskega, kar je Friderik izkoristil sebi v prid. Peter je takoj umaknil vojsko iz vojne, zapustil Vzhodno Prusijo, ki so jo zasedli Rusi, in s Friderikom sklenil mir. Nato je poslal enote, da bi pruski vojski pomagale v pohodu proti Avstrijcem.

Petrova vladavina pa je bila kratka: prestol je zasedla njegova žena Katarina Velika, Peter pa je kmalu zatem umrl. Katarina je Rusijo umaknila iz vojne in grofu Zaharju Černišovu, ki je pomagal Prusom, ukazala umik.

source.title: Battle of Burkersdorf (1762)
paragraphs: The Battle of Burkersdorf took place on 21 July 1762 during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). A Prussian army of 23,000 men fought an Austrian army of around 20,000 men.

After the death of Elizabeth of Russia, czarina of Russia, her nephew Peter III came to the throne. Peter was a great admirer of Frederick the Great and all things Prussian, and Frederick used this to his advantage. Peter promptly withdrew his army from the war, abandoned Russian-occupied East Prussia, and signed a treaty of peace with Frederick. Peter then sent a force to aid the Prussian army in the campaign against the Austrians.

Peter's reign was short-lived, however, as his wife Catherine the Great seized the throne, and he died shortly afterwards. Catherine withdrew from the war and sent orders for Count Zakhar Tchernyshov aiding the Prussians to withdraw.

Battle of Cabezón.headline: Bitka pri Cabezónu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cabezónu je bila spopad na začetku polotoške vojne 12. junija 1808 med špansko kastiljsko vojsko pod Cuesto s sedežem v Valladolidu in oddelki francoskega armadnega korpusa maršala Bessièresa pod generaloma Lasallom in Merlom. Lasalle je še isti večer brez odpora zasedel Valladolid.
Merlovo kolono je sestavljalo šest bataljonov in dva eskadrona, Lasallovo pa so sestavljali štirje bataljoni in dva polka lovcev.
Cuestove sile so sestavljali štirje topovi in 4000 ali 5000 prostovoljcev, ki niso bili pod orožjem več kot dva tedna, ter 300 konjenikov, njegove edine izkušene enote.

source.title: Battle of Cabezón
paragraphs: The Battle of Cabezón was an engagement early in the Peninsular War on 12 June 1808 between Spain's Army of Castile, under Cuesta, based at Valladolid, and detachments of Marshal Bessières' French Army Corps under generals General Lasalle and Merle. Lasalle occupied Valladolid without opposition that same evening.
Merle's column consisted of six battalions and two squadrons, while Lasalle's was made up of four battalions and two regiments of chasseurs.
Cuesta's forces consisted of four cannon and 4,000 or 5,000 volunteers, who had not been more than a fortnight under arms, plus 300 cavalry, his only veteran troops.

Battle of Cádiz (1702).headline: Bitka pri Cádizu (1702)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cádizu je bila poskus angleških in nizozemskih sil leta 1702, da bi v vojni za špansko nasledstvo zavzele južnošpansko pristanišče Cádiz. Andaluzijsko pristanišče Cádiz je bilo središče španske trgovine z ameriškimi kolonijami. Zavzetje pristanišča bi zato ne le pomagalo pretrgati vezi Španije z njenim imperijem v Ameriki, temveč bi zaveznikom dalo tudi strateško pomembno oporišče, iz katerega bi angleška in nizozemska mornarica lahko nadzorovali zahodno Sredozemsko morje.

Vojaške priprave so spremljali zavezniški diplomatski ukrepi na Portugalskem, s katerimi so portugalskega kralja Petra II. skušali pridobiti za pristop k veliki alianci. Zavezniki so v Španiji nameravali tudi pridobiti podporo za upor v imenu avstrijskega pretendenta za španski prestol, nadvojvode Karla. Bitka je bila prva v tej vojni na Iberskem polotoku, toda zaradi rivalstva med rodovi vojske, slabe discipline, slabega sodelovanja in spretne obrambe markiza Villadariasa admiral George Rooke cilja ni dosegel in je po mesecu dni odplul domov.

source.title: Battle of Cádiz (1702)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cádiz was an attempt by English and Dutch forces to seize the southern Spanish port of Cádiz in 1702 during the War of the Spanish Succession. The Andalusian port of Cádiz served as the centre of Spanish trade with its American colonies. As such, the port's capture would not only help to sever Spain's links with her empire in the Americas, but it would also provide the Allies with a strategically important base from which the English and Dutch navies could control the western Mediterranean Sea.

The military build-up was accompanied by Allied diplomatic measures in Portugal aimed at enticing King Peter II to join the Grand Alliance. The Allies also intended to garner support in Spain for an insurrection in the name of the Austrian pretender to the Spanish throne, the Archduke Charles. The battle was the first of the war in the Iberian Peninsula, but due to interservice rivalry, ill discipline, poor co-operation, and a skilful defence from the Marquis of Villadarias, Admiral George Rooke was unable to complete his objective and, after a month, he set sail for home.

Battle of Cadzand.headline: Bitka pri Cadzandu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cadzandu je bila zgodnji manjši spopad stoletne vojne leta 1337. Šlo je za napad na flamski otok Cadzand, s katerim so hoteli izzvati domačo posadko k odzivu in boju ter z lahko zmago vojske kralja Edvarda III. dvigniti moralo v Angliji in med njegovimi celinskimi zavezniki. Sir Walter Manny je 9. novembra s predhodnico Edvardove celinske invazije poskušal zavzeti mesto Sluis, a so ga odbili.

source.title: Battle of Cadzand
paragraphs: The Battle of Cadzand was an early skirmish of the Hundred Years' War fought in 1337. It consisted of a raid on the Flemish island of Cadzand, designed to provoke a reaction and battle from the local garrison and so improve morale in England and amongst King Edward III's continental allies by providing his army with an easy victory. On 9 November Sir Walter Manny, with the advance troops for Edward III's continental invasion, made an attempt to take the city of Sluys, but was driven off.

Battle of Caen (1346).headline: Bitka pri Caenu (1346)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Caenu je bila napad sil Kraljevine Anglije pod vodstvom kralja Edvarda III., ki so 26. julija 1346 v okviru stoletne vojne udarile na Caen, mesto v francoskih rokah, in na Normandijo.

Napad je bil del pustošečega pohoda (chevauchée) Edvarda III., ki se je začel mesec prej, ko so se Angleži izkrcali v Normandiji. Francozom angleških transportnih ladij ni uspelo prestreči na morju in so bili presenečeni, saj je bila njihova glavna vojska z več kot 15.000 možmi v Gaskonji. Angleži skoraj niso naleteli na odpor in so pred napadom na Caen opustošili velik del Normandije. Del angleške vojske, ki je štela 12.000–15.000 mož, je pod poveljstvom grofov Warwicka in Northamptona prehitro napadel Caen. Mesto je branilo 1000–1500 vojakov, ki jim je pomagalo neznano, a veliko število oboroženih meščanov, poveljeval pa jim je Raoul, grof Euja, veliki konetabl Francije. Mesto je padlo že ob prvem naskoku. Ubitih je bilo več kot 5000 navadnih vojakov in meščanov, nekaj plemičev pa so ujeli. Mesto so pet dni plenili.

source.title: Battle of Caen (1346)
paragraphs: The Battle of Caen was an assault conducted on 26 July 1346 by forces from the Kingdom of England, led by King Edward III, on the French-held town of Caen and Normandy as a part of the Hundred Years' War.

The assault was part of the Chevauchée of Edward III, which had started a month earlier when the English landed in Normandy. The French failed to intercept the English transports at sea and were taken by surprise, with their main army of more than 15,000 men in Gascony. The English were virtually unopposed and devastated much of Normandy before assaulting Caen. Part of the English army, which consisted of 12,000–15,000, commanded by the Earls of Warwick and Northampton, prematurely attacked Caen. It was garrisoned by 1,000–1,500 soldiers, who were supplemented by an unknown, large number of armed townsmen, and commanded by Raoul, the Count of Eu, the Grand Constable of France. The town was captured in the first assault. More than 5,000 of the ordinary soldiers and townspeople were killed, and a few nobles were taken prisoner. The town was sacked for five days.

Battle of Calcinato.headline: Bitka pri Calcinatu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Calcinatu je potekala blizu Calcinata v Lombardiji v Italiji 19. aprila 1706 v španski nasledstveni vojni. Združena francosko-španska vojska pod poveljstvom vojvode de Vendôme je porazila cesarske sile pod grofom von Reventlowom.

source.title: Battle of Calcinato
paragraphs: The Battle of Calcinato took place near Calcinato in Lombardy, Italy on 19 April 1706 during the War of the Spanish Succession. A combined French-Spanish army led by the duc de Vendôme defeated an Imperial force under Graf von Reventlow.

Battle of Caldiero (1805).headline: Bitka pri Caldieru leta 1805
paragraphs: Bitka pri Caldieru je potekala 30. oktobra 1805: francoska italijanska armada (Armée d'Italie) pod maršalom Andréjem Masséno se je spopadla z avstrijsko vojsko pod poveljstvom nadvojvode Karla, tešinskega vojvode. Francozi so v boj poslali le del svojih sil, okoli 33.000 mož, nadvojvoda Karel pa glavnino svoje vojske, 49.000 mož; korpus Paula Davidovicha je pustil v obrambi spodnje Adige, korpus Franza Seraha Orsini-Rosenberga pa je pokrival avstrijski desni bok pred morebitnimi obhodnimi manevri. Spopad je potekal pri Caldieru, 15 kilometrov vzhodno od Verone, v vojni tretje koalicije, delu napoleonskih vojn.

source.title: Battle of Caldiero (1805)
paragraphs: The Battle of Caldiero took place on 30 October 1805, pitting the French Armée d'Italie under Marshal André Masséna against an Austrian army under the command of Archduke Charles, Duke of Teschen. The French engaged only some of their forces, around 33,000 men, but Archduke Charles engaged the bulk of his army, 49,000 men, leaving out Paul Davidovich's corps to defend the lower Adige and Franz Seraph of Orsini-Rosenberg's corps to cover the Austrian right against any flanking maneuvers. The fighting took place at Caldiero, 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) east of Verona, during the War of the Third Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

Battle of Callinicus.headline: Bitka pri Kaliniku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kaliniku (grško: μάχη του Καλλίνικου) je potekala leta 171 pr. n. št. med Makedonijo in Rimsko republiko blizu griča Kalinik, v bližini rimskega tabora v Tripolisu Larisaji, pet kilometrov severno od Larise, glavnega mesta Tesalije. Spopad se je zgodil v prvem letu tretje makedonske vojne (171–168 pr. n. št.). Makedonce je vodil njihov kralj Perzej Makedonski, rimske sile pa konzul Publij Licinij Kras. Makedonce so podpirali Kotis IV., kralj Odriškega kraljestva (največje države v Trakiji), s svojimi silami, kretski najemniki in pomožne čete mešanih narodnosti. Rimljani so imeli s seboj italske zaveznike, podpirali pa so jih vojaki, ki jih je poslal Evmen II. Pergamski, ter oddelek tesalske konjenice in grški zavezniki. V bitki so konjenico pomešali z lahko pehoto. Bitka se dejansko ni odločila, ker se je Perzej umaknil, preden se je končala, vendar so jo šteli za makedonsko zmago, saj so Rimljani utrpeli hude izgube.

source.title: Battle of Callinicus
paragraphs: The Battle of Callinicus (Greek: μάχη του Καλλίνικου) was fought in 171 BC between Macedonia and the Roman Republic near a hill called Callinicus, close to the Roman camp at Tripolis Larisaia, five kilometres north of Larissa, the capital of Thessaly. It was fought during the first year of the Third Macedonian War (171-168 BC). The Macedonians were led by their king, Perseus of Macedon, while the Roman force was led by the consul Publius Licinius Crassus. The Macedonians were supported by Cotys IV, the king of the Odrysian kingdom (the largest state in Thrace) and his forces, Cretan mercenaries, and auxiliaries of mixed nationalities. The Romans had their Italian allies with them and were supported by soldiers provided by Eumenes II of Pergamon, as well as a force of Thessalian cavalry and Greek allies. The battle saw the deployment of troops with cavalry intermixed with light infantry. Although the battle was actually inconclusive because Perseus withdrew before it came to a conclusion, it was considered a Macedonian victory because the Romans suffered heavy casualties.

Battle of Călugăreni.headline: Bitka pri Călugăreniju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Călugăreniju je potekala v zgodnjem novem veku romunske zgodovine, 23. avgusta [13. avgusta po starem koledarju] 1595, med vlaško vojsko pod vodstvom Mihaela Hrabrega in osmansko vojsko pod vodstvom Koce Sinan-paše. Bila je del dolge turške vojne, ki so jo krščanske in osmanske sile bojevale konec 16. in v začetku 17. stoletja.
Vso osmansko vojsko so ocenjevali na 100.000 mož, a vsi niso bili na bojišču pri Călugăreniju. V bitki naj bi sodelovalo le okoli 30.000–40.000 osmanskih vojakov.

source.title: Battle of Călugăreni
paragraphs: The Battle of Călugăreni took place during the history of early modern Romania on 23 August [O.S. 13 August] 1595 between the Wallachian army led by Michael the Brave and the Ottoman army led by Koca Sinan Pasha. It was part of the Long Turkish War, fought between Christian and Ottoman forces at the end of the 16th and the beginning of the 17th centuries.

The whole Ottoman force was estimated at 100,000 men, but not all of their troops were on the battlefield at Călugăreni. It seems that only about 30,000-40,000 Ottoman soldiers were involved in the battle.
