Bitka za Cambrai (bitka pri Cambraiju 1917, prva bitka za Cambrai, nemško Schlacht von Cambrai) je bila britanski napad v prvi svetovni vojni, ki mu je sledil največji nemški protinapad na britansko ekspedicijsko silo (BEF) od leta 1914. Mesto Cambrai v departmaju Nord v Franciji je bilo pomembno oskrbovalno središče za nemško Siegfriedstellung (Britancem znano kot Hindenburgova linija), zavzetje mesta in bližnjega grebena Bourlon pa bi ogrozilo zaledje nemške linije na severu. Generalmajor Henry Tudor, poveljnik kraljevega topništva (CRA) 9. (škotske) divizije, se je v svojem odseku fronte zavzemal za novo taktiko sodelovanja topništva in pehote. Med pripravami je J. F. C. Fuller, štabni častnik tankovskega korpusa, iskal kraje, kjer bi lahko tanke uporabili za vpade. General Julian Byng, poveljnik 3. armade, se je odločil združiti oba načrta. Francoska in britanska vojska sta tanke množično uporabili že v začetku leta 1917, vendar z veliko manjšim učinkom.

source.title: Battle of Cambrai (1917)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cambrai (Battle of Cambrai, 1917, First Battle of Cambrai and Schlacht von Cambrai) was a British attack in the First World War, followed by the biggest German counter-attack against the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) since 1914. The town of Cambrai, in the département of Nord, in France, was an important supply centre for the German Siegfriedstellung (known to the British as the Hindenburg Line) and capture of the town and the nearby Bourlon Ridge would threaten the rear of the German line to the north. Major General Henry Tudor, Commander, Royal Artillery (CRA), of the 9th (Scottish) Division, advocated the use of new artillery-infantry tactics on his sector of the front. During preparations, J. F. C. Fuller, a staff officer with the Tank Corps, looked for places to use tanks for raids. General Julian Byng, commander of the Third Army, decided to combine both plans. The French and British armies had used tanks en masse earlier in 1917, although to considerably less effect.

Bitka za Cambrai leta 1918 (znana tudi kot druga bitka za Cambrai) je bila spopad med enotami britanske 1., 3. in 4. armade ter silami Nemškega cesarstva med stodnevno ofenzivo prve svetovne vojne. Potekala je v francoskem mestu Cambrai in okoli njega med 8. in 10. oktobrom 1918. V bitki so uporabili veliko novejših taktik iz leta 1918, zlasti tanke. Sodelovalo je več kot 300 tankov, ki so v manj kot 36 urah osvojili precej ozemlja; britanske izgube so bile za približno 2000 mož večje od nemških, kar je bilo v primerjavi s prejšnjimi fazami vojne malo.

source.title: Battle of Cambrai (1918)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cambrai, 1918 (also known as the Second Battle of Cambrai) was fought between troops of the British First, Third and Fourth Armies and German Empire forces during the Hundred Days Offensive of the First World War. The battle took place in and around the French city of Cambrai, between 8 and 10 October 1918. The battle incorporated many of the newer tactics of 1918, in particular tanks. The battle witnessed over 300 tanks taking part, gaining considerable ground in less than 36 hours, with about 2,000 more British casualties than German, which was light relative to earlier phases of the war.

Battle of Campo Tenese.headline: Bitka pri Campo Tenese
paragraphs: V bitki pri Campo Tenese (9. marca 1806) sta dve diviziji francoske neapeljske armade pod poveljstvom Jeana Reynierja napadli levo krilo kraljeve neapeljske vojske pod Rogerjem de Damasom. Čeprav so bili branilci zaščiteni s poljskimi utrdbami, je čelni francoski napad v kombinaciji z obhodnim manevrom položaj hitro preplavil in Neapeljčane z velikimi izgubami razbil. Spopad je potekal v Campotenese, majhni gorski vasi v občini Morano Calabro na severu Kalabrije. Bitka je bila del vojne tretje koalicije v napoleonskih vojnah.

source.title: Battle of Campo Tenese
paragraphs: The Battle of Campo Tenese (9 March 1806) saw two divisions of the French Army of Naples led by Jean Reynier attack the left wing of the Royal Neapolitan Army under Roger de Damas. Though the defenders were protected by field fortifications, a French frontal attack combined with a turning movement rapidly overran the position and routed the Neapolitans with heavy losses. The action occurred at Campotenese, a little mountain village in the municipality of Morano Calabro in the north of Calabria. The battle was fought during the War of the Third Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

Battle of Cannae (1018).headline: Bitka pri Kanah leta 1018
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kanah je potekala leta 1018 med Bizantinci pod katepanom Italije Bazilijem Bojoanesom in Langobardi pod Melom iz Barija. Langobardi so najeli tudi nekaj normanskih konjeniških najemnikov pod njihovim vodjo Gilbertom Buatèrejem, Bojoanesu pa so na njegovo prošnjo poslali oddelek elitne varjaške garde za boj proti Normanom. Bil je eden prvih spopadov med južnoitalijanskimi Bizantinci in Normani.

Za Langobarde je bila bitka pogubna: razbili so jih. Melo iz Barija je uspel pobegniti v Papeško državo in nazadnje na dvor svetorimskega cesarja Henrika II. v Bambergu. Normani so izgubili svojega vodjo Gilberta Buatèreja in večino svoje skupine. Vendar so bili preostali Normani iz te skupine prvi od mnogih, ki so odšli v južno Italijo.
V enem letu so v Troii namestili normansko posadko v bizantinski službi.

source.title: Battle of Cannae (1018)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cannae took place in 1018 between the Byzantines under the Catepan of Italy Basil Boioannes and the Lombards under Melus of Bari. The Lombards had also hired some Norman cavalry mercenaries under their leader Gilbert Buatère, while Boioannes had a detachment of elite Varangian Guard sent to him at his request to combat the Normans. The engagement was one of the first clashes between the Byzantines of southern Italy and the Normans.

The battle was disastrous for the Lombards, who were routed. Melus of Bari managed to escape to the Papal States and eventually to the court of Holy Roman Emperor Henry II at Bamberg. The Normans lost their leader, Gilbert Buatère, and most of their group. However, what remained of this group of Normans was the first of many to go to southern Italy.
Within a year, a Norman garrison would be stationed at Troia in the pay of the Byzantine Empire.

Battle of Canusium.headline: Bitka pri Canusiumu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Canusiumu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Askulu, je bila tridnevni spopad med silami Rima in Kartagine. Potekal je v Apuliji spomladi 209 pr. n. št., v desetem letu druge punske vojne. Bila je del večje rimske ofenzive, katere cilj je bil podjarmiti in kaznovati mesta in plemena, ki so po bitki pri Kanah zapustila zavezništvo z Rimom, ter zožiti oporišče kartažanskega vodje Hanibala v južni Italiji.

Bitka pri Canusiumu je bila tudi epizoda dolgoletnega boja za nadzor nad tem ozemljem med Hanibalom in rimskim poveljnikom Markom Klavdijem Marcelom. Ker nobena stran ni dosegla odločilne zmage in sta obe utrpeli znatne izgube (skupaj do 14.000 mrtvih), so lahko antični in sodobni zgodovinarji izid te bitke razlagali različno. Čeprav je Marcel pri Canusiumu doživel hud udarec, je vendarle za nekaj časa zaustavil gibanje glavnih punskih sil in tako prispeval k hkratnim rimskim uspehom proti Hanibalovim zaveznikom v Veliki Grčiji in Lukaniji.
notes: The English alternative name Battle of Asculum is also the name of the 279 BC Pyrrhic battle (glossary: Bitka pri Askulu); kept as in the source.

source.title: Battle of Canusium
paragraphs: The Battle of Canusium also known as the Battle of Asculum was a three-day engagement between the forces of Rome and Carthage. It took place in Apulia during the spring of 209 BC, the tenth year of the Second Punic War. A larger Roman offensive, of which it was a part, aimed to subjugate and to punish cities and tribes that had abandoned the alliance with Rome after the Battle of Cannae, and to narrow the base of the Carthaginian leader, Hannibal, in southern Italy.

The battle of Canusium was also an episode of the years-long contest between Hannibal and the Roman general Marcus Claudius Marcellus for control over that territory. As neither side gained a decisive victory and both suffered considerable losses (up to 14,000 killed overall), the outcome of this engagement was open to differing interpretations by both ancient and modern historians. While Marcellus took a heavy blow at Canusium, he nevertheless checked for some time the movements of the main Punic forces and thus contributed to the simultaneous Roman successes against Hannibal's allies in Magna Graecia and Lucania.

Battle of Cape Ecnomus.headline: Bitka pri rtu Ecnomus
paragraphs: Bitka pri rtu Ecnomus ali Eknomos (starogrško: Ἔκνομος) je bila pomorska bitka, ki je potekala ob južni Siciliji leta 256 pr. n. št. med ladjevjema Kartagine in Rimske republike v prvi punski vojni (264–241 pr. n. št.). Kartažanskemu ladjevju sta poveljevala Hanon in Hamilkar, rimskemu pa skupaj tedanja konzula Mark Atilij Regul in Lucij Manlij Vulson Longus. Končala se je z jasno rimsko zmago.

Rimsko ladjevje s 330 vojaškimi ladjami in neznanim številom transportnih ladij je izplulo iz Ostije, rimskega pristanišča, in tik pred bitko vkrcalo približno 26.000 izbranih legionarjev. Nameravali so prečkati morje do Afrike in vdreti v kartažansko domovino, v današnji Tuniziji. Kartažani so poznali rimske namere in zbrali vse razpoložljive vojaške ladje, 350, ob južni obali Sicilije, da bi jih prestregli. Z okoli 680 vojaškimi ladjami in do 290.000 možmi posadk in mornariških pehotincev je bila bitka morda največja posamična bitka antične zgodovine, po številu udeležencev pa verjetno tudi največja pomorska bitka v zgodovini.

source.title: Battle of Cape Ecnomus
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape Ecnomus or Eknomos (Ancient Greek: Ἔκνομος) was a naval battle, fought off southern Sicily, in 256 BC, between the fleets of Carthage and the Roman Republic, during the First Punic War (264–241 BC). The Carthaginian fleet was commanded by Hanno and Hamilcar; the Roman fleet jointly by the consuls for the year, Marcus Atilius Regulus and Lucius Manlius Vulso Longus. It resulted in a clear victory for the Romans.

The Roman fleet of 330 warships plus an unknown number of transports had sailed from Ostia, the port of Rome, and had embarked approximately 26,000 picked legionaries shortly before the battle. They planned to cross to Africa and invade the Carthaginian homeland, in Tunisia. The Carthaginians were aware of the Romans' intentions and mustered all available warships, 350, off the south coast of Sicily to intercept them. With a combined total of about 680 warships carrying up to 290,000 crew and marines, the battle was arguably the single largest battle of ancient history, and was possibly the largest naval battle in history by the number of combatants involved.

Battle of Cape Finisterre (1805).headline: Bitka pri rtu Finisterre (1805)
paragraphs: V bitki pri rtu Finisterre (22. julija 1805) pred Galicijo v Španiji se je britansko ladjevje pod admiralom Robertom Calderjem v neodločeni pomorski bitki spopadlo z združenim francosko-španskim ladjevjem, ki se je vračalo iz Zahodne Indije. Britanci so zajeli dve španski linijski ladji, niso pa preprečili, da bi se ladjevje francoskega viceadmirala Pierra-Charlesa Villeneuva združilo z eskadro iz Ferrola, in niso zadali uničujočega udarca, ki bi Veliko Britanijo rešil nevarnosti invazije. Calderju so pozneje sodili pred vojaškim sodiščem in ga ostro grajali zaradi neuspeha in ker 23. in 24. julija ni obnovil spopada. Hkrati se je Villeneuve po bitki odločil, da ne bo nadaljeval proti Brestu, kjer bi se njegovo ladjevje lahko združilo z drugimi francoskimi ladjami in očistilo Rokavski preliv za invazijo na Veliko Britanijo.

source.title: Battle of Cape Finisterre (1805)
paragraphs: In the Battle of Cape Finisterre (22 July 1805) off Galicia, Spain, the British fleet under Admiral Robert Calder fought an indecisive naval battle against the combined Franco-Spanish fleet which was returning from the West Indies. In the ensuing battle the British captured two Spanish ships of the line, but failed to prevent the joining of French Vice-admiral Pierre-Charles Villeneuve's fleet to the squadron of Ferrol and to strike the shattering blow that would have freed Great Britain from the danger of an invasion. Calder was later court-martialled and severely reprimanded for his failure and for avoiding the renewal of the engagement on 23 and 24 July. At the same time, in the aftermath Villeneuve elected not to continue on to Brest, where his fleet could have joined with other French ships to clear the English Channel for an invasion of Great Britain.

Battle of Cape Ortegal.headline: Bitka pri rtu Ortegal
paragraphs: Bitka pri rtu Ortegal je bila zadnji spopad trafalgarske kampanje, v katerem sta se spopadli eskadra Kraljeve vojne mornarice in ostanek francoskega ladjevja, poraženega v bitki pri Trafalgarju. Potekala je 4. novembra 1805 pred rtom Ortegal na severozahodu Španije, kapitan sir Richard Strachan pa je v njej premagal in zajel francosko eskadro pod poveljstvom kontraadmirala Pierra Dumanoirja le Pelleyja. Včasih jo imenujejo Strachanov spopad.

source.title: Battle of Cape Ortegal
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape Ortegal was the final action of the Trafalgar campaign, and was fought between a squadron of the Royal Navy and a remnant of the French fleet that had been defeated earlier at the Battle of Trafalgar. It took place on 4 November 1805 off Cape Ortegal, in north-west Spain and saw Captain Sir Richard Strachan defeat and capture a French squadron under Counter-admiral Pierre Dumanoir le Pelley. It is sometimes referred to as Strachan's Action.

Battle of Cape Passaro.headline: Bitka pri rtu Passaro
paragraphs: Bitka pri rtu Passaro (znana tudi kot bitka pri Avoli ali bitka pri Sirakuzah) je potekala 11.–12. avgusta 1718 ob rtu Passaro med britanskim ladjevjem pod admiralom flote sirom Georgeom Byngom in španskim ladjevjem pod generalporočnikom Josém Antoniem de Gaztañeto v vojni četverne zveze. Bojevali so se ob južni konici Sicilije, ki so jo španske sile tistega leta že prej napadle in zasedle, bitka pa se je izkazala za najpomembnejši dogodek vse vojne.

source.title: Battle of Cape Passaro
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape Passaro (also known as the Battle of Avola or Battle of Syracuse) was fought on 11–12 August 1718 off Cape Passaro between a British fleet under Admiral of the Fleet Sir George Byng and a Spanish fleet under Lieutenant-general José Antonio de Gaztañeta during the War of the Quadruple Alliance. Fought off the southern tip of Sicily, which Spanish forces had invaded and occupied earlier that year, the battle proved to be the most significant event of the entire war.

Battle of Cape Spada.headline: Bitka pri rtu Spada
paragraphs: Bitka pri rtu Spada (italijansko: Battaglia di Capo Spada) je bila pomorska bitka med britansko kraljevo vojno mornarico in italijansko Regia Marina v bitki za Sredozemlje med drugo svetovno vojno. Potekala je dopoldne 19. julija 1940 pri rtu Spada, severozahodnem koncu Krete.

Italijansko 2ª Divisione Incrociatori (2. divizijo križark) sta sestavljali hitri lahki križarki Giovanni delle Bande Nere in Bartolomeo Colleoni. V nenačrtovanem srečanju se je spopadla z 2. flotiljo rušilcev britanske mornarice ter s samostojno plujočo lahko križarko HMAS Sydney in rušilcem HMS Havock.

V bitki so Britanci potopili križarko Bartolomeo Colleoni in poškodovali Giovannija delle Bande Nere, Sydney pa je utrpela manjšo škodo. Z Bartolomea Colleonija so rešili 555 preživelih, 121 mož pa je umrlo. Kapitan bojne ladje Umberto Novaro je bil smrtno ranjen in je umrl 23. julija.

source.title: Battle of Cape Spada
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape Spada (Battaglia di Capo Spada) was a naval battle between the Royal Navy and the Regia Marina during the Battle of the Mediterranean in the second World War. It took place during the morning of 19 July 1940 off Cape Spada, the north-western extremity of Crete.

The Italian 2ª Divisione Incrociatori (2nd Cruiser Division) comprised the fast light cruisers Giovanni delle Bande Nere and Bartolomeo Colleoni. In a meeting encounter it engaged the Royal Navy's 2nd Destroyer Flotilla and the independently sailing light cruiser HMAS Sydney and destroyer HMS Havock.

During the battle Bartolomeo Colleoni was sunk and Giovanni delle Bande Nere damaged, with minor damage inflicted on Sydney. There were 555 survivors from Bartolomeo Colleoni but 121 men were killed. Capitano di vascello Umberto Novaro was mortally wounded and died on 23 July.

Bitka pri rtu São Vicente je bila pomorska bitka 14. februarja 1797 med britansko in špansko vojno mornarico pred rtom São Vicente na Portugalskem v vojni prve koalicije. V eni prvih bitk nedavno napovedane vojne med Britanijo in Španijo je britansko ladjevje pod admiralom modre zastave sirom Johnom Jervisom premagalo večje špansko ladjevje pod generalporočnikom Joséjem de Córdobo y Ramosom, ki je izplulo iz Cádiza, da bi se spopadlo z britansko mornarico. Komodor Horatio Nelson se je v bitki izkazal, ko je z abordažo zavzel dve španski linijski ladji.

source.title: Battle of Cape St. Vincent (1797)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cape St. Vincent was a fleet action fought on 14 February 1797 between the British and Spanish navies off Cape St. Vincent in Portugal as part of the War of the First Coalition. In one of the opening battles of the recently declared war between Britain and Spain, a British fleet under Admiral of the Blue Sir John Jervis defeated a larger Spanish fleet under Lieutenant-general José de Córdoba y Ramos which had left Cádiz to confront the British navy. Commodore Horatio Nelson distinguished himself in the battle by boarding and capturing two Spanish ships of the line.

Battle of Capua (212 BC).headline: Prva bitka pri Capui
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Capui je potekala leta 212 pr. n. št. med Hanibalom Barko in dvema rimskima konzularnima vojskama. Rimsko vojsko sta vodila konzula Kvint Fulvij Flak in Apij Klavdij Pulher. Rimska vojska je bila poražena, a ji je uspelo pobegniti. Hanibalu je začasno uspelo prekiniti obleganje Capue. Čeprav je bila to taktična kartažanska zmaga, Capuancem nazadnje ni pomagala.

source.title: Battle of Capua (212 BC)
paragraphs: The First Battle of Capua was fought in 212 BC between Hannibal Barca and two Roman consular armies. The Roman force was led by two consuls, Quintus Fulvius Flaccus and Appius Claudius Pulcher. The Roman force was defeated, but managed to escape. Hannibal temporarily managed to raise the siege of Capua. A tactical Carthaginian victory, it ultimately did not help the Capuans.

Battle of Carentan.headline: Bitka pri Carentanu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Carentanu je bila spopad med zračnoprevoznimi enotami Kopenske vojske ZDA in nemškim Wehrmachtom med bitko za Normandijo v drugi svetovni vojni. Potekala je od 10. do 14. junija 1944 na pristopih k francoskemu mestu Carentan in v njem.

Cilj napadajočih ameriških sil je bil utrditi ameriški mostišči na obali (Utah Beach in Omaha Beach) in vzpostaviti sklenjeno obrambno črto proti pričakovanim nemškim protinapadom. Nemški branilci so skušali mesto držati dovolj dolgo, da bi prispele okrepitve, ki so bile na poti z juga, da bi preprečili ali zavlekli združitev obeh mostišč in da ameriška 1. armada ne bi mogla napasti proti Lessay-Périersu ter odrezati polotoka Cotentin.

source.title: Battle of Carentan
paragraphs: The Battle of Carentan was an engagement in World War II between airborne forces of the United States Army and the German Wehrmacht during the Battle of Normandy. The battle took place from 10 to 14 June 1944, on the approaches to and within the town of Carentan, France.

The objective of the attacking American forces was consolidation of the U.S. beachheads (Utah Beach and Omaha Beach) and establishment of a continuous defensive line against expected German counterattacks. The defending German force attempted to hold the town long enough to allow reinforcements en route from the south to arrive, prevent or delay the merging of the lodgments, and keep the U.S. First Army from launching an attack towards Lessay-Périers that would cut off the Cotentin Peninsula.

Battle of Carpi.headline: Bitka pri Carpiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Carpiju je bila niz spopadov poleti 1701 in prva bitka španske nasledstvene vojne, ki je potekala 9. julija 1701 med Francijo in Avstrijo. Bila je manjši spopad, za katerega je francoski poveljnik presodil, da se ga ne splača bojevati, vendar so bili njegovi vojaki z odločitvijo o umiku nezadovoljni, poveljnika pa so pozneje zamenjali.

source.title: Battle of Carpi
paragraphs: The Battle of Carpi was a series of engagements in the summer of 1701, and the first battle of the War of the Spanish Succession that took place on 9 July 1701 between France and Austria. It was a minor skirmish that the French commander decided was not worth fighting, but his soldiers were displeased at his decision to retreat, and he was subsequently replaced.

Battle of Cassano (1705).headline: Bitka pri Cassanu leta 1705
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cassanu je potekala 16. avgusta 1705 v španski nasledstveni vojni blizu Cassana d'Adda v Lombardiji v Italiji. Spopadla sta se francoska vojska pod poveljstvom vojvode de Vendôme in cesarska vojska pod princem Evgenom Savojskim.

Oktobra 1703 se je Viktor Amadej II. Savojski pridružil veliki zvezi. Do avgusta 1705 so Francozi zasedli večino Savoje in nameravali oblegati Torino. Princ Evgen je skušal to upočasniti tako, da bi pri Cassanu prečkal Addo in zagrozil Milanu.

Francozi so bili presenečeni, vendar so po več urah boja obdržali most, obe strani pa sta utrpeli hude izgube. Princ Evgen ni mogel prečkati Adde, je pa upočasnil francoski napad na Torino, medtem ko so Vendôma in številne njegove čete maja 1706 odpoklicali v Francijo. Torino so septembra osvobodili, vojna v severni Italiji pa se je končala z milansko konvencijo marca 1707.

source.title: Battle of Cassano (1705)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cassano took place on 16 August 1705, during the War of the Spanish Succession, near Cassano d'Adda, in Lombardy, Italy. It was fought between a French army commanded by the duc de Vendôme, and an Imperial force under Prince Eugene of Savoy.

In October 1703, Victor Amadeus II of Savoy joined the Grand Alliance. By August 1705, the French had occupied most of Savoy, and were about to besiege Turin. Prince Eugene sought to delay this by crossing the Adda at Cassano, and threatening Milan.

Taken by surprise, the French managed to hold the bridge after several hours of combat, both sides suffering heavy casualties. Prince Eugene was unable to cross the Adda but delayed the assault on Turin, while Vendôme and many of his troops were recalled to France in May 1706. Turin was relieved in September, and the war in Northern Italy ended with the March 1707 Convention of Milan.

Battle of Cassano (1799).headline: Bitka pri Cassanu leta 1799
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cassanu (francosko: Bataille de Cassano, nemško: Schlacht bei Cassano) je potekala od 27. do 28. aprila 1799 (po starem koledarju od 16. do 17. aprila) blizu Cassana d'Adda, približno 28 kilometrov vzhodnoseverovzhodno od Milana. Spopad je del bitke ob reki Adda (rusko: Сражение на реке Адда, nemško: Schlacht an der Adda) ali tako imenovanega prisilnega prehoda čez Addo. Prvi dan, 26. aprila (po starem koledarju 15. aprila), so Rusi pod grofom Suvorovom pri Lecchu dosegli manjšo zmago nad francoskimi silami Barthélemyja Schérerja. Drugi dan so Suvorovovi Avstrijci in kozaki premagali vojsko Jeana Moreauja, ki je Schérerja nadomestil kot vrhovni poveljnik, tretji dan pa ujeli njegovo osamljeno divizijo. Bitka je potekala v vojni druge koalicije, v okviru širšega spopada, znanega kot francoske revolucionarne vojne. Moreau za svoj poraz ni bil povsem odgovoren: večino odgovornosti nosi Schérer, ki je svoje čete preveč raztegnil in ni izkoristil prednosti svojega položaja.
notes: The mile conversion (17 mi) is dropped; the Russian name is kept in Cyrillic.

source.title: Battle of Cassano (1799)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cassano (French: Bataille de Cassano, German: Schlacht bei Cassano) was fought in 1799 from 27 to 28 April (O.S.: 16 to 17 April) near Cassano d'Adda, which about 28 km (17 mi) ENE of Milan. The clash is part of the battle of the Adda River (Russian: Сражение на реке Адда, German: Schlacht an der Adda) or the so-called forcing of the Adda, which on the first day of 26 April (O.S.: 15 April) resulted in a minor victory for the Russians under the Count Suvorov over Barthélemy Schérer's French forces at Lecco. Then, on the second day, Suvorov's Austrians and Cossacks prevailed over Jean Moreau's army, who replaced Schérer as supreme commander, and trapped his isolated division on the third. The action took place during the War of the Second Coalition, as part of the larger conflict known as the French Revolutionary Wars. Moreau was not entirely responsible for his defeat, much of the responsibility for which lies with Schérer, who overextended his troops and failed to exploit the advantages of his position.

Battle of Cassel (1071).headline: Bitka pri Casselu (1071)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Casselu je potekala februarja 1071 med flandrijskim grofom Robertom I. (ali Robertom Frizijcem) in njegovim nečakom Arnulfom III. (sinom flandrijskega grofa Balduina VI.). Zmagal je Robert, Arnulf pa je v bitki padel.

Arnulf je leta 1070 nasledil očeta Balduina, podpirala pa ga je mati Richilda, grofica Monsa in Hainauta. Robert je izpodbijal Arnulfovo nasledstvo flandrijskega prestola in začel zbirati podporo predvsem v severni Flandriji (kjer je bila večina Arnulfovih sil). V Arnulfovih vrstah sta bila Evstahij II. in Evstahij III. Boulognski, podpiral pa ga je tudi francoski kralj Filip I. Med silami, ki jih je Filip poslal Arnulfu na pomoč, je bil tudi odred desetih normanskih vitezov pod vodstvom Viljema FitzOsberna.

Robertove sile so Arnulfovo številčnejšo vojsko napadle, preden se je utegnila urediti. Arnulf je padel skupaj z Viljemom FitzOsbernom, Richildo pa so Robertove sile ujele. Tudi Roberta je ujel Evstahij II. Nazadnje so Richildo zamenjali za Robertovo svobodo.

source.title: Battle of Cassel (1071)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cassel was fought in February 1071 between Robert I of Flanders (or Robert the Frisian) and his nephew, Arnulf III (son of Baldwin VI of Flanders). The battle was a victory for Robert, and Arnulf was killed in the battle.

Arnulf succeeded his father Baldwin in 1070 and was supported by his mother Richilde, Countess of Mons and Hainaut. However, Robert challenged Arnulf's succession to the throne of Flanders and began rallying support mainly in northern Flanders (where the bulk of Arnulf's forces were located). Arnulf's ranks contained Eustace II and Eustace III of Boulogne. Moreover, Arnulf was supported by King Philip I of France. A contingent of ten Norman knights led by William FitzOsbern were among the forces sent by Philip to aid Arnulf.

Robert's forces attacked Arnulf's numerically superior army before it could organize. Arnulf himself was killed along with William FitzOsbern, while Richilde was captured by Robert's forces. However, Robert himself was also captured by Eustace II. Ultimately, Richilde was exchanged for Robert's freedom.

Battle of Cassel (1328).headline: Bitka pri Casselu (1328)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Casselu je potekala 23. avgusta 1328 blizu mesta Cassel, 30 km južno od Dunkerqua v današnji Franciji. Filip VI. (francoski kralj od leta 1328 do 1350) se je spopadel z Nicolaasom Zannekinom, premožnim kmetom iz Lampernisseja, ki je vodil skupino flamskih upornikov. Boji so izbruhnili zaradi davkov in kazenskih odlokov, ki so jih Francozi naložili Flamcem. Francozi so prepričljivo zmagali. V bitki so padli Zannekin in okoli 3200 flamskih upornikov.

source.title: Battle of Cassel (1328)
paragraphs: On 23 August 1328, the Battle of Cassel took place near the city of Cassel, 30 km south of Dunkirk in present-day France. Philip VI (King of France from 1328 to 1350) fought Nicolaas Zannekin, a wealthy farmer from Lampernisse. Zannekin was the leader of a band of Flemish rebels. The fighting erupted over taxation and punitive edicts of the French over the Flemish. The battle was won decisively by the French. Zannekin and about 3,200 Flemish rebels were killed in the battle.

Battle of Cassel (1677).headline: Bitka pri Casselu (1677)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Casselu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Peenu, je potekala 11. aprila 1677 med francosko-nizozemsko vojno blizu Cassela, 15 km zahodno od Saint-Omerja. Francoska vojska pod poveljstvom vojvode Luxembourga je premagala združene nizozemsko-španske sile pod vodstvom Viljema Oranskega.

V začetku leta 1677 so se v Nijmegnu začela mirovna pogajanja; Francija je že imela večino položajev na Španski Nizozemski, ki jih je francoski kralj Ludvik XIV. štel za nujne za obrambno mejo. To naj bi dopolnil z zavzetjem Saint-Omerja in Cambraija, ki ju je hotel čim prej osvojiti, da bi se lahko pogajal z močnejšega položaja. Viljem Saint-Omerja ni mogel rešiti, za Cambrai pa se je bil odločen boriti, kar je privedlo do bitke pred Casselom.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Cassel (1677)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cassel, also known as the Battle of Peene, took place on 11 April 1677 during the Franco-Dutch War, near Cassel, 15 km (9 mi) west of Saint-Omer. A French army commanded by the duc de Luxembourg defeated a combined Dutch–Spanish force under William of Orange.

At the start of 1677, peace negotiations opened at Nijmegen; France already held most of the positions in the Spanish Netherlands that Louis XIV of France considered necessary for a defensible border. This would be completed by taking St-Omer and Cambrai, which he wanted to capture as soon as possible, allowing him to negotiate from a position of strength. While William could not save St-Omer, he was determined to fight for Cambrai, leading to the battle outside Cassel.

Battle of Castelfidardo.headline: Bitka pri Castelfidardu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Castelfidardu je potekala 18. septembra 1860 blizu mesta Castelfidardo v deželi Marke. Bila je spopad med kraljevo sardinsko vojsko in vojsko Papeške države med piemontskim vdorom v Papeško državo. Končala se je s sardinsko zmago, ki je papeškim silam preprečila, da bi dosegle trdnjavo Ancona, in privedla do poznejše priključitve Marc in Umbrije Kraljevini Sardiniji.

source.title: Battle of Castelfidardo
paragraphs: The Battle of Castelfidardo was fought on 18 September 1860 near the town of Castelfidardo in the Marche region. It was an engagement between the Royal Sardinian Army and the army of the Papal States during the Piedmontese invasion of the Papal States. The battle resulted in a Sardinian victory, preventing the Papal forces from reaching the fortress of Ancona and leading to the subsequent annexation of the Marche and Umbria into the Kingdom of Sardinia.

Battle of Castiglione.headline: Bitka pri Castiglioneju leta 1796
paragraphs: V bitki pri Castiglioneju je francoska italijanska armada (Armée d'Italie) pod generalom Napoleonom Bonapartom 5. avgusta 1796 napadla vojsko habsburške monarhije pod feldmaršalom Dagobertom Sigmundom von Wurmserjem. Številčno šibkejše Avstrijce so porazili in jih po vrsti hribov potisnili do rečnega prehoda pri Borghettu, kjer so se umaknili čez reko Mincio. Mesto Castiglione delle Stiviere leži 10 kilometrov južno od Gardskega jezera v severni Italiji. Bitka je bila ena od štirih slavnih Bonapartovih zmag v vojni prve koalicije, delu francoskih revolucionarnih vojn. Druge so bile pri Bassanu, Arcolu in Rivoliju.
notes: The mile conversion (6 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Castiglione
paragraphs: The Battle of Castiglione saw the French Army of Italy under General Napoleon Bonaparte attack an army of the Habsburg monarchy led by Feldmarschall Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser on 5 August 1796. The outnumbered Austrians were defeated and driven back along a line of hills to the river crossing at Borghetto, where they retired beyond the Mincio River. The town of Castiglione delle Stiviere is located 10 kilometres (6 mi) south of Lake Garda in northern Italy. This battle was one of four famous victories won by Bonaparte during the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. The others were Bassano, Arcole, and Rivoli.

Battle of Castiglione (1706).headline: Bitka pri Castiglioneju leta 1706
paragraphs: Bitka pri Castiglioneju je potekala blizu mesta Castiglione delle Stiviere v Lombardiji v Italiji 9. septembra 1706 v španski nasledstveni vojni. Francoska vojska 12.000 mož je napadla hessenski korpus 10.000 mož, ki je oblegal mesto, in ga z velikimi izgubami prisilila k umiku.

Vendar bitka ni vplivala na splošni strateški položaj, saj so cesarske zmage drugod pomenile, da so bile francoske čete v Lombardiji do konca leta 1706 osamljene, njihova vdaja pa je bila le še vprašanje časa. To je marca 1707 pripeljalo do milanske konvencije, ki jim je dovolila prosto pot v Francijo v zameno za umik iz preostalih garnizij in je dejansko končala vojno v severni Italiji.

source.title: Battle of Castiglione (1706)
paragraphs: The Battle of Castiglione took place near Castiglione delle Stiviere in Lombardy, Italy on 9 September 1706 during the War of the Spanish Succession. A French army of 12,000 attacked a Hessian corps of 10,000 that was besieging the town and forced them to retreat with heavy losses.

However, the battle did not affect the overall strategic position since Imperial victories elsewhere meant that by the end of 1706, French troops in Lombardy were isolated and their surrender only a matter of time. This led to the Convention of Milan in March 1707, which allowed them free passage to France in return for withdrawing from their remaining garrisons and effectively ended the war in Northern Italy.

Battle of Castillon.headline: Bitka pri Castillonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Castillonu je bila spopad med angleškimi in francoskimi silami 17. julija 1453 v Gaskonji blizu mesta Castillon-sur-Dordogne (pozneje Castillon-la-Bataille).

Na dan bitke je angleški poveljnik John Talbot, 1. grof Shrewsburyja, v zmotnem prepričanju, da se sovražnik umika, s sorazmerno majhno predhodnico svoje vojske napadel močno utrjen francoski tabor, ne da bi počakal na okrepitve. Talbot se tudi potem, ko je spoznal moč francoskega položaja, ni hotel umakniti, zato je francosko topništvo njegove okrepitve uničevalo po delih. To je bila prva velika evropska bitka, dobljena z obsežno uporabo poljskega topništva.
Zaradi bitke so Angleži izgubili skoraj vse posesti v Franciji, zlasti Gaskonjo, ki je bila prejšnja tri stoletja v posesti plantagenetskih kraljev. V Angliji je sledila politična nestabilnost.

source.title: Battle of Castillon
paragraphs: The Battle of Castillon was a battle between the forces of England and France which took place on 17 July 1453 in Gascony near the town of Castillon-sur-Dordogne (later Castillon-la-Bataille).

On the day of the battle, the English commander, John Talbot, 1st Earl of Shrewsbury, mistakenly believing that the enemy was retreating, led a relatively small advance force of his army in an attack on a strongly fortified French encampment without waiting for reinforcements. Talbot then refused to withdraw even after realising the strength of the French position, allowing the French artillery to destroy his reinforcements piecemeal. Castillon was the first major European battle won through the extensive use of field artillery.

The battle led to the English losing nearly all their holdings in France, especially Gascony, which had been a possession of the Plantagenet kings for the previous three centuries. Political instability ensued in England.

Battle of Castle Itter.headline: Bitka za grad Itter
paragraphs: Bitka za grad Itter je potekala 5. maja 1945 v avstrijski vasi Itter v pokrajini Severna Tirolska, v zadnjih dneh evropskega bojišča druge svetovne vojne.

Vojaki 23. tankovskega bataljona 12. oklepne divizije ameriškega XXI. korpusa pod vodstvom poročnika Johna C. »Jacka« Leeja mlajšega, skupina vojakov Wehrmachta pod vodstvom majorja Josefa »Seppa« Gangla, SS-Hauptsturmführer Kurt-Siegfried Schrader in nedavno osvobojeni francoski vojni ujetniki so grad Itter branili pred napadalci iz 17. SS-tankovskogrenadirske divizije, dokler jim na pomoč ni prispel ameriški 142. pehotni polk 36. divizije XXI. korpusa.

Bitka je eden od dveh znanih primerov v vojni, ko so se Američani in Nemci bojevali ramo ob rami (drugi je bila operacija Cowboy), in edini znani primer, ko se je dejavni pripadnik Waffen-SS boril na zavezniški strani. Poljudni opisi jo imenujejo najnenavadnejša bitka druge svetovne vojne.

source.title: Battle of Castle Itter
paragraphs: The Battle of Castle Itter was fought on 5 May 1945, in the Austrian village of Itter in the North Tyrol region of the country, during the last days of the European Theater of World War II.

Troops of the 23rd Tank Battalion of the 12th Armored Division of the US XXI Corps led by Lieutenant John C. "Jack" Lee Jr, a number of Wehrmacht soldiers led by Major Josef "Sepp" Gangl, SS-Hauptsturmführer Kurt-Siegfried Schrader, and recently freed French prisoners of war defended Castle Itter against an attacking force from the 17th SS Panzergrenadier Division until relief from the American 142nd Infantry Regiment of the 36th Division of XXI Corps arrived.

The battle is one of two known times during the war in which Americans and Germans fought side by side, the other being Operation Cowboy, and the only known time where an active member of the Waffen-SS fought on the Allied side. Popular accounts have called it the strangest battle of World War II.

Battle of Cecora (1620).headline: Bitka pri Cecori (1620)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cecori (znana tudi kot bitka pri Țuțori) je potekala od 17. septembra do 7. oktobra 1620 v Moldaviji blizu reke Prut, med poljsko-osmansko vojno (1620–1621), med Poljsko-litovsko republiko (ob pomoči upornih moldavskih čet) in osmanskimi silami (ob podpori Nogajcev).

source.title: Battle of Cecora (1620)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cecora (also known as the Battle of Țuțora) took place during the Polish–Ottoman War (1620–21) between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth (aided by rebel Moldavian troops) and Ottoman forces (backed by Nogais), fought from 17 September to 7 October 1620 in Moldavia, near the Prut River.

Battle of Cedynia.headline: Bitka pri Cedyniji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cedyniji (znana tudi kot bitka pri Zehdnu) je potekala 24. junija 972 blizu reke Odre, ko je vojska poljskega Mješka I. premagala sile saškega mejnega grofa Hoda (ali Oda I. Lužiškega). Ali je bitka res potekala blizu današnjega mesta Cedynia, je v sodobni znanosti sporno.

Mješko I., prvi zgodovinsko izpričani poljski vladar s središčem v Velikopoljski, se je uspešno vojskoval na območju Cedynije, tedaj ozemlju zahodnoslovanskih plemen, po katerem so hlepeli tudi cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Oton I. in nemški plemiči. Mješkova nesoglasja z Otonom I. je razrešilo zavezništvo in plačevanje davka Otonu, plemiči, ki jim je Oton I. podelil nekdanjo Saško vzhodno marko, predvsem Odo I., pa so Mješkove pridobitve izpodbijali. Bitka naj bi odločila, komu bo pripadlo območje, Mješku ali Odu. Zapisov o bitki je malo; na kratko jo je opisal kronist Thietmar iz Merseburga (975–1018), čigar oče je v bitki sodeloval (Chronicon II.19).

source.title: Battle of Cedynia
paragraphs: The Battle of Cedynia (also known as the Battle of Zehden) was fought on 24 June 972 near the Oder river, when an army led by Mieszko I of Poland defeated the forces of the Saxon margrave Hodo (or Odo I of Lusatia). Whether the battle actually took place near the modern-day town of Cedynia is disputed in modern scholarship.

Mieszko I, Poland's first documented ruler based in Greater Poland, had successfully campaigned in the Cedynia area, then a West Slavic tribal territory also coveted by Holy Roman Emperor Otto I and German nobles. While Mieszko's differences with Otto I were settled by an alliance and payment of tribute to the latter, the nobles whom Otto I had invested with the former Saxon Eastern March, most notably Odo I, challenged Mieszko's gains. The battle was to determine the possession of the area between Mieszko and Odo. Records of the battle are sparse, it was briefly described by the chronicler Thietmar of Merseburg (975−1018), whose father participated in the battle (Chronicon II.19).

Battle of Ceresole.headline: Bitka pri Ceresolu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ceresolu (tudi Cérisoles) je potekala 14. aprila 1544 v italijanski vojni 1542–1546 zunaj vasi Ceresole d'Alba v Piemontu v Italiji. Francoska vojska pod poveljstvom Françoisa de Bourbona, grofa d'Enghien, je premagala združene sile Svetega rimskega cesarstva in Španije pod poveljstvom Alfonsa d'Avalosa d'Aquina, markiza del Vasto. Čeprav so cesarskim četam prizadejali znatne izgube, Francozi nato zmage niso izkoristili z zavzetjem Milana.
notes: The Italian IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Ceresole
paragraphs: The Battle of Ceresole (Italian pronunciation: [tʃereˈzɔːle]; also Cérisoles) took place on 14 April 1544, during the Italian War of 1542–1546, outside the village of Ceresole d'Alba in the Piedmont region of Italy. A French army, commanded by François de Bourbon, Count of Enghien, defeated the combined forces of the Holy Roman Empire and Spain, commanded by Alfonso d'Avalos d'Aquino, Marquis del Vasto. Despite having inflicted substantial casualties on the Imperial troops, the French subsequently failed to exploit their victory by taking Milan.

Battle of Chaeronea (86 BC).headline: Bitka pri Heroneji (86 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Heroneji je potekala leta 86 pr. n. št. v prvi mitridatski vojni blizu Heroneje v Beotiji med rimskimi silami Lucija Kornelija Sule in Mitridatovim vojskovodjo Arhelajem. Končala se je s popolnim porazom pontske vojske in odločilno zmago Rimljanov.

source.title: Battle of Chaeronea (86 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Chaeronea was fought by the Roman forces of Lucius Cornelius Sulla and Mithridates' general, Archelaus, near Chaeronea, in Boeotia, in 86 BC during the First Mithridatic War. The battle ended with a complete rout of the Pontic army and a decisive victory for the Romans.

Battle of Châlons (274).headline: Bitka pri Châlonsu (274)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Châlonsu, znana tudi kot prva bitka na Katalaunskih poljih, je potekala leta 273 ali 274 v deželi Katalaunov, na neznanem kraju verjetno nedaleč od današnjega Châlons-en-Champagna v Franciji. Rimski cesar Avrelijan je v njej premagal cesarja Galskega cesarstva Tetrika I., katerega ozemlja je Rimsko cesarstvo tako po 14 letih ločenosti znova pridobilo.

source.title: Battle of Châlons (274)
paragraphs: The Battle of Châlons, also known as the First Battle of the Catalaunian Plains, was fought in 273 or 274 in the land of the Catalauni, at an unknown location probably not far from the present-day Châlons-en-Champagne, France. In the battle, the Roman Emperor Aurelian defeated the Emperor Tetricus I of the Gallic Empire, whose territories were thus recovered by the Roman Empire after 14 years of separation.

Battle of Champaubert.headline: Bitka pri Champaubertu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Champaubertu (10. februarja 1814) je bila uvodni spopad šestdnevnega pohoda. V njej sta se spopadla francoska vojska pod vodstvom cesarja Napoleona in majhen ruski korpus pod poveljstvom generalpodpolkovnika grofa Zaharja Dmitrijeviča Olsufjeva. Ruska enota se je dobro upirala, a je bila uničena; preživeli so pobegnili v gozdove, Olsufjev pa je postal francoski ujetnik.

source.title: Battle of Champaubert
paragraphs: The Battle of Champaubert (10 February 1814) was the opening engagement of the Six Days' Campaign. It was fought between a French army led by Emperor Napoleon and a small Russian corps commanded by Lieutenant General Count Zakhar Dmitrievich Olsufiev. After putting up a good fight, the Russian formation was destroyed; the survivors escaped into the woods while Olsufiev became a French prisoner.

Battle of Charleroi.headline: Bitka pri Charleroiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Charleroiju (francosko: Bataille de Charleroi) ali bitka na Sambri je potekala 21. avgusta 1914 med francosko 5. armado ter nemško 2. in 3. armado v okviru bitke za meje. Francozi so načrtovali napad čez reko Sambro, a so Nemci napadli prvi, Francoze potisnili nazaj od reke in jim skoraj odrezali umik, ko so pri Dinantu prečkali reko Mozo in prišli za francosko desno krilo. Francoze sta rešila protinapad pri Dinantu in preusmeritev 3. armade proti severozahodu v podporo 2. armadi namesto proti jugozahodu.

source.title: Battle of Charleroi
paragraphs: The Battle of Charleroi (French: Bataille de Charleroi) or the Battle of the Sambre, was fought on 21 August 1914, by the French Fifth Army and the German 2nd and 3rd armies, during the Battle of the Frontiers. The French were planning an attack across the Sambre River, when the Germans attacked first, forced back the French from the river and nearly cut off the French retreat by crossing the Meuse River around Dinant and getting behind the French right flank. The French were saved by a counter-attack at Dinant and the re-direction of the 3rd Army to the north-west in support of the 2nd Army, rather than south-west.

Battle of Chasiv Yar.headline: Bitka za Časiv Jar
paragraphs: Bitka za Časiv Jar je spopad v rusko-ukrajinski vojni med ruskimi oboroženimi silami in oboroženimi silami Ukrajine za nadzor nad mestom Časiv Jar in okoliškimi vasmi. Začela se je 4. aprila 2024 s prvim neposrednim ruskim napadom na mesto; doslej so ruske sile zavzele del mesta vzhodno od kanala, ki teče skozenj, prečkale kanal in v začetku avgusta 2025 trdile, da so mesto zavzele. Decembra 2025 je Inštitut za preučevanje vojne poročal o nadaljnjih bojih v mestu.

Zaradi vzpetega terena, ki ga je lahko braniti, in strateške lege v Doneški oblasti velja Časiv Jar za ključno pokrajinsko mesto za obe vojski. Po mnenju analitikov bi rusko zavzetje Časiv Jara verjetno omogočilo nadaljnje napredovanje proti mestoma Kramatorsk in Slovjansk, največjima naseljema Doneške oblasti, ki nista pod rusko okupacijo. Avgusta 2026 sta bili ti mesti še pod ukrajinskim nadzorom, čeprav pod ruskim obstreljevanjem.

source.title: Battle of Chasiv Yar
paragraphs: The Battle of Chasiv Yar is a military engagement in the Russo-Ukrainian war between the Russian Armed Forces and the Armed Forces of Ukraine for control of the city of Chasiv Yar and surrounding villages. The battle began on 4 April 2024 with the first direct assault on the city by Russian forces, and has thus far seen the capture of the district east of a canal passing through the city, the crossing of the canal, and the claimed capture of the city as of early August 2025. As of December 2025, the Institute for the Study of War reported continued fighting in the city

Due to its defensible elevated terrain and strategic location in Donetsk Oblast, Chasiv Yar is regarded as a pivotal provincial city for either army to control. According to analysts, a Russian capture of Chasiv Yar would likely allow further advances towards the cities of Kramatorsk and Sloviansk, the two largest settlements in Donetsk Oblast not under Russian occupation. However, as of August 2026, these cities remain under Ukrainian control, although subject to Russian shelling.

Battle of Château-Thierry (1814).headline: Bitka pri Château-Thierryju (1814)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Château-Thierryju (12. februarja 1814) je bila spopad, v katerem je francoska cesarska vojska pod poveljstvom cesarja Napoleona skušala uničiti pruski korpus Ludwiga Yorcka von Wartenburga in ruski cesarski korpus Fabiana Wilhelma von Osten-Sackena. Zavezniškima korpusoma je uspelo pobegniti čez reko Marno, a sta utrpela precej večje izgube kot Francozi, ki so ju zasledovali. Spopad je potekal med šestdnevnim pohodom, vrsto zmag, ki jih je Napoleon dosegel nad šlezijsko armado pruskega feldmaršala Gebharda Leberechta von Blücherja. Château-Thierry leži približno 75 kilometrov severovzhodno od Pariza.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Château-Thierry (1814)
paragraphs: The Battle of Château-Thierry (12 February 1814) saw the Imperial French army commanded by Emperor Napoleon attempt to destroy a Prussian corps led by Ludwig Yorck von Wartenburg and an Imperial Russian corps under Fabian Wilhelm von Osten-Sacken. The two Allied corps managed to escape across the Marne River, but suffered considerably heavier losses than the pursuing French. This action occurred during the Six Days' Campaign, a series of victories that Napoleon won over Prussian Field Marshal Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher's Army of Silesia. Château-Thierry lies about 75 kilometres (47 mi) northeast of Paris.

Battle of Cherbourg.headline: Bitka za Cherbourg
paragraphs: Bitka za Cherbourg je bila del bitke za Normandijo med drugo svetovno vojno. Potekala je takoj po uspešnem zavezniškem izkrcanju 6. junija 1944. Zavezniške čete, večinoma ameriške, so v trdem, mesec dni dolgem pohodu obkolile in zavzele utrjeno pristanišče, ki je veljalo za ključno za vojskovanje v zahodni Evropi.

source.title: Battle of Cherbourg
paragraphs: The Battle of Cherbourg was part of the Battle of Normandy during World War II. It was fought immediately after the successful Allied landings on 6 June 1944. Allied troops, mainly American, isolated and captured the fortified port, which was considered vital to the campaign in Western Europe, in a hard-fought, month-long campaign.

Battle of Chester.headline: Bitka pri Chestru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Chestru (starovaližansko: Guaith Caer Legion; valižansko: Brwydr Caer) je bila velika zmaga Anglosasov nad domačimi Briti blizu mesta Chester v Angliji v začetku 7. stoletja. Æthelfrith Northumbrijski je uničil združene sile valižanskih kraljestev Powys in Rhôs (kantrefa Kraljestva Gwynedd), morda pa tudi Mercie. V bitki so padli valižanska voditelja Selyf Sarffgadau iz Powysa in Cadwal Crysban iz Rhôsa ter številni drugi visoki bojevniki, kot je bil Gwion ap Cyndrwyn iz Pengwerna. Posredni dokazi kažejo, da je morda padel tudi gwyneddski kralj Iago. Po drugih virih je bitka morda potekala leta 613 ali celo že leta 607 ali 605 n. št.

Po Bedi so pred bitko po Æthelfrithovem ukazu pobili veliko menihov iz samostana Bangor on Dee, ki so prišli opazovat boj. Æthelfrith je bojevnikom ukazal, naj pokoljejo duhovnike, ker so ti, čeprav neoboroženi, molili za poraz Northumbrije.

source.title: Battle of Chester
paragraphs: The Battle of Chester (Old Welsh: Guaith Caer Legion; Welsh: Brwydr Caer) was a major victory for the Anglo-Saxons over the native Britons near the city of Chester, England in the early 7th century. Æthelfrith of Northumbria annihilated a combined force from the Welsh kingdoms of Powys and Rhôs (a cantref of the Kingdom of Gwynedd), and possibly from Mercia as well. It resulted in the deaths of Welsh leaders Selyf Sarffgadau of Powys, Cadwal Crysban of Rhôs, and numerous other high-ranking warriors such as Gwion ap Cyndrwyn of Pengwern. Circumstantial evidence suggests that King Iago of Gwynedd may have also been killed. Other sources state the battle may have been in 613 or even as early as 607 or 605 AD.

According to Bede, a large number of monks from the monastery at Bangor on Dee who had come to witness the fight were killed on the orders of Æthelfrith before the battle. He told his warriors to massacre the clerics because although they bore no arms, they were praying for a Northumbria defeat.

Battle of Chiari.headline: Bitka pri Chiariju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Chiariju je potekala 1. septembra 1701 v španski nasledstveni vojni. Spopad je bil del kampanje princa Evgena Savojskega za osvojitev Milanske vojvodine pod špansko oblastjo na Apeninskem polotoku in je sledil njegovi zmagi nad maršalom Catinatom v bitki pri Carpiju julija. Maršal Villeroi je na bojišču nadomestil Catinata kot poveljnika francosko-špansko-savojskih sil in s seboj prinesel ukaze kralja Ludvika XIV., naj cesarske sile iztisne iz Italije.

Evgen je predvidel, da bo Villeroi napadel za vsako ceno, zato se je zakopal pred majhno trdnjavo Chiari in čakal na napad. V bitki, ki je trajala več ur, so Avstrijci Villeroijevim silam prizadejali hude izgube in dosegli odločilno zmago. Zmaga v kampanji je Evgena utrdila v Lombardiji in pripomogla k temu, da so pomorske sile priskočile cesarju na pomoč. V enem tednu po bitki so Anglija, Republika Nizozemska in Leopold I. podpisali drugo pogodbo velike zveze.

source.title: Battle of Chiari
paragraphs: The Battle of Chiari was fought on 1 September 1701 during the War of the Spanish Succession. The engagement was part of Prince Eugene of Savoy's campaign to seize the Spanish controlled Duchy of Milan in the Italian peninsula, and had followed his victory over Marshal Catinat at the Battle of Carpi in July. Marshal Villeroi replaced Catinat as commander of the Franco–Spanish–Savoyard forces in the theatre, carrying with him orders from King Louis XIV to push the Imperialists out of Italy.

Foreseeing Villeroi's intention of attacking at any price, Eugene entrenched himself in front of the small fortress of Chiari, and waited for the attack. In a battle that lasted several hours the Austrians inflicted heavy casualties on Villeroi's forces, gaining an overwhelming victory. The victory in the campaign established Eugene in Lombardy, and helped to persuade the Maritime Powers to come to the aid of the Emperor. Within a week of the battle England, the Dutch Republic, and Leopold I had signed the second treaty of the Grand Alliance.

Battle of Chotusitz.headline: Bitka pri Chotusitzu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Chotusitzu (Chotusice) je potekala 17. maja 1742 na Češkem, danes v Češki republiki, med prvo šlezijsko vojno, delom širše vojne za avstrijsko nasledstvo. Cesarska vojska s približno 25.000 možmi pod vodstvom Karla Lotarinškega je prodirala proti Pragi, ki so jo zasedli Francozi, ko je naletela na približno enako veliko prusko vojsko pod poveljstvom Friderika Velikega. Izgube so bile na obeh straneh velike in bitka je na potek vojne malo vplivala, a navadno velja za prusko zmago.
Vojna se je končala z vroclavskim mirom junija 1742, Avstrija pa je decembra znova zavzela Prago. Sovražnosti so se nadaljevale leta 1744 z izbruhom druge šlezijske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Chotusitz
paragraphs: The Battle of Chotusitz, took place on 17 May 1742, in Bohemia, now the Czech Republic, during the First Silesian War, part of the wider War of the Austrian Succession. Led by Charles of Lorraine, an Imperial force of around 25,000 men was advancing against French-occupied Prague, when it ran into a Prussian army of roughly equal size, commanded by Frederick the Great. Casualties were heavy on both sides, and the battle had little impact on the war in general, but is generally considered a Prussian victory.
The war ended with the Treaty of Breslau in June 1742, allowing Austria to recapture Prague in December. Hostilities resumed in 1744 with the outbreak of the Second Silesian War.

Battle of Cibalae.headline: Bitka pri Cibalah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cibalah je potekala leta 316 med rimskima cesarjema Konstantinom I. (vladal 306–337) in Licinijem (vladal 308–324). Bojišče blizu mesta Cibale (danes Vinkovci na Hrvaškem) v rimski provinci Druga Panonija je bilo približno 350 kilometrov globoko na Licinijevem ozemlju. Konstantin je kljub številčni podrejenosti dosegel prepričljivo zmago.

source.title: Battle of Cibalae
paragraphs: The Battle of Cibalae was fought in 316 between the two Roman emperors Constantine I (r. 306–337) and Licinius (r. 308–324). The site of the battle, near the town of Cibalae (now Vinkovci, Croatia) in the Roman province of Pannonia Secunda, was approximately 350 kilometers within the territory of Licinius. Constantine won a resounding victory, despite being outnumbered.

Battle of Cissa.headline: Bitka pri Cissi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cissi je bila del druge punske vojne. Potekala je jeseni 218 pr. n. št. blizu mesta Tarraco na severovzhodu Iberskega polotoka. Rimska vojska pod Gnejem Kornelijem Scipionom Kalvom je premagala številčno šibkejšo kartažansko vojsko pod Hanonom in tako prevzela nadzor nad ozemljem severno od reke Ebro, ki ga je Hanibal podjarmil le nekaj mesecev prej, poleti 218 pr. n. št. To je bila prva bitka, v kateri so se Rimljani kdaj bojevali na Iberskem polotoku.

Rimljanom je omogočila, da so si med prijateljskimi iberskimi plemeni ustvarili varno oporišče, in zaradi poznejšega uspeha bratov Scipionov v Hispaniji Hanibal med vojno ni nikoli dobil okrepitev iz Hispanije, čeprav jih je iskal.

source.title: Battle of Cissa
paragraphs: The Battle of Cissa was part of the Second Punic War. It was fought in the fall of 218 BC, near the town of Tarraco in north-eastern Iberia. A Roman army under Gnaeus Cornelius Scipio Calvus defeated an outnumbered Carthaginian army under Hanno, thus gaining control of the territory north of the Ebro River that Hannibal had just subdued a few months prior in the summer of 218 BC. This was the first battle that the Romans had ever fought in Iberia.

It allowed the Romans to establish a secure base among friendly Iberian tribes, and due to the eventual success of the Scipio brothers in Spain, Hannibal looked for but never received reinforcements from Spain during the war.

Battle of Civitate.headline: Bitka pri Civitate
paragraphs: Bitka pri Civitate je potekala 18. junija 1053 v južni Italiji med Normani, ki jih je vodil apulijski grof Humphrey de Hauteville, in švabsko-italijansko-langobardsko vojsko, ki jo je organiziral papež Leon IX. in na bojišču vodila lorenski vojvoda Gerard in beneventski knez Rudolf. Normanska zmaga nad zavezniško papeško vojsko je bila vrhunec spora med normanskimi najemniki, ki so v 11. stoletju prišli v južno Italijo, rodbino Hauteville in krajevnimi langobardskimi knezi. Do leta 1059 so Normani sklenili zavezništvo s papeštvom: papež Nikolaj II. je uradno priznal normansko osvojitev južne Italije in Roberta Guiscarda postavil za vojvodo Apulije in Kalabrije ter grofa Sicilije.

source.title: Battle of Civitate
paragraphs: The Battle of Civitate was fought on 18 June 1053 in southern Italy, between the Normans, led by the Count of Apulia Humphrey of Hauteville, and a Swabian-Italian-Lombard army, organised by Pope Leo IX and led on the battlefield by Gerard, Duke of Lorraine, and Rudolf, Prince of Benevento. The Norman victory over the allied papal army marked the climax of a conflict between the Norman mercenaries who came to southern Italy in the eleventh century, the de Hauteville family, and the local Lombard princes. By 1059 the Normans would create an alliance with the papacy, which included a formal recognition by Pope Nicholas II of the Norman conquest in south Italy, investing Robert Guiscard as Duke of Apulia and Calabria, and Count of Sicily.

Battle of Clavijo.headline: Bitka pri Claviju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Claviju je bitka, ki je postala priljubljena tema španskega izročila o rekonkvisti. Zgodbe o njej so se prvič pojavile v 13. stoletju. Po teh zgodbah naj bi se blizu Clavija spopadli kristjani pod vodstvom Ramira I. Asturijskega in muslimani pod vodstvom kordobskega emirja. Zaradi Diccionario de historia de España (1968) in zgodovinopisne kritike Juana Francisca Masdeuja jo danes štejejo za legendarno bitko, ki naj bi jo v kronike v 13. stoletju vključil nadškof Rodrigo Jiménez de Rada, ki je mešal podatke iz drugih bitk iz različnih časov in krajev. Kljub temu so bitko slavili kot prvino oblikovanja španske narodne zgodovine in izvor romanja po Jakobovi poti.
notes: The English sentence about Rodrigo Jiménez de Rada is garbled ("in the 1200s that would include"); translated as meant, with "the 1200s" as the 13th century.

source.title: Battle of Clavijo
paragraphs: The Battle of Clavijo is a battle which became a popular theme of Spanish traditions regarding the Reconquista. Stories about the battle first arose in the 13th century. According to these stories, it was fought near Clavijo between Christians led by Ramiro I of Asturias and Muslims led by the Emir of Córdoba. The Diccionario de historia de España (1968) and the historiographical criticism of Juan Francisco Masdeu have made it be considered today a legendary battle, whose inclusion in the chronicles would be due to Archbishop Rodrigo Jiménez de Rada, in the 1200s that would include, mixing data from other battles of different times and locations. However, the battle was celebrated as an element of shaping Spanish national history and the origin of the pilgrimage of the way of Saint James.

Battle of Clontarf.headline: Bitka pri Clontarfu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Clontarfu (irsko: Cath Chluain Tarbh) je potekala 23. aprila 1014 pri Clontarfu blizu Dublina na vzhodni obali Irske. V njej se je vojska irskega velikega kralja Briana Boruja spopadla z nordijsko-irskim zavezništvom, ki so ga sestavljale sile dublinskega kralja Sigtrygga Svilenobradega, leinsterskega kralja Máela Mórde mac Murchade in vikinška vojska iz tujine pod vodstvom Sigurda Orkneyjskega in Brodirja z Mana. Trajala je od sončnega vzhoda do zahoda in se končala z begom vikinške in leinsterske vojske.

V bitki je po ocenah padlo med 7000 in 10.000 mož, med njimi večina voditeljev. Brianove sile so sicer zmagale, a je padel sam Brian, pa tudi njegov sin Murchad in vnuk Toirdelbach. Padli so tudi leinsterski kralj Máel Mórda ter vikinška voditelja Sigurd in Brodir. Po bitki je bila moč Vikingov in Dublinskega kraljestva v veliki meri strta.

source.title: Battle of Clontarf
paragraphs: The Battle of Clontarf (Irish: Cath Chluain Tarbh) took place on 23 April 1014 at Clontarf, near Dublin, on the east coast of Ireland. It pitted an army led by Brian Boru, High King of Ireland, against a Norse-Irish alliance comprising the forces of Sigtrygg Silkbeard, King of Dublin; Máel Mórda mac Murchada, King of Leinster; and a Viking army from abroad led by Sigurd of Orkney and Brodir of Mann. It lasted from sunrise to sunset, and ended in a rout of the Viking and Leinster armies.

It is estimated that between 7,000 and 10,000 men were killed in the battle, including most of the leaders. Although Brian's forces were victorious, Brian himself was killed, as were his son Murchad and his grandson Toirdelbach. Leinster king Máel Mórda and Viking leaders Sigurd and Brodir were also slain. After the battle, the power of the Vikings and the Kingdom of Dublin was largely broken.

Battle of Cocherel.headline: Bitka pri Cocherelu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cocherelu je potekala 16. maja 1364 med silami francoskega kralja Karla V., ki jim je poveljeval Bertrand du Guesclin, in silami navarskega kralja Karla II. (imenovanega Karel Hudobni) zaradi nasledstva v Kraljevini Franciji. Končala se je s francosko zmago.

source.title: Battle of Cocherel
paragraphs: The Battle of Cocherel was fought on 16 May 1364 between the forces of Charles V of France and the forces of Charles II of Navarre (known as Charles the Bad) under the command of Bertrand du Guesclin, over the succession to the Kingdom of France. The result was a French victory.
Bitka pri Kölnu je potekala leta 716 blizu mesta Köln (danes v Nemčiji). Znana je predvsem kot prva bitka, v kateri je poveljeval Karel Martel, in njegov edini poraz.

Leta 716 sta frankovski kralj Hilperik II. in majordom Ragenfrid vdrla v Avstrazijo, da bi svojo voljo vsilila tamkajšnjim tekmujočim strankam: stranki majordoma Teudoalda in nevstrijske regentke Plektrude. Plektruda je Karla Martela zaprla v Kölnu; po pobegu so ga razglasili za avstrazijskega majordoma. Hkrati je v Avstrazijo vdrl frizijski kralj Radbod in se zavezal s Hilperikom in Nevstrijci.

Pred Kölnom, ki ga je držala Plektruda, je Radbod premagal slabo pripravljenega Karla Martela, ki je moral pobegniti v gorovje Eifel. Köln je po kratkem obleganju padel. Nevstrijci so Plektrudo prisilili, da je Hilperika priznala za kralja.

source.title: Battle of Cologne
paragraphs: The Battle of Cologne was fought near the city of Köln (English: Cologne) (now part of Germany) in 716. The battle is known chiefly as the first battle of Charles Martel's command and was his only defeat.

In 716 King of the Franks Chilperic II and Mayor of the Palace Ragenfrid invaded Austrasia to impose their will on the competing factions there: those of Mayor of the Palace Theudoald and Neustrian regent Plectrude. Charles Martel had been imprisoned at Cologne by Plectrude, and following his escape he was acclaimed mayor of the palace of Austrasia. Simultaneously Radbod, King of Frisia, invaded Austrasia and allied with Chilperic and the Neustrians.

Outside of Cologne, which was held by Plectrude, an ill-prepared Charles Martel was defeated by Radbod and forced to flee to the mountains of the Eifel. Cologne fell after a short siege. The Neustrians compelled Plectrude to acknowledge Chilperic as king.

Battle of Corinth (146 BC).headline: Bitka pri Korintu (146 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Korintu leta 146 pr. n. št., znana tudi kot bitka pri Levkopetri ali Lefkopetri, je bila odločilen spopad med Rimsko republiko ter grško mestno državo Korint in njenimi zaveznicami v Ahajski zvezi. Z njo se je končala ahajska vojna in začelo obdobje rimske prevlade v grški zgodovini, znana pa je tudi po tem, da so Rimljani Korint po njej popolnoma porušili.

source.title: Battle of Corinth (146 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Corinth of 146 BC, also known as the Battle of Leucapetra or the Battle of Lefkopetra, was a decisive engagement fought between the Roman Republic and the Greek city-state of Corinth and its allies in the Achaean League. The battle marked the end of the Achaean War and the beginning of the period of Roman domination in Greek history, and is also notable for the complete destruction of Corinth by the Romans in its aftermath.

Battle of Coronea (394 BC).headline: Bitka pri Koroneji (394 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Koroneji leta 394 pr. n. št. je potekala v korintski vojni; Špartanci in njihovi zavezniki pod vodstvom kralja Agesilaja II. so v njej premagali vojsko Tebancev in Argivcev, ki jim je skušala zapreti pot nazaj na Peloponez. Čeprav je razmeroma malo znana, sodi med najbolj krvave hoplitske bitke, tudi v primerjavi z bolj znanimi, kot sta bitka pri Deliju leta 424 pr. n. št. in bitka pri Mantineji leta 362 pr. n. št.
notes: The English alternative spelling Coroneia has no Slovenian counterpart and is left out. The English gives 424 and 362 without BC; the Slovenian adds pr. n. št., as the context requires.

source.title: Battle of Coronea (394 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Coronea in 394 BC, also Battle of Coroneia, took place during the Corinthian War, in which the Spartans and their allies under King Agesilaus II defeated a force of Thebans and Argives that was attempting to block their march back into the Peloponnese. It ranks among the deadliest of the Hoplite battles, despite its comparative obscurity, when matched up against more famous battles like the Battle of Delium in 424, and the Battle of Mantinea in 362.

Battle of Coronea (447 BC).headline: Bitka pri Koroneji (447 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Koroneji (znana tudi kot prva bitka pri Koroneji) je potekala leta 447 pr. n. št. v prvi peloponeški vojni med Delsko zvezo pod vodstvom Aten in Beotsko zvezo.

Atenci so leta 457 pr. n. št. v bitki pri Ojnofitah prevzeli nadzor nad Beotijo in naslednjih deset let skušali utrditi moč zveze. Leta 454 pr. n. št. so Atene izgubile ladjevje, ko so skušale pomagati egipčanskemu uporu proti Perziji; ker so se bale uporov drugih članic Delske zveze, so leta 453 pr. n. št. zakladnico z Delosa preselile v svoje mesto in okoli leta 450 pr. n. št. s Perzijo sklenile Kalijev mir.

source.title: Battle of Coronea (447 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Coronea (also known as the First Battle of Coronea) took place between the Athenian-led Delian League and the Boeotian League in 447 BC during the First Peloponnesian War.

In 457 BC the Athenians had taken control of Boeotia at the Battle of Oenophyta, and spent the next ten years attempting to consolidate the League's power. In 454 BC Athens lost a fleet attempting to aid an Egyptian revolt against Persia; fearing revolts by the other members of the Delian League, Athens moved the treasury to their city from Delos in 453 BC, and signed the Peace of Callias with Persia around 450 BC.

Battle of Cortenuova.headline: Bitka pri Cortenuovi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cortenuovi (včasih zapisana Cortenova) je potekala 27. novembra 1237 med vojsko cesarja Friderika II. Štaufovskega in silami druge Lombardske lige v dolgem sporu, ki ga običajno povezujejo z vojnami gvelfov in gibelinov. Končala se je z uničujočo cesarsko zmago in uničenjem glavne vojske lige. Cortenuova, ena največjih in najkrvavejših odprtih bitk Italije v 13. stoletju, je pomenila največji bojni uspeh Friderikove vladavine in preoblikovala politično ravnovesje v severni Italiji.

source.title: Battle of Cortenuova
paragraphs: The Battle of Cortenuova (sometimes spelled Cortenova) was fought on 27 November 1237 between the army of Emperor Frederick II Hohenstaufen and the forces of the Second Lombard League, during the prolonged conflict conventionally associated with the Guelphs and Ghibellines Wars. It ended in a crushing imperial victory and the destruction of the League's field army. One of the largest and bloodiest pitched battles of thirteenth-century Italy, Cortenuova represented the greatest battlefield success of Frederick's reign and transformed the political balance of northern Italy.

Battle of Corunna.headline: Bitka pri La Coruñi
paragraphs: Bitka pri La Coruñi (tudi Corunna, A Coruña, La Corunna ali La Corogne), v Španiji znana kot bitka pri Elviñi, je potekala 16. januarja 1809, ko je francoski korpus pod maršalom cesarstva Jeanom de Dieu Soultom napadel britansko vojsko pod generalpodpolkovnikom sirom Johnom Moorom. Bitka je potekala med polotoško vojno, ki je bila del širših napoleonskih vojn.

Britanci so se pred Francozi pod Soultom, ki so jim bili trdovratno za petami, umikali čez severno Španijo, njihova zaledna straža pa je odbijala vedno nove francoske napade. Obe vojski sta trpeli zaradi ostre zime. Velik del britanske vojske, razen elitne lahke brigade pod Robertom Craufurdom, je med umikom izgubil red in disciplino. Ko so Britanci nekaj dni pred Francozi nazadnje prišli do pristanišča La Coruña na severni obali Galicije, prevoznih ladij še ni bilo. Ladjevje je prispelo čez nekaj dni in Britanci so se ravno vkrcavali, ko so napadle francoske sile.

source.title: Battle of Corunna
paragraphs: The Battle of Corunna (or A Coruña, La Corunna, La Coruña or La Corogne), in Spain known as Battle of Elviña, took place on 16 January 1809, when a French corps under Marshal of the Empire Jean de Dieu Soult attacked a British army under Lieutenant-General Sir John Moore. The battle took place during the Peninsular War, which was part of the wider Napoleonic Wars.

Doggedly pursued by the French under Soult, the British retreated across northern Spain while their rearguard fought off repeated French attacks. Both armies suffered from the harsh winter conditions. Much of the British army, excluding the elite Light Brigade under Robert Craufurd, suffered from a loss of order and discipline during the retreat. When the British eventually reached the port of Corunna on the northern coast of Galicia, a few days ahead of the French, they found their transport ships had not arrived. The fleet arrived after a couple of days and the British were embarking when the French forces attacked.

Battle of Coulmiers.headline: Bitka pri Coulmiersu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Coulmiersu je potekala 9. novembra 1870 med francoskimi in bavarskimi silami v francosko-pruski vojni in se končala s francosko zmago.

source.title: Battle of Coulmiers
paragraphs: The Battle of Coulmiers was fought on 9 November 1870 between French and Bavarian forces during the Franco-Prussian War, ending in French victory.

Battle of Crannon.headline: Bitka pri Kranonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kranonu (322 pr. n. št.), v kateri so se makedonske sile Antipatra in Kratera spopadle s silami koalicije mest, med njimi Aten in Etolske zveze, je bila odločilna bitka lamijske vojne. Makedonska zmaga, čeprav vojaško nič posebnega, je druge Grke prepričala, da so zaprosili za mir.

source.title: Battle of Crannon
paragraphs: The Battle of Crannon (322 BC), fought between the Macedonian forces of Antipater and Craterus and the forces of a coalition of cities including Athens and the Aetolian League, was the decisive battle of the Lamian War. The Macedonian victory, though militarily unspectacular, convinced the other Greeks to sue for peace.

Battle of Cravant.headline: Bitka pri Cravantu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cravantu je potekala 31. julija 1423 v stoletni vojni: angleške in francoske sile so se spopadle pri vasi Cravant v Burgundiji, ob mostu in brodu na bregu reke Yonne, levega pritoka Sene, jugovzhodno od Auxerra. Bitka se je končala z zmago Angležev in njihovih burgundskih zaveznikov.

source.title: Battle of Cravant
paragraphs: The Battle of Cravant was fought on 31 July 1423, during the Hundred Years' War between English and French forces at the village of Cravant in Burgundy, at a bridge and ford on the banks of the river Yonne, a left-bank tributary of the Seine, southeast of Auxerre. The battle ended in a victory for the English and their Burgundian allies.

Battle of Cremona.headline: Bitka pri Cremoni
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cremoni je potekala v noči od 31. januarja na 1. februar 1702 v španski nasledstveni vojni med francosko vojsko pod maršalom Villeroijem in cesarsko (avstrijsko) vojsko pod princem Evgenom Savojskim.

source.title: Battle of Cremona
paragraphs: The Battle of Cremona took place on the night of 31 January to 1 February 1702, during the War of the Spanish Succession, between a French force under Maréchal Villeroi and an Imperial/Austrian army led by Prince Eugene of Savoy.

Battle of Crete.headline: Bitka za Kreto
paragraphs: Bitka za Kreto (nemško: Luftlandeschlacht um Kreta; grško: Μάχη της Κρήτης), s kodnim imenom operacija Merkur (nemško: Unternehmen Merkur), je bila obsežna zračnoprevozna in amfibijska operacija sil osi med drugo svetovno vojno, s katero so želele zavzeti otok Kreto.

Bitka se je začela zjutraj 20. maja 1941 z več nemškimi zračnimi desanti na Kreti; otok so branile grške in druge zavezniške sile skupaj s kretskimi civilisti. Po prvem dnevu bojev so Nemci utrpeli hude izgube in zavezniške čete so bile prepričane, da bodo invazijo odbile.

source.title: Battle of Crete
paragraphs: The Battle of Crete (German: Luftlandeschlacht um Kreta, Greek: Μάχη της Κρήτης), codenamed Operation Mercury (German: Unternehmen Merkur), was a major Axis airborne and amphibious operation during World War II to capture the island of Crete.

The battle began on the morning of 20 May 1941, with multiple German airborne landings on Crete; Greek and other Allied forces, along with Cretan civilians, defended the island. After the first day of fighting, the Germans had suffered heavy casualties and Allied troops were confident that they would defeat the invasion.

Battle of Crocus Field.headline: Bitka na Krokusovem polju
paragraphs: Bitka na Krokusovem polju (Krokion pedion; 353 ali 352 pr. n. št.) je bila bitka tretje svete vojne med vojsko Fokide pod vodstvom Onomarha ter združeno tesalsko in makedonsko vojsko pod vodstvom Filipa II. Makedonskega. Filipove sile so Fokidčane odločilno porazile. Zmaga je Filipu zagotovila imenovanje za vladarja Tesalije, kar je bil pomemben korak pri vzponu Makedonije do politične prevlade v antični Grčiji. Zgodovinarji se o letu bitke ne strinjajo: nekateri dajejo prednost letu 353 pr. n. št., drugi letu 352 pr. n. št.

source.title: Battle of Crocus Field
paragraphs: The Battle of Crocus Field (Krokion pedion) (353 BC or 352 BC) was a battle in the Third Sacred War, fought between the armies of Phocis, under Onomarchos, and the combined Thessalian and Macedonian army under Philip II of Macedon. The Phocians were decisively defeated by Philip's forces. Philip's victory secured his appointment as ruler of Thessaly, marking an important step in the rise of Macedon to political ascendancy in Ancient Greece. Opinion amongst historians is divided as to the year of the battle; some favour 353 BC, and others 352 BC.

Battle of Culloden.headline: Bitka pri Cullodnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cullodnu je potekala 16. aprila 1746 blizu Invernessa v Škotskem višavju. Britanske vladne sile pod poveljstvom vojvode Cumberlandskega so odločilno premagale jakobitsko vojsko pod Charlesom Edwardom Stuartom in s tem končale jakobitski upor iz leta 1745.

Charles se je julija 1745 izkrcal na Škotskem, da bi na britanski prestol vrnil svojega očeta Jamesa Francisa Edwarda Stuarta. Hitro je zavzel velike dele Škotske, vdor v Anglijo pa je segel vse do Derbyja na jugu, preden se je moral obrniti nazaj. Do aprila 1746 pa je jakobitom primanjkovalo zalog, nasproti pa so imeli močnejšega in bolje opremljenega nasprotnika.

Jakobitski poveljniki so sklenili, da jim ne preostane drugega, kot da se postavijo v bran. Ko sta se vojski srečali pri Cullodnu, je bila bitka kratka, trajala je manj kot uro, jakobiti pa so doživeli popoln in krvav poraz. S tem sta se dejansko končala upor iz leta 1745 in jakobitstvo kot pomembna prvina britanske politike.

source.title: Battle of Culloden
paragraphs: The Battle of Culloden took place on 16 April 1746, near Inverness, in the Scottish Highlands. A Jacobite army under Charles Edward Stuart was decisively defeated by a British government force commanded by the Duke of Cumberland, thereby ending the Jacobite rising of 1745.

Charles landed in Scotland in July 1745, seeking to restore his father James Francis Edward Stuart to the British throne. He quickly won control of large parts of Scotland, and an invasion of England reached as far south as Derby before being forced to turn back. However by April 1746 the Jacobites were short of supplies, facing a superior and better-equipped opponent.

The Jacobite commanders decided their only option was to stand and fight. When the two armies met at Culloden, the battle was brief, lasting less than an hour, with the Jacobites suffering an overwhelming and bloody defeat. This effectively ended both the 1745 rising and Jacobitism as a significant element in British politics.

Battle of Cumae (474 BC).headline: Bitka pri Kumah leta 474 pr. n. št.
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kumah je bila pomorska bitka, ki sta jo leta 474 pr. n. št. bojevali združeni vojni mornarici Sirakuz in Kum proti Etruščanom.

Mesto Kume v južni Italiji so v 8. stoletju pr. n. št. ustanovili grški naseljenci na območju blizu južne meje etruščanskega nadzora. Do leta 504 pr. n. št. so Kumčani južne Etruščane že porazili, vendar so ti še vedno imeli močno vojsko. Leta 474 pr. n. št. so uspeli zbrati ladjevje za neposreden napad na Kume.

Kumčani so za vojaško pomoč zaprosili sirakuškega tirana Hierona I. Ta je sklenil zavezništvo s pomorskimi silami grških mest v južni Italiji, da bi se skupaj branili pred etruščanskim širjenjem proti jugu. Etruščansko ladjevje so srečali in porazili pri Kumah v Neapeljskem zalivu.

source.title: Battle of Cumae (474 BC)
