paragraphs: The Battle of Cumae was a naval battle fought by the combined navies of Syracuse and Cumae against the Etruscans in 474 BC.

The city of Cumae in southern Italy was founded by Greek settlers in the 8th century BC in an area near the southern frontier of Etruscan control. By 504 BC, the southern Etruscans had been defeated by the Cumaeans, but they still maintained a powerful force. In 474 BC, they were able to raise a fleet to launch a direct attack on Cumae.

The Cumaeans called on the tyrant Hiero I of Syracuse for military assistance. He allied with naval forces from the Greek cities of southern Italy to defend against Etruscan expansion towards the south. They met and defeated the Etruscan fleet at Cumae in the Bay of Naples.

Battle of Curzola.headline: Bitka pri Korčuli
paragraphs: Bitka pri Korčuli (italijansko Curzola; južna Dalmacija, danes Hrvaška) je bila pomorska bitka med genovsko in beneško mornarico 9. septembra 1298. Za Benetke je bila katastrofa in hud udarec med številnimi bitkami, ki so jih Pisa, Genova in Benetke v 13. in 14. stoletju bojevale v dolgi vrsti vojn za nadzor nad sredozemsko in levantsko trgovino.

source.title: Battle of Curzola
paragraphs: The Battle of Curzola (today Korčula, southern Dalmatia, now in Croatia) was a naval battle fought on 9 September 1298 between the Genoese and Venetian navies. It was a disaster for Venice, a major setback among the many battles fought in the 13th and 14th centuries between Pisa, Genoa, and Venice in a long series of wars for the control of Mediterranean and Levantine trade.

Battle of Cynoscephalae.headline: Bitka pri Kinoskefalah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kinoskefalah (grško: Μάχη τῶν Κυνὸς Κεφαλῶν) je bila srečanjska bitka, ki je potekala junija 197 pr. n. št. v Tesaliji med rimsko-etolsko vojsko pod vodstvom Tita Kvinkcija Flaminina in antigonidsko Makedonijo pod vodstvom Filipa V. v drugi makedonski vojni. Bila je odločilna rimska zmaga in je končala spopad.

source.title: Battle of Cynoscephalae
paragraphs: The Battle of Cynoscephalae (Greek: Μάχη τῶν Κυνὸς Κεφαλῶν) was an encounter battle fought in Thessaly in June 197 BC between the Roman-Aetolian army, led by Titus Quinctius Flamininus, and Antigonid Macedon, led by Philip V, during the Second Macedonian War. It was a decisive Roman victory and marked the end of the conflict.

Battle of Cynoscephalae (364 BC).headline: Bitka pri Kinoskefalah (364 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kinoskefalah je bila spopad leta 364 pr. n. št. med silami Teb in njihovih tesalskih zaveznikov pod vodstvom Pelopide ter vojsko Aleksandra Ferskega. Pelopidova vojska je premagala precej večjo Aleksandrovo vojsko in končala njegove poskuse, da bi si zagotovil prevlado v Tesaliji, a je Pelopida v bitki padel.

Aleksander je od prevzema oblasti leta 369 pr. n. št. širil prevlado Fer nad drugimi tesalskimi mesti, zato so Tesalci za vojaško pomoč prosili Tebe, tedaj vodilno vojaško silo v Grčiji. Po neodločenih posegih v letih 369 in 368 so Tebanci leta 364 izglasovali, da pod Pelopido pošljejo 7000 mož, a so vojsko razpustili po sončnem mrku 13. julija, ki so ga imeli za slabo znamenje. Pelopida se je v Tesalijo odpravil z majhnim oddelkom prostovoljne konjenice in pri Tesalcih nabral še neizurjene vojake. Končna sestava nasprotnih sil ni jasna: domnevajo, da je imel Aleksander približno dvakrat več vojakov kot Pelopida, okoli 17.000–20.000.

source.title: Battle of Cynoscephalae (364 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cynoscephalae was a military engagement in 364 BC between the forces of Thebes and its Thessalian allies, led by Pelopidas, against the army of Alexander of Pherae. Pelopidas's army defeated Alexander's much larger force, ending Alexander's attempts to secure hegemony in Thessaly, though Pelopidas himself was killed.

Alexander had extended the dominance of Pherae over the other cities of Thessaly since his assumption of power in 369 BC, leading the Thessalians to request military support from Thebes, then the dominant military power in Greece. After inconclusive interventions in 369 and 368, the Thebans voted to send a force of 7,000 under Pelopidas in 364, but the army was disbanded following a solar eclipse on 13 July, considered a bad omen. Pelopidas set out for Thessaly with a small force of volunteer cavalry, and recruited further untrained troops from the Thessalians. The final compositions of the opposing forces are unclear: Alexander is believed to have outnumbered Pelopidas by a factor of around two to one, and to have commanded around 17,000–20,000 troops.

Bitka za Debalcevo je bila vojaški spopad, ki se je začel sredi januarja 2015 med vojno v Donbasu, v mestu Debalcevo v Doneški oblasti, med proruskimi separatističnimi silami Doneške ljudske republike (DLR) in Luganske ljudske republike (LLR) ter ukrajinskimi oboroženimi silami. Ruske sile, ki so jih večinoma sestavljali vojaki »skupine Wagner«, so znova zavzele Debalcevo, ki je bilo pod ukrajinskim nadzorom od protiofenzive vladnih sil julija 2014. Mesto je ležalo v »klinu« ozemlja pod ukrajinskim nadzorom, ki ga je na eni strani obdajala DLR, na drugi pa LLR, in je bilo pomembno cestno in železniško križišče.

Separatistične in ruske sile so si 16. in 17. januarja začele usklajeno prizadevati, da bi ukrajinske vojake pregnale iz mesta, in s tem sprožile bitko. Hudi boji so trajali do 18. februarja 2015, ko so se ukrajinske sile iz Debalceva umaknile v Artemivsk (današnji Bahmut).
notes: DPR and LPR are given by their Slovenian abbreviations DLR and LLR.

source.title: Battle of Debaltseve
paragraphs: The Battle of Debaltseve was a military confrontation in the city of Debaltseve, Donetsk Oblast, between the pro-Russian separatist forces of the Donetsk People's Republic (DPR) and Luhansk People's Republic (LPR), and the Ukrainian Armed Forces, starting in mid-January 2015 during the war in the Donbas region. The Russian forces composed mostly of "Wagner Group" soldiers recaptured Debaltseve, which had been under Ukrainian control since a counter-offensive by government forces in July 2014. The city lay in a "wedge" of Ukrainian-held territory bordered by the DPR on one side, and the LPR on the other, and was a vital road and railway junction.

Separatist and Russian forces began a concerted effort to force Ukrainian troops out of the city on 16–17 January, sparking the battle. Heavy fighting went on until 18 February 2015, when Ukrainian forces retreated from Debaltseve to Artemivsk (present-day Bakhmut).

Battle of Decimomannu.headline: Bitka pri Decimomannu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Decimomannu, bitka pri Cornusu ali bitka pri Caralisu je potekala leta 215 pr. n. št. na otoku Sardiniji, ko je kartažanska vojska priplula na otok, da bi podprla krajevni upor proti rimski oblasti. Vojska pod poveljstvom Hasdrubala Plešastega se je jeseni 215 pr. n. št. nekje med krajema Sestu in Decimomannu, tik severno od Caralisa, spopadla z rimsko vojsko podobne velikosti pod pretorjem Titom Manlijem Torkvatom. Rimljani so kartažansko vojsko uničili, nato pa v pomorski bitki južno od Sardinije razpršili še njeno ladjevje.

source.title: Battle of Decimomannu
paragraphs: The Battle of Decimomannu, Battle of Cornus or Battle of Caralis was fought 215 BC on the island of Sardinia when a Carthaginian army sailed to the island to support a local revolt against Roman rule. The army, led by Hasdrubal the Bald, fought a Roman army of similar size under the praetor Titus Manlius Torquatus in the Fall of 215 BC somewhere between Sestu and Decimomannu, just north of Caralis. The Romans destroyed the Carthaginian army and then scattered their fleet in a sea battle south of Sardinia.

Battle of Delium.headline: Bitka pri Deliju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Deliju (ali Delionu, mestu v Beotiji) je potekala leta 424 pr. n. št. med peloponeško vojno. V njej so se spopadli Atenci in Beočani, zavezniki Špartancev, končala pa se je z obleganjem Delija v naslednjih tednih.

source.title: Battle of Delium
paragraphs: The Battle of Delium (or Delion, a city in Boeotia) took place in 424 BC, during the Peloponnesian War. It was fought between the Athenians and the Boeotians, who were allies of the Spartans, and ended with the siege of Delium in the following weeks.

Battle of Denain.headline: Bitka pri Denainu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Denainu je potekala 24. julija 1712 v okviru vojne za špansko nasledstvo. Francoska vojska pod poveljstvom maršala Villarsa je v njej premagala nizozemske in avstrijske sile pod vodstvom princa Evgena Savojskega.

Bila je zadnja bitka vojne v Flandriji in ena najpomembnejših: velika aliansa ni mogla več ogrožati Pariza, Francija pa je izničila skoraj dve leti ozemeljskih izgub. Bitka je bila sama po sebi krajevna in taktična zmaga, odločilna pa je postala, ker jo je Villars neutrudno izkoristil: spretno je manevriral in znova zavzel strateške mejne utrdbe, ki bi otopile vsak zavezniški poskus, da bi znova prodrli proti Parizu in Ludviku XIV. narekovali mirovne pogoje.

source.title: Battle of Denain
paragraphs: The Battle of Denain was fought on 24 July 1712 as part of the War of the Spanish Succession. It resulted in a French victory, under Marshal Villars, against Dutch and Austrian forces, under Prince Eugene of Savoy.

It was the war's last battle in Flanders and one of the most consequential, breaking the Grand Alliance's ability to threaten Paris and reversing nearly two years of French territorial losses. In itself a local and tactical victory, Denain was made decisive by its relentless exploitation by Villars, who skillfully maneuvered to reclaim strategic border fortifications that would blunt any allied effort to renew their advance on Paris and dictate peace terms to Louis XIV.

Bitka pri Dennewitzu (nemško: Schlacht von Dennewitz) je potekala 6. septembra 1813 med francoskimi silami pod poveljstvom maršala Michela Neya in zavezniško Severno armado šeste koalicije pod poveljstvom švedskega prestolonaslednika Karla Ivana, Friedricha Wilhelma von Bülowa in Bogislava von Tauentziena. Bojevali so se v Dennewitzu, vasi v pruski provinci Brandenburg blizu Jüterboga, 40 kilometrov jugozahodno od Berlina. Bitka je pomenila prelomnico nemškega pohoda leta 1813: zavezniška zmaga ni le končala Napoleonovega upanja, da bo zavzel Berlin in Prusijo izločil iz vojne, temveč je resnost francoskega poraza, ki ga je zadala predvsem pruska vojska, tudi načela zvestobo nemških zaveznikov Napoleonu. Francoske izgube in diplomatski neuspehi, ki so sledili Dennewitzu, so močno prispevali k Napoleonovemu porazu mesec pozneje v bitki pri Leipzigu.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Dennewitz
paragraphs: The Battle of Dennewitz (German: Schlacht von Dennewitz) took place on 6 September 1813 between French forces commanded by Marshal Michel Ney and the Sixth Coalition's Allied Army of the North commanded by Crown Prince Charles John of Sweden, Friedrich Wilhelm von Bülow and Bogislav von Tauentzien. It occurred in Dennewitz, a village in the Prussian province of Brandenburg, near Jüterbog, 40 kilometres (25 mi) southwest of Berlin. The battle marked a turning point in the German Campaign of 1813 as not only did the Allied victory end Napoleon's hopes of capturing Berlin and knocking Prussia out of the war, but the severity of the French defeat, inflicted by a primarily Prussian force, also led to the erosion of fidelity of German allies to the Napoleonic cause. The French losses, and consequent diplomatic reverses, that resulted from Dennewitz contributed greatly to Napoleon's defeat a month later at the Battle of Leipzig.

Battle of Deorham.headline: Bitka pri Deorhamu
paragraphs: Bitko pri Deorhamu (ali Dyrhamu) Anglosaška kronika prikazuje kot pomemben vojaški spopad med Zahodnimi Sasi in Briti na zahodu Anglije (West Country) leta 577. Kronika bitko opisuje kot veliko zmago wessexških sil pod vodstvom Ceawlina in nekega Cuthwina, ki so zavzele rimsko-britanska mesta Glevum (Gloucester), Corinium Dobunnorum (Cirencester) in Aquae Sulis (Bath).

source.title: Battle of Deorham
paragraphs: The Battle of Deorham (or Dyrham) is portrayed by the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle as an important military encounter between the West Saxons and the Britons in the West Country in 577. The Chronicle depicts the battle as a major victory for Wessex's forces, led by Ceawlin and one Cuthwine, resulting in the capture of the Romano-British towns of Glevum (Gloucester), Corinium Dobunnorum (Cirencester), and Aquae Sulis (Bath).

Battle of Dessau Bridge.headline: Bitka pri dessauskem mostu
paragraphs: Bitka pri dessauskem mostu (nemško: Schlacht bei Dessau) je bila pomembna bitka tridesetletne vojne, v kateri so se 25. aprila 1626 ob reki Labi pred Dessauom v Nemčiji spopadli danski protestanti in cesarske nemške katoliške sile.

Ernst von Mansfeld je skušal prečkati dessauski most, da bi napadel glavni stan cesarske vojske v Magdeburgu. Dessauski most je bil edina kopenska povezava med Magdeburgom in Dresdnom, kar je Dancem oteževalo prodor. Grof Tilly je hotel nadzorovati most, da bi danskemu kralju Kristijanu IV. preprečil dostop do Kassla in zavaroval spodnjesaško okrožje. Cesarske nemške sile Albrechta von Wallensteina so v tej bitki zlahka premagale protestantske sile Ernsta von Mansfelda.

source.title: Battle of Dessau Bridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Dessau Bridge (German: Schlacht bei Dessau) was a significant battle of the Thirty Years' War between Danish Protestants and the Imperial German Catholic forces on the Elbe River outside Dessau, Germany on 25 April 1626.

This battle was an attempt by Ernst von Mansfeld to cross the Dessau bridge in order to invade the headquarters of the Imperial Army in Magdeburg, Germany. The Dessau bridge was the only land access between Magdeburg and Dresden, which made it difficult for the Danes to advance. The Count of Tilly wanted control of the bridge in order to prevent King Christian IV of Denmark from having access to Kassel and to protect the Lower Saxon Circle. The Imperial German forces of Albrecht von Wallenstein handily defeated the Protestant forces of Ernst von Mansfeld in this battle.

Battle of Dettingen.headline: Bitka pri Dettingnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dettingnu je potekala 27. junija 1743 med vojno za avstrijsko nasledstvo blizu Karlsteina ob Majni na Bavarskem. Zavezništvo britanskih, hannovrskih in avstrijskih čet, znano kot pragmatična vojska, je premagalo francoske sile pod poveljstvom vojvode Noaillesa. Operativno je poveljeval grof Stair, nominalno pa je zaveznikom poveljeval britanski kralj Jurij II.; pri Dettingnu je zadnjič kak vladajoči britanski monarh vodil čete v boj. Bitka je na širši potek vojne malo vplivala in so jo opisali kot »srečen pobeg, ne pa veliko zmago«.

source.title: Battle of Dettingen
paragraphs: The Battle of Dettingen took place on 27 June 1743 during the War of the Austrian Succession, near Karlstein am Main in Bavaria. An alliance composed of British, Hanoverian and Austrian troops, known as the Pragmatic Army, defeated a French force commanded by the Duke of Noailles. While the Earl of Stair exercised operational control, the Allies were nominally commanded by George II of Great Britain, and Dettingen was the last time a reigning British monarch led troops in combat. The battle had little impact on the wider war, and has been described as 'a happy escape, rather than a great victory.'

Battle of Dobro Pole.headline: Bitka na Dobrem polju
paragraphs: Bitka na Dobrem polju (srbsko: Битка код Доброг Поља; grško: Μάχη του Ντόμπρο Πόλε), znana tudi kot preboj na Dobrem polju (bolgarsko: Пробив при Добро Поле), je potekala od 15. do 18. septembra 1918 na balkanski fronti prve svetovne vojne, v začetni fazi vardarske ofenzive. Združene srbske, francoske in grške sile so 15. septembra napadle bolgarske jarke na Dobrem polju, ki je bilo tedaj del Kraljevine Srbije pod bolgarsko okupacijo in Kraljevine Grčije (danes Severna Makedonija in Grčija). Ofenziva in predhodna topniška priprava sta bolgarsko moralo hudo načeli in sčasoma pripeljali do množičnega dezerterstva.
notes: The romanizations and the English gloss "Good Field" are left out; the Slovenian name says it.

source.title: Battle of Dobro Pole
paragraphs: The Battle of Dobro Pole (Serbian: Битка код Доброг Поља, romanized: Bitka kod Dobrog Polja; Greek: Μάχη του Ντόμπρο Πόλε, romanized: Máchi tou Dóbro Póle), also known as the Breakthrough at Dobro Pole (Bulgarian: Пробив при Добро Поле, romanized: Probiv pri Dobro Pole), was a World War I battle fought between 15 and 18 September 1918. The battle was fought in the initial stage of the Vardar offensive, in the Balkan Front. On 15 September, a combined force of Serbian, French and Greek troops attacked the Bulgarian-held trenches in Dobro Pole ("Good Field"), at the time part of the Bulgarian-occupied Kingdom of Serbia and the Kingdom of Greece (present-day North Macedonia and Greece). The offensive and the preceding artillery preparation had devastating effects on Bulgarian morale, eventually leading to mass desertions.

Battle of Doiran (1916).headline: Bitka pri Dojranu (1916)
paragraphs: V začetku avgusta 1916 so tri francoske in ena britanska divizija s 45.000 možmi in 400 topovi začele ofenzivo proti bolgarskim položajem ob Dojranskem jezeru, ki jih je branila 2. traška pehotna divizija. Napad se je začel 9. avgusta z močnim topniškim ognjem na položaje 27. čepinskega in 9. plovdivskega polka. Vse štiri napade, ki so sledili 10., 15., 16. in 18. avgusta, je druga divizija odbila, zavezniki pa so se morali s hudimi izgubami umakniti na izhodiščne položaje.

Drugi viri navajajo, da so Francozi zavzeli Želvji grič (Tortue) in Doldželi, območje 30 km², a za zelo visoko ceno. Britanski 7. bataljon lahke pehote Oxfordshira in Buckinghamshira je zavzel Podkvasti grič.
notes: The English opens without a definition sentence; kept as in the source.

source.title: Battle of Doiran (1916)
paragraphs: At the beginning of August 1916, three French and one British division with 45,000 men and 400 guns launched an offensive against the Bulgarian positions at Doiran Lake, defended by the 2nd Thracian Infantry Division. The attack began on 9 August with heavy artillery fire on the positions of the 27th Chepino Regiment and 9th Plovdiv Regiment. All four attacks that followed on 10, 15, 16 and 18 August were repulsed by the Second Division, and the Allies were forced to retreat to their original positions with heavy casualties.

Other sources state that the French took Tortoise Hill (Tortue) and Doldzeli, an area of 30 km2, but at a very high cost. The British 7th Battalion of the Oxfordshire & Buckinghamshire Light Infantry took Horseshoe Hill.

Battle of Doiran (1918).headline: Bitka pri Dojranu (1918)
paragraphs: Tretja bitka pri Dojranu je potekala od 18. do 19. septembra 1918, ko so Britanci in Grki napadli položaje bolgarske prve armade blizu Dojranskega jezera. Bitka je bila del prve svetovne vojne in je potekala na balkanskem bojišču. Končala se je tako, da so Bolgari odbili vse napade.

source.title: Battle of Doiran (1918)
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Doiran was fought from 18 to 19 September 1918, with the British and the Greeks assaulting the positions of the Bulgarian First Army near Doiran Lake. The battle was part of World War I and took place in the Balkan Theatre. The battle ended with the Bulgarians repulsing all attacks.

Battle of Domokos.headline: Bitka pri Domokosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Domokosu (turško: Dömeke muharebesi) je potekala med Osmanskim cesarstvom in Kraljevino Grčijo in je bila del grško-turške vojne leta 1897. Končala se je z osmansko zmago in evropske velesile spodbudila, da so posredovale v prid Grčiji in preprečile nadaljnje osmansko prodiranje na grško ozemlje.

source.title: Battle of Domokos
paragraphs: The Battle of Domokos (Turkish: Dömeke muharebesi) took place between the Ottoman Empire and the Kingdom of Greece. This battle was a part of the Greco-Turkish War (1897). The battle resulted in an Ottoman victory, and prompted European powers to intervene on behalf of Greece to prevent further Ottoman advances into Greek territory.

Battle of Domstadtl.headline: Bitka pri Domstadtlu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Domstadtlu (tudi Domstadt, češko: Domašov) je bila spopad med habsburško monarhijo in Kraljevino Prusijo v moravski vasi Domašov nad Bystřicí med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne) 30. junija 1758, pred njo pa je 28. junija prišlo do manjšega spopada pri Guntramovicah (Gundersdorf). Avstrijci pod poveljstvom generalmajorjev Ernsta Gideona von Laudona in Josepha von Siskovitsa so napadli in uničili oskrbovalni konvoj, namenjen pruski vojski, ki je oblegala Olomouc (Olmütz). Avstrijska zmaga je mesto rešila, pruski kralj Friderik Veliki pa je moral zapustiti Moravsko.

source.title: Battle of Domstadtl
paragraphs: The Battle of Domstadtl (also spelled Domstadt, Czech: Domašov) was a battle between the Habsburg monarchy and the Kingdom of Prussia in the Moravian village of Domašov nad Bystřicí during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War) on 30 June 1758, preceded by a minor clash at Guntramovice (Gundersdorf) on 28 June. Austrians under the command of Major General Ernst Gideon von Laudon and Major General Joseph von Siskovits attacked and destroyed a supply convoy bound for the Prussian army besieging Olomouc (Olmütz). The Austrian victory saved the city and the Prussian King Frederick the Great was forced to leave Moravia.

Bitka za Donbas je bila vojaška ofenziva, del širše vzhodne fronte rusko-ukrajinske vojne. Ofenziva za nadzor nad regijo Donbas se je med oboroženimi silami Rusije in Ukrajine začela 18. aprila 2022. Vojaški analitiki menijo, da je bila druga strateška faza invazije, po začetnem ruskem napadu na Ukrajino v treh smereh.

Ruska strategija v tem sektorju je bila obkoliti ukrajinske čete v Donbasu ter vso Doneško in Lugansko oblast priključiti separatističnima državama pod rusko zaščito, Doneški ljudski republiki (DLR) in Luganski ljudski republiki (LLR). Rusija je trdila, da je do 23. junija 2022 nadzorovala 55 % Doneške oblasti in do 3. julija 2022 vso Lugansko oblast, ruske in separatistične sile pa so nadzorovale mesta Mariupol, Severodoneck, Lisičansk, Rubižne in mnoga druga.

source.title: Battle of Donbas (2022)
paragraphs: The Battle of Donbas was a military offensive that was part of the wider eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war. The offensive began on 18 April 2022 between the armed forces of Russia and Ukraine for control of the Donbas region. Military analysts consider the campaign to have been the second strategic phase of the invasion, after Russia's initial three-pronged attack into Ukraine.

Russia's strategy in the sector was to encircle Ukrainian troops in the Donbas and to annexe the entire Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts to the Russian-backed separatist states of the Donetsk People's Republic (DPR) and Luhansk People's Republic (LPR). Russia claimed to have controlled 55% of Donetsk Oblast by 23 June 2022 and all of Luhansk Oblast by 3 July 2022, with Russian and separatist forces controlling the cities of Mariupol, Sievierodonetsk, Lysychansk, Rubizhne, and many others.

Battle of Dornach.headline: Bitka pri Dornachu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dornachu je potekala 22. julija 1499 med četami cesarja Maksimilijana I. in staro švicarsko konfederacijo blizu švicarske vasi Dornach. Končala se je z odločilnim Maksimilijanovim porazom in sklenila švabsko vojno med Švicarji in Švabsko zvezo.

source.title: Battle of Dornach
paragraphs: The Battle of Dornach was fought on 22 July 1499 between the troops of Emperor Maximilian I and the Old Swiss Confederacy, close to the Swiss village of Dornach. The battle ended in a decisive defeat for Maximilian, and concluded the Swabian War between the Swiss and the Swabian League.

Battle of Dover (1652).headline: Bitka pri Dovru (1652)
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Dovru, ki je potekala 19. maja 1652 (29. maja 1652 po gregorijanskem koledarju), je bila prvi spopad prve angleško-nizozemske vojne med mornaricama Angleške republike in Republike Združenih Nizozemskih provinc. Bila je neodločena bitka, v kateri sta sodelovali admiralski ladji admiralov Maartena Trompa in Roberta Blaka. Zgodovinarji tega obdobja si o izidu bitke niso enotni.

source.title: Battle of Dover (1652)
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Dover, fought on 19 May 1652 (29 May 1652 Gregorian calendar), was the first engagement of the First Anglo-Dutch War between the navies of the Commonwealth of England and the United Provinces of the Netherlands. It proved to be an indecisive battle involving the flagships of Admirals Maarten Tromp and Robert Blake. Opinions about the outcome of that battle vary among historians of that period.

Battle of Drăgășani.headline: Bitka pri Drăgășaniju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Drăgășaniju (ali Dragašaniju) je potekala 19. junija 1821 v Drăgășaniju v Vlaški med osmanskimi silami sultana Mahmuda II. in grškimi uporniki Filiki Eterije v okviru grške osamosvojitvene vojne.

source.title: Battle of Drăgășani
paragraphs: The Battle of Drăgășani (or Dragashani) was fought on 19 June 1821 in Drăgășani, Wallachia, between the Ottoman forces of Sultan Mahmud II and the Greek Filiki Etaireia insurgents as a part of the Greek War of Independence.

Battle of Drepana.headline: Bitka pri Drepani
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Drepani (ali Drepanumu) je potekala leta 249 pr. n. št. v prvi punski vojni blizu Drepane (današnji Trapani) v zahodni Siciliji med kartažanskim ladjevjem pod Adherbalom in rimskim ladjevjem pod poveljstvom Publija Klavdija Pulhra.

source.title: Battle of Drepana
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Drepana (or Drepanum) took place in 249 BC during the First Punic War near Drepana (modern Trapani) in western Sicily, between a Carthaginian fleet under Adherbal and a Roman fleet commanded by Publius Claudius Pulcher.

Bitka za Dresden (26.–27. avgusta 1813) je bila velik spopad napoleonskih vojn. Potekala je okoli mesta Dresden v današnji Nemčiji, tedaj prestolnice Kraljevine Saške. Šesta koalicija se je po nedavnem pristopu Avstrije počutila opogumljeno v prizadevanjih, da bi Francoze pregnala iz srednje Evrope. Čeprav so bile francoske sile pod Napoleonom močno v manjšini, so zmagale nad češko armado pod vodstvom generalisimusa Karla von Schwarzenberga. Napoleonova zmaga pa ni privedla do razpada koalicije, vreme in neuporabljene ruske rezerve, ki so tvorile učinkovito zaščitnico, pa so preprečile obsežnejše zasledovanje. Tri dni po bitki je koalicija v bitki pri Kulmu obkolila in uničila francoski korpus, ki je prodiral na njeno umikalno pot.

source.title: Battle of Dresden
paragraphs: The Battle of Dresden (26–27 August 1813) was a major engagement of the Napoleonic Wars. The battle took place around the city of Dresden in modern-day Germany, then the capital of the Kingdom of Saxony. With the recent addition of Austria, the Sixth Coalition felt emboldened in their quest to expel the French from Central Europe. Despite being heavily outnumbered, French forces under Napoleon scored a victory against the Army of Bohemia led by Generalissimo Karl von Schwarzenberg. However, Napoleon's victory did not lead to the collapse of the coalition, and the weather and the uncommitted Russian reserves who formed an effective rearguard precluded a major pursuit. Three days after the battle, the Coalition surrounded and destroyed a French corps advancing into their line of withdrawal at the Battle of Kulm.

Battle of Dublin.headline: Bitka za Dublin
paragraphs: Bitka za Dublin je bila teden uličnih bojev v Dublinu od 28. junija do 5. julija 1922, s katerim se je začela irska državljanska vojna. Šest mesecev po tem, ko je anglo-irska pogodba končala irsko osamosvojitveno vojno, so se v njej spopadle sile nove začasne vlade in del Irske republikanske armade (IRA), ki je pogodbi nasprotoval.

V bitki je sodelovala tudi Irska državljanska vojska, ki je na območju ulice O'Connell podpirala del IRA, ki je nasprotoval pogodbi. Boji so se začeli z napadom sil začasne vlade na stavbo Four Courts in se končali z odločilno zmago začasne vlade.

source.title: Battle of Dublin
paragraphs: The Battle of Dublin was a week of street battles in Dublin from 28 June to 5 July 1922 that marked the beginning of the Irish Civil War. Six months after the Anglo-Irish Treaty ended the recent Irish War of Independence, it was fought between the forces of the new Provisional Government and a section of the Irish Republican Army (IRA) that opposed the Treaty.

The Irish Citizen Army also became involved in the battle, having supported the anti-Treaty IRA in the O'Connell Street area. The fighting began with an assault by Provisional Government forces on the Four Courts building, and ended in a decisive victory for the Provisional Government.

Battle of Dun Nechtain.headline: Bitka pri Dun Nechtainu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dun Nechtainu ali bitka pri Nechtansmeru (staroirsko: Cath Dúin Nechtáin; starovaližansko: Gueith Linn Garan) je potekala 20. maja 685 med Pikti pod vodstvom kralja Brideija Mac Bilija in Northumbrijci pod vodstvom kralja Ecgfritha.

Northumbrijska prevlada nad severno Britanijo, ki so jo izbojevali Ecgfrithovi predhodniki, je začela razpadati. Več podložnih ljudstev Northumbrije se je v zadnjih letih uprlo, kar je privedlo do vrste velikih bitk proti Piktom, Mercijcem in Ircem z različnim uspehom. Potem ko so Pikti oblegali sosednja ozemlja, je Ecgfrith kljub nasprotnim nasvetom povedel svoje sile nadnje, da bi znova uveljavil nadoblast nad piktskimi ljudstvi.

Pikti so z navideznim umikom zvabili Northumbrijce v zasedo pri Dun Nechtainu blizu jezera Linn Garan. Dolgo so menili, da je bojišče blizu današnje vasi Dunnichen v Angusu. Novejše raziskave pa kažejo na severnejšo lokacijo blizu Dunachtona na obali jezera Loch Insh v pokrajini Badenoch and Strathspey.

source.title: Battle of Dun Nechtain
paragraphs: The Battle of Dun Nechtain or Battle of Nechtansmere (Old Irish: Cath Dúin Nechtáin; Old Welsh: Gueith Linn Garan) was fought between the Picts, led by King Bridei Mac Bili, and the Northumbrians, led by King Ecgfrith, on 20 May 685.

The Northumbrian hegemony over northern Britain, won by Ecgfrith's predecessors, had begun to disintegrate. Several of Northumbria's subject nations had rebelled in recent years, leading to a number of large-scale battles against the Picts, Mercians and Irish, with varied success. After sieges of neighbouring territories carried out by the Picts, Ecgfrith led his forces against them, despite advice to the contrary, in an effort to reassert his suzerainty over the Pictish nations.

A feigned retreat by the Picts drew the Northumbrians into an ambush at Dun Nechtain near the lake of Linn Garan. The battle site has long been thought to have been near the present-day village of Dunnichen in Angus. Recent research, however, has suggested a more northerly location near Dunachton, on the shores of Loch Insh in Badenoch and Strathspey.

Battle of Dunbar (1296).headline: Bitka pri Dunbarju (1296)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dunbarju je bila edini pomembnejši spopad na bojnem polju v pohodu leta 1296 na začetku prve škotske osamosvojitvene vojne.

source.title: Battle of Dunbar (1296)
paragraphs: The Battle of Dunbar was the only significant field action of the campaign of 1296 during the beginning of the First War of Scottish Independence.

Battle of Dunbar (1650).headline: Bitka pri Dunbarju (1650)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dunbarju je potekala 3. septembra 1650 blizu Dunbarja na Škotskem med angleško vojsko novega kova (New Model Army) pod Oliverjem Cromwellom in škotsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Davida Leslieja. Angleži so odločilno zmagali. Bila je prva večja bitka vdora na Škotsko leta 1650.

source.title: Battle of Dunbar (1650)
paragraphs: The Battle of Dunbar was fought between the English New Model Army, under Oliver Cromwell, and a Scottish army commanded by David Leslie on 3 September 1650 near Dunbar, Scotland. The battle resulted in a decisive victory for the English. It was the first major battle of the 1650 invasion of Scotland.

Battle of Dungeness.headline: Bitka pri Dungenessu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Dungenessu je potekala 30. novembra 1652 (10. decembra po gregorijanskem koledarju) v prvi angleško-nizozemski vojni blizu rta Dungeness v Kentu.

source.title: Battle of Dungeness
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Dungeness took place on 30 November 1652 (10 December in the Gregorian calendar) during the First Anglo-Dutch War near the cape of Dungeness in Kent.

Battle of Dupplin Moor.headline: Bitka pri Dupplin Mooru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dupplin Mooru je potekala 11. avgusta 1332 med privrženci škotskega kralja Davida II., sina kralja Roberta Brucea, in napadalci, ki jih je podpirala Anglija in so podpirali Edvarda Balliola, sina škotskega kralja Ivana I. Spopad je potekal malo jugozahodno od Pertha na Škotskem, ko je škotska vojska pod poveljstvom Donalda, grofa Mara, ki je po ocenah štela več kot 15.000 in morda celo 40.000 mož, napadla pretežno angleško vojsko 1500 mož pod poveljstvom Balliola in Henryja Beaumonta, grofa Buchana. Bila je prva večja bitka druge škotske osamosvojitvene vojne.

source.title: Battle of Dupplin Moor
paragraphs: The Battle of Dupplin Moor was fought between supporters of King David II of Scotland, the son of King Robert Bruce, and English-backed invaders supporting Edward Balliol, son of King John I of Scotland, on 11 August 1332. It took place a little to the south-west of Perth, Scotland, when a Scottish force commanded by Donald, Earl of Mar, estimated to have been stronger than 15,000 and possibly as many as 40,000 men, attacked a largely English force of 1,500 commanded by Balliol and Henry Beaumont, Earl of Buchan. This was the first major battle of the Second War of Scottish Independence.

Battle of Dürenstein.headline: Bitka pri Dürnsteinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dürensteinu (nemško: Schlacht bei Dürnstein; tudi Dürrenstein, Dürnstein in Diernstein) ali bitka pri Kremsu (rusko: Сражение при Кремсе) 11. novembra 1805 je bila spopad napoleonskih vojn med vojno tretje koalicije. Dürenstein (danes Dürnstein) v Avstriji leži v dolini Wachau ob Donavi, 73 kilometrov gorvodno od Dunaja. Reka med Dürnsteinom in bližnjim Kremsom ob Donavi naredi polmesečast zavoj, bitka pa je potekala na poplavni ravnici med reko in gorami.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Dürenstein
paragraphs: The Battle of Dürenstein (German: Schlacht bei Dürnstein; also known as Dürrenstein, Dürnstein and Diernstein) or the Battle of Krems (Russian: Сражение при Кремсе), on 11 November 1805, was an engagement in the Napoleonic Wars during the War of the Third Coalition. Dürenstein (modern Dürnstein), Austria, is located in the Wachau valley, on the river Danube, 73 kilometers (45 mi) upstream from Vienna, Austria. The river makes a crescent-shaped curve between Dürnstein and nearby Krems an der Donau, and the battle was fought in the flood plain between the river and the mountains.

Battle of Dyrrhachium (48 BC).headline: Bitka pri Dirahiju (48 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dirahiju je potekala od aprila do konca julija 48 pr. n. št. blizu mesta Dirahij (današnji Drač) na ozemlju današnje Albanije. V njej sta se v Cezarjevi državljanski vojni spopadla Gaj Julij Cezar in vojska pod vodstvom Gneja Pompeja.

Cezar je skušal zavzeti Dirahij, ključno oskrbovalno središče Pompejancev, vendar mu ni uspelo, ker je Pompej zasedel mesto in okoliške vzpetine. V odgovor je Cezar Pompejev tabor oblegal in ga obdal z obkolitvenim obzidjem, dokler se Pompeju po več mesecih spopadov ni uspelo prebiti skozi Cezarjeve utrjene črte, zaradi česar se je moral Cezar strateško umakniti v Tesalijo.
Po bitki je Pompej zasledoval Cezarja v Tesalijo in nato proti Farzalu, kjer je pozneje potekala odločilna bitka Cezarjevega grškega pohoda.

source.title: Battle of Dyrrhachium (48 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Dyrrachium (or Dyrrhachium) took place from April to late July 48 BC near the city of Dyrrachium (modern-day Durrës) in what is now Albania. It was fought between Gaius Julius Caesar and an army led by Gnaeus Pompey during Caesar's civil war.

Caesar attempted to capture the vital Pompeian logistics hub of Dyrrachium, but was unsuccessful after Pompey occupied it and the surrounding heights. In response, Caesar besieged Pompey's camp and constructed a circumvallation thereof, until after months of skirmishes, Pompey was able to break through Caesar's fortified lines, forcing Caesar to make a strategic retreat into Thessaly.
After the battle, Pompey pursued Caesar into Thessaly and then towards Pharsalus, where the decisive battle of Caesar's Greek campaign would be fought.

Battle of Ebro River.headline: Bitka pri reki Ebro
paragraphs: Bitka pri reki Ebro je bila pomorska bitka spomladi 217 pr. n. št. blizu ustja reke Ebro med kartažanskim ladjevjem s približno 40 kvinkveremami pod poveljstvom Himilka in rimskim ladjevjem s 35 ladjami pod Gnejem Kornelijem Scipionom Kalvom. Hasdrubal Barka, kartažanski poveljnik na Iberskem polotoku, je sprožil skupen pohod, da bi uničil rimsko oporišče severno od reke Ebro. Kartažanski pomorski oddelek je bil po presenetljivem napadu rimskih ladij popolnoma poražen: izgubil je 29 ladij in nadzor nad morji okoli Iberskega polotoka. Po tej zmagi je ugled Rimljanov na Iberskem polotoku še zrasel, zato so se uprla nekatera iberska plemena pod kartažansko oblastjo.

source.title: Battle of Ebro River
paragraphs: The Battle of Ebro River was a naval battle fought near the mouth of Ebro River in the spring of 217 BC between a Carthaginian fleet of approximately 40 quinqueremes, under the command of Himilco, and a Roman fleet of 35 ships, under Gnaeus Cornelius Scipio Calvus. Hasdrubal Barca, the Carthaginian commander in Iberia, had launched a joint expedition to destroy the Roman base north of the Ebro River. The Carthaginian naval contingent was totally defeated after a surprise attack by the Roman ships, losing 29 ships and the control of seas around Iberia. The reputation of the Romans was further enhanced in Iberia after this victory, causing rebellion among some of the Iberian tribes under Carthaginian control.

Battle of Eckmühl.headline: Bitka pri Eckmühlu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Eckmühlu, ki je potekala 21. in 22. aprila 1809, je bila prelomnica pohoda leta 1809, znanega tudi kot vojna pete koalicije. Napoleon I. ni bil pripravljen na začetek sovražnosti, ki so jih 10. aprila 1809 sprožili Avstrijci pod vodstvom nadvojvode Karla Avstrijskega, in je bil prvič, odkar je prevzel francosko cesarsko krono, prisiljen strateško pobudo prepustiti nasprotniku. Zaradi trdovratne obrambe III. korpusa pod poveljstvom maršala Davouta in bavarskega VII. korpusa pod poveljstvom maršala Lefebvra je Napoleon premagal glavno avstrijsko vojsko in si za preostanek vojne priboril strateško pobudo.

source.title: Battle of Eckmühl
paragraphs: The Battle of Eckmühl fought on 21–22 April 1809, was the turning point of the 1809 Campaign, also known as the War of the Fifth Coalition. Napoleon I had been unprepared for the start of hostilities on 10 April 1809, by the Austrians under Archduke Charles of Austria, and for the first time since assuming the French Imperial Crown had been forced to give up the strategic initiative to an opponent. Thanks to the dogged defense waged by the III Corps, commanded by Marshal Davout, and the Bavarian VII Corps, commanded by Marshal Lefebvre, Napoleon was able to defeat the principal Austrian army and wrest the strategic initiative for the remainder of the war.

Battle of Edgcote.headline: Bitka pri Edgcotu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Edgcotu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Banburyju ali bitka pri Danes Mooru) je potekala 24. julija 1469 v vojni rož. V njej sta se spopadli kraljeva vojska pod poveljstvom grofov Pembroka in Devona ter uporniška vojska, ki so jo vodili privrženci grofa Warwicka.

Bitka je potekala 9,7 kilometra severovzhodno od Banburyja v Oxfordshiru in se končala z zmago upornikov, ki je oblast začasno prepustila grofu Warwicku. Septembra pa je angleški kralj Edvard IV. znova prevzel nadzor in Warwick se je znašel v podobnem položaju kot pred bitko, zato je začel načrtovati drugi upor. Po Edgcotu ni bilo več poti nazaj. Edvard mu ni mogel več povsem zaupati, Warwick pa se je neizprosno približeval lancastrski strani.
notes: The miles (6 mi) are dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Edgcote
paragraphs: The Battle of Edgcote (also known as the Battle of Banbury or the Battle of Danes Moor) took place on 24 July 1469, during the Wars of the Roses. It was fought between a royal army, commanded by the earls of Pembroke and Devon, and a rebel force led by supporters of the Earl of Warwick.

The battle took place 6 miles (9.7 km) northeast of Banbury in Oxfordshire; it resulted in a rebel victory which temporarily handed power over to the Earl of Warwick. By September, though, Edward IV of England was back in control, and Warwick found himself in a situation similar to the one before the battle, prompting him to plan a second rebellion. After Edgcote there was no turning back. Edward could no longer trust him fully and he was inexorably moving towards becoming a Lancastrian.

Battle of Edgehill.headline: Bitka pri Edgehillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Edgehillu (ali Edge Hillu) je bila redna bitka prve angleške državljanske vojne. Potekala je v nedeljo, 23. oktobra 1642, blizu Edge Hilla in Kinetona v južnem Warwickshiru.

Vsi poskusi ustavnega kompromisa med kraljem Karlom in parlamentom so v začetku leta 1642 propadli. Kralj in parlament sta zbrala veliki vojski, da bi svoje dosegla z orožjem. Oktobra se je kralj v začasnem oporišču blizu Shrewsburyja odločil, da bo krenil proti Londonu in tako izsilil odločilni spopad z glavno parlamentarno vojsko pod poveljstvom grofa Essexa.

Pozno 22. oktobra sta obe vojski nepričakovano ugotovili, da je sovražnik blizu. Naslednji dan se je rojalistična vojska spustila z Edge Hilla, da bi izsilila bitko. Ko je parlamentarna artilerija začela obstreljevanje, so rojalisti napadli. Obe vojski so sestavljali večinoma neizkušeni in včasih slabo opremljeni vojaki. Veliko mož z obeh strani je pobegnilo ali se odcepilo, da bi plenili sovražnikovo prtljago, in nobena vojska ni dosegla odločilne prednosti.

source.title: Battle of Edgehill
paragraphs: The Battle of Edgehill (or Edge Hill) was a pitched battle of the First English Civil War. It was fought near Edge Hill and Kineton in southern Warwickshire on Sunday, 23 October 1642.

All attempts at constitutional compromise between King Charles and Parliament broke down early in 1642. Both the King and Parliament raised large armies to gain their way by force of arms. In October, at his temporary base near Shrewsbury, the King decided to march to London in order to force a decisive confrontation with Parliament's main army, commanded by the Earl of Essex.

Late on 22 October, both armies unexpectedly found the enemy to be close by. The next day, the Royalist army descended from Edge Hill to force battle. After the Parliamentarian artillery opened a cannonade, the Royalists attacked. Both armies consisted mostly of inexperienced and sometimes ill-equipped troops. Many men from both sides fled or fell out to loot enemy baggage, and neither army was able to gain a decisive advantage.

Battle of Edington.headline: Bitka pri Edingtonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Edingtonu ali bitka pri Ethandunu je potekala maja 878 med zahodnosaško vojsko kralja Alfreda Velikega in veliko pogansko vojsko pod vodstvom danskega vojskovodje Guthruma. Bitka je potekala blizu Edingtona v Wiltshiru, kjer je Alfred dosegel odločilno zmago, ki je ustavila vikinško prodiranje v Wessex.

Spopad je sledil obdobju nenehnih danskih vpadov na anglosaško ozemlje. V začetku leta 878 je Guthrum presenetljivo napadel Chippenham, zato se je moral Alfred skriti v močvirjih Athelneyja. Ko je zbral krajevne sile, se je z Guthrumom spopadel in ga premagal pri Edingtonu, nato pa oblegal vikinški položaj in Vikinge prisilil k predaji.

Po bitki je Guthrum privolil v pogoje, med katerimi so bili njegov krst, umik v Vzhodno Anglijo in sklenitev miru z wedmorsko pogodbo. Izid je ohranil Wessex kot samostojno kraljestvo in pomenil prelomnico vikinških vojn, saj je postavil temelje za poznejšo združitev Anglije.

source.title: Battle of Edington
paragraphs: The Battle of Edington or Battle of Ethandun was fought in May 878 between the West Saxon army of King Alfred the Great and the Great Heathen Army led by the Danish warlord Guthrum. The battle took place near Edington in Wiltshire, where Alfred secured a decisive victory that halted the Viking advance into Wessex.

The engagement followed a period of sustained Danish incursions into Anglo-Saxon territory. In early 878, Guthrum launched a surprise attack on Chippenham, forcing Alfred into hiding in the marshes of Athelney. After rallying local forces, Alfred confronted and defeated Guthrum at Edington, then laid siege to the Viking position, compelling their surrender.

Following the battle, Guthrum agreed to terms that included his baptism, withdrawal to East Anglia, and the establishment of peace through the Treaty of Wedmore. The outcome preserved Wessex as an independent kingdom and marked a turning point in the Viking wars, laying foundations for the eventual unification of England.

Battle of Ekeren.headline: Bitka pri Ekerenu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ekerenu je potekala 30. junija 1703 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo. Burbonska vojska s približno 24.000 možmi, ki so jo sestavljale čete iz Francije, Španije in Kölna, je obkolila manjše nizozemske sile z 12.000 možmi, ki pa so se uspele prebiti iz obroča in umakniti na varno.

Bitka je imela omejen strateški učinek, a je ob tem, da je pokazala spretnost nizozemskih čet, razkrila nesložnost anglo-nizozemskega poveljstva. Med poveljniki so izbruhnili spori, saj so drug drugega krivili za skorajšnjo katastrofo. V Franciji je bil nezadovoljen tudi Ludvik XIV., ker je njegova močnejša vojska pustila Nizozemcem pobegniti.

source.title: Battle of Ekeren
paragraphs: The Battle of Ekeren, which took place on 30 June 1703, was a battle of the War of the Spanish Succession. A Bourbon army of around 24,000 men, consisting of troops from France, Spain and Cologne, surrounded a smaller Dutch force of 12,000 men, which however managed to break out and retire to safety.

The battle had limited strategic effect, but, while showing the skill of the Dutch troops, it highlighted the disunity in the Anglo-Dutch command structure. Conflicts arose between various commanders, who all blamed each other for the near-disaster. In France Louis XIV was also displeased, as his superior force had let the Dutch escape.

Battle of Elchingen.headline: Bitka pri Elchingnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Elchingnu je potekala 14. oktobra 1805: francoske sile pod vodstvom Michela Neya so razbile avstrijski korpus, ki ga je vodil Johann Sigismund Riesch. Zaradi poraza je vojska francoskega cesarja Napoleona Bonaparta velik del avstrijske vojske obkolila v trdnjavi Ulm, druge enote pa so pobegnile proti vzhodu. Kmalu zatem so se Avstrijci, ujeti v Ulmu, predali, Francozi pa so počistili večino preostalih avstrijskih sil in tako sklenili ulmski pohod.

Konec septembra in v začetku oktobra 1805 je Napoleon obsežno obkolil avstrijsko vojsko na Bavarskem pod vodstvom Karla Macka von Liebericha. Medtem ko je avstrijska vojska stala blizu Ulma južno od Donave, je francoska vojska korakala proti zahodu po severni strani reke. Nato so Napoleonove čete prečkale reko vzhodno od Ulma in Avstrijcem presekale pot za umik proti Dunaju. Mack je nevarnost končno spoznal in skušal prodreti na severni strani reke, a je njegov prvi poskus ustavila ena sama francoska divizija.

source.title: Battle of Elchingen
paragraphs: The Battle of Elchingen, fought on 14 October 1805, saw French forces under Michel Ney rout an Austrian corps led by Johann Sigismund Riesch. This defeat led to a large part of the Austrian army being invested in the fortress of Ulm by the army of Emperor Napoleon Bonaparte of France while other formations fled to the east. Soon afterward, the Austrians trapped in Ulm surrendered and the French mopped up most of the remaining Austrian forces, bringing the Ulm Campaign to a close.

In late September and early October 1805, Napoleon carried out a gigantic envelopment of the Austrian army in Bavaria led by Karl Mack von Lieberich. While the Austrian army lay near Ulm, south of the Danube River, the French army marched west on the north side of the river. Then Napoleon's troops crossed the river east of Ulm, cutting the Austrian retreat route to Vienna. Finally waking up to his danger, Mack tried to break out on the north side of the river, but a lone French division blocked his first attempt.

Battle of Elixheim.headline: Bitka pri Elixheimu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Elixheimu (18. julija 1705), znana tudi kot prehod brabantskih linij, je bila spopad v vojni za špansko nasledstvo, v katerem so anglo-nizozemske sile velike aliance pod vodstvom vojvode Marlborougha in feldmaršala Ouwerkerka uspešno prebile francoske brabantske linije. Linije so bile lok obrambnih poljskih utrdb, ki se je v dolžini sedemdeset milj raztezal od Antwerpna do Namurja. Zaveznikom sicer ni uspelo izsiliti odločilne bitke, a sta se preboj in poznejše rušenje linij izkazala za ključna za zavezniško zmago pri Ramilliesu naslednje leto.

source.title: Battle of Elixheim
paragraphs: At the Battle of Elixheim, 18 July 1705, also known as the Passage of the Lines of Brabant during the War of the Spanish Succession, the Anglo-Dutch forces of the Grand Alliance, under the Duke of Marlborough and Field Marshal Ouwerkerk, successfully broke through the French Lines of Brabant. These lines were an arc of defensive fieldworks stretching in a seventy-mile arc from Antwerp to Namur. Although the Allies were unable to bring about a decisive battle, the breaking and subsequent razing of the lines would prove critical to the Allied victory at Ramillies the next year.

Battle of Ellendun.headline: Bitka pri Ellendunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ellendunu ali bitka pri Wroughtonu je potekala septembra 825 med wessexškim kraljem Ecgberhtom in mercijskim kraljem Beornwulfom. Sir Frank Stenton jo je opisal kot »eno najbolj odločilnih bitk angleške zgodovine«. Z njo se je začela prevlada Zahodnih Sasov v južni Angliji.

source.title: Battle of Ellendun
paragraphs: The Battle of Ellendun or Battle of Wroughton was fought between Ecgberht of Wessex and Beornwulf of Mercia in September 825. Sir Frank Stenton described it as "one of the most decisive battles of English history". It began the establishment of West Saxon dominance in southern England.

Battle of Englefield.headline: Bitka pri Englefieldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Englefieldu je bila zmaga Zahodnih Sasov nad dansko vikinško vojsko okoli 31. decembra 870 pri Englefieldu blizu Readinga v Berkshiru. Bila je prva v vrsti bitk po vdoru danske vojske v Wessex decembra 870.

Do leta 870 so Vikingi osvojili dve od štirih anglosaških kraljestev, Northumbrijo in Vzhodno Anglijo. Konec leta 870 so poskusili osvojiti Wessex in iz Vzhodne Anglije krenili proti Readingu, kamor so prispeli okoli 28. decembra. Tri dni pozneje so pod vodstvom dveh jarlov poslali velik oddelek, da bi nabiral hrano in izvidoval, pri Englefieldu pa ga je pričakala vojska krajevnih vpoklicancev pod poveljstvom Æthelwulfa, ealdormana Berkshira. Ko je eden od jarlov padel in je bil velik del danske vojske strt, so se Vikingi razbežali.

source.title: Battle of Englefield
paragraphs: The Battle of Englefield was a West Saxon victory against a Danish Viking army on about 31 December 870 at Englefield, near Reading in Berkshire. It was the first of a series of battles that took place following an invasion of Wessex by the Danish army in December 870.

By 870, the Vikings had conquered two of the four Anglo-Saxon kingdoms, Northumbria and East Anglia. At the end of 870 they launched an attempt to conquer Wessex and marched from East Anglia to Reading, arriving on about 28 December. Three days later they sent out a large party under two earls to forage and reconnoitre, and it was met at Englefield by an army of local levies under the command of Æthelwulf, Ealdorman of Berkshire. After one of the earls was killed and a large part of the Danish army was overthrown, the Viking force broke and ran.

Battle of Espinosa de los Monteros.headline: Bitka pri Espinosi de los Monteros
paragraphs: Bitka pri Espinosi de los Monteros je potekala med napoleonskimi vojnami 10. in 11. novembra 1808 pri vasi Espinosa de los Monteros v Kantabrijskem gorovju. Končala se je z zmago Francozov pod maršalom Victorjem nad galicijsko vojsko generalporočnika Joaquína Blaka.

source.title: Battle of Espinosa de los Monteros
paragraphs: The Battle of Espinosa de los Monteros took place during the Napoleonic Wars, on 10 and 11 November 1808 at the village of Espinosa de los Monteros in the Cantabrian Mountains. It resulted in a French victory under Marshal Victor against Lieutenant General Joaquín Blake's Army of Galicia.

Battle of Evesham.headline: Bitka pri Eveshamu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Eveshamu (4. avgusta 1265) je bila ena od dveh glavnih bitk druge baronske vojne v Angliji 13. stoletja. Poznejši kralj Edvard I., ki je vodil sile svojega očeta, kralja Henrika III., je v njej premagal Simona de Montforta, grofa Leicestra, in uporne barone. Potekala je 4. avgusta 1265 blizu mesta Evesham v Worcestershiru.

Z bitko pri Lewesu je de Montfort pridobil nadzor nad kraljevo vlado, a ko je več bližnjih zaveznikov prestopilo na drugo stran in je princ Edvard pobegnil iz ujetništva, se je znašel v obrambi. Pri Eveshamu se je moral spopasti z rojalisti in se znašel pred dvakrat večjo vojsko od svoje. Bitka se je kmalu sprevrgla v pokol; de Montfort je padel, njegovo truplo pa so pohabili. Takratni zgodovinar Robert iz Gloucestra jo je opisal kot »umor v Eveshamu, kajti bitka to ni bila«. Bitka je sicer dejansko obnovila kraljevo oblast, vendar se je razpršen odpor nadaljeval vse do podpisa kenilworthske razsodbe leta 1267.

source.title: Battle of Evesham
paragraphs: The Battle of Evesham (4 August 1265) was one of the two main battles of 13th century England's Second Barons' War. It marked the defeat of Simon de Montfort, Earl of Leicester, and the rebellious barons by the future King Edward I, who led the forces of his father, King Henry III. It took place on 4 August 1265, near the town of Evesham, Worcestershire.

With the Battle of Lewes, de Montfort had won control of royal government, but after the defection of several close allies and the escape from captivity of Prince Edward, he found himself on the defensive. Forced to engage the royalists at Evesham, he faced an army twice the size of his own. The battle soon turned into a massacre; de Montfort himself was killed and his body mutilated. It was described by the contemporary historian Robert of Gloucester as the "murder of Evesham, for battle it was none". Though the battle effectively restored royal authority, scattered resistance remained until the Dictum of Kenilworth was signed in 1267.

Bitka pri Eylauu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Preussisch-Eylauu) je potekala 7. in 8. februarja (po starem koledarju 26. in 27. januarja) 1807 med Napoleonovo veliko armado in rusko cesarsko vojsko pod poveljstvom generala Levina Augusta von Bennigsena blizu mesta Preussisch Eylau v Vzhodni Prusiji; bila je krvava in strateško neodločena. Proti koncu bitke so Rusi dobili pravočasne okrepitve, prusko divizijo von L'Estocqa. Po letu 1945 so mesto preimenovali v Bagrationovsk; danes je v Kaliningrajski oblasti v Rusiji. Spopad je potekal med vojno četrte koalicije, delom napoleonskih vojn.

Napoleonove vojske so v ulmskem pohodu razbile vojsko Avstrijskega cesarstva, 2. decembra 1805 pa v bitki pri Slavkovu združeni avstrijsko in rusko vojsko. Napoleon je 14. oktobra 1806 v bitki pri Jeni in Auerstedtu strl vojske Kraljevine Prusije in razkropljene Pruse lovil pri Prenzlauu, Lübecku, Erfurtu, Pasewalku, Szczecinu (Stettin), Magdeburgu in Hamelnu.

source.title: Battle of Eylau
paragraphs: The Battle of Eylau (also known as the Battle of Preussisch-Eylau) was a bloody and strategically inconclusive battle on 7 and 8 February [O.S. 26 and 27 Jan.] 1807 between Napoleon's Grande Armée and the Imperial Russian Army under the command of General Levin August von Bennigsen near the town of Preussisch Eylau in East Prussia. Late in the battle, the Russians received timely reinforcements from a Prussian division of von L'Estocq. After 1945, the town was renamed Bagrationovsk as part of Kaliningrad Oblast, Russia. The engagement was fought during the War of the Fourth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

Napoleon's armies had smashed the army of the Austrian Empire in the Ulm Campaign and the combined Austrian and Russian armies at the Battle of Austerlitz on 2 December 1805. On 14 October 1806, Napoleon crushed the armies of the Kingdom of Prussia at the Battle of Jena–Auerstedt and hunted down the scattered Prussians at Prenzlau, Lübeck, Erfurt, Pasewalk, Stettin, Magdeburg and Hamelin.

Battle of Faesulae (406).headline: Bitka pri Faesulae leta 406
paragraphs: Bitka pri Faesulae je potekala leta 406 v okviru Radagajsove vojne med Goti in Zahodnim rimskim cesarstvom. Potem ko je general Flavij Stilihon pri Pollentii in Veroni odbil Vizigote, je naletel na nov vdor Vandalov in Gotov pod vodstvom Radagajsa, katerega sile so napadle Firence. Stilihon je napadalce nazadnje porazil pri Faesulae (današnji Fiesole) s podporo Huna Uldina in Gota Sarosa. Radagajsa so po bitki usmrtili, preživeli iz njegovih vojsk pa so pobegnili k Alariku.

source.title: Battle of Faesulae (406)
paragraphs: The Battle of Faesulae was fought in 406 as part of the War of Radagaisus between the Goths and the Western Roman Empire. After General Flavius Stilicho repelled the Visigoths at Pollentia and Verona, he encountered a new incursion of Vandals and Goths led by Radagaisus whose forces attacked Florence. Stilicho ultimately defeated the invaders at Faesulae (modern Fiesole) with support from Uldin the Hun and Sarus the Goth. Radagaisus was executed after the battle and survivors of his armies fled to Alaric.

Battle of Falkirk.headline: Bitka pri Falkirku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Falkirku (škotsko gelsko: Blàr na h-Eaglaise Brice; škotsko: Battle o Fawkirk) 22. julija 1298 je bila ena od velikih bitk prve škotske osamosvojitvene vojne. Angleška vojska pod vodstvom angleškega kralja Edvarda I. je premagala Škote, ki jih je vodil William Wallace. Kmalu po bitki je Wallace odstopil kot varuh Škotske.

source.title: Battle of Falkirk
paragraphs: The Battle of Falkirk (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr na h-Eaglaise Brice; Scots: Battle o Fawkirk), on 22 July 1298, was one of the major battles in the First War of Scottish Independence. Led by King Edward I of England, the English army defeated the Scots, led by William Wallace. Shortly after the battle Wallace resigned as Guardian of Scotland.

Battle of Famars.headline: Bitka pri Famarsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Famarsu je potekala 23. maja 1793 med flandrijskim pohodom vojne prve koalicije. Zavezniška avstrijska, hannovrska in britanska vojska pod vodstvom princa Josiasa Saško-Coburško-Saalfeldskega je premagala francosko Severno armado, ki jo je vodil François Joseph Drouot de Lamarche. Bojevali so se blizu vasi Famars na severu Francije, pet kilometrov južno od Valenciennesa.

source.title: Battle of Famars
paragraphs: The Battle of Famars was fought on 23 May 1793 during the Flanders Campaign of the War of the First Coalition. An Allied Austrian, Hanoverian, and British army under Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld defeated the French Army of the North led by François Joseph Drouot de Lamarche. The battle occurred near the village of Famars in northern France, five km south of Valenciennes.

Battle of Fehrbellin.headline: Bitka pri Fehrbellinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fehrbellinu je potekala v skanijski vojni 18. junija 1675 po julijanskem (28. junija po gregorijanskem koledarju) med švedskimi in brandenburško-pruskimi četami. Švedi pod vodstvom grofa Waldemarja von Wrangla (polbrata državnega admirala Carla Gustafa Wrangla) so iz svojih posesti na Pomorjanskem vdrli v Brandenburg in zasedli njegove dele, pri mestu Fehrbellin pa so jih odbile sile Friderika Viljema, velikega volilnega kneza, pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Georga von Derfflingerja. Skupaj z bitko pri Varšavi (1656) je bil Fehrbellin ključen za ugled Friderika Viljema in brandenburško-pruske vojske.

source.title: Battle of Fehrbellin
paragraphs: The Battle of Fehrbellin was a battle in the Scanian War. It was fought on June 18, 1675 (Julian calendar date, June 28, Gregorian), between Swedish and Brandenburg-Prussian troops. The Swedes, under Count Waldemar von Wrangel (stepbrother of Riksamiral Carl Gustaf Wrangel), had invaded and occupied parts of Brandenburg from their possessions in Pomerania, but were repelled by the forces of Frederick William, the Great Elector, under his Feldmarschall Georg von Derfflinger near the town of Fehrbellin. Along with the Battle of Warsaw (1656), Fehrbellin was crucial in establishing the prestige of Frederick William and Brandenburg-Prussia's army.

Battle of Ferrybridge.headline: Bitka pri Ferrybridgeu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ferrybridgeu 28. marca 1461 je bila predhodni spopad med hišama York in Lancaster pred večjo bitko pri Towtonu, v obdobju, ki ga danes imenujemo vojna rož.

source.title: Battle of Ferrybridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Ferrybridge, 28 March 1461, was a preliminary engagement between the houses of York and Lancaster before the larger battle of Towton, during the period now known as the Wars of the Roses.

Battle of Fleurus (1622).headline: Bitka pri Fleurusu (1622)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fleurusu je potekala 29. avgusta 1622 med tridesetletno vojno blizu Fleurusa v Belgiji, tedaj delu Španske Nizozemske. Španska vojska pod poveljstvom Córdobe je premagala večjo protestantsko plačniško vojsko pod vodstvom Ernsta von Mansfelda in Kristijana Brunšviškega.

source.title: Battle of Fleurus (1622)
paragraphs: The Battle of Fleurus, 29 August 1622, took place during the Thirty Years' War near Fleurus in Belgium, then part of the Spanish Netherlands. A Spanish army commanded by Córdoba defeated a larger Protestant mercenary force under Ernst von Mansfeld and Christian of Brunswick.

Battle of Fleurus (1690).headline: Bitka pri Fleurusu (1690)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fleurusu, ki je potekala 1. julija 1690 blizu Fleurusa, tedaj na Španski Nizozemski, danes v Belgiji, je bila pomemben spopad devetletne vojne. Francoska vojska pod vodstvom maršala Luxembourga je premagala zavezniške sile pod poveljstvom Waldecka.

Luxembourgova zmaga je imela omejen strateški učinek, saj mu je francoski kralj Ludvik XIV. ukazal, naj konča pohod na Španski Nizozemski in namesto tega okrepi prestolonaslednika (dauphina) ob Renu. Zavezniki so tako dobili čas, da so se umaknili v Bruselj in obnovili vojsko.

source.title: Battle of Fleurus (1690)
paragraphs: The Battle of Fleurus, fought on 1 July 1690 near Fleurus, then part of the Spanish Netherlands, now in modern Belgium, was a major engagement of the Nine Years' War. A French army led by Marshall Luxembourg defeated an Allied force under Waldeck.

Luxembourg's victory had limited strategic impact, since Louis XIV of France ordered him to end his campaign in the Spanish Netherlands, and instead reinforce the Dauphin on the Rhine. This gave the Allies time to withdraw to Brussels, and rebuild their army.

Battle of Fleurus (1794).headline: Bitka pri Fleurusu (1794)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fleurusu je potekala 26. junija 1794 v vojni prve koalicije: francoska revolucionarna vojska pod vodstvom Jean-Baptista Jourdana se je spopadla z avstrijsko-nizozemsko vojsko pod poveljstvom princa Josiasa Coburškega. V najpomembnejši bitki vojne prve koalicije na bojišču v Nizkih deželah je Jourdanova vojska uspela zbrati sile ter premagati Coburga in njegove čete. Zavezniški poraz je privedel do dokončne izgube Avstrijske Nizozemske in razpada Nizozemske republike. Bitka je pomenila prelomnico za francosko vojsko, ki je do konca vojne prve koalicije ostala v premoči.

source.title: Battle of Fleurus (1794)
paragraphs: The Battle of Fleurus was fought on 26 June 1794 during the War of the First Coalition between the French Revolutionary Army under Jean-Baptiste Jourdan and an Austro-Dutch army commanded by Prince Josias of Coburg. In what was the most significant battle of the Low Countries theatre of the War of the First Coalition, Jourdan's army was able to concentrate its forces and defeat Coburg and his troops. The Allied defeat led to the permanent loss of the Austrian Netherlands and to the dissolution of the Dutch Republic. The battle marked a turning point for the French army, which remained ascendant for the rest of the War of the First Coalition.

Battle of Flodden.headline: Bitka pri Floddnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Floddnu, imenovana tudi bitka na polju Flodden ali občasno bitka pri Branxtonu ali Brainston Mooru, je potekala 9. septembra 1513 med Kraljevino Anglijo in Kraljevino Škotsko v vojni Cambraijske lige in se končala z angleško zmago. Bitka je potekala blizu Branxtona v grofiji Northumberland na severu Anglije med škotsko vojsko kralja Jakoba IV., ki je vdrla v Anglijo, in angleško vojsko pod poveljstvom grofa Surreyja. Po številu vojakov je bila največja bitka med kraljestvoma.

Jakob je oblegal in zavzel več angleških obmejnih gradov, nato pa se je z vojsko utaboril na nadvladujočem položaju na griču pri Floddnu, počakal angleško vojsko, poslano nadenj, in zavrnil izziv na boj na odprtem polju. Surreyjeva vojska je zato z obhodnim pohodom prišla v hrbet škotskemu taboru. Škoti so odgovorili tako, da so tabor zapustili in zasedli sosednji grič Branxton Hill, da ga ne bi zasedli Angleži.

source.title: Battle of Flodden
paragraphs: The Battle of Flodden, Flodden Field, or occasionally Branxton or Brainston Moor was fought on 9 September 1513 between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland as part of the War of the League of Cambrai and resulted in an English victory. The battle was fought near Branxton, in the county of Northumberland, in northern England, between an invading Scots army under King James IV and an English army commanded by the Earl of Surrey. In terms of troop numbers, it was the largest battle ever fought between the two kingdoms.

After besieging and capturing several English border castles, James encamped his invading army on a commanding hilltop position at Flodden, awaited the English force that had been sent against him, and declined a challenge to fight in an open field. Surrey's army, therefore, carried out a circuitous march to position themselves in the rear of the Scottish camp. The Scots countered that by abandoning their camp and occupying the adjacent Branxton Hill and denying it to the English.

Battle of Focșani.headline: Bitka pri Focșaniju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Focșaniju (tudi bitka pri Fokschaniju ali Focsaniju; madžarsko: Foksányi csata) je potekala med rusko-turško vojno (1787–1792), 1. avgusta 1789 (po starem koledarju 21. julija), blizu Focșanija v Moldaviji (danes v Romuniji); spopadla sta se Osmansko cesarstvo in zavezništvo Ruskega cesarstva in Habsburške monarhije. Ruse je vodil Aleksander Suvorov, Avstrijce knez Josias Coburški, Osmane pa veliki vezir Koca Jusuf-paša.
Avstrijska vojska je štela 18.000 avstrijskih in madžarskih vojakov, ruski kontingent 7000 vojakov. Osmani so zbrali okoli 30.000 vojakov.
Zavezniki so naskočili utrjeni osmanski tabor in Turke pregnali iz Moldavije.

source.title: Battle of Focșani
paragraphs: The Battle of Focșani (also Battle of Fokschani or Battle of Focsani; Hungarian: Foksányi csata) took place during the Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792) on 1 August 1789 (Old Style 21 July) between the Ottoman Empire and the alliance of the Russian Empire and the Habsburg monarchy near Focșani, Moldavia (now in Romania). The Russians were led by Alexander Suvorov, the Austrians by Prince Josias of Coburg, and the Ottomans by Grand Vizier Koca Yusuf Pasha.
The Austrian army numbered 18,000 Austrian and Hungarian troops. The Russian contingent was made up of 7,000 soldiers. The Ottomans mustered ca. 30,000 soldiers.
The allies stormed the Ottoman entrenched camp and drove the Turks out of Moldavia.

Bitka pri Fontenoyju je potekala 11. maja 1745 med vojno za avstrijsko nasledstvo blizu Tournaija v Belgiji. Francoska vojska s 50.000 možmi pod poveljstvom maršala Saxa je premagala približno enako veliko pragmatično vojsko pod vodstvom vojvode Cumberlanda.

Francija je bila do leta 1745 blizu bankrota in je iskala konec vojne. Avstrijska Nizozemska je ponujala najboljšo priložnost za odločilno zmago: aprila je Saxe oblegal Tournai, strateško ključno mesto ob zgornjem toku Šelde, in glavno zavezniško vojsko prisilil, da je krenila mestu na pomoč. Saxe je pustil 22.000 mož, da so nadaljevali obleganje, glavnino pa je postavil približno 8 kilometrov stran v vaseh Antoing, Vezon in Fontenoy, ob naravno močni legi, ki jo je dodatno okrepil z obrambnimi utrdbami.

Po več neuspešnih napadih na krila je zavezniška pehotna kolona s 15.000 možmi napadla francosko središče, a so jo odbili. Zavezniki so se pod okriljem konjenice umaknili proti Bruslju in prepustili Tournai, ki je kmalu zatem padel. Boji so se kljub temu nadaljevali do novembra 1748, ko je vojno končal aachenski mir.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Fontenoy
paragraphs: The Battle of Fontenoy, 11 May 1745, took place during the War of the Austrian Succession, near Tournai, in Belgium. A French army of 50,000 under Marshal Saxe defeated a Pragmatic Army of roughly the same size, led by the Duke of Cumberland.

By 1745, France was close to bankruptcy, and seeking an end to the war. The Austrian Netherlands offered the best opportunity for a decisive victory, and in April, Saxe besieged Tournai, a key strategic town on the upper Scheldt, compelling the main Allied army to march to its relief. Leaving 22,000 men to continue the siege, Saxe placed his main force about 8 kilometres (5 mi) away in the villages of Antoing, Vezon and Fontenoy, along a naturally strong feature strengthened with defensive works.

After several unsuccessful flank assaults, an Allied infantry column of 15,000 attacked the French centre, before being repulsed. Covered by their cavalry, they retreated toward Brussels, abandoning Tournai which fell shortly afterwards. Despite this, fighting continued until November 1748, when the Treaty of Aix-la-Chapelle ended the war.

Battle of Fontenoy (841).headline: Bitka pri Fontenoyju (841)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fontenoyju (25. junija 841), imenovana tudi bitka pri Fontenoy-en-Puisayu, v starejših delih pa bitka pri Fontenayju, je bila največja bitka karolinške državljanske vojne. Bojevali so se pri Fontenoyju v pokrajini Puisaye; bitka je bila hud poraz zavezniških sil italijanskega kralja Lotarja I. in akvitanskega kralja Pipina II. ter zmaga Karla Plešastega in Ludvika Nemškega. Odločilna pa ni bila: sovražnosti so se vlekle še dve leti, do verdunske pogodbe.

source.title: Battle of Fontenoy (841)
paragraphs: The Battle of Fontenoy (25 June 841), also called the Battle of Fontenoy-en-Puisaye or Battle of Fontenay in older works, was the largest battle of the Carolingian civil war. Fought at Fontenoy in the Puisaye, the battle was a major defeat for the allied forces of Lothair I of Italy and Pepin II of Aquitaine, and a victory for Charles the Bald and Louis the German. It was not, however, decisive. Hostilities dragged on for another two years until the Treaty of Verdun.

Battle of Formentera.headline: Bitka pri Formenteri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Formenteri je potekala 28. oktobra 1529, ko je osmansko ladjevje pod Aydinom Reisom pred otokom Formentera blizu Ibize zajelo majhno špansko ladjevje osmih galej.
notes: The English text spells the island Formentara once; the Slovenian uses Formentera.

source.title: Battle of Formentera
paragraphs: The Battle of Formentara occurred on 28 October 1529 when an Ottoman fleet under Aydin Reis captured a small Spanish fleet of eight galleys off the island of Formentera near Ibiza.

Battle of Formigny.headline: Bitka pri Formignyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Formignyju je potekala 15. aprila 1450 proti koncu stoletne vojne med Anglijo in Francijo. Odločilna francoska zmaga je uničila zadnjo pomembnejšo angleško vojsko na terenu v Normandiji in odprla pot k ponovnemu zavzetju preostalih angleških utrdb.
Topove so v obleganjih uporabljali že od začetka 14. stoletja, bitka pri Formignyju pa je pomembna kot ena prvih zabeleženih uporab poljskega topništva na evropskem bojišču.

source.title: Battle of Formigny
paragraphs: The Battle of Formigny, fought on 15 April 1450, took place towards the end of the Hundred Years' War between England and France. A decisive French victory that destroyed the last significant English field army in Normandy, it paved the way for the recapture of their remaining strongholds.
Although cannon had been employed in siege warfare since the early 14th century, Formigny is notable as one of the first recorded uses of field artillery on a European battlefield.

Battle of Fornovo.headline: Bitka pri Fornovu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fornovu je potekala 6. julija 1495, 30 kilometrov jugozahodno od Parme. Zgodila se je, ko je francoski kralj Karel VIII. zapuščal Neapelj, potem ko je izvedel za veliko koalicijo, zbrano proti njemu. Kljub številčni premoči nasprotnikov so Francozi spopad dobili in Karel je lahko svojo vojsko popeljal iz Italije. Strateških posledic pa bitka ni imela, saj so Francozi vsa osvajanja na Apeninskem polotoku opustili. Fornovo je bila prva velika odprta bitka italijanskih vojn.
notes: The mile conversion (19 miles) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Fornovo
paragraphs: The Battle of Fornovo took place 30 km (19 miles) southwest of the city of Parma on 6 July 1495. It was fought as King Charles VIII of France left Naples upon hearing the news of the grand coalition assembled against him. Despite the numerical advantage of their opponents, the French won the engagement and Charles was able to march his army out of Italy. It was nonetheless devoid of any strategic result as all of their conquests in the Italian Peninsula were abandoned. Fornovo was the first major pitched battle of the Italian Wars.

Battle of Fort Ében-Émael.headline: Bitka za trdnjavo Ében-Émael
paragraphs: Bitka za trdnjavo Ében-Émael je bila spopad med belgijskimi in nemškimi silami 10. in 11. maja 1940, del bitke za Belgijo in načrta Fall Gelb, nemške invazije na Nizke dežele in Francijo. Udarna skupina nemških padalcev (Fallschirmjäger) je dobila nalogo napasti in zavzeti Ében-Émael, belgijsko trdnjavo, ki je s strateško lego in močnimi topniškimi položaji obvladovala več pomembnih mostov čez Albertov kanal. Čez mostove so vodile ceste v belgijsko notranjost, po katerih je Wehrmacht nameraval prodirati. Medtem ko so nekatere nemške zračnoprevozne enote napadle trdnjavo ter onesposobile posadko in topove v njej, so druge hkrati zavzele dva mostova čez kanal.
Ko so zračnoprevozne čete onesposobile trdnjavo, so dobile ukaz, naj mostove branijo pred belgijskimi protinapadi, dokler se jim ne pridružijo kopenske sile nemške 18. armade.

source.title: Battle of Fort Ében-Émael
paragraphs: The Battle of Fort Ében-Émael was a battle between Belgian and German forces that took place between 10 May and 11 May 1940, and was part of the Battle of Belgium and Fall Gelb, the German invasion of the Low Countries and France. An assault force of German paratroopers, Fallschirmjäger, was tasked with assaulting and capturing Fort Ében-Émael, a Belgian fortress whose strategic position and strong artillery emplacements dominated several important bridges over the Albert Canal. These carried roads which led into the Belgian heartland and were what the Wehrmacht intended to use to advance. As some of the German airborne forces assaulted the fortress and disabled the garrison and the artillery pieces inside it, others simultaneously captured two bridges over the canal.
Having disabled the fortress, the airborne troops were then ordered to protect the bridges against Belgian counter-attacks until they linked up with ground forces from the German 18th Army.

Battle of Forum Gallorum.headline: Bitka pri Forum Gallorum
paragraphs: Bitka pri Forum Gallorum je potekala 14. aprila 43 pr. n. št. med silami Marka Antonija in legijami, zvestimi rimskemu senatu, pod vrhovnim poveljstvom konzula Gaja Panse ob pomoči njegovega kolega konzula Avla Hirtija. Senatov tabor je varoval nepreizkušeni Cezar Oktavijan (bodoči cesar Avgust). Bitka je potekala na Emilijski cesti (Via Aemilia) blizu vasi v severni Italiji, morda blizu današnjega Castelfranca Emilia.

source.title: Battle of Forum Gallorum
paragraphs: The Battle of Forum Gallorum was fought on 14 April 43 BC between the forces of Mark Antony and legions loyal to the Roman Senate under the overall command of consul Gaius Pansa, aided by his fellow consul Aulus Hirtius. The untested Caesar Octavian (the future emperor Augustus) guarded the Senate's camp. The battle occurred on the Via Aemilia near a village in northern Italy, perhaps near modern-day Castelfranco Emilia.

Bitka za Frago je bila bitka španske rekonkviste, ki je potekala 17. julija 1134 pri Fragi v Aragoniji v Španiji. V njej so se združene sile kralja Alfonza Bojevnika in vikonta Centula VI. iz Béarna spopadle z različnimi almoravidskimi silami, ki so prišle na pomoč mestu Fraga, ki ga je Alfonz oblegal. Bitka se je končala z zmago Almoravidov. Aragonski kralj Alfonz je kmalu po bitki umrl.

source.title: Battle of Fraga
paragraphs: The Battle of Fraga was a battle of the Spanish Reconquista that took place on 17 July 1134 at Fraga, Aragon, Spain. The battle was fought between the combined forces of King Alfonso the Battler and Viscount Centule VI of Béarn, and a variety of Almoravid forces that had come to the aid of the town of Fraga which was being besieged by Alfonso. The battle resulted in an Almoravid victory. The Aragonese monarch Alfonso died shortly after the battle.

Battle of Frankenhausen.headline: Bitka pri Frankenhausnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Frankenhausnu je potekala 14. in 15. maja 1525. Bila je pomembna bitka nemške kmečke vojne in zadnje dejanje vojne v Turingiji: združene čete hessenskega deželnega grofa Filipa I. in saškega vojvode Jurija so pri Frankenhausnu v grofiji Schwarzburg premagale kmete pod vodstvom njihovega duhovnega voditelja Thomasa Müntzerja.

source.title: Battle of Frankenhausen
paragraphs: The Battle of Frankenhausen was fought on 14 and 15 May 1525. It was an important battle in the German Peasants' War and the final act of the war in Thuringia: joint troops of Landgrave Philip I of Hesse and Duke George of Saxony defeated the peasants under their spiritual leader Thomas Müntzer near Frankenhausen in the County of Schwarzburg.

Battle of Fraustadt.headline: Bitka pri Fraustadtu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fraustadtu je potekala 2. februarja 1706 (po starem koledarju) oziroma 3. februarja 1706 (po švedskem koledarju) oziroma 13. februarja 1706 (po novem koledarju) blizu Fraustadta, danes Wschowa na Poljskem, med veliko severno vojno.
