Švedska vojska pod vodstvom Carla Gustafa Rehnskiölda je premagala večje saško-ruske sile pod poveljstvom Johanna Matthiasa von der Schulenburga, ki so jih sestavljale čete iz Saške, Republike obeh narodov, nemški plačanci in vojaki Ruskega carstva.

Čeprav je bil v več kot dvakratni manjšini, je Rehnskiöld napadel Schulenburgov utrjeni položaj. Švedska konjenica je na obeh krilih razbila saško konjenico, nato pa se obrnila navznoter proti zaledju sovražne pehote in sovražnika tako dvojno obkolila. Bitka se je končala z odločilno švedsko zmago: ruski kontingent je bil skoraj uničen, več tisoč saških in nemških vojakov pa je bilo ujetih. Fraustadt je postal ena najslavnejših švedskih zmag v vojni in ga pogosto navajajo kot klasičen primer uspešnega klešastega manevra.

source.title: Battle of Fraustadt
paragraphs: The Battle of Fraustadt was fought on 2 February 1706 (O.S.) / 3 February 1706 (Swedish calendar) / 13 February 1706 (N.S.) near Fraustadt, now Wschowa, Poland, during the Great Northern War. A Swedish army under Carl Gustaf Rehnskiöld defeated a larger Saxon–Russian force commanded by Johann Matthias von der Schulenburg, consisting of troops from Saxony, the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, German mercenaries, and the Tsardom of Russia.

Although outnumbered by more than two to one, Rehnskiöld attacked Schulenburg's entrenched position. Swedish cavalry routed the Saxon horse on both flanks and then turned inward against the rear of the enemy infantry, completing a double envelopment. The result was a decisive Swedish victory: the Russian contingent was almost destroyed, while thousands of Saxon and German troops were taken prisoner. Fraustadt became one of Sweden's most notable victories of the war and is often cited as a classic example of a successful pincer movement.

Battle of Freiberg.headline: Bitka pri Freibergu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Freibergu je potekala 29. oktobra 1762 in je bila zadnja velika bitka tretje šlezijske vojne (in širše sedemletne vojne).

source.title: Battle of Freiberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Freiberg was fought on 29 October 1762 and was the last great battle of the Third Silesian War (and of the wider Seven Years' War).

Battle of Freiburg.headline: Bitka pri Freiburgu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Freiburgu je potekala v treh dneh, 3., 5. in 9. avgusta 1644, med tridesetletno vojno blizu Freiburga v Breisgauu, danes v Baden-Württembergu. Francoska vojska za pomoč s 16.000 možmi, ki sta jo skupaj vodila Condé in Turenne, je skušala znova zavzeti mesto, ki se je nedavno predalo bavarski vojski pod vodstvom Franza von Mercyja. V eni najkrvavejših bitk vojne sta obe strani utrpeli hude izgube, nobena pa ni dosegla jasne prednosti.

Potem ko je Mercy 28. julija zavzel Freiburg, je svoje može postavil na močne obrambne položaje na gričih pred mestom. Francozi so te položaje napadli 3. in 5. avgusta, in čeprav niso veliko napredovali, je Bavarcem primanjkovalo zalog. Mercy je 9. avgusta izvedel, da mu odred pod Turennovim vodstvom koraka v zaledje, da bi presekal oskrbovalne poti, in ukazal splošen umik, v Freiburgu pa pustil posadko. Razen kratkega spopada s Turennovo konjenico naslednji dan so se umaknili v dobrem redu, čeprav so pustili tovorno kolono in več topov.

source.title: Battle of Freiburg
paragraphs: The Battle of Freiburg, fought over three days on 3, 5, and 9 August 1644, took place during the Thirty Years' War, near Freiburg im Breisgau, now in Baden-Württemberg. A French relief army of 16,000, led jointly by Condé and Turenne, sought to recapture the town, which had recently surrendered to a Bavarian force under Franz von Mercy. In one of the bloodiest battles of the war, both sides incurred heavy casualties, with neither gaining a clear advantage.

Having captured Freiburg on 28 July, Mercy placed his men in strong defences on the hills outside the town. The French assaulted these positions on 3 and 5 August, and although they made little progress, the Bavarians were short of supplies. On 9 August, Mercy learned a detachment under Turenne was marching into his rear to cut off his supply lines, and ordered a general retreat, leaving a garrison in Freiburg. Apart from a brief skirmish with Turenne's cavalry next day, they withdrew in good order, despite abandoning their baggage train and several guns.

Bitka pri Friedlandu (14. junija 1807) je bila velik spopad napoleonskih vojn med vojskama Francoskega cesarstva in Ruskega cesarstva, ki sta ju vodila Napoleon I. in general Levin August von Bennigsen. Napoleon in Francozi so dosegli odločilno zmago in pognali v beg velik del ruske vojske, ki se je do konca bojev v neredu umaknila čez reko Alle. Bojišče leži v današnji Kaliningrajski oblasti blizu mesta Pravdinsk v Rusiji.

source.title: Battle of Friedland
paragraphs: The Battle of Friedland (14 June 1807) was a major engagement of the Napoleonic Wars between the armies of the French Empire and the Russian Empire, led by Napoleon I and General Levin August von Bennigsen respectively. Napoleon and the French obtained a decisive victory that routed much of the Russian army, which retreated chaotically over the Alle river by the end of the fighting. The battlefield is located in modern-day Kaliningrad Oblast, near the town of Pravdinsk, Russia.

Battle of Friedlingen.headline: Bitka pri Friedlingnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Friedlingnu je potekala 14. oktobra 1702 med vojno za špansko nasledstvo. Večina bojev je potekala okoli Friedlingna, danes predmestja Weila ob Renu na sedanji meji med Baden-Württembergom v Nemčiji in Švico. Francoske sile pod vodstvom Villarsa so premagale cesarsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Ludvika Viljema, mejnega grofa Baden-Badna.

Zavzetje Landaua septembra je Ludviku Viljemu omogočilo, da je ogrozil francosko obmejno pokrajino Alzacijo. Malo prej se je francoskemu zavezništvu pridružil bavarski volilni knez Maksimilijan II. Emanuel, Villars pa je dobil ukaz, naj prečka Ren pri Huningueu blizu švicarske meje in se mu pridruži. Ludvik Viljem je sprva lahko zaprl pot, a so ga obšli, ko so francoske čete prečkale Ren bolj severno, in zgodaj zjutraj 14. oktobra se je začel umikati.

source.title: Battle of Friedlingen
paragraphs: The Battle of Friedlingen took place on 14 October 1702, during the War of the Spanish Succession. Most of the fighting centred around Friedlingen, now a suburb of Weil am Rhein, on the current border between Baden-Württemberg in Germany, and Switzerland. A French force under Villars defeated an Imperial army commanded by Louis William, Margrave of Baden-Baden.

The capture of Landau in September allowed Louis William to threaten the French border region of Alsace. Shortly before, Maximilian II Emanuel, Elector of Bavaria joined the French alliance, and Villars was ordered to cross the Rhine at Huningue near the Swiss border, then link up with him. Although Louis William was initially able to block the advance, he was outflanked when French troops crossed the Rhine further north, and began retreating early on the morning of 14 October.

Battle of Fulford.headline: Bitka pri Fulfordu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fulfordu je potekala 20. septembra 1066 na obrobju vasi Fulford tik južno od Yorka v Angliji. Norveški kralj Harald III., znan tudi kot Harald Hardrada, pretendent za angleški prestol, in njegov angleški zaveznik Tostig Godwinson sta premagala severna grofa Edwina in Morcarja.

Hardradovo vojsko so sestavljali zavezniki z Orkneyja in oddelek, ki je prišel s Tostigom, ter možje z Norveške. Morje so prečkali z ladjevjem in si oporišče uredili južno od Yorka pri Riccallu. Vikingi so 20. septembra 1066 krenili proti Yorku. Pretežno neizkušena saška vojska, ki sta jo vodila Morcar iz Yorka in Edwin iz Tadcastra, jim je skušala zapreti pot. Po Anglosaški kroniki sta se nasprotni vojski srečali na vzhodnem bregu reke Ouse in Sasi so vikinški vojski sprva prizadejali hude izgube. Nordijska vojska je saško nazadnje strla, a sta grofa poraz preživela. Zmagoviti Norvežani so nato vkorakali v York, zbrali zaloge in zahtevali talce.

source.title: Battle of Fulford
paragraphs: The Battle of Fulford was fought on the outskirts of the village of Fulford, just south of York in England, on 20 September 1066. King Harald III of Norway, also known as Harald Hardrada, a claimant to the English throne, and Tostig Godwinson, his English ally, fought and defeated the Northern Earls Edwin and Morcar.

Hardrada's army consisted of allies from Orkney and a contingent with Tostig, as well as those coming from Norway. They crossed the sea in a fleet of ships and made their base south of York at Riccall. On 20 September 1066 the Vikings advanced towards York. The largely inexperienced Saxon army led by Morcar at York and Edwin at Tadcaster moved to block the invaders. The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle says that the opposing armies met on the east bank of the River Ouse and that initially the Saxons caused heavy losses on the Viking army. Ultimately, the Norse army overwhelmed the Saxon army although the earls themselves survived this defeat. After winning, the victorious Norwegians entered York, gathered supplies, and asked for hostages.

Battle of Gadebusch.headline: Bitka pri Gadebuschu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gadebuschu ali Wakenstädtu (20. decembra 1712) je bila zadnja velika švedska zmaga v veliki severni vojni. Švedi so se bojevali, da ne bi izgubili mesta Stralsund v korist danskih in saških sil.

source.title: Battle of Gadebusch
paragraphs: The Battle of Gadebusch or Wakenstädt (20 December 1712) was Sweden's final great victory in the Great Northern War. It was fought by the Swedes to prevent the loss of the city of Stralsund to Danish and Saxon forces.

Bitka v Galiciji, znana tudi kot velika bitka v Galiciji, je bila velika bitka med Rusijo in Avstro-Ogrsko v začetni fazi prve svetovne vojne leta 1914. Avstro-ogrske armade so bile v več spopadih hudo poražene in pregnane iz Galicije, Rusi pa so zavzeli Lemberg (danes Lvov) in približno devet mesecev vladali vzhodni Galiciji, dokler niso bili poraženi pri Gorlicah in Tarnówu. Bitka v Galiciji je razkrila slabosti tedanje avstro-ogrske vojske, hkrati pa je bila ena velikih zmag ruske cesarske vojske v tej vojni.

source.title: Battle of Galicia
paragraphs: The Battle of Galicia, also known as the Great Battle of Galicia, was a major battle between Russia and Austria-Hungary during the early stages of World War I in 1914. In the course of the battle, the Austro-Hungarian armies were severely defeated in several encounters and forced out of Galicia, while the Russians captured Lemberg (now Lviv) and, for approximately nine months, ruled Eastern Galicia until their defeat at Gorlice and Tarnów. The Battle of Galicia showed weaknesses of the Austro-Hungarian Army during that period and at the same time was one of the formidable victories of the Imperial Russian Army in the war.

Battle of Garigliano (1503).headline: Bitka ob Garigliano
paragraphs: Bitka ob Garigliano je potekala 29. decembra 1503 med špansko vojsko pod Gonzalom Fernándezom de Córdobo in francosko vojsko pod poveljstvom Ludovica II., markiza Saluzza, in se je končala z odločilno špansko zmago.

source.title: Battle of Garigliano (1503)
paragraphs: The Battle of Garigliano was fought on 29 December 1503 between a Spanish army under Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba and a French army commanded by Ludovico II, Marquis of Saluzzo, resulting in a decisive Spanish victory.

Battle of Gela (405 BC).headline: Bitka pri Geli
paragraphs: Bitka pri Geli je potekala poleti 405 pr. n. št. na Siciliji. Kartažanska vojska pod Himilkonom (članom rodbine Magonidov in sorodnikom Hanibala Maga), ki je zimo in pomlad preživela v zavzetem Akragasu, je odkorakala proti Geli, da bi se soočila z Grki. Sirakuška vlada je Dafnaja, neuspešnega poveljnika grške vojske pri Akragasu, odstavila in na njegovo mesto postavila Dionizija, drugega častnika, ki je bil privrženec Hermokrata. Dionizij je spletkaril in si pridobil polna diktatorska pooblastila.

Ko so Kartažani oblegali Gelo, se je Dionizij odzval in svoje sile popeljal iz Sirakuz, da bi se soočil z grožnjo. Zasnoval je zapleteno strategijo tristranskega napada na Kartažane, a se je načrt izjalovil zaradi pomanjkljivega usklajevanja. Ker je grozil poraz in je v Sirakuzah naraščalo nezadovoljstvo, se je Dionizij odločil Gelo izprazniti in tako ohraniti oblast. Ko so Grki pobegnili v Kamarino, je kartažanski general Himilkon izropal zapuščeno mesto.

source.title: Battle of Gela (405 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Gela took place in the summer of 405 BC in Sicily. The Carthaginian army under Himilco (a member of the Magonid family and kinsman of Hannibal Mago), which had spent the winter and spring in the captured city of Akragas, marched to confront the Greeks at Gela. The Syracuse government had deposed Daphnaeus, the unsuccessful general of the Greek army at Akragas, with Dionysius, another officer who had been a follower of Hermocrates. Dionysius schemed and gained full dictatorial powers.

When the Carthaginians laid siege to Gela, Dionysius responded by leading his forces from Syracuse to confront the threat. He devised a complex three-pronged attack strategy against the Carthaginians, but the plan failed due to a lack of proper coordination. Faced with the defeat and growing discontent in Syracuse, Dionysius made the decision to evacuate Gela to preserve his own power. After the Greeks had fled to Camarina Himilco, the Carthaginian general, sacked the abandoned city.

Battle of Gembloux (1940).headline: Bitka pri Gemblouxu (1940)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gemblouxu (ali bitka v vrzeli pri Gemblouxu) je potekala maja 1940 med francoskimi in nemškimi silami v drugi svetovni vojni. Wehrmacht je 10. maja 1940 po operativnem načrtu Fall Gelb (primer Rumeno) vdrl v Luksemburg, na Nizozemsko in v Belgijo. Zavezniške vojske so se odzvale z načrtom Dyle (različica Breda), ki naj bi Nemce ustavil v Belgiji, saj so zavezniki menili, da je tam glavni nemški udar. Zavezniki so 10. maja v prodor v Belgijo poslali svoje najboljše in najbolj gibljive enote, Nemci pa so 12. maja začeli drugi del načrta Fall Gelb, Mansteinov načrt, prodor skozi Ardene, da bi dosegli Rokavski preliv in odrezali zavezniške sile v Belgiji.

source.title: Battle of Gembloux (1940)
paragraphs: The Battle of Gembloux (or Battle of the Gembloux Gap) was fought between French and German forces in May 1940 during the Second World War. On 10 May 1940, The Wehrmacht, invaded Luxembourg, The Netherlands and Belgium under the operational plan Fall Gelb (Case Yellow). Allied armies responded with the Dyle Plan (Breda variant), intended to halt the Germans in Belgium, believing it to be the main German thrust. The Allies committed their best and most mobile to an advance into Belgium on 10 May and on 12 May, the Germans began the second part of Fall Gelb, the Manstein Plan an advance through the Ardennes, to reach the English Channel and cut off the Allied forces in Belgium.

Bitka pri Gergoviji je potekala leta 52 pr. n. št. v Galiji pri Gergoviji, glavnem opidu (utrjenem mestu) Arvernov. V njej sta se spopadli vojska rimske republike pod vodstvom prokonzula Julija Cezarja in galske sile pod vodstvom Vercingetoriksa, ki je bil tudi arvernski poglavar. Rimljani so skušali Gergovijo oblegati, a so jim načrt pokvarili nesporazumi. Galska konjenica je zmedene Rimljane napadla, jih pognala v beg in dobila bitko.

Kraj enačijo z vasjo Merdogne, pozneje preimenovano v Gergovie, ki leži na griču v občini La Roche-Blanche blizu Clermont-Ferranda v južni osrednji Franciji. Ohranili so se nekateri zidovi in zemeljski okopi iz predrimske železne dobe. Bitka je v Franciji znana kot primer galske zmage.

source.title: Battle of Gergovia
paragraphs: The Battle of Gergovia took place in 52 BC in Gaul at Gergovia, the chief oppidum (fortified town) of the Arverni. The battle was fought between a Roman Republican army, led by proconsul Julius Caesar, and Gallic forces led by Vercingetorix, who was also the Arverni chieftain. The Romans attempted to besiege Gergovia, but miscommunication ruined the Roman plan. The Gallic cavalry counterattacked the confused Romans and sent them to flight, winning the battle.

The site is identified with Merdogne, since renamed Gergovie, a village located on a hill within the town of La Roche-Blanche, near Clermont-Ferrand, in south central France. Some walls and earthworks still survive from the pre-Roman Iron Age. The battle is well known in France as an example of a Gallic victory.

Battle of Geronium.headline: Bitka pri Geroniumu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Geroniumu (zapisana tudi Gerunium) je bila pomemben spopad med silami Kartagine in Rimske republike poleti in jeseni 217 pr. n. št. v širšem okviru druge punske vojne. Spopad se je končal s taktično zmago kartažanskega poveljnika Hanibala Barke, ki je utrdila njegov položaj v južni Italiji in dodatno spodkopala rimski moral.

Po uspešnem manevriranju v bitki na Falernskem polju je Hanibal vojsko popeljal proti severu, nato pa zavil proti vzhodu, proti Moliseju, in prečkal razgiban svet Samnija. Ves ta čas so ga zasledovale rimske sile pod poveljstvom Kvinta Fabija Maksima Verukoza, ki je še naprej izvajal svojo strategijo izčrpavanja, pozneje znano kot fabijska strategija, in se namenoma izogibal odprti bitki s Hanibalovimi taktično boljšimi silami.

source.title: Battle of Geronium
paragraphs: The Battle of Geronium (also spelled Gerunium) was a significant engagement fought between the forces of Carthage and the Roman Republic during the summer and autumn of 217 BC, amid the broader context of the Second Punic War. The confrontation resulted in a tactical victory for the Carthaginian general Hannibal Barca, consolidating his position in southern Italy and further undermining Roman morale.

Following his successful maneuvering in the Battle of Ager Falernus, Hannibal led his army northward before turning east toward Molise, passing through the rugged terrain of Samnium. Throughout this movement, he was shadowed by Roman forces under the command of Quintus Fabius Maximus Verrucosus, who continued to implement his strategy of attrition—later known as the Fabian strategy—deliberately avoiding pitched battle with Hannibal's superior tactical forces.

Battle of Giglio.headline: Bitka pri Gigliu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Gigliu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Montecristu, je potekala 3. maja 1241 med združenim cesarskim, sicilskim in pisanskim ladjevjem ter genovsko eskadro, ki je vozila visoke cerkvene odposlance na koncil, ki ga je v Rimu sklical papež Gregor IX. Spopad je potekal v Tirenskem morju med Montecristom in Giglijem in se je končal z odločilno zmago sil cesarja Friderika II.

source.title: Battle of Giglio
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Giglio, also known as the Battle of Montecristo, was fought on 3 May 1241 between a combined Imperial, Sicilian and Pisan fleet and a Genoese squadron carrying high-ranking ecclesiastical delegates to a council summoned at Rome by Pope Gregory IX. The engagement took place in the Tyrrhenian Sea between Montecristo and Giglio and ended in a decisive victory for the forces of Emperor Frederick II.

Battle of Glen Shiel.headline: Bitka pri Glen Shielu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Glen Shielu 10. junija 1719 je bila odločilni vojaški spopad jakobitskega upora leta 1719. Britanske vladne enote so blizu Glen Shiela v Škotskem višavju premagale jakobitsko vojsko, sestavljeno iz višavskih vpoklicancev in španskih marincev.

Upor je podpirala Španija, ki je bila tedaj z Britanijo v vojni četverne zveze (1718–1720). Prvotno naj bi bil le odvračalni manever za izkrcanje na jugozahodu Anglije, ki so ga nekaj tednov prej odpovedali, njegov neuspeh pa je po splošnem mnenju usodno škodoval jakobitski stvari.
Bojišče je danes vpisano v Popis zgodovinskih bojišč na Škotskem in ga varuje ustanova Historic Scotland.

source.title: Battle of Glen Shiel
paragraphs: The Battle of Glen Shiel, 10 June 1719, was the decisive military engagement of the Jacobite rising of 1719. Fought near Glen Shiel in the Scottish Highlands, a Jacobite army composed of Highland levies and Spanish marines was defeated by British government troops.

The rebellion was backed by Spain, then engaged in the 1718–1720 War of the Quadruple Alliance with Britain. Originally intended only as a diversion for a landing in south-west England which was cancelled several weeks earlier, its failure was seen as having fatally damaged the Jacobite cause.
The battlefield is now included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland, and protected by Historic Scotland.

Battle of Goito.headline: Bitka pri Goitu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Goitu je potekala med piemontsko in avstrijsko vojsko 30. maja 1848 v prvi italijanski vojni za neodvisnost. Piemontska vojska je bitko dobila, ker se Avstrijci niso mogli prebiti do Peschiere, da bi prekinili obleganje in preprečili njeno vdajo, do katere je prišlo že dan pred bitko.

source.title: Battle of Goito
paragraphs: The Battle of Goito was fought between the Piedmontese and the Austrian army on 30 May 1848, in the course of the First Italian War of Independence. The Piedmontese army won the battle, as the Austrians were unable to break through to relieve the siege of Peschiera and prevent its surrender which happened on the day before the battle.

Battle of Göllheim.headline: Bitka pri Göllheimu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Göllheimu je potekala 2. julija 1298 med silami habsburškega vojvode Albrehta I. in kralja Adolfa Nassauskega, potem ko so se volilni knezi brez formalnih volitev enostransko odločili, da Adolfa odstavijo in za kralja razglasijo Albrehta. Adolf je v bitki padel.

source.title: Battle of Göllheim
paragraphs: The Battle of Göllheim was fought on 2 July 1298 between the forces of duke Albert I of Habsburg (German: Albrecht) and king Adolf of Nassau following the unilateral decision of the prince electors, without any formal election, to dethrone Adolf and proclaim Albert as king. Adolf died in the battle.

Battle of Golymin.headline: Bitka pri Gołyminu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gołyminu (ali Golyminu) je potekala 26. decembra 1806 med vojno četrte koalicije pri Gołyminu na Poljskem med približno 22.000 ruskimi vojaki z 28 topovi pod vodstvom kneza Golicina in 38.000 francoskimi vojaki pod vodstvom maršala Murata. Ruske sile so se uspešno odlepile od močnejših francoskih sil. Bitka je potekala istega dne kot bitka za Pułtusk.

source.title: Battle of Golymin
paragraphs: The Battle of Golymin (or Gołymin) took place on 26 December 1806 during the War of the Fourth Coalition at Gołymin, Poland, between around 22,000 Russian soldiers with 28 guns under Prince Golitsyn and 38,000 French soldiers under Marshal Murat. The Russian forces disengaged successfully from the superior French forces. The battle took place on the same day as the Battle of Pułtusk.

Battle of Gorizia (1916).headline: Šesta soška bitka
paragraphs: Šesta soška bitka, bolj znana kot bitka za Gorico, je bila najuspešnejša italijanska ofenziva ob reki Soči (Isonzo) med prvo svetovno vojno.
notes: Headline after the Slovenian name of the Sixth Battle of the Isonzo, in line with the glossary's Prva and Druga soška bitka; Gorizia is Gorica.

source.title: Battle of Gorizia (1916)
paragraphs: The Sixth Battle of the Isonzo, better known as the Battle of Gorizia, was the most successful Italian offensive along the Soča (Isonzo) River during World War I.

Battle of Gorjani.headline: Bitka pri Gorjanih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gorjanih (hrvaško: Bitka kod Gorjana; nemško: Schlacht bei Gorjani) ali bitka pri Đakovu (madžarsko: Diakovári csata) je potekala 9. oktobra 1537 pri Gorjanih, kraju v Slavoniji (danes na vzhodu Hrvaške) med mestoma Đakovo in Valpovo, v okviru male vojne na Ogrskem in stoletne hrvaško-turške vojne.

source.title: Battle of Gorjani
paragraphs: The Battle of Gorjani (Croatian: Bitka kod Gorjana, German: Schlacht bei Gorjani) or Battle of Đakovo (Hungarian: Diakovári csata) was fought on 9 October 1537 at Gorjani, a place in Slavonia (today in eastern Croatia), between the towns of Đakovo and Valpovo, as part of the Little War in Hungary as well as the Hundred Years' Croatian–Ottoman War.

Battle of Gorni Dubnik.headline: Bitka pri Gornjem Dubniku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gornjem Dubniku je potekala med rusko-turško vojno 24. oktobra 1877. Ruske sile so želele hitreje zavzeti trdnjavo Plevna, zato so začele napadati garnizije ob osmanski oskrbovalni in komunikacijski poti. Pomembno garnizijo so zavzeli že septembra v bitki pri Loveču. General Josif Vladimirovič Gurko je bil poklican z območja prelaza Šipka, da bi obračunal še z drugimi garnizijami, ki so varovale Plevno.

Gurko je 24. oktobra napadel trdnjavo Gorni Dubnik. Ruski napad je naletel na hud odpor, drugi dve ruski koloni pa sta osmanske črte zlahka potisnili nazaj. V bitki je sodeloval bataljon ostrostrelcev finske garde, ki je naskočil obzidje trdnjave. Gurko je nadaljeval napade in poveljnik garnizije Ahmed Hifzi-paša se je predal. Še isti mesec je padlo več drugih osmanskih garnizij, med njimi Orhanie. Do 24. oktobra je ruska vojska obkolila Plevno, ki je kapitulirala 10. decembra.
notes: Gorni Dubnik is given in the Slovenian form of the adjective in the headline and first mention. The English dates both the battle and the encirclement of Plevna to 24 October, after saying more garrisons fell within the month; kept as in the source.

source.title: Battle of Gorni Dubnik
paragraphs: The Battle of Gorni Dubnik took place during the Russo-Turkish War on 24 October 1877. In an effort to reduce the fortress of Pleven quicker, Russian forces began targeting garrisons along the Ottoman supply and communications route. A significant garrison had been reduced at the Battle of Lovcha in September. General Joseph Vladimirovich Gourko was called up from the Shipka Pass area to deal with more of the garrisons protecting Pleven.

On October 24 Gourko attacked the fortress of Gorni-Dubnik. The Russian attack met heavy resistance but two other Russian columns were able to easily push back the Ottoman lines. The Finnish Guard sharpshooter battalion participated on the battle and stormed the fortress walls. Gourko continued the attacks and the garrison commander Ahmed Hifzi Pasha surrendered. Within the month several more Ottoman garrisons were to fall including Orhanie. By October 24 the Russian army had surrounded Plevna which capitulated December 10.

Battle of Grandson.headline: Bitka pri Grandsonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Grandsonu je potekala 2. marca 1476 med burgundskimi vojnami in se končala s hudim porazom burgundskega vojvode Karla Drznega proti stari švicarski konfederaciji.

source.title: Battle of Grandson
paragraphs: The Battle of Grandson was fought on 2 March 1476, during the Burgundian Wars, and resulted in a major defeat for Charles the Bold, Duke of Burgundy, at the hands of the Old Swiss Confederacy.

Battle of Graus.headline: Bitka pri Grausu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Grausu je bila bitka rekonkviste, ki naj bi po izročilu potekala 8. maja 1063. V bitki ali zaradi nje je umrl aragonski kralj Ramiro I.
Antonio Ubieto Arteta je bitko v svojem delu Historia de Aragón datiral v leto 1069. Chronica naierensis iz poznega 12. stoletja spopad datira v leto 1070.

source.title: Battle of Graus
paragraphs: The Battle of Graus was a battle of the Reconquista, traditionally said to have taken place on 8 May 1063. Either in or as a result of the battle, King Ramiro I of Aragon died.
Antonio Ubieto Arteta, in his Historia de Aragón, re-dated the battle to 1069. The late twelfth-century Chronica naierensis dates the encounter to 1070.

Battle of Gravelotte.headline: Bitka pri Gravelottu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gravelottu (ali bitka pri Gravelotte-Saint-Privatu) 18. avgusta 1870 je bila največja bitka francosko-pruske vojne. Imenovana je po Gravelottu, vasi v Loreni, bojevali pa so se približno 9,7 km zahodno od Metza: Prusi so dan prej v bitki pri Mars-la-Touru francoski vojski prestregli umik proti zahodu in so se zdaj bližali, da bi francoske sile dokončno uničili.

Združene nemške sile pod poveljstvom kralja Viljema I. sta sestavljali pruska 1. in 2. armada Severnonemške zveze z 210 pehotnimi bataljoni, 133 konjeniškimi eskadroni in 732 težkimi topovi, skupaj 188.332 častnikov in vojakov. Francoska renska armada pod poveljstvom maršala Françoisa Achilla Bazaina se je vkopala na vzpetinah, z južnim levim krilom pri mestu Rozerieulles in severnim desnim krilom pri Saint-Privatu.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Gravelotte
paragraphs: The Battle of Gravelotte (or Battle of Gravelotte–St. Privat) on 18 August 1870 was the largest battle of the Franco-Prussian War. Named after Gravelotte, a village in Lorraine, it was fought about 6 miles (9.7 km) west of Metz, where on the previous day, having intercepted the French army's retreat to the west at the Battle of Mars-la-Tour, the Prussians were now closing in to complete the destruction of the French forces.

The combined German forces under King Wilhelm I were the Prussian First and Second Armies of the North German Confederation with 210 infantry battalions, 133 cavalry squadrons, and 732 heavy cannons totaling 188,332 officers and men. The French Army of the Rhine, commanded by Marshal François Achille Bazaine, dug in along high ground with their southern left flank at the town of Rozerieulles, and their northern right flank at St. Privat.

Battle of Gravia Inn.headline: Bitka pri gostišču v Graviji
paragraphs: Bitka pri gostišču v Graviji (grško: Μάχη στο Χάνι της Γραβιάς) je potekala med grškimi revolucionarji in Osmanskim cesarstvom v grški osamosvojitveni vojni. Grški voditelji Odisej Andrucos, Janis Guras in Angelis Govios so s skupino okoli 120 mož odbili osmansko vojsko z 8000 do 9000 možmi in topništvom pod poveljstvom Omerja Vrionija in Köseja Mehmeda. Bitka se je za Osmane končala s hudimi izgubami, Grki pa so imeli le malo žrtev.

source.title: Battle of Gravia Inn
paragraphs: The Battle of Gravia Inn (Greek: Μάχη στο Χάνι της Γραβιάς) was fought between Greek revolutionaries and the Ottoman Empire during the Greek War of Independence. The Greek leaders Odysseas Androutsos, Yannis Gouras and Angelis Govios, with a group of c. 120 men, repulsed an Ottoman army numbering 8,000 to 9,000 men and artillery under the command of Omer Vrioni and Köse Mehmed. The battle ended with heavy losses for the Ottomans and minimal casualties on the Greek side.

Bitka pri Groixu je potekala 23. junija 1795 pred otokom Groix v Biskajskem zalivu med vojno prve koalicije. V njej so se spopadli deli britanske Rokavske flote in francoske Atlantske flote, ki sta v tem območju pluli z ločenima nalogama. Britanska flota pod poveljstvom admirala lorda Bridporta je varovala invazijski konvoj s francosko rojalistično vojsko, ki naj bi vdrla na Quiberon, francoska flota pod poveljstvom viceadmirala Villareta de Joyeusa pa je teden prej izplula, da bi neki konvoj rešila pred napadom britanske eskadre. Francoska flota je britansko eskadro pregnala v bitki 17. junija, znani kot Cornwallisov umik, in se skušala vrniti v oporišče v Brestu, ko se je 22. junija pojavila Bridportova flota s 14 linijskimi ladjami.
notes: The French pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Groix
paragraphs: The Battle of Groix ([ɡʁwa]) took place on 23 June 1795 off the island of Groix in the Bay of Biscay during the War of the First Coalition. It was fought between elements of the British Channel Fleet and the French Atlantic Fleet, which were cruising in the region on separate missions. The British fleet, commanded by Admiral Lord Bridport, was covering an invasion convoy carrying a French Royalist army tasked with invading Quiberon, while the French fleet under Vice-admiral Villaret de Joyeuse had sailed a week earlier to rescue a convoy from being attacked by a British squadron. The French fleet had driven off the British squadron in a battle on 17 June known as Cornwallis's Retreat, and were attempting to return to their base at Brest when Bridport's force of 14 ships of the line appeared on 22 June.

Battle of Gross-Jägersdorf.headline: Bitka pri Gross-Jägersdorfu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gross-Jägersdorfu (30. avgusta 1757) je bila zmaga ruske vojske pod vodstvom feldmaršala Stepana Fjodoroviča Apraksina nad manjšo prusko vojsko pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Hansa von Lehwaldta v sedemletni vojni. To je bila prva bitka, v kateri je Rusija sodelovala v sedemletni vojni.

Kljub taktičnemu uspehu je zaradi težav z oskrbo nadaljnje uspešno prodiranje v Vzhodno Prusijo postalo neizvedljivo. Apraksin se je odločil, da Königsberga ne bo zavzel, in kmalu po bitki ukazal umik. Ruska cesarica Elizabeta je posumila, da se je Apraksin dogovarjal s kanclerjem Aleksejem Bestužev-Rjuminom, ki je invaziji nasprotoval, zato je Apraksina odstavila, Bestužev-Rjumina postavila pred sodišče zaradi izdaje, za poveljnika vojske pa imenovala Williama Fermorja. Fermor je vojsko naslednje leto spet popeljal v Vzhodno Prusijo.

source.title: Battle of Gross-Jägersdorf
paragraphs: The Battle of Gross Jägersdorf (Gross-Jägersdorf; 30 August 1757) was a victory for the Russian force under Field Marshal Stepan Fyodorovich Apraksin over a smaller Prussian force commanded by Field Marshal Hans von Lehwaldt, during the Seven Years' War. This was the first battle in which Russia engaged during the Seven Years' War.

Despite the tactical success, supply problems made a successful advance further into East Prussia impractical. Apraksin decided not to take Königsberg and ordered a withdrawal soon after the battle. Suspecting collusion between Apraksin and Chancellor Alexey Bestuzhev-Ryumin, who had opposed the invasion, Elizabeth of Russia removed Apraksin from command, ordered Bestuzhev-Ryumin to face trial for treason, and appointed William Fermor as the head of the army. Femor led the army back into East Prussia in the following year.

Battle of Großbeeren.headline: Bitka pri Großbeerenu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Großbeerenu je potekala 23. avgusta 1813 v sosednjih Blankenfeldeju in Sputendorfu med pruskim III. korpusom pod vodstvom Friedricha von Bülowa in francosko-saškim VII. korpusom pod vodstvom Jeana Reyniera. Napoleon je upal, da bo Pruse z zavzetjem njihove prestolnice izločil iz šeste koalicije, a so k francoskemu porazu prispevali močvirja južno od Berlina, dež in slabo zdravje maršala Nicolasa Oudinota.

source.title: Battle of Großbeeren
paragraphs: The Battle of Großbeeren occurred on 23 August 1813 in neighboring Blankenfelde and Sputendorf between the Prussian III Corps under Friedrich von Bülow and the Franco-Saxon VII Corps under Jean Reynier. Napoleon had hoped to drive the Prussians out of the Sixth Coalition by capturing their capital, but the swamps south of Berlin combined with rain and marshal Nicolas Oudinot's ill health all contributed to the French defeat.

Prva bitka za Grozni je bila vdor ruske vojske v čečensko prestolnico Grozni in njena osvojitev v prvih mesecih prve čečenske vojne. Napad je trajal od decembra 1994 do marca 1995; ruska vojska je mesto vojaško zasedla, večina čečenskega naroda pa se je zbrala okoli vlade Džoharja Dudajeva.

Prvi napad je Rusom prinesel precejšnje izgube in demoralizacijo v ruskih silah. Ruska vojska je potrebovala še dva meseca hudih bojev in spremembo taktike, preden je zavzela Grozni. Bitka je povzročila ogromno razdejanje in žrtve med civilnim prebivalstvom, v njej pa je bilo najhujše bombardiranje v Evropi od konca druge svetovne vojne.

source.title: Battle of Grozny (1994–1995)
paragraphs: The First Battle of Grozny was the Russian Army's invasion and subsequent conquest of the Chechen capital, Grozny, during the early months of the First Chechen War. The attack would last from December 1994 to March 1995, which resulted in the military occupation of the city by the Russian Army and rallied most of the Chechen nation around the government of Dzhokhar Dudayev.

The initial assault resulted in considerable Russian casualties and demoralization in the Russian forces. It took another two months of heavy fighting, and a change in tactics, before the Russian Army was able to capture Grozny. The battle caused enormous destruction and casualties amongst the civilian population and saw the heaviest bombing campaign in Europe since the end of World War II.

Druga bitka za Grozni ali operacija Lov na volka je bila obleganje in naskok ruskih sil na čečensko prestolnico Grozni, ki sta trajala od konca leta 1999 do začetka leta 2000. Obleganje in naskok sta mestno območje skoraj povsem uničila. Združeni narodi so Grozni leta 2003 označili za najbolj razrušeno mesto na Zemlji. Bitka je imela uničujoče posledice za civilno prebivalstvo. Ocenjujejo, da je bilo med obleganjem ubitih od 5000 do 8000 civilistov, zato velja za najbolj krvavo epizodo druge čečenske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Grozny (1999–2000)
paragraphs: The second battle of Grozny or Operation Wolf Hunt was the siege and assault of the Chechen capital Grozny by Russian forces, lasting from late 1999 to early 2000. The siege and assault on the city resulted in the near total destruction of the urban area. In 2003, the United Nations designated Grozny as the most destroyed city on Earth. The battle had a devastating impact on the civilian population. It is estimated that between 5,000 and 8,000 civilians were killed during the siege, making it the bloodiest episode of the Second Chechen War.

Bitka za Grozni avgusta 1996, znana tudi kot operacija Džihad ali operacija Ničelna možnost, je bila presenetljiv napad, v katerem so čečenski borci znova zavzeli prestolnico Čečenije Grozni in jo obdržali. Ruske zvezne sile so mesto zavzele v prejšnji bitki, ki se je končala februarja 1995, in nato v mestu namestile veliko posadko zveznih in republiških enot notranjega ministrstva (MVD).

Precej manjše čečenske sile so se prikradle v Grozni in enote MVD pognale v beg ali jih razbile v številne obkoljene žepe. Čečenski borci so nato odbili enote ruske kopenske vojske, poslane, da bi borce pregnale in rešile ujete enote. Končni izid je bilo premirje, ki je dejansko končalo prvo čečensko vojno 1994–1996.
notes: The English first sentence has no main verb; the Slovenian says what it plainly means.

source.title: Battle of Grozny (August 1996)
paragraphs: The Battle of Grozny of August 1996, also known as Operation Jihad or Operation Zero Option, when Chechen fighters regained and then kept control of Chechnya's capital Grozny in a surprise raid. Russian federal forces had captured the city in a previous battle that ended in February 1995, and subsequently posted a large garrison of federal and republican Ministry of the Interior (MVD) troops in the city.

The much smaller Chechen forces infiltrated Grozny and either routed the MVD forces or split them into many pockets of encirclement. Chechen fighters then beat back the Russian Ground Forces units that had been sent to expel the fighters and rescue their own trapped forces. The final result was a ceasefire that effectively ended the First Chechen War of 1994–1996.

Bitka za Grozni novembra 1994 je bila prikrit poskus ruskih obveščevalnih služb, da bi z zavzetjem čečenske prestolnice Grozni strmoglavile čečensko vlado Džoharja Dudajeva. Napad so 26. novembra 1994 ob prikriti podpori oklepnikov in letal Ruske federacije izvedle oborožene enote opozicijskega Začasnega sveta pod vodstvom Umarja Avturhanova. Boji so po prvih 10 urah pojenjali, Čečenska republika Ičkerija pa je napad odločno odbila.

source.title: Battle of Grozny (November 1994)
paragraphs: The November 1994 Battle of Grozny was a covert attempt by Russian Intelligence services to oust the Chechen government of Dzhokhar Dudayev, by seizing the Chechen capital of Grozny. The attack was conducted by armed formations of the opposition Provisional Council, led by Umar Avturkhanov, with a clandestine support of Russian Federation armor and aircraft on 26 November 1994. The fighting subsided after the first 10 hours, with the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria decisively repelling the assault.

Battle of Grumentum.headline: Bitka pri Grumentumu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Grumentumu je potekala leta 207 pr. n. št. med Rimljani pod vodstvom Gaja Klavdija Nerona in delom Hanibalove kartažanske vojske. Bila je manjši spopad, ki so ga rimski viri napihnili v veliko zmago. Po Liviju so Rimljani pobili 8000 Kartažanov in jih ujeli 700, sami pa so izgubili 500 mož. Števili kartažanskih mrtvih in ujetih sta videti sumljivo neskladni. Naslednji dan je tik severno od bojišča prišlo do neurejenega spopada, v katerem naj bi bilo ubitih še 2000 Kartažanov. Nato je Neron odkorakal proti severu, kjer je na Metavru premagal in ubil Hanibalovega brata Hasdrubala. Livij jo opisuje v 27.41–42.

source.title: Battle of Grumentum
paragraphs: The Battle of Grumentum was fought in 207 BC between Romans led by Gaius Claudius Nero, and a part of Hannibal's Carthaginian army. The battle was a minor engagement that Roman sources inflated as a major success. According to Livy, the Romans killed 8,000 Carthaginians and took 700 prisoners for the cost of 500 dead Romans. The Carthaginian loss figures for dead and prisoners appear suspiciously out of proportion to each other. Just north of the battlefield the next day, an irregular clash occurred where allegedly another 2,000 Carthaginians were killed. Afterwards, Nero marched north, where he defeated and killed Hannibal's brother Hasdrubal at Metaurus. The battle is described by Livy at 27.41–42.

Battle of Guadalacete.headline: Bitka pri Guadalaceteju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Guadalaceteju je potekala leta 852 med koalicijo enot Kraljestva Asturija in Kraljestva Pamplona ter enotami umajadskega muslimanskega Kordobskega emirata pod poveljstvom kordobskega emirja Mohameda I. Zmagali so Umajadi.

source.title: Battle of Guadalacete
paragraphs: The Battle of Guadalacete was fought in 852 between a coalition of troops from the Kingdom of Asturias and the Kingdom of Pamplona, and a force of troops from the Umayyad Muslim Emirate of Córdoba under the command of Muhammad I of Córdoba. The outcome was a Umayyad victory.

Battle of Guadalajara.headline: Bitka pri Guadalajari
paragraphs: V bitki pri Guadalajari (8.–23. marca 1937) sta Španska republikanska vojska (Ejército Popular Republicano, EPR) in mednarodne brigade premagali italijanske in nacionalistične sile, ki so v španski državljanski vojni skušale obkoliti Madrid. Nacionalistične sile v bitki pri Guadalajari so bile predvsem italijanski Korpus prostovoljnih enot (Corpo Truppe Volontarie, CTV).

Bitka se je začela z italijansko ofenzivo 8. marca, ki so jo do 11. marca ustavili. Med 12. in 14. marcem so ponovne italijanske napade podprle španske nacionalistične enote, a so jih prav tako ustavili. Republikanci so 15. marca pripravili protiofenzivo in jo med 18. in 23. marcem uspešno sprožili. Bitko je odločila premoč sovjetskih oklepnih vozil nad italijanskimi.

source.title: Battle of Guadalajara
paragraphs: The Battle of Guadalajara (8–23 March 1937) saw the victory of the Spanish Republican Army (Ejército Popular Republicano, or EPR) and of the International Brigades over the Italian and Nationalist forces attempting to encircle Madrid during the Spanish Civil War. The Nationalist forces involved in the Battle of Guadalajara were primarily the Italian Corps of Volunteer Troops (Corpo Truppe Volontarie, or CTV).

The battle opened with an Italian offensive on 8 March. This offensive was halted by 11 March. Between 12 and 14 March, renewed Italian attacks were supported by Spanish Nationalist units. These were halted too. On 15 March, a counter-offensive of the Republicans was prepared; it was successfully launched between 18 and 23 March. The battle was decided by the superiority of Soviet armoured vehicles over Italian ones.

Battle of Gumbinnen.headline: Bitka pri Gumbinnenu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gumbinnenu, ki so jo 20. avgusta 1914 začele sile Nemškega cesarstva, je bila nemška ofenziva na vzhodni fronti prve svetovne vojne. Ker je bil nemški napad prenagljen, je zmagala ruska vojska.

source.title: Battle of Gumbinnen
paragraphs: The Battle of Gumbinnen, initiated by forces of the German Empire on 20 August 1914, was a German offensive on the Eastern Front during the First World War. Because of the hastiness of the German attack, the Russian Army emerged victorious.

Battle of Halbe.headline: Bitka pri Halbeju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Halbeju (nemško: Kesselschlacht von Halbe, bitka v halbejskem žepu; rusko: Хальбский котёл, halbejski kotel) je trajala od 24. aprila do 1. maja 1945; v njej je prodirajoča Rdeča armada med bitko za Berlin uničila nemško 9. armado pod poveljstvom generala Theodorja Busseja kot bojno silo.

Deveta armada, obkoljena v velikem žepu na območju Spreewalda jugovzhodno od Berlina, se je skušala prebiti proti zahodu skozi vas Halbe in borove gozdove južno od Berlina ter se povezati z nemško 12. armado pod poveljstvom generala Waltherja Wencka, da bi se nato umaknila proti zahodu in se predala zahodnim zaveznikom. Pri tem se je morala 9. armada prebiti skozi tri črte sovjetskih čet 1. ukrajinske fronte pod poveljstvom maršala Ivana Koneva, hkrati pa so enote 1. beloruske fronte pod poveljstvom maršala Georgija Žukova s severovzhoda napadale nemško zaščitnico.

source.title: Battle of Halbe
paragraphs: The Battle of Halbe (German: Kesselschlacht von Halbe, Battle of the Halbe Pocket; Russian: Хальбский котёл, Halbe pocket) was a battle lasting from April 24 to May 1, 1945, in which the German Ninth Army under the command of General Theodor Busse was destroyed as a fighting force by the advancing Red Army during the Battle of Berlin.

The Ninth Army, encircled in a large pocket in the Spree Forest region south-east of Berlin, attempted to break out westwards through the village of Halbe and the pine forests south of Berlin to link up with the German Twelfth Army commanded by General Walther Wenck with the intention of heading west and surrendering to the Western Allies. To do this, the Ninth Army had to fight its way through three lines of Soviet troops of the 1st Ukrainian Front under the command of Marshal Ivan Konev, while at the same time units of the 1st Belorussian Front, under the command of Marshal Georgy Zhukov, attacked the German rearguard from the northeast.

Battle of Halen.headline: Bitka pri Halenu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Halenu (nemško: Gefecht bei Halen), znana tudi kot bitka srebrnih čelad (nizozemsko: Slag der Zilveren Helmen; francosko: Bataille des casques d'argent), ker so nemški kirasirji na bojišču pustili veliko konjeniških čelad, je potekala 12. avgusta 1914 na začetku prve svetovne vojne med nemškimi silami pod vodstvom Georga von der Marwitza in belgijskimi četami pod vodstvom Léona De Witteja.

Ime bitke namiguje na bitko zlatih ostrog leta 1302, po kateri so z bojišča pobrali 500 parov zlatih ostrog. Halen (francosko Haelen) je bil majhen trg in priročen prehod čez reko Gete, ležal pa je na glavni smeri prodiranja nemške cesarske vojske. Bitka je bila taktična zmaga Belgijcev, a nemške invazije na Belgijo ni bistveno zavlekla.

source.title: Battle of Halen
paragraphs: The Battle of Halen (German: Gefecht bei Halen), also known as the Battle of the Silver Helmets (Dutch: Slag der Zilveren Helmen; French: Bataille des casques d'argent) because of the many cavalry helmets left behind on the battlefield by the German cuirassiers, took place on 12 August 1914 at the beginning of the First World War, between German forces led by Georg von der Marwitz and Belgian troops led by Léon De Witte.

The name of the battle alludes to the Battle of the Golden Spurs in 1302, where 500 pairs of golden spurs were recovered from the battlefield. Halen (Haelen in French) was a small market town and a convenient river crossing of the Gete and was situated on the principal axis of advance of the Imperial German army. The battle was a Belgian tactical victory but did little to delay the German invasion of Belgium.

Battle of Haliartus.headline: Bitka pri Haliartu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Haliartu je potekala leta 395 pr. n. št. med Šparto in Atenami. Po porazu v peloponeški vojni so si Atene skušale opomoči in pridobile tudi podporo Beotije. Šparta, nezadovoljna s takim položajem, je proti Atenam poslala vojsko, ki so jo Atenci in Beočani premagali. V bitki je padel Lisander, eden najuspešnejših špartanskih vojskovodij. Bitka pri Haliartu je pomenila začetek korintske vojne, ki je trajala do leta 387 pr. n. št.

source.title: Battle of Haliartus
paragraphs: The Battle of Haliartus was fought in 395 BC between Sparta and Athens. After the Athenian defeat at the Peloponnesian War, Athens tried to recover, but also gained the support of Boeotia. Dissatisfied with this situation, Sparta sent an army against Athens and was defeated by the Athenians and Boeotians. Lysander, one of Sparta's most successful generals, was killed in this battle. Haliartus marked the start of the Corinthian War, which continued until 387 BC.

Battle of Halidon Hill.headline: Bitka pri Halidon Hillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Halidon Hillu je potekala 19. julija 1333, ko je škotska vojska pod sirom Archibaldom Douglasom napadla angleško vojsko pod poveljstvom angleškega kralja Edvarda III. (vladal 1327–1377) in doživela hud poraz. Leto prej je Edvard Balliol ob prikriti podpori Edvarda III. petletnemu Davidu II. (vladal 1329–1371) odvzel škotsko krono. S tem se je začela druga škotska osamosvojitvena vojna. Balliola je kmalu iz Škotske pregnala ljudska vstaja, ki jo je Edvard III. izkoristil kot casus belli in leta 1333 vdrl na Škotsko. Neposredni cilj je bilo strateško pomembno obmejno mesto Berwick-upon-Tweed, ki so ga Angleži marca oblegali.

source.title: Battle of Halidon Hill
paragraphs: The Battle of Halidon Hill took place on 19 July 1333 when a Scottish army under Sir Archibald Douglas attacked an English army commanded by King Edward III of England (r. 1327–1377) and was heavily defeated. The year before, Edward Balliol had seized the Scottish Crown from five-year-old David II (r. 1329–1371), surreptitiously supported by Edward III. This marked the start of the Second War of Scottish Independence. Balliol was shortly expelled from Scotland by a popular uprising, which Edward III used as a casus belli, invading Scotland in 1333. The immediate target was the strategically-important border town of Berwick-upon-Tweed, which the English besieged in March.

Battle of Halmyros.headline: Bitka pri Halmirosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Halmirosu, ki so jo starejši raziskovalci imenovali bitka ob Kefisu ali bitka pri Orhomenu, je potekala 15. marca 1311 med silami frankovske Atenske vojvodine in njenih vazalov pod vodstvom Valterja Briennskega ter najemniki Katalonske kompanije. Končala se je z odločilno zmago najemnikov.

source.title: Battle of Halmyros
paragraphs: The Battle of Halmyros, known by earlier scholars as the Battle of the Cephissus or Battle of Orchomenos, was fought on 15 March 1311, between the forces of the Frankish Duchy of Athens and its vassals under Walter of Brienne against the mercenaries of the Catalan Company, resulting in a decisive victory for the mercenaries.

Bitka pri Hanauu je potekala od 30. do 31. oktobra 1813 med avstrijsko-bavarskim korpusom Karla Philippa von Wredeja in Napoleonovimi Francozi, ki so se umikali med vojno šeste koalicije. Po porazu v bitki pri Leipzigu prej istega oktobra se je Napoleon začel razmeroma varno umikati iz Nemčije v Francijo. Wrede je 30. oktobra pri Hanauu skušal zapreti francosko umikalno pot. Napoleon je z okrepitvami prispel do Hanaua in premagal Wredejeve sile. Hanau je bil 31. oktobra v francoskih rokah, s čimer je bila Napoleonu odprta pot za umik.
Bitka pri Hanauu je bila pomembna taktična zmaga, ki je Napoleonovi oslabljeni vojski omogočila umik na francoska tla, kjer se je pripravila na invazijo na Francijo.

source.title: Battle of Hanau
paragraphs: The Battle of Hanau was fought from 30 to 31 October 1813 between Karl Philipp von Wrede's Austro-Bavarian corps and Napoleons retreating French during the War of the Sixth Coalition. Following his defeat at the Battle of Leipzig earlier in October, Napoleon began to retreat from Germany into France in relative safety. Wrede attempted to block the French line of retreat at Hanau on 30 October. Napoleon arrived at Hanau with reinforcements and defeated Wrede's forces. On 31 October Hanau was in French control, opening Napoleon's line of retreat.
The Battle of Hanau was an important tactical victory allowing Napoleon's depleted army to retreat onto French soil to prepare to face an invasion of France.

Battle of Hannut.headline: Bitka pri Hannutu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hannutu je potekala med 12. in 14. majem 1940 pri Hannutu v Belgiji v okviru bitke za Belgijo med drugo svetovno vojno. Bila je največja tankovska bitka pohoda, tedaj pa tudi največji spopad tankov v zgodovini oklepnega bojevanja.

source.title: Battle of Hannut
paragraphs: The Battle of Hannut was a Second World War battle fought during the Battle of Belgium which took place between 12 and 14 May 1940 at Hannut in Belgium. It was the largest tank battle in the campaign. It was also the largest clash of tanks in armoured warfare history at the time.

Battle of Haslach-Jungingen.headline: Bitka pri Haslach-Jungingnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Haslach-Jungingnu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Albecku, je potekala 11. oktobra 1805 pri Ulm-Jungingnu severno od Ulma ob Donavi med francoskimi in avstrijskimi silami ter je bila del ulmskega pohoda v vojni tretje koalicije, dela širših napoleonskih vojn. Avstrijci kljub številčni premoči te niso mogli dobro izkoristiti zaradi neodločnosti, ki je izvirala iz precenjevanja števila Francozov, in zaradi krajevnega terena. Bitka se je končala s francosko zmago.

source.title: Battle of Haslach-Jungingen
paragraphs: The Battle of Haslach-Jungingen, also known as the Battle of Albeck, fought on 11 October 1805 at Ulm-Jungingen north of Ulm at the Danube between French and Austrian forces, was part of the Ulm campaign during the War of the Third Coalition, which was a part of the greater Napoleonic Wars. The Austrians, despite their numerical advantage, were unable to make good use of it due to indecision resulting from an overestimation of the French numbers and the local terrain. The outcome of this battle was a French victory.

Battle of Hastenbeck.headline: Bitka pri Hastenbecku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hastenbecku (26. julija 1757) je bila del invazije na Hannover v sedemletni vojni; v njej so se zavezniške sile Hannovra, Hessen-Kassla in Braunschweiga spopadle s Francozi. Francoska vojska je zaveznike premagala blizu Hamelna v Volilni kneževini Hannover.
notes: The English variant spelling Hesse-Cassel is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Hastenbeck
paragraphs: The Battle of Hastenbeck (26 July 1757) was fought as part of the Invasion of Hanover during the Seven Years' War between the allied forces of Hanover, Hesse-Kassel (or Hesse-Cassel) and Brunswick, and the French. The allies were defeated by the French army near Hamelin in the Electorate of Hanover.

Battle of Hatfield Chase.headline: Bitka pri Hatfield Chaseu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hatfield Chaseu (staroangleško: Hæðfeld; starovaližansko: Meigen) je potekala 12. oktobra 633. V njej so se Northumbrijci spopadli z zavezništvom Gwynedda in Mercie. Northumbrijce je vodil Edwin, gwyneddsko-mercijsko zavezništvo pa Cadwallon ap Cadfan in Penda. Bojišče je bilo močvirnato območje približno 13 kilometrov severovzhodno od Doncastra na južnem bregu reke Don, čeprav je ta lokacija sporna. Gwynedd in Mercijci so odločilno zmagali: Edwin je padel, njegova vojska je bila poražena, Northumbrija pa je začasno razpadla.
notes: The miles (8 mi) are dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Hatfield Chase
paragraphs: The Battle of Hatfield Chase (Old English: Hæðfeld; Old Welsh: Meigen) was fought on 12 October 633 It pitted the Northumbrians against an alliance of Gwynedd and Mercia. The Northumbrians were led by Edwin and the Gwynedd-Mercian alliance was led by Cadwallon ap Cadfan and Penda. The site of the battle was a marshy area about 8 miles (13 km) northeast of Doncaster on the south bank of the River Don, though this location has been disputed. It was a decisive victory for Gwynedd and the Mercians: Edwin was killed and his army defeated, leading to the temporary collapse of Northumbria.

Battle of Heavenfield.headline: Bitka pri Heavenfieldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Heavenfieldu je potekala leta 633 ali 634 med northumbrijsko vojsko pod Oswaldom Bernicijskim in valižansko vojsko pod Cadwallonom ap Cadfanom iz Gwynedda. Northumbrijci so odločilno zmagali. Annales Cambriae (Valižanski anali) bitko beležijo kot Bellum Cantscaul leta 631. Beda jo je imenoval bitka pri Deniseburni blizu Hefenfeltha.

source.title: Battle of Heavenfield
paragraphs: The Battle of Heavenfield was fought in 633 or 634 between a Northumbrian army under Oswald of Bernicia and a Welsh army under Cadwallon ap Cadfan of Gwynedd. The battle resulted in a decisive Northumbrian victory. The Annales Cambriae (Annals of Wales) record the battle as Bellum Cantscaul in 631. Bede referred to it as the Battle of Deniseburna near Hefenfelth.

Battle of Hedgeley Moor.headline: Bitka pri Hedgeley Mooru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hedgeley Mooru 25. aprila 1464 je potekala v vojni rož. Pri Hedgeley Mooru severno od vasi Glanton in Powburn v Northumberlandu sta se spopadli yorška vojska pod vodstvom Johna Nevilla, lorda Montaguja, in lancastrska vojska pod vodstvom Henryja Beauforta, vojvode Somerseta. Bitka se je končala z zmago Yorkov.

source.title: Battle of Hedgeley Moor
paragraphs: The Battle of Hedgeley Moor, 25 April 1464, took place during the Wars of the Roses. It was fought at Hedgeley Moor, north of the villages of Glanton and Powburn in Northumberland, between a Yorkist army led by John Neville, Lord Montagu and a Lancastrian army led by Henry Beaufort, Duke of Somerset. The battle ended in a Yorkist victory.

Battle of Heiligerlee (1568).headline: Bitka pri Heiligerleeju (1568)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Heiligerleeju (Heiligerlee, Groningen, 23. maja 1568) je bila spopad med nizozemskimi uporniki in špansko vojsko Frizije. Bila je prva nizozemska zmaga v osemdesetletni vojni.

V provinco Groningen na Španski Nizozemski je vdrla vojska s 3900 pešci, ki jih je vodil Ludvik Nassauski, in 200 konjeniki pod vodstvom Adolfa Nassauskega. Oba sta bila brata Viljema I. Oranskega. Namen je bil začeti oborožen upor proti španskim vladarjem Nizozemske.
Frizijski namestnik (stadtholder) in vojvoda Arenberški Johan de Ligne je imel vojsko s 3200 pešci in 20 konjeniki.

source.title: Battle of Heiligerlee (1568)
paragraphs: The Battle of Heiligerlee (Heiligerlee, Groningen, 23 May 1568) was fought between Dutch rebels and the Spanish army of Friesland. It was the first Dutch victory during the Eighty Years' War.

The Groningen province of the Spanish Netherlands was invaded by an army consisting of 3,900 infantry, led by Louis of Nassau, and 200 cavalry, led by Adolf of Nassau. Both of them were brothers of William I of Orange. The intention was to begin an armed uprising against the Spanish rulers of the Netherlands.
The Stadtholder of Friesland and also Duke of Arenberg, Johan de Ligne, had an army of 3,200 infantry and 20 cavalry.

Battle of Heilsberg.headline: Bitka pri Heilsbergu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Heilsbergu je potekala 10. junija (po starem koledarju 29. maja) 1807 pri mestu Heilsberg (danes Lidzbark Warmiński) med napoleonskimi vojnami. Francoske čete Joachima Murata so v njej začele napad na rusko vojsko Leontija (Levina) Bennigsena pred načrtovanim časom. Nasprotnika sta se bojevala do noči, ko francoski napadi še vedno niso prinesli uspeha. Sklenila sta operativno premirje. Napoleon, vrhovni poveljnik francoske vojske, je nameraval pripeljati več sil in nadaljevati spopad, a se mu je Bennigsen izognil in krenil proti Königsbergu. Ker je bil Bennigsen bolan, ga je med bojem do samega konca začasno nadomeščal poveljnik korpusa Andrej Gorčakov. Na bojišče je prispel tudi Napoleon, a bitko je začel Murat.

source.title: Battle of Heilsberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Heilsberg took place on 10 June [O.S. 29 May] 1807 off the town of Heilsberg (now Lidzbark Warmiński), during the Napoleonic Wars. In it, Joachim Murat's French troops began the offensive on Leonty (Levin) Bennigsen's Russian force ahead of schedule. The opponents fought until nightfall, by which time the French attacks had produced no results. They concluded an operational armistice. Napoleon, French supreme commander, intended to bring up more forces and continue the encounter, but Bennigsen eluded this, heading towards Königsberg. Due to Bennigsen's illness, corps-level commander Andrei Gorchakov temporarily replaced him during the action until the very end of it. Napoleon also arrived on the battlefield, but it was Murat who initiated the battle.

Battle of Hel.headline: Bitka za Hel
paragraphs: Bitka za Hel (poljsko: Obrona Helu, dobesedno »obramba Hela«) je bila spopad druge svetovne vojne, ki je med nemško invazijo na Poljsko (v poljskem zgodovinopisju znano tudi kot septembrski pohod) od 1. septembra do 2. oktobra 1939 potekal na polotoku Hel ob baltski obali med napadajočimi nemškimi silami in poljskimi branilci. Obramba polotoka Hel je potekala okoli utrjenega območja Hel, sistema poljskih utrdb, zgrajenih v 1930. letih blizu medvojne meje z nemškim tretjim rajhom.

Od 20. septembra 1939, potem ko je bila poljska armada Pomorje poražena v bitki v Tucholskih gozdovih in so druge poljske obalne utrdbe kapitulirale v bitkah za Westerplatte, Gdynio in Kępo Oksywsko, je bil Hel edini večji žep poljskega vojaškega odpora na severu Poljske. Tam je potekal tudi edini spopad površinskih vojnih ladij v invaziji.

source.title: Battle of Hel
paragraphs: The Battle of Hel (Polish: Obrona Helu, literally "the Defense of Hel") was a World War II engagement fought from 1 September to 2 October 1939 on the Hel Peninsula, of the Baltic Sea coast, between invading German forces and defending Polish units during the German invasion of Poland (also known in Polish historiography as the September Campaign). The defense of the Hel Peninsula took place around the Hel Fortified Area, a system of Polish fortifications that had been constructed in the 1930s near the interwar border with the German Third Reich.

Beginning on 20 September 1939, after the Polish Army Pomorze had been defeated in the Battle of Tuchola Forest and after other Polish coastal strongholds had capitulated in the Battle of Westerplatte, Battle of Gdynia and the Battle of Kępa Oksywska, Hel was the only substantial pocket of Polish military resistance left in northern Poland. It was also the site of the invasion's only naval surface engagement.

Battle of Heligoland (1864).headline: Bitka pri Helgolandu (1864)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Helgolandu je potekala 9. maja 1864 med drugo šlezviško vojno med dansko eskadro pod vodstvom komodorja Edouarda Suensona in združeno avstrijsko-prusko eskadro pod poveljstvom avstrijskega komodorja Wilhelma von Tegetthoffa. Do spopada je prišlo zaradi danske blokade nemških pristanišč v Severnem morju; Avstrijci so poslali parni fregati SMS Schwarzenberg in Radetzky, da bi okrepili majhno prusko mornarico in pomagali prebiti blokado. Ko je Tegetthoff prispel v Severno morje, sta se mu pridružila pruski aviso in dve topnjači. Suenson je imel proti njemu na voljo parni fregati Niels Juel in Jylland ter korveto Hejmdal.

source.title: Battle of Heligoland (1864)
paragraphs: The Battle of Heligoland (or Helgoland) was fought on 9 May 1864, during the Second Schleswig War, between a Danish squadron led by Commodore Edouard Suenson and a joint Austro-Prussian squadron commanded by the Austrian Commodore Wilhelm von Tegetthoff. The action came about as a result of the Danish blockade of German ports in the North Sea; the Austrians had sent two steam frigates, SMS Schwarzenberg and Radetzky, to reinforce the small Prussian Navy to help break the blockade. After arriving in the North Sea, Tegetthoff joined a Prussian aviso and a pair of gunboats. To oppose him, Suenson had available the steam frigates Niels Juel and Jylland and the corvette Hejmdal.

Battle of Hemmingstedt.headline: Bitka pri Hemmingstedtu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hemmingstedtu je potekala 17. februarja 1500 južno od vasi Hemmingstedt blizu današnje vasi Epenwöhrden v zahodnem delu današnjega Schleswig-Holsteina v Nemčiji. Danski kralj Ivan in njegov brat vojvoda Friderik, ki sta bila sovojvodi Schleswiga in Holsteina, sta z njo skušala podjarmiti kmete Dithmarschna, ki so na obali Severnega morja ustanovili kmečko republiko. Ivan je bil tedaj tudi kralj Kalmarske unije.

source.title: Battle of Hemmingstedt
paragraphs: The Battle of Hemmingstedt occurred on 17 February 1500, south of the village of Hemmingstedt near the present village of Epenwöhrden in the western part of present-day Schleswig-Holstein, Germany. It was an attempt by King John of Denmark and his brother Duke Frederick, who were co-dukes of Schleswig and Holstein to subdue the peasantry of Dithmarschen, who had established a peasants' republic on the coast of the North Sea. John was, at the time, also king of the Kalmar Union.

Battle of Hennersdorf.headline: Bitka pri Hennersdorfu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hennersdorfu, včasih imenovana katoliški Hennersdorf, je bila manjši spopad 23. novembra 1745 v Katholisch-Hennersdorfu v Šleziji (Prusija, danes Poljska) med drugo šlezijsko vojno (delom vojne za avstrijsko nasledstvo). Prusi pod vodstvom Friderika II. so premagali Avstrijce pod vodstvom princa Karla Aleksandra Lotarinškega. Prusi so Avstrijce in Saše presenetili v njihovih nastanitvah v Lužici, največji uspeh pa so dosegli pri Hennersdorfu. Tam so sile dveh huzarskih in dveh kirasirskih polkov pod Zietenovim vodstvom napadle manjšo skupino dveh bataljonov saške pehote in treh polkov saške konjenice. Saši so se obupano upirali, a so jih strli, ko so prispeli dodatni pruski konjeniki, pešci in topničarji.

source.title: Battle of Hennersdorf
paragraphs: The Battle of Hennersdorf, sometimes referred to as Catholic-Hennersdorf, was a minor encounter that took place on 23 November 1745 in Katholisch-Hennersdorf in Silesia (Prussia, present-day Poland) during the Second Silesian War (part of the War of the Austrian Succession). The Prussians under Frederick II defeated the Austrians under Prince Charles Alexander of Lorraine. The Prussians surprised the Austrians and Saxons in their cantonments in Lusatia with the most success at Hennersdorf. There a force of two regiments of hussars and two regiments of cuirassiers under Zieten attacked a small force of two battalions of Saxon infantry and three regiments of Saxon cavalry. The Saxons, after making a desperate stand, were overwhelmed by the arrival of additional Prussian cavalry, infantry and artillery.

Bitka pri Herakleji je potekala leta 280 pr. n. št. med Rimljani pod poveljstvom konzula Publija Valerija Levina in združenimi silami Grkov iz Epira, Tarenta, Turijev, Metaponta in Herakleje pod poveljstvom Pira, epirskega kralja. Čeprav je bila bitka grška zmaga, so Grki utrpeli hude izgube.

source.title: Battle of Heraclea
paragraphs: The Battle of Heraclea took place in 280 BC between the Romans under the command of consul Publius Valerius Laevinus, and the combined forces of Greeks from Epirus, Tarentum, Thurii, Metapontum, and Heraclea under the command of Pyrrhus, king of Epirus. Although the battle was a victory for the Greeks, they incurred severe losses.

Battle of Herdonia (210 BC).headline: Druga bitka pri Herdoniji
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Herdoniji je potekala leta 210 pr. n. št. v drugi punski vojni. Hanibal, vodja Kartažanov, ki je v Italijo vdrl osem let prej, je obkolil in uničil rimsko vojsko, ki je delovala proti njegovim zaveznikom v Apuliji. Težki poraz je povečal breme vojne za Rim in skupaj s prejšnjimi vojaškimi katastrofami (kot so bile Trasimensko jezero, Kane in druge) poslabšal odnose z izčrpanimi italijanskimi zavezniki. Za Hanibala je bila bitka taktičen uspeh, vendar rimskega napredovanja ni za dolgo ustavila. V naslednjih treh letih so Rimljani ponovno osvojili večino ozemelj in mest, izgubljenih na začetku vojne, in kartažanskega poveljnika potisnili na jugozahodni konec Apeninskega polotoka.

source.title: Battle of Herdonia (210 BC)
paragraphs: The second battle of Herdonia took place in 210 BC during the Second Punic War. Hannibal, leader of the Carthaginians, who had invaded Italy eight years earlier, encircled and destroyed a Roman army which was operating against his allies in Apulia. The heavy defeat increased the war's burden on Rome and, piled on previous military disasters (such as Lake Trasimene, Cannae, and others), aggravated the relations with her exhausted Italian allies. For Hannibal the battle was a tactical success, but did not halt for long the Roman advance. Within the next three years the Romans reconquered most of the territories and cities lost at the beginning of the war and pushed the Carthaginian general to the southwestern end of the Apennine Peninsula.

Battle of Herdonia (212 BC).headline: Prva bitka pri Herdoniji
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Herdoniji je potekala leta 212 pr. n. št. v drugi punski vojni med Hanibalovo kartažansko vojsko in rimskimi silami pod vodstvom pretorja Gneja Fulvija Flaka, brata konzula Kvinta Fulvija Flaka. Rimska vojska je bila uničena, zato je bila Apulija tisto leto brez Rimljanov.

source.title: Battle of Herdonia (212 BC)
paragraphs: The first Battle of Herdonia was fought in 212 BC during the Second Punic War between Hannibal's Carthaginian army and Roman forces led by Praetor Gnaeus Fulvius Flaccus, brother of the consul Quintus Fulvius Flaccus. The Roman army was destroyed, leaving Apulia free of Romans for the year.

Battle of Héricourt.headline: Bitka pri Héricourtu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Héricourtu je potekala 13. novembra 1474 blizu Héricourta v Burgundiji v okviru burgundskih vojn. Končala se je z zmago švicarske konfederacije in njenih zaveznikov nad burgundsko državo.

source.title: Battle of Héricourt
paragraphs: The Battle of Héricourt was fought on 13 November 1474 near Héricourt, Burgundy, as part of the Burgundian Wars. It resulted in victory for the Swiss Confederacy and its allies over the Burgundian State.

Battle of Hexham.headline: Bitka pri Hexhamu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hexhamu 15. maja 1464 je pomenila konec pomembnejšega lancastrskega odpora na severu Anglije v zgodnjem delu vladavine Edvarda IV.

Bitka je potekala blizu mesta Hexham v Northumberlandu. John Neville, poznejši 1. markiz Montagu, je s skromno vojsko 3000–4000 mož pognal v beg uporne lancastrovce. Večino uporniških voditeljev so ujeli in usmrtili, med njimi Henryja Beauforta, vojvodo Somerseta, in lorda Hungerforda. Henrik VI. pa je bil na varnem daleč stran (pred tem so ga v bojih že trikrat ujeli) in je pobegnil na sever.

Ker uporniki niso imeli več vodstva, je v njihovih rokah ostalo le nekaj gradov. Ko so ti pozneje istega leta padli, Edvarda IV. ni nihče resneje ogrožal, dokler grof Warwick leta 1469 ni prestopil z yorške na lancastrsko stran.

source.title: Battle of Hexham
paragraphs: The Battle of Hexham, 15 May 1464, marked the end of significant Lancastrian resistance in the north of England during the early part of the reign of Edward IV.

The battle was fought near the town of Hexham in Northumberland. John Neville, later to be 1st Marquess of Montagu, led a modest force of 3,000-4,000 men, and routed the rebel Lancastrians. Most of the rebel leaders were captured and executed, including Henry Beaufort, Duke of Somerset, and Lord Hungerford. Henry VI, however, was kept safely away (having been captured in battle three times earlier), and escaped to the north.

With their leadership gone, only a few castles remained in rebel hands. After these fell later in the year, Edward IV was not seriously challenged until the Earl of Warwick changed his allegiance from the Yorkist to the Lancastrian cause in 1469.

Battle of Himera (409 BC).headline: Bitka pri Himeri leta 409 pr. n. št.
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Himeri je potekala blizu kraja prve bitke in velikega kartažanskega poraza iz leta 480 pr. n. št., pri mestu Himera na Siciliji leta 409 pr. n. št., med kartažanskimi silami pod Hanibalom Magom (kraljem Kartagine iz rodbine Magonidov, ne znamenitim Hanibalom iz rodbine Barkidov) in jonskimi Grki iz Himere, ki so jim pomagali vojska in ladjevje iz Sirakuz. Hanibal je po bitki pri Selinuntu leta 409 pr. n. št. že prej, po navodilih kartažanskega senata, izropal in uničil mesto Selinunt. Nato je uničil Himero, ki ni bila nikoli obnovljena.
Množična grobišča, povezana s to bitko (skupaj s prvo bitko pri Himeri leta 480 pr. n. št.), so odkrili v letih 2008–2011 in potrdili zgodbe, ki so jih povedali antični zgodovinarji.
notes: The English dates the Battle of Himera to 409 without BC in its first sentence; the Slovenian writes 409 pr. n. št. throughout, as the title does.

source.title: Battle of Himera (409 BC)
paragraphs: Near the site of the first battle and great Carthaginian defeat of 480 BC, the Second Battle of Himera was fought near the city of Himera in Sicily in 409 between the Carthaginian forces under Hannibal Mago (a king of Carthage of the Magonid family, not the famous Hannibal of the Barcid family) and the Ionian Greeks of Himera aided by an army and a fleet from Syracuse. Hannibal, acting under the instructions of the Carthaginian senate, had previously sacked and destroyed the city of Selinus after the Battle of Selinus in 409. Hannibal then destroyed Himera which was never rebuilt.
Mass graves associated with this battle (along with the first Battle of Himera in 480 BC) were discovered in 2008-2011, corroborating the stories told by ancient historians.

Bitka pri Himeri (480 pr. n. št.) je bila spopad, v katerem so grške sile Gelona, kralja Sirakuz, in Terona, tirana Agrigenta, porazile kartažansko vojsko Hamilkarja iz rodbine Magonidov in tako preprečile kartažanski poskus, da bi odstavljenega himerskega tirana vrnili na oblast. Po izročilu naj bi potekala istega dne kot bitka pri Salamini ali istočasno z bitko pri Termopilah. Sodobni raziskovalci zavračajo trditev, da je bitka sovpadala s pomorsko bitko pri Salamini in da je tako preprečila punsko-perzijsko zaroto za uničenje grške civilizacije. Strinjajo se tudi, da je bitka za več desetletij močno oslabila kartažansko moč na Siciliji. Bila je ena najpomembnejših bitk sicilskih vojn.
Odkritje množičnih grobišč iz bitke v letih 2007 in 2008 je potrdilo lokacijo in naravo bitke.

source.title: Battle of Himera (480 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Himera (480 BC), supposedly fought on the same day as the Battle of Salamis, or at the same time as the Battle of Thermopylae, saw the Greek forces of Gelon, King of Syracuse, and Theron, tyrant of Agrigentum, defeat the Carthaginian force of Hamilcar the Magonid, ending a Carthaginian bid to restore the deposed tyrant of Himera. The alleged coincidence of this battle with the naval battle of Salamis and the resultant derailing of a Punic-Persian conspiracy aimed at destroying the Greek civilization is rejected by modern scholars. Scholars also agree that the battle led to the crippling of Carthage's power in Sicily for many decades. It was one of the most important battles of the Sicilian Wars.
The discovery in 2007 and 2008 of mass graves from the battle has confirmed the location and nature of the battle.

Battle of Hochkirch.headline: Bitka pri Hochkirchu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hochkirchu je potekala 14. oktobra 1758 med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne). Po več tednih manevriranja za položaje je avstrijska vojska z 80.000 možmi pod poveljstvom podmaršala Leopolda Josefa grofa Dauna presenetila prusko vojsko s 30.000–36.000 možmi pod poveljstvom Friderika Velikega. Avstrijska vojska je strla Pruse in jih prisilila v splošen umik. Bitka je potekala v vasi Hochkirch in okoli nje, 9 kilometrov vzhodno od Bautzna na Saškem.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Hochkirch
paragraphs: The Battle of Hochkirch took place on 14 October 1758, during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). After several weeks of maneuvering for position, an Austrian army of 80,000 commanded by Lieutenant Field Marshal Leopold Josef Graf Daun surprised the Prussian army of 30,000–36,000 commanded by Frederick the Great. The Austrian army overwhelmed the Prussians and forced a general retreat. The battle took place in and around the village of Hochkirch, 9 kilometers (6 mi) east of Bautzen, Saxony.

Bitka pri Höchstu (20. junija 1622) je bila spopad med vojsko katoliške lige pod vodstvom Johana Tserclaesa, grofa Tillyja, in protestantsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Kristijana mlajšega Brunšviškega, vojvode Braunschweig-Lüneburga, blizu mesta Höchst, danes predmestja Frankfurta ob Majni. Končala se je s prepričljivo zmago katoliške lige. Spopad je potekal med tridesetletno vojno.

source.title: Battle of Höchst
paragraphs: The Battle of Höchst (20 June 1622) was fought between a Catholic League army led by Johan Tzerclaes, Count of Tilly and a Protestant army commanded by Christian the Younger, Duke of Brunswick-Lüneburg, close to the town of Höchst, today a suburb of the city of Frankfurt am Main. The result was a one-sided Catholic League victory. The action occurred during the Thirty Years' War.

Battle of Hohenfriedberg.headline: Bitka pri Hohenfriedbergu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hohenfriedbergu ali Hohenfriedebergu (danes Dobromierz na Poljskem), znana tudi kot bitka pri Striegauu (danes Strzegom na Poljskem), je bila ena najbolj občudovanih zmag Friderika Velikega. Friderikova pruska vojska je 4. junija 1745 med drugo šlezijsko vojno, delom vojne za avstrijsko nasledstvo, odločilno premagala avstrijsko-saško vojsko pod vodstvom princa Karla Aleksandra Lotarinškega.

source.title: Battle of Hohenfriedberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Hohenfriedberg or Hohenfriedeberg (now Dobromierz, Poland), also known as the Battle of Striegau (now Strzegom, Poland) was one of Frederick the Great's most admired victories. Frederick's Prussian army decisively defeated an Austro-Saxon army under Prince Charles Alexander of Lorraine on June 4, 1745, during the Second Silesian War – part of the War of the Austrian Succession.

Battle of Hohenlinden.headline: Bitka pri Hohenlindnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hohenlindnu je potekala 3. decembra 1800 med francoskimi revolucionarnimi vojnami. Francoska vojska pod vodstvom Jeana Victorja Marieja Moreauja je odločilno zmagala nad avstrijskimi in bavarskimi silami, ki jih je vodil 18-letni nadvojvoda Janez Avstrijski. Zavezniki so bili prisiljeni v katastrofalen umik in so morali prositi za premirje, s čimer se je vojna druge koalicije dejansko končala. Hohenlinden leži 33 km vzhodno od Münchna v današnji Nemčiji.

Vojska divizijskega generala Moreauja s 56.000 možmi se je spopadla s približno 64.000 Avstrijci in Bavarci. Avstrijci so mislili, da zasledujejo poraženega sovražnika, in so se skozi gosto gozdnat teren premikali v štirih nepovezanih kolonah. Moreau jim je pripravil zasedo, ko so prihajali iz Ebersberškega gozda, hkrati pa je divizijo Antoina Richepansa poslal v presenetljiv obhod avstrijskega levega krila. Moreaujevi generali so z izjemno osebno iniciativo obkolili in razbili največjo avstrijsko kolono.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Hohenlinden
