paragraphs: The Battle of Hohenlinden was fought on 3 December 1800 during the French Revolutionary Wars. A French army under Jean Victor Marie Moreau won a decisive victory over an Austrian and Bavarian force led by 18-year-old Archduke John of Austria. The allies were forced into a disastrous retreat that compelled them to request an armistice, effectively ending the War of the Second Coalition. Hohenlinden is 33 km (21 mi) east of Munich in modern Germany.

General of Division Moreau's 56,000-strong army engaged some 64,000 Austrians and Bavarians. The Austrians, believing they were pursuing a beaten enemy, moved through heavily wooded terrain in four disconnected columns. Moreau ambushed the Austrians as they emerged from the Ebersberg forest while launching Antoine Richepanse's division in a surprise envelopment of the Austrian left flank. Displaying superb individual initiative, Moreau's generals managed to encircle and smash the largest Austrian column.

Battle of Holowczyn.headline: Bitka pri Holowczynu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Holowczynu (tudi Holofzin ali Golovčin) je potekala julija 1708 med rusko vojsko in švedsko vojsko pod vodstvom švedskega kralja Karla XII., ki je bil tedaj star šele 26 let. Kljub zahtevnim naravnim oviram in močnejšemu sovražnikovemu topništvu so Švedi Ruse presenetili in premagali številčnejše ruske sile, ki so bile ločene druga od druge, brez skupnega poveljstva in niso mogle usklajevati delovanja, zato se niso mogle bojevati z vso močjo. Menda je bila to Karlova najljubša zmaga.

source.title: Battle of Holowczyn
paragraphs: The Battle of Holowczyn (also spelled Holofzin or Golovchin) was fought in July 1708 between the Russian army and the Swedish army, led by Charles XII of Sweden, who was only 26 years of age at the time. Despite difficult natural obstacles and superior enemy artillery, the Swedes were able to achieve surprise and defeat the numerically superior Russian forces, who were separated from each other, had no overall command and could not coordinate their actions, disallowing them an engagement in full force. Reportedly, it was Charles' favourite victory.

Battle of Hondschoote.headline: Bitka pri Hondschootu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hondschootu je potekala med flandrijskim pohodom leta 1793 v francoskih revolucionarnih vojnah. Bojevali so se med operacijami ob obleganju Dunkerqua med 6. in 8. septembrom 1793 pri Hondschootu v departmaju Nord v Franciji, bitka pa se je končala z zmago Francozov pod vodstvom generalov Jeana Nicolasa Houcharda in Jean-Baptista Jourdana nad silami maršala Freytaga, dela anglo-hannovrskega korpusa vojvode Yorka.

source.title: Battle of Hondschoote
paragraphs: The Battle of Hondschoote took place during the Flanders Campaign of the Campaign of 1793 in the French Revolutionary Wars. It was fought during operations surrounding the siege of Dunkirk between 6 and 8 September 1793 at Hondschoote, Nord, France, and resulted in a French victory under General Jean Nicolas Houchard and General Jean-Baptiste Jourdan against the command of Marshal Freytag, part of the Anglo-Hanoverian corps of the Duke of York.

Battle of Honnecourt.headline: Bitka pri Honnecourtu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Honnecourtu je potekala 26. maja 1642 med francosko-špansko vojno v letih 1635–1659. Španska vojska pod vodstvom Francisca de Mela je porazila in večinoma uničila francoske sile pod poveljstvom grofa de Guicha.

Ker je bila večina francoskih sil vpletena v obleganje Perpignana v Kataloniji, je Melo začel ofenzivo v Artois, tedaj del Španske Nizozemske. Potem ko je v začetku maja znova zavzel Lens in La Bassée, je krenil nad Guichevo »šampanjsko armado«, ki je bila nameščena blizu Honnecourt-sur-Escauta.

Guiche je svoje čete postavil na močan položaj, a se niso mogle kosati z izkušeno flandrijsko armado: po sedmih urah boja sta obe krili razpadli. Ker jim je umik zapirala reka Šelda tik za njimi, čez katero je vodil en sam most, je bila večina Francozov ubitih ali ujetih. Guiche je bil med zadnjimi, ki so zapustili bojišče, pobegnilo pa je le 1600 njegovih vojakov.

source.title: Battle of Honnecourt
paragraphs: The Battle of Honnecourt took place on 26 May 1642, during the 1635 to 1659 Franco-Spanish War. A Spanish army led by Francisco de Melo defeated and largely destroyed a French force under the Comte de Guiche.

With the bulk of French forces committed to the Siege of Perpignan in Catalonia, Melo launched an offensive into Artois, then part of the Spanish Netherlands. After retaking Lens and La Bassée in early May, he moved to attack Guiche's "Army of Champagne", based near Honnecourt-sur-Escaut.

Guiche placed his troops in a strong position but they proved no match for the veteran Army of Flanders and both wings collapsed after seven hours of fighting. With their retreat blocked by the River Scheldt directly behind them and only one bridge, most of the French were either killed or captured. Guiche was one of the last to leave the battlefield and only 1,600 of his troops escaped.

Battle of Hostomel.headline: Bitka za Hostomel
paragraphs: Med rusko invazijo na Ukrajino je prišlo do spopada med ruskimi in ukrajinskimi oboroženimi silami za nadzor nad mestom Hostomel. V okviru ofenzive na Kijev so ruske sile skušale prevzeti nadzor nad Hostomelom, Bučo in Irpinom, da bi ukrajinsko prestolnico Kijev obkolile in oblegale z zahoda. Kijevska oblastna državna uprava je pozneje Hostomel skupaj z Irpinom, Bučo, avtocesto M06 in severnim delom Višgorodskega rajona navedla med najnevarnejšimi kraji v Kijevski oblasti.
notes: The English opens without a definition sentence; kept as in the source.

source.title: Battle of Hostomel
paragraphs: During the Russian invasion of Ukraine, a military engagement was fought for control over the town of Hostomel between the Russian and Ukrainian armed forces. As part of an offensive on Kyiv, the Russian forces sought control over Hostomel, Bucha and Irpin in order to encircle and besiege the Ukrainian capital city Kyiv from the west. The Kyiv Oblast State Administration would later name Hostomel, along with Irpin, Bucha, Highway M06, and the northern part of Vyshhorod Raion as the most dangerous places in Kyiv Oblast.

Battle of Hoyerswerda.headline: Bitka pri Hoyerswerdi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hoyerswerdi je bila manjši spopad 25. septembra 1759 med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne) med pruskimi in avstrijskimi silami. Po katastrofalnem pruskem porazu pri Kunersdorfu avgusta pa je ta majhna zmaga Friderika Velikega skupaj z zmago, ki jo je Friedrich August von Finck štiri dni prej dosegel pri Korbitzu, gotovo pravočasno okrepila njegovo krhko samozavest.

source.title: Battle of Hoyerswerda
paragraphs: The Battle of Hoyerswerda was a minor encounter of September 25, 1759 during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War) between Prussian and Austrian forces. Following on from the calamitous Prussian defeat at Kunersdorf in August however, this small victory for Frederick the Great, taken together with the one fashioned at Korbitz four days earlier by Friedrich August von Finck, no doubt proved a timely tonic to his fragile confidence.

Battle of Humin-Bolimów.headline: Bitka pri Huminu in Bolimówu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Huminu in Bolimówu je bila neodločen spopad prve svetovne vojne, ki je med 14. januarjem in 28. februarjem 1915 potekal med nemško cesarsko vojsko in Rusijo. Velja za uvod v drugo bitko pri Mazurskih jezerih.

source.title: Battle of Humin-Bolimów
paragraphs: The Battle of Humin-Bolimów was an inconclusive battle of World War I fought between January 14 and February 28, 1915 between the Imperial German Army and Russia. The battle is considered a preliminary to the Second Battle of the Masurian Lakes.

Battle of Hürtgen Forest.headline: Bitka v Hürtgenskem gozdu
paragraphs: Bitka v Hürtgenskem gozdu (nemško: Schlacht im Hürtgenwald) je bila vrsta bitk med ameriškimi in nemškimi silami na zahodni fronti druge svetovne vojne od 19. septembra do 16. decembra 1944 v Hürtgenskem gozdu, 140 km² velikem območju približno 5 km vzhodno od belgijsko-nemške meje. Trajala je 88 dni in je bila najdaljša bitka na nemških tleh v drugi svetovni vojni ter druga najdaljša posamezna bitka, v kateri se je kdaj bojevala Kopenska vojska ZDA, takoj za tri mesece dolgo bitko za Bataan.

Prvotni cilj ameriških poveljnikov je bil zadržati nemške sile na tem območju, da ne bi okrepile bojnih črt severneje v bitki za Aachen, kjer so se ameriške sile bojevale proti Siegfriedovi liniji, mreži utrjenih industrijskih mest in vasi, posejanih z bunkerji, protitankovskimi ovirami in minskimi polji. Prvotna taktična cilja Američanov sta bila zavzeti vas Schmidt in očistiti Monschau. V drugi fazi so zavezniki hoteli v okviru operacije Queen prodreti do reke Rur.
notes: The square-mile and mile figures are dropped; the metric figures are kept.

source.title: Battle of Hürtgen Forest
paragraphs: The Battle of Hürtgen Forest (German: Schlacht im Hürtgenwald) was a series of battles fought from 19 September to 16 December 1944, between American and German forces on the Western Front during World War II, in the Hürtgen Forest, a 140 km2 (54 mi2) area about 5 km (3.1 mi) east of the Belgian–German border. Lasting 88 days, it was the longest battle on German ground during World War II and it is the second longest single battle the U.S. Army has ever fought after the three-month-long Battle of Bataan.

The U.S. commanders' initial goal was to pin down German forces in the area to keep them from reinforcing the front lines farther north in the Battle of Aachen, where the US forces were fighting against the Siegfried Line network of fortified industrial towns and villages speckled with pillboxes, tank traps, and minefields. The Americans' initial tactical objectives were to take the village of Schmidt and clear Monschau. In a second phase the Allies wanted to advance to the Rur River as part of Operation Queen.

Battle of Ibera.headline: Bitka pri Iberi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Iberi, znana tudi kot bitka pri Dertosi, je potekala spomladi 215 pr. n. št. na južnem bregu reke Ebro blizu mesta Ibera in je bila del druge punske vojne. Rimska vojska pod poveljstvom bratov Gneja in Publija Scipiona je premagala podobno veliko kartažansko vojsko pod Hasdrubalom Barko. Rimljani pod Gnejem Scipionom so konec leta 218 pr. n. št. vdrli na Iberski polotok in si po zmagi v bitki pri Cissi ustvarili oporišče. To oporišče na severovzhodni iberski obali med Ebrom in Pireneji je zapiralo pot vsem okrepitvam z Iberskega polotoka za vojsko Hanibala, ki je v začetku tistega leta z Iberskega polotoka vdrl v Italijo. Hasdrubal je Rimljane skušal pregnati leta 217 pr. n. št., a se je to končalo s porazom, ko je bil kartažanski pomorski oddelek uničen v bitki pri reki Ebro.

source.title: Battle of Ibera
paragraphs: The Battle of Ibera, also known as the Battle of Dertosa, was fought in the spring of 215 BC on the south bank of the Ebro River near the town of Ibera and was part of the Second Punic War. A Roman army, under the command of the brothers Gnaeus and Publius Scipio, defeated a similarly sized Carthaginian army under Hasdrubal Barca. The Romans, under Gnaeus Scipio, had invaded Iberia in late 218 BC and established a foothold after winning the Battle of Cissa. This lodgement, on the north-east Iberian coast, between the Ebro and the Pyrenees, blocked the route of any reinforcements from Iberia for the army of Hannibal, who had invaded Italy from Iberia earlier in the year. Hasdrubal attempted to evict the Romans in 217 BC, but this ended in defeat when the Carthaginian naval contingent was mauled at the Battle of Ebro River.

Battle of Ilerda.headline: Bitka pri Ilerdi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ilerdi je potekala junija 49 pr. n. št. med silami Julija Cezarja in hispansko vojsko Pompeja Velikega, ki sta jo vodila njegova legata Lucij Afranij in Mark Petrej. V nasprotju s številnimi drugimi bitkami državljanske vojne je šlo bolj za manevrski pohod kot za prave boje. Cezarju je omogočil, da je odpravil nevarnost Pompejevih sil v Hispaniji in se s samim Pompejem spopadel v Grčiji v bitki pri Farzalu (48 pr. n. št.).

source.title: Battle of Ilerda
paragraphs: The Battle of Ilerda took place in June 49 BC between the forces of Julius Caesar and the Hispanian army of Pompey Magnus, led by his legates Lucius Afranius and Marcus Petreius. Unlike many of the other battles of the civil war, this was more a campaign of manoeuvre than actual fighting. It allowed Caesar to eliminate the threat of Pompey's forces in Hispania and face Pompey himself in Greece at the Battle of Pharsalus (48 BC).

Battle of Ilipa.headline: Bitka pri Ilipi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ilipi je bila spopad leta 206 pr. n. št. v drugi punski vojni, ki ga mnogi štejejo za najsijajnejšo zmago v vojaški karieri Scipiona Afriškega. Morda je potekala na ravnini vzhodno od kraja Alcalá del Río pri Sevilli v Španiji, blizu vasi Esquivel, kjer je bil kartažanski tabor.

Čeprav se morda ne zdi tako izvirna kot Hanibalova taktika pri Kanah, sta Scipionov manever pred bitko in njegova obrnjena formacija »Kane« vrhunec njegove taktične spretnosti: z njima je dokončno strl kartažanski nadzor in vir moči na Iberskem polotoku ter tako preprečil vsak nadaljnji kopenski vdor v Italijo in rodbini Barka odrezal bogato zaledje srebra in ljudi.

source.title: Battle of Ilipa
paragraphs: The Battle of Ilipa was an engagement considered by many as Scipio Africanus's most brilliant victory in his military career during the Second Punic War in 206 BC. It may have taken place on a plain east of Alcalá del Río, Seville, Spain, near the village of Esquivel, the site of the Carthaginian camp.

Though it may not seem to be as original as Hannibal's tactic at Cannae, Scipio's pre-battle maneuver and his reverse Cannae formation stands as the acme of his tactical ability, in which he permanently broke the Carthaginian grip and source of power in Iberia, thus denying any further land invasion into Italy and cutting off a rich base for the Barca dynasty both in silver and manpower.

Battle of Ilomantsi (1944).headline: Bitka pri Ilomantsiju (1944)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ilomantsiju (finsko: Ilomantsin taistelu) je bila del svirsko-petrozavodske ofenzive v nadaljevalni vojni (1941–1944). Potekala je od 26. julija do 13. avgusta 1944 med Finsko in Sovjetsko zvezo na območju, širokem približno 40 kilometrov in globokem 30 kilometrov, blizu finsko-sovjetske meje in finske vasi Ilomantsi v Severni Kareliji. Končala se je s finsko zmago: tu so ustavili zadnji večji sovjetski napad na Finsko.

source.title: Battle of Ilomantsi (1944)
paragraphs: The Battle of Ilomantsi (Finnish: Ilomantsin taistelu) was a part of the Svir–Petrozavodsk Offensive of the Continuation War (1941–1944). It was fought from 26 July to 13 August 1944, between Finland and the Soviet Union in an area roughly 40 kilometers wide and 30 kilometers deep, near the Finnish-Soviet border, close to the Finnish village of Ilomantsi, in North Karelia. The battle ended with a Finnish victory—the last major Soviet attack against Finland was stopped here.

Battle of Irpin.headline: Bitka za Irpin
paragraphs: V okviru ruske ofenzive na Kijev med rusko invazijo na Ukrajino je potekala bitka za nadzor nad mestom Irpin. Spopadle so se enote ruskih oboroženih sil in ukrajinske kopenske vojske. Do 28. marca 2022 so ukrajinske sile mesto znova zavzele.

Bitka je bila del širše operacije obkolitve Kijeva, ukrajinske prestolnice. Ukrajinske sile so se ruskemu napredovanju upirale v zahodnih predmestjih prestolnice, Irpinu, Buči in Hostomelu. Bitko so zaznamovali srditi ulični boji. Skoraj 70 % mesta je bilo zaradi tega hudo poškodovanega ali uničenega.

source.title: Battle of Irpin
paragraphs: As part of the Russian offensive on Kyiv during the Russian invasion of Ukraine, a battle took place for control of the city of Irpin. The combatants were elements of the Russian Armed Forces and Ukrainian Ground Forces. By 28 March 2022, Ukrainian forces recaptured the city.

The battle was part of a larger operation to encircle Kyiv, the capital city of Ukraine. The Ukrainian forces resisted the Russian advance in the capital's western suburbs of Irpin, Bucha, and Hostomel. The battle was marked by fierce urban fighting. Nearly 70% of the city was heavily damaged or destroyed as a result.

Ruska vojska je 24. februarja 2022 v okviru ruske invazije na Ukrajino prestopila rusko-ukrajinsko in belorusko-ukrajinsko mejo ter vdrla na sever Ukrajine, v Kijevsko, Černigovsko, Sumsko in Žitomirsko oblast. Ruske operacije na severu Ukrajine so se sprva začele kot poskus zavzetja Kijeva, ukrajinske prestolnice in sedeža ukrajinske vlade.

Ruske sile so sprva zavzele več mest, vendar so njihovo napredovanje ustavili logistične in oskrbovalne težave, trdovraten ukrajinski odpor in slaba morala. Ker so imele velike izgube in niso mogle več napredovati, je Rusija konec marca in v začetku aprila 2022 umaknila svoje sile iz Kijevske, Žitomirske, Černigovske in Sumske oblasti, nadzor pa so znova prevzele ukrajinske sile.
notes: The record's article now leads to the summary of the northern Ukraine campaign, which does not mention Ivankiv; translated as it stands.

source.title: Northern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine
paragraphs: On 24 February 2022, as part of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, the Russian military crossed the Russia–Ukraine and Belarus–Ukraine borders into northern Ukraine, entering the oblasts (regions) of Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, and Zhytomyr. The Russian operations in northern Ukraine were initially launched as an attempt to capture Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine and the seat of the Ukrainian government.

Russian forces initially captured several towns and cities, but logistical and supply failures, stiff Ukrainian resistance, and poor morale caused their advance to stall. With heavy losses and the inability to make further progress, Russia withdrew its forces from Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv and Sumy oblasts in late March and early April 2022, and Ukrainian forces retook control.

Battle of Izium (2022).headline: Bitka za Izjum (2022)
paragraphs: Na vzhodni fronti ruske invazije na Ukrajino se je marca 2022 začel spopad med ruskimi in ukrajinskimi silami za nadzor nad mestom Izjum, pomembnim prometnim vozliščem. Ruska vojska je hotela zavzeti Izjum, da bi se njene sile v Harkovski oblasti povezale s četami v Donbasu.
notes: The English first sentence has two main verbs ("began … took place"); the Slovenian keeps one.

source.title: Battle of Izium
paragraphs: On the eastern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine, a military engagement began in March 2022 between Russian and Ukrainian forces took place for control over the city of Izium, an important transportation node. The Russian military wanted to capture Izium so its forces in Kharkiv Oblast could link up with their troops in the Donbas region.

Battle of Jankau.headline: Bitka pri Jankovu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jankovu (Jankau) je potekala 6. marca 1645 v poznejših fazah tridesetletne vojne blizu Jankova na Češkem (danes Češka republika). Spopadli sta se švedska in cesarska vojska, vsaka s približno 16.000 možmi.

Bolj gibljivi in bolje vodeni Švedi pod vodstvom Lennarta Torstenssona so nasprotnike pod poveljstvom Melchiorja von Hatzfeldta tako rekoč uničili. Zaradi opustošenja po desetletjih vojne pa so vojske tedaj večino časa porabile za oskrbo, zato Švedi zmage niso mogli izkoristiti.

Cesarske sile so leta 1646 znova prevzele nadzor nad Češko, a neodločni pohodi v Porenju in na Saškem so pokazali, da nobena stran nima dovolj moči za vojaško rešitev. Čeprav so se boji nadaljevali, ker so udeleženci skušali izboljšati svoj položaj, je to povečalo nujnost pogajanj, ki so se končala z vestfalskim mirom leta 1648.

source.title: Battle of Jankau
paragraphs: The Battle of Jankau, took place on 6 March 1645 during the later stages of the Thirty Years' War, near Jankov in Bohemia (today the Czech Republic). It featured Swedish and Imperial armies, each containing around 16,000 men.

The more mobile and better led Swedes under Lennart Torstensson effectively destroyed their opponents, commanded by Melchior von Hatzfeldt. However, the devastation caused by decades of conflict meant armies now spent much of their time obtaining supplies, and the Swedes were unable to take advantage of their victory.

Imperial forces regained control of Bohemia in 1646, but inconclusive campaigns in the Rhineland and Saxony made it clear neither side had the strength to impose a military solution. Although fighting continued as participants tried to improve their positions, it increased the urgency of negotiations which culminated in the 1648 Peace of Westphalia.

Battle of Jarama.headline: Bitka pri Jarami
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jarami (6.–27. februarja 1937) je bila poskus nacionalistov generala Francisca Franca, da bi v španski državljanski vojni pregnali republikance z njihovih položajev ob reki Jarama tik vzhodno od Madrida. Elitni španski legionarji in maroški regulares iz Afriške armade so potisnili nazaj republikansko armado centra, vključno z mednarodnimi brigadami, a po več dneh hudih bojev preboja niso dosegli. Tudi republikanski protinapadi na izgubljenem ozemlju so spodleteli, obe strani pa sta utrpeli hude izgube.

source.title: Battle of Jarama
paragraphs: The Battle of Jarama (6–27 February 1937) was an attempt by General Francisco Franco's Nationalists to dislodge the Republican lines along the river Jarama, just east of Madrid, during the Spanish Civil War. Elite Spanish Legionnaires and Moroccan Regulares from the Army of Africa forced back the Republican Army of the Centre, including the International Brigades, but after days of fierce fighting no breakthrough was achieved. Republican counterattacks along the captured ground likewise failed, resulting in heavy casualties to both sides.

Bitka pri Jargeauju je potekala 11. in 12. junija 1429. Bila je del pohoda ob Loari med stoletno vojno, v katerem so sile francoskega kralja Karla VII. po zmagi pri obleganju Orléansa znova zavzele velik del pokrajine. Bitka se je končala z zmago Karla VII. in je znana kot prva napadalna bitka Ivane Orleanske.

source.title: Battle of Jargeau
paragraphs: The Battle of Jargeau took place on 11–12 June 1429. It was part of the Loire Campaign during the Hundred Years' War, where the forces of Charles VII of France successfully recaptured much of the region, following their victory at the Siege of Orléans. The battle ended in victory for Charles VII and is notable as Joan of Arc's first offensive battle.

Battle of Jemappes.headline: Bitka pri Jemappesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jemappesu (6. novembra 1792) je potekala blizu mesta Jemappes v Hainautu na Avstrijski Nizozemski (danes Belgija), v bližini Monsa, med vojno prve koalicije, delom francoskih revolucionarnih vojn. Bila je ena prvih velikih napadalnih bitk vojne in zmaga vojsk mlade Francoske republike: francoska Severna armada, v kateri je bilo veliko neizkušenih prostovoljcev, je premagala precej manjšo redno avstrijsko vojsko.

General Charles François Dumouriez, poveljnik vojske francoskih revolucionarnih prostovoljcev, se je spoprijel s cesarsko vojsko feldmaršala vojvode Alberta Saško-Tešinskega in njegovega namestnika Françoisa de Croixa, grofa Clerfayta. Francozi, ki so imeli približno trikratno premoč, so na avstrijski položaj na slemenu sprožili vrsto zagnanih, a neusklajenih napadov. Nazadnje so zavzeli del slemena in Avstrijci jih niso mogli pregnati. Vojvoda Saško-Tešinski je priznal poraz in ukazal umik.

source.title: Battle of Jemappes
paragraphs: The Battle of Jemappes (6 November 1792) took place near the town of Jemappes in Hainaut, Austrian Netherlands (now Belgium), near Mons during the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. One of the first major offensive battles of the war, it was a victory for the armies of the infant French Republic, and saw the French Armée du Nord, which included many inexperienced volunteers, defeat a substantially smaller regular Austrian army.

General Charles François Dumouriez, in command of an army of French Revolutionary volunteers, faced the Imperial army of Field Marshal Duke Albert of Saxe-Teschen and his second-in-command François de Croix, Count of Clerfayt. The French, who outnumbered their opponents by about three-to-one, launched a series of enthusiastic but uncoordinated attacks against the Austrian position on a ridge. At length, the French seized a portion of the ridge and the Austrians were unable to drive them away. Saxe-Teschen conceded defeat by ordering a withdrawal.

Battle of Jemmingen.headline: Bitka pri Jemmingnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jemmingnu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Jemgumu) je potekala 21. julija 1568 pri Jemgumu v Vzhodni Friziji, danes v Nemčiji. Po bitki pri Heiligerleeju nizozemskemu uporniškemu voditelju Ludviku Nassauskemu (bratu Viljema Molčečega) ni uspelo zavzeti mesta Groningen; Fernando Álvarez de Toledo, vojvoda Albe, ga je pregnal in ga pri Jemmingnu porazil.

source.title: Battle of Jemmingen
paragraphs: After the Battle of Heiligerlee, the Dutch rebel leader Louis of Nassau (brother of William the Silent) failed to capture the city of Groningen. Louis was driven away by Fernando Álvarez de Toledo, Duke of Alba and defeated at the Battle of Jemmingen (also known as Battle of Jemgum, at Jemgum in East Frisia, now part of Germany) on 21 July 1568.

Battle of Kagul.headline: Bitka pri Kagulu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kagulu ali Cahulu (rusko: Сражение при Кагуле, dobesedno »bitka ob Kagulu«; turško: Kartal Ovası Muharebesi, dobesedno »bitka na Orlovi planjavi«) je potekala 1. avgusta 1770 (21. julija 1770 po julijanskem koledarju) med rusko-turško vojno 1768–1774. Bila je odločilna in najpomembnejša kopenska bitka te vojne in ena največjih bitk 18. stoletja. Potekala je v Moldaviji blizu vasi Frumoasa (danes Cahul v Moldaviji), skoraj mesec dni po ruski zmagi pri Largi.

Vojska Osmanov in njihovih krimskotatarskih vazalov je bila precej številčnejša od ruske, toda ruski poveljnik feldmaršal Pjotr Rumjancev je svojo veliko manjšo vojsko spretno razvrstil v trdne pehotne kvadrate in se presenetljivo odločil za napad na zavezniške sile. Pri tem mu je pomagalo izvrstno usklajeno in hitro streljanje ruskega topništva, ki je osmansko topništvo učinkovito onesposobilo in v veliki meri izničilo številčno premoč osmanske vojske. Izid je bila odločilna ruska zmaga.

source.title: Battle of Kagul
paragraphs: The Battle of Kagul or Cahul (Russian: Сражение при Кагуле, lit. 'Battle of the Kagul', Turkish: Kartal Ovası Muharebesi, lit. 'Battle of the Eagle Plain') occurred on 1 August 1770 (21 July 1770 in Julian Calendar) during the Russo-Turkish War of 1768–1774. It was the decisive and most important land battle of the war and one of the largest battles of the 18th century. It was fought in Moldavia, near the village of Frumoasa (now Cahul, Moldova), nearly a month after the Russian victory at Larga.

While the army of the Ottomans and its Crimean Tatar vassals greatly outnumbered the Russian force opposite them, the Russian commander, Field Marshal Pyotr Rumyantsev, deftly arranged his far smaller army in solid infantry squares and surprisingly chose to go on the offensive against the allied forces. Assisting it was the superb coordination and firing rapidity of the Russian artillery, which effectively neutralized the Ottoman artillery and largely negated the numerical superiority of the Ottoman army. The result was a decisive Russian victory.

Battle of Karánsebes.headline: Bitka pri Karánsebesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Karánsebesu (turško: Şebeş Muharebesi; nemško: Rückzug von Karánsebes; madžarsko: Karánsebesi csata; romunsko: Bătălia de la Caransebeș) je bila v resnici streljanje na lastne vojake v avstrijski vojski v noči z 21. na 22. september 1788, med avstrijsko-turško vojno 1788–1791. Nekateri zgodovinarji so jo označili za »najhujši primer streljanja na lastne vojake v zgodovini«.

source.title: Battle of Karánsebes
paragraphs: The Battle of Karánsebes (Turkish: Şebeş Muharebesi; German: Rückzug von Karánsebes; Hungarian: Karánsebesi csata; Romanian: Bătălia de la Caransebeș) was a friendly fire incident in the Austrian army, occurring during the night of 21–22 September 1788, during the Austro-Turkish War of 1788–1791. Some historians have referred to the battle as "history's worst friendly fire incident".

Battle of Kay.headline: Bitka pri Kayu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kayu (nemško: Schlacht bei Kay), imenovana tudi bitka pri Sulechówu, Züllichauu ali Paltzigu, je bila spopad 23. julija 1759 med sedemletno vojno. Potekala je blizu Kaya (Kije) v Novi marki, danes na Poljskem.

General Carl Heinrich von Wedel, poveljnik pruske vojske s 26.000–28.000 možmi, je napadel večjo rusko vojsko s 40.000–41.000 možmi pod poveljstvom grofa Petra Saltikova. Prusi so izgubili okoli 7669 mož, Rusi pa približno 4804. Po bitki se je pruski kralj Friderik II. odločil, da bo Ruse prisilil v odločilen spopad, da se ne bi združili z glavno avstrijsko vojsko. Tri tedne pozneje so se Prusi pri Kunersdorfu spopadli z združeno rusko-avstrijsko vojsko.

source.title: Battle of Kay
paragraphs: The Battle of Kay (German: Schlacht bei Kay), also referred to as the Battle of Sulechów, Battle of Züllichau, or Battle of Paltzig, was an engagement fought on 23 July 1759 during the Seven Years' War. It occurred near Kay (Kije) in the Neumark, now part of Poland.

General Carl Heinrich von Wedel, the commander of the Prussian army of 26,000–28,000 men, attacked a larger Russian army of 40,000–41,000 men commanded by Count Pyotr Saltykov. The Prussians lost in the region of 7,669 men; the Russians lost around 4,804. After the battle, King Frederick II of Prussia was determined to force the Russians into a decisive engagement in order to prevent them joining up with the main Austrian army. Three weeks later, the Prussians met the combined Russian-Austrian army at Kunersdorf.

Battle of Kaymakchalan.headline: Bitka za Kajmakčalan
paragraphs: Bitka za Kajmakčalan je potekala med srbskimi in bolgarskimi četami na makedonski fronti v prvi svetovni vojni.

Bojevali so se od 12. do 30. septembra 1916; srbska vojska je zavzela vrh Preroka Elije in Bolgare potiskala proti kraju Mariovo, kjer so ti postavili nove obrambne črte. Med 26. in 30. septembrom je vrh večkrat zamenjal lastnika, dokler ga srbska vojska 30. septembra ni dokončno zavzela.

Bitka je bila za obe strani zelo draga. Srbske izgube so do 23. septembra dosegle okoli 10.000 mrtvih in ranjenih. Bolgarske čete so se skrčile na po 90 mož, en polk, 11. slivenski, pa je imel 73 častnikov in 3000 vojakov izven boja.

source.title: Battle of Kaymakchalan
paragraphs: The Battle of Kaymakchalan was fought between Serbian and Bulgarian troops on the Macedonian front during World War I.

The battle was fought between 12 and 30 September 1916, when the Serbian army managed to capture the peak of Prophet Elijah while pushing the Bulgarians towards the town of Mariovo, where the latter formed new defensive lines. Between 26 and 30 September, the peak changed hands several times until the Serbian army decisively captured it on the 30th.

The battle proved to be very costly for both sides. Serbian losses had reached around 10,000 killed and wounded by 23 September. The Bulgarian companies had been reduced to 90 men each, and one regiment, the 11th Sliven Regiment, had 73 officers and 3,000 men hors de combat.

Battle of Kerch Strait (1790).headline: Bitka v Kerškem prelivu (1790)
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka v Kerškem prelivu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Jenikaleju, po starem turškem imenu preliva pri Kerču) je potekala 19. julija 1790 blizu Kerča na Krimu in se končala z zmago cesarske Rusije nad Osmanskim cesarstvom v rusko-turški vojni 1787–1792.

source.title: Battle of Kerch Strait (1790)
paragraphs: The naval Battle of (the) Kerch Strait (also known as Battle of Yenikale, by the old Turkish name of the strait near Kerch) took place on 19 July 1790 near Kerch, Crimea, was a victory for Imperial Russia over the Ottoman Empire during the Russo-Turkish War, 1787-1792.

Battle of Keresztes.headline: Bitka pri Keresztesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Keresztesu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Mezőkeresztesu; turško: Haçova Muharebesi) je potekala 24.–26. oktobra 1596. V njej so se združene habsburško-transilvanske sile spopadle z Osmanskim cesarstvom blizu vasi Mezőkeresztes (turško: Haçova) na severu današnje Madžarske. Osmani so vojsko pod habsburškim vodstvom razbili, a zaradi lastnih izgub zmage niso mogli izkoristiti.

source.title: Battle of Keresztes
paragraphs: The Battle of Keresztes (also known as the Battle of Mezőkeresztes) (Turkish: Haçova Muharebesi) took place on 24–26 October 1596. It was fought between a combined Habsburg-Transylvanian force and the Ottoman Empire near the village of Mezőkeresztes (Turkish: Haçova) in modern-day northern Hungary. The Ottomans routed the Habsburg-led army, but due to their own losses, they were unable to exploit their victory.

Battle of Kesselsdorf.headline: Bitka pri Kesselsdorfu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kesselsdorfu je potekala 15. decembra 1745 med Kraljevino Prusijo ter združenimi silami Avstrijske nadvojvodine in Saške volilne kneževine v delu vojne za avstrijsko nasledstvo, znanem kot druga šlezijska vojna. Pruse je vodil Leopold I., knez Anhalt-Dessaua, Avstrijce in Saše pa feldmaršal Rutowsky. Prusi so zmagali nad kraljevo saško vojsko in cesarsko vojsko cesarja Svetega rimskega cesarstva.

source.title: Battle of Kesselsdorf
paragraphs: The Battle of Kesselsdorf was fought on 15 December 1745, between the Kingdom of Prussia and the combined forces of the Archduchy of Austria and the Electorate of Saxony during the part of the War of the Austrian Succession known as the Second Silesian War. The Prussians were led by Leopold I, Prince of Anhalt-Dessau, while the Austrians and Saxons were led by Field Marshal Rutowsky. The Prussians were victorious over the Royal Saxon Army and the Imperial Army of the Holy Roman Emperor.

Battle of Khotyn (1673).headline: Bitka pri Hotinu (1673)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hotinu ali Chocimu, znana tudi kot hotinska vojna, je potekala 11. novembra 1673 pri Hotinu, kjer so sile Poljsko-litovske republike pod vodstvom velikega kronskega hetmana Jana Sobieskega premagale sile Osmanskega cesarstva z moldavskimi in vlaškimi polki pod vodstvom Hüseyin-paše. Zmaga je obrnila potek prejšnjega leta, ko je šibkost republike pripeljala do miru v Bučaču, in Janu Sobieskemu omogočila, da je zmagal na bližnjih kraljevih volitvah in postal poljski kralj.

source.title: Battle of Khotyn (1673)
paragraphs: The Battle of Khotyn or Battle of Chocim, also known as the Hotin War, took place on 11 November 1673 in Khotyn, where the forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth under the Grand Hetman of the Polish Crown John Sobieski defeated Ottoman Empire forces, with Moldavian and Wallachian regiments, led by Hüseyin Pasha. It reversed the fortunes of the previous year, when Commonwealth weakness led to the signing of the Treaty of Buchach, and allowed John Sobieski to win the upcoming royal election and become the King of Poland.

Battle of Kiev (1918).headline: Bitka za Kijev (1918)
paragraphs: Bitka za Kijev februarja (po starem koledarju januarja) 1918 je bila boljševiška vojaška operacija petrograjskih in moskovskih enot rdeče garde, s katero so hoteli zavzeti ukrajinsko prestolnico. Operacijo je vodil poveljnik rdeče garde Mihail Artemjevič Muravjov v okviru sovjetskih ekspedicijskih sil proti Kaledinu in ukrajinski Centralni radi. Naskok na Kijev je potekal od 5. do 8. februarja 1918 (od 23. do 26. januarja po julijanskem koledarju), med mirovnimi pogajanji v Brest-Litovsku. Operacija se je končala 9. februarja z boljševiško zasedbo mesta in umikom ukrajinske vlade v Žitomir.

source.title: Battle of Kiev (1918)
paragraphs: The Battle of Kiev of February (O.S. January) 1918 was a Bolshevik military operation of Petrograd and Moscow Red Guard formations directed to capture the capital of Ukraine. The operation was led by Red Guards commander Mikhail Artemyevich Muravyov as part of the Soviet expeditionary force against Kaledin and the Central Council of Ukraine. The storming of Kiev took place during the ongoing peace negotiations at Brest-Litovsk on 5–8 February 1918 (23–26 January in the Julian calendar). The operation resulted in the occupation of the city by Bolshevik troops on 9 February and the evacuation of the Ukrainian government to Zhytomyr.

Prva bitka za Kijev ali kijevska operacija, na nemški strani znana kot bitka pri Kijevu (nemško: Schlacht bei Kiew), je bila velika bitka druge svetovne vojne, v kateri so bile sovjetske čete obkoljene v okolici Kijeva, prestolnice in najbolj naseljenega mesta Ukrajinske sovjetske socialistične republike. Po številu vojakov je to največja obkolitev v zgodovini vojskovanja. Bitka je trajala od 7. julija do 26. septembra 1941 in je bila del operacije Barbarossa, invazije sil osi na Sovjetsko zvezo. Čeprav je znana kot »bitka za Kijev«, je imelo mesto v celotni bitki le obrobno vlogo; za Sovjete je bila to strateška obrambna operacija. Bitka je potekala na velikem območju vzhodne Ukrajine, Kijev pa je bil žarišče sovjetske obrambe in nemške obkolitve.

source.title: Battle of Kiev (1941)
paragraphs: The First Battle of Kiev or Kiev operation, known as the Battle of Kiev on the German side (German: Schlacht bei Kiew), was a major battle that resulted in an encirclement of Soviet troops in the vicinity of Kiev during World War II, the capital and most populous city of the Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic. This encirclement is the largest in the history of warfare by number of troops. The battle lasted from 7 July to 26 September 1941 as part of Operation Barbarossa, the Axis invasion of the Soviet Union. Although it is known as the "Battle of Kiev", the city played only a peripheral role in the overall battle; for the Soviets, a strategic defensive operation. The battle took place over a large area in eastern Ukraine, with Kiev being the focal point of Soviet defenses and of the German encirclement.

Battle of Kiev (1943).headline: Bitka za Kijev (1943)
paragraphs: Druga bitka za Kijev, na nemški strani znana kot obrambna bitka na območju Kijeva in Žitomirja (nemško: Abwehrschlacht im Raum Kiew-Shitomir), je bila del precej širše sovjetske ofenzive v Ukrajini, imenovane bitka za Dneper; obsegala je tri strateške operacije sovjetske Rdeče armade in njenih češkoslovaških enot ter en operativni protinapad Wehrmachta in je potekala med 4. novembrom in 22. decembrom 1943.

Po bitki pri Kursku je Rdeča armada začela belgorodsko-harkovsko ofenzivno operacijo in skupino armad Jug (Erich von Manstein) potisnila nazaj proti Dnepru. Stavka, sovjetsko vrhovno poveljstvo, je centralni in voroneški fronti ukazala, naj si izborita prehode čez Dneper. Ko je oktobra poskus prečkanja Dnepra spodletel, je nalogo prevzela 1. ukrajinska fronta (Nikolaj Vatutin) z nekaj podpore 2. ukrajinske fronte. Fronti je uspelo zavzeti mostišči severno in južno od Kijeva.

source.title: Battle of Kiev (1943)
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Kiev, known on the German side as the Defensive battle in the Kiev-Zhitomir area (German: Abwehrschlacht im Raum Kiew-Shitomir), was a part of a much wider Soviet offensive in Ukraine known as the Battle of the Dnieper involving three strategic operations by the Soviet Red Army and its Czechoslovak units and one operational counterattack by the Wehrmacht, which took place between 4 November and 22 December 1943.

Following the Battle of Kursk, the Red Army launched the Belgorod-Kharkov Offensive Operation, pushing Army Group South (Erich von Manstein) back towards the Dnieper River. Stavka, the Soviet high command, ordered the Central Front and the Voronezh Front to force crossings of the Dnieper. When the attempt to cross the Dnieper failed in October, the effort was handed to the 1st Ukrainian Front (Nikolai Vatutin) with some support from the 2nd Ukrainian Front. The 1st Ukrainian Front was able to secure bridgeheads north and south of Kiev.

Battle of Killiecrankie.headline: Bitka pri Killiecrankieju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Killiecrankieju je potekala 27. julija 1689 med jakobitskim uporom leta 1689. Jakobitske sile pod vodstvom Ewana Camerona iz Lochiela in vikonta Dundeeja so premagale vojsko škotske vlade pod poveljstvom generalporočnika Hugha Mackaya. Jakob VII. je decembra 1688 odšel v izgnanstvo, potem ko ga je na Škotskem odstavila slavna revolucija. Marca 1689 je začel viljemovsko vojno na Irskem, hkrati pa je izbruhnil upor pod vodstvom Dundeeja, pred tem njegovega vojaškega poveljnika na Škotskem.

Čeprav so bili jakobiti v manjšini in jim je primanjkovalo zalog, so njihovi poveljniki upali, da jim bo odločilna zmaga prinesla širšo podporo. Zmago so sicer dosegli, a je njihova vojska utrpela hude izgube, Dundee pa je padel v zadnjih trenutkih bitke. Jakobiti zato uspeha niso mogli izkoristiti.

source.title: Battle of Killiecrankie
paragraphs: The Battle of Killiecrankie was fought on 27 July 1689 during the Jacobite rising of 1689. A Jacobite force led by Ewan Cameron of Lochiel and Viscount Dundee defeated a Scottish government army commanded by Lieutenant-general Hugh Mackay. James VII went into exile in December 1688 after being deposed by the Glorious Revolution in Scotland. In March 1689, he began the Williamite War in Ireland, with a simultaneous revolt led by Dundee, previously his military commander in Scotland.

Despite being outnumbered and short of supplies, the Jacobite commanders hoped a decisive victory would bring them wider support. Although this was achieved, their army suffered heavy casualties, and Dundee was killed in the final moments. As a result, the Jacobites were unable to capitalise on their success.

Battle of Kinburn (1855).headline: Bitka pri Kinburnu (1855)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kinburnu, kombiniran kopenski in pomorski spopad v zadnji fazi krimske vojne, je potekala 17. oktobra 1855 na konici Kinburnskega polotoka (na južni obali dnepro-buškega limana v današnji Ukrajini). Združeno ladjevje francoske vojne mornarice in britanske kraljeve vojne mornarice je obstreljevalo ruske obalne utrdbe, potem ko jih je oblegala angleško-francoska kopenska vojska. Glavni napad so izvedle tri francoske oklepne baterije, ki so v približno treh urah uničile glavno rusko trdnjavo.

Bitka je bila strateško nepomembna in na izid vojne ni vplivala, je pa znana po prvi bojni uporabi sodobnih oklepnih vojnih ladij. Čeprav so jih pogosto zadeli, so francoske ladje ruske utrdbe uničile v treh urah in pri tem utrpele zanemarljive izgube. Bitka je tedanje mornarice prepričala, da so začele načrtovati in graditi nove velike vojne ladje z oklepom; to je sprožilo pomorsko oboroževalno tekmo med Francijo in Britanijo, ki je trajala več kot desetletje.

source.title: Battle of Kinburn (1855)
paragraphs: The Battle of Kinburn, a combined land-naval engagement during the final stage of the Crimean War, took place on the tip of the Kinburn Peninsula (on the south shore of the Dnieper–Bug estuary in what is now Ukraine) on 17 October 1855. During the battle a combined fleet of vessels from the French Navy and the British Royal Navy bombarded Russian coastal fortifications after an Anglo-French ground force had besieged them. Three French ironclad batteries carried out the main attack, which saw the main Russian fortress destroyed in an action that lasted about three hours.

The battle, although strategically insignificant with little effect on the outcome of the war, is notable for the first use of modern ironclad warships in action. Although frequently hit, the French ships destroyed the Russian forts within three hours, suffering minimal casualties in the process. This battle convinced contemporary navies to design and build new major warships with armour plating; this instigated a naval arms race between France and Britain lasting over a decade.

Battle of Kliszów.headline: Bitka pri Kliszówu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kliszówu (tudi Klissow ali Klezow) je potekala 19. julija 1702 blizu vasi Kliszów v Republiki obeh narodov med veliko severno vojno. Švedska vojska pod poveljstvom švedskega kralja Karla XII. je premagala dvakrat večjo poljsko-saško vojsko, ki jo je vodil kralj Avgust II. Močni.

V drugem letu vojne je Karel po švedskih zmagah pri Narvi in Dvini začel pohod proti Republiki obeh narodov. Maja 1702 je zavzel Varšavo, prestolnico republike, kjer je izvedel, da Avgust v Krakovu zbira veliko saško vojsko. Karel se je odločil Avgusta zasledovati in poklical švedske okrepitve. Do julija je bil Karel po manjših spopadih in prihodu okrepitev pripravljen napasti Avgustovo vojsko, ki je zavzela močan obrambni položaj pri Kliszówu.

source.title: Battle of Kliszów
paragraphs: The Battle of Kliszów (also spelled Klissow or Klezow) took place on 19 July 1702, near the village of Kliszów in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth during the Great Northern War. A Swedish army under the command of King Charles XII of Sweden defeated a Polish–Saxon army twice the size that was led by King Augustus II the Strong.

During the second year of the war, following Swedish victories at Narva and Düna, Charles launched a campaign against the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. In May 1702, Charles captured Warsaw, the Commonwealth's capital, where he received intelligence that Augustus was assembling a large Saxon army in Kraków. Charles chose to pursue Augustus and called for Swedish reinforcements. By July, after minor skirmishes and the arrival of his reinforcements, Charles was ready to attack Augustus's army, which had taken up a strong defensive position at Kliszów.

Battle of Kloster Kampen.headline: Bitka pri Kloster Kampnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kloster Kampnu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Kloster Kampu ali bitka pri Campnu) je bila francoska zmaga nad anglo-nemško vojsko med sedemletno vojno. Zavezniške sile so bile pregnane z bojišča.

source.title: Battle of Kloster Kampen
paragraphs: The Battle of Kloster Kampen (also known as the Battle of Kloster Kamp or Battle of Campen) was a French victory over an Anglo-German army during the Seven Years' War. The Allied forces were driven from the field.

Battle of Klushino.headline: Bitka pri Klušinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Klušinu ali Kłuszynu je potekala 4. julija 1610 med silami Poljsko-litovske republike in Ruskega carstva v poljsko-ruski vojni, ki je bila del ruske dobe velikih nemirov (smute). Bojevali so se blizu vasi Klušino (poljsko: Kłuszyn) pri Smolensku (poljsko: Smoleńsk). Številčno šibkejša poljsko-litovska vojska je dosegla odločilno zmago nad Rusijo zaradi taktične spretnosti hetmana Stanisława Żółkiewskega in vojaške sposobnosti poljskih husarjev, elite vojske krone Kraljevine Poljske. Bitka velja za eno največjih zmag poljske konjenice in zgled odličnosti in premoči tedanje poljske vojske.

source.title: Battle of Klushino
paragraphs: The Battle of Klushino, or the Battle of Kłuszyn, was fought on 4 July 1610, between forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Tsardom of Russia during the Polish–Russian War, part of Russia's Time of Troubles. The battle occurred near the village of Klushino (Polish: Kłuszyn) near Smolensk (Polish: Smoleńsk). In the battle the outnumbered Polish-Lithuanian force secured a decisive victory over Russia, due to the tactical competence of hetman Stanisław Żółkiewski and the military prowess of Polish hussars, the elite of the army of the Crown of the Kingdom of Poland. The battle is remembered as one of the greatest triumphs of the Polish cavalry and an example of excellence and supremacy of the Polish military at the time.

Battle of Kock (1939).headline: Bitka pri Kocku (1939)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kocku je bila zadnja bitka invazije na Poljsko na začetku druge svetovne vojne v Evropi. Potekala je od 2. do 5. oktobra 1939 blizu mesta Kock na Poljskem. Samostojna operativna skupina Polesje pod vodstvom generala Franciszka Kleeberga se je bojevala proti nemškemu XIV. motoriziranemu korpusu, ki ga je vodil general Gustav Anton von Wietersheim.

source.title: Battle of Kock (1939)
paragraphs: The Battle of Kock was the final battle in the invasion of Poland at the beginning of World War II in Europe. It took place from 2 to 5 October 1939, near the town of Kock in Poland. The Independent Operational Group Polesie, led by General Franciszek Kleeberg, fought the German XIV Motorized Corps, which was led by General Gustav Anton von Wietersheim.

Battle of Kollaa.headline: Bitka pri Kollai
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kollai je potekala od 7. decembra 1939 do 13. marca 1940 v Ladoški Kareliji na Finskem v okviru sovjetsko-finske zimske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Kollaa
paragraphs: The Battle of Kollaa was fought from 7 December 1939 to 13 March 1940 in Ladoga Karelia, Finland, as a part of the Soviet-Finnish Winter War.

Battle of Komarów.headline: Bitka pri Komarówu (1920)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Komarówu ali bitka v zamośćskem obroču je bila eden najpomembnejših spopadov poljsko-sovjetske vojne. Potekala je med 20. avgustom in 2. septembrom 1920 blizu vasi Komarowo (danes Komarów) pri Zamośću. Bila je zadnja velika bitka v Evropi, v kateri so konjenico uporabili kot konjenico, ne kot pehoto na konjih.

Bitka se je končala s katastrofo za sovjetsko 1. konjeniško armado, ki je utrpela hude izgube in se je komaj izognila obkolitvi in uničenju. Po bitki se je morala 1. konjeniške armade sesula in ta ni bila več učinkovita bojna sila.

source.title: Battle of Komarów
paragraphs: The Battle of Komarów, or the Battle of Zamość Ring, was one of the most important engagements of the Polish-Soviet War. It took place between 20 August and 2 September 1920, near the village of Komarowo (now Komarów) near Zamość. It was the last large battle in Europe in which cavalry was used as such and not as mounted infantry.

The battle ended in a disaster for the Soviet 1st Cavalry Army, which sustained heavy casualties and barely avoided being surrounded and destroyed. After the battle, the morale of the 1st Cavalry Army collapsed, and it no longer remained an effective fighting force.

Battle of Komarów (1914).headline: Bitka pri Komarówu (1914)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Komarówu (v Rusiji znana kot bitka pri Tomaszówu) je potekala na vzhodni fronti prve svetovne vojne. Končala se je z zmago avstro-ogrskih sil, ki pa je v naslednjih mesecih vojne niso mogle ponoviti.

source.title: Battle of Komarów (1914)
paragraphs: The Battle of Komarow (known in Russia as the Battle of Tomaszów) was a battle on the Eastern Front during World War I. It would prove a victory for the Austro-Hungarian forces, but one they would not be able to reproduce in the coming months of the war.

Battle of Königgrätz.headline: Bitka pri Königgrätzu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Königgrätzu ali bitka pri Sadovi (češko: Bitva u Hradce Králové) je bila odločilna bitka avstrijsko-pruske vojne, v kateri je Kraljevina Prusija premagala Avstrijsko cesarstvo. Potekala je 3. julija 1866 blizu češkega mesta Hradec Králové (nemško: Königgrätz) in vasi Sadová, danes v Češki republiki. Bila je največja posamezna bitka vojne in največja bitka na svetu po bitki pri Leipzigu leta 1813.

source.title: Battle of Königgrätz
paragraphs: The Battle of Königgrätz (or Battle of Sadová; Czech: Bitva u Hradce Králové) was the decisive battle of the Austro-Prussian War in which the Kingdom of Prussia defeated the Austrian Empire. It took place on 3 July 1866, near the Bohemian city of Hradec Králové (German: Königgrätz) and village of Sadová, now in the Czech Republic. It was the single largest battle of the war, and the largest battle in the world since the Battle of Leipzig in 1813.

Bitka za Königsberg, znana tudi kot königsberška ofenziva, je bila ena zadnjih operacij vzhodnopruske ofenzive med drugo svetovno vojno. Sovjetske sile 1. baltske in 3. beloruske fronte so v štirih dneh uličnih bojev zavzele mesto Königsberg, današnji Kaliningrad v Rusiji. Obleganje se je začelo konec januarja 1945, ko so Sovjeti mesto prvič obkolili. Hudi boji so potekali za nadzor nad kopensko povezavo med Königsbergom in pristaniščem Pillau, toda do marca 1945 je bil Königsberg že več sto kilometrov za glavno frontno črto na vzhodni fronti. Bitka se je končala 9. aprila, ko se je nemška posadka predala Sovjetom, potem ko je tridnevni naskok njen položaj naredil nevzdržen.

source.title: Battle of Königsberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Königsberg, also known as the Königsberg offensive, was one of the last operations of the East Prussian offensive during World War II. In four days of urban warfare, Soviet forces of the 1st Baltic Front and the 3rd Belorussian Front captured the city of Königsberg, present day Kaliningrad, Russia. The siege started in late January 1945 when the Soviets initially surrounded the city. Heavy fighting took place for control of overland connection between Königsberg and the port of Pillau, but by March 1945 Königsberg was hundreds of kilometres behind the main front line in the eastern front. The battle ended when the German garrison surrendered to the Soviets on 9 April after a three-day assault made their position untenable.

Battle of Konotop.headline: Bitka pri Konotopu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Konotopu ali bitka pri Sosnivki je potekala 29. junija 1659 blizu mesta Konotop v Ukrajini med rusko-poljsko vojno (1654–1667); koalicija pod vodstvom hetmana zaporoških kozakov Ivana Vihovskega se je spopadla s konjeniškimi enotami Ruskega carstva pod poveljstvom Semjona Požarskega in Semjona Lvova, ki so jih podpirali kozaki Ivana Bezpalija. Koalicija Vihovskega je premagala Ruse in njihove zaveznike ter glavno rusko vojsko prisilila, da je prekinila obleganje Konotopa. Izid bitke pa je le zaostril politične napetosti v Ukrajini in nekaj mesecev pozneje pripeljal do odstavitve Vihovskega.

source.title: Battle of Konotop
paragraphs: The Battle of Konotop or Battle of Sosnivka was fought between a coalition led by the Hetman of Zaporizhian Cossacks Ivan Vyhovsky and cavalry units of the Russian Tsardom under the command of Semyon Pozharsky and Semyon Lvov, supported by Cossacks of Ivan Bezpaly, on 29 June 1659, near the town of Konotop, Ukraine, during the Russo-Polish War (1654–1667). Vyhovsky's coalition defeated the Russians and their allies and forced the main Russian army to interrupt the siege of Konotop. However, the result of the battle only intensified political tensions in Ukraine and led to Vyhovsky's removal from power several months later.

Battle of Korsuń.headline: Bitka pri Korsunu (1648)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Korsunu (ukrajinsko: Битва під Корсунем, Корсунська битва; poljsko: Bitwa pod Korsuniem, Korsuńska bitwa; 25.–26. maja 1648) je bila druga pomembna bitka vstaje Hmelnickega. Blizu današnjega mesta Korsun-Ševčenkivski v Ukrajini so sile Zaporoške vojske in Krimskega kanata pod poveljstvom hetmana Bohdana Hmelnickega, polkovnikov Mihajla Kričevskega, Ivana Bohuna, Maksima Krivonosa, Martina Puškarja, Matvija Hladkega in Mihajla Hromike ter Tugaj-beja napadle in premagale sile Poljsko-litovske republike pod poveljstvom hetmanov Mikołaja Potockega in Marcina Kalinowskega ter oba ujele. Kot v bitki pri Žovtih Vodah (29. aprila – 16. maja 1648) so se sile Poljsko-litovske republike utrdile v obrambnem položaju in umaknile, sile Zaporoške vojske in Krimskega kanata pa so jih povsem porazile in uničile.

source.title: Battle of Korsuń
paragraphs: The Battle of Korsuń (Ukrainian: Битва під Корсунем, Корсунська битва, Polish: Bitwa pod Korsuniem, Korsuńska bitwa; 25–26 May 1648) was the second significant battle of the Khmelnytsky Uprising. Near the site of the present-day city of Korsun-Shevchenkivskyi in Ukraine, forces of the Zaporozhian Host and Crimean Khanate under the command of Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky, Colonels Mykhailo Krychevsky, Ivan Bohun, Maksym Kryvonis, Martyn Pushkar, Matviy Hladky and Mykhailo Hromyka with Tugay Bey attacked and defeated the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth’s forces under the command of Hetmans Mikołaj Potocki and Marcin Kalinowski, capturing both men. As in the Battle of Zhovti Vody in 29 April — 16 May 1648 the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth’s forces took a defensive position, retreated and were thoroughly routed and destroyed by the forces of the Zaporozhian Host and Crimean Khanate.

Battle of Korsun–Cherkassy.headline: Bitka pri Korsunu in Čerkasih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Korsunu in Čerkasih (rusko: Корсунь-Шевченковская операция; ukrajinsko: Корсунь-Шевченківська операція), znana tudi kot bitka v korsunsko-čerkaškem žepu, je bila bitka druge svetovne vojne, ki je potekala od 24. januarja do 16. februarja 1944 v okviru sovjetske dneprsko-karpatske ofenzive v Ukrajini, po korsunsko-ševčenkovski ofenzivi.

V bitki sta 1. in 2. ukrajinska fronta pod poveljstvom Nikolaja Vatutina oziroma Ivana Koneva obkolili nemške sile skupine armad Jug v žepu blizu Dnepra. Obe fronti Rdeče armade sta tedne skušali žep uničiti. Obkoljene nemške enote so poskusile preboj, usklajen s poskusom reševanja drugih nemških sil, kar je povzročilo hude izgube, o katerih se ocene razlikujejo.

source.title: Battle of Korsun–Cherkassy
paragraphs: The Battle of Korsun–Cherkassy (Russian: Корсунь-Шевченковская операция; Ukrainian: Корсунь-Шевченківська операція), also known as the Battle of the Korsun–Cherkassy Pocket, was a World War II battle fought from 24 January to 16 February 1944 in the course of the Soviet Dnieper–Carpathian offensive in Ukraine, following the Korsun–Shevchenkovsky offensive.

In the battle, the 1st and 2nd Ukrainian Fronts, commanded, respectively, by Nikolai Vatutin and Ivan Konev, encircled German forces of Army Group South in a pocket near the Dnieper River. During weeks of fighting, the two Red Army Fronts tried to eradicate the pocket. The encircled German units attempted a breakout in coordination with a relief attempt by other German forces, resulting in heavy casualties, estimates of which vary.

Battle of Košare.headline: Bitka na Košarah
paragraphs: Bitka na Košarah (srbsko: Битка на Кошарама; albansko: Beteja e Kosharës) je potekala med vojno na Kosovu med silami ZR Jugoslavije in Osvobodilno vojsko Kosova (OVK), ki sta jo podpirala Natovo letalstvo in albanska vojska. Bojevali so se okoli Košar na meji med ZR Jugoslavijo in Albanijo od 9. aprila do 10. junija 1999, med Natovim bombardiranjem ZR Jugoslavije.

Uporniki OVK so po silovitem topniškem obstreljevanju albanske vojske in Natovih letalskih napadih na jugoslovanske strateške cilje zavzeli mejno karavlo Košare in več okoliških obmejnih območij, naprej pa niso mogli prodreti. Napad je v veliki meri usklajeval krajevni albanski poveljnik general Lama, ki je bil v neposrednem stiku z generalom Clarkom. Taktične pobude na terenu so bile zaupane krajevnim poveljnikom OVK, ki so sodelovali v napadu.
notes: The KLA is given by its Slovenian abbreviation OVK.

source.title: Battle of Košare
paragraphs: The Battle of Košare (Serbian: Битка на Кошарама, romanized: Bitka na Košarama; Albanian: Beteja e Kosharës) was fought during the Kosovo War between the forces of FR Yugoslavia and the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA), the latter supported by the NATO air forces and Albanian Army. The battle was fought around Košare on the border between FR Yugoslavia and Albania from 9 April 1999 until 10 June 1999 during the NATO bombing of FR Yugoslavia.

KLA insurgents managed to take the Košare border outpost and a number of surrounding border areas following a massive artillery barrage by the Albanian Army and NATO airstrikes of Yugoslav strategic sites, but were unable to make further advances. The attack was largely coordinated by the local Albanian commander, General Lama, who was in direct contact with General Clark. Tactical initiatives on the ground were entrusted to local KLA commanders who took part in the attack.

Battle of Kramatorsk.headline: Bitka za Kramatorsk
paragraphs: Bitka za Kramatorsk je ime za vrsto oboroženih prask in spopadov med oboroženimi silami Ukrajine in proruskimi separatisti, povezanimi z Doneško ljudsko republiko, od 12. aprila do 5. julija 2014.

Med naraščajočimi nemiri v Ukrajini po ukrajinski revoluciji leta 2014 je mesto Kramatorsk v Doneški oblasti 12. aprila prišlo pod nadzor odcepljene Doneške ljudske republike. Ukrajinska vlada je začela protiofenzivo proti separatistom, ki so se utrdili v mestu, da bi ga znova zavzela. V naslednjih mesecih je med stranema prišlo do vrste incidentov, prask in oboroženih spopadov.
Enote vojske DLR so se 5. julija umaknile iz mesta, ukrajinske sile pa so vkorakale vanj in ga znova zavzele, s čimer se je zastoj končal.

source.title: Battle of Kramatorsk
paragraphs: A series of armed skirmishes and confrontations between the Armed Forces of Ukraine and pro-Russian separatists affiliated with the Donetsk People's Republic took place from 12 April until 5 July 2014, and is known as the Battle of Kramatorsk.

During the rising unrest in Ukraine in the aftermath of the 2014 Ukrainian revolution, the city of Kramatorsk in Donetsk Oblast came under the control of the breakaway Donetsk People's Republic on 12 April. In an effort to retake the city, the Ukrainian government launched a counter-offensive against the separatists, who had taken up positions in the city. Over the next several months there would be a series of incidents, skirmishes, and armed confrontations between the sides.
The DPR army units withdrew from the city on 5 July, allowing Ukrainian forces to sweep in and recapture the city, ending the standoff.

Battle of Kraśnik.headline: Bitka pri Kraśniku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kraśniku (nemško: Schlacht von Kraśnik) se je začela 23. avgusta 1914 v deželi Galiciji in sosednjih območjih onkraj meje v Ruskem cesarstvu, na severu Avstrije (na ozemlju današnje Poljske), končala pa se je dva dni pozneje. Avstro-ogrska 1. armada je premagala rusko 4. armado. To je bila prva zmaga Avstro-Ogrske v prvi svetovni vojni. Poveljnika 1. armade generala Viktorja Dankla so zato (za kratek čas) slavili kot narodnega junaka. Bitka je bila tudi prva v vrsti spopadov med Avstro-Ogrsko in Rusijo vzdolž vse galicijske fronte.

source.title: Battle of Kraśnik
paragraphs: The Battle of Kraśnik (German: Schlacht von Kraśnik) started on August 23, 1914, in the province of Galicia and the adjacent areas across the border in the Russian Empire, in northern Austria (in present-day Poland), and ended two days later. The Austro-Hungarian 1st Army defeated the Russian 4th Army. It was the first victory by Austria-Hungary in World War I. As a result, the 1st Army's commander, General Viktor Dankl, was (briefly) lauded as a national hero for his success. The battle was also the first of a series of engagements between Austria-Hungary and Russia all along the Galicia front.

Bitka pri Krasnoju (Krasni ali Krasnoje) je potekala od 15. do 18. novembra 1812 in je bila ključna epizoda Napoleonovega mučnega umika iz Moskve. Ruske sile pod vodstvom feldmaršala Kutuzova so v šestih spopadih iz pripravljene zasede zadale hude udarce ostankom velike armade, ki jo je vojna izčrpavanja že močno oslabila. Spopadi se sicer niso razvili v prave bitke, vendar so Francozom zaradi pomanjkanja orožja in konj prizadejali velike izgube.

source.title: Battle of Krasnoi
paragraphs: The Battle of Krasnoi (at Krasny or Krasnoe) unfolded from 15 to 18 November 1812 marking a critical episode in Napoleon's arduous retreat from Moscow. Over the course of six skirmishes the Russian forces under Field Marshal Kutuzov inflicted significant blows from a prepared ambush upon the remnants of the Grande Armée, already severely weakened by attrition warfare. These confrontations, though not escalated into full-scale battles, led to substantial losses for the French due to their depleted weapons and horses.

Battle of Krefeld.headline: Bitka pri Krefeldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Krefeldu (včasih imenovana s francoskim imenom Créfeld in kot Creveld) je potekala pri Krefeldu blizu Rena 23. junija 1758 med nemško vojsko pod vodstvom vojvode Ferdinanda Brunšviško-Wolfenbüttelskega in francosko vojsko pod vodstvom grofa Louisa de Clermonta med sedemletno vojno. Zaradi Ferdinandove zmage se je britanska vlada nazadnje odločila, da mu z otoka pošlje okrepitve, 2000 konjenikov in 4000 pešcev.

Francoska vojska v Nemčiji je bila v času bitke že načeta zaradi slabe oskrbe, slabe uprave in nenehnih umikov, kar je vplivalo tudi na moralo vojakov. Njeno navzočnost tam so zaznamovali hudi porazi, kot so bili Krefeld, Rossbach leta 1757 in Minden leta 1759.

source.title: Battle of Krefeld
paragraphs: The Battle of Krefeld (sometimes referred to by its French name of Créfeld, and as Creveld) was fought at Krefeld near the Rhine on 23 June 1758 between a German army under Duke Ferdinand of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel and a French army under Count Louis of Clermont during the Seven Years' War. As a result of this Ferdinand's victory, the British government eventually decided to reinforce him with 2,000 cavalry and 4,000 infantry from the island.

By the time of the battle, the French army in Germany had deteriorated due to poor provisions, poor administration, and constant retreats; all this also had an impact on the soldiers' morale. Its presence there was marked by major defeats such as Krefeld, Rossbach in 1757, and Minden in 1759.

Bitka za Donbas je bila vojaška ofenziva, del širše vzhodne fronte rusko-ukrajinske vojne. Ofenziva za nadzor nad regijo Donbas se je med oboroženimi silami Rusije in Ukrajine začela 18. aprila 2022. Vojaški analitiki menijo, da je bila druga strateška faza invazije, po začetnem ruskem napadu na Ukrajino v treh smereh.

Ruska strategija v tem sektorju je bila obkoliti ukrajinske čete v Donbasu ter vso Doneško in Lugansko oblast priključiti separatističnima državama pod rusko zaščito, Doneški ljudski republiki (DLR) in Luganski ljudski republiki (LLR). Rusija je trdila, da je do 23. junija 2022 nadzorovala 55 % Doneške oblasti in do 3. julija 2022 vso Lugansko oblast, ruske in separatistične sile pa so nadzorovale mesta Mariupol, Severodoneck, Lisičansk, Rubižne in mnoga druga.
notes: The record's article now leads to the Battle of Donbas, so the text is the same as that unit's and does not mention Kreminna.

source.title: Battle of Donbas (2022)
paragraphs: The Battle of Donbas was a military offensive that was part of the wider eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war. The offensive began on 18 April 2022 between the armed forces of Russia and Ukraine for control of the Donbas region. Military analysts consider the campaign to have been the second strategic phase of the invasion, after Russia's initial three-pronged attack into Ukraine.

Russia's strategy in the sector was to encircle Ukrainian troops in the Donbas and to annexe the entire Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts to the Russian-backed separatist states of the Donetsk People's Republic (DPR) and Luhansk People's Republic (LPR). Russia claimed to have controlled 55% of Donetsk Oblast by 23 June 2022 and all of Luhansk Oblast by 3 July 2022, with Russian and separatist forces controlling the cities of Mariupol, Sievierodonetsk, Lysychansk, Rubizhne, and many others.

Battle of Krivolak.headline: Bitka pri Krivolaku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Krivolaku (bolgarsko: Криволашко сражение, Битка при Криволак) je potekala med prvo svetovno vojno od 21. oktobra do 22. novembra 1915, v začetni fazi makedonske kampanje na balkanskem bojišču. Bolgarske čete so 21. oktobra napadle francoske položaje blizu železniške postaje Strumica, ki je bila tedaj del Kraljevine Srbije (danes Severna Makedonija), in s tem začele bitko. Boji so se nadaljevali do 22. novembra, ko dvema srbskima divizijama ni uspelo zavzeti Skopja; nadaljevanje ofenzivnih operacij antante je postalo nevarno in Francozi so morali svoje sile umakniti iz regije.

Poraz antante pri Krivolaku in poznejša bitka pri Kosturinu sta pripeljala do popolnega umika zavezniških sil iz Srbije, kar je centralnim silam omogočilo, da so znova odprle železniško progo Berlin–Carigrad. Zavezniki so medtem utrdili obrambo v Grčiji.

source.title: Battle of Krivolak
paragraphs: The Battle of Krivolak (in Bulgarian: Криволашко сражение, Битка при Криволак) was a World War I battle, fought between 21 October and 22 November 1915. It was fought in the initial stage of the Macedonian campaign, in the Balkans Theatre. On 21 October, Bulgarian troops attacked the French-held positions near the Strumica rail station, at the time part of the Kingdom of Serbia (present-day North Macedonia), starting the battle. Fighting continued until 22 November, when two Serbian divisions failed to capture Skopje, thus rendering the continuation of Entente offensive operations dangerous and forcing the French to evacuate their forces from the region.

The Entente defeat at Krivolak and the follow-up battle of Kosturino led to the complete withdrawal of Allied forces from Serbia, thus enabling the Central Powers to re-open the Berlin to Constantinople rail line. The Allies, in the meantime, consolidated their defenses in Greece.

Bitka pri Krutih (ukrajinsko: Бій під Крутами) je potekala 29. ali 30. januarja 1918 blizu železniške postaje Kruti (danes vas Pamjatne v Nižinskem rajonu Černigovske oblasti), približno 130 kilometrov severovzhodno od Kijeva v Ukrajini; območje je tedaj spadalo v Nižinski ujezd Černigovske gubernije.

V bitki je številčno šibkejša enota, sestavljena iz vojaških kadetov in delov Ukrajinske ljudske armade, za ceno velikih izgub v lastnih vrstah zadržala boljševiško napredovanje proti Kijevu. Ukrajinska delegacija je tako pridobila čas na mirovnih pogajanjih v Brestu. Bitka je postala moralni simbol žrtve, ki jo je ukrajinska mladina prinesla v obrambi domovine.
notes: The mile conversion and the romanization are left out. The glossary had Bitka pri Krutiju; Kruty is plural, so an override now gives Bitka pri Krutih.

source.title: Battle of Kruty
paragraphs: The Battle of Kruty (Ukrainian: Бій під Крутами, romanized: Bii pid Krutamy) took place on January 29 or 30, 1918, near Kruty railway station (today the village of Pamiatne, Nizhyn Raion, Chernihiv Oblast), about 130 kilometres (81 miles) northeast of Kiev, Ukraine, which at the time was part of Nizhyn Povit of Chernihiv Governorate.

The battle involved a numerically inferior force composed of military cadets and parts of the Ukrainian People's Army, which managed to postpone the Bolshevik advance on Kyiv at the cost of huge losses in its own ranks. This allowed the Ukrainian delegation to win time at the peace negotiations in Brest. The battle became a moral symbol of sacrifice brought by Ukrainian youth in defence of their country.

Battle of Kulm.headline: Bitka pri Kulmu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kulmu je potekala blizu mesta Kulm (češko: Chlumec) in vasi Přestanov (tedaj Priesten) na severu Češke. Bojevali so se 29. in 30. avgusta 1813 med vojno šeste koalicije. Francoski korpus pod vodstvom generala Dominiqua Vandamma je 29. avgusta napadel ruski korpus Aleksandra Ostermana-Tolstoja. Naslednji dan je pruski korpus Friedricha von Kleista udaril Vandammu v hrbet, ruske in avstrijske okrepitve pa so napadle francosko čelo in levo krilo. Vandamme je bil poražen in je izgubil med 13.000 in 25.000 možmi ter 82 topov. Friderik Viljem je za tiste, ki so se v bitki odlikovali, ustanovil odlikovanje kulmski križ.

source.title: Battle of Kulm
paragraphs: The Battle of Kulm was fought near the town Kulm (Czech: Chlumec) and the village Přestanov (then called Priesten) in northern Bohemia. It was fought on 29–30 August 1813, during the War of the Sixth Coalition. A French corps under General Dominique Vandamme attacked Alexander Osterman-Tolstoy's Russian corps on 29 August. The next day, Friedrich von Kleist's Prussian corps hit Vandamme in the rear while Russian and Austrian reinforcements attacked the French front and left. Vandamme was defeated with the loss of between 13,000 and 25,000 men and 82 guns. Frederick William created an award for those who distinguished themselves in battle, the Kulm Cross.

Battle of Kunersdorf.headline: Bitka pri Kunersdorfu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kunersdorfu je potekala 12. avgusta 1759 blizu Kunersdorfa (danes Kunowice na Poljskem), tik vzhodno od Frankfurta ob Odri. V bitki, ki je bila del tretje šlezijske vojne in širše sedemletne vojne, je sodelovalo več kot 100.000 mož. Zavezniška vojska pod poveljstvom Petra Saltikova in Ernsta Gideona von Laudona z 41.000 Rusi in 18.500 Avstrijci je premagala vojsko Friderika Velikega s 50.900 Prusi.

Teren je obema stranema otežil taktiko, a Rusi in Avstrijci, ki so na območje prispeli prvi, so mnoge težave premagali, tako da so utrdili nasip med dvema majhnima ribnikoma. Iznašli so tudi odgovor na Friderikov smrtonosni način bojevanja, poševni bojni red. Čeprav so Friderikove čete v bitki sprva prevladovale, sta Rusom in Avstrijcem prednost dala njegovo pomanjkljivo izvidovanje in močne obrambne priprave zavezniških čet. Popoldne, ko so bili nasprotniki izčrpani, so v boj poslane sveže avstrijske čete zaveznikom zagotovile zmago.

source.title: Battle of Kunersdorf
paragraphs: The Battle of Kunersdorf occurred on 12 August 1759 near Kunersdorf (now Kunowice, Poland) immediately east of Frankfurt an der Oder. Part of the Third Silesian War and the wider Seven Years' War, the battle involved over 100,000 men. An Allied army commanded by Pyotr Saltykov and Ernst Gideon von Laudon that included 41,000 Russians and 18,500 Austrians defeated Frederick the Great's army of 50,900 Prussians.

The terrain complicated battle tactics for both sides, but the Russians and the Austrians, having arrived in the area first, were able to overcome many of its difficulties by strengthening a causeway between two small ponds. They had also devised a solution to Frederick's deadly modus operandi, the oblique order. Although Frederick's troops initially gained the upper hand in the battle, his limited scouting, combined with the strong defensive preparations of the Allied troops, gave the Russians and Austrians an advantage. By afternoon, when the combatants were exhausted, fresh Austrian troops thrown into the fray secured the Allied victory.

Battle of La Higueruela.headline: Bitka pri La Higueruela
paragraphs: Bitka pri La Higueruela (dobesedno »bitka pri drobni figi«) je potekala 1. julija 1431 v rodovitni dolini (vega) reke Genil blizu Granade med silami kastiljskega kralja Ivana II. pod vodstvom Álvara de Lune in enotami, zvestimi Mohamedu IX., nasridskemu sultanu Granade. Bitka je bila skromna zmaga kastiljskih sil, saj niso pridobile ozemlja in niso zavzele Granade. Po bitki je kastiljski kralj Ivan II. za granadskega sultana postavil Jusufa IV., vnuka Mohameda VI.
Bitko prikazuje slavna serija fresk Fabrizia Castella, Orazia Cambiasija in Lazzara Tavaroneja v Galeriji bitk v kraljevem samostanu San Lorenzo de El Escorial.

source.title: Battle of La Higueruela
paragraphs: The Battle of La Higueruela (lit. 'Battle at the little fig tree') was fought in the vega of the river Genil near Granada on 1 July 1431 between the forces of John II of Castile, led by Álvaro de Luna, and troops loyal to Muhammed IX, Nasrid Sultan of Granada. The battle was a modest victory for the forces of Castile, with no territorial gain and failing to take Granada. Following this battle, John II of Castile installed Yusuf IV, grandson of Muhammed VI, as Sultan of Granada.

The battle is depicted in a famous series of fresco paintings by Fabrizio Castello, Orazio Cambiasi and Lazzaro Tavarone in the Gallery of Battles at the Royal Monastery of San Lorenzo de El Escorial.

Battle of La Rochelle.headline: Bitka pri La Rochelle
paragraphs: Bitka pri La Rochelle je potekala 22. in 23. junija 1372 med kastiljsko floto pod poveljstvom kastiljskega admirala Ambrosia Boccanegre in angleško floto pod poveljstvom Johna Hastingsa, 2. grofa Pembroka. Kastiljsko floto so poslali, da bi napadla Angleže v La Rochelle, ki so jo oblegali francoski zavezniki Kastilje.

Pembroka so v mesto poslali z majhno četo manj kot 200 vojakov. Njegove ladje so vozile tudi 12.000 funtov v srebru (kar ustreza 10.000.000 funtom leta 2025) in navodila, naj s tem denarjem v Akvitaniji na jugozahodu Francije zbere vojsko 3000 vojakov. Moč angleške flote ocenjujejo nekje med 12 galejami, ki jih navaja kastiljski kronist in pomorski kapitan López de Ayala, in 40 jadrnicami, med katerimi so bile tri vojne ladje, ter 13 barkami, ki jih omenja francoski kronist Jean Froissart. Verjetno je štela 22 ladij, večinoma galej in nekaj naosov (karak), tri- ali štirijamborskih oceanskih jadrnic. Angleška flota je verjetno štela 32 ladij in 17 manjših bark s približno 50 tonami.
notes: The English source contradicts itself: the estimate of 12 galleys to 40 ships and the 22 ships, mainly galleys, almost certainly describe the Castilian fleet, though the text says "the English fleet". The Slovenian keeps the source wording; worth checking in review.

source.title: Battle of La Rochelle
paragraphs: The Battle of La Rochelle was fought on 22 and 23 June 1372 between a Castilian fleet commanded by the Castilian Almirant Ambrosio Boccanegra and an English fleet commanded by John Hastings, 2nd Earl of Pembroke. The Castilian fleet had been sent to attack the English at La Rochelle, which was being besieged by Castile's French allies.

Pembroke had been dispatched to the town with a small force of fewer than 200 soldiers. His ships also carried £12,000 (equivalent to £10,000,000 in 2025) in silver and instructions to use the money to recruit an army of 3,000 soldiers in Aquitaine in south-west France. The strength of the English fleet is estimated as between the 12 galleys given by the Castilian chronicler and naval captain López de Ayala and the 40 sailing ships, of which three ships were warships and 13 barges mentioned by the French chronicler Jean Froissart. Probably it consisted of 22 ships, mainly galleys and some naos (carracks) three- or four-masted ocean sailing ships. The English fleet probably consisted of 32 ships and 17 small barges of about 50 tons.

Battle of La Rothière.headline: Bitka pri La Rothièru
paragraphs: Bitka pri La Rothièru (1. februarja 1814) je bila spopad, v katerem so koalicijske sile Avstrijskega cesarstva, Ruskega cesarstva, Kraljevine Prusije, Kraljevine Bavarske in Kraljevine Württemberg napadle francosko vojsko pod vodstvom cesarja Napoleona. Glavni koalicijski vojski je poveljeval feldmaršal Karl Philipp, knez Schwarzenberg, taktično vodenje boja pa je dobil Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher. Zavezniki so med sneženjem premagali številčno šibkejše in preveč raztegnjene Francoze.

Po spopadu z Blücherjevimi silami v bitki za Brienne 29. januarja se je Napoleon predolgo zadrževal na tem območju. Ko je koalicijska vojska napadla, so bile Napoleonove čete za obrambo slabo razporejene in bitki se ni bilo več mogoče izogniti. Francoska vojska se je kljub temu srdito borila in se obdržala na položajih, dokler se ni mogla pod okriljem teme umakniti.

source.title: Battle of La Rothière
paragraphs: The Battle of La Rothière (1 February 1814) saw the Coalition forces of the Austrian Empire, Russian Empire, Kingdom of Prussia, Kingdom of Bavaria, and Kingdom of Württemberg attack a French army led by Emperor Napoleon. The main Coalition army was under the command of Field Marshal Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg but Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher was given tactical control of the fighting. The Allies defeated the outnumbered and overextended French during a snowfall.
