After clashing with Blücher's forces in the Battle of Brienne on 29 January, Napoleon lingered in the area too long. When the Coalition army attacked, Napoleon's troops were poorly positioned to defend themselves and it was too late to avoid battle. Nevertheless, the French army fought hard and managed to hold its ground until it could retreat under cover of darkness.

Battle of Lagos.headline: Bitka pri Lagosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lagosu je bila dvodnevni spopad leta 1759 v sedemletni vojni med britanskim ladjevjem pod poveljstvom Edwarda Boscawena in francoskim ladjevjem pod Jeanom-Françoisom de La Clue-Sabranom. Ladjevji sta se 18. avgusta spopadli jugozahodno od Cádiškega zaliva, 19. avgusta pa vzhodno od majhnega portugalskega pristanišča Lagos, po katerem je bitka dobila ime.

source.title: Battle of Lagos
paragraphs: The Battle of Lagos took place between a British fleet commanded by Edward Boscawen and a French fleet under Jean-François de La Clue-Sabran over two days in 1759 during the Seven Years' War. They fought south west of the Gulf of Cádiz on 18 August and to the east of the small Portuguese port of Lagos, after which the battle is named, on 19 August.

Battle of Lake Regillus.headline: Bitka pri jezeru Regillus
paragraphs: Bitka pri jezeru Regillus je bila legendarna rimska zmaga nad latinsko zvezo kmalu po ustanovitvi Rimske republike in del širše latinske vojne. Latince je vodil ostareli Lucij Tarkvinij Ošabni, sedmi in zadnji rimski kralj, ki so ga leta 509 pr. n. št. pregnali, in njegov zet Oktavij Mamilij, diktator Tuskula. Bitka je bila zadnji poskus Tarkvinijcev, da bi si povrnili prestol. Po legendi sta na rimski strani bojevala Kastor in Poluks.

source.title: Battle of Lake Regillus
paragraphs: The Battle of Lake Regillus was a legendary Roman victory over the Latin League shortly after the establishment of the Roman Republic and as part of a wider Latin War. The Latins were led by an elderly Lucius Tarquinius Superbus, the seventh and last King of Rome, who had been expelled in 509 BC, and his son-in-law, Octavius Mamilius, the dictator of Tusculum. The battle marked the final attempt of the Tarquins to reclaim their throne. According to legend, Castor and Pollux fought on the side of the Romans.

Bitka na Trasimenskem jezeru je potekala, ko je kartažanska vojska pod Hanibalom 21. junija 217 pr. n. št. v drugi punski vojni iz zasede napadla rimsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Gaja Flaminija. Bitka je potekala na severnem bregu Trasimenskega jezera, južno od Cortone, in se je končala s hudim porazom Rimljanov.

Vojna med Rimom in Kartagino je izbruhnila v začetku leta 218 pr. n. št. Hanibal, vladar kartažanskih ozemelj v jugovzhodni Iberiji, je vojsko popeljal skozi Galijo, prečkal Alpe in tistega leta pozneje prispel v Cisalpinsko Galijo (severna Italija). Rimljani so s Sicilije v naglici poslali okrepitve na sever, a so doživeli hud poraz v bitki pri Trebiji.

source.title: Battle of Lake Trasimene
paragraphs: The Battle of Lake Trasimene was fought when a Carthaginian force under Hannibal ambushed a Roman army commanded by Gaius Flaminius on 21 June 217 BC, during the Second Punic War. The battle took place on the north shore of Lake Trasimene, to the south of Cortona, and resulted in a heavy defeat for the Romans.

War had broken out between Rome and Carthage early in 218 BC. Hannibal, ruler of the Carthaginian territories in south-east Iberia, marched an army through Gaul, crossed the Alps and arrived in Cisalpine Gaul (northern Italy) later that year. The Romans rushed reinforcements north from Sicily but were badly defeated at the Battle of the Trebia.

Battle of Lake Vadimo (310 BC).headline: Prva bitka pri jezeru Vadimo
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri jezeru Vadimo je potekala leta 310 pr. n. št. med Rimom in Etruščani in je postala največja bitka med tema narodoma. Rimljani so zmagali in pridobili zemljo in vpliv v regiji. Etruščani so v bitki utrpeli hude izgube in svoje nekdanje slave nikoli več niso dosegli.

source.title: Battle of Lake Vadimo (310 BC)
paragraphs: The first Battle of Lake Vadimo was fought in 310 BC between Rome and the Etruscans, and ended up being the largest battle between these nations. The Romans were victorious, gaining land and influence in the region. The Etruscans sustained heavy losses in the battle and would never again reclaim their previous glory.

Battle of Lake Vadimon (283 BC).headline: Druga bitka pri jezeru Vadimo
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri jezeru Vadimo je potekala leta 283 pr. n. št. med Rimom in združenimi silami Etruščanov ter galskih plemen Bojev in Senonov. Rimsko vojsko je vodil konzul Publij Kornelij Dolabela. Bitka se je končala z rimsko zmago.

source.title: Battle of Lake Vadimon (283 BC)
paragraphs: The second Battle of Lake Vadimo was fought in 283 BC between Rome and the combined forces of the Etruscans and the Gallic tribes of the Boii and the Senones. The Roman army was led by consul Publius Cornelius Dolabella. The result of the battle was a Roman victory.

Battle of Landen.headline: Bitka pri Landnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Landnu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Neerwindnu, je potekala 29. julija 1693 med devetletno vojno blizu Landna, tedaj na Španski Nizozemski, danes v Belgiji. Francoska vojska pod vodstvom maršala Luxembourga je premagala zavezniške sile, ki jih je vodil Viljem III.

Do leta 1693 so se vse vojskujoče strani težko spoprijemale s finančnimi in materialnimi bremeni vojne. Francoski kralj Ludvik XIV. je upal vojno končati z ugodnim izpogajanim mirom, zato se je odločil, da bo svoj položaj najprej izboljšal z ofenzivo. Ko je Luxembourg dosegel krajevno številčno premoč, je napadel glavno zavezniško vojsko, ki je imela položaje okoli Landna.

Največ bojev je potekalo na zavezniškem desnem krilu, ki so ga Francozi trikrat napadli, preden so ga nazadnje prebili. Večina zavezniške vojske se je morala sicer odpovedati topovom, a se je umaknila v dobrem redu, saj so bili Francozi preveč izčrpani, da bi jo zasledovali.

source.title: Battle of Landen
paragraphs: The Battle of Landen, also known as Battle of Neerwinden took place on 29 July 1693, during the Nine Years' War near Landen, then in the Spanish Netherlands, now part of Belgium. A French army under Marshal Luxembourg defeated an Allied force led by William III.

By 1693, all combatants were struggling with the financial and material costs of the conflict. Hoping to end the war with a favourable negotiated peace, Louis XIV of France decided first to improve his position by taking the offensive. Having achieved local superiority in numbers, Luxembourg attacked the main Allied army, which was holding positions around Landen.

Most of the fighting took place on the Allied right, which the French assaulted three times before finally breaking through. Although forced to abandon their guns, most of the Allied army retreated in good order as the French were too exhausted to initiate a pursuit.

Battle of Landeshut (1760).headline: Bitka pri Landeshutu (1760)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Landeshutu je potekala 23. junija 1760 med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne).

Pruska vojska z 12.000 možmi pod vodstvom generala Heinricha Augusta de la Motte Fouquéja se je spopadla z avstrijsko vojsko z več kot 28.000 možmi pod vodstvom Ernsta Gideona von Laudona in bila poražena, njen poveljnik pa je bil ranjen in ujet. Prusi so izgubili 10.242 mož, od tega 1927 mrtvih in 8315 ujetih, ter 68 topov. Avstrijci so imeli 774 mrtvih in 2195 ranjenih. Prusi so se odločno bojevali in se predali šele, ko jim je zmanjkalo streliva.

source.title: Battle of Landeshut (1760)
paragraphs: The Battle of Landeshut was an engagement fought on 23 June 1760 during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War).

A Prussian army of 12,000 men under General Heinrich August de la Motte Fouqué fought an Austrian army of over 28,000 men under Ernst Gideon von Laudon and suffered a defeat, with its commander wounded and taken prisoner. The Prussians lost 10,242 men including 1,927 killed along with 8,315 prisoners as well as 68 guns captured. The Austrians lost 774 killed and 2,195 wounded. The Prussians fought with resolution, surrendering after running out of ammunition.

Battle of Landshut (1809).headline: Bitka pri Landshutu (1809)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Landshutu je potekala 21. aprila 1809 med približno 60.000 Francozi, Württemberžani (VIII. korpus) in Bavarci (VII. korpus) pod Napoleonom ter 40.000 Avstrijci pod vodstvom generala Johanna von Hillerja. Avstrijci so se kljub številčni podrejenosti srdito borili, dokler ni prispel Napoleon, nato pa se je bitka končala z jasno francosko zmago. Pred njo je potekala prva bitka pri Landshutu (16. aprila 1809) med predhodnico nadvojvode Ludvika pod vodstvom Josepha Radetzkyja in bavarsko III. divizijo Bernharda Deroya, v kateri so Avstrijci Bavarce prisilili k umiku, obe strani pa sta imeli malo izgub.

source.title: Battle of Landshut (1809)
paragraphs: The Battle of Landshut took place on 21 April 1809 between the French, Württembergers (VIII Corps) and Bavarians (VII Corps) under Napoleon which numbered about 60,000 strong, and 40,000 Austrians under the General Johann von Hiller. The Austrians, though outnumbered, fought hard until Napoleon arrived, when the battle subsequently became a clear French victory. This battle was preceded by the first battle of Landshut (16 April 1809) between Archduke Louis's vanguard under Joseph Radetzky and Bernhard Deroy's Bavarian III Division, in which the Austrians forced the Bavarians to retreat, with little loss on both sides.

Battle of Langensalza (1866).headline: Bitka pri Langensalzi (1866)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Langensalzi je potekala 27. junija 1866 v avstrijsko-pruski vojni blizu Bad Langensalze na ozemlju današnje Nemčije: Kraljevina Hannover se je spopadla s Kraljevino Prusijo. Hannovrčani so bitko dobili, nato pa jih je obkolila večja in okrepljena pruska vojska. Ker se niso mogli povezati s svojimi bavarskimi zavezniki na jugu, so se Hannovrčani predali.
To je pomenilo konec kraljeve hannovrske vojske in priključitev Hannovra vse močnejši Prusiji, ki je sistematično združila Nemčijo v sodobno nacionalno državo.

source.title: Battle of Langensalza (1866)
paragraphs: The Battle of Langensalza was fought on 27 June 1866, during the Austro-Prussian War, near Bad Langensalza in what is now modern Germany, between the Kingdom of Hanover and the Kingdom of Prussia. The Hanoverians won the battle but were then surrounded by a larger and reinforced Prussian army. Unable to link up with their Bavarian allies to the south, the Hanoverians surrendered.
That marked the demise of the Royal Hanoverian Army and the annexation of Hanover into the burgeoning Prussia, which systematically unified Germany into the modern nation state.

Battle of Laon.headline: Bitka pri Laonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Laonu, ki je potekala 9. in 10. marca 1814, je bila ključen spopad v zadnjih mesecih napoleonskih vojn. Blücherjeva prusko-ruska vojska, ki je imela trden obrambni položaj pri mestu Laon, je odbila napade francoskega cesarja Napoleona in njegovega podrejenega poveljnika korpusa, maršala Marmonta, nato pa ju je sama uspešno napadla.

source.title: Battle of Laon
paragraphs: The Battle of Laon, fought on March 9–10, 1814, was a pivotal engagement during the waning months of the Napoleonic Wars. Blücher's Prusso-Russian force, occupying a tough defensive position at the town of Laon, repelled attacks by and successfully counterattacked French Emperor Napoleon and his subordinate corps commander, Marshal Marmont.

Battle of Larga.headline: Bitka pri Largi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Largi je bila osemurni spopad 18. julija 1770 (7. julija po starem koledarju) na bregovih reke Large, pritoka Pruta, v Kneževini Moldaviji (danes Moldavija), med združenimi silami 65.000 krimskih Tatarov in 15.000 Osmanov pod vodstvom Kaplana II. Gireja ter 38.000 Rusi pod vodstvom feldmaršala Rumjanceva.

Rusi so dosegli odločilno zmago ter zaplenili 33 turških topov in ogromen sovražni tabor. Za to zmago je Rumjancev prejel red svetega Jurija 1. stopnje. Dva tedna pozneje so Rusi dosegli še večjo zmago v bitki pri Kagulu.

source.title: Battle of Larga
paragraphs: The Battle of (the) Larga was fought by a combined force of 65,000 Crimean Tatars and 15,000 Ottomans under Qaplan II Giray, against 38,000 Russians under Field-Marshal Rumyantsev on the banks of the Larga River, a tributary of the Prut River, in Moldavia (now in Moldova), for eight hours on 18 July 1770 (O.S. 7 July).

The battle was a decisive victory for the Russians who captured 33 Turkish cannons and the vast enemy camp. For this victory, Rumyantsev was awarded the Order of Saint George of the 1st degree. Two weeks later, the Russians scored an even greater victory in the Battle of Kagul.

Battle of Largs.headline: Bitka pri Largsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Largsu (2. oktobra 1263) je bila bitka med kraljevinama Norveško in Škotsko v zalivu Firth of Clyde blizu Largsa na Škotskem. Spopad je bil del norveške odprave proti Škotski leta 1263, s katero je norveški kralj Haakon Haakonsson skušal znova uveljaviti norveško suverenost nad zahodno obalo Škotske. Škoti so zmagali po zaslugi premetene trojne strategije mladega škotskega kralja Aleksandra III.: počasna diplomacija je pohod potisnila v mesece slabega vremena, silovita nevihta je opustošila norveško ladjevje in mu odnesla veliko ladij in zalog, sile na škotski obali pa so postale ranljive za napad, ki je Norvežane prisilil v nagel umik. Ta je končal njihovo 500-letno zgodovino vpadov, Škotska pa je lahko svoje vire usmerila v graditev države.

source.title: Battle of Largs
paragraphs: The Battle of Largs (2 October 1263) was a battle between the kingdoms of Norway and Scotland, on the Firth of Clyde near Largs, Scotland. The conflict formed part of the Norwegian expedition against Scotland in 1263, in which Haakon Haakonsson, King of Norway attempted to reassert Norwegian sovereignty over the western seaboard of Scotland. Victory was achieved by the Scots with a crafty three-tiered strategy on the part of the young Scottish king, Alexander III: plodding diplomacy forced the campaign to bad weather months and a ferocious storm ravaged the Norwegian fleet, stripping it of many vessels and supplies and making the forces on the Scottish coast vulnerable to an attack that forced the Norwegians into a hasty retreat that was to end their 500-year history of invasion, and leaving Scotland to consolidate its resources into building the nation.

Bitka pri Las Navas de Tolosa, v islamski zgodovini znana kot bitka pri Al Ukabu (arabsko: معركة العقاب), je potekala 16. julija 1212 in je bila pomembna prelomnica rekonkviste in zgodovine srednjeveške Španije. Krščanske sile je vodil kastiljski kralj Alfonz VIII., pridružila pa sta se mu njegova tekmeca, navarski kralj Sančo VII. in aragonski kralj Peter II. Muslimansko vojsko je vodil kalif al Nasir (v španskih kronikah Miramamolín), vladar Almohadskega kalifata, ki je obsegal južno polovico Iberskega polotoka in Maroko.
Navas de Tolosa (imenovan tudi Las Navas) je kraj in zaselek na jugu Španije v občini La Carolina v provinci Jaén, na vzhodu pogorja Sierra Morena, 15 kilometrov od meje s provinco Ciudad Real.
notes: The miles conversion (9.3 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa
paragraphs: The Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa, known in Islamic history as the Battle of Al-Uqab (Arabic: معركة العقاب), took place on 16 July 1212 and was an important turning point in the Reconquista and the history of medieval Spain. The Christian forces were led by King Alfonso VIII of Castile, joined by his rivals, Kings Sancho VII of Navarre and Peter II of Aragon. The Muslim army was led by caliph al-Nasir (Miramamolín in the Spanish chronicles), ruler of the Almohad Caliphate, which included the southern half of the Iberian Peninsula and Morocco.

Navas de Tolosa (also called Las Navas) is a town and hamlet in southern Spain, in the municipality of La Carolina, in the province of Jaén, in the eastern part of the Sierra Morena region, 15 kilometres (9.3 mi) from the border with the province of Ciudad Real.

Battle of Lauffeld.headline: Bitka pri Lauffeldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lauffeldu je potekala 2. julija 1747 med vojno za avstrijsko nasledstvo. Na bojišču med mestom Tongeren v današnji Belgiji in nizozemskim mestom Maastricht je francoska vojska s 136.000 možmi pod poveljstvom maršala Saxa premagala pragmatično vojsko s 100.000 možmi pod vodstvom vojvode Cumberlanda.

Saxe, morda najnadarjenejši general svoje generacije, je med letoma 1744 in 1746 osvojil velik del Avstrijske Nizozemske. V začetku leta 1747 je Cumberland načrtoval ofenzivo, da bi znova zavzel Antwerpen, a se je moral umakniti, ko so mu Francozi zagrozili, da ga bodo odrezali od oskrbovalnega oporišča v Maastrichtu. Ko sta se vojski srečali pri Lauffeldu, je Cumberland z vrsto napak ogrozil svoj položaj, hud poraz pa so preprečili le protinapadi zavezniške konjenice pod poveljstvom sira Johna Ligonierja.

Cumberland je sprva ukazal požgati Lauffeld, britanske čete pa naj bi se v bojno vrsto razvrstile za vasjo. Ligonier pa je vojvodo prepričal, naj znova zasede požgane ruševine in jih spremeni v utrjeno točko.

source.title: Battle of Lauffeld
paragraphs: The Battle of Lauffeld took place on 2 July 1747, during the War of the Austrian Succession. Fought between the towns of Tongeren in modern Belgium, and the Dutch city of Maastricht, a French army of 136,000 under Marshal Saxe defeated a Pragmatic Army of 100,000, led by the Duke of Cumberland.

Arguably the most talented general of his generation, Saxe had conquered much of the Austrian Netherlands between 1744 and 1746. In early 1747, Cumberland planned an offensive to retake Antwerp, but was forced to fall back when the French threatened to cut him off from his supply base at Maastricht. When the two armies met at Lauffeld, a series of mistakes by Cumberland compromised his position, and only counterattacks by the Allied cavalry under Sir John Ligonier prevented a serious defeat.

Initially, Cumberland had order Lauffeldt to be burnt, with the British troops forming a battle line behind the village. However, Ligonier persuaded the Duke to reoccupy the burnt ruins and turn it in to a strongpoint.

Battle of Laupen.headline: Bitka pri Laupnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Laupnu je potekala junija 1339 med Bernom in njegovimi zavezniki na eni strani ter Fribourgom (Freiburgom) skupaj s fevdalnimi zemljiškimi gospodi iz grofije Burgundije in habsburških ozemelj na drugi. Zmagal je Bern, ki je utrdil svoj položaj v regiji. Zaradi spopada so se odnosi med Bernom in švicarsko konfederacijo okrepili, kar je leta 1353 privedlo do trajnega pristopa Berna.
To je tudi prva bitka, v kateri je izpričana raba belega križa kot bojnega znamenja švicarskih bojevnikov.

source.title: Battle of Laupen
paragraphs: The Battle of Laupen was fought in June 1339, between Bern and its allies on one side, and Freiburg together with feudal landholders from the County of Burgundy and Habsburg territories on the other. Bern was victorious, consolidating its position in the region. As a consequence of the conflict, the relations of Bern and the Swiss Confederacy tightened, resulting in Bern's permanent accession in 1353.
This is also the first battle that the white cross was documented as being used as a field sign worn by Swiss combatants.

Battle of Lautulae.headline: Bitka pri Lautulae
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lautulae je potekala leta 315 pr. n. št. v drugi samnitski vojni; v njej sta se spopadla Rimska republika (pod vodstvom diktatorja Kvinta Fabija Maksima Rulijana) in Samniti, ki so Rimljane porazili.

source.title: Battle of Lautulae
paragraphs: The Battle of Lautulae was fought in 315 BC during the Second Samnite War, opposing the Roman Republic (led by dictator Quintus Fabius Maximus Rullianus) and the Samnites, who defeated the Romans.

Battle of Le Cateau.headline: Bitka pri Le Cateauju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Le Cateauju je potekala 26. avgusta 1914 na zahodni fronti med prvo svetovno vojno. Britanska ekspedicijska sila (BEF) in francoska 5. armada sta se umikali po porazih v bitki pri Charleroiju (21.–23. avgusta) in bitki pri Monsu (23. avgusta). Britanski II. korpus je pri Le Cateauju vodil zadrževalni boj, da bi upočasnil nemško zasledovanje. Večina BEF je lahko nadaljevala umik proti Saint-Quentinu.

source.title: Battle of Le Cateau
paragraphs: The Battle of Le Cateau was fought on the Western Front during the First World War on 26 August 1914. The British Expeditionary Force (BEF) and the French Fifth Army had retreated after their defeats at the Battle of Charleroi (21–23 August) and the Battle of Mons (23 August). The British II Corps fought a delaying action at Le Cateau to slow the German pursuit. Most of the BEF was able to continue its retreat to Saint-Quentin.

Battle of Le Mans.headline: Bitka pri Le Mansu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Le Mansu je bila nemška zmaga v francosko-pruski vojni, s katero se je končal francoski odpor na zahodu Francije.

source.title: Battle of Le Mans
paragraphs: The Battle of Le Mans was a German victory during the Franco-Prussian War that ended French resistance in western France.

Battle of Lechaeum.headline: Bitka pri Lehaju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lehaju (391 pr. n. št.) je potekala med Atenci in Špartanci v korintski vojni in se končala z atensko zmago. Atenski vojskovodja Ifikrat je izkoristil priložnost, ko je špartanski hoplitski polk, ki je deloval blizu Korinta, korakal čez odprt teren brez zaščite metalcev. Odločil se je, da ga napade iz zasede s svojimi metalci kopij, peltasti. Ifikrat in njegovi možje so s ponavljajočimi se napadi in hitrimi umiki špartansko formacijo izčrpali, jo nazadnje pognali v beg in pobili skoraj polovico mož. To je bil eden prvih primerov v grški vojaški zgodovini, ko so peltasti premagali hoplitsko težko pehoto.

source.title: Battle of Lechaeum
paragraphs: The Battle of Lechaeum (391 BC) was fought between the Athenians and the Spartans during the Corinthian War; it ended in an Athenian victory. During the battle, the Athenian general Iphicrates took advantage of the situation when a Spartan hoplite regiment operating near Corinth was marching through open terrain without the protection of any missile throwing troops. He decided to ambush it with his force of javelin throwers, or peltasts. By launching repeated hit-and-run attacks against the Spartan formation, Iphicrates and his men were able to wear the Spartans down, eventually routing them and killing just under half. This marked one of the first occasions in Greek military history in which a force of peltasts had defeated a force of hoplite heavy infantry.

Battle of Leghorn.headline: Bitka pri Livornu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Livornu (angleško Leghorn) je potekala 4. marca 1653 (14. marca po gregorijanskem koledarju) v prvi angleško-nizozemski vojni blizu Livorna v Italiji. Bila je zmaga nizozemske eskadre pod komodorjem Johanom van Galenom nad angleško eskadro pod kapitanom Henryjem Appletonom. Nato je na prizorišče pravočasno prispela še ena angleška eskadra pod kapitanom Richardom Badileyjem, s katero se je Appleton skušal povezati, in opazovala zajetje zadnjih ladij Appletonove eskadre, vendar so jo premočni nasprotniki prisilili, da se je vrnila v Porto Longone.

source.title: Battle of Leghorn
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Leghorn took place on 4 March 1653 (14 March Gregorian calendar), during the First Anglo-Dutch War, near Leghorn (Livorno), Italy. It was a victory of a Dutch squadron under Commodore Johan van Galen over an English squadron under Captain Henry Appleton. Afterwards, another English squadron under Captain Richard Badiley, which Appleton had been trying to join up with, reached the scene in time to observe the capture of the last ships of Appleton's squadron, but was outnumbered and forced to return to Porto Longone.

Battle of Lemnos (1913).headline: Bitka pri Lemnosu (1913)
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Lemnosu (grško: Ναυμαχία της Λήμνου; turško: Mondros Deniz Muharebesi) je potekala 18. januarja [5. januarja po starem koledarju] 1913 v prvi balkanski vojni: Grki so v njej odbili drugi in zadnji poskus Osmanskega cesarstva, da bi prebilo grško pomorsko blokado Dardanel in znova zavladalo Egejskemu morju. Ta zadnja pomorska bitka prve balkanske vojne je osmansko mornarico prisilila k umiku v oporišče v Dardanelah, ki ga do konca vojne ni več zapustila; tako je Grčija obdržala prevlado nad Egejskim morjem in egejskimi otoki.

source.title: Battle of Lemnos (1913)
paragraphs: The Naval Battle of Lemnos (Greek: Ναυμαχία της Λήμνου, Turkish: Mondros Deniz Muharebesi), fought on 18 January [O.S. 5 January] 1913, was a naval battle during the First Balkan War, in which the Greeks defeated the second and last attempt of the Ottoman Empire to break the Greek naval blockade of the Dardanelles and reclaim supremacy over the Aegean Sea. This, the final naval battle of the First Balkan War, forced the Ottoman Navy to retreat to its base within the Dardanelles, from which it did not venture for the rest of the war, thus ensuring the dominion of the Aegean Sea and the Aegean islands by Greece.

Battle of Lenino.headline: Bitka pri Leninu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Leninu je bila taktičen spopad druge svetovne vojne, ki je potekal 12. in 13. oktobra 1943 severno od vasi Lenino v Mogiljovski regiji v Belorusiji. Bila je del širše sovjetske spas-demenske ofenzivne operacije, katere cilj je bil očistiti vzhodni breg Dnepra nemških sil in prebiti obrambno črto Panther-Wotan. Bitka ima vidno mesto v poljski vojaški zgodovini, saj je bila eden prvih večjih spopadov Poljskih oboroženih sil na Vzhodu.

source.title: Battle of Lenino
paragraphs: The Battle of Lenino was a tactical World War II engagement that took place on 12 and 13 October 1943, north of the village of Lenino in the Mogilev region of Byelorussia. The battle itself was a part of a larger Soviet Spas-Demensk offensive operation with the aims of clearing the eastern bank of the Dnieper River of German forces and piercing the Panther-Wotan line of defences. The battle is prominent in Polish military history, as it was one of the first major engagements of Polish Armed Forces in the East.

Battle of Lens.headline: Bitka pri Lensu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lensu (20. avgusta 1648) je bila zadnja velika bitka tridesetletne vojne (1618–1648).
Francoske sile pod poveljstvom Ludvika, Velikega Condéja, so premagale špansko vojsko nadvojvode Leopolda Viljema. Bitka je utrdila Condéjev sloves enega največjih generalov svojega časa.

V štirih letih po odločilni francoski zmagi nad špansko flandrijsko armado pri Rocroiju so Francozi zavzeli več deset mest po vsej severni Franciji in Španski Nizozemski. Nadvojvoda Leopold Viljem je bil leta 1647 imenovan za guvernerja Španske Nizozemske, da bi okrepil habsburško zavezništvo Španije z Avstrijo, in je istega leta začel veliko protiofenzivo. Španska vojska je najprej uspešno znova zavzela trdnjave Armentières, Comines in Landrecies.
notes: The English splits the second sentence across paragraphs 1 and 2 ("A" / "French force …"); the Slovenian moves the break to the sentence boundary.

source.title: Battle of Lens
paragraphs: The Battle of Lens (20 August 1648) was the last major battle of the Thirty Years' War (1618–1648). A
French force commanded by Louis, Grand Condé defeated a Spanish army under Archduke Leopold Wilhelm. The battle cemented the reputation of Condé as one of the greatest generals of his age.

Over the four years following the decisive French victory at Rocroi against the Spanish Army of Flanders, the French captured dozens of towns throughout northern France and the Spanish Netherlands. Archduke Leopold Wilhelm was appointed governor of the Spanish Netherlands in 1647 to strengthen Spain's Habsburg alliance with Austria, and began a major counteroffensive the same year. The Spanish army first found success recapturing the fortresses of Armentières, Comines and Landrecies.

Battle of Lesnaya.headline: Bitka pri Lesnaji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lesnaji je potekala 9. oktobra 1708 med švedskim vdorom v Rusijo v veliki severni vojni. Po razpadu protišvedske koalicije leta 1706 je bila Rusija edina preostala sovražnica Švedske. Ruski car Peter I. je vodil leteči korpus (corps volant), ki sta ga podpirali še dve diviziji, da bi uničil konvoj generala Adama Ludwiga Lewenhaupta, ki je glavni švedski vojski v Ukrajini vozil okrepitve in zaloge. Peter je konvoj dohitel pri vasi Lesnaja (Ljasnaja) v Poljsko-litovski republiki, na ozemlju današnje Belorusije.

source.title: Battle of Lesnaya
paragraphs: The Battle of Lesnaya was fought on 9 October 1708 during the Swedish invasion of Russia in the Great Northern War. Russia was the sole remaining enemy of Sweden following the dissolution of the anti-Swedish coalition in 1706. Peter I of Russia led a flying corps (corps volant [ru]), supported by two additional divisions, to destroy a convoy under general Adam Ludwig Lewenhaupt that was heading for the Swedish main army in Ukraine with reinforcements and supplies. Peter caught up with the convoy at the village of Lesnaya (Lyasnaya) in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, present-day Belarus.

Battle of Leuctra.headline: Bitka pri Levktri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Levktri (starogrško: Λεῦκτρα) je potekala 6. julija 371 pr. n. št. med Beočani pod vodstvom Tebancev ter Špartanci in njihovimi zavezniki. Do nje je prišlo v okviru kraljevega ali Antalkidovega miru, ki je leta 386 pr. n. št. končal korintsko vojno. Mir so formalno obnovili leta 375 pr. n. št., spor med Špartanci in Tebanci glede postopka za njegovo ponovno obnovitev leta 371 pa je neposredno pripeljal do bitke, ki je potekala v bližini Levktre, vasi v Beotiji na ozemlju Tespij. Pretežno tebanska zmaga je strla ogromen vpliv Šparte na grškem polotoku in v širšem egejskem grškem svetu, ki si ga je Šparta pridobila z zmago v peloponeški vojni generacijo prej.
notes: The IPA pronunciation is left out.

source.title: Battle of Leuctra
paragraphs: The Battle of Leuctra (Ancient Greek: Λεῦκτρα, Ancient Greek: [lêu̯k.tra]) was fought on 6 July 371 BC between the Boeotians led by the Thebans, and the Spartans along with their allies. The battle occurred in the context of the King's Peace, or Peace of Antalcidas, which had ended the Corinthian War in 386 BC. The Peace was formally renewed in 375 BC, but a disagreement between the Spartans and the Thebans over the protocol for renewing the Peace again in 371 led directly to the battle, which took place in the vicinity of Leuctra, a village in Boeotia in the territory of Thespiae. The mainly Theban victory shattered Sparta's immense influence over the Greek peninsula, and the wider Aegean Greek world, which Sparta had gained with its victory in the Peloponnesian War a generation earlier.

Battle of Leuze.headline: Bitka pri Leuzu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Leuzu je bila velik konjeniški spopad devetletne vojne, ki je potekal 18. septembra 1691 med francoskim odredom in močnejšimi zavezniškimi silami.

Maršal Luxembourg je izvedel, da je Viljem III. Oranski odpotoval v Anglijo, ker je menil, da je pohod leta 1691 končan. Izvedel je tudi, da se maršal Waldeck, ki mu je bilo prepuščeno poveljstvo, pripravlja na umik v zimovališča.

Luxembourg je bil blizu Tournaija in je poslal izvidnico pod vodstvom Marsillyja, od katerega je izvedel, da se glavnina zavezniške vojske umika in da je pri Leuzu pustila konjeniško zaščitnico s komaj 3000 možmi pod poveljstvom grofa Tillyja. Luxembourg je takoj ukrepal. Poslal je odred, ki naj bi sledil premikom glavnine, z eskadroni Villarsa in Marsillyja pa je brez opozorila napadel manjšo skupino. Francoska konjenica je jurišala samo z meči.

source.title: Battle of Leuze
paragraphs: The Battle of Leuze was a large Cavalry engagement of the Nine Years' War that took place on 18 September 1691 between a detachment of French and a superior Allied force.

Marshal Luxembourg had been informed that William III of Orange had left for England, in the supposition that the campaign of 1691 was at its end. He was also informed that Marshal Waldeck, who was left in charge, was preparing to retire into winter quarters.

Luxembourg was near Tournai and sent out a reconnaissance under Marsilly, from whom he learned that the main body of the Allied army was retreating, leaving a rear-guard of cavalry, consisting of just 3,000 men, under the Count of Tilly at Leuze. Luxembourg acted immediately. He sent a detachment to follow the movements of the main body, and with the squadrons of Villars and Marsilly he attacked the smaller party without warning. The French cavalry charged, only using their swords.

Battle of Lewes.headline: Bitka pri Lewesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lewesu je bila ena od dveh glavnih bitk spopada, znanega kot druga baronska vojna. Potekala je 14. maja 1264 pri Lewesu v Sussexu. Pomenila je vrhunec kariere Simona de Montforta, 6. grofa Leicestra, in iz njega naredila »nekronanega angleškega kralja«. Sile Henrika III. so zapustile varno zavetje gradu Lewes in priorata sv. Pankracija, da bi se z baroni spopadle v bitki, in bile sprva uspešne, saj je Henrikov sin princ Edvard s konjeniškim napadom pognal v beg del baronske vojske. Edvard pa je ubežnike zasledoval daleč z bojišča in Henrikove može pustil nezaščitene. Henrik je moral sprožiti pehotni napad na grič Offham Hill, kjer so ga premagali možje baronov, ki so branili vrh. Rojalisti so pobegnili nazaj v grad in priorat, kralj pa je moral podpisati lewesko poravnavo (Mise of Lewes) in de Montfortu prepustiti velik del svoje oblasti.

source.title: Battle of Lewes
paragraphs: The Battle of Lewes was one of two main battles of the conflict known as the Second Barons' War. It took place at Lewes in Sussex, on 14 May 1264. It marked the high point of the career of Simon de Montfort, 6th Earl of Leicester, and made him the "uncrowned King of England". Henry III's forces left the safety of Lewes Castle and St. Pancras Priory to engage the barons in battle and were initially successful, with Henry's son Prince Edward routing part of the baronial army with a cavalry charge. However, Edward pursued his quarry off the battlefield and left Henry's men exposed. Henry was forced to launch an infantry attack up Offham Hill where he was defeated by the barons' men defending the summit. The royalists fled back to the castle and priory and the King was forced to sign the Mise of Lewes, ceding many of his powers to de Montfort.

Bitka za Liège (5.–16. avgusta 1914) je bila uvodni spopad nemške invazije na Belgijo in prva bitka prve svetovne vojne. Mesto Liège je varoval obroč sodobnih trdnjav; bilo je eno od več utrjenih mest, ki naj bi zavlekla invazijo, da bi se čete sil, ki so jamčile belgijsko nevtralnost, lahko mobilizirale in se belgijski vojski pridružile pri izgonu napadalca.

Nemška 1. armada je prispela pozno 5. avgusta 1914 in mesto zavzela 7. avgusta, ko se je Erich Ludendorff pripeljal vanj in posadko prepričal, naj se preda. Okoliške trdnjave so se borile naprej in več napadov nemške pehote se je drago izjalovilo. Prispeli so supertežki oblegovalni topovi in trdnjave uničevali drugo za drugo; zadnja se je predala 16. avgusta.

source.title: Battle of Liège
paragraphs: The Battle of Liège (5–16 August 1914) was the opening engagement of the German invasion of Belgium and the first battle of the First World War. The city of Liège was protected by a ring of modern fortresses, one of several fortified cities intended to delay an invasion for troops from the powers guaranteeing Belgian neutrality to mobilise and join the Belgian Army in the expulsion of the invader.

The German 1st Army arrived late 5 August 1914 and captured the city on 7 August when Erich Ludendorff drove in and convinced the garrison to surrender. The surrounding forts fought on and several attacks by German infantry were costly failures. Super-heavy siege guns arrived and destroyed the forts one by one; the last fort surrendered on 16 August.

Battle of Liegnitz (1760).headline: Bitka pri Legnici (1760)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Legnici je potekala 15. avgusta 1760 med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne): pruska vojska Friderika Velikega je premagala avstrijsko vojsko pod vodstvom Ernsta von Laudona.

Vojski sta se spopadli okoli mesta Liegnitz (danes Legnica na Poljskem) v Spodnji Šleziji. Laudonova avstrijska konjenica je zgodaj zjutraj napadla pruski položaj, a so jo odbili huzarji generala Zietna. Razvil se je topniški dvoboj, ki so ga nazadnje dobili Prusi, ko je granata zadela avstrijski voz s smodnikom. Avstrijska pehota je nato napadla prusko bojno vrsto, a jo je pričakal zgoščen topniški ogenj. Pruski pehotni protinapad, ki ga je na levem krilu vodil polk Anhalt-Bernburg, je Avstrijce prisilil k umiku. Pripadniki polka Anhalt-Bernburg so z bajoneti jurišali celo na avstrijsko konjenico, kar je redek primer napada pehote na konjenico.

Kmalu po zori je bil glavni boj končan, prusko topništvo pa je Avstrijce še naprej obstreljevalo. Prispel je general Leopold von Daun in se, ko je izvedel za Laudonov poraz, odločil, da ne bo napadel, čeprav so bili njegovi vojaki spočiti.

source.title: Battle of Liegnitz (1760)
paragraphs: The Battle of Liegnitz on 15 August 1760 saw Frederick the Great's Prussian Army defeat the Austrian army under Ernst von Laudon during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War).

The armies collided around the town of Liegnitz (now Legnica, Poland) in Lower Silesia. Laudon's Austrian cavalry attacked the Prussian position in the early morning but were beaten back by General Zieten's Hussars. An artillery duel emerged which was eventually won for the Prussians when a shell hit an Austrian powder wagon. The Austrian infantry then proceeded to attack the Prussian line, but was met with concentrated artillery fire. A Prussian infantry counter-attack led by the Regiment Anhalt-Bernburg on the left forced the Austrians into retreat. Notably, the Anhalt-Bernburgers charged Austrian cavalry with bayonets, a rare example of infantry assaulting cavalry.

Shortly after dawn the major action was over but Prussian artillery fire continued to harass the Austrians. General Leopold von Daun arrived and, learning of Laudon's defeat, decided not to attack despite his soldiers being fresh.

Bitka pri Lignyju, v kateri so francoske čete Severne armade (Armée du Nord) pod poveljstvom Napoleona I. premagale del pruske vojske pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Blücherja, je potekala 16. junija 1815 blizu Lignyja na ozemlju današnje Belgije. Bila je taktična zmaga Francozov, a glavnina pruske vojske je bitko preživela v dobrem redu, okrepile so jo pruske čete, ki se pri Lignyju niso bojevale, in dva dni pozneje je odigrala svojo vlogo v bitki pri Waterlooju. To je bila zadnja zmaga Napoleonove vojaške kariere. Na vrhuncu bitke je bil Blücher ranjen in so ga odnesli z bojišča, zamenjal pa ga je načelnik štaba, generalpodpolkovnik Gneisenau.

source.title: Battle of Ligny
paragraphs: The Battle of Ligny, in which French troops of the Armée du Nord under the command of Napoleon I defeated part of a Prussian army under Field Marshal Blücher, was fought on 16 June 1815 near Ligny in what is now Belgium. The result was a tactical victory for the French, but the bulk of the Prussian army survived the battle in good order, was reinforced by Prussian troops who had not fought at Ligny, and played a role two days later at the Battle of Waterloo. Ligny was the last victory in Napoleon's military career. In the culminating moment of this battle Blücher was wounded and carried off the battlefield, and was replaced by his chief of staff, Lieutenant General Gneisenau.

Battle of Lilybaeum.headline: Bitka pri Lilibeju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lilibeju je bila prvi spopad med ladjevjema Kartagine in Rima leta 218 pr. n. št. v drugi punski vojni. Kartažani so poslali 35 kvinkerem, da bi plenile po Siciliji, začenši pri Lilibeju. Rimljane je pred napadom, ki je grozil, pravočasno posvaril Hieron iz Sirakuz, zato so imeli dovolj časa, da so z ladjevjem 20 kvinkerem prestregli kartažansko enoto in zajeli več njenih ladij.
notes: No established Slovenian form of Lilybaeum was found; Lilibej is used (modern Marsala).

source.title: Battle of Lilybaeum
paragraphs: The Battle of Lilybaeum was the first clash between the navies of Carthage and Rome in 218 BC during the Second Punic War. The Carthaginians had sent 35 quinqueremes to raid Sicily, starting with Lilybaeum. The Romans, warned by Hiero of Syracuse of the coming raid, had time to intercept the Carthaginian contingent with a fleet of 20 quinqueremes and managed to capture several Carthaginian ships.

Battle of Limanowa.headline: Bitka pri Limanowi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Limanowi in Łapanówu je potekala od 1. do 13. decembra 1914 med avstro-ogrsko in rusko vojsko blizu mesta Limanowa (40 kilometrov jugovzhodno od Krakova).
Avstro-ogrsko vrhovno poveljstvo je domnevalo, da bo nemški uspeh oslabil ruske sile na severu in da bo galicijska fronta ostala mirna. Obe domnevi sta se izkazali za napačni.

Ofenziva avstro-ogrske 2. armade se je sicer začela 16. novembra in bila sprva uspešna, vendar so se Rusi izkazali za močnejše od pričakovanj, njihova 4. armada pa se je le malo umaknila. Južneje je ruska 2. armada medtem prečkala reko San in do 20. novembra prodrla na območje Tarnówa. Severneje je avstro-ogrska 4. armada ob podpori nemške 47. rezervne divizije v zadnjih dneh novembra prešla v napad.
notes: The mile conversion is left out.

source.title: Battle of Limanowa
paragraphs: The Battle of Limanowa-Łapanów took place from 1 December to 13 December 1914, between the Austro-Hungarian Army and the Russian Army near the town of Limanowa (40 kilometres (25 mi) south-east of Kraków).
The Austro-Hungarian high command had assumed that the German success would weaken Russian forces in the north and that the Galician front would remain quiet. Both these assumptions were incorrect.

Though the Austro-Hungarian 2nd Army offensive opened on 16 November and met early success, the Russians proved stronger than expected and their 4th Army yielded little ground. Meanwhile, further south the Russian 2nd Army advanced across the San river and moved into the Tarnów area by 20 November. Further north, the Austro-Hungarian 4th Army, supported by the German 47th Reserve Division, moved onto the offensive in the last days of November.

Battle of Lincoln (1141).headline: Bitka pri Lincolnu (1141)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lincolnu ali prva bitka pri Lincolnu je potekala 2. februarja 1141 v Lincolnu v Angliji med angleškim kraljem Štefanom in silami, zvestimi cesarici Matildi. Štefana so v bitki ujeli, zaprli in dejansko odstavili, Matilda pa je za kratek čas vladala.

source.title: Battle of Lincoln (1141)
paragraphs: The Battle of Lincoln, or the First Battle of Lincoln, occurred on 2 February 1141 in Lincoln, England between King Stephen of England and forces loyal to Empress Matilda. Stephen was captured during the battle, imprisoned, and effectively deposed while Matilda ruled for a short time.

Battle of Lincoln (1217).headline: Bitka pri Lincolnu (1217)
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Lincolnu je potekala v soboto, 20. maja 1217, pri gradu Lincoln med prvo baronsko vojno, med silami poznejšega francoskega kralja Ludvika VIII. in silami angleškega kralja Henrika III. Ludvikove sile je napadla reševalna vojska pod poveljstvom Williama Marshala, 1. grofa Pembroka. Tomaž, grof Perchea, ki je poveljeval francoskim enotam, je padel, Ludvik pa je bil pregnan iz svojega oporišča na jugovzhodu Anglije. Plenjenje, ki je sledilo, je znano kot »lincolnski sejem«. Meščani Lincolna so bili zvesti Ludviku, zato so Henrikove sile mesto oplenile.

source.title: Battle of Lincoln (1217)
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Lincoln occurred at Lincoln Castle on Saturday 20 May 1217, during the First Barons' War, between the forces of the future Louis VIII of France and those of King Henry III of England. Louis's forces were attacked by a relief force under the command of William Marshal, 1st Earl of Pembroke. Thomas, Count of Perche, commanding the French troops, was killed and Louis was expelled from his base in the southeast of England. The looting that took place afterwards is known as the "Lincoln Fair". The citizens of Lincoln were loyal to Louis so Henry's forces sacked the city.

Battle of Lipany.headline: Bitka pri Lipanih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lipanih (češko: Bitva u Lipan), imenovana tudi bitka pri Českém Brodu, je potekala pri Lipanih 40 km vzhodno od Prage 30. maja 1434 in je tako rekoč končala husitske vojne. Vojska zmernega husitskega (kališniškega) plemstva in katoličanov, imenovana češka zveza, je premagala radikalne taborite in sirotke pod vodstvom vrhovnega poveljnika Prokopa Velikega in poveljnika konjenice Jana Čapka iz Sán.

source.title: Battle of Lipany
paragraphs: The Battle of Lipany (Czech: Bitva u Lipan), also called the Battle of Český Brod, was fought at Lipany 40 km east of Prague on 30 May 1434 and virtually ended the Hussite Wars. An army of moderate Hussite (or Calixtine) nobility and Catholics, called the Bohemian League, defeated the radical Taborites and Orphans (or Sirotci) led by Prokop the Great, the overall commander, and by Jan Čapek of Sány, the cavalry commander.

Battle of Lobositz.headline: Bitka pri Lobositzu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lobositzu ali Lovosicah (tudi Lowositz) 1. oktobra 1756 je bila uvodna kopenska bitka tretje šlezijske vojne in širše sedemletne vojne. Avstrijci, 33.000 mož pod poveljstvom grofa Maximiliana Ulyssesa von Browna, so 28.000 Prusom Friderika Velikega preprečili, da bi nadaljevali invazijo v bogato češko nižino, zato se je moral Friderik nazadnje za zimo umakniti na sever na Saško.

source.title: Battle of Lobositz
paragraphs: The Battle of Lobositz or Lovosice also Lowositz on 1 October 1756 was the opening land battle of the Third Silesian War and the wider Seven Years' War. Frederick the Great's 28,000 Prussians were prevented by 33,000 Austrians under Maximilian Ulysses Count von Browne from continuing their invasion into the rich Bohemian plain, forcing Frederick to ultimately fall back north into Saxony for the winter.

Battle of Łódź (1914).headline: Bitka pri Lodžu (1914)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lodžu (nemško: Schlacht um Łódź) ali lodška operacija (rusko: Лодзинская операция) je potekala od 11. novembra do 6. decembra 1914 blizu mesta Lodž na Poljskem. V hudih zimskih razmerah so se bojevale nemške enote 8. in 9. armade ter avstrijska 1. armada proti ruski 1., 2. in 5. armadi. Nemci so po neuspehih v bitki na Visli svojo 9. armado prerazporedili okoli Toruńa (Thorn), da bi ogrozili rusko severno krilo. Nemški cilj je bil preprečiti invazijo na Nemčijo z obkolitvijo in uničenjem Rusov; namesto tega so bili obkoljeni Nemci, ki so izgubili dva korpusa, invazijo na Nemčijo pa so vseeno preprečili. Bitka je močno vplivala na zahodno in vzhodno fronto. Končala se je s taktično zmago ruskih čet, čeprav so se Rusi nazadnje umaknili, pritisk na Avstrijce pa je popustil, saj so okrepitve, ki bi lahko šle v Przemyśl, odšle v Lodž; to pomeni strateško zmago Nemčije.
notes: The Russian romanization is dropped; the Cyrillic is kept.

source.title: Battle of Łódź (1914)
paragraphs: The Battle of Łódź (German: Schlacht um Łódź) or Lodz operation (Russian: Лодзинская операция, romanized: Lodzinskaya operatsia) took place from 11 November to 6 December 1914, near the city of Łódź in Poland. Battles were fought between German units of the 8th Army, 9th Army, Austrian 1st Army, and the Russian 1st, 2nd, and 5th Armies, in harsh winter conditions. The Germans redeployed their 9th Army around Thorn, so as to threaten the Russian northern flank, following German reversals after the Battle of the Vistula River. The German objective was to prevent an invasion of Germany, by encircling and destroying the Russians; instead, the Germans were surrounded and lost two corps; still, the invasion of Germany was prevented. The battle had a strong impact on both the Western and Eastern fronts. It ended with the tactical victory of the Russian troops, although the Russians eventually withdrew and the pressure on the Austrians eased, as reinforcements that could have gone to Przemyśl went instead to Łódź; implying a strategic victory for Germany.

Battle of Loos.headline: Bitka pri Loosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Loosu je potekala od 25. septembra do 8. oktobra 1915 v Franciji na zahodni fronti med prvo svetovno vojno. Bila je največji britanski napad leta 1915: Britanci so v njej prvič uporabili plin kot orožje, prvič pa so se v velikem obsegu bojevale tudi divizije nove armade (New Army). Francozi in Britanci so skušali prebiti nemško obrambo v Artoisu na severu in v Šampanji na južnem koncu noyonskega izbočenja, da bi obnovili gibljivo vojskovanje.

Kljub izboljšanim metodam, več strelivu, boljši opremi in plinu so Nemci francosko-britanske napade zajezili in izgubili le nekaj ozemlja. Britanski plinski napad branilcev ni dovolj onesposobil, topniško obstreljevanje pa je bilo prekratko, da bi uničilo bodečo žico in mitralješka gnezda. Britanci, ki so šele zbirali množično vojsko, primerno za razmere na zahodni fronti, nemških obrambnih utrdb in taktike niso mogli premagati.

source.title: Battle of Loos
paragraphs: The Battle of Loos took place from 25 September to 8 October 1915 in France on the Western Front, during the First World War. It was the biggest British attack of 1915, the first time that the British used gas as a weapon and the first mass engagement of New Army divisions. The French and British tried to break through the German defences in Artois in the north and Champagne at the south end of the Noyon Salient, to restore a war of movement.

Despite improved methods, more ammunition, better equipment and gas, the Franco–British attacks were contained by the Germans, except for local losses of ground. The British gas attack failed sufficiently to neutralise the defenders and the artillery bombardment was too short to destroy barbed wire and machine-gun nests. German defensive fortifications and tactics could not be overcome by the British who were still assembling a mass army suitable for Western Front conditions.

Battle of Lorraine.headline: Bitka v Loreni
paragraphs: Bitka v Loreni (14. avgusta – 7. septembra 1914) je potekala na zahodni fronti med prvo svetovno vojno. Francoska in nemška vojska sta končali mobilizacijo: Francozi po načrtu XVII za ofenzivo prek Lorene in Alzacije v Nemčijo, Nemci pa po načrtu Aufmarsch II West za ofenzivo na severu prek Luksemburga in Belgije v Francijo, ki naj bi jo dopolnili napadi na jugu, da Francozi ne bi mogli premeščati čet proti večji nevarnosti na severu.

source.title: Battle of Lorraine
paragraphs: The Battle of Lorraine (14 August – 7 September 1914) was a battle on the Western Front during the First World War. The armies of France and Germany had completed their mobilisation, the French with Plan XVII, to conduct an offensive through Lorraine and Alsace into Germany and the Germans with Aufmarsch II West, for an offensive in the north through Luxembourg and Belgium into France, supplemented with attacks in the south to prevent the French from transferring troops to the greater threat in the north.

Battle of Losecoat Field.headline: Bitka pri Losecoat Fieldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Losecoat Fieldu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Empinghamu) je potekala 12. marca 1470 v vojni rož. Zapis imena »Losecoat« se razlikuje, pojavljata se tudi »Losecote« in »Loose-coat«.

Bitka je zapečatila poraz slabo organiziranega Wellesovega upora proti kralju Edvardu IV., nazadnje pa je privedla do prestopa Richarda Nevilla, 16. grofa Warwicka, in kraljevega brata Jurija, vojvode Clarenca, na lancastrsko stran, potem ko sta morala zaradi vpletenosti v upor pobegniti iz države.

source.title: Battle of Losecoat Field
paragraphs: The Battle of Losecoat Field (also known as the Battle of Empingham) was fought on 12 March 1470, during the Wars of the Roses. Spellings of "Losecoat" vary, with "Losecote" and "Loose-coat" also seen.

The battle secured the defeat of the poorly organised Welles Uprising against King Edward IV, but ultimately led to the defection of Richard Neville, 16th Earl of Warwick and the king's brother George, Duke of Clarence to the Lancastrian cause after they were forced to flee the country having been implicated in the rebellion.

Battle of Loudoun Hill.headline: Bitka pri Loudoun Hillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Loudoun Hillu je potekala 10. maja 1307 med škotskimi silami pod vodstvom kralja Roberta Brucea in Angleži pod poveljstvom Aymerja de Valencea, grofa Pembroka. Potekala je pod gričem Loudoun Hill v Ayrshiru in se končala z zmago kralja Roberta. To je bila njegova prva velika vojaška zmaga.
Bojišče je bilo leta 2012 vpisano v Popis zgodovinskih bojišč na Škotskem.

source.title: Battle of Loudoun Hill
paragraphs: The Battle of Loudoun Hill was fought on 10 May 1307, between a Scots force led by King Robert the Bruce and the English commanded by Aymer de Valence, Earl of Pembroke. It took place beneath Loudoun Hill, in Ayrshire, and ended in a victory for King Robert. It was the king's first major military victory.
The battlefield was added to the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland in 2012.

Bitka pri Lübecku je potekala 6. novembra 1806 v Lübecku v Nemčiji med vojaki Kraljevine Prusije pod vodstvom Gebharda Leberechta von Blücherja, ki so se umikali po porazu v bitki pri Jeni in Auerstedtu, in četami prvega francoskega cesarstva pod vodstvom maršalov Murata, Bernadotta in Soulta, ki so jih zasledovale. V tem spopadu vojne četrte koalicije so Francozi Prusom zadali hud poraz in jih pregnali iz nevtralnega mesta. Lübeck je staro baltsko pristanišče približno 50 kilometrov severovzhodno od Hamburga.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Lübeck
paragraphs: The Battle of Lübeck took place on 6 November 1806 in Lübeck, Germany between soldiers of the Kingdom of Prussia led by Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher, who were retreating from defeat at the Battle of Jena–Auerstedt, and troops of the First French Empire under Marshals Murat, Bernadotte, and Soult, who were pursuing them. In this War of the Fourth Coalition action, the French inflicted a severe defeat on the Prussians, driving them from the neutral city. Lübeck is an old Baltic Sea port approximately 50 kilometres (31 mi) northeast of Hamburg.

Bitka za Lutecijo je potekala leta 52 pr. n. št. na ravnini Grenelle na območju današnjega Pariza med rimskimi silami pod poveljstvom Tita Labiena in protirimsko galsko koalicijo v galskih vojnah. Zmagali so Rimljani. Julij Cezar bitko opisuje v svojih Zapiskih o galski vojni, pri čemer se opira tako na Labienovo poročilo kot na epizodo iz Polibijeve zgodovine.

source.title: Battle of Lutetia
paragraphs: The Battle of Lutetia was fought in 52 BC on the plain of Grenelle in what is now Paris, between Roman forces under Titus Labienus and an anti-Roman Gallic coalition during the Gallic Wars. The Romans were victorious. Julius Caesar offers an account of the battle in his Gallic Wars, for which he draws both on Labienus' report and an episode in Polybius's history.

Battle of Lutos.headline: Bitka pri Lutosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lutosu je potekala leta 794, ko je kordobski emir Hišam I. nad Kraljestvo Asturija poslal vojaške vpade pod poveljstvom bratov Abd al Karima ibn Abd al Valida ibn Mugaitha in Abd al Malika ibn Abd al Valida ibn Mugaitha.

source.title: Battle of Lutos
paragraphs: The Battle of Lutos occurred in 794 when the Emir of Cordoba, Hisham I sent military incursions against the Kingdom of Asturias under the command of the brothers Abd al-Karim ibn Abd al-Walid ibn Mugaith and Abd al-Malik ibn Abd al-Walid ibn Mugaith.

Battle of Lutter.headline: Bitka pri Lutterju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lutterju (nemško: Lutter am Barenberge) je potekala 27. avgusta 1626 med tridesetletno vojno južno od Salzgittra na Spodnjem Saškem. Združene dansko-nemške sile pod vodstvom danskega kralja Kristijana IV. je premagal Johann Tserclaes, grof Tilly, ki je poveljeval vojski katoliške lige, zvesti cesarju Ferdinandu II.

Kristijanov vojni načrt za leto 1626 je obsegal tri dele: medtem ko bi sam z glavno vojsko krenil nad Tillyja, bi Ernst von Mansfeld ob podpori Kristijana Brunšviškega napadel Wallensteina. Mansfeld je bil aprila poražen v bitki pri dessauskem mostu, napad Kristijana Brunšviškega je spodletel, junija pa je ta umrl zaradi bolezni.

source.title: Battle of Lutter
paragraphs: The Battle of Lutter (German: Lutter am Barenberge) took place on 27 August 1626 during the Thirty Years' War, south of Salzgitter, in Lower Saxony. A combined Danish-German force led by Christian IV of Denmark was defeated by Johann Tserclaes, Count of Tilly, commanding an army of the Catholic League loyal to Emperor Ferdinand II.

Christian's campaign plan for 1626 consisted of three parts; while he led the main army against Tilly, Ernst von Mansfeld would attack Wallenstein, supported by Christian of Brunswick. In the event, Mansfeld was defeated at the Battle of Dessau Bridge in April, while Christian of Brunswick's attack failed, and he died of disease in June.

Battle of Lutterberg (1758).headline: Bitka pri Lutterbergu (1758)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lutterbergu je potekala 10. oktobra 1758 v sedemletni vojni med francoskimi silami z 42.000 možmi pod poveljstvom Karla, kneza Soubisa, in veliko manjšimi anglo-nemškimi silami pod poveljstvom generala Christopha Ludwiga von Oberga.

Vojski sta se spopadli blizu mesta Lutterberg na Spodnjem Saškem. Zavezniške čete, 14.000 mož, večinoma Prusov, so po več juriših francoske konjenice popustile in se morale umakniti. Čeprav je Soubise dosegel odločilno zmago, je umikajočega se sovražnika počasi zasledoval, zato so ga nadrejeni v Parizu zamenjali z markizom de Contadesom.
Soubise je za to zmago prejel maršalsko palico. François de Chevert je bil za svoj prispevek v bitki odlikovan z velikim križem (Grand Croix).

source.title: Battle of Lutterberg (1758)
paragraphs: The Battle of Lutterberg took place on 10 October 1758 during the Seven Years' War between a French force of 42,000 commanded by Charles, Prince of Soubise and a much smaller Anglo-German force commanded by General Christoph Ludwig von Oberg.

The two armies clashed near the town of Lutterberg, Lower Saxony. The 14,000 mostly Prussian Allied troops, were overwhelmed by several charges of French cavalry and were forced to withdraw. Despite having won a decisive victory, Soubise was slow to pursue the retreating enemy - causing his superiors in Paris to replace him with the Marquis de Contades.
Soubise earned a Marshal's baton for this victory. François de Chevert was decorated with the Grand Croix for his contributions in the battle.

Battle of Lützen (1632).headline: Bitka pri Lütznu (1632)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Lütznu 16. novembra 1632 je bila ena najpomembnejših bitk tridesetletne vojne. Švedska vojska pod vodstvom Gustava II. Adolfa, ki so jo podpirale čete iz Saške in Hessen-Kassla, je tesno premagala cesarsko vojsko pod vodstvom Albrechta von Wallensteina. Obe strani sta utrpeli hude izgube, med mrtvimi pa je bil tudi sam Gustav Adolf.

Bitka se je začela z vrsto čelnih napadov švedske pehote, ki je skoraj prebila nasprotnika, preden jo je cesarska konjenica pod Pappenheimom z velikimi izgubami odbila. Gustav je padel med umikom, a so njegovo pehoto podrejeni znova uredili in ta je tik pred nočjo ob podpori topniškega ognja z bližine zavzela cesarsko središče. Wallenstein se je umaknil v dobrem redu, a je moral pustiti ranjence, veliko topov in večino tovorne kolone.

source.title: Battle of Lützen (1632)
paragraphs: The Battle of Lützen, fought on 16 November 1632, was one of the most important of the Thirty Years' War. A Swedish army under Gustavus Adolphus, supported by troops from Saxony and Hesse-Kassel, narrowly defeated an Imperial force under Albrecht von Wallenstein. Both sides suffered heavy casualties, with Gustavus himself among the dead.

The battle began with a series of frontal attacks by the Swedish infantry, which nearly succeeded in breaking through before being repulsed with severe losses by Imperial cavalry under Pappenheim. Gustavus was killed as they fell back, but re-formed by his subordinates, his infantry overran the Imperial centre just before nightfall, supported by close range artillery fire. Wallenstein withdrew in good order, but was forced to abandon his wounded, many of his guns, and most of his supply train.

Bitka pri Lütznu, ki je potekala 2. maja 1813 blizu mesta Lützen na Saškem, je bila velik spopad vojne šeste koalicije. V njej so se francoske sile Napoleona Bonaparta spopadle s koalicijsko vojsko pruskih in ruskih čet pod poveljstvom generalov Wittgensteina in Blücherja. Z bitko je Napoleon po katastrofalnem umiku iz Rusije leta 1812 skušal znova uveljaviti prevlado v srednji Evropi. Čeprav so zavezniki sprva pridobili ozemlje in Francozom prizadejali precejšnjo škodo, je Napoleon s taktično spretnostjo in uporabo zbranih rezerv obrnil potek bitke. Francozi so nazadnje dosegli drago zmago in zaveznike prisilili k umiku.

source.title: Battle of Lützen (1813)
paragraphs: The Battle of Lützen, fought on 2 May 1813 near the town of Lützen in Saxony, was a major engagement during the War of the Sixth Coalition. It pitted Napoleon Bonaparte's French forces against a coalition army of Prussian and Russian troops commanded by Generals Wittgenstein and Blücher. The battle marked Napoleon's attempt to reassert dominance in Central Europe following his disastrous retreat from Russia in 1812. Although the Allies initially gained ground and inflicted significant damage on the French forces, Napoleon's tactical brilliance and use of concentrated reserves allowed him to turn the tide of the battle. The French ultimately secured a costly victory, forcing the Allies to retreat.

Battle of Luzzara.headline: Bitka pri Luzzari
paragraphs: Bitka pri Luzzari je potekala 15. avgusta 1702 v Lombardiji v španski nasledstveni vojni med združeno francosko-savojsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Louisa Josepha, vojvode de Vendôme, in cesarsko vojsko princa Evgena.

Vojskovanje v severni Italiji se je vrtelo okoli špansko nadzorovanih vojvodin, Milanske in Mantovske, ki sta nadzorovali dostop do južnih meja Francije in Avstrije. Ko se je vojna leta 1701 začela, se je Savoja povezala s Francijo. Čeprav so bili cesarski v številčni manjšini, so do februarja 1702 imeli strateško pobudo.

Vendôme je prešel v ofenzivo: julija je zavzel Modeno in Reggio, avgusta pa še Luzzaro, ključni prehod čez reko Pad. Ker mu je grozila odrezanost od oskrbovalne baze v Mirandoli, je princ Evgen začel vrsto napadov na francoske položaje pri Luzzari.

source.title: Battle of Luzzara
paragraphs: The Battle of Luzzara took place in Lombardy on 15 August 1702 during the War of the Spanish Succession, between a combined French and Savoyard army under Louis Joseph, duc de Vendôme, and an Imperial force under Prince Eugene.

Conflict in Northern Italy centred around the Spanish-held Duchies of Milan and Mantua, which controlled access to the southern borders of both France and Austria. When the war began in 1701, Savoy allied with France; despite being out numbered, by February 1702 the Imperialists held the strategic initiative.

Vendôme took the offensive, taking Modena and Reggio in July, followed by Luzzara in August, a vital crossing point over the River Po. Threatened with being cut off from his supply base at Mirandola, Prince Eugene launched a series of attacks on the French positions at Luzzara.

Battle of Lwów (1939).headline: Bitka za Lvov (1939)
paragraphs: Bitka za Lvov (včasih imenovana obleganje Lvova) je bila bitka druge svetovne vojne za nadzor nad nekdaj poljskim mestom Lvov (poljsko Lwów, danes ukrajinski Lviv) med poljsko vojsko ter Wehrmachtom in Rdečo armado, ki sta vdrla v državo. Mesto je veljalo za ključ do tako imenovanega romunskega mostišča in so ga branili za vsako ceno.

source.title: Battle of Lwów (1939)
paragraphs: The Battle of Lwów (sometimes called the Siege of Lwów) was a World War II battle for the control over the formerly Polish city of Lwów (now Lviv, Ukraine) between the Polish Army and the invading Wehrmacht and the Red Army. The city was seen as the key to the so-called Romanian Bridgehead and was defended at all costs.

Bitka za Lisičansk je bila spopad med Rusijo in Ukrajino v okviru širše bitke za Donbas v kampanji na vzhodu Ukrajine med rusko-ukrajinsko vojno. Maja 2022 sta bila Lisičansk in njegovo dvojčično mesto Severodoneck največji mesti Luganske oblasti, ki nista bili pod ruskim nadzorom. Ruske sile so maja začele napad na Severodoneck, kjer so srditi boji trajali do konca junija, ko so se ukrajinske sile iz mesta umaknile. Boji so se nato nadaljevali, ko so ruske sile čez reko Donec začele napadati Lisičansk.

Rusija in Luganska ljudska republika (LLR) sta 2. in 3. julija sporočili, da so njune sile zavzele Lisičansk, čeprav je Ukrajina zavzetje mesta sprva zanikala. Ukrajinski generalštab je 3. julija priznal, da so se njegove sile iz mesta umaknile, »da bi rešili življenja ukrajinskih branilcev«.
Lisičansk je bil zadnja ukrajinska utrdba v Luganski oblasti, ki je padla; Rusija je nato trdila, da oblast v celoti nadzoruje.

source.title: Battle of Lysychansk
paragraphs: The Battle of Lysychansk was a military engagement between Russia and Ukraine in the wider battle of Donbas of the eastern Ukraine campaign during the Russo-Ukrainian war. By May 2022, Lysychansk and its twin city of Sievierodonetsk were the two largest cities of the Luhansk Oblast not under Russian control. Russian forces launched an assault on Sievierodonetsk in May where a fierce battle occurred until late June, when Ukrainian forces withdrew from the city. Fighting then continued as Russian forces started to attack Lysychansk across the Donets River.

Russia and the Luhansk People's Republic (LPR) announced their forces had seized Lysychansk on 2–3 July, although Ukraine initially denied the city's capture. The Ukrainian general staff conceded on 3 July that their forces had withdrawn from the city "in order to save the lives of Ukrainian defenders."
Lysychansk was the last Ukrainian stronghold to be captured in Luhansk Oblast, which Russia then claimed to fully control.

Ljubanska ofenziva, imenovana tudi bitka pri Ljubanu ali bitka ob Volhovu (7. januarja – 30. aprila 1942) (rusko: Любанская наступательная операция; nemško: Schlacht am Wolchow), je bila sovjetska ofenzivna operacija druge svetovne vojne. Izvedli sta jo volhovska in leningrajska fronta Rdeče armade, njen cilj pa je bil prekiniti obleganje Leningrada ter obkoliti in uničiti nemške sile, ki so mesto oblegale.

source.title: Battle of Lyuban
paragraphs: The Battle of Lyuban, Lyuban offensive operation or Battle of the Volkhov (7 January 1942 – 30 April 1942) (Russian: Любанская наступательная операция; German: Schlacht am Wolchow) was a Soviet offensive operation of World War II. It was conducted by the Volkhov and Leningrad Fronts of the Red Army with the goal of relieving the siege of Leningrad and encircling and destroying the German forces carrying out the siege.

Battle of Maastricht.headline: Bitka pri Maastrichtu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Maastrichtu je bila ena prvih bitk nemškega pohoda na zahodni fronti med drugo svetovno vojno. Maastricht je bil ključno mesto za zavzetje belgijske trdnjave Eben-Emael in razcepitev zavezniških vojsk na dvoje.

Nemci so hoteli z operacijo nepoškodovane zavzeti glavne mostove čez reko Mozo (Maas) in si olajšati pot v osrednjo Belgijo. Zato so poslali skupine, preoblečene v civiliste, ki naj bi onesposobile razstrelivo na mostovih. Može so opazili in aretirali, ko pa so skušali pobegniti, so jih ustrelili.

source.title: Battle of Maastricht
paragraphs: The Battle of Maastricht was one of the first battles that took place during the German Campaign on the Western Front during World War II. Maastricht was a key city in order to capture the Belgian Fort Eben-Emael and split the allied armies in half.

The German goal of the operation was to take the main bridges over the river Maas intact, to have an easier road to central Belgium. Therefore, the Germans sent in teams disguised as civilians whose job was to sabotage the bridge charges. However, they were spotted and arrested, and when they attempted to run, shot.
Bitka pri Maciejowicah je potekala 10. oktobra 1794 med Republiko obeh narodov in Ruskim cesarstvom med poljsko vstajo leta 1794.

Poljake je vodil Tadeusz Kościuszko. Kościuszko je s 6200 možmi nameraval preprečiti združitev treh večjih ruskih korpusov pod poveljstvom generalov Fjodorja Denisova, Ivana Fersna in Aleksandra Suvorova. Zaprosil je tudi za podporo Adama Ponińskega (ki je imel 4000 vojakov), a Poniński na bojišče ni prispel pravočasno.
notes: The English sentence on Kościuszko's 6,200 men has no main verb; the Slovenian makes it a full sentence.

source.title: Battle of Maciejowice
paragraphs: The Battle of Maciejowice was fought on 10 October 1794, between the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Russian Empire during the Polish Uprising of 1794.

The Poles were led by Tadeusz Kościuszko. Kościuszko with 6,200 men, who planned to prevent the linking of three larger Russian corps, commanded by generals Fyodor Denisov, Ivan Fersen and Alexander Suvorov. He also had requested the support of Adam Poniński (who had 4,000 soldiers), but Poniński failed to arrive on the battlefield in time.

Bitka pri Magenti je potekala 4. junija 1859 blizu mesta Magenta v Lombardsko-beneškem kraljestvu, avstrijski kronski deželi, v drugi italijanski vojni za neodvisnost. Končala se je s francosko-sardinsko zmago pod Napoleonom III. nad Avstrijci pod maršalom Ferencem Gyulayjem. Vojska Napoleona III. je prečkala reko Ticino in obšla avstrijsko desno krilo, zato se je morala avstrijska vojska pod Gyulayjem umakniti. Utesnjen teren, ki so ga sestavljali obsežni sadovnjaki, prerezani s potoki in namakalnimi kanali, ni dopuščal zapletenih manevrov. Avstrijci so vsako hišo spremenili v majhno trdnjavo. Glavno breme boja je nosilo 5000 grenadirjev francoske cesarske garde, večinoma še v uniformah iz časa prvega cesarstva. Bitka pri Magenti ni bila posebej velika, a je pomenila odločilno zmago francosko-sardinskega zavezništva. Patrica de MacMahona so za zasluge v tej bitki povzdignili v magentskega vojvodo, pozneje pa je bil predsednik francoske tretje republike.
notes: The Italian IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Magenta
paragraphs: The Battle of Magenta (Italian pronunciation: [maˈdʒenta]) was fought on 4 June 1859 near the town of Magenta in the Kingdom of Lombardy–Venetia, a crown land of the Austrian Empire, during the Second Italian War of Independence. It resulted in a French-Sardinian victory under Napoleon III against the Austrians under Marshal Ferenc Gyulay. Napoleon III's army crossed the Ticino River and outflanked the Austrian right forcing the Austrian army under Gyulay to retreat. The confined nature of the country, a vast spread of orchards cut up by streams and irrigation canals, precluded elaborate manoeuvre. The Austrians turned every house into a miniature fortress. The brunt of the fighting was borne by 5,000 grenadiers of the French Imperial Guard, still mostly in their First Empire style of uniforms. The battle of Magenta was not a particularly large battle, but it was a decisive victory for the Franco-Sardinian alliance. Patrice de MacMahon was created Duke of Magenta for his role in this battle, and would later go on to serve as President of the French Third Republic.

Battle of Málaga (1704).headline: Bitka pri Málagi (1704)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Málagi, znana tudi kot bitka pri Vélez-Málagi, je bila velika pomorska bitka v vojni za špansko nasledstvo med angleško-nizozemskim ladjevjem in francosko-španskimi pomorskimi silami 24. avgusta 1704. Obe strani sta se ostro bojevali, nato pa se je angleško-nizozemsko ladjevje naslednji dan umaknilo. Francozi so se nato vrnili v Toulon in do konca spopada niso več izpluli na morje, s čimer se je bitka iz taktičnega pata spremenila v strateški poraz. Bitka je sledila angleško-nizozemskemu zavzetju Gibraltarja nekaj tednov prej in je bila eden od številnih spopadov za nadzor nad tem naseljem med vojno.

source.title: Battle of Málaga (1704)
paragraphs: The Battle of Málaga, also known as the Battle of Vélez-Málaga, was a major fleet action which took place during the War of the Spanish Succession between an Anglo-Dutch fleet and a Franco-Spanish naval force on 24 August 1704. Both sides fought an intense engagement before the Anglo-Dutch fleet withdrew the next day. The French subsequently returned to Toulon, transforming the battle from a tactical stalemate into a strategic defeat, as they would not put out to sea again for the duration of the conflict. Occurring soon after the Anglo-Dutch capture of Gibraltar a few weeks prior, the battle served as one of the numerous engagements which took place for control over the settlement during the war.

Battle of Málaga (1937).headline: Bitka za Málago (1937)
paragraphs: Bitka za Málago je bila vrhunec ofenzive združenih nacionalističnih in italijanskih sil februarja 1937, s katero so v španski državljanski vojni hoteli odpraviti republikanski nadzor nad provinco Málaga. Sodelovala je tudi nacistična Nemčija z letalsko in pomorsko podporo. Zaradi udeležbe maroških regulares in zlasti sodobnih oklepnih italijanskih sil iz nedavno prispelega Corpo Truppe Volontarie je bila Španska republikanska vojska popolnoma poražena, Málaga pa je kapitulirala v manj kot tednu dni.

source.title: Battle of Málaga (1937)
paragraphs: The Battle of Málaga was the culmination of an offensive in February 1937 by the combined Nationalist and Italian forces to eliminate Republican control of the province of Málaga during the Spanish Civil War. Nazi Germany was also involved through air and naval support. The participation of Moroccan regulars and especially of modern and armoured Italian forces from the recently arrived Corpo Truppe Volontarie resulted in a complete rout of the Spanish Republican Army and the capitulation of Málaga in less than a week.

Battle of Malakoff.headline: Bitka za Malakoff
paragraphs: Bitka za Malakoff (francosko: Bataille de Malakoff; rusko: Бой на Малаховом кургане) ali naskok na Malahov kurgan (rusko: Штурм Малахова кургана) je bila vrsta francoskih napadov na ruske sile v reduti Malakoff. Prvi napad 18. junija 1855 ni uspel, reduto pa so zavzeli 8. septembra 1855. Napadi so bili del krimske vojne in obleganja Sevastopola. Francoska vojska pod vodstvom generala MacMahona je reduto Malakoff 8. septembra uspešno naskočila, hkratni britanski napad na reduto Redan južno od Malakoffa pa je bil odbit. V enem od odločilnih trenutkov vojne je francoski zuav Eugène Libaut na vrhu ruske redute izobesil francosko zastavo. Bitka za Malakoff je pripeljala do padca Sevastopola 9. septembra in končala 11 mesecev dolgo obleganje.

source.title: Battle of Malakoff
paragraphs: The Battle of Malakoff (French: Bataille de Malakoff, Russian: Бой на Малаховом кургане) or the Storming of the Malakhov Kurgan (Russian: Штурм Малахова кургана) was a series of French attacks against Russian forces on the Malakoff redoubt. The first attack was unsuccessful, and occurred on 18 June 1855; subsequent capture of the redoubt was on 8 September 1855. The assaults were parts of the Crimean War and the siege of Sevastopol. The French army under General MacMahon successfully stormed the Malakoff redoubt on 8th, while a simultaneous British attack on the Redan to the south of the Malakoff was repulsed. In one of the war's defining moments, the French zouave Eugène Libaut raised the French flag on the top of the Russian redoubt. The battle of Malakoff resulted in the fall of Sevastopol on 9 September, bringing the 11-month siege to an end.

Battle of Maldon.headline: Bitka pri Maldonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Maldonu je potekala 10. ali 11. avgusta 991 n. št. blizu Maldona ob reki Blackwater v Essexu v Angliji, med vladavino Æthelreda Nepripravljenega. Ealdorman Byrhtnoth in njegovi thegni so vodili Angleže proti vikinškemu vpadu. Bitka se je končala s porazom Anglosasov. Po bitki so canterburyjski nadškof Sigeric in ealdormani jugozahodnih pokrajin kralju Æthelredu svetovali, naj Vikinge raje podkupi, kot da bi nadaljeval oboroženi boj. Vikingom so plačali 10.000 funtov, da so zapustili Anglijo.
Opis bitke, okrašen s številnimi govori, pripisanimi bojevnikom, in drugimi podrobnostmi, podaja staroangleška pesnitev, ki jo navadno imenujejo Bitka pri Maldonu.

source.title: Battle of Maldon
paragraphs: The Battle of Maldon took place on 10 or 11 August 991 AD near Maldon beside the River Blackwater in Essex, England, during the reign of Æthelred the Unready. Earl Byrhtnoth and his thegns led the English against a Viking invasion. The battle ended in an Anglo-Saxon defeat. After the battle Archbishop Sigeric of Canterbury and the aldermen of the south-western provinces advised King Æthelred to buy off the Vikings rather than continue the armed struggle. They were paid 10,000 pounds to leave England.
An account of the battle, embellished with many speeches attributed to the warriors and with other details, is related in an Old English poem which is usually named The Battle of Maldon.

Battle of Malka Nidzhe.headline: Bitka pri Malki Nidže
paragraphs: Bitka pri Malki Nidže (bolgarsko: Боят на Малка Нидже), znana tudi kot bitka pri Gorničevu, je bila uvodna bitka bitoljske ofenzive. Trajala je tri dni in se končala z zmago antantnih sil.
notes: Monastir Offensive: bitoljska ofenziva, after the Slovenian name of Monastir (Bitola).

source.title: Battle of Malka Nidzhe
paragraphs: The Battle of Malka Nidzhe (Bulgarian: Боят на Малка Нидже), also known as the Battle of Gornichevo, was the opening battle of the Monastir Offensive. It lasted for three days and ended in victory for the Entente forces.

Battle of Mallorca.headline: Bitka za Majorko
paragraphs: Bitka za Majorko, znana tudi kot izkrcanje na Majorki, je bila amfibijsko izkrcanje republikanskih sil leta 1936, na začetku španske državljanske vojne, s katerim so hoteli nacionaliste pregnati z Majorke in otok vrniti republiki. Po začetnem taktičnem uspehu se je odprava pod poveljstvom stotnika Alberta Baya končala neuspešno, ko so nacionalisti s kopenskimi enotami in močno premočnim letalstvom prešli v protinapad in republikance pognali v morje. Republikanci so bili tako prepričani v zmago, da so operacijo optimistično poimenovali »la reconquista de Mallorca« – »ponovna osvojitev Majorke«.

source.title: Battle of Mallorca
paragraphs: The Battle of Mallorca, also known as the Mallorca Landings, was an amphibious landing of Republican forces in 1936, early in the Spanish Civil War, aimed at driving the Nationalists from Mallorca and reclaiming the island for the Republic. After some initial tactical success, the expedition, commanded by Captain Alberto Bayo, ended in failure when the Nationalists counterattacked with ground troops and massively superior air power and drove the Republicans into the sea. So confident were the Republicans in their prediction of victory they optimistically called the operation "la reconquista de Mallorca" - "the reconquest of Mallorca".

Battle of Maloyaroslavets.headline: Bitka pri Malojaroslavcu
