paragraphs: Bitka pri Malojaroslavcu je potekala 24. oktobra 1812 med francoskim vdorom v Rusijo. Vojski sta bili enakovredni in sta utrpeli podobne izgube, rahlo prednost pa je imela francosko-italijanska vojska. Bila je odločilna bitka Mihaila Kutuzova, s katero je Napoleona prisilil, da se je umaknil proti severozahodu prek Možajska v Smolensk, po opustošeni poti svojega prodiranja, kjer mu je bolj grozila lakota. Kutuzov je naslednji napad na ostanke velike armade, bitko pri Krasnoju, začel 15. novembra 1812, tri tedne pozneje.

source.title: Battle of Maloyaroslavets
paragraphs: The Battle of Maloyaroslavets took place on 24 October 1812 as part of the French invasion of Russia. Armies were evenly matched in the battle and suffered similar casualties, with a marginal edge going to the Franco-Italian army. It was Mikhail Kutuzov's decisive battle to force Napoleon to retreat northwest over Mozhaisk to Smolensk on the devastated route of his advance with a higher probability of starvation. Kutuzov's next attack against the remnants of the Grande Armée, the Battle of Krasnoi, began on 15 November 1812, three weeks later.

Bitka pri Malplaquetu je potekala 11. septembra 1709 med vojno za špansko nasledstvo pri Taisnières-sur-Honu, blizu tedanje meje med Francijo in Belgijo. Francoska vojska s približno 75.000 možmi pod poveljstvom vojvode Villarsa se je spopadla s silami velike aliance s 86.000 možmi pod poveljstvom vojvode Marlborougha. V eni najkrvavejših bitk 18. stoletja so zavezniki tesno zmagali, a utrpeli hude izgube.

Zavezniški uspehi leta 1708 so privedli do obnovitve mirovnih pogajanj, ki pa so se aprila 1709 izjalovila. Potem ko so zavezniki v začetku septembra zavzeli Tournai, so oblegali Mons, z zavzetjem katerega bi lahko vstopili v samo Francijo, Ludvik XIV. pa je Villarsu ukazal, naj prepreči njegov padec. To se je izkazalo za nemogoče, a se je Villars vseeno odločil za boj in vojski sta 10. septembra prišli v stik. Marlboroughov napad se je zavlekel na naslednji dan, kar je Francozom dalo čas za gradnjo močnih obrambnih položajev.

source.title: Battle of Malplaquet
paragraphs: The Battle of Malplaquet, 11 September 1709, was fought during the War of the Spanish Succession, near Taisnières-sur-Hon, close to the then border between France and Belgium. A French army of around 75,000 men, commanded by the Duke of Villars, engaged a Grand Alliance force of 86,000 under the Duke of Marlborough. In one of the bloodiest battles of the 18th century, the Allies won a narrow victory, but suffered heavy casualties.

Allied advances in 1708 led to the renewal of peace talks, which collapsed in April 1709. After taking Tournai in early September, the Allies besieged Mons, whose capture would allow them to enter France itself, and Louis XIV ordered Villars to prevent its loss. Although this proved impossible, he decided to fight anyway, and the two armies made contact on 10 September. Marlborough's attack was delayed until the next day, giving the French time to construct strong defensive positions.

Battle of Mantinea (207 BC).headline: Bitka pri Mantineji (207 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mantineji je potekala leta 207 pr. n. št. med Šparto pod tiranom Mahanido, ki je bila del Etolske zveze, in Ahajsko zvezo, katere sile je vodil Filopojmen. Obe strani sta imeli tudi najemnike. Bila je glavna kopenska bitka prve makedonske vojne v Grčiji; vojna je izbruhnila zaradi makedonskega zavezništva s Kartagino po Hanibalovi zmagi v bitki pri Kanah v drugi punski vojni.

Mahanida in njegovi najemniki so Filopojmenove najemnike pognali v beg in jih pregnali z bojišča, a so jih zasledovali preveč vneto. Ko je Mahanida svoje može pripeljal nazaj v glavno bitko, je bila številčno šibkejša špartanska pehota že poražena, Ahajci pa so se utrdili za jarkom z vodo. Mahanida je svoje može vodil v napad na Ahajce, a je pri skoku čez jarek padel s konja in so ga ubili. Zmagali so Ahajci, zavezniki Makedonije.

source.title: Battle of Mantinea (207 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Mantinea was fought in 207 BC between Sparta under the tyrant Machanidas, as part of the Aetolian League, and the Achaean League whose forces were led by Philopoemen. Both sides were supplemented by mercenaries. It was the major land battle in Greece of the First Macedonian War, which had occurred due to Macedonian alliance with Carthage in the aftermath of Hannibal's victory at the Battle of Cannae in the Second Punic War.

Machanidas and his mercenaries routed Philopoemen's mercenaries and chased them from the field. They pursued too eagerly. When Machanidas led his men back to the main battle the outnumbered Spartan infantry had been defeated and the Achaeans had entrechnced themselves behind a water filled ditch. Leading his men in an assault on the Achaeans, Machanidas fell from his horse as he attempted to leap over the ditch and was slain. The Achaeans, allies of Macedonia, were victorious.

Battle of Mantinea (362 BC).headline: Bitka pri Mantineji (362 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mantineji je potekala 4. julija 362 pr. n. št. med Tebanci pod vodstvom Epaminonde, ki so jih podpirali Arkadijci, Argivci, Mesenci, Tesalci, Evbojci in Beotska zveza, ter Špartanci, Elejci, Atenci in Mantinejci. Z njo naj bi se odločilo, katero od obeh zavezništev bo prevladovalo v Grčiji. Toda zaradi smrti Epaminonde in njegovih predvidenih naslednikov so Tebe izgubile vojaško vodstvo in pobudo, da bi ohranile tebansko prevlado v regiji. Tudi Špartance sta oslabila še en poraz in izguba vojakov. Epaminondova smrt in učinek novega poraza na Špartance sta oslabila obe zavezništvi in utrla pot makedonskemu osvajanju pod vodstvom Filipa II. Makedonskega.

source.title: Battle of Mantinea (362 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Mantinea was fought on 4 July 362 BC between the Thebans, led by Epaminondas and supported by the Arcadians, Argives, Messenians, Thessalians, Euboeans and the Boeotian league against the Spartans, Eleans, Athenians, and Mantineans. The battle was to determine which of the two alliances would dominate Greece. However, the death of Epaminondas and his intended successors would cost Thebes the military leadership and initiative to maintain Theban supremacy in the region. Similarly, the Spartans were weakened by yet another defeat and loss of troops. Epaminondas's death coupled with the impact on the Spartans of yet another defeat weakened both alliances, and paved the way for Macedonian conquest led by Philip II of Macedon.

Battle of Mantinea (418 BC).headline: Bitka pri Mantineji (418 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Mantineji je potekala leta 418 pr. n. št. v peloponeški vojni. Šparta in njene peloponeške zaveznice so v njej premagale zavezniško vojsko Argosa, Aten, Mantineje in več drugih.

source.title: Battle of Mantinea (418 BC)
paragraphs: The first Battle of Mantinea was fought in 418 BC during the Peloponnesian War. In this battle, Sparta and its Peloponnesian allies defeated an allied army of Argos, Athens, Mantinea and several others.

Bitka pri Mărăşeştiju (6. avgusta – 3. septembra 1917) je bila zadnja velika bitka centralnih sil proti Kraljevini Romuniji in Rusiji na romunski fronti v prvi svetovni vojni. Centralne sile so zasedle večji del Romunije, bitka pri Mărăşeştiju pa je sever države obvarovala pred okupacijo.

source.title: Battle of Mărășești
paragraphs: The Battle of Mărășești (6 August 1917 – 3 September 1917) was the last major battle fought by the Central Powers against the Kingdom of Romania and Russia on the Romanian front during World War I. Romania was mostly occupied by the Central Powers, but the Battle of Mărășești kept the northern region of the country free from occupation.

Battle of Marcellae.headline: Bitka pri Markelah (792)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Markelah (bolgarsko: Битката при Маркели; grško: Μάχη των Μαρκελλών) je potekala 20. julija 792 med silami Bizantinskega cesarstva pod vodstvom Konstantina VI. in silami Prvega bolgarskega cesarstva pod vodstvom Kardama. Bizantinci so bili hudo poraženi in so se morali umakniti v Carigrad. Boji so potekali pri Markelah (Markeli) blizu današnjega mesta Karnobat na jugovzhodu Bolgarije, na istem kraju kot že prej bitka leta 756.
notes: The headline adds the year to tell this battle from the one of 756.

source.title: Battle of Marcellae
paragraphs: The Battle of Marcellae (Bulgarian: Битката при Маркели; Greek: Μάχη των Μαρκελλών) was fought on the 20 July 792 between the forces of the Byzantine Empire, led by Constantine VI, and those of the First Bulgarian Empire under Kardam. The Byzantines were routed and forced to retreat to Constantinople. Fighting took place at Marcellae (Markeli), near the modern town of Karnobat in southeastern Bulgaria, the same site as an earlier battle in 756.

Battle of Marcellae (756).headline: Bitka pri Markelah (756)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Markelah (bolgarsko: Битката при Маркели; grško: Μάχη των Μαρκελλών) je potekala leta 756 med vojskama Prvega bolgarskega cesarstva in Bizantinskega cesarstva pri Markelah blizu mesta Karnobat na jugovzhodu Bolgarije. Zmagali so Bizantinci.

source.title: Battle of Marcellae (756)
paragraphs: The Battle of Marcellae (Bulgarian: Битката при Маркели, Greek: Μάχη των Μαρκελλών) took place in 756 between the armies of the First Bulgarian Empire and the Byzantine Empire at Markeli, near the town of Karnobat in south eastern Bulgaria. The result was a Byzantine victory.

Battle of Marcianople.headline: Bitka pri Markianopolu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Markianopolu je potekala leta 376, potem ko so Goti prečkali Donavo. Bila je prva pomembna bitka gotske vojne 376–382.

Po neuspelem rimskem poskusu, da bi na pojedini v Markianopolu umorili gotske voditelje, je rimski poveljnik Lupicin zbral vse razpoložljive čete, okoli 5000 mož, in napadel 7000–8000 tervinških Gotov pod vodstvom Fritigerna devet milj zahodno od mesta. Rimljani so na bojišču zavzeli obrambni položaj, Goti pa so takoj silovito napadli ter Rimljane pobijali s ščiti, meči in sulicami. Lupicin je zbežal, ko je več kot polovica njegove vojske padla na kraju samem. Goti so se nato oborožili z rimskim orožjem.

source.title: Battle of Marcianople
paragraphs: The Battle of Marcianople or Marcianopolis took place in 376 following the Goths' migration over the Danube. It was the first notable battle of the Gothic War of 376–382.

After a failed Roman attempt to assassinate the Gothic leadership at a banquet in Marcianople, the Roman commander Lupicinius gathered all available troops, some 5,000 men, and attacked the 7,000–8,000 Thervingi Goths under Fritigern nine miles to the west of the town. While the Romans adopted a defensive posture on the battlefield, the Goths launched an immediate, all-out assault and bashed and slew the Romans with their shields, swords, and spears. Lupicinius fled as more than half of his army was killed on the spot. The Goths then re-armed themselves with Roman weaponry.

Battle of Mardia.headline: Bitka pri Mardiji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mardiji, znana tudi kot bitka na Campus Mardiensis ali Campus Ardiensis, je potekala konec leta 316 ali v začetku leta 317 med silami rimskih cesarjev Konstantina I. in Licinija. Bojišče je bilo verjetno pri današnjem Harmanliju (Bolgarija) v Trakiji.

source.title: Battle of Mardia
paragraphs: The Battle of Mardia, also known as Battle of Campus Mardiensis or Battle of Campus Ardiensis, was fought in late 316/early 317 between the forces of Roman Emperors Constantine I and Licinius. Its location was probably modern Harmanli (Bulgaria) in Thrace.

Bitka pri Marengu je potekala 14. junija 1800 med francoskimi silami pod prvim konzulom Napoleonom Bonapartom in avstrijskimi silami blizu mesta Alessandria v Piemontu v Italiji. Proti večeru so Francozi odbili presenetljivi napad generala Michaela von Melasa, Avstrijce pregnali iz Italije in utrdili Bonapartov politični položaj v Parizu kot prvega konzula Francije po državnem udaru novembra prejšnjega leta.

Bonaparte, presenečen nad avstrijskim napredovanjem proti Genovi sredi aprila 1800, je sredi maja svojo vojsko popeljal čez Alpe in 2. junija prispel v Milan. Po tem ko je s prečkanjem Pada presekal Melasovo komunikacijsko linijo in 9. junija pri Montebellu premagal feldmaršalporočnika (Feldmarschallleutnant, FML) Petra Karla Otta von Bátorkéza, so se Francozi približali avstrijski vojski, zbrani v Alessandriji. Ker ga je preslepil krajevni dvojni agent, je Bonaparte velike sile poslal proti severu in jugu, Avstrijci pa so 14. junija presenetljivo napadli glavno francosko vojsko pod generalom Louisom Alexandrom Berthierom.

source.title: Battle of Marengo
paragraphs: The Battle of Marengo was fought on 14 June 1800 between French forces under the First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte and Austrian forces near the city of Alessandria, in Piedmont, Italy. Near the end of the day, the French overcame General Michael von Melas's surprise attack, drove the Austrians out of Italy and consolidated Bonaparte's political position in Paris as First Consul of France in the wake of his coup d'état the previous November.

Surprised by the Austrian advance toward Genoa in mid-April 1800, Bonaparte led his army over the Alps in mid-May and reached Milan on 2 June. After cutting Melas's line of communications by crossing the river Po and defeating Feldmarschallleutnant (FML) Peter Karl Ott von Bátorkéz at Montebello on 9 June, the French closed in on the Austrian Army, which had massed in Alessandria. Deceived by a local double agent, Bonaparte dispatched large forces to the north and the south, but the Austrians launched a surprise attack on 14 June against the main French army, under General Louis Alexandre Berthier.

Battle of Marignano.headline: Bitka pri Marignanu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Marignanu (francosko: bataille de Marignan) je potekala od 13. do 14. septembra 1515 blizu mesta, ki se danes imenuje Melegnano, 16 kilometrov jugovzhodno od Milana, in je bila zadnji večji spopad vojne kambrejske lige. V njej se je francoska vojska, ki jo je vodil novopokronani francoski kralj Franc I., spopadla s staro švicarsko konfederacijo. Francozom so se pridružili nemški landsknehti in beneški zavezniki, ki so prispeli pozno.
Bitka se je končala z odločilno francosko zmago in podpisom miru v Fribourgu, znanega kot »večni mir« (nemško: Ewiger Frieden, francosko: Paix perpétuelle).

source.title: Battle of Marignano
paragraphs: The Battle of Marignano, (or bataille de Marignan in French) which took place on 13–14 September 1515, near the town now called Melegnano, 16 km southeast of Milan, was the last major engagement of the War of the League of Cambrai. It pitted the French army, led by Francis I, newly crowned King of France, against the Old Swiss Confederacy. With the French were German landsknechts, and their late-arriving Venetian allies.
The battle resulted in a decisive French victory and the signing of the Treaty of Fribourg, known as the "Perpetual Peace" (Ewiger Frieden, Paix perpétuelle).

Battle of Marinka (2015).headline: Bitka za Marinko (2015)
paragraphs: Bitka za Marinko je bila kratka bitka vojne v Donbasu v Marinki v Doneški oblasti in okolici, ki je potekala 3. junija 2015. Ukrajinske sile so se spopadle z republiško gardo samooklicane Doneške ljudske republike (DLR) in brigado Pjatnaška pod vodstvom Ahre Avidzbe. Sile DLR so mesto Marinka za kratek čas zavzele, nato pa so ga Ukrajinci znova osvojili.

source.title: Battle of Marinka (2015)
paragraphs: The Battle of Marinka was a short battle in the war in Donbas in and around Marinka, Donetsk Oblast which took place on 3 June 2015. Ukrainian forces fought the self-proclaimed Donetsk People's Republic's (DPR) Republican Guard and Pyatnashka Brigade under Akhra Avidzba. The town of Marinka was briefly seized by DPR forces before it was recaptured by the Ukrainians.

Battle of Marinka (2022–2023).headline: Bitka za Marinko (2022–2023)
paragraphs: Med rusko-ukrajinsko vojno je potekala bitka med ruskimi in ukrajinskimi silami za nadzor nad mestom Marinka.

Bitka je bila znana po dolžini in obsegu uničenja mestne infrastrukture. Do novembra 2022 je bil velik del mesta uničen, civilistov ni bilo več, po bojih pa je ostalo le malo stavb. Do decembra 2023 je Rusija zavzela skoraj vso Marinko.

Rusija je 25. decembra 2023 sporočila, da so njene sile mesto v celoti zavzele, ukrajinska vojska pa je to sprva zanikala. Vrhovni poveljnik ukrajinske vojske Valerij Zalužni je izgubo Marinke potrdil naslednji dan.

source.title: Battle of Marinka (2022–2023)
paragraphs: During the Russo-Ukrainian war, a battle took place between Russian forces and Ukrainian forces for control over the city of Marinka.

The battle was notable for its length and the extent of destruction of the city's infrastructure. By November 2022, much of the city was destroyed, with no civilians remaining and few buildings left standing from the fighting. By December 2023, Russia had captured almost all of Marinka.

On 25 December 2023, Russia said that its forces had fully captured the city, but the Ukrainian military initially denied the claim. Ukraine's commander-in-chief Valerii Zaluzhnyi confirmed the loss of Marinka the next day.

Med proruskimi protesti v Ukrajini leta 2014, po revoluciji dostojanstva, je v mestu Mariupol v Doneški oblasti prišlo do spopadov med ukrajinskimi vladnimi silami, krajevno policijo in separatističnimi borci, povezanimi z Doneško ljudsko republiko. Vladne sile so se iz Mariupola umaknile 9. maja 2014, potem ko je v hudih bojih pogorel sedež mestne policije. Te sile so obdržale kontrolne točke zunaj mesta. Posredovanje jeklarjev podjetja Metinvest 15. maja 2014 je pripeljalo do odstranitve barikad iz središča mesta in ponovne uvedbe patrulj krajevne policije. Separatisti so v drugem delu mesta še naprej imeli svoj sedež, dokler njihovih položajev 13. junija 2014 v vladni ofenzivi niso zavzeli.

source.title: Battle of Mariupol (May–June 2014)
paragraphs: During the 2014 pro-Russian unrest in Ukraine in the aftermath of the Revolution of Dignity, the city of Mariupol, in Donetsk Oblast, saw skirmishes break out between Ukrainian government forces, local police, and separatist militants affiliated with the Donetsk People's Republic. Government forces withdrew from Mariupol on 9 May 2014 after heavy fighting left the city's police headquarters gutted by fire. These forces maintained checkpoints outside the city. Intervention by Metinvest steelworkers on 15 May 2014 led to the removal of barricades from the city centre, and the resumption of patrols by local police. Separatists continued to operate a headquarters in another part of the city until their positions were overrun in a government offensive on 13 June 2014.

Battle of Mars-la-Tour.headline: Bitka pri Mars-la-Touru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mars-la-Touru (znana tudi kot bitka pri Vionvillu ali bitka pri Rezonvillu) je potekala 16. avgusta 1870 med francosko-prusko vojno blizu vasi Mars-la-Tour na severovzhodu Francije. En pruski korpus, ki sta ga čez dan okrepila še dva, je v srečanjskem boju naletel na celotno francosko rensko armado, ta pa se je po poteku bitke umaknila proti trdnjavi Metz.

source.title: Battle of Mars-la-Tour
paragraphs: The Battle of Mars-la-Tour (also known as the Battle of Vionville or Battle of Rezonville) was fought on 16 August 1870, during the Franco-Prussian War, near the village of Mars-la-Tour in northeast France. One Prussian corps, reinforced by two more later in the day, encountered the entire French Army of the Rhine in a meeting engagement and, following the course of battle, the Army of the Rhine retreated toward the fortress of Metz.

Battle of Marsaglia.headline: Bitka pri Marsagliji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Marsagliji ali Orbassanu je bila bitka v devetletni vojni, ki je potekala 4. oktobra 1693 v Italiji med francosko vojsko maršala Nicolasa Catinata in vojsko velike zveze pod vojvodo Viktorjem Amadejem II. Savojskim.

Catinat je napredoval iz Fenestrelle in Suse, da bi rešil Pinerolo, ki ga je branil grof Tessé in oblegal savojski vojvoda, in se razvrstil v bojni red severno od vasi Marsaglia blizu Orbassana. Tam ga je 4. oktobra savojski vojvoda s celotno vojsko napadel čelno, vendar sta velika premoč francoskih polkov v učinkovitosti in Catinatova natančna skrb za podrobnosti pri njihovi razporeditvi novemu maršalu prinesli zmago, ki je bila vredna dvojnica zmage pri Neerwindnu.
Piemontčani in njihovi zavezniki so izgubili približno 11.000 mrtvih, ranjenih in ujetih, Catinat pa 3000.

source.title: Battle of Marsaglia
paragraphs: The Battle of Marsaglia or Orbassano was a battle in the Nine Years' War, fought in Italy on 4 October 1693, between the French army of Marshal Nicolas Catinat and the army of the Grand Alliance under Duke Victor Amadeus II of Savoy.

Catinat, advancing from Fenestrelle and Susa to the relief Pinerolo, defended by the count of Tessé and which the duke of Savoy was besieging, took up a position in formal order of battle north of the village of Marsaglia, near Orbassano. Here, on 4 October, the duke of Savoy attacked him with his whole army, front to front, but the greatly superior regimental efficiency of the French, and Catinat's minute attention to detail in arraying them, gave the new marshal a victory that was a worthy pendant to Neerwinden.
The Piedmontese and their allies lost approx. 11,000 killed, wounded and prisoners, as against Catinat's 3,000.

Battle of Marston Moor.headline: Bitka pri Marston Mooru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Marston Mooru je potekala 2. julija 1644 v vojnah treh kraljestev (1639–1653). Združene sile angleških parlamentarcev pod lordom Fairfaxom in grofom Manchestrom ter škotskih covenanterjev pod grofom Levenom so premagale rojaliste pod poveljstvom princa Ruperta Renskega in markiza Newcastla.

Covenanterji in parlamentarci so poleti 1644 oblegali York, ki ga je branil markiz Newcastle. Rupert je zbral vojsko, ki je krenila čez severozahodno Anglijo, med potjo zbirala okrepitve in nove nabornike ter prečkala Penine, da bi mesto osvobodila obleganja. Zaradi zbiranja teh sil je bila bitka, ki je sledila, največja v državljanskih vojnah.

source.title: Battle of Marston Moor
paragraphs: The Battle of Marston Moor was fought on 2 July 1644, during the Wars of the Three Kingdoms of 1639–1653. The combined forces of the English Parliamentarians under Lord Fairfax and the Earl of Manchester and the Scottish Covenanters under the Earl of Leven defeated the Royalists commanded by Prince Rupert of the Rhine and the Marquess of Newcastle.

During the summer of 1644, the Covenanters and Parliamentarians had been besieging York, which was defended by the Marquess of Newcastle. Rupert had gathered an army which marched through the northwest of England, gathering reinforcements and fresh recruits on the way, and across the Pennines to relieve the city. The convergence of these forces made the ensuing battle the largest of the civil wars.

Battle of Maserfield.headline: Bitka pri Maserfieldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Maserfieldu (valižansko: Cad Maes Cogwy) je potekala 5. avgusta 641 ali 642 (po Wardu 642) med anglosaškima kraljema Oswaldom Northumbrijskim in Pendo Mercijskim, ki je bil v zavezništvu z valižanskim kraljestvom Gwynedd, in se končala z Oswaldovim porazom, smrtjo in razkosanjem.

Kraj je bil v valižanščini znan tudi kot Cogwy, v bitki pa so sodelovali Valižani iz Pengwerna (po pesnitvi Canu Heledd, verjetno iz 9. stoletja), verjetno kot zavezniki Mercijcev. Beda navaja zgoraj omenjeni splošno sprejeti datum; valižanske Annales Cambriae, ki bitko postavljajo v leto 644, navadno štejejo za netočne. Bojišče po izročilu enačijo z Oswestryjem.

source.title: Battle of Maserfield
paragraphs: The Battle of Maserfield, (Welsh: Cad Maes Cogwy) was fought on 5 August 641 or 642 (642 according to Ward) between the Anglo-Saxon kings Oswald of Northumbria and Penda of Mercia allied with Welsh Kingdom of Gwynedd, ending in Oswald's defeat, death, and dismemberment.

The location was also known as Cogwy in Welsh, with Welshmen from Pengwern participating in the battle (according to the probably ninth-century Canu Heledd), probably as allies of the Mercians. Bede reports the commonly accepted date given above; the Welsh Annales Cambriae is generally considered incorrect in giving the year of the battle as 644. The site of the battle is traditionally identified with Oswestry.

Battle of Matapan.headline: Bitka pri rtu Matapan
paragraphs: Bitka pri Matapanu, znana tudi kot bitka pri rtu Matapan, je bila pomorska bitka v Lakonskem zalivu, delu Sredozemskega morja, med Kraljevino Portugalsko in Osmanskim cesarstvom 19. julija 1717 pri rtu Matapan v južni Grčiji. Bila je del sedme osmansko-beneške vojne 1714–1718.

source.title: Battle of Matapan
paragraphs: The Battle of Matapan, also known as the Battle of Cape Matapan, was a naval battle in the Laconian Gulf, an arm of the Mediterranean Sea, fought between the Kingdom of Portugal and the Ottoman Empire on 19 July 1717, off Cape Matapan in southern Greece. It was part of the Seventh Ottoman-Venetian War of 1714 – 1718.

Battle of Maxen.headline: Bitka pri Maxnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Maxnu (20. novembra 1759) je potekala pri Maxnu v Saški volilni kneževini med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne). Končala se je s predajo pruskega korpusa.

Pruski korpus s 14.000 možmi pod poveljstvom Friedricha Augusta von Fincka (enega od generalov Friderika Velikega) je bil poslan, da bi ogrozil zveze med avstrijsko vojsko v Dresdnu in Češko. Feldmaršal grof Daun je s svojo vojsko s 40.000 možmi 20. novembra 1759 napadel in premagal Finckov osamljeni korpus. Naslednji dan (21. novembra) se je Finck odločil, da se preda.

source.title: Battle of Maxen
paragraphs: The Battle of Maxen (20 November 1759) was a battle at Maxen, in the Electorate of Saxony during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). It resulted in surrender of a Prussian corps.

The Prussian corps of 14,000 men, commanded by Friedrich August von Finck (one of Frederick the Great's generals), was sent to threaten lines of communication between the Austrian army at Dresden and Bohemia. Field Marshal Count Daun attacked and defeated Finck's isolated corps on 20 November 1759 with his army of 40,000 men. The next day (21 November) Finck decided to surrender.

Battle of Medina de Rioseco.headline: Bitka pri Medini de Rioseco
paragraphs: Bitka pri Medini de Rioseco, znana tudi kot bitka pri Moclínu, je potekala v polotoški vojni 14. julija 1808, ko so združene enote španske milice in redne vojske skušale pretrgati francoske zveze z Madridom. Galicijsko vojsko generala Joaquína Blaka, ki ji je poveljeval skupaj z generalom Gregoriem de la Cuesto, je po slabo usklajenem, a trdovratnem boju proti francoskemu korpusu severno od Valladolida pognal v beg maršal Bessières.

Bessières je izkoristil slabo usklajenost med Blakom in Cuesto ter Špance premagal posamič: Blaka je pregnal z nizkega slemena, medtem ko je Cuesta stal v ozadju, ta pa slemena s svojimi enotami ni mogel znova zavzeti. Galicijska vojska je bila edina formacija, ki je lahko ogrozila francosko prodiranje v Staro Kastiljo – Cuestove sile so bile že prej uničene pri Cabezónu –, zato je bilo njeno uničenje hud udarec za špansko narodno vstajo.

source.title: Battle of Medina de Rioseco
paragraphs: The Battle of Medina de Rioseco, also known as the Battle of Moclín, was fought during the Peninsular War on 14 July 1808 when a combined body of Spanish militia and regulars moved to rupture the French line of communications to Madrid. General Joaquín Blake's Army of Galicia, under joint command with General Gregorio de la Cuesta, was routed by Marshal Bessières after a badly coordinated but stubborn fight against the French corps north of Valladolid.

Bessières exploited the poor coordination between Blake and Cuesta to defeat the Spaniards in detail, with Blake being ejected from a low ridge while Cuesta sat to the rear, and Cuesta failing to recapture the ridge with his own troops. The Army of Galicia was the only formation capable of threatening the French advance into Old Castile—Cuesta's command having been destroyed earlier at Cabezón—and its destruction marked a serious blow to Spain's national uprising.

Battle of Megalopolis.headline: Bitka pri Megalopolisu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Megalopolisu je potekala leta 331 pr. n. št. med silami pod vodstvom Šparte in Makedonijo. Aleksandrov namestnik Antipater je Makedonce popeljal do zmage nad kraljem Agisom III. Aleksander, ki se je tedaj vojskoval v Aziji, jo je po Plutarhu imenoval »mišja bitka« (starogrško: μυομαχίᾱ).

source.title: Battle of Megalopolis
paragraphs: The Battle of Megalopolis was fought in 331 BC between Spartan-led forces and Macedonia. Alexander's regent Antipater led the Macedonians to victory over King Agis III. Alexander, warring in Asia at the time, called it a "battle of mice" (Ancient Greek: μυομαχίᾱ), according to Plutarch.

Battle of Meissen.headline: Bitka pri Meissnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Meissnu (4. decembra 1759) je bila avstrijska zmaga nad manjšimi pruskimi silami med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne). Avstrijske sile pod poveljstvom generala Becka so pri Meissnu napadle 3500 pruskih vojakov pod vodstvom Dierickeja, jih strle in preživele pognale čez Labo. Prusi so v spopadu izgubili 400 mož, 1543 pa jih je bilo ujetih. Avstrijske izgube so bile majhne, skupaj le 72 mrtvih in 115 ranjenih. Avstrijci so dosegli pomembno zmago, ki je njihovo zaveznico Saško dejansko obdržala v vojni.

source.title: Battle of Meissen
paragraphs: The Battle of Meissen (4 December 1759) was an Austrian victory over a smaller Prussian force during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). An Austrian force under the command of general Beck assaulted 3,500 Prussian troops under Diericke at Meissen, overwhelming them and driving the survivors across the Elbe. The Prussians lost 400 men in the action and 1,543 fell prisoner. Austrian losses were few, totalling only 72 killed and 115 wounded. The Austrians secured an important victory, which effectively kept their ally Saxony in the war.

Battle of Ménfő.headline: Bitka pri Ménfőju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ménfőju je bila pomemben spopad v zgodnji zgodovini Kraljevine Ogrske. Potekala je leta 1044 pri Ménfőju blizu Győra med pretežno nemško vojsko in Madžari (Ogri); zmagali so Nemci in s tem zahodni vplivi na Ogrskem.

Peter Orseolo, ki ga je leta 1041 odstavil Samuel Aba, se je vrnil s pomočjo cesarja Henrika III. in junija 1044 vdrl na Ogrsko. Njegove sile so bile majhne, ogrska vojska Samuela Abe pa velika. V ogrskih vrstah pa je vladalo nezadovoljstvo in vojska je pred nemško konjenico hitro razpadla. Samuel je pobegnil z bojišča, a so ga ujeli in ubili. Petra so v Stolnem Belgradu (Székesfehérvár) znova ustoličili za kralja, Henriku pa se je za svoje kraljestvo poklonil kot vazal. Vodilni magnati in nižji plemiči so vsi prišli k Henriku in mu prisegli zvestobo in vazalstvo. Ogrska je postala vazalka Svetega rimskega cesarstva, a ne za dolgo.

source.title: Battle of Ménfő
paragraphs: The Battle of Ménfő was an important battle in the early history of the Kingdom of Hungary. Fought in 1044 at Ménfő, near Győr, between an army of mostly Germans and Hungarians (Magyars), it was a victory for the Germans and thus for Westernising influences in Hungary.

Peter Orseolo, who had been deposed by Samuel Aba in 1041, returned with the assistance of Emperor Henry III, and invaded Hungary in June 1044. His force was small and the Hungarian army of Samuel Aba was large. However, there was disaffection in the Hungarian ranks and the army quickly fell apart in the face of the German cavalry. Samuel fled the field, but was captured and killed. Peter was reinstalled as king at Székesfehérvár and did homage for his kingdom to Henry. The leading magnates and the less important nobles all came to Henry to make oaths of fidelity and vassalage. Hungary was made a vassal of the Holy Roman Empire, though it was not to remain so for long.

Battle of Mentana.headline: Bitka pri Mentani
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mentani je potekala 3. novembra 1867 blizu vasi Mentana, severovzhodno od Rima (takrat v Papeški državi, danes v deželi Lacij), med francosko-papeškimi četami in italijanskimi prostovoljci pod vodstvom Giuseppeja Garibaldija. Garibaldijeve čete so skušale zavzeti Rim, ki je bil tedaj glavno italijansko mesto, še ne vključeno v pravkar združeno Kraljevino Italijo. Bitka se je končala z zmago francosko-papeških čet, ki so tako do leta 1870 ohranile neodvisnost Papeške države.

source.title: Battle of Mentana
paragraphs: The Battle of Mentana was fought on November 3, 1867, near the village of Mentana, located north-east of Rome (then in the Papal States, now modern Lazio), between French-Papal troops and the Italian volunteers led by Giuseppe Garibaldi. Garibaldi's troops tried to capture Rome, which was at that time the main Italian city not yet incorporated into the newly unified Kingdom of Italy. The battle ended in victory for the French-Papal troops, maintaining the independence of the Papal States until 1870.

Battle of Messana.headline: Bitka pri Mesini
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mesini leta 264 pr. n. št. je bila prvi vojaški spopad med Rimsko republiko in Kartagino. Z njo se je začela prva punska vojna. Po nedavnih uspehih v južni Italiji je Sicilija tedaj za Rim postajala strateško vse pomembnejša.

source.title: Battle of Messana
paragraphs: The Battle of Messana in 264 BC was the first military clash between the Roman Republic and Carthage. It marked the start of the First Punic War. In that period, and after the recent successes in southern Italy, Sicily became of increasing strategic importance to Rome.

Battle of Messines (1914).headline: Bitka pri Messinesu (1914)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Messinesu je potekala oktobra 1914 med vojskami Nemškega cesarstva na eni ter Britanskega imperija in Francije na drugi strani v okviru tako imenovane »dirke do morja«, vzajemnih poskusov nemške vojske in vojsk antante, da bi napadle prek severnega krila nasprotnika. Poskusi obkolitve severnega krila so privedli do več srečanjskih bojev, dokler zaradi Severnega morja nobena stran ni imela več krila, na katerega bi lahko merila. Bojevali so se med reko Douve in kanalom Comines–Ypres.

source.title: Battle of Messines (1914)
paragraphs: The Battle of Messines was fought in October 1914 between the armies of the German Empire against the British Empire and France, as part of what came to be called the Race to the Sea: reciprocal attempts by the German and Entente armies to attack beyond the northern flank of their opponent. The attempts to turn the northern flank led to several meeting engagements until the North Sea left neither side with a flank to aim at. The battle was fought between the river Douve and the Comines–Ypres canal.

Battle of Messines (1917).headline: Bitka pri Messinesu (1917)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Messinesu (7.–14. junija 1917) je bila napad britanske 2. armade (general sir Herbert Plumer) na zahodni fronti blizu vasi Messines (nizozemsko: Mesen) v Zahodni Flandriji v Belgiji med prvo svetovno vojno. Nivellova ofenziva aprila in maja ni dosegla svojih velikopoteznejših ciljev, demoralizirala je francoske čete in zmedla anglo-francosko strategijo za leto 1917.

source.title: Battle of Messines (1917)
paragraphs: The Battle of Messines (7–14 June 1917) was an attack by the British Second Army (General Sir Herbert Plumer), on the Western Front, near the village of Messines (Dutch: Mesen) in West Flanders, Belgium, during the First World War. The Nivelle Offensive in April and May had failed to achieve its more grandiose aims, had led to the demoralisation of French troops and confounded the Anglo-French strategy for 1917.

Battle of Methven.headline: Bitka pri Methvenu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Methvenu je potekala 19. junija 1306 pri Methvenu na Škotskem med škotskimi osamosvojitvenimi vojnami. Bojišče so preučili za vpis v Popis zgodovinskih bojišč na Škotskem in zaščito ustanove Historic Scotland po škotski politiki zgodovinskega okolja iz leta 2009, vendar so ga zaradi negotove lokacije izključili.

source.title: Battle of Methven
paragraphs: The Battle of Methven took place at Methven, Scotland on 19 June 1306, during the Wars of Scottish Independence. The battlefield was researched to be included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009, but was excluded due to the uncertainty of its location.

Battle of Metz.headline: Bitka za Metz
paragraphs: Bitka za Metz je potekala med drugo svetovno vojno v francoskem mestu Metz, tedaj delu nacistične Nemčije, od konca septembra do sredine decembra 1944 v okviru lorenskega pohoda. V njej sta se spopadli ameriška 3. armada pod poveljstvom generalpodpolkovnika Georgea Pattona in nemška vojska pod poveljstvom generala Otta von Knobelsdorffa. Močan nemški odpor je obema stranema prizadejal hude izgube. Ameriške sile so mesto zavzele in sovražnosti so se formalno končale 22. novembra, zadnja trdnjava, ki je branila Metz, pa se je predala 13. decembra.

source.title: Battle of Metz
paragraphs: The Battle of Metz was fought during World War II at the French city of Metz, then part of Nazi Germany, from late September 1944 through mid-December as part of the Lorraine Campaign between the U.S. Third Army commanded by Lieutenant General George Patton and the German Army commanded by General Otto von Knobelsdorff. Strong German resistance resulted in heavy casualties for both sides. The city was captured by U.S. forces and hostilities formally ceased on 22 November; the last of the forts defending Metz surrendered on 13 December.

Battle of Milazzo (888).headline: Bitka pri Milazzu leta 888
paragraphs: Bitka pri Milazzu je bila pomorska bitka, ki je potekala leta 888 med bizantinskim in aglabidskim ladjevjem ob severovzhodni Siciliji. Bila je velika aglabidska zmaga. Včasih jo imenujejo tudi druga bitka pri Milazzu, pri čemer za prvo štejejo bitko pri Stelai.
notes: The Battle of Stelai has no established Slovenian form; kept as in the source.

source.title: Battle of Milazzo (888)
paragraphs: The Battle of Milazzo was a naval battle fought in 888 between the Byzantine and Aghlabid fleets off northeastern Sicily. The battle was a major Aghlabid victory. It is sometimes known as the Second Battle of Milazzo, counting the Battle of Stelai as the First Battle of Milazzo.

Battle of Millesimo.headline: Bitka pri Millesimu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Millesimu (13. in 14. aprila 1796) je ime, ki ga je Napoleon Bonaparte v svojem dopisovanju dal enemu od niza manjših spopadov v Liguriji v severni Italiji med francosko vojsko in zavezniškima vojskama habsburške monarhije ter Kraljevine Sardinija-Piemonta.

source.title: Battle of Millesimo
paragraphs: The Battle of Millesimo, fought on 13 and 14 April 1796, was the name that Napoleon Bonaparte gave in his correspondence to one of a series of small battles that were fought in Liguria, Northern Italy between the armies of France and the allied armies of the Habsburg monarchy and of the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont.

Battle of Minden.headline: Bitka pri Mindnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mindnu je bila velik spopad sedemletne vojne, ki je potekal 1. avgusta 1759. Zavezniška vojska pod vrhovnim poveljstvom pruskega feldmaršala Ferdinanda Brunšviškega je premagala francosko-saško vojsko pod poveljstvom francoskega maršala markiza de Contadesa. Dve leti prej so Francozi uspešno vdrli v Hannover in zavezniškim državam Veliki Britaniji, Hannovru in Prusiji skušali vsiliti nepriljubljeno mirovno pogodbo. Po pruski zmagi pri Rossbachu in pod pritiskom pruskega kralja Friderika Velikega in britanskega predsednika vlade Williama Pitta je kralj Jurij II. pogodbo zavrnil. Leta 1758 so zavezniki začeli protiofenzivo proti francoskim in saškim silam in jih potisnili nazaj čez Ren.

source.title: Battle of Minden
paragraphs: The Battle of Minden was a major engagement during the Seven Years' War, fought on 1 August 1759. An Allied army, under the overall command of Prussian Field Marshal Ferdinand of Brunswick, defeated a Franco-Saxon army commanded by Marshal of France, Marquis de Contades. Two years previously, the French had launched a successful invasion of Hanover and attempted to impose an unpopular peace treaty upon the Allied nations of Britain, Hanover and Prussia. After a Prussian victory at Rossbach and under pressure from the Prussian king Frederick the Great and the British prime minister William Pitt, King George II disavowed the treaty. In 1758, the Allies launched a counter-offensive against the French and Saxon forces and drove them back across the Rhine.

Bitka pri Mingolsheimu (nemško: Schlacht bei Mingolsheim) je potekala 27. aprila 1622 blizu nemške vasi Wiesloch, 23 km južno od Heidelberga (in 8 km južno od Wieslocha), med protestantsko vojsko pod vodstvom generala von Mansfelda, Hansa Michaela Eliasa von Obentrauta in mejnega grofa Baden-Durlacha ter rimskokatoliško vojsko pod vodstvom grofa Tillyja.
notes: The mile figures are dropped; the kilometres are kept.
The English places the battle both near Wiesloch and 8 km south of it; kept as written.

source.title: Battle of Mingolsheim
paragraphs: The Battle of Mingolsheim (German: Schlacht bei Mingolsheim) was fought on 27 April 1622, near the German village of Wiesloch, 23 km (14 mi) south of Heidelberg (and 8 km or 5 mi south of Wiesloch), between a Protestant army under General von Mansfeld, Hans Michael Elias von Obentraut, and the Margrave of Baden-Durlach against a Roman Catholic army under Count Tilly.

Battle of Minorca (1756).headline: Bitka pri Minorki (1756)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Minorki je bila pomorska bitka 20. maja 1756 med francosko in britansko mornarico v sedemletni vojni. Potekala je pred Minorko kmalu po začetku vojne, bila je prva pomorska bitka na evropskem bojišču te vojne in se je končala s francosko strateško zmago. Odločitev poveljnika britanskega ladjevja, admirala modre zastave Johna Bynga, da se umakne v Gibraltar, je neposredno povzročila padec Minorke. Zaradi Byngovega neuspeha pri reševanju Minorke je sledilo sporno sojenje pred vojaškim sodiščem, ki se je končalo z njegovo usmrtitvijo, ker »ni storil vsega, kar je mogel«, da bi rešil obleganjo britansko posadko na Minorki.

source.title: Battle of Minorca (1756)
paragraphs: The Battle of Minorca was a fleet action fought on 20 May 1756 between the French and British navies during the Seven Years' War. Fought off Minorca shortly after the war began, it was the opening naval battle of the war's European theatre and resulted in a French strategic victory. The decision by the British fleet's commander, Admiral of the Blue John Byng, to withdraw to Gibraltar led directly to the fall of Minorca. Byng's failure to save Minorca led to a controversial court-martial which resulted in his execution for "failure to do his utmost" to relieve the siege of the British garrison on Minorca.

Battle of Mir (1812).headline: Bitka pri Miru (1812)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Miru je potekala 9. in 10. julija 1812 med Napoleonovim vdorom v Rusijo. Tri divizije poljskih ulancev so se spopadle z rusko konjenico; bitka se je končala s prvo veliko rusko zmago v tej vojni.

source.title: Battle of Mir (1812)
paragraphs: The Battle of Mir took place on 9 and 10 July 1812 during Napoleon's invasion of Russia. Three Polish Lancers divisions battled against Russian cavalry, ending in the first major Russian victory in the war.

Battle of Mišar.headline: Bitka na Mišarju
paragraphs: Bitka na Mišarju (srbsko: Бој на Мишару) je potekala med srbskimi revolucionarji in osmansko vojsko od 13. do 15. avgusta 1806 med prvo srbsko vstajo.

Potem ko so leto prej pri Ivankovcu odbili osmanske sile, so srbski uporniki pod vodstvom Karađorđa zavzeli močan položaj in se utrdili v šancah na polju pod gričem Mišar blizu Šabca zahodno od Beograda. Dva dni zapored so se upirali napadom osmanske vojske in njenih bosanskih zaveznikov, ki so napadalce drago stali. Tretji dan je srbska konjenica napadla in porazila Osmane, uporniki pa so nato zavzeli citadeli Šabca in Beograda.

source.title: Battle of Mišar
paragraphs: The Battle of Mišar (Serbian: Бој на Мишару, romanized: Boj na Mišaru) was fought between Serbian revolutionaries and an Ottoman army, it took place from 13 to 15 August 1806 during the First Serbian Uprising.

After repulsing an Ottoman force at Ivankovac, the year before, the Serbian insurgents under Karađorđe took strong position, entrenched in sconces on the field of Mišar Hill, near Šabac west of Belgrade. For two consecutive days they faced costly assault by an Ottoman Army and its Bosnian allies. On the third day, the Serbian cavalry attacked and defeated the Ottomans, the insurgents then conquered the citadels of Šabac and Belgrade.

Battle of Mława.headline: Bitka pri Mławi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mławi, znana tudi kot obramba položaja pri Mławi, je potekala severno od mesta Mława na severu Poljske med 1. in 3. septembrom 1939. Bila je ena prvih bitk invazije na Poljsko in druge svetovne vojne nasploh. V njej so se spopadle sile poljske armade Modlin pod vodstvom generala Krukowicza-Przedrzymirskega in nemška 3. armada pod vodstvom generala Georga von Küchlerja.

source.title: Battle of Mława
paragraphs: The Battle of Mława, otherwise known as the Defence of the Mława position, took place to the north of the town of Mława in northern Poland between 1 and 3 September 1939. It was one of the opening battles of the Invasion of Poland and World War II in general. It was fought between the forces of the Polish Modlin Army under General Krukowicz-Przedrzymirski and the German 3rd Army under General Georg von Küchler.

Battle of Modlin.headline: Bitka pri Modlinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Modlinu je potekala med nemško invazijo na Poljsko leta 1939 na začetku druge svetovne vojne. Trdnjava Modlin je bila sprva glavni stan armade Modlin, dokler se ta ni umaknila proti vzhodu. Od 13. do 29. septembra 1939 je bila obrambna citadela poljskih sil pod poveljstvom generala Wiktorja Thommée proti napadajočim nemškim enotam. Boji so bili tesno povezani s strateškim položajem v bitki za Varšavo.

Med poljskimi silami, ki so branile trdnjavo, sta bila oklepni vlak Śmierć (»smrt«) in protiletalska baterija Modlin, ki ji pripisujejo več sestreljenih letal Luftwaffe kot kateri koli drugi v vsem septembrskem pohodu.

Trdnjava Modlin je kapitulirala 29. septembra kot ena zadnjih v pohodu, ki so odložile orožje, in predala 24.000 vojakov. Nekaj dni prej je Rochus Misch skušal izpogajati predajo trdnjave, ob vrnitvi s pogajanj pa je bil ustreljen in hudo ranjen, za kar je prejel železni križ.

source.title: Battle of Modlin
paragraphs: The Battle of Modlin took place during the 1939 German invasion of Poland at the beginning of the Second World War. Modlin Fortress was initially the headquarters of the Modlin Army until its retreat eastwards. From 13 to 29 September 1939, it served as a defensive citadel for Polish forces under the command of General Wiktor Thommée against assaulting German units. The fighting was closely linked with the strategic situation of the Battle of Warsaw.

The Polish forces defending the fortress included the armoured train Śmierć ("death") and the Modlin anti-aircraft battery, which was credited with shooting down more Luftwaffe planes than any other in the entire September campaign.

Fortress Modlin capitulated on 29 September, one of the last to lay down its arms in the campaign, and surrendered 24,000 troops. Several days earlier, Rochus Misch had attempted to negotiate the surrender of the fortress and was shot and badly wounded while returning from the negotiations, for which he was awarded the Iron Cross.

Battle of Mollwitz.headline: Bitka pri Mollwitzu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mollwitzu je potekala med Prusijo in Avstrijo 10. aprila 1741 med prvo šlezijsko vojno (v zgodnji fazi vojne za avstrijsko nasledstvo). Bila je prva bitka novega pruskega kralja Friderika II., v kateri sta obe strani naredili veliko vojaških napak. Friderik je pobegnil z bojišča, pruski vojski pa je vseeno uspelo zmagati. Bitka je utrdila Friderikovo oblast nad novoosvojenim ozemljem Šlezije in mu dala dragocene vojaške izkušnje.

source.title: Battle of Mollwitz
paragraphs: The Battle of Mollwitz was fought by Prussia and Austria on 10 April 1741, during the First Silesian War (in the early stages of the War of the Austrian Succession). It was the first battle of the new Prussian King Frederick II, in which both sides made numerous military blunders. Frederick fled the battlefield, but the Prussian Army managed to attain victory. This battle cemented Frederick's authority over the newly conquered territory of Silesia and gave him valuable military experience.

Battle of Molodi.headline: Bitka pri Molodih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Molodih (rusko: Би́тва при Мóлодях) je bila ena ključnih bitk vladavine Ivana Groznega. Potekala je julija in avgusta 1572 blizu vasi Molodi, okoli 50 km južno od Moskve, med 120.000-glavo hordo krimskega kana Devleta I. Gireja in približno 60.000–70.000 Rusi in kozaki pod vodstvom kneza Mihaila Vorotinskega. Krimci so Moskvo požgali leto prej, tokrat pa so bili popolnoma poraženi.
notes: The mile conversion is left out.

source.title: Battle of Molodi
paragraphs: The Battle of Molodi (Russian: Би́тва при Мóлодях) was one of the key battles of Ivan the Terrible's reign. It was fought near the village of Molodi, circa 50 km (31 mi) south of Moscow, in July–August 1572 between the 120,000 horde of Devlet I Giray of Crimea and about 60,000–70,000 Russians and Cossacks led by Prince Mikhail Vorotynsky. The Crimeans had burned Moscow the previous year, but this time they were thoroughly defeated.

Battle of Monastir.headline: Bitka pri Bitoli
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bitoli ali Monastirju (srbsko: Битољска битка) je potekala od 16. do 19. novembra 1912 med prvo balkansko vojno, med srbskimi in osmanskimi silami blizu mesta Monastir (danes Bitola), tedanje prestolnice Manastirskega vilajeta v pokrajini Makedonija. Po hudih bojih severno od mesta so zmagali Srbi, poraženi Osmani pa so zbežali in pustili svoje topove.

source.title: Battle of Monastir
paragraphs: The Battle of Monastir (Serbian: Битољска битка) took place near the town of Monastir (now Bitola) in the Macedonia region (the then capital of the Manastir vilayet) during the First Balkan War, between Serbian and Ottoman forces, from 16 to 19 November 1912. It resulted in a Serbian victory after heavy fighting north of the city, the routed Ottomans fled abandoning their guns.

Battle of Mondovì.headline: Bitka pri Mondoviju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mondoviju je potekala 21. aprila 1796 med francosko vojsko Napoleona Bonaparta in vojsko Kraljevine Sardinija-Piemonta pod vodstvom Michelangela Alessandra Collija-Marchija. Z zmago so Francozi Ligurske Alpe pustili za seboj, pred njimi pa so ležale piemontske ravnine. Teden pozneje je kralj Viktor Amadej III. zaprosil za mir in svoje kraljestvo umaknil iz prve koalicije. Poraz sardinskega zaveznika je razbil avstrijsko habsburško strategijo in povzročil, da je severozahodna Italija pripadla prvi francoski republiki.

source.title: Battle of Mondovì
paragraphs: The Battle of Mondovì was fought on 21 April 1796 between the French army of Napoleon Bonaparte and the army of the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont led by Michelangelo Alessandro Colli-Marchi. The French victory meant that they had put the Ligurian Alps behind them, while the plains of Piedmont lay before them. A week later, King Victor Amadeus III sued for peace, taking his kingdom out of the First Coalition. The defeat of their Sardinian ally wrecked the Austrian Habsburg strategy and led to the loss of northwest Italy to the First French Republic.

Battle of Mons.headline: Bitka pri Monsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Monsu ali prva bitka pri Monsu, kot jo imenujejo v razlikovanju od poznejše bitke v isti vojni, je bila prvi večji spopad britanske ekspedicijske sile (BEF) v prvi svetovni vojni. Bila je stranski spopad bitke za meje, v kateri so se zavezniki na francosko-nemški meji spopadli z nemško vojsko. Britanska vojska je pri Monsu skušala zadržati črto kanala Mons–Condé pred prodirajočo nemško 1. armado.

Britanci so se dobro borili in številčno močnejšim Nemcem prizadejali nesorazmerno velike izgube, a so se morali umakniti, ker so bili v manjšini in ker se je nenadoma umaknila francoska 5. armada (general Charles Lanrezac), s čimer je bilo britansko desno krilo odkrito. Britanski umik iz Monsa je bil sprva načrtovan kot preprost taktični umik in je potekal v dobrem redu, a je trajal dva tedna in BEF pripeljal do predmestij Pariza, preden je skupaj s Francozi prešla v protinapad v prvi bitki na Marni.

source.title: Battle of Mons
paragraphs: The Battle of Mons, or the First Battle of Mons to differentiate it from another battle later in the war, was the first big engagement of the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) in the First World War. It was a subsidiary action of the Battle of the Frontiers, in which the Allies clashed with the German Army on the French–German frontier. At Mons, the British Army attempted to hold the line of the Mons–Condé Canal against the advancing German 1st Army.

Although the British fought well and inflicted disproportionate casualties on the numerically superior Germans, they were forced to retreat due to being outnumbered and the sudden retreat of the French Fifth Army (General Charles Lanrezac) which exposed the British right flank. Though initially planned as a simple tactical withdrawal and executed in good order, the British retreat from Mons lasted for two weeks and took the BEF to the outskirts of Paris, before it counter-attacked in concert with the French, at the First Battle of the Marne.

Battle of Mons Seleucus.headline: Bitka pri Mons Seleucu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mons Seleucu je potekala leta 353 med vojskama rimskega cesarja Konstancija II. in uzurpatorja Magnencija. Zmagale so Konstancijeve sile. Podpora Magnenciju je kopnela že od njegovega poraza v bitki pri Mursi dve leti prej; po porazu pri Mons Seleucu se je njegova stvar sesula in Magnencij si je vzel življenje.

source.title: Battle of Mons Seleucus
paragraphs: The Battle of Mons Seleucus was fought in 353 between the armies of the Roman emperor Constantius II and the usurper Magnentius. Constantius' forces were victorious. Support for Magnentius had been eroding since his defeat at the Battle of Mursa Major two years prior; after Mons Seleucus his cause collapsed and he killed himself.

Battle of Mons-en-Pévèle.headline: Bitka pri Mons-en-Pévèlu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mons-en-Pévèlu (ali Pevelenbergu) je potekala 18. avgusta 1304 med Francozi in Flamci. Francoze je vodil njihov kralj Filip IV.

source.title: Battle of Mons-en-Pévèle
paragraphs: The Battle of Mons-en-Pévèle (or Pevelenberg) was fought on 18 August 1304 between the French and the Flemish. The French were led by their king, Philip IV.

Battle of Montaperti.headline: Bitka pri Montapertiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Montapertiju je potekala 4. septembra 1260 med Firencami in Sieno v Toskani v okviru spora med gvelfi in gibelini. Florentince so razbili. Bila je najkrvavejša bitka srednjeveške Italije, saj je terjala več kot 10.000 življenj. Dejanje izdaje med bitko je zapisal Dante Alighieri v Peklu, delu Božanske komedije.

source.title: Battle of Montaperti
paragraphs: The Battle of Montaperti was fought on 4 September 1260 between Florence and Siena in Tuscany as part of the conflict between the Guelphs and Ghibellines. The Florentines were routed. It was the bloodiest battle fought in medieval Italy, with more than 10,000 fatalities. An act of treachery during the battle is recorded by Dante Alighieri in the Inferno section of the Divine Comedy.

Battle of Montcornet.headline: Bitka pri Montcornetu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Montcornetu je potekala 17. maja 1940 med bitko za Francijo. Francoska 4. oklepna divizija (4e Division cuirassée; polkovnik Charles de Gaulle) je z več kot 200 tanki napadla vas Montcornet, ki so jo držali Nemci. Francozi so Nemce pregnali, a so se morali pozneje umakniti, ker niso dobili podpore in ker je posegla Luftwaffe.

source.title: Battle of Montcornet
paragraphs: The Battle of Montcornet, on 17 May 1940 took place during the Battle of France. The French 4e Division cuirassée (Colonel Charles de Gaulle), attacked the German-held village of Montcornet with over 200 tanks. The French drove off the Germans but later had to retreat due to lack of support and the intervention of the Luftwaffe.

Battle of Monte Laturce.headline: Bitka pri Monte Laturce
paragraphs: Bitka pri Monte Laturce, znana tudi kot druga bitka pri Albeldi, je bila zmaga sil asturijskega kralja Ordoña I. in njegovega zaveznika Garcíe Íñigueza iz Pamplone nad Garcíjevim stricem in nekdanjim zaveznikom Musom ibn Muso al Kasavijem, gospodom Borje, Zaragoze, Terrerja in Tudele v Navari iz rodbine Banu Kasi, leta 859 ali 860.

Bitka je potekala med asturijskim obleganjem nove trdnjave, ki jo je Musa gradil pri Albeldi de Iregua. Trdnjavo so zavzeli nekaj dni po bitki. Po porazu pri Monte Laturce se je moral Musa povsem podrediti kordobskemu emirju, ki je Musovo šibkost izkoristil, da ga je odstavil kot valija Zgornje marke, s čimer se je začel desetletni zaton rodbine Banu Kasi.

source.title: Battle of Monte Laturce
paragraphs: The Battle of Monte Laturce, also known as the second Battle of Albelda, was a victory for the forces of Ordoño I of Asturias and his ally García Íñiguez of Pamplona over the latter's uncle and former ally, Musa ibn Musa al-Qasawi, the Banu Qasi lord of Borja, Zaragoza, Terrer, and Tudela, Navarre, in 859 or 860.

The battle took place during the Asturian siege of a new fortress under construction by Musa at Albelda de Iregua. The fortress was taken a few days after the battle. After Monte Laturce, Musa was forced to fully submit to the Emir of Córdoba, who took advantage of Musa's weakness to remove him as wāli of the Upper March, initiating a decade-long eclipse of the Banu Qasi.

Battle of Montebello (1859).headline: Bitka pri Montebellu leta 1859
paragraphs: Bitka pri Montebellu je potekala 20. maja 1859 v Montebellu (danes Montebello della Battaglia) v Lombardiji v severni Italiji. Bila je prvi večji spopad druge italijanske vojne za neodvisnost, v katerem so se avstrijske čete pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Philippa von Stadiona und Thannhausna spopadle s piemontsko konjenico in francosko pehoto pod vodstvom generala Élieja Frédérica Foreyja.

Foreyjeva divizija se je skupaj s tremi piemontskimi konjeniškimi polki pod poveljstvom generala Maurizia Gerbaixa de Sonnaza pri Montebellu spopadla s Stadionovim armadnim korpusom. Forey je pokazal poveljniški talent, ko je v pomembnem območju zbral premočne sile. Ker Foreyjeve ofenzive po treh urah ni mogel ustaviti, se je Stadion umaknil. Zaradi te bitke je moral avstrijski vrhovni poveljnik del čet obdržati za kritje južnega dela fronte.

source.title: Battle of Montebello (1859)
paragraphs: The Battle of Montebello was fought on 20 May 1859 at Montebello (now Montebello della Battaglia) in Lombardy, northern Italy. The first major engagement of the Second Italian War of Independence, it was fought between Austrian troops commanded by Field Marshal Philipp von Stadion und Thannhausen against Piedmontese cavalry and French infantry headed by General Élie Frédéric Forey.

Forey's division, accompanied by three Piedmontese cavalry regiments commanded by General Maurizio Gerbaix de Sonnaz, engaged Stadion's army corps at Montebello. Forey demonstrated his military command talents by concentrating superior forces in an important area. After three hours, failing to stop Forey's offensive, Stadion withdrew. Because of this battle, the Austrian commander-in-chief was obliged to keep troops to cover the southern part of the front.

Bitka pri Montenottu je potekala 12. aprila 1796 blizu Montenotte Superiore (tedaj v Kraljevini Sardiniji, danes v Italiji) in je bila uvodni spopad Bonapartove italijanske kampanje ter drugi spopad montenottske kampanje. Francoska italijanska armada pod poveljstvom generala Napoleona Bonaparta je premagala avstrijski korpus feldmaršala Eugèna-Guillauma Argenteauja. Zmaga je uspešno pretrgala zvezo med avstrijsko vojsko in njenimi zavezniki, vojsko Kraljevine Sardinije, in Bonaparteju omogočila, da je obe sili izoliral in ju posamič premagal.

source.title: Battle of Montenotte
paragraphs: The Battle of Montenotte was fought on 12 April 1796, near Montenotte Superiore (then in the Kingdom of Sardinia, now in Italy), being the opening engagement of Napoleon Bonaparte's Italian Campaign and the second engagement of the Montenotte campaign. The French Army of Italy, under the command of General Napoleon Bonaparte, defeated an Austrian corps under Field Marshal Eugène-Guillaume Argenteau. The victory successfully severed the connection between the Austrian army and their allies, the army of the Kingdom of Sardinia, allowing Bonaparte to isolate and defeat each force in detail.

Battle of Montereau.headline: Bitka pri Montereauju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Montereauju (18. februarja 1814) je bila spopad v vojni šeste koalicije med francosko cesarsko vojsko pod vodstvom cesarja Napoleona in korpusom Avstrijcev in Württemberžanov pod poveljstvom württemberškega prestolonaslednika Friderika Viljema. Medtem ko je Napoleonova vojska hudo zdelala zavezniško vojsko pod vodstvom Gebharda Leberechta von Blücherja, se je glavna zavezniška vojska pod poveljstvom Karla Philippa, kneza Schwarzenberga, nevarno približala Parizu. Napoleon je zbral svoje številčno šibkejše sile in vojake v naglici poslal proti jugu nad Schwarzenberga. Ko je zavezniški poveljnik izvedel, da se bliža francoski cesar, je ukazal umik, a so 17. februarja njegove zaščitnice pregazili ali odrinili.

source.title: Battle of Montereau
paragraphs: The Battle of Montereau (18 February 1814) was fought during the War of the Sixth Coalition between an Imperial French army led by Emperor Napoleon and a corps of Austrians and Württembergers commanded by Crown Prince Frederick William of Württemberg. While Napoleon's army mauled an Allied army under Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher, the main Allied army commanded by Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg, advanced to a position dangerously close to Paris. Gathering up his outnumbered forces, Napoleon rushed his soldiers south to deal with Schwarzenberg. Hearing of the approach of the French emperor, the Allied commander ordered a withdrawal, but on 17 February saw his rear guards overrun or brushed aside.

Battle of Montiel.headline: Bitka pri Montielu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Montielu je potekala 14. marca 1369 med francosko-kastiljskimi silami, ki so podpirale Henrika Trastamarskega, in granadsko-kastiljskimi silami, ki so podpirale vladajočega kastiljskega kralja Petra.

source.title: Battle of Montiel
paragraphs: The Battle of Montiel was fought on 14 March 1369 between the Franco-Castilian forces supporting Henry of Trastámara and the Granadian-Castilian forces supporting the reigning Peter of Castile.

Battle of Montmirail.headline: Bitka pri Montmirailu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Montmirailu (11. februarja 1814) je bila spopad med francoskimi silami pod vodstvom cesarja Napoleona in dvema zavezniškima korpusoma pod poveljstvom Fabiana Wilhelma von Osten-Sackena in Ludwiga Yorcka von Wartenburga. V hudih bojih, ki so trajali do večera, so francoske čete, med njimi cesarska garda, premagale Sackenove ruske vojake in jih prisilile k umiku proti severu. Del Yorckovega pruskega I. korpusa je skušal poseči v boj, a so tudi njega odbili. Bitka je potekala blizu Montmiraila v Franciji med šestdnevnim pohodom napoleonskih vojn. Montmirail leži 51 kilometrov vzhodno od Meauxa.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Montmirail
paragraphs: The Battle of Montmirail (11 February 1814) was fought between a French force led by Emperor Napoleon and two Allied corps commanded by Fabian Wilhelm von Osten-Sacken and Ludwig Yorck von Wartenburg. In hard fighting that lasted until evening, French troops including the Imperial Guard defeated Sacken's Russian soldiers and compelled them to retreat to the north. Part of Yorck's Prussian I Corps tried to intervene in the struggle but it was also driven off. The battle occurred near Montmirail, France, during the Six Days Campaign of the Napoleonic Wars. Montmirail is located 51 kilometres (32 mi) east of Meaux.

Battle of Morat.headline: Bitka pri Moratu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Moratu (francosko: Bataille de Morat; nemško: Schlacht bei Murten) je potekala med burgundskimi vojnami (1474–1477), in sicer 22. junija 1476 med burgundskim vojvodo Karlom Drznim in vojsko švicarske konfederacije pri Moratu (Murtnu), približno 30 kilometrov od Berna. Bila je drugi večji spopad burgundskih vojn in se je končala z uničujočim porazom Karla Drznega. Izgube so bile tako hude, da so burgundsko vojsko in njena vojaška prizadevanja trajno ohromile.

source.title: Battle of Morat
paragraphs: The Battle of Morat ((French: Bataille de Morat; German: Schlacht bei Murten) took place during the Burgundian Wars (1474–1477) that was fought on 22 June 1476 between Charles the Bold, the Duke of Burgundy, and a Swiss Confederation army at Morat (Murten), about 30 kilometres from Bern. It was the second major engagement of the Burgundian Wars, and ended in a crippling defeat for Charles the Bold. The severity of the losses permanently crippled the Burgundian army and their military efforts.

Bitka v Morbihanu, znana tudi kot bitka v zalivu Quiberon, je bila pomorska bitka poleti 56 pr. n. št. med galskim plemenom Venetov in rimsko floto, ki jo je poslal Julij Cezar. Potekala je pred obalo Bretanje v današnji Franciji, verjetno blizu zaliva Quiberon. Bila je del galskih vojn in se je končala z odločilno rimsko zmago.

source.title: Battle of Morbihan
paragraphs: The Battle of Morbihan, also known as the Battle of Quiberon Bay, was a naval battle fought in the summer of 56 BC between the Gallic tribe of the Veneti and a Roman fleet sent by Julius Caesar. The battle was fought off the coast of Brittany in modern-day France, likely near Quiberon Bay. The battle was a part of the Gallic Wars. The battle ended in a decisive Roman victory.

Battle of Morlaix.headline: Bitka pri Morlaixu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Morlaixu je potekala 30. septembra 1342 blizu vasi Lanmeur v Bretanji v Franciji med anglo-bretonsko vojsko in veliko večjimi francosko-bretonskimi silami. Anglija, ki se je s Francijo od leta 1337 bojevala v stoletni vojni, je v bretonski državljanski vojni kmalu po njenem izbruhu leta 1341 podprla stranko Ivana Montforta. Francozi so podpirali vojvodo Karla Bloiškega, nečaka francoskega kralja.

source.title: Battle of Morlaix
paragraphs: The battle of Morlaix was fought near the village of Lanmeur in Brittany, France, on 30 September 1342 between an Anglo-Breton army and a much larger Franco-Breton force. England, at war with France since 1337 in the Hundred Years' War, had sided with John of Montfort's faction in the Breton Civil War shortly after it broke out in 1341. The French were supporting Duke Charles of Blois, a nephew of the French king.

Battle of Mortimer's Cross.headline: Bitka pri Mortimer's Crossu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mortimer's Crossu je potekala 2. februarja 1461 blizu Kingslanda v Herefordshiru (med Leominstrom in Leintwardinom ob reki Lugg), nedaleč od valižanske meje. Bila je ena velikih bitk vojne rož. Na eni strani je bila vojska pod vodstvom Jasperja Tudorja in njegovega očeta Owena Tudorja ter plemičev, zvestih kralju Henriku VI. iz lancastrske hiše, njegovi ženi Margareti Anžujski in njunemu sedemletnemu sinu Edvardu, princu Walesa. Na drugi strani je bila vojska Edvarda, grofa Marcha. Po nekaterih virih je bitka potekala 3. februarja, natančna lokacija pa je predmet ugibanj.

source.title: Battle of Mortimer's Cross
paragraphs: The Battle of Mortimer's Cross was fought on 2 February, 1461 near Kingsland, Herefordshire (between Leominster and Leintwardine, by the River Lugg), not far from the Welsh border. It was a major battle of the Wars of the Roses. The opposing forces consisted of, on one side, an army led by Jasper Tudor and his father, Owen Tudor, as well as nobles loyal to King Henry VI of the House of Lancaster, his wife, Margaret of Anjou, and their seven-year-old son, Edward, Prince of Wales. On the other side, was the army of Edward, Earl of March. Some sources say it was fought on 3 February, and the exact location has been the subject of some speculation.

Battle of Moscow (1612).headline: Bitka za Moskvo (1612)
paragraphs: Bitka za Moskvo je bila niz dveh spopadov, ki sta potekala v Moskvi 1. in 3. septembra 1612 med poljsko-rusko vojno 1609–1618 in dobo velikih nemirov. Silam Poljsko-litovske republike je poveljeval poljni hetman Jan Karol Chodkiewicz, Ruse pa je vodil knez Dmitrij Požarski. Spopada sta se končala z odločilnima ruskima zmagama.

source.title: Battle of Moscow (1612)
paragraphs: The Battle of Moscow was a series of two engagements that took place in Moscow on 1 and 3 September 1612, during the Polish–Russian War of 1609–1618 and the Time of Troubles. The forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth were commanded by Field Hetman Jan Karol Chodkiewicz, while the Russians were led by Prince Dmitry Pozharsky. The engagements ended in decisive Russian victories.

Battle of Mount Gaurus.headline: Bitka pri gori Gaurus
paragraphs: Bitka pri gori Gaurus (343 pr. n. št.) je bila prva bitka prve samnitske vojne in tudi prva bitka med Rimsko republiko in Samniti. Rimski zgodovinar Livij (59 pr. n. št. – 17 n. št.) jo opisuje v sedmi knjigi svoje zgodovine Rima Ab urbe condita libri (»Knjige od ustanovitve mesta«), kjer pripoveduje, kako je rimski konzul Mark Valerij Korvus v trdi bitki premagal Samnite pri gori Gaurus blizu Kum v Kampaniji. Sodobni zgodovinarji pa menijo, da si je večino podrobnosti Livijevega opisa, če ne vse, izmislil on sam ali njegovi viri.

source.title: Battle of Mount Gaurus
paragraphs: The Battle of Mount Gaurus, 343 BC, was the first battle of the First Samnite War and also the first battle fought between the Roman Republic and the Samnites. The battle is described by the Roman historian Livy (59 BC – AD 17) as part of Book Seven of his history of Rome, Ab Urbe Condita Libri, where he narrates how the Roman consul Marcus Valerius Corvus won a hard-fought battle against the Samnites at Mount Gaurus, near Cumae, in Campania. Modern historians however believe that most, if not all, of the detail in Livy's description has been invented by him or his sources.

Battle of Mount Ortigara.headline: Bitka za goro Ortigara
paragraphs: Bitka za goro Ortigara je potekala od 10. do 25. junija 1917 med italijansko in avstro-ogrsko vojsko za posest gore Ortigara na planoti Asiago.

source.title: Battle of Mount Ortigara
paragraphs: The Battle of Mount Ortigara was fought from 10 to 25 June 1917 between the Italian and Austro-Hungarian armies for possession of Mount Ortigara, in the Asiago Plateau.

Battle of Mühlberg.headline: Bitka pri Mühlbergu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mühlbergu je potekala blizu Mühlberga v Saški volilni kneževini leta 1547 med šmalkaldsko vojno. Katoliški knezi Svetega rimskega cesarstva pod vodstvom cesarja Karla V. so odločilno premagali luteransko šmalkaldsko zvezo protestantskih knezov pod poveljstvom saškega volilnega kneza Ivana Friderika I. in hessenskega deželnega grofa Filipa I.
Bitka je končala šmalkaldsko vojno in privedla do razpada šmalkaldske zveze.

source.title: Battle of Mühlberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Mühlberg took place near Mühlberg in the Electorate of Saxony in 1547, during the Schmalkaldic War. The Catholic princes of the Holy Roman Empire led by the Holy Roman Emperor Charles V decisively defeated the Lutheran Schmalkaldic League of Protestant princes under the command of Elector John Frederick I of Saxony and Landgrave Philip I of Hesse.
The battle ended the Schmalkaldic war and led to the dissolution of the Schmalkaldic League.

Bitka pri Mühldorfu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Ampfingu) je potekala blizu Mühldorfa ob Innu 28. septembra 1322 med (Zgornjo) Bavarsko vojvodino in Avstrijsko nadvojvodino. Bavarce je vodil nemški kralj Ludvik Wittelsbaški, Avstrijce pa njegov bratranec, protikralj Friderik Habsburški.

source.title: Battle of Mühldorf
paragraphs: The Battle of Mühldorf (also known as the Battle of Ampfing) was fought near Mühldorf am Inn on September 28, 1322 between the Duchy of (Upper) Bavaria and the Archduchy of Austria. The Bavarians were led by German King Louis of Wittelsbach, while the Austrians were under the command of his cousin, Anti-king Frederick of Habsburg.

Bitka pri Mulhousu (nemško: Mülhausen), imenovana tudi bitka v Alzaciji (francosko: Bataille d'Alsace), se je začela 7. avgusta 1914 in je bila prvi napad francoske vojske na Nemško cesarstvo v prvi svetovni vojni. Francozi so z njo skušali znova pridobiti Alzacijo, ki jo je Francija po francosko-pruski vojni 1870–1871 odstopila Nemčiji. Mulhouse so zasedli 8. avgusta, 10. avgusta pa so jih nemški protinapadi pregnali iz mesta.

Francozi so se umaknili v Belfort, kjer so odstavili generala Louisa Bonneauja, poveljnika VII. korpusa, skupaj s poveljnikom 8. konjeniške divizije. Zaradi dogodkov bolj severno so nemški XIV. in XV. korpus premestili stran od Belforta, 14. avgusta pa je francoski VII. korpus, okrepljen in preimenovan v alzaško armado (general Paul Pau), začel drugo francosko ofenzivo.

source.title: Battle of Mulhouse
paragraphs: The Battle of Mulhouse (German: Mülhausen), also called the Battle of Alsace (French: Bataille d'Alsace), began on 7 August 1914 and was the opening attack of the First World War by the French Army against the German Empire. The battle was a French attempt to recover Alsace, which France had ceded to Germany after the Franco-Prussian War of 1870–1871. The French occupied Mulhouse on 8 August and were then forced out by German counter-attacks on 10 August.

The French retired to Belfort, where General Louis Bonneau, the VII Corps commander, was sacked, along with the commander of the 8th Cavalry Division. Events further north led to the German XIV and XV corps being moved away from Belfort and a second French offensive by the French VII Corps, reinforced and renamed the French Army of Alsace (General Paul Pau), began on 14 August.

Battle of Munda.headline: Bitka pri Mundi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mundi (17. marca 45 pr. n. št.) na jugu Daljne Hispanije je bila zadnja bitka Cezarjeve državljanske vojne proti voditeljem optimatov. Z vojaško zmago pri Mundi ter smrtjo Tita Labiena in Gneja Pompeja (najstarejšega Pompejevega sina) se je Cezar politično lahko zmagoslavno vrnil v Rim in nato vladal kot izvoljeni rimski diktator. Umor Julija Cezarja je nato pospešil dolgi zaton republike, ki je pripeljal do Rimskega cesarstva, začetega z vladavino cesarja Avgusta.

source.title: Battle of Munda
paragraphs: The Battle of Munda (17 March 45 BC), in southern Hispania Ulterior, was the final battle of Caesar's civil war against the leaders of the Optimates. With the military victory at Munda and the deaths of Titus Labienus and Gnaeus Pompeius (eldest son of Pompey), Caesar was politically able to return in triumph to Rome, and then govern as the elected Roman dictator. Subsequently, the assassination of Julius Caesar furthered the long Republican decline that led to the Roman Empire, initiated with the reign of the emperor Augustus.

Battle of Muret.headline: Bitka pri Muretu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Muretu (okcitansko: Batalha de Murèth), ki je potekala 12. septembra 1213 blizu Mureta, 25 km južno od Toulousa, je bila zadnja velika bitka albižanske križarske vojne in ena najbolj znanih bitk na odprtem polju v srednjem veku. Ocene velikosti obeh vojsk se tudi med uglednimi sodobnimi zgodovinarji močno razlikujejo, bitka pa je najbolj znana po tem, da je majhna skupina francoskih vitezov in križarjev pod poveljstvom Simona de Montforta starejšega premagala veliko večjo zavezniško vojsko pod vodstvom aragonskega kralja Petra II. in toulouškega grofa Rajmonda VI.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Muret
paragraphs: The Battle of Muret (Occitan: Batalha de Murèth), fought on 12 September 1213 near Muret, 25 km (16 mi) south of Toulouse, was the last major battle of the Albigensian Crusade and one of the most notable pitched battles of the Middle Ages. Although estimates of the sizes of the respective armies vary considerably even among distinguished modern historians, it is most well known for a small force of French knights and crusaders commanded by Simon de Montfort the Elder defeating a much larger allied army led by King Peter II of Aragon and Count Raymond VI of Toulouse.

Battle of Mursa Major.headline: Bitka pri Mursi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mursi je potekala 28. septembra 351 med vzhodnimi rimskimi vojskami pod vodstvom cesarja Konstancija II. in zahodnimi silami, ki so podpirale uzurpatorja Magnencija. Bojevali so se pri Mursi blizu ceste Via Militaris v provinci Panoniji (današnji Osijek na Hrvaškem). Bitka, ena najbolj krvavih v rimski zgodovini, je bila za Konstancija Pirova zmaga.

source.title: Battle of Mursa Major
paragraphs: The Battle of Mursa was fought on 28 September 351 between the eastern Roman armies led by the Emperor Constantius II and the western forces supporting the usurper Magnentius. It took place at Mursa, near the Via Militaris in the province of Pannonia (modern Osijek, Croatia). The battle, one of the bloodiest in Roman history, was a pyrrhic victory for Constantius.

Battle of Mutina.headline: Bitka pri Mutini
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mutini je potekala 21. aprila 43 pr. n. št. med silami, zvestimi senatu, pod konzuloma Gajem Vibijem Pansom in Avlom Hirtijem, ki so jim pomagale sile Cezarja Oktavijana, in silami Marka Antonija, ki so oblegale čete Decima Bruta. Slednji, eden od Cezarjevih morilcev, je držal mesto Mutina (današnja Modena) v Cisalpinski Galiji.

source.title: Battle of Mutina
paragraphs: The Battle of Mutina took place on 21 April 43 BC between the forces loyal to the Senate under consuls Gaius Vibius Pansa and Aulus Hirtius, supported by the forces of Caesar Octavian, versus the forces of Mark Antony which were besieging the troops of Decimus Brutus. The latter, one of Caesar's assassins, held the city of Mutina (present-day Modena) in Cisalpine Gaul.

Battle of Mylae.headline: Bitka pri Milah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Milah je potekala leta 260 pr. n. št. v prvi punski vojni in je bila prva prava pomorska bitka med Kartagino in Rimsko republiko. Bila je ključna za rimsko zmago pri Milah (današnji Milazzo) in za Sicilijo samo. Pomenila je tudi prvi rimski pomorski triumf in prvo uporabo korvusa v bitki.
notes: No established Slovenian form of Mylae was found; Mile (Greek Mylai) is used.

source.title: Battle of Mylae
paragraphs: The Battle of Mylae took place in 260 BC during the First Punic War and was the first real naval battle between Carthage and the Roman Republic. This battle was key in the Roman victory of Mylae (present-day Milazzo) as well as Sicily itself. It also marked Rome's first naval triumph and also the first use of the corvus in battle.

Battle of Mysunde (1864).headline: Bitka pri Mysundeju (1864)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mysundeju 2. februarja 1864 je bila prva bitka med zavezniško prusko-avstrijsko vojsko in dansko vojsko v drugi šlezviški vojni.
