Pruska predhodnica z 10.000 možmi je skušala prebiti in obiti danske obrambne položaje pri Danevirkeju, a sta jo odbili posadka utrdb in dva bataljona danske vojske.

source.title: Battle of Mysunde (1864)
paragraphs: The Battle of Mysunde on 2 February 1864 was the first battle between the Prusso-Austrian allied army and the Danish army in the Second Schleswig War. The Prussian vanguard force of 10,000 men attempted to break through and outflank the Danish defenses at the Danevirke, but were repulsed by the fortification garrison and two battalions of the Danish army.

Battle of Náchod.headline: Bitka pri Náchodu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Náchodu (nemško: Nachod) 27. junija 1866 je bila prvi večji spopad avstrijsko-pruske vojne. Predhodnica 5. korpusa generala Karla Friedricha von Steinmetza je v okviru pruskega prodora iz Šlezije na Češko zasedla vzpetine blizu Náchoda. Na prizorišče so prispeli deli avstrijskega 6. korpusa pod vodstvom generala von Ramminga in napadli Pruse, a so jih odbili. Ko je prispelo več Avstrijcev, so dobili ukaz za napade, ki so bili dragi in neuspešni. Hudo zdelani Avstrijci so se nazadnje umaknili z bojišča. Pruska pehota je imela tehnično prednost, saj je imela iglično puško, zadnjepolnilko, ki jo je bilo mogoče polniti in z njo streljati leže. Avstrijska pehota, oborožena le s sprednjepolnilnimi puškami, je zato utrpela nesorazmerno velike izgube.

source.title: Battle of Náchod
paragraphs: The Battle of Náchod (German: Nachod) on 27 June 1866 was the first major action of the Austro-Prussian War. The advance guard of General Karl Friedrich von Steinmetz's 5th Corps occupied some high ground near Náchod as part of a Prussian advance into Bohemia from Silesia. Elements of the Austrian 6th Corps under General Von Ramming came on the scene and attacked the Prussians but were repulsed. As more Austrians arrived, they were ordered into attacks which proved both costly and unsuccessful. Finally, the badly mauled Austrians retreated from the field. The Prussian infantry enjoyed a technical advantage in having the needle gun, a breech-loading rifle that could be fired and loaded from a prone position. Consequently, the Austrian infantry, which were only equipped with muzzle-loading rifles, suffered a disproportionate number of casualties.

Battle of Näfels.headline: Bitka pri Näfelsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Näfelsu je potekala 9. aprila 1388 med švicarskim kantonom Glarus, ki so ga podpirali zavezniki iz stare švicarske konfederacije, in Avstrijsko vojvodino, ki ji je vladala rodbina Habsburžanov. Bila je odločilna zmaga Glarusa in je privedla do njegove neodvisnosti od habsburške oblasti. Bitka je bila zadnji od švicarsko-avstrijskih spopadov, ki so se vlekli skoraj vse 14. stoletje.

source.title: Battle of Näfels
paragraphs: The Battle of Näfels was fought on 9 April 1388 between the Swiss canton of Glarus, supported by its allies of the Old Swiss Confederation, and the Duchy of Austria ruled by the House of Habsburg. It was a decisive victory for Glarus and led to its independence from Habsburg rule. The battle was the last of the Swiss-Austrian conflicts that stretched through most of the 14th century.

Battle of Naissus.headline: Bitka pri Naisu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Naisu leta 268 ali 269 je bila spopad, v katerem je Rimsko cesarstvo pod cesarjem Galienom (ali cesarjem Klavdijem II. Gotskim) in poznejšim cesarjem Avrelijanom blizu Naisa (Niša) porazilo gotsko koalicijo. Dogodki okoli vpada in bitke so pomemben del zgodovine krize 3. stoletja.

Izid je bila velika rimska zmaga, ki je skupaj z uspešnim zasledovanjem napadalcev po bitki in odločnimi prizadevanji poznejšega cesarja Avrelijana za naslednja desetletja v veliki meri odpravila nevarnost germanskih plemen na balkanski meji.

source.title: Battle of Naissus
paragraphs: The Battle of Naissus in 268 or 269 was the defeat of a Gothic coalition by the Roman Empire under Emperor Gallienus (or Emperor Claudius II Gothicus) and the future Emperor Aurelian near Naissus (Niš). The events around the invasion and the battle are an important part of the history of the Crisis of the Third Century.

The result was a great Roman victory which, combined with the effective pursuit of the invaders in the aftermath of the battle and the energetic efforts of the future Emperor Aurelian, largely removed the threat from Germanic tribes in the Balkan frontier for the following decades.

Battle of Nájera.headline: Bitka pri Nájeri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nájeri, znana tudi kot bitka pri Navarretu, je potekala 3. aprila 1367 severovzhodno od Nájere v provinci La Rioja v Kastilji. Bila je epizoda prve kastiljske državljanske vojne, v kateri se je kastiljski kralj Peter spopadel s polbratom, grofom Henrikom Trastamarskim, ki si je prizadeval za prestol; vojna je Kastiljo vpletla v stoletno vojno. Kastiljska pomorska moč, ki je daleč presegala francosko in angleško, je obe državi spodbudila, da sta se v državljanski vojni postavili na eno od strani, da bi pridobili nadzor nad kastiljskim ladjevjem.

source.title: Battle of Nájera
paragraphs: The Battle of Nájera, also known as the Battle of Navarrete, was fought on 3 April 1367 to the northeast of Nájera, in the province of La Rioja, Castile. It was an episode of the first Castilian Civil War which confronted King Peter of Castile with his half-brother Count Henry of Trastámara who aspired to the throne; the war involved Castile in the Hundred Years' War. Castilian naval power, far superior to that of France or England, encouraged the two polities to take sides in the civil war, to gain control over the Castilian fleet.

Battle of Nancy.headline: Bitka pri Nancyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nancyju je bila zadnja in odločilna bitka burgundskih vojn: 5. januarja 1477 se je pred obzidjem Nancyja v Loreni burgundski vojvoda Karel Drzni spopadel z lorenskim vojvodo Renéjem II. in švicarsko konfederacijo. Zmagale so Renéjeve sile, Karlovo iznakaženo truplo pa so našli dva dni pozneje.

source.title: Battle of Nancy
paragraphs: The Battle of Nancy was the final and decisive battle of the Burgundian Wars, fought on 5 January 1477 outside the walls of Nancy, Lorraine by Charles the Bold, Duke of Burgundy, against René II, Duke of Lorraine, and the Swiss Confederacy. René's forces won the battle, and Charles' mutilated body was found two days later.

Battle of Narva (1700).headline: Bitka pri Narvi (1700)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Narvi 30. novembra 1700 je bila ena zgodnjih bitk velike severne vojne. Švedska reševalna vojska pod vodstvom švedskega kralja Karla XII. je premagala tri- do štirikrat večjo rusko oblegovalno vojsko. Karel XII. je pred tem Dansko-Norveško prisilil k podpisu miru v Travendalu. Narvi niso sledili nadaljnji pohodi švedske vojske v Rusijo; Karel XII. se je namesto tega obrnil proti jugu, da bi Avgusta Močnega pregnal iz Livonije in Poljsko-litovske države. Ruski car Peter Veliki je Narvo zavzel v drugi bitki leta 1704.

source.title: Battle of Narva (1700)
paragraphs: The Battle of Narva on 30 November 1700 was an early battle in the Great Northern War. A Swedish relief army under Charles XII of Sweden defeated a Russian siege force three to four times its size. Previously, Charles XII had forced Denmark–Norway to sign the Treaty of Travendal. Narva was not followed by further advances of the Swedish army into Russia; instead, Charles XII turned southward to expel August the Strong from Livonia and Poland–Lithuania. Tsar Peter the Great of Russia took Narva in a second battle in 1704.

Bitka za Narvo je bila vojaška kampanja druge svetovne vojne, ki je trajala od 2. februarja do 10. avgusta 1944; nemški armadni odred »Narwa« in sovjetska leningrajska fronta sta se v njej bojevala za strateško pomembno Narvsko prevlako.

source.title: Battle of Narva (1944)
paragraphs: The Battle of Narva was a World War II military campaign, lasting from 2 February to 10 August 1944, in which the German Army Detachment "Narwa" and the Soviet Leningrad Front fought for possession of the strategically important Narva Isthmus.

Battle of Naseby.headline: Bitka pri Nasebyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nasebyju je potekala 14. junija 1645 v prvi angleški državljanski vojni blizu vasi Naseby v Northamptonshiru. Parlamentarna vojska novega kova pod poveljstvom sira Thomasa Fairfaxa in Oliverja Cromwella je uničila glavno rojalistično vojsko pod Karlom I. in princem Rupertom. Poraz je pokopal vsako resno upanje na rojalistično zmago, čeprav se je Karel dokončno predal šele maja 1646.

Pohod leta 1645 se je začel aprila, ko je novoustanovljena vojska novega kova krenila na zahod, da bi osvobodila Taunton, nato pa je dobila ukaz, naj se vrne in oblega Oxford, vojno prestolnico rojalistov. Rojalisti so 31. maja naskočili Leicester, Fairfax pa je dobil navodilo, naj opusti obleganje in se z njimi spopade. Čeprav je imel precej manj vojakov, se je Karel odločil za boj in po več urah bojev je bila njegova vojska dejansko uničena. Rojalisti so imeli več kot 1000 žrtev, več kot 4500 pešcev pa so ujeli in jih vodili po londonskih ulicah; nikoli več niso postavili vojske primerljive kakovosti.

source.title: Battle of Naseby
paragraphs: The Battle of Naseby took place on 14 June 1645 during the First English Civil War, near the village of Naseby in Northamptonshire. The Parliamentarian New Model Army, commanded by Sir Thomas Fairfax and Oliver Cromwell, destroyed the main Royalist army under Charles I and Prince Rupert. The defeat ended any real hope of Royalist victory, although Charles did not finally surrender until May 1646.

The 1645 campaign began in April when the newly formed New Model Army marched west to relieve Taunton, before being ordered back to lay siege to Oxford, the Royalist wartime capital. On 31 May, the Royalists stormed Leicester and Fairfax was instructed to abandon the siege and engage them. Although heavily outnumbered, Charles decided to stand and fight and after several hours of combat, his force was effectively destroyed. The Royalists suffered over 1,000 casualties, with over 4,500 of their infantry captured and paraded through the streets of London; they would never again field an army of comparable quality.

Battle of Naulochus.headline: Bitka pri Naulohu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Naulohu je potekala 3. septembra 36 pr. n. št. med ladjevjema Seksta Pompeja in Marka Vipsanija Agripe pred Naulohom na Siciliji. Z zmago Agripe, Oktavijanovega admirala, se je končal pompejanski odpor proti drugemu triumviratu.
notes: No established Slovenian form of Naulochus was found; Nauloh is used.

source.title: Battle of Naulochus
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Naulochus was fought on 3 September 36 BC between the fleets of Sextus Pompeius and Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa, off Naulochus, Sicily. The victory of Agrippa, admiral of Octavian, marked the end of the Pompeian resistance to the Second Triumvirate.

Battle of Naupactus.headline: Bitka pri Navpaktu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Navpaktu je bila pomorska bitka v peloponeški vojni. Potekala je teden dni po atenski zmagi pri Riju; atensko ladjevje dvajsetih ladij pod poveljstvom Formiona se je v njej spopadlo s peloponeškim ladjevjem sedeminsedemdesetih ladij pod poveljstvom Knema.

Peloponežani so Atence izvabili s sidrišča pri Antiriju, tako da so zapluli v Korintski zaliv, kakor da bodo napadli pomembno atensko oporišče Navpakt. Atenci so jim morali slediti in pluti proti vzhodu ob severni obali zaliva. Peloponežani so nenadoma napadli, devet atenskih ladij pognali na obalo, druge pa zasledovali proti Navpaktu; zmaga se jim je zdela zagotovljena. Pri vhodu v pristanišče Navpakt pa je zadnja atenska ladja, ki je dosegla pristanišče, obrnila potek bitke: obkrožila je zasidrano trgovsko ladjo, s kljunom zadela vodilnega zasledovalca in ga potopila. Med Peloponežani je nastala zmeda, opogumljeni Atenci pa so se spustili za njimi in jih razbili.

source.title: Battle of Naupactus
paragraphs: The Battle of Naupactus was a naval battle in the Peloponnesian War. The battle, which took place a week after the Athenian victory at Rhium, set an Athenian fleet of twenty ships, commanded by Phormio, against a Peloponnesian fleet of seventy-seven ships, commanded by Cnemus.

In the battle, the Peloponnesians drew the Athenians out from their anchorage at Antirrhium by sailing into the Gulf of Corinth, moving as if to attack the vital Athenian base at Naupactus. The Athenians were forced to shadow their movements, sailing eastward along the northern shore of the gulf. Attacking suddenly, the Peloponnesians drove nine Athenian ships ashore and pursued the others towards Naupactus; victory seemed securely in their hands. At the entrance to the harbor of Naupactus, however, the last Athenian ship to reach the harbor turned the tide by circling around an anchored merchant ship to ram and sink its leading pursuer. Confusion set in among the Peloponnesians, and the newly emboldened Athenians set out after them and routed them.

Battle of Naxos.headline: Bitka pri Naksosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Naksosu (376 pr. n. št.) je bila spopad, v katerem je novo atensko ladjevje pod vodstvom Habrije odločilno premagalo Špartance. S tem so Atene začele obnavljati hegemonijo v Egejskem morju, ki so jo izgubile v peloponeški vojni. Zmago je odločilo pogumno in spretno ravnanje Fokiona na levem krilu. V zahodnih vodah je drug velik atenski poveljnik, Timotej, leta 374 pr. n. št. premagal Šparto v bitki pri Aliziji.

source.title: Battle of Naxos
paragraphs: At the Battle of Naxos (376 BC) the new Athenian fleet of Chabrias decisively defeated the Spartans. This was the beginning of Athens's recovery of its Aegean hegemony following its loss in the Peloponnesian War. The victory was decided by Phocion's courageous and skillful action on the left wing. In western waters another great Athenian commander, Timotheus, won the battle of Alyzia against Sparta in 374 BC.

Bitka pri Neerwindnu (18. marca 1793) je bila spopad, v katerem je francoska republikanska vojska pod vodstvom Charlesa Françoisa Dumourieza napadla koalicijsko vojsko pod poveljstvom princa Josiasa Saško-Coburško-Saalfeldskega. Koalicijska vojska habsburške monarhije je skupaj z manjšim kontingentom zavezniških čet Nizozemske republike po srditih bojih odbila vse francoske napade, Dumouriez pa je priznal poraz in se umaknil z bojišča. Francoski položaj na Avstrijski Nizozemski se je hitro sesul: s tem je minila nevarnost za Nizozemsko republiko, Avstrija pa je znova pridobila nadzor nad izgubljeno provinco. Spopad vojne prve koalicije je potekal pri Neerwindnu, 57 kilometrov vzhodno od Bruslja v današnji Belgiji.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Neerwinden (1793)
paragraphs: The Battle of Neerwinden (18 March 1793) saw a Republican French army led by Charles François Dumouriez attack a Coalition army commanded by Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. The Coalition army of the Habsburg monarchy together with a small contingent of allied Dutch Republic troops repulsed all French assaults after bitter fighting and Dumouriez conceded defeat, withdrawing from the field. The French position in the Austrian Netherlands swiftly collapsed, ending the threat to the Dutch Republic and allowing Austria to regain control of its lost province. The War of the First Coalition engagement was fought at Neerwinden, located 57 kilometres (35 mi) east of Brussels in present-day Belgium.

Battle of Nemea.headline: Bitka pri Nemeji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nemeji leta 394 pr. n. št., v antičnih Atenah znana tudi kot bitka pri Korintu, je bila bitka korintske vojne med Šparto in koalicijo Argosa, Aten, Korinta in Teb. Potekala je na korintskem ozemlju, v suhi strugi reke Nemeje. Končala se je z odločilno špartansko zmago, ki je Šparti skupaj z bitko pri Koroneji pozneje istega leta zagotovila prednost v prvih bojih na grški celini.

source.title: Battle of Nemea
paragraphs: The Battle of Nemea of 394 BC, also known in ancient Athens as the Battle of Corinth, was a battle in the Corinthian War, between Sparta and the coalition of Argos, Athens, Corinth, and Thebes. The battle was fought in Corinthian territory, at the dry bed of the Nemea River. The battle was a decisive Spartan victory, which, coupled with the Battle of Coronea later in the same year, gave Sparta the advantage in the early fighting on the Greek mainland.

Battle of Neuve-Chapelle.headline: Bitka pri Neuve-Chapellu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Neuve-Chapellu (10.–13. marca 1915) je potekala v prvi svetovni vojni v Artoisu v Franciji. Napad naj bi prebil nemške črte, preboj pa bi nato izkoristili s hitrim prodorom na greben Aubers in morda do Lilla. Načrtovan je bil tudi francoski napad na greben Vimy na planoti Artois, ki naj bi z juga ogrozil cestna, železniška in kanalska križišča pri La Bassée, medtem ko bi Britanci napadli s severa. Britanski napadalci so prebili nemško obrambo v izbočenju pri vasi Neuve-Chapelle, a uspeha niso mogli izkoristiti.

source.title: Battle of Neuve-Chapelle
paragraphs: The Battle of Neuve-Chapelle (10–13 March 1915) took place in the First World War in Artois in France. The attack was intended to cause a rupture in the German lines, which would then be exploited with a rush to the Aubers Ridge and possibly Lille. A French assault at Vimy Ridge on the Artois plateau was also planned to threaten the road, rail and canal junctions at La Bassée from the south as the British attacked from the north. The British attackers broke through German defences in a salient at the village of Neuve-Chapelle but the success could not be exploited.

Battle of Neville's Cross.headline: Bitka pri Neville's Crossu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Neville's Crossu je potekala med drugo škotsko osamosvojitveno vojno 17. oktobra 1346, pol milje (800 m) zahodno od Durhama v Angliji. Angleška vojska s približno 6000–7000 možmi pod vodstvom Ralpha Nevilla, lorda Nevilla, je premagala škotsko vojsko z 12.000 možmi, ki je pod vodstvom kralja Davida II. vdrla v Anglijo, in ji prizadejala hude izgube. Bitka je dobila ime po anglosaškem kamnitem križu, ki je stal na griču, kjer so se Škoti postavili v bran. Neville je po zmagi dal postaviti nov križ v spomin na ta dan.

source.title: Battle of Neville's Cross
paragraphs: The Battle of Neville's Cross took place during the Second War of Scottish Independence on 17 October 1346, half a mile (800 m) to the west of Durham, England. An invading Scottish army of 12,000 led by King David II was defeated with heavy loss by an English army of approximately 6,000–7,000 men led by Ralph Neville, Lord Neville. The battle was named after an Anglo-Saxon stone cross that stood on the hill where the Scots made their stand. After the victory, Neville paid to have a new cross erected to commemorate the day.

Bitka za Novo Kartagino je potekala v začetku leta 209 pr. n. št., ko je rimska vojska pod Publijem Kornelijem Scipionom uspešno naskočila Novo Kartagino, prestolnico kartažanske Iberije, ki jo je branila posadka pod Magonom. Bitka je bila del druge punske vojne.

Leta 211 pr. n. št. so Rimljani na Iberskem polotoku (današnji Španiji in Portugalski) doživeli hud poraz v bitki ob gornjem Baetisu. Okrepitve so prispele v začetku leta 210 pr. n. št., nove pa je pripeljal Scipion, ko je konec leta prevzel poveljstvo. Scipion ni videl možnosti, da bi katero od treh močnih kartažanskih vojsk na polotoku zvabil v bitko in jo premagal, zato se je odločil udariti na materialno središče kartažanske moči na Iberskem polotoku: njeno prestolnico Novo Kartagino. Pred mesto je prispel v začetku leta 209 pr. n. št. in naslednji dan začel napad. Ko je pred obzidjem premagal kartažanski oddelek, je napadel vzhodna vrata. Hkrati so se možje z rimskih ladij s pristaniškega območja skušali povzpeti na obzidje na jugu. Oba napada so odbili.

source.title: Battle of New Carthage
paragraphs: The battle of New Carthage took place in early 209 BC when a Roman army under Publius Cornelius Scipio successfully assaulted New Carthage, the capital of Carthaginian Iberia, which was defended by a garrison under Mago. The battle was part of the Second Punic War.

In 211 BC the Romans in Iberia (modern Spain and Portugal) were heavily defeated at the battle of the Upper Baetis. Reinforcements arrived in early 210 BC and Scipio brought further reinforcements when he took command late in the year. Scipio felt unable to draw into battle and defeat any of the three strong Carthaginian armies in the peninsula and so decided to strike at the material centre of Carthaginian power in Iberia: its capital, New Carthage. He arrived outside the city early in 209 BC and commenced his attack the next day. After defeating a Carthaginian force outside the walls, he pressed an attack on the east gate. Simultaneously men from the Roman ships attempted to escalade the wall to the south from the harbour area. Both attacks were repulsed.

Bitka pri Nikopolu ali Nikopolisu (turško: Niğbolu Muharebesi) je bila ena prvih bitk rusko-turške vojne (1877–1878). Ko je ruska vojska prečkala Donavo, se je približala utrjenemu mestu Nikopol (Nikopolis). Turško vrhovno poveljstvo je poslalo Osman-pašo s četami iz Vidina, da bi Rusom preprečil prehod čez Donavo. Osman je nameraval Nikopol okrepiti in braniti. Toda ruski IX. korpus generala Nikolaja Kridenerja je prispel prvi, obstreljeval mesto in garnizijo prisilil k predaji, preden je Osman-paša prišel do mesta. Osman se je zato umaknil v Plevno. Ko nikopolske garnizije ni bilo več, so Rusi lahko nemoteno nadaljevali pohod proti Plevni.

source.title: Battle of Nikopol
paragraphs: The Battle of Nikopol, or Nicopolis (Turkish: Niğbolu Muharebesi), was one of the early battles of the Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878). As the Russian army crossed the Danube river, they approached the fortified city of Nikopol (Nicopolis). The Turkish high command sent Osman Pasha with the troops from Vidin to oppose the Russians' crossing of the Danube. Osman's intentions were to reinforce and defend Nikopol. However, General Nikolai Kridener's Russian IX Corps arrived first, bombarding and compelling the garrison's surrender before Osman Pasha could reach the city. He instead fell back to Plevna. With the Nikopol garrison eliminated, the Russians were free to march on to Plevna.

Battle of Nish (1443).headline: Bitka pri Nišu (1443)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nišu (v začetku novembra 1443) je potekala med križarji pod vodstvom Janoša Hunyadija in Đurađa Brankovića ter Osmanskim cesarstvom pod vodstvom Kasim-paše. Križarji so v njej zavzeli osmansko utrdbo Niš v Srbiji in premagali dve osmanski vojski. Bitka pri Nišu je bila del Hunyadijevega pohoda, imenovanega dolgi pohod. Hunyadi je na čelu predhodnice prečkal Balkan skozi Trajanova vrata, zavzel Niš, premagal tri osmanske paše in Osmanom vzel Sofijo, nato pa združil sile s kraljevo vojsko in pri Snaimu (Kustinici) porazil sultana Murata II. Kraljeva nestrpnost in huda zima sta ga nato (februarja 1444) prisilili, da se je vrnil domov.

source.title: Battle of Nish (1443)
paragraphs: The Battle of Nish (early November 1443) was fought between the Crusaders led by John Hunyadi and Đurađ Branković and the Ottoman Empire led by Kasım Pasha. It saw the Crusaders capture the Ottoman stronghold of Nish (Niš) in Serbia, and defeat two armies of the Ottoman Empire. The Battle of Nish was part of Hunyadi's expedition known as the long campaign. Hunyadi, at the head of the vanguard, crossed the Balkans through the Gate of Trajan, captured Nish, defeated three Ottoman pashas, and after taking Sofia from the Ottomans, united with the royal army and defeated Sultan Murad II at Snaim (Kustinitza). The impatience of the king and the severity of the winter then compelled him (in February 1444) to return home.

Battle of Noisseville.headline: Bitka pri Noissevillu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Noissevillu je potekala 31. avgusta 1870 med francosko-prusko vojno in se končala s prusko zmago.

Francoske sile pod poveljstvom maršala Françoisa Achilla Bazaina so iz Metza skušale prebiti obkolitveno črto pruskih sil princa Friderika Karla. Francozi so sprva dosegli manjši uspeh in čez dan obdržali osvojeno ozemlje. Naslednji dan, 1. septembra, pa so jih potisnili nazaj v Metz; izgubili so 3379 vojakov in 145 častnikov. Prusi so izgubili 2850 vojakov in 126 častnikov.

source.title: Battle of Noisseville
paragraphs: The Battle of Noisseville on 31 August 1870 was fought during the Franco-Prussian War and ended in a Prussian victory.

Traveling from Metz, the French forces under Marshal François Achille Bazaine attempted to break through the investing line of the Prussian forces under Prince Frederick Charles. At first, the French had slight success, and maintained the ground they won during the day. But on 1 September the French were driven back into Metz, with a loss of 3,379 soldiers and 145 officers. The Prussians lost 2,850 soldiers and 126 officers.

Battle of Nola (214 BC).headline: Tretja bitka pri Noli
paragraphs: Tretja bitka pri Noli je potekala leta 214 pr. n. št. med Hanibalom in rimsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Marka Klavdija Marcela. Hanibal je mesto Nolo skušal zavzeti že tretjič. Marcel je spet uspešno preprečil njeno zavzetje.

source.title: Battle of Nola (214 BC)
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Nola was fought in 214 BC between Hannibal and a Roman army led by Marcus Claudius Marcellus. It was Hannibal's third attempt to take the town of Nola. Once again, Marcellus successfully prevented the town's capture.

Battle of Nola (215 BC).headline: Druga bitka pri Noli
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Noli je potekala leta 215 pr. n. št. med Hanibalovo vojsko in rimskimi silami pod poveljstvom Marka Klavdija Marcela. Hanibal je Nolo po neuspehu prejšnjega leta skušal zavzeti drugič. Spet so ga odbili, naslednje leto pa je poskusil še zadnjič, prav tako neuspešno. Za Rimljane je bil to ključen uspeh proti Hanibalovi vojski, ki jim je dal upanje, da lahko vojno dobijo.

source.title: Battle of Nola (215 BC)
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Nola was fought in 215 BC between Hannibal's army and a Roman force under Marcus Claudius Marcellus. It was Hannibal's second attempt to seize Nola after a failure the year before. He was again repelled and would make one more, also unsuccessful attempt the next year. For the Romans, it was a crucial success against Hannibal's army and gave them hope that they could win the war.

Battle of Nola (216 BC).headline: Prva bitka pri Noli
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Noli je potekala leta 216 pr. n. št. med Hanibalovimi silami in rimskimi silami pod poveljstvom Marka Klavdija Marcela. Hanibal je skušal mesto Nolo zavzeti, a mu ni uspelo, v naslednjih dveh letih pa je poskusil še dvakrat, prav tako neuspešno.

Hanibal je mesto Nolo skušal zavzeti, ker so mu nekateri mestni voditelji ponudili, da mu odprejo vrata. Rimske sile pod Marcelovim poveljstvom so prispele pred Hanibalom in so lahko vstopile v mesto. Hanibal se je utaboril blizu mesta, med vojskama pa so bile vsak dan praske. Marcel je ugotovil, da mu v mestu pomagajo samo senatorji. Da bi preprečil izdajo, je začel spodkopavati Hanibalu naklonjeno frakcijo v mestu. Izvedel je, da so nekateri voditelji mesta kovali zaroto s Hanibalom, in odkril, da so načrtovali, da bi oplenili njegovo prtljago in za njim zaprli vrata, če bi naredil izpad iz mesta ali se zunaj postavil v bojni red. Po tem je Marcel presodil, da njegov položaj ni vzdržen.

source.title: Battle of Nola (216 BC)
paragraphs: The First Battle of Nola was fought in 216 BC between the forces of Hannibal and a Roman force led by Marcus Claudius Marcellus. Hannibal was attempting to seize the town of Nola: He failed to do so, and would make two more unsuccessful attempts on the city over the next two years.

Hannibal moved to capture the city of Nola due to some leaders in the city offering to open their gates to him. A Roman force under the command of Marcellus arrived before Hannibal and was able to enter the city. Hannibal camped near the city, and daily skirmishes took place between the two armies. Marcellus learnt that the only support he enjoyed was the senators in the city. Marcellus took action to prevent betrayal by undermining the pro-Hannibal faction in the city. Marcellus learnt that some leaders in the city had been conspiring with Hannibal, and he discovered that should he make any sortie from the town or draw up for battle outside, they planned on plundering the baggage and closing the gates behind him. After this, Marcellus decided his situation was not sustainable.

Battle of Nördlingen (1634).headline: Bitka pri Nördlingnu (1634)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nördlingnu, ki je potekala dva dni, 5. in 6. septembra 1634, je bila velika bitka tridesetletne vojne. Cesarsko-španske sile pod vodstvom kardinala infanta Ferdinanda in Ferdinanda Ogrskega so švedsko-nemški vojski pod vodstvom Gustava Horna in Bernharda Saško-Weimarskega zadale uničujoč poraz.

Do leta 1634 so Švedi in njihovi nemški zavezniki zasedli velik del južne Nemčije. Tako so lahko zaprli špansko cesto, kopensko oskrbovalno pot iz Italije v Flandrijo, ki je služila španski vojni proti Nizozemski republiki. Da bi jo znova odprla, se je španska vojska pod vodstvom kardinala infanta združila s cesarskimi silami blizu Nördlingna, ki ga je držala švedska posadka.

source.title: Battle of Nördlingen (1634)
paragraphs: The Battle of Nördlingen, fought over two days from 5 to 6 September 1634, was a major battle of the Thirty Years' War. An Imperial–Spanish force led by the Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand and Ferdinand of Hungary inflicted a crushing defeat on the Swedish–German army led by Gustav Horn and Bernhard of Saxe-Weimar.

By 1634, the Swedes and their German allies occupied much of southern Germany. This allowed them to block the Spanish Road, an overland supply route running from Italy to Flanders, used to support Spain's war against the Dutch Republic. Seeking to re-open this, a Spanish army under the Cardinal-Infante linked up with Imperial forces near Nördlingen, which was held by a Swedish garrison.

Battle of Nördlingen (1645).headline: Bitka pri Nördlingnu (1645)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Nördlingnu (1645) je potekala 3. avgusta 1645 v poznejših fazah tridesetletne vojne jugovzhodno od Nördlingna blizu vasi Alerheim. Združena francosko-hessenska vojska pod vodstvom d'Enghiena in Turenna je premagala bavarske sile pod vodstvom Franza von Mercyja.
Obe strani sta utrpeli hude izgube, med mrtvimi je bil tudi sam Mercy, a izid je imel na vojno zelo malo strateškega vpliva.

source.title: Battle of Nördlingen (1645)
paragraphs: The Battle of Nördlingen (1645) took place on 3 August 1645 in the later stages of the Thirty Years' War, southeast of Nördlingen near the village of Alerheim. A combined Franco-Hessian army led by d'Enghien and Turenne defeated a Bavarian force led by Franz von Mercy.
Both sides suffered heavy casualties, with Mercy himself among the dead, but the result had very little strategic impact on the war.

Battle of Noreia.headline: Bitka pri Noreji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Noreji leta 113 pr. n. št. je bila uvodna bitka kimbrske vojne med rimsko republiko in selečima se protogermanskima plemenoma Kimbrov in Tevtonov. Končala se je z rimskim porazom, ki je bil skoraj katastrofa.

source.title: Battle of Noreia
paragraphs: The Battle of Noreia, in 113 BC, was the opening battle of the Cimbrian War fought between the Roman Republic and the migrating Proto-Germanic tribes, the Cimbri and the Teutons. It ended in defeat, and near disaster, for the Romans.

Battle of Northampton (1460).headline: Bitka pri Northamptonu (1460)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Northamptonu je potekala 10. julija 1460 blizu reke Nene v Northamptonshiru. Bila je ena velikih bitk vojne rož. Na eni strani je bila vojska pod vodstvom plemičev, zvestih kralju Henriku VI. iz lancastrske hiše, njegovi kraljici Margareti Anžujski in njunemu šestletnemu sinu Edvardu, princu Walesa, na drugi pa vojska Edvarda, grofa Marcha, in Warwicka Kraljevotvorca. Bila je prva bitka v Angliji, v kateri so uporabili artilerijo.

source.title: Battle of Northampton (1460)
paragraphs: The Battle of Northampton was fought on 10 July 1460 near the River Nene, Northamptonshire. It was a major battle of the Wars of the Roses. The opposing forces were an army led by nobles loyal to King Henry VI of the House of Lancaster, his Queen Margaret of Anjou and their six-year-old son Edward, Prince of Wales, on one side, and the army of Edward, Earl of March, and Warwick the Kingmaker on the other. The battle was the first in which artillery was used in England.

Battle of Novara (1500).headline: Bitka pri Novari leta 1500
paragraphs: Bitka pri Novari je potekala 8. aprila 1500 med silami francoskega kralja Ludvika XII. in silami milanskega vojvode Ludovica Sforze.

Louis II. de la Trémoille se je 24. marca 1500 pri Mortari v Lombardiji s korpusom okoli 500 mož in topništvom pridružil glavni francoski vojski. Kmalu mu je sledilo še 10.000 Švicarjev, ki jih je zbral dijonski bailli. Do 5. aprila je bila vsa kraljeva vojska zbrana in je odkorakala, da se pred Novaro spopade z milanskimi silami.

V vrstah obeh vojsk je bilo veliko švicarskih najemnikov. Helvetski kantoni so ob sprejemu pogodb v njihova besedila zapisali, da jih ne bodo mogli prisiliti v boj proti drugim Švicarjem. (Švicarski vojaki so bili tesno povezani in so kljub službi pod različnimi zastavami skupaj pili.)

source.title: Battle of Novara (1500)
paragraphs: The Battle of Novara was fought on 8 April 1500 between the forces of King Louis XII of France and the forces of Ludovico Sforza, the Duke of Milan.

On 24 March 1500, Louis II de la Trémoille joined the main French army at Mortara, Lombardy, with a corps of about 500 men, supported by artillery. He was quickly followed by the 10,000 Swiss raised by the Baillie of Dijon. On 5 April, all the King's army was united and marched to engage the Milanese forces before Novara.

There was a large number of Swiss mercenaries in the ranks of each of the two armies. The Helvetic cantons, in accepting their contracts, had it placed in the contracts that they would not be forced to fight against other Swiss. (The Swiss troops were close and, even though serving under different flags, would drink together.)

Battle of Novara (1513).headline: Bitka pri Novari leta 1513
paragraphs: Bitka pri Novari (znana tudi kot bitka pri Ariotti) je bila bitka vojne kambrejske lige, ki je potekala 6. junija 1513 blizu Novare v severni Italiji. Zavezniške švicarsko-milanske čete so razbile napadalno francosko vojsko. Zato se je morala Francija popolnoma umakniti iz Italije.

source.title: Battle of Novara (1513)
paragraphs: The Battle of Novara (also known as the battle of Ariotta) was a battle of the War of the League of Cambrai fought on 6 June 1513, near Novara, in Northern Italy. A French attacking force was routed by allied Swiss-Milanese troops. As a consequence, France was forced to withdraw entirely from Italy.

Battle of Novi (1799).headline: Bitka pri Noviju leta 1799
paragraphs: Bitka pri Noviju, ki je potekala 15. avgusta 1799, je bila bitka med združeno vojsko habsburške monarhije in carskih Rusov pod feldmaršalom Aleksandrom Suvorovom ter republikansko francosko vojsko pod poveljstvom generala Barthélemyja Catherine Jouberta. Ko je Joubert v bitki padel, je vrhovno poveljstvo nad francoskimi silami takoj prevzel Jean Victor Marie Moreau. Po dolgem in krvavem boju so Avstrijci in Rusi prebili francoske obrambne položaje in sovražnika pognali v neurejen umik, francoska divizijska poveljnika Catherine-Dominique de Pérignon in Emmanuel Grouchy pa sta bila ujeta. Novi Ligure leži v deželi Piemont v severni Italiji, 58 kilometrov severno od Genove. Bitka je potekala v vojni druge koalicije, ki je bila del francoskih revolucionarnih vojn.
notes: The mile conversion (36 mi) is dropped. The English calls Piedmont a province; the Slovenian says region (dežela).

source.title: Battle of Novi (1799)
paragraphs: The Battle of Novi, which took place on 15 August 1799, was a battle between a combined army of the Habsburg monarchy and the Imperial Russians under Field Marshal Alexander Suvorov and a Republican French army under General Barthélemy Catherine Joubert. As soon as Joubert fell during the battle, Jean Victor Marie Moreau immediately took overall command of the French forces. After a prolonged and bloody struggle, the Austro-Russians broke through the French defenses and drove their enemies into a disorderly retreat, while French division commanders Catherine-Dominique de Pérignon and Emmanuel Grouchy were captured. Novi Ligure is in the province of Piedmont in Northern Italy a distance of 58 kilometres (36 mi) north of Genoa. The battle occurred during the War of the Second Coalition which was part of the French Revolutionary Wars.

Battle of Numistro.headline: Bitka pri Numistru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Numistru je potekala leta 210 pr. n. št. med Hanibalovo vojsko in eno od rimskih konzularnih vojsk pod vodstvom konzula Marka Klavdija Marcela. Bila je njuno četrto srečanje v bitki. Prejšnja srečanja so potekala ob obzidju Nole (Kampanija) leta 216, 215 in 214 pr. n. št. in so bila za Rimljane ugodna.

source.title: Battle of Numistro
paragraphs: The Battle of Numistro was fought in 210 BC between Hannibal's army and one of the Roman consular armies led by consul Marcus Claudius Marcellus. It was the fourth time they met in a battle. Previous encounters were located around the walls of Nola (Campania) in 216, 215, and 214 and had been favourable for the Roman side.

Battle of Nuremberg (1945).headline: Bitka za Nürnberg (1945)
paragraphs: Bitka za Nürnberg (nemško: Schlacht um Nürnberg), imenovana tudi padec Nürnberga, je bila petdnevna bitka med silami ameriške 7. armade na eni in nacistično Nemčijo na drugi strani v zadnjih dneh druge svetovne vojne. V bitki so potekali eni najsrditejših uličnih bojev v vojni in Američani so mesto zavzemali štiri dni. Bitka je bila udarec za nacistično Nemčijo, saj je bil Nürnberg središče nacističnega režima. V mestu so potekali nürnberški shodi in izguba mesta je močno prizadela že tako nizko nemško moralo. Čeprav so imele ameriške sile veliko številčno premoč, je 7. armada središče mesta zavzela šele 20. aprila. Bitka je mesto opustošila.

source.title: Battle of Nuremberg (1945)
paragraphs: The Battle of Nuremberg (German: Schlacht um Nürnberg), also called the Fall of Nuremberg, was a five-day battle between the forces of the United States 7th Army on one side, and Nazi Germany on the other during the last days of World War II. The battle saw some of the fiercest urban combat during the war and it took four days for the United States to capture the city. The battle was a blow to Nazi Germany as Nuremberg was a center of the Nazi regime. The Nuremberg Rallies took place in the city and to lose the city to the Americans took a heavy toll on already low German morale. Even though American forces heavily outnumbered the German forces, it was not until 20 April, that the 7th Army took the city center. The battle devastated the city.

Battle of Ocaña.headline: Bitka pri Ocañi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ocañi je potekala 19. novembra 1809 med francoskimi silami pod maršalom Jeanom de Dieu Soultom in špansko vojsko pod generalom Juanom Carlosom Aréizago, ki je v njej doživela svoj največji posamični poraz v polotoški vojni.

Španska vojska generala Aréizage z 51.000 vojaki je izgubila skoraj 19.000 mož, ki so bili ubiti, ranjeni, ujeti ali so dezertirali, predvsem zaradi francoske uporabe konjenice. Taktično je bila bitka obkolitev španske vojske po zgledu Kan in najhujši poraz, ki ga je španska vojska kdaj doživela na domačih tleh. Tudi strateške posledice so bile uničujoče, saj je bila uničena edina sila, ki je lahko branila južno Španijo.

source.title: Battle of Ocaña
paragraphs: The Battle of Ocaña was fought on 19 November 1809 between French forces under Marshal Jean-de-Dieu Soult against the Spanish army under General Juan Carlos Aréizaga, which suffered its greatest single defeat in the Peninsular War.

General Aréizaga's Spanish army of 51,000 troops lost nearly 19,000 men killed, wounded, prisoners and deserters, mostly due to the French use of their cavalry. Tactically, the battle was a Cannae-like encirclement of the Spanish army, and the worst defeat ever suffered by a Spanish army on home soil. The strategic consequences were also devastating, as it destroyed the only force capable of defending southern Spain.

Bitka v Oktoduru je potekala pozimi 57–56 pr. n. št. v galskem mestu Oktodur na območju današnjega Martignyja v kantonu Valais v Švici. Do nje je prišlo zaradi rimskega poskusa, da bi odprli prelaz Veliki Sveti Bernard čez Alpe. Bila je rimska zmaga, a zaradi srditosti bojev se je rimska legija umaknila iz Alp.

source.title: Battle of Octodurus
paragraphs: The battle of Octodurus took place in the winter of 57–56 BC in the Gallic town of Octodurus in what is now Martigny, Valais, Switzerland. The battle resulted from a Roman attempt to open the Great St. Bernard Pass over the Alps. It was a Roman victory, but the ferocity of the fighting ended with the Roman legion moving back out of the Alps.

Battle of Odžak.headline: Bitka za Odžak
paragraphs: Bitka za Odžak je bila zadnja bitka druge svetovne vojne v Evropi. Začela se je 19. aprila 1945 in trajala do 25. maja 1945, 17 dni po koncu vojne v Evropi. Spopadle so se Hrvaške oborožene sile, povezane s silami osi, pod poveljstvom Petra Rajkovačića, in jugoslovanski partizani pod poveljstvom Miloša Zekića. Bitka je potekala v bosanskem mestu Odžak v nekdanji Jugoslaviji in se končala z zmago partizanov.

Bitka je natančno opisana v več knjigah, na primer v knjigi o 53. diviziji iz leta 1969, o 16. muslimanski brigadi iz leta 1981, o 27. vzhodnobosanski diviziji iz leta 1983 in o 14. srednjebosanski brigadi iz leta 1983.

source.title: Battle of Odžak
paragraphs: The Battle of Odžak was the last battle of World War II in Europe. The battle began on 19 April 1945 and lasted until 25 May 1945, 17 days after the end of the war in Europe. The combatants were the Axis-aligned Croatian Armed Forces, commanded by Petar Rajkovačić, and the Yugoslav Partisans, commanded by Miloš Zekić. The battle took place in the Bosnian town of Odžak, in the former country of Yugoslavia. The battle was a victory for the partisans.

The battle is thoroughly described in a number of books, for example, in a 1969 book on 53rd Division, 1981 book on 16th Muslim Brigade, 1983 book on 27th East Bosnian Division, and 1983 book on 14th Central Bosnian Brigade.

Battle of Oenophyta.headline: Bitka pri Ojnofitah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ojnofitah je potekala leta 457 pr. n. št. med Atenami in beotskimi mestnimi državami v prvi peloponeški vojni.

V tem obdobju med perzijskimi vojnami in peloponeško vojno so zavezništva in zveze nastajala in razpadala, čeprav dolgotrajnih vojn skoraj ni bilo. Leta 457 pr. n. št. so Atene, vodja Delske zveze, prišle v spor s Korintom in njegovo zaveznico Šparto (vodjo Peloponeške zveze) zaradi Megare; 62 dni pred bitko pri Ojnofitah je Šparta Atence porazila v bitki pri Tanagri, a je izgubila toliko mož, da zmage ni mogla izkoristiti.

Atenci, ki so imeli pri Tanagri 14.000 mož, so se po tej bitki zbrali in vkorakali v Beotijo. Pri Ojnofitah so pod vodstvom Mironida premagali Beočane, nato porušili obzidje Tanagre ter opustošili Lokrido in Fokido. Zmagi pri Ojnofitah je kmalu sledila predaja Egine in dokončanje dolgih zidov do atenskega pristanišča Pirej (čemur je Šparta nasprotovala).

source.title: Battle of Oenophyta
paragraphs: The Battle of Oenophyta took place between Athens and the Boeotian city-states in 457 BC during the First Peloponnesian War.

In this period between the Persian Wars and the Peloponnesian War, alliances and leagues sprang up and collapsed, although there was very little prolonged warfare. In 457 BC Athens, the leader of the Delian League, came into conflict with Corinth and their ally Sparta (leader of the Peloponnesian League) over Megara; 62 days prior to the Battle of Oenophyta, the Athenians were defeated at the Battle of Tanagra by Sparta, but Sparta had lost so many men that they could not take advantage of their victory.

The Athenians, who had 14,000 men at Tanagra, regrouped after that battle and marched into Boeotia. At Oenophyta, led by Myronides they defeated the Boeotians, and then destroyed the walls of Tanagra and ravaged Locrida and Phocis. Their victory at Oenophyta was quickly followed by the surrender of Aegina, and the completion of the construction of the Long Walls to the Athenian port of Piraeus (an action opposed by Sparta).

Ruska vojska je 24. februarja 2022 v okviru ruske invazije na Ukrajino prestopila rusko-ukrajinsko in belorusko-ukrajinsko mejo ter vdrla na sever Ukrajine, v Kijevsko, Černigovsko, Sumsko in Žitomirsko oblast. Ruske operacije na severu Ukrajine so se sprva začele kot poskus zavzetja Kijeva, ukrajinske prestolnice in sedeža ukrajinske vlade.

Ruske sile so sprva zavzele več mest, vendar so njihovo napredovanje ustavili logistične in oskrbovalne težave, trdovraten ukrajinski odpor in slaba morala. Ker so imele velike izgube in niso mogle več napredovati, je Rusija konec marca in v začetku aprila 2022 umaknila svoje sile iz Kijevske, Žitomirske, Černigovske in Sumske oblasti, nadzor pa so znova prevzele ukrajinske sile.
notes: The record's article now leads to the summary of the northern Ukraine campaign, which does not mention Okhtyrka; translated as it stands.
The glossary had Bitka za Oktirko; an override now gives Bitka za Ohtirko.

source.title: Northern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine
paragraphs: On 24 February 2022, as part of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, the Russian military crossed the Russia–Ukraine and Belarus–Ukraine borders into northern Ukraine, entering the oblasts (regions) of Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, and Zhytomyr. The Russian operations in northern Ukraine were initially launched as an attempt to capture Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine and the seat of the Ukrainian government.

Russian forces initially captured several towns and cities, but logistical and supply failures, stiff Ukrainian resistance, and poor morale caused their advance to stall. With heavy losses and the inability to make further progress, Russia withdrew its forces from Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv and Sumy oblasts in late March and early April 2022, and Ukrainian forces retook control.

Battle of Olasch.headline: Bitka pri Olaschu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Olaschu (tudi Ólas, Ulaş, Olaschin) se je zgodila, potem ko je habsburška cesarska vojska pod vodstvom saškega volilnega kneza, generala Avgusta II. Močnega, oblegala Temišvar, ki so ga imeli v rokah Turki. Ko je Avgust izvedel, da reševalna vojska sultana Mustafe II. prečka Donavo pri Pančevu, je 26. avgusta 1696 opustil obleganje in se odpravil naproti osmanski vojski. Bitka blizu reke Begej se je končala neodločeno, saj sta se obe vojski s hudimi izgubami umaknili. Strateško je osmanski pohod mogoče šteti za uspeh, ker je dosegel svoj cilj, ohraniti Temišvar.

source.title: Battle of Olasch
paragraphs: The Battle of Olasch (also Ólas, Ulaş, Olaschin) took place after a Habsburg Imperial army led by Saxon Elector General, Augustus II the Strong, laid siege to Turkish held Temesvár. On 26 August 1696, after learning that Sultan Mustafa II's relief army was crossing the Danube at Pancsova, Augustus gave up the siege and headed to meet the Ottoman army. The battle near the Bega River resulted in a draw after both armies retreated with heavy casualties on both sides. Strategically, the Ottoman army's campaign can be considered a success, as it achieved its goal of retaining Temesvár.

Battle of Oliwa.headline: Bitka pri Oliwi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Oliwi, znana tudi kot bitka pri Olivi ali bitka na gdanskem sidrišču, je bila pomorska bitka 28. novembra 1627 nekoliko severno od pristanišča Gdansk (Danzig) pred obalo vasi Oliwa med poljsko-švedsko vojno. Bila je največji pomorski spopad mornarice Republike obeh narodov in se je končala s porazom švedske eskadre pod vodstvom Nielsa Stiernskölda, ki je blokirala gdansko pristanišče. Poljaki so izpluli iz gdanskega pristanišča in napadli švedsko eskadro, zajeli švedsko poveljniško ladjo in potopili še eno švedsko vojno ladjo.

source.title: Battle of Oliwa
paragraphs: The Battle of Oliwa, also known as the Battle of Oliva or the Battle of Gdańsk Roadstead, was a naval battle that took place on 28 November, 1627, slightly north of the port of Danzig (Gdańsk) off of the coast of the village of Oliva during the Polish–Swedish War. It was the largest naval engagement to be fought by the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth Navy and resulted in defeating a Swedish squadron led by Niels Stiernsköld that conducted a blockade of the harbour of Gdańsk. The Poles sailed out of the Danzig harbour and engaged the Swedish squadron capturing the Swedish flagship and sinking another Swedish warship.

Battle of Olpae.headline: Bitka pri Olpah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Olpah je potekala v peloponeški vojni leta 426 pr. n. št. med vojskama pod vodstvom Aten in Šparte.

Leta 426 je 3000 hoplitov iz Ambrakije vdrlo v Amfiloški Argos v Akarnaniji ob zalivu Jonskega morja in zasedlo utrdbo Olpe. Akarnanci so za pomoč prosili atenskega vojskovodjo Demostena in 20 atenskih ladij, ki so bile v bližini pod poveljstvom Aristotela in Hierofonta. Ambrakijci so za pomoč prosili Špartanca Evriloha, ki mu je uspelo vojsko neopaženo pripeljati mimo Akarnancev. Nato je Demosten z ladjami, 200 hopliti in 60 lokostrelci prispel v zaliv pod Olpami. Pridružil se je akarnanski vojski in postavil tabor v soteski nasproti Evriloha, kjer sta se obe strani pet dni pripravljali. Ker je bila ambrakijska in peloponeška vojska večja, je Demosten pripravil zasedo s 400 akarnanskimi hopliti, ki naj bi jo uporabil ob začetku bitke.

source.title: Battle of Olpae
paragraphs: The Battle of Olpae took place during the Peloponnesian War in 426 BC, between armies led by Athens and Sparta.

In 426, 3,000 hoplites from Ambracia invaded Amphilochian Argos in Acarnania on a gulf of the Ionian Sea and occupied the fort of Olpae. The Acarnanians asked for help from both the Athenian general Demosthenes, and the 20 Athenian ships located nearby under the command of Aristotle and Hierophon. The Ambraciots asked for help from Eurylochus of Sparta, who managed to march his army past the Acarnanians without being observed. After this, Demosthenes arrived in the gulf below Olpae with his ships, 200 hoplites, and 60 archers. He joined with the Acarnanian army and set up camp in a ravine opposite Eurylochus, where both sides made preparations for five days. As the Ambraciot and Peloponnesian army was larger, Demosthenes set up an ambush with 400 hoplites from Acarnania, to be used when the battle began.

Battle of Oltenița.headline: Bitka pri Olteniți
paragraphs: Bitka pri Olteniți (ali Oltenici) je potekala 4. novembra 1853.

Bila je prvi spopad krimske vojne. Osmanska vojska pod poveljstvom Omer-paše je v njej branila utrjene položaje pred ruskimi silami pod vodstvom generala Petra Dannenberga, dokler Rusi niso dobili ukaza za umik. Ruski napad so odpovedali ravno, ko so Rusi dosegli osmanske utrdbe; umaknili so se urejeno, a s hudimi izgubami. Turki so obdržali položaje, vendar sovražnika niso zasledovali in so se pozneje umaknili na drugo stran Donave.
notes: The English breaks its first sentence across two paragraphs; each Slovenian paragraph is a full sentence.

source.title: Battle of Oltenița
paragraphs: The Battle of Oltenița (or Oltenitza) was fought on 4 November 1853

and was the first engagement of the Crimean War. In this battle an Ottoman army under the command of Omar Pasha was defending its fortified positions from the Russian forces led by General Peter Dannenberg, until the Russians were ordered to withdraw. The Russian attack was called off just when they reached the Ottoman fortifications, and they retreated in good order, but suffered heavy losses. The Turks held their positions, but did not pursue the enemy, and later retreated to the other side of Danube.

Battle of Ongal.headline: Bitka pri Ongalu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ongalu je potekala poleti leta 680 na območju Ongal, nedoločenem kraju v delti Donave ali njeni okolici blizu otoka Peuke, v današnjem okrožju Tulcea v Romuniji. Spopadli so se Bolgari pod vodstvom Asparuha, ki so pred kratkim vdrli na Balkan, in Bizantinsko cesarstvo, ki je bitko nazadnje izgubilo. Bitka je bila ključna za nastanek Prvega bolgarskega cesarstva.

source.title: Battle of Ongal
paragraphs: The Battle of Ongal took place in the summer of 680 in the Ongal area, an unspecified location in and around the Danube Delta near the Peuce Island, present-day Tulcea County, Romania. It was fought between the Bulgars of Asparuh of Bulgaria, who had recently invaded the Balkans, and the Byzantine Empire, which ultimately lost the battle. The battle was crucial for the creation of the First Bulgarian Empire.

Battle of Órbigo (456).headline: Bitka pri Órbigu (456)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Órbigu, znana tudi kot bitka ob Urbicu in bitka na Campus Paramus, je potekala leta 456, ko so Vizigoti Teoderika II. premagali Kraljestvo Suebov in oplenili njegovo prestolnico Brago. O bitki je znanega zelo malo, a je bil poraz za Suebe hud udarec: zatem so zašli v obdobje zatona in svojega ozemlja niso nikoli več povsem obnovili.

Suebski kralj Rehiar je širil svoje ozemlje na račun Rimljanov v Hispaniji, ki ga niso mogli ustaviti. Rimski cesar Avit je svoje zaveznike, Vizigote Teoderika II. ter Burgunde Gundioha in Hilperika, zaprosil, naj zanj napadejo Suebe. Teoderik je privolil in z vojsko vdrl v Hispanijo.

source.title: Battle of Órbigo (456)
paragraphs: The Battle of Órbigo, also known as the Battle of the Urbicus and the Battle of Campus Paramus took place in 456 when the Visigoths of Theodoric II defeated the Suevi Kingdom and sacked their capital Braga. Although very little is known of the battle the defeat proved a significant blow to the Suevi who would enter a period of decline afterwards and would never fully recover their territory.

The Suevi King Rechiar had been expanding his territory at the expense of the Romans in Hispania, who were unable stop them. The Roman Emperor Avitus requested his allies the Visigoths of Theodoric II and the Burgundians of Gondiloc and Chilperic to attack the Suebi for him. Theodoric agreed and invaded Spain with his army.

Battle of Orchomenus.headline: Bitka pri Orhomenu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Orhomenu je potekala jeseni leta 86 pr. n. št. med Rimom in silami Mitridata VI. Pontskega. Rimsko vojsko je vodil Lucij Kornelij Sula, Mitridatovo pa Arhelaj. Zmagali so Rimljani, Arhelaj pa je pozneje prestopil na rimsko stran. Bitka je končala Mitridatov vdor v Evropo. Podatki o njej so v Plutarhovem Sulovem življenjepisu, v poglavjih 20–21.

source.title: Battle of Orchomenus
paragraphs: The Battle of Orchomenus was fought in autumn 86 BC between Rome and the forces of Mithridates VI of Pontus. The Roman army was led by Lucius Cornelius Sulla, while Mithridates' army was led by Archelaus. The Roman force was victorious, and Archelaus later defected to Rome. The battle ended the Mithridatic invasion of Europe. Information on the battle is included in Plutarch's Life of Sulla, chapters 20–21.

Battle of Ortona.headline: Bitka pri Ortoni
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ortoni (20.–28. decembra 1943) je potekala med dvema bataljonoma elitnih nemških padalcev (Fallschirmjäger) iz nemške 1. padalske divizije pod generalporočnikom Richardom Heidrichom in napadajočimi kanadskimi četami iz 1. kanadske pehotne divizije pod generalmajorjem Christopherjem Vokesom. Bila je vrhunec bojev na jadranski fronti v Italiji v »krvavem decembru«. Borci so jo imenovali »italijanski Stalingrad« in »mali Stalingrad« zaradi brutalnosti spopadov od blizu, ki so jih še poslabšale kaotične razvaline mesta in številne pasti, ki sta jih nastavljali obe strani. Potekala je v majhnem jadranskem mestu Ortona (Abruci), ki je imelo v miru 10.000 prebivalcev.

source.title: Battle of Ortona
paragraphs: The Battle of Ortona (20–28 December 1943) was fought between two battalions of elite German Fallschirmjäger (paratroops) from the German 1st Parachute Division under Generalleutnant Richard Heidrich, and assaulting Canadian troops from the 1st Canadian Infantry Division under Major General Christopher Vokes. It was the culmination of the fighting on the Adriatic front in Italy during "Bloody December". The battle was known to those who fought it as the "Italian Stalingrad," and as "Little Stalingrad", for the brutality of its close-quarters combat, which was only worsened by the chaotic rubble of the town and the many booby traps used by both sides. The battle took place in the small Adriatic Sea town of Ortona (Abruzzo), with a peacetime population of 10,000.

Battle of Osijek.headline: Bitka za Osijek
paragraphs: Bitka za Osijek (srbohrvaško: Bitka za Osijek) je bila topniško obstreljevanje hrvaškega mesta Osijek, ki ga je Jugoslovanska ljudska armada (JLA) izvajala od avgusta 1991 do junija 1992 med hrvaško osamosvojitveno vojno. Obstreljevanje je bilo najhujše konec novembra in decembra 1991, leta 1992 pa je oslabelo, potem ko so sprte strani sprejele Vanceov načrt. Spremljali so ga letalski napadi ter napadi pehotnih in oklepnih enot JLA na cilje v mestu; umrlo je okoli 800 ljudi, velik del prebivalstva pa je mesto zapustil. Hrvaški viri so ocenili, da so v tem času na Osijek izstrelili 6000 topniških granat.

Ko je JLA 18. novembra 1991 zavzela Vukovar, je bil Osijek naslednji cilj njenega pohoda na Hrvaškem. Enote JLA, podrejene 12. (novosadskemu) korpusu, ki jih je podpirala Srbska prostovoljna garda, so konec novembra in v začetku decembra nekoliko napredovale in zavzele več vasi južno od Osijeka, vendar je hrvaška vojska obdržala obrambno črto in napredovanje JLA zamejila.

source.title: Battle of Osijek
paragraphs: The Battle of Osijek (Serbo-Croatian: Bitka za Osijek) was the artillery bombardment of the Croatian city of Osijek by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) which took place from August 1991 to June 1992 during the Croatian War of Independence. Shelling peaked in late November and December 1991, then diminished in 1992 after the Vance plan was accepted by the combatants. Airstrikes and attacks by JNA infantry and armored units against targets in the city accompanied the bombardment, which caused approximately 800 deaths and resulted in a large portion of the city's population leaving. Croatian sources estimated that 6,000 artillery shells were fired against Osijek over the period.

After the JNA captured Vukovar on 18 November 1991, Osijek was the next target for its campaign in Croatia. The JNA units subordinated to the 12th (Novi Sad) Corps, supported by the Serb Volunteer Guard, achieved modest advances in late November and early December, capturing several villages south of Osijek, but the Croatian Army maintained its defensive front and limited the JNA's advances.

Battle of Ostia.headline: Bitka pri Ostiji
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Ostiji je potekala leta 849 na Tirenskem morju med muslimanskim ladjevjem in italijansko zvezo papeških, neapeljskih, amalfijskih in gaetanskih ladij. Končala se je v korist italijanske zveze, ki je muslimane premagala. Bitka je eden redkih dogodkov v južni Italiji v 9. stoletju, ki jih še danes obeležujejo, predvsem z obzidjem, imenovanim po Leonu, in z renesančno Rafaelovo sliko Bitka pri Ostiji (Battaglia di Ostia).

source.title: Battle of Ostia
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Ostia took place in 849 in the Tyrrhenian Sea between a Muslim fleet and an Italian league of Papal, Neapolitan, Amalfitan, and Gaetan ships. The battle ended in favor of the Italian league, as they defeated the Muslims. It is one of the few events to occur in southern Italy during the ninth century that is still commemorated today, largely through the walls named after Leo and for the Renaissance painting Battaglia di Ostia by Raphael.

Bitka pri Ostrołęki 26. maja 1831 je bila eden največjih spopadov poljske novembrske vstaje. Poljske sile pod vodstvom Jana Skrzyneckega so se ves dan bojevale za nadzor nad mestom Ostrołęka proti napadajočim ruskim silam Hansa Karla von Diebitscha. Čeprav je bilo mesto ob koncu dneva še v poljskih rokah in sta obe strani utrpeli primerljive izgube, bitka navadno velja za poljski poraz, saj je ruska vojska lahko skoraj neomejeno strateško dopolnjevala svoje sile. Poljska vojska svojih izgub ni mogla podobno nadomestiti. Bitka jo je močno oslabila in bila je izčrpana, zato so Poljaki tisto noč zapustili Ostrołęko. Diebitsch je imel tedaj priložnost, da bi z enim odločilnim udarcem končal vstajo, a tega ni storil, ker so bile v bližini sveže poljske sile in ker ni imel podatkov o stanju Skrzyneckega vojske.

source.title: Battle of Ostrołęka (1831)
paragraphs: The Battle of Ostrołęka of 26 May 1831 was one of the largest engagements of Poland's November Uprising. Throughout the day, Polish forces under Jan Skrzynecki fought for the control over the town of Ostrołęka against the assaulting Russian forces of Hans Karl von Diebitsch. Although by the end of the day the town was still in Polish hands and the two sides suffered comparable losses, the battle is usually considered a Polish defeat because of the Russian army's almost unlimited strategic reinforcement capability. The Polish Army could not similarly replenish its casualties. It had been seriously depleted by the battle and was in a state of exhaustion, resulting in the Poles abandoning Ostrołęka that night. Diebitsch had the opportunity to end the uprising at that moment with one decisive blow, but due to fresh Polish forces nearby and lack of information on the state of Skrzynecki's army, he did not do so.

Battle of Oudenarde.headline: Bitka pri Oudenaardu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Oudenaardu (tudi Oudenarde) je bila velik spopad vojne za špansko nasledstvo, v katerem so se anglo-nizozemske sile z osemdeset tisoč možmi pod poveljstvom vojvode Marlborougha, lorda Overkirka in princa Evgena Savojskega spopadle s francoskimi silami s petinosemdeset tisoč možmi pod poveljstvom vojvode Burgundskega in vojvode de Vendôma; bitka se je končala s sijajno zmago velike aliance. Potekala je 11. julija 1708 blizu mesta Oudenaarde, tedaj dela Španske Nizozemske. S to zmago je velika aliansa zagotovila padec več francoskih ozemelj in si v tej fazi vojne pridobila pomembno strateško in taktično prednost. Bitka je potekala v poznejših letih vojne, ki je izbruhnila, ker so se Anglija, Nizozemska in Habsburžani bali, da bo pokojnega španskega kralja Karla II. nasledil Burbon in obe državi ter imperija združil v eno.

source.title: Battle of Oudenarde
paragraphs: The Battle of Oudenarde, also known as the Battle of Oudenaarde, was a major engagement of the War of the Spanish Succession, pitting an Anglo-Dutch force consisting of eighty thousand men under the command of the Duke of Marlborough, Lord Overkirk and Prince Eugene of Savoy against a French force of eighty-five thousand men under the command of the Duc de Bourgogne and the Duc de Vendôme, the battle resulting in a great victory for the Grand Alliance. The battle was fought near the city of Oudenaarde, at the time part of the Spanish Netherlands, on 11 July 1708. With this victory, the Grand Alliance ensured the fall of various French territories, giving them a significant strategic and tactical advantage during this stage of the war. The battle was fought in the later years of the war, a conflict that had come about as a result of English, Dutch and Habsburg apprehension at the possibility of a Bourbon succeeding the deceased King of Spain, Charles II, and combining their two nations and empires into one.

Battle of Ourique.headline: Bitka pri Ouriqueu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ouriqueu (portugalsko: Batalha de Ourique; arabsko: معركة أوريكه) je potekala 25. julija 1139, ko so portugalske sile pod Afonsom Henriquesom premagale sile, ki jih je vodil almoravidski vali (upravitelj) Córdobe Mohamed az Zubair ibn Umar, v krščanskih kronikah znan kot »kralj Ismar«.

Natančna lokacija bitke ostaja negotova in je bila predmet obsežnih razprav. Kljub temu je bitka kmalu dobila velik pomen in se povezala s tem, da je Afonso Henriques zahteval naslov »kralja«. Postala je njegova najslavnejša zmaga nad muslimanskimi silami.

Bitko že dolgo povezujejo s čudežem ali legendo o Ouriqueu, po kateri se je Afonsu Henriquesu noč pred bitko prikazal Križani in mu razodel portugalski grb. Po izročilu so grb sprejeli po bitki, pet ščitkov pa razlagajo kot pet premaganih muslimanskih »kraljev«, ki naj bi sodelovali v bitki.

source.title: Battle of Ourique
paragraphs: The Battle of Ourique (Portuguese: Batalha de Ourique; Arabic: معركة أوريكه) was fought on 25 July 1139, when Portuguese forces under Afonso Henriques defeated forces led by the Almoravid wāli (governor) of Córdoba, Muhammad Az-Zubayr Ibn Umar, who is identified as "King Ismar" in Christian chronicles.

The exact location of the battle remains uncertain and has been the subject of considerable debate. Nevertheless, the battle soon acquired major significance and became associated with Afonso Henriques's claim to the title of "king". It became his most celebrated victory over Muslim forces.

The battle has long been associated with the Miracle or legend of Ourique, according to which Christ Crucified appeared to Afonso Henriques on the night before the battle and revealed the coat of arms of Portugal. According to tradition, the arms were adopted after the battle, with the five escutcheons interpreted as representing the five vanquished Muslim "kings" said to have participated in the battle.

Battle of Palermo.headline: Bitka pri Palermu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Palermu je potekala 2. junija 1676 v francosko-nizozemski vojni med francoskimi silami, poslanimi v podporo uporu v Mesini proti španski oblasti na Siciliji, in španskimi silami, ki jih je podpirala nizozemska pomorska odprava.

source.title: Battle of Palermo
paragraphs: The Battle of Palermo took place on 2 June 1676 during the Franco-Dutch War, between a French force sent to support a revolt in the city of Messina against the Spanish rule in Sicily, and a Spanish force supported by a Dutch maritime expedition force.

Battle of Palestro.headline: Bitka pri Palestru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Palestru je potekala 30. in 31. maja 1859 med Avstrijskim cesarstvom in združenimi silami Kraljevine Sardinija-Piemonta ter Francije. Zmagale so francosko-piemontske sile. Bojevali so se tik južno od Palestra, mesta v današnji pokrajini Pavia v severni Italiji. Menili so, da je bila bitka pri Palestru zadnja evropska bitka, v katero je evropski vladar jezdil osebno: kralj Viktor Emanuel II. se je neposredno vključil v boj z Avstrijci.

source.title: Battle of Palestro
paragraphs: The Battle of Palestro was fought on 30–31 May 1859 between the Austrian Empire and the combined forces of the Kingdom of Sardinia-Piedmont and France. The Franco-Piedmontese forces were victorious. It was fought just south to Palestro, a town in what is now the province of Pavia in northern Italy. It was believed that the Battle of Palestro was the last European battle in which a European Monarch rode into battle, that being King Victor Emmanuel II, who directly entered the fray with the Austrians.

Bitka za Pancorbo je potekala leta 816 med mavrsko vojsko Kordobskega emirata, ki jo je poslal al Hakam I. in ji je poveljeval Abd al Karim ibn Abd al Vahid ibn Mugit, ter profrankovskimi silami pod poveljstvom Balaska al Jalaskija. Bitka se je odvila, ko so kordobske sile skušale prečkati prelaz pri Pancorbu.
Bitka se je končala s kordobsko zmago in je odločilno vplivala na baskovski upor ter na uveljavitev Íñiga Ariste iz Pamplone kot pomembnega igralca na tedanjem iberskem političnem prizorišču.

source.title: Battle of Pancorbo (816)
paragraphs: The Battle of Pancorbo took place in 816 between a Moorish army from the Emirate of Cordoba sent by Al-Hakam I and under the control of Abd al-Karim ibn Abd al-Wahid ibn Mugit and pro-Frankish forces under the control of Balask al-Yalasqi. The battle was fought when the Córdoban forces attempted to cross the pass at Pancorbo.
The battle resulted in a Córdoban victory and was instrumental in the Basque revolt and the establishment of Íñigo Arista of Pamplona as a major player in the contemporary Iberian political scene.

Battle of Panormus.headline: Bitka pri Panormu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Panormu je potekala na Siciliji leta 250 pr. n. št. v prvi punski vojni med rimsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Lucija Cecilija Metela in kartažanskimi silami pod poveljstvom Hasdrubala, Hanonovega sina. Rimske sile, dve rimski in dve zavezniški legiji, ki so branile mesto Panorm, so premagale veliko močnejšo kartažansko vojsko s 30.000 možmi in od 60 do 142 bojnimi slonovi.

Vojna se je začela leta 264 pr. n. št., ko je Kartagina nadzorovala velik del Sicilije, kjer je potekala večina bojev. Leta 256–255 pr. n. št. so Rimljani skušali udariti po mestu Kartagina v Severni Afriki, a jih je kartažanska vojska, močna v konjenici in slonih, hudo porazila. Ko se je težišče vojne vrnilo na Sicilijo, so Rimljani leta 254 pr. n. št. zavzeli veliko in pomembno mesto Panorm. Nato so se zaradi strahu pred bojnimi slonovi, ki so jih Kartažani pripeljali na Sicilijo, izogibali bitki. Ob koncu poletja 250 pr. n. št. je Hasdrubal popeljal vojsko, da bi opustošil pridelke v mestih rimskih zaveznikov. Rimljani so se umaknili v Panorm, Hasdrubal pa je prodrl do mestnega obzidja.

source.title: Battle of Panormus
paragraphs: The Battle of Panormus was fought in Sicily in 250 BC during the First Punic War between a Roman army led by Lucius Caecilius Metellus and a Carthaginian force led by Hasdrubal, son of Hanno. The Roman force of two Roman and two allied legions defending the city of Panormus defeated the much larger Carthaginian army of 30,000 men and between 60 and 142 war elephants.

The war had commenced in 264 BC with Carthage in control of much of Sicily, where most of the fighting took place. In 256–255 BC the Romans attempted to strike at the city of Carthage in North Africa, but suffered a heavy defeat by a Carthaginian army strong in cavalry and elephants. When the focus of the war returned to Sicily, the Romans captured the large and important city of Panormus in 254 BC. Thereafter they avoided battle for fear of the war elephants which the Carthaginians had shipped to Sicily. In late summer 250 BC Hasdrubal led out his army to devastate the crops of the cities of Rome's allies. The Romans withdrew to Panormus and Hasdrubal pressed on to the city walls.

Bitka pri Parizu ali naskok na Pariz (30.–31. marca 1814) je bila spopad, v katerem so zavezniške sile Rusije, Avstrije, Prusije in Württemberga napadle Pariz, ki so ga branile čete prvega francoskega cesarstva pod vodstvom Jožefa Bonaparta. Francoski vojaki so se 30. marca v vzhodnih predmestjih prestolnice trdno upirali, a so jih močno številčnejše zavezniške sile vztrajno potiskale nazaj. Maršala Auguste de Marmont in Édouard Mortier sta se v brezupnem položaju pozno popoldne z zavezniki dogovorila za premirje. Francozi so Pariz 31. marca izpraznili po določilih dogovora z zavezniškimi voditelji, ruskim carjem Aleksandrom I., pruskim kraljem Friderikom Viljemom III. in avstrijskim feldmaršalom Karlom Philippom, knezom Schwarzenbergom. Poraz je pomenil konec vojne šeste koalicije in je kmalu prisilil cesarja Napoleona, da je odstopil in odšel v izgnanstvo.

source.title: Battle of Paris (1814)
paragraphs: The Battle of Paris or the Storming of Paris (30–31 March 1814) saw the Allied forces of Russia, Austria, Prussia, and Württemberg attack Paris defended by troops of the First French Empire under Joseph Bonaparte. The French soldiers put up a stout resistance at the capital's eastern suburbs on 30 March but were steadily driven back by the overwhelmingly superior Allied forces. Faced with a hopeless situation, Marshals Auguste de Marmont and Édouard Mortier agreed to a ceasefire with the Allies in the late afternoon. The French evacuated Paris on 31 March according to the terms of the convention reached with the Allied leaders Tsar Alexander I of Russia, King Frederick William III of Prussia, and Austrian Field Marshal Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg. This defeat marked the end of the War of the Sixth Coalition and soon forced Emperor Napoleon to abdicate and go into exile.

Battle of Párkány.headline: Bitka pri Párkányu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Párkányu (turško: Ciğerdelen Savaşı) je potekala od 7. do 9. oktobra 1683 v mestu Párkány (danes Štúrovo) v Osmanskem cesarstvu in njegovi okolici v okviru poljsko-osmanske vojne in velike turške vojne. Potekala je v dveh fazah. V prvi je osmanska vojska pod vodstvom Kara Mehmed paše 7. oktobra 1683 premagala poljske čete pod vodstvom Jana III. Sobieskega. V drugi je Sobieski ob podpori avstrijskih sil pod vodstvom lorenskega vojvode Karla V. premagal osmanske sile, ki so jih podpirale čete Imreja Thökölyja, in 9. oktobra 1683 zavzel Párkány. Po osmanskem porazu so Avstrijci oblegali Ostrogon (Esztergom) in ga konec leta 1683 zavzeli.

source.title: Battle of Párkány
paragraphs: The Battle of Párkány (Turkish: Ciğerdelen Savaşı) was fought between October 7–9, 1683 in the town of Párkány (today: Štúrovo), in the Ottoman Empire, and the area surrounding it as part of the Polish-Ottoman War and the Great Turkish War. The battle was fought in two stages. In the first stage Polish troops under John III Sobieski were defeated by the Ottoman army under Kara Mehmed Pasha on October 7, 1683. In the second stage Sobieski, supported by Austrian forces under Charles V, Duke of Lorraine, defeated the Ottoman forces, which were supported by the troops of Imre Thököly, and gained control of Párkány on October 9, 1683. After the Ottoman defeat, the Austrians would besiege Esztergom and captured it at the end of 1683.

Tretja bitka za Ypres (nemško: Dritte Flandernschlacht; francosko: Troisième Bataille des Flandres; nizozemsko: Derde Slag om Ieper), znana tudi kot bitka pri Passchendaelu, je bila vojaški pohod prve svetovne vojne, ki so ga zavezniki vodili proti Nemškemu cesarstvu. Potekala je na zahodni fronti od julija do novembra 1917 za nadzor nad grebeni južno in vzhodno od belgijskega mesta Ypres v Zahodni Flandriji, v okviru strategije, o kateri se je antanta dogovorila na konferencah novembra 1916 in maja 1917. Passchendaele (danes Passendale) leži na zadnjem grebenu vzhodno od Ypresa, 8 km od Roulersa (danes Roeselare), križišča železniške proge Bruges (Brugge)–Kortrijk. Postaja v Roulersu je ležala na glavni oskrbovalni poti nemške 4. armade. Ko bi zavzeli greben Passchendaele, naj bi zavezniki napredovali do črte od Thouruta (danes Torhout) do Couckelaereja (Koekelare).
notes: The English pronunciation and the mile figure are dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Passchendaele
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Ypres (German: Dritte Flandernschlacht; French: Troisième Bataille des Flandres; Dutch: Derde Slag om Ieper), also known as the Battle of Passchendaele ( PASH-ən-dayl), was a campaign of the First World War, fought by the Allies against the German Empire. The battle took place on the Western Front, from July to November 1917, for control of the ridges south and east of the Belgian city of Ypres in West Flanders, as part of a strategy decided by the Entente at conferences in November 1916 and May 1917. Passchendaele (now Passendale) lies on the last ridge east of Ypres, 5 mi (8 km) from Roulers (now Roeselare), a junction of the Bruges-(Brugge)-to-Kortrijk railway. The station at Roulers was on the main supply route of the German 4th Army. Once Passchendaele Ridge had been captured, the Allied advance was to continue to a line from Thourout (now Torhout) to Couckelaere (Koekelare).

Bitka pri Patayu, ki je potekala 18. junija 1429 med stoletno vojno, je bila vrhunec pohoda ob Loari med Francozi in Angleži v severni osrednji Franciji. V njej so konjeniki francoske predhodnice angleški vojski prizadejali hude izgube, večinoma lokostrelcem z dolgimi loki, saj je angleška konjenica pobegnila. Ujeli so tudi vse visoke angleške poveljnike razen enega. Zmago pogosto pripisujejo Ivani Orleanski, a ta pri bitki dejansko ni bila navzoča, saj je ostala pri glavnini francoske vojske. Predhodnico pri Patayu sta vodila La Hire in Jean Poton de Xaintrailles.

Bitka je bila za angleške težnje v Franciji katastrofalen udarec. Francozom je utrdila preobrat sreče, ki se je začel pri Orléansu, in sklenila zelo uspešen pohod. Temu je sledil pohod v Reims, kjer so dauphina Karla kronali za francoskega kralja. Stoletna vojna pa se je nadaljevala do leta 1453.

source.title: Battle of Patay
paragraphs: The Battle of Patay, fought on 18 June 1429 during the Hundred Years' War, was the culmination of the Loire Campaign between the French and English in north-central France. In this engagement, the horsemen of the French vanguard inflicted heavy casualties on an English army, most of them sustained by longbowmen as the English cavalry fled. In addition, all but one of the senior English commanders were captured. A victory often credited to Joan of Arc, she was in fact not present for the battle as she had remained with the main body of the French army. The vanguard at Patay was led by La Hire and Jean Poton de Xaintrailles.

The battle was a disastrous blow to English aspirations in France. For the French, it cemented the turn of fortune which had begun at Orléans and concluded a highly successful campaign. The latter was followed by a march to Reims which saw the Dauphin Charles crowned King of France. The Hundred Years' War, however, would continue until 1453.

Bitka pri Pavii, ki je potekala zjutraj 24. februarja 1525, je bila odločilni spopad italijanske vojne 1521–1526 med Kraljevino Francijo in habsburškim cesarstvom Karla V., svetorimskega cesarja ter vladarja Španije, Avstrije, Nizozemske in dveh Sicilij.

source.title: Battle of Pavia
paragraphs: The Battle of Pavia, fought on the morning of 24 February 1525, was the decisive engagement of the Italian War of 1521–1526 between the Kingdom of France and the Habsburg Empire of Charles V, Holy Roman Emperor as well as ruler of Spain, Austria, the Low Countries, and the Two Sicilies.

Battle of Pelagonia.headline: Bitka pri Pelagoniji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pelagoniji ali bitka pri Kastoriji je potekala zgodaj poleti ali jeseni leta 1259 med Nikejskim cesarstvom in protinikejskim zavezništvom Epirskega despotata, Kraljevine Sicilije in Ahajske kneževine. Bila je odločilen dogodek v zgodovini vzhodnega Sredozemlja, saj je zagotovila poznejše ponovno zavzetje Carigrada in konec Latinskega cesarstva leta 1261.

source.title: Battle of Pelagonia
paragraphs: The Battle of Pelagonia or Battle of Kastoria took place in early summer or autumn 1259, between the Empire of Nicaea and an anti-Nicaean alliance comprising Despotate of Epirus, Kingdom of Sicily and the Principality of Achaea. It was a decisive event in the history of the Eastern Mediterranean, ensuring the eventual reconquest of Constantinople and the end of the Latin Empire in 1261.

Battle of Peta.headline: Bitka pri Peti
paragraphs: Bitka pri Peti ali Petti je potekala 16. julija 1822 (4. julija po julijanskem koledarju) med Grki (s filheleni) pod vodstvom Aleksandrosa Mavrokordatosa in Markosa Bocarisa ter Osmani pod vodstvom Omerja Vrionija. Spopad je bil na pobočju blizu vasi Peta v Epiru.

source.title: Battle of Peta
