paragraphs: The Battle of Peta or Battle of Petta was fought between the Greeks (with Philhellenes) led by Alexandros Mavrokordatos with Markos Botsaris and the Ottomans led by Omer Vrioni on 16 July 1822 (4 July Julian calendar). The conflict occurred on a hillside near the village of Peta in Epirus.

Battle of Petsamo.headline: Bitka pri Petsamu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Petsamu je potekala med finskimi in sovjetskimi četami na območju Petsama na skrajnem severu Finske v letih 1939 in 1940. Finske čete so bile v veliki številčni podrejenosti, a jim je zaradi skrajnega terena, vremena in dobrega vodstva uspelo zadržati sovjetske čete.

source.title: Battle of Petsamo
paragraphs: The Battle of Petsamo was fought between Finnish and Soviet troops in the area of Petsamo in the far north of Finland in 1939 and 1940. The Finnish troops were greatly outnumbered but managed to contain the Soviet troops due to the extreme terrain, weather and leadership.

Battle of Pfaffenhofen.headline: Bitka pri Pfaffenhofnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pfaffenhofnu je potekala 15. aprila 1745 med Francijo in Avstrijo. Avstrijci pod vodstvom Karla Josefa Batthyányja so premagali številčno šibkejše Francoze pod vodstvom generala Ségurja in s tem končali vojno na Bavarskem.

source.title: Battle of Pfaffenhofen
paragraphs: The Battle of Pfaffenhofen was fought on 15 April 1745 between France and Austria. The Austrians under Karl Josef Batthyány defeated the outnumbered French under General Ségur, ending the war in Bavaria.

Battle of Piacenza.headline: Bitka pri Piacenzi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Piacenzi ali bitka pri San Lazzaru (16. junija 1746) je potekala med avstrijsko in burbonsko vojsko blizu Piacenze v severni Italiji v avstrijski nasledstveni vojni. Burbonsko vojsko so sestavljale velike španske sile pod poveljstvom Jeana Bonaventure du Monta, grofa de Gages, in nekoliko manjši francoski korpus pod vodstvom Jean-Baptista Francoisa des Maretsa, markiza de Maillebois. Pod Gagesovim poveljstvom so bili tudi zavezniški neapeljski in genovski vojaki. Avstrijski vojski je poveljeval Josef Wenzel, knez Liechtensteina. Burbonski generali so se odločili za napad, ker je bila Avstrijcem na poti okrepitev s sardinskim korpusom. Avstrijski generali so francosko-španski napad predvideli in ta se je končal s hudimi izgubami. Zaradi poraza se je burbonska vojska umaknila v Genovo, vendar se je morala v naknadni bitki pri Rottofreddu prebiti ven. Med znanimi francoskimi vojaki je bil tudi Louis-Joseph de Montcalm.

source.title: Battle of Piacenza
paragraphs: The Battle of Piacenza or Battle of St. Lazaro (16 June 1746) was fought between an Austrian army and a Bourbon army near Piacenza, in Northern Italy during the War of the Austrian Succession. The Bourbon army consisted of a large Spanish force commanded by Jean Bonaventure du Mont, comte de Gages and a somewhat smaller French corps led by Jean-Baptiste Francois des Marets, marquis de Maillebois. Gages' command included allied Neapolitan and Genoese soldiers. The Austrian army was commanded by Josef Wenzel, Prince of Liechtenstein. The Bourbon generals determined to attack because the Austrians were about to be reinforced by a Sardinian corps. The Franco-Spanish assault was anticipated by the Austrian generals and it failed with heavy losses. The defeat caused the Bourbon army to retreat to Genoa, though it had to fight its way out at the subsequent Battle of Rottofreddo. Louis-Joseph de Montcalm was among the notable French combatants.

Battle of Piave River (1809).headline: Bitka ob reki Piave leta 1809
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki Piave je potekala 8. maja 1809 med francosko-italijansko vojsko pod poveljstvom Eugèna de Beauharnaisa in avstrijsko vojsko nadvojvode Janeza Avstrijskega. Avstrijski poveljnik se je ustavil za reko Piave, a ga je številčno močnejši sovražnik premagal. Boj je potekal blizu kraja Nervesa della Battaglia v Italiji v vojni pete koalicije, delu napoleonskih vojn.

Začetni avstrijski vdor v Benečijo je francosko-italijanske branilce potisnil nazaj do Verone. V začetku maja je nadvojvoda Janez, ker je izvedel za avstrijske poraze na Bavarskem in ker je bil številčno šibkejši, začel umik proti severovzhodu. Ko je izvedel, da sovražnik prečka Piavo, se je avstrijski poveljnik obrnil in sprejel boj, da bi upočasnil Eugènovo zasledovanje svoje vojske.

source.title: Battle of Piave River (1809)
paragraphs: The Battle of Piave River was fought on 8 May 1809 between the Franco-Italian army under the command of Eugène de Beauharnais and an Austrian army led by Archduke John of Austria. The Austrian commander made a stand behind the Piave River but he suffered a defeat at the hands of his numerically superior foes. The combat took place near Nervesa della Battaglia, Italy during the War of the Fifth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

The initial Austrian invasion of Venetia succeeded in driving the Franco-Italian defenders back to Verona. At the beginning of May, news of Austrian defeats in Bavaria and inferiority in numbers caused Archduke John to begin retreating to the northeast. When he heard that his enemies were crossing the Piave, the Austrian commander turned back to give battle, intending to slow Eugène's pursuit of his army.

Battle of Pinkie.headline: Bitka pri Pinkieju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pinkieju, znana tudi kot bitka pri Pinkie Cleughu, je potekala 10. septembra 1547 na bregovih reke Esk blizu Musselburgha na Škotskem. Bila je zadnja redna bitka med Škotsko in Anglijo pred personalno unijo kron in del spopada, znanega kot surovo snubljenje (Rough Wooing). Za Škotsko je bila katastrofalen poraz, ki so ga tam poimenovali »črna sobota«. Zelo podroben in ilustriran angleški opis bitke in pohoda, ki ga je napisal očividec William Patten, so štiri mesece po bitki kot propagando objavili v Londonu.

source.title: Battle of Pinkie
paragraphs: The Battle of Pinkie, also known as the Battle of Pinkie Cleugh, took place on 10 September 1547 on the banks of the River Esk near Musselburgh, Scotland. The last pitched battle between Scotland and England before the Union of the Crowns, it was part of the conflict known as the Rough Wooing. It was a catastrophic defeat for Scotland, where it became known as "Black Saturday". A highly detailed and illustrated English account of the battle and campaign authored by eyewitness William Patten was published in London as propaganda four months after the battle.

Battle of Pirot.headline: Bitka pri Pirotu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pirotu (bolgarsko: Битка при Пирот; srbsko: Битка код Пирота) je potekala 26. in 27. novembra 1885 med srbsko-bolgarsko vojno blizu mesta Pirot v Srbiji. Bolgarski Zahodni korpus se je v njej spopadel s srbsko Nišavsko armado. Končala se je z bolgarsko zmago in podpisom premirja. Bitka je pripeljala do miru v Bukarešti, ki je končal srbsko-bolgarsko vojno in med državama obnovil mir.
notes: The footnote marker [a] in the English is left out.

source.title: Battle of Pirot
paragraphs: The Battle of Pirot (Bulgarian: Битка при Пирот Serbian: Битка код Пирота) took place between 26 and 27 November 1885[a], during the Serbo-Bulgarian War, near the town of Pirot, Serbia. The battle opposed the Bulgaria Western Corps to the Serbian Nišava Army. It ended with a Bulgarian victory and the signing of an armistice. The battle led to the treaty of Bucharest ending the Serbo-Bulgarian War, restoring peace between the two countries.

Battle of Pločnik.headline: Bitka pri Pločniku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pločniku je potekala nekje med letoma 1385 in 1387 blizu vasi Pločnik (pri Prokuplju na jugovzhodu današnje Srbije) med silami srbskega kneza Lazarja Hrebeljanovića in osmansko vojsko sultana Murata I., ki je vdrla v državo.

source.title: Battle of Pločnik
paragraphs: The Battle of Pločnik was fought sometime between 1385 and 1387 near the village of Pločnik (near Prokuplje in today's southeastern Serbia), between the forces of Serbian Prince Lazar Hrebeljanović, and the invading Ottoman Army of Sultan Murad I.

Battle of Płowce.headline: Bitka pri Płowcah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Płowcah je potekala 27. septembra 1331 med Kraljevino Poljsko in Tevtonskim redom.

source.title: Battle of Płowce
paragraphs: The Battle of Płowce took place on 27 September 1331 between the Kingdom of Poland and the Teutonic Order.

Battle of Pollentia.headline: Bitka pri Pollentii
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pollentii je potekala 6. aprila 402 med Rimljani pod vodstvom Stilihona in Vizigoti pod vodstvom Alarika I. med prvim gotskim vdorom v Italijo (401–403). Rimljani so zmagali in Alarika prisilili k umiku, vendar se je naslednje leto zbral za nov boj v bitki pri Veroni, kjer so ga spet premagali. Nato se je Alarik umaknil iz Italije in pokrajino pustil v miru do svojega drugega vdora leta 409, po Stilihonovi smrti.

source.title: Battle of Pollentia
paragraphs: The Battle of Pollentia was fought on 6 April 402 between the Romans under Stilicho and the Visigoths under Alaric I, during the first Gothic invasion of Italy (401–403). The Romans were victorious, and forced Alaric to retreat, though he rallied to fight again in the next year in the Battle of Verona, where he was again defeated. After this, Alaric retreated from Italy, leaving the province in peace until his second invasion in 409, after Stilicho's death.
Bitka za Popasno se je med ukrajinskimi in ruskimi silami začela sredi aprila 2022 v Popasni. Mesto je 7. maja prišlo pod ruski nadzor.

source.title: Battle of Popasna
paragraphs: In mid-April 2022, a military engagement began in Popasna between Ukrainian and Russian forces. On 7 May, the city came under Russian control.

Battle of Portland.headline: Bitka pri Portlandu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Portlandu ali tridnevna bitka je potekala od 18. do 20. februarja 1653 (od 28. februarja do 2. marca 1653 po gregorijanskem koledarju) v prvi angleško-nizozemski vojni, ko je ladjevje Nizozemske republike pod poročnikom admiralom Maartenom Trompom, ki je spremljalo trgovske ladje skozi Rokavski preliv, napadlo ladjevje Angleške republike pod poveljstvom generala na morju Roberta Blaka.

Bitka ni odločila o prevladi v Rokavskem prelivu, čeprav sta obe strani razglasili zmago; o dokončnem nadzoru nad prelivom je odločila šele bitka pri Gabbardu, po kateri so Angleži lahko blokirali nizozemsko obalo vse do bitke pri Scheveningenu, v kateri je admiral Maarten Tromp padel v spopadu.

source.title: Battle of Portland
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Portland, or Three Days' Battle, took place during 18–20 February 1653 (28 February – 2 March 1653 (Gregorian calendar)), during the First Anglo-Dutch War, when the fleet of the Commonwealth of England under General at Sea Robert Blake was attacked by a fleet of the Dutch Republic under Lieutenant-Admiral Maarten Tromp escorting merchant shipping through the English Channel.

The battle failed to settle supremacy of the English Channel, although both sides claimed victory, and ultimate control over the Channel would only be decided at the Battle of the Gabbard which allowed the English to blockade the Dutch coast until the Battle of Scheveningen, where Admiral Maarten Tromp was killed in a firefight.
Bitka pri Potideji je potekala leta 432 pr. n. št. med Atenami ter združeno vojsko Korinta in Potideje z njunimi zavezniki. Skupaj z bitko pri Sibotih je bila eden od povodov za peloponeško vojno.

source.title: Battle of Potidaea
paragraphs: The Battle of Potidaea was fought in 432 BC between Athens and a combined army from Corinth and Potidaea, along with their various allies. Along with the Battle of Sybota, it was one of the catalysts for the Peloponnesian War.

Battle of Praga.headline: Bitka za varšavsko Prago
paragraphs: Bitka za Prago ali druga bitka za Varšavo leta 1794, v ruščini in nemščini znana tudi kot naskok na Prago (rusko: Штурм Праги), v poljščini pa kot obramba Prage (poljsko: Obrona Pragi), je bila uspešen ruski napad na Prago, najvzhodnejši del Varšave, med Kościuszkovo vstajo leta 1794. Sledil mu je pokol civilnega prebivalstva Prage (znan kot praški pokol).

Praga je bila predmestje (»faubourg«) Varšave na desnem bregu Visle. Leta 1794 je bila dobro utrjena, bolje kot zahodni del prestolnice na levem bregu Visle. Zgodovinar in profesor Friedrich Christoph Schlosser je Prago označil za »ključ do Varšave«. Bitka za Prago je pomenila zlom moralne in materialne moči uporniške Poljske.
notes: Praga here is the Warsaw district, which Slovenian names the same as Prague; the headline says varšavska Praga to tell them apart.

source.title: Battle of Praga
paragraphs: The Battle of Praga or the Second Battle of Warsaw of 1794, also known in Russian and German as the Storming of Praga (Russian: Штурм Праги) and in Polish as the Defence of Praga (Polish: Obrona Pragi), was a successful Russian assault on Praga, the easternmost community of Warsaw, during the Kościuszko Uprising in 1794. It was followed by a massacre (known as the Massacre of Praga) of the civilian population of Praga.

Praga was a suburb ("Faubourg") of Warsaw, lying on the right bank of the Vistula river. In 1794 it was well fortified and was better strengthened than the western part of the capital, located on the left bank of the Vistula. Historian and professor Friedrich Christoph Schlosser labelled Praga as "the key to Warsaw". The Praga battle marked the collapse of moral and material strength of insurgent Poland.

Battle of Prague (1648).headline: Bitka za Prago (1648)
paragraphs: Bitka za Prago, ki je potekala med 25. julijem in 1. novembrom 1648, je bila zadnji spopad tridesetletne vojne. Medtem ko so potekala pogajanja za vestfalski mir, je Švedska izkoristila priložnost za še zadnji pohod na Češko. Glavni rezultat in verjetno tudi glavni cilj pohoda je bil plen: oplenili so čudovito umetniško zbirko, ki jo je na Praškem gradu zbral cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Rudolf II. (1552–1612); najboljše kose so z barkami odpeljali po Labi in jih poslali na Švedsko.

Švedi so več mesecev držali grad in zahodni breg Vltave, ko pa je prispela novica o podpisu pogodbe, so ustavili napade na Staro in Novo mesto na vzhodnem bregu. Na zahodni strani so kljub temu obdržali posadko do dokončnega umika 30. septembra 1649.
To je bil zadnji večji spopad tridesetletne vojne, ki je potekal v Pragi, kjer se je vojna 30 let prej začela s tretjo praško defenestracijo.

source.title: Battle of Prague (1648)
paragraphs: The Battle of Prague, which occurred between 25 July and 1 November 1648 was the last action of the Thirty Years' War. While the negotiations for the Peace of Westphalia were proceeding, Sweden took the opportunity to mount one last campaign into Bohemia. The main result, and probably the main aim, was to loot the fabulous art collection assembled in Prague Castle by Rudolf II, Holy Roman Emperor (1552–1612), the pick of which was taken down the Elbe in barges and shipped to Sweden.

After holding the castle and the western bank of the Vltava for several months, the Swedes halted their attacks on the Old and New Town on the eastern bank once word arrived that the treaty had been signed. They nevertheless maintained a garrison on the western side until their final withdrawal on 30 September 1649.
It was the last major clash of the Thirty Years' War, taking place in the city of Prague, where the war originally began 30 years earlier with the Third Defenestration of Prague.

Battle of Preston (1648).headline: Bitka pri Prestonu (1648)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Prestonu je potekala 17. avgusta 1648 v drugi angleški državljanski vojni. Parlamentarna vojska pod poveljstvom generalporočnika Oliverja Cromwella je blizu mesta Preston v Lancashiru napadla precej večjo rojalistično vojsko pod Jamesom Hamiltonom, vojvodo Hamiltonom; rojalisti so bili poraženi s hudimi izgubami.

source.title: Battle of Preston (1648)
paragraphs: The battle of Preston was fought on 17 August 1648 during the Second English Civil War. A Parliamentarian army commanded by Lieutenant General Oliver Cromwell attacked a considerably larger force of Royalists under James Hamilton, Duke of Hamilton, near the Lancashire town of Preston; the Royalists were defeated with heavy losses.

Battle of Prestonpans.headline: Bitka pri Prestonpansu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Prestonpansu 21. septembra 1745 je potekala blizu Prestonpansa v East Lothianu. Bila je prvi pomembnejši spopad jakobitskega upora leta 1745.

Jakobitske sile pod vodstvom izgnanega Charlesa Edwarda Stuarta in Georgea Murraya so premagale britansko vladno vojsko pod sirom Johnom Copom, katere neizkušene enote so se pred napadom višavcev razbežale. Bitka je trajala manj kot trideset minut, močno je dvignila moralo jakobitov in upor uveljavila kot resno grožnjo.

source.title: Battle of Prestonpans
paragraphs: The Battle of Prestonpans, 21 September 1745, took place near Prestonpans, in East Lothian. It was the first significant engagement of the Jacobite rising of 1745.

Jacobite forces, led by the exiled Charles Edward Stuart and George Murray, defeated a British government army under Sir John Cope, whose inexperienced troops broke in the face of a Highland charge. The battle lasted less than thirty minutes, was a huge boost to Jacobite morale, and established the revolt as a serious threat.

Battle of Preveza.headline: Bitka pri Prevezi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Prevezi (tudi Prevesa) je bila pomorska bitka 28. septembra 1538 blizu Preveze v Jonskem morju na severozahodu Grčije, na istem območju kot bitka pri Akciju leta 31 pr. n. št. Spopadla sta se osmansko ladjevje pod vodstvom kapudan paše Hajredina Barbarose in Sveta liga iz beneških in špansko-cesarskih sil pod vodstvom genovskega admirala Andrea Dorie. Bitka je bila del osmansko-habsburških vojn in osmansko-beneške vojne 1537–1547. Končala se je s porazom Svete lige, čeprav je ta imela ogromno prednost v številu ladij in tonaži.

source.title: Battle of Preveza
paragraphs: The Battle of Preveza (also known as Prevesa) was a naval engagement that occurred on 28 September 1538 near Preveza in the Ionian Sea in northwest Greece, in the same area as the Battle of Actium in 31 BC. The battle was between an Ottoman fleet, led by Kapudan Pasha Hayreddin Barbarossa, and a Holy League of Venetian and Hispano-Imperial composition, led by Genoese admiral Andrea Doria. It was part of both the Ottoman–Habsburg wars and the Ottoman Venetian War of 1537-1547. It ended with the Holy League defeated by the Ottomans despite its enormous advantage in numbers and tonnage.

Battle of Prilep.headline: Bitka pri Prilepu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Prilepu v prvi balkanski vojni je potekala od 3. do 5. novembra 1912, ko je srbska vojska naletela na osmanske čete blizu mesta Prilep v današnji Severni Makedoniji. Spopad je trajal tri dni. Osmanska vojska je bila nazadnje strta in se je morala umakniti.

Slabo vreme in težavne poti so 1. armadi otežili zasledovanje Osmanov po bitki pri Kumanovem, zato je moravska divizija napredovala pred drinsko. Predhodnica moravske divizije je 3. novembra v jesenskem dežju naletela na ogenj 5. korpusa Kara Said-paše s položajev severno od Prilepa. Tako se je začela tridnevna bitka za Prilep, ki so jo tisto noč prekinili in naslednje jutro nadaljevali. Ko je na bojišče prispela drinska divizija, so Srbi dobili veliko premoč in Osmane prisilili k umiku južno od mesta.

source.title: Battle of Prilep
paragraphs: The Battle of Prilep in the First Balkan War took place on 3-5 November 1912 when the Serbian army encountered Ottoman troops near the town of Prilep, in today's North Macedonia. The clash lasted for three days. Eventually the Ottoman army was overwhelmed and forced to retreat.

Bad weather and difficult roads hampered the 1st Army’s pursuit of the Ottomans after the battle of Kumanovo, forcing the Morava Division to move ahead of the Drina Division. On 3 November, in the autumn rain, forward elements of the Morava Division encountered fire from Kara Said Pasha’s 5th Corps from positions north of Prilep. This started the three-day battle for Prilep, which was broken off that night and was renewed the next morning. When the Drina Division arrived on the battlefield, the Serbs gained an overwhelming advantage, forcing the Ottomans to withdraw south of the city.

Battle of Prokhorovka.headline: Bitka pri Prohorovki
paragraphs: Bitka pri Prohorovki je potekala 12. julija 1943 blizu Prohorovke, 87 kilometrov jugovzhodno od Kurska v Sovjetski zvezi, med drugo svetovno vojno. Spopad na vzhodni fronti je bil del širše bitke pri Kursku: 5. gardna tankovska armada sovjetske Rdeče armade je napadla II. tankovski korpus SS nemških Waffen-SS v eni največjih tankovskih bitk v zgodovini.
notes: The mile conversion is left out.

source.title: Battle of Prokhorovka
paragraphs: The Battle of Prokhorovka was fought on 12 July 1943 near Prokhorovka, 87 kilometres (54 mi) southeast of Kursk, in the Soviet Union, during the Second World War. Taking place on the Eastern Front, the engagement was part of the wider Battle of Kursk and occurred when the 5th Guards Tank Army of the Soviet Red Army attacked the II SS-Panzer Corps of the German Waffen-SS in one of the largest tank battles in history.

Battle of Pułtusk (1703).headline: Bitka pri Pułtusku (1703)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pułtusku je potekala 1. maja 1703 (po novem koledarju) v Pułtusku med veliko severno vojno. Švedska vojska pod poveljstvom Karla XII. je premagala saško vojsko pod vodstvom Adama Heinricha von Steinaua.
Karel je nato decembra zavzel Toruń (Thorn).

source.title: Battle of Pułtusk (1703)
paragraphs: The Battle of Pułtusk took place on 1 May 1703 (N.S.) in Pułtusk during the Great Northern War. The Swedish army under the command of Charles XII defeated the Saxon army under Adam Heinrich von Steinau.
Charles later went on to take Toruń (Thorn) in December.

Bitka za Pułtusk (ali Pultusk) je potekala 26. decembra 1806 med vojno četrte koalicije blizu Pultuska v Prusiji (danes Pułtusk na Poljskem). Rusi pod vodstvom konjeniškega generala Levina von Bennigsena so kljub veliki številčni premoči in topništvu prestali hude francoske napade maršala Jeana Lannesa, nato pa so se naslednji dan umaknili; tako kot Francozi so utrpeli velike izgube, kar je njihovo vojsko do konca leta spravilo v nered.

source.title: Battle of Pułtusk (1806)
paragraphs: The Battle of Pułtusk (or Pultusk) took place on 26 December 1806 during the War of the Fourth Coalition near Pultusk, Prussia (today Pułtusk, Poland). Despite their strong numerical superiority and artillery, the Russians under the lead of General of Cavalry Levin von Benningsen underwent heavy French attacks by Marshal Jean Lannes, before retiring the next day having suffered great losses like the French, disorganizing their army for the rest of the year.

Battle of Pydna.headline: Bitka pri Pidni
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pidni je potekala leta 168 pr. n. št. med Rimom in Makedonijo v tretji makedonski vojni. Z njo se je vpliv Rima v helenističnem svetu še povečal, končala pa se je tudi vladarska rodbina Antigonidov, katere moč je izhajala iz Aleksandrovega diadoha Antigona Monoftalma. Bitka velja tudi za zmago prožnega manipularnega sistema rimske legije nad togo antigonidsko makedonsko falango.

source.title: Battle of Pydna
paragraphs: The Battle of Pydna took place in 168 BC between Rome and Macedon during the Third Macedonian War. The battle saw the further ascendancy of Rome in the Hellenistic world and the end of the Antigonid line of kings, whose power traced back to Alexander the Great's Diadochi Antigonus Monophthalmus. The battle is also considered to be a victory of the Roman legion's manipular system's flexibility over the Antigonid Macedonian phalanx's rigidity.

Battle of Pydna (148 BC).headline: Bitka pri Pidni (148 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pidni je potekala leta 148 pr. n. št. med Rimom in silami makedonskega voditelja Andriska. Rimske sile pod vodstvom Kvinta Cecilija Metela so zmagale. Bitka je odločilno vplivala na izid četrte makedonske vojne, v njej pa je bila uničena zadnja vojaško-politična sila Makedonije.

Vojna se je začela, ko je pretendent Andrisk premagal rimske varovance v Makedoniji in se okronal za kralja, nato pa porazil rimsko vojsko, poslano, da bi ga ustavila, in vdrl v dele Grčije. Senat je nato proti pretendentu poslal Kvinta Cecilija Metela z drugo, večjo vojsko; rimski poveljnik se je odločil za ofenzivo po kopnem in morju ter Andriska prisilil v obrambni položaj blizu Pidne, kjer ga je napadel in hudo porazil.

Bitka je odločila izid vojne: Andrisk je moral zbežati iz Makedonije, Rimljani pa so ga zasledovali in ujeli, preden je lahko zbral močno vojsko. Rim je nato Makedonijo prevzel pod neposredno oblast in jo spremenil v rimsko provinco.

source.title: Battle of Pydna (148 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Pydna was fought in 148 BC between Rome and the forces of the Macedonian leader Andriscus. The Roman force was led by Quintus Caecilius Metellus, and was victorious. The battle played an important role in deciding the outcome of the Fourth Macedonian War, and saw the annihilation of the last military-political force of Macedon.

The war had begun when the pretender Andriscus defeated Rome's clients in Macedon and crowned himself king, defeating a Roman force sent to stop him and invading parts of Greece. The senate then sent Quintus Caecilius Metellus with another, larger army to stop the pretender; the Roman commander chose to undertake both a land and sea offensive, forcing Andriscus to take a defensive position near Pydna, where Metellus engaged and soundly defeated him.

The battle decided the outcome of the war; Andriscus was forced to flee Macedon, and was pursued and captured by the Romans before he could raise a strong army. Rome now took direct control of Macedon, making it a Roman province.

Battle of Pylos.headline: Bitka pri Pilosu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pilosu, v kateri so se bojevali na morju in na kopnem, je potekala leta 425 pr. n. št. v peloponeški vojni na polotoku Pilos ob današnjem zalivu Navarino v Meseniji in se končala z atensko zmago nad Šparto. Nevihta je atensko ladjevje naplavila na obalo pri Pilosu; na Demostenovo pobudo so atenski vojaki polotok utrdili, in ko je ladjevje znova odplulo, je tam ostal majhen oddelek. Atenska posadka na špartanskem ozemlju je prestrašila špartansko vodstvo: špartanska vojska, ki je pod Agisovim poveljstvom pustošila Atiko, je pohod končala (trajal je le 15 dni) in se vrnila domov, špartansko ladjevje pri Korkiri pa je odplulo proti Pilosu.

source.title: Battle of Pylos
paragraphs: The Battle of Pylos, fought at sea and land, took place in 425 BC during the Peloponnesian War at the peninsula of Pylos, on the present-day Bay of Navarino in Messenia, and was an Athenian victory over Sparta. An Athenian fleet had been driven ashore at Pylos by a storm, and, at the instigation of Demosthenes, the Athenian soldiers fortified the peninsula, and a small force was left there when the fleet departed again. The establishment of an Athenian garrison in Spartan territory frightened the Spartan leadership, and the Spartan army, which had been ravaging Attica under the command of Agis, ended their expedition (the expedition only lasted 15 days) and marched home, while the Spartan fleet at Corcyra sailed to Pylos.

Battle of Qbaada.headline: Bitka pri Kbaadi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kbaadi je potekala na območju današnje Krasne Poljane 2. junija [21. maja po starem koledarju] 1864. Splošno velja za zadnji vojaški spopad rusko-čerkeške vojne, saj se Čerkezi invazijski ruski cesarski vojski niso mogli več upirati.

Bitka pri Kbaadi je bila pomemben dogodek širše kavkaške vojne: po njej je Rusko cesarstvo priključilo Čerkezijo in začelo čerkeški genocid, v katerem so 95 do 97 % prebivalstva dežele etnično očistili, kar je pripeljalo do nastanka čerkeške diaspore.

source.title: Battle of Qbaada
paragraphs: The Battle of Qbaada took place in today's Krasnaya Polyana on 2 June [O.S. 21 May] 1864. It is widely accepted as the final military engagement of the Russo-Circassian War, as the Circassian people could no longer continue to resist the invading Imperial Russian Army.

A significant development in the wider Caucasian War, it was after the Battle of Qbaada that the Russian Empire annexed Circassia and initiated the Circassian genocide, in which 95% to 97% of the country's population was ethnically cleansed, leading to the creation of the Circassian diaspora.

Battle of Quatre Bras.headline: Bitka pri Quatre Brasu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Quatre Brasu je potekala 16. junija 1815 kot uvodni spopad pred odločilno bitko pri Waterlooju dva dni pozneje. Bojevali so se blizu strateškega križišča Quatre Bras, spopadli pa so se deli anglo-zavezniške vojske vojvode Wellingtona in levo krilo francoske Severne armade (Armée du Nord) Napoleona Bonaparta pod poveljstvom maršala Michela Neya. Bitka je bila taktična zmaga Wellingtona (ki je ob mraku obvladoval bojišče), a strateška zmaga Francozov, saj mu je Ney preprečil, da bi priskočil na pomoč Blücherjevim Prusom, ki so se pri Lignyju bojevali s francosko vojsko pod poveljstvom Napoleona Bonaparta.

source.title: Battle of Quatre Bras
paragraphs: The Battle of Quatre Bras was fought on 16 June 1815, as a preliminary engagement to the decisive Battle of Waterloo that occurred two days later. The battle took place near the strategic crossroads of Quatre Bras and was contested between elements of the Duke of Wellington's Anglo-allied army and the left wing of Napoleon Bonaparte's French Armée du Nord under Marshal Michel Ney. The battle was a tactical victory for Wellington (as he possessed the field at dusk), but because Ney prevented him going to the aid of Blücher's Prussians who were fighting the French army under the command of Napoleon Bonaparte at Ligny it was a strategic victory for the French.

Bitka v zalivu Quiberon (Francozi jo imenujejo Bataille des Cardinaux) je bila odločilen pomorski spopad sedemletne vojne. Potekala je 20. in 21. novembra 1759 med britansko kraljevo mornarico in francosko mornarico v zalivu Quiberon pred francosko obalo blizu Saint-Nazaira. Bitka je bila vrhunec britanskih prizadevanj, da bi odpravili francosko pomorsko premoč, ki bi Francozom lahko omogočila načrtovano invazijo na Veliko Britanijo.

V bitki je britanska flota s 24 linijskimi ladjami pod poveljstvom admirala modre zastave sira Edwarda Hawka izsledila in napadla francosko floto z 21 linijskimi ladjami pod poveljstvom chef d'escadre Huberta de Brienna. Po hudih bojih je britanska flota šest francoskih linijskih ladij potopila ali pognala na plitvino, eno zajela, preostale pa razkropila; to je bila ena največjih zmag kraljeve mornarice, ki je za vedno odpravila nevarnost francoske invazije. Bitka je utrdila prevlado kraljeve mornarice do konca vojne in je bila za Britance del čudežnega leta (Annus Mirabilis) 1759.

source.title: Battle of Quiberon Bay
paragraphs: The Battle of Quiberon Bay (known as the Bataille des Cardinaux by the French) was a decisive naval engagement during the Seven Years' War. It was fought on 20–21 November 1759 between the Royal Navy and the French Navy in Quiberon Bay, off the coast of France near Saint-Nazaire. The battle was the culmination of British efforts to eliminate French naval superiority, which could have given the French the ability to carry out their planned invasion of Great Britain.

In the battle, a British fleet of 24 ships of the line under Admiral of the Blue Sir Edward Hawke tracked down and engaged a French fleet of 21 ships of the line under Chef d'escadre Hubert de Brienne. After hard fighting, the British fleet sank or ran aground six French ships of the line, captured one and scattered the rest, giving the Royal Navy one of its greatest victories, and ending the threat of French invasion for good. The battle cemented the dominance of the Royal Navy for the rest of the war and for the British formed part of the Annus Mirabilis of 1759.

Battle of Raab (1809).headline: Bitka pri Győru (1809)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rabu ali bitka pri Győru (madžarsko: győri csata) je potekala 14. junija 1809 v napoleonskih vojnah: francosko-italijanske sile so se spopadle s habsburškimi. Habsburško vojsko so večinoma sestavljali slabo izurjeni pripadniki deželne brambe (Landwehr) in milice. Bitka je potekala blizu Győra (nemško Raab) v Kraljevini Ogrski in se končala s francosko-italijansko zmago. Zmaga je nadvojvodi Janezu Avstrijskemu preprečila, da bi v bitko pri Wagramu pripeljal kakršne koli pomembnejše sile, sile princa Eugèna de Beauharnaisa pa so se lahko pravočasno združile s cesarjem Napoleonom pri Dunaju in se bojevale pri Wagramu. Napoleon je bitko imenoval »vnukinja Marenga in Friedlanda«, saj je bila na obletnico teh dveh bitk.

source.title: Battle of Raab (1809)
paragraphs: The Battle of Raab or Battle of Győr (Hungarian: győri csata) was fought on 14 June 1809 during the Napoleonic Wars, between Franco-Italian forces and Habsburg forces. Most of the Habsburg army consisted of poorly trained Landwehr and militia. The battle was fought near Győr (Raab in German), Kingdom of Hungary, and ended in a Franco-Italian victory. The victory prevented Archduke John of Austria from bringing any significant force to the Battle of Wagram, while Prince Eugène de Beauharnais's force was able to link up with Emperor Napoleon at Vienna in time to fight at Wagram. Napoleon referred to the battle as "a granddaughter of Marengo and Friedland", as it fell on the anniversary of those two battles.

Battle of Racławice.headline: Bitka pri Racławicah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Racławicah (poljsko: Bitwa pod Racławicami) je bila ena prvih bitk Kościuszkove vstaje proti Rusiji. Potekala je 4. aprila 1794 blizu vasi Racławice v Malopoljski.

Bojišče je od 1. maja 2004 eden od uradnih poljskih narodnih zgodovinskih spomenikov (Pomnik historii). Seznam vodi poljski urad za narodno dediščino. V prvotnem besedilu pesmi Poljska še ni izgubljena je bitka omenjena v zadnji kitici.

source.title: Battle of Racławice
paragraphs: The Battle of Racławice (Polish: Bitwa pod Racławicami) was one of the first battles of the Kościuszko Uprising against Russia. It was fought on 4 April 1794 near the village of Racławice in Lesser Poland.

The battle site is one of Poland's official national Historic Monuments (Pomnik historii), as designated on 1 May 2004. Its listing is maintained by the National Heritage Board of Poland. In the original text of Poland Is Not Yet Lost, the battle is mentioned in the last verse.

Battle of Rain.headline: Bitka pri Rainu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rainu je potekala 15. aprila 1632 blizu Raina na Bavarskem med tridesetletno vojno. Švedska vojska pod vodstvom švedskega kralja Gustava II. Adolfa je premagala vojsko katoliške lige pod vodstvom Johanna Tserclaesa, grofa Tillyja, ki je pozneje umrl zaradi ran, ki jih je dobil v bitki.

Tilly je imel manj vojakov, med njimi veliko neizkušenih, zato je ob reki Lech s središčem v mestu Rain zgradil obrambne utrdbe v upanju, da bo Gustava zadržal dovolj dolgo, da bi do njega prispele cesarske okrepitve pod vodstvom Albrechta von Wallensteina. Švedi so 14. aprila obstreljevali utrdbe, naslednji dan pa prečkali reko in nasprotniku prizadejali skoraj 3000 izgub; ranjen je bil tudi Tilly. Bavarski Maksimilijan je 16. aprila ukazal umik in pustil zaloge in topove.

Kljub zmagi so se Švedi oddaljili od svojih oporišč v severni Nemčiji, in ko se je Maksimilijan združil z Wallensteinom, so se znašli oblegani v Nürnbergu. To je 3. septembra privedlo do največje bitke vojne, ko so bili pri napadu na cesarski tabor pred mestom krvavo odbiti.

source.title: Battle of Rain
paragraphs: The Battle of Rain took place on 15 April 1632 near Rain in Bavaria during the Thirty Years' War. A Swedish army under Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden defeated a Catholic League force led by Johann Tserclaes, Count of Tilly, who later died of wounds received in the battle.

Outnumbered and with many inexperienced troops, Tilly built defensive works along the River Lech, centred on the town of Rain, hoping to delay Gustavus long enough for Imperial reinforcements under Albrecht von Wallenstein to reach him. The Swedes spent 14 April bombarding the defences, then crossed the river the next day, inflicting nearly 3,000 casualties, including Tilly. On 16 April, Maximilian of Bavaria ordered a retreat, abandoning his supplies and guns.

Despite this victory, the Swedes had been drawn away from their bases in Northern Germany and when Maximilian linked up with Wallenstein found themselves besieged in Nuremberg. This led to the largest battle of the war on 3 September, when an assault on the Imperial camp outside the town was bloodily repulsed.

Bitka pri Ramilliesu je potekala 23. maja 1706 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo. Za veliko alianso – Avstrijo, Anglijo in Nizozemsko republiko – je bitki leta 1705 predhodil neodločen pohod proti burbonskim vojskam francoskega kralja Ludvika XIV. Zavezniki so tisto leto sicer zavzeli Barcelono, a so morali opustiti pohod ob Mozeli, na Španski Nizozemski so obtičali, v severni Italiji pa doživeli poraz. Kljub neuspehom nasprotnikov si je Ludvik XIV. želel miru, a pod sprejemljivimi pogoji. Zato in da bi ohranili zagon, so Francozi in njihovi zavezniki leta 1706 prešli v ofenzivo.

source.title: Battle of Ramillies
paragraphs: The Battle of Ramillies, fought on 23 May 1706, was a battle of the War of the Spanish Succession. For the Grand Alliance – Austria, England, and the Dutch Republic – the battle had followed an indecisive campaign against the Bourbon armies of King Louis XIV of France in 1705. Although the Allies had captured Barcelona that year, they had been forced to abandon their campaign on the Moselle, had stalled in the Spanish Netherlands and suffered defeat in northern Italy. Yet despite his opponents' setbacks Louis XIV wanted peace, but on reasonable terms. Because of this, as well as to maintain their momentum, the French and their allies took the offensive in 1706.

Bitka pri Raszynu je potekala 19. aprila 1809 med vojskama Avstrijskega cesarstva pod vodstvom nadvojvode Ferdinanda Karla Jožefa Avstrijsko-Estejskega in Varšavskega vojvodstva pod vodstvom Józefa Antonija Poniatowskega v okviru vojne pete koalicije v napoleonskih vojnah. Bitka ni bila odločilna, a so Avstrijci dosegli svoj cilj in zavzeli poljsko prestolnico Varšavo.

source.title: Battle of Raszyn (1809)
paragraphs: The Battle of Raszyn was fought on 19 April 1809 between armies of the Austrian Empire under Archduke Ferdinand Karl Joseph of Austria-Este and the Duchy of Warsaw under Józef Antoni Poniatowski, as part of the War of the Fifth Coalition in the Napoleonic Wars. The battle was not decisive, but it did result in the Austrians obtaining their goal by capturing the Polish capital Warsaw.

Battle of Ratisbon.headline: Bitka pri Regensburgu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ratisboni, imenovana tudi bitka pri Regensburgu, je bila srečanjski boj v napoleonskih vojnah 23. aprila 1809 med vojsko Francoskega cesarstva pod vodstvom Napoleona I. in vojsko Avstrijskega cesarstva pod vodstvom nadvojvode Karla. Kratka obramba mesta, prizorišča zadnjega spopada bavarske faze pohoda leta 1809, in postavitev pontonskega mostu vzhodno od njega sta umikajoči se avstrijski vojski omogočili pobeg na Češko. Med naskokom je maršal Jean Lannes vodil svoje čete po lestvah na obzidje, Napoleona pa je v gleženj zadel majhen topniški izstrelek. Strel je bil izstreljen z velike razdalje in cesarja ni hudo poškodoval, povzročil pa je udarnino.

source.title: Battle of Ratisbon
paragraphs: The Battle of Ratisbon, also called the Battle of Regensburg, was a meeting engagement fought on 23 April 1809, during the Napoleonic Wars, between the army of the French Empire, led by Napoleon I, and that of the Austrian Empire, led by Archduke Charles. Scene of the last engagement of the Bavaria phase of the campaign of 1809, the brief defense of the city and installation of a pontoon bridge to the east enabled the retreating Austrian army to escape into Bohemia. During the assault, Marshal Jean Lannes led his troops up ladders onto the walls, and Napoleon was wounded in his ankle by a small artillery round. The shot had been fired at great distance and did not severely hurt the Emperor, but caused a contusion.

Battle of Reading (871).headline: Bitka pri Readingu (871)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Readingu je bila zmaga danske vikinške vojske nad zahodnosaškimi silami okoli 4. januarja 871 pri Readingu v Berkshiru. Vikinge sta vodila Bagsecg in Halfdan Ragnarsson, Zahodne Sase pa kralj Æthelred in njegov brat, poznejši kralj Alfred Veliki. Bila je druga v vrsti bitk po vdoru danske vojske v Wessex decembra 870.

source.title: Battle of Reading (871)
paragraphs: The Battle of Reading was a victory for a Danish Viking army over a West Saxon force on or about 4 January 871 at Reading in Berkshire. The Vikings were led by Bagsecg and Halfdan Ragnarsson and the West Saxons by King Æthelred and his brother, the future King Alfred the Great. It was the second of a series of battles that took place following an invasion of Wessex by the Danish army in December 870.

Battle of Reichenberg.headline: Bitka pri Reichenbergu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Reichenbergu je potekala med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (delom sedemletne vojne) 21. aprila 1757 blizu mesta Reichenberg (češko: Liberec) na Češkem.

source.title: Battle of Reichenberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Reichenberg took place during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War) on 21 April 1757 near the town of Reichenberg (Czech: Liberec) in Bohemia.

Battle of Remagen.headline: Bitka pri Remagnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Remagnu je bila 18-dnevna bitka med zavezniško invazijo na Nemčijo v drugi svetovni vojni. Trajala je od 7. marca, ko so ameriške sile nepričakovano zavzele nepoškodovani Ludendorffov most čez Ren, do 25. marca 1945. Most so uspeli obdržati proti nemškemu odporu in zgraditi dodatne začasne prehode. Mostišče čez Ren je načrtovani prehod zahodnih zaveznikov čez Ren v nemško notranjost pospešilo za tri tedne.

source.title: Battle of Remagen
paragraphs: The Battle of Remagen was an 18-day battle during the Allied invasion of Germany in World War II. It lasted from 7 to 25 March 1945 when American forces unexpectedly captured the Ludendorff Bridge over the Rhine intact. They were able to hold it against German opposition and build additional temporary crossings. The presence of a bridgehead across the Rhine advanced the Western Allies' planned crossing of the Rhine into the German interior by three weeks.

Battle of Riade.headline: Bitka pri Riadeju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Riadeju, imenovana tudi bitka pri Merseburgu ali bitka ob Unstruti, je potekala 15. marca 933 med četami Vzhodne Frankovske pod vodstvom kralja Henrika I. in Madžari na neznanem kraju v severni Turingiji ob reki Unstruti. Do bitke je prišlo, ker se je sinoda v Erfurtu leta 932 odločila, da Madžarom ne bo več plačevala letnega davka.

source.title: Battle of Riade
paragraphs: The Battle of Riade, also called Battle of Merseburg or Battle at the Unstrut, was fought between the troops of East Francia under King Henry I and the Magyars at an unidentified location in northern Thuringia along the river Unstrut on 15 March 933. The battle was precipitated by the decision of the Synod of Erfurt to stop paying an annual tribute to the Magyars in 932.

Bitka pri Rivoliju (14. januarja 1797) je bila ključni spopad vojne prve koalicije blizu vasi Rivoli, ki je bila tedaj del Beneške republike. Na vrhuncu italijanske kampanje 1796–1797 je številčno šibkejša francoska italijanska armada pod poveljstvom generala Napoleona Bonaparta odločilno premagala napadajočo avstrijsko vojsko pod vodstvom generala topništva Józsefa Alvinczija. Alvinczi je kljub slabšanju zdravja skušal v četrtem in zadnjem prizadevanju prodreti proti jugu in rešiti Mantovo pred obleganjem. Francoska zmaga pri Rivoliju je pokazala Bonapartovo sposobnost in spretnost vojaškega poveljnika. Privedla je tudi do avstrijske vdaje Mantove februarja, francoske utrditve severne Italije in navsezadnje do francoske zmage nad Avstrijo v vojni še istega leta.

source.title: Battle of Rivoli
paragraphs: The Battle of Rivoli (14 January 1797) was a key military engagement during the War of the First Coalition near the village of Rivoli, then part of the Republic of Venice. In the climax of the Italian campaign of 1796–1797, the outnumbered French Army of Italy, commanded by General Napoleon Bonaparte, decisively defeated the attacking Austrian army led by General of the Artillery József Alvinczi. Alvinczi was attempting to march south in a fourth and final effort to relieve the siege of Mantua, despite his deteriorating health. The French victory at Rivoli demonstrated Bonaparte's capability and deftness as a military commander. The French victory also led to the Austrian surrender of Mantua in February, French consolidation of northern Italy, and ultimately France's victory over Austria in the war later that year.

Battle of Rocoux.headline: Bitka pri Rocouxu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rocouxu je potekala 11. oktobra 1746 med vojno za avstrijsko nasledstvo blizu Rocourta pri Liègeu v Belgiji. V njej sta se spopadli francoska vojska pod poveljstvom maršala Saxa ter združena britanska, nizozemska, nemška in avstrijska vojska pod vodstvom Karla Lotarinškega, grofa Ligonierja in princa Waldecka.

Kljub vrsti zmag v Flandriji je Francija do leta 1746 težko financirala vojno in je avgusta na kongresu v Bredi začela dvostranska mirovna pogajanja z Britanijo. Bitka pri Rocouxu je sicer potrdila francoski nadzor nad Avstrijsko Nizozemsko, Saxu pa ni uspelo doseči odločilne zmage, zato sta se vojski umaknili v zimovališča, da bi se pripravili na nov pohod leta 1747.

source.title: Battle of Rocoux
paragraphs: The Battle of Rocoux took place on 11 October 1746 during the War of the Austrian Succession, near Rocourt, Liège in Belgium. It was fought between a French army under Marshal Saxe and a combined British, Dutch, German and Austrian force led by Charles of Lorraine, Earl Ligonier and Prince Waldeck.

Despite a series of victories in Flanders, by 1746 France was struggling to finance the war, and opened bilateral peace negotiations with Britain at the Congress of Breda in August. While Rocoux confirmed French control of the Austrian Netherlands, Saxe failed to achieve a decisive victory, and the two armies went into winter quarters to prepare for a new campaign in 1747.

Battle of Rocroi.headline: Bitka pri Rocroiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rocroiju, ki je potekala 19. maja 1643, je bila velik spopad tridesetletne vojne med francosko vojsko pod vodstvom 21-letnega vojvode Enghiena (pozneje znanega kot Veliki Condé) in španskimi silami pod poveljstvom generala Francisca de Mela, le pet dni po tem, ko je Ludvik XIV. po očetovi smrti zasedel francoski prestol. Bitka je razblinila mit o nepremagljivosti španskih tercij, pehotnih enot s kopjaniki in strelci, ki so prejšnjih 120 let obvladovale evropska bojišča. Zato pogosto velja za konec španske vojaške veličine in začetek francoske prevlade v Evropi v drugi polovici 17. stoletja v času vladavine Ludvika XIV. Po Rocroiju so Španci sistem tercij postopoma preoblikovali in vanj sčasoma vključili več doktrine linijske pehote, kakršno so uporabljali Francozi.

source.title: Battle of Rocroi
paragraphs: The Battle of Rocroi, fought on 19 May 1643, was a major engagement of the Thirty Years' War between a French army, led by the 21-year-old Duke of Enghien (later known as the Great Condé) and Spanish forces under General Francisco de Melo only five days after the accession of Louis XIV to the throne of France after his father's death. Rocroi shattered the myth of invincibility of the Spanish tercios, the pike and shot infantry units that had dominated European battlefields for the previous 120 years. The battle is therefore often considered to mark the end of Spanish military greatness and the beginning of French hegemony in Europe in the second half-17th century during the reign of Louis XIV. After Rocroi, the Spanish progressively transformed the tercio system incorporating more of the line infantry doctrine used by the French over time.

Battle of Roliça.headline: Bitka pri Roliçi
paragraphs: V bitki pri Roliçi (17. avgusta 1808), prvi bitki britanske vojske v polotoški vojni, je angleško-portugalska vojska pod sirom Arthurjem Wellesleyjem blizu vasi Roliça na Portugalskem premagala številčno šibkejšo francosko cesarsko divizijo pod divizijskim generalom Henrijem Françoisom Delabordom. Francozi so se umaknili v dobrem redu.

source.title: Battle of Roliça
paragraphs: At the Battle of Roliça (17 August 1808), the first battle fought by the British army during the Peninsular War, an Anglo-Portuguese army under Sir Arthur Wellesley defeated an outnumbered Imperial French division under General of Division Henri François Delaborde, near the village of Roliça in Portugal. The French retired in good order.

Battle of Roncevaux Pass.headline: Bitka na prelazu Roncevaux
paragraphs: V bitki na prelazu Roncevaux (francoski in angleški zapis, špansko Roncesvalles, baskovsko Orreaga) leta 778 so velike baskovske sile iz zasede napadle del vojske Karla Velikega na prelazu Roncevaux, visokem gorskem prelazu v Pirenejih na današnji meji med Francijo in Španijo, potem ko je Karel vdrl na Iberski polotok.

Baski so napadli iz maščevanja, ker je Karel Veliki porušil obzidje njihove prestolnice Pamplone. Ko so se Franki čez Pireneje umikali nazaj v Frankovsko, so frankovske gospode v zaledni straži odrezali, ti so vztrajali na položaju in bili pobiti. Med padlimi je bil frankovski poveljnik Roland. Njegova smrt je njega in paladine, najodličnejše bojevnike dvora Karla Velikega, povzdignila v legendo; postali so vzor vitezov in močno vplivali na viteški kodeks v srednjem veku.

source.title: Battle of Roncevaux Pass
paragraphs: The Battle of Roncevaux Pass (French and English spelling, Roncesvalles in Spanish, Orreaga in Basque) in 778 saw a large force of Basques ambush a part of Charlemagne's army in Roncevaux Pass, a high mountain pass in the Pyrenees on the present border between France and Spain, after his invasion of the Iberian Peninsula.

The Basque attack was in retaliation for Charlemagne's destruction of the city walls of their capital, Pamplona. As the Franks retreated across the Pyrenees back to Francia, the rearguard of Frankish lords was cut off, stood its ground, and was wiped out. Among those killed in the battle was Roland, a Frankish commander. His death elevated him and the paladins, the foremost warriors of Charlemagne's court, into legend, becoming the quintessential role model for knights and also greatly influencing the code of chivalry in the Middle Ages.

Battle of Roosebeke.headline: Bitka pri Roosebekeju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Roosebekeju (včasih imenovana s tedanjim imenom bitka pri Westrozebekeju) je potekala 27. novembra 1382 na Goudbergu med flamsko vojsko pod vodstvom Philipa van Arteveldeja in francosko vojsko pod vodstvom flandrijskega grofa Ludvika II., ki je po porazu v bitki pri Beverhoutsveldu na pomoč poklical francoskega kralja Karla VI. Flamska vojska je bila poražena, Philip van Artevelde je padel, njegovo truplo pa so razstavili na ogled.

source.title: Battle of Roosebeke
paragraphs: The Battle of Roosebeke (sometimes referred by its contemporary name as Battle of Westrozebeke) took place on 27 November 1382 on the Goudberg between a Flemish army under Philip van Artevelde and a French army under Louis II of Flanders who had called upon the help of the French king Charles VI after he had suffered a defeat during the Battle of Beverhoutsveld. The Flemish army was defeated, Philip van Artevelde was slain and his corpse was put on display.

Battle of Rossbach.headline: Bitka pri Rossbachu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rossbachu je potekala 5. novembra 1757 med tretjo šlezijsko vojno (1756–1763, delom sedemletne vojne) blizu vasi Rossbach (Roßbach) v Saški volilni kneževini. Včasih jo po drugem bližnjem kraju imenujejo bitka pri Reichardtswerbnu. V 90-minutni bitki je pruski kralj Friderik Veliki premagal zavezniško vojsko, ki so jo sestavljale francoske sile in kontingent cesarske vojske (Reichsarmee) Svetega rimskega cesarstva. Francosko-cesarska vojska je štela 41.110 mož, precej manjša pruska vojska pa 22.000. Kljub veliki premoči nasprotnika je Friderik premagal cesarske in Francoze.

source.title: Battle of Rossbach
paragraphs: The Battle of Rossbach took place on 5 November 1757 during the Third Silesian War (1756–1763, part of the Seven Years' War) near the village of Rossbach (Roßbach), in the Electorate of Saxony. It is sometimes called the Battle of, or at, Reichardtswerben, after a different nearby town. In this 90-minute battle, Frederick the Great, king of Prussia, defeated an Allied army composed of French forces augmented by a contingent of the Reichsarmee (Imperial Army) of the Holy Roman Empire. The French and Imperial army included 41,110 men, opposing a considerably smaller Prussian force of 22,000. Despite overwhelming odds, Frederick managed to defeat the Imperials and the French.

Battle of Rostov (1941).headline: Bitka za Rostov (1941)
paragraphs: Bitka za Rostov (1941) je potekala na vzhodni fronti druge svetovne vojne okoli Rostova na Donu med skupino armad Jug nacistične Nemčije in južno fronto Sovjetske zveze.

Bitka je obsegala tri faze: nemško azovsko ofenzivno operacijo skupine armad Jug (general Gerd von Rundstedt), ki se je začela 12. septembra 1941, sovjetsko rostovsko obrambno operacijo južne fronte (general Jakov Timofejevič Čerevičenko) od 5. do 16. novembra 1941 in rostovsko ofenzivno operacijo iste sovjetske fronte od 27. novembra do 2. decembra 1941.

source.title: Battle of Rostov (1941)
paragraphs: The Battle of Rostov (1941) took place on the Eastern Front of World War II around Rostov-on-Don and was fought between Army Group South of Nazi Germany and the Southern Front of the Soviet Union.

The battle comprised three phases: the German Sea of Azov Offensive Operation by Army Group South (General Gerd von Rundstedt) (begun on 12 September 1941), the Soviet Rostov Defensive Operation (5 November 1941 – 16 November 1941) by the Southern Front (General Yakov Timofeyevich Cherevichenko), and the Rostov Offensive Operation (27 November 1941 – 2 December 1941) executed by the same Soviet Front.

Battle of Rotterdam.headline: Bitka za Rotterdam
paragraphs: Bitka za Rotterdam je bila spopad druge svetovne vojne med bitko za Nizozemsko. Potekala je med 10. in 14. majem 1940, Nemci pa so z njo skušali zavzeti nizozemsko mesto. Končala se je z nemško zmago po bombardiranju Rotterdama.

source.title: Battle of Rotterdam
paragraphs: The Battle of Rotterdam was a Second World War battle fought during the Battle of the Netherlands. Fought between 10 and 14 May 1940, it was a German attempt to seize the Dutch city. It ended in a German victory, following the Rotterdam Blitz.

Battle of Rozgony.headline: Bitka pri Rozgonyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rozgonyju ali bitka pri Rozhanovcah je potekala 15. junija 1312 na polju Rozgony (danes Rozhanovce) med ogrskim kraljem Karlom Robertom in rodbino palatina Amadeja Abe. Slikovna kronika (Chronicon Pictum) jo je opisala kot »najkrutejšo bitko od mongolskega vpada v Evropo«. Čeprav je bilo na kraljevi strani veliko žrtev, je njegova odločilna zmaga končala oblast rodbine Aba nad vzhodnim delom Kraljevine Ogrske, oslabila njegovega glavnega domačega nasprotnika Mateja Csáka III. in Karlu Robertu nazadnje zagotovila oblast.

source.title: Battle of Rozgony
paragraphs: The Battle of Rozgony or Battle of Rozhanovce was fought between King Charles Robert of Hungary and the family of Palatine Amade Aba on 15 June 1312, on the Rozgony (today Rozhanovce) field. Chronicon Pictum described it as the "most cruel battle since the Mongol invasion of Europe". Despite many casualties on the King's side, his decisive victory brought an end to the Aba family's rule over the eastern Kingdom of Hungary, weakened his major domestic opponent Máté Csák III, and ultimately secured power for Charles Robert of Hungary.

Battle of Rubizhne.headline: Bitka za Rubižne
paragraphs: Bitka za Rubižne je bila velika mestna bitka na vzhodnem bojišču rusko-ukrajinske vojne. Potekala je od 17. marca do 12. maja 2022, ko je mesto prišlo pod ruski nadzor.

source.title: Battle of Rubizhne
paragraphs: The battle of Rubizhne was a major urban military battle in the eastern theatre of the Russo-Ukrainian war. The battle took place between 17 March and 12 May 2022. The city came under Russian control on 12 May.

Battle of Rusokastro.headline: Bitka pri Rusokastru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rusokastru (bolgarsko: Битка при Русокастро; grško: Μάχη τοῦ Ῥουσοκάστρου) je potekala 18. julija 1332 blizu vasi Rusokastro v Bolgariji med vojskama Bolgarskega in Bizantinskega cesarstva. Zmagali so Bolgari.

source.title: Battle of Rusokastro
paragraphs: The Battle of Rusokastro (Bulgarian: Битка при Русокастро, Greek: Μάχη τοῦ Ῥουσοκάστρου) occurred on July 18, 1332 near the village of Rusokastro, Bulgaria, between the armies of the Bulgarian and Byzantine Empires. The outcome was a Bulgarian victory

Battle of Rymnik.headline: Bitka pri Rimniku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Rimniku, imenovana tudi bitka pri Mărtineștiju (turško: Boze Savaşı [bitka ob Bozi]; rusko: Рымникское сражение [bitka ob Rimniku]; nemško: Schlacht am Rimnik), je potekala 22. septembra [11. septembra po starem koledarju] 1789 v Vlaški ob reki Râmnicul Sărat, znani kot Rimnik, blizu mesta Râmnicu Sărat ali Rimnik (danes v Romuniji), med rusko-turško vojno 1787–1792 in avstrijsko-turško vojno 1788–1791. Ruski general Aleksander Suvorov je skupaj s habsburškim generalom knezom Josiasom Coburškim napadel precej večjo glavno osmansko vojsko pod vodstvom velikega vezirja Cenaze Hasan-paše.

source.title: Battle of Rymnik
paragraphs: The Battle of Rymnik or Rimnik, also Battle of Mărtinești (Turkish: Boze Savaşı [Battle of the Boze]; Russian: Рымникское сражение [Battle of the Rymnik]; German: Schlacht am Rimnik), on September 22 [O.S. September 11] 1789, took place in Wallachia, at the Râmnicul Sărat River, known as the Rymnik, near Râmnicu Sărat or Rymnik (now in Romania) during the Russo-Turkish War of 1787–1792 and the Austro-Turkish War of 1788–1791. The Russian general Alexander Suvorov, acting together with the Habsburg general Prince Josias of Coburg, attacked the main Ottoman army under Grand Vizier Cenaze Hasan Pasha, which was much larger.

Battle of Saalfeld.headline: Bitka pri Saalfeldu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Saalfeldu je potekala 10. oktobra 1806: francoske sile z 12.800 možmi pod poveljstvom maršala Jeana Lannesa so premagale prusko-saške sile z 8300 možmi pod vodstvom princa Ludvika Ferdinanda. Bojevali so se v Turingiji, v tedanji ernestinski vojvodini Saška-Coburg-Saalfeld. Bitka je bila drugi spopad pruskega pohoda v vojni četrte koalicije.

source.title: Battle of Saalfeld
paragraphs: The Battle of Saalfeld took place on 10 October 1806, at which a French force of 12,800 men commanded by Marshal Jean Lannes defeated a Prussian-Saxon force of 8,300 men under Prince Louis Ferdinand. The battle took place in Thuringia in what was the Ernestine duchy of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. The battle was the second clash in the Prussian Campaign of the War of the Fourth Coalition.

Battle of Sablat.headline: Bitka pri Sablatu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sablatu ali Záblatíju je potekala 10. junija 1619 v češkem obdobju tridesetletne vojne. V njej sta se spopadli rimskokatoliška cesarska vojska pod vodstvom Charlesa Bonaventura de Longuevala, grofa Bucquoya, in protestantska vojska Ernsta von Mansfelda.

Ko je bil Mansfeld na poti, da bi okrepil generala Hohenloheja, ki je oblegal České Budějovice, ga je Bucquoy prestregel blizu vasice Záblatí (nemško: Sablat), približno 25 km severozahodno od Českih Budějovic, in ga prisilil v boj. Mansfeld je bil poražen in je izgubil najmanj 1500 pešcev in tovorno kolono. Čehi so morali zato prekiniti obleganje Českih Budějovic.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Sablat
paragraphs: The Battle of Sablat or Záblatí occurred on 10 June 1619, during the Bohemian period of the Thirty Years' War. The battle was fought between a Roman Catholic Imperial army led by Charles Bonaventure de Longueval, Count of Bucquoy and the Protestant army of Ernst von Mansfeld.

When Mansfeld was on his way to reinforce general Hohenlohe, who was besieging České Budějovice, Bucquoy intercepted Mansfeld near the small village of Záblatí (German: Sablat), about 25 km (16 mi) km northwest of České Budějovice, and brought him to battle. Mansfeld suffered defeat, losing at least 1,500 infantry and his baggage train. As a result, the Bohemians had to lift the siege of České Budějovice.

Battle of Sacile.headline: Bitka pri Sacileju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sacileju (znana tudi kot bitka pri Fontana Fredda) 16. aprila 1809 in spremljajoči spopad pri Pordenonu 15. aprila sta se končala z zmago avstrijske vojske nadvojvode Janeza Avstrijskega nad francosko-italijansko vojsko Eugèna de Beauharnaisa, ki se je morala umakniti. Sacile je bil največji uspeh Janezove kariere. Boj je potekal vzhodno od reke Livenza blizu Sacileja v današnji Italiji v vojni pete koalicije, delu napoleonskih vojn.

Nadvojvoda Janez je aprila 1809 hitro vdrl v Benečijo v severovzhodni Italiji. Avstrijska prednja straža je 15. aprila pri Pordenonu razbila francosko zaščitnico in ji prizadejala hude izgube. Eugène se zaradi tega neuspeha ni pustil motiti: ker je verjel, da ima številčno premoč, je naslednji dan napadel Avstrijce vzhodno od Sacileja. Čeprav sta bili strani po številu pehote enaki, so imeli Avstrijci v konjenici premoč dva proti ena, kar se je izkazalo za ključni dejavnik njihove zmage.

source.title: Battle of Sacile
paragraphs: The Battle of Sacile (also known as the Battle of Fontana Fredda) on 16 April 1809 and its companion Clash at Pordenone on 15 April saw an Austrian army commanded by Archduke John of Austria defeat a Franco-Italian army led by Eugène de Beauharnais and force it to retreat. Sacile proved to be the most notable victory of John's career. The action took place east of the Livenza River near Sacile in modern-day Italy during the War of the Fifth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

In April 1809, Archduke John quickly invaded Venetia in northeastern Italy. On 15 April at Pordenone, the Austrian advance guard routed the French rear guard, inflicting heavy losses. Undeterred by this setback and believing he enjoyed a numerical superiority over his opponents, Eugène attacked the Austrians east of Sacile the following day. Though the two sides were equal in numbers of foot soldiers, the Austrians possessed a two-to-one advantage in cavalry, and this turned out to be a key factor in their victory.

Battle of Sagrajas.headline: Bitka pri Sagrajasu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sagrajasu (23. oktobra 1086), imenovana tudi Zalaca ali Zalaka (arabsko: معركة الزلاقة), je bila spopad leta 1086 med almoravidsko vojsko pod vodstvom njihovega kralja Jusufa ibn Tašfina in silami kastiljskega kralja Alfonza VI. Almoravide so v boj poklicale taife, muslimanske kneževine v Al Andalusu, ki so se pogosto bojevale med seboj, proti širjenju krščanskih kraljestev na severu pa so se združile. Poleg almoravidskih sil so muslimansko stran okrepile tudi taife in tehtnico prevesile v njeno korist. Bojišče je postalo znano kot az Zalaka (»spolzka tla«), ker je bilo zaradi ogromnega prelivanja krvi zahrbtno, od tod tudi arabsko ime.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Sagrajas
paragraphs: The Battle of Sagrajas (23 October 1086), also called Zalaca or Zallaqah (Arabic: معركة الزلاقة, romanized: Maʿrakat az-Zallāqah), was a conflict fought in 1086 between the Almoravid army, led by their king, Yusuf ibn Tashfin, and the forces of King Alfonso VI of Castile. The Almoravids were called into battle by the taifas, Muslim principalities in Al-Andalus that often fought amongst themselves but united against the expanding Christian kingdoms to the north. In addition to the Almoravid forces, the Taifas, bolstered the Muslim side, tilting the battle in their favor. The battlefield became known as az-Zallaqah (meaning "slippery ground") due to the immense bloodshed that made the terrain treacherous, giving rise to its name in Arabic.

Battle of Saint-Denis (1678).headline: Bitka pri Saint-Denisu (1678)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Saint-Denisu je bila zadnji večji spopad francosko-nizozemske vojne (1672–1678). Potekala je 14. avgusta 1678, štiri dni po tem, ko je francoski kralj Ludvik XIV. z Nizozemsko republiko sklenil nijmegenski mir, a preden je dokončno uredil pogoje s Španijo. Bitko so začeli Nizozemci in Španci, da bi Francozom preprečili zavzetje Monsa, ki so ga držali Španci in je tedaj ležal na meji med Francijo in Špansko Nizozemsko. Izid je bil sporen, saj sta si zmago pripisali obe strani.

Francoski poveljnik Luxembourg je za nadaljevanje obleganja Monsa pustil manjšo četo, 40.000 do 50.000 mož pa je zbral okoli bližnjih vasi Saint-Denis in Casteau, kjer jih je napadla združena nizozemsko-španska vojska s 35.000 do 45.000 možmi pod vodstvom Viljema Oranskega.

source.title: Battle of Saint-Denis (1678)
paragraphs: The Battle of Saint-Denis was the last major action of the 1672 to 1678 Franco-Dutch War. It took place on 14 August 1678, four days after Louis XIV of France had agreed the Treaty of Nijmegen with the Dutch Republic, but before he finalised terms with Spain. The Dutch and Spanish initiated the battle to prevent the French capturing the Spanish-held town of Mons, then on the border between France and the Spanish Netherlands. The result was disputed, as both sides claimed victory.

Leaving a small force to maintain the siege of Mons, French commander Luxembourg concentrated 40,000 to 50,000 men around the nearby villages of Saint-Dénis and Casteau, where they were attacked by a combined Dutch-Spanish army of 35,000 to 45,000 men led by William of Orange.

Battle of Saint-Mathieu.headline: Bitka pri Saint-Mathieuju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Saint-Mathieuju je potekala 10. avgusta 1512 med vojno Cambraiške lige blizu Bresta v Franciji, in sicer med angleško floto 25 ladij pod poveljstvom sira Edwarda Howarda in francosko-bretonsko floto 22 ladij pod poveljstvom Renéja de Clermonta. Morda je bila to prva bitka, v kateri so ladje streljale s topovi skozi topovske line, čeprav je to imelo v boju manjšo vlogo. Bila je ena od le dveh pravih pomorskih bitk tudorske mornarice kralja Henrika VIII., poleg poznejše bitke v Solentu. Med bitko sta bili največji in najmočnejši ladji obeh mornaric – Regent in Marie-la-Cordelière (ali preprosto Cordelière) – uničeni v veliki eksploziji na krovu slednje.

source.title: Battle of Saint-Mathieu
paragraphs: The Battle of Saint-Mathieu took place on 10 August 1512 during the War of the League of Cambrai, near Brest, France, between an English fleet of 25 ships commanded by Sir Edward Howard and a Franco-Breton fleet of 22 ships commanded by René de Clermont. It is possibly the first battle between ships using cannon through ports, although this played a minor role in the fighting. This was one of only two full-fledged naval battles fought by King Henry VIII's Tudor navy, along with the later Battle of the Solent. During the battle, each navy's largest and most powerful ship — Regent and the Marie-la-Cordelière (or simply Cordelière) – were destroyed in a large explosion aboard the latter.

Battle of Saint-Mihiel.headline: Bitka pri Saint-Mihielu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Saint-Mihielu je bila velika bitka prve svetovne vojne, ki je potekala od 12. do 16. septembra 1918. V njej so ameriške ekspedicijske sile (AEF) in 110.000 francoskih vojakov pod poveljstvom ameriškega generala Johna J. Pershinga napadle nemške položaje. Pomembno vlogo je imela letalska služba Kopenske vojske ZDA (U.S. Army Air Service).
V tej bitki so Američani prvič uporabili izraza »dan D« in »ura H«.

source.title: Battle of Saint-Mihiel
paragraphs: The Battle of Saint-Mihiel was a major World War I battle fought from 12 to 16 September 1918, involving the American Expeditionary Forces (AEF) and 110,000 French troops under the command of General John J. Pershing of the United States against German positions. The U.S. Army Air Service played a significant role in this action.
This battle marked the first use of the terms "D-Day" and "H-Hour" by the Americans.

Bitka pri Salamanci (v francoščini in španščini znana kot bitka pri Arapilesu) je potekala 22. julija 1812. Angleško-portugalska vojska pod grofom Wellingtonom (poznejšim vojvodo Wellingtonom) je med polotoško vojno pri Arapilesu južno od Salamance v Španiji premagala francoske sile maršala Augusta Marmonta. Navzoča je bila tudi španska divizija, ki pa v bitki ni sodelovala.

source.title: Battle of Salamanca
paragraphs: The Battle of Salamanca (in French and Spanish known as the Battle of the Arapiles) took place on 22 July 1812. An Anglo-Portuguese army under the Earl of Wellington (future Duke of Wellington) defeated Marshal Auguste Marmont's French forces at Arapiles, south of Salamanca, Spain, during the Peninsular War. A Spanish division was also present but took no part in the battle.

Battle of Saltanovka.headline: Bitka pri Saltanovki
paragraphs: Bitka pri Saltanovki, znana tudi kot bitka pri Mogiljovu (francosko: Bataille de Mogilev), je potekala 23. julija 1812 v začetni fazi francoskega vdora v Rusijo leta 1812.

source.title: Battle of Saltanovka
paragraphs: The Battle of Saltanovka, also known as the Battle of Mogilev (French: Bataille de Mogilev), took place on 23 July 1812 during the early stages of the 1812 French invasion of Russia.

Battle of San Marino.headline: Bitka za San Marino
paragraphs: Bitka za San Marino je bila spopad od 17. do 20. septembra 1944 v italijanski kampanji druge svetovne vojne, v katerem so nemške kopenske sile zasedle nevtralno mikrodržavo, Republiko San Marino, nato pa so jih napadle zavezniške sile. Včasih jo imenujejo tudi bitka pri Monte Pulitu.

source.title: Battle of San Marino
paragraphs: The Battle of San Marino was an engagement on 17–20 September 1944 during the Italian Campaign of the Second World War, in which German Army forces occupied the neutral Republic of San Marino microstate and were then attacked by Allied forces. It is also sometimes known as the Battle of Monte Pulito.

Battle of San Pietro.headline: Bitka pri San Pietru
paragraphs: Bitka pri San Pietru, znana tudi kot bitka pri Crocetti ali bitka pri Parmi, je potekala 29. junija 1734 med francoskimi in sardinskimi četami na eni strani ter avstrijskimi habsburškimi četami na drugi v poljski nasledstveni vojni, med vasjo La Crocetta in mestom Parma, ki je bilo takrat v Parmski vojvodini. Avstrijci so napadli utrjen francosko-sardinski položaj, a so jih nazadnje odbili, deloma tudi zato, ker je padel njihov poveljnik Florimund Mercy in je bil ranjen njegov namestnik Friderik Württemberški. Obe strani sta v bitki, ki je trajala večino dneva, utrpeli znatne izgube.

source.title: Battle of San Pietro
paragraphs: The Battle of San Pietro, also known as the Battle of Crocetta or the Battle of Parma, was fought on 29 June 1734 between troops of France and Sardinia on one side, and Habsburg Austrian troops on the other, as part of the War of Polish Succession, between the village of La Crocetta and the city of Parma, then in the Duchy of Parma. Austrian troops assaulted an entrenched Franco-Sardinian position, and were ultimately repulsed, due in part to the death of their commander, Florimund Mercy, and the wounding of his second in command, Frederick of Württemberg. Both sides suffered significant casualties in the battle, which lasted for most of the day.

Battle of Sandwich (1217).headline: Bitka pri Sandwichu (1217)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sandwichu, imenovana tudi bitka pri Dovru, je potekala 24. avgusta 1217 v prvi baronski vojni. Angleško plantagenetsko ladjevje pod poveljstvom Huberta de Burgha je pred Sandwichem v Kentu napadlo francosko kapetinško ladjevje pod vodstvom Eustahija Meniha in Roberta de Courtenayja. Angleži so zajeli francosko admiralsko ladjo in večino oskrbovalnih ladij, preostanek francoskega ladjevja pa se je moral vrniti v Calais.

Francosko ladjevje je skušalo pripeljati zaloge in okrepitve princu Ludviku, poznejšemu francoskemu kralju Ludviku VIII., čigar francoske sile so tedaj držale London. Angleške ladje so napadle s privetrne strani, zavzele Eustahijevo ladjo, ujele Roberta in viteze ter pobile preostalo posadko. Eustahija, razvpitega pirata, so po ujetju usmrtili. Bitka je princa Ludvika prepričala, da opusti poskus osvojitve Anglije, nekaj tednov pozneje pa je bila podpisana lambethska pogodba.

source.title: Battle of Sandwich (1217)
paragraphs: The Battle of Sandwich, also called the Battle of Dover took place on 24 August 1217 as part of the First Barons' War. A Plantagenet English fleet commanded by Hubert de Burgh attacked a Capetian French fleet led by Eustace the Monk and Robert of Courtenay off Sandwich, Kent. The English captured the French flagship and most of the supply vessels, forcing the rest of the French fleet to return to Calais.

The French fleet was attempting to bring supplies and reinforcements to Prince Louis, later King Louis VIII of France, whose French forces held London at that time. The English vessels attacked from windward, seizing Eustace's ship, making Robert and the knights prisoner and killing the rest of the crew. Eustace, a notorious pirate, was executed after being taken prisoner. The battle convinced Prince Louis to abandon his effort to conquer England and the Treaty of Lambeth was signed a few weeks later.

Battle of Santander.headline: Bitka za Santander
paragraphs: Bitka za Santander se je odvila poleti 1937 v okviru kampanje vojne na severu v španski državljanski vojni in se končala z zmago italijanskih in nacionalističnih sil nad republikanci. Padec Santandra 26. avgusta je nacionalistom zagotovil osvojitev province Santander, današnje Kantabrije. Bitka je uničila republikansko »severno armado«; ujetih je bilo 60.000 vojakov, med njimi baskovske sile, ki so se 25. avgusta predale Italijanom.

source.title: Battle of Santander
paragraphs: The Battle of Santander was fought in the War in the North campaign of the Spanish Civil War during the summer of 1937 and saw the victory of Italian and Nationalist forces against the Republicans. Santander's fall on 26 August assured the Nationalist conquest of the province of Santander, now Cantabria. The battle devastated the Republic's "Army of the North"; 60,000 soldiers were captured, among them the Basque forces which surrendered to the Italians on August 25.

Bitka pri São Mamede (portugalsko: Batalha de São Mamede) je potekala 24. junija 1128 blizu Guimarãesa in velja za pomemben dogodek v procesu, ki je privedel do nastanka Portugalske kot samostojnega kraljestva.

Sile pod vodstvom Afonsa Henriquesa so premagale sile njegove matere Terezije Portugalske in Fernãa Peresa de Trave. Afonso je sicer prevzel nadzor nad grofijo Portugalsko, a je ostal vazal leonsko-kastiljskega kralja Alfonza VII., ki je bil formalno nadoblastnik grofije.

Afonso Henriques je po bitki utrdil nadzor nad grofijo Portugalsko. Po zmagi v bitki pri Ouriqueu leta 1139 je prevzel naslov portugalskega kralja, leonsko-kastiljski kralj Alfonz VII. pa je njegov kraljevski naslov priznal z zamorsko pogodbo leta 1143.

source.title: Battle of São Mamede
paragraphs: The Battle of São Mamede (Portuguese: Batalha de São Mamede) took place on 24 June 1128 near Guimarães and is considered an important event in the process that led to the establishment of Portugal as an independent kingdom.

Forces led by Afonso Henriques defeated forces led by his mother, Theresa of Portugal, and Fernão Peres de Trava. Though he took control of the County of Portugal, he remained a vassal of King Alfonso VII of León and Castile, who was nominally the overlord of the county.

Following the battle, Afonso Henriques consolidated his control over the County of Portugal. He later adopted the title of King of Portugal, following his victory at the Battle of Ourique in 1139, and his royal title was recognized by Alfonso VII of León and Castile in the Treaty of Zamora in 1143.

Bitka pri Zaragozi 20. avgusta 1710 je potekala v vojni za špansko nasledstvo blizu Zaragoze v Španiji. Sile velike alianse pod Guidom Starhembergom, med katerimi so bile tudi habsburške španske enote, so hudo porazile nekoliko šibkejšo francosko-burbonsko špansko vojsko pod poveljstvom markiza de Baya.

Zmaga je zaveznikom omogočila vstop v Madrid, a so se morali zaradi pomanjkanja zalog umakniti, porazi pri Brihuegi novembra in pri Villaviciosi decembra pa so dejansko pokopali upanje, da bi odstavili španskega kralja Filipa V. Markiz de Bay se je s silami alianse spopadel že prej: uspešno je oblegal Ciudad Rodrigo in jih premagal pri La Gudiñi. Bitka pri Zaragozi je Starhemberga uvrstila med sposobne poveljnike svojega časa.
notes: The English text spells the marquis both de Bay and de Bey; the Slovenian uses de Bay throughout.

source.title: Battle of Saragossa
paragraphs: The Battle of Saragossa, 20 August 1710, took place during the War of the Spanish Succession, near Zaragoza in Spain. A slightly inferior Franco-Bourbon Spanish army commanded by the Marquis de Bay was severely defeated by a Grand Alliance force under Guido Starhemberg, which included Habsburg Spanish troops.

Victory allowed the Allies to enter Madrid, but lack of supplies forced them to retreat, while defeats at Brihuega in November and Villaviciosa in December effectively ended hopes of deposing Philip V of Spain. The Marquis de Bey had already faced the forces of the alliance; he had successfully besieged Ciudad Rodrigo and defeated them at La Gudiña. Saragossa placed Starhemberg among the capable commanders from his time.

Battle of Sarantaporo.headline: Bitka pri Sarantaporu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sarantaporu, prečrkovano tudi Sarantaporon ali Sarandaporon (grško: Μάχη του Σαρανταπόρου; turško: Sarandapor Muharebesi), je potekala 9. in 10. oktobra 1912. Bila je prva večja bitka med grškimi silami pod vodstvom prestolonaslednika Konstantina in osmanskimi silami pod vodstvom generala Hasana Tahsin-paše v prvi balkanski vojni. Začela se je, ko je grška vojska napadla osmansko obrambno črto na prelazu Sarantaporo, ki je povezoval Tesalijo z osrednjo Makedonijo.

Branilci so prelaz imeli za neosvojljiv, vendar je glavnina grških sil prodrla globoko vanj, pomožne enote pa so prebile osmanska krila. Osmani so se bali obkolitve in so obrambno črto ponoči zapustili. Grška zmaga pri Sarantaporu je odprla pot do zavzetja Servie in Kozanija.

source.title: Battle of Sarantaporo
paragraphs: The Battle of Sarantaporo, also variously transliterated as Sarantaporon or Sarandaporon (Greek: Μάχη του Σαρανταπόρου, Turkish: Sarandapor Muharebesi), took place on 9–10 October, 1912. It was the first major battle fought between Greek forces under Crown Prince Constantine and Ottoman forces under General Hasan Tahsin Pasha during the First Balkan War. The battle began when the Greek army attacked the Ottoman defensive line at the Sarantaporo pass, which connected Thessaly with central Macedonia.

Despite being perceived as impregnable by its defenders, the main body of the Greek forces managed to advance deep inside the pass, while auxiliary units broke through the Ottoman flanks.
