The Ottomans abandoned their defensive line during the night, fearing encirclement. The Greek victory at Sarantaporo opened the way for the capture of Servia and Kozani.

Battle of Sarmizegetusa.headline: Bitka pri Sarmizegetusi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sarmizegetusi (tudi Sarmizegethuza) je bila obleganje Sarmizegetuse, prestolnice Dakije, v drugi Trajanovi dačanski vojni leta 106, med vojsko rimskega cesarja Trajana in Dačani pod vodstvom kralja Decebala.

source.title: Battle of Sarmizegetusa
paragraphs: The Battle of Sarmizegetusa (also spelled Sarmizegethuza) was a siege of Sarmizegetusa, the capital of Dacia, fought in Trajan's Second Dacian War in 106 between the army of the Roman Emperor Trajan, and the Dacians led by King Decebalus.

Battle of Savra.headline: Bitka pri Savri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Savri (albansko: Beteja e Savrës; srbsko: Bitka na Saurskom polju; turško: Savra Muharebesi) ali bitka ob Vjosi je potekala 18. septembra 1385 med osmanskimi in precej manjšimi zetskimi silami na polju Savra blizu Lushnjë (na jugu današnje Albanije). Osmane je na pomoč v sporu z Balšo II. poklical Karl Thopia.
notes: The English gloss of the Serbian name ("Battle on the Saurian field") is left out; the Serbian is close enough to read.

source.title: Battle of Savra
paragraphs: The Battle of Savra (Albanian: Beteja e Savrës; Serbian: Bitka na Saurskom polju; Turkish: Savra Muharebesi; "Battle on the Saurian field") or the Battle of the Vjosë was fought on 18 September 1385 between Ottoman and much smaller Zetan forces, at the Savra field near Lushnjë (in modern-day southern Albania). The Ottomans were invited by Karl Thopia to support him in his feud against Balša II.

Battle of Schellenberg.headline: Bitka pri Schellenbergu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Schellenbergu je potekala 2. julija 1704 med vojno za špansko nasledstvo. Spopad je bil del pohoda vojvode Marlborougha, s katerim je hotel habsburško prestolnico Dunaj rešiti pred grozečim prodorom francosko-bavarskih sil kralja Ludvika XIV. v južni Nemčiji. Marlborough je 8. maja začel 400 km dolg pohod iz Bedburga blizu Kölna; v petih tednih je svoje sile združil s silami badenskega mejnega grofa, nato pa nadaljeval pot do Donave. V južni Nemčiji je bila naloga zaveznikov, da bavarskega volilnega kneza Maksimilijana II. Emanuela pripravijo do tega, da se odpove zvestobi Ludviku XIV. in se znova pridruži veliki alianci; da bi to izsilili, pa so morali zavezniki najprej zavarovati utrjeno mostišče in skladišče ob Donavi, prek katerega bi oskrba lahko prešla na južno stran reke v osrčje dežel volilnega kneza. V ta namen je Marlborough izbral mesto Donauwörth.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Schellenberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Schellenberg took place on 2 July 1704 during the War of the Spanish Succession. The engagement was part of the Duke of Marlborough's campaign to save the Habsburg capital of Vienna from a threatened advance by King Louis XIV's Franco-Bavarian forces ranged in southern Germany. Marlborough had commenced his 250-mile (400 km) march from Bedburg, near Cologne, on 8 May; within five weeks he had linked his forces with those of the Margrave of Baden, before continuing on to the river Danube. Once in southern Germany, the Allies' task was to induce Maximilian II Emanuel, Elector of Bavaria, to abandon his allegiance to Louis XIV and rejoin the Grand Alliance; but to force the issue, the Allies first needed to secure a fortified bridgehead and magazine on the Danube, through which their supplies could cross to the south of the river into the heart of the Elector's lands. For this purpose, Marlborough selected the town of Donauwörth.

Battle of Scheveningen.headline: Bitka pri Scheveningnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Scheveningnu je bila zadnja pomorska bitka prve angleško-nizozemske vojne. Potekala je 31. julija 1653 med flotama Angleške republike in Nizozemske republike. Nizozemska flota je utrpela hude izgube.

source.title: Battle of Scheveningen
paragraphs: The Battle of Scheveningen was the final naval battle of the First Anglo-Dutch War. It took place on 31 July 1653 between the fleets of the Commonwealth of England and the Dutch Republic. The Dutch fleet suffered heavy losses.

Battle of Schleiz.headline: Bitka pri Schleizu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Schleizu je potekala 9. oktobra 1806 v Schleizu v Nemčiji med prusko-saško divizijo pod vodstvom Bogislava Friedricha Emanuela von Tauentziena in delom I. korpusa Jean-Baptista Bernadotta pod poveljstvom Jean-Baptista Droueta, grofa d'Erlona. Bila je prvi spopad vojne četrte koalicije, dela napoleonskih vojn. Ko je velika armada francoskega cesarja Napoleona I. prodirala proti severu skozi Frankovski gozd, je udarila na levo krilo vojsk Kraljevine Prusije in Saške volilne kneževine, ki so bile razporejene na dolgi fronti. Schleiz leži 30 kilometrov severno od Hofa in 145 kilometrov jugozahodno od Dresdna na križišču cest 2 in 94.

source.title: Battle of Schleiz
paragraphs: The Battle of Schleiz took place on 9 October 1806 in Schleiz, Germany between a Prussian-Saxon division under Bogislav Friedrich Emanuel von Tauentzien and a part of Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte's I Corps under the command of Jean-Baptiste Drouet, Comte d'Erlon. It was the first clash of the War of the Fourth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. As Emperor Napoleon I of France's Grande Armée advanced north through the Franconian Forest it struck the left wing of the armies belonging to the Kingdom of Prussia and the Electorate of Saxony, which were deployed on a long front. Schleiz is located 30 kilometers north of Hof and 145 kilometers southwest of Dresden at the intersection of Routes 2 and 94.

Battle of Schöngrabern.headline: Bitka pri Schöngrabernu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Schöngrabernu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Hollabrunnu, je bila spopad napoleonskih vojn med vojno tretje koalicije, ki je potekal 16. novembra 1805 blizu Hollabrunna v Spodnji Avstriji, štiri tedne po bitki pri Ulmu in dva tedna pred bitko pri Slavkovu (Austerlitz) na Moravskem, danes v Češki republiki.

source.title: Battle of Schöngrabern
paragraphs: The Battle of Schöngrabern, also known as the Battle of Hollabrunn, was an engagement in the Napoleonic Wars during the War of the Third Coalition, fought on 16 November 1805 near Hollabrunn in Lower Austria, four weeks after the Battle of Ulm and two weeks before the Battle of Austerlitz (Slavkov, Moravia - now Czech Republic).

Bitka pri Sedanu, znana tudi kot prva bitka pri Sedanu, je potekala med francosko-prusko vojno od 1. do 2. septembra 1870. Ujeti so bili cesar Napoleon III. in več kot sto tisoč vojakov, s tem pa je bila vojna dejansko odločena v korist Prusije in njenih zaveznikov; boji so se sicer nadaljevali pod novo francosko vlado.

Châlonska armada s 130.000 možmi, ki ji je poveljeval maršal Patrice de MacMahon in jo je spremljal Napoleon III., je skušala prekiniti obleganje Metza, a jo je dohitela pruska 4. armada in jo 30. avgusta porazila v bitki pri Beaumontu. Pruska 4. in 3. armada sta pod poveljstvom generalfeldmaršala Helmutha von Moltkeja, ob navzočnosti pruskega kralja Viljema I. in pruskega kanclerja Otta von Bismarcka, MacMahonovo vojsko pri Sedanu obkolili v uničevalni bitki. Maršal MacMahon je bil med napadi ranjen in poveljstvo je prešlo na generala Auguste-Alexandra Ducrota, nato pa ga je prevzel general Emmanuel Félix de Wimpffen.

source.title: Battle of Sedan
paragraphs: The Battle of Sedan, also known as the First Battle of Sedan, was fought during the Franco-Prussian War from 1 to 2 September 1870. Resulting in the capture of Emperor Napoleon III and over a hundred thousand troops, it effectively decided the war in favour of Prussia and its allies; however, fighting continued under a new French government.

The 130,000-strong French Army of Châlons, commanded by Marshal Patrice de MacMahon and accompanied by Napoleon III, was attempting to lift the siege of Metz, only to be caught by the Prussian Fourth Army and defeated at the Battle of Beaumont on 30 August. Commanded by Generalfeldmarschall Helmuth von Moltke and accompanied by Prussian King Wilhelm I and Prussian Chancellor Otto von Bismarck, the Fourth Army and the Prussian Third Army encircled MacMahon's army at Sedan in a battle of annihilation. Marshal MacMahon was wounded during the attacks and command passed to General Auguste-Alexandre Ducrot, until it was assumed by General Emmanuel Félix de Wimpffen.

Battle of Sedan (1940).headline: Bitka pri Sedanu (1940)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sedanu ali druga bitka pri Sedanu (12.–15. maja 1940) je potekala v drugi svetovni vojni med bitko za Francijo leta 1940. Bila je del operativnega načrta nemškega Wehrmachta s kodnim imenom Fall Gelb (primer Rumeno) za ofenzivo skozi hribovite in gozdnate Ardene, s katero naj bi obkolili zavezniške vojske v Belgiji in na severovzhodu Francije. Nemška armadna skupina A je prečkala Mozo, da bi zavzela Sedan in prodirala proti zahodu do obale Rokavskega preliva ter ujela zavezniške sile, ki so v okviru zavezniškega načrta Dyle prodirale na vzhod v Belgijo.

source.title: Battle of Sedan (1940)
paragraphs: The Battle of Sedan or Second Battle of Sedan (12–15 May 1940) took place in World War II during the Battle of France in 1940. It was part of the German Wehrmacht's operational plan codenamed Fall Gelb (Case Yellow) for an offensive through the hilly and forested Ardennes to encircle the Allied armies in Belgium and north-eastern France. German Army Group A crossed the Meuse with the intention of capturing Sedan and pushing westwards towards the Channel coast, to trap the Allied forces that were advancing east into Belgium as part of the Allied Dyle Plan.

Battle of Sedgemoor.headline: Bitka pri Sedgemooru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sedgemooru je bila zadnji in odločilni spopad Monmouthovega upora med silami, zvestimi Jakobu II., in uporniškimi silami pod vodstvom vojvode Monmoutha. Potekala je 6. julija 1685 pri Westonzoylandu blizu Bridgwatra v Somersetu v Angliji.

Bitki je predhodila vrsta prask med obema silama na jugozahodu Anglije. Sile kralja Jakoba so zmagale in zajele okoli 500 ujetnikov. Monmouth je pobegnil z bojišča, a so ga ujeli, odpeljali v London in devet dni pozneje usmrtili. Številnim Monmouthovim privržencem so sodili na krvavih sodnih zasedanjih (Bloody Assizes). Veliko so jih izgnali v tujino, druge pa usmrtili z vlečenjem in razčetverjenjem.

source.title: Battle of Sedgemoor
paragraphs: The Battle of Sedgemoor was the final and decisive engagement of the Monmouth Rebellion, between forces loyal to James II and rebel forces led by the Duke of Monmouth. It was fought on 6 July 1685 at Westonzoyland near Bridgwater in Somerset, England.

The battle followed a series of skirmishes around south-west England between these two forces. King James' forces won the battle, and took about 500 prisoners. Monmouth escaped from the battlefield but was captured, taken to London and executed nine days later. Many of Monmouth's supporters were tried during the Bloody Assizes. Many were transported abroad, while others were executed by drawing and quartering.

Battle of Șelimbăr.headline: Bitka pri Șelimbăru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Șelimbăru ali bitka pri Sellenberku (madžarsko: Sellenberk; nemško: Schellenberg) je potekala 18. oktobra 1599 med vlaško vojsko Mihaela Hrabrega (romunsko: Mihai Viteazul) in transilvansko-ogrsko vojsko Andreja Báthoryja (madžarsko: Báthory András). Bojevali so se blizu vasi Șelimbăr (madžarsko: Sellenberk) v bližini Sibiua (nemško: Hermannstadt; madžarsko: Nagyszeben).

source.title: Battle of Șelimbăr
paragraphs: The Battle of Șelimbăr, or Battle of Sellenberk (Hungarian: Sellenberk; German: Schellenberg), took place on 18 October 1599 between the Wallachian army of Michael the Brave (Romanian: Mihai Viteazul) and the Transylvanian-Hungarian army of Andrew Báthory (Hungarian: Báthory András). The battle was fought near the village of Șelimbăr (Hungarian: Sellenberk) close to Sibiu (German: Hermannstadt; Hungarian: Nagyszeben).

Battle of Selinus.headline: Bitka pri Selinuntu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Selinuntu, ki je potekala v začetku leta 409 pr. n. št., je bila uvodna bitka tako imenovane druge sicilske vojne. Desetdnevno obleganje in bitka sta potekala na Siciliji med kartažanskimi silami pod Hanibalom Magom (kraljem Kartagine iz rodbine Magonidov, ne slavnim Hanibalom iz rodbine Barkidov) in dorskimi Grki iz Selinunta. Selinunt je leta 415 premagal elimsko mesto Segesto, kar je pripeljalo do atenske invazije na Sicilijo istega leta, ki se je končala s porazom atenskih sil leta 413. Ko je Selinunt leta 411 Segesto spet premagal, se je Kartagina odzvala na prošnjo Segeste: ker so Grki zavrnili njeno ponudbo pogajanj, je Selinunt oblegala in izropala. To je bil prvi korak Hanibalove kampanje, s katero je hotel maščevati kartažanski poraz v prvi bitki pri Himeri leta 480 pr. n. št. Selinunt so pozneje obnovili, a nekdanjega položaja ni nikoli več dosegel.

source.title: Battle of Selinus
paragraphs: The Battle of Selinus, which took place early in 409 BC, is the opening battle of the so-called Second Sicilian War. The ten-day-long siege and battle was fought in Sicily between the Carthaginian forces under Hannibal Mago (a king of Carthage of the Magonid family, not the famous Hannibal of the Barcid family) and the Dorian Greeks of Selinus. The city of Selinus had defeated the Elymian city of Segesta in 415, an event that led to the Athenian invasion of Sicily in 415 and ended in the defeat of Athenian forces in 413. When Selinus again worsted Segesta in 411, Carthage, responding to the appeal of Segesta, had besieged and sacked Selinus after the Carthaginian offer of negotiations had been refused by the Greeks. This was the first step towards Hannibal's campaign to avenge the Carthaginian defeat at the first battle of Himera in 480. The city of Selinus was later rebuilt, but never regained her former status.

Battle of Sellasia.headline: Bitka pri Selaziji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Selaziji je potekala poleti 222 pr. n. št. med Makedonijo in Ahajsko zvezo pod vodstvom Antigona III. Dosona ter Šparto pod poveljstvom kralja Kleomena III. Bojevali so se pri Selaziji na severni meji Lakonije, bitka pa se je končala z makedonsko-ahajsko zmago.

Kleomen je leta 229 pr. n. št. začel sovražnosti proti Ahajski zvezi, vodilni sili na Peloponezu. V vrsti pohodov je Ahajce premagal in Šparto naredil za glavno regionalno silo. Zato se je vodilni mož Ahajske zveze, Arat iz Sikiona, za vojaško pomoč obrnil na makedonskega kralja Antigona III. Dosona. Makedonci so privolili pod pogojem, da jim Ahajci predajo mogočno trdnjavo Akrokorint. Leta 224 pr. n. št. so na čelu grškega zavezništva vdrli na Peloponez in do leta 222 pr. n. št. Kleomena zaprli v Lakonijo.

source.title: Battle of Sellasia
paragraphs: The Battle of Sellasia took place during the summer of 222 BC between Macedon and the Achaean League, led by Antigonus III Doson, and Sparta under the command of King Cleomenes III. The battle was fought at Sellasia, on the northern frontier of Laconia and ended in a Macedonian-Achaean victory.

In 229 BC, Cleomenes initiated hostilities against the Achaean League, the dominant power of the Peloponnese. In a series of campaigns, Cleomenes was successful in defeating the Achaeans, making Sparta the main regional power. This prompted the chief figure of the Achaean League, Aratus of Sicyon, to approach the King of Macedon, Antigonus III Doson, for military assistance. The Macedonians acquiesced on the terms that the Achaean surrender the formidable fortress of Acrocorinth to them. The Macedonians invaded the Peloponnese in 224 BC at the head of a Greek alliance and by 222 BC managed to hem Cleomenes in Laconia.

Battle of Sempach.headline: Bitka pri Sempachu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sempachu je potekala 9. julija 1386 med avstrijskim vojvodo Leopoldom III. in staro švicarsko konfederacijo. Bila je odločilna švicarska zmaga, v kateri so padli vojvoda Leopold in številni avstrijski plemiči. Zmaga je pripomogla k temu, da se je ohlapno povezana švicarska konfederacija spremenila v bolj enotno državo, in velja za prelomnico v razvoju Švice.

source.title: Battle of Sempach
paragraphs: The Battle of Sempach was fought on 9 July 1386, between Leopold III, Duke of Austria and the Old Swiss Confederacy. The battle was a decisive Swiss victory in which Duke Leopold and numerous Austrian nobles died. The victory helped turn the loosely allied Swiss Confederation into a more unified nation and is seen as a turning point in the growth of Switzerland.

Battle of Seneffe.headline: Bitka pri Seneffu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Seneffu je potekala 11. avgusta 1674 med francosko-nizozemsko vojno blizu Seneffa v Belgiji, tedaj delu Španske Nizozemske. Francoska vojska pod poveljstvom Condéja se je spopadla z združenimi nizozemskimi, cesarskimi in španskimi silami pod vodstvom Viljema Oranskega. Bila je ena najkrvavejših bitk vojne: izgube so na obeh straneh presegle 20 % udeležencev, izid pa je sporen.

Leta 1674 so imele zavezniške sile na Španski Nizozemski številčno premoč nad francosko vojsko pod Condéjem, ki je bila nameščena ob reki Piéton blizu Charleroija. Viljem je prešel v napad in skušal izsiliti bitko z obhodom francoskih položajev, a ga je razgiban teren prisilil, da je vojsko razdelil v tri ločene kolone.

source.title: Battle of Seneffe
paragraphs: The Battle of Seneffe, 11 August 1674, took place during the Franco-Dutch War, near Seneffe in Belgium, then part of the Spanish Netherlands. A French army commanded by Condé confronted a combined Dutch, Imperial, and Spanish force under William of Orange. One of the bloodiest battles of the war, over 20% of those engaged on both sides became casualties, and the result is disputed.

By 1674, Allied forces in the Spanish Netherlands were numerically superior to the French army under Condé, which was based along the Piéton river near Charleroi. William took the offensive and sought to bring on a battle by outflanking the French positions, but the broken ground forced him to divide his army into three separate columns.

Battle of Sentinum.headline: Bitka pri Sentinumu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sentinumu je bila odločilna bitka tretje samnitske vojne, ki je potekala leta 295 pr. n. št. blizu Sentinuma (ob današnjem mestu Sassoferrato v italijanski deželi Marke). V njej so Rimljani premagali mogočno koalicijo Samnitov, Etruščanov, Umbrov in galskih Senonov. Odločilna rimska zmaga je koalicijo plemen razbila (Etruščani, Umbri in Senoni so se umaknili iz vojne) in utrla pot popolni rimski zmagi nad Samniti. Rimskim silam v bitki sta poveljevala konzula Publij Decij Mus in Kvint Fabij Maksim Rulijan.

source.title: Battle of Sentinum
paragraphs: The Battle of Sentinum was the decisive battle of the Third Samnite War, fought in 295 BC near Sentinum (next to the modern town of Sassoferrato, in the Marches region of Italy), in which the Romans overcame a formidable coalition of Samnites, Etruscans, Umbrians, and Senone Gauls. The Romans won a decisive victory that broke up the tribal coalition (the Etruscans, Umbrians, and Senones pulled out of the war) and paved the way for the Romans' complete victory over the Samnites. The Romans involved in the battle of Sentinum were commanded by consuls Publius Decius Mus and Quintus Fabius Maximus Rullianus.

Battle of Sepeia.headline: Bitka pri Sepeji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sepeji (starogrško: Σήπεια; ok. 494 pr. n. št.) se je končala z zmago špartanskih sil Kleomena I. nad Argivci, ki je dokončno utrdila špartansko prevlado na Peloponezu. Bitka pri Sepeji je zloglasna, ker je imela največ žrtev med vsemi bitkami grškega klasičnega obdobja.

source.title: Battle of Sepeia
paragraphs: At the Battle of Sepeia (Ancient Greek: Σήπεια; c. 494 BC), the Spartan forces of Cleomenes I defeated the Argives, fully establishing Spartan dominance in the Peloponnese. The Battle of Sepeia is infamous for having the highest number of casualties within a battle during the classical Greek period.

Battle of Settepozzi.headline: Bitka pri Settepozziju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Settepozziju je potekala v prvi polovici leta 1263 pri grškem otoku Settepozzi (srednjeveško italijansko ime za Spetses) med genovsko-bizantinskim ladjevjem in manjšim beneškim ladjevjem.

Genova in Bizantinci so bili zavezniki proti Benetkam od nimfejske pogodbe leta 1261, Genova pa se je z Benetkami od leta 1256 bojevala tudi v vojni svetega Sabe. Leta 1263 je genovsko ladjevje 48 ladij, ki je plulo proti bizantinski utrdbi Monemvaziji, naletelo na beneško ladjevje 32 ladij. Genovežani so se odločili za napad, vendar sta v spopadu sodelovala le dva od štirih admiralov genovskega ladjevja in 14 ladij, ki so jih Benečani zlahka pognali v beg, zajeli štiri ladje in jim prizadejali precejšnje izgube.

source.title: Battle of Settepozzi
paragraphs: The Battle of Settepozzi was fought in the first half of 1263 off the Greek island of Settepozzi (the medieval Italian name for Spetses) between a Genoese–Byzantine fleet and a smaller Venetian fleet.

Genoa and the Byzantines had been allied against Venice since the Treaty of Nymphaeum in 1261, while Genoa, in particular, had been engaged in the War of Saint Sabas against Venice from 1256. In 1263, a Genoese fleet of 48 ships, which was sailing to the Byzantine stronghold of Monemvasia, encountered a Venetian fleet of 32 ships. The Genoese decided to attack, but only two of the four admirals of the Genoese fleet and 14 of its ships took part in the engagement, and were easily routed by the Venetians, who captured four vessels and inflicted considerable casualties.

Battle of Sheriffmuir.headline: Bitka pri Sheriffmuirju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sheriffmuirju (škotsko gelsko: Blàr Sliabh an t-Siorraim) je bila spopad leta 1715 na vrhuncu jakobitskega upora na Škotskem. Bojišče je vpisano v Popis zgodovinskih bojišč na Škotskem in ga po škotski politiki zgodovinskega okolja iz leta 2009 varuje ustanova Historic Scotland. Sheriffmuir je odmaknjena dvignjena planota resave med Stirlingom in Auchterarderjem na severnem robu gričevja Ochil Hills.
notes: The Gaelic pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Sheriffmuir
paragraphs: The Battle of Sheriffmuir (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Sliabh an t-Siorraim, [pl̪ˠaɾ ˈʃʎiəv əɲ ˈtʲʰirˠəm]) was an engagement in 1715 at the height of the Jacobite rising in Scotland. The battlefield has been included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and protected by Historic Scotland under the Scottish Historical Environment Policy of 2009. Sheriffmuir is a remote elevated plateau of moorland lying between Stirling and Auchterarder on the north fringe of the Ochil Hills.

Battle of Shipka Pass.headline: Bitka na prelazu Šipka
paragraphs: Bitka na prelazu Šipka je obsegala štiri bitke, v katerih sta se med rusko-turško vojno (1877–1878) za nadzor nad pomembnim prelazom Šipka bojevala Rusko cesarstvo, ki so mu pomagali bolgarski prostovoljci, imenovani opalčenci, in Osmansko cesarstvo. Zadnja bitka je znana kot bitka pri Šipki in Šejnovu ali preprosto bitka pri Šejnovu (rusko: Шипко-Шейновское сражение; bolgarsko: Шейновска битка).

source.title: Battle of Shipka Pass
paragraphs: The Battle of Shipka Pass consisted of four battles that were fought between the Russian Empire, aided by Bulgarian volunteers known as opalchentsi, and the Ottoman Empire for control over the vital Shipka Pass during the Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878). The final battle is known as the battle of Shipka-Sheynovo or simply the battle of Sheynovo (Russian: Шипко-Шейновское сражение; Bulgarian: Шейновска битка).

Battle of Shrewsbury.headline: Bitka pri Shrewsburyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Shrewsburyju je potekala 21. julija 1403 med vojsko lancastrskega kralja Henrika IV. in uporniško vojsko pod vodstvom Henryja »Harryja Hotspurja« Percyja iz Northumberlanda. Bitka, prva, v kateri so se angleški lokostrelci bojevali drug proti drugemu na angleških tleh, je znova potrdila učinkovitost dolgega loka in končala Percyjev izziv angleškemu kralju Henriku IV. Del bojev naj bi potekal na območju današnjega kraja Battlefield v Shropshiru v Angliji, tri milje (5 km) severno od središča Shrewsburyja. Danes ga zaznamujeta cerkev Battlefield Church in dediščinski park Battlefield Heritage Park.

source.title: Battle of Shrewsbury
paragraphs: The Battle of Shrewsbury was fought on 21 July 1403, waged between an army led by the Lancastrian King Henry IV and a rebel army led by Henry "Harry Hotspur" Percy from Northumberland. The battle, the first in which English archers fought each other on English soil, reaffirmed the effectiveness of the longbow and ended the Percy challenge to King Henry IV of England. Part of the fighting is believed to have taken place at what is now Battlefield, Shropshire, England, three miles (5 km) north of the centre of Shrewsbury. It is marked today by Battlefield Church and Battlefield Heritage Park.

Battle of Simancas.headline: Bitka pri Simancasu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Simancasu (imenovana tudi Alhandega ali al Handak) je bila vojaška bitka, ki se je 19. julija 939 začela na Iberskem polotoku med enotami leonskega kralja Ramira II. in kordobskega kalifa Abd al Rahmana III. pod obzidjem mesta Simancas.

Bitka se je razvila, potem ko je vojska Abd al Rahmana III. leta 934 krenila proti severnim krščanskim ozemljem. Abd al Rahman III. je s pomočjo andaluzijskega upravitelja Zaragoze Mohameda ibn Jahje al Tudžibija zbral veliko kalifsko vojsko. Leonski kralj Ramiro II. je vodil protinapad z vojsko, ki so jo sestavljale njegove lastne enote, kastiljske pod grofom Fernánom Gonzálezom in navarske pod Garcío Sánchezom I.
Mavrski pričevalci so zabeležili veličasten sončni mrk, ki se je zgodil prvi dan bitke.
notes: The English excerpt ends with a colon before a quotation it leaves out; the Slovenian ends the sentence with a full stop.

source.title: Battle of Simancas
paragraphs: The Battle of Simancas (also called Alhandega or al-Khandaq) was a military battle that started on 19 July 939 in the Iberian Peninsula between the troops of the King of León Ramiro II and Cordovan caliph Abd al-Rahman III near the walls of the city of Simancas.

The battle unfolded after the army of Abd al-Rahman III launched toward the northern Christian territories in 934. Abd al-Rahman III had gathered a large army of caliphal fighters, with the help of the Andalusi governor of Zaragoza, Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Tujibi. The Leonese king Ramiro II led the counterattack with an army consisting of his own troops, those of Castile under Count Fernán González, and the Navarrese under García Sánchez I.
Moorish witnesses chronicle a spectacular eclipse of the sun that took place on the first day of the battle:

Battle of Sinsheim.headline: Bitka pri Sinsheimu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sinsheimu je potekala 16. junija 1674 blizu Sinsheima v današnjem Baden-Württembergu, tedaj v Svetem rimskem cesarstvu. V njej, delu francosko-nizozemske vojne 1672–1678, je francoska vojska pod vodstvom maršala Turenna premagala cesarske sile pod vodstvom Aeneasa de Caprare.

Vojna se je začela maja 1672, ko je francoska vojska vdrla v Nizozemsko republiko. Avgusta 1673 so se Nizozemci zavezali s cesarjem Leopoldom, s čimer se je odprlo novo bojišče v Porenju. Za pohod leta 1674 je Turenne dobil ukaz, naj cesarskim četam prepreči vstop v sporno Alzacijo; ker je imel proti sebi več ločenih vojsk, ki so bile skupaj številčnejše od njegove, je skušal nasprotnike premagati posamično.

Turenne je 16. junija 1674 prestregel nekoliko večji cesarski odred s približno 8500 možmi, ki je bil na poti, da bi se blizu Heidelberga pridružil Alexandru von Bournonvillu in glavni cesarski vojski. De Caprara je odbil prva dva francoska napada, nato pa se umaknil; Turenne mu ni mogel preprečiti, da bi se združil z von Bournonvillom, prizadejal pa mu je hude izgube in nato v pohodu prevzel strateško pobudo.

source.title: Battle of Sinsheim
paragraphs: The Battle of Sinsheim took place on 16 June 1674, near Sinsheim in modern Baden-Württemberg, then in the Holy Roman Empire. Part of the 1672 to 1678 Franco-Dutch War, a French army under Marshall Turenne defeated an Imperial force led by Aeneas de Caprara.

The war began in May 1672, when a French army invaded the Dutch Republic. In August 1673, the Dutch agreed an alliance with Emperor Leopold, opening a new theatre of operations in the Rhineland. For the 1674 campaign, Turenne was ordered to prevent Imperial troops entering the contested area of Alsace; facing a number of separate forces which outnumbered his in total, he sought to defeat his opponents piecemeal.

On 16 June 1674, Turenne intercepted a slightly larger Imperial detachment of around 8,500 men, on its way to join Alexander von Bournonville and their main army near Heidelberg. De Caprara managed to repulse the first two French assaults before withdrawing; although unable to prevent him linking up with von Bournonville, Turenne inflicted heavy casualties, and thereafter gained the strategic initiative in the campaign.

Battle of Skalitz.headline: Bitka pri Skalitzu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Skalitzu je bila manjši spopad pohoda pri Königgrätzu oziroma Sadovi v avstrijsko-pruski vojni leta 1866 na Češkem 28. junija. Po pruski zmagi v bitki pri Náchodu dan prej (27. junija) so pruske sile pod vodstvom pehotnega generala Steinmetza prodrle proti Skalitzu (Česká Skalice) in premagale sile nadvojvode Leopolda.

source.title: Battle of Skalitz
paragraphs: The Battle of Skalitz was a minor engagement in the Königgratz/Sadowa campaign of the Austro-Prussian War of 1866 in Bohemia on 28 June. Following the Prussian victory at the Battle of Náchod the previous day (27 June), the Prussian forces, led by General of the Infantry Steinmetz, advanced on Skalitz (Česká Skalice) and defeated the forces of Archduke Leopold.

Battle of Skopje.headline: Bitka pri Skopju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Skopju je potekala leta 1004 med bizantinskim ponovnim osvajanjem Bolgarije. Bizantinci so pohod vodili počasi in sistematično, včasih tudi vse leto, ne le po ustaljenem sezonskem vzorcu. Bazilij II. se je za dolgotrajno vojskovanje odločil predvsem zato, ker je spoznal, da Bolgarije ni mogoče osvojiti v enem samem pohodu. Cesar je raje izvajal sistematičen in nenehen pritisk, s katerim je pridobil nadzor nad ključnimi trdnjavami. Najprej si je zagotovil Serdiko (današnjo Sofijo), nato pa prodrl proti severu, da bi Samuelu odrezal dostop do nekdanjih bolgarskih osrednjih dežel okoli Preslava. Ko je bilo to območje v njegovih rokah, so bizantinske sile iz Serdike krenile na jug v Makedonijo, zavzele Berojo in znova odprle pot v Grčijo. Bizantinsko oblast so kmalu obnovili v Tesaliji in delih vzhodne Makedonije, tudi v Vodnu. Bazilij je nato začel veliko ofenzivo proti severu do Donave, ki se je končala z zavzetjem Vidina po osemmesečnem obleganju. Medtem je Samuel osebno vodil pohod skozi znova osvojena ozemlja in za kratek čas zavzel Odrin, ki ga je izropal, a ga ni mogel obdržati.

source.title: Battle of Skopje
paragraphs: The Battle of Skopje was a battle in 1004 during the Byzantine reconquest of Bulgaria. The campaign was carried out in a slow and systematic manner, with campaigns sometimes continuing year-round rather than following the traditional seasonal pattern. The primary reason for mounting a long campaign was the realization by Basil II that Bulgaria could not be conquered in a single campaign. Instead the emperor chose to employ systematic and constant pressure, resulting in gaining control over crucial fortresses. He first secured Sardika (modern Sofia) and then advanced north to sever Samuil's access to the former Bulgarian heartlands around Preslav. Once this area was under control, Byzantine forces moved south from Sardika into Macedonia, capturing Berrhoia and reopening the route to Greece. Byzantine authority was soon restored in Thessaly and in parts of eastern Macedonia, including Voden. Basil then launched a major offensive northward toward the Danube, culminating in the capture of Vidin after an eight-month siege. During this time, Samuil personally led a raid through the reconquered territories and briefly seized Adrianople, which he plundered but was unable to hold.

Battle of Slavutych.headline: Bitka za Slavutič
paragraphs: Bitka za Slavutič je bila spopad med rusko invazijo na Ukrajino v mestu Slavutič, naselju, zgrajenem za delavce v černobilskem izključitvenem območju. Ruske sile so mesto napadle marca 2022 in ukrajinske branilce pregnale iz njega.

source.title: Battle of Slavutych
paragraphs: The Battle of Slavutych was a military engagement that took place during the Russian invasion of Ukraine in the city of Slavutych, a purpose-built settlement for workers in the Chernobyl Exclusion Zone. The city came under attack by Russian forces in March 2022, forcing out Ukrainian defenders.

Battle of Sluys.headline: Bitka pri Sluisu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sluisu je bila pomorska bitka med Anglijo in Francijo 24. junija 1340. Potekala je na sidrišču pristanišča Sluis ob zalivu, ki se je od tedaj zamuljil, v grofiji Flandriji (med današnjima provincama Zelandija na Nizozemskem in Zahodna Flandrija v Belgiji). Angleško floto s 120–150 ladjami je vodil angleški kralj Edvard III., francosko floto z 230 ladjami pa bretonski vitez Hugues Quiéret, admiral Francije, in Nicolas Béhuchet, konetabl Francije. Bitka je bila eden prvih spopadov stoletne vojne.
notes: The English and Dutch pronunciations are dropped.

source.title: Battle of Sluys
paragraphs: The Battle of Sluys ( SLOYZ, Dutch: [slœys]), was a naval battle fought on 24 June 1340 between England and France. It took place in the roadstead of the port of Sluys, on a since silted-up inlet in the county of Flanders (between the current provinces of Zeeland in the Netherlands and West Flanders in Belgium). The English fleet of 120–150 ships was led by Edward III of England and the 230-strong French fleet by the Breton knight Hugues Quiéret, Admiral of France, and Nicolas Béhuchet, Constable of France. The battle was one of the opening engagements of the Hundred Years' War.

Bitka pri Smolensku je bila prva velika bitka francoskega vdora v Rusijo. Potekala je od 16. do 18. avgusta 1812; okoli 45.000 mož velike armade pod vodstvom cesarja Napoleona I. se je spopadlo z okoli 30.000 ruskimi vojaki pod vodstvom generala Barclaya de Tollyja. Napoleon je zasedel Smolensk, potem ko je iz njega pregnal drugo armado kneza Pjotra Bagrationa. Francosko topniško obstreljevanje je mesto požgalo do tal. Od 2250 stavb je bilo uničenih 84 %, nepoškodovanih je ostalo le 350. Od 15.000 prebivalcev mesta jih je ob koncu bitke v kadečih se ruševinah ostalo okoli 1000. Z več kot 15.000 žrtvami je bila ena najbolj krvavih bitk vdora.

source.title: Battle of Smolensk (1812)
paragraphs: The Battle of Smolensk was the first major battle of the French invasion of Russia. It took place on 16–18 August 1812 and involved about 45,000 men of the Grande Armée under Emperor Napoleon I against about 30,000 Russian troops under General Barclay de Tolly. Napoleon occupied Smolensk by driving out Prince Pyotr Bagration's Second Army. The French artillery bombardment burned the city to the ground. Of 2,250 buildings, 84% were destroyed, leaving only 350 intact. Of the city's 15,000 inhabitants, about 1,000 were left at the end of the battle inside the smoking ruins. With over 15,000 casualties, it was one of the bloodiest battles of the invasion.

Prva bitka pri Smolensku (nemško: Kesselschlacht bei Smolensk, dobesedno »kotlovska bitka pri Smolensku«) je bila bitka v drugi fazi operacije Barbarossa, invazije sil osi na Sovjetsko zvezo med drugo svetovno vojno. Potekala je okoli mesta Smolensk, približno 400 km zahodno od Moskve, med 10. julijem in 10. septembrom 1941. Ostheer je v 18 dneh po invaziji 22. junija 1941 prodrl 500 km globoko v ZSSR.

Sovjetske 16., 19. in 20. armada so bile obkoljene in uničene tik vzhodno od Smolenska, čeprav je mnogim možem 19. in 20. armade uspelo pobegniti iz žepa. Bitka je bila za Nemce osupljiv operativni uspeh, vendar je hitro prodiranje na sovjetsko ozemlje povzročilo vse hujše oskrbovalne in logistične krize, saj so bile nemške oskrbovalne linije raztegnjene do skrajnosti. Sovjetski protinapadi sicer niso uspeli, so pa upočasnili napadajoče Nemce in Sovjetom pridobili dragocen čas.
notes: The mile conversions are left out.

source.title: Battle of Smolensk (1941)
paragraphs: The first Battle of Smolensk (German: Kesselschlacht bei Smolensk, lit. 'Cauldron-battle at Smolensk') was a battle during the second phase of Operation Barbarossa, the Axis invasion of the Soviet Union, in World War II. It was fought around the city of Smolensk between 10 July and 10 September 1941, about 400 km (250 mi) west of Moscow. The Ostheer had advanced 500 km (310 mi) into the USSR in the 18 days after the invasion on 22 June 1941.

The Soviet 16th, 19th and the 20th armies were encircled and destroyed just to the east of Smolensk, though many of the men from the 19th and 20th armies managed to escape the pocket. While the battle was a stunning operational success for the Germans, the rapid advances into Soviet territory led to supply and logistics crises of increasing severity, as German supply lines were stretched to their limit. The Soviet counter-attacks, while ultimately unsuccessful, did cause a slowdown of the attacking Germans and bought the Soviets crucial time.

Battle of Soissons (486).headline: Bitka pri Soissonsu (486)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Soissonsu je potekala leta 486 med frankovskimi silami pod vodstvom Klodvika I. in galsko-rimskim gospostvom Soissons pod Siagrijem. Zmagali so Franki in osvojili okrnjeno rimsko državo Soissons, kar je bil mejnik v prizadevanjih Frankov, da bi postali velika regionalna sila. V nekem smislu je bil ta spopad tudi boj za oblast med sinovoma dveh rimskih generalov, ki sta imela pomembno vlogo v poznorimskem obdobju. Včasih ga obravnavajo kot del širše frankovsko-rimske vojne leta 486, ki je vključevala tudi osvojitev severne Galije.
notes: The text uses galsko-rimski for Gallo-Roman; the glossary headline for the Domain of Soissons reads Galsko-romansko gospostvo, which is worth reviewing.

source.title: Battle of Soissons (486)
paragraphs: The Battle of Soissons was fought in 486 between Frankish forces under Clovis I and the Gallo-Roman domain of Soissons under Syagrius. The battle was a victory for the Franks, and led to the conquest of the Roman rump state of Soissons, a milestone for the Franks in their attempt to establish themselves as a major regional power. In a sense, this conflict is also the struggle for power between the sons of two Roman generals who played an important role in the Late Roman period. It is sometimes seen as part of a broader Franco-Roman War of 486, including the conquest of Northern Gaul.

Bitka v Solebayju je potekala 6. junija 1672 po gregorijanskem koledarju v tretji angleško-nizozemski vojni blizu Southwolda v Suffolku na vzhodu Anglije. Nizozemsko ladjevje pod Michielom de Ruyterjem je napadlo združene angleško-francoske sile v eni največjih pomorskih bitk dobe jadrnic. Boji so trajali večji del dneva, a so se ob sončnem zahodu končali brez jasne zmage. Razpršeno zavezniško ladjevje pa je utrpelo precej večjo škodo in je moralo opustiti vse načrte za izkrcanje enot na nizozemski obali.

source.title: Battle of Solebay
paragraphs: The Battle of Solebay took place on 6 June 1672 New Style, during the Third Anglo-Dutch War, near Southwold, Suffolk, in eastern England. A Dutch fleet under Michiel de Ruyter attacked a combined Anglo-French force in one of the largest naval battles of the Age of Sail. Fighting continued much of the day, but ended at sunset without a clear victory. However, the scattered Allied fleet had suffered far more damage and was forced to abandon any plans to land troops on the Dutch coast.
Bitka za Soledar je bila vrsta spopadov v naselju mestnega tipa Soledar in njegovi okolici med bitko za Donbas v rusko-ukrajinski vojni.

Ruske sile so 3. avgusta 2022 začele ofenzivo in obstreljevale Soledar, Bahmut in okoliške vasi na jugu in vzhodu. Ponavljajoči se krajevni ruski napadi na Soledar ali v njegovi bližini so se nadaljevali do oktobra, ukrajinska vojska pa je mnoge odbila. Konec decembra so se boji v regiji večinoma osredotočili na Bahmut, Soledar pa je veljal za satelitsko utrdbo, ki je varovala severovzhodni bok mesta in njegove oskrbovalne poti. Do takrat je bil velik del Soledarja že v ruševinah.

Neposredni ruski napadi na Soledar so se znova začeli konec decembra 2022 in v začetku januarja 2023; ruske sile so 16. januarja zavzele zadnji del industrijske cone in prevzele nadzor nad naseljem, kar jim je omogočilo, da so še bolj ogrozile severno in severovzhodno obrobje Bahmuta.

source.title: Battle of Soledar
paragraphs: The Battle of Soledar was a series of military engagements in and around the urban-type settlement of Soledar during the Battle of Donbas in the Russo-Ukrainian war.

Russian forces began an offensive on 3 August 2022, shelling Soledar, Bakhmut, and surrounding villages to the south and east. Repeated local Russian assaults on or near Soledar continued into October, with many repelled by the Ukrainian army. By late December, much of the fighting in the region centered around Bakhmut, with Soledar seen as a satellite stronghold protecting the city's northeastern flank and supply lines. By this time, much of Soledar had been reduced to ruins.

Direct Russian assaults on Soledar resumed in late December 2022 and early January 2023, and on 16 January Russian forces captured the last sector of its industrial zone and secured control of the town, allowing the Russians to further threaten Bakhmut's northern and northeastern outskirts.

Battle of Solferino.headline: Bitka pri Solferinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Solferinu (v Italiji jo imenujejo bitka pri Solferinu in San Martinu) 24. junija 1859 je bila vrhunec druge italijanske vojne za neodvisnost. Zmagala sta zavezniška francoska vojska pod Napoleonom III. in piemontsko-sardinska vojska pod Viktorjem Emanuelom II. (skupaj znani kot francosko-sardinsko zavezništvo) nad avstrijsko vojsko pod cesarjem Francem Jožefom I. Bila je zadnja velika bitka v svetovni zgodovini, v kateri so vsem vojskam neposredno poveljevali njihovi monarhi. V najpomembnejši bitki, največji od bitke pri Leipzigu leta 1813, je bilo na obeh straneh skupaj približno 300.000 vojakov. Navzočih je bilo okoli 130.000 avstrijskih vojakov in skupaj 140.000 francoskih in zavezniških piemontskih vojakov, a vsi niso dejansko sodelovali v bitki. Po bitki avstrijski cesar ni več neposredno poveljeval svoji vojski.

source.title: Battle of Solferino
paragraphs: The Battle of Solferino (referred to in Italy as the Battle of Solferino and San Martino) on 24 June 1859 was the climactic battle of the Second Italian War of Independence and resulted in the victory of the allied French army under Napoleon III and the Piedmont-Sardinian army under Victor Emmanuel II (together known as the Franco-Sardinian alliance) against the Austrian army under Emperor Franz Joseph I. It was the last major battle in world history in which all the armies were under the personal command of their monarchs. There were approximately 300,000 soldiers on both sides in the most important battle, the largest since the Battle of Leipzig in 1813. The number of soldiers present was about 130,000 Austrian troops and a combined total of 140,000 French and allied Piedmontese troops, but not all were actually involved in the battle. After the battle, the Austrian emperor stopped directly commanding his army.

Battle of Solway Moss.headline: Bitka pri Solway Mossu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Solway Mossu je potekala novembra 1542 med angleškimi in škotskimi silami na barju Solway Moss blizu reke Esk na angleški strani angleško-škotske meje.

Škotski kralj Jakob V. se ni hotel odreči katoliški Cerkvi, kot ga je spodbujal njegov stric, angleški kralj Henrik VIII., ki je nato sprožil velik vpad na jugozahod Škotske. Škotska vojska, ki je krenila proti Angležem, je bila slabo vodena in organizirana, veliko Škotov so ujeli ali pa so utonili v reki. Novica o porazu naj bi pospešila zgodnjo smrt Jakoba V.

source.title: Battle of Solway Moss
paragraphs: The Battle of Solway Moss took place on Solway Moss near the River Esk on the English side of the Anglo-Scottish border in November 1542 between English and Scottish forces.

The Scottish King James V had refused to break from the Catholic Church, as urged by his uncle King Henry VIII, who then launched a major raid into south-west Scotland. The Scottish army that marched against them was poorly led and organised, and many Scots were either captured or drowned in the river. News of the defeat is believed to have hastened the early death of James V.

Battle of Somosierra.headline: Bitka pri Somosierri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Somosierri je potekala 30. novembra 1808 v polotoški vojni, ko so združene sile Francozov, napoleonskih Špancev in Poljakov pod neposrednim poveljstvom Napoleona I. prebile pot skozi špansko divizijo v pogorju Sierra de Guadarrama, ki je Madrid ščitilo pred neposrednim francoskim napadom. Na gorskem prelazu Somosierra, 97 kilometrov severno od Madrida, je številčno močno šibkejši španski oddelek rednih vojakov, prostovoljcev in topništva pod Benitom de San Juanom skušal zapreti Napoleonovo pot proti Madridu. Napoleon je španske položaje strl s kombiniranim napadom: poljske lahke konjenike (chevau-légers) cesarske garde je poslal nad španske topove, francoska pehota pa je napredovala po pobočjih. Zmaga je odstranila zadnjo oviro na cesti proti Madridu, ki je padel nekaj dni pozneje.
notes: The miles (60 mi) are dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Somosierra
paragraphs: The Battle of Somosierra took place on 30 November 1808, during the Peninsular War, when a combined Franco-Napoleonic Spanish-Polish force under the direct command of Napoleon I forced a passage through a Spanish division stationed at the Sierra de Guadarrama, which shielded Madrid from direct French attack. At the Somosierra mountain pass, 60 miles (97 km) north of Madrid, a heavily outnumbered Spanish detachment of regulars, volunteers and artillery under Benito de San Juan attempted to block Napoleon's advance onto Madrid. Napoleon overwhelmed the Spanish positions in a combined arms attack, sending the Polish Chevau-légers of the Imperial Guard at the Spanish guns while French infantry advanced up the slopes. The victory removed the last obstacle barring the road to Madrid, which fell a few days later.

Battle of Soor.headline: Bitka pri Sooru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sooru (30. septembra 1745) je bila spopad med prusko vojsko Friderika Velikega in avstrijsko-saško vojsko pod vodstvom princa Karla Aleksandra Lotarinškega med drugo šlezijsko vojno (delom vojne za avstrijsko nasledstvo). Potekala je v bližini Soora, znanega tudi kot Hajnice, v današnji Češki republiki. Bitka se je začela z neuspelim avstrijskim presenetljivim napadom na številčno šibkejše Pruse. Pruska vojska je kljub začetnim neuspehom premagala Avstrijce, ker je nepričakovano napadel rezervni polk, ki ni hotel ubogati Friderikovih ukazov.

source.title: Battle of Soor
paragraphs: The Battle of Soor (30 September 1745) was a battle between Frederick the Great's Prussian army and an Austro-Saxon army led by Prince Charles Alexander of Lorraine during the Second Silesian War (part of the War of the Austrian Succession). The battle occurred in the vicinity of Soor, also known as Hajnice, in the modern day Czech Republic. The battle started with a failed Austrian surprise attack on the outnumbered Prussians. Despite initial setbacks the Prussian army managed to defeat the Austrians, due to an unexpected attack from a reserve regiment that refused to follow Frederick's orders.

Battle of Southern Buh.headline: Bitka ob Južnem Bugu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Južnem Bugu je potekala blizu bregov istoimenske reke (danes v Ukrajini). Končala se je z veliko bolgarsko zmago, zaradi katere so morali Madžari iz države Etelköz zapustiti stepe južne Ukrajine in se odpovedati načrtom za podreditev podonavske Bolgarije. Umaknili so se v na novo zasedene dežele onkraj Karpatov s središčem v Panoniji, od koder so začeli naslednjo vojno, tokrat proti Moravanom; premagali so jih in ustanovili novo Madžarsko. Ta je sledila državi Etelköz v današnji Ukrajini, ki je nasledila zgodnejšo stopnjo madžarske državnosti, legendarno, a kratkotrajno Levedijo, in še prejšnjo v pravi pradomovini Madžarov, Jugri onkraj reke Ob.
notes: The English gives no date (the battle is usually dated 895 or 896); kept as in the source.

source.title: Battle of Southern Buh
paragraphs: The Battle of Southern Buh occurred near the banks of the eponymous river (today in Ukraine). The result was a great Bulgarian victory which forced the Magyars of the Etelköz realm to abandon the steppes of southern Ukraine, as well as their aspirations of subduing Danube Bulgaria, retreating to the newly occupied lands beyond the Carpathian Mountains, centering on Pannonia, from where they would stage their next war, against Moravians this time, defeating them and establishing a new Hungary, after the Etelköz state in modern Ukraine, which succeeded an earlier stage of statehood for the Magyars, the legendary although short-lived Levedia, and even one before that, in the actual country of origin for the Magyars, Yugra, beyond river Ob.

Battle of Spartolos.headline: Bitka pri Spartolu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Spartolu je potekala leta 429 pr. n. št. v začetnem obdobju peloponeške vojne med Atenami ter Halkidiško zvezo in njenimi zavezniki.

source.title: Battle of Spartolos
paragraphs: The Battle of Spartolos took place in 429 BC between Athens and the Chalcidian League and their allies, in the early part of the Peloponnesian War.

Battle of Spercheios.headline: Bitka ob Sperheju
paragraphs: Bitka ob Sperheju (bolgarsko: Битка при Сперхей; grško: Μάχη του Σπερχειού) je potekala leta 997 na bregovih reke Sperhej blizu mesta Lamija v osrednji Grčiji. Spopadli sta se bolgarska vojska pod vodstvom carja Samuela, ki je leto prej prodrla na jug v Grčijo, in bizantinska vojska pod poveljstvom generala Nikeforja Urana. Bizantinska zmaga je bolgarsko vojsko tako rekoč uničila in končala njene vpade na južni Balkan in v Grčijo. Glavni zgodovinski vir o bitki je grški zgodovinar Janez Skilica, čigar Pregled zgodovine (Σύνοψις Ἱστοριῶν) vsebuje življenjepis tedanjega bizantinskega cesarja Bazilija II.

source.title: Battle of Spercheios
paragraphs: The Battle of Spercheios (Bulgarian: Битка при Сперхей, Greek: Μάχη του Σπερχειού) took place in 997 AD, on the shores of the Spercheios river near the city of Lamia in central Greece. It was fought between a Bulgarian army led by Tsar Samuil, which in the previous year had penetrated south into Greece, and a Byzantine army under the command of General Nikephoros Ouranos. The Byzantine victory virtually destroyed the Bulgarian army, and ended its raids in the southern Balkans and Greece. The major historical source on the battle comes from Greek historian John Skylitzes whose Synopsis of Histories (Σύνοψις Ἱστοριῶν) contains a biography of the then-reigning Byzantine emperor, Basil II.

Battle of Sphacteria.headline: Bitka pri Sfakteriji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sfakteriji je bila kopenska bitka peloponeške vojne leta 425 pr. n. št. med Atenami in Šparto. Po bitki pri Pilosu in neuspelih mirovnih pogajanjih, ki so ji sledila, je na otoku Sfakterija obtičalo več Špartancev. Atenske sile pod vodstvom Kleona in Demostena so jih napadle in prisilile k predaji.

source.title: Battle of Sphacteria
paragraphs: The Battle of Sphacteria was a land battle of the Peloponnesian War, fought in 425 BC between Athens and Sparta. Following the Battle of Pylos and subsequent peace negotiations, which failed, a number of Spartans were stranded on the island of Sphacteria. An Athenian force under Cleon and Demosthenes attacked and forced them to surrender.

Battle of Spicheren.headline: Bitka pri Spicherenu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Spicherenu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Forbachu) je potekala 6. avgusta 1870 med francosko-prusko vojno. Nemške sile so zmagale in Francoze prisilile k umiku za obrambne položaje Metza. Bitka je bila drugi od treh odločilnih francoskih porazov. General Helmuth von Moltke starejši je prvotno nameraval vojsko Françoisa Achilla Bazaina zadržati ob Saari, dokler je ne bi mogel napasti z 2. armado od spredaj in 1. armado na njenem levem boku, medtem ko bi se 3. armada približala od zadaj. Ostareli general Karl Friedrich von Steinmetz pa je s pretirano vnemo in brez načrta 1. armado s položaja ob Mozeli popeljal proti jugu. Krenil je naravnost proti mestu Spicheren in pri tem odrezal princa Friderika Karla od njegovih prednjih konjeniških enot.

source.title: Battle of Spicheren
paragraphs: The Battle of Spicheren (also known as the Battle of Forbach) was fought on 6 August 1870 during the Franco-Prussian War. German forces won a victory compelled the French to withdraw to the defenses of Metz. The battle was the second of three critical French defeats. General Helmuth von Moltke the Elder had originally planned to keep François Achille Bazaine's army around the Saar until he could attack it with the 2nd Army in front and the 1st Army on its left flank, while the 3rd Army closed towards the rear. The aging General Karl Friedrich von Steinmetz made an overzealous, unplanned move, leading the 1st Army south from his position on the Moselle. He moved straight toward the town of Spicheren, cutting off Prince Frederick Charles from his forward cavalry units in the process.

Battle of St Quentin Canal.headline: Bitka pri kanalu Saint-Quentin
paragraphs: Bitka pri kanalu Saint-Quentin je bila ključna bitka prve svetovne vojne, ki se je začela 29. septembra 1918; v njej so sodelovale britanske, avstralske in ameriške sile v sestavi britanske 4. armade pod vrhovnim poveljstvom generala sira Henryja Rawlinsona. Bolj severno je napad podprl tudi del britanske 3. armade. Južno od 19 km široke fronte 4. armade je francoska 1. armada na 9,5 km široki fronti začela usklajen napad. Cilj je bil prebiti enega najmočneje branjenih odsekov nemške Siegfriedstellung (Hindenburgove linije), ki je na tem odseku kanal Saint-Quentin uporabljala kot del obrambe. Napad je dosegel cilje (čeprav ne po načrtovanem časovnem razporedu) in kljub močnemu nemškemu odporu prvič v celoti prebil Hindenburgovo linijo. Skupaj z drugimi napadi velike ofenzive vzdolž vse linije je zavezniški uspeh nemško vrhovno poveljstvo prepričal, da je upanja na končno nemško zmago malo.
notes: The mile figures are dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of St Quentin Canal
paragraphs: The Battle of St Quentin Canal was a pivotal battle of World War I that began on 29 September 1918 and involved British, Australian and American forces operating as part of the British Fourth Army under the overall command of General Sir Henry Rawlinson. Further north, part of the British Third Army also supported the attack. South of the Fourth Army's 19 km (12 mi) front, the French First Army launched a coordinated attack on a 9.5 km (6 mi) front. The objective was to break through one of the most heavily defended stretches of the German Siegfriedstellung (Hindenburg Line), which in this sector used the St Quentin Canal as part of its defences. The assault achieved its objectives (though not according to the planned timetable), resulting in the first full breach of the Hindenburg Line, in the face of heavy German resistance. In concert with other attacks of the Grand Offensive along the length of the line, Allied success convinced the German high command that there was little hope of an ultimate German victory.

Bitka pri Saint-Quentinu leta 1557 je bila odločilni spopad italijanske vojne v letih 1551–1559 med Kraljevino Francijo in Španskim imperijem pri Saint-Quentinu v Pikardiji. Habsburške španske sile pod vodstvom savojskega vojvode Emanuela Filiberta so premagale francosko vojsko pod poveljstvom Louisa de Gonzaguea in Anneja de Montmorencyja, vojvode Montmorencyja.

source.title: Battle of St. Quentin (1557)
paragraphs: The Battle of Saint-Quentin of 1557 was a decisive engagement of the Italian War of 1551–1559 between the Kingdom of France and the Spanish Empire, at Saint-Quentin in Picardy. A Habsburg Spanish force under Duke Emmanuel Philibert of Savoy defeated a French army under the command of Louis de Gonzague, and Anne de Montmorency, Duke of Montmorency.

Battle of St. Quentin (1871).headline: Bitka pri Saint-Quentinu (1871)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Saint-Quentinu je potekala med francosko-prusko vojno, ko so pruske sile preprečile francoske poskuse, da bi osvobodili oblegani Pariz.

Medtem ko so pruske vojske pod Viljemom I. oblegale Pariz, so prusko I. armado, ki ji je tedaj poveljeval August Karl von Goeben, poslali nad francoske sile severno od Pariza. Potem ko so prvi poskus osvoboditve Pariza zaustavili v bitki pri Bapaumu, so Francozi načrtovali nov poskus.

Von Goeben je s svojo vojsko krenil proti severu in blizu Saint-Quentina naletel na neregularno francosko vojsko generala Louisa Faidherba. Prusi so 19. januarja napadli in francoske sile odločilno porazili. Istega dne je general Trochu poskusil prodor iz Pariza, a je tudi ta spodletel. Drugih pomembnejših poskusov, da bi prekinili obleganje Pariza, ni bilo več.

source.title: Battle of St. Quentin (1871)
paragraphs: The Battle of St. Quentin took place during the Franco-Prussian War when Prussian forces defeated French attempts to relieve the besieged city of Paris.

While the Prussian armies under Wilhelm I besieged Paris, the Prussian I Army, now under the command of August Karl von Goeben was sent to deal with French forces north of Paris. After a first attempt to relieve Paris had been checked at the battle of Bapaume, the French were planning another relief effort.

Von Goeben marched his army north and met the irregular French army under General Louis Faidherbe near Saint-Quentin. On 19 January the Prussians attacked and decisively defeated the French forces. The same day General Trochu attempted a breakout of Paris but it too was defeated. No other significant attempts would be made to lift the siege of Paris.

Battle of St. Quentin (1914).headline: Bitka pri Saint-Quentinu (1914)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Saint-Quentinu (imenovana tudi prva bitka pri Guisu, francosko: 1ere Bataille de Guise) je potekala od 29. do 30. avgusta 1914 med prvo svetovno vojno.

source.title: Battle of St. Quentin (1914)
paragraphs: The Battle of St. Quentin (also called the First Battle of Guise, French: 1ere Bataille de Guise) was fought from 29 to 30 August 1914, during the First World War.

Bitka pri Stadtlohnu je potekala 6. avgusta 1623 med vojskama Pfalške volilne kneževine in katoliške lige med tridesetletno vojno. Sile lige je vodil Johann Tserclaes, grof Tilly, protestante pa Kristijan Brunšviški. Bitka se je končala s prepričljivo katoliško zmago, ki je večinoma končala vojaški odpor pfalških sil in s tem pomenila konec prve faze tridesetletne vojne.

source.title: Battle of Stadtlohn
paragraphs: The Battle of Stadtlohn was fought on 6 August 1623 between the armies of the Electoral Palatinate and of the Catholic League during the Thirty Years' War. The League's forces were led by Johann Tserclaes, Count of Tilly, the Protestants by Christian of Brunswick. The battle resulted in a resounding Catholic victory that largely ended the military resistance of the Palatinate forces and thus marked the end of the first phase of the Thirty Years' War.

Battle of Staffarda.headline: Bitka pri Staffardi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Staffardi je potekala 18. avgusta 1690 v devetletni vojni v Piemontu v severni Italiji. Bila je prva velika bitka devetletne vojne v Italiji, odkar se je Viktor Amadej II. Savojski prej istega leta pridružil veliki zvezi proti francoskemu kralju Ludviku XIV.

Francoska vojska okoli 12.000 mož pod Nicolasom Catinatom je premagala savojsko vojsko 18.000 mož pod vodstvom Viktorja Amadeja in cesarskega generala princa Evgena Savojskega. Zmaga je Catinatu omogočila, da je preplavil večino Piemonta, vendar zaradi bolezni, pomanjkanja mož in težav z oskrbo ni mogel zavzeti prestolnice Torino.

source.title: Battle of Staffarda
paragraphs: The Battle of Staffarda took place on 18 August 1690 during the Nine Years' War in Piedmont, Northern Italy. The engagement was the first major battle of the Nine Years' War in Italy since Victor Amadeus II of Savoy joined the Grand Alliance against Louis XIV of France earlier that year.

A French force of around 12,000 under Nicolas Catinat defeated a Savoyard army of 18,000 led by Victor Amadeus and the Imperial general Prince Eugène of Savoy. Victory allowed Catinat to over-run most of Piedmont but he was unable to take the capital of Turin due to sickness, lack of men and supply problems.

Battle of Stallupönen.headline: Bitka pri Stallupönenu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Stallupönenu med rusko in nemško vojsko 17. avgusta 1914 je bila uvodna bitka prve svetovne vojne na vzhodni fronti. Nemci pod poveljstvom Hermanna von Françoisa so izvedli uspešen protinapad na štiri ruske pehotne divizije iz različnih pehotnih korpusov, ki so bile precej številčnejše, a ločene druga od druge – med 27. in 40. pehotno divizijo je zevala vrzel – in se med seboj slabo usklajevale. Nemci so se nato umaknili h Gumbinnenu.

source.title: Battle of Stallupönen
paragraphs: The Battle of Stallupönen, fought between Russian and German armies on August 17, 1914, was the opening battle of World War I on the Eastern Front. The Germans under the command of Hermann von François conducted a successful counterattack against four Russian infantry divisions from different infantry corps, which heavily outnumbered them but were separated from each other, creating a gap between the 27th Infantry Division and the 40th Infantry Division, and had little coordination with each other. The Germans retreated to Gumbinnen thereafter.

Battle of Stamford Bridge.headline: Bitka pri Stamford Bridgeu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Stamford Bridgeu je potekala 25. septembra 1066 pri vasi Stamford Bridge v East Ridingu v Yorkshiru v Angliji med angleško vojsko kralja Harolda Godwinsona in norveško invazijsko vojsko pod vodstvom kralja Haralda Hardrade in brata angleškega kralja Tostiga Godwinsona. V krvavi bitki sta padla Hardrada in Tostig, pa tudi večina Norvežanov. Harold Godwinson je norveške napadalce sicer odbil, a so manj kot tri tedne pozneje Normani pri Hastingsu porazili njegovo vojsko.

Bitko tradicionalno štejejo za konec vikinške dobe, čeprav so v naslednjih desetletjih v Britaniji in na Irskem potekali veliki skandinavski pohodi, denimo danskega kralja Svena Estridsena v letih 1069–1070 in norveškega kralja Magnusa Bosonogega v letih 1098 in 1102–1103.

source.title: Battle of Stamford Bridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Stamford Bridge took place at the village of Stamford Bridge, East Riding of Yorkshire, in England, on 25 September 1066, between an English army under King Harold Godwinson and an invading Norwegian force led by King Harald Hardrada and the English king's brother Tostig Godwinson. After a bloody battle, both Hardrada and Tostig, along with most of the Norwegians, were killed. Although Harold Godwinson repelled the Norwegian invaders, his army was defeated by the Normans at Hastings less than three weeks later.

The battle has traditionally been presented as marking the end of the Viking Age, although major Scandinavian campaigns in Britain and Ireland occurred in the following decades, such as those of King Sweyn Estrithson of Denmark in 1069–1070 and King Magnus Barefoot of Norway in 1098 and 1102–1103.

Battle of Steenkerque.headline: Bitka pri Steenkerqu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Steenkerqu je potekala 3. avgusta 1692 med devetletno vojno blizu Steenkerqua v Belgiji, tedaj delu Španske Nizozemske. Francoske sile pod poveljstvom maršala Françoisa-Henrija de Montmorencyja, vojvode Luxembourga, so odbile nenaden napad zavezniške vojske pod vodstvom Viljema Oranskega. Po več urah hudih bojev so se zavezniki umaknili in med umikom odbili še francoski protinapad.

source.title: Battle of Steenkerque
paragraphs: The Battle of Steenkerque was fought on 3 August 1692, during the Nine Years' War, near Steenkerque in Belgium, then part of the Spanish Netherlands. A French force under Marshal François-Henri de Montmorency, duc de Luxembourg, repulsed a surprise attack by an Allied army led by William of Orange. After several hours of heavy fighting, the Allies withdrew, repulsing a French counterattack as they did so.

Battle of Štěrboholy.headline: Bitka pri Pragi (1757)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pragi, znana tudi kot bitka pri Štěrboholyh, je potekala 6. maja 1757 med tretjo šlezijsko vojno in širšo sedemletno vojno med Kraljevino Prusijo in habsburško Avstrijo. Čeprav je vojska Friderika Velikega s 64.000 Prusi 60.000 Avstrijcev prisilila k umiku, je izgubila 14.300 mož in Friderik se je odločil, da ni dovolj močan za napad na Prago.
Bitka je omenjena v slavni nemški baladi Lenora, ki jo je leta 1773 napisal Gottfried August Bürger.

source.title: Battle of Štěrboholy
paragraphs: The Battle of Prague, also known as Battle of Štěrboholy, was fought on 6 May 1757, during the Third Silesian War and the broader Seven Years' War, between the Kingdom of Prussia and Habsburg Austria. Although Frederick the Great's army of 64,000 Prussians forced 60,000 Austrians to retreat, he lost 14,300 men and decided he was not strong enough to attack Prague.
The battle is mentioned in the famous German ballad Lenore written in 1773 by Gottfried August Bürger.

Battle of Stilo.headline: Bitka pri Stilu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Stilu (znana tudi kot bitka pri rtu Colonna in bitka pri Crotoneju) je potekala 13. ali 14. julija 982 blizu Crotoneja v Kalabriji med silami svetorimskega cesarja Otona II. in njegovih italijansko-langobardskih zaveznikov ter silami kalbidskega emirja Sicilije Abu al-Kasima (del Fatimidskega kalifata), ki je Nemcem napovedal sveto vojno.

source.title: Battle of Stilo
paragraphs: The Battle of Stilo (also known as the Battle of Cape Colonna and the Battle of Crotone) was fought on 13 or 14 July 982 near Crotone in Calabria between the forces of Holy Roman Emperor Otto II and his Italo-Lombard allies and those of the Kalbid emir of Sicily (part of the Fatimid Caliphate), Abu'l-Qasim, who had declared a holy war against the Germans.

Battle of Stirling Bridge.headline: Bitka pri Stirlinškem mostu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Stirlinškem mostu (škotsko gelsko: Blàr Drochaid Shruighlea) je potekala v prvi škotski osamosvojitveni vojni. Sile Andrewa Moraya in Williama Wallacea so 11. septembra 1297 blizu Stirlinga ob reki Forth premagale združene angleške sile Johna de Warenna, 6. grofa Surreyja, in Hugha de Cressinghama.

source.title: Battle of Stirling Bridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Stirling Bridge (Scottish Gaelic: Blàr Drochaid Shruighlea) was fought during the First War of Scottish Independence. On 11 September 1297, the forces of Andrew Moray and William Wallace defeated the combined English forces of John de Warenne, 6th Earl of Surrey, and Hugh de Cressingham near Stirling, on the River Forth.

Battle of Stockach (1799).headline: Bitka pri Stockachu (1799)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Stockachu je potekala 25. marca 1799, ko sta se francoska in avstrijska vojska bojevali za nadzor nad zemljepisno strateško pokrajino Hegau v današnjem Baden-Württembergu. V širšem vojaškem okviru je bitka ključni del prvega pohoda v jugozahodni Nemčiji med vojnami druge koalicije, delom francoskih revolucionarnih vojn.

Bila je druga bitka med francosko Donavsko armado pod poveljstvom Jean-Baptista Jourdana in habsburško vojsko pod vodstvom nadvojvode Karla; vojski sta se nekaj dni prej, 20.–22. marca, spopadli na močvirnih poljih jugovzhodno od Ostracha in na vzpetinah pri Pfullendorfu. Skoraj trikratna premoč avstrijske vojske je Francoze prisilila k umiku.

source.title: Battle of Stockach (1799)
paragraphs: The Battle of Stockach occurred on 25 March 1799, when French and Austrian armies fought for control of the geographically strategic Hegau region in present-day Baden-Württemberg. In the broader military context, this battle constitutes a keystone in the first campaign in southwestern Germany during the Wars of the Second Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars.

It was the second battle between the French Army of the Danube, commanded by Jean-Baptiste Jourdan, and the Habsburg Army under Archduke Charles; the armies had met a few days earlier, 20–22 March, on the marshy fields southeast of Ostrach and the Pfullendorf heights. The Austrian Army's superior strength, almost three-to-one, forced the French to withdraw.

Battle of Stoke Field.headline: Bitka pri Stoke Fieldu
paragraphs: Bitko pri Stoke Fieldu, ki je potekala 16. junija 1487 pri East Stoku v Nottinghamshiru, lahko štejemo za zadnjo bitko vojne rož, saj je bila zadnji večji spopad med tekmeci za prestol, katerih zahteve so izhajale iz porekla iz hiš Lancaster in York. Bitka pri Bosworth Fieldu dve leti prej je na prestol postavila Henrika VII., končala zadnje obdobje yorške vladavine in začela tudorsko. Bitka pri Stoke Fieldu je bila odločilni spopad v poskusu vodilnih Rikardu zvestih privržencev Yorkov, da bi kralja odstavili v korist pretendenta Lamberta Simnela.

Čeprav jo pogosto prikazujejo skoraj kot opombo k velikim bitkam med Yorki in Lancastri, je bila morda nekoliko večja od bitke pri Bosworthu in je imela precej več žrtev, morda zaradi terena, ki je obe strani prisilil v tesen, izčrpavajoč boj. Henrikova zmaga je bila nazadnje uničujoča. V bitki so padli skoraj vsi vodilni privrženci Yorkov.

source.title: Battle of Stoke Field
paragraphs: The Battle of Stoke Field, which took place at East Stoke, Nottinghamshire, on 16 June 1487, may be considered the last battle of the Wars of the Roses, since it was the last major engagement between contenders for the throne whose claims derived from descent from the houses of Lancaster and York. The Battle of Bosworth Field, two years previously, had established Henry VII on the throne, ending the last period of Yorkist rule and initiating that of the Tudors. The Battle of Stoke Field was the decisive engagement in an attempt by leading Ricardian Yorkists to unseat the King in favour of the pretender Lambert Simnel.

Though it is often portrayed as almost a footnote to the major battles between York and Lancaster, it may have been slightly larger than Bosworth, with much heavier casualties, possibly because of the terrain which forced the two sides into close, attritional combat. In the end, though, Henry's victory was crushing. Almost all the leading Yorkists were killed in the battle.

Battle of Sulci.headline: Bitka pri Sulciju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sulciju je bila pomorska bitka, ki je potekala leta 258 pr. n. št. med rimskim in kartažanskim ladjevjem ob obali blizu mesta Sulci na Sardiniji. Bila je rimska zmaga, ki jo je dosegel konzul Gaj Sulpicij Paterkul. Kartažansko ladjevje so večinoma potopili, preostale ladje pa so pustili na kopnem. Kartažanskega poveljnika Hanibala Giskona je njegova vojska, ki se je uprla, razpela na križ ali ubila s kamenjanjem.
Rimljane je pozneje na Sardiniji premagal nek Hanon in rimski poskus zavzetja otoka je spodletel. Zaradi izgube ladij Kartažani s Sardinije niso mogli začeti večjih operacij proti Rimljanom.

source.title: Battle of Sulci
paragraphs: The Battle of Sulci was a naval battle fought in 258 BC between the Roman and Carthaginian navies on the coast near the town of Sulci, Sardinia. It was a Roman victory, obtained by consul Gaius Sulpicius Paterculus. The Carthaginian fleet was largely sunk, and the rest of the ships were abandoned on land. The Carthaginian commander Hannibal Gisco was crucified or stoned to death by his mutinying army.

The Romans were subsequently defeated by a certain Hanno in Sardinia, and the Roman attempt to capture the island failed. The loss of ships prevented the Carthaginians from mounting major operations from Sardinia against the Romans.

Battle of Sybota.headline: Bitka pri Sibotih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sibotih (starogrško: Σύβοτα) je potekala leta 433 pr. n. št. med Korkiro (današnjim Krfom) in Korintom. Bila je eden neposrednih povodov za peloponeško vojno.

source.title: Battle of Sybota
paragraphs: The Battle of Sybota (Ancient Greek: Σύβοτα) took place in 433 BC between Corcyra (modern Corfu) and Corinth. It was one of the immediate catalysts for the Peloponnesian War.

Battle of Tagliacozzo.headline: Bitka pri Tagliacozzu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tagliacozzu je potekala 23. avgusta 1268 med gibelinskimi privrženci Konradina Štaufovskega in gvelfsko vojsko Karla Anžujskega. Bila je zadnje dejanje štaufovske oblasti v Italiji. Ujetje in usmrtitev Konradina nekaj mesecev po bitki sta pomenila tudi propad rodbine s cesarskega in sicilskega prestola ter odprla novo poglavje anžujske prevlade v južni Italiji.

source.title: Battle of Tagliacozzo
paragraphs: The Battle of Tagliacozzo was fought on 23 August 1268 between the Ghibelline supporters of Conradin of Hohenstaufen and the Guelph army of Charles of Anjou. The battle represented the last act of Hohenstaufen power in Italy. The capture and execution of Conradin several months after the battle also marked the fall of the family from the Imperial and Sicilian thrones, leading to the new chapter of Angevin domination in Southern Italy.

Battle of Taillebourg.headline: Bitka pri Taillebourgu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Taillebourgu, velika srednjeveška bitka julija 1242, je bila odločilni spopad saintongeške vojne. V njej se je francoska kapetinška vojska pod poveljstvom kralja Ludvika IX., znanega tudi kot sveti Ludvik, in njegovega mlajšega brata Alfonza Poitierskega spopadla s silami, ki so jih vodili angleški kralj Henrik III., njegov brat Rihard Cornwallski in njun očim Hugo X. Lusignanski.

Bojevali so se na mostu čez reko Charente, strateško pomembni točki na poti med severno in južno Francijo, pozneje pa blizu mesta Saintes. Po Charlesu Omanu so bili Angleži in njihovi zavezniki razbiti in prisiljeni skleniti mir, francoski kralj pa se je zadovoljil s tem, da je stanje ostalo takšno kot pred vojno. Bitka je zatrla upor v Poitouju in pomenila konec upanja Henrika III., da bi obnovil Anžujski imperij, ki je razpadel med vladavino njegovega očeta.

source.title: Battle of Taillebourg
paragraphs: The Battle of Taillebourg, a major medieval battle fought in July 1242, was the decisive engagement of the Saintonge War. It pitted a French Capetian army under the command of King Louis IX, also known as Saint Louis, and his younger brother Alphonse of Poitiers, against forces led by King Henry III of England, his brother Richard of Cornwall and their stepfather Hugh X of Lusignan.

The battle was fought on the bridge built over the river Charente, a point of strategic importance on the route between northern and southern France. Later it was fought near the city of Saintes. According to Charles Oman; the English and their allies were routed and forced to make peace but the King of France contented himself of leaving things as they had been before the war. The battle put down the Poitevin revolt and marked the end of Henry III's hopes of restoring the Angevin Empire, which had collapsed during his father's reign.

Battle of Talavera.headline: Bitka pri Talaveri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Talaveri (27.–28. julija 1809) je potekala tik pred mestom Talavera de la Reina v Španiji, približno 120 kilometrov jugozahodno od Madrida, v polotoški vojni. Britanska vojska pod sirom Arthurjem Wellesleyjem se je pri Talaveri skupaj s špansko vojsko pod generalom Gregoriem Garcío de la Cuesto bojevala v operacijah proti Madridu, ki so ga zasedli Francozi. Ob mraku se je francoska vojska, potem ko so ji odbili več napadov, umaknila za kratko razdaljo; zavezniki, ki so utrpeli podobne izgube kot Francozi, je niso poskušali zasledovati.
notes: The miles conversion (75 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Talavera
paragraphs: The Battle of Talavera (27–28 July 1809) was fought just outside the town of Talavera de la Reina, Spain some 120 kilometres (75 mi) southwest of Madrid, during the Peninsular War. At Talavera, a British army under Sir Arthur Wellesley combined with a Spanish army under General Gregorio García de la Cuesta fought in operations against French-occupied Madrid. At nightfall, the French army withdrew a short distance after several of its attacks had been repulsed; the allies, having suffered comparable casualties to the French, made no attempt to pursue.

Battle of Tali–Ihantala.headline: Bitka pri Taliju in Ihantali
paragraphs: Bitka pri Taliju in Ihantali (od 25. junija do 9. julija 1944) je bila del finsko-sovjetske nadaljevalne vojne (1941–1944) med drugo svetovno vojno. V njej so se finske sile, ki so uporabljale vojaško opremo iz Nemčije, spopadle s sovjetskimi silami. Doslej je to največja bitka v zgodovini nordijskih držav.

Bitka je bila trenutek sovjetske ofenzive, ko so finske sile Sovjetom prvič preprečile pomembnejše pridobitve. Že prej so Finci napredujoče sovjetske sile ustavili pri Siiranmäkiju in Perkjärviju. Finske sile so proti veliki premoči dosegle obrambno zmago.

Ko Sovjetom ni uspelo prebiti fronte pri Taliju in Ihantali, v Viborškem zalivu ali pri Vuosalmiju, je sovjetska leningrajska fronta začela že načrtovano premeščanje čet s Karelijske prevlake v podporo narvski ofenzivi, kjer so naletele na posebej srdit odpor. Leningrajski fronti sicer ni uspelo prodreti na Finsko, kot je ukazala Stavka, vendar nekateri zgodovinarji menijo, da je ofenziva Finsko nazadnje prisilila k izstopu iz vojne.

source.title: Battle of Tali–Ihantala
paragraphs: The Battle of Tali–Ihantala (June 25 to July 9, 1944) was part of the Finnish-Soviet Continuation War (1941–1944), which occurred during World War II. The battle was fought between Finnish forces—using war materiel provided by Germany—and Soviet forces. To date, it is the largest battle in the history of the Nordic countries.

The battle marked a point in the Soviet offensive when the Finnish forces first prevented the Soviets from making any significant gains. Earlier at Siiranmäki and Perkjärvi the Finns had halted advancing Soviet forces. The Finnish forces achieved a defensive victory against overwhelming odds.

After the Soviets had failed to create any breakthroughs at Tali–Ihantala, Vyborg Bay, or Vuosalmi, the Soviet Leningrad Front started the previously planned transfer of troops from the Karelian Isthmus to support the Narva offensive, where they were encountering particularly fierce resistance. Though the Leningrad Front failed to advance into Finland as ordered by the Stavka, some historians state that the offensive did eventually force Finland from the war.

Battle of Tanagra (426 BC).headline: Bitka pri Tanagri (426 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tanagri je potekala v peloponeški vojni leta 426 pr. n. št. med Atenami ter Tanagro in Tebami.

Leta 426 so Atene na otok Melos poslale ladjevje s 60 ladjami in 2000 hopliti pod poveljstvom Nikije. Melos se ni hotel pridružiti Delski zvezi in je to zavračal tudi, ko so Atenci otok izropali. Atenci pa so se nato izkrcali na obali in odkorakali proti Tanagri, kjer se jim je pridružila glavnina atenske vojske, ki je iz Aten prišla pod vodstvom Hiponika in Evrimedonta.
