Opustošili so podeželje in naslednji dan premagali združeno tanagrsko in tebansko vojsko, a so se po zmagi vrnili v Atene.
notes: The English has a stray word ("dides") in the third sentence; translated as the sentence plainly means.

source.title: Battle of Tanagra (426 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Tanagra took place during the Peloponnesian War in 426 BC between Athens, Tanagra and Thebes.

In 426 Athens sent a fleet to the island of Melos consisting of 60 ships and 2,000 hoplites under the command of Nicias. Melos had refused to join the Delian League, and still refused to do so even when the Athenians plundered the island. The Athenians, however, dides landed on shore and marched towards Tanagra, where they were joined by the main Athenian army that had been marching from Athens under Hipponicus and Eurymedon. They plundered the countryside, and the next day defeated a combined Tanagran and Theban army, but returned to Athens after the victory.

Battle of Tanagra (457 BC).headline: Bitka pri Tanagri (457 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tanagri je bila kopenska bitka, ki je potekala leta 457 pr. n. št. v Beotiji med Atenami in Šparto v prvi peloponeški vojni. Napetosti med Atenami in Šparto so se stopnjevale zaradi obnove atenskega obzidja in špartanske zavrnitve atenske vojaške pomoči. Atence je vodil Mironid in imeli so 14.000 mož. Špartance je vodil Nikomed in imeli so skupaj 11.500 vojakov. Obe strani sta utrpeli velike izgube, Šparta pa si je nazadnje pripisala zmago.

source.title: Battle of Tanagra (457 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Tanagra was a land battle that took place in Boeotia in 457 BC between Athens and Sparta during the First Peloponnesian War. Tension between Athens and Sparta had built up due the rebuilding of Athens' walls and Spartan rejection of Athenian military assistance. The Athenians were led by Myronides and held a strength of 14,000. The Spartans were led by Nicomedes and had a total of 11,500 soldiers. While both the Athenians and Spartans suffered great losses, Sparta ultimately claimed victory in this battle.

Battle of Tannenberg.headline: Bitka pri Tannenbergu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tannenbergu, znana tudi kot druga bitka pri Tannenbergu, je potekala med Rusijo in Nemčijo med 26. in 30. avgustom 1914, v prvem mesecu prve svetovne vojne. Nemška 8. armada je rusko 2. armado obkolila in skoraj popolnoma uničila, njen poveljnik general Aleksander Samsonov pa si je vzel življenje. Vrsta nadaljnjih bitk (prva bitka pri Mazurskih jezerih) je privedla do izgona ruske 1. armade iz Vzhodne Prusije.

Izid je nemškemu poveljniku generalu Paulu von Hindenburgu in njegovemu vzhajajočemu štabnemu častniku generalu Erichu Ludendorffu prinesel velik ugled. Čeprav je bitka dejansko potekala blizu Allensteina (Olsztyn), jo je Hindenburg poimenoval po Tannenbergu 30 km zahodno, da bi maščeval poraz tevtonskih vitezov v bitki pri Grunwaldu 500 let prej.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Tannenberg
paragraphs: The Battle of Tannenberg, also known as the Second Battle of Tannenberg, was fought between Russia and Germany between 26 and 30 August 1914, the first month of World War I. The battle resulted in the encirclement and the almost complete destruction of the Russian 2nd Army by the German 8th Army and the suicide of its commanding general, Alexander Samsonov. A series of follow-up battles (First Masurian Lakes) led to the ousting of the Russian 1st Army from East Prussia.

The outcome brought considerable prestige to the German army commander, General Paul von Hindenburg, and his rising staff officer, General Erich Ludendorff. Although the battle actually took place near Allenstein (Olsztyn), Hindenburg named it after Tannenberg, 30 km (19 mi) to the west, in order to avenge the Teutonic Knights' defeat at the Battle of Grunwald 500 years earlier.

Battle of Tarutino.headline: Bitka pri Tarutinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tarutinu (18. oktobra 1812; rusko: Тарутинское сражение) je bila del Napoleonovega vdora v Rusijo. Ruske čete pod splošnim poveljstvom Bennigsena, ki so delovale po Kutuzovih navodilih in so bile del njegove vojske, so v njej presenetljivo napadle in premagale francoske čete pod Muratovim poveljstvom. Kutuzov kljub prošnjam Miloradoviča in Jermolova svoje ofenzive ni razširil, ker se je bal, da bi v bitki naletel na samega Napoleona, Murata pa niso zasledovali, ker se je Bennigsen odločil, da razpoložljivih sil ne bo uporabil v ta namen. Ruska pehota, polna novincev, se je v bitki odrezala okorno, Ruse pa so ovirale tudi nočne zamude. Zaradi vsega tega Rusi kljub številčni premoči in presenečenju niso dosegli večjega uspeha. Bitka pri Tarutinu je pripeljala do preloma odnosov med Kutuzovom in Bennigsenom, ki je za nekaj časa izgubil vpliv v vojski. Izgubljena bitka je Napoleona v vsakem primeru prepričala, da je začel usodni francoski umik iz Rusije.

source.title: Battle of Tarutino
paragraphs: The Battle of Tarutino (18 October 1812; Russian: Тарутинское сражение) was a part of Napoleon's invasion of Russia. In the battle, Russian troops under the general command of Bennigsen, acting on instructions from Kutuzov and being part of his army, launched a surprise attack and defeated French troops under Murat's command. However, despite the pleas of Miloradovich and Yermolov, Kutuzov did not extend his own offensive, fearing to encounter Napoleon himself in battle, while Murat was not pursued as Bennigsen decided not to use the available forces for this purpose. The Russian infantry, stuffed with new recruits, performed heavy-handedly in this battle, and the Russians were also hampered by night delays. All this led to the Russians not being able to achieve greater success, despite their numerical superiority and surprise method. The Tarutino battle led to a breakdown in relations between Kutuzov and Bennigsen, who lost his influence in the army for certain time. In any event, the lost battle convinced Napoleon to commence the disastrous French retreat from Russia.

Battle of Tegyra.headline: Bitka pri Tegiri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tegiri (375 pr. n. št.) je bila starogrška bitka med tebanskimi in špartanskimi hoplitskimi silami. Tebanska vojska pod vodstvom Pelopide se je med umikom po neuspelem napadu na Orhomen znašla pred precej večjo špartansko vojsko, a jo je uspešno napadla in pognala v beg. To je bil prvi zgodovinsko izpričani primer, da je številčno šibkejši sovražnik premagal špartansko vojsko v redni bitki (ne v neregularnem vojskovanju, kakršnega je uporabljal Ifikrat).
notes: The English variant Battle of Tegyrae is left out.

source.title: Battle of Tegyra
paragraphs: The Battle of Tegyra (375 BC) (also known as the Battle of Tegyrae) was an ancient Greek battle between Theban and Spartan hoplite forces. In the battle, a Theban army under Pelopidas was challenged by a substantially larger Spartan force while retreating from an abortive attack on Orchomenus, but successfully attacked and routed the Spartans. The battle marked the first occasion in the historical record in which a Spartan force had been defeated by a numerically inferior enemy in a set battle (as opposed to irregular warfare, employed by Iphicrates).

Battle of Telamon.headline: Bitka pri Telamonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Telamonu je potekala leta 225 pr. n. št. med Rimsko republiko in zavezništvom keltskih plemen. Rimljani pod vodstvom konzulov Gaja Atilija Regula in Lucija Emilija Papusa so premagali Kelte pod vodstvom gezatskih kraljev Koncolitana in Aneroësta. Tako je bila keltska grožnja Rimu odpravljena, Rimljani pa so lahko razširili svoj vpliv nad severno Italijo.

source.title: Battle of Telamon
paragraphs: The Battle of Telamon was fought between the Roman Republic and an alliance of Celtic tribes in 225 BC. The Romans, led by the consuls Gaius Atilius Regulus and Lucius Aemilius Papus, defeated the Celts led by the Gaesatae kings Concolitanus and Aneroëstes. This removed the Celtic threat from Rome and allowed the Romans to extend their influence over northern Italy.

Battle of Teruel.headline: Bitka pri Teruelu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Teruelu je med špansko državljansko vojno potekala v mestu Teruel in okolici med decembrom 1937 in februarjem 1938, v najhujši španski zimi v 20 letih. Bila je eden najbolj krvavih spopadov vojne: mesto je večkrat menjalo gospodarja, najprej so ga zavzeli republikanci, nazadnje pa so ga znova osvojili nacionalisti. Med boji je bil Teruel izpostavljen hudemu topniškemu in letalskemu obstreljevanju. V dvomesečni bitki sta obe strani skupaj utrpeli 110.000 žrtev.
Nacionalistični voditelj Francisco Franco je Teruel s premočjo v ljudeh in opremi znova osvojil. Bitka je postala vojaška prelomnica vojne.

source.title: Battle of Teruel
paragraphs: The Battle of Teruel was fought in and around the city of Teruel during the Spanish Civil War between December 1937 and February 1938, during the worst Spanish winter in 20 years. The battle was one of the bloodiest actions of the war, with the city changing hands several times by first falling to the Republicans and eventually being retaken by the Nationalists. In the course of the fighting, Teruel was subjected to heavy artillery and aerial bombardment. In the two-month battle, both factions together took 110,000 casualties.
With his superiority in men and material, the Nationalist leader Francisco Franco regained Teruel. This battle became the military turning point of the war.

Battle of Teugen–Hausen.headline: Bitka pri Teugnu in Hausnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Teugnu in Hausnu ali bitka pri Thannu je bila spopad vojne pete koalicije, dela napoleonskih vojn. Potekala je 19. aprila 1809 med francoskim III. korpusom pod vodstvom maršala Louisa-Nicolasa Davouta in avstrijskim III. armadnim korpusom pod poveljstvom princa Friderika Franca Ksaverja Hohenzollern-Hechingenskega. Ko so se Avstrijci zvečer umaknili, so Francozi po hudem boju zmagali. Bojišče je gozdnata vzpetina približno na pol poti med vasema Teugn in Hausen na Spodnjem Bavarskem v današnji Nemčiji.

Istega dne, 19. aprila, so potekali spopadi tudi pri Arnhofnu blizu Abensberga, Dünzlingu, Regensburgu in Pfaffenhofnu ob Ilmu. Skupaj z bitko pri Teugnu in Hausnu so ti boji pomenili prvi dan štiridnevnega pohoda, ki se je končal s francosko zmago v bitki pri Eckmühlu.

source.title: Battle of Teugen–Hausen
paragraphs: The Battle of Teugen–Hausen or the Battle of Thann was an engagement that occurred during the War of the Fifth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. The battle was fought on 19 April 1809 between the French III Corps led by Marshal Louis-Nicolas Davout and the Austrian III Armeekorps commanded by Prince Friedrich Franz Xaver of Hohenzollern-Hechingen. When the Austrians withdrew that evening, the French won a hard-fought victory over their opponents. The site of the battle is a wooded height approximately halfway between the villages of Teugn and Hausen in Lower Bavaria, part of modern-day Germany.

Also on April 19, clashes occurred at Arnhofen near Abensberg, Dünzling, Regensburg, and Pfaffenhofen an der Ilm. Together with the Battle of Teugen–Hausen, the fighting marked the first day of a four-day campaign, culminating in the French victory at the Battle of Eckmühl.

Battle of Tewkesbury.headline: Bitka pri Tewkesburyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tewkesburyju (4. maja 1471) je bila ena najbolj odločilnih bitk vojne rož v Angliji.

Kralj Edvard IV. in njegove sile, zveste hiši York, so popolnoma porazile sile tekmovalne hiše Lancaster. Lancastrski prestolonaslednik Edvard Westminstrski, princ Walesa, in številni ugledni lancastrski plemiči so v bitki padli ali bili po njej usmrčeni. Lancastrski kralj Henrik VI., ki je bil ujetnik v londonskem Towru, je kmalu po bitki umrl, verjetno umorjen, čeprav je bil uradni vzrok smrti »velika otožnost«. Tewkesbury je Angliji vrnil politično stabilnost, ki je trajala do smrti Edvarda IV. leta 1483.

source.title: Battle of Tewkesbury
paragraphs: The Battle of Tewkesbury (4 May 1471) was one of the most decisive battles of the Wars of the Roses in England.

King Edward IV and his forces loyal to the House of York completely defeated those of the rival House of Lancaster. The Lancastrian heir to the throne, Edward of Westminster, Prince of Wales, and many prominent Lancastrian nobles were killed during the battle or executed after it. The Lancastrian king, Henry VI, who was a prisoner in the Tower of London, died shortly after the battle, likely murdered, although the official cause was stated as being of 'great melancholy'. Tewkesbury restored political stability to England until the death of Edward IV in 1483.

Battle of Texel.headline: Bitka pri Texelu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Texelu ali bitka pri Kijkduinu je potekala pred zahodno obalo otoka Texel 21. avgusta 1673 (11. avgusta po starem koledarju) med Nizozemci ter združeno angleško in francosko floto. Bila je zadnja velika bitka tretje angleško-nizozemske vojne, ki je bila del francosko-nizozemske vojne (1672–1678), v kateri je francoski kralj Ludvik XIV. vdrl v Nizozemsko republiko in si skušal zagotoviti nadzor nad Špansko Nizozemsko. Anglija je v vojno vstopila zaradi doverske pogodbe, ki jo je na skrivaj sklenil angleški kralj Karel II. in je bila v angleškem parlamentu zelo nepriljubljena.

Vrhovna poveljnika angleških in nizozemskih sil sta bila lord visoki admiral Jakob, vojvoda Yorški, poznejši Jakob II., in generaladmiral Viljem III. Oranski, njegov zet in prav tako poznejši angleški kralj. Nobeden od njiju se bitke ni udeležil.

source.title: Battle of Texel
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Texel or Battle of Kijkduin took place off the western coast of the island of Texel on 21 August 1673 (11 August O.S.) between the Dutch and the combined English and French fleets. It was the last major battle of the Third Anglo-Dutch War, which was itself part of the Franco-Dutch War (1672–1678), during which Louis XIV of France invaded the Republic and sought to establish control over the Spanish Netherlands. English involvement came about because of the Treaty of Dover, secretly concluded by Charles II of England, and which was highly unpopular with the English Parliament.

The overall commanders of the English and Dutch military forces were Lord High Admiral James, Duke of York, later James II, and Admiral-General William III of Orange, his son-in-law and another future King of England. Neither of them took part in the fight.

Battle of the Aegates.headline: Bitka pri Egatskih otokih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Egatskih otokih je bila pomorska bitka, ki je potekala 10. marca 241 pr. n. št. med ladjevjema Kartagine in Rima v prvi punski vojni. Bojevali so se med Egatskimi otoki ob zahodni obali Sicilije. Kartažanom je poveljeval Hanon, Rimljane pa je vrhovno vodil Gaj Lutacij Katul, med samo bitko pa jim je poveljeval Kvint Valerij Falton. Bila je zadnja in odločilna bitka 23 let trajajoče prve punske vojne.

source.title: Battle of the Aegates
paragraphs: The Battle of the Aegates was a naval battle fought on 10 March 241 BC between the fleets of Carthage and Rome during the First Punic War. It took place among the Aegates Islands, off the western coast of the island of Sicily. The Carthaginians were commanded by Hanno, and the Romans were under the overall authority of Gaius Lutatius Catulus, but Quintus Valerius Falto commanded during the battle. It was the final and deciding battle of the 23-year-long First Punic War.

Battle of the Afsluitdijk.headline: Bitka za Afsluitdijk
paragraphs: Bitka za Afsluitdijk 12.–14. maja 1940 je bila neuspešen poskus enot nemškega Wehrmachta, da bi med invazijo na Nizozemsko zavzele Afsluitdijk. Nemški invazijski načrti so predvidevali hkraten napad na trdnjavo Holandija (Vesting Holland) iz več smeri, s katerim bi v enem dnevu zavzeli prestolnico in najpomembnejše območje države.

Za napad s severa so morale enote Wehrmachta pod poveljstvom generala Kurta Feldta najprej prečkati Afsluitdijk, 32 kilometrov dolg nasip in jez, ki severne province države povezuje z zahodno provinco Severna Holandija in naprej z Amsterdamom in drugimi kraji.

Čeprav so bile številčno in ognjeno v slabšem položaju, so čete nizozemske kraljeve kopenske vojske pod poveljstvom stotnika Christiaana Boersa in pod vrhovnim poveljstvom kontraadmirala Hoyteja Jollesa napadalce uspešno zadržale pri utrdbi Kornwerderzand, ki so jo varovali posodobljeni, močno utrjeni obrambni položaji. Nemška vojska tako ni mogla takoj zbrati vse svoje moči na najpomembnejšem območju države.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of the Afsluitdijk
paragraphs: The Battle of the Afsluitdijk of 12–14 May 1940 was an unsuccessful attempt by German Wehrmacht forces to seize the Afsluitdijk during the invasion of the Netherlands. German invasion plans called for a simultaneous attack on Vesting Holland from multiple directions, expecting to capture the country's capital and most important region in a day's time.

To facilitate an attack from the north, Wehrmacht elements commanded by General Kurt Feldt first needed to cross the Afsluitdijk, a 32-kilometer-long (20 mi) causeway and dike connecting the country's northern provinces to its western province of North Holland and ultimately to Amsterdam and beyond.

Despite finding themselves outmanned and outgunned, Royal Dutch Army troops commanded by Captain Christiaan Boers, under the overall command of rear-Admiral Hoyte Jolles, managed to successfully hold back the attackers at Fort Kornwerderzand, protected by modernized heavily fortified defensive positions. The German Army was thus prevented from immediately concentrating its full strength on the country's most vital area.

Battle of the Allia.headline: Bitka ob Aliji
paragraphs: Bitka ob Aliji je potekala okoli 387 pr. n. št. med Senoni, galskim plemenom pod vodstvom Brena, ki je vdrlo v severno Italijo, in Rimsko republiko.
Bitka je potekala ob sotočju reke Tibere in potoka Alija, 11 rimskih milj (16 km) severno od Rima. Rimljane so razbili, nato pa so Senoni izropali Rim.

Dies Alliensis (»dan Alije«) so v rimskem koledarju šteli za nesrečen dan in z njim ravnali kot z dies religiosus, ko so se izogibali javnim in obrednim dejavnostim. Čeprav ga poznejši avtorji, kakršen je Livij, prikazujejo kot trajen državljanski tabu, je izročilo izpričano šele od 1. stoletja pr. n. št. in verjetno odraža poznejšo rekonstrukcijo, ne pa neprekinjenega spoštovanja od 4. do 1. stoletja n. št.
notes: The mile conversion (10 mi) is dropped.
The English says the observance ran from the 4th to the 1st century AD, which looks like a slip for BC; the Slovenian follows the English.

source.title: Battle of the Allia
paragraphs: The Battle of the Allia was fought c. 387 BC between the Senones – a Gallic tribe led by Brennus, who had invaded Northern Italy – and the Roman Republic.
The battle was fought at the confluence of the Tiber river and Allia brook, 11 Roman miles (16 km, 10 mi) north of Rome. The Romans were routed and subsequently Rome was sacked by the Senones.

The dies Alliensis ('Day of the Allia') was regarded as an ill-omened day in the Roman calendar, and treated as a dies religiosus on which public and ritual activity was avoided. Although later authors such as Livy present it as a lasting civic taboo, the tradition is only attested from the 1st century BC and likely reflects later reconstruction rather than continuous observance from the 4th to the 1st century AD.

Bitka na Almi je potekala 20. septembra 1854 med krimsko vojno med zavezniško ekspedicijsko vojsko (francoskimi, britanskimi in osmanskimi silami) in ruskimi silami, ki so branile Krimski polotok. Zavezniki so se 14. septembra presenetljivo izkrcali na Krimu. Zavezniška poveljnika, maršal Jacques Leroy de Saint-Arnaud in lord Raglan, sta nato odkorakala proti strateško pomembnemu pristaniškemu mestu Sevastopol, oddaljenemu 45 km. Ruski poveljnik knez Aleksander Sergejevič Menšikov je razpoložljive sile hitro poslal na zadnji naravni obrambni položaj pred mestom, Alminske višine južno od reke Alme.
notes: The mile conversion and the English note that the name is short for Battle of the Alma River are left out.

source.title: Battle of the Alma
paragraphs: The Battle of the Alma (short for Battle of the Alma River) took place during the Crimean War between an allied expeditionary force (made up of French, British, and Ottoman forces) and Russian forces defending the Crimean Peninsula on 20 September 1854. The allies had made a surprise landing in Crimea on 14 September. The allied commanders, Maréchal Jacques Leroy de Saint-Arnaud and Lord Raglan, then marched toward the strategically important port city of Sevastopol, 45 km (28 miles) away. Russian commander Prince Alexander Sergeyevich Menshikov rushed his available forces to the last natural defensive position before the city, the Alma Heights, south of the Alma River.

Battle of the Alte Veste.headline: Bitka pri Alte Veste
paragraphs: Bitka pri Alte Veste ali bitka pri Fürthu je bila pomembna bitka tridesetletne vojne, v kateri so Wallensteinove vkopane čete porazile napadajoče sile Gustava Adolfa. Potekala je 3. septembra 1632 (med obleganjem Nürnberga) med katoliškimi silami cesarja Svetega rimskega cesarstva Ferdinanda II. in protestantskimi silami švedskega kralja Gustava II. Adolfa v obdobju švedskega posega v tridesetletno vojno.
Taktična zmaga katoliških sil je cesarski vojski omogočila hiter prodor na Saško, švedske sile pa so se morale umakniti.

source.title: Battle of the Alte Veste
paragraphs: The Battle of the Alte Veste or Battle of Fürth was a significant battle of the Thirty Years' War in which Gustavus Adolphus' attacking forces were defeated by Wallenstein's entrenched troops. It was fought on 3 September 1632 (in the process of the siege of Nuremberg) between the Catholic forces of Holy Roman Emperor Ferdinand II and the Protestant forces of King Gustavus II Adolphus of Sweden during the period of Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years War.
The tactical victory by the Catholic forces allowed the Imperial army to quickly advance into Saxony, while the Swedish forces were forced into retreat.

Battle of the Aous (198 BC).headline: Bitka ob Aoosu (198 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka ob Aoosu je potekala leta 198 pr. n. št. med Rimsko republiko in Makedonskim kraljestvom na območju med današnjima Tepeleno in Këlcyro v Albaniji. Rimske sile je vodil Tit Kvinkcij Flaminin, makedonske pa Filip V.

Antigonidska makedonska vojska se je utaborila za prelazom na nenapadljivem položaju. Krajevni pastir je Rimljane vodil po skrivni stezi za makedonski položaj. Flaminin je čete popeljal po tej stezi in Makedonce napadel od zadaj, zato njihovega položaja ni bilo več mogoče braniti; prizadejal jim je okoli 2000 izgub. Filipova vojska se je s preživelimi umaknila, poveljnika pa sta se naslednje leto znova srečala pri Kinoskefalah, kjer so Rimljani spet zmagali in končali vojno.
notes: The English spells the Roman commander Flaminius once; the Slovenian uses Flaminin throughout.

source.title: Battle of the Aous (198 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Aous was fought in 198 BC between the Roman Republic and the Kingdom of Macedon, in the area between modern Tepelenë and Këlcyrë in Albania. The Roman forces were led by Titus Quinctius Flamininus and the Macedonian ones were led by Philip V.

The Antigonid Macedonian army encamped behind a pass in an unassailable position. A local shepherd guided the Romans to a secret path that took them behind the Macedonian position. Flaminius led his troops through this secret path and attacked the Macedonians from the rear, rendering their position untenable and inflicting some 2,000 casualties. Philip's army retreated with the survivors, and the two commanders would meet again at Cynoscephalae the following year, where the Romans would triumph again and end the war.

Bitka na reki Arar je bila spopad med selečimi se plemeni Helvečanov in šestimi rimskimi legijami pod poveljstvom Gaja Julija Cezarja leta 58 pr. n. št. Bila je prva velika bitka galskih vojn in se je končala s taktično zmago številčno šibkejše rimske vojske.

source.title: Battle of the Arar
paragraphs: The Battle of the Arar was fought between the migrating tribes of the Helvetii and six Roman legions under the command of Gaius Julius Caesar in 58 BC. It was the first major battle of the Gallic Wars and ended in a tactical victory for the outnumbered Roman army.

Ardenska bitka je potekala med prvo svetovno vojno na mejah Francije, Nemčije, Belgije in Luksemburga od 21. do 23. avgusta 1914. Nemško cesarstvo je premagalo Tretjo francosko republiko in Francoze prisililo k umiku. Bitka je bila del večje bitke za meje, prve bitke na zahodni fronti.

source.title: Battle of the Ardennes
paragraphs: The Battle of the Ardennes took place during the First World War fought on the frontiers of France, Germany, Belgium and Luxembourg from 21 to 23 August 1914. The German Empire defeated the Third French Republic and forced a French retreat. The battle was part of the larger Battle of the Frontiers, the first battle of the Western Front.

Bitka na Axoni je potekala leta 57 pr. n. št. med rimsko vojsko Gaja Julija Cezarja in Belgi. Belgi pod vodstvom kralja Suesionov Galbe so napadli, a jih je Cezar odbil. Rimljani so zasledovanje odložili, ker so se bali zasede. Cezar bitko opisuje v Zapiskih o galski vojni (Commentarii de Bello Gallico), 2.7–2.11.

source.title: Battle of the Axona
paragraphs: The Battle of the Axona was fought in 57 BC, between the Roman army of Gaius Julius Caesar and the Belgae. The Belgae, led by King Galba of the Suessiones, attacked, only to be repelled by Caesar. Fearing an ambush, the Romans delayed their pursuit. Caesar's Commentarii de Bello Gallico describes this battle at 2.7 - 2.11.

Battle of the Barracks.headline: Bitka za vojašnice
paragraphs: Bitka za vojašnice (hrvaško: Bitka za vojarne) je bila vrsta spopadov sredi in v drugi polovici leta 1991 med Zborom narodne garde (ZNG, pozneje preimenovanim v Hrvaško vojsko) in hrvaško policijo na eni strani ter Jugoslovansko ljudsko armado (JLA) na drugi. Potekala je okoli številnih objektov JLA na Hrvaškem, potem ko so hrvaške sile blokirale vojašnice, skladišča orožja in druge objekte JLA. Formalno se je začela 14. septembra; njen cilj je bil onesposobiti položaje JLA na ozemlju pod nadzorom ZNG in slabo oboroženemu ZNG zagotoviti orožje in strelivo.

source.title: Battle of the Barracks
paragraphs: The Battle of the Barracks (Croatian: Bitka za vojarne) was a series of engagements that occurred in mid-to-late 1991 between the Croatian National Guard (ZNG, later renamed the Croatian Army) and the Croatian police on one side and the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) on the other. The battle took place around numerous JNA posts in Croatia, starting when Croatian forces blockaded the JNA barracks, weapons storage depots and other facilities. It formally began on 14 September; its objective was to neutralise the JNA positions in ZNG-held territory and to secure arms and ammunition supplies for the poorly equipped ZNG.

Bitka na Boorni (zahodnofrizijsko: Slach oan de Boarn; nizozemsko: Slag aan de Boorne) ali bitka pri Jirnsumu je bila spopad med Franki in Frizijci v 8. stoletju blizu ustja reke Boorne na območju današnjega Jirnsuma v nizozemski provinci Frizija.

source.title: Battle of the Boarn
paragraphs: The Battle of the Boarn (West Frisian: Slach oan de Boarn; Dutch: Slag aan de Boorne) or Battle by Jirnsum was an 8th century battle between the Franks and the Frisians near the mouth of the river Boarn in what is now Jirnsum in the Dutch province of Friesland.

Battle of the Bogside.headline: Bitka za Bogside
paragraphs: Bitka za Bogside je bila velik tridnevni izgred, ki je od 12. do 14. avgusta 1969 potekal v Derryju na Severnem Irskem. Na tisoče katoliških oziroma irskih nacionalističnih prebivalcev četrti Bogside, organiziranih v Derryjskem društvu za obrambo državljanov, se je spopadlo s Kraljevo ulstrsko policijo (RUC) in lojalisti ter četrt zaprlo za oblasti. Bitka je sprožila razširjeno nasilje drugod po Severni Irski, privedla do napotitve britanskih vojakov in jo pogosto štejejo za začetek tridesetletnega spopada, znanega kot nemiri (The Troubles).

source.title: Battle of the Bogside
paragraphs: The Battle of the Bogside was a large three-day riot that took place from 12 to 14 August 1969 in Derry, Northern Ireland. Thousands of Catholic/Irish nationalist residents of the Bogside, organised under the Derry Citizens' Defence Association, clashed with the Royal Ulster Constabulary (RUC) and loyalists, and sealed off the neighbourhood to authorities. It sparked widespread violence elsewhere in Northern Ireland, led to the deployment of British troops, and is often seen as the beginning of the thirty-year conflict known as the Troubles.

Battle of the Burbia River.headline: Bitka ob reki Burbia
paragraphs: Bitka pri Río Burbia ali bitka ob reki Burbia je potekala leta 791 med enotami Kraljestva Asturija pod poveljstvom asturijskega kralja Bermuda I. in enotami Kordobskega emirata pod vodstvom Jusufa ibn Buhta. Bitka je potekala v okviru pohodov (gazv) Hišama I. proti Asturijcem na severu Iberskega polotoka. Odvila se je blizu reke Burbia na območju današnjega kraja Villafranca del Bierzo in se končala z zmago Kordobskega emirata.

source.title: Battle of the Burbia River
paragraphs: The Battle of Río Burbia or the Battle of the Burbia River was fought in the year 791 between the troops of the Kingdom of Asturias, commanded by King Bermudo I of Asturias, and the troops of the Emirate of Córdoba, led by Yusuf ibn Bukht. The battle occurred in the context of the Ghazws of Hisham I against the Asturians in the northern Iberian Peninsula. The battle took place near the Río Burbia, in the area which is today known as Villafranca del Bierzo. The battle resulted in a victory for the Emirate of Cordoba.

Bitka za Kavkaz je bila vrsta operacij sil osi in Sovjetske zveze na Kavkazu v okviru vzhodne fronte druge svetovne vojne. Nemške čete so 25. julija 1942 zavzele Rostov na Donu in si odprle pot v kavkaško regijo na jugu Sovjetske zveze ter ogrozile naftna polja pri Majkopu, Groznem in nazadnje Bakuju. Dva dni prej je Adolf Hitler izdal ukaz za operacijo na Kavkazu z imenom Edelweiß. Nemške enote so na Kavkazu največ ozemlja dosegle v začetku novembra 1942, ko so prišle do kraja Alagir in mesta Ordžonikidze, okoli 610 km od izhodiščnih položajev. Sile osi so se morale z območja pozneje tisto zimo umakniti, ker jim je operacija Mali Saturn grozila z odrezanjem.

source.title: Battle of the Caucasus
paragraphs: The Battle of the Caucasus was a series of Axis and Soviet operations in the Caucasus as part of the Eastern Front of World War II. On 25 July 1942, German troops captured Rostov-on-Don, opening the Caucasus region of the southern Soviet Union to the Germans and threatening the oil fields beyond at Maykop, Grozny, and ultimately Baku. Two days prior, Adolf Hitler had issued a directive to launch an operation into the Caucasus named Operation Edelweiß. German units would reach their high water mark in the Caucasus in early November 1942, getting as far as the town of Alagir and city of Ordzhonikidze, some 610 km from their starting positions. Axis forces were compelled to withdraw from the area later that winter as Operation Little Saturn threatened to cut them off.

Battle of the Caudine Forks.headline: Bitka pri Kavdinskih soteskah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kavdinskih soteskah (321 pr. n. št.) je bila odločilen dogodek druge samnitske vojne. Da je to bitka, je zgolj zgodovinska formalnost: bojev ni bilo in izgub tudi ne. Samniti so Rimljane ujeli v zaprti dolini, še preden so ti ugotovili, kaj se dogaja, in nič drugega jim ni preostalo, kot da se pogajajo o neugodni vdaji. Dogajanje je bilo povsem politično: magistrati na obeh straneh so skušali doseči najboljše pogoje za svojo stran, ne da bi žalili splošno sprejeta prepričanja o pravilih vojne in ravnanju v miru. Nazadnje so se Samniti odločili, da bo za prihodnje odnose bolje, če Rimljane izpustijo, Rimljane pa so pri nadaljevanju pohoda proti Samnitom ovirali verski razlogi in čast.
notes: No established Slovenian form of Caudine Forks was found; Kavdinske soteske is used.

source.title: Battle of the Caudine Forks
paragraphs: The Battle of Caudine Forks (321 BC) was a decisive event of the Second Samnite War. Its designation as a battle is a mere historical formality: there was no fighting and there were no casualties. The Romans were trapped in an enclosed valley by the Samnites before they knew what was happening and nothing remained but to negotiate an unfavorable surrender. The action was entirely political, with the magistrates on both sides trying to obtain the best terms for their side without disrespecting common beliefs concerning the rules of war and the conduct of peace. In the end the Samnites decided it would be better for future relations to let the Romans go, while the Romans were impeded in the prosecution of their campaign against the Samnites by considerations of religion and honor.

Battle of the Chernaya.headline: Bitka na Černaji
paragraphs: Bitka na Černaji (tudi Tchernaïa; rusko: Сражение у Черной речки, Сражение у реки Черной, dobesedno »bitka ob Črni reki«) je potekala 16. avgusta 1855 pri Traktirskem mostu na reki Černaji med krimsko vojno. Spopadle so se ruske, francoske, piemontske in osmanske čete. Reka Černaja teče na obrobju Sevastopola, blizu zavezniške oblegovalne črte okoli mesta.
Ruski napad je bil slabo organiziran in izveden, številčno šibkejše zavezniške sile pod poveljstvom A. Pélissierja in A. La Marmore pa so ga odbile.
M. Gorčakov je osebno sodeloval v vročici boja, a izida ni mogel obrniti v prid Rusije.

source.title: Battle of the Chernaya
paragraphs: The Battle of the Chernaya (also Tchernaïa; Russian: Сражение у Черной речки, Сражение у реки Черной, literally: Battle of the Black River) was fought at the Traktir Bridge on the Chernaya River during the Crimean War on August 16, 1855. The battle was fought between Russian, French, Piedmontese and Ottoman troops. The Chernaya River is on the outskirts of Sevastopol, near the line of the allies' siege of the city.
The Russian attack was poorly organised and conducted, and was defeated by the numerically inferior allied forces under commanders A. Pélissier and A. La Marmora.
M. Gorchakov personally participated in the heat of battle, but was unable to tilt the outcome in Russia's favor.

Battle of the Colline Gate.headline: Bitka pri Kolinskih vratih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kolinskih vratih, ki je potekala 1. novembra 82 pr. n. št., je bila odločilna bitka državljanske vojne med Lucijem Kornelijem Sulo ter Marijevci, Samniti in Lukanci. Sula je bitko dobil na severovzhodnem koncu Rima, blizu Kolinskih vrat, in si zagotovil nadzor nad Italijo. Podrobnosti o bitki navaja samo Apijan.
Naslednji dan je Sula ukazal pobiti marijevske voditelje in samnitske ujetnike v Villi Publici. 3. novembra je začel s proskripcijo svojih sovražnikov.

source.title: Battle of the Colline Gate
paragraphs: The Battle of the Colline Gate, fought on 1 November 82 BC, was the decisive battle of the civil war between Lucius Cornelius Sulla and the Marians, Samnites and Lucanians. Sulla won the battle at the northeastern end of Rome, near the Colline Gate, and secured control of Italy. Appian is the only source who provides details about the battle.
The next day Sulla ordered the slaughter of the Marian leaders and Samnite prisoners in the Villa Publica. On 3 November, he started the proscription of his enemies.

Battle of the Cremera.headline: Bitka ob Kremeri
paragraphs: Bitka ob Kremeri je potekala med Rimsko republiko in etruščanskim mestom Veji leta 477 pr. n. št. (AUC 277).
Verjetno se je zgodila 18. julija, čeprav Ovidij navaja drug datum: 13. februar.

source.title: Battle of the Cremera
paragraphs: The Battle of the Cremera was fought between the Roman Republic and the Etruscan city of Veii, in 477 BC (AUC 277).
It most likely occurred on 18 July, although Ovid gives a different date of 13 February.

Battle of the Crimissus.headline: Bitka ob reki Krimis
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki Krimis (zapisana tudi Crimisus in Crimesus) je potekala leta 339 pr. n. št. med veliko kartažansko vojsko pod poveljstvom Asdrubala in Hamilkarja ter vojsko Sirakuz pod vodstvom Timoleona. Timoleon je kartažansko vojsko presenetljivo napadel blizu reke Krimis v zahodni Siciliji (sprva so menili, da gre za današnjo reko Belice v jugozahodni Siciliji, nedavno pa so jo prepoznali kot današnjo reko Freddo v severozahodni Siciliji) in dosegel veliko zmago. Ko je kmalu zatem premagal še eno, veliko manjšo kartažansko vojsko, je Kartagina zaprosila za mir. Mir je grškim mestom na Siciliji omogočil okrevanje in začel obdobje stabilnosti. Vendar je po Timoleonovi smrti, kmalu po tem, ko je Agatokles leta 317 pr. n. št. prevzel oblast, izbruhnila nova vojna med Sirakuzami in Kartagino.

source.title: Battle of the Crimissus
paragraphs: The Battle of the Crimissus (also spelled Crimisus and Crimesus) was fought in 339 BC between a large Carthaginian army commanded by Asdrubal and Hamilcar and an army from Syracuse led by Timoleon. Timoleon attacked the Carthaginian army by surprise near the Crimissus river in western Sicily (originally it was thought that it was the modern Belice river in southwest Sicily, but it has been recently identified with the modern Freddo river in northwest Sicily) and won a great victory. When he defeated another much smaller force of Carthaginians shortly afterwards, Carthage sued for peace. The peace allowed the Greek cities on Sicily to recover and began a period of stability. However, another war between Syracuse and Carthage erupted after Timoleon's death, not long after Agathocles seized power in 317 BC.

Battle of the Dnieper.headline: Bitka za Dneper
paragraphs: Bitka za Dneper, na nemški strani znana kot obrambne bitke ob Dnepru (nemško: Abwehrschlachten am Dnepr), je bila vojaška kampanja leta 1943 na vzhodni fronti druge svetovne vojne. Bila je ena največjih operacij vojne: v nekem trenutku je v njej sodelovalo skoraj štiri milijone vojakov, fronta pa je segala 1400 kilometrov daleč.

Pet front Rdeče armade je v štirih mesecih nemškim silam iztrgalo vzhodni breg Dnepra; z več jurišnimi prehodi čez reko so si ustvarile več mostišč na zahodnem bregu. Kijev je bil pozneje osvobojen v drugi bitki za Kijev. Za sodelovanje v bitki je naziv heroja Sovjetske zveze prejelo 2438 vojakov Rdeče armade.
notes: The mile conversion is left out.

source.title: Battle of the Dnieper
paragraphs: The Battle of the Dnieper, known on the German side as the Defensive battles on the Dnieper (German: Abwehrschlachten am Dnepr), was a military campaign that took place in 1943 on the Eastern Front of World War II. Being one of the largest operations of the war, it involved almost four million troops at one point and stretched over a 1,400 kilometres (870 mi) front.

Over four months, the eastern bank of the Dnieper was recovered from German forces by five of the Red Army's fronts, which conducted several assault river crossings to establish several lodgements on the western bank. Kiev was later liberated in the Second Battle of Kiev. 2,438 Red Army soldiers were awarded the title Hero of the Soviet Union for their involvement.

Battle of the Downs.headline: Bitka pri Downsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Downsu 21. oktobra 1639 je potekala v osemdesetletni vojni. Nizozemske sile pod Maartenom Trompom so premagale špansko ladjevje pod poveljstvom Antonia de Oquenda, zmaga pa je potrdila nizozemski nadzor nad Rokavskim prelivom in Severnim morjem.

Bitka se je začela, ko je španski prvi minister Olivares poslal velik konvoj enot in zalog za flandrijsko armado, ki ga je spremljalo okoli 50 vojnih ladij. Od leta 1621 se je španska pomorska dejavnost v Rokavskem prelivu osredotočala na izogibanje neposrednemu spopadu z močnejšim nizozemskim ladjevjem, medtem ko je iz kaperskih oporišč v Dunkerqueu in Ostendu napadala nizozemske trgovske ladje. Oquendo je v nasprotju s to politiko dobil ukaz, naj okrepitve dostavi, hkrati pa Nizozemce prisili v bitko; Olivares je upal, da bo zmaga znova uveljavila špansko pomorsko prevlado v severnoevropskih vodah, obnovila španski ugled in nizozemske generalne stanove prisilila v mirovna pogajanja.

source.title: Battle of the Downs
paragraphs: The Battle of the Downs, 21 October 1639, took place during the Eighty Years' War. A Spanish fleet commanded by Antonio de Oquendo was defeated by a Dutch force under Maarten Tromp, a victory that confirmed Dutch control of the English Channel and North Sea.

The battle was initiated when Spanish chief minister Olivares sent a large convoy of troops and supplies for the Army of Flanders, escorted by some 50 warships. Since 1621, Spanish naval activity in the Channel had focused on avoiding direct conflict with the superior Dutch fleet, while attacking their merchant ships from privateering bases in Dunkirk and Ostend. In a change from this policy, Oquendo was ordered to deliver the reinforcements but also bring the Dutch to battle; Olivares hoped victory would reassert Spanish naval dominance in northern European waters, restore Spanish prestige and force the Dutch States General to negotiate peace terms.

Battle of the Drina.headline: Bitka na Drini
paragraphs: Bitka na Drini (srbsko: Bitka na Drini, Битка на Дрини) je potekala med srbsko in avstro-ogrsko vojsko septembra 1914 blizu Loznice v Srbiji, med prvo srbsko kampanjo prve svetovne vojne.

Po prvem neuspelem vdoru v Srbijo, v katerem je izgubil 40.000 mož, je Oskar Potiorek, avstro-ogrski poveljnik Balkanstreitkräfte, začel novo ofenzivo čez reko Drino na zahodni srbski meji. Avstro-ogrske sile so reko uspešno prečkale v noči s 7. na 8. september, nato pa so jih ustavili močni srbski obrambni položaji. Srbska vojska je morala medtem končati ofenzivo v avstrijski Srem in prerazporediti sile proti novi grožnji. Na skrajnem zahodu je manjša skupina srbskih in črnogorskih čet vdrla v Bosno in zavzela Višegrad. Na jugu so Avstrijci zavzeli Šabac (Shabatz). Protinapad je Avstrijce 17. septembra potisnil nazaj do Drine, kjer sta se obe strani ukopali v jarke.
Bitka na Drini velja za eno najbolj krvavih na balkanski fronti te vojne.

source.title: Battle of the Drina
paragraphs: The Battle of the Drina (Serbian: Bitka na Drini, Битка на Дрини) was fought between Serbian and Austro-Hungarian armies in September 1914, near Loznica, Serbia, during the First Serbian campaign of World War I.

After a first failed invasion of Serbia where he lost 40,000 men, Oskar Potiorek, the Austro-Hungarian commander of the Balkanstreitkräfte, launched a new offensive across the River Drina at the western Serbian border; after successfully crossing the river the night of 7—8 September the Austro-Hungarian forces were stopped facing strong Serbian defensive positions. In the meantime, the Serbian army was forced to end their offensive into Austrian Syrmia and regroup their forces to face the threat. Meanwhile, in the far west, a smaller force of Serbian and Montenegrin troops moved into Bosnia, taking Višegrad. In the South, the Austrians took Shabatz (Šabac). On 17 September, a counterattack pushed the Austrians back to the Drina, where both sides settled into trench warfare.
The Battle of the Drina is considered one of the bloodiest on the war's Balkan Front.

Bitka za Dukelski prelaz, znana tudi kot dukelska, karpatsko-dukelska, rzeszowsko-dukelska ali dukelsko-prešovska ofenziva, je bila spopad za nadzor nad Dukelskim prelazom na meji med Poljsko in Slovaško na vzhodni fronti druge svetovne vojne med nacistično Nemčijo in Sovjetsko zvezo septembra in oktobra 1944. Bila je del sovjetske vzhodnokarpatske strateške ofenzive, ki je obsegala tudi karpatsko-užgorodsko ofenzivo. Glavni cilj operacije, podpora slovaški narodni vstaji, ni bil dosežen, z njo pa se je končala popolna osvoboditev Ukrajinske SSR.

source.title: Battle of the Dukla Pass
paragraphs: The Battle of the Dukla Pass, also known as the Dukla, Carpatho–Dukla, Rzeszów–Dukla, or Dukla–Prešov offensive, was the battle for control over the Dukla Pass on the border between Poland and Slovakia on the Eastern Front of World War II between Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union in September–October 1944. It was part of the Soviet east Carpathian strategic offensive that also included the Carpathian–Uzhgorod offensive. The operation's primary goal, to provide support for the Slovak National Uprising, was not achieved, but it concluded the full liberation of the Ukrainian SSR.

Bitka na sipinah (francosko: Bataille des Dunes, špansko: Batalla de las Dunas), znana tudi kot bitka pri Dunkerqu, je potekala 14. junija 1658 blizu strateškega pristanišča Dunkerque na tedanji Španski Nizozemski. V okviru francosko-španske vojne in sočasne angleško-španske vojne je francoska vojska pod vodstvom Turenna ob podpori čet Angleške republike oblegala Dunkerque. Španske sile pod vodstvom don Juana Joséja Avstrijskega in Ludvika, Velikega Condéja, ki so jih podpirali rojalistična vojska v izgnanstvu in francoski uporniki fronde, so skušale obleganje prekiniti, a so doživele hud poraz.

Kljub zmagi sta bili Francija in Španija zaradi dolge vojne finančno izčrpani in sta novembra 1659 izpogajali pirenejski mir. Anglija je Dunkerque obdržala do leta 1662, ko ga je Karel II. prodal Franciji.

source.title: Battle of the Dunes (1658)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Dunes (French: Bataille des Dunes, Spanish: Batalla de las Dunas), also known as the Battle of Dunkirk, took place on 14 June 1658, near the strategic port of Dunkirk in what was then the Spanish Netherlands. Part of the Franco-Spanish War and concurrent Anglo-Spanish War, a French army under Turenne, supported by troops from the Commonwealth of England, had besieged Dunkirk. Led by John Joseph of Austria and Louis, Grand Condé, a Spanish force supported by the Royalist Army in Exile and French Fronde rebels attempted to raise the siege but suffered a severe defeat.

Despite this victory, both the French and Spanish were financially exhausted by the long running war and negotiated the Treaty of the Pyrenees in November 1659. England retained possession of Dunkirk until 1662 when the port was sold to France by Charles II.

Bitka za meje (francosko: Bataille des Frontières; nemško: Grenzschlachten; nizozemsko: Slag der Grenzen) je obsegala bitke vzdolž vzhodne meje Francije in v južni Belgiji kmalu po izbruhu prve svetovne vojne. V njih sta se preizkusili vojaška strategija načelnika francoskega generalštaba generala Josepha Joffra z načrtom XVII in napadalna priredba nemškega načrta razmestitve Aufmarsch II Helmutha von Moltkeja mlajšega. Nemške sile, zbrane na desnem (severnem) krilu, naj bi zavile skozi Belgijo in Francoze napadle v hrbet.

source.title: Battle of the Frontiers
paragraphs: The Battle of the Frontiers (French: Bataille des Frontières; German: Grenzschlachten; Dutch: Slag der Grenzen) comprised battles fought along the eastern frontier of France and in southern Belgium, shortly after the outbreak of the First World War. The battles resolved the military strategies of the French Chief of Staff General Joseph Joffre with Plan XVII and an offensive adaptation of the German Aufmarsch II deployment plan by Helmuth von Moltke the Younger. The German concentration on the right (northern) flank, was to wheel through Belgium and attack the French in the rear.

Battle of the Gabbard.headline: Bitka pri Gabbardu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gabbardu je bila pomorska bitka, ki je potekala od 2. do 3. junija 1653 v prvi angleško-nizozemski vojni. Odvila se je blizu plitvine Gabbard pred obalo Suffolka v Angliji med ladjevjema Angleške republike in Nizozemske republike in se končala s pomembno angleško zmago.

source.title: Battle of the Gabbard
paragraphs: The Battle of the Gabbard, was a naval battle fought from 2 to 3 June 1653 during the First Anglo-Dutch War. It took place near the Gabbard shoal off the coast of Suffolk, England, between fleets of the Commonwealth of England and the Dutch Republic. It resulted in a significant English victory.

Battle of the Gebora.headline: Bitka ob Gebori
paragraphs: Bitka ob Gebori je potekala v polotoški vojni med špansko in francosko vojsko 19. februarja 1811 severozahodno od Badajoza v Španiji. Številčno šibkejše francoske sile so pognale v beg in skoraj uničile špansko vojsko Extremadure.

Da bi pomagal rešiti vojsko maršala Andréja Massénaja iz zagate na Portugalskem – obtičala je pred lizbonskimi obrambnimi linijami Torres Vedras –, je maršal Jean de Dieu Soult del francoske Armée du Midi (Južne armade) iz Andaluzije povedel v sosednjo špansko pokrajino Extremaduro in oblegal pomembno utrjeno mesto Badajoz. Vikont Wellington in španski generalni kapitan Pedro Caro y Sureda, 3. markiz de La Romana, sta poslala špansko vojsko, da bi obleganje prekinila. La Romana pa je umrl, preden je vojska odšla, in poveljstvo je prevzel general Gabriel de Mendizábal Iraeta. Španci so ob podpori manjših portugalskih konjeniških sil prišli do mesta in se v začetku februarja 1811 utaborili na bližnjih višavah San Cristóbal.

source.title: Battle of the Gebora
paragraphs: The Battle of the Gebora took place during the Peninsular War between Spanish and French armies on 19 February 1811, northwest of Badajoz, Spain. An outnumbered French force routed and nearly destroyed the Spanish Army of Extremadura.

In a bid to help extricate Marshal André Masséna's army from its position in Portugal—mired in front of Lisbon's defensive Lines of Torres Vedras—Marshal Jean de Dieu Soult led part of the French Armée du Midi (Army of the South) from Andalusia into the neighbouring Spanish region of Extremadura and laid siege to the important fortress town of Badajoz. Viscount Wellington and the Spanish captain-general Pedro Caro y Sureda, 3rd Marquis de La Romana, sent a Spanish army to raise the siege. La Romana, however, died before the army could depart, and command fell to General Gabriel de Mendizábal Iraeta. Supported by a small force of Portuguese cavalry, the Spaniards reached the town and camped on the nearby heights of San Cristóbal in early February 1811.

Battle of the Golden Spurs.headline: Bitka zlatih ostrog
paragraphs: Bitka zlatih ostrog (nizozemsko: Guldensporenslag; francosko: Bataille des éperons d'or) ali bitka pri Kortrijku je bila vojaški spopad med francosko kraljevo vojsko in uporniškimi silami grofije Flandrije 11. julija 1302 med francosko-flamsko vojno 1297–1305. Potekala je blizu mesta Kortrijk v današnji Belgiji in se končala z nepričakovano zmago Flamcev.

Po dveh letih francoske vojaške zasedbe in več letih nemirov so se 18. maja 1302 številna flandrijska mesta uprla francoski oblasti, domača milica pa je v Bruggeu pobila veliko Francozov. Francoski kralj Filip IV. je takoj organiziral pohod 8000 vojakov, med njimi 2500 oklepnih konjenikov, pod poveljstvom grofa Roberta II. Artoiškega, da bi zatrl upor. Medtem so zbrali 9400 mož iz meščanskih milic več flamskih mest, da bi se zoperstavili pričakovanemu francoskemu napadu.

source.title: Battle of the Golden Spurs
paragraphs: The Battle of the Golden Spurs (Dutch: Guldensporenslag; French: Bataille des éperons d'or) or Battle of Courtrai was a military confrontation between the royal army of France and rebellious forces of the County of Flanders on 11 July 1302 during the 1297–1305 Franco-Flemish War. It took place near the town of Kortrijk in modern-day Belgium and resulted in an unexpected victory for the Flemish.

On 18 May 1302, after two years of French military occupation and several years of unrest, many cities in Flanders revolted against French rule, and the local militia massacred many Frenchmen in the city of Bruges. King Philip IV of France immediately organized an expedition of 8,000 troops, including 2,500 men-at-arms, under Count Robert II of Artois to put down the rebellion. Meanwhile, 9,400 men from the civic militias of several Flemish cities were assembled to counter the expected French attack.

Battle of the Hague (1940).headline: Bitka za Haag (1940)
paragraphs: Bitka za Haag (nizozemsko: Slag om Den Haag) je potekala 10. maja 1940 med bitko za Nizozemsko. Nemške padalske enote (Fallschirmjäger) so odvrgli v Haag in okolico, da bi zavzele nizozemska letališča in samo mesto.

Nacistična Nemčija je pričakovala, da se bo Nizozemska po zavarovanju mostišča še isti dan predala. Nemci tega cilja niso dosegli, saj njihove sile začetnih pridobitev niso mogle obdržati: Nizozemci so se namreč znova zbrali in sprožili učinkovite protinapade. Osamljene skupine nemških vojakov pod vodstvom Hansa von Sponecka so se umaknile v bližnje sipine, kjer so jih pet dni nenehno zasledovali in nadlegovali, dokler se nizozemski vrhovni poveljnik Henri Winkelman zaradi hudih porazov na drugih frontah ni moral predati.

source.title: Battle of the Hague (1940)
paragraphs: The Battle for The Hague (Dutch: Slag om Den Haag) took place on 10 May 1940 during the Battle of the Netherlands. German Fallschirmjäger units were dropped in and around The Hague to capture Dutch airfields and the city itself.

After securing a bridgehead, Nazi Germany had expected the Netherlands to surrender that day. The Germans, however, failed to achieve that objective since their forces had been unable to hold onto their initial gains. That is because the Dutch regrouped and then launched effective counter-attacks. Isolated pockets of German troops, led by Hans von Sponeck, retreated to the nearby dunes, where they were continually pursued and harassed for five days, when Henri Winkelman, the Dutch commander-in-chief, was forced to surrender by major setbacks on other fronts.

Bitka heringov, imenovana tudi bitka pri Rouvrayju, je bila vojaški spopad blizu mesta Rouvray v Franciji, severno od Orléansa, 12. februarja 1429 med obleganjem Orléansa v stoletni vojni. Neposredni povod zanjo je bil poskus francoskih in škotskih sil pod vodstvom Karla Burbonskega in sira Johna Stewarta iz Darnleyja, da bi prestregle oskrbovalni konvoj, namenjen angleški vojski pri Orléansu. Angleži so mesto oblegali od oktobra prejšnjega leta. Konvoj je spremljala angleška četa pod poveljstvom sira Johna Fastolfa; opremili so ga v Parizu, od koder je odpotoval nekaj časa prej. Angleži so bitko prepričljivo dobili.

Po navedbah Régine Pernoud je konvoj sestavljalo »okoli 300 dvokolnic in vozov, ki so prevažali puščice za samostrele, topove in topovske krogle, pa tudi sode heringov«. Sode s heringi so pošiljali, ker se je bližal postni čas brez mesa. Prav ta zaloga rib je bitki dala nekoliko nenavadno ime.

source.title: Battle of the Herrings
paragraphs: The Battle of the Herrings, also called the Battle of Rouvray, was a military action near the town of Rouvray in France, just north of Orléans, which took place on 12 February 1429, during the siege of Orléans in the Hundred Years' War. The immediate cause of the battle was an attempt by French and Scottish forces, led by Charles of Bourbon and Sir John Stewart of Darnley, to intercept a supply convoy headed for the English army at Orléans. The English had been laying siege to the city since the previous October. This supply convoy was escorted by an English force under Sir John Fastolf and had been outfitted in Paris, from whence it had departed some time earlier. The battle was decisively won by the English.

According to Régine Pernoud, the supply train consisted of "some 300 carts and wagons, carrying crossbow shafts, cannons and cannonballs but also barrels of herring". The latter were being sent since the meatless Lenten days were approaching. It was the presence of this stock of fish which would give the somewhat unusual name to the battle.

Battle of the Himera River (311 BC).headline: Bitka ob reki Himera leta 311 pr. n. št.
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki Himera je potekala leta 311 pr. n. št. med Kartagino in Sirakuzami blizu izliva reke Himera (današnja reka Salso). Kartažane je vodil Hamilkar, vnuk Hanona Velikega, Sirakužane pa Agatokles. Agatokles je Kartažane sprva presenetil z napadom na njihovo taborišče, vendar so Grki bitko izgubili, ko so jih napadle nepričakovane kartažanske okrepitve. Med umikom je grška vojska utrpela velike izgube. Agatokles je uspel zbrati ostanke vojske in se umakniti v Sirakuze, a je izgubil nadzor nad Sicilijo.

Ime Himera so v klasični antiki uporabljali za dve reki na Siciliji: Imera Settentrionale in Salso. Imera Settentrionale teče proti severu do izliva na mestu antične Himere, Salso pa teče proti jugu do izliva v današnji Licati. Bitka je potekala blizu izliva reke Salso, ker so se Kartažani med bitko utaborili na griču Ecnomus. Ta grič leži zahodno od Licate.

source.title: Battle of the Himera River (311 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Himera River was fought in 311 BC between Carthage and Syracuse near the mouth of the Himera river (the modern Salso river). Hamilcar, grandson of Hanno the Great, led the Carthaginians, while the Syracusans were led by Agathocles. Agathocles initially surprised the Carthaginians with an attack on their camp, but the Greeks lost the battle when they were attacked by unexpected Carthaginian reinforcements. The Greek army took many casualties as it retreated. Agathocles managed to gather the remains of his army and retreat to Syracuse, but lost control of Sicily.

In classical antiquity the name Himera was used for two rivers on Sicily: the Imera Settentrionale and the Salso. The Imera Settentrionale flows north towards its mouth at the site of ancient Himera, the Salso follows a southern course to its mouth in modern Licata. The battle took place near the mouth of the Salso river because the Carthaginians positioned themselves on the hill of Ecnomus during the battle. This hill lies west of Licata.

Battle of the Iron Gate.headline: Bitka pri Železnih vratih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Železnih vratih (v starejšem zgodovinopisju bitka pri Hermannstadtu/Szebenu) je potekala med vojsko Ogrskega kraljestva in Osmanskim cesarstvom 18. in 22. marca 1442 blizu Marosszentimreja (danes Sântimbru v Romuniji) in nato na prelazu Železna vrata v Transilvaniji. Ogrske sile je vodil Janoš Hunyadi, osmanske pa Mezid-beg, mejni gospod Nikopola. Bila je Hunyadijeva tretja zmaga nad Osmani, po osvoboditvi obleganega Smedereva leta 1437 in porazu Ishak-bega na pol poti med Smederevom in Beogradom leta 1441.

source.title: Battle of the Iron Gate
paragraphs: The Battle of the Iron Gate (Battle of Hermannstadt/Szeben by older historiography) was fought between the army of the Kingdom of Hungary and the Ottoman Empire on 18 March and 22 March 1442, near Marosszentimre (now Sântimbru, Romania) and after at the Iron Gate Pass of Transylvania. The Hungarian forces were commanded by John Hunyadi and the Ottoman forces by Mezid Bey, the Marcher Lord of Nicopolis. This was Hunyadi's third victory over the Ottomans after the relief of Smederevo in 1437 and the defeat of Ishak Beg midway between Semendria and Belgrade in 1441.

Battle of the Katzbach.headline: Bitka na Katzbachu
paragraphs: Bitka na Katzbachu 26. avgusta 1813 je bila velika bitka napoleonskih vojn med silami prvega francoskega cesarstva pod vodstvom maršala MacDonalda in rusko-prusko vojsko šeste koalicije pod vodstvom pruskega maršala grofa von Blücherja. Potekala je med hudo nevihto ob reki Katzbach med Wahlstattom in Liegnitzem v pruski provinci Šleziji. Bila je istega dne kot bitka za Dresden in se je končala z zmago koalicije, Francozi pa so se umaknili na Saško.

source.title: Battle of the Katzbach
paragraphs: The Battle of the Katzbach on 26 August 1813, was a major battle of the Napoleonic Wars between the forces of the First French Empire under Marshal MacDonald and a Russo-Prussian army of the Sixth Coalition under Prussian Marshal Graf (Count) von Blücher. It occurred during a heavy thunderstorm at the Katzbach river between Wahlstatt and Liegnitz in the Prussian province of Silesia. Taking place the same day as the Battle of Dresden, it resulted in a Coalition victory, with the French retreating to Saxony.

Battle of the Kerch Peninsula.headline: Bitka na Kerškem polotoku
paragraphs: Bitka na Kerškem polotoku, ki se je začela s sovjetsko kerško-feodosijsko desantno operacijo (rusko: Керченско-Феодосийская десантная операция) in končala z nemško operacijo Lov na droplje (nemško: Unternehmen Trappenjagd), je bila bitka druge svetovne vojne med nemško-romunsko 11. armado Ericha von Mansteina in silami sovjetske krimske fronte na Kerškem polotoku na vzhodu Krimskega polotoka. Začela se je 26. decembra 1941 z amfibijskim izkrcanjem dveh sovjetskih armad, ki naj bi prekinili obleganje Sevastopola. Sile osi so sovjetsko mostišče najprej zamejile čez zimo in z letalskimi napadi prekinjale njegove pomorske oskrbovalne poti. Krimska fronta je od januarja do aprila večkrat napadla 11. armado, a so vsi napadi spodleteli z velikimi izgubami. Rdeča armada je v napadih izgubila 352.000 mož, sile osi pa so utrpele 24.120 žrtev. Za sovjetski polom je bila v veliki meri kriva premoč nemškega topništva.

source.title: Battle of the Kerch Peninsula
paragraphs: The Battle of the Kerch Peninsula, which commenced with the Soviet Kerch-Feodosia Landing Operation (Russian: Керченско-Феодосийская десантная операция, romanized: Kerchensko-Feodosiyskaya desantnaya operatsiya) and ended with the German Operation Bustard Hunt (German: Unternehmen Trappenjagd), was a World War II battle between Erich von Manstein's German and Romanian 11th Army and the Soviet Crimean Front forces in the Kerch Peninsula, in the eastern part of the Crimean Peninsula. It began on 26 December 1941, with an amphibious landing operation by two Soviet armies intended to break the Siege of Sevastopol. Axis forces first contained the Soviet beachhead throughout the winter and interdicted its naval supply lines through aerial bombing. From January through April, the Crimean Front launched repeated offensives against the 11th Army, all of which failed with heavy losses. The Red Army lost 352,000 men in the attacks, while the Axis suffered 24,120 casualties. Superior German artillery firepower was largely responsible for the Soviet debacle.

Battle of the Kodori Valley.headline: Bitka v dolini Kodori
paragraphs: Bitka v dolini Kodori je bila vojaška operacija med rusko-gruzijsko vojno v Zgornji dolini Kodori v Abhaziji, odcepljeni regiji Gruzije. To je bil pred spopadom edini del Abhazije pod gruzijskim nadzorom. Abhaška vojska je 9. avgusta 2008 ob podpori ruskih sil začela operacijo, da bi iz sporne soteske pregnala preostale gruzijske čete. Po treh dneh se je gruzijska vojska iz Zgornje doline Kodori umaknila.

source.title: Battle of the Kodori Valley
paragraphs: The Battle of the Kodori Valley was a military operation during the Russo-Georgian War in the Upper Kodori Valley of Abkhazia, a breakaway region of Georgia. It was the only part of Abkhazia under Georgian control before this military conflict. On 9 August 2008, the Abkhaz military, with support by Russian forces, launched an operation to remove the remaining Georgian troops from the disputed gorge. After three days, the Georgian military withdrew from the Upper Kodori Valley.

Battle of the Leitha River.headline: Bitka ob Litavi
paragraphs: Bitka ob Litavi je potekala 15. junija 1246 blizu bregov reke Litave (Leitha) med silami ogrskega kralja Béle IV. in avstrijskega vojvode Friderika II. Ogrska vojska je bila razbita, a je vojvoda Friderik padel, s čimer so se končale avstrijske zahteve po zahodnih ogrskih komitatih. Natančen kraj ni znan; po opisu sodobnega minnesängerja Ulricha von Liechtensteina je bojišče morda ležalo med mestoma Ebenfurth in Neufeld.

Proti koncu 10. stoletja, v času vladavine Gejze, je reka Litava veljala za mejo med Ogrsko in nemškimi deželami. Ozemlja zahodno od Litave so bila kot Štajerska marka vključena v Sveto rimsko cesarstvo. Leta 1180 je cesar Friderik Barbarossa štajerske dežele povzdignil v vojvodino, ki so jo leta 1192 pridobili avstrijski vojvode iz rodbine Babenberžanov.

source.title: Battle of the Leitha River
paragraphs: The Battle of the Leitha River was fought on 15 June 1246 near the banks of the Leitha river between the forces of the King Béla IV of Hungary and Duke Frederick II of Austria. The Hungarian army was routed, but Duke Frederick was killed, ending Austrian claims to the western counties of Hungary. Its exact location is unknown; according to the description delivered by contemporary minnesinger Ulrich von Liechtenstein the battlefield may have been between the towns of Ebenfurth and Neufeld.

Towards the end of the tenth century, in the reign of Géza, the River Leitha came to be seen as the boundary between Hungary and the German lands. The territories west of the Leitha were incorporated as the March of Styria into the Holy Roman Empire. In 1180 Emperor Frederick Barbarossa raised the Styrian lands to a duchy, which in 1192 was acquired by the Austrian dukes from the House of Babenberg.

Bitka za Lys, znana tudi kot četrta bitka za Ypres, je potekala od 7. do 29. aprila 1918 in je bila del nemške pomladanske ofenzive v Flandriji med prvo svetovno vojno. General Erich Ludendorff jo je prvotno načrtoval kot operacijo George, a so jo skrčili v operacijo Georgette, katere cilj je bil zavzeti Ypres, potisniti britanske sile nazaj do pristanišč ob Rokavskem prelivu in jih izločiti iz vojne. Po načrtovanju, izvedbi in učinkih je bila Georgette podobna operaciji Michael (čeprav manjša od nje), ki je potekala prej v pomladanski ofenzivi.

source.title: Battle of the Lys (1918)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Lys, also known as the Fourth Battle of Ypres, was fought from 7 to 29 April 1918 and was part of the German spring offensive in Flanders during the First World War. It was originally planned by General Erich Ludendorff as Operation George but was reduced to Operation Georgette, with the objective of capturing Ypres, forcing the British forces back to the Channel ports and out of the war. In planning, execution and effects, Georgette was similar to (although smaller than) Operation Michael, earlier in the Spring Offensive.

Battle of the Lys (1940).headline: Bitka za Lys (1940)
paragraphs: Bitka za Lys (francosko: Bataille de la Lys, nizozemsko: Leieslag) je bila velik spopad med belgijskimi in nemškimi silami med nemško invazijo na Belgijo leta 1940 in zadnja velika bitka belgijskih čet pred njihovo predajo 28. maja. Bila je najkrvavejša bitka 18-dnevnega pohoda. Ime je dobila po reki Leie (francosko: Lys), ob kateri je ležalo bojišče.

source.title: Battle of the Lys (1940)
paragraphs: The Battle of the Lys (French: Bataille de la Lys, Dutch: Leieslag) was a major battle between Belgian and German forces during the German invasion of Belgium of 1940 and the final major battle fought by Belgian troops before their surrender on 28 May. The battle was the bloodiest of the 18 Days' Campaign. The battle was named after the Leie (French: Lys), the river at which the battlefield occurred.

Battle of the Margus.headline: Bitka ob Margu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Margu ali bitka pri Margumu je potekala julija 285 med vojskama Dioklecijana in Karina za oblast v Rimskem cesarstvu, v dolini reke Marg (danes Velika Morava) v Meziji (današnja Srbija), najverjetneje blizu naselja Margum. Bitka je bila prelomnica, ki je pripeljala do konca krize 3. stoletja in vrnitve stabilnosti v cesarstvo.

Karin je imel večjo vojsko, a je bila njena zvestoba vprašljiva. Karin naj bi si odtujil može, od katerih podpore je bil odvisen njegov uspeh: med drugim naj bi slabo ravnal s senatom in ženskami senatorskih rodbin ter zapeljeval žene svojih častnikov. Natančne okoliščine bitke niso znane, znano pa je, da je Karin med bitko umrl, najverjetneje od roke enega od svojih častnikov.

source.title: Battle of the Margus
paragraphs: The Battle of the Margus or Battle of Margum was fought in July 285 for control of the Roman Empire between the armies of Diocletian and Carinus in the valley of the Margus River (today Great Morava) in Moesia (present day Serbia), probably near the settlement of Margum. The battle proved to be the tipping point that led to the eventual resolution of the Crisis of the Third Century and the return of stability to the Empire.

Carinus led the larger force, but the loyalty of his army was questionable. Carinus had allegedly alienated men whose support his success depended upon, including mistreating the Senate and its womenfolk and seducing the wives of his officers. The exact circumstances of the battle are uncertain, but it is known that Carinus was killed in the course of the battle, most probably by one of his own officers.

Battle of the Medway.headline: Bitka ob reki Medway
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki Medway je potekala leta 43 n. št., verjetno ob reki Medway na ozemlju železnodobnega plemena Kantiakov, danes angleške grofije Kent. Bila je ena zgodnjih bitk Klavdijevega vdora v Britanijo, ki ga je vodil Avl Plavcij.

source.title: Battle of the Medway
paragraphs: The Battle of the Medway took place in 43 AD, probably on the River Medway in the lands of the Iron Age tribe of the Cantiaci, now the English county of Kent. This was an early battle in the Claudian invasion of Britain, led by Aulus Plautius.

Bitka na Metavru je bila prelomna bitka v drugi punski vojni med Rimom in Kartagino, ki je potekala leta 207 pr. n. št. blizu reke Metaver (italijansko Metauro) v Italiji. Kartažane je vodil Hasdrubal Barka, Hanibalov brat, ki bi moral Hanibalu prinesti obleganjsko opremo in okrepitve. Rimski vojski sta vodila konzula Mark Livij, ki so mu pozneje nadeli vzdevek Salinator, in Gaj Klavdij Neron.

Klavdij Neron se je pravkar spopadel s Hanibalom pri Grumentumu, nekaj sto kilometrov južno od reke Metaver, in je do Marka Livija prispel s prisilnim pohodom, ki ga ni opazil ne Hanibal ne Hasdrubal, tako da so se Kartažani nenadoma znašli v številčni podrejenosti. V bitki so Rimljani s številčno premočjo obšli kartažansko vojsko in jo razbili, Kartažani pa so izgubili 15.400 mož, mrtvih ali ujetih, med njimi Hasdrubala.

source.title: Battle of the Metaurus
paragraphs: The Battle of the Metaurus was a pivotal battle in the Second Punic War between Rome and Carthage, fought in 207 BC near the Metauro River in Italy. The Carthaginians were led by Hasdrubal Barca, brother of Hannibal, who was to have brought siege equipment and reinforcements for Hannibal. The Roman armies were led by the consuls Marcus Livius, who was later nicknamed the Salinator, and Gaius Claudius Nero.

Claudius Nero had just fought Hannibal in Grumentum, some hundreds of kilometres south of the Metaurus river, and reached Marcus Livius by a forced march that went unnoticed by both Hannibal and Hasdrubal, so that the Carthaginians suddenly found themselves outnumbered. In the battle, the Romans used their numerical superiority to outflank the Carthaginian army and rout them, the Carthaginians losing 15,400 men killed or captured, including Hasdrubal.

Battle of the Niemen River.headline: Bitka ob Njemnu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Njemnu je bila druga največja bitka poljsko-sovjetske vojne. Potekala je ob srednjem toku reke Njemen med mesti Suwałki, Grodno in Białystok. Po skoraj popolnem porazu v bitki za Varšavo (avgust 1920) so sile Rdeče armade Mihaila Tuhačevskega skušale proti protinapadajoči poljski vojski Józefa Piłsudskega vzpostaviti obrambno črto, ki je potekala od poljsko-litovske meje do Polesja s središčem v Grodnu. Med 15. in 25. septembrom 1920 so Poljaki Sovjete obšli in jih znova premagali. Po bitki ob Ščari sredi oktobra je poljska vojska dosegla črto Tarnopol–Dubno–Minsk–Drisa.

Čeprav ta del spopada v poljskem in ruskem zgodovinopisju običajno imenujejo bitka, nekateri zgodovinarji menijo, da je šlo bolj za vojaško operacijo z vrsto bitk, ki so pogosto potekale več sto kilometrov narazen.

source.title: Battle of the Niemen River
paragraphs: The Battle of the Niemen River was the second-largest battle of the Polish–Soviet War. It took place near the middle Neman River between the cities of Suwałki, Grodno, and Białystok. After suffering almost complete defeat in the Battle of Warsaw (August 1920), Mikhail Tukhachevsky's Red Army forces tried to establish a defensive line, against Józef Piłsudski's counter-attacking Polish Army, running northward from the Polish-Lithuanian border to Polesie, and centering on Grodno. Between 15 September and 25 September 1920, the Poles outflanked the Soviets, once again defeating them. After the mid-October Battle of the Szczara River, the Polish Army had reached the Tarnopol-Dubno-Minsk-Drissa line.

Although this part of the conflict is usually referred to as a battle both in Polish and Russian historiography, some historians argue that it was more of a military operation with a series of battles fought often several hundred kilometres apart.

Battle of the Rhône Crossing.headline: Bitka pri prečkanju Rone
paragraphs: Bitka pri prečkanju Rone je potekala septembra 218 pr. n. št. med drugo punsko vojno. Hanibal je krenil proti italijanskim Alpam, vojska galskih Volkov pa je na vzhodnem bregu Rone napadla kartažansko vojsko. Rimska vojska je taborila blizu Massalije. Volki so skušali Kartažanom preprečiti, da bi prečkali Alpe in vdrli v Italijo.

Preden so prečkali reko, so Kartažani poslali odred pod vodstvom Hanona, Bomilkarjevega sina, da je reko prečkal više gor in se postavil za Galce. Ko je bil odred na položaju, je Hanibal reko prečkal z glavnino vojske. Ko so se Galci zbrali, da bi se Hanibalu postavili po robu, je Hanon napadel njihovo zaledje in vojsko Volkov pognal v beg. To je bila Hanibalova prva velika bitka (zmaga) zunaj Iberskega polotoka, ki mu je odprla nemoteno pot do Alp in v Italijo.

source.title: Battle of the Rhône Crossing
paragraphs: The Battle of the Rhône Crossing was a battle during the Second Punic War in September of 218 BC. Hannibal marched on the Italian Alps, and an army of Gallic Volcae attacked the Carthaginian army on the east bank of the Rhône. The Roman army camped near Massalia. The Volcae tried to prevent the Carthaginians from crossing the Alps and invading Italy.

Before they crossed the river, the Carthaginians sent a detachment to cross upriver, under Hanno, son of Bomilcar, and took up position behind the Gauls. Once the detachment was in place, Hannibal crossed the river with the main contingent of his army. As the Gauls massed to oppose Hannibal, Hanno attacked their rear and routed the Volcae army. This was Hannibal's first major battle (victory) outside of the Iberian Peninsula. It gave him an unopposed path to the Alps and into Italy.

Battle of the Rishki Pass.headline: Bitka na prelazu Riški
paragraphs: Bitka na prelazu Riški (bolgarsko: Битката при Ришкия проход) ali bitka pri Veregavi je potekala leta 759 na istoimenskem prelazu v Stari planini v Bolgariji. Spopadli sta se Bolgarsko in Bizantinsko cesarstvo. Zmagali so Bolgari.

source.title: Battle of the Rishki Pass
paragraphs: The Battle of the Rishki Pass (Bulgarian: Битката при Ришкия проход) or Battle of Veregava took place in the pass of the same name, in Stara Planina, Bulgaria in 759. It was fought between the Bulgarian Empire and the Byzantine Empire. The result was a Bulgarian victory.

Battle of the River Garonne.headline: Bitka na Garoni
paragraphs: Bitka na Garoni, znana tudi kot bitka pri Bordeauxu, je potekala leta 732 med omajadsko vojsko pod vodstvom Abd al-Rahmana al-Gafikija, guvernerja Al-Andalusa, in akvitanskimi silami pod vodstvom akvitanskega vojvode Oda.

source.title: Battle of the River Garonne
paragraphs: The Battle of the River Garonne, also known as the Battle of Bordeaux, was fought in 732 between an Umayyad army led by Abdul Rahman Al-Ghafiqi, governor of Al-Andalus, and Aquitanian forces led by Duke Odo of Aquitaine.

Bitka na reki Sabis, znana tudi (verjetno napačno) kot bitka na Sambri ali bitka proti Nervijem, je potekala leta 57 pr. n. št. blizu današnjega Saulzoirja na severu Francije. Ob reki Sabis se je rimska vojska pod poveljstvom Gaja Julija Cezarja spopadla z zvezo plemen Belgov, predvsem z Nerviji. Belgi so Cezarja z nenadnim napadom presenetili in ga skoraj premagali. Po Cezarjevih zapiskih so Rimljanom odločna obramba, spretno poveljevanje in pravočasen prihod okrepitev omogočili, da so zasedo Belgov spremenili v rimsko zmago. Malo primarnih virov bitko podrobno opisuje; večina podatkov izhaja iz Cezarjevega lastnega poročila v delu Zapiski o galski vojni (Commentarii de Bello Gallico). O tem, kako so bitko doživljali Nerviji, je zato malo znanega.

source.title: Battle of the Sabis
paragraphs: The Battle of the Sabis also (arguably erroneously) known as the Battle of the Sambre or the Battle against the Nervians (or Nervii) was fought in 57 BC near modern Saulzoir in Northern France. At the River Sabis a Roman army under the command of Gaius Julius Caesar fought an association of Belgae tribes, principally the Nervii. Caesar was surprised and nearly defeated by a Belgae surprise attack. According to Caesar's commentaries, a combination of determined defence, skilled generalship, and the timely arrival of reinforcements allowed the Romans to turn the Belgae ambush into a Roman victory. Few primary sources describe the battle in detail, with most information coming from Caesar's own report on the battle from his book, Commentarii de Bello Gallico. Little is therefore known about the Nervii perspective on the battle.

Battle of the Scheldt.headline: Bitka za Šeldo
paragraphs: Bitka za Šeldo v drugi svetovni vojni je bila vrsta vojaških operacij, s katerimi so hoteli reko Šeldo med Antwerpnom in Severnim morjem odpreti za ladijski promet, da bi lahko antwerpensko pristanišče uporabljali za oskrbo zaveznikov v severozahodni Evropi. Operacije je izvedla kanadska 1. armada s pomočjo priključenih poljskih in britanskih enot. Začasno jim je poveljeval generalpodpolkovnik Guy Simonds iz kanadske 1. armade. Bitka je potekala ob reki Šeldi na severu Belgije in jugozahodu Nizozemske od 2. oktobra do 8. novembra 1944.

source.title: Battle of the Scheldt
paragraphs: The Battle of the Scheldt in World War II was a series of military operations to open up the Scheldt river between Antwerp and the North Sea for shipping, so that Antwerp's port could be used to supply the Allies in north-west Europe. The operations were carried out by the First Canadian Army, with assistance from Polish and British units which had been attached. The action was under the acting command of the First Canadian's Lieutenant-General Guy Simonds. The battle took place in the vicinity of the Scheldt river in northern Belgium and southwestern Netherlands from 2 October to 8 November 1944.

Battle of the Seelow Heights.headline: Bitka za Seelowske višine
paragraphs: Bitka za Seelowske višine (nemško: Schlacht um die Seelower Höhen) je bila del berlinske strateške ofenzivne operacije (16. aprila – 2. maja 1945). Ta bitka na odprtem polju je bila eden zadnjih napadov na velike utrjene obrambne položaje v drugi svetovni vojni. Trajala je tri dni, od 16. do 19. aprila 1945. Skoraj 1.000.000 sovjetskih vojakov 1. beloruske fronte (med njimi 78.556 vojakov poljske 1. armade) pod poveljstvom maršala Georgija Žukova je napadlo položaj, znan kot »vrata Berlina«. Nasproti jim je stalo približno 110.000 vojakov nemške 9. armade pod poveljstvom generala Theodorja Busseja v sestavi armadne skupine Visla.
