Bitko pogosto štejejo za del bitke na Odri in Nisi. Na Seelowskih višinah so potekali nekateri najsrditejši boji celotne bitke, a so bile le ena od več točk prehoda ob Odri in Nisi, kjer so napadli Sovjeti. Bitka na Odri in Nisi pa je bila le uvodna faza bitke za Berlin.

source.title: Battle of the Seelow Heights
paragraphs: The Battle of the Seelow Heights (German: Schlacht um die Seelower Höhen) was part of the Berlin Strategic Offensive Operation (16 April – 2 May 1945). A pitched battle, it was one of the last assaults on large entrenched defensive positions of the Second World War. It was fought over three days, from 16 to 19 April 1945. Close to 1,000,000 Soviet soldiers of the 1st Belorussian Front (including 78,556 soldiers of the Polish 1st Army), commanded by Marshal Georgy Zhukov, attacked the position known as the "Gates of Berlin". They were opposed by about 110,000 soldiers of the German 9th Army, commanded by General Theodor Busse, as part of the Army Group Vistula.

This battle is often incorporated into the Battle of the Oder–Neisse. The Seelow Heights was where some of the most bitter fighting in the overall battle took place, but it was only one of several crossing points along the Oder and Neisse rivers where the Soviets attacked. The Battle of the Oder–Neisse was itself only the opening phase of the Battle of Berlin.

Battle of the Silarius River.headline: Bitka ob reki Silarius
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki Silarius je bila zadnji, odločilni spopad tretje suženjske vojne, zadnje od rimskih suženjskih vojn. Potekala je blizu izliva današnje reke Sele v južni Kampaniji v južni Italiji.

source.title: Battle of the Silarius River
paragraphs: The Battle of the Silarius River was the final, decisive action of the Third Servile War, the last of the Roman Servile Wars. It occurred near the mouth of modern Sele River, southern Campania, southern Italy.

Battle of the Silarus.headline: Bitka pri Silarusu leta 212 pr. n. št.
paragraphs: Bitka pri Silarusu je potekala leta 212 pr. n. št. med Hanibalovo vojsko in rimskimi silami pod poveljstvom stotnika Marka Centenija Penule. Kartažani, ki so bili v veliki številčni manjšini, so zmagali: uničili so vso rimsko vojsko in pri tem ubili 15.000 rimskih vojakov.

source.title: Battle of the Silarus
paragraphs: The Battle of the Silarus was fought in 212 BC between Hannibal's army and a Roman force led by centurion Marcus Centenius Penula. The vastly outnumbered Carthaginians were victorious, destroying the entire Roman army and killing 15,000 Roman soldiers in the process.

Battle of the Sit River.headline: Bitka ob reki Sit
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki Sit je potekala 4. marca 1238 med mongolskimi silami Batu-kana in vojsko Vladimirsko-Suzdalske kneževine pod vodstvom vladimirskega velikega kneza Jurija II. med mongolskim vdorom v Kijevsko Rusijo. Spopad je bil na severu današnjega Sonkovskega okraja v Tverski oblasti, blizu vasi Božonka.

source.title: Battle of the Sit River
paragraphs: The Battle of the Sit River took place on 4 March 1238 between the Mongol forces of Batu Khan and the army of Vladimir-Suzdal led by Grand Prince Yuri II of Vladimir during the Mongol invasion of Kievan Rus'. The engagement occurred in the northern part of what is now the Sonkovsky District of Tver Oblast, near the selo of Bozhonka.
Bitka ob Severskem Donecu je ime za vrsto spopadov maja 2022, predvsem od 5. do 13. maja, blizu Limana in Severodonecka na vzhodni fronti rusko-ukrajinske vojne.

Tanki 30. mehanizirane brigade in topništvo 17. tankovske brigade ukrajinskih oboroženih sil so porazili ruske sile 74. samostojne gardne motostrelske brigade 41. kombinirane armade, ko so te večkrat poskušale prečkati reko Donec blizu vasi Dronivka, Bilohorivka in Serebrjanka.

Ukrajinske sile so že prej odbile številne ruske poskuse prečkanja reke. Uničenje celotne bataljonske taktične skupine 10. maja pa so opisali kot »doslej najbolj smrtonosni spopad vojne« in »katastrofo« za rusko vojsko.
notes: The glossary had Bitka za Siverskji Donec; an override now gives Bitka ob Severskem Donecu.

source.title: Battle of the Siverskyi Donets
paragraphs: A series of military engagements took place in May 2022, most notably from 5 to 13 May, near Lyman and Sievierodonetsk, on the eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war.

Russian forces from the 74th Separate Guards Motor Rifle Brigade of the 41st Combined Arms Army were defeated by tanks of the 30th Mechanized Brigade and artillery of the 17th Tank Brigade of the Ukrainian Armed Forces as the Russians attempted several crossings over the Donets river near the villages of Dronivka, Bilohorivka, and Serebrianka.

Ukrainian forces had previously managed to repel numerous attempted crossings of the river by Russian forces. The destruction of an entire battalion tactical group on 10 May, however, was described as "the deadliest engagement of the war" so far and was a "disaster" for the Russian army.

Battle of the Solent.headline: Bitka v Solentu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka v Solentu je potekala 18. in 19. julija 1545 v italijanskih vojnah med ladjevjema francoskega kralja Franca I. in angleškega kralja Henrika VIII. v ožini Solent med Hampshirom in otokom Wight. Bila je ena od le dveh pravih pomorskih bitk, v katerih se je bojevala tudorska mornarica kralja Henrika VIII., ob zgodnejši bitki pri Saint-Mathieuju.

Spopad se je končal brez zmagovalca, vendar so boji onemogočili francoske načrte za večjo invazijo na Anglijo in francosko ladjevje se je kmalu zatem umaknilo. Bitke se danes spominjajo predvsem po potopu angleške karake Mary Rose.

source.title: Battle of the Solent
paragraphs: The naval Battle of the Solent took place on 18 and 19 July 1545 during the Italian Wars, between the fleets of Francis I of France and Henry VIII of England, in the Solent, between Hampshire and the Isle of Wight. This was one of only two full-fledged naval battles fought by King Henry VIII's Tudor navy, along with the earlier Battle of Saint-Mathieu.

The engagement resulted in a standstill between both sides, but the French ambition to conduct a larger invasion of England had been rendered untenable by the fighting, and the French fleet withdrew shortly after. The battle is remembered today primarily for the sinking of the English carrack, Mary Rose.

Battle of the Spurs.headline: Bitka ostrog
paragraphs: Bitka ostrog ali (druga) bitka pri Guinegatu je potekala 16. avgusta 1513. Bila je del vojne Cambraiške lige (1508–1516) v italijanskih vojnah. Angleški kralj Henrik VIII. in cesar Maksimilijan I. sta oblegala francosko mesto Thérouanne v Artoisu (danes Pas-de-Calais). Henrikov tabor je bil pri Guinegatu (današnji Enguinegatte). Velika skupina francoske težke konjenice pod vodstvom Jacquesa de La Palica je krila poskus lahke konjenice, da bi oblegani posadki pripeljala zaloge. Angleške in cesarske čete so francosko konjenico presenetile in razbile. Francozi so se v naglici razbežali, zmagovalci pa so jih daleč zasledovali in med zasledovanjem ujeli več uglednih francoskih poveljnikov in vitezov. Po padcu Thérouanna je Henrik VIII. oblegal in zavzel Tournai.

source.title: Battle of the Spurs
paragraphs: The Battle of the Spurs or (Second) Battle of Guinegate took place on 16 August 1513. It formed a part of the War of the League of Cambrai of 1508 to 1516, during the Italian Wars. King Henry VIII of England and Emperor Maximilian I were besieging the French town of Thérouanne in Artois (now Pas-de-Calais). Henry's camp was at Guinegate (present-day Enguinegatte). A large body of French heavy cavalry under Jacques de La Palice was covering an attempt by light cavalry to bring supplies to the besieged garrison. English and Imperial troops surprised and routed the French cavalry. The battle resulted in the precipitate flight and extensive pursuit of the French. During the pursuit, a number of notable French leaders and knights were captured. After the fall of Thérouanne, Henry VIII besieged and took Tournai.

Battle of the Standard.headline: Bitka pod praporom
paragraphs: Bitka pod praporom, včasih imenovana bitka pri Northallertonu, je potekala 22. avgusta 1138 na barju Cowton Moor blizu Northallertona v Yorkshiru v Angliji. Angleške sile pod Williamom iz Aumala so odbile škotsko vojsko pod vodstvom škotskega kralja Davida I.

Angleški kralj Štefan, ki se je na jugu bojeval z upornimi baroni, je poslal manjše sile (večinoma najemnike), angleško vojsko pa so sestavljali predvsem krajevna milica in spremstva baronov iz Yorkshira in severnega Midlandsa. Yorški nadškof Thurstan si je zelo prizadeval zbrati vojsko in pridigal, da je upreti se Škotom božje delo. Središče angleškega položaja je zato označeval jambor (nameščen na vozu) s piksido s posvečeno hostijo, na njem pa so plapolali posvečeni prapori cerkva v Yorku, Beverleyju in Riponu: od tod ime bitke. Ta prapor na vozu je bil zelo severen primer vrste prapora, ki je bila tedaj običajna v Italiji, kjer so ga imenovali carroccio.
Kralj David je v Anglijo vdrl iz dveh razglašenih razlogov.
notes: The English excerpt ends before it lists the two reasons; the Slovenian ends the sentence with a full stop.

source.title: Battle of the Standard
paragraphs: The Battle of the Standard, sometimes called the Battle of Northallerton, took place on 22 August 1138 on Cowton Moor near Northallerton in Yorkshire, England. English forces under William of Aumale repelled a Scottish army led by King David I of Scotland.

King Stephen of England, fighting rebel barons in the south, had sent a small force (largely mercenaries), but the English army was mainly local militia and baronial retinues from Yorkshire and the north Midlands. Archbishop Thurstan of York had exerted himself greatly to raise the army, preaching that to withstand the Scots was to do God's work. The centre of the English position was therefore marked by a mast (mounted upon a cart) bearing a pyx carrying the consecrated host and from which were flown the consecrated banners of the minsters of York, Beverley and Ripon: hence the name of the battle. This cart-mounted standard was a very northerly example of a type of standard common in contemporary Italy, where it was known as a carroccio.
King David had entered England for two declared reasons:

Battle of the Terek River.headline: Bitka ob Tereku
paragraphs: Bitka ob Tereku je bila zadnja velika bitka vojne med Tohtamišem in Timurjem. Potekala je 14. aprila 1395 ob reki Terek na Severnem Kavkazu in se končala s Timurjevo zmago.

source.title: Battle of the Terek River
paragraphs: The Battle of the Terek River was the last major battle of the Tokhtamysh–Timur war. It took place on 14 April 1395, at the Terek River, North Caucasus. The result was a victory for Timur.

Battle of the Upper Baetis.headline: Bitka ob gornjem Baetisu
paragraphs: Bitka ob gornjem Baetisu je bila dvojna bitka, sestavljena iz bitk pri Kastulu in Ilorki, ki je potekala leta 211 pr. n. št. v drugi punski vojni med kartažanskimi silami pod vodstvom Hasdrubala Barke (Hanibalovega brata) in rimskimi silami pod vodstvom Publija Kornelija Scipiona in njegovega brata Gneja. Neposredni izid je bila kartažanska zmaga, v kateri sta padla oba rimska brata. Pred tem porazom sta se brata sedem let (218–211 pr. n. št.) bojevala proti Kartažanom v Hispaniji in tako omejevala vire, ki so bili na voljo Hanibalu, ki se je hkrati bojeval z Rimljani v Italiji.

source.title: Battle of the Upper Baetis
paragraphs: The Battle of the Upper Baetis was a double battle, comprising the battles of Castulo and Ilorca, fought in 211 BC during the Second Punic War between a Carthaginian force led by Hasdrubal Barca (Hannibal's brother) and a Roman force led by Publius Cornelius Scipio and his brother Gnaeus. The immediate result was a Carthaginian victory in which both Roman brothers were killed. Before this defeat, the brothers had spent seven years (218–211 BC) campaigning against the Carthaginians in Hispania, thus limiting the resources available to Hannibal, who was simultaneously fighting the Romans in Italy.

Battle of the Utus.headline: Bitka ob Utu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Utu je potekala leta 447 med vojsko Vzhodnega rimskega cesarstva in Huni pod vodstvom Atile ob Utu, reki, ki se danes imenuje Vit in teče po Bolgariji. Bila je zadnja od krvavih bitk na odprtem polju med Vzhodnim rimskim cesarstvom in Huni, ko je cesarstvo skušalo zadržati hunski vdor.

Podrobnosti o Atilovem pohodu, ki se je končal z bitko ob Utu, in o poznejših dogodkih niso jasne. Na voljo je le nekaj kratkih odlomkov v bizantinskih virih (Jordanesovi Romani, kroniki Marcelina Comesa in Velikonočni kroniki). Kot pri vsem delovanju Atilovih Hunov na Balkanu skopi viri ne omogočajo nesporne rekonstrukcije dogodkov.

source.title: Battle of the Utus
paragraphs: The Battle of the Utus was fought in 447 between the army of the Eastern Roman Empire, and the Huns led by Attila at Utus, a river that is today the Vit in Bulgaria. It was the last of the bloody pitched battles between the Eastern Roman Empire and the Huns, as the former attempted to stave off the Hunnic invasion.

The details about Attila's campaign which culminated in the battle of Utus, as well as the events afterwards, are obscure. Only a few short passages from Byzantine sources (Jordanes' Romana, the chronicle of Marcellinus Comes, and the Paschal Chronicle) are available. As with the whole activity of Attila's Huns in the Balkans, the fragmentary evidence does not permit an undisputed reconstruction of the events.

Battle of the Vistula River.headline: Bitka na Visli
paragraphs: Bitka na Visli, znana tudi kot bitka za Varšavo in Ivangorod, je bila velika ruska zmaga nad Nemčijo in Avstro-Ogrsko na vzhodni fronti prve svetovne vojne.

Bitka je ena največjih in najpomembnejših bitk prve svetovne vojne in ena najsijajnejših zmag ruske vojske, ki je pokazala, da so ruske čete močne in se lahko upirajo Nemcem. Obe strani sta utrpeli hude izgube. Bitka je postala tudi nekakšna psihološka prelomnica. Rusi so verjeli v lastno moč, opomogli so si od poraza v bitki pri Tannenbergu in postali prepričani, da so Nemcem nadrejeni. Ta samozavest jim je nekaj dni pozneje pomagala zmagati v bitki pri Lodžu.

source.title: Battle of the Vistula River
paragraphs: The Battle of the Vistula River, also known as the Battle of Warsaw and Ivangorod, was a major Russian victory against Germany and Austria-Hungary on the Eastern Front during the First World War.

The battle is one of the largest and most important battles in the First World War, one of the most striking victories of the Russian army, which showed that the Russian troops were strong and could resist the Germans. Both sides suffered heavy losses. The battle also became a kind of psychological turning point. The Russians, believing in their own strength, recovered from the defeat at the Battle of Tannenberg, and became confident that they were superior to the Germans. This confidence helped them to win the Battle of Lodz a few days later.

Battle of the Vorskla River.headline: Bitka ob Vorskli
paragraphs: Bitka ob Vorskli je potekala 12. avgusta 1399 med Tatari Zlate horde pod vodstvom Edigeja in Temür Kutluga ter vojskama Tohtamiša in velike križarske vojske pod vodstvom litovskega velikega kneza Vitolda Velikega. Končala se je z odločilno zmago Tatarov Zlate horde.

source.title: Battle of the Vorskla River
paragraphs: The Battle of the Vorskla River was fought on August 12, 1399, between the Tatars of the Golden Horde, under Edigu and Temür Qutlugh, and the armies of Tokhtamysh and a large Crusader force led by Grand Duke Vytautas the Great of Lithuania. The battle ended in a decisive Tatar victory for the Golden Horde.

Battle of the Willows.headline: Bitka pri Vrbah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vrbah (377) je potekala v kraju, imenovanem ad Salices (»mesto pri vrbah«), ali po Amijanu v obcestni postaji Ad Salices (»pri vrbah«), ki je bila verjetno manj kot 15 kilometrov od Markianopola (današnja Dobrudža v Bolgariji), čeprav njena natančna lega ni znana. Sile Zahodnega rimskega cesarstva pod poveljstvom Rihomera so napredovale proti zahodu, sile Vzhodnega rimskega cesarstva pod vodstvom Trajana in Profuturja pa proti severu, kjer so se združile, da bi napadle Gote, ki so se pred kratkim uprli pod vodstvom Fritigerna in pustošili severni Balkan.

Edini ohranjeni opis je Amijanov, ki je zapustil malo podrobnosti: na dolgo opisuje mrtve in umirajoče, o številu bojevnikov pa ne pove ničesar. Rimsko levo krilo je v nekem trenutku popustilo, a so ga okrepili in je zdržalo. Bitko je končala noč. Izid je bil krvav neodločen spopad z velikimi izgubami na obeh straneh; Goti so po bitki več kot teden dni ostali utaborjeni za obročem bojnih voz.

source.title: Battle of the Willows
paragraphs: The Battle of the Willows (377) took place at a place called ad Salices ("town by the willows"), or according to Ammianus, a road way-station called Ad Salices ("by the Willows"); probably located within 15 kilometres of Marcianople (modern day Dobrudja, Bulgaria), although its exact location is unknown. Forces from the Western Roman Empire under the command of Richomeres advanced westward, while forces of the eastern Roman Empire under Traianus and Profuturus advanced northward where they joined forces to attack the Goths who had recently rebelled under command of Fritigern. and were laying waste to the northern Balkans.

The only extant description comes from Ammianus who left few details; he gives a lengthy description of the dead and dying, but no information on the number of combatants. At one point the Roman left wing gave way, but it was re-enforced and held. The battle ended with nightfall. The result was a bloody draw with both sides taking many losses; the Goths remained encamped behind their war-wagon circle for over a week after the battle.

Battle of the Winwaed.headline: Bitka ob Winwaedu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Winwaedu je potekala 15. novembra 655 med mercijskim kraljem Pendo in Oswiujem Bernicijskim in se končala s porazom Mercijcev in Pendovo smrtjo. Po Bedi je bitka dejansko pomenila konec anglosaškega poganstva.

source.title: Battle of the Winwaed
paragraphs: The Battle of the Winwaed was fought on 15 November 655 between King Penda of Mercia and Oswiu of Bernicia, ending in the Mercians' defeat and Penda's death. According to Bede, the battle marked the effective demise of Anglo-Saxon paganism.

Battle of the Yser.headline: Bitka na Yserju
paragraphs: Bitka na Yserju je potekala oktobra 1914 v prvi svetovni vojni med mestoma Nieuwpoort in Diksmuide, na 35 km dolgem odseku reke Yser in kanala Yperlee v Belgiji. Fronto so držale močne belgijske sile, ki so v dragi obrambni bitki ustavile nemško prodiranje.

Zmaga na Yserju je Belgiji omogočila, da je obdržala majhen pas ozemlja, medtem ko je Nemčija nadzorovala 95 % belgijskega ozemlja. Kralj Albert je zaradi nje postal belgijski narodni junak, ohranila je narodni ponos, naslednjih sto let pa je bila prizorišče spominskih slovesnosti v čast junaški žrtvi.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of the Yser
paragraphs: The Battle of the Yser was a battle of the First World War that took place in October 1914 between the towns of Nieuwpoort and Diksmuide, along a 35 km (22 mi) stretch of the Yser River and the Yperlee Canal, in Belgium. The front line was held by a large Belgian force, which halted the German advance in a costly defensive battle.

The victory at the Yser allowed Belgium to retain a small strip of territory, with Germany in control of 95 per cent of Belgian territory, which made King Albert a Belgian national hero, sustained national pride and provided a venue for commemorations of heroic sacrifice for the next hundred years.

Battle of Thebes.headline: Bitka pri Tebah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tebah je potekala leta 335 pr. n. št. med vojsko Aleksandra Velikega in grškim mestom Tebe v Beotiji, tik pred mestom in v njem samem. Ko je Aleksander po očetu prevzel položaj hegemona Helenske zveze, je odkorakal na sever, da bi zatrl upore v Iliriji in Trakiji.

source.title: Battle of Thebes
paragraphs: The Battle of Thebes took place between the army of Alexander the Great and the Greek city of Thebes in 335 BC immediately outside of and in the city proper in Boeotia. After succeeding his father as the hegemon of the Hellenic League, Alexander had marched to the north to deal with revolts in Illyria and Thrace.

Battle of Thermopylae (191 BC).headline: Bitka pri Termopilah (191 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Termopilah je potekala 24. aprila 191 pr. n. št. v rimsko-selevkidski vojni; sile Rimske republike pod vodstvom konzula Manija Acilija Glabriona so se v njej spopadle s selevkidsko-etolsko vojsko Antioha III. Velikega.

Ko sta se glavnini vojsk najprej spopadli na prelazu Termopile, so se Selevkidi obdržali in odbili več rimskih napadov. Toda majhen rimski oddelek pod vodstvom Marka Porcija Katona je presenetil etolsko posadko utrdbe Kalidromos in Selevkide obšel s pobočja. Selevkide je zajela panika, njihova bojna vrsta je razpadla in vojska je bila uničena. Antiohu je s konjenico uspelo pobegniti z bojišča in kmalu zatem je zapustil grško celino.

source.title: Battle of Thermopylae (191 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Thermopylae took place on 24 April 191 BC. It was fought as part of the Roman–Seleucid War, pitting forces of the Roman Republic led by the consul Manius Acilius Glabrio against a Seleucid-Aetolian army of Antiochus III the Great.

When the main bodies of the armies initially clashed at the Thermopylae pass, the Seleucids managed to hold their ground, repulsing multiple Roman assaults. However, a small Roman force under Marcus Porcius Cato managed to outflank the Seleucids from the hillside after surprising the Aetolian garrison of Fort Callidromus. The Seleucids panicked and broke ranks, leading to the destruction of their force. Antiochus managed to escape the battlefield with his cavalry, departing mainland Greece soon afterwards.

Bitka pri Ticinu je potekala med kartažanskimi silami Hanibala in rimsko vojsko pod Publijem Kornelijem Scipionom konec novembra 218 pr. n. št. v drugi punski vojni. Bojevali so se na ravnini na desnem bregu reke Ticin, zahodno od današnje Pavie v severni Italiji. Hanibal je vodil 6000 libijskih in iberskih konjenikov, Scipion pa 3600 rimskih, italskih in galskih konjenikov ter veliko, a neznano število lahkih pehotnih metalcev kopij.

source.title: Battle of Ticinus
paragraphs: The Battle of Ticinus was fought between the Carthaginian forces of Hannibal and a Roman army under Publius Cornelius Scipio in late November 218 BC as part of the Second Punic War. It took place in the flat country on the right bank of the river Ticinus, to the west of modern Pavia in northern Italy. Hannibal led 6,000 Libyan and Iberian cavalry, while Scipio led 3,600 Roman, Italian and Gallic cavalry and a large but unknown number of light infantry javelinmen.

Battle of Tinchebray.headline: Bitka pri Tinchebrayju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tinchebrayju (tudi Tinchebrai ali Tenchebrai) je potekala 28. septembra 1106 v Tinchebrayju (danes v departmaju Orne v Franciji) v Normandiji med invazijsko vojsko angleškega kralja Henrika I. in normansko vojsko njegovega starejšega brata Roberta Curthosa, normandijskega vojvode. Henrikovi vitezi so odločilno zmagali: ujeli so Roberta, Henrik pa ga je zaprl v Angliji (na gradu Devizes) in nato v Walesu, kjer je Robert leta 1134 umrl (na gradu Cardiff).

source.title: Battle of Tinchebray
paragraphs: The Battle of Tinchebray (alternative spellings: Tinchebrai or Tenchebrai) took place on 28 September 1106, in Tinchebray (today in the Orne département of France), Normandy, between an invading force led by King Henry I of England, and the Norman army of his elder brother Robert Curthose, the Duke of Normandy. Henry's knights won a decisive victory: they captured Robert, and Henry imprisoned him in England (in Devizes Castle) and then in Wales until Robert's death (in Cardiff Castle) in 1134.

Battle of Tolentino.headline: Bitka pri Tolentinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tolentinu je potekala od 2. do 3. maja 1815 blizu Tolentina v Neapeljskem kraljestvu, na območju današnjih Marc v Italiji. Bila je odločilna bitka neapeljske vojne, v kateri se je napoleonski neapeljski kralj Joachim Murat po dunajskem kongresu bojeval za ohranitev prestola. Bitka je potekala v obdobju sto dni po Napoleonovi vrnitvi iz izgnanstva in se je, tako kot bitka pri Waterlooju, končala z odločilno zmago sedme koalicije, kar je pripeljalo do vrnitve prejšnjega burbonskega kralja Ferdinanda I. na prestol.

source.title: Battle of Tolentino
paragraphs: The Battle of Tolentino was fought from 2–3 May 1815 near Tolentino, Kingdom of Naples in what is now Marche, Italy: it was the decisive battle in the Neapolitan War, fought by the Napoleonic King of Naples Joachim Murat to keep the throne after the Congress of Vienna. The battle occurred during the Hundred Days following Napoleon's return from exile and, like the Battle of Waterloo, resulted in a decisive victory for the Seventh Coalition, leading to the restoration of the previous Bourbon king, Ferdinand I.

Battle of Tolvajärvi.headline: Bitka pri Tolvajärviju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tolvajärviju (finsko: Tolvajärven–Ägläjärven taistelu; rusko: Битва при Толваярви) se je med Finsko in Sovjetsko zvezo začela 12. decembra 1939 in trajala približno poldrugi teden. Bila je prva velika ofenzivna zmaga Fincev v zimski vojni.
Bitka je potekala na ozemlju tako imenovane Ladoške Karelije (finsko: Laatokan Karjala), ki je danes del Republike Karelije v Rusiji.
notes: The IPA pronunciation is left out.

source.title: Battle of Tolvajärvi
paragraphs: The Battle of Tolvajärvi ([ˈtol.ʋɑˌjær.ʋi]; Finnish: Tolvajärven–Ägläjärven taistelu, Russian: Битва при Толваярви) began on 12 December 1939 and continued for about a week and a half, between Finland and the Soviet Union. It was the first large offensive victory for the Finns in the Winter War.
The battle took place on the territory of so-called Ladoga Karelia (Finnish: Laatokan Karjala) which today is part of the Republic of Karelia in Russia.

Battle of Torgau.headline: Bitka pri Torgauu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Torgauu je potekala 3. novembra 1760: pruska vojska kralja Friderika Velikega se je spopadla z avstrijsko vojsko pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Leopolda Josefa grofa Dauna. Prusi so dosegli drago zmago v eni najkrvavejših bitk tretje šlezijske vojne (dela sedemletne vojne).

source.title: Battle of Torgau
paragraphs: In the Battle of Torgau on 3 November 1760, King Frederick the Great's Prussian army fought an Austrian army under the command of Field Marshal Leopold Josef Graf Daun. The Prussians won a costly victory in one of the bloodiest battles of the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War).

Battle of Tornow.headline: Bitka pri Tornowu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tornowu je potekala med pruskimi in švedskimi silami 26. septembra 1758 med sedemletno vojno blizu današnjega Fürstenberga ob Havli (tedaj Tornow v Veliki vojvodini Mecklenburg-Strelitz).

Pruski poveljnik Carl Heinrich von Wedel je ukazal napad na švedski položaj pri Tornowu. Njegova konjenica, 3. huzarski polk, je švedsko konjenico pregnala, švedska pehota pa je zdržala šest pruskih napadov, izvidniški prodor proti Fehrbellinu pa so odbili. Wedel se je umaknil z bojišča, s čimer je švedski vojski prepustil redko zmago v tem pohodu. Prusi so izgubili 153 mož, Švedi pa 162. Švedi so po bitki izpraznili svoje prednje položaje na območju, ker so jih imeli za preveč izpostavljene pruskim napadom.

source.title: Battle of Tornow
paragraphs: The Battle of Tornow was fought between the forces of Prussia and Sweden on 26 September 1758 during the Seven Years' War, near modern-day Fürstenberg/Havel (then called Tornow, in the Grand Duchy of Mecklenburg-Strelitz).

Prussian commander Carl Heinrich von Wedel ordered an attack on the Swedish position at Tornow. His cavalry, the 3rd Hussars, were successful in driving off the Swedish horse but the Swedish infantry weathered six assaults by the Prussians and a probe towards Fehrbellin was pushed back. Wedel withdrew from the field, granting the Swedish army a rare victory in the campaign. Casualties were 153 men on the Prussian side and 162 men on the Swedish side. The Swedes evacuated their forward posts in the area in the aftermath of the battle, considering them too exposed to Prussian attack.

Battle of Toro.headline: Bitka pri Toru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Toru je bila del vojne za kastiljsko nasledstvo; potekala je 1. marca 1476 blizu mesta Toro med kastiljsko-aragonskimi enotami katoliških vladarjev in portugalsko-kastiljskimi silami Afonsa V. in portugalskega princa Ivana.

Vojaško bitka ni bila odločena, saj sta obe strani razglasili zmago: sile pod princem Ivanom, ki so obdržale bojišče, so porazile kastiljsko desno krilo, enote Afonsa V. pa je premagalo kastiljsko levo središče pod vodstvom vojvode Albe in kardinala Mendoze.

Za katoliška vladarja pa je bila velika politična zmaga, saj je Izabeli zagotovila kastiljski prestol: preostali plemiči, zvesti Juani Trastamarski, so prestopili k Izabeli. Izabela je z veliko politično daljnovidnostjo izkoristila trenutek in sklicala »cortes« v Madrigalu in Segovii (april–oktober 1476). Tam so njeno hčer razglasili za dedinjo kastiljske krone, kar je pomenilo legitimacijo njenega lastnega prestola.

source.title: Battle of Toro
paragraphs: The Battle of Toro was part of the War of the Castilian Succession, fought on 1 March 1476, near the city of Toro, between the Castilian-Aragonese troops of the Catholic Monarchs and the Portuguese-Castilian forces of Afonso V and Prince John of Portugal.

The battle was militarily inconclusive, as both sides claimed victory: the Castilian right wing was defeated by the forces under Prince John who possessed the battlefield, but the troops of Afonso V were beaten by the Castilian left-centre led by the Duke of Alba and Cardinal Mendoza.

However, it was a major political victory for the Catholic Monarchs by assuring to Isabella the throne of Castile: The remnants of the nobles loyal to Juana de Trastámara adhered to Isabella. With great political vision, Isabella took advantage of the moment and summoned the 'Cortes' at Madrigal-Segovia (April–October 1476). There her daughter was proclaimed heiress of Castile's crown, which was equivalent to legitimising her own throne.

Battle of Torvioll.headline: Bitka pri Torviollu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Torviollu (albansko: Beteja e Torviollit), znana tudi kot bitka v Spodnji Dibri, je potekala 29. junija 1444 na planjavi Torvioll na ozemlju današnje Albanije. Gjergj Kastrioti Skenderbeg je bil albanski plemič, ki se je odločil vrniti v domovino in prevzeti vodstvo nove albanske zveze proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu. Skupaj s 300 drugimi Albanci, ki so se bojevali v bitki pri Nišu, je dezertiral iz osmanske vojske in se odpravil v Krujo, ki je zaradi spodkopavanja od znotraj hitro padla. Nato je ustanovil Lješko ligo, zvezo albanskih knezov, združenih v vojni proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu. Murat II. se je zavedal nevarnosti in je enega svojih najizkušenejših vojskovodij, Ali-pašo, s 25.000–40.000 možmi poslal, da novo državo zatre.

source.title: Battle of Torvioll
paragraphs: The Battle of Torvioll (Albanian: Beteja e Torviollit), also known as the Battle of Lower Dibra, was fought on 29 June 1444 on the Plain of Torvioll, in what is now Albania. Gjergj Kastrioti Skanderbeg was an Albanian nobleman who decided to return to his homeland and take the reins of a new Albanian league against the Ottoman Empire. He and 300 other Albanians who fought in the Battle of Niš deserted the Ottoman Army and made their way to Krujë, which quickly fell due to subversion. He then formed the League of Lezhë, a confederation of Albanian princes united in war against the Ottoman Empire. Realising the threat, Murad II sent one of his most experienced generals, Ali Pasha, to crush the new state with a force of 25,000–40,000 men.

Battle of Toulouse (1814).headline: Bitka pri Toulousu (1814)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Toulousu je potekala 10. aprila 1814, le štiri dni po tem, ko je Napoleon Francosko cesarstvo predal šesti koaliciji, in je bila eden zadnjih spopadov napoleonskih vojn. Zavezniška britansko-portugalska in španska vojska pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Arthurja Wellesleyja, 1. markiza Wellingtona, je prejšnjo jesen v težkem pohodu potisnila demoralizirano in razpadajočo francosko cesarsko vojsko iz Španije, spomladi 1814 pa je vojno prenesla na jug Francije.

source.title: Battle of Toulouse (1814)
paragraphs: The Battle of Toulouse took place on April 10, 1814, just four days after Napoleon's surrender of the French Empire to the Sixth Coalition, marking one of the final conflicts of the Napoleonic Wars. Having pushed the demoralised and disintegrating French Imperial Army out of Spain in a difficult campaign the previous autumn, the Allied British-Portuguese and Spanish army under Field Marshal Arthur Wellesley, 1st Marquess of Wellington pursued the war into southern France in the spring of 1814.

Battle of Toulouse (721).headline: Bitka pri Toulousu (721)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Toulousu (721) je bila zmaga akvitanske krščanske vojske pod vodstvom akvitanskega vojvode Oda Velikega nad omajadsko muslimansko vojsko, ki je oblegala mesto Toulouse in jo je vodil al-Samh ibn Malik al-Havlani, omajadski vali (generalni guverner) Al-Andalusa. Odločilna akvitanska zmaga je zaustavila širjenje omajadske oblasti od Narbonne proti zahodu v Akvitanijo.

source.title: Battle of Toulouse (721)
paragraphs: The Battle of Toulouse (721) was a victory of an Aquitanian Christian army led by Odo the Great, Duke of Aquitaine over an Umayyad Muslim army besieging the city of Toulouse, led by al-Samh ibn Malik al-Khawlani, the Umayyad wāli (governor-general) of al-Andalus. The decisive Aquitanian victory checked the spread of Umayyad control westward from Narbonne into Aquitaine.

Battle of Towton.headline: Bitka pri Towtonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Towtonu je potekala 29. marca 1461 v vojni rož blizu Towtona v Severnem Yorkshiru. Yorške sile so odločilno porazile lancastrske privržence Henrika VI. in Edvardu IV. zagotovile angleški prestol. Bitka, v kateri se je na cvetno nedeljo v snežnem metežu deset ur bojevalo po ocenah 50.000 vojakov obeh strani, je bila »verjetno največja in najbolj krvava bitka na angleških tleh«.

Henrik VI. je očeta Henrika V. nasledil leta 1422, star devet mesecev, a je bil šibek, nesposoben in duševno neuravnovešen vladar, zato so plemiči spletkarili, da bi ga obvladovali. Razmere so se v 1450. letih sprevrgle v državljansko vojno med njegovimi sorodniki Beauforti in njegovo ženo, kraljico Margareto, na eni strani ter privrženci njegovega bratranca Riharda, vojvode Yorka, na drugi.

source.title: Battle of Towton
paragraphs: The Battle of Towton took place on 29 March 1461 during the Wars of the Roses, near Towton in North Yorkshire. Yorkist forces decisively defeated Lancastrian supporters of Henry VI, securing the English throne for Edward IV. Fought for ten hours between an estimated 50,000 soldiers from both sides in a snowstorm on Palm Sunday, it was "probably the largest and bloodiest battle on English soil".

Henry VI succeeded his father, Henry V, when he was nine months old in 1422, but was a weak, ineffectual and mentally unsound ruler, which encouraged the nobles to scheme for control over him. The situation deteriorated in the 1450s into a civil war between his Beaufort relatives and his wife, Queen Margaret, on one side, with those of his cousin Richard, Duke of York, on the other.

Battle of Transylvania.headline: Bitka za Transilvanijo
paragraphs: Bitka za Transilvanijo je bila prva velika operacija Romunije v prvi svetovni vojni; začela se je 27. avgusta 1916. Romunska vojska je z njo skušala zavzeti Transilvanijo in morda izločiti Avstro-Ogrsko iz vojne. Ofenziva je bila sprva uspešna, a se je ustavila po bolgarskem napadu na Dobrudžo. Ker je sredi septembra sledil še uspešen nemški in avstro-ogrski protinapad, se je morala romunska vojska do sredine oktobra umakniti nazaj v Karpate. Romunske armade pa so se vseeno izognile poskusom centralnih sil, da bi jih povsem uničile. Bitka za Transilvanijo je povzročila tudi zamenjavo načelnika generalštaba nemške vojske in preusmeritev nemške pozornosti v regijo, zaradi česar so se nemške ofenzivne operacije pri Verdunu ustavile.

source.title: Battle of Transylvania
paragraphs: The Battle of Transylvania was the first major operation of Romania during World War I, beginning on 27 August 1916. It started as an attempt by the Romanian Army to seize Transylvania, and potentially knock Austria-Hungary out of the war. Although initially successful, the offensive was brought to a halt after Bulgaria's attack on Dobruja. Coupled with a successful German and Austro-Hungarian counterattack which started in mid-September, the Romanian Army was eventually forced to retreat back to the Carpathians by mid-October. The Romanian armies however managed to escape the Central Powers' attempts to completely destroy them. The Battle of Transylvania also caused the replacement of the chief of staff of the German Army and the shifting of German attention to the region, causing German offensive operations at Verdun to cease.

Battle of Trebbia (1799).headline: Bitka ob Trebbii leta 1799
paragraphs: Bitka ob Trebbii (17.–20. junija 1799 [po starem koledarju 6.–9. junija]) je potekala blizu rek Tidone, Trebbia in Nure v severni Italiji med združeno rusko-habsburško vojsko pod Aleksandrom Suvorovom in republikansko francosko vojsko, ki jo je vodil Étienne-Jacques-Joseph-Alexandre Macdonald. Čeprav so imeli Francozi zmerno številčno premoč, so Avstrijci in Rusi z uporabo taktike poševnega bojnega reda Francoze hudo porazili, pri čemer so imeli približno 5500 izgub, sovražniku pa so jih prizadejali 16.500. Ruski kontingent je bil na desnem krilu koalicijskih sil in v središču, glavno napadalno vlogo pa so imele ruske enote; Avstrijci so se spopadali s Francozi na levem krilu in pomagali Rusom v središču. Bitka v vojni druge koalicije je potekala zahodno od Piacenze, mesta, ki leži 70 kilometrov jugovzhodno od Milana.
notes: The mile conversion (43 mi) is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Trebbia (1799)
paragraphs: The Battle of (the) Trebbia (17–20 June [O.S. 6–9 June] 1799) was fought near the rivers of Tidone, Trebbia, and Nure in northern Italy between the joint Russian and Habsburg army under Alexander Suvorov and the Republican French army of Étienne-Jacques-Joseph-Alexandre Macdonald. Though French forces were moderately more numerous, the Austro-Russians severely defeated the French using the oblique order tactics, sustaining about 5,500 casualties while inflicting losses of 16,500 on their enemies. The Russian contingent was on the right flank of the coalition force and in the center, and it was the Russian units that played the main attacking role; the Austrians dealt with the French on the left flank, and they helped the Russians in the center. The War of the Second Coalition engagement occurred west of Piacenza, a city located 70 kilometres (43 mi) southeast of Milan.

Battle of Trifanum.headline: Bitka pri Trifanumu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Trifanumu je potekala leta 340 pr. n. št. med Rimsko republiko in latinsko zvezo. Rimsko vojsko je vodil Manlij Imperiosus. Po bitki pri Vezuvu je zasledoval Latince proti severu in se z njimi spopadel pri Trifanumu blizu izliva reke Liri. Livij pripoveduje, da sta obe vojski odvrgli prtljago in se bojevali, kjer sta se srečali. Trdil je, da so Rimljani zmagali in da je bila njihova zmaga tako uničujoča, da so se Latinci takoj vdali, ko je konzul vstopil v Lacij. Ker se je vojna nadaljevala še dve leti, so bili Latinci morda pri Trifanumu presenečeni in razkropljeni.

source.title: Battle of Trifanum
paragraphs: The Battle of Trifanum was fought in 340 BC between the Roman Republic and the Latin League. The Roman force was led by Manlius Imperiosus. He pursued the Latins to the north following the Battle of Vesuvius and met them at Trifanum near the mouth of the Liri River. Livy records that the two forces dumped their baggage and fought where they met. He claimed that the Romans were victorious and that their victory was so crushing that afterwards, when the consul entered Latium, the Latins immediately surrendered. As the war continued for another two years it may be that the Latins were surprised at Trifanum and dispersed.

Bitka pri Trocaderu, ki je potekala 31. avgusta 1823, je bila pomembna bitka francoske odprave v podporo španskemu kralju Ferdinandu VII. Francozi so premagali španske liberalne sile in Ferdinandu vrnili absolutno oblast.

source.title: Battle of Trocadero
paragraphs: The Battle of Trocadero, fought on 31 August 1823, was a significant battle in France's expedition in support of the Spanish King Ferdinand VII. The French defeated the Spanish liberal forces and restored Ferdinand to absolute rule.

Battle of Trostianets.headline: Bitka za Trostjanec
paragraphs: Ruska vojska je 24. februarja 2022 v okviru ruske invazije na Ukrajino prestopila rusko-ukrajinsko in belorusko-ukrajinsko mejo ter vdrla na sever Ukrajine, v Kijevsko, Černigovsko, Sumsko in Žitomirsko oblast. Ruske operacije na severu Ukrajine so se sprva začele kot poskus zavzetja Kijeva, ukrajinske prestolnice in sedeža ukrajinske vlade.

Ruske sile so sprva zavzele več mest, vendar so njihovo napredovanje ustavili logistične in oskrbovalne težave, trdovraten ukrajinski odpor in slaba morala. Ker so imele velike izgube in niso mogle več napredovati, je Rusija konec marca in v začetku aprila 2022 umaknila svoje sile iz Kijevske, Žitomirske, Černigovske in Sumske oblasti, nadzor pa so znova prevzele ukrajinske sile.
notes: The record's article now leads to the summary of the northern Ukraine campaign, which does not mention Trostianets; translated as it stands.

source.title: Northern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine
paragraphs: On 24 February 2022, as part of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, the Russian military crossed the Russia–Ukraine and Belarus–Ukraine borders into northern Ukraine, entering the oblasts (regions) of Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, and Zhytomyr. The Russian operations in northern Ukraine were initially launched as an attempt to capture Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine and the seat of the Ukrainian government.

Russian forces initially captured several towns and cities, but logistical and supply failures, stiff Ukrainian resistance, and poor morale caused their advance to stall. With heavy losses and the inability to make further progress, Russia withdrew its forces from Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv and Sumy oblasts in late March and early April 2022, and Ukrainian forces retook control.

Battle of Trzciana.headline: Bitka pri Trzciani
paragraphs: Bitka pri Trzciani (znana tudi kot bitka pri Honigfeldeju, bitka na Stuhmer Heide ali bitka pri Sztumu) je potekala 25. junija 1629 (po novem koledarju navadno 27. junija) in je bila ena od bitk poljsko-švedske vojne (1626–1629) ali druge švedsko-poljske vojne. Poljske sile, med njimi krilati huzarji, pod vodstvom poljskega kronskega hetmana Stanisława Koniecpolskega in cesarske čete pod vodstvom Hansa Georga von Arnim-Boitzenburga, ki jih je cesar Ferdinand II. poslal na pomoč Sigismundu III., so se spopadle s četami švedskega kralja Gustava II. Adolfa, ki je podpiral protestantske luterance v Nemčiji in severni Evropi. Gustav Adolf je bil dvakrat skoraj ubit ali ujet. Boji v Prusiji so se po bitki nadaljevali še julija in avgusta ter se končali z neodločenim izidom in nazadnje s premirjem, ki ga je sprejel Sigismund III.

source.title: Battle of Trzciana
paragraphs: The Battle of Trzciana (also known as Battle of Honigfelde or Battle on the Stuhmer Heide or Battle of Sztum) took place on 25 June 1629 (usually said to be 27th in the New Style calendar) and was one of the battles of the Polish-Swedish War (1626–1629) or Second Swedish-Polish War. The Polish forces, including the winged hussars, were led by Crown Field Hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and imperial troops under Hans Georg von Arnim-Boitzenburg, sent by Emperor Ferdinand II to aid Sigismund III, met with troops commanded by Swedish King Gustav II Adolf, who supported the Protestant Lutherans of Germany and northern Europe. Gustav Adolf was almost killed or captured twice. Fighting in Prussia continued after the battle into July and August and ended with stalemate and finally a truce accepted by Sigismund III.

Battle of Tsaritsyn.headline: Bitka za Caricin
paragraphs: Bitka za Caricin je bila vojaški spopad med Rdečo armado in Belo armado v ruski državljanski vojni za nadzor nad Caricinom (danes Volgograd), pomembnim mestom in pristaniščem ob Volgi na jugozahodu Rusije.

Mesto, ki je bilo pomembno oporišče oktobrske revolucije in je ostalo v rokah rdečih, so protiboljševiški donski kozaki pod poveljstvom Pjotra Krasnova trikrat oblegali: julija–septembra 1918, septembra–oktobra 1918 in januarja–februarja 1919. Nov poskus osvojitve Caricina je maja–junija 1919 izvedla prostovoljska armada, ki je mesto zavzela. Med avgustom 1919 in januarjem 1920 so mesto nato pred boljševiki branili beli. Rdeči so Caricin dokončno zavzeli v začetku leta 1920.

Obramba Caricina, imenovana »rdeči Verdun«, je bila eden najpogosteje opisovanih in spominsko obeleževanih dogodkov državljanske vojne v sovjetskem zgodovinopisju, umetnosti in propagandi. Razlog je bil, da je pri obrambi mesta med julijem 1918 in januarjem 1920 sodeloval Josif Stalin.

source.title: Battle of Tsaritsyn
paragraphs: The Battle of Tsaritsyn was a military confrontation between the Red Army and the White Army during the Russian Civil War for control of Tsaritsyn (now Volgograd), a significant city and port on the Volga River in southwestern Russia.

The city, which had been an important center of support for the October Revolution and remained in the hands of the Reds, was besieged three times by anti-Bolshevik Don Cossacks under the command of Pyotr Krasnov: July–September 1918, September–October 1918, and January–February 1919. Another attempt to conquer Tsaritsyn was made in May–June 1919 by the Volunteer Army, which successfully captured the city. In turn, between August 1919 and January 1920, the Whites defended the city against the Bolsheviks. Tsaritsyn was finally conquered by the Reds in early 1920.

The defense of Tsaritsyn, nicknamed the "Red Verdun", was one of the most widely described and commemorated events of the Civil War in Soviet historiography, art and propaganda. This was because Joseph Stalin took part in the defense of the city between July 1918 and January 1920.

Battle of Tudela.headline: Bitka pri Tudeli
paragraphs: V bitki pri Tudeli (23. novembra 1808) je francoska cesarska vojska pod vodstvom maršala Jeana Lannesa napadla špansko vojsko pod generalom Castañosom. Bitka se je končala s popolno zmago cesarskih sil. Spopad se je odvil blizu Tudele v Navari v Španiji med polotoško vojno, delom širšega spopada, znanega kot napoleonske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Tudela
paragraphs: The Battle of Tudela (23 November 1808) saw an Imperial French army led by Marshal Jean Lannes attack a Spanish army under General Castaños. The battle resulted in the complete victory of the Imperial forces over their adversaries. The combat occurred near Tudela in Navarre, Spain during the Peninsular War, part of a wider conflict known as the Napoleonic Wars.

Battle of Turckheim.headline: Bitka pri Turckheimu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Turckheimu je potekala 5. januarja 1675 med francosko-nizozemsko vojno na kraju med mestoma Colmar in Turckheim v Alzaciji. Francoska vojska pod poveljstvom vikonta Turenna je premagala avstrijsko in brandenburško vojsko pod vodstvom Alexandra von Bournonvilla in brandenburškega volilnega kneza Friderika Viljema.

source.title: Battle of Turckheim
paragraphs: The Battle of Turckheim took place on 5 January 1675 during the Franco-Dutch War at a site between the towns of Colmar and Turckheim in Alsace. The French army, commanded by the Viscount of Turenne, defeated the armies of Austria and Brandenburg, led by Alexander von Bournonville and Frederick William, Elector of Brandenburg.

Battle of Turin (312).headline: Bitka pri Torinu leta 312
paragraphs: Bitka pri Torinu je potekala leta 312 med rimskim cesarjem Konstantinom Velikim in četami njegovega tekmeca Maksencija. Konstantin je bitko dobil in pokazal zgodnji primer taktične spretnosti, ki je pozneje zaznamovala njegovo vojaško kariero. Pohod se je končal z njegovo slavnejšo zmago pri Milvijskem mostu tik pred Rimom.

source.title: Battle of Turin (312)
paragraphs: The Battle of Turin was fought in 312 between Roman emperor Constantine the Great and the troops of his rival Maxentius. Constantine won the battle, showing an early example of the tactical skill which was to characterise his later military career. The campaign ended with his more famous victory at the Milvian Bridge immediately outside of Rome.

Battle of Turtucaia.headline: Bitka pri Turtucaii
paragraphs: Bitka pri Turtucaii (romunsko: Bătălia de la Turtucaia; bolgarsko: Битка при Тутракан), v Bolgariji znana tudi kot tutrakanska epopeja (bolgarsko: Тутраканска епопея), je bila uvodna bitka prve ofenzive centralnih sil v romunski kampanji prve svetovne vojne. Trajala je pet dni in se končala z zavzetjem trdnjave Turtucaia (danes Tutrakan) in predajo njenih romunskih branilcev.

source.title: Battle of Turtucaia
paragraphs: The Battle of Turtucaia (Romanian: Bătălia de la Turtucaia; Bulgarian: Битка при Тутракан, Bitka pri Tutrakan), also known as Tutrakan Epopee (Bulgarian: Тутраканска епопея, Tutrakanska epopeya) in Bulgaria, was the opening battle of the first Central Powers offensive during the Romanian Campaign of World War I. The battle lasted for five days and ended with the capture of the fortress of Turtucaia (now Tutrakan) and the surrender of its Romanian defenders.

Battle of Tyndaris.headline: Bitka pri Tindaridi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tindaridi je bila pomorska bitka prve punske vojne, ki je potekala leta 257 pr. n. št. pred Tindarido (današnji Tindari). Tindarida je bilo sicilsko mesto, ustanovljeno leta 396 pr. n. št. kot grška kolonija na visokem svetu nad Tirenskim morjem v zalivu Patti. Hieron II., sirakuški tiran, je dovolil, da je Tindarida postala oporišče Kartažanov. Bitka je potekala v vodah med Tindarido in Eolskimi otoki, rimskemu ladjevju pa je poveljeval Gaj Atilij Regul. Mesto je nato padlo v rimske roke.
notes: No established Slovenian form of Tyndaris was found; Tindarida is used.

source.title: Battle of Tyndaris
paragraphs: The Battle of Tyndaris was a naval battle of the First Punic War that took place off Tyndaris (modern Tindari) in 257 BC. Tyndaris was a Sicilian town founded as a Greek colony in 396 BC located on the high ground overlooking the Tyrrhenian Sea in the Gulf of Patti. Hiero II, the tyrant of Syracuse, allowed Tyndaris to become a base for the Carthaginians. The battle took place in the waters between Tyndaris and the Aeolian Islands, with Gaius Atilius Regulus in command of the Roman fleet. Subsequently, the town fell to Rome.

Battle of Uclés (1108).headline: Bitka pri Uclésu (1108)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Uclésu je potekala 29. maja 1108 v obdobju rekonkviste blizu Uclésa tik južno od reke Tajo med krščanskimi silami Kastilje in Leóna pod Alfonzom VI. in silami muslimanskih Almoravidov pod Tamimom ibn Jusufom. Bitka je bila za kristjane katastrofa: veliko visokih leonskih plemičev, med njimi sedem grofov, je padlo v boju ali so jim pozneje odsekali glave, prestolonaslednika Sanča Alfónseza pa so med begom umorili vaščani. Kljub temu Almoravidi uspeha na odprtem polju niso mogli izkoristiti za zavzetje Toleda.

source.title: Battle of Uclés (1108)
paragraphs: The Battle of Uclés was fought on 29 May 1108 during the Reconquista period near Uclés just south of the river Tagus between the Christian forces of Castile and León under Alfonso VI and the forces of the Muslim Almoravids under Tamim ibn-Yusuf. The battle was a disaster for the Christians and many of the high nobility of León, including seven counts, died in the fray or were beheaded afterwards, while the heir-apparent, Sancho Alfónsez, was murdered by villagers while trying to flee. Despite this, the Almoravids could not capitalise on their success in the open field by taking Toledo.

Battle of Ulm.headline: Bitka pri Ulmu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ulmu 16.–20. oktobra 1805 je bila vrsta spopadov ob koncu ulmskega pohoda, ki so Napoleonu I. omogočili, da je z minimalnimi izgubami ujel celotno avstrijsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Karla barona Macka von Leibericha in jo prisilil k predaji blizu Ulma v Bavarski volilni kneževini.

source.title: Battle of Ulm
paragraphs: The Battle of Ulm on 16–20 October 1805 was a series of skirmishes, at the end of the Ulm campaign, which allowed Napoleon I to trap an entire Austrian army under the command of Karl Freiherr Mack von Leiberich with minimal losses and to force its surrender near Ulm in the Electorate of Bavaria.

Bitka pri Umanu (15. julija – 8. avgusta 1941) je bila nemška ofenziva druge svetovne vojne pri Umanu v Ukrajini proti sovjetski 6. in 12. armadi. Wehrmacht je obe sovjetski armadi v treh tednih obkolil in uničil.

Bitka je potekala med kijevsko obrambno operacijo med enotami jugozahodne fronte Rdeče armade, ki so se umikale iz lvovskega izbočenja, in nemško skupino armad Jug pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Gerda von Rundstedta, v okviru operacije Barbarossa.

Sovjetske sile so bile pod splošnim poveljstvom jugozahodne smeri, ki ji je poveljeval maršal Semjon Budjoni in je obsegala jugozahodno fronto pod poveljstvom generalpolkovnika Mihaila Kirponosa in južno fronto pod poveljstvom generala Ivana Tjulenjeva. Poveljnik 6. armade je bil generalpodpolkovnik I. N. Muzičenko, 12. armade pa generalmajor P. G. Ponedelin.

source.title: Battle of Uman
paragraphs: The Battle of Uman (15 July – 8 August 1941) was the World War II German offensive in Uman, Ukraine against the 6th and 12th Soviet Armies. In a three-week period, the Wehrmacht encircled and annihilated the two Soviet armies.

The battle occurred during the Kiev defensive operation between the elements of the Red Army's Southwestern Front, retreating from the Lwow salient, and German Army Group South, commanded by Field Marshal Gerd von Rundstedt, as part of Operation Barbarossa.

The Soviet forces were under overall command of the Southwestern Direction, commanded by Marshal Semyon Budyonny, which included the Southwestern Front commanded by Colonel General Mikhail Kirponos and Southern Front commanded by General Ivan Tyulenev. The 6th army was commanded by Lieutenant General I. N. Muzychenko and the 12th army by Major General P. G. Ponedelin.

Battle of Val-ès-Dunes.headline: Bitka pri Val-ès-Dunesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Val-ès-Dunesu (Valesdunes) je potekala leta 1047 med združenimi silami normandijskega vojvode Viljema I. in francoskega kralja Henrika I. ter silami več upornih normanskih baronov pod vodstvom Viljemovega bratranca Guya Brionnskega.
Z zmago je Viljem obdržal naslov in nadzor nad zahodno polovico svoje vojvodine.

source.title: Battle of Val-ès-Dunes
paragraphs: The Battle of Val-ès-Dunes (Valesdunes) was fought in 1047 by the combined forces of the Norman duke William I and the French king Henry I against the forces of several rebel Norman barons, led by William's cousin Guy of Brionne.
As a result of winning the battle, William was able to retain his title and maintain control over the western half of his duchy.

Battle of Valea Albă.headline: Bitka pri Valea Albă
paragraphs: Bitka pri Valea Albă, znana tudi kot bitka pri Războieniju ali bitka pri Akdereju, je bila pomemben dogodek v srednjeveški zgodovini Moldavije. Potekala je 26. julija 1476 pri Războieniju, imenovanem tudi Valea Albă, med moldavsko vojsko Štefana Velikega in osmansko vojsko, ki je vdrla v deželo in ji je osebno poveljeval sultan Mehmed Osvajalec.

source.title: Battle of Valea Albă
paragraphs: The Battle of Valea Albă, also known as the Battle of Războieni or the Battle of Akdere, was an important event in the medieval history of Moldavia. It took place at Războieni, also known as Valea Albă, on 26 July 1476, between the Moldavian army of Stephen the Great and an invading Ottoman army which was commanded personally by Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror.

Battle of Valmy.headline: Bitka pri Valmyju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Valmyju, znana tudi kot kanonada pri Valmyju, je bila prva velika zmaga francoske vojske v revolucionarnih vojnah, ki so sledile francoski revoluciji. Potekala je 20. septembra 1792, ko so pruske čete pod poveljstvom brunšviškega vojvode skušale prodreti proti Parizu. Generala François Kellermann in Charles Dumouriez sta prodiranje ustavila blizu severne vasi Valmy v Champagne-Ardenni.

source.title: Battle of Valmy
paragraphs: The Battle of Valmy, also known as the Cannonade of Valmy, was the first major victory by the army of France during the Revolutionary Wars that followed the French Revolution. The battle took place on 20 September 1792 as Prussian troops commanded by the Duke of Brunswick attempted to march on Paris. Generals François Kellermann and Charles Dumouriez stopped the advance near the northern village of Valmy in Champagne-Ardenne.

Ruska vojska je 24. februarja 2022 v okviru ruske invazije na Ukrajino prestopila rusko-ukrajinsko in belorusko-ukrajinsko mejo ter vdrla na sever Ukrajine, v Kijevsko, Černigovsko, Sumsko in Žitomirsko oblast. Ruske operacije na severu Ukrajine so se sprva začele kot poskus zavzetja Kijeva, ukrajinske prestolnice in sedeža ukrajinske vlade.

Ruske sile so sprva zavzele več mest, vendar so njihovo napredovanje ustavili logistične in oskrbovalne težave, trdovraten ukrajinski odpor in slaba morala. Ker so imele velike izgube in niso mogle več napredovati, je Rusija konec marca in v začetku aprila 2022 umaknila svoje sile iz Kijevske, Žitomirske, Černigovske in Sumske oblasti, nadzor pa so znova prevzele ukrajinske sile.
notes: The record's article now leads to the summary of the northern Ukraine campaign, which does not mention Vasylkiv; translated as it stands.

source.title: Northern front of the Russian invasion of Ukraine
paragraphs: On 24 February 2022, as part of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, the Russian military crossed the Russia–Ukraine and Belarus–Ukraine borders into northern Ukraine, entering the oblasts (regions) of Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, and Zhytomyr. The Russian operations in northern Ukraine were initially launched as an attempt to capture Kyiv, the capital of Ukraine and the seat of the Ukrainian government.

Russian forces initially captured several towns and cities, but logistical and supply failures, stiff Ukrainian resistance, and poor morale caused their advance to stall. With heavy losses and the inability to make further progress, Russia withdrew its forces from Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv and Sumy oblasts in late March and early April 2022, and Ukrainian forces retook control.

Battle of Vauchamps.headline: Bitka pri Vauchampsu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vauchampsu (14. februarja 1814) je bila zadnji večji spopad šestdnevnega pohoda v vojni šeste koalicije. Del velike armade (Grande Armée) pod Napoleonom I. je v njej premagal močnejše pruske in ruske sile šlezijske armade pod poveljstvom feldmaršala Gebharda Leberechta von Blücherja. To je bila ena najsijajnejših taktičnih zmag v Napoleonovi vojaški karieri.

source.title: Battle of Vauchamps
paragraphs: The Battle of Vauchamps (14 February 1814) was the final major engagement of the Six Days Campaign of the War of the Sixth Coalition. It resulted in a part of the Grande Armée under Napoleon I defeating a superior Prussian and Russian force of the Army of Silesia under Field-marshal Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher. In the military career of Napoleon, this was one of his most outstanding tactical victories.

Battle of Vedrosha.headline: Bitka ob Vedroši
paragraphs: Bitka ob Vedroši (litovsko: Vedrošos mūšis; rusko: Ведрошская битва) je potekala 14. julija 1500 blizu reke Vedroša pri Dorogobužu (tedaj v Veliki kneževini Litvi, danes v Rusiji) med drugo moskovsko-litovsko vojno (1500–1503).
Moskovske sile so v bitki porazile številčno šibkejše litovske čete, ki so jih napadle. Bitka ob Vedroši je bila prva velika moskovska zmaga nad Litvo v vojni 1500–1503.

Geopolitični položaj Litve je bil po bitki obupen. Aleksander Litovski je zaman skušal Krimski kanat pod Menglijem I. Girejem in Moldavijo pod Štefanom III. pripraviti, da bi začela sovražnosti proti Moskoviji, s katero sta bila zaveznika. Edino pomoč je Litva dobila z napadom Livonskega reda na Pskov, ki je spodletel zaradi griže.

source.title: Battle of Vedrosha
paragraphs: The Battle of Vedrosha (Lithuanian: Vedrošos mūšis; Russian: Ведрошская битва) was fought near the Vedrosha river, close to Dorogobuzh (then in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, now in Russia) on 14 July 1500, during the Second Muscovite–Lithuanian War (1500–1503).
In the battle of Vedrosha, Muscovite forces defeated outnumbered Lithuanian troops attacking them. The Battle of Vedrosha was the first major Muscovite victory over Lithuania in the war of 1500–1503.

The Lithuanian geopolitical situation after the battle was desperate. Alexander of Lithuania unsuccessfully tried to even make the Crimean Khanate under Meñli I Giray and Moldavia under Stephen III begin hostilities against Muscovy, with which they were allied. The only help the Lithuanians received was the Livonian Order's attack on Pskov, which failed due to dysentery.

Battle of Veii.headline: Bitka pri Veijih
paragraphs: Bitka pri Veijih, imenovana tudi obleganje Veijev, je bila spopad starega Rima, datiran približno v leto 396 pr. n. št. Glavni vir o njej je Livijevo delo Ab urbe condita (»Od ustanovitve mesta«).

Bitka pri Veijih je bila zadnja bitka med Rimljani pod vodstvom Marka Furija Kamila, ki so ga izvolili za diktatorja, in etruščanskim mestom Veji. Veji so se Rimljanom upirali v dolgi in neodločeni vojni z zmagami in porazi na obeh straneh. Rimljani so oblegali Veje in izkopali predor pod mestom. Kamil je napadel mesto z vseh strani, da bi odvrnil pozornost Vejčanov. Nato so Rimljani izšli iz predora in njihove sile so Veje hitro premagale.

source.title: Battle of Veii
paragraphs: The battle of Veii, also known as the siege of Veii, involved ancient Rome, and is approximately dated at 396 BC. The main source about it is Livy's Ab Urbe Condita.

The battle of Veii was the final battle between the Romans, who were led by Marcus Furius Camillus, who had been elected dictator, and the Etruscan city of Veii. Veii had resisted the Romans in a long and inconclusive war with victories and defeats on both sides. The Romans besieged Veii and dug a tunnel beneath the city. Camillus attacked the city on all sides so as to distract the Veientines. The Romans then emerged from the tunnel and their forces quickly overwhelmed Veii.

Battle of Velikiye Luki.headline: Bitka za Velike Luki
paragraphs: Bitka za Velike Luki, imenovana tudi velikolukska ofenzivna operacija (rusko: Великолукская наступательная операция), se je začela z napadom sil kalininske fronte na 3. tankovsko armado med zimsko kampanjo 1942–1943, s ciljem osvoboditi rusko mesto Velike Luki kot del severnih klešč rževsko-sičevske strateške ofenzivne operacije (operacija Mars).

Sovjetske sile so mesto, čigar obleganje včasih imenujejo »mali Stalingrad severa«, obkolile 27. novembra 1942, vendar proti nemškim enotam zahodneje niso veliko napredovale in niso znova zavzele ključne železnice proti Leningradu. Nemška posadka v mestu je dobila ukaz, naj zdrži do prihoda reševalnih sil. Tako kot pri Stalingradu nemški protinapadi niso dosegli mesta in posadka se je 16. januarja 1943 predala.

source.title: Battle of Velikiye Luki
paragraphs: The Battle of Velikiye Luki, also named Velikiye Luki offensive operation (Russian: Великолукская наступательная операция), started with the attack by the forces of the Kalinin Front against the 3rd Panzer Army during the winter campaign of 1942–1943 with the objective of liberating the Russian city of Velikiye Luki as a previous part of the northern pincer of the Rzhev-Sychevka Strategic Offensive Operation (Operation Mars).

Sometimes known as "The Little Stalingrad of the North", the Soviet forces encircled the city on 27 November 1942 but were unable to make much progress against German units further west nor retake a key railway to Leningrad. The German garrison in the city was ordered to hold out for a relief force. As was the case at Stalingrad, German counter-attacks were unable to reach the city and the garrison surrendered on 16 January 1943.

Battle of Vercellae.headline: Bitka pri Vercellae
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vercellae ali bitka na Raudijski ravnini je potekala 30. julija 101 pr. n. št. na ravnini blizu Vercellae v Cisalpinski Galiji, današnji severni Italiji. Keltsko-germansko zvezo pod poveljstvom kimbrskega kralja Boiorixa je premagala rimska vojska pod skupnim poveljstvom konzula Gaja Marija in prokonzula Kvinta Lutacija Katula. Z bitko se je končala kimbrska vojna.

source.title: Battle of Vercellae
paragraphs: The Battle of Vercellae or Battle of the Raudine Plain was fought on 30 July 101 BC on a plain near Vercellae in Gallia Cisalpina, modern-day Northern Italy. A Celtic-Germanic confederation under the command of the Cimbric king Boiorix was defeated by a Roman army under the joint command of the consul Gaius Marius and the proconsul Quintus Lutatius Catulus. The battle marked the end of the Cimbrian War.

Bitka pri Verdunu je potekala med 29. avgustom in 2. septembrom 1792 med francoskimi revolucionarnimi silami in prusko vojsko v prvih mesecih vojne prve koalicije. Zmagali so Prusi, ki so si odprli prosto pot proti zahodu do Pariza.

source.title: Battle of Verdun (1792)
paragraphs: The Battle of Verdun was fought between 29 August and 2 September 1792 between French Revolutionary forces and a Prussian army during the opening months of the War of the First Coalition. The Prussians were victorious, gaining a clear westward path to Paris.

Battle of Verneuil.headline: Bitka pri Verneuilu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Verneuilu je potekala 17. avgusta 1424 v stoletni vojni blizu Verneuil-sur-Avra v Normandiji: angleška vojska se je spopadla z združenimi francosko-škotskimi silami, ki jih je okrepila milanska težka konjenica. Bila je pomembna angleška zmaga, ki so jo Angleži opisali kot drugi Agincourt.

source.title: Battle of Verneuil
paragraphs: The Battle of Verneuil was a battle of the Hundred Years' War, fought on 17 August 1424 near Verneuil-sur-Avre in Normandy between an English army and a combined Franco-Scottish force, augmented by Milanese heavy cavalry. The battle was a significant English victory, and was described by them as a second Agincourt.

Battle of Verona (312).headline: Bitka pri Veroni leta 312
paragraphs: Bitka pri Veroni je potekala leta 312 med silami rimskih cesarjev Konstantina I. in Maksencija. Maksencijeve sile so doživele poraz, v boju pa je padel Ruricij Pompejan, najvišji Maksencijev poveljnik.

source.title: Battle of Verona (312)
paragraphs: The Battle of Verona was fought in 312 between the forces of the Roman emperors Constantine I and Maxentius. Maxentius' forces were defeated, and Ruricius Pompeianus, the most senior Maxentian commander, was killed in the fighting.

Battle of Verona (402).headline: Bitka pri Veroni leta 402
paragraphs: Bitka pri Veroni je potekala junija 402 med Alarikovimi Vizigoti in rimsko vojsko pod Stilihonom. Rimljani so Alarika premagali in ga prisilili k umiku iz Italije.

source.title: Battle of Verona (402)
paragraphs: The Battle of Verona was fought in June 402 by Alaric's Visigoths and a Roman force led by Stilicho. Alaric was defeated and forced to withdraw from Italy.

Battle of Vesuvius.headline: Bitka pri Vezuvu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vezuvu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Veserisu) je bila prva zapisana bitka latinske vojne. Potekala je blizu gore Vezuv leta 340 pr. n. št. med Rimljani in njihovimi zavezniki Samniti ter koalicijo več ljudstev: Latincev, Kampancev, Volskov, Sidicinov in Avrunkov. Ohranjeni viri o bitki pa se osredotočajo skoraj izključno na Rimljane (pod vodstvom Tita Manlija Torkvata in Publija Decija Musa) in Latince.

Bitka je zaslovela zaradi dveh epizod, ki naj bi se zgodili: Manlij Torkvat je dal usmrtiti lastnega sina, ker je ta kršil ukaze in se v dvoboju spopadel s sovražnikovim prvakom, Decij Mus pa se je žrtvoval, ko je sebe in sovražno vojsko posvetil podzemnim bogovom, nato pa planil v sovražnikove vrste in padel.

Ko je Decij Mus padel, je konzul Manlij Torkvat s svojo veteransko rezervo napadel latinske vrste in pobil ali ujel skoraj tri četrtine latinske vojske. Preostali vojaki latinske vojske so zbežali, vendar jih zaradi velikih rimskih izgub niso mogli zasledovati.

source.title: Battle of Vesuvius
paragraphs: The Battle of Vesuvius (also known as the Battle of the Veseris) was the first recorded battle of the Latin War. The battle was fought near Mount Vesuvius in 340 BC between the Romans, with their allies the Samnites, against a coalition of several peoples: Latins, Campanians, Volsci, Sidicini, and Aurunci. The surviving sources on the battle, however, focus almost solely on the Romans (led by Titus Manlius Torquatus and Publius Decius Mus) and the Latins.

The battle became famous for two episodes said to have taken place: Manlius Torquatus' execution of his own son after he disobeyed orders and fought an enemy champion in single combat, and the self-sacrifice of Decius Mus, who devoted himself and the enemy army to the gods of the underworld, and then charged into the enemy lines and was slain.

After Decius Mus had fallen, consul Manlius Torquatus led his veteran reserve against Latin lines and killed or captured nearly three fourths of the Latin army. The remaining soldiers of the Latin army fled, but because the Roman loss was so great, they could not pursue their enemies.

Bitka v zalivu Vigo, znana tudi kot bitka pri Randeju (galicijsko in špansko: Batalla de Rande) ali včasih kot bitka v zalivu Redondela, je bila pomorski spopad 23. oktobra 1702 v prvih letih vojne za špansko nasledstvo. Spopadu je predhodil angleško-nizozemski poskus, da bi septembra zavzeli špansko pristanišče Cádiz in si zagotovili pomorsko oporišče na Iberskem polotoku. Zavezniki so upali, da bodo iz tega oporišča vodili operacije v zahodnem Sredozemskem morju, zlasti proti Francozom v Toulonu.

Amfibijski napad pa se je končal s polomom, toda ko se je admiral George Rooke v začetku oktobra vračal domov, je izvedel, da je španska zakladna flota iz Amerike, natovorjena s srebrom in blagom, priplula v zaliv Vigo na severu Španije. Philips van Almonde je Rooka prepričal, naj napade zakladne ladje, čeprav je bilo leto že pozno in so ladje varovale francoske linijske ladje.

source.title: Battle of Vigo Bay
paragraphs: The Battle of Vigo Bay, also known as the Battle of Rande (Galician: Batalla de Rande; Spanish: Batalla de Rande) or sometimes as the Battle of Redondela Bay, was a naval engagement fought on 23 October 1702 during the opening years of the War of the Spanish Succession. The engagement followed an Anglo-Dutch attempt to capture the Spanish port of Cádiz in September in an effort to secure a naval base in the Iberian Peninsula. From this station the Allies had hoped to conduct operations in the western Mediterranean Sea, particularly against the French at Toulon.

The amphibious assault, however, had proved a disaster, but as Admiral George Rooke retreated home in early October, he received news that the Spanish treasure fleet from America, laden with silver and merchandise, had entered Vigo Bay in northern Spain. Philips van Almonde convinced Rooke to attack the treasure ships, despite the lateness of the year and the fact that the vessels were protected by French ships-of-the-line.

Pomorska bitka pri Vila Franca do Campo, znana tudi kot bitka pri Ponta Delgadi in pomorska bitka pri otoku Terceira, je potekala 26. julija 1582 pred obalo otoka São Miguel v portugalskem otočju Azori med vojno za portugalsko nasledstvo. Združena korzarska odprava, večinoma francoska (francosko in angleško ladjevje s portugalskimi silami), je odplula proti španskim pomorskim silam iz portugalskih in kastiljskih ladij, da bi ohranila Azore pod nadzorom pretendenta Antónia, priorja Crata, in otoke ubranila pred vključitvijo v Ibersko unijo; to so bile največje francoske sile, poslane čez morje pred dobo Ludvika XIV.

V prvem spopadu velikih ladjevij karak in galeon daleč od celine je eskadra pod Álvarom de Bazánom hudo porazila najemniško ladjevje pod Filippom di Piero Strozzijem. Španska zmaga je privedla do hitre španske osvojitve Azorov in dokončala vključitev Portugalske v Španski imperij.

source.title: Battle of Vila Franca do Campo
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Vila Franca do Campo, also known as Battle of Ponta Delgada and Naval Battle of Terceira Island, took place on 26 July 1582, off the coast of the island of São Miguel in the Portuguese archipelago of the Azores, during the War of the Portuguese Succession. A combined corsair expedition, mainly French (a French, and English fleet with Portuguese forces included), sailed against a Spanish naval force made up of Portuguese and Castilian ships, to preserve control of the Azores under the pretender António, Prior of Crato and to defend the islands from incorporation into the Iberian Union, the largest French force sent overseas before the age of Louis XIV.

In the first engagement between large fleets of carracks and galleons operating at great distances from the mainland, the mercenary fleet under Filippo di Piero Strozzi was severely defeated by a squadron under Álvaro de Bazán. The Spanish victory resulted in the rapid Spanish conquest of the Azores and completed the incorporation of Portugal into the Spanish Empire.

Battle of Villaviciosa.headline: Bitka pri Villaviciosi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Villaviciosi (11. decembra 1710) je bila bitka med francosko-špansko vojsko pod vodstvom Louisa Josepha, vojvode Vendômskega, in španskega kralja Filipa V. ter vojsko velike alianse pod poveljstvom avstrijskega generala Guida Starhemberga. Potekala je v vojni za špansko nasledstvo, dan po tem, ko je Vendômova vojska pri Brihuegi strla manjše britanske sile pod Jamesom Stanhopom. Zmago sta si pripisala tako španski kralj Filip V. kot nadvojvoda Karel Avstrijski, toda število mrtvih in ranjenih, število topov in drugega orožja, ki ga je zavezniška vojska pustila za sabo, ter strateške posledice bitke za vojno so potrdili Filipovo zmago.

Bitko so v veliki meri odločili španski dragonci pod poveljstvom markiza Valdecañasa in grofa Aguilarja, ki so daleč presegali nasprotne sile. Avstrijsko-zavezniške sile so se umaknile, zasledovala jih je španska konjenica, in ko je zavezniška vojska 6. januarja prispela v Barcelono (enega redkih krajev v Španiji, ki so še priznavali Karlovo oblast), je štela le še 6000 ali 7000 mož.

source.title: Battle of Villaviciosa
paragraphs: The Battle of Villaviciosa (11 December 1710) was a battle between a Franco-Spanish army led by Louis Joseph, Duke of Vendôme and Philip V of Spain and a Grand Alliance army commanded by Austrian General Guido Starhemberg. The battle took place during the War of the Spanish Succession, one day after a Vendôme's army overran a smaller British force under James Stanhope at Brihuega. Both Philip V of Spain and the Archduke Charles of Austria claimed victory, but the number of dead and wounded, the number of artillery and other weapons abandoned by the Allied army and the battle's strategic consequences for the war confirmed victory for Philip.

The battle was largely determined by the Spanish dragoons commanded by the Marquis of Valdecañas and the Count of Aguilar, which far exceeded the opposing forces. The Austro-allied forces retreated, pursued by Spanish cavalry, and the allied army was reduced to 6,000 or 7,000 men when it reached Barcelona (one of the few places in Spain still recognizing Charles' authority) on 6 January.

Battle of Villinghausen.headline: Bitka pri Villinghausnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Villinghausnu (ali Vellinghausnu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Kirchdenkernu) je potekala med sedemletno vojno 15. in 16. julija 1761 na zahodu današnje Nemčije med veliko francosko vojsko in anglo-nemškimi silami pod vodstvom princa Ferdinanda Brunšviškega. Francoski poveljniki niso uskladili svojih dejanj in so bili poraženi.

source.title: Battle of Villinghausen
paragraphs: The Battle of Villinghausen (or Vellinghausen, also known as the Battle of Kirchdenkern), took place during the Seven Years' War fought on the 15th and 16 July 1761 in the western area of present-day Germany, between a large French army and an Anglo-German force led by Prince Ferdinand of Brunswick. The French commanders failed to coordinate their actions and suffered defeat.

Battle of Vimeiro.headline: Bitka pri Vimeiru
paragraphs: V bitki pri Vimeiru (v tedanjih britanskih besedilih včasih zapisano »Vimiera« ali »Vimeira«) 21. avgusta 1808 so Britanci pod generalom Arthurjem Wellesleyjem (poznejšim vojvodo Wellingtonom) premagali Francoze pod generalmajorjem Jeanom-Andochom Junotom blizu vasi Vimeiro pri Lizboni na Portugalskem med polotoško vojno. Bitka je končala prvo francosko invazijo na Portugalsko.
notes: The Portuguese pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Vimeiro
paragraphs: In the Battle of Vimeiro (sometimes shown as "Vimiera" or "Vimeira" in contemporary British texts) on 21 August 1808, the British under General Arthur Wellesley (who later became the Duke of Wellington) defeated the French under Major-General Jean-Andoche Junot near the village of Vimeiro (Portuguese pronunciation: [viˈmɐjɾu]), near Lisbon, Portugal, during the Peninsular War. This battle put an end to the first French invasion of Portugal.

Battle of Vimy Ridge.headline: Bitka za greben Vimy
paragraphs: Bitka za greben Vimy (9.–12. aprila 1917) je bila del bitke pri Arrasu v departmaju Pas-de-Calais v Franciji med prvo svetovno vojno. Na eni strani so se bojevale štiri divizije kanadskega korpusa v sestavi 1. armade, na drugi pa tri divizije nemške 6. armade. Z njo se je začela bitka pri Arrasu in bila je prvi napad Nivellove ofenzive. Cilj je bil odvleči nemške rezerve stran od francoskih sil, ki so se pripravljale na francosko ofenzivo ob Aisni in na grebenu Chemin des Dames nekaj dni pozneje.

source.title: Battle of Vimy Ridge
paragraphs: The Battle of Vimy Ridge (9–12 April 1917) was part of the Battle of Arras, in the Pas-de-Calais department of France, during the First World War. The main combatants were the four divisions of the Canadian Corps in the First Army, against three divisions of the German 6th Army. The battle began the Battle of Arras and was the first attack of the Nivelle Offensive. The objective was to draw German reserves away from the French forces, preparing for the French offensive along the Aisne and the Chemin des Dames ridge several days later.

Bitka na Vítkovu je bila del husitskih vojn. V njej so se sile kralja Sigismunda spopadle s husitskimi silami pod poveljstvom Jana Žižke. Grič Vítkov je ležal na robu mesta Praga, bitka pa je potekala v vinogradu, ki ga je dal zasaditi Sigismundov oče Karel IV. Končala se je z odločilno husitsko zmago.
notes: The English form of Žižka's name is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Vítkov Hill
