paragraphs: The Battle of Vítkov Hill was a part of the Hussite Wars. The battle pitted the forces of King Sigismund, against Hussite forces under command of Jan Žižka (English: John Zizka). Vítkov Hill was located on the edge of the city of Prague and the battle occurred in a vineyard established by Sigismund's father, Charles IV. It ended with a decisive Hussite victory.

V bitki pri Vitorii (21. junija 1813) je britanska, portugalska in španska vojska pod markizom Wellingtonom blizu Vitorie v Španiji strla francosko vojsko pod kraljem Jožefom Bonapartejem in maršalom Jeanom-Baptistom Jourdanom, kar je nazadnje privedlo do zmage v polotoški vojni.

source.title: Battle of Vitoria
paragraphs: At the Battle of Vitoria (21 June 1813), a British, Portuguese and Spanish army under the Marquess of Wellington broke the French army under King Joseph Bonaparte and Marshal Jean-Baptiste Jourdan near Vitoria in Spain, eventually leading to victory in the Peninsular War.

Battle of Vlaardingen.headline: Bitka pri Vlaardingnu
paragraphs: (Prva) bitka pri Vlaardingnu je potekala 29. julija 1018 med četami Svetega rimskega cesarstva in Zahodne Frizije (ki je pozneje postala znana kot grofija Holandija). Zaradi trgovinskega spora je cesar Henrik II. proti Zahodni Friziji poslal vojsko, da bi podjarmil upornega grofa Dirka III. Cesarska vojska pa je bila odločilno poražena in je v paniki pobegnila.

Vedenje o bitki temelji na treh kronikah, napisanih kmalu po dogodku: delu De diversitate temporum (»O raznolikosti časov«) meniha Alperta iz Metza, Kroniki (Chronicon) merseburškega škofa Thietmarja in kroniki cambraiških škofov. Nekaj luči na Vlaardingen v 11. stoletju mečejo tudi nedavna arheološka odkritja.

source.title: Battle of Vlaardingen
paragraphs: The (First) Battle of Vlaardingen was fought on 29 July 1018 between troops of the Holy Roman Empire and West Frisia (which would later become known as the County of Holland). As a result of a trade dispute, Emperor Henry II sent an army towards West Frisia to subdue the rebellious Count Dirk III. However, the Imperial army was decisively defeated and fled in panic.

Knowledge of the battle is based on three chronicles, written shortly after the date: De diversitate temporum by the monk Alpertus of Metz, the Chronicon of Thietmar, bishop of Merseburg, and in the Cambrai Bishop's Chronicle. Also, recent archaeological discoveries shed some light on Vlaardingen in the 11th century.

Battle of Voronezh (1942).headline: Bitka za Voronež (1942)
paragraphs: Bitka za Voronež ali prva bitka za Voronež je bila bitka na vzhodni fronti druge svetovne vojne, ki je potekala od 28. junija do 24. julija 1942 v strateško pomembnem mestu Voronež ob Donu, 450 km južno od Moskve, in njegovi okolici; bila je uvodna poteza nemške poletne ofenzive leta 1942.
Bitko so zaznamovali hudi mestni in srditi ulični boji, ki so napovedali, kaj se bo zgodilo v bitki za Stalingrad.
notes: The mile conversion is left out.

source.title: Battle of Voronezh (1942)
paragraphs: The Battle of Voronezh, or First Battle of Voronezh, was a battle on the Eastern Front of World War II, fought in and around the strategically important city of Voronezh on the Don river, 450 km (280 mi) south of Moscow, from 28 June to 24 July 1942, as the opening move of the German summer offensive in 1942.
The battle was marked by heavy urban and ferocious street-fighting, showing what was to come at the Battle of Stalingrad.

Battle of Vučji Do.headline: Bitka pri Vučjem Dolu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vučjem Dolu je bila velika bitka črnogorsko-turške vojne 1876–78, ki je potekala 18. julija 1876 pri Vučjem Dolu v Črni gori: združene sile črnogorskih in vzhodnohercegovskih plemen (bataljonov) so se spopadle z osmansko vojsko pod vodstvom velikega vezirja Ahmeda Muhtar-paše. Črnogorsko-hercegovske sile so Osmane hudo porazile in zajele dva njihova poveljnika. Zaplenile so tudi veliko pošiljko orožja.
notes: The war is named as in the glossary (Črnogorsko-turška vojna 1876–78), which shortens the second year.

source.title: Battle of Vučji Do
paragraphs: The Battle of Vučji Do was a major battle of the Montenegrin-Ottoman War of 1876-78 that took place on 18 July 1876 in Vučji Do, Montenegro, fought between the combined forces of Montenegrin and Eastern Herzegovinian tribes (battalions) against the Ottoman Army under Grand Vizier Ahmed Muhtar Pasha. The Montenegrin-Herzegovinian forces heavily defeated the Ottomans, and managed to capture two of their commanders. In addition, they captured a large consignment of armaments.

Prvi večji ruski poskus zavzetja Vugledarja, mesta v Doneški oblasti, je med rusko-ukrajinsko vojno potekal v prvih mesecih leta 2023, potem ko so ruske sile prejšnje leto napredovale po okolici. Ukrajinski poveljniki so te spopade opisali kot »največjo tankovsko bitko« vojne do tedaj. Napad na mesto in okolico ni uspel; Rusi so imeli velike izgube, poveljnik Rustam Muradov, ki je vodil napad, pa je bil odstavljen. Podobno neuspešni manjši poskusi napredovanja pri mestu so se vrstili vse leto 2023 in v prvi polovici leta 2024.

Konec avgusta 2024 se je začel nov obsežen poskus zavzetja Vugledarja. Ruske sile so ob hkratnem napredovanju na južnem, zahodnem in vzhodnem boku mesto do konca septembra skoraj obkolile, hkrati pa naskakovale samo mesto. Vugledar je padel 1. oktobra.
notes: The English opens without a definition sentence; kept as in the source. The town is named in the glossary's form, Vugledar.

source.title: Battle of Vuhledar
paragraphs: During the Russo-Ukrainian war, the first main Russian effort to capture Vuhledar, a city in Donetsk Oblast, took place in the early months of 2023, following an advance through the surrounding area the preceding year. Ukrainian commanders described these clashes as "the largest tank battle" of the war to date. This assault in and around the city failed, with large-scale Russian losses and the dismissal of commander Rustam Muradov, who led the attack. Similarly unsuccessful small-scale attempts at advancing near the city were launched throughout 2023 and the first half of 2024.

In late August 2024, a renewed large-scale effort to capture Vuhledar was launched. Aided by the support of simultaneous advances on the city's southern, western, and eastern flanks, Russian forces near-encircled Vuhledar by late September, while storming the city itself. On 1 October, Vuhledar was captured.

Battle of Wagram.headline: Bitka pri Wagramu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Wagramu (5.–6. julija 1809) je bila vojaški spopad napoleonskih vojn, ki se je končal z drago, a odločilno zmago francoske in zavezniške vojske cesarja Napoleona nad avstrijsko vojsko pod poveljstvom nadvojvode Karla Avstrijsko-Tešinskega. Bitka je privedla do razpada pete koalicije, zavezništva proti Franciji pod vodstvom Avstrije in Britanije. To je bila največja bitka v evropski zgodovini do tedaj.
notes: The German pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Battle of Wagram
paragraphs: The Battle of Wagram ([ˈvaɡram]; 5–6 July 1809) was a military engagement of the Napoleonic Wars that ended in a costly but decisive victory for Emperor Napoleon's French and allied army against the Austrian army under the command of Archduke Charles of Austria-Teschen. The battle led to the breakup of the Fifth Coalition, the Austrian and British-led alliance against France. Wagram was the largest battle in European history up to that time.

Battle of Wakefield.headline: Bitka pri Wakefieldu
paragraphs: »Bitka« pri Wakefieldu naj bi po izročilu potekala 30. decembra 1460 v Sandal Magni blizu Wakefielda na severu Anglije. Novejše raziskave kažejo, da ni šlo za bitko v pravem pomenu besede, temveč za manjšo prasko, v kateri so bili ujeti in so nato umrli Rihard Yorški, 3. vojvoda York, njegov drugi sin Edmund, grof Rutland, in Richard Neville, 5. grof Salisbury.

source.title: Battle of Wakefield
paragraphs: The 'Battle' of Wakefield has traditionally been said to have taken place in Sandal Magna near Wakefield in northern England, on 30 December 1460. Recent research demonstrates that it was not a battle in the proper sense of a word, but a small-scale skirmish that resulted in the capture and subsequent deaths of Richard of York, 3rd Duke of York, his second son, Edmund, Earl of Rutland, and Richard Neville, 5th Earl of Salisbury.

Battle of Warburg.headline: Bitka pri Warburgu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Warburgu je potekala 31. julija 1760 med sedemletno vojno. Bila je zmaga Hannovrčanov in Britancev nad nekoliko večjo francosko vojsko. Z zmago so anglo-nemški zavezniki uspešno ubranili Vestfalijo pred Francozi, saj so preprečili prehod čez reko Diemel, a so morali Francozom prepustiti zavezniško državo Hessen-Kassel na jugu. Trdnjava Kassel je nazadnje padla in ostala v francoskih rokah do zadnjih mesecev vojne, ko so jo anglo-nemški zavezniki konec leta 1762 znova zavzeli.

Britanski general John Manners, markiz Granby, je v bitki zaslovel, ker je jurišal na čelu britanske konjenice in med jurišem izgubil klobuk in lasuljo. Francozi so izgubili 1500 mrtvih in ranjenih, okoli 1500 ujetih in deset topov.

source.title: Battle of Warburg
paragraphs: The Battle of Warburg was fought on 31 July 1760 during the Seven Years' War. The battle was a victory for the Hanoverians and the British against a slightly larger French army. The victory meant the Anglo-German allies had successfully defended Westphalia from the French by preventing a crossing of the Diemel River, but were forced to abandon the allied state of Hesse-Kassel to the south. The fortress of Kassel ultimately fell, and would remain in French hands until the final months of the war, when it was finally recaptured by the Anglo-German allies in late 1762.

The British general, John Manners, Marquess of Granby, became famous in the battle for charging at the head of the British cavalry and losing his hat and wig during the charge. The French lost 1,500 men, killed and wounded, around 1,500 prisoners and ten pieces of artillery.

Battle of Warsaw (1656).headline: Bitka pri Varšavi (1656)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Varšavi (nemško: Schlacht von Warschau; poljsko: Bitwa pod Warszawą; švedsko: Tredagarsslaget vid Warschau) je potekala blizu Varšave od 28. do 30. julija (po starem koledarju 18.–20. julija) 1656 med vojskami Republike obeh narodov ter Švedske in Brandenburga. Bila je velika bitka druge severne vojne med Poljsko in Švedsko v letih 1655–1660, znane tudi kot potop. Po Haju Holbornu je pomenila »začetek pruske vojaške zgodovine«.

V bitki so manjše švedsko-brandenburške sile, ki pa so imele premoč v ognju pehote in topništva, dosegle taktično zmago nad številčno močnejšimi poljsko-litovskimi silami, čeprav zmaga dolgoročno ni prinesla veliko. Poljsko-litovske izgube so bile neznatne, saj so se poljsko-litovske sile, med njimi številna plemiška vojska, z bojišča umaknile v dobrem redu.

source.title: Battle of Warsaw (1656)
paragraphs: The Battle of Warsaw (German: Schlacht von Warschau; Polish: Bitwa pod Warszawą; Swedish: Tredagarsslaget vid Warschau) took place near Warsaw on July 28–July 30 [O.S. July 18–20] 1656, between the armies of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Sweden and Brandenburg. It was a major battle in the Second Northern War between Poland and Sweden in the period 1655–1660, also known as The Deluge. According to Hajo Holborn, it marked "the beginning of Prussian military history".

In the battle, a smaller Swedish-Brandenburg force, but with the fire superiority of infantry and artillery, gained tactical victory over a Polish–Lithuanian force superior in numbers, though in the long term the victory achieved little. Polish–Lithuanian losses were insignificant, since the Polish-Lithuanian forces, including the sizeable noble levy, retreated in good order from the battlefield.

Battle of Warsaw (1705).headline: Bitka pri Varšavi (1705)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Varšavi (znana tudi kot bitka pri Rakowitzu ali Rakowcu) je potekala 31. julija 1705 (po gregorijanskem koledarju) blizu Varšave v Republiki obeh narodov med veliko severno vojno in švedsko invazijo na Poljsko 1701–1706. Bila je del boja za poljsko-litovski prestol med Avgustom II. Močnim in Stanisławom Leszczyńskim ter njunimi zavezniki. Avgust je v veliko severno vojno vstopil kot saški volilni knez in kralj Republike obeh narodov ter sklenil zavezništvo z Dansko-Norveško in Rusijo. Stanisław Leszczyński si je poljski prestol prilastil leta 1704 s podporo švedske vojske kralja Karla XII. Boj za prestol je poljsko plemstvo prisilil, da se je opredelilo: varšavska konfederacija je podprla Leszczyńskega in Švedsko, sandomierska konfederacija pa Avgusta in njegove zaveznike. Spopad je privedel do poljske državljanske vojne 1704–1706.

source.title: Battle of Warsaw (1705)
paragraphs: The Battle of Warsaw (also known as the Battle of Rakowitz or Rakowiec) was fought on 31 July 1705 (Gregorian calendar) near Warsaw in the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, during the Great Northern War and the 1701–1706 Swedish invasion of Poland. The battle was part of a power struggle for the Polish–Lithuanian throne, and was fought between Augustus II the Strong and Stanisław Leszczyński and their allies. Augustus entered the Great Northern War as Elector of Saxony and King of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, and had formed an alliance with Denmark–Norway and Russia. Stanisław Leszczyński had seized the Polish throne in 1704, with the support of the Swedish army of King Charles XII. The struggle for the throne forced the Polish nobility to pick sides; the Warsaw Confederation supported Leszczyński and Sweden, and the Sandomierz Confederation supported Augustus and his allies. The conflict resulted in the Polish civil war of 1704–1706.

Battle of Warsaw (1920).headline: Bitka za Varšavo (1920)
paragraphs: Bitka za Varšavo (poljsko: Bitwa Warszawska; rusko: Варшавская битва), znana tudi kot čudež na Visli (poljsko: Cud nad Wisłą), je bila vrsta bitk, ki so se avgusta 1920 med poljsko-sovjetsko vojno končale z odločilno poljsko zmago in popolnim razpadom Rdeče armade.

Po poljski ofenzivi na Kijev so sovjetske sile poleti 1920 začele uspešen protinapad in poljsko vojsko prisilile k umiku proti zahodu. Poljske sile so bile videti tik pred razpadom in opazovalci so napovedovali odločilno sovjetsko zmago.
notes: The Russian romanization is dropped; the Cyrillic is kept.

source.title: Battle of Warsaw (1920)
paragraphs: The Battle of Warsaw (Polish: Bitwa Warszawska; Russian: Варшавская битва, Varshavskaya bitva), also known as the Miracle on the Vistula (Polish: Cud nad Wisłą), was a series of battles that resulted in a decisive Polish victory and complete disintegration of the Red Army in August 1920 during the Polish–Soviet War.

After the Polish Kiev offensive, Soviet forces launched a successful counterattack in summer 1920, forcing the Polish army to retreat westward. The Polish forces seemed on the verge of disintegration and observers predicted a decisive Soviet victory.

Battle of Wattignies.headline: Bitka pri Wattigniesu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Wattigniesu (15.–16. oktobra 1793) je bila spopad, v katerem je francoska vojska pod poveljstvom Jean-Baptista Jourdana napadla koalicijsko vojsko, ki jo je vodil princ Josias Saško-Coburško-Saalfeldski. Po dveh dneh boja so Jourdanove čete habsburške zaščitne sile pod vodstvom Françoisa Sébastiena Charlesa Josepha de Croixa, grofa Clerfayta, prisilile k umiku. Zmaga v vojni prve koalicije je Francozom omogočila, da so prekinili obleganje Maubeuga. V času, ko so neuspešne generale pogosto usmrtili ali zaprli, je moral Jourdan prenašati vmešavanje Lazara Carnota iz Odbora za javno blaginjo. Vas, ki so jo v čast pomembnemu uspehu preimenovali v Wattignies-la-Victoire, leži 9 kilometrov jugovzhodno od Maubeuga.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Wattignies
paragraphs: The Battle of Wattignies (15–16 October 1793) saw a French army commanded by Jean-Baptiste Jourdan attack a Coalition army directed by Prince Josias of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld. After two days of combat Jourdan's troops compelled the Habsburg covering force led by François Sébastien Charles Joseph de Croix, Count of Clerfayt to withdraw. The War of the First Coalition victory allowed the French to raise the siege of Maubeuge. At a time when failed generals were often executed or imprisoned, Jourdan had to endure interference from Lazare Carnot from the Committee of Public Safety. The village, renamed Wattignies-la-Victoire in honor of the important success, is located 9 kilometres (6 mi) southeast of Maubeuge.

Battle of Wavre.headline: Bitka pri Wavru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Wavru je bila zadnji večji vojaški spopad pohoda stotih dni in napoleonskih vojn. Potekala je 18. in 19. junija 1815 med prusko zaščitnico, ki jo je sestavljal pruski III. korpus pod poveljstvom generala Johanna von Thielmanna (njegov načelnik štaba je bil Carl von Clausewitz), in tremi korpusi francoske vojske pod poveljstvom maršala Grouchyja. Prusi so s tem zapornim bojem 33.000 francoskim vojakom preprečili, da bi prispeli k bitki pri Waterlooju, in tako pripomogli k Napoleonovemu porazu pri Waterlooju.

source.title: Battle of Wavre
paragraphs: The Battle of Wavre was the final major military action of the Hundred Days campaign and the Napoleonic Wars. It was fought on 18–19 June 1815 between the Prussian rearguard, consisting of the Prussian III Corps under the command of General Johann von Thielmann (whose chief-of-staff was Carl von Clausewitz) and three corps of the French army under the command of Marshal Grouchy. A blocking action, this battle kept 33,000 French soldiers from reaching the Battle of Waterloo and so helped in the defeat of Napoleon at Waterloo.

Battle of Werben.headline: Bitka pri Werbnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Werbnu je potekala med tridesetletno vojno 7. avgusta 1631 (po novem koledarju) med Švedskim imperijem in Svetim rimskim cesarstvom. Švedi so imeli 15.100 vojakov pod vodstvom Gustava II. Adolfa, cesarski pa 16.200 vojakov pod vodstvom feldmaršala grofa Tillyja. Tillyjeve čete so napadle Gustavove okope pred Werbnom (ob Labi), a so jih švedske baterije in konjenica pod vodstvom Wolfa Heinricha von Baudissina prisilile k umiku; cesarski so izgubili 6000 mož, Švedi pa 200.

source.title: Battle of Werben
paragraphs: The Battle of Werben took place during the Thirty Years' War on 7 August 1631 (N.S.), between the Swedish Empire and the Holy Roman Empire. The Swedes had 15,100 soldiers and were led by Gustavus Adolphus, while the Imperialists had 16,200 soldiers and were led by Field-Marshal Count Tilly. Tilly's troops attacked Gustavus' entrenchments in front of Werben (Elbe), but Swedish batteries and the cavalry under Wolf Heinrich von Baudissin forced them to retreat, at the cost of 6,000 Imperials and 200 Swedes.

Battle of Westerplatte.headline: Bitka za Westerplatte
paragraphs: Bitka za Westerplatte je bila prva bitka nemške invazije na Poljsko, s katero se je začela druga svetovna vojna v Evropi. Potekala je na polotoku Westerplatte v pristanišču Svobodnega mesta Gdansk (Danzig; danes Gdańsk na Poljskem). Westerplatte, majhen gozdnat otok, ki ga od Gdanska loči pristaniški kanal, je bil v medvojnem obdobju poljska vojaška postojanka.

Sredi 1920. let je druga poljska republika na polotoku Westerplatte v Svobodnem mestu Gdansk ustanovila poljsko vojaško tranzitno skladišče (Wojskowa Składnica Tranzytowa, WST). Od 1. septembra 1939 sta skladišče napadala nemški Wehrmacht in gdanska policija. Čeprav sta obe strani sprva ocenjevali, da bo poljska posadka zdržala nekaj ur, preden jo okrepijo ali strejo, so Poljaki zdržali sedem dni in odbili trinajst napadov, med njimi napade strmoglavcev in obstreljevanje z morja.

source.title: Battle of Westerplatte
paragraphs: The Battle of Westerplatte was the first battle of the German invasion of Poland, marking the start of World War II in Europe. It occurred on the Westerplatte peninsula in the harbour of the Free City of Danzig (now Gdańsk, Poland). A small forested island separated from Gdansk by the harbour channel, Westerplatte was established as a Polish military outpost during the interwar period.

In the mid-1920s, the Second Polish Republic established the Polish Military Transit Depot (Wojskowa Składnica Tranzytowa, WST) on the Westerplatte peninsula in the Free City of Danzig. Beginning on 1 September 1939, the German Wehrmacht and Danzig Police assaulted the WST. Despite initial assessment on both sides that the Polish garrison might hold out for several hours before being reinforced or overwhelmed, the Poles held out for seven days and repelled thirteen assaults that included dive-bomber attacks and naval shelling.
Bitka pri Wimpfnu je potekala v obdobju pfalškega pohoda tridesetletne vojne 6. maja 1622 blizu Wimpfna.
Združene sile katoliške lige in Španskega imperija pod vodstvom maršala Tillyja in Gonzala de Córdobe so premagale protestantske sile badenskega mejnega grofa Georga Friedricha.
notes: The glossary had a typo (Bitka pri Wipfnu); an override now gives Bitka pri Wimpfnu.

source.title: Battle of Wimpfen
paragraphs: The Battle of Wimpfen took place during the Palatinate campaign period of the Thirty Years' War on 6 May 1622 near Wimpfen.
The combined forces of the Catholic League and the Spanish Empire under Marshal Tilly and Gonzalo de Córdoba defeated the Protestant forces of Georg Friedrich, Margrave of Baden.

Battle of Winchelsea.headline: Bitka pri Winchelseaju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Winchelseaju ali bitka Les Espagnols sur Mer (»Španci na morju«) je bila pomorska bitka 29. avgusta 1350 v stoletni vojni med Anglijo in Francijo. Angleško ladjevje s 50 ladjami pod poveljstvom kralja Edvarda III. je v njej premagalo kastiljsko ladjevje s 47 večjimi ladjami pod poveljstvom Charlesa de la Cerde. Angleži so zajeli med 14 in 26 kastiljskih ladij, več so jih potopili. Znano je, da sta bili potopljeni le dve angleški ladji, vendar je umrlo veliko ljudi.

Angleška trgovina, financiranje vojne in zmožnost bojevanja proti Franciji so bili močno odvisni od pomorskega prevoza, zlasti na angleško ozemlje v Gaskonji. Ker so angleške akcije močno zmanjšale lastno zmožnost Francozov, da zberejo in vzdržujejo ladjevje, so ti najeli kastiljske ladje, da bi blokirale angleška pristanišča. Edvard III., razočaran nad njihovo učinkovitostjo, je vodil ladjevje, ki jih je prestreglo in jim prizadejalo hude izgube. Kljub temu uspehu so francosko ladjevje in njegovi zavezniki angleško trgovino in pristanišča še naprej nadlegovali skoraj nezmanjšano.

source.title: Battle of Winchelsea
paragraphs: The Battle of Winchelsea or the Battle of Les Espagnols sur Mer ("the Spaniards on the Sea") was a naval battle that took place on 29 August 1350 as part of the Hundred Years' War between England and France. It was a victory for an English fleet of 50 ships, commanded by King Edward III, over a Castilian fleet of 47 larger vessels, commanded by Charles de la Cerda. Between 14 and 26 Castilian ships were captured, and several were sunk. Only two English vessels are known to have been sunk, but there was a significant loss of life.

England's trade, its war finance and its ability to bring force to bear against France were heavily reliant on seaborne transportation, especially to its territory in Gascony. With their own ability to raise and support a fleet much reduced by English activities, the French hired Castilian ships to blockade English ports. Frustrated by their effectiveness, Edward III led the fleet that intercepted them and inflicted heavy losses. In spite of that success, English trade and ports saw little relief from naval harassment by the French and their allies.

Battle of Winterthur.headline: Bitka pri Winterthurju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Winterthurju (27. maja 1799) je bila pomemben spopad med deli Donavske armade in deli habsburške vojske pod poveljstvom Friedricha barona von Hotzeja med vojno druge koalicije, delom francoskih revolucionarnih vojn. Mestece Winterthur leži 18 kilometrov severovzhodno od Züricha v Švici. Ker leži na križišču sedmih cest, je vojska, ki je držala mesto, nadzorovala dostop do večjega dela Švice in prehode čez Ren v južno Nemčijo. Čeprav so bile udeležene sile majhne, je avstrijski 11-urni napad na francosko črto omogočil, da so se tri avstrijske sile zbrale na planoti severno od Züricha, kar je nekaj dni pozneje privedlo do francoskega poraza.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Winterthur
paragraphs: The Battle of Winterthur (27 May 1799) was an important action between elements of the Army of the Danube and elements of the Habsburg army, commanded by Friedrich Freiherr von Hotze, during the War of the Second Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. The small town of Winterthur lies 18 kilometers (11 mi) northeast of Zürich, in Switzerland. Because of its position at the junction of seven roads, the army that held the town controlled access to most of Switzerland and points crossing the Rhine into southern Germany. Although the forces involved were small, the ability of the Austrians to sustain their 11-hour assault on the French line resulted in the consolidation of three Austrian forces on the plateau north of Zürich, leading to the French defeat a few days later.

Bitka pri Wissembourgu ali bitka pri Weissenburgu, prva bitka francosko-pruske vojne, se je začela, ko so trije nemški armadni korpusi 4. avgusta 1870 presenetili majhno francosko posadko v Wissembourgu. Močno številčno šibkejši branilci so se trdovratno borili: »zlasti če upoštevamo, da so bili presenečeni in v veliki manjšini, so Francozi ohranili stari sloves bojevnikov in prvi poraz, čeprav hud, vojakom 1. korpusa ni bil v sramoto.« Padec Wissembourga je pruski vojski omogočil prodor v Francijo in maršala Patricea MacMahona prisilil, da se je 6. avgusta spustil v bitko pri Wörthu, v kateri je bil poražen.
notes: The glossary had a typo (Bitka pri Wssembourgu); an override in src/i18n/names/sl.json corrects it to Bitka pri Wissembourgu.

source.title: Battle of Wissembourg (1870)
paragraphs: The Battle of Wissembourg or Battle of Weissenburg, the first of the Franco-Prussian War, was joined when three German army corps surprised the small French garrison at Wissembourg on 4 August 1870. The defenders, greatly outnumbered, fought stubbornly "especially considering they were surprised and greatly outnumbered, that the French sustained their old renown as fighting men and that the first defeat, although severe, reflected no discredit on the soldiers of the 1st Corps." The fall of Wissembourg allowed the Prussian army to move into France and compelled Marshal Patrice MacMahon to give battle, and suffer defeat, at the Battle of Wörth on 6 August.

Battle of Wittstock.headline: Bitka pri Wittstocku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Wittstocku je potekala 4. oktobra 1636 blizu Wittstocka v severni Nemčiji med tridesetletno vojno. Švedska vojska pod skupnim poveljstvom Johana Banérja in Alexandra Leslieja je odločilno zmagala nad združeno cesarsko-saško vojsko pod vodstvom grofa Melchiorja von Hatzfelda in saškega volilnega kneza Ivana Jurija I.

source.title: Battle of Wittstock
paragraphs: The Battle of Wittstock was fought on 4 October 1636, near Wittstock in northern Germany, during the Thirty Years' War. A Swedish army commanded jointly by Johan Banér and Alexander Leslie won a decisive victory against a combined Imperial–Saxon army, led by Count Melchior von Hatzfeld and John George I, Elector of Saxony.

Battle of Wizna.headline: Bitka pri Wizni
paragraphs: Bitka pri Wizni (poljsko: Obrona Wizny) je potekala med 7. in 10. septembrom 1939; poljske in nemške sile so se v njej spopadle v začetni fazi invazije na Poljsko, s katero se je začela druga svetovna vojna v Evropi. Po poljskem zgodovinarju Leszku Moczulskem je med 350 in 720 Poljakov tri dni branilo utrjeno črto pred več kot 40.000 Nemci. Čeprav je bil poraz neizogiben, je poljska obramba napadalce zadržala tri dni in odložila obkolitev bližnje samostojne operativne skupine Narew. Nazadnje so tanki prebili poljsko črto, nemški inženirci pa so drugo za drugim uničili vsa zaklonišča. Zadnje zaklonišče se je predalo okoli poldneva 10. septembra.

source.title: Battle of Wizna
paragraphs: The Battle of Wizna (Polish: Obrona Wizny) was fought between September 7 and September 10, 1939, between the forces of Poland and Germany during the initial stages of the invasion of Poland, which marked the beginning of the Second World War in Europe. According to Polish historian Leszek Moczulski, between 350 and 720 Poles defended a fortified line for three days against more than 40,000 Germans. Although defeat was inevitable, the Polish defence stalled the attacking forces for three days and postponed the encirclement of Independent Operational Group Narew fighting nearby. Eventually the tanks broke through the Polish line and German engineers eliminated all the shelters one by one. The last shelter surrendered around midday on September 10.

Battle of Worcester.headline: Bitka pri Worcestru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Worcestru je potekala 3. septembra 1651 v mestu Worcester v Angliji in okolici in je bila zadnja velika bitka vojn treh kraljestev v letih 1642–1651. Parlamentarna vojska s približno 28.000 možmi pod Oliverjem Cromwellom je premagala pretežno škotske rojalistične sile s 16.000 možmi pod vodstvom Karla II., kralja Anglije in Škotske.

Rojalisti so zavzeli obrambne položaje v Worcestru in okolici. Bojišče je delila reka Severn, reka Teme pa je bila dodatna ovira jugozahodno od Worcestra. Cromwell je vojsko razdelil na dva glavna dela, ločena s Severnom, da bi napadel z vzhoda in jugozahoda. Pri rečnih prehodih so potekali hudi boji, dva nevarna izpada rojalistov proti vzhodnim parlamentarnim silam pa so odbili. Ko so parlamentarci naskočili veliko reduto vzhodno od mesta, so vstopili v Worcester in organizirani odpor rojalistov je propadel. Karel II. se je izognil ujetju.

source.title: Battle of Worcester
paragraphs: The Battle of Worcester took place on 3 September 1651 in and around the city of Worcester, England and was the last major battle of the 1642 to 1651 Wars of the Three Kingdoms. A Parliamentarian army of around 28,000 under Oliver Cromwell defeated a largely Scottish Royalist force of 16,000 led by Charles II of England and Scotland.

The Royalists took up defensive positions in and around the city of Worcester. The area of the battle was bisected by the River Severn, with the River Teme forming an additional obstacle to the south-west of Worcester. Cromwell divided his army into two main sections, divided by the Severn, in order to attack from both the east and south-west. There was fierce fighting at river crossing points and two dangerous sorties by the Royalists against the eastern Parliamentary force were beaten back. Following the storming of a major redoubt to the east of the city, the Parliamentarians entered Worcester and organised Royalist resistance collapsed. Charles II was able to escape capture.

Battle of Wörth.headline: Bitka pri Wörthu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Wörthu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Reichshoffnu ali bitka pri Frœschwillerju, je druga bitka pri Wörthu, ki je potekala 6. avgusta 1870 v začetni fazi francosko-pruske vojne (prva bitka pri Wörthu je potekala 23. decembra 1793 med francoskimi revolucionarnimi vojnami). V drugi bitki so nemške čete pod poveljstvom prestolonaslednika Friderika Viljema, ki jih je usmerjal njegov načelnik štaba general Leonhard grof von Blumenthal, premagale Francoze pod poveljstvom maršala MacMahona blizu vasi Wœrth v Alzaciji ob reki Sauer, 10 kilometrov severno od Haguenauja.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Battle of Wörth
paragraphs: The Battle of Wörth, also known as the Battle of Reichshoffen or as the Battle of Frœschwiller, refers to the second battle of Wörth, which took place on 6 August 1870 in the opening stages of the Franco-Prussian War (the first Battle of Wörth occurred on 23 December 1793 during the French Revolutionary Wars). In the second battle, troops from Germany commanded by Crown Prince Frederick William and directed by his chief of staff, General Leonhard Graf von Blumenthal, defeated the French under Marshal MacMahon near the village of Wœrth in Alsace, on the Sauer River, 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) north of Haguenau.

Battle of Yenidje.headline: Bitka pri Jenidžeju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jenidžeju, prečrkovano tudi Yenice (grško: Μάχη των Γιαννιτσών, bitka pri Janici), je bila velika bitka med grškimi silami pod vodstvom prestolonaslednika Konstantina in osmanskimi silami pod vodstvom generala Hasana Tahsin-paše, ki je potekala od 19. do 20. oktobra (po starem koledarju) 1912 v prvi balkanski vojni. Začela se je, ko je grška vojska napadla utrjeni osmanski položaj pri Jenidžeju (danes Janica v Grčiji), zadnjo obrambno črto pred Solunom.

Razgiban in močviren teren okoli Jenidžeja je močno oviral napredovanje grške vojske, zlasti topništva. Zgodaj zjutraj 20. oktobra je naskok grškega 9. evzonskega bataljona grški vojski dal zagon in povzročil zlom celotnega zahodnega krila Osmanov. Osmanska morala je strmoglavila in glavnina branilcev je dve uri pozneje začela bežati. Grška zmaga pri Jenidžeju je odprla pot do zavzetja Soluna in predaje njegove posadke ter pomagala oblikovati sodobni zemljevid Grčije.

source.title: Battle of Yenidje
paragraphs: The Battle of Yenidje, also transliterated as Yenice (Greek: Μάχη των Γιαννιτσών, Battle of Giannitsa), was a major battle between Greek forces under Crown Prince Constantine and Ottoman forces under General Hasan Tahsin Pasha and took place between October 19–20 (O.S.), 1912 during the First Balkan War. The battle began when the Greek army attacked the Ottoman fortified position at Yenidje (now Giannitsa, Greece), which was the last line of defense for the city of Thessaloniki.

The rough and swampy terrain surrounding Yenidje significantly complicated the advance of the Greek army, most notably its artillery. In the early morning of 20 October, an infantry charge by the Greek 9th Evzone Battalion caused the Greek army to gain momentum, leading to the collapse of the entire western wing of the Ottomans. Ottoman morale plunged and the bulk of the defenders began fleeing two hours later. The Greek victory at Yenidje opened the way for the capture of Thessaloniki and the surrender of its garrison, helping shape the modern map of Greece.

Battle of Zborov (1917).headline: Bitka pri Zborovu (1917)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Zborovu (ukrajinsko: Зборівська битва; rusko: Зборовское сражение; nemško: Schlacht bei Zborów; češko: bitva u Zborova; slovaško: bitka pri Zborove) je bila del Kerenskijeve ofenzive (zadnje ruske ofenzive v prvi svetovni vojni julija 1917). Bila je prvi pomembnejši boj češkoslovaških legij (prostovoljcev, ki so se bojevali proti centralnim silam) na vzhodni fronti.

source.title: Battle of Zborov (1917)
paragraphs: The Battle of Zborov (Зборівська битва, Zborivska bytva in Ukrainian, Зборовское сражение in Russian, Schlacht bei Zborów in German, bitva u Zborova in Czech, bitka pri Zborove in Slovak) was a part of the Kerensky Offensive (the last Russian offensive in World War I, taking place in July 1917). The battle was the first significant action of the Czechoslovak Legions (volunteers fighting against the Central Powers) on the Eastern Front.

Battle of Zhovti Vody.headline: Bitka pri Žovtih Vodah
paragraphs: Bitka pri Žovtih Vodah ali Rumenih vodah (ukrajinsko: Битва під Жовтими Водами; poljsko: Bitwa pod Żołtymi Wodami; 29. aprila – 16. maja 1648) je bila prva pomembna bitka vstaje Hmelnickega. Blizu današnjega mesta Žovti Vodi ob reki Žovti v Ukrajini so sile Zaporoške vojske in Krimskega kanata pod poveljstvom hetmana Bohdana Hmelnickega, polkovnikov Mihajla Kričevskega, Maksima Krivonosa in Filona Džalalija ter Tugaj-beja napadle in premagale sile Poljsko-litovske republike pod poveljstvom hetmana Stefana Potockega in generala Stefana Czarnieckega; oba so v bitki ujeli zaporoški kozaki in krimski Tatari.

source.title: Battle of Zhovti Vody
paragraphs: The Battle of Zhovti Vody or Yellow Waters (Ukrainian: Битва під Жовтими Водами; Polish: Bitwa pod Żołtymi Wodami; 29 April — 16 May 1648) was the first significant battle of the Khmelnytsky Uprising. Near the site of the present-day city of Zhovti Vody on the Zhovta River in Ukraine, the forces of the Zaporozhian Host and Crimean Khanate under the command of Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky, Colonels Mykhailo Krychevsky, Maksym Kryvonis, and Fylon Dzhalaliy with Tugay Bey attacked and defeated the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth's forces under the command of Hetman Stefan Potocki and General Stefan Czarniecki, both of them were captured in the battle by the Zaporozhian Cossacks and Crimean Tatars.

Bitka pri Zieleńcu je bila bitka poljsko-ruske vojne leta 1792 v obrambo poljske ustave 3. maja 1791. Potekala je 18. junija 1792 med vojsko Poljsko-litovske republike Józefa Poniatowskega in skupino ruske cesarske vojske pod poveljstvom generala Iraklija Morkova, ki je bila del ruskih sil generala Mihaila Krečetnikova, ki so z juga vdirale v Poljsko-litovsko republiko. Končala se je s poljsko zmago, saj so ruski napad odbili, čeprav so se Poljaki kmalu umaknili z bojišča.

source.title: Battle of Zieleńce
paragraphs: The Battle of Zieleńce was a battle in the Polish–Russian War of 1792, in defence of the Polish Constitution of 3 May 1791. The battle took place on 18 June 1792, between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth Army of Józef Poniatowski and an Imperial Russian Army group under the command of General Irakly Morkov, which was a part of General Mikhail Krechetnikov's Russian forces invading the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth from the south. The battle ended in Polish victory, as the Russian assault was repulsed, although the Poles soon withdrew from the battlefield.

Battle of Zonchio.headline: Bitka pri Zonchiu
paragraphs: Pomorska bitka pri Zonchiu (turško: Sapienza Deniz Muharebesi; znana tudi kot bitka pri Sapienzi ali prva bitka pri Lepantu) je potekala v štirih ločenih dneh: 12., 20., 22. in 25. avgusta 1499. Bila je del osmansko-beneške vojne 1499–1503.

Benečani so med njo skušali prestreči osmansko ladjevje, ki je plulo osvojit Lepanto, a jih je oviralo slabo usklajevanje in z Osmani se večkrat niso uspeli spopasti. Ker jim prodiranja ni uspelo zaustaviti, je Lepanto kmalu zatem padel. Osmani so se z zmago uveljavili kot resna pomorska sila v Sredozemlju, med vojno pa so sledili še podobni uspehi.

source.title: Battle of Zonchio
paragraphs: The naval Battle of Zonchio (Turkish: Sapienza Deniz Muharebesi, also known as the Battle of Sapienza or the First Battle of Lepanto) took place on four separate days: 12, 20, 22, and 25 August 1499. It was a part of the Ottoman–Venetian War of 1499–1503.

During its course, the Venetians attempted to intercept an Ottoman fleet en route to conquer Lepanto, but were hampered by miscoordination and repeatedly failed to engage the Ottomans. With their failure at checking their advance, Lepanto fell shortly after. The Ottomans emerged as a serious naval force in the Mediterranean with their victory, followed by a series of similar successes during the war.

Bitka pri Zorndorfu je potekala v sedemletni vojni 25. avgusta 1758 med ruskimi četami pod poveljstvom grofa Williama Fermorja in prusko vojsko pod poveljstvom kralja Friderika Velikega. Taktično je bila neodločena: obe vojski sta obdržali položaje in si pripisali zmago. Bojišče je bilo pri pruski vasi Zorndorf (danes Sarbinowo na Poljskem). Med bitko je Friderik, kot je znano, sam zgrabil polkovni prapor in vodil napad ter tako zbral svoje čete.

source.title: Battle of Zorndorf
paragraphs: The Battle of Zorndorf, during the Seven Years' War, was fought on 25 August 1758 between Russian troops commanded by Count William Fermor and a Prussian army commanded by King Frederick the Great. The battle was tactically inconclusive, with both armies holding their ground and claiming victory. The site of the battle was the Prussian village of Zorndorf (now Sarbinowo, Poland). During the battle, Frederick famously took a regimental standard and led an attack himself, rallying his troops.

Battle of Zusmarshausen.headline: Bitka pri Zusmarshausnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Zusmarshausnu je potekala 17. maja 1648 med bavarsko-cesarskimi silami pod vodstvom von Holzappla in zavezniško francosko-švedsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Carla Gustafa Wrangla in Turenna v današnjem okrožju Augsburg na Bavarskem v Nemčiji. Zavezniške sile so zmagale, cesarsko vojsko pa je pred uničenjem rešil le trdovratni boj zaščitnice Raimonda Montecuccolija in njegove konjenice.
To je bila zadnja večja bitka tridesetletne vojne na nemških tleh in tudi največja bitka (po številu udeležencev; izgube so bile razmeroma majhne) v zadnjih treh letih vojne.

source.title: Battle of Zusmarshausen
paragraphs: The Battle of Zusmarshausen was fought on 17 May 1648 between Bavarian-Imperial forces under von Holzappel and an allied Franco-Swedish army under the command of Carl Gustaf Wrangel and Turenne in the modern Augsburg district of Bavaria, Germany. The allied force emerged victorious, and the Imperial army was only rescued from annihilation by the stubborn rearguard fighting of Raimondo Montecuccoli and his cavalry.

Zusmarshausen was the last major battle of the war to be fought on German soil during the Thirty Years' War, and was also the largest battle (in terms of numbers of men involved; casualties were relatively light) to take place in the final three years of the war.

Battle of Zutphen.headline: Bitka pri Zutphnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Zutphnu je potekala 22. septembra 1586 blizu vasi Warnsveld in mesta Zutphen na Nizozemskem med osemdesetletno vojno in angleško-špansko vojno (1585–1604). Sile Združenih provinc Nizozemske, ki so jim pomagali Angleži, so se spopadle s Španci. Leta 1585 je Anglija z generalnimi stanovi Nizozemske podpisala pogodbo iz Nonsucha in formalno vstopila v vojno proti Španiji. Robert Dudley, grof Leicestra, je bil imenovan za generalnega guvernerja Nizozemske in tja poslan kot poveljnik angleške vojske v podporo nizozemskim upornikom. Ko je Alessandro Farnese, parmski vojvoda in poveljnik španske flandrijske armade, med kölnsko vojno oblegal mesto Rheinberg, je Leicester sam oblegal mesto Zutphen v provinci Gelderland na vzhodnem bregu reke IJssel.

source.title: Battle of Zutphen
paragraphs: The Battle of Zutphen was fought on 22 September 1586, near the village of Warnsveld and the town of Zutphen, the Netherlands, during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). It was fought between the forces of the United Provinces of the Netherlands, aided by the English, against the Spanish. In 1585, England signed the Treaty of Nonsuch with the States-General of the Netherlands and formally entered the war against Spain. Robert Dudley, Earl of Leicester, was appointed as the Governor-General of the Netherlands and sent there in command of an English army to support the Dutch rebels. When Alessandro Farnese, Duke of Parma and commander of the Spanish Army of Flanders, besieged the town of Rheinberg during the Cologne War, Leicester, in turn, besieged the town of Zutphen, in the province of Gelderland and on the eastern bank of the river IJssel.

Battle on the Elster.headline: Bitka ob Elstri
paragraphs: Bitka ob Elstri (nemško: Schlacht bei Hohenmölsen) je bila tretja in zadnja bitka med salijskim nemškim kraljem Henrikom IV. in protikraljem Rudolfom Rheinfeldenskim; potekala je 14. oktobra 1080 blizu Hohenmölsna ob Beli Elstri. Rudolfove sile so zmagale, a je bil sam smrtno ranjen in je naslednji dan umrl.

source.title: Battle on the Elster
paragraphs: Battle on the Elster (German: Schlacht bei Hohenmölsen) was the third and last battle between the Salian king Henry IV of Germany and anti-king Rudolf of Rheinfelden, fought on October 14, 1080 near Hohenmölsen on the White Elster river. Rudolf's forces were victorious; however, he was mortally wounded and succumbed to his injuries the next day.

Battle on the Irpin River.headline: Bitka ob reki Irpin
paragraphs: Bitka ob reki Irpin je bila napol legendarna bitka med vojskama Velike kneževine Litve in Kijevske kneževine. Po izročilu je litovski veliki knez Gedimin osvojil Volinijo, preden se je obrnil proti Kijevu. Nasproti mu je stopil kijevski knez Stanislav, zaveznik Kneževine Perejaslavl in Brjanska. Litovci so dosegli veliko zmago in razširili svoj vpliv na Kijev. Sodobnih virov, ki bi bitko potrjevali, ni. Znana je le iz poznih in na splošno nezanesljivih litovskih kronik. Zgodovinarji se zato ne strinjajo, ali je šlo za resnično bitko v začetku 1320. let ali za zgodbo, ki so si jo izmislili poznejši pisarji. Litovci so mesto popolnoma obvladali šele leta 1362 po bitki pri Modrih vodah proti Zlati hordi.

source.title: Battle on the Irpin River
paragraphs: The Battle on the Irpin River was a semi-legendary battle between the armies of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and Principality of Kiev. According to the story, Gediminas, the Grand Duke of Lithuania, conquered Volhynia before turning his attention to Kiev. He was opposed by Prince Stanislav of Kiev allied with the Principality of Pereyaslavl and Bryansk. Lithuanians achieved a great victory and extended their influence to Kiev. There are no contemporary sources attesting to the battle. It is known only from late and generally unreliable Lithuanian Chronicles. Therefore, historians disagree whether it was an actual battle in the early 1320s or a fictional story invented by later scribes. Lithuanians gained full control of the city only in 1362 after the Battle of Blue Waters against the Golden Horde.

Bitki pri Barfleurju in La Hougueju sta potekali med devetletno vojno med 19. majem po starem (29. majem po novem koledarju) in 4. junijem po starem (14. junijem po novem koledarju) 1692. Prva je potekala blizu Barfleurja 19. maja po starem (29. maja po novem koledarju), poznejši spopadi pa med 20. majem po starem (30. majem po novem koledarju) in 4. junijem po starem (14. junijem po novem koledarju) pri Cherbourgu in Saint-Vaast-la-Hougueju v Normandiji v Franciji.

Francoski poskus, da bi Jakoba II. vrnili na angleški prestol – viljemovska vojna na Irskem –, se je oktobra 1691 končal s porazom. Namesto tega naj bi flota 44 linijskih ladij pod poveljstvom admirala de Tourvilla prepeljala invazijske sile pod poveljstvom Bernardina Gigaulta de Bellefondsa. Anglo-nizozemske ladje so prezimovale v ločenih pristaniščih, Tourville pa je dobil ukaz, naj čim prej izpluje, da bi jih prestregel, preden se združijo. Ko je konec maja nazadnje izplul, sta se obe floti pod poveljstvom admirala Edwarda Russella že združili in sta skupaj šteli 82 ladij, ko sta pred rtom Barfleur naleteli na Francoze.

source.title: Battles of Barfleur and La Hougue
paragraphs: The Battles of Barfleur and La Hougue took place during the Nine Years' War, between 19 May O.S. (29 May N.S.) and 4 June O.S. (14 June N.S.) 1692. The first was fought near Barfleur on 19 May O.S. (29 May N.S.), with later actions occurring between 20 May O.S. (30 May N.S.) and 4 June O.S. (14 June N.S.) at Cherbourg and Saint-Vaast-la-Hougue in Normandy, France.

The French attempt to restore James II to the English throne—the Williamite War in Ireland—ended in defeat in October 1691. Instead, a fleet of 44 ships of the line under Admiral de Tourville was to transport an invasion force commanded by Bernardin Gigault de Bellefonds. The Anglo-Dutch ships wintered in separate ports, and Tourville was ordered to put to sea as early as possible, hoping to intercept them before they could combine. However, when he finally did so in late May, the two fleets under Admiral Edward Russell had already met up and were 82 strong when they encountered the French off Cape Barfleur.

Battles of El Bruch.headline: Bitki pri El Brucu
paragraphs: Bitki pri El Brucu (špansko: Batallas del Bruch; katalonsko: Batalles del Bruc) sta bili spopada, ki sta si sledila 6. in 14. junija 1808 pri El Brucu blizu Barcelone v Kataloniji med polotoško vojno; francoske enote pod poveljstvom brigadnega generala Françoisa de Schwarza in divizijskega generala Josepha Chabrana so se bojevale proti španskim prostovoljcem in najemnikom pod vodstvom generala Antonija Francha i Estalelle in Joana Bageta.
Izid teh bitk in spopadov je bila španska zmaga.

source.title: Battles of El Bruch
paragraphs: The two battles of the Bruch (Spanish: Batallas del Bruch; Catalan: Batalles del Bruc) were engagements fought successively, at El Bruc, near Barcelona, Catalonia, on 6 and 14 June 1808, during the Peninsular War, by French troops commanded by Brigadier General François de Schwarz and General of Division Joseph Chabran against Spanish volunteers and mercenaries led by General Antoni Franch i Estalella and Joan Baget.
The result of these battles and actions was a Spanish victory.

Battles of Kroton.headline: Bitki pri Krotonu
paragraphs: Bitki pri Krotonu (Crotone) v letih 204 in 203 pr. n. št. sta bili poleg plenilnega pohoda v Cisalpinski Galiji zadnja večja spopada med Rimljani in Kartažani v Italiji med drugo punsko vojno. Po Hanibalovem umiku v Brutij zaradi poraza na Metavru so Rimljani nenehno poskušali preprečiti, da bi njegove sile dosegle Jonsko morje, in prekiniti njegov morebitni pobeg v Kartagino, in sicer z zavzetjem Krotona, zadnjega pristanišča, ki je ostalo v njegovih rokah po letih bojev.

source.title: Battles of Kroton
paragraphs: The Battles of Kroton or Crotone in 204 and 203 BC were, as well as the raid in Cisalpine Gaul, the last larger scale engagements between the Romans and the Carthaginians in Italy during the Second Punic War. After Hannibal’s retreat to Bruttium due to the Metaurus debacle, the Romans continuously tried to block his forces from gaining access to the Ionian Sea and cut his eventual escape to Carthage by capturing Kroton, the last port which had remained in his hands after years of fighting.

Bitke pri Rževu (rusko: Ржевская битва) so bile vrsta ofenziv Rdeče armade proti Wehrmachtu med 8. januarjem 1942 in 31. marcem 1943 na vzhodni fronti druge svetovne vojne. Potekale so na severovzhodu Smolenske oblasti in na jugu Tverske oblasti, v izbočenju okoli Rževa in njegovi okolici. Zaradi velikih izgub Rdeče armade so veterani in zgodovinarji kampanjo poimenovali »rževski mlinček za meso« (rusko: Ржевская мясорубка).

source.title: Battles of Rzhev
paragraphs: The Battles of Rzhev (Russian: Ржевская битва, romanized: Rzhevskaya bitva) were a series of Red Army offensives against the Wehrmacht between 8 January 1942 and 31 March 1943, on the Eastern Front of World War II. The battles took place in the northeast of Smolensk Oblast and the south of Tver Oblast, in and around the salient surrounding Rzhev. Due to the high losses suffered by the Red Army, the campaign became known by veterans and historians as the "Rzhev Meat Grinder" (Russian: Ржевская мясорубка, romanized: Rzhevskaya myasorubka).

Bavarci so etnografska skupina Nemcev, ki izvira iz Bavarske, zvezne dežele v Nemčiji. Njihovo narečje ali jezik se imenuje bavarščina in izvira iz Stare Bavarske (Altbayern), ki približno ustreza ozemlju zgodovinske Bavarske volilne kneževine v 17. stoletju.
Tako kot sosednji Avstrijci so Bavarci tradicionalno katoličani. V velikem delu Stare Bavarske je v Katoliško cerkev še vedno včlanjenih več kot 70 % prebivalcev.

Desnosredinska Krščansko-socialna unija na Bavarskem (naslednica Bavarske ljudske stranke iz let 1919–1933) je tradicionalno najmočnejša stranka v deželnem zboru, iz nje pa so od leta 1946 izhajali vsi bavarski ministrski predsedniki z edino izjemo Wilhelma Hoegnerja (1954–1957).
notes: The English breaks one sentence across paragraphs 2 and 3 ("… above 70%," / "and the center-right …"); the Slovenian ends paragraph 2 with a full stop and starts paragraph 3 as a new sentence.

source.title: Bavarians
paragraphs: Bavarians are an ethnographic group of Germans native to Bavaria, a state in Germany. The group's dialect or language is known as Bavarian, native to Altbayern ("Old Bavaria"), roughly the territory of the historic Electorate of Bavaria in the 17th century.
Like the neighboring Austrians, Bavarians are traditionally Catholic. In much of Altbayern, membership in the Catholic Church remains above 70%,

and the center-right Christian Social Union in Bavaria (successor of the Bavarian People's Party of 1919–1933) has traditionally been the strongest party in the Landtag, and also the party of all minister-presidents of Bavaria since 1946, with the single exception of Wilhelm Hoegner, 1954–1957.

Béarn.headline: Béarn
paragraphs: Béarn (okcitansko: Bearn ali Biarn; baskovsko: Bearno ali Biarno; latinsko: Benearnia ali Bearnia) je ena od tradicionalnih francoskih provinc v Pirenejih in na ravnini ob njihovem vznožju na jugozahodu Francije. Skupaj s tremi baskovskimi provincami Soule, Spodnja Navara in Labourd, kneževino Bidache in majhnimi deli Gaskonje tvori današnji departma Pyrénées-Atlantiques. Prestolnice Béarna so bile zaporedoma Beneharnum (do leta 841), Morlaàs (od ok. 1100), Orthez (od druge polovice 13. stoletja) in nato Pau (od sredine 15. stoletja).
Béarn na zahodu meji na baskovski provinci Soule in Spodnja Navara, na severu na Gaskonjo (Landes in Armagnac), na vzhodu na Bigorre, na jugu pa na Španijo (Aragonijo).
notes: The pronunciation guides are dropped.

source.title: Béarn
paragraphs: Béarn (US:; French: [beaʁn]; Occitan: Bearn [beˈaɾ] or Biarn; Basque: Bearno or Biarno; Latin: Benearnia or Bearnia) is one of the traditional provinces of France, located in the Pyrenees mountains and in the plain at their feet, in Southwestern France. Along with the three Basque provinces of Soule, Lower Navarre and Labourd, the Principality of Bidache, as well as small parts of Gascony, it forms the current Pyrénées-Atlantiques department. The capitals of Béarn were successively Beneharnum (until 841), Morlaàs (from c. 1100), Orthez (from the second half of the 13th century) and then Pau (beginning in the mid-15th century).
Béarn is bordered by the Basque provinces of Soule and Lower Navarre to the west, Gascony (Landes and Armagnac) to the north, Bigorre to the east, in addition to Spain (Aragon) to the south.

Sporazum o ustanovitvi Skupnosti neodvisnih držav (uradno), neuradno minski sporazum, najbolj znan pa kot Beloveški sporazum, je bil sporazum, ki je razglasil, da je Sovjetska zveza (ZSSR) dejansko prenehala obstajati, in namesto nje ustanovil Skupnost neodvisnih držav (SND) kot organizacijo istih zveznih republik. Dokumente so 8. decembra 1991 v državni dači pri Viskulih v Beloveškem pragozdu v Belorusiji podpisali voditelji treh od štirih republik (razen nekdanje Zakavkaške SFSR), ki so leta 1922 podpisale pogodbo o ustanovitvi ZSSR:
predsednik beloruskega parlamenta Stanislav Šuškevič in predsednik beloruske vlade Vjačeslav Kebič;
ruski predsednik Boris Jelcin in prvi podpredsednik vlade RSFSR oziroma Ruske federacije Genadij Burbulis.
notes: The English list of signatories breaks off after Belarus and Russia; the Ukrainian signatories are not in the source text.

source.title: Belovezha Accords
paragraphs: The Agreement on the creation of the Commonwealth of Independent States (officially), or unofficially the Minsk Agreement and best known as the Belovezha Accords, is the agreement declaring that the Soviet Union (USSR) had effectively ceased to exist and establishing the Commonwealth of Independent States (CIS) in its place as an organization created by the same Union Republics. The documentation was signed at the state dacha near Viskuli in Belovezhskaya Pushcha, Belarus on 8 December 1991, by leaders of three of the four republics (except for the defunct Transcaucasian SFSR) which had signed the 1922 Treaty on the Creation of the USSR:
Belarusian Parliament chairman Stanislav Shushkevich and Prime Minister of Belarus Vyacheslav Kebich
Russian president Boris Yeltsin and First Deputy Prime Minister of the RSFSR/Russian Federation Gennady Burbulis
Berga je glavno mesto comarce (okraja) Berguedà v provinci Barcelona v Kataloniji v Španiji. Meji na občine Cercs, Olvan, Avià, Capolat in Castellar del Riu.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is a state, but its link points to the article on the modern town; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Berga
paragraphs: Berga (Catalan pronunciation: [ˈbeɾɣə]) is the capital of the comarca (county) of Berguedà, in the province of Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It is bordered by the municipalities of Cercs, Olvan, Avià, Capolat and Castellar del Riu.

Berke–Hulegu war.headline: Vojna med Berkejem in Hulagujem
paragraphs: Vojna med Berkejem in Hulagujem je potekala med mongolskima voditeljema, Berke-kanom iz Zlate horde in Hulagu-kanom iz Ilkanata. Bojevali so se večinoma na območju Kavkaza v 1260. letih, po uničenju Bagdada leta 1258. Vojna se je prekrivala s toluidsko državljansko vojno v Mongolskem cesarstvu med dvema pripadnikoma Toluijeve rodbine, Kublajkanom in Arik Bökejem, ki sta oba zahtevala naslov velikega kana (kagana). Kublaj se je povezal s Hulagujem, Arik Böke pa se je postavil na stran Berkeja. Hulagu se je odpravil v Mongolijo na volitve novega kagana, naslednika Möngke-kana, a ga je poraz v bitki pri Ajn Džalutu proti Mamelukom prisilil k vrnitvi na Bližnji vzhod. Mameluška zmaga je Berkeja opogumila, da je vdrl v Ilkanat. Vojna med Berkejem in Hulagujem, toluidska državljanska vojna in poznejša vojna med Kaidujem in Kublajem so pomenile ključni trenutek v razpadu Mongolskega cesarstva po smrti Möngkeja, četrtega kana Mongolskega cesarstva.

source.title: Berke–Hulegu war
paragraphs: The Berke–Hulegu war was fought between two Mongol leaders, Berke Khan of the Golden Horde and Hulegu Khan of the Ilkhanate. It was fought mostly in the Caucasus Mountains area in the 1260s after the destruction of Baghdad in 1258. The war overlaps with the Toluid Civil War in the Mongol Empire between two members of the Tolui family line, Kublai Khan and Ariq Böke, who both claimed the title of Great Khan (Khagan). Kublai allied with Hulegu, while Ariq Böke sided with Berke. Hulegu headed to Mongolia for the election of a new Khagan to succeed Möngke Khan, but the loss of the Battle of Ain Jalut to the Mamluks forced him to withdraw back to the Middle East. The Mamluk victory emboldened Berke to invade the Ilkhanate. The Berke–Hulegu war and the Toluid Civil War as well as the subsequent Kaidu–Kublai war marked a key moment in the fragmentation of the Mongol empire after the death of Möngke, the fourth khan of the Mongol Empire.

Bernska konvencija za varstvo književnih in umetniških del, navadno imenovana Bernska konvencija, je bila mednarodna skupščina, ki jo je leta 1886 v švicarskem mestu Bern organiziralo deset evropskih držav, da bi se dogovorile o sklopu pravnih načel za varstvo izvirnih del in intelektualne lastnine. Pripravile in sprejele so večstransko pogodbo z dogovori o enotnem čezmejnem sistemu, ki je postal znan pod istim imenom. Njena pravila so bila od tedaj večkrat posodobljena. Pogodba avtorjem, glasbenikom, pesnikom, slikarjem in drugim ustvarjalcem daje sredstva za nadzor nad tem, kako, kdo in pod katerimi pogoji uporablja njihova dela. V nekaterih pravnih sistemih se te pravice imenujejo copyright, na evropski celini pa navadno avtorske pravice.
Novembra 2022 je Bernsko konvencijo ratificiralo 182 od 195 držav sveta, večina med njimi je tudi pogodbenic pariškega akta iz leta 1971.

source.title: Berne Convention
paragraphs: The Berne Convention for the Protection of Literary and Artistic Works, usually known as the Berne Convention, was an international assembly held in 1886 in the Swiss city of Bern by ten European countries with the goal of agreeing on a set of legal principles for the protection of original work and intellectual property. They drafted and adopted a multi-party contract containing agreements for a uniform, border-crossing system that became known under the same name. Its rules have been updated many times since then. The treaty provides authors, musicians, poets, painters, and other creators with the means to control how their works are used, by whom, and on what terms. In some jurisdictions these types of rights are referred to as copyright; on the European continent they are generally referred to as authors' rights.
As of November 2022, the Berne Convention has been ratified by 182 states out of 195 countries in the world, most of which are also parties to the Paris Act of 1971.

Berne Convention on the Conservation of.headline: Bernska konvencija (1979)
paragraphs: Konvencija o varstvu prosto živečega evropskega rastlinstva in živalstva ter njunih naravnih življenjskih prostorov, znana tudi kot Bernska konvencija, je zavezujoč mednarodni pravni instrument na področju varstva narave, ki zajema naravno dediščino Evrope in nekaterih afriških držav.
Konvencija je bila odprta za podpis 19. septembra 1979 in je začela veljati 1. junija 1982. Posebej se posveča varstvu naravnih življenjskih prostorov in ogroženih vrst, tudi selitvenih.

source.title: Berne Convention on the Conservation of European Wildlife and Natural Habitats
paragraphs: The Bern Convention on the Conservation of European Wildlife and Natural Habitats, also known as the Bern Convention (or Berne Convention), is a binding international legal instrument in the field of Nature Conservation, it covers the natural heritage in Europe, as well as in some African countries.

The Convention was open for signature on 19 September 1979 and came into force on 1 June 1982. It is particularly concerned about protecting natural habitats and endangered species, including migratory species.

Bernicia.headline: Bernicija
paragraphs: Bernicija (staroangleško: Bernica rice, Beornica rice) je bila anglosaško kraljestvo, ki so ga v 6. stoletju ustanovili anglski naseljenci na območju današnje jugovzhodne Škotske in severovzhodne Anglije.

Anglsko ozemlje Bernicije je približno ustrezalo današnjim angleškim grofijam Northumberland, Tyne and Wear in Durham ter škotskima grofijama Berwickshire in East Lothian in je segalo od reke Forth do reke Tees. V začetku 7. stoletja se je Bernicija združila z južno sosedo Deiro v kraljestvo Northumbrija, njene meje pa so se nato precej razširile.

source.title: Bernicia
paragraphs: Bernicia (Old English: Bernica rice, Beornica rice) was an Anglo-Saxon kingdom established by Anglian settlers of the 6th century in what is now southeastern Scotland and North East England.

The Anglian territory of Bernicia was approximately equivalent to the modern English counties of Northumberland, Tyne and Wear, and Durham, as well as the Scottish counties of Berwickshire and East Lothian, stretching from the Forth to the Tees. In the early 7th century, it merged with its southern neighbour, Deira, to form the kingdom of Northumbria, and its borders subsequently expanded considerably.

Vojne škofov so bile dve vojni, ki sta v letih 1639 in 1640 potekali med Karlom I. in njegovimi nasprotniki covenanterji na Škotskem. Z njimi so se začele vojne treh kraljestev, ki vključujejo tudi prvo in drugo angleško državljansko vojno, irske konfederacijske vojne in angleško-škotsko vojno v letih 1650–1652.

Leta 1637 je Karel I., tedaj kralj Škotske in Anglije, škotski Cerkvi vsilil spremembe verske prakse. Številni Škoti so jih zamerili, zato so leta 1638 podpisali narodno zavezo (National Covenant), s katero so se zavezali, da bodo preprečili njihovo uveljavitev. Generalna skupščina škotske Cerkve je nato izgnala škofe, s čimer se je verski spor sprevrgel v boj za politično prevlado. Nova covenanterska vlada je zbrala vojsko, da bi Karlu preprečila, da bi s silo obnovil svojo oblast.

source.title: Bishops' Wars
paragraphs: The Bishops' Wars were two wars fought in 1639 and 1640 between Charles I and his Covenanter opponents in Scotland. They were the first of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms, which also include the First and Second English Civil Wars, the Irish Confederate Wars, and the 1650 to 1652 Anglo-Scottish War.

In 1637, Charles I, then king of Scotland and England, imposed changes in religious practice on the Church of Scotland. These were resented by many Scots, leading to the signing of a National Covenant in 1638, pledging to prevent their implementation. The General Assembly of the Church of Scotland then expelled bishops, turning a religious dispute into a struggle for political supremacy. The new Covenanter government raised an army to prevent Charles using force to restore his authority.

Boeotian War.headline: Beotska vojna
paragraphs: Tebansko-špartanska vojna v letih 378–362 pr. n. št. je bila vrsta vojaških spopadov med Šparto in Tebami za prevlado nad Grčijo. Leta 378 pr. n. št. so se Tebe pod vodstvom vojskovodje Epaminonde uprle špartanski posadki in uspešno odbile špartanske napade. Epaminonda, premeten taktik, je leta 371 pr. n. št. pri Levktri strl dotlej nepremagljivo špartansko vojsko, s tem končal špartansko hegemonijo in začel tebansko hegemonijo nad Grčijo. Po Levktri se je vojna nadaljevala na Peloponezu, kjer se je Šparta borila za preživetje. Leta 362 pr. n. št. je bitka pri Mantineji prinesla Tebam novo zmago, a je v njej padel tudi Epaminonda. Spopad se je kmalu zatem končal s pogodbo o splošnem miru, ki so jo podpisale vse vojskujoče se strani razen Šparte, ki je bila tedaj osamljena in trajno oslabljena.
notes: The record is named Boeotian War; the English summary calls it the Theban–Spartan War, and the Slovenian follows the summary in running text.

source.title: Theban–Spartan War
paragraphs: The Theban–Spartan War of 378–362 BC was a series of military conflicts fought between Sparta and Thebes for hegemony over Greece. In 378 BC, led by General Epaminondas, Thebes revolted against its Spartan garrison and successfully repelled Spartan offensives. A clever tactician, Epaminondas crushed the hitherto invincible Spartan army at Leuctra in 371 BC, thereby ending Sparta's hegemony and starting Thebes' own hegemony over Greece. After Leuctra, the war continued in the Peloponnese, where Sparta was fighting for survival. In 362 BC, the Battle of Mantinea was a new victory for Thebes, but Epaminondas was also killed. The conflict ended soon after with a treaty of general peace signed by all the belligerents, except Sparta, which was by now isolated and permanently weakened.

Bombardment of Ancona.headline: Obstreljevanje Ancone
paragraphs: Obstreljevanje Ancone je bilo pomorski spopad jadranske kampanje prve svetovne vojne med mornaricama Italije in Avstro-Ogrske. Sile avstro-ogrske cesarske in kraljeve vojne mornarice so napadle in obstreljevale vojaške in civilne cilje po vsej Anconi v osrednji Italiji ter na več drugih bližnjih otokih in v krajih, in sicer kot odziv na italijansko vojno napoved Avstro-Ogrski.

source.title: Bombardment of Ancona
paragraphs: The Bombardment of Ancona was a naval engagement of the Adriatic Campaign of World War I between the navies of Italy and Austria-Hungary. Forces of the Imperial and Royal Navy attacked and bombarded military and civilian targets all across Ancona in central Italy and several other nearby islands and communities in response to Italy's declaration of war on Austria-Hungary.

Bonn–Paris conventions.headline: Bonnsko-pariške konvencije
paragraphs: Bonnsko-pariške konvencije so bile podpisane maja 1952 in so začele veljati po ratifikaciji leta 1955. Z njimi se je končala zavezniška zasedba Zahodne Nemčije.

Med podpisom in ratifikacijo je minilo veliko časa, ker Francija ni ratificirala povezane pogodbe o Evropski obrambni skupnosti. Oviro je nazadnje odpravil predlog britanskega zunanjega ministra Anthonyja Edna, naj Zahodna Nemčija postane članica Nata, ter odstranitev sklicev na Evropsko obrambno skupnost iz bonnsko-pariških konvencij. Revidirana pogodba je bila podpisana na slovesnosti v Parizu 23. oktobra 1954. Konvencije so začele veljati na zadnjem zasedanju zavezniške visoke komisije na veleposlaništvu ZDA v Bonnu 5. maja 1955.

source.title: Bonn–Paris conventions
paragraphs: The Bonn–Paris conventions were signed in May 1952 and came into force after the 1955 ratification. The conventions put an end to the Allied occupation of West Germany.

The delay between the signing and the ratification was due to the French failure to ratify the related treaty on the European Defense Community. This was eventually overcome by the British Foreign Secretary Anthony Eden proposing that West Germany become a member of NATO and the removal of the references to the European Defense Community in the Bonn–Paris conventions. The revised treaty was signed at a ceremony in Paris on 23 October 1954. The conventions came into force during the last meeting of the Allied High Commission, that took place in the United States Embassy in Bonn, on 5 May 1955.

Bowring Treaty.headline: Bowringova pogodba
paragraphs: Pogodba o prijateljstvu in trgovini med Veliko Britanijo in Siamom (tajsko: หนังสือสัญญากรุงเทพมหานครกับกรุงอังกริษเปนทางไมตรีค้าขายกัน), pogovorno znana kot Bowringova pogodba, je bila zgodovinska prelomna pogodba, ki sta jo 18. aprila 1855 v Thonburiju v Bangkoku podpisala Združeno kraljestvo v času vladavine kraljice Viktorije in Kraljevina Siam v času vladavine kralja Mongkuta. Pogodba je močno vplivala na siamsko gospodarstvo, družbo in mednarodne odnose v tajski zgodovini; v večini zgodovinopisja pomeni začetek »modernega Siama«, hkrati pa je bila vzor za neenakopravne pogodbe »bowringovskega tipa«, ki jih je Siam v 19. stoletju sklepal z drugimi zahodnimi državami.

source.title: Bowring Treaty
paragraphs: Treaty of Friendship and Commerce between Great Britain and Siam (Thai: หนังสือสัญญากรุงเทพมหานครกับกรุงอังกริษเปนทางไมตรีค้าขายกัน), known colloquially as the Bowring Treaty, was the historic landmark treaty signed between the United Kingdom during the reign of Queen Victoria and the Kingdom of Siam during the reign of King Mongkut on 18 April 1855 at Thonburi, Bangkok. The treaty had tremendous effects on Siamese economy, society and international relations in Thai history, marking the advent of "Modern Siam" in most historiographies, also serving as the model for "Bowring-type" unequal treaties that Siam was going to make with other Western nations in the nineteenth century.

Brandenburška Prusija (nemško: Brandenburg-Preußen; nizkonemško: Brannenborg-Preußen) je zgodovinopisno ime za zgodnjenovoveško državo brandenburške veje Hohenzollernov med letoma 1618 in 1701. Glavna veja Hohenzollernov s sedežem v Brandenburški volilni kneževini se je s porokami povezala z vejo, ki je vladala Vojvodini Prusiji, in si zagotovila nasledstvo, ko je ta leta 1618 izumrla po moški liniji. Druga posledica porok je bila priključitev spodnjerenskih kneževin Kleve, Mark in Ravensberg po ksantenski pogodbi leta 1614.

source.title: Brandenburg–Prussia
paragraphs: Brandenburg–Prussia (German: Brandenburg-Preußen; Low German: Brannenborg-Preußen) is the historiographic denomination for the early modern realm of the Brandenburgian House of Hohenzollern between 1618 and 1701. Based in the Electorate of Brandenburg, the main branch of the Hohenzollern intermarried with the branch ruling the Duchy of Prussia, and secured succession upon the latter's extinction in the male line in 1618. Another consequence of intermarriage was the incorporation of the lower Rhenish principalities of Cleves, Mark and Ravensberg after the Treaty of Xanten in 1614.

Brécourt Manor assault.headline: Napad na dvorec Brécourt
paragraphs: Napad na dvorec Brécourt (6. junija 1944) med ameriškim padalskim napadom v okviru izkrcanja v Normandiji v drugi svetovni vojni pogosto navajajo kot klasičen primer taktike in vodenja majhne enote pri premagovanju večjih sovražnih sil.

source.title: Brécourt Manor assault
paragraphs: The Brécourt Manor Assault (6 June 1944) during the US parachute assault of the Normandy Invasion of World War II is often cited as a classic example of small-unit tactics and leadership in overcoming a larger enemy force.

Bretonci (bretonsko: Bretoned ali Vretoned) so keltska etnična skupina, ki izvira iz Bretanje na severozahodu Francije. Prvotno je ime označevalo skupine govorcev britonskih jezikov, ki so se izselili z jugozahoda Velike Britanije, zlasti iz Cornwalla in Devona, večinoma med anglosaško naselitvijo Britanije. V valovih so se od 3. do 9. stoletja (najmočneje od leta 450 do 600) selili na zahod Armorike. Ta zahodni del Armorike je bil nato poimenovan po njih, po njih pa so poimenovali tudi prebivalce.

Tradicionalni jezik Bretanje je bretonščina (brezhoneg), keltski jezik britonske veje, ki ga danes govorijo predvsem v Spodnji Bretanji (zahodnem delu polotoka). Leta 2013 je bretonsko govorilo okoli 206.000 ljudi. Drugi glavni manjšinski jezik Bretanje je galo, romanski jezik; galo govorijo le v Zgornji Bretanji, kjer so nekoč govorili tudi bretonsko, a je bretonščina tam približno od leta 900 v zatonu in manj prevladujoča. Danes je materni jezik večine Bretoncev standardna francoščina.
notes: The Breton pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is a state, but its link points to the article on the people; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Bretons
paragraphs: The Bretons (Breton: Bretoned or Vretoned, Breton pronunciation: [breˈtɔ̃nɛt]) are a Celtic ethnic group native to Brittany, north-western France. Originally, the demonym designated groups of Brittonic speakers who emigrated from southwestern Great Britain, particularly Cornwall and Devon, mostly during the Anglo-Saxon settlement of Britain. They migrated in waves from the 3rd to 9th century (most heavily from 450 to 600) to the west of Armorica. That western part of Armorica was subsequently named after them, as were the inhabitants.

The traditional language of Brittany is Breton (Brezhoneg), a Celtic language of the Brittonic branch now mostly spoken in Lower Brittany (i.e., the western part of the peninsula). Breton is spoken by around 206,000 people as of 2013. The other principal minority language of Brittany is Gallo, a Romance language; Gallo is spoken only in Upper Brittany, where Breton used to be spoken as well but it has seen a decline and has been less dominant in Upper Brittany since around the year 900. Currently, most Bretons' native language is standard French.

Brusilov offensive.headline: Brusilovova ofenziva
paragraphs: Brusilovova ofenziva (rusko: Брусиловский прорыв, dobesedno »Brusilovov preboj«) od junija do septembra 1916 je bila največji vojaški podvig Ruskega cesarstva v prvi svetovni vojni in ena najbolj smrtonosnih ofenziv v svetovni zgodovini. Zgodovinar Graydon Tunstall jo je označil za najhujšo krizo prve svetovne vojne za Avstro-Ogrsko in največjo zmago antante, vendar je terjala ogromno življenj. Zmaga je dvignila moralo ruskih vojakov. Zaradi uspeha ofenzive so zaveznice Rusije ponovno pretehtale svoja stališča do povojnih ozemeljskih koncesij, tudi do statusa Anatolije in Bosporja.

source.title: Brusilov offensive
paragraphs: The Brusilov offensive (Russian: Брусиловский прорыв, romanized: Brusilovskiĭ proryv, lit. 'Brusilov's breakthrough') of June to September 1916 was the Russian Empire's greatest feat of arms during World War I and among the most lethal offensives in world history. The historian Graydon Tunstall called the Brusilov offensive the worst crisis of World War I for Austria-Hungary and the Triple Entente's greatest victory, but it came at a tremendous loss of life. The victory contributed to a morale upsurge among the Russian troops. The offensive's success led Russia's allies to reconsider their positions on postwar territorial concessions, including the status of Anatolia and the Bosphorus Strait.

Brycheiniog.headline: Brycheiniog
paragraphs: Brycheiniog je bil neodvisno kraljestvo v južnem Walesu v zgodnjem srednjem veku. Pogosto je bil tamponska država med Anglijo na vzhodu in južnovaližanskim kraljestvom Deheubarth na zahodu. Normani so ga med letoma 1088 in 1095 osvojili in pomirili, a je ohranil valižanski značaj. Preoblikovali so ga v gospostvo Brecknock, pozneje pa je tvoril južni in večji del zgodovinske grofije Brecknockshire. Južno od njega je ležalo kraljestvo Morgannwg.

Glavna dediščina kraljestva Brycheiniog je etimološka in geografska. Ime se ohranja v Bannau Brycheiniog, valižanskem imenu gorovja Brecon Beacons, od leta 2023 pa tudi v imenu narodnega parka v tem gorovju. Iz njega izhajata tudi poangleščeni imeni Brecknockshire (v valižanščini ohranjeno kot Sir Frycheiniog, »grofija Brycheiniog«) in Brecon (v valižanščini tudi Aberhonddu).

source.title: Brycheiniog
paragraphs: Brycheiniog was an independent kingdom in South Wales in the Early Middle Ages. It often acted as a buffer state between England to the east and the south Welsh kingdom of Deheubarth to the west. It was conquered and pacified by the Normans between 1088 and 1095, though it remained Welsh in character. It was transformed into the Lordship of Brecknock and later formed the southern and larger part of the historic county of Brecknockshire. To its south was the Kingdom of Morgannwg.

The main legacy of the kingdom of Brycheiniog is etymological and geographical. It is used in Bannau Brycheiniog, the Welsh name for the Brecon Beacons range and, since 2023, in name used for the range's national park. Its name is also the origin to the anglicised names Brecknockshire (retained in Welsh as Sir Frycheiniog, 'the shire of Brycheiniog'), and Brecon (otherwise known as Aberhonddu in Welsh).

Budapest Convention of 1877.headline: Budimpeštanska konvencija (1877)
paragraphs: Budimpeštanska konvencija (Budapester Vertrag) je bila tajni sporazum med Avstro-Ogrsko in Rusijo iz leta 1877 o politiki in razdelitvi interesnih območij v jugovzhodni Evropi v primeru vojne med Rusijo in Osmanskim cesarstvom. Tako imenovano vzhodno vprašanje (Orientalische Frage), razdelitev propadajočega Osmanskega cesarstva na Balkanu, je bilo v 19. stoletju prednostna naloga evropskih velesil. Za Rusijo je bilo prednostno tudi zagotovilo avstro-ogrske nevtralnosti.

Sporazum je potrdil izide prejšnjega reichstadtskega dogovora; cesar Franc Jožef in ruski car Aleksander II. sta ga sprva sklenila med carigrajsko konferenco (1876–1877), dokončno pa je bil sklenjen v Budimpešti 15. januarja 1877.

source.title: Budapest Convention of 1877
paragraphs: The Budapest Convention (Budapester Vertrag) was a secret agreement between Austria-Hungary and Russia in 1877 to agree on policies and the division of powers in Southeast Europe in the eventuality of war between Russia and the Ottoman Empire. The so-called Eastern Question (Orientalische Frage), the division of the declining Ottoman Empire in the Balkans, was a priority of the European great powers in the nineteenth century. For Russia, obtaining assurances of Austro-Hungarian neutrality was also a priority.

The agreement confirmed the results of the earlier Reichstadt Agreement and was made between the Emperor Franz Joseph and Tsar Alexander II of Russia initially during the Constantinople Conference (1876–1877) and was subsequently finalised in Budapest on January 15, 1877.

Bulgarian–Latin wars.headline: Bolgarsko-latinske vojne
paragraphs: Bolgarsko-latinske vojne so bile vrsta spopadov med Drugim bolgarskim cesarstvom (1185–1396) in Latinskim cesarstvom (1204–1261). Zaznamovale so severno mejo Latinskega cesarstva ves čas njegovega obstoja.
