Začetne osvajalne ambicije Latinskega cesarstva so bile strte že leto po njegovi ustanovitvi, v bitki pri Odrinu leta 1205, v kateri je bil cesar Balduin I. ujet, večina njegovih vitezov pa je padla. Po tem odločilnem porazu se je moralo Latinsko cesarstvo braniti pred Bolgarijo in državami naslednicami Bizantinskega cesarstva, Nikejskim cesarstvom v Mali Aziji in Epirskim despotatom na Balkanu.

Zaradi teh spopadov je Bolgarsko cesarstvo razširilo ozemlje in prevzelo nadzor nad večjim delom Balkanskega polotoka, vpliv Latinskega cesarstva pa se je skrčil na Carigrad ter nekaj mest in otokov. Ker so rimskokatoliški križarji odpravili carigrajski patriarhat, je Bolgarija postala središče pravoslavnega krščanstva.

source.title: Bulgarian–Latin wars
paragraphs: The Bulgarian–Latin wars were a series of conflicts between the Second Bulgarian Empire (1185–1396) and the Latin Empire (1204–61). The wars affected the northern border of the Latin Empire throughout its existence.

The initial expansionist ambitions of the Latin Empire were crushed only one year after its foundation after the Battle of Adrianople in 1205, where its Emperor Baldwin I was captured and most of his knights perished. After that crucial defeat the Latin Empire had to defend itself against Bulgaria and the successor states of the Byzantine Empire, the Nicaean Empire in Asia Minor and the Despotate of Epirus in the Balkans.

As a result of the conflicts the Bulgarian Empire expanded its territory taking control of most of the Balkan Peninsula while the influence of the Latin Empire was reduced to Constantinople and a few towns and islands. With the elimination of the Patriarchate of Constantinople by the Roman Catholic Crusaders, Bulgaria became the centre of Orthodox Christianity.

Bündner Wirren.headline: Graubündenski nemiri
paragraphs: Graubündenski nemiri (nemško: Bündner Wirren; retoromansko: Scumbigls grischuns/Scumpigls grischuns/Sgurdins grischuns, francosko: Troubles des Grisons, italijansko: Torbidi grigionesi), imenovani tudi upor lig, so bili spopad, ki je med letoma 1618 in 1639 potekal na območju današnjega švicarskega kantona Graubünden.

Sprva je šlo za upor domačih katoličanov proti protestantskim gospodom, nato pa se je vpletlo veliko regionalnih sil, saj je spopad lahko vplival na nadzor nad alpskimi prelazi v Valtellini. Ohlapno zavezništvo Francije, Benetk in Savojske vojvodine je podpiralo tri lige proti graubündenskim upornikom, ki jih je podpirala habsburška monarhija. Spopad je grozil, da bo v tridesetletno vojno potegnil tudi švicarsko konfederacijo.

source.title: Bündner Wirren
paragraphs: The Bündner Wirren (Romansh: Scumbigls grischuns/Scumpigls grischuns/Sgurdins grischuns, French: Troubles des Grisons, Italian: Torbidi grigionesi, English: Graubünden disturbances or Revolt of the Leagues) was a conflict that lasted between 1618 and 1639 in what is now the Swiss canton of Graubünden.

Initially a revolt by local Catholics against their Protestant overlords, many regional powers became involved as it potentially affected control of the Valtellina alpine passes. A loose alliance of France, Venice, and the Duchy of Savoy supported the Three Leagues against the Grison rebels, backed by the Habsburg monarchy. The conflict threatened to draw the Swiss Confederation into the Thirty Years War.

Burgundian Wars.headline: Burgundske vojne
paragraphs: Burgundske vojne (1474–1477) so bile spopad med burgundsko državo ter staro švicarsko konfederacijo in njenimi zavezniki. Odprta vojna je izbruhnila leta 1474; burgundski vojvoda Karel Drzni je bil v naslednjih letih trikrat poražen na bojišču in je leta 1477 padel v bitki pri Nancyju. Vojvodina Burgundija in več drugih burgundskih dežel so nato postale del Francije, Burgundsko Nizozemsko in Franche-Comté pa je podedovala Karlova hči Marija Burgundska; po njeni smrti sta zaradi njene poroke s cesarjem Svetega rimskega cesarstva Maksimilijanom I. nazadnje prešli na Habsburžane.

source.title: Burgundian Wars
paragraphs: The Burgundian Wars (1474–1477) were a conflict between the Burgundian State and the Old Swiss Confederacy and its allies. Open war broke out in 1474, and the Duke of Burgundy, Charles the Bold, was defeated three times on the battlefield in the following years and was killed at the Battle of Nancy in 1477. The Duchy of Burgundy and several other Burgundian lands then became part of France, and the Burgundian Netherlands and Franche-Comté were inherited by Charles's daughter, Mary of Burgundy, and eventually passed to the House of Habsburg upon her death because of her marriage to Maximilian I, Holy Roman Emperor.

Burney Treaty.headline: Burneyjeva pogodba
paragraphs: Pogodbo med Kraljevino Siam in Veliko Britanijo, splošno znano kot Burneyjeva pogodba, sta 20. junija 1826 v Bangkoku podpisala Henry Burney, zastopnik britanske Vzhodnoindijske družbe, v imenu Britanije in kralj Rama III. v imenu Siama. Sledila je zgodnejši pogodbi s 24. februarja 1826, s katero je Siam postal zaveznik Britanije proti dinastiji Konbaung (Burmi), s katero je bila Britanija v vojni. Siamska vojska je bila zbrana in opremljena, a v vojni ni resneje sodelovala zaradi zamer in nezaupanja, ki jih je povzročil siamski vdor v Kedah leta 1821.

source.title: Burney Treaty
paragraphs: The treaty between Kingdom of Siam and Great Britain commonly known as the Burney Treaty was signed at Bangkok on 20 June 1826 by Henry Burney, an agent of British East India Company, for Britain, and King Rama III for Siam. It followed an earlier treaty of 24 February 1826, in which Siam became an ally of Britain against the Konbaung Dynasty (Burma) with which Britain was at war. A Siamese army was raised and equipped but took no serious part in the war because of ill feeling and suspicion arising from the Siamese invasion of Kedah in 1821.

Byzantine civil war of 1321–1328.headline: Bizantinska državljanska vojna 1321–1328
paragraphs: Bizantinska državljanska vojna 1321–1328 je bila vrsta spopadov med bizantinskim cesarjem Andronikom II. Paleologom in njegovim vnukom Andronikom III. Paleologom za oblast v Bizantinskem cesarstvu.

source.title: Byzantine civil war of 1321–1328
paragraphs: The Byzantine civil war of 1321–1328 was a series of conflicts between the Byzantine emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos and his grandson Andronikos III Palaiologos over control of the Byzantine Empire.

Bizantinsko-normanske vojne so bile niz vojaških spopadov med Normani in Bizantinskim cesarstvom, ki so potekali od okoli leta 1040 do 1186 in v katerih so sodelovali normanska Kraljevina Sicilija na zahodu in Antiohijska kneževina na Levantu. Zadnji od normanskih vpadov je sicer povzročil katastrofo za Bizantince, ko je leta 1185 izropal Solun, vendar so ga do leta 1186 nazadnje pregnali in premagali.

source.title: Byzantine–Norman wars
paragraphs: The Byzantine–Norman wars were a series of military conflicts between the Normans and the Byzantine Empire fought from c. 1040 to 1186 involving the Norman-led Kingdom of Sicily in the west, and the Principality of Antioch in the Levant. The last of the Norman invasions, though having incurred disaster upon the Romans by sacking Thessalonica in 1185, was eventually driven out and vanquished by 1186.
Kantonalna revolucija (špansko: Revolución cantonal) je bila poskus, da bi leta 1873 v Španiji ustanovili revolucionarno republiko, ki bi temeljila na decentraliziranem sistemu kantonov.

Po slavni revoluciji leta 1868 je Španija zašla v politično nestabilnost, ki je dosegla vrhunec z ustanovitvijo prve španske republike. Zvezna demokratična republikanska stranka (PRDF) pod vodstvom Francesca Pija i Margalla je bila izvoljena, da bi državo preuredila v zvezno republiko, vendar so notranje delitve v stranki privedle do novih sporov. Levičarski »nepopustljivi« republikanci so se zavzemali, da bi zvezno republiko oblikovali od spodaj navzgor, ne pa z ustavo od zgoraj navzdol, kot jo je predlagala vlada Pija i Margalla.

source.title: Cantonal Rebellion
paragraphs: The Cantonal Revolution (Spanish: Revolución cantonal) was an attempt to establish a revolutionary republic, based on a decentralised system of cantons, in Spain in 1873.

Following the Glorious Revolution of 1868, Spain was thrown into political instability which culminated in the establishment of the First Spanish Republic. The Federal Democratic Republican Party (PRDF), led by Francesc Pi i Margall, was elected to reconstitute the country as a federal republic, but internal divisions within the party led to further conflict. Left-wing "intransigent" republicans advocated for the formation of the federal republic from the bottom-up, rather than the top-down constitution proposed by the Pi i Margall government.

Zavzetje Rima (italijansko: Presa di Roma) je potekalo 20. septembra 1870, ko so sile Kraljevine Italije prevzele nadzor nad mestom in Papeško državo. Po plebiscitu 2. oktobra 1870 so Rim 3. februarja 1871 uradno razglasili za prestolnico Italije, s čimer se je združitev Italije (risorgimento) končala.

Ko je Rim zavzela kraljeva italijanska vojska, se je končala Papeška država, ki je obstajala od Pipinove darovnice leta 756, skupaj s posvetno oblastjo Svetega sedeža, Rim pa je postal prestolnica združene Italije. V Italiji ga množično obeležujejo, zlasti v mestih s stolnico, s poimenovanjem ulic po datumu: Via XX Settembre (govorjena oblika: »Via Venti Settembre«).

source.title: Capture of Rome
paragraphs: The capture of Rome (Italian: Presa di Roma) occurred on 20 September 1870, as forces of the Kingdom of Italy took control of the city and of the Papal States. After a plebiscite held on 2 October 1870, Rome was officially made capital of Italy on 3 February 1871, completing the unification of Italy (Risorgimento).

The capture of Rome by the Royal Italian Army brought an end to the Papal States, which had existed since the Donation of Pepin in 756, along with the temporal power of the Holy See, and led to the establishment of Rome as the capital of unified Italy. It is widely commemorated in Italy, especially in cathedral cities, by naming streets for the date: Via XX Settembre (spoken form: "Via Venti Settembre").

Capture of the Dutch fleet at Den Helder.headline: Zajetje nizozemske flote pri Den Helderju
paragraphs: Zajetje nizozemske flote pri Den Helderju v noči na 23. januar 1795 je redek primer spopada med vojnimi ladjami in konjenico: francoski revolucionarni huzarski polk se je približal nizozemski floti, ki je zamrznjena stala na sidrišču v Nieuwediepu, tik vzhodno od mesta Den Helder. Potem ko se je del huzarjev približal čez zamrznjeni Nieuwediep, je francoska konjenica izpogajala, da vseh 14 nizozemskih vojnih ladij ostane na sidru. Zajetje ladij s konjeniki je v vojaški zgodovini izjemno redek podvig.

Francoski enoti sta bili 8. huzarski polk in voltižerska četa 15. linijskega pehotnega polka francoske revolucionarne vojske. Jean-Charles Pichegru je vodil francosko vojsko, ki je vdrla v Nizozemsko republiko. Nizozemski floti je poveljeval kapitan Hermanus Reintjes. Dogodek se je zgodil med vojno prve koalicije, ki je bila del francoskih revolucionarnih vojn.

source.title: Capture of the Dutch fleet at Den Helder
paragraphs: The capture of the Dutch fleet at Den Helder on the night of 23 January 1795 presents a rare occurrence of an interaction between warships and cavalry, in which a French Revolutionary Hussar regiment came close to a Dutch fleet frozen at anchor in the Nieuwediep, just east of the town of Den Helder. After some of the Hussars had approached across the frozen Nieuwediep, the French cavalry negotiated that all 14 Dutch warships would remain at anchor. A capture of ships by horsemen is an extremely rare feat in military history.

The French units were the 8th Hussar Regiment and the Voltigeur company of the 15th Line Infantry Regiment of the French Revolutionary Army. Jean-Charles Pichegru was the leader of the French army that invaded the Dutch Republic. The Dutch fleet was commanded by Captain Hermanus Reintjes. The action happened during the War of the First Coalition, which was part of the French Revolutionary Wars.

Nageljnova revolucija (portugalsko: Revolução dos Cravos), s kodnim imenom operacija Zgodovinski preobrat, znana tudi kot 25. april in portugalska revolucija (portugalsko: Revolução Portuguesa), je bila vojaški udar častnikov na Portugalskem, ki je 25. aprila 1974 strmoglavil Marcela Caetana in režim Estado Novo, ki ga je vzpostavil António de Oliveira Salazar (vladal 1932–1968). Udar se je zgodil sredi portugalske kolonialne vojne (1961–1974) v čezmorskih kolonijah in prek tako imenovanega tekočega revolucionarnega procesa povzročil velike družbene, gospodarske, ozemeljske, demografske in politične spremembe na Portugalskem ter v Angoli, Gvineji Bissau, Mozambiku in drugih nekdanjih portugalskih kolonijah. Pripeljal je do portugalskega prehoda v demokracijo in konca portugalske kolonialne vojne. Imel je tudi svetovne posledice, saj je pomenil začetek tretjega vala demokratizacije.

source.title: Carnation Revolution
paragraphs: The Carnation Revolution (Portuguese: Revolução dos Cravos), code-named Operation Historic Turn, also known as the 25 April, and Portuguese Revolution (Portuguese: Revolução Portuguesa) was a military coup in Portugal by officers that on 25 April 1974 overthrew Marcelo Caetano and the Estado Novo regime established by António de Oliveira Salazar (r. 1932–1968). The coup came in the midst of the Portuguese Colonial War (1961–1974) in its overseas colonies and produced major social, economic, territorial, demographic, and political changes in Portugal and in Angola, Guinea-Bissau, Mozambique, and other former Portuguese colonies through the Ongoing Revolutionary Process. It resulted in the Portuguese transition to democracy and an end to the Portuguese Colonial War. It also had worldwide repercussions by marking the beginning of the third wave of democracy.

Catalan Civil War.headline: Katalonska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Katalonska državljanska vojna, imenovana tudi vojna proti Ivanu II., je bila državljanska vojna v Kneževini Kataloniji, tedaj delu Aragonske krone, med letoma 1462 in 1472. Obe strani, rojalisti, ki so podpirali aragonskega kralja Ivana II., in katalonski konstitucionalisti (katalanisti, paktisti in foralisti), sta se prepirali o obsegu kraljevih pravic v Kataloniji. Francozi so v vojni nastopali enkrat na strani Ivana II., drugič na strani Kataloncev. Katalonci, ki so se sprva zbrali okoli Ivanovega sina Karla iz Viane, so med spopadom proti Ivanu postavili več pretendentov. Barcelona je ostala njihovo oporišče do konca: z njeno predajo se je vojna končala. Zmagoviti Ivan je obnovil stanje pred vojno (status quo ante bellum).

source.title: Catalan Civil War
paragraphs: The Catalan Civil War, also called the Catalonian Civil War or the War against John II, was a civil war in the Principality of Catalonia, then part of the Crown of Aragon, between 1462 and 1472. The two factions, the royalists who supported John II of Aragon and the Catalan constitutionalists (Catalanists, pactists, and foralists), disputed the extent of royal rights in Catalonia. The French entered the war at times on the side on John II and at times with the Catalans. The Catalans, who at first rallied around John's son Charles of Viana, set up several pretenders in opposition to John during the course of the conflict. Barcelona remained their stronghold to the end: with its surrender the war came to a close. John, victorious, re-established the status quo ante bellum.

Katalonska kompanija ali Velika katalonska kompanija (katalonsko: Gran Companyia Catalana; Societas exercitus catalanorum, Societas cathalanorum ali Magna Societas Catalanorum) je bila najemniška četa, ki jo je v začetku 14. stoletja vodil Roger de Flor in jo je bizantinski cesar Andronik II. Paleolog najel za boj proti vse močnejšim anatolskim bejlikom. Sestavljali so jo almogavarski veterani vojne sicilskih večernic, ki so ostali brez dela, ko sta aragonska krona in francoska dinastija Anžuvincev leta 1302 sklenili mir v Caltabellotti.

source.title: Catalan Company
paragraphs: The Catalan Company or the Great Catalan Company (Catalan: Gran Companyia Catalana; Societas exercitus catalanorum, Societas cathalanorum, or Magna Societas Catalanorum) was a company of mercenaries led by Roger de Flor in the early 14th century and hired by Byzantine Emperor Andronikos II Palaiologos to combat the increasing power of the Anatolian beyliks. It was formed by almogavar veterans of the War of the Sicilian Vespers, who had remained unemployed after the signing in 1302 of the Peace of Caltabellotta between the Crown of Aragon and the French dynasty of the Angevins.

Catalonia Offensive.headline: Katalonska ofenziva
paragraphs: Katalonska ofenziva (katalonsko: Ofensiva de Catalunya, špansko: Ofensiva de Cataluña) je bila del španske državljanske vojne. Nacionalistična vojska je ofenzivo začela 23. decembra 1938 in hitro osvojila republikansko Katalonijo z Barcelono (od oktobra 1937 prestolnico republike). Barcelona je padla 26. januarja 1939. Republikanska in katalonska vlada sta se umaknili proti francoski meji. Mejo je v naslednjem mesecu prečkalo tudi na tisoče ljudi, ki so bežali pred nacionalisti, in so jih namestili v internacijska taborišča. Franco je mejo s Francijo zaprl do 10. februarja 1939.

source.title: Catalonia Offensive
paragraphs: The Catalonia Offensive (Catalan: Ofensiva de Catalunya, Spanish: Ofensiva de Cataluña) was part of the Spanish Civil War. The Nationalist Army started the offensive on 23 December 1938 and rapidly conquered Republican-held Catalonia with Barcelona (the Republic's capital city from October 1937). Barcelona was captured on 26 January 1939. The Republican and Catalan governments headed for the French border. Thousands of people fleeing the Nationalists also crossed the frontier in the following month, to be placed in internment camps. Franco closed the border with France by 10 February 1939.

Kavkaški imamat, znan tudi kot Severnokavkaški imamat (arabsko: إمامة شمال القوقاز), je bil islamska država, ki so jo muslimanski imami v prvi polovici 19. stoletja ustanovili v Dagestanu in Čečeniji. Po združitvi čečenskih in avarskih plemen je nastal med kavkaško vojno (1817–1864) kot odporniško gibanje proti širjenju Ruskega cesarstva v regijo. Imamat je skušal raznolika ljudstva Severnega Kavkaza združiti pod osrednjo islamsko oblastjo in uvedel šeriatsko pravo, da bi utrdil politični in vojaški odpor proti ruski oblasti.

Rusija je hotela zavarovati svoje južne meje in utrditi poti do na novo pridobljenih ozemelj na Južnem Kavkazu (današnje Gruzije, Armenije in Azerbajdžana), zato je skušala priključiti Severni Kavkaz. Imamat je bil glavna sila, ki se je temu osvajanju upirala; desetletja je vzdržal v spopadih, dokler ni po zajetju zadnjega voditelja, imama Šamila, leta 1859 razpadel.
notes: The glossary had the typo Kavkaški imanat; an override now gives Kavkaški imamat.

source.title: Caucasian Imamate
paragraphs: The Caucasian Imamate, also known as the North Caucasian Imamate (Arabic: إمامة شمال القوقاز, romanized: Imāmat Shamal al-Qawqāz), was a state founded by Muslim imams in the early-to-mid 19th century across Dagestan and Chechnya. After uniting Chechen and Avar tribes It emerged during the Caucasian War (1817–1864) as a resistance movement against the Russian Empire's expansion into the region. The Imamate sought to unify the diverse peoples of the North Caucasus under a centralized Islamic governance structure, implementing sharia law to consolidate political and military opposition to Russian rule.

Russia, aiming to secure its southern frontiers and stabilize communication routes to its newly acquired territories in the South Caucasus (modern-day Georgia, Armenia, and Azerbaijan), sought to annex the North Caucasus. The Imamate became the primary force opposing this conquest, enduring decades of conflict before its eventual dissolution following the capture of its final leader, Imam Shamil, in 1859.

Celtiberian Wars.headline: Keltiberske vojne
paragraphs: Prva keltiberska vojna (181–179 pr. n. št.) in druga keltiberska vojna (154–151 pr. n. št.) sta bili dva od treh velikih uporov Keltiberov (ohlapnega zavezništva keltskih plemen v vzhodnem osrednjem delu Hispanije, med katerimi lahko omenimo Pelendone, Arevake, Luzone, Tite in Bele) proti navzočnosti Rimljanov v Hispaniji.

Ob koncu druge punske vojne so Kartažani nadzor nad svojimi hispanskimi ozemlji prepustili Rimu. Keltiberi so mejili na to novo rimsko provinco. Začeli so se spopadati z rimsko vojsko, ki je delovala na območjih okoli Keltiberije, kar je privedlo do prve keltiberske vojne. Rimska zmaga v tej vojni in mirovne pogodbe, ki jih je rimski pretor Grakh sklenil z več plemeni, so prinesle 24 let razmernega miru.

source.title: Celtiberian Wars
paragraphs: The First Celtiberian War (181–179 BC) and Second Celtiberian War (154–151 BC) were two of the three major rebellions by the Celtiberians (a loose alliance of Celtic tribes living in east central Hispania, among which we can name the Pellendones, the Arevaci, the Lusones, the Titti and the Belli) against the presence of the Romans in Hispania.

When the Second Punic War ended, the Carthaginians relinquished the control of its Hispanic territories to Rome. The Celtiberians shared a border with this new Roman province. They started to confront the Roman army acting in the areas around Celtiberia and this led to the First Celtiberian War. The Roman victory in this war and the peace treaties established by the Roman praetor Gracchus with several tribes led to 24 years of relative peace.

Charge at Krojanty.headline: Juriš pri Krojantyh
paragraphs: Juriš pri Krojantyh (tudi bitka, napad ali spopad pri Krojantyh) je bil napad poljske konjenice zvečer 1. septembra 1939, prvi dan druge svetovne vojne, blizu pomorjanske vasi Krojanty. Zgodil se je na začetku invazije na Poljsko in je bil del večje bitke v Tucholskih gozdovih. Poljski vojaki so prodirali proti vzhodu ob železnici do železniškega križišča 7 kilometrov od mesta Chojnice, kjer so deli poljske konjenice napadli in razkropili nemški pehotni bataljon. Mitralješki ogenj nemških oklepnih avtomobilov, ki so prišli iz bližnjega gozda, je Poljake prisilil k umiku. Napad pa je zavlekel nemško prodiranje in omogočil, da sta se poljski 1. strelski bataljon in operativna skupina Czersk varno umaknila.
notes: The mile figure is dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Charge at Krojanty
paragraphs: The charge at Krojanty, battle of Krojanty, the riding of Krojanty or skirmish of Krojanty was a Polish cavalry charge on the evening of 1 September 1939, the first day of the Second World War, near the Pomeranian village of Krojanty. It occurred at the start of the invasion of Poland and was part of the larger Battle of Tuchola Forest. Polish soldiers advanced east along the railway to a railroad crossroads 7 kilometres (4.3 mi) from the town of Chojnice, where elements of the Polish cavalry charged and dispersed a German infantry battalion. Machine gun fire from German armoured cars that appeared from a nearby forest forced the Poles to retreat. However, the attack delayed the German advance, allowing the Polish 1st Rifle Battalion and Czersk Operational Group to withdraw safely.

Napad lahke konjenice je bil vojaški podvig britanske lahke konjenice proti ruskim silam v bitki pri Balaklavi med krimsko vojno, v katerem je konjenica utrpela veliko žrtev. Lahka brigada pod vodstvom lorda Cardigana je 25. oktobra 1854 čelno napadla rusko topniško baterijo, ki je bila dobro pripravljena in je imela odlično obrambno strelno polje. Napad je bil posledica napačno razumljenega ukaza vrhovnega poveljnika lorda Raglana, ki je hotel, da lahka brigada napade drug cilj, primernejši za lahko konjenico, in Rusom prepreči, da bi odpeljali topove, zaplenjene na zavzetih turških položajih. Lahka brigada je napadla pod uničujočim neposrednim ognjem in dosegla cilj ter razpršila nekaj topničarjev, vendar se je morala takoj umakniti.

source.title: Charge of the Light Brigade
paragraphs: The Charge of the Light Brigade was a military action undertaken by British light cavalry against Russian forces during the Battle of Balaclava in the Crimean War, resulting in many casualties to the cavalry. On 25 October 1854, the Light Brigade, led by Lord Cardigan, mounted a frontal assault against a Russian artillery battery which was well-prepared with excellent fields of defensive fire. The charge was the result of a misunderstood order from the commander-in-chief, Lord Raglan, who had intended the Light Brigade to attack a different objective for which light cavalry was better suited, to prevent the Russians from removing captured guns from overrun Turkish positions. The Light Brigade made its charge under withering direct fire and reached its target, scattering some of the gunners, but was forced to retreat immediately.

Chouannerie.headline: Chouannerie
paragraphs: Chouannerie (po bratih Chouan, dveh njenih voditeljih) je bila rojalistična vstaja ali protirevolucija v dvanajstih zahodnih departmajih Francije, zlasti v provincah Bretanja in Maine, proti prvi republiki med francosko revolucijo. Potekala je v treh fazah in trajala od pomladi 1794 do leta 1800. Upor je bil primerljiv z vojno v Vendéeju, ki je potekala v pokrajini Vendée.
notes: The French pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Chouannerie
paragraphs: The Chouannerie (French pronunciation: [ʃwanʁi]; from the Chouan brothers, two of its leaders) was a royalist uprising or counter-revolution in twelve of the western départements of France, particularly in the provinces of Brittany and Maine, against the First Republic during the French Revolution. It played out in three phases and lasted from spring 1794 to 1800. The revolt was comparable to the War in the Vendée, which took place in the Vendée region.

Chremonidean War.headline: Hremonidova vojna
paragraphs: Hremonidova vojna (starogrško: Χρεμωνίδειος Πόλεμος; 267–261 pr. n. št.) je bila vojna koalicije grških mestnih držav in ptolemajskega Egipta proti antigonidski Makedoniji. Končala se je z makedonsko zmago, ki je potrdila antigonidski nadzor nad Grčijo. Spopad velja za prelomni dogodek v zgodovini helenistične Grčije, saj je bil zadnji resen poskus grških mestnih držav, da bi si povrnile neodvisnost.

Hremonidova vojna je slabo dokumentirana in znana predvsem iz drobcev poznejših zgodovinarjev Pavzanija in Justina. Atene in Šparta sta si prizadevali za vrnitev nekdanje neodvisnosti, ambicije Ptolemaja II. Filadelfa, faraona ptolemajskega Egipta, v Egejskem morju pa je ogrožalo ladjevje Antigona Gonata, zato je med grškimi mestnimi državami sestavil protimakedonsko koalicijo. Atene si je pridobil z dobavami žita.

source.title: Chremonidean War
paragraphs: The Chremonidean War (Ancient Greek: Χρεμωνίδειος Πόλεμος) (267–261 BC) was fought by a coalition of Greek city-states and Ptolemaic Egypt against Antigonid Macedonia. It ended in a Macedonian victory that confirmed Antigonid control over Greece. The conflict is considered a seminal event in the history of Greece during the Hellenistic period, as it was the last credible effort by the Greek city-states to re-establish their independence.

The Chremonidean War is poorly documented and known mostly through fragmentary accounts by later historians Pausanias and Justin. Athens and Sparta sought a restoration of their former independence, while the ambitions of Ptolemy II Philadelphus, pharaoh of Ptolemaic Egypt, in the Aegean were threatened by Antigonus Gonatas's fleet, so he built an anti-Macedonian coalition among the Greek city-states. He courted Athens by supplying the city with grain.

Cleomenean War.headline: Kleomenova vojna
paragraphs: Kleomenova vojna (229/228–222 pr. n. št.) je potekala med Šparto in Ahajsko zvezo za nadzor nad Peloponezom. Pod vodstvom kralja Kleomena III. je imela Šparta sprva premoč, zato je morala Ahajska zveza na pomoč poklicati makedonskega kralja Antigona Dosona, ki je Kleomena leta 222 odločilno premagal v bitki pri Selaziji.

Leta 235 pr. n. št. je na špartanski prestol stopil Kleomen III. (vladal 235–222 pr. n. št.) in začel reforme, s katerimi je želel obnoviti tradicionalno špartansko disciplino in oslabiti vpliv eforov, izvoljenih uradnikov, ki so sicer prisegali, da bodo varovali oblast špartanskih kraljev, a so do Kleomenovega časa v špartanskem sistemu pridobili izjemno politično moč. Ko so efori leta 229 pr. n. št. Kleomena poslali zavzet mesto na meji z Megalopolisom, so Ahajci napovedali vojno. Kleomen je odgovoril s pustošenjem Ahaje. Pri gori Likajon je premagal vojsko Arata iz Sikiona, stratega Ahajske zveze, ki je bila poslana nad Elido, nato pa pri Megalopolisu pognal v beg še drugo vojsko.

source.title: Cleomenean War
paragraphs: The Cleomenean War (229/228–222 BC) was fought between Sparta and the Achaean League for the control of the Peloponnese. Under the leadership of king Cleomenes III, Sparta initially had the upper hand, which forced the Achaean League to call for help the Macedonian king Antigonos Doson, who decisively defeated Cleomenes in the battle of Sellasia in 222.

In 235 BC, Cleomenes III (r. 235–222 BC) ascended the throne of Sparta and began a program of reform aimed at restoring traditional Spartan discipline while weakening the influence of the ephors, elected officials who, though sworn to uphold the rule of Sparta's kings, had by the time of Cleomenes come to wield extraordinary political power in the Spartan system. When, in 229 BC, the ephors sent Cleomenes to seize a town on the border with Megalopolis, the Achaeans declared war. Cleomenes responded by ravaging Achaea. At Mount Lycaeum he defeated an army under Aratus of Sicyon, the strategos of the Achaean League, that had been sent to attack Elis, and then routed a second army near Megalopolis.

Colmar Pocket.headline: Colmarski žep
paragraphs: Colmarski žep (francosko: Poche de Colmar; nemško: Brückenkopf Elsass) je bil območje v osrednji Alzaciji v Franciji, ki ga je od novembra 1944 do februarja 1945 nemška 19. armada držala proti ameriški 6. armadni skupini (6. AG) med drugo svetovno vojno. Nastal je, ko je 6. armadna skupina osvobodila južno in severno Alzacijo ter sosednjo vzhodno Loreno, osrednje Alzacije pa ni mogla očistiti. Med operacijo Nordwind decembra 1944 je 19. armada iz žepa napadla proti severu v podporo drugim nemškim silam, ki so iz Posarja napadale proti jugu v severno Alzacijo. Konec januarja in v začetku februarja 1945 je francoska 1. armada (okrepljena z ameriškim XXI. korpusom) žep očistila nemških sil.

source.title: Colmar Pocket
paragraphs: The Colmar Pocket (French: Poche de Colmar; German: Brückenkopf Elsass) was the area held in central Alsace, France, by the German Nineteenth Army from November 1944 to February 1945, against the U.S. 6th Army Group (6th AG) during World War II. It was formed when 6th AG liberated southern and northern Alsace and adjacent eastern Lorraine, but could not clear central Alsace. During Operation Nordwind in December 1944, the 19th Army attacked north out of the Pocket in support of other German forces attacking south from the Saar into northern Alsace. In late January and early February 1945, the French First Army (reinforced by the U.S. XXI Corps) cleared the Pocket of German forces.

Combat of the Thirty.headline: Boj tridesetih
paragraphs: Boj tridesetih (francosko: Combat des Trente, bretonsko: Emgann an Tregont), ki se je zgodil 26. marca 1351, je bil epizoda bretonske nasledstvene vojne, v kateri se je odločalo, kdo bo vladal Vojvodini Bretanji. Šlo je za dogovorjeni boj med izbranimi borci obeh strani na kraju na pol poti med bretonskima gradovoma Josselin in Ploërmel, s po 30 borci, vitezi in oprodami na vsaki strani. Izziv je izrekel Jean de Beaumanoir, kapitan Karla Bloiškega, ki ga je podpiral francoski kralj Filip VI., Robertu Bemboroughu, kapitanu Ivana Montforta, ki ga je podpiral angleški kralj Edvard III.

Po trdem boju je zmagala francosko-bretonska stranka Karla Bloiškega. Srednjeveški kronisti in pevci balad so boj pozneje slavili kot plemenit prikaz viteških idealov. Po besedah Jeana Froissarta so se bojevniki »na obeh straneh držali tako hrabro, kot da bi bili sami Rolandi in Oliverji«.

source.title: Combat of the Thirty
paragraphs: The Combat of the Thirty (French: Combat des Trente, Breton: Emgann an Tregont), occurring on 26 March 1351, was an episode in the Breton War of Succession fought to determine who would rule the Duchy of Brittany. It was an arranged fight between selected combatants from both sides of the conflict, fought at a site midway between the Breton castles of Josselin and Ploërmel among 30 champions, knights, and squires on each side. The challenge was issued by Jean de Beaumanoir, a captain of Charles of Blois supported by King Philip VI of France, to Robert Bemborough, a captain of Jean de Montfort supported by Edward III of England.

After a hard-fought battle, the Franco-Breton Blois faction emerged victorious. The combat was later celebrated by medieval chroniclers and balladeers as a noble display of the ideals of chivalry. In the words of Jean Froissart, the warriors "held themselves as valiantly on both sides as if they had been all Rolands and Olivers".

Angleška republika (Commonwealth of England), ki se je leta 1653 razširila v Republiko Anglijo, Škotsko in Irsko, je bila politična ureditev v obdobju 1649–1660, ko je bilo Kraljestvo Anglija po koncu druge angleške državljanske vojne ter sojenju in usmrtitvi Karla I. razpuščeno in spremenjeno v republiko. Obstoj republike je razglasil zakon »An Act declaring England to be a Commonwealth« (Zakon o razglasitvi Anglije za republiko), ki ga je okrnjeni parlament (Rump Parliament) sprejel 19. maja 1649. Oblast v zgodnji republiki sta imela predvsem parlament in državni svet. V tem času so se nadaljevali boji med parlamentarnimi silami in njihovimi nasprotniki, zlasti na Irskem in Škotskem: Cromwellova osvojitev Irske in angleško-škotska vojna v letih 1650–1652.

source.title: Commonwealth of England
paragraphs: The Commonwealth of England, enlarged in 1653 as the Commonwealth of England, Scotland and Ireland, was the political structure during the period from 1649 to 1660 when the Kingdom of England was dissolved into a republic after the end of the Second English Civil War and the trial and execution of Charles I. The republic's existence was declared through "An Act declaring England to be a Commonwealth", adopted by the Rump Parliament on 19 May 1649. Power in the early Commonwealth was vested primarily in the Parliament and a Council of State. During the period, fighting continued, particularly in Ireland and Scotland, between the parliamentary forces and those opposed to them, in the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland and the Anglo-Scottish war of 1650–1652.

Compromise of Caspe.headline: Kompromis iz Caspeja
paragraphs: Kompromis iz Caspeja leta 1412 (špansko: Compromiso de Caspe, katalonsko: Compromís de Casp) je bil dogovor in sklep parlamentarnih predstavnikov sestavnih kraljestev Aragonske krone (Kraljestva Aragonija, Kraljestva Valencija in Kneževine Katalonija), ki so se sestali v Caspeju, da bi razrešili medvladje po smrti aragonskega kralja Martina leta 1410, ki je umrl brez zakonitega dediča. Po moški liniji, kot je določala oporoka aragonskega kralja Jakoba I., bi moral prestol pripasti Jakobu II., grofu Urgella, vendar so ga zahtevali še številni drugi, kar je privedlo do »konklava« in kompromisa.

source.title: Compromise of Caspe
paragraphs: The 1412 Compromise of Caspe (Compromiso de Caspe in Spanish, Compromís de Casp in Catalan) was an act and resolution of parliamentary representatives of the constituent realms of the Crown of Aragon (the Kingdom of Aragon, Kingdom of Valencia, and Principality of Catalonia), meeting in Caspe, to resolve the interregnum following the death of King Martin of Aragon in 1410 without a legitimate heir. Succession through the male line, as ordained in the will of James I of Aragon should have gone to James II, Count of Urgell, however multiple others claimed the throne, which led to the "conclave" and compromise.

Konkordat iz leta 1801 je sporazum med prvo francosko republiko in Svetim sedežem, ki sta ga 15. julija 1801 v Parizu podpisala prvi konzul Napoleon Bonaparte in papež Pij VII. Veljal je do leta 1905, razen v Alzaciji in Loreni, kjer velja še danes. Z njim so skušali doseči narodno spravo med francosko revolucijo in katoličani; Katoliško cerkev je utrdil kot večinsko cerkev v Franciji in ji povrnil večino civilnega položaja. S tem se je končalo sovraštvo pobožnih francoskih katoličanov do revolucionarne države. Ni pa vrnil obsežnih cerkvenih zemljišč in nadarbin, ki so jih med revolucijo zaplenili in razprodali. Katoliška duhovščina se je vrnila iz izgnanstva ali skrivališč in znova prevzela tradicionalne položaje v tradicionalnih cerkvah. Le redke župnije so še naprej zaposlovale duhovnike, ki so sprejeli civilno ustavo duhovščine revolucionarnega režima. Konkordat je papeštvu povrnil precej moči, vendar se je ravnotežje v odnosih med cerkvijo in državo trdno nagnilo v Bonapartejevo korist: izbiral je škofe in nadzoroval cerkvene finance.

source.title: Concordat of 1801
paragraphs: The Concordat of 1801 is an agreement between the First French Republic and the Holy See, signed by First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte and Pope Pius VII on 15 July 1801 in Paris. It remained in effect until 1905, except in Alsace–Lorraine, where it remains in force. It sought national reconciliation between the French Revolution and Catholics and solidified the Catholic Church as the majority church of France, with most of its civil status restored. This resolved the hostility of devout French Catholics against the revolutionary state. It did not restore the vast Church lands and endowments that had been seized during the Revolution and sold off. Catholic clergy returned from exile, or from hiding, and resumed their traditional positions in their traditional churches. Very few parishes continued to employ the priests who had accepted the Civil Constitution of the Clergy of the revolutionary regime. While the Concordat restored much power to the papacy, the balance of church-state relations tilted firmly in Bonaparte's favour. He selected the bishops and supervised church finances.

Concordat of Bologna.headline: Bolonjski konkordat
paragraphs: Bolonjski konkordat (1516) je bil sporazum med francoskim kraljem Francem I. in papežem Leonom X., ki ga je Franc izpogajal po zmagi pri Marignanu septembra 1515. Temelje so postavila osebna srečanja kralja in papeža v Bologni od 11. do 15. decembra 1515. Konkordat so podpisali v Rimu 18. avgusta 1516. Pomenil je stopnjo v razvoju galikanske cerkve.

Konkordat je izrecno nadomestil bourgeško pragmatično sankcijo (1438), ki se je izkazala za neučinkovito pri zagotavljanju cerkvenih privilegijev v Franciji, kjer so se za škofije in opatije prerekali že pred pariškim parlamentom: »Skoraj nikjer volitve niso potekale po predpisih,« ugotavlja R. Aubenas, »saj je kralju z vsemi mogočimi sredstvi, ne da bi se izogibal najbolj neusmiljenim, uspelo volilcem vsiliti lastne kandidate.«

source.title: Concordat of Bologna
paragraphs: The Concordat of Bologna (1516) was an agreement between King Francis I of France and Pope Leo X that Francis negotiated in the wake of his victory at Marignano in September 1515. The groundwork was laid in a series of personal meetings of king and pope in Bologna, 11–15 December 1515. The concordat was signed in Rome on 18 August 1516. It marked a stage in the evolution of the Gallican Church.

The Concordat explicitly superseded the Pragmatic Sanction of Bourges (1438), which had proved ineffective in guaranteeing the privileges of the Church in France, where bishoprics and abbacies had been wrangled over even before the Parlement of Paris: "hardly anywhere were elections held in due form", R. Aubenas observes, "for the king succeeded in foisting his own candidates upon the electors by every conceivable means, not excluding the most ruthless".

Irska konfederacija, imenovana tudi Irska katoliška konfederacija, je bila obdobje irske katoliške samouprave med letoma 1642 in 1652, med enajstletno vojno. Ustanovili so jo katoliški aristokrati, zemljiško plemstvo, duhovščina in vojaški voditelji po irskem uporu leta 1641; konfederati so s sedežem v Kilkennyju nadzorovali do dve tretjini Irske, zato jo včasih imenujejo tudi konfederacija iz Kilkennyja.

source.title: Confederate Ireland
paragraphs: Confederate Ireland, also referred to as the Irish Catholic Confederation, was a period of Irish Catholic self-government between 1642 and 1652, during the Eleven Years' War. Formed by Catholic aristocrats, landed gentry, clergy and military leaders after the Irish Rebellion of 1641, the Confederates controlled up to two-thirds of Ireland from their base in Kilkenny; hence it is sometimes called the Confederation of Kilkenny.

Congress of Arras.headline: Kongres v Arrasu
paragraphs: Kongres v Arrasu je bil diplomatsko srečanje predstavnikov Anglije, Francije in Burgundije v Arrasu poleti 1435 med stoletno vojno. To so bila prva pogajanja po pogodbi iz Troyesa; nadomestila so petnajst let star sporazum med Burgundijo in Anglijo, po katerem naj bi francosko krono podedovala dinastija Henrika V. Zgodovinar Richard Vaughan ga je imenoval »prvi pravi mirovni kongres v Evropi«.
Proti koncu stoletne vojne sta tako kongres kot poznejša arraška pogodba pomenila diplomatski neuspeh za Anglijo in velik uspeh za Francijo ter privedla do izgona Angležev iz Francije.

source.title: Congress of Arras
paragraphs: The Congress of Arras was a diplomatic congregation established at Arras in the summer of 1435 during the Hundred Years' War, between representatives of England, France and Burgundy. It was the first negotiation since the Treaty of Troyes and replaced the fifteen-year agreement between Burgundy and England that would have seen the dynasty of Henry V inherit the French crown. Historian Richard Vaughan has called it "Europe's first real peace congress".

Toward the close of the Hundred Years' War, both the Congress and the subsequent Treaty of Arras represented diplomatic failures for England and major successes for France and led to the expulsion of the English from France.

Zavzetje Majorke je bilo osvojitev otoka v imenu rimskokatoliških kraljestev, ki jo je med letoma 1229 in 1231 izpeljal aragonski kralj Jakob I. Dogovor o invaziji, ki so ga sklenili Jakob I. ter cerkveni in posvetni voditelji, je bil potrjen 28. avgusta 1229 v Tarragoni. Bil je odprt in vsem, ki so hoteli sodelovati, obljubljal enake pogoje.

Jakob I. se je o prihodu katoliških enot dogovoril s krajevnim poglavarjem v Port de Pollença, vendar je moral kralj zaradi močnega mistrala zaviti na južni del otoka. Izkrcal se je opolnoči 10. septembra 1229 na obali, kjer je danes turistično letovišče Santa Ponsa, središče občine Calvià. Čeprav je mesto Madina Majurka (danes Palma de Mallorca) padlo že v prvem letu osvojitve, je muslimanski odpor v gorah trajal tri leta.

source.title: Conquest of Majorca
paragraphs: The conquest of the island of Majorca on behalf of the Roman Catholic kingdoms was carried out by King James I of Aragon between 1229 and 1231. The pact to carry out the invasion, concluded between James I and the ecclesiastical and secular leaders, was ratified in Tarragona on 28 August 1229. It was open and promised conditions of parity for all who wished to participate.

James I reached an agreement regarding the arrival of the Catholic troops with a local chief in the Port de Pollença, but the strong mistral winds forced the king to divert to the southern part of the island. He landed at midnight on 10 September 1229, on the coast where there is now the tourist resort of Santa Ponsa, the population centre of the Calviá municipality. Although the city of Madina Mayurqa (now Palma de Mallorca) fell within the first year of the conquest, the Muslim resistance in the mountains lasted for three years.

Convention for the Protection of Human R.headline: Oviedska konvencija
paragraphs: Konvencija o varstvu človekovih pravic in dostojanstva človeškega bitja v zvezi z uporabo biologije in medicine, znana tudi kot Evropska konvencija o bioetiki, je mednarodni instrument, katerega namen je prepovedati zlorabo novosti v biomedicini in varovati človekovo dostojanstvo. Konvencija je bila 4. aprila 1997 v Oviedu v Španiji dana na voljo za podpis, zato jo imenujejo tudi Oviedska konvencija. Mednarodna pogodba izraža prizadevanje Sveta Evrope, da bi sledil razvoju na področju biomedicine; je prva večstranska zavezujoča listina, posvečena izključno biopravu. Konvencija je začela veljati 1. decembra 1999.

source.title: Convention for the Protection of Human Rights and Dignity of the Human Being with regard to the Application of Biology and Medicine
paragraphs: The Convention for the Protection of Human Rights and Dignity of the Human Being with regard to the Application of Biology and Medicine, otherwise known as the European Convention on Bioethics or the European Bioethics Convention, is an international instrument aiming to prohibit the misuse of innovations in biomedicine and to protect human dignity. The Convention was opened for signature on 4 April 1997 in Oviedo, Spain and is thus otherwise known as the Oviedo Convention. The International treaty is a manifestation of the effort on the part of the Council of Europe to keep pace with developments in the field of biomedicine; it is notably the first multilateral binding instrument entirely devoted to biolaw. The Convention entered into force on 1 December 1999.

Convention of 1800.headline: Konvencija iz leta 1800
paragraphs: Konvencija iz leta 1800, znana tudi kot pogodba iz Mortefontaina (francosko: Traité de Mortefontaine), je bila pogodba, ki so jo 30. septembra 1800 podpisale Združene države in Francija. Različno ime je bilo posledica občutljivosti kongresa pri sklepanju pogodb zaradi sporov o zavezniški in trgovinski pogodbi med Francijo in ZDA iz leta 1778.

Konvencija je odpravila sporazuma iz leta 1778, potrdila načelo »svobodna trgovina, svobodno blago« med državama in končala kvazivojno 1798–1800, nenapovedano pomorsko vojno, ki je potekala predvsem na Karibih. Ni pa rešila vprašanja odškodnin, ki so jih ameriški ladjarji zahtevali za izgube pred kvazivojno in med njo, zato jo je kongres potrdil šele decembra 1801.
Ker je odpravila vire trenj med državama, je obnovila francosko-ameriške odnose in nazadnje olajšala nakup Louisiane leta 1803.

source.title: Convention of 1800
paragraphs: The Convention of 1800, also known as the Treaty of Mortefontaine (French: Traité de Mortefontaine), was signed on September 30, 1800, by the United States and France. The difference in name was due to congressional sensitivity at entering into treaties, due to disputes over the 1778 treaties of Alliance and Commerce between France and the U.S.

The Convention terminated the 1778 agreements, confirmed the principle of 'free trade, free goods' between the two countries and ended the 1798–1800 Quasi-War, an undeclared naval war waged primarily in the Caribbean. However, it failed to address the issue of compensation demanded by American ship owners for losses suffered before and during the Quasi-War, and as a result was not approved by Congress until December 1801.
By removing areas of friction between the two countries, it re-established Franco-American relations, and ultimately facilitated the 1803 Louisiana Purchase.

Convention of London (1840).headline: Londonska konvencija (1840)
paragraphs: Londonska konvencija iz leta 1840 je bila pogodba z naslovom Konvencija o pomiritvi Levanta, ki so jo 15. julija 1840 podpisale velesile Združeno kraljestvo, Avstrija, Prusija in Rusija na eni strani ter Osmansko cesarstvo na drugi. Konvencija je nekoliko podprla Osmansko cesarstvo, ki je imelo težave z upornim egiptovskim valijem.
Ker Mohamed Ali Egiptovski pogojev konvencije ni sprejel, je izbruhnila orientalska kriza leta 1840. Mohamed Ali je moral konvencijo nazadnje sprejeti 27. novembra 1840.

source.title: Convention of London (1840)
paragraphs: The Convention of London of 1840 was a treaty with the title of Convention for the Pacification of the Levant, signed on 15 July 1840 between the Great Powers of United Kingdom, Austria, Prussia, Russia on one hand and the Ottoman Empire on the other. The Convention lent some support to the Ottoman Empire, which was having difficulties with the rebellious Wali of Egypt.
Because Muhammad Ali of Egypt did not accept the terms of the convention, the Oriental Crisis of 1840 resulted. Thus, Muhammad Ali finally had to accept the convention on 27 November 1840.

Convention of Vergara.headline: Konvencija iz Vergare
paragraphs: Konvencija iz Vergare (špansko: Convenio de Vergara, baskovsko: Bergarako hitzarmena), sklenjena 31. avgusta 1839, je bila pogodba, s katero so se uspešno končali glavni boji prve karlistične vojne v Španiji. Pogodbo, znano tudi pod mnogimi drugimi imeni, med njimi objem iz Vergare (špansko: Abrazo de Vergara), sta podpisala Baldomero Espartero za izabelince (ali »konstitucionaliste«) in Rafael Maroto za karliste.

Generala sta se srečala v puščavniški kapeli San Antolín de Abadiano blizu Duranga v Biskaji. Kot opazovalec je bil navzoč britanski komisar polkovnik Wylde, zaradi nedavne posredniške vloge Britanije v spopadu in konvencije lorda Eliota o vojnih ujetnikih iz leta 1835, ki naj bi predvsem končala neselektivne usmrtitve s strelskim vodom, ki sta jih izvajali obe strani. Navzoč je bil tudi brigadir Francisco Linage, Esparterov tajnik.

source.title: Convention of Vergara
paragraphs: The Convention of Vergara (Spanish: Convenio de Vergara, Basque: Bergarako hitzarmena), entered into on 31 August 1839, was a treaty successfully ending the major fighting in Spain's First Carlist War. The treaty, also known by many other names including the Embrace of Vergara (Spanish: Abrazo de Vergara), was signed by Baldomero Espartero for the Isabelines (or "Constitutionalists") and Rafael Maroto for the Carlists.

The two generals met at the hermitage of San Antolín de Abadiano near Durango, Biscay. The British commissioner Colonel Wylde attended as an observer, because of Britain's recent role as mediator in the conflict and the 1835 Lord Eliot Convention on prisoners of war, mainly to end the indiscriminate executions by firing squad that had been committed by both sides. Also present was Brigadier Francisco Linage, secretary to Espartero.

Convention on Certain Conventional Weapo.headline: Konvencija o nekaterih vrstah konvencionalnega orožja
paragraphs: Konvencija Združenih narodov o nekaterih vrstah konvencionalnega orožja (CCW ali CCWC), sklenjena v Ženevi 10. oktobra 1980, ki je začela veljati decembra 1983, si prizadeva prepovedati ali omejiti uporabo nekaterih vrst konvencionalnega orožja, ki veljajo za čezmerno škodljiva ali katerih učinki so nerazlikovalni. Polni naslov pogodbe je »Konvencija o prepovedi ali omejitvi uporabe nekaterih vrst konvencionalnega orožja, za katere se šteje, da imajo čezmerne travmatične učinke ali da delujejo slepo«. Konvencija zajema kopenske mine, nastavljene eksplozivne pasti, zažigalna sredstva, oslepljujoče lasersko orožje in odstranjevanje eksplozivnih ostankov vojne.

source.title: Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons
paragraphs: The United Nations Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons (CCW or CCWC), concluded at Geneva on October 10, 1980, and entered into force in December 1983, seeks to prohibit or restrict the use of certain conventional weapons which are considered excessively injurious or whose effects are indiscriminate. The full title of the treaty is "Convention on Prohibitions or Restrictions on the Use of Certain Conventional Weapons Which May Be Deemed to Be Excessively Injurious or to Have Indiscriminate Effects." The convention covers land mines, booby traps, incendiary devices, blinding laser weapons and clearance of explosive remnants of war.

Convention on Psychotropic Substances.headline: Konvencija o psihotropnih snoveh
paragraphs: Konvencija o psihotropnih snoveh iz leta 1971 je pogodba Združenih narodov za nadzor nad psihoaktivnimi drogami, kot so stimulansi amfetaminskega tipa, barbiturati, benzodiazepini in psihedeliki, podpisana 21. februarja 1971 na Dunaju v Avstriji. Enotna konvencija o mamilih iz leta 1961 številnih na novo odkritih psihotropnih snovi ni prepovedala, saj je bila omejena na droge z učinki, podobnimi konoplji, koki in opiju.

source.title: Convention on Psychotropic Substances
paragraphs: The Convention on Psychotropic Substances of 1971 is a United Nations treaty designed to control psychoactive drugs such as amphetamine-type stimulants, barbiturates, benzodiazepines, and psychedelics signed in Vienna, Austria on 21 February 1971. The Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs of 1961 did not ban the many newly discovered psychotropics, since its scope was limited to drugs with cannabis, coca and opium-like effects.

Convention on the Conservation of Migrat.headline: Bonnska konvencija o selitvenih vrstah
paragraphs: Konvencija o varstvu selitvenih vrst prosto živečih živali, znana tudi kot Konvencija o selitvenih vrstah (CMS) ali Bonnska konvencija, je mednarodni sporazum, katerega cilj je varovati selitvene vrste na celotnem območju njihove razširjenosti. Sporazum je bil podpisan pod okriljem Programa Združenih narodov za okolje in se ukvarja z varstvom prosto živečih živali in njihovih habitatov v svetovnem merilu.
Konvencija je bila podpisana leta 1979 v Bonnu v Zahodni Nemčiji, veljati pa je začela leta 1983. Marca 2022 je imela 132 držav članic. Depozitar je vlada Zvezne republike Nemčije.

CMS je edina svetovna medvladna organizacija v okviru Združenih narodov, ustanovljena izključno za varstvo in upravljanje kopenskih, vodnih in ptičjih selitvenih vrst. CMS in njeni hčerinski sporazumi določajo politiko in dajejo nadaljnje usmeritve o posameznih vprašanjih s strateškimi načrti, akcijskimi načrti, resolucijami, odločitvami in smernicami.

source.title: Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals
paragraphs: The Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals, also known as the Convention on Migratory Species (CMS) or the Bonn Convention, is an international agreement that aims to conserve migratory species throughout their ranges. The agreement was signed under the auspices of the United Nations Environment Programme and is concerned with conservation of wildlife and habitats on a global scale.

Signed in 1979 in Bonn, West Germany, the convention entered into force in 1983. As of March 2022, there are 132 Member States to the convention. The depositary is the Government of the Federal Republic of Germany.

The CMS is the only global, and United Nations-based, intergovernmental organization established exclusively for the conservation and management of terrestrial, aquatic and avian migratory species. The CMS, and its daughter agreements, determine policy and provide further guidance on specific issues through their strategic plans, action plans, resolutions, decisions and guidelines.

Cornish rebellion of 1497.headline: Cornwallski upor leta 1497
paragraphs: Cornwallski upor leta 1497 (kornijsko: Rebellyans Kernow), znan tudi kot prvi cornwallski upor, je bil ljudska vstaja v Kraljevini Angliji, ki se je začela v Cornwallu in dosegla vrhunec z bitko pri Deptfordskem mostu blizu Londona 17. junija 1497.

Uporniško vojsko so sestavljali predvsem prebivalci Cornwalla, dobila pa je podporo tudi v Devonu, Somersetu in drugih angleških grofijah. Upor je bil odziv na stisko, ki so jo povzročili vojni davki kralja Henrika VII. za financiranje pohoda proti Škotski. Cornwall je trpel še posebej, ker je kralj nedavno ustavil zakonito delovanje cornwallskih rudnikov kositra.

source.title: Cornish rebellion of 1497
paragraphs: The Cornish rebellion of 1497 (Cornish: Rebellyans Kernow), also known as the First Cornish rebellion, was a popular uprising in the Kingdom of England, which began in Cornwall and culminated with the Battle of Deptford Bridge near London on 17 June 1497.

The insurgent army mainly comprised Cornishmen, although it also gathered support from Devon, Somerset, and other English counties. The rebellion was a response to hardship caused by the raising of war taxes by King Henry VII to finance a campaign against Scotland. Cornwall suffered particularly because the king had recently stopped the legal operation of Cornish tin mining.

Grofija Anžu (latinsko: Andegavia) je bila francoska grofija, predhodnica Vojvodine Anžu. Glavno mesto je bil Angers, njeno ozemlje pa se je približno ujemalo s škofijo Angers. Anžu je na zahodu mejil na Bretanjo, na severu na Maine, na vzhodu na Touraine in na jugu na Poitou. Njen grof Godfrej iz 12. stoletja je ustvaril jedro poznejšega Anžujskega imperija. Pridevnik je anžujski (angevin), prebivalci Anžuja pa so Anžujci. Leta 1360 je bila grofija povzdignjena v Vojvodino Anžu v Kraljevini Franciji. Vojvodina je bila leta 1482 priključena francoski kraljevi domeni in je ostala provinca kraljestva do leta 1790.
notes: The pronunciation guides are dropped.

source.title: County of Anjou
paragraphs: The County of Anjou (UK:, US:; French: [ɑ̃ʒu]; Latin: Andegavia) was a French county that was the predecessor to the Duchy of Anjou. Its capital was Angers, and its area was roughly co-extensive with the diocese of Angers. Anjou was bordered by Brittany to the west, Maine to the north, Touraine to the east and Poitou to the south. Its 12th-century Count Geoffrey created the nucleus of what became the Angevin Empire. The adjectival form is Angevin, and inhabitants of Anjou are known as Angevins. In 1360, the county was raised into the Duchy of Anjou within the Kingdom of France. This duchy was later absorbed into the French royal domain in 1482, and remained a province of the kingdom until 1790.

Grofija Aragonija (aragonsko: Condato d'Aragón) ali grofija Jaca (aragonsko: Condato de Chaca) je bila majhna frankovska mejna grofija v osrednji pirenejski dolini reke Aragón, ki je obsegala Ansó, Echo in Canfranc s središčem v mestecu Jaca (latinsko Iacca, aragonsko Chaca), na območju današnje Španije. Ustanovili so jo Karolingi konec 8. ali v začetku 9. stoletja, a je kmalu prišla pod vpliv navarskega kraljestva, ki mu je bila leta 922 priključena. Pozneje je postala jedro aragonskega kraljestva v 11. stoletju.

source.title: County of Aragon
paragraphs: The County of Aragon (Aragonese: Condato d'Aragón) or County of Jaca (Aragonese: Condato de Chaca) was a small Frankish marcher county in the central Pyrenean valley of the Aragon river, comprising Ansó, Echo, and Canfranc and centered on the small town of Jaca (Iacca in Latin and Chaca in Aragonese), an area now part of Spain. It was created by the Carolingians late in the 8th or early in the 9th century, but soon fell into the orbit of the Kingdom of Navarre, into which it was absorbed in 922. It would later form the core of the 11th century Kingdom of Aragon.

County of Armagnac.headline: Grofija Armagnac
paragraphs: Grofija Armagnac (gaskonsko: Armanhac) med rekama Adour in Garona v nižjem predgorju Pirenejev je bila zgodovinska grofija Vojvodine Gaskonje, ustanovljena leta 601 v Akvitaniji (danes Francija). Leta 960 je bil ustanovljen naslov »grof Armagnaca« in s tem grofija Armagnac. Leta 1751 je po smrti Charlesa de Lorraine, grofa Armagnaca, ki ni imel otrok, naslov grofije prešel na posesti francoske krone, kralj, tedaj Ludvik XV., pa je prevzel naslov »grof Armagnaca« (Comte d'Armagnac). Leta 1791 je bila grofija po odloku o razdelitvi Francije na departmaje odpravljena, a ostaja pomembna naravna pokrajina Francije.
notes: The pronunciation guides are dropped.

source.title: County of Armagnac
paragraphs: The County of Armagnac (US:, French: [aʁmaɲak]; Gascon: Armanhac), situated between the Adour and Garonne rivers in the lower foothills of the Pyrenees, was a historic county of the Duchy of Gascony, established in 601 in Aquitaine (now France). In 960, the title of 'Count of Armagnac' was established, and thus the County of Armagnac was created. In 1751, following the death of childless Charles de Lorraine, Comte d'Armagnac, the title of the county was absorbed into the Crown lands of France and the King, then Louis XV took the title of 'Count of Armagnac' (Comte d'Armagnac). In 1791, following the decree dividing France into departments, the county was disestablished, but remains an important natural region of France.

County of Artois.headline: Grofija Artois
paragraphs: Grofija Artois (francosko: comté d'Artois, nizozemsko: graafschap Artesië, pikardsko: Comté d'Artoé) je bila zgodovinska provinca Kraljevine Francije, ki so jo od leta 1384 do 1477/82 imeli burgundski vojvode, od leta 1493 do 1659 pa je bila država Svetega rimskega cesarstva.

Današnji Artois leži na severu Francije blizu meje z Belgijo. Njegovo ozemlje meri okoli 4000 kvadratnih kilometrov, prebivalcev pa ima okoli milijon. Med glavnimi mesti so Arras (nizozemsko: Atrecht), Calais (nizozemsko: Kales), Boulogne-sur-Mer (nizozemsko: Bonen), Saint-Omer (zahodnoflamsko: Sint-Omaars), Lens in Béthune. Tvori notranjost francoskega departmaja Pas-de-Calais.
notes: The square-mile conversion is dropped.

source.title: County of Artois
paragraphs: The County of Artois (French: comté d'Artois, Dutch: graafschap Artesië, Picard: Comté d'Artoé) was a historic province of the Kingdom of France, held by the Dukes of Burgundy from 1384 until 1477/82, and a state of the Holy Roman Empire from 1493 until 1659.

Present-day Artois lies in northern France, near the border with Belgium. Its territory has an area of around 4,000 square kilometres (1,500 sq mi) and a population of about one million. Its principal cities include Arras (Dutch: Atrecht), Calais (Dutch: Kales), Boulogne-sur-Mer (Dutch: Bonen), Saint-Omer (West Flemish: Sint-Omaars, Lens and Béthune. It forms the interior of the French département of Pas-de-Calais.

County of Besalú.headline: Grofija Besalú
paragraphs: Grofija Besalú (katalonsko: Comtat de Besalú; latinsko: Comitatus Bisuldunensis) je bila ena od srednjeveških katalonskih grofij brez dostopa do morja blizu sredozemske obale. Približno se je ujemala z današnjo comarco Garrotxa, občasno pa je segala vse do Corbièresa v departmaju Aude, danes v Franciji. Glavni kraj je bila vas Besalú. Večino zgodovine je bila priključena kateri od drugih, močnejših grofij, stoletje pa je bila neodvisna, preden so jo dokončno in nepreklicno priključili barcelonski grofiji.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Besalú
paragraphs: The County of Besalú (Catalan: Comtat de Besalú, IPA: [kumˈtad də βəzəˈlu]; Latin: Comitatus Bisuldunensis) was one of the landlocked medieval Catalan counties near the Mediterranean coastline. It was roughly coterminous with the modern comarca of Garrotxa and at various times extended as far north as Corbières, Aude, now in France. Its capital was the village of Besalú. Throughout most of its history it was attached to one of the other more powerful counties, but it experienced a century of independence before it was finally and irrevocably annexed to the County of Barcelona.

County of Blois.headline: Grofija Blois
paragraphs: Grofija Blois je bila fevdalna kneževina s središčem v Bloisu južno od Pariza v Franciji. Nastala je kmalu potem, ko je kralj Klodvik I. okoli leta 500 osvojil rimsko Galijo. Med 8. in 13. stoletjem je bila med najmočnejšimi vazalnimi grofijami v Kraljevini Franciji, saj je s priključitvijo Šampanje obkolila dežele kapetinške dinastije.

Od ustanovitve do leta 1498 so grofijo vodili grofje, pogosto z različno uglednimi plemiškimi naslovi, ali pa so naloge prenašali na vikonte. Grofija je obstajala do dokončne priključitve kraljevim deželam leta 1660, ko je umrl Gaston, vojvoda Orléanski in zadnji grof Bloisa.

source.title: County of Blois
paragraphs: The County of Blois was a feudal principality centred on Blois, south of Paris, France. It was created just after king Clovis I conquered Roman Gaul around AD 500. Between the 8th and the 13th centuries, it was amongst the most powerful vassal counties within the Kingdom of France, after having succeeded in surrounding the Capetian dynasty's lands of France since Blois annexed the Champagne.

Since its creation up to 1498, the county was directed by counts, often with various more or less prestigious titles of nobility, or sometimes delegating their task to viscounts. The county existed until its definitive attachment to the Kingdom's lands in 1660, when Gaston, Duke of Orléans and last count of Blois, died.

Grofija Boulogne je bila grofija v Kraljevini Franciji od 9. do 15. stoletja s središčem v mestu Boulogne-sur-Mer. V 10. stoletju so ji vladali flandrijski grofje, v 11. stoletju pa je nastala samostojna rodbina Boulogne. Francoski kralj Filip II. jo je leta 1212 združil z grofijo Artois, kraljevi domeni pa je bila nazadnje priključena leta 1477.

source.title: County of Boulogne
paragraphs: The County of Boulogne was a county within the Kingdom of France during the 9th to 15th centuries, centred on the city of Boulogne-sur-Mer. It was ruled by the counts of Flanders in the 10th century, but a separate House of Boulogne emerged during the 11th century. It was merged into the County of Artois by Philip II of France in 1212 and eventually annexed to the royal domain itself in 1477.

Grofija Šampanja (latinsko: Comitatus Campaniensis; starofrancosko: Conté de Champaigne) je bila srednjeveško ozemlje in fevdalna kneževina v Kraljevini Franciji. Razvila se je v 12. stoletju na bogatih ravninah med Parizom in mejo Svetega rimskega cesarstva. Postala je gospodarsko središče severne Francije in mednarodno trgovsko središče, deloma zaradi sejmov, ki jih je uvedel grof Tibald II., nenehno krčenje gozdov pa je spodbujalo gospodarsko rast in rast mest. Grof Henrik Darežljivi je mesto Troyes postavil za prestolnico grofije in razširil državo. Na dvoru Šampanje pod grofom Henrikom in grofico Marijo so se razcveteli književni ustvarjalci. V 13. stoletju so grof Tibald III., grofica Blanka in grof Tibald IV. vodili centralizacijo države. Grofija je znana po podpori križarskim vojnam in samostanskim ustanovam, zlasti cistercijanom, ki so nastali na njenem ozemlju. Od leta 1234 je bil grof Šampanje tudi navarski kralj, poroka navarske kraljice Ivane I. s francoskim kraljem Filipom IV. pa je privedla do tega, da je bila grofija v 14. stoletju priključena kraljevi domeni francoskih kraljev.

source.title: County of Champagne
paragraphs: The County of Champagne (Latin: Comitatus Campaniensis; Old French: Conté de Champaigne) was a medieval territory and feudal principality in the Kingdom of France. It developed on the rich plains between Paris and the border of the Holy Roman Empire in the 12th century. It became an economic hub of northern France and an international trade center in part due to the trade fairs instituted by Count Theobald II, and steady land clearing led to economic and urban growth. Count Henry the Liberal established the city of Troyes as the county's capital and expanded the state. The court of Champagne under Count Henry and Countess Marie saw a proliferation of literary authors. In the 13th century, Count Theobald III, Countess Blanche, and Count Theobald IV oversaw a centralization of the state. The county is noted for its support to the crusades and monastic foundations, especially those of the Cistercians, which originated within its borders. From 1234 the count of Champagne was also the king of Navarre, and the marriage of Queen Joan I of Navarre with King Philip IV of France led to the county being absorbed into the royal domain of the kings of France in the 14th century.

Grofija Empúries (katalonsko: Comtat d'Empúries), znana tudi kot grofija Ampurias (špansko: Condado de Ampurias), je bila srednjeveška grofija s središčem v mestu Empúries, ki je obsegala katalonsko pokrajino Peralada. Ustreza zgodovinski comarci Empordà.

Ko so Franki leta 785 osvojili te pokrajine, sta Empúries in Peralada prišli pod oblast grofije Girona. Okoli leta 813 je Empúries skupaj s Peralado postala samostojna grofija pod Ermenguerjem. Ta in drugi zgodnji grofje so bili verjetno vizigotskega rodu. Leta 817 so Empúries združili z grofijo Roussillon, zveza pa je trajala do leta 989. Eden od grofov Empúriesa v 9. stoletju je zbral dovolj močno ladjevje, da je osvojil Balearske otoke, a le za kratek čas. Od leta 835 do 844 je Empúriesu in Peraladi vladal Sunyer I., Roussillonu in Vallespirju pa Alarik I.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Empúries
paragraphs: The County of Empúries (Catalan: Comtat d'Empúries, IPA: [kumˈtad dəmˈpuɾiəs]), also known as the County of Ampurias (Spanish: Condado de Ampurias), was a medieval county centred on the town of Empúries and enclosing the Catalan region of Peralada. It corresponds to the historic comarca of Empordà.

After the Franks conquered the regions in 785, Empúries and Peralada came under the authority of the County of Girona. Around 813, Empúries, with Peralada, became a separate county under Ermenguer. He and the other early counts were probably of Visigothic origin. In 817, Empúries was merged with the County of Roussillon, a union which lasted until 989. One of the ninth-century counts of Empúries assembled a fleet powerful enough to conquer the Balearic Islands, but only for a brief time. From 835 to 844, Sunyer I ruled Empúries and Peralada while Alaric I ruled Roussillon and Vallespir.

County of Nevers.headline: Grofija Nevers
paragraphs: Grofija Nevers (francosko: Comté de Nevers) je bila grofija v osrednji Franciji. Glavno mesto je bil Nevers. Približno ustreza poznejši provinci Nivernais in današnjemu departmaju Nièvre.

source.title: County of Nevers
paragraphs: The County of Nevers (French: Comté de Nevers) was a county in central France. Its principal town was Nevers. It roughly corresponds to the later province of Nivernais and the modern of department of Nièvre.

County of Osona.headline: Grofija Osona
paragraphs: Grofija Osona ali Ausona (katalonsko: Comtat d'Osona; latinsko: Comitatus Ausonae) je bila ena od katalonskih grofij Hispanske marke v zgodnjem in visokem srednjem veku. Središče je imela v glavnem mestu Vic (Vicus) in pripadajoči škofiji, katere ozemlje je približno ustrezalo današnji comarci Osona.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Osona
paragraphs: The County of Osona, also Ausona (Catalan: Comtat d'Osona, IPA: [kumˈtad duˈzonə]; Latin: Comitatus Ausonae), was one of the Catalan counties of the Marca Hispanica in the Early and High Middle Ages. It was based around the capital city of Vic (Vicus) and the corresponding diocese, whose territory was roughly the current comarca of Osona.

County of Pallars.headline: Grofija Pallars
paragraphs: Grofija Pallars ali Pallás (katalonsko: Comtat de Pallars; latinsko: Comitatus Pallariensis) je bila v 9. in 10. stoletju dejansko neodvisna majhna država, formalno v Karolinškem cesarstvu in nato v Zahodni Frankovski, morda ena od katalonskih grofij, ki je bila sprva v 9. stoletju del Hispanske marke. Obsegala je zgornjo dolino reke Noguera Pallaresa od grebena Pirenejev do vasi Tremp, z dolinami Vall d'Àneu, Vall de Cardós in Vall Ferrera, desnim bregom reke Noguera Ribagorçana in dolino reke Flamicell. Približno je ustrezala zgodovinski katalonski pokrajini Pallars. Glavno mesto je bil Sort.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Pallars
paragraphs: The County of Pallars or Pallás (Catalan: Comtat de Pallars, IPA: [kumˈtad də pəˈʎas]; Latin: Comitatus Pallariensis) was a de facto independent petty state, nominally within the Carolingian Empire and then West Francia during the ninth and tenth centuries, perhaps one of the Catalan counties, originally part of the Marca Hispanica in the ninth century. It was coterminous with the upper Noguera Pallaresa valley from the crest of the Pyrenees to the village of Tremp, comprising the Vall d'Àneu, Vall de Cardós, Vall Ferrera, the right bank of the Noguera Ribagorçana, and the valley of the Flamicell. It roughly corresponded with the historic region of Catalonia called Pallars. Its chief city was Sort.

County of Périgord.headline: Grofija Périgord
paragraphs: Grofija Périgord je bila zgodovinska pokrajina Francije. Ime Périgord izhaja iz galskega plemena Petrokorijev, ki so se upirali rimski osvojitvi. V zgodnjem srednjem veku se je ohranilo kot dežela Petragoric (latinsko: pagus Petragoricus). Périgord je bil fevd Vojvodine Akvitanije, sestavljen iz treh delov: Périgueux, Bergerac in Sarlat. Za zadeve grofije, s katero so kot s fevdom vladali grofje Périgorda, je skrbel senešal Périgorda. Grofija je na severu mejila na Poitou, na severovzhodu na Limousin in na jugovzhodu na Quercy. Sedež grofije je bil v Périgueuxu. Périgord je bil v 14. in 15. stoletju eno glavnih bojišč stoletne vojne med Francozi in Angleži. Kraljevini Franciji je bil priključen leta 1398. Grofija približno ustreza današnjemu departmaju Dordogne.
notes: The English spells Périgueux once as Périgieux; the Slovenian uses Périgueux.

source.title: County of Périgord
paragraphs: The County of Périgord was a historical region of France. The name Périgord derived from the Gaul tribe of the Petrocorii, who resisted the Roman conquest. It was preserved in the early Middle Ages as the Petragoric land (Latin: pagus Petragoricus). Périgord was a fief of the Duchy of Aquitaine, consisting of the three subregions of Périgieux, Bergerac, and Sarlat. The Seneschal of Périgord was responsible for the affairs of the county, ruled as a fief by the Counts of Périgord. The county was bounded on the north by Poitou, on the northeast by Limousin, on the southeast by Quercy. The seat of the county was at Périgueux. Périgord was one of the main battlegrounds of Hundred Years' War between the French and English in the 14th and 15th centuries. Périgord was eventually absorbed into the Kingdom of France in 1398. The County roughly corresponds to the current Dordogne département.

Grofija Poitou (latinsko: comitatus Pictavensis) je bila zgodovinska pokrajina Francije, sestavljena iz treh delov: Vendée, Deux-Sèvres in Vienne. Ime izhaja iz starodavnega galskega plemena Piktonov. Grofija je na severu mejila na Vojvodino Bretanjo ter grofiji Anžu in Touraine, na vzhodu na grofijo La Marche, na jugu pa na grofijo Angoulême. Sedež grofije je bil v Poitiersu.

Poitouju je vladal grof Poitouja, čigar neprekinjeno linijo je mogoče izslediti do imenovanja Karla Velikega leta 778. Od 950. let so bili grofje tudi akvitanski vojvode. Po poroki Eleonore Akvitanske s francoskim kraljem Ludvikom VII. leta 1138 je za vsakdanje zadeve grofije skrbel senešal Poitouja. Od leta 1154 je Poitou z Eleonorino drugo poroko prešel na angleške kralje.

source.title: County of Poitou
paragraphs: The County of Poitou (Latin comitatus Pictavensis) was a historical region of France, consisting of the three sub-regions of Vendée, Deux-Sèvres and Vienne. Its name is derived from the ancient Gaul tribe of Pictones. The county was bounded on the north by the Duchy of Brittany, the counties of Anjou and Touraine, on the east by the County of La Marche and on the south by the County of Angoulême. The seat of the county was at Poitiers.

Poitou was ruled by the count of Poitou, a continuous line of which can be traced back to an appointment of Charlemagne in 778. From the 950s on, the counts were also dukes of Aquitaine. After the marriage of Eleanor of Aquitaine with Louis VII of France in 1138, the Seneschal of Poitou was responsible for the day-to-day affairs of the county. From 1154, through Eleanor's second marriage, Poitou passed to the kings of England.

County of Ribagorza.headline: Grofija Ribagorza
paragraphs: Grofija Ribagorza ali Ribagorça (aragonsko: Condato de Ribagorza; katalonsko: Comtat de Ribagorça; latinsko: Comitatus Ripacurtiae) je bila srednjeveška grofija na južni strani Pirenejev, ki je obsegala severovzhod današnje Aragonije in del severozahoda današnje Katalonije, obe v Španiji. Sprva jo je samostojno ustanovila krajevna dinastija, pozneje pa je bila vključena v navarsko kraljestvo in nato v Aragonsko krono. Tesno zgodovinsko je bila povezana s sosednjima grofijama Sobrarbe (na zahodu) in Pallars (na vzhodu). Njeno ozemlje so sestavljale doline rek Ésera, Isábena in Noguera Ribagorzana. Sedež grofov je bil v Benabarreju, med drugimi pomembnimi kraji so Benasque, Graus in Pont de Suert. Zahodni del grofije danes približno ustreza aragonski comarci Ribagorza s središčem v Grausu, vzhodni pa katalonski comarci Alta Ribagorça.

source.title: County of Ribagorza
paragraphs: The County of Ribagorza or Ribagorça (Aragonese: Condato de Ribagorza; Catalan: Comtat de Ribagorça; Latin: Comitatus Ripacurtiae) was a medieval county on the southern side of the Pyrenees, including the northeast of modern Aragón and part of the northwest of modern Catalonia, both in Spain. It was originally the independent creation of a local dynasty, later absorbed into the Kingdom of Navarre and then into the Crown of Aragon. It had a strong historical connection with the neighboring counties of Sobrarbe (to the west) and Pallars (to the east). Its territory consisted of the valleys of the rivers Ésera, Isábena, and Noguera Ribagorzana. The seat of its counts was at Benabarre. Other notable towns include Benasque, Graus and Pont de Suert. Today the western portion of the county roughly corresponds to the Aragonese comarca of Ribagorza, with its administrative centre in Graus; the eastern portion roughly corresponds to the Catalan comarca of Alta Ribagorça.

Grofija Savoja je bila fevdalna država Svetega rimskega cesarstva, ki je skupaj s svobodnimi komunami Švice nastala ob razpadu Kraljevine Burgundije v 11. stoletju. Bila je zibelka poznejše savojske države.

source.title: County of Savoy
paragraphs: The County of Savoy was a feudal state of the Holy Roman Empire which emerged, along with the free communes of Switzerland, from the collapse of the Kingdom of Burgundy in the 11th century. It was the cradle of the future Savoyard state.

Grofija Toulouse (okcitansko: Comtat de Tolosa, latinsko: Comitatus Tolosanus, srednjefrancosko: Conté de Thoulouse) je bila ozemlje na jugu današnje Francije, ki je obsegalo mesto Toulouse z okolico in mu je od konca 9. do konca 13. stoletja vladal grof Toulousa.

Ko je Pipin Mali osvojil Septimanijo, je njegov naslednik Karel Veliki uvedel upravo, v kateri so bili v ključnih mestih, kot je Toulouse, nameščeni frankovski grofje. Prvi grof Fredelo (ki ga je imenoval Pipin II.) je v 840. letih vladal območju Toulousa pod suverenostjo kralja Frankovske. Njegovi potomci so sčasoma pridobili več oblasti nad območjem kot njihov frankovski nadoblastnik; do konca 9. stoletja so postali povsem neodvisni. V 12. stoletju je grofijo prizadela albižanska križarska vojna, s pariško pogodbo leta 1229 pa se je Toulouse formalno podredil francoski kroni in izgubil neodvisnost. Grofje Toulousa pa so mestu Toulouse in okoliški grofiji vladali do leta 1271.

source.title: County of Toulouse
