paragraphs: The County of Toulouse (Occitan: Comtat de Tolosa, Latin: Comitatus Tolosanus, Middle French: Conté de Thoulouse) was a territory in present-day southern France consisting of the city of Toulouse and its environs, ruled by the Count of Toulouse from the late 9th century until the late 13th century.

After Pippin the Short conquered Septimania, his successor Charlemagne imposed an administration where Frankish counts were established in key cities such as Toulouse. The first count, Fredelo (appointed by Pippin II) ruled the Toulouse region under the sovereignty of the king of Francia in the 840s. Over time his descendants gained more power over the region compared to their Frankish overlord; by the end of the 9th century, they had gained total independence. Later in the 12th century, the county was affected by the Albigensian Crusade, and by 1229, the Treaty of Paris saw Toulouse formally submitted to the crown of France, ending its independence. But the counts of Toulouse ruled Toulouse town and the surrounding county until 1271.
Grofija Urgell (katalonsko: Comtat d'Urgell; latinsko: Comitatus Urgellensis) je ena od zgodovinskih katalonskih grofij, ki je mejila na grofiji Pallars in Cerdanya.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: County of Urgell
paragraphs: The County of Urgell (Catalan: Comtat d'Urgell, IPA: [komˈtad duɾˈdʒeʎ]; Latin: Comitatus Urgellensis) is one of the historical Catalan counties, bordering on the counties of Pallars and Cerdanya.

County Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynt.headline: Palatinska grofija Kefalonija in Zakintos
paragraphs: Palatinska grofija Kefalonija in Zakintos je od leta 1185 do 1479 obstajala kot del Kraljevine Sicilije. Naslov in pravico do vladanja jonskima otokoma Kefaloniji in Zakintosu je leta 1185 dobil Margarit iz Brindisija za zasluge pri sicilskem kralju Viljemu II.

Za Margaritom je grofija prešla na vejo rodbine Orsini, ki jo je imela do leta 1325, ko je za kratek čas pripadla Anžuvincem, od leta 1357 pa rodbini Tocco. Toccovi so grofijo uporabili kot odskočno desko za pridobivanje ozemelj na grški celini in leta 1411 prevzeli nadzor nad Epirskim despotatom. Ko so napredovali osmanski Turki, so celinska ozemlja drugo za drugim izgubili in spet jim je ostala le palatinska grofija, ki so jo držali do leta 1479, ko so si jo razdelili Benetke in Osmani. Zakintos je prišel pod neposredno beneško oblast.

source.title: County Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos
paragraphs: The County Palatine of Cephalonia and Zakynthos existed from 1185 to 1479 as part of the Kingdom of Sicily. The title and the right to rule the Ionian islands of Cephalonia and Zakynthos was originally given to Margaritus of Brindisi for his services to William II, King of Sicily, in 1185.

Following Margaritus, the county passed on to a branch of the Orsini family until 1325, when it passed briefly to Angevins and then, from 1357, to the Tocco family. The Tocco used the county as a springboard for their acquisition of lands in the Greek mainland, and were successful in gaining control over the Despotate of Epirus in 1411. However, facing the advance of the Ottoman Turks they successively lost their mainland territories and were once again reduced to the County Palatine, which they held until 1479, when it was divided between Venice and the Ottomans. Zakynthos was put under the direct rule of Venice.

Državni udar 18. brumaira (francosko: Coup d'État du 18 Brumaire) je Napoleona Bonaparta pripeljal na oblast kot prvega konzula prve francoske republike. Po mnenju večine zgodovinarjev je končal francosko revolucijo in kmalu privedel do Napoleonovega kronanja za cesarja Francozov. Nekrvavi državni udar je strmoglavil direktorij in ga nadomestil s francoskim konzulatom. Zgodil se je 9. novembra 1799, kar je bil po kratkotrajnem francoskem republikanskem koledarju 18. brumaire leta VIII.

source.title: Coup of 18 Brumaire
paragraphs: The Coup of 18 Brumaire (French: Coup d'État du 18 Brumaire) brought Napoleon Bonaparte to power as First Consul of the French First Republic. In the view of most historians, it ended the French Revolution and would soon lead to the coronation of Napoleon as Emperor of the French. This bloodless coup d'état overthrew the Directory, replacing it with the French Consulate. This occurred on 9 November 1799, which was 18 Brumaire, Year VIII, under the short-lived French Republican calendar system.

Coup of 18 Fructidor.headline: Državni udar 18. fructidorja
paragraphs: Državni udar 18. fructidorja leta V (4. septembra 1797 po gregorijanskem koledarju) je bil prevzem oblasti v Franciji, ki so ga ob podpori vojske izvedli člani direktorija, tedanje vlade prve francoske republike. Udar so sprožili izidi volitev nekaj mesecev prej, na katerih so večino sedežev v zakonodajnem telesu (Corps législatif) dobili rojalistični kandidati, kar je grozilo z obnovo monarhije in vrnitvijo starega režima (ancien régime). Trije od petih članov direktorija, Paul Barras, Jean-François Rewbell in Louis Marie de La Révellière-Lépeaux, so ob podpori zunanjega ministra Charlesa Mauricea de Talleyranda-Périgorda izvedli državni udar, s katerim so razveljavili številne izide prejšnjih volitev in monarhiste odstranili iz zakonodajnega telesa.
notes: The English labels 4 September 1797 as the Republican-calendar date; it is the Gregorian equivalent of 18 Fructidor Year V, and the Slovenian says so.

source.title: Coup of 18 Fructidor
paragraphs: The Coup of 18 Fructidor, Year V (4 September 1797 in the French Republican Calendar), was a seizure of power in France by members of the Directory, then forming the government of the First French Republic, with support from the military. The coup was provoked by the results of elections held months earlier, which had given the majority of seats in the country's Corps législatif (Legislative body) to royalist candidates, threatening a restoration of the monarchy and a return to the ancien régime. Three of the five members of the Directory, Paul Barras, Jean-François Rewbell and Louis Marie de La Révellière-Lépeaux, with support of foreign minister Charles Maurice de Talleyrand-Périgord, staged the coup d'état that annulled many of the previous election's results and ousted the monarchists from the legislature.

Kretska država (grško: Κρητική Πολιτεία; osmansko turško: كرید دولتی) je bila avtonomna država, ki je od leta 1898 do 1913 upravljala otok Kreto: de iure je bila pod nadoblastjo Osmanskega cesarstva, de facto pa neodvisna, kar so ji zagotovile evropske velesile. Leta 1897 je kretski upor Osmansko cesarstvo pripeljal do vojne napovedi Grčiji, zato so posredovali Združeno kraljestvo, Francija, Italija in Rusija z utemeljitvijo, da Osmansko cesarstvo ne more več ohranjati nadzora. Kretska država je bila uvod v dokončno priključitev otoka Kraljevini Grčiji, ki je bila de facto izvedena leta 1908, de iure pa leta 1913 po prvi balkanski vojni.

source.title: Cretan State
paragraphs: The Cretan State (Greek: Κρητική Πολιτεία, romanized: Kritiki Politeia; Ottoman Turkish: كرید دولتی, romanized: Girid Devleti) was an autonomous state governing the island of Crete from 1898 to 1913, under de jure suzerainty of the Ottoman Empire but with de facto independence secured by European Great Powers. In 1897, the Cretan Revolt led the Ottoman Empire to declare war on Greece, which led the United Kingdom, France, Italy and Russia to intervene on the grounds that the Ottoman Empire could no longer maintain control. The Cretan State was the prelude to the island's final annexation to the Kingdom of Greece, which occurred de facto in 1908 and de jure in 1913 after the First Balkan War.

Cretan War (205–200 BC).headline: Kretska vojna (205–200 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Kretska vojna (205–200 pr. n. št.) je bila vojna, v kateri so se makedonski kralj Filip V., Etolska zveza, številna kretska mesta (najpomembnejši sta bili Olus in Hierapitna) in špartanski pirati bojevali proti silam Rodosa, pozneje pa tudi Atala I. Pergamskega, Bizantiona, Kizika, Aten in Knososa.

Makedonci so pravkar končali prvo makedonsko vojno in Filip je videl priložnost, da premaga Rodos, zato je sklenil zavezništvo z etolskimi in špartanskimi pirati, ki so začeli napadati rodoške ladje. Zavezništvo je sklenil tudi z več pomembnimi kretskimi mesti, kot sta Hierapitna in Olus. Ker sta rodoško ladjevje in gospodarstvo trpela zaradi piratskega plenjenja, je Filip menil, da je prišla priložnost, da Rodos stre. Da bi dosegel svoj cilj, je sklenil zavezništvo s selevkidskim kraljem Antiohom Velikim proti egiptovskemu Ptolemaju V. (selevkidska država in Egipt sta bili drugi dve diadoški državi). Filip je začel napadati ozemlja Ptolemaja in rodoških zaveznikov v Trakiji in okoli Propontide.

source.title: Cretan War (205–200 BC)
paragraphs: The Cretan War (205–200 BC) was fought by King Philip V of Macedon, the Aetolian League, many Cretan cities (of which Olous and Hierapytna were the most important) and Spartan pirates against the forces of Rhodes and later Attalus I of Pergamum, Byzantium, Cyzicus, Athens, and Knossos.

The Macedonians had just concluded the First Macedonian War and Philip, seeing his chance to defeat Rhodes, formed an alliance with Aetolian and Spartan pirates who began raiding Rhodian ships. Philip also formed an alliance with several important Cretan cities, such as Hierapytna and Olous. With the Rhodian fleet and economy suffering from the depredations of the pirates, Philip believed his chance to crush Rhodes was at hand. To help achieve his goal, he formed an alliance with the King of the Seleucid Empire, Antiochus the Great, against Ptolemy V of Egypt (the Seleucid Empire and Egypt were the other two Diadochi states). Philip began attacking the lands of Ptolemy and Rhodes's allies in Thrace and around the Propontis.

Krimska kampanja je bila operacija sil osi v okviru operacije Barbarossa med drugo svetovno vojno. Napadalne sile je vodila Nemčija ob podpori Romunije in Italije, Sovjetska zveza pa je zavzela obrambne položaje po vsem Krimskem polotoku. Ofenziva sil osi je Rdečo armado pognala v beg in omogočila triletno nemško okupacijo Krima.

Od 26. septembra 1941 so v bojih sodelovale nemška 11. armada ter romunska 3. in 4. armada. Nasproti so jim stale sovjetska 51. armada in deli Črnomorske flote. Po kampanji je Krim zasedla nemška skupina armad A, katere glavna podrejena enota je bila 17. armada.

source.title: Crimean campaign
paragraphs: The Crimean campaign was conducted by the Axis as part of Operation Barbarossa during World War II. The invading force was led by Germany with support from Romania and Italy, while the Soviet Union took up defensive positions throughout the Crimean Peninsula. The Axis offensive routed the Red Army and enabled the three-year-long German occupation of Crimea.

Beginning on 26 September 1941, the German 11th Army and the Romanian Third Army and Fourth Army were involved in the fighting. They were opposed by the Soviet 51st Army and elements of the Black Sea Fleet. After the campaign, Crimea was occupied by Germany's Army Group A, with the 17th Army as a major subordinate formation.

Crimean campaigns (1687–1689).headline: Krimska pohoda (1687–1689)
paragraphs: Krimska pohoda (1687–1689) (rusko: Крымские походы) sta bila vojaška pohoda Ruskega carstva proti Krimskemu kanatu. Bila sta del rusko-turške vojne (1686–1700) in rusko-krimskih vojn. To so bile prve ruske sile, ki so se Krimu približale po letu 1569. Pohoda sta spodletela zaradi slabega načrtovanja in praktične težave premikanja tako velike vojske čez stepo, a sta kljub temu odločilno pripomogla k zaustavitvi osmanskega širjenja v Evropi. Presenetila sta osmansko vodstvo, mu pokvarila načrte za vdor na Poljsko in Ogrsko ter ga prisilila, da je precejšnje sile iz Evrope premestilo na vzhod, kar je močno pomagalo Sveti ligi v boju proti Osmanom.

source.title: Crimean campaigns (1687–1689)
paragraphs: The Crimean campaigns (1687–1689) (Russian: Крымские походы, Krymskiye pokhody) were two military campaigns of the Tsardom of Russia against the Crimean Khanate. They were a part of the Russo-Turkish War (1686–1700) and Russo-Crimean Wars. These were the first Russian forces to come close to Crimea since 1569. They failed due to poor planning and the practical problem of moving such a large force across the steppe but nonetheless played a key role in halting the Ottoman expansion in Europe. The campaigns came as a surprise for the Ottoman leadership, spoiled its plans to invade Poland and Hungary and forced it to move significant forces from Europe to the east, which greatly helped the League in its struggle against the Ottomans.

Krimska ofenziva (8. aprila – 12. maja 1944), v nemških virih znana kot bitka za Krim, je bila vrsta ofenziv Rdeče armade proti Krimu, ki so ga držali Nemci. Rdeča armada je s 4. ukrajinsko fronto napadla nemško 17. armado skupine armad Južna Ukrajina, ki so jo sestavljale enote Wehrmachta in romunske enote. Boji so se končali z nemško evakuacijo Krima. Nemške in romunske sile so med evakuacijo utrpele precejšnje izgube.

source.title: Crimean offensive
paragraphs: The Crimean offensive (8 April – 12 May 1944), known in German sources as the Battle of the Crimea, was a series of offensives by the Red Army directed at the German-held Crimea. The Red Army's 4th Ukrainian Front engaged the German 17th Army of Army Group South Ukraine, which consisted of Wehrmacht and Romanian formations. The battles ended with the evacuation of Crimea by the Germans. German and Romanian forces suffered considerable losses during the evacuation.

Besedna zveza »prečkanje Rubikona« je idiom, ki pomeni »prestopiti točko, od koder ni vrnitve«. Izvira iz prečkanja reke Rubikon, ki ga je Julij Cezar januarja 49 pr. n. št. opravil na čelu 13. legije. Cezarju ni bilo dovoljeno poveljevati vojski znotraj same Italije, zato je s prečkanjem reke s svojimi četami kršil zakon in tvegal smrt. Prečkanje je sprožilo državljansko vojno, zaradi katere je Cezar nazadnje postal dosmrtni diktator (dictator perpetuo).

source.title: Crossing the Rubicon
paragraphs: The phrase "crossing the Rubicon" is an idiom meaning "passing the point of no return". Its meaning comes from the crossing of the Rubicon river by Julius Caesar in January 49 BC at the head of the 13th Legion. Caesar was not allowed to command an army within Italy proper, and by crossing the river with his forces was defying law and risking death. The crossing precipitated a civil war, which eventually led to Caesar becoming dictator for life (dictator perpetuo).

Crusade of Barbastro.headline: Križarski pohod na Barbastro
paragraphs: Križarski pohod na Barbastro (znan tudi kot obleganje Barbastra ali bitka pri Barbastru) je bil mednarodna odprava z odobritvijo papeža Aleksandra II., da bi zavzeli špansko mesto Barbastro, tedaj del hudidskega emirata Larida. V obleganju in osvojitvi mesta (1064) je sodelovala velika vojska iz vse zahodne Evrope. O naravi odprave, ki jo je Ramón Menéndez Pidal slavno opisal kot »križarsko vojno pred križarskimi vojnami«, v zgodovinopisju razpravljajo, križarska prvina pohoda pa je še vedno sporna.

source.title: Crusade of Barbastro
paragraphs: The crusade of Barbastro (also known as the siege of Barbastro or battle of Barbastro) was an international expedition, sanctioned by Pope Alexander II, to take the Spanish city of Barbastro, then part of the Hudid Emirate of Lārida. A large army composed of elements from all over Western Europe took part in the siege and conquest of the city (1064). The nature of the expedition, famously described by Ramón Menéndez Pidal as "a crusade before the crusades", is discussed in historiography, and the crusading element of the campaign is still a disputed point.

Dál Riata.headline: Dál Riata
paragraphs: Dál Riata ali Dál Riada (tudi Dalriada) je bila gelsko kraljestvo na zahodni obali Škotske in severovzhodu Irske, na obeh straneh Severnega preliva. Na vrhuncu v 6. in 7. stoletju je obsegala današnji Argyll (»obala Gelov«) na Škotskem in del grofije Antrim na Severnem Irskem. Po obdobju širitve se je Dál Riata sčasoma povezala z gelskim kraljestvom Alba.

source.title: Dál Riata
paragraphs: Dál Riata or Dál Riada (also Dalriada) was a Gaelic kingdom that encompassed the western seaboard of Scotland and northeastern Ireland, on each side of the North Channel. At its height in the 6th and 7th centuries, it covered what is now Argyll ("Coast of the Gaels") in Scotland and part of County Antrim in Northern Ireland. After a period of expansion, Dál Riata eventually became associated with the Gaelic Kingdom of Alba.

Danish attacks on Norman England.headline: Danski napadi na normansko Anglijo
paragraphs: Danci so normansko Anglijo napadli dvakrat. Prvič so v letih 1069–1070 vdrli v zavezništvu z različnimi angleškimi uporniki in zavzeli najprej York in nato Ely, nazadnje pa so sprejeli podkupnino in zapustili državo. Drugič je šlo za obsežen roparski pohod leta 1075 v podporo uporu grofov, med katerim so opustošili obalo Lincolnshira in York. Tretji napad je bil načrtovan leta 1085: zbrali so veliko invazijsko ladjevje danskih, flamskih in norveških ladij, ki pa ni nikoli izplulo. Vse tri napade je spodbudila zahteva po angleškem prestolu, ki jo je prvi uveljavljal danski kralj Sven II. (vladal 1047–1076), nečak Knuta Velikega, poznejši danski kralji pa so jo vzdrževali vse do 13. stoletja. Toda nobeden od obeh uresničenih napadov ni Svenove zahteve uveljavil niti Dancem ni prinesel ničesar razen nekaj plena.

source.title: Danish attacks on Norman England
paragraphs: There were two Danish attacks on Norman England. The first was an invasion in 1069–1070 conducted in alliance with various English rebels which succeeded in taking first York and then Ely before the Danes finally accepted a bribe to leave the country. The second was a large-scale raid in 1075, intended to support the Revolt of the Earls, in which the Lincolnshire coast and York were both ravaged. A third attack was planned in 1085, and a large invasion fleet composed of Danish, Flemish, and Norwegian vessels was assembled which never sailed. All three attacks were motivated by a claim on the English throne asserted originally by Cnut the Great's nephew Sweyn II, king of Denmark (r. 1047–1076), and maintained by later Danish kings until as late as the 13th century, but neither of the two realised attacks succeeded in making Sweyn's claim good, or indeed gained anything for the Danes apart from a certain amount of plunder.

Danska kraljevina v širšem smislu, uradno Kraljevina Danska, pogosto kar Danska, je suverena država, sestavljena iz več ozemelj, ki jih združuje ustavni akt, veljaven za vse ozemlje. Sestavljajo jo celinska Danska (včasih imenovana »Danska v ožjem smislu«) – ozemlje kraljevine na evropski celini in bližnji otoki – ter dve avtonomni (a ne suvereni) pokrajini: Ferski otoki v severnem Atlantiku in Grenlandija v Severni Ameriki. Razmerje med tremi deli kraljevine se imenuje Rigsfællesskabet (»enotnost kraljevine«, prevajano tudi kot danska skupnost narodov ali Združeno kraljestvo Danske).

source.title: Danish Realm
paragraphs: The Danish Realm, officially the Kingdom of Denmark, often known as Denmark, is a sovereign state consisting of a collection of constituent territories united by the Constitutional Act, which applies to the entire territory. It consists of metropolitan Denmark (sometimes called "Denmark proper")—the kingdom's territory in continental Europe and its proximate islands—and the realm's two autonomous (but not sovereign) regions: the Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic and Greenland in North America. The relationship between the three parts of the kingdom is known as Rigsfællesskabet (The Unity of the Realm, which has also been translated as the Danish Commonwealth or the United Kingdom of Denmark).

Dekabristični upor (rusko: Восстание декабристов, dobesedno »vstaja dekabristov«) je bil neuspel državni udar liberalnih vojaških in političnih disidentov proti Ruskemu cesarstvu. Zgodil se je v Sankt Peterburgu 26. decembra [14. decembra po starem koledarju] 1825, po smrti cesarja Aleksandra I.

Aleksandrov brat in domnevni dedič veliki knez Konstantin Pavlovič se je prestolu zasebno odpovedal že dve leti pred Aleksandrovo nenadno smrtjo 1. decembra [19. novembra po starem koledarju] 1825. Naslednji v vrsti je bil zato mlajši brat Nikolaj, ki je pozneje zasedel prestol kot cesar Nikolaj I. Niti ruska vlada niti javnost sprva nista vedeli za Konstantinovo odpoved, zato so deli vojske prenagljeno prisegli zvestobo Konstantinu. Splošna prisega zvestobe pravemu cesarju Nikolaju je bila napovedana za 26. december [14. december po starem koledarju] 1825 na Senatnem trgu v Sankt Peterburgu.

source.title: Decembrist revolt
paragraphs: The Decembrist revolt (Russian: Восстание декабристов, romanized: Vosstaniye dekabristov, lit. 'Uprising of the Decembrists') was a failed coup d'état led by liberal military and political dissidents against the Russian Empire. It took place in Saint Petersburg on 26 December [O.S. 14 December] 1825, following the death of Emperor Alexander I.

Alexander's brother and heir-presumptive Grand Duke Konstantin Pavlovich privately renounced his claim to the throne two years prior to Alexander's sudden death on 1 December [O.S. 19 November] 1825. The next in the line of succession therefore was younger brother Nicholas, who would ascend the throne as Emperor Nicholas I. Neither the Russian government nor the general public were initially aware of Konstantin's renunciation, and as a result, parts of the military took a premature oath of loyalty to Konstantin. A general swearing of loyalty to the true emperor Nicholas was scheduled for 26 December [O.S. 14 December] 1825 in Senate Square, Saint Petersburg.

Defence of the Polish Post Office in Dan.headline: Obramba Poljske pošte v Gdansku
paragraphs: Obramba Poljske pošte v Gdansku (Danzig) je bila eno prvih dejanj druge svetovne vojne v Evropi in del septembrskega pohoda. Nemčija je invazijo na Poljsko začela 1. septembra 1939 okoli 4.45, ko je bojna ladja Schleswig-Holstein odprla ogenj na gdansko pristanišče pod poljskim nadzorom. Gdanški paravojaški oddelki in policija, ki jih je podpirala Nemčija, so se takoj pridružili napadu, da bi z zavzetjem poljske pošte prevzeli popoln nadzor nad mestom. Poljsko osebje je stavbo približno 15 ur branilo pred napadi enote SS Heimwehr Danzig (gdanska domobranska enota SS), lokalnih formacij SA in posebnih enot gdanske policije. Vse branilce razen štirih, ki jim je ob predaji uspelo pobegniti iz stavbe, je nemško vojaško sodišče 5. oktobra 1939 kot nezakonite borce obsodilo na smrt in usmrtilo (sodbo so pozneje priznali za sodni umor).
notes: 04:45 is written in the Slovenian form, 4.45.

source.title: Defence of the Polish Post Office in Danzig
paragraphs: The Defence of the Polish Post Office in Gdańsk (Danzig) was one of the first acts of World War II in Europe, as part of the September Campaign. On 1 September 1939 the Invasion of Poland was initiated by Germany when the battleship Schleswig-Holstein opened fire on the Polish-controlled harbor of Danzig, around 04:45. Danzig paramilitaries and police, supported by Germany, immediately joined the offensive to take full control of the city, by capturing the Polish post office. Polish personnel defended the building for some 15 hours against assaults by the SS Heimwehr Danzig (SS Danzig Home Defence), local SA formations and special units of Danzig police. All but four of the defenders, who were able to escape from the building during the surrender, were sentenced to death by a German court martial as illegal combatants on 5 October 1939, and executed (the judgement was later acknowledged as judicial murder).

Defense of Brest Fortress.headline: Obramba Brestske trdnjave
paragraphs: Obramba Brestske trdnjave je bila prva bitka operacije Barbarossa, invazije sil osi na Sovjetsko zvezo, ki se je začela 22. junija 1941. Nemška vojska je napadla brez opozorila in pričakovala, da bo Brest zavzela že prvi dan samo s pehoto in topništvom, vendar je za to potrebovala teden dni in dve bombardiranji Luftwaffe. Veliko branilcev je padlo ali bilo ujetih.

source.title: Defense of Brest Fortress
paragraphs: The defense of Brest Fortress was the first battle of Operation Barbarossa, the Axis invasion of the Soviet Union launched on 22 June 1941. The German Army attacked without warning, expecting to take Brest on the first day, using only infantry and artillery, but it took them a week, and only after two bombardments by the Luftwaffe. Many defenders were killed or captured.
Deira (starovaližansko/kumbrijsko: Deywr ali Deifr; staroangleško: Dere ali Dera rice) je bila območje v porimski Britaniji in pozneje anglsko kraljestvo.
notes: The English pronunciation guide is dropped.

source.title: Deira
paragraphs: Deira ( DY-rə, DAIR-ə; Old Welsh/Cumbric: Deywr or Deifr; Old English: Dere or Dera rice) was an area of Post-Roman Britain, and a later Anglian kingdom.

Dekemvriana.headline: Dekemvriana
paragraphs: Dekemvriana (grško: Δεκεμβριανά, dobesedno »decembrski dogodki«) je ime za vrsto spopadov, ki so med drugo svetovno vojno potekali v Atenah od 3. decembra 1944 do 11. januarja 1945. Spopadi so bili vrhunec večmesečnih napetosti med levičarsko EAM, deli njene vojaške veje ELAS, nameščenimi v Atenah, KKE in OPLA na eni strani ter grško vlado, deli Kraljeve helenske vojske, helenskim orožništvom, mestno policijo, Organizacijo X in drugimi ter britansko vojsko na drugi strani.

source.title: Dekemvriana
paragraphs: The Dekemvriana (Greek: Δεκεμβριανά, lit. 'December events') was a series of clashes fought during World War II in Athens, Greece, from 3 December 1944 to 11 January 1945. The conflict was the culmination of months of tension between the left-wing EAM, some parts of its military arm, the ELAS, stationed in Athens, the KKE and the OPLA from one side and from the other side, the Greek Government, some parts of the Hellenic Royal Army, the Hellenic Gendarmerie, the Cities Police, the Organization X, among others and also the British Army.

Demjanski žep (nemško: Kessel von Demjansk; rusko: Демя́нский котёл) je ime za žep nemških čet, ki jih je Rdeča armada obkolila pri Demjansku južno od Leningrada na vzhodni fronti druge svetovne vojne. Žep je obstajal predvsem od 8. februarja do 21. aprila 1942.
Precej manjše sile so bile obkoljene v holmskem žepu pri mestu Holm, približno 100 km jugozahodno. Oba žepa sta nastala zaradi nemškega umika po porazu v bitki za Moskvo.

Uspešno obrambo Demjanska so omogočili z zračnim mostom, kar je bil pomemben razvoj v sodobnem vojskovanju. Uspeh je močno vplival na odločitev vrhovnega poveljstva kopenske vojske, da isto taktiko poskusi v bitki za Stalingrad, kjer pa 6. armade pod poveljstvom Friedricha Paulusa ni rešila.
notes: The mile conversion is left out.

source.title: Demyansk Pocket
paragraphs: The Demyansk Pocket (German: Kessel von Demjansk; Russian: Демя́нский котёл) was the name given to the pocket of German troops encircled by the Red Army around Demyansk, south of Leningrad, on World War II's Eastern Front. The pocket existed mainly from 8 February to 21 April 1942.

A much smaller force was surrounded in the Kholm Pocket at the town of Kholm, about 100 km (62 mi) to the southwest. Both resulted from the German retreat after its defeat during the Battle of Moscow.

The successful defence of Demyansk was achieved by using an airbridge and was a significant development in modern warfare. Its success was a major contributor to the decision by the Army High Command to try the same tactic during the Battle of Stalingrad, but it then failed to save the 6th Army, commanded by Friedrich Paulus.

Danska - Norveška je bila večnarodna in večjezična realna unija od 16. do 19. stoletja, ki so jo sestavljali Kraljevina Danska, Kraljevina Norveška (s tedanjimi norveškimi čezmorskimi posestmi: Ferskimi otoki, Islandijo, Grenlandijo in drugimi), Vojvodina Schleswig in Vojvodina Holstein. Država je zahtevala suverenost tudi nad tremi zgodovinskimi ljudstvi: Frizijci, Guti in Vendi. Imela je več kolonij, in sicer Dansko Zlato obalo, Dansko Indijo (Nikobarske otoke, Serampore, Tharangambadi) in Dansko Zahodno Indijo.

Prebivalci države so bili predvsem Danci, Norvežani in Nemci, v norveških čezmorskih posestih pa tudi Ferci, Islandci in Inuiti, na severu Norveške samijska manjšina ter druga domorodna ljudstva. Glavna mesta Danske - Norveške so bila København, Christiania (Oslo), Altona, Bergen in Trondhjem, glavna uradna jezika sta bila danščina in nemščina, krajevno pa so govorili tudi norveško, islandsko, fersko, samijsko in grenlandsko.

source.title: Denmark–Norway
paragraphs: Denmark–Norway was a 16th-to-19th-century multi-national and multi-lingual real union consisting of the Kingdom of Denmark, the Kingdom of Norway (including the then Norwegian overseas possessions: the Faroe Islands, Iceland, Greenland, and other possessions), the Duchy of Schleswig, and the Duchy of Holstein. The state also claimed sovereignty over three historical peoples: Frisians, Gutes and Wends. Denmark–Norway had several colonies, namely the Danish Gold Coast, Danish India (the Nicobar Islands, Serampore, Tharangambadi), and the Danish West Indies.

The state's inhabitants were mainly Danes, Norwegians and Germans, and also included Faroese, Icelanders and Inuit in the Norwegian overseas possessions, a Sami minority in northern Norway, as well as other indigenous peoples. The main cities of Denmark–Norway were Copenhagen, Christiania (Oslo), Altona, Bergen and Trondhjem, and the primary official languages were Danish and German, but Norwegian, Icelandic, Faroese, Sami and Greenlandic were also spoken locally.

Despotate of Arta.headline: Artski despotat
paragraphs: Artski despotat (albansko: Despotati i Artës; grško: Δεσποτάτο της Άρτας) je bil despotat, ki so ga v 14. stoletju ustanovili albanski vladarji, potem ko so albanski plemenski bojevniki leta 1359 v bitki pri Aheloju premagali krajevnega epirskega despota Nikeforja II. Orsinija. Despotat je prenehal obstajati leta 1416, ko je prešel v roke Carla I. Tocca.
notes: This Battle of Achelous (1359) is not the battle of 917 that the glossary names Bitka pri Aheloju; lowercase in running text.

source.title: Despotate of Arta
paragraphs: The Despotate of Arta (Albanian: Despotati i Artës; Greek: Δεσποτάτο της Άρτας) was a despotate established by Albanian rulers during the 14th century, after the defeat of the local Despot of Epirus, Nikephoros II Orsini, by Albanian tribesmen in the Battle of Achelous in 1359. The Despotate ceased to exist in 1416, when it passed to Carlo I Tocco.

Despotate of Dobruja.headline: Dobrudžanski despotat
paragraphs: Dobrudžanski despotat ali Kneževina Karvuna (bolgarsko: Добруджанско деспотство ali Карвунско княжество; romunsko: Despotatul Dobrogei ali Țara Cărvunei) je bil v 14. stoletju napol neodvisna bolgarska država na območju današnje Dobrudže, ki se je pod vplivom Bizantinskega cesarstva odcepila od Drugega bolgarskega cesarstva. Obstajal je od leta 1356 do 1411.

Ime kneževine izhaja iz trdnjave Karvuna (današnji Balčik, ki ga ne gre zamenjevati s Karnavo oziroma Kavarno), ki jo bolgarski in bizantinski dokumenti ter italijanski portolani iz 14. stoletja omenjajo kot prvo prestolnico; stala je med Varno in rtom Kaliakra.

source.title: Despotate of Dobruja
paragraphs: The Despotate of Dobruja or Principality of Karvuna (Bulgarian: Добруджанско деспотство or Карвунско княжество; Romanian: Despotatul Dobrogei or Țara Cărvunei) was a 14th-century quasi-independent Bulgarian polity in the region of modern Dobruja, that split off from the Second Bulgarian Empire under the influence of the Byzantine Empire. The Despotate of Dobruja existed from 1356 to 1411.

The principality's name is derived from the fortress of Karvuna (present-day Balchik, not to be confused with Karnava/Kavarna), mentioned in Bulgarian and Byzantine documents and Italian portolans of the 14th century as its first capital, and located between Varna and Cape Kaliakra.

Destruction of Psara.headline: Uničenje Psare
paragraphs: Uničenje Psare (grško: Καταστροφή των Ψαρών) je bilo pobijanje tisočev Grkov na otoku Psara, ki so ga leta 1824 med grško osamosvojitveno vojno zagrešile osmanske čete.

source.title: Destruction of Psara
paragraphs: The Destruction of Psara (in Greek: Καταστροφή των Ψαρών, Katastrofí ton Psarón) was the killing of thousands of Greeks on the island of Psara by Ottoman troops during the Greek War of Independence in 1824.

Donation of Pepin.headline: Pipinova darovnica
paragraphs: Pipinova darovnica je bila prenos frankovskega ozemlja v osrednji Italiji papežu Štefanu II., ki ga je leta 756 izvedel frankovski kralj Pipin Mali. Darovnici pripisujejo, da je »dejansko vzpostavila posvetno oblast papeštva«; nastala je v času zatona Bizantinskega cesarstva v Italiji in pomenila tako »pomemben trenutek v papeško-karolinškem zavezništvu« kot »pomemben korak« pri nastanku Papeške države. Ko je leta 751 cesarska prestolnica v Italiji Ravena padla v roke langobardskega kralja Aistulfa, je izginil »vsakršen videz cesarske zaščite Rima«, papež, ki je bil do tedaj formalno bizantinski podanik, pa se je za pomoč obrnil na Pipina. Papež je najprej prosil bizantinskega cesarja Konstantina V., a brez uspeha. Pipin je vdrl v Italijo in po prvi zmagi leta 755 leta 756 odločilno »premagal Aistulfa in mu vsilil mir«.
notes: The English variant spelling (Donation of Pippin) is dropped.

source.title: Donation of Pepin
paragraphs: The Donation of Pepin, or Donation of Pippin, was the transfer of Frankish territory in Central Italy to Pope Stephen II made by Pepin the Short, King of the Franks, in 756. Credited with "effectively establishing the temporal authority of the papacy," the Donation took place amid the Byzantine Empire's decline in Italy and marked both "an important moment in the papal–Carolingian alliance" and an "important step" in the formation of the Papal States. With the fall of Ravenna, the imperial capital in Italy, to Aistulf, King of the Lombards in 751, "any semblance of imperial protection for Rome" had vanished and the pope, who had technically been a Byzantine subject to this point, turned to Pepin for assistance. The pope initially appealed to Byzantine Emperor Constantine V, but without success. Pepin invaded Italy and, following an initial victory in 755, he decisively "defeated Aistulf and imposed a peace on him" in 756.

Vstaja Dos de Mayo ali vstaja 2. maja je potekala 2. in 3. maja 1808 v Madridu v Španiji. Upor, predvsem civilistov, s posameznimi vojaškimi akcijami nižjih častnikov, je bil uperjen proti francoski zasedbi mesta, francoske cesarske sile pa so ga nasilno zatrle s stotinami javnih usmrtitev. Ti dogodki so privedli do upora španskega ljudstva proti francoski zasedbi in izbruha polotoške vojne ter končali francosko-špansko zavezništvo v napoleonskih vojnah.

source.title: Dos de Mayo Uprising
paragraphs: The Dos de Mayo or Second of May Uprising took place in Madrid, Spain, on 2–3 May 1808. The rebellion, mainly by civilians, with some isolated military action by junior officers, was against the occupation of the city by French troops, and was violently repressed by the French Imperial forces, with hundreds of public executions. These actions led to the Spanish people revolting against French occupation and outbreak of the Peninsular War, and ended the Franco-Spanish alliance in the Napoleonic Wars.

Dubrovnik Charter.headline: Dubrovniška listina
paragraphs: Dubrovniška listina je srednjeveška bolgarska vladarska listina iz leta 1230, s katero bolgarski car Ivan Asen II. dubrovniškim trgovcem podeljuje pravico do svobodne trgovine v svoji državi.

Listina vsebuje podatke o ozemeljski širitvi druge bolgarske države po bitki pri Klokotnici ter dragocene podatke o stanju srednjebolgarskega jezika v 13. stoletju. Hranijo jo v rokopisnem oddelku Knjižnice Ruske akademije znanosti v Sankt Peterburgu.

source.title: Dubrovnik Charter
paragraphs: The Dubrovnik Charter is a medieval Bulgarian royal charter from 1230, by which the Tsar Ivan Asen II of Bulgaria gives the Dubrovnik merchants the right to trade freely in his country.

The charter contains information about the territorial expansion of the Second Bulgarian State after the Battle of Klokotnitsa, as well as valuable data on the status of the Middle Bulgarian language in the 13th century. It is stored in the handwriting department of the Library of the Russian Academy of Sciences in St. Petersburg.

Duchy of Anhalt.headline: Vojvodina Anhalt
paragraphs: Vojvodina Anhalt (nemško: Herzogtum Anhalt) je bila zgodovinska nemška vojvodina. Ležala je med pogorjem Harz na zahodu ter reko Labo in še dlje do vresišča Fläming na vzhodu. Ozemlju je nekoč vladala rodbina Askanijcev, danes pa je del zvezne dežele Saška-Anhalt.

source.title: Duchy of Anhalt
paragraphs: The Duchy of Anhalt (German: Herzogtum Anhalt) was a historical German duchy. The duchy was located between the Harz Mountains in the west and the River Elbe and beyond to the Fläming Heath in the east. The territory was once ruled by the House of Ascania, and is now part of the federal state of Saxony-Anhalt.

Vojvodina Akvitanija (okcitansko: Ducat d'Aquitània; francosko: Duché d'Aquitaine) je bila zgodovinski fevd na zahodu, v osrednjem delu in na jugu današnje Francije, južno od reke Loare. Celoten obseg vojvodine in njeno ime sta se v stoletjih močno spreminjala, občasno pa je obsegala velik del današnje jugozahodne (vključno z Gaskonjo) in osrednje Francije.
notes: The Occitan and French pronunciations in IPA are dropped.

source.title: Duchy of Aquitaine
paragraphs: The Duchy of Aquitaine (Occitan: Ducat d'Aquitània, IPA: [dyˈkad dakiˈtanjɔ]; French: Duché d'Aquitaine, IPA: [dyʃe dakitɛn]) was a historical fiefdom located in the western, central, and southern areas of present-day France, south of the river Loire. The full extent of the duchy, as well as its name, fluctuated greatly over the centuries and at times comprised much of what is now southwestern (including Gascony) and central France.

Vojvodina Bretanja (bretonsko: Dugelezh Breizh; francosko: Duché de Bretagne) je bila srednjeveška fevdalna država, ki je obstajala približno med letoma 939 in 1547. Njeno ozemlje je obsegalo severozahodni polotok Francije, ki ga na zahodu omejuje Biskajski zaliv, na severu pa Rokavski preliv. Manj natančno so jo na jugu omejevali reka Loara, na vzhodu pa Normandija in druge francoske province. Vojvodina je nastala po izgonu vikinških vojsk iz pokrajine okoli leta 939. V 10. in 11. stoletju je bila politično nestabilna, vojvode pa so imeli zunaj svojih osebnih posesti le omejeno moč. Vojvodina Bretanja je imela s sosednjo Vojvodino Normandijo spremenljive odnose: včasih se je z Normandijo povezovala, drugič, denimo v bretonsko-normanski vojni, pa sta se odkrito spopadali.
notes: The Breton pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Duchy of Brittany
paragraphs: The Duchy of Brittany (Breton: Dugelezh Breizh [dyˈɡɛːlɛs ˈbrɛjs]; French: Duché de Bretagne) was a medieval feudal state that existed between approximately 939 and 1547. Its territory covered the northwestern peninsula of France, bordered by the Bay of Biscay to the west, and the English Channel to the north. It was also less definitively bordered by the river Loire to the south, and Normandy, and other French provinces, to the east. The duchy was established after the expulsion of Viking armies from the region around 939. In the 10th and 11th centuries, it was politically unstable, with the dukes holding only limited power outside their own personal lands. The Duchy of Brittany had mixed relationships with the neighbouring Duchy of Normandy, sometimes allying itself with Normandy, and at other times, such as the Breton–Norman War, entering into open conflict.

Vojvodina Braunschweig (nemško: Herzogtum Braunschweig) je bila zgodovinska nemška država, ki je prenehala obstajati leta 1918. Njena prestolnica je bila v Braunschweigu. Dunajski kongres jo je leta 1815 ustanovil kot naslednico Kneževine Braunschweig-Wolfenbüttel. V nemški zgodovini 19. stoletja je bila vojvodina del Nemške zveze, Severnonemške zveze in od leta 1871 Nemškega cesarstva. Po koncu prve svetovne vojne so jo odpravili, njeno ozemlje pa je kot Svobodna država Braunschweig postalo del Weimarske republike.

source.title: Duchy of Brunswick
paragraphs: The Duchy of Brunswick (German: Herzogtum Braunschweig) was a historical German state that ceased to exist in 1918. Its capital was the city of Brunswick (Braunschweig). It was established as the successor state of the Principality of Brunswick-Wolfenbüttel by the Congress of Vienna in 1815. In the course of the 19th-century history of Germany, the duchy was part of the German Confederation, the North German Confederation and from 1871 the German Empire. It was disestablished after the end of World War I, its territory incorporated into the Weimar Republic as the Free State of Brunswick.

Duchy of Bytom.headline: Vojvodina Bytom
paragraphs: Vojvodina Bytom (poljsko: Księstwo Bytomskie, češko: Bytomské knížectví, nemško: Herzogtum Beuthen) je bila vojvodina v Zgornji Šleziji, ena od šlezijskih vojvodin razdrobljene Poljske pod Piasti. Nastala je v Zgornji Šleziji okoli leta 1281 ob delitvi Vojvodine Opole in Racibórz med sinove vojvode Vladislava Opolskega. Vojvodina je imela prestolnico v Bytomu, ki je bil del Malopoljske, dokler ga poljski veliki vojvoda Kazimir II. Pravični leta 1177 ni priključil šlezijski Vojvodini Racibórz.

source.title: Duchy of Bytom
paragraphs: The Duchy of Bytom (Polish: Księstwo Bytomskie, Czech: Bytomské knížectví, German: Herzogtum Beuthen) was a duchy in Upper Silesia, one of the Silesian duchies of fragmented Piast-ruled Poland. It was established in Upper Silesia about 1281 during the division of the Duchy of Opole and Racibórz among the sons of Duke Władysław Opolski. The duchy's capital was Bytom, formerly part of Lesser Poland until in 1177 the Polish High Duke Casimir II the Just had attached it to the Silesian Duchy of Racibórz.

Vojvodina Gaskonja ali vojvodina Vaskonija je bila vojvodina na jugozahodu današnje Francije in severovzhodu Španije, na območju današnje pokrajine Gaskonja. Vojvodina, tedaj znana kot Vaskonija, je bila sprva frankovska marka, ustanovljena za obvladovanje Baskov. Doživela je različna obdobja, od zgodnjih let z izrazito baskovsko prvino prek personalne unije z Vojvodino Akvitanijo do poznejšega obdobja, ko je bila odvisno ozemlje angleških kraljev iz rodbine Plantagenet.

Gaskonja je bila približno 300 let, od leta 1152 do 1453, neprekinjeno pod angleško oblastjo. Francoski kralj Karel VII. je ozemlje znova osvojil kot zadnje dejanje stoletne vojne, Kraljevina Francija pa si je severni del ozemlja priključila leta 1453. Ustrezni del na Iberskem polotoku je postal Kraljestvo Navara.

source.title: Duchy of Gascony
paragraphs: The Duchy of Gascony or Duchy of Vasconia was a duchy located in present-day southwestern France and northeastern Spain, an area encompassing the modern region of Gascony. The Duchy of Gascony, then known as Vasconia, was originally a Frankish march formed to hold sway over the Basques. However, the duchy went through different periods, from its early years with its distinctively Basque element to the merger in personal union with the Duchy of Aquitaine to the later period as a dependency of the Plantagenet kings of England.

Gascony was under continuous English rule for approximately 300 years, from 1152 to 1453. Charles VII of France reconquered the territory as a final act of the Hundred Years' War and the northern part of the territory was annexed by the Kingdom of France in 1453. The corresponding portion within the Iberian Peninsula became the Kingdom of Navarre.

Duchy of Głogów.headline: Vojvodina Głogów
paragraphs: Vojvodina Głogów (poljsko: Księstwo głogowskie, češko: Hlohovské knížectví) ali Vojvodina Glogau (nemško: Herzogtum Glogau) je bila ena od šlezijskih vojvodin, ki so nastale med srednjeveško razdrobitvijo Poljske na manjše pokrajinske vojvodine. Prestolnica je bila v Głogówu v Spodnji Šleziji. Obstajala je v letih 1177–1185 in 1251–1506, vladali pa so ji šlezijski Piasti, nato Ivan Korvin in jagelonska dinastija.

source.title: Duchy of Głogów
paragraphs: The Duchy of Głogów (Polish: Księstwo głogowskie, Czech: Hlohovské knížectví) or Duchy of Glogau (German: Herzogtum Glogau) was one of the Duchies of Silesia, formed in course of the medieval fragmentation of Poland into smaller provincial duchies. Its capital was Głogów in Lower Silesia. It existed in 1177–1185 and 1251–1506 and was ruled by the Silesian Piasts, followed by John Corvinus and the Jagiellonian dynasty.

Duchy of Greater Poland.headline: Vojvodina Velikopoljska
paragraphs: Vojvodina Velikopoljska je bila pokrajinska kneževina, ki je obsegala velik del zgodovinske pokrajine Velikopoljske, njeno ozemlje pa je približno ustrezalo današnjemu Velikopoljskemu vojvodstvu v zahodni osrednji Poljski. Nastala je v 12. stoletju po oporoki Boleslava III. Krivoustega iz leta 1138, ki je prej enotno Kraljevino Poljsko razdelila na več dednih vojvodin in sprožila obdobje fevdalne razdrobljenosti. Čeprav je bila nominalno del poljskega kraljestva, je delovala kot polavtonomna piastovska kneževina, ki so ji samostojno vladali lastni vojvode.

source.title: Duchy of Greater Poland
paragraphs: The Duchy of Greater Poland was a district principality that encompassed much of the historical region of Greater Poland, with a territory roughly corresponding to the present-day Greater Poland Voivodeship in west-central Poland. It emerged in the 12th century following the 1138 testament of Bolesław III Wrymouth, which divided the previously unified Kingdom of Poland into several hereditary duchies, initiating a period of feudal fragmentation. Although nominally part of the Polish realm, the duchy functioned as a semi-autonomous Piast principality, governed independently by its own dukes.

Vojvodina Jawor (poljsko: Księstwo Jaworskie, nemško: Herzogtum Jauer, češko: Javorské knížectví) je bila ena od šlezijskih vojvodin srednjeveške Poljske, ustanovljena leta 1274 z odcepitvijo od Vojvodine Legnica. Vladali so ji šlezijski Piasti, prestolnica pa je bila v Jaworu v Spodnji Šleziji.

Bila je tedaj najbolj jugozahodna poljska vojvodina, razen v obdobju 1281–1286, ko je bila še bolj jugozahodno začasno odcepljena Vojvodina Lwówek. V različnih obdobjih je mejila tudi na poljske vojvodine Głogów, Legnica, Vroclav in Świdnica, prek slednje pa še na Nyso, Brzeg in Ziębice.

source.title: Duchy of Jawor
paragraphs: Duchy of Jawor (Polish: Księstwo Jaworskie, German: Herzogtum Jauer, Czech: Javorské knížectví) was one of the duchies of Silesia and medieval Poland established in 1274 as a subdivision of the Duchy of Legnica. It was ruled by the Silesian Piasts, with its capital at Jawor in Lower Silesia.

It was the southwesternmost duchy of Poland at the time, with the exception of the 1281–1286 period, when the more southwestern was the temporarily split off Duchy of Lwówek. At various times, it also bordered the fellow Polish duchies of Głogów, Legnica, Wrocław and Świdnica, and via the latter also Nysa, Brzeg and Ziębice.

Duchy of Kalisz.headline: Vojvodina Kalisz
paragraphs: Vojvodina Kalisz je bila fevdalna pokrajinska vojvodina v Velikopoljski, katere ozemeljsko in upravno jedro je bila kališka dežela, območje okoli mesta Kalisz. Prestolnica je bila v Kaliszu. Vojvodina je nastala leta 1177 po delitvi Vojvodine Velikopoljske, ki je sledila uporu proti Mješku III. Njen prvi vladar je postal vojvoda Kazimir II. Pravični iz dinastije Piastov.

Kalisz je sprva ostal fevd znotraj širše Vojvodine Poljske – izraza, ki se navadno uporablja za razdrobljeno državo in ki jo nekateri viri še naprej imenujejo Kraljevina Poljska –, dokler ni leta 1227 postal samostojna vojvodina. V tej obliki je obstajal do leta 1279, ko se je pod vladavino Przemysła II. združil z vojvodinama Gniezno in Poznań in je nastala obnovljena Vojvodina Velikopoljska.

source.title: Duchy of Kalisz
paragraphs: The Duchy of Kalisz was a feudal district duchy in Greater Poland, with its territorial and administrative core in the Kalisz Land — the region surrounding the city of Kalisz. Its capital was Kalisz. The duchy was established in 1177, following the partition of the Duchy of Greater Poland after a rebellion against Mieszko III. Duke Casimir II the Just of the Piast dynasty became its first ruler.

Initially, Kalisz remained a fiefdom within the broader Duchy of Poland — a term commonly applied to the fragmented realm, which some sources continue to refer to as the Kingdom of Poland — until 1227, when Kalisz gained independence as a duchy. It existed in this form until 1279, when it was united with the duchies of Gniezno and Poznań under the rule of Przemysł II, forming a reconstituted Duchy of Greater Poland.

Duchy of Kuyavia.headline: Vojvodina Kujavija
paragraphs: Vojvodina Kujavija je bila pokrajinska kneževina v srednji Evropi, ki je nastala v 13. stoletju na območju današnje Kujavije, potem ko je bila Kraljevina Poljska leta 1138 z oporoko vojvode Boleslava III. Krivoustega razdeljena na delne vojvodine.

source.title: Duchy of Kuyavia
paragraphs: The Duchy of Kuyavia was a district principality in Central Europe, created in the course of the 13th century in the region of modern-day Kuyavia after the inheritance of the Kingdom of Poland in 1138 into partial duchies through the will and testament of Duke Bolesław III Wrymouth.

Vojvodina Lorena, sprva znana tudi kot Vojvodina Zgornja Lorena, je bila vojvodina Svetega rimskega cesarstva, ki je obstajala od 10. stoletja do leta 1766, ko jo je priključila Kraljevina Francija. Po njej je dobila ime današnja pokrajina Lorena na severovzhodu Francije. Glavno mesto je bil Nancy.

Ustanovljena je bila v letih 959–965, ko se je staro plemensko vojvodstvo Lotaringija razdelilo na dve ločeni vojvodini, Zgornjo in Spodnjo Loreno, najzahodnejša dela Svetega rimskega cesarstva. Spodnja vojvodina je do 12. stoletja razpadla, Zgornjo Loreno pa so sčasoma imenovali kar Vojvodina Lorena. Vojvodino Loreno so si želeli burgundski vojvode in francoski kralji, ki so jo za kratek čas zasedli, po letu 1473 pa so ji vladali vojvode iz rodbine Lorena.

source.title: Duchy of Lorraine
paragraphs: The Duchy of Lorraine, initially also known as the Duchy of Upper Lorraine, was a duchy of the Holy Roman Empire which existed from the 10th century until 1766, when it was annexed by the Kingdom of France. It gave its name to the present-day region of Lorraine in northeastern France. Its capital was Nancy.

It was founded in 959–965, following the division of the old Stem Duchy of Lotharingia into two separate duchies: Upper and Lower Lorraine, the westernmost parts of the Holy Roman Empire. The Lower duchy was dismantled by the 12th century, while Upper Lorraine in time came to be known just as the Duchy of Lorraine. The Duchy of Lorraine was coveted and briefly occupied by the dukes of Burgundy and the kings of France, but was ruled by the dukes of the House of Lorraine after 1473.

Vojvodina Luksemburg (francosko: Luxembourg; nemško: Luxemburg; luksemburško: Lëtzebuerg) je bila država Svetega rimskega cesarstva in pradomovina plemiške rodbine Luxembourg. Rodbina Luxembourg je v 14. stoletju postala ena najpomembnejših političnih sil in se s Habsburžani in Wittelsbachi potegovala za prevlado v Svetem rimskem cesarstvu. Luksemburžani so bili dediči Přemyslidov v Kraljevini Češki, nasledili so Kraljevino Ogrsko in dali štiri cesarje Svetega rimskega cesarstva, dokler njihova moška linija ni izumrla in so Habsburžani prejeli ozemlja, o katerih sta se rodbini prvotno dogovorili z brnsko pogodbo leta 1364.

source.title: Duchy of Luxembourg
paragraphs: The Duchy of Luxembourg (French: Luxembourg; German: Luxemburg; Luxembourgish: Lëtzebuerg) was a state of the Holy Roman Empire, the ancestral homeland of the noble House of Luxembourg. The House of Luxembourg became one of the most important political forces in the 14th century, competing against the Houses of Habsburg and Wittelsbach for supremacy in the Holy Roman Empire. They would be the heirs to the Přemyslid dynasty in the Kingdom of Bohemia, succeeding to the Kingdom of Hungary and contributing four Holy Roman Emperors until their own line of male heirs came to an end and the House of Habsburg received the territories that the two Houses had originally agreed upon in the Treaty of Brünn in 1364.

Vojvodina Mazovija je bila v srednjem veku pokrajinska kneževina in fevd Kraljevine Poljske. Središče države je bila Mazovija na severovzhodu Kraljevine Poljske, njena prestolnica pa je bila v času obstoja v Płocku, Czersku in Varšavi. Nastala je leta 1138 na ozemlju Kraljevine Poljske ob njeni razdrobitvi, ki jo je sprožila oporoka Boleslava III. Krivoustega. Država je obstajala v letih 1138–1275, 1294–1310, 1370–1381 in 1495–1526, vmes pa se je njeno ozemlje drobilo na manjše vojvodine in znova združevalo. Med razdrobitvijo so nastale vojvodine Kujavija, Dobrzyń, Czersk, Płock, Varšava, Rawa in Belz. Leta 1526 je bila država priključena Kraljevini Poljski.

source.title: Duchy of Masovia
paragraphs: The Duchy of Masovia was a district principality and a fiefdom of the Kingdom of Poland, existing during the Middle Ages. The state was centered in Mazovia in the northeastern Kingdom of Poland, and during its existence, its capital was located in Płock, Czersk and Warsaw. It was formed in 1138 from the territories of the Kingdom of Poland, following its fragmentation, that was started by the testament of Bolesław III Wrymouth. The country existed in the years: 1138–1275, 1294–1310, 1370–1381, and 1495–1526, between that time, going through fragmentations of its territory into smaller duchies and its unification. The states formed during its fragmentation were duchies of Kuyavia, Dobrzyń, Czersk, Płock, Warsaw, Rawa and Belz. In 1526, the country was incorporated into the Kingdom of Poland.

Duchy of Mecklenburg.headline: Vojvodina Mecklenburg
paragraphs: Vojvodina Mecklenburg je bila vojvodina v Svetem rimskem cesarstvu v pokrajini Mecklenburg. Obstajala je v poznem srednjem veku in zgodnjem novem veku, od leta 1471 do 1520 ter od 1695 do 1701. Prestolnica je bila v Schwerinu.

Država je nastala leta 1471, ko je vojvoda Henrik IV. združil vojvodini Mecklenburg-Stargard in Mecklenburg-Schwerin. Obstajala je do 7. maja 1520, ko so jo razdelili na vojvodini Mecklenburg-Güstrow in Mecklenburg-Schwerin. Znova je nastala leta 1695 z združitvijo Mecklenburg-Güstrowa in Mecklenburg-Schwerina; vojvoda je postal Friderik Viljem. Leta 1701 so jo razdelili na vojvodini Mecklenburg-Schwerin in Mecklenburg-Strelitz.

source.title: Duchy of Mecklenburg
paragraphs: The Duchy of Mecklenburg was a duchy within the Holy Roman Empire, located in the region of Mecklenburg. It existed during the Late Middle Ages and the early modern period, from 1471 to 1520, as well as 1695 to 1701. Its capital was Schwerin.

The state was formed in 1471, when duke Henry IV, had united the duchies of Mecklenburg-Stargard and Mecklenburg-Schwerin. The state existed until 7 May 1520, when it was partitioned into the duchies of Mecklenburg-Güstrow and Mecklenburg-Schwerin. It was again reestablished in 1695, with the unification of Mecklenburg-Güstrow and Mecklenburg-Schwerin. Frederick William became the duke. In 1701, it was partitioned into the duchies of Mecklenburg-Schwerin and Mecklenburg-Strelitz.

Vojvodina Modena in Reggio (italijansko: Ducato di Modena e Reggio; latinsko: Ducatus Mutinae et Regii; emilijsko: Duchêt ed Mòdna e Rèz) je bila italijanska država, ustanovljena leta 1452 na severozahodu Italije, na območju današnje Emilije-Romanje. Od ustanovitve so jo vladali plemiči iz rodbine Este, od leta 1814 pa avstrijsko-estenska veja rodbine. Dinastija Este je bila velika pokroviteljica umetnosti, zato je bila vojvodina v renesansi in baroku kulturna zgled.

source.title: Duchy of Modena and Reggio
paragraphs: The Duchy of Modena and Reggio (Italian: Ducato di Modena e Reggio; Latin: Ducatus Mutinae et Regii; Emilian: Duchêt ed Mòdna e Rèz) was an Italian state created in 1452 located in Northwestern Italy, in the present-day region of Emilia-Romagna. It was ruled since its establishment by the noble House of Este, and from 1814 by the Austria-Este branch of the family. The Este dynasty was a great sponsor of the arts, making the Duchy a cultural reference during the Renaissance and Baroque periods.

Vojvodina Neapelj (latinsko: Ducatus Neapolitanus, neapeljsko: Ducato di Napule) je nastala kot bizantinska provinca v južni Evropi, ustanovljena v 7. stoletju na območju, ki približno ustreza današnji provinci Neapelj in ga Langobardi ob vdoru v Italijo v 6. stoletju niso osvojili. Bila je ena od tirenskih vojvodin skupaj z vojvodinami Gaeta, Amalfi in Sorrento, ki so se v začetku 9. stoletja osamosvojile od Neaplja.

Vladal ji je vojaški poveljnik (dux), hitro pa je postala dejansko neodvisna država, ki je v zgodnjem in visokem srednjem veku trajala več kot pet stoletij. Neapelj je še danes pomembno velemesto v Italiji.
notes: The English spells tyrrhenian with a lower-case t; the Slovenian is tirenske.

source.title: Duchy of Naples
paragraphs: The Duchy of Naples (Latin: Ducatus Neapolitanus, Neapolitan: Ducato di Napule) began as a Byzantine province in Southern Europe that was constituted in the seventh century, in the lands roughly corresponding to the current province of Naples that the Lombards had not conquered during their invasion of Italy in the sixth century. It was one of the tyrrhenian duchies along with the duchy of Gaeta, Amalfi and Sorrento which took their independence from Naples in the early 9th century.

It was governed by a military commander (dux), and rapidly became a de facto independent state, lasting more than five centuries during the Early and High Middle Ages. Naples remains a significant metropolitan city in present-day Italy.

Vojvodina Nassau (nemško: Herzogtum Nassau) je bila med letoma 1806 in 1866 samostojna država na območju današnjih nemških zveznih dežel Porenje-Pfalška in Hessen. Bila je članica Renske zveze in pozneje Nemške zveze. Vladajoča dinastija, pozneje izumrla, je bila rodbina Nassau. Ime je dobila po gradu Nassau, ta pa po svojem zgodovinskem središču, mestu Nassau, čeprav prestolnica ni bila v Nassauu, temveč v Wiesbadnu. Leta 1865 je imela Vojvodina Nassau 465.636 prebivalcev. Potem ko jo je Kraljevina Prusija po avstrijsko-pruski vojni leta 1866 zasedla in priključila, je postala del province Hessen-Nassau. Območje je zemljepisna in zgodovinska pokrajina Nassau, Nassau pa je tudi ime naravnega parka Nassau v mejah nekdanje vojvodine.

source.title: Duchy of Nassau
paragraphs: The Duchy of Nassau (German: Herzogtum Nassau) was an independent state between 1806 and 1866, located in what became the German states of Rhineland-Palatinate and Hesse. It was a member of the Confederation of the Rhine and later of the German Confederation. Its ruling dynasty, later extinct, was the House of Nassau. The duchy was named after the Nassau Castle, itself after its historical core city, Nassau, although Wiesbaden rather than Nassau was its capital. In 1865, the Duchy of Nassau had 465,636 inhabitants. After being occupied and annexed into the Kingdom of Prussia in 1866 following the Austro-Prussian War, it was incorporated into the Province of Hesse-Nassau. The area is a geographical and historical region, Nassau, and Nassau is also the name of the Nassau Nature Park within the borders of the former duchy.

Vojvodina Normandija je nastala s pogodbo iz Saint-Clair-sur-Epte leta 911 med zahodnofrankovskim kraljem Karlom III. in vikinškim voditeljem Rollonom. Vojvodina je dobila ime po svojih prebivalcih, Normanih.

Od leta 1066 do 1204 so bili normandijski vojvode zaradi normanske osvojitve Anglije navadno tudi angleški kralji; izjeme so bili le vojvode Robert Curthose (1087–1106), Godfrej Plantagenet (1144–1150) in Henrik II. (1150–1152), ki je leta 1154 postal angleški kralj.

Leta 1202 je francoski kralj Filip II. razglasil, da je Normandija zapadla njemu, in jo leta 1204 z orožjem zavzel (razen Kanalskih otokov). Ozemlje je ostalo sporno do leta 1259, ko se je angleški vladar odpovedal zahtevi po celinski Normandiji, ki je bila priključena francoski kraljevi domeni.

source.title: Duchy of Normandy
paragraphs: The Duchy of Normandy grew out of the 911 Treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte between King Charles III of West Francia and the Viking leader Rollo. The duchy was named for its inhabitants, the Normans.

From 1066 until 1204, as a result of the Norman Conquest of England, the dukes of Normandy were usually also kings of England, the only exceptions being Dukes Robert Curthose (1087–1106), Geoffrey Plantagenet (1144–1150), and Henry II (1150–1152), who became king of England in 1154.

In 1202, Philip II of France declared Normandy forfeit to him and seized it by force of arms in 1204 (with the exception of the Channel Islands). It remained disputed territory until 1259, when the English sovereign ceded his claim to mainland Normandy which was absorbed into the French royal domain.
Vojvodina Oldenburg (nemško: Herzogtum Oldenburg), imenovana po prestolnici, mestu Oldenburg, je bila država na severozahodu današnje Nemčije.

Ko je leta 1667 umrl grof Anton Günther, je grofijo Oldenburg podedoval danski kralj Friderik III., član danske veje rodbine Oldenburg. Leta 1773 je pogodba iz Carskega Sela grofijo prenesla na Friderika Avgusta I. iz mlajše veje Holstein-Gottorp. Grofija je bila nato povzdignjena v vojvodino.
Po priključitvi Francoskemu cesarstvu leta 1810 je bila vojvodina leta 1815 obnovljena kot velika vojvodina. Vojvoda Peter I. je naslov velikega vojvode Oldenburga prevzel leta 1823.

source.title: Duchy of Oldenburg
paragraphs: The Duchy of Oldenburg (German: Herzogtum Oldenburg), named for its capital, the town of Oldenburg, was a state in the north-west of present-day Germany.

On the death of Count Anthony Günther in 1667, the county of Oldenburg was inherited by King Frederick III of Denmark, a member of the Danish line of the House of Oldenburg. In 1773, the Treaty of Tsarskoye Selo transferred the county to Frederick August I of the junior Holstein-Gottorp branch. Subsequently, the county was elevated to a duchy.
After annexation by the French Empire in 1810, the duchy was restored as a grand duchy in 1815. Duke Peter I assumed the title of Grand Duke of Oldenburg in 1823.

Duchy of Opole.headline: Vojvodina Opole
paragraphs: Vojvodina Opole (poljsko: Księstwo opolskie; češko: Opolské knížectví; nemško: Herzogtum Oppeln) je bila ena od šlezijskih vojvodin, ki ji je vladala veja poljske dinastije Piastov, nastala pa je med srednjeveško razdrobitvijo Poljske na pokrajinske vojvodine. Prestolnica je bila v Opolu v Zgornji Šleziji.

source.title: Duchy of Opole
paragraphs: The Duchy of Opole (Polish: Księstwo opolskie; Czech: Opolské knížectví; German: Herzogtum Oppeln) was one of the duchies of Silesia ruled by the branch of Polish Piast dynasty, formed during the medieval fragmentation of Poland into provincial duchies. Its capital was Opole in Upper Silesia.

Vojvodina Parma in Piacenza (italijansko: Ducato di Parma e Piacenza, latinsko: Ducatus Parmae et Placentiae) je bila italijanska država, ustanovljena leta 1545 v severni Italiji, na območju današnje Emilije-Romanje.

Sprva je bila posest rodbine Farnese, potem ko je papež Pavel III. vojvodino podelil kot dedno svojemu sinu Pieru Luigiju Farneseju. Rodbina je vladala do leta 1731, ko je umrl zadnji vojvoda Antonio Farnese brez neposrednih dedičev. Po desetletju habsburške oblasti je vojvodina pripadla rodbini Bourbon-Parma.

Napoleonove sile so jo napadle in Francija jo je priključila, po Napoleonovem porazu leta 1814 pa so ji vrnili suverenost. Nato ji je do smrti vladala Napoleonova žena Marija Ljudovika (Maria Luigia) kot vojvodinja. Leta 1847 so Parmo vrnili burbonski oblasti, leta 1859 pa so vojvodino uradno ukinili, ker so jo vključili v novo italijansko državo.

source.title: Duchy of Parma and Piacenza
paragraphs: The Duchy of Parma and Piacenza (Italian: Ducato di Parma e Piacenza, Latin: Ducatus Parmae et Placentiae) was an Italian state created in 1545 and located in northern Italy, in the current region of Emilia-Romagna.

Originally a realm of the Farnese family after Pope Paul III made it a hereditary duchy for his son, Pier Luigi Farnese, it was ruled by the dynasty until 1731, when the last duke, Antonio Farnese, died without direct heirs. After a decade of Habsburg rule, the duchy passed to the House of Bourbon-Parma.

It was invaded by Napoleon and annexed by France, having its sovereignty restored in 1814 after Napoleon's defeat. Napoleon's wife, Marie Louise (Maria Luigia), then ruled as its duchess until her death. Parma was restored to Bourbon rule in 1847, and in 1859, the duchy was formally abolished as it was integrated into the new Italian state.

Vojvodina Prusija (nemško: Herzogtum Preußen, poljsko: Księstwo Pruskie, litovsko: Prūsijos kunigaikštystė) ali vojvodska Prusija (nemško: Herzogliches Preußen; poljsko: Prusy Książęce) je bila vojvodina v pokrajini Prusiji, ki je nastala s sekularizacijo samostanske Prusije, ozemlja, ki je bilo do protestantske reformacije leta 1525 pod oblastjo države Tevtonskega reda.

source.title: Duchy of Prussia
paragraphs: The Duchy of Prussia (German: Herzogtum Preußen, Polish: Księstwo Pruskie, Lithuanian: Prūsijos kunigaikštystė) or Ducal Prussia (German: Herzogliches Preußen; Polish: Prusy Książęce) was a duchy in the region of Prussia established as a result of secularization of the Monastic Prussia, the territory that remained under the control of the State of the Teutonic Order until the Protestant Reformation in 1525.

Vojvodina Racibórz (poljsko: Księstwo raciborskie, češko: Ratibořské knížectví, nemško: Herzogtum Ratibor) je bila ena od šlezijskih vojvodin, ki so nastale med srednjeveško razdrobitvijo Poljske na pokrajinske vojvodine. Prestolnica je bila v Raciborzu v Zgornji Šleziji.

source.title: Duchy of Racibórz
paragraphs: Duchy of Racibórz (Polish: Księstwo raciborskie, Czech: Ratibořské knížectví, German: Herzogtum Ratibor) was one of the duchies of Silesia, formed during the medieval fragmentation of Poland into provincial duchies. Its capital was Racibórz in Upper Silesia.

Duchy of Saint Sava.headline: Vojvodina svetega Save
paragraphs: Vojvodina svetega Save (srbohrvaško: Vojvodstvo Svetog Save / Војводство Светог Саве) je bila poznosrednjeveška država v jugovzhodni Evropi, ki je obstajala od leta 1448 do 1482, ko jo je priključilo Osmansko cesarstvo. Ustanovila in nadzorovala jo je plemiška rodbina Kosača, katere vladarji so nosili naslov vojvoda svetega Save (srbohrvaško: Vojvoda Svetog Save / Војвода Светог Саве). Njihova posest je obsegala južne dele današnje Bosne in Hercegovine ter segala do južnih delov današnje obalne Hrvaške, severozahodne Črne gore in jugozahodne Srbije. Ustanovitelj Stjepan Vukčić Kosača (vojvoda od leta 1448) se je imenoval herceg svetega Save. Iz tega naslova je pozneje nastalo novo ime pokrajine, Hercegovina, Osmani pa so ga uporabili v imenu Hersek Sancağı (Hercegov sandžak), kakor so imenovali Hercegovinski sandžak.

source.title: Duchy of Saint Sava
paragraphs: The Duchy of Saint Sava (Serbo-Croatian: Vojvodstvo Svetog Save / Војводство Светог Саве) was a late medieval polity in southeastern Europe, that existed from 1448 up to 1482, when it was absorbed by the Ottoman Empire. It was founded and controlled by the Kosača noble family, whose rulers held the title Duke of Saint Sava (Serbo-Croatian: Vojvoda Svetog Save / Војвода Светог Саве). Their domains included southern parts of modern-day Bosnia and Herzegovina, extending to southern parts of modern-day coastal Croatia, northwestern Montenegro and southwestern Serbia. Its founder, Stjepan Vukčić Kosača (duke since 1448), titled himself Herceg of Saint Sava, a title which would later give rise to the new name to the region: Herzegovina, and will be also used by the Ottomans as Hersek Sancağı (Sanjak of the Herzeg), designating the Sanjak of Herzegovina.

Duchy of Sandomierz.headline: Vojvodina Sandomierz
paragraphs: Vojvodina Sandomierz je bila pokrajinska kneževina in fevd Kraljevine Poljske. Nastala je leta 1138 na ozemlju Kraljevine Poljske ob njeni razdrobitvi, ki jo je sprožila oporoka Boleslava III. Krivoustega. Obstajala je do leta 1320, ko je bila priključena Kraljevini Poljski. Prestolnica je bila v Sandomierzu. Ozemlje je imelo središče v sandomierski deželi v jugovzhodnem kotu Poljske, med rekami Pilica, Visla, San in Dunajec.

source.title: Duchy of Sandomierz
paragraphs: The Duchy of Sandomierz was a district principality and a fiefdom of the Kingdom of Poland. It was formed in 1138 from the territories of the Kingdom of Poland, following its fragmentation, that was started by the testament of Bolesław III Wrymouth. The Duchy existed until 1320 when it was incorporated into the Kingdom of Poland. Its capital was the city of Sandomierz. The territory was centred around Sandomierz Land in the southeastern corner of Poland, between the rivers of Pilica, Vistula, San, and Dunajec.

Duchy of Silesia.headline: Vojvodina Šlezija
paragraphs: Vojvodina Šlezija (poljsko: Księstwo Śląskie, nemško: Herzogtum Schlesien, češko: Slezské knížectví, šlezijsko: Ślōnski firsztyntōm) s prestolnico v Vroclavu je bila srednjeveška pokrajinska vojvodina Poljske v pokrajini Šleziji.

Kmalu po nastanku pod piastovsko dinastijo leta 1138 se je razdrobila na različne šlezijske vojvodine. Leta 1327 so preostala Vojvodina Vroclav in večina drugih vojvodin, ki so jim vladali šlezijski Piasti, kot šlezijske vojvodine prešle pod nadoblast Kraljevine Češke. Pridobitev je bila dokončana, ko se je poljski kralj Kazimir III. Veliki v trenčinski pogodbi leta 1335 odpovedal pravicam do Šlezije.

source.title: Duchy of Silesia
paragraphs: The Duchy of Silesia (Polish: Księstwo Śląskie, German: Herzogtum Schlesien, Czech: Slezské knížectví, Silesian: Ślōnski firsztyntōm) with its capital at Wrocław was a medieval provincial duchy of Poland located in the region of Silesia.

Soon after it was formed under the Piast dynasty in 1138, it fragmented into various Silesian duchies. In 1327, the remaining Duchy of Wrocław as well as most other duchies ruled by the Silesian Piasts passed under the suzerainty of the Kingdom of Bohemia as the Duchies of Silesia. The acquisition was completed when King Casimir III the Great of Poland renounced his rights to Silesia in the 1335 Treaty of Trentschin.

Duchy of Thuringia.headline: Vojvodina Turingija
paragraphs: Vojvodina Turingija, pozneje znana kot Deželna grofija Turingija, je bila politična tvorba v srednjeveški Turingiji, sprva vojvodina, nato deželna grofija. Njeno središče je bila domovina Turingov, obsegala pa je ozemlja, ki so jim prej vladali neodvisni turinški kralji. V prvi polovici 6. stoletja je Turingija prišla pod vrhovno oblast frankovskih kraljev in je bila organizirana kot vzhodna obmejna pokrajina merovinškega kraljestva Avstrazije. Kot vojvodino jo je okoli leta 631 ustanovil kralj Dagobert I., ki je za prvega turinškega vojvodo imenoval domačega turinškega plemiča Radulfa. Znova je nastala v Karolinškem cesarstvu, nato pa je pripadala Vzhodnofrankovskemu kraljestvu.

source.title: Duchy of Thuringia
paragraphs: The Duchy of Thuringia, later known as the Landgraviate of Thuringia, was a polity in medieval Thuringia, initially a duchy, and then a landgraviate. It was centered in the homeland of Thuringians, encompassing territories previously ruled by independent Kings of Thuringia. During the first half of the 6th century, Thuringia came under the supreme rule of Frankish kings, and was organized as an eastern frontier region of the Merovingian kingdom of Austrasia. It was established as a duchy about 631, by King Dagobert I, who appointed a local Thuringian noble Radulf as the first Duke of Thuringia. It was recreated within the Carolingian Empire, and then belonged to the East Frankish Realm.

Duchy of Tuscia.headline: Vojvodina Tuscia
paragraphs: Vojvodina Tuscia (italijansko: Ducato di Tuscia; latinsko: Ducatus Tusciae), sprva znana kot Vojvodina Lucca (italijansko: Ducato di Lucca; latinsko: Ducatus Lucaniae), je bila langobardska vojvodina v osrednji Italiji, ki je obsegala velik del današnje Toskane. Po zasedbi bizantinskih ozemelj so Langobardi ustanovili to cvetočo vojvodino, ki je poleg drugih središč zajemala tudi Firence. Prestolnica vojvodine je bila Lucca, ki je ležala ob poti Via Francigena in je bila tudi kraj, kjer so prebivali vojvode.
notes: The English pronunciation respellings and the IPA are dropped.

source.title: Duchy of Tuscia
paragraphs: The Duchy of Tuscia ( TUSS-ee-ə, TUSH-(ee-)ə; Modern Italian: Ducato di Tuscia [duˈkaːto di ˈtuʃʃa]; Latin: Ducatus Tusciae), initially known as the Duchy of Lucca (Modern Italian: Ducato di Lucca; Latin: Ducatus Lucaniae), was a Lombard duchy in Central Italy, which included much of today's Tuscany. After the occupation of the territories belonging to the Byzantines, the Lombards founded this flourishing duchy which, among other centres, also included Florence. The capital of the duchy was Lucca, which was located along the Via Francigena, being also the city where the dukes resided.

Duchy of Wrocław.headline: Vojvodina Vroclav
paragraphs: Vojvodina Šlezija (poljsko: Księstwo Śląskie, nemško: Herzogtum Schlesien, češko: Slezské knížectví, šlezijsko: Ślōnski firsztyntōm) s prestolnico v Vroclavu je bila srednjeveška pokrajinska vojvodina Poljske v pokrajini Šleziji.

Kmalu po nastanku pod piastovsko dinastijo leta 1138 se je razdrobila na različne šlezijske vojvodine. Leta 1327 so preostala Vojvodina Vroclav in večina drugih vojvodin, ki so jim vladali šlezijski Piasti, kot šlezijske vojvodine prešle pod nadoblast Kraljevine Češke. Pridobitev je bila dokončana, ko se je poljski kralj Kazimir III. Veliki v trenčinski pogodbi leta 1335 odpovedal pravicam do Šlezije.
notes: The English title redirects to Duchy of Silesia, so the summary is the same as that record's.

source.title: Duchy of Silesia
paragraphs: The Duchy of Silesia (Polish: Księstwo Śląskie, German: Herzogtum Schlesien, Czech: Slezské knížectví, Silesian: Ślōnski firsztyntōm) with its capital at Wrocław was a medieval provincial duchy of Poland located in the region of Silesia.

Soon after it was formed under the Piast dynasty in 1138, it fragmented into various Silesian duchies. In 1327, the remaining Duchy of Wrocław as well as most other duchies ruled by the Silesian Piasts passed under the suzerainty of the Kingdom of Bohemia as the Duchies of Silesia. The acquisition was completed when King Casimir III the Great of Poland renounced his rights to Silesia in the 1335 Treaty of Trentschin.

Dumnonija (starogrško: Δαμνόνιον, Damnónion, v pridevniški obliki), polatinjeno ime, je bila britonsko kraljestvo, ki je med 6. in 7. stoletjem n. št. obstajalo v porimski Britaniji, v zahodnejših delih današnje jugozahodne Anglije.

Predhodno predrimsko ozemlje Dumnonijcev je imelo središče na območju današnjega Devona, obsegalo pa je tudi današnji Cornwall in del Somerseta; njegova vzhodna meja se je sčasoma pomikala proti zahodu, ko se je postopoma širilo sosednje anglosaško kraljestvo Wessex. Včasih se pojavlja tudi zapis Damnonia, ki pa označuje tudi deželo Damnonijcev, pozneje del Kraljestva Strathclyde na jugu današnje Škotske.
Pojavlja se tudi oblika Domnonia. Ime kraljestva je jezikovno sorodno z imenom bretonske pokrajine Domnonée (bretonsko: Domnonea).

source.title: Dumnonia
paragraphs: Dumnonia (Ancient Greek: Δαμνόνιον, romanized: Damnónion, in the adjective form), a Latinised name, was a Brythonic kingdom that existed in Sub-Roman Britain between the 6th century CE and the 7th century CE in the more westerly parts of present-day South West England.

Its predecessor, the pre-Roman Dumnonii territory, was centred in the area of modern Devon, but also included modern Cornwall and part of Somerset; its eastern boundary was moved westward over time with the gradual expansion of the neighbouring Anglo-Saxon kingdom of Wessex. The spelling Damnonia is sometimes encountered, but that spelling is also used for the land of the Damnonii, later part of the Kingdom of Strathclyde, in present-day southern Scotland.
The form Domnonia also occurs. The name of the kingdom shares a linguistic relationship with the Breton region of Domnonée (Breton: Domnonea).

Dunoding.headline: Dunoding
paragraphs: Dunoding je bil zgodnje podkraljestvo v Kraljestvu Gwynedd na severozahodu Walesa, ki je obstajalo med 5. in 10. stoletjem. Po izročilu je dobil ime po Dunodu, ki je okoli leta 460 z območja pregnal irske naseljence; Dunod je bil sin Cunedde Wlediga, ustanovitelja Gwynedda. Ozemlje je kot podrejeno kraljestvo v Gwyneddu obstajalo, dokler okoli leta 925 ni izumrla rodbina vladarjev, ki so izhajali od Dunoda. Po koncu Dunodove rodbine so ga razdelili na kantrefa Eifionydd in Ardudwy ter ga v celoti priključili Gwyneddu. Ko je bilo kraljestvo Gwynedd leta 1283 poraženo in priključeno Angliji, sta kantrefa postala dela grofij Caernarfonshire oziroma Merionethshire. Danes je ozemlje del sodobne grofije Gwynedd.

source.title: Dunoding
paragraphs: Dunoding was an early sub-kingdom within the Kingdom of Gwynedd in north-west Wales which existed between the 5th and 10th centuries. According to tradition, it was named after Dunod, a son of the founding father of Gwynedd – Cunedda Wledig – who drove the Irish settlers from the area in c. 460. The territory existed as a subordinate realm within Gwynedd until the line of rulers descended from Dunod expired in c. 925. Following the end of the House of Dunod, it was split into the cantrefi of Eifionydd and Ardudwy and fully incorporated into Gwynedd. After the defeat of the kingdom of Gwynedd in 1283 and its annexation to England, the two cantrefi became parts of the counties of Caernarfonshire and Merionethshire, respectively. It is now part of the modern county of Gwynedd.

Earl of Desmond.headline: Grof Desmond
paragraphs: Grof Desmond (irsko: Iarla Dheasumhan, kar pomeni »grof južnega Munstra«) je plemiški naslov, ki ga je angleški monarh ustvaril v irskem plemstvu. Naslov je bil podeljen štirikrat. Prvič ga je leta 1329 dobil Maurice FitzGerald, 4. baron Desmond, hibernsko-normanski gospod na jugozahodu Irske, njegovi potomci pa so ga imeli do leta 1583, ko so se v desmondskih uporih uprli angleški kroni. Po dveh kratkotrajnih ponovnih podelitvah v začetku 17. stoletja ima naslov od leta 1628 rodbina Feilding iz Warwickshira v Angliji. Sedanji nosilec je Alexander Feilding, 12. grof Denbigh in 11. grof Desmond (4. podelitev). Grofija rodbine Fitzgerald je zgodovinsko obsegala vso današnjo grofijo Limerick ter velike dele grofij Cork, Kerry in Waterford. Mejila je na kraljestvi Desmond in Thomond ter na grofijo Ormond.
notes: The record is the earldom as a state; the article is about the title. "The early 1600s" is given as the beginning of the 17th century.

source.title: Earl of Desmond
paragraphs: Earl of Desmond (Irish: Iarla Dheasumhan meaning Earl of South Munster) is a title of nobility created by the English monarch in the peerage of Ireland. The title has been created four times.
