It was first awarded in 1329 to Maurice FitzGerald, 4th Baron Desmond, a Hiberno-Norman lord in Southwest Ireland, and it was held by his descendants until 1583 when they rose against the English crown in the Desmond Rebellions. Following two short-lived recreations of the title in the early 1600s, the title has been held since 1628 by the Feilding family of Warwickshire, England. The current holder is Alexander Feilding, 12th Earl of Denbigh and 11th Earl of Desmond (4th creation). The earldom held by the Fitzgerald family historically comprised what is now the entirety of County Limerick with large swathes of County Cork, County Kerry and County Waterford also being included. It bordered the Kingdom of Desmond, Kingdom of Thomond and the Earldom of Ormond

East Pomeranian offensive.headline: Vzhodnopomorjanska ofenziva
paragraphs: Vzhodnopomorjanska strateška ofenzivna operacija (rusko: Восточно-Померанская наступательная операция) je bila ofenziva sovjetske Rdeče armade proti nemškemu Wehrmachtu na vzhodni fronti. Potekala je na Pomorjanskem in v Zahodni Prusiji od 10. februarja do 4. aprila 1945.
Operacija je potekala v štirih fazah.
Ena od njih je bila konitško-köslinska ofenzivna operacija od 24. februarja do 6. marca 1945.
notes: The English excerpt is the start of a list of the four phases; the Slovenian turns it into complete sentences.

source.title: East Pomeranian offensive
paragraphs: The East Pomeranian strategic offensive operation (Russian: Восточно-Померанская наступательная операция) was an offensive by the Soviet Red Army against the German Wehrmacht on the Eastern Front. It took place in Pomerania and West Prussia from 10 February – 4 April 1945.
The operation happened in four phases:
Konitz–Köslin offensive operation 24 February – 6 March 1945

Easter Rising.headline: Velikonočna vstaja
paragraphs: Velikonočna vstaja (irsko: Éirí Amach na Cásca), znana tudi kot velikonočni upor, je bila oborožena vstaja na Irskem v velikonočnem tednu aprila 1916. Sprožili so jo irski republikanci proti britanski oblasti na Irskem, da bi ustanovili neodvisno Irsko republiko, medtem ko se je Združeno kraljestvo bojevalo v prvi svetovni vojni. Bila je najpomembnejša vstaja na Irskem po uporu leta 1798 in prvi oboroženi spopad irskega revolucionarnega obdobja. Od maja 1916 so usmrtili šestnajst voditeljev vstaje. Način usmrtitev in poznejši politični razvoj sta nazadnje prispevala k večji podpori irski neodvisnosti med ljudmi.

source.title: Easter Rising
paragraphs: The Easter Rising (Irish: Éirí Amach na Cásca), also known as the Easter Rebellion, was an armed insurrection in Ireland during Easter Week in April 1916. The Rising was launched by Irish republicans against British rule in Ireland with the aim of establishing an independent Irish Republic while the United Kingdom was fighting the First World War. It was the most significant uprising in Ireland since the rebellion of 1798 and the first armed conflict of the Irish revolutionary period. Sixteen of the Rising's leaders were executed starting in May 1916. The nature of the executions, and subsequent political developments, ultimately contributed to an increase in popular support for Irish independence.

Eighth Battle of the Isonzo.headline: Osma soška bitka
paragraphs: Osma soška bitka je potekala od 10. do 12. oktobra 1916 med Italijo in Avstro-Ogrsko.

source.title: Eighth Battle of the Isonzo
paragraphs: The Eighth Battle of the Isonzo was fought between 10 and 12 October 1916 between Italy and Austria-Hungary.

Volilna kneževina Hannover (nemško: Kurfürstentum Hannover ali preprosto Kurhannover) je bila volilna kneževina Svetega rimskega cesarstva na severozahodu Nemčije, ki je nastala iz Kneževine Calenberg. Čeprav je bilo njeno uradno ime Volilna kneževina Braunschweig-Lüneburg (nemško: Kurfürstentum Braunschweig-Lüneburg), je za prestolnico izbrala Hannover. Večino časa je bila volilna kneževina zaradi hannovrskega nasledstva v personalni uniji z Veliko Britanijo in Irsko.
notes: The glossary headline is the formal name, written with a spaced hyphen (Volilna kneževina Braunschweig - Lüneburg); the text uses the common name Hannover and the unspaced German form. Worth reviewing with the other spaced-hyphen names (Danska - Norveška, Saška - Weimar - Eisenach, Kneževina Hohenzollern - Sigmaringen).

source.title: Electorate of Hanover
paragraphs: The Electorate of Hanover (German: Kurfürstentum Hannover or simply Kurhannover) was an electorate of the Holy Roman Empire located in northwestern Germany that arose from the Principality of Calenberg. Although formally known as the Electorate of Brunswick-Lüneburg (German: Kurfürstentum Braunschweig-Lüneburg), it made Hanover its capital city. For most of its existence, the electorate was ruled in personal union with Great Britain and Ireland following the Hanoverian Succession.

Volilna kneževina Hessen (nemško: Kurfürstentum Hessen), znana tudi kot Hessen-Kassel ali Kurhessen, je ime, ki ga je nosila nekdanja Deželna grofija Hessen-Kassel po reformi leta 1803, ko je cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Franc II. njenega vladarja povzdignil v volilnega kneza in mu tako dal glas pri prihodnjih volitvah cesarja. Ko je bilo leta 1806 Sveto rimsko cesarstvo odpravljeno, je hessenski volilni knez Viljem I. obdržal naslov volilnega kneza, čeprav ni bilo več cesarja, ki bi ga volil. Leta 1807 so ozemlje s tilsitskima pogodbama priključili Kraljevini Vestfaliji, leta 1814 pa je dunajski kongres volilno kneževino obnovil.

Država je bila edina volilna kneževina v Nemški zvezi. Sestavljalo jo je več ločenih ozemelj severno od Frankfurta, ki so obstajala do leta 1866, ko jo je po avstrijsko-pruski vojni priključila Prusija.

Formalni naslovi volilnega kneza so obsegali »volilni knez Hessna, knez Fulde (Fürst von Fulda), knez Hersfelda, Hanaua, Fritzlarja in Isenburga, grof Katzenelnbogna, Dietza, Ziegenhaina, Nidde in Schaumburga«.

source.title: Electorate of Hesse
paragraphs: The Electorate of Hesse (German: Kurfürstentum Hessen), also known as Hesse-Kassel or Kurhessen, was the title used for the former Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel after an 1803 reform where Francis II, Holy Roman Emperor elevated its ruler to the rank of Elector, thus giving him a vote in any future elections to the emperorship. When the Holy Roman Empire was abolished in 1806, William I, Elector of Hesse, chose to retain the title of Elector, even though there was no longer an Emperor to elect. In 1807, with the Treaties of Tilsit, the area was annexed to the Kingdom of Westphalia, but in 1814, the Congress of Vienna restored the electorate.

The state was the only electorate within the German Confederation. It consisted of several detached territories to the north of Frankfurt, which survived until the state was annexed by Prussia in 1866 following the Austro-Prussian War.

The Elector's formal titles included "Elector of Hesse, Prince of Fulda (Fürst von Fulda), Prince of Hersfeld, Hanau, Fritzlar and Isenburg, Count of Katzenelnbogen, Dietz, Ziegenhain, Nidda, and Schaumburg."

Elektorat Trier (nemško: Kurfürstentum Trier ali Kurtrier; francosko: Trèves) je bil cerkvena kneževina Svetega rimskega cesarstva, ki je obstajala od konca 9. do začetka 19. stoletja. Bil je posvetna posest trierskega knezonadškofa (Erzbistum Trier), ki je bil po položaju volilni knez cesarstva. Druga cerkvena volilna kneza sta bila nadškofa Kölna in Mainza (v posvetnem kontekstu imenovana preprosto volilna kneza).
Prestolnica elektorata je bila v Trierju; od 16. stoletja je bila glavna rezidenca volilnega kneza v Koblenzu. Elektorat je bil sekulariziran leta 1803 med nemško mediatizacijo.
Trierski volilni knez je kot nadškof upravljal tudi trierško nadškofijo, katere ozemlje se ni ujemalo z elektoratom.
notes: The reference "(see map below)" points to the English article and is dropped.
The glossary has Elektorat Trier, while the other electorates are Volilna kneževina (Hessen, Braunschweig-Lüneburg); worth harmonising.

source.title: Electorate of Trier
paragraphs: The Electorate of Trier (German: Kurfürstentum Trier or Kurtrier; French: Trèves) was an ecclesiastical principality of the Holy Roman Empire that existed from the end of the 9th to the early 19th century. It was the temporal possession of the prince-archbishop of Trier (Erzbistum Trier) who was, ex officio, a prince-elector of the empire. The other ecclesiastical electors were the archbishops (in the secular context called simply electors) of Cologne and Mainz.

The capital of the electorate was Trier; from the 16th century onward, the main residence of the Elector was in Koblenz. The electorate was secularized in 1803 in the course of the German mediatisation.
The Elector of Trier, in his capacity as archbishop, also administered the Archdiocese of Trier, whose territory did not correspond to the electorate (see map below).

Eleventh Battle of the Isonzo.headline: Enajsta soška bitka
paragraphs: Enajsta soška bitka je bila bitka prve svetovne vojne, ki sta jo od 18. avgusta do 12. septembra 1917 na italijanski fronti bojevali italijanska in avstro-ogrska vojska.

source.title: Eleventh Battle of the Isonzo
paragraphs: The Eleventh Battle of the Isonzo was a World War I battle fought by the Italian and Austro-Hungarian Armies on the Italian Front between 18 August and 12 September 1917.

Empire of Thessalonica.headline: Solunsko cesarstvo
paragraphs: Solunsko cesarstvo je zgodovinopisni izraz, s katerim nekateri sodobni raziskovalci označujejo kratkotrajno grško državo s središčem v Solunu med letoma 1224 in 1246 (v ožjem pomenu do leta 1242), ki ji je vladala dinastija Komnen Duka iz Epirskega despotata. Ob nastanku, v času boja za Carigrad, je Solunsko cesarstvo pod sposobnim Teodorjem Komnenom Duko tekmovalo z Nikejskim cesarstvom in Drugim bolgarskim cesarstvom za položaj najmočnejše države v regiji ter si prizadevalo zavzeti Carigrad, odpraviti Latinsko cesarstvo in obnoviti Bizantinsko cesarstvo, ki je leta 1204 propadlo.

source.title: Empire of Thessalonica
paragraphs: The Empire of Thessalonica is a historiographic term used by some modern scholars to refer to the short-lived Greek state centred on the city of Thessalonica between 1224 and 1246 (sensu stricto until 1242) and ruled by the Komnenodoukas dynasty of the Despotate of Epirus. At the time of its establishment during the struggle for Constantinople, the Empire of Thessalonica, under the capable Theodore Komnenos Doukas, rivaled the Empire of Nicaea and the Second Bulgarian Empire as the strongest state in the region, and aspired to capturing Constantinople, putting an end to the Latin Empire, and restoring the Byzantine Empire that had been extinguished in 1204.

English Armada.headline: Angleška armada
paragraphs: Angleška armada (špansko: Invencible Inglesa, dobesedno »nepremagljiva angleška«), znana tudi kot protiarmada, odprava Drakea in Norrisa ali portugalska odprava, je bila napadalna flota, ki jo je angleška kraljica Elizabeta I. poslala nad Španijo; izplula je 28. aprila 1589 med nenapovedano angleško-špansko vojno (1585–1604) in osemdesetletno vojno.

Pod vodstvom sira Francisa Drakea kot admirala in sira Johna Norrisa kot generala ni izkoristila prednosti, ki si jo je Anglija pridobila s porazom španske armade leto prej. Španska zmaga je pomenila oživitev pomorske moči Filipa II.

source.title: English Armada
paragraphs: The English Armada (Spanish: Invencible Inglesa, lit. 'Invincible English'), also known as the Counter Armada, the Drake–Norris Expedition, or the Portugal Expedition, was an attack fleet sent against Spain by Queen Elizabeth I of England that sailed on 28 April 1589 during the undeclared Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604) and the Eighty Years' War.

Led by Sir Francis Drake as admiral and Sir John Norris as general, it failed to drive home the advantage that England had gained from defeating the Spanish Armada the previous year. The Spanish victory marked a revival in Philip II's naval power.

Environmental Modification Convention.headline: Konvencija o prepovedi spreminjanja okolja
paragraphs: Konvencija o spreminjanju okolja (ENMOD), uradno Konvencija o prepovedi vojaške ali kakršne koli druge sovražne uporabe tehnik spreminjanja okolja, je mednarodna pogodba, ki prepoveduje vojaško ali drugo sovražno uporabo tehnik spreminjanja okolja s široko razširjenimi, dolgotrajnimi ali hudimi učinki. Za podpis je bila odprta 18. maja 1977 v Ženevi, veljati pa je začela 5. oktobra 1978.

Konvencija prepoveduje vremensko vojskovanje, torej uporabo tehnik spreminjanja vremena za povzročanje škode ali uničenja. Konvencija o biološki raznovrstnosti iz leta 2010 naj bi prepovedala tudi nekatere oblike spreminjanja vremena ali geoinženiringa.
Mnoge države tega ne štejejo za popolno prepoved uporabe herbicidov v vojni, kot je bil agent orange, vendar konvencija zahteva presojo vsakega primera posebej.

source.title: Environmental Modification Convention
paragraphs: The Environmental Modification Convention (ENMOD), formally the Convention on the Prohibition of Military or Any Other Hostile Use of Environmental Modification Techniques, is an international treaty prohibiting the military or other hostile use of environmental modification techniques having widespread, long-lasting or severe effects. It opened for signature on 18 May 1977 in Geneva and entered into force on 5 October 1978.

The Convention bans weather warfare, which is the use of weather modification techniques for the purposes of inducing damage or destruction. The Convention on Biological Diversity of 2010 would also ban some forms of weather modification or geoengineering.
Many states do not regard this as a complete ban on the use of herbicides in warfare, such as Agent Orange, but it does require case-by-case consideration.

Erdut Agreement.headline: Erdutski sporazum
paragraphs: Erdutski sporazum (srbohrvaško: Erdutski sporazum / Ердутски споразум), uradno Temeljni sporazum o območju Vzhodne Slavonije, Baranje in Zahodnega Srema, je bil sporazum, ki so ga 12. novembra 1995 sklenile oblasti Republike Hrvaške in krajevne srbske oblasti območja Vzhodne Slavonije, Baranje in Zahodnega Srema o mirni rešitvi hrvaške osamosvojitvene vojne na vzhodu Hrvaške. Dejansko je končal etnonacionalistični spopad v regiji in začel proces mirne reintegracije območja pod nadzor hrvaške osrednje oblasti. Reintegracijo so neposredno izvajali Združeni narodi. Sporazum je določil vrsto jamstev za človekove pravice in pravice manjšin ter za vrnitev beguncev. Ime je dobil po vasi Erdut, kjer so ga podpisali predstavniki krajevnih Srbov.

source.title: Erdut Agreement
paragraphs: The Erdut Agreement (Serbo-Croatian: Erdutski sporazum / Ердутски споразум), officially the Basic Agreement on the Region of Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium, is an agreement reached on 12 November 1995 between the authorities of the Republic of Croatia and the local Serb authorities of the Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia region on the peaceful resolution to the Croatian War of Independence in eastern Croatia. It effectively ended the ethno-nationalist conflict in the region and initiated the process of peaceful reintegration of the region to central government control of Croatia. The reintegration was directly implemented by the United Nations. The agreement provided a set of guarantees on human and minority rights as well as on the refugee return. It was named after Erdut, the village in which it was signed by local Serb representatives.

Euratom Treaty.headline: Pogodba o Euratomu
paragraphs: Pogodba o Euratomu, uradno Pogodba o ustanovitvi Evropske skupnosti za atomsko energijo, je ustanovila Evropsko skupnost za atomsko energijo. Podpisali so jo 25. marca 1957, hkrati s Pogodbo o ustanovitvi Evropske gospodarske skupnosti (pogodba EGS).

Pogodba o Euratomu je manj znana zaradi manjše prepoznavnosti organizacije, ki jo je ustanovila. EGS se je razvila v današnjo Evropsko unijo, Euratom pa je ostal v glavnem enak kot leta 1957, čeprav ga upravljajo institucije Evropske unije. Ustanovljen je bil z lastno komisijo in svetom, vendar je pogodba o združitvi iz leta 1967 te institucije Euratoma in Evropske skupnosti za premog in jeklo združila z institucijami EGS.

source.title: Euratom Treaty
paragraphs: The Euratom Treaty, officially the Treaty establishing the European Atomic Energy Community, established the European Atomic Energy Community. It was signed on 25 March 1957 at the same time as the Treaty establishing the European Economic Community (EEC Treaty).

The Euratom Treaty is less well known because of the lower profile of the organisation that it founded. The EEC has evolved into what is now the European Union, but Euratom has remained much the same as it was in 1957 although it is governed by the institutions of the European Union. It was established with its own Commission and Council, but the 1967 Merger Treaty merged these institutions of Euratom and the European Coal and Steel Community with those of the EEC.

Evropska listina o regionalnih ali manjšinskih jezikih (ECRML) je evropska pogodba (CETS 148), sprejeta leta 1992 pod okriljem Sveta Evrope za zaščito in spodbujanje zgodovinskih regionalnih in manjšinskih jezikov v Evropi. Listina pa ne določa nobenega merila ali opredelitve, kdaj je neki jezik manjšinski ali regionalni, razvrstitev pa ostaja v rokah posamezne države.

source.title: European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages
paragraphs: The European Charter for Regional or Minority Languages (ECRML) is a European treaty (CETS 148) adopted in 1992 under the auspices of the Council of Europe to protect and promote historical regional and minority languages in Europe. However, the charter does not provide any criterion or definition for an idiom to be a minority or a regional language, and the classification stays in the hands of the national state.

European Charter of Local Self-Governmen.headline: Evropska listina lokalne samouprave
paragraphs: Evropska listina lokalne samouprave je bila sprejeta pod okriljem Kongresa Sveta Evrope in 15. oktobra 1985 odprta za podpis državam članicam Sveta Evrope. Pogodbenice listine so vse države članice Sveta Evrope. Od novih držav članic se pričakuje, da jo ratificirajo ob prvi priložnosti.

Listina države članice, ki jo ratificirajo, zavezuje k zagotavljanju politične, upravne in finančne neodvisnosti lokalnih oblasti. Določa, da mora biti načelo lokalne samouprave priznano v notranji zakonodaji in, kjer je to izvedljivo, v ustavi. Lokalne oblasti naj bi bile izvoljene na splošnih volitvah, listina pa je najstarejši pravni instrument, ki določa načelo subsidiarnosti.

source.title: European Charter of Local Self-Government
paragraphs: The European Charter of Local Self-Government was adopted under the auspices of the Congress of the Council of Europe and was opened for signature by the Council of Europe's member states on 15 October 1985. All Council of Europe member states are parties to the Charter. New member states of the Council of Europe are expected to ratify the Charter at the earliest opportunity.

The Charter commits the ratifying member states to guaranteeing the political, administrative and financial independence of local authorities. It provides that the principle of local self-government shall be recognised in domestic legislation and, where practicable, in the constitution. Local authorities are to be elected by universal suffrage, and it is the earliest legal instrument to set out the principle of subsidiarity.

European Fiscal Compact.headline: Evropski fiskalni dogovor
paragraphs: Pogodba o stabilnosti, usklajevanju in upravljanju v ekonomski in monetarni uniji, imenovana tudi TSCG ali preprosteje pogodba o fiskalni stabilnosti, je medvladna pogodba, uvedena kot nova, strožja različica Pakta za stabilnost in rast, ki so jo 2. marca 2012 podpisale vse države članice Evropske unije (EU) razen Češke in Združenega kraljestva. Pogodba je 1. januarja 2013 začela veljati za 16 držav, ki so pred tem dnem končale ratifikacijo. Do 3. aprila 2019 je bila ratificirana in je začela veljati za vseh 25 podpisnic, za Hrvaško, ki je EU pristopila julija 2013, in za Češko.

Fiskalni dogovor je fiskalno poglavje pogodbe (naslov III). Zavezuje 23 držav članic: 21 držav članic evroobmočja ter Dansko in Romunijo, ki sta se zanj prostovoljno odločili. Spremlja ga sklop skupnih načel.

source.title: European Fiscal Compact
paragraphs: The Treaty on Stability, Coordination and Governance in the Economic and Monetary Union; also referred to as TSCG, or more plainly the Fiscal Stability Treaty is an intergovernmental treaty introduced as a new stricter version of the Stability and Growth Pact, signed on 2 March 2012 by all member states of the European Union (EU), except the Czech Republic and the United Kingdom. The treaty entered into force on 1 January 2013 for the 16 states which completed ratification prior to this date. As of 3 April 2019, it had been ratified and entered into force for all 25 signatories plus Croatia, which acceded to the EU in July 2013, and the Czech Republic.

The Fiscal Compact is the fiscal chapter of the Treaty (Title III). It binds 23 member states: the 21 member states of the eurozone, plus Denmark and Romania, who have chosen to opt in. It is accompanied by a set of common principles.

European Landscape Convention.headline: Evropska konvencija o krajini
paragraphs: Evropska konvencija o krajini Sveta Evrope, znana tudi kot Firenška konvencija, je prva mednarodna pogodba, ki je izključno namenjena vsem vidikom evropske krajine. Velja na celotnem ozemlju pogodbenic in zajema naravna, podeželska, mestna in primestna območja. Nanaša se na krajine, ki jih lahko štejemo za izjemne, pa tudi na vsakdanje ali degradirane krajine. Konvencija želi zaščititi, upravljati in načrtovati vse krajine ter dvigniti ozaveščenost o vrednosti žive krajine.

source.title: European Landscape Convention
paragraphs: The European Landscape Convention of the Council of Europe, also known as the Florence Convention, is the first international treaty to be exclusively devoted to all aspects of European landscape. It applies to the entire territory of the Parties and covers natural, rural, urban and peri-urban areas. It concerns landscapes that might be considered outstanding as well as everyday or degraded landscapes. The convention is aimed at: the protection, management and planning of all landscapes and raising awareness of the value of a living landscape.

Konvencija o evropskem patentu (EPC), znana tudi kot Konvencija o podeljevanju evropskih patentov z dne 5. oktobra 1973, je večstranska pogodba, ki ustanavlja Evropsko patentno organizacijo in vzpostavlja samostojen pravni sistem, po katerem se podeljujejo evropski patenti. Izraz evropski patent označuje patente, podeljene po Konvenciji o evropskem patentu. Evropski patent pa ni enotna pravica, temveč skupina v bistvu neodvisnih patentov, ki jih je mogoče uveljavljati in razveljaviti na nacionalni ravni, za skupino pa veljata centralna razveljavitev ali omejitev po dveh vrstah enotnih postopkov po podelitvi: časovno omejenem postopku ugovora, ki ga lahko sproži kdor koli razen imetnika patenta, ter postopkih omejitve in razveljavitve, ki ju lahko sproži le imetnik patenta.

source.title: European Patent Convention
paragraphs: The European Patent Convention (EPC), also known as the Convention on the Grant of European Patents of 5 October 1973, is a multilateral treaty instituting the European Patent Organisation and providing an autonomous legal system according to which European patents are granted. The term European patent is used to refer to patents granted under the European Patent Convention. However, a European patent is not a unitary right, but a group of essentially independent nationally enforceable, nationally revocable patents, subject to central revocation or narrowing as a group pursuant to two types of unified, post-grant procedures: a time-limited opposition procedure, which can be initiated by any person except the patent proprietor, and limitation and revocation procedures, which can be initiated by the patent proprietor only.

Pridružitveni sporazum med Ukrajino in Evropsko unijo je pridružitveni sporazum, katerega pogodbenice so Evropska unija (EU), Evropska skupnost za atomsko energijo (Euratom), Ukrajina in 28 tedanjih držav članic EU (ki so poleg EU in Euratoma samostojne pogodbenice). Med pogodbenicami vzpostavlja politično in gospodarsko pridružitev. Sporazum je začel veljati 1. septembra 2017; deli so se pred tem uporabljali začasno. Pogodbenice so se zavezale k sodelovanju in zbliževanju gospodarske politike, zakonodaje in predpisov na številnih področjih, med drugim pri enakih pravicah delavcev, korakih k odpravi vizumov, izmenjavi informacij in osebja na področju pravosodja, posodobitvi ukrajinske energetske infrastrukture in dostopu do Evropske investicijske banke (EIB). Zavezale so se tudi k rednim vrhom ter srečanjem ministrov, drugih uradnikov in strokovnjakov. Sporazum poleg tega med pogodbenicami vzpostavlja poglobljeno in celovito območje proste trgovine.

source.title: European Union–Ukraine Association Agreement
paragraphs: The European Union–Ukraine Association Agreement is a European Union association agreement between the European Union (EU), the European Atomic Energy Community (Euratom), Ukraine and the EU's 28 member states at the time (which are separate parties in addition to the EU and Euratom). It establishes a political and economic association between the parties. The agreement entered into force on 1 September 2017; previously parts had been provisionally applied. The parties committed to co-operate and converge economic policy, legislation, as well as regulation across a broad range of areas, including equal rights for workers, steps towards visa-free movement of people, the exchange of information and staff in the area of justice, the modernisation of Ukraine's energy infrastructure and access to the European Investment Bank (EIB). The parties committed to regular summit meetings and meetings among ministers, other officials and experts. The agreement furthermore establishes a Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Area between the parties.

Evianski sporazumi so bili sklop izjav, ki sta jih 18. marca 1962 v Évian-les-Bainsu sprejeli francoska vlada in začasna vlada Alžirske republike in so določali dogovore o neodvisnosti Alžirije ter o sodelovanju s Francijo. Sporazumi so obsegali pet poglavij, ki so podrobno določala jamstva in načela te neodvisnosti. Končali so alžirsko vojno s premirjem, razglašenim 19. marca 1962, in dejansko formalizirali status Alžirije kot neodvisne države.

source.title: Évian Accords
paragraphs: The Évian Accords were a set of declarations between the French Government and the Provisional Government of the Algerian Republic on 18 March 1962 in Évian-les-Bains which outlined the agreements for Algeria's Independence alongside cooperation with France. The Accords consisted of five chapters which detailed the guarantees and principals of this Independence. The Accords ended the Algerian War with a cease-fire that was declared on the 19th March 1962, and effectively formalised the status of Algeria as an independent nation.

Ekspedicija tisočev (italijansko: Spedizione dei Mille) je bila dogodek v procesu združevanja Italije, ki se je zgodil leta 1860. Zbor prostovoljcev pod vodstvom Giuseppeja Garibaldija je izplul iz kraja Quarto al Mare blizu Genove in pristal v Marsali na Siciliji, da bi osvojil Kraljevino dveh Sicilij, ki jo je vladala španska rodbina Burbonov dveh Sicilij. Ime odprave izhaja iz prvotnega števila udeležencev, okoli 1000 ljudi.

Garibaldinci so se s prispevkom južnih prostovoljcev in okrepitev odprave razrasli v Južno armado. Po nekaj mesecev trajajoči kampanji z nekaj zmagovitimi bitkami proti burbonski vojski so Tisoč in na novo nastala južna armada uspeli osvojiti vso Kraljevino dveh Sicilij. Odprava je bila uspešna in se je končala s plebiscitom, s katerim sta Neapelj in Sicilija postala del Kraljevine Piemont-Sardinije; bila je zadnja ozemeljska osvojitev pred razglasitvijo Kraljevine Italije 17. marca 1861.

source.title: Expedition of the Thousand
paragraphs: The Expedition of the Thousand (Italian: Spedizione dei Mille) was an event of the unification of Italy that took place in 1860. A corps of volunteers led by Giuseppe Garibaldi sailed from Quarto al Mare near Genoa and landed in Marsala, Sicily, in order to conquer the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, ruled by the Spanish House of Bourbon-Two Sicilies. The name of the expedition derives from the initial number of participants, which was around 1,000 people.

The Garibaldians, with the contribution of southern volunteers and reinforcements to the expedition, increased in number, creating the Southern Army. After a campaign of a few months with some victorious battles against the Bourbon army, the Thousand and the newborn southern army managed to conquer the entire Kingdom of the Two Sicilies. The expedition was a success and concluded with a plebiscite that brought Naples and Sicily into the Kingdom of Piedmont-Sardinia, the last territorial conquest before the proclamation of the Kingdom of Italy on 17 March 1861.

Falaise pocket.headline: Žep pri Falaisu
paragraphs: Žep pri Falaisu ali bitka v žepu pri Falaisu (nemško: Kessel von Falaise; 12.–21. avgusta 1944) je bil odločilni spopad bitke za Normandijo v drugi svetovni vojni. Zavezniške sile so okoli Falaisa v departmaju Calvados oblikovale žep, v katerem so zahodni zavezniki obkolili nemško armadno skupino B, ki sta jo sestavljali 7. armada in 5. tankovska armada (prej Panzergruppe West). Bitka se je končala z uničenjem večine armadne skupine B zahodno od Sene, kar je odprlo pot do Pariza in francosko-nemške meje.

Šest tednov po zavezniški invaziji na Normandijo 6. junija 1944 so bile nemške sile v zmedi: pri obrambi bojne črte so porabile nenadomestljive vire, zavezniška premoč v zraku pa je ogrožala dobavo hrane in streliva. Na zavezniški strani pa so Britanci pričakovali, da bodo Caen osvobodili takoj po invaziji, a je operacija trajala skoraj dva meseca, Američani pa so pričakovali, da bodo do 7. junija nadzorovali Saint-Lô, vendar je nemški odpor to zavlekel do časa po osvoboditvi Caena.

source.title: Falaise pocket
paragraphs: The Falaise pocket or battle of the Falaise pocket (German: Kessel von Falaise; 12–21 August 1944) was the decisive engagement of the Battle of Normandy in the Second World War. Allied forces formed a pocket around Falaise, Calvados, in which German Army Group B, consisting of the 7th Army and the Fifth Panzer Army (formerly Panzergruppe West), were encircled by the Western Allies. The battle resulted in the destruction of most of Army Group B west of the Seine, which opened the way to Paris and the Franco-German border.

Six weeks after the 6 June 1944 Allied invasion of Normandy, German forces were in turmoil, having expended irreplaceable resources defending the frontline and with Allied air superiority threatening the availability of food and ammunition. However, on the Allied side, British forces had expected to liberate Caen immediately after the invasion, an operation which ended up taking nearly two months, and US forces had expected to control Saint-Lô by 7 June, yet German resistance delayed this until after Caen's liberation.

Fall of Antwerp.headline: Padec Antwerpna
paragraphs: Padec Antwerpna (nizozemsko: val van Antwerpen) 17. avgusta 1585 se je zgodil med osemdesetletno vojno po več kot leto dni dolgem obleganju od julija 1584 do avgusta 1585. Mesto Antwerpen je bilo žarišče nizozemskega upora, v katerem so prevladovali protestanti, a se je moralo predati španskim silam pod poveljstvom Alessandra Farneseja. Po dogovorjenih pogojih so imeli vsi antwerpenski protestanti štiri leta časa, da uredijo svoje zadeve in zapustijo mesto. Mnogi so se izselili na sever, zlasti v Amsterdam. Antwerpen ni izgubil le velikega dela srednjega sloja in trgovcev, njegova trgovina je trpela še dve stoletji, saj so nizozemske utrdbe do leta 1795 blokirale reko Šeldo.
notes: The Dutch pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Fall of Antwerp
paragraphs: The fall of Antwerp (Dutch: val van Antwerpen [vɑl vɑn ˈɑntʋɛrpə(n)]) on 17 August 1585 took place during the Eighty Years' War, after a siege lasting over a year from July 1584 until August 1585. The city of Antwerp was the focal point of the Protestant-dominated Dutch Revolt, but was forced to surrender to the Spanish forces under the command of Alessandro Farnese. Under the terms agreed, all the Protestants of Antwerp were given four years to settle their affairs and leave the city. Many migrated north, especially to Amsterdam. Apart from losing a high proportion of its middle class and mercantile population, Antwerp's trade suffered for two centuries afterwards as Dutch forts blockaded the River Scheldt until 1795.

Faro Convention.headline: Konvencija iz Fara
paragraphs: Okvirna konvencija Sveta Evrope o vrednosti kulturne dediščine za družbo, bolj znana kot Konvencija iz Fara, je večstranska pogodba Sveta Evrope, s katero se države zavezujejo varovati kulturno dediščino in pravice državljanov do dostopa do te dediščine in sodelovanja pri njej.

source.title: Faro Convention
paragraphs: The Council of Europe Framework Convention on the Value of Cultural Heritage for Society, better known as the Faro Convention, is a multilateral Council of Europe treaty whereby states agree to protect cultural heritage and the rights of citizens to access and participate in that heritage.

Fifth Battle of the Isonzo.headline: Peta soška bitka
paragraphs: Peta soška bitka je potekala od 9. do 15. marca 1916 med vojskami Kraljevine Italije in Avstro-Ogrske. Italijani so se odločili za novo ofenzivo ob reki Soči (Isonzo).

source.title: Fifth Battle of the Isonzo
paragraphs: The Fifth Battle of the Isonzo was fought from 9 to 15 March 1916 between the armies of the Kingdom of Italy and those of Austria-Hungary. The Italians had decided to launch another offensive on the Soča (Isonzo) River.

Finno-Soviet Treaty of 1948.headline: Finsko-sovjetska pogodba iz leta 1948
paragraphs: Sporazum o prijateljstvu, sodelovanju in medsebojni pomoči iz leta 1948, znan tudi kot pogodba YYA po finskem imenu Ystävyys-, yhteistyö- ja avunantosopimus (YYA-sopimus) (švedsko: Vänskaps-, samarbets- och biståndsavtalet (VSB-avtalet)), je bil od leta 1948 do 1992 temelj finsko-sovjetskih odnosov. Bil je glavno orodje za uresničevanje finske politike, imenovane Paasikivi-Kekkonenova doktrina.

S pogodbo, podpisano 6. aprila 1948, so Sovjeti želeli odvrniti zahodne ali zavezniške sile od napada na Sovjetsko zvezo prek finskega ozemlja, Finci pa so si prizadevali povečati politično neodvisnost Finske od Sovjetske zveze. Pogodba je tako zagotovila preživetje Finske kot liberalne demokracije v neposredni bližini strateških sovjetskih območij, kot sta polotok Kola in veliko mesto Leningrad.

source.title: Finno-Soviet Treaty of 1948
paragraphs: The Agreement of Friendship, Cooperation, and Mutual Assistance of 1948, also known as the YYA Treaty from the Finnish Ystävyys-, yhteistyö- ja avunantosopimus (YYA-sopimus) (Swedish: Vänskaps-, samarbets- och biståndsavtalet (VSB-avtalet)), was the basis for Finno–Soviet relations from 1948 to 1992. It was the main instrument in implementing the Finnish policy called Paasikivi–Kekkonen doctrine.

Under the treaty, which was signed on 6 April 1948, the Soviets sought to deter Western or Allied Powers from attacking the Soviet Union through Finnish territory, and the Finns sought to increase Finland's political independence from the Soviet Union. It thus ensured Finland's survival as a liberal democracy in close proximity to strategic Soviet regions, such as the Kola Peninsula and the major city of Leningrad.

Prva angleško-nizozemska vojna ali prva nizozemska vojna je bila pomorski spopad med Angleško republiko in Nizozemsko republiko. Povzročili so jo predvsem trgovinski spori; začela se je z angleškimi napadi na nizozemske trgovske ladje, nato pa prerasla v obsežne spopade flot. Kljub vrsti zmag v letih 1652 in 1653 Angleška republika ni mogla blokirati nizozemske trgovine, čeprav so angleški zasebniki nizozemskemu trgovskemu ladjevju prizadejali hude izgube.

Gospodarska škoda je nazadnje privedla do westminstrske pogodbe leta 1654, v kateri so morali Nizozemci Angleški republiki narediti manjše koncesije. Obe strani sta se strinjali, da Oranska hiša ne sme zasesti položaja namestnika (stadtholderja), temeljnih trgovinskih vprašanj pa nista rešili. Leta 1665 so nizozemski ugovori zoper navigacijske akte in angleška zaskrbljenost zaradi tekmečevih trgovskih praks privedli do druge angleško-nizozemske vojne.

source.title: First Anglo-Dutch War
paragraphs: The First Anglo-Dutch War, or First Dutch War, was a naval conflict between the Commonwealth of England and the Dutch Republic. Largely caused by disputes over trade, it began with English attacks on Dutch merchant shipping, but expanded to vast fleet actions. Despite a series of victories in 1652 and 1653, the Commonwealth was unable to blockade Dutch trade, although English privateers inflicted serious losses on Dutch merchant shipping.

The economic damage eventually led to the Treaty of Westminster in 1654 where the Dutch were forced to make minor concessions to the Commonwealth. Both sides agreed to the exclusion of the House of Orange from the office of Stadtholder, but failed to resolve underlying commercial issues. In 1665, Dutch objections to the Navigation Acts and English concerns over their rival's trading practices led to the Second Anglo-Dutch War.

First Battle of Cape Finisterre (1747).headline: Prva bitka pri rtu Finisterre (1747)
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri rtu Finisterre (14. maja 1747) je potekala v vojni za avstrijsko nasledstvo. Gre za napad 14 britanskih linijskih ladij pod admiralom Georgeom Ansonom na francoski konvoj s 30 ladjami pod poveljstvom admirala de la Jonquièra. Francozi so svoje trgovske ladje skušali zaščititi s spremstvom vojnih ladij. V petiurni bitki v Atlantskem oceanu pred rtom Finisterre na severozahodu Španije so Britanci zajeli 4 linijske ladje, 2 fregati in 7 trgovskih ladij. Ena francoska fregata, ena vojna ladja francoske Vzhodnoindijske družbe in preostale trgovske ladje so ušle.

source.title: First Battle of Cape Finisterre (1747)
paragraphs: The First Battle of Cape Finisterre (14 May 1747) was waged during the War of the Austrian Succession. It refers to the attack by 14 British ships of the line under Admiral George Anson against a French 30-ship convoy commanded by Admiral de la Jonquière. The French were attempting to protect their merchant ships by using warships with them. The British captured 4 ships of the line, 2 frigates, and 7 merchantmen, in a five-hour battle in the Atlantic Ocean off Cape Finisterre in northwest Spain. One French frigate, one French East India Company warship, and the other merchantmen escaped.

First Battle of Champagne.headline: Prva bitka v Šampanji
paragraphs: Prva bitka v Šampanji (francosko: 1ère Bataille de Champagne) je potekala od 20. decembra 1914 do 17. marca 1915 med prvo svetovno vojno v francoski pokrajini Šampanja in je bila druga ofenziva zaveznikov proti Nemškemu cesarstvu, odkar se je gibljivo vojskovanje končalo po prvi bitki za Ypres v Flandriji (19. oktobra – 22. novembra 1914). Bojevali sta se francoska 4. armada in nemška 3. armada. Ofenziva je bila del francoske strategije napada na noyonsko izbočenje, veliko izboklino na novi zahodni fronti, ki je segala od Švice do Severnega morja. Prva bitka v Artoisu se je začela na severnem boku izbočenja 17. decembra, ofenziva proti južnemu boku v Šampanji pa tri dni pozneje.

source.title: First Battle of Champagne
paragraphs: The First Battle of Champagne (French: 1ère Bataille de Champagne) was fought from 20 December 1914 – 17 March 1915 in World War I in the Champagne region of France and was the second offensive by the Allies against the German Empire since mobile warfare had ended after the First Battle of Ypres in Flanders (19 October – 22 November 1914). The battle was fought by the French Fourth Army and the German 3rd Army. The offensive was part of a French strategy to attack the Noyon Salient, a large bulge in the new Western Front, which ran from Switzerland to the North Sea. The First Battle of Artois began on the northern flank of the salient on 17 December and the offensive against the southern flank in Champagne began three days later.

First Battle of Donetsk Airport.headline: Prva bitka za doneško letališče
paragraphs: Prva bitka za doneško letališče je potekala 26. in 27. maja 2014 na Mednarodnem letališču Doneck med borci, povezanimi z Doneško ljudsko republiko, in ukrajinskimi vladnimi silami, v okviru vojne v Donbasu, ki se je začela po revoluciji dostojanstva leta 2014. Druga bitka na letališču je izbruhnila 28. septembra 2014.

source.title: First Battle of Donetsk Airport
paragraphs: The First Battle of Donetsk Airport took place between fighters associated with the Donetsk People's Republic and Ukrainian government forces that took place at Donetsk International Airport on 26–27 May 2014, as part of the war in Donbas that began after the 2014 Revolution of Dignity. A second battle broke out at the airport on 28 September 2014.

First Battle of Höchstädt.headline: Prva bitka pri Höchstädtu
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Höchstädtu je potekala 20. septembra 1703 med špansko nasledstveno vojno. V bližini Höchstädta ob Donavi (Höchstädt an der Donau) na Bavarskem so združene francosko-bavarske sile pod poveljstvom Clauda Louisa Hectorja de Villarsa porazile cesarsko vojsko, ki jo je vodil Hermann Otto II. von Limburg Stirum.

Poleti 1703 je francosko-bavarska ofenziva ob Donavi pomenila morebitno grožnjo habsburški prestolnici Dunaju. Cesarske sile pod poveljstvom badenskega mejnega grofa Ludvika Viljema (Baden-Baden) so zato vdrle na Bavarsko in zavzele Augsburg. Ludvik Viljem je nato Limburg Stirumu ukazal, naj z 18.000 možmi prečka Donavo pri Donauwörthu in se pridruži napadu na francosko-bavarski tabor pri Nordendorfu. Limburg Stirum je 19. septembra prispel v Höchstädt, Villars in Maksimilijan pa sta takrat že dosegla Donauwörth.

source.title: First Battle of Höchstädt
paragraphs: The First Battle of Höchstädt took place on 20 September 1703 during the War of the Spanish Succession. Fought near Höchstädt an der Donau in Bavaria, a combined Franco-Bavarian force under Claude Louis Hector de Villars defeated an Imperial army led by Hermann Otto II of Limburg Stirum.

During the summer of 1703, a Franco-Bavarian offensive along the Danube potentially threatened the Habsburg capital of Vienna. In response, Imperial forces under Louis William, Margrave of Baden-Baden entered Bavaria, and captured Augsburg. He then ordered Limburg Stirum to cross the Danube at Donauwörth with 18,000 men, and join an attack on the Franco-Bavarian camp at Nordendorf. The latter arrived in Höchstädt on 19 September, but Villars and Maximilian had already reached Donauwörth.

First Battle of Kharkov.headline: Prva bitka za Harkov
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Harkov je potekala od 20. do 24. oktobra 1941 za nadzor nad mestom Harkov v Ukrajinski SSR v zadnji fazi operacije Barbarossa. Spopadli sta se nemška 6. armada, del skupine armad Jug, in sovjetska jugozahodna fronta. Sovjetska 38. armada je imela nalogo braniti mesto, medtem ko so njegove tovarne razstavljali in jih selili bolj na vzhod.

Glavni cilj nemške 6. armade je bil zavzeti Harkov, kar bi ji pomagalo zapreti vse večjo vrzel med njo in nemško 17. armado. Do 20. oktobra so Nemci prodrli do zahodnega roba mesta, do 24. oktobra pa je 57. pehotna divizija prevzela nadzor nad Harkovom. Do takrat pa so sovjetske oblasti večino mestnih industrijskih obratov že evakuirale ali onesposobile.

source.title: First Battle of Kharkov
paragraphs: The First Battle of Kharkov was a battle that took place from 20 to 24 October 1941 for control of the city of Kharkov, located in the Ukrainian SSR, during the final stage of Operation Barbarossa. The battle was fought between the German 6th Army, part of Army Group South, and the Soviet Southwestern Front. The Soviet 38th Army was tasked with defending the city while its factories were dismantled and moved to a more easterly location.

The main objective for the German 6th Army was to capture Kharkov, which would help them close the growing gap between themselves and the German 17th Army. By 20 October, the Germans had advanced to the western edge of the city, and by 24 October, the 57th Infantry Division was able to take control of Kharkov. By this time, however, most of the city's industrial facilities had been evacuated or rendered useless by Soviet authorities.

First Battle of Polotsk.headline: Prva bitka pri Polocku
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Polocku je potekala 17. in 18. avgusta 1812 blizu mesta Polock; ruske čete pod poveljstvom Petra Wittgensteina so se v njej spopadle s francoskimi in bavarskimi četami pod vodstvom Nicolasa Oudinota in Oudinotovo prodiranje proti Sankt Peterburgu znova ustavile, kot že v bitki pri Kljasticah. Bila je strateški uspeh Rusije, taktično pa se je končala neodločeno. Prvo bitko pri Polocku je treba razlikovati od druge bitke pri Polocku, ki je med istim pohodom potekala dva meseca pozneje.

source.title: First Battle of Polotsk
paragraphs: In the First Battle of Polotsk, which took place on 17–18 August 1812, Russian troops under the command of Peter Wittgenstein fought French and Bavarian troops led by Nicolas Oudinot near the city of Polotsk, halting Oudinot's advance toward Saint Petersburg once more as at the Battle of Klyastitsy. It was a strategic Russian success, but tactically the battle ended in a draw. The First Battle of Polotsk should be distinguished from the Second Battle of Polotsk which took place during the same campaign two months later.

First Battle of St Albans.headline: Prva bitka pri St Albansu
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri St Albansu je potekala 22. maja 1455 pri St Albansu, 35 kilometrov severno od Londona, in tradicionalno pomeni začetek vojne rož v Angliji. Rihard, vojvoda York, in njegova zaveznika iz rodbine Neville, grofa Salisbury in Warwick, so premagali kraljevo vojsko pod poveljstvom Edmunda Beauforta, vojvode Somerseta.

Nenavadno je bilo, da so se bojevali v samem mestu St Albans, večinoma na ulicah. Somerset je v bitki padel, kralja Henrika VI. pa so ujeli, kar je naslednjemu parlamentu odprlo pot, da je Riharda Yorškega imenoval za lorda protektorja.
notes: The miles (22 mi) are dropped; the kilometres are kept.
The English source breaks its last sentence across the two paragraphs; the Slovenian moves the break to the sentence boundary.

source.title: First Battle of St Albans
paragraphs: The First Battle of St Albans took place on 22 May 1455, at St Albans, 22 miles (35 km) north of London, and traditionally marks the beginning of the Wars of the Roses in England. Richard, Duke of York, and his allies, the Neville Earls of Salisbury and Warwick, defeated a royal army commanded by Edmund Beaufort, Duke of Somerset. Unusually, the battle was contested in the town of St Albans itself, with the bulk of the fighting taking place in
the streets. Somerset was killed in the battle, and King Henry VI captured, clearing the way for a subsequent parliament to appoint Richard of York Lord Protector.

First Battle of the Aisne.headline: Prva bitka na Aisni
paragraphs: Prva bitka na Aisni (francosko: 1ère Bataille de l'Aisne) je bila nadaljevalna zavezniška ofenziva proti desnemu krilu nemške 1. armade (pod vodstvom Alexandra von Klucka) in 2. armade (pod vodstvom Karla von Bülowa), ko sta se umikali po prvi bitki na Marni, ki je potekala v začetku septembra 1914. Prodor do Aisne (6. septembra – 1. oktobra) je obsegal bitko na Marni (7.–10. septembra) in bitko na Aisni (12.–15. septembra).

source.title: First Battle of the Aisne
paragraphs: The First Battle of the Aisne (French: 1ère Bataille de l'Aisne) was the Allied follow-up offensive against the right wing of the German First Army (led by Alexander von Kluck) and the Second Army (led by Karl von Bülow) as they retreated after the First Battle of the Marne earlier in September 1914. The Advance to the Aisne (6 September – 1 October) consisted of the Battle of the Marne (7–10 September) and the Battle of the Aisne (12–15 September).

First Battle of the Masurian Lakes.headline: Prva bitka pri Mazurskih jezerih
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Mazurskih jezerih je bila nemška ofenziva na vzhodni fronti, ki je potekala od 2. do 16. septembra 1914 med ruskim vdorom v Vzhodno Prusijo. Začela se je le nekaj dni po bitki pri Tannenbergu, v kateri je nemška 8. armada obkolila in uničila rusko 2. armado. Nemška 8. armada se je s hitrimi premiki po vzhodnopruskem železniškem omrežju na novo razvrstila pred raztegnjeno rusko 1. armado, jo potisnila nazaj vzdolž vse fronte in jo nazadnje pregnala iz Nemčije. Nadaljnje napredovanje je ovirala ruska 10. armada, ki je prispela na desni bok Nemcev.

Do konca bitke je cesarska nemška vojska v nizu spopadov v le nekaj tednih uničila 2. armado in razbila prvo. Rusija pa je imela največjo vojsko na svetu, zato je ruska vojska zelo hitro nadomestila izgube v moštvu, Rusi pa so po nekaj tednih začeli novo ofenzivo v Vzhodni Prusiji.

source.title: First Battle of the Masurian Lakes
paragraphs: The First Battle of the Masurian Lakes was a German offensive in the Eastern Front 2–16 September 1914, during the Russian invasion of East Prussia. It took place only days after the Battle of Tannenberg where the German 8th Army encircled and destroyed the Russian 2nd Army. Using the rapid movements aided by the East Prussian railway network, the 8th Army reformed in front of the spread-out Russian 1st Army and pushed it back across its entire front, eventually ejecting it from Germany. Further progress was hampered by the arrival of the Russian 10th Army on the Germans' right flank.

By the conclusion of the battle, the Imperial German Army had destroyed the 2nd Army and shattered the First in a series of actions over only a few weeks. However, Russia had the largest army in the world, so the Russian army very quickly restored its losses in manpower, and after a couple of weeks the Russians launched a new offensive in East Prussia.

First Battle of Zurich.headline: Prva bitka pri Zürichu
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Zürichu je potekala od 4. do 7. junija 1799: francoski general André Masséna je moral mesto Zürich prepustiti Avstrijcem pod poveljstvom nadvojvode Karla in se umakniti za reko Limmat. Tam mu je uspelo utrditi položaje, zato se je bojevanje ustavilo na mrtvi točki.

V prvi bitki pri Zürichu so Avstrijci napadali močne francoske položaje; zavzeli so jih, a so jih morali zaradi francoskega protinapada spet zapustiti. Že prej v tej bitki pa je Avstrijcem uspelo Francoze potisniti z enega oporišča (Schwamendingen) in odbiti francosko protiofenzivo pri Zürichu, medtem ko so avstrijski napadi na tri francoska zbirališča (Rapperswil, Hirslanden in Fällanden–Pfaffhausen) spodleteli. Karel se je pripravil na nadaljevanje bitke, Masséna pa se za to ni odločil: umaknil se je in Avstrijcem prepustil veliko svojih topov (178 kosov).
notes: Zurich is written in the Slovenian form Zürich.

source.title: First Battle of Zurich
paragraphs: The First Battle of Zurich, from 4 to 7 June 1799, forced French General André Masséna to yield the city of Zurich to the Austrians, under Archduke Charles, and to retreat beyond the Limmat, where he managed to fortify his positions, which resulted in a stalemate.

The first battle of Zurich saw Austrian attacks on strong French positions, which were captured but then had to be abandoned due to a French counterattack. However, previously in this battle, the Austrians were able to press the French back from one foothold (Schwamendingen) and to repel a French counteroffensive near Zurich, while Austrian assaults on three French staging areas (Rapperswil, Hirslanden and Fällanden–Pfaffhausen) failed. Charles prepared to continue the battle, but Masséna did not decide to do it and retreated, leaving many of his guns behind (178 pieces) at the mercy of the Austrians.

Prva karlistična vojna je bila državljanska vojna v Španiji od leta 1833 do 1840, prva od treh karlističnih vojn. Bojevali sta se dve strani zaradi nasledstva prestola in narave španske monarhije: konservativne in decentralistične privržence brata pokojnega kralja, Carlosa de Borbóna (ali Carlosa V.), so imenovali karlisti (carlistas), napredne in centralistične privržence regentke Marije Kristine, ki je vladala v imenu Izabele II., pa liberalci (liberales), kristinovci ali izabelinci. Šlo je za nasledstveno vojno o tem, kdo je zakoniti naslednik kralja Ferdinanda VII., poleg tega pa so si karlisti prizadevali za vrnitev absolutne monarhije, liberalci pa so branili ustavno monarhijo.

source.title: First Carlist War
paragraphs: The First Carlist War was a civil war in Spain from 1833 to 1840, the first of three Carlist Wars. It was fought between two factions over the succession to the throne and the nature of the Spanish monarchy: the conservative and devolutionist supporters of the late king's brother, Carlos de Borbón (or Carlos V), became known as Carlists (carlistas), while the progressive and centralist supporters of the regent, Maria Christina, acting for Isabella II of Spain, were called Liberals (liberales), cristinos or isabelinos. Aside from being a war of succession, on the question who was the rightful successor to King Ferdinand VII of Spain, the Carlists' goal was the return to an absolute monarchy, while the Liberals sought to defend the constitutional monarchy.

Prva angleška državljanska vojna je potekala v Angliji in Walesu od leta 1642 do 1646 in je del vojn treh kraljestev v letih 1639–1653. Po ocenah je med letoma 1639 in 1653 v vojski kdaj služilo od 15 % do 20 % odraslih moških v Angliji in Walesu, približno 4 % vsega prebivalstva pa je umrlo zaradi vzrokov, povezanih z vojno. Ti podatki kažejo, kako močno je spopad zaznamoval družbo in kakšno zagrenjenost je zato povzročil.

Spori o vlogi parlamenta in verski praksi so se začeli z nastopom Jakoba VI. in I. leta 1603. Napetosti so dosegle vrhunec, ko je njegov sin Karel I. leta 1629 uvedel osebno vladavino; parlament je znova sklical aprila in novembra 1640. S tem je upal pridobiti denar, ki bi mu omogočil popraviti poraz proti škotskim covenanterjem v vojnah škofov, parlament pa je v zameno zahteval večji delež pri vladanju, kot ga je bil pripravljen dati.

source.title: First English Civil War
paragraphs: The First English Civil War took place in England and Wales from 1642 to 1646, and forms part of the 1639 to 1653 Wars of the Three Kingdoms. An estimated 15% to 20% of adult males in England and Wales served in the military at some point between 1639 and 1653, while around 4% of the total population died from war-related causes. These figures illustrate the widespread impact of the conflict on society, and the bitterness it engendered as a result.

Conflict over the role of Parliament and religious practice dated from the accession of James VI and I in 1603. These tensions culminated in the imposition of Personal Rule in 1629 by his son, Charles I, who recalled Parliament in April and November 1640. He hoped by doing so to obtain funding that would enable him to reverse his defeat by Scots Covenanters in the Bishops' Wars, but in return Parliament demanded a greater share in government than he was willing to concede.

Ženevska konvencija (I) za izboljšanje položaja ranjencev in bolnikov v oboroženih silah na bojišču (francosko: Convention pour l'amélioration du sort des blessés et des malades dans les forces armées en campagne), pogosteje imenovana prva ženevska konvencija ali ženevska konvencija I, s kratico GCI, je prva od štirih pogodb ženevskih konvencij iz leta 1949. Opredeljuje »temelje, na katerih slonijo pravila mednarodnega prava za zaščito žrtev oboroženih spopadov«.

GCI je četrta različica niza ženevskih konvencij, ki so vse skušale uvesti zavezujoče mednarodne dogovore za zaščito ranjenih vojakov. Prvo različico so sprejeli leta 1864, nato pa so jo bistveno spremenili in nadomestili v letih 1906, 1929 in nazadnje 1949.
Ženevska konvencija I je neločljivo povezana z Mednarodnim odborom Rdečega križa, ki je dal pobudo za nastanek teh konvencij in bdi nad izvajanjem njihovih členov.
notes: The convention's title follows the official Slovenian title, which, like the French and the full English title, names the sick as well as the wounded.
The English second paragraph lacks its final full stop; the Slovenian has one.

source.title: First Geneva Convention
paragraphs: The Geneva Convention (I) for the Amelioration of the Condition of the Wounded in Armies in the Field (French: Convention pour l'amélioration du sort des blessés et des malades dans les forces armées en campagne), more commonly referred to as the First Geneva Convention or Geneva Convention I and abbreviated as GCI, is the first of the four treaties of the 1949 Geneva Conventions. It defines "the basis on which rest the rules of international law for the protection of the victims of armed conflicts."

GCI is the fourth iteration of a series of Geneva Conventions, all of which sought to implement binding international arrangements for the protection of wounded armies. The first iteration was adopted in 1864, which was then significantly revised and replaced in 1906, 1929, and finally 1949
Geneva Convention I is inextricably linked to the International Committee of the Red Cross, which is both the instigator for the inception and enforcer of the articles in these conventions.

Prva helenska republika (grško: Α΄ Ελληνική Δημοκρατία) je bila začasna grška država med grško revolucijo proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu. Od leta 1822 do 1827 se je imenovala Začasna uprava Grčije, med letoma 1827 in 1832 pa Helenska država.

»Prva helenska republika« je zgodovinopisni izraz, ki ga uporabljajo akademiki in grška vlada, da bi poudarili ustavno in demokratično naravo revolucionarne oblasti pred ustanovitvijo neodvisne Kraljevine Grčije in to obdobje grške zgodovine povezali s poznejšo drugo in tretjo republiko.

source.title: First Hellenic Republic
paragraphs: The First Hellenic Republic (Greek: Α΄ Ελληνική Δημοκρατία) was the provisional Greek state during the Greek Revolution against the Ottoman Empire. From 1822 until 1827, it was known as the Provisional Administration of Greece, and between 1827 and 1832, it was known as the Hellenic State.

"First Hellenic Republic" is a historiographical term, which is used by academics and the Greek government to emphasize the constitutional and democratic nature of the revolutionary regime prior to the establishment of the independent Kingdom of Greece, and associate this period of Greek history with the later Second and Third Republics.

Prva stoletna vojna (francosko: Première Guerre de Cent Ans; 1159–1259) je bila vrsta spopadov in sporov v visokem srednjem veku, v katerih se je dinastija Kapetingov, vladarjev Kraljevine Francije, bojevala z dinastijo Plantagenetov (znano tudi kot dinastija Anžu ali Anžujci), vladarji Kraljevine Anglije. Spor je nastal zaradi fevdov v Franciji, ki so jih imeli Anžujci in so na vrhuncu obsegali okoli polovico ozemlja francoskega kraljestva. Boj med dinastijama je privedel do postopnega kapetinškega osvajanja teh fevdov in njihove priključitve francoski kraljevi domeni, pa tudi do poznejših poskusov Plantagenetov, da bi znova pridobili ozemlja v zahodni Franciji, ki so jih imeli za svojo zakonito dediščino.
notes: The glossary headline is Rivalstvo med Kapetingi in Plantageneti; the text keeps the English article's name, Prva stoletna vojna.

source.title: First Hundred Years' War
paragraphs: The First Hundred Years' War (French: Première Guerre de Cent Ans; 1159–1259) was a series of conflicts and disputes during the High Middle Ages in which the House of Capet, rulers of the Kingdom of France, fought the House of Plantagenet (also known as the House of Anjou or the Angevins), rulers of the Kingdom of England. The conflict emerged over the fiefs in France held by the Angevins, which at their peak covered around half of the territory of the French realm. The struggle between the two dynasties resulted in the gradual conquest of these fiefs by the Capetians and their annexation to the French crown lands, as well as subsequent attempts by the House of Plantagenet to retake what they believed to be their rightful ancestral claims in western France.

First International Opium Convention.headline: Prva mednarodna opijska konvencija
paragraphs: Prva mednarodna opijska konvencija (imenovana tudi opijska konvencija iz leta 1912 ali haaška opijska konvencija) je nekdanja mednarodna pogodba, podpisana v Haagu leta 1912. Konferenca je bila mednarodno prizadevanje držav, da bi uredile trgovino z opijem in zatrle nezakonito uživanje opija. Leta 1925 ji je sledila druga mednarodna opijska konvencija, podpisana v Ženevi.

source.title: First International Opium Convention
paragraphs: The First International Opium Convention (also called 1912 Opium Convention or Hague Opium Convention) is a former international treaty signed at The Hague in 1912. The conference were an international effort by states to regulate the trade of opium and suppress illicit opium consumption. It was followed in 1925 by the Second International Opium Convention signed in Geneva.

Prva italijanska vojna za neodvisnost (italijansko: Prima guerra d'indipendenza italiana) je bila vojna, ki sta jo od 23. marca 1848 do 22. avgusta 1849 na Apeninskem polotoku bojevala Kraljevina Sardinija (Piemont) in italijanski prostovoljci proti Avstrijskemu cesarstvu in drugim konservativnim državam; bila je del risorgimenta, združevanja Italije. Pred vojno je izbruhnila sicilska revolucija leta 1848 proti burbonski rodbini dveh Sicilij. Sprožili so jo nemiri v Milanu (pet dni) in Benetkah: obe mesti sta se uprli Avstriji in ustanovili vladi.

source.title: First Italian War of Independence
paragraphs: The First Italian War of Independence (Italian: Prima guerra d'indipendenza italiana), part of the Risorgimento or unification of Italy, was fought by the Kingdom of Sardinia (Piedmont) and Italian volunteers against the Austrian Empire and other conservative states from 23 March 1848 to 22 August 1849 in the Italian Peninsula. The conflict was preceded by the outbreak of the Sicilian revolution of 1848 against the House of Bourbon-Two Sicilies. It was precipitated by riots in the cities of Milan (Five Days) and Venice, which rebelled against Austria and established governments.

First Messenian War.headline: Prva mesenska vojna
paragraphs: Prva mesenska vojna je bila vojna med Mesenijo in Šparto. Po Pavzanijevih datacijah se je začela leta 743 pr. n. št. in končala leta 724 pr. n. št.

Vojna je nadaljevala rivalstvo med Ahajci in Dorci, ki ga je sprožila domnevna vrnitev Heraklidov. Obe strani sta izkoristili hud incident, da bi rivalstvo razrešili z vsesplošno vojno. Vojna se je zavlekla na 20 let in se končala s špartansko zmago. Mesenija se je izpraznila, ker so se Ahajci izselili v druge države. Tiste, ki se niso izselili, so družbeno ponižali v helote ali tlačane. Njihovi potomci so bili stoletja v dedni sužnosti, vse do propada špartanske države leta 370 pr. n. št.

source.title: First Messenian War
paragraphs: The First Messenian War was a war between Messenia and Sparta. It began in 743 BC and ended in 724 BC, according to the dates given by Pausanias.

The war continued the rivalry between the Achaeans and the Dorians that had been initiated by the purported Return of the Heracleidae. Both sides utilized an explosive incident to settle the rivalry by full-scale war. The war was prolonged into 20 years. The result was a Spartan victory. Messenia was depopulated by emigration of the Achaeans to other states. Those who did not emigrate were reduced socially to helots, or serfs. Their descendants were held in hereditary servitude for centuries, until the collapse of the Spartan state in 370 BC.

First Mongol invasion of Poland.headline: Prvi mongolski vpad na Poljsko
paragraphs: Mongolski vpad na Poljsko od konca leta 1240 do leta 1241 je dosegel vrhunec v bitki pri Legnici, v kateri so Mongoli porazili zavezništvo sil razdrobljene Poljske in njihovih zaveznikov pod vodstvom Henrika II. Pobožnega, šlezijskega vojvode in vrhovnega poljskega vojvode. Namen prvega vpada je bil zavarovati bok glavne mongolske vojske, ki je napadala Ogrsko. Mongoli so onemogočili vsakršno pomoč, ki bi jo kralju Béli IV. lahko poslali Poljaki ali viteški redovi.

source.title: First Mongol invasion of Poland
paragraphs: The Mongol invasion of Poland from late 1240 to 1241 culminated in the Battle of Legnica, where the Mongols defeated an alliance which included forces from fragmented Poland and their allies, led by Henry II the Pious, the Duke of Silesia and High Duke of Poland. The first invasion's intention was to secure the flank of the main Mongolian army attacking the Kingdom of Hungary. The Mongols neutralized any potential help to King Béla IV being provided by the Poles or any military orders.

Prva perzijska invazija na Grčijo je potekala od leta 492 do 490 pr. n. št. v okviru grško-perzijskih vojn. Čeprav so Atenci Ahemenidsko cesarstvo premagali v bitki na Maratonskem polju, so Perzijci zmagali v večini bitk proti Grkom in dosegli večino svojih ciljev. Invazijo na neodvisne grške mestne države, ki je obsegala dva ločena pohoda, je ukazal perzijski kralj Darej Veliki, ki je hotel kaznovati Atene in Eretrijo, ker sta podprli predhodno jonsko vstajo. Darej je v podreditvi Grčije videl tudi priložnost za širitev v jugovzhodno Evropo in s tem za zavarovanje zahodne meje Ahemenidskega cesarstva.

source.title: First Persian invasion of Greece
paragraphs: The first Persian invasion of Greece took place from 492 BC to 490 BC, as part of the Greco-Persian Wars. Although the Achaemenid empire were defeated by the Athenian at the Battle of Marathon, they emerged victorious in most of their battles against the Greeks and achieved the majority of their objectives. Consisting of two distinct campaigns, the invasion of the independent Greek city-states was ordered by the Persian king Darius the Great, who sought to punish Athens and Eretria after they had supported the earlier Ionian Revolt. Additionally, Darius also saw the subjugation of Greece as an opportunity to expand into Southeast Europe and thereby ensure the security of the Achaemenid Empire's western frontier.

First Sacred War.headline: Prva sveta vojna
paragraphs: Prva sveta vojna ali kirska vojna je potekala med delfsko amfiktionijo in mestom Kira. V začetku 6. stoletja pr. n. št. je pilajsko-delfska amfiktionija, ki so jo nadzorovali Tesalci, skušala prevzeti Apolonovo sveto zemljo (ali kirsko ravnico), kar je pripeljalo do vojne. Spopad je izbruhnil, ker so Kirčani pogosto ropali romarje na poti v Delfe in z njimi grdo ravnali ter posegali na delfsko zemljo. Vojna, ki se je končala s porazom in uničenjem Kire, je znana po uporabi kemičnega bojevanja med obleganjem Kire: s čemeriko so zastrupili mestno vodo. Konec vojne so zaznamovale prve pitijske igre.

source.title: First Sacred War
paragraphs: The First Sacred War, or Cirraean War, was fought between the Amphictyonic League of Delphi and the city of Kirrha. At the beginning of the 6th century BC, the Pylaeo-Delphic Amphictyony, controlled by the Thessalians, attempted to take hold of the Sacred Land (or Kirrhaean Plain) of Apollo, resulting in this war. The conflict arose due to Kirrha's frequent robbery and mistreatment of pilgrims going to Delphi and their encroachments upon Delphic land. The war, which culminated with the defeat and destruction of Kirrha, is notable for the use of chemical warfare at the Siege of Kirrha, in the form of hellebore being used to poison the city's water supply. The war's end was marked by the organization of the first Pythian Games.

Prva srbsko-osmanska vojna (srbsko: Први српско-турски рат) je bila vojaški spopad med Kneževino Srbijo in Osmanskim cesarstvom. Srbija je Osmanskemu cesarstvu napovedala vojno 30. junija 1876, med hercegovskim uporom. Osmanske čete so srbsko ofenzivo proti jugu in zahodu odbile že po treh tednih bojev, nato pa je Turčija vdrla v ožjo Srbijo. Vzhodno Srbijo so hitro zasedli, na južni fronti pa je srbska vojska osmansko napredovanje uspešno ustavila in več kot dva meseca branila utrjene položaje okoli Aleksinca.

Rusko cesarstvo je jeseni 1876 z grožnjo vojaškega posega posredovalo premirje, evropske velesile pa so nato sklicale carigrajsko konferenco, da bi uredile vojno in širša balkanska vprašanja. Mir so podpisali 28. februarja 1877 na podlagi stanja pred vojno (status quo ante bellum).

source.title: First Serbian–Ottoman War
paragraphs: The First Serbian–Ottoman War (Serbian: Први српско-турски рат, romanized: Prvi srpsko-turski rat), was a military conflict fought by the Principality of Serbia against the Ottoman Empire. Serbia declared war on the Ottoman Empire on 30 June 1876, during the Herzegovina Uprising. A Serbian south- and westward offensive was repulsed by Ottoman troops after just three weeks of fighting, upon which Turkey then invaded Serbia proper. Eastern Serbia was quickly occupied, but on the southern front the Serbian army successfully stopped the Ottoman advance, defending the fortified positions around Aleksinac for more than two months.

The Russian Empire brokered a ceasefire in autumn of 1876 by threatening military intervention, and the European Great Powers then organized the Constantinople Conference to settle the war and wider issues in the Balkans. Peace was signed on 28 February 1877 on the basis of status quo ante bellum.

Prva šlezijska vojna (nemško: Erster Schlesischer Krieg) je bila vojna med Prusijo in Avstrijo, ki je trajala od leta 1740 do 1742 in se končala tako, da je Prusija Avstriji odvzela večji del Šlezije (danes na jugozahodu Poljske). Bojevali so se večinoma v Šleziji, na Moravskem in Češkem (v deželah češke krone), vojna pa je bila eno od prizorišč širše avstrijske nasledstvene vojne. Bila je prva od treh šlezijskih vojn med Prusijo Friderika Velikega in Avstrijo Marije Terezije sredi 18. stoletja; vse tri so se končale s prusko oblastjo nad Šlezijo.

Vojne ni sprožil noben poseben dogodek. Prusija se je kot povod za vojno (casus belli) sklicevala na svoje stoletja stare dinastične zahteve po delih Šlezije, k spopadu pa so pripomogli tudi realpolitika in geostrateški dejavniki. Sporno nasledstvo Marije Terezije na čelu habsburške monarhije je Prusiji ponudilo priložnost, da se okrepi v razmerju do regionalnih tekmic, kot sta bili Saška in Bavarska.

source.title: First Silesian War
paragraphs: The First Silesian War (German: Erster Schlesischer Krieg) was a war between Prussia and Austria that lasted from 1740 to 1742 and resulted in Prussia's seizure of most of the region of Silesia (now in south-western Poland) from Austria. The war was fought mainly in Silesia, Moravia and Bohemia (the lands of the Bohemian Crown) and formed one theatre of the wider War of the Austrian Succession. It was the first of three Silesian Wars fought between Frederick the Great's Prussia and Maria Theresa's Austria in the mid-18th century, all three of which ended in Prussian control of Silesia.

No particular triggering event started the war. Prussia cited its centuries-old dynastic claims on parts of Silesia as a casus belli, but Realpolitik and geostrategic factors also played a role in provoking the conflict. Maria Theresa's contested succession to the Habsburg monarchy provided an opportunity for Prussia to strengthen itself relative to regional rivals such as Saxony and Bavaria.

First Treaty of San Ildefonso.headline: Prva pogodba iz San Ildefonsa
paragraphs: Prva pogodba iz San Ildefonsa z dne 1. oktobra 1777 je določila meje med kolonialnimi posestmi Španije in Portugalske v Južni Ameriki, predvsem na območju Río de la Plata.

source.title: First Treaty of San Ildefonso
paragraphs: The First Treaty of San Ildefonso, 1 October 1777, fixed borders between the colonial possessions in South America held by Spain and Portugal, primarily in the Río de la Plata region.

First Vienna Award.headline: Prva dunajska arbitraža
paragraphs: Prva dunajska arbitraža je bila pogodba, podpisana 2. novembra 1938 kot izid arbitražnega postopka v dunajski palači Belvedere. Arbitražni postopek in razsodba sta bila neposredni posledici münchenskega sporazuma iz prejšnjega meseca, s katerim so razdelili Češkoslovaško.

Madžarska je izgubljena ozemlja skušala dobiti nazaj po mirni poti, da bi obnovila svoje zgodovinske meje in z matično državo znova združila številno madžarsko manjšino, ki je živela tik za njenimi mejami. Med obema vojnama je bila Madžarska gospodarsko in vojaško šibkejša od sosed, do katerih je imela ozemeljske zahteve. Nemčija in Italija sta podpirali madžarske ozemeljske zahteve in revizijo trianonske mirovne pogodbe iz leta 1920, ki je bila Madžarski vsiljena po prvi svetovni vojni. Nacistična Nemčija je versajsko mirovno pogodbo kršila že z remilitarizacijo Porenja (7. marca 1936) in anšlusom Avstrije (12. marca 1938).

source.title: First Vienna Award
paragraphs: The First Vienna Award was a treaty signed on 2 November 1938 pursuant to the Vienna Arbitration, which took place at Vienna's Belvedere Palace. The arbitration and award were direct consequences of the previous month's Munich Agreement, which resulted in the partitioning of Czechoslovakia.

Hungary sought to reclaim the lost territories through peaceful ways to restore its historical borders, and reunite the significant Hungarian minority living right across its borders with the mother country. In the interwar period, Hungary was weaker economically and militarily than the neighbours against which it had territorial claims. Germany and Italy had supported the territorial claims of Hungary, and revision of the 1920 Treaty of Trianon, imposed on Hungary in the aftermath of World War I. Nazi Germany had already violated the Versailles Treaty via the remilitarisation of the Rhineland (7 March 1936) and the Anschluss of Austria (12 March 1938).

Prva vojna za škotsko neodvisnost je bila prva v vrsti vojn med Kraljevino Anglijo in Kraljevino Škotsko. Trajala je od angleškega vdora na Škotsko leta 1296 do de iure obnovitve škotske neodvisnosti z edinburško-northamptonsko pogodbo leta 1328. Dejansko neodvisnost so Škoti dosegli leta 1314, ko so Angleži izgubili bitko pri Bannockburnu. Vojne so povzročili poskusi angleških kraljev, da bi z zahtevami po suverenosti nad Škotsko prigrabili ozemlje, Škoti pa so se bojevali, da bi angleško oblast in vpliv obdržali zunaj Škotske.

Prve vojne za škotsko neodvisnost ne gre obravnavati ločeno od gaskonjske vojne in francosko-flamske vojne, saj sta francoski kralj Filip IV. in angleški kralj Edvard I. v začetnem spopadu iskala zaveznike na Škotskem in v Flandriji. Škotski kralj Ivan Balliol se je leta 1295 povezal s francoskim kraljem Filipom IV. (stara zveza, Auld Alliance), flandrijski grof Guy pa z angleškim kraljem Edvardom I.

source.title: First War of Scottish Independence
paragraphs: The First War of Scottish Independence was the first of a series of different wars between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland. It lasted from the English invasion of Scotland in 1296 until the de jure restoration of Scottish independence with the Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton in 1328. De facto independence was established in 1314 AD following an English defeat at the Battle of Bannockburn. The wars were caused by the attempts of the English kings to seize territory by claiming sovereignty over Scotland, while the Scots fought to keep both English rule and authority out of Scotland.

The First War of Scottish Independence should not be viewed in isolation from the Gascon War and Franco-Flemish War since Philip IV of France and Edward I of England sought allies in Scotland and Flanders as part of their initial conflict. John Balliol of Scotland allied himself with Philip IV of France in 1295 (the Auld Alliance) while Guy, Count of Flanders allied himself with Edward I of England.

Four Days of Naples.headline: Štirje dnevi Neaplja
paragraphs: Štirje dnevi Neaplja (italijansko: Quattro giornate di Napoli) so bili upor v Neaplju v Italiji proti nacistični nemški okupacijski sili od 27. do 30. septembra 1943, tik pred prihodom zavezniških sil v Neapelj 1. oktobra v drugi svetovni vojni.

Spontani upor neapeljskega prebivalstva in italijanskega odporniškega gibanja proti nemškim okupacijskim silam je kljub omejeni oborožitvi in brez prave organizacije ali načrtovanja uspešno prekrižal nemške načrte za množično deportacijo Neapeljčanov, uničenje mesta in preprečitev zavezniškim silam, da bi dobile strateško oporišče.
Mesto so pozneje odlikovali z zlato medaljo za vojaško hrabrost. Vsako leto praznujejo ta štiri dni, leta 1962 pa je bil o njih posnet film Štirje dnevi Neaplja (The Four Days of Naples).

source.title: Four Days of Naples
paragraphs: The Four Days of Naples (Italian: Quattro giornate di Napoli) was an uprising in Naples, Italy, against Nazi German occupation forces from 27 September to 30 September 1943, immediately prior to the arrival of Allied forces in Naples on 1 October during World War II.

The spontaneous uprising of Neapolitan and Italian Resistance against German occupying forces, despite their limited armament, and without proper organization or planning, successfully disrupted German plans to deport Neapolitans en masse, destroy the city, and prevent Allied forces from gaining a strategic foothold.
The city was subsequently awarded the Gold Medal of Military Valor. The four days are celebrated annually and were the subject of the 1962 film The Four Days of Naples.

Four Power Agreement on Berlin.headline: Sporazum štirih sil o Berlinu
paragraphs: Sporazum štirih sil o Berlinu, znan tudi kot berlinski sporazum ali štiristranski sporazum o Berlinu, je 3. septembra 1971 sklenil ponovno sklicani Zavezniški nadzorni svet, ki so ga sestavljali veleposlaniki štirih zavezniških sil iz druge svetovne vojne. Štirje zunanji ministri – sir Alec Douglas-Home iz Združenega kraljestva, Andrej Gromiko iz Sovjetske zveze, Maurice Schumann iz Francije in William P. Rogers iz ZDA – so sporazum podpisali in ga uveljavili 3. junija 1972 na zasedanju Sveta zunanjih ministrov v Zahodnem Berlinu. Sporazum ni bil mednarodna pogodba in ga ni bilo treba formalno ratificirati.
notes: The English gives two alternative names, Four Power Agreement and Quadripartite Agreement, which mean the same; the Slovenian renders them as sporazum štirih sil and štiristranski sporazum.

source.title: Four Power Agreement on Berlin
paragraphs: The Four Power Agreement on Berlin, also known as the Berlin Agreement or the Quadripartite Agreement on Berlin, was agreed on 3 September 1971 by the reconvened Allied Control Council, consisting of ambassadors of the four wartime Allied powers. The four foreign ministers, Sir Alec Douglas-Home of the United Kingdom, Andrei Gromyko of the Soviet Union, Maurice Schumann of France, and William P. Rogers of the United States signed the agreement and put it into force at a meeting of the Council of Foreign Ministers in West Berlin on 3 June 1972. The agreement was not a treaty and required no formal ratification.

Fourth Battle of the Isonzo.headline: Četrta soška bitka
