paragraphs: Četrta soška bitka je potekala med vojskami Kraljevine Italije in Avstro-Ogrske na italijanski fronti prve svetovne vojne od 10. novembra do 2. decembra 1915.

source.title: Fourth Battle of the Isonzo
paragraphs: The Fourth Battle of the Isonzo was fought between the armies of Kingdom of Italy and those of Austria-Hungary on the Italian Front in World War I, between 10 November and 2 December 1915.

Ženevska konvencija (IV) o zaščiti civilnih oseb med vojno (francosko: Convention relative à la protection des personnes civiles en temps de guerre), pogosteje imenovana četrta ženevska konvencija ali ženevska konvencija IV (s kratico GCIV), je ena od štirih pogodb ženevskih konvencij iz leta 1949. Sprejeli so jo 12. avgusta 1949, veljati pa je začela oktobra 1950. Medtem ko so prve tri konvencije iz leta 1949 obravnavale bojevnike, je bila ženevska konvencija IV prva, ki je urejala humanitarno zaščito civilistov med vojno. GCIV opredeljuje humanitarno zaščito civilistov. Leta 2010 je bilo pogodbenic ženevskih konvencij iz leta 1949 – te in drugih treh pogodb – 196 držav.

Ženevska konvencija IV se nanaša le na zaščitene civiliste na zasedenem ozemlju, ne pa na posledice sovražnosti, kot je bilo strateško bombardiranje med drugo svetovno vojno. Med množico določb GCIV izrecno prepoveduje preseljevanje prebivalstva okupacijske sile na ozemlje, ki ga ta zaseda.

source.title: Fourth Geneva Convention
paragraphs: The Geneva Convention (IV) relative to the Protection of Civilian Persons in Time of War (French: Convention relative à la protection des personnes civiles en temps de guerre), more commonly referred to as the Fourth Geneva Convention or Geneva Convention IV (abbreviated as GCIV), is one of the four treaties of the 1949 Geneva Conventions. It was adopted on 12 August 1949, and came into force in October 1950. While the first three 1949 conventions dealt with combatants, Geneva Convention IV was the first to deal with humanitarian protections for civilians during war. GCIV defines humanitarian protections for civilians. As of 2010 there were 196 countries party to the 1949 Geneva Conventions, including this and the three other treaties.

Geneva Convention IV only concerns protected civilians in occupied territory rather than the effects of hostilities, such as the strategic bombing during World War II. Among its mass amount of provisions, GCIV explicitly prohibits the transfer of the population of an occupying power into the territory it occupies.

Franco-Flemish War.headline: Francosko-flamska vojna
paragraphs: Francosko-flamska vojna (francosko: Guerre de Flandre) je bila spopad med Kraljevino Francijo in grofijo Flandrijo med letoma 1297 in 1305.

Vojna je povezana s prvotno gaskonjsko vojno in prvo vojno za škotsko neodvisnost, saj sta francoski kralj Filip IV. in angleški kralj Edvard I. iskala zaveznike na Škotskem oziroma v Flandriji in tako vpletla sorodne spopade.

source.title: Franco-Flemish War
paragraphs: The Franco-Flemish War (French: Guerre de Flandre) was a conflict between the Kingdom of France and the County of Flanders between 1297 and 1305.

The war is related to the original Gascon War and the First War of Scottish Independence, as Philip IV of France and Edward I of England sought allies in Scotland and Flanders respectively and thus involved the related conflicts.

Franco-Soviet Treaty of Mutual Assistanc.headline: Francosko-sovjetska pogodba o medsebojni pomoči
paragraphs: Francosko-sovjetska pogodba o medsebojni pomoči je bila dvostranska pogodba med Francijo in Sovjetsko zvezo iz leta 1935, katere cilj je bil obkoliti nacistično Nemčijo in zmanjšati vojaško grožnjo iz srednje Evrope. Zanjo sta si prizadevala sovjetski zunanji minister Maksim Litvinov in francoski zunanji minister Louis Barthou, ki je bil oktobra 1934, preden so se pogajanja končala, po nesreči ubit.

Njegov naslednik Pierre Laval je dvomil o smiselnosti in vrednosti zavezništva s Sovjetsko zvezo. Ko pa je Nemčija marca 1935 razglasila ponovno oboroževanje, je francoska vlada neodločnega zunanjega ministra prisilila, da je dokončal dogovore z Moskvo, ki jih je začel Barthou.

source.title: Franco-Soviet Treaty of Mutual Assistance
paragraphs: The Franco-Soviet Treaty of Mutual Assistance was a 1935 bilateral treaty between France and the Soviet Union with the aim of enveloping Nazi Germany and reducing the military threat from Central Europe. It was pursued by Maxim Litvinov, the Soviet foreign minister, and Louis Barthou, the French foreign minister, who was accidentally killed in October 1934, before negotiations had been finished.

His successor, Pierre Laval, was sceptical of the desirability and value of an alliance with the Soviet Union. However, after the declaration of German rearmament in March 1935, the French government forced the reluctant foreign minister to complete the arrangements with Moscow that Barthou had begun.

Francosko-španska vojna, ki je trajala od maja 1635 do novembra 1659, je bila spopad med Francijo in Španijo, ki so ju v različnih obdobjih podpirali različni zavezniki. Obsega dve ločeni fazi: prvo od maja 1635 do oktobra 1648, ki velja za spopad, povezan s tridesetletno vojno, in drugo, ki je trajala do pirenejskega miru leta 1659.

Glavna bojišča so bila severna Italija, Španska Nizozemska in Porenje. Francija je podpirala upore proti španski oblasti na Portugalskem (1640–1668), v Kataloniji (1640–1653) in Neaplju (1647), Španija pa je podpirala francoske upornike v »frondi« 1647–1653. Obe državi sta podpirali tudi nasprotni strani v piemontski državljanski vojni 1639–1642.

source.title: Franco-Spanish War (1635–1659)
paragraphs: The Franco-Spanish War, from May 1635 to November 1659, was fought between France and Spain, each supported by various allies at different points. It consists of two distinct phases, the first from May 1635 to October 1648, which is considered a related conflict of the Thirty Years' War, the second continued until the Treaty of the Pyrenees in 1659.

Major areas of conflict included northern Italy, the Spanish Netherlands and the Rhineland. France supported revolts against Spanish rule in Portugal (1640–1668), Catalonia (1640–1653) and Naples (1647), while Spain backed French rebels in the 1647 to 1653 "Fronde". Both also backed opposing sides in the 1639 to 1642 Piedmontese Civil War.

Franco-Syrian Treaty of Independence.headline: Francosko-sirska pogodba o neodvisnosti
paragraphs: Francosko-sirska pogodba o neodvisnosti, znana tudi kot Viénotovi sporazumi, je bila pogodba, ki sta jo izpogajali Francija in Sirija in naj bi Siriji zagotovila neodvisnost od francoske oblasti.

source.title: Franco-Syrian Treaty of Independence
paragraphs: The Franco-Syrian Treaty of Independence, also known as the Viénot Accords, was a treaty negotiated between France and Syria to provide for Syrian independence from French authority.

Svobodno mesto Krakov (poljsko: Wolne Miasto Kraków), znano tudi kot Krakovska republika (poljsko: Rzeczpospolita Krakowska), uradno Svobodno, neodvisno in strogo nevtralno mesto Krakov z okrožjem, je bilo nominalno neodvisna mestna država, ki je obstajala od leta 1815 do 1846. Ustanovil jo je dunajski kongres na ozemlju nekdanjega Varšavskega vojvodstva, ki so si ga po kongresu leta 1815 razdelili Rusko, Prusko in Avstrijsko cesarstvo. Svobodno mesto je obsegalo poljsko mesto Krakov in okoliško okrožje.

Čeprav je bilo formalno avtonomno, so svobodno mesto skupaj nadzorovale tri močnejše sosede: Rusija, Prusija in Avstrija. Bilo je središče političnega in intelektualnega delovanja za poljsko neodvisnost. Leta 1846 je Avstrija po neuspeli krakovski vstaji mestno državo enostransko priključila in jo postavila pod neposreden nadzor.

source.title: Free City of Cracow
paragraphs: The Free City of Cracow (Polish: Wolne Miasto Kraków), also known as the Republic of Cracow (Polish: Rzeczpospolita Krakowska), and officially the Free, Independent, and Strictly Neutral City of Cracow and its District, was a nominally independent city-state that existed from 1815 to 1846. It was established by the Congress of Vienna using territory from the former Duchy of Warsaw, which had been divided among the Russian, Prussian and Austrian empires after the Congress in 1815. The Free City comprised the Polish city of Cracow (Kraków) and its surrounding district.

Although formally autonomous, the Free City was jointly overseen by its three more powerful neighbours: Russia, Prussia and Austria. It served as a centre of political and intellectual activity promoting Polish independence. In 1846, after the failed Kraków Uprising, Austria unilaterally annexed the city-state and brought it under direct control.

Frankfurt je bil eno glavnih mest Svetega rimskega cesarstva: od leta 885 je bil sedež cesarskih volitev, od leta 1562 (prej so jih opravljali v svobodnem cesarskem mestu Aachen) do leta 1792 pa kraj cesarskih kronanj. Leta 1372 je bil razglašen za svobodno cesarsko mesto (Freie und Reichsstadt), kar mu je dalo status cesarske neposrednosti: neposredno je bil podrejen cesarju Svetega rimskega cesarstva in ne kateremu koli deželnemu knezu.
notes: The record is the Free City of Frankfurt (1815–1866), but the summary describes the earlier Imperial Free City; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Free City of Frankfurt
paragraphs: Frankfurt was a major city of the Holy Roman Empire, serving as the seat of imperial elections since 885 and as the site of imperial coronations from 1562 (previously held in the Free Imperial City of Aachen) until 1792. Frankfurt was declared an Imperial Free City (Freie und Reichsstadt) in 1372, giving it the status of Imperial immediacy, meaning it was directly subordinate to the Holy Roman Emperor rather than to any territorial prince.
Svobodno in hanzeatsko mesto Lübeck (nemško: Freie und Hansestadt Lübeck) je bilo nemška mestna država od leta 1226 do 1937 na območju današnje zvezne dežele Schleswig-Holstein.

source.title: Free City of Lübeck
paragraphs: The Free and Hanseatic City of Lübeck (German: Freie und Hansestadt Lübeck) was a German city-state from 1226 to 1937, in what is now the federal state of Schleswig-Holstein.

French expedition to Ireland (1796).headline: Francoska odprava na Irsko (1796)
paragraphs: Francoska odprava na Irsko (francosko: Expédition d'Irlande, »odprava na Irsko«) je bila neuspešen poskus Francoske republike, da bi med vojno prve koalicije pomagala prepovedanemu Društvu združenih Ircev pri načrtovanem uporu proti britanski oblasti. Francija je nameravala pozimi 1796–1797 na Irskem izkrcati veliko ekspedicijsko vojsko, ki bi se združila z Združenimi Irci in strmoglavila britansko oblast na Irskem. Francozi so pričakovali, da uspešna invazija ne bi bila le hud udarec za britansko moralo, ugled in vojaško učinkovitost, temveč bi Irska lahko služila tudi kot izhodišče za poznejšo invazijo na Britanijo. Konec leta 1796 je francoski direktorij v Brestu pod generalom Lazarjem Hochem zbral med 12.000 in 25.000 vojakov francoske revolucionarne vojske, pripravljenih na izkrcanje v zalivu Bantry decembra.
notes: The French pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: French expedition to Ireland (1796)
paragraphs: The French expedition to Ireland, known in French as the Expédition d'Irlande (French pronunciation: [ɛkspedisjɔ̃ diʁlɑ̃d], "Expedition to Ireland"), was an unsuccessful attempt by the French Republic to assist the outlawed Society of United Irishmen in their planned rebellion against British rule during the War of the First Coalition. France intended to land a large expeditionary force in Ireland during the winter of 1796–1797 which would join forces with the United Irishmen and overthrow British rule in Ireland. The French anticipated that a successful invasion would not only be a major blow to British morale, prestige and military effectiveness but allow for Ireland to serve as a staging point for an eventual invasion of Britain. In late 1796, the French Directory gathered a force of between 12,000 and 25,000 French Revolutionary Army troops at Brest under General Lazare Hoche in readiness for a landing at Bantry Bay in December.

French invasion of Switzerland.headline: Francoski vdor v Švico
paragraphs: Francoski vdor v Švico (nemško: Franzoseneinfall) je potekal od januarja do maja 1798 v okviru francoskih revolucionarnih vojn. Neodvisna Stara švicarska konfederacija je pod vdorom in hkratnimi notranjimi upori, imenovanimi »helvetska revolucija«, razpadla. Ustanove švicarskega starega režima (ancien régime) so odpravili in nadomestili s centralizirano Helvetsko republiko, eno od sestrskih republik Francoske prve republike.

source.title: French invasion of Switzerland
paragraphs: The French invasion of Switzerland (German: Franzoseneinfall) occurred from January to May 1798 as part of the French Revolutionary Wars. The independent Old Swiss Confederacy collapsed from the invasion and simultaneous internal revolts called the "Helvetic Revolution". The Swiss ancien régime institutions were abolished and replaced by the centralised Helvetic Republic, one of the sister republics of the French First Republic.

Francoska revolucija leta 1848 (francosko: Révolution française de 1848), znana tudi kot februarska revolucija (Révolution de février), je bila obdobje državljanskih nemirov v Franciji februarja 1848, ki je privedlo do padca julijske monarhije in ustanovitve druge francoske republike. Sprožila je val revolucij leta 1848.

Revolucija je potekala v Parizu, pred njo pa je francoska vlada zatrla gibanje banketov (campagne des banquets). Začela se je 22. februarja kot obsežen protest proti vladi Françoisa Guizota in se pozneje razvila v nasilno vstajo proti monarhiji. Po hudih uličnih bojih so velike množice prevzele nadzor nad prestolnico, kar je privedlo do odstopa kralja Ludvika Filipa I. 24. februarja in razglasitve druge republike.

source.title: French Revolution of 1848
paragraphs: The French Revolution of 1848 (French: Révolution française de 1848), also known as the February Revolution (Révolution de février), was a period of civil unrest in France, in February 1848, that led to the collapse of the July Monarchy and the foundation of the French Second Republic. It sparked the wave of revolutions of 1848.

The revolution took place in Paris, and was preceded by the French government's crackdown on the campagne des banquets. Starting on 22 February as a large-scale protest against the government of François Guizot, it later developed into a violent uprising against the monarchy. After intense urban fighting, large crowds managed to take control of the capital, leading to the abdication of King Louis Philippe I on 24 February and the subsequent proclamation of the Second Republic.

Frizija je čezmejna kulturna pokrajina v severozahodni Evropi. Razteza se ob Vatskem morju in obsega sever Nizozemske ter dele severozahodne Nemčije. Širše opredelitve »Frizije« lahko vključujejo tudi otok Rømø in druge danske otoke Vatskega morja. Pokrajino tradicionalno naseljujejo Frizijci, zahodnogermanska etnična skupina.
notes: A state record linked to the article on the modern cultural region; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Frisia
paragraphs: Frisia is a cross-border cultural region in Northwestern Europe. Stretching along the Wadden Sea, it encompasses the north of the Netherlands and parts of northwestern Germany. Wider definitions of "Frisia" may include the island of Rømø and the other Danish Wadden Sea Islands. The region is traditionally inhabited by the Frisians, a West Germanic ethnic group.

Frizijsko kraljestvo (zahodnofrizijsko: Fryske Keninkryk) je sodobno ime za porimsko frizijsko državo v zahodni Evropi v obdobju njenega največjega obsega (650–734). Tej oblasti so vladali kralji; nastala je sredi 7. stoletja in se verjetno končala z bitko na Boorni leta 734, ko je Frankovsko cesarstvo premagalo Frizijce. Ležala je predvsem na ozemlju današnje Nizozemske in je po nekaterih avtorjih iz 19. stoletja segala od Zwina pri Bruggeu v Belgiji do Wesra v Nemčiji. Središče moči je bilo mesto Utrecht.

V srednjeveških spisih je pokrajina označena z latinskim izrazom Frisia. Zgodovinarji se o obsegu te države ne strinjajo; ni dokumentarnih dokazov o obstoju stalne osrednje oblasti. Frizija je morda obsegala več majhnih kraljestev, ki so se v času vojne povezala v enoto, da bi se uprla napadalcem, in jih je nato vodil izvoljeni voditelj, primus inter pares. Mogoče je, da je Radbod ustanovil upravno enoto. Pri tedanjih Frizijcih fevdalnega sistema ni bilo.

source.title: Frisian Kingdom
paragraphs: The Frisian Kingdom (West Frisian: Fryske Keninkryk) is a modern name for the post-Roman Frisian realm in Western Europe in the period when it was at its largest (650–734). This dominion was ruled by kings and emerged in the mid-7th century and probably ended with the Battle of the Boarn in 734 when the Frisians were defeated by the Frankish Empire. It lay mainly in what is now the Netherlands and – according to some 19th century authors – extended from the Zwin near Bruges in Belgium to the Weser in Germany. The center of power was the city of Utrecht.

In medieval writings, the region is designated by the Latin term Frisia. There is a dispute among historians about the extent of this realm; There is no documentary evidence for the existence of a permanent central authority. Possibly, Frisia consisted of multiple petty kingdoms, which transformed in time of war to a unit to resist invading powers, and then headed by an elected leader, the primus inter pares. It is possible that Redbad established an administrative unit. Among the Frisians at that time, there was no feudal system.

Galician peasant uprising of 1846.headline: Galicijska kmečka vstaja leta 1846
paragraphs: Galicijska kmečka vstaja leta 1846, znana tudi kot galicijska rabacija, galicijski pokol ali Szelova vstaja (nemško: Galizischer Bauernaufstand; poljsko: Rzeź galicyjska ali Rabacja galicyjska), je bila dvomesečna vstaja obubožanih kmetov v avstrijski Galiciji, v kateri so pobili več sto pripadnikov poljskega zemljiškega plemstva oziroma šlahte. Vstaja, ki je trajala od februarja do marca, je prizadela predvsem območje okoli mesta Tarnów. Bila je upor proti tlačanstvu, naperjen proti zemljiški posesti in zatiranju (na primer graščinskim ječam). Po nekaterih ocenah so galicijski kmetje ubili okoli 1000 plemičev in uničili okoli 500 graščin. Avstrijska vlada je vstajo sprva spodbujala, da bi z njo odgovorila na nedavno kratkotrajno krakovsko vstajo, med organizatorji katere so bili številni pripadniki poljskega plemstva.
notes: The footnote marker [a] in the English is left out.

source.title: Galician peasant uprising of 1846
paragraphs: The Galician peasant uprising of 1846, also known as the Galician Rabacja, Galician Slaughter, or the Szela Uprising (German: Galizischer Bauernaufstand; Polish: Rzeź galicyjska or Rabacja galicyjska), was a two-month uprising of impoverished Austrian Galician[a] peasants in which hundreds of members of the Polish land-owning nobility or szlachta were massacred. The uprising, which lasted from February to March, primarily affected the lands around the town of Tarnów. A revolt against serfdom, it was directed against manorial property and oppression (such as the manorial prisons). By some estimates, Galician peasants killed about 1,000 nobles and destroyed about 500 manors. The Austrian government initially encouraged the uprising to counter the recent, short-lived Krakow Uprising, the organizers of which had included numerous members of the Polish nobility.

General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade.headline: Splošni sporazum o carinah in trgovini
paragraphs: Splošni sporazum o carinah in trgovini (GATT) je pravni sporazum med številnimi državami, s katerim so te želele spodbujati mednarodno trgovino tako, da bi zmanjšale ali odpravile trgovinske ovire, kot so carine ali kvote. Po preambuli je bil njegov namen »znatno znižanje carin in drugih trgovinskih ovir ter odprava preferencialov na vzajemni in obojestransko koristni podlagi«.

source.title: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade
paragraphs: The General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) is a legal agreement between many countries, whose overall purpose was to promote international trade by reducing or eliminating trade barriers such as tariffs or quotas. According to its preamble, its purpose was the "substantial reduction of tariffs and other trade barriers and the elimination of preferences, on a reciprocal and mutually advantageous basis".

Geneva Accords (1988).headline: Ženevski sporazumi iz leta 1988
paragraphs: Ženevski sporazumi so bili sporazumi o ureditvi razmer v zvezi z Afganistanom, ki sta jih 14. aprila 1988 na sedežu Združenih narodov v Ženevi podpisala Afganistan in Pakistan, ZDA in Sovjetska zveza pa sta bili njihovi porokinji.

Sporazumi so obsegali več listin: dvostranski sporazum med Islamsko republiko Pakistan in Republiko Afganistan o načelih medsebojnih odnosov, zlasti o nevmešavanju in neposeganju; izjavo o mednarodnih jamstvih, ki sta jo podpisali Sovjetska zveza in ZDA; dvostranski sporazum med Pakistanom in Afganistanom o prostovoljni vrnitvi afganistanskih beguncev ter sporazum o medsebojnih razmerjih za ureditev razmer v zvezi z Afganistanom, ki sta ga podpisala Pakistan in Afganistan, Sovjetska zveza in ZDA pa sta bili priči.

source.title: Geneva Accords (1988)
paragraphs: The Geneva Accords were the agreements on the settlement of the situation relating to Afghanistan, were signed on 14 April 1988 at the Geneva headquarters of the United Nations, between Afghanistan and Pakistan, with the United States and the Soviet Union serving as guarantors.

The accords consisted of several instruments: a bilateral agreement between the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and the Republic of Afghanistan on the principles of mutual relations, in particular on non-interference and non-intervention; a declaration on international guarantees, signed by the Soviet Union and the United States; a bilateral agreement between Pakistan and Afghanistan on the voluntary return of Afghan refugees; and an agreement on the interrelationships for the settlement of the situation relating to Afghanistan, signed by Pakistan and Afghanistan and witnessed by the Soviet Union and the United States.

Ženevsko konvencijo o ravnanju z vojnimi ujetniki so podpisali 27. julija 1929 v Ženevi. Uradno se imenuje Konvencija o ravnanju z vojnimi ujetniki, veljati pa je začela 19. junija 1931. Prav ta različica ženevskih konvencij je med drugo svetovno vojno urejala ravnanje z vojnimi ujetniki. Nasledila jo je tretja ženevska konvencija, podpisana leta 1949.
Konvencijo komentira tudi Mednarodni odbor Rdečega križa.
notes: The English excerpt ends with "The International Committee of the Red Cross states that:" before a quotation it leaves out; the Slovenian closes the sentence with a full stop.

source.title: Geneva Convention on Prisoners of War
paragraphs: The Geneva Convention on Prisoners of War was signed at Geneva on 27 July 1929. Its official name is the Convention relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War. It entered into force on 19 June 1931. It is this version of the Geneva Conventions which covered the treatment of prisoners of war during World War II. It is the predecessor of the Third Geneva Convention signed in 1949.
The International Committee of the Red Cross states that:

Protokol o prepovedi uporabe zadušljivih, strupenih ali drugih plinov in bakterioloških sredstev v vojni, navadno imenovan ženevski protokol, je pogodba, ki prepoveduje uporabo kemičnega in biološkega orožja v mednarodnih oboroženih spopadih. Podpisali so ga 17. junija 1925 v Ženevi, veljati pa je začel 8. februarja 1928. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov so ga registrirali 7. septembra 1929. Ženevski protokol je protokol h Konvenciji o nadzoru mednarodne trgovine z orožjem, strelivom in vojnimi pripomočki, podpisani istega dne, in je sledil haaškima konvencijama iz let 1899 in 1907.

source.title: Geneva Protocol
paragraphs: The Protocol for the Prohibition of the Use in War of Asphyxiating, Poisonous or other Gases, and of Bacteriological Methods of Warfare, usually called the Geneva Protocol, is a treaty prohibiting the use of chemical and biological weapons in international armed conflicts. It was signed at Geneva on 17 June 1925 and entered into force on 8 February 1928. It was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 7 September 1929. The Geneva Protocol is a protocol to the Convention for the Supervision of the International Trade in Arms and Ammunition and in Implements of War signed on the same date, and followed the Hague Conventions of 1899 and 1907.

Konvencija o preprečevanju in kaznovanju zločina genocida (CPPCG) ali konvencija o genocidu je mednarodna pogodba, ki genocid opredeljuje kot kaznivo dejanje in države pogodbenice zavezuje k uveljavljanju njegove prepovedi. Bila je prvi pravni instrument, ki je genocid kodificiral kot zločin, in prva pogodba o človekovih pravicah, ki jo je Generalna skupščina Združenih narodov soglasno sprejela, in sicer 9. decembra 1948 na svojem tretjem zasedanju. Konvencija je začela veljati 12. januarja 1951 in je imela septembra 2026 154 držav pogodbenic.

source.title: Genocide Convention
paragraphs: The Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide (CPPCG), or the Genocide Convention, is an international treaty that criminalizes genocide and obligates state parties to pursue the enforcement of its prohibition. It was the first legal instrument to codify genocide as a crime and the first human rights treaty unanimously adopted by the United Nations General Assembly on 9 December 1948, during the third session of the United Nations General Assembly. The Convention entered into force on 12 January 1951 and has 154 state parties as of September 2026.

Georgian uprising on Texel.headline: Gruzijska vstaja na Texelu
paragraphs: Gruzijska vstaja na Texelu (nizozemsko: Opstand der Georgiërs; 5. aprila 1945 – 20. maja 1945) je bila vstaja 882. pehotnega bataljona Königin Tamara (kraljica Tamara) gruzijske legije nemške vojske, nameščenega na nizozemskem otoku Texel, ki so ga zasedli Nemci. Bataljon je sestavljalo 800 Gruzijcev in 400 Nemcev, častniki pa so bili večinoma Nemci. To je bila ena zadnjih bitk na evropskem bojišču.
notes: The note on how Texel is pronounced in Dutch, English, Frisian and German is dropped.

source.title: Georgian uprising on Texel
paragraphs: The Georgian uprising on Texel (Dutch: Opstand der Georgiërs) (5 April 1945 – 20 May 1945) was an insurrection by the 882nd Infantry Battalion Königin Tamara (Queen Tamar or Tamara) of the Georgian Legion of the German Army stationed on the German-occupied Dutch island of Texel (pronounced Tessel in Dutch, and Texel in English, Frisian, and German). The battalion was made up of 800 Georgians and 400 Germans, with mainly German officers. It was one of the last battles in the European theatre.

German bombing of Belgrade.headline: Nemško bombardiranje Beograda
paragraphs: Operacija Povračilo (nemško: Unternehmen Strafgericht) ali operacija Kazen je bila nemško bombardiranje Beograda, prestolnice Jugoslavije, aprila 1941, kot maščevanje za državni udar proti vladi, ki je podpisala trojni pakt. Bombardiranje je potekalo v prvih dneh invazije sil osi pod nemškim vodstvom na Jugoslavijo med drugo svetovno vojno. Vojno letalstvo Kraljevine Jugoslavije (VVKJ) je imelo za obrambo Beograda na voljo le 77 sodobnih lovcev proti stotinam nemških lovcev in bombnikov, ki so v prvem valu napadli zgodaj zjutraj 6. aprila. Tri dni prej je major VVKJ Vladimir Kren prebegnil k Nemcem ter jim izdal lege številnih vojaških zmogljivosti in šifre VVKJ.

source.title: German bombing of Belgrade
paragraphs: Operation Retribution (German: Unternehmen Strafgericht) or Operation Punishment was the April 1941 German bombing of Belgrade, the capital of Yugoslavia, in retaliation for the coup d'état that overthrew the government that had signed the Tripartite Pact. The bombing occurred in the first days of the German-led Axis invasion of Yugoslavia during World War II. The Royal Yugoslav Army Air Force (VVKJ) had only 77 modern fighter aircraft available to defend Belgrade against the hundreds of German fighters and bombers that struck in the first wave early on 6 April. Three days prior, VVKJ Major Vladimir Kren had defected to the Germans, disclosing the locations of multiple military assets and divulging the VVKJ's codes.

Nemška kampanja (nemško: Befreiungskriege, dobesedno »osvobodilne vojne«) je potekala leta 1813. Članice šeste koalicije, med njimi nemški državi Avstrija in Prusija ter Rusija in Švedska, so se v vrsti bitk v Nemčiji spopadle s francoskim cesarjem Napoleonom, njegovimi maršali in vojskami Renske zveze – zavezništva večine drugih nemških držav – in s tem končale prevlado Prvega francoskega cesarstva.

Po uničujočem porazu Napoleonove Velike armade na pohodu na Rusijo leta 1812 je Johann Yorck, general, ki je poveljeval nemškim pomožnim enotam Velike armade (Hilfskorps), 30. decembra 1812 s tauroggensko konvencijo sklenil premirje z Rusi. To je bil odločilni dejavnik za izbruh nemške kampanje naslednjega leta.
notes: The English punctuation around the aside on the Confederation of the Rhine ("– an alliance of most of the other German states, –") is normalised to a pair of dashes.

source.title: German campaign of 1813
paragraphs: The German campaign (German: Befreiungskriege, lit. 'Wars of Liberation') was fought in 1813. Members of the Sixth Coalition, including the German states of Austria and Prussia, plus Russia and Sweden, fought a series of battles in Germany against the French Emperor Napoleon, his marshals, and the armies of the Confederation of the Rhine – an alliance of most of the other German states, – which ended the domination of the First French Empire.

After the devastating defeat of Napoleon's Grande Armée in the Russian campaign of 1812, Johann Yorck – the general in command of the Grande Armée's German auxiliaries (Hilfskorps) – declared a ceasefire with the Russians on 30 December 1812 via the Convention of Tauroggen. This was the decisive factor in the outbreak of the German campaign the following year.

German invasion of Luxembourg.headline: Nemška invazija na Luksemburg
paragraphs: Nemška invazija na Luksemburg je bila del načrta Fall Gelb (primer Rumeno), nemške invazije na Nizke dežele – Belgijo, Luksemburg in Nizozemsko – ter Francijo med drugo svetovno vojno. Boji so se začeli 10. maja 1940 in trajali le en dan. Nemške čete so ob le šibkem odporu hitro zasedle Luksemburg. Luksemburški vladi in veliki vojvodinji Charlotte je uspelo pobegniti iz države, v Londonu pa je nastala vlada v izgnanstvu.

source.title: German invasion of Luxembourg
paragraphs: The German invasion of Luxembourg was part of Case Yellow (German: Fall Gelb), the German invasion of the Low Countries—Belgium, Luxembourg and the Netherlands—and France during World War II. The battle began on 10 May 1940 and lasted just one day. Facing only light resistance, German troops quickly occupied Luxembourg. The Luxembourgish government, and Grand Duchess Charlotte, managed to escape the country and a government-in-exile was created in London.

Nemška revolucija v letih 1918–1919, znana tudi kot novembrska revolucija (nemško: Novemberrevolution), je ob koncu prve svetovne vojne strmoglavila Nemško cesarstvo in pripravila pot za ustanovitev Weimarske republike. Sprožile so jo stiske, ki jih je nemško ljudstvo trpelo med vojno, gospodarske in psihološke posledice poraza cesarstva ter družbene napetosti med širšim prebivalstvom in aristokratsko, vojaško in meščansko elito. Do 9. novembra 1918 je revolucija hitro in skoraj brez prelivanja krvi strmoglavila cesarstvo, v drugi, bolj nasilni fazi pa so zagovorniki parlamentarne republike premagali tiste, ki so želeli ustanoviti republiko svetov po sovjetskem zgledu.

source.title: German revolution of 1918–1919
paragraphs: The German revolution of 1918–1919, also known as the November Revolution (German: Novemberrevolution), brought down the German Empire at the end of World War I and set the stage for the establishment of the Weimar Republic. The revolution was sparked by the hardships suffered by the German people during the war, the economic and psychological impacts of the Empire's defeat, and the social tensions between the general populace and the aristocratic, military and bourgeois elite. It quickly and almost bloodlessly brought down the Empire by 9 November 1918, then in its second and more violent stage, the supporters of a parliamentary republic defeated those who wanted to create a soviet-style council republic.

German–Estonian Non-Aggression Pact.headline: Nemško-estonski pakt o nenapadanju
paragraphs: Nemško-estonski pakt o nenapadanju sta 7. junija 1939 v Berlinu podpisala estonski in nemški zunanji minister, Karl Selter in Joachim von Ribbentrop. Istega dne so podpisali tudi nemško-latvijski pakt o nenapadanju. Ratifikacijske listine nemško-estonskega pakta so izmenjali v Berlinu 24. julija 1939 in pakt je začel veljati istega dne. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov so ga registrirali 12. avgusta 1939. Sklenjen je bil za deset let.

Namen paktov je bil preprečiti, da bi Zahod ali Sovjeti pridobili vpliv v baltskih državah in tako obkolili Nemčijo. Pakt o nenapadanju z Litvo je Nemčija sklenila marca, po nemškem ultimatu Litvi leta 1939 zaradi Klajpedskega ozemlja. Baltske države naj bi bile pregrada pred morebitnim sovjetskim posegom v načrtovani nemško-poljski vojni.

source.title: German–Estonian Non-Aggression Pact
paragraphs: The German–Estonian Non-Aggression Pact was signed in Berlin on 7 June 1939 by Estonian and German Foreign Ministers Karl Selter and Joachim von Ribbentrop. The German–Latvian Non-Aggression Pact was also signed on the same day. Ratifications of the German-Estonian Pact were exchanged in Berlin on 24 July 1939, and it became effective the same day. It was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 12 August 1939. The pact was intended for a period of ten years.

The pacts were intended to prevent the West or the Soviets from gaining influence in the Baltic states and thus encircling Germany. A non-aggression pact with Lithuania was concluded in March after the 1939 German ultimatum to Lithuania regarding the Klaipėda Region. The states were to provide a barrier against any Soviet intervention in a planned German–Polish war.

German–Latvian Non-Aggression Pact.headline: Nemško-latvijski pakt o nenapadanju
paragraphs: Nemško-latvijski pakt o nenapadanju so podpisali v Berlinu 7. junija 1939.

Zaradi nemškega prodiranja na vzhod je sovjetska vlada med pogajanji z zahodnimi silami o zavezništvu zahtevala angleško-francosko jamstvo za neodvisnost baltskih držav. Latvijska in estonska vlada, ki sta bili do sovjetskih namenov vedno nezaupljivi, sta se odločili za vzajemni pakt o nenapadanju z Nemčijo. Nemško-estonski in nemško-latvijski pakt o nenapadanju sta v Berlinu 7. junija 1939 podpisala latvijski zunanji minister Vilhelms Munters in nemški zunanji minister Joachim von Ribbentrop. Naslednji dan je Adolf Hitler sprejel estonske in latvijske odposlance ter v pogovorih z njimi poudaril, da je treba ohraniti in okrepiti trgovinske vezi med Nemčijo in baltskimi državami. Ratifikacijske listine pakta so izmenjali v Berlinu 24. julija 1939 in pakt je začel veljati istega dne. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov so ga registrirali 24. avgusta 1939, sklenjen pa je bil za deset let.
notes: The English says Munters and Ribbentrop signed both the Estonian and the Latvian pact, while the German–Estonian Non-Aggression Pact summary names the Estonian minister Karl Selter as its signatory; the Slovenian follows each source as written.

source.title: German–Latvian Non-Aggression Pact
paragraphs: The German–Latvian Non-Aggression Pact was signed in Berlin on June 7, 1939.

In light of the German advance in the east, the Soviet government demanded an Anglo-French guarantee of the independence of the Baltic states during the negotiations for an alliance with the Western Powers. The Latvian and Estonian governments, ever suspicious of Soviet intentions, decided to accept a mutual non-aggression pact with Germany. The German–Estonian and German–Latvian Non-aggression pacts were signed in Berlin on June 7, 1939, by Latvian Foreign Minister Vilhelms Munters and German Foreign Minister Joachim von Ribbentrop. The next day, Adolf Hitler received the Estonian and Latvian envoys and, in the course of his interviews, stressed the maintaining and strengthening of commercial links between Germany and the Baltic states. Ratifications of the pact were exchanged in Berlin on July 24, 1939, and it became effective the same day. It was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on August 24, 1939 and was intended for a period of ten years.

German–Polish Border Treaty.headline: Nemško-poljska mejna pogodba
paragraphs: Nemško-poljska mejna pogodba iz leta 1990 je dokončno uredila vprašanje poljsko-nemške meje, ki je bilo z vidika mednarodnega prava odprto od leta 1945. Podpisala sta jo zunanja ministra Poljske in Nemčije, Krzysztof Skubiszewski in Hans-Dietrich Genscher, 14. novembra 1990 v Varšavi; poljski sejm jo je ratificiral 26. novembra 1991, nemški bundestag pa 16. decembra 1991, veljati pa je začela z izmenjavo ratifikacijskih listin 16. januarja 1992.

source.title: German–Polish Border Treaty
paragraphs: The German–Polish Border Treaty of 1990 finally settled the issue of the Polish–German border, which in terms of international law had been pending since 1945. It was signed by the foreign ministers of Poland and Germany, Krzysztof Skubiszewski and Hans-Dietrich Genscher, on 14 November 1990 in Warsaw, ratified by the Polish Sejm on 26 November 1991 and the German Bundestag on 16 December 1991, and entered into force with the exchange of the instruments of ratification on 16 January 1992.

Nemško-poljska izjava o nenapadanju, znana tudi kot nemško-poljski pakt o nenapadanju, je bila sporazum med nacistično Nemčijo in Drugo poljsko republiko, ki sta ga državi podpisali 26. januarja 1934 v Berlinu.

Obe državi sta se zavezali, da bosta težave reševali z dvostranskimi pogajanji in se 10 let odpovedali oboroženemu spopadu. Sporazum je dejansko normaliziral odnose med Poljsko in Nemčijo, ki so jih obremenjevali mejni spori zaradi ozemeljske ureditve v versajski mirovni pogodbi. Izjava je končala gospodarsko škodljivo carinsko vojno med državama, ki je trajala prejšnje desetletje.

source.title: German–Polish declaration of non-aggression
paragraphs: The German–Polish declaration of non-aggression, also known as the German–Polish non-aggression pact, was an agreement between Nazi Germany and the Second Polish Republic that was signed on 26 January 1934 in Berlin.

Both countries pledged to resolve their problems by bilateral negotiations and to forgo armed conflict for a period of 10 years. The agreement effectively normalised relations between Poland and Germany, which had been strained by border disputes arising from the territorial settlement in the Treaty of Versailles. The declaration marked an end to an economically damaging customs war between the two countries that had taken place over the previous decade.

German–Soviet Boundary and Friendship Tr.headline: Nemško-sovjetska pogodba o mejah in prijateljstvu
paragraphs: Nemško-sovjetska pogodba o mejah in prijateljstvu je bila drugi dopolnilni protokol k paktu Ribbentrop-Molotov z dne 23. avgusta 1939. Šlo je za tajno določilo, ki sta ga nacistična Nemčija in Sovjetska zveza 28. septembra 1939 spremenili po skupni invaziji in zasedbi suverene Poljske. Podpisala sta ga zunanja ministra Nemčije in Sovjetske zveze Joachim von Ribbentrop in Vjačeslav Molotov v navzočnosti Josifa Stalina. Javno so objavili le majhen del protokola, ki je nadomestil prvo pogodbo, medtem ko so vplivne sfere nacistične Nemčije in Sovjetske zveze ostale tajne. Tretji tajni protokol pakta sta 10. januarja 1941 podpisala Friedrich Werner von Schulenburg in Molotov; v njem se je Nemčija odpovedala zahtevam po delu Litve zahodno od reke Šešupe. Le nekaj mesecev pozneje je Nemčija začela invazijo na Sovjetsko zvezo.

source.title: German–Soviet Boundary and Friendship Treaty
paragraphs: The German–Soviet Boundary and Friendship Treaty was a second supplementary protocol of the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact of 23 August 1939. It was a secret clause as amended on 28 September 1939 by Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union after their joint invasion and occupation of sovereign Poland. It was signed by Joachim von Ribbentrop and Vyacheslav Molotov, the foreign ministers of Germany and the Soviet Union respectively, in the presence of Joseph Stalin. Only a small portion of the protocol, which superseded the first treaty, was publicly announced, while the spheres of influence of Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union remained secret. The third secret protocol of the Pact was signed on 10 January 1941 by Friedrich Werner von Schulenburg and Molotov, in which Germany renounced its claims on a part of Lithuania, west of the Šešupė river. Only a few months after this, Germany started its invasion of the Soviet Union.

German–Soviet Commercial Agreement (1940.headline: Nemško-sovjetski trgovinski sporazum (1940)
paragraphs: Nemško-sovjetski trgovinski sporazum iz leta 1940 (rusko: Хозяйственное соглашение между Союзом Советских Социалистических Республик и Германией; znan tudi kot gospodarski sporazum med Nemškim rajhom in Zvezo sovjetskih socialističnih republik z dne 11. februarja 1940) je bil gospodarski dogovor med Sovjetsko zvezo in nacistično Nemčijo, podpisan 11. februarja 1940. Sovjetska zveza se je v njem zavezala, da bo v obdobju od 11. februarja 1940 do leta 1941 poleg dobav po nemško-sovjetskem trgovinskem sporazumu, podpisanem 19. avgusta 1939, dobavila blago (nafto, surovine in žito) v vrednosti od 420 do 430 milijonov rajhovskih mark.

Pozneje sta se državi dogovorili tudi o tranzitu blaga iz tretjih držav, ki ga je Nemčija kupila, čez sovjetsko ozemlje. Sporazum sta nadgradili in druga vprašanja uredili z nemško-sovjetskim sporazumom o meji in trgovini z dne 10. januarja 1941. Junija 1941 je Nemčija v nasprotju s paktom Ribbentrop-Molotov iz leta 1939 napadla Sovjetsko zvezo in vsi gospodarski sporazumi med državama so prenehali veljati.

source.title: German–Soviet Commercial Agreement (1940)
paragraphs: The 1940 German–Soviet Commercial Agreement (Russian: Хозяйственное соглашение между Союзом Советских Социалистических Республик и Германией; also known as Economic Agreement of 11 February 1940 Between the German Reich and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics) was an economic arrangement between the Soviet Union and Nazi Germany signed on 11 February 1940. In it the Soviet Union agreed in the period from 11 February 1940 to 1941, in addition to the deliveries under German–Soviet Commercial Agreement, signed on 19 August 1939 to deliver commodities (oil, raw materials, and grain) to the value of 420 to 430 million Reichsmarks.

A policy on the transit through Soviet territory of third countries' commodities purchased by Germany was later agreed. The countries followed up the agreement and resolved other issues with the 10 January 1941 German–Soviet Border and Commercial Agreement. In June 1941 Germany invaded the Soviet Union in violation of the 1939 Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, and all economic agreements between the two countries ended.

Glyndŵr rebellion.headline: Glyndŵrjev upor
paragraphs: Glyndŵrjev upor je bil valižanski upor, ki ga je med letoma 1400 in okoli 1416 vodil Owain Glyndŵr proti Kraljevini Angliji v poznem srednjem veku. Na vrhuncu upora je Owain nadzoroval večino Walesa, potem ko je zavzel več najmočnejših gradov železnega obroča, in v Machynllethu ustanovil parlament. Upor je bil zadnji velik izraz valižanske neodvisnosti pred priključitvijo Walesa Angliji v letih 1542–1543.

Upor se je začel leta 1400, ko si je Owain Glyndŵr, potomec več valižanskih kraljevih dinastij, po sporu s sosednjim angleškim gospodom prilastil naslov valižanskega princa. Leta 1404 je Owain po vrsti uspešnih obleganj gradov in zmag na bojišču sklical parlament, pozneje pa napovedal, da bo znova uvedel tradicionalne valižanske zakone Hywela Dobrega, ustanovil samostojno valižansko cerkev in zgradil dve univerzi. Owain je sklenil tudi zavezništvo s francoskim kraljem Karlom VI., leta 1405 pa se je v Walesu izkrcala francoska vojska v podporo uporu.

source.title: Glyndŵr rebellion
paragraphs: The Glyndŵr rebellion was a Welsh rebellion led between 1400 and c. 1416 by Owain Glyndŵr against the Kingdom of England during the Late Middle Ages. During the rebellion's height, Owain exercised control over the majority of Wales after capturing several of the most powerful Ring of Iron castles, and formed a parliament at Machynlleth. The revolt was the last major manifestation of Welsh independence before the annexation of Wales into England in 1542–43.

The uprising began in 1400, when Owain Glyndŵr, a descendant of several Welsh royal dynasties, claimed the title Prince of Wales following a dispute with a neighbouring English lord. In 1404, after a series of successful castle sieges and battlefield victories, Owain summoned a parliament, later announcing plans to reintroduce the traditional Welsh laws of Hywel Dda, establish an independent Welsh church, and build two universities. Owain also formed an alliance with Charles VI of France, and in 1405 a French army landed in Wales to support the rebellion.

Golub War.headline: Golubska vojna
paragraphs: Golubska vojna je bila dvomesečna vojna tevtonskih vitezov proti Kraljevini Poljski in Veliki litovski kneževini leta 1422. Končala se je s poljsko-litovsko-moldavsko zmago. Uradno jo je končal mir v Melnu, ki je razrešil ozemeljske spore med vitezi in Litvo glede Žemaitije, ki so se vlekli od leta 1398.
notes: Samogitia is written in the Slovenian form Žemaitija.

source.title: Golub War
paragraphs: The Golub War was a two-month war of the Teutonic Knights against the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1422. It resulted in a Polish–Lithuanian–Moldavian victory. The Treaty of Melno officially ended the war, which resolved territorial disputes between the Knights and Lithuania over Samogitia that had dragged on since 1398.

Velikonočni sporazum ali belfastski sporazum (irsko: Comhaontú Aoine an Chéasta ali Comhaontú Bhéal Feirste; ulstrsko škotsko: Guid Friday Greeance ali Bilfawst Greeance) je par sporazumov, podpisanih 10. aprila (na veliki petek) 1998, ki sta končala večino nasilja nemirov (The Troubles), etničnega in narodnostnega spopada na Severnem Irskem od konca 1960. let. Bil je velik korak v severnoirskem mirovnem procesu v 1990. letih. Sestavljata ga večstranski sporazum med večino severnoirskih političnih strank in britansko-irski sporazum med britansko in irsko vlado. Na sporazumu temelji sedanji decentralizirani sistem vlade na Severnem Irskem.

source.title: Good Friday Agreement
paragraphs: The Good Friday Agreement or Belfast Agreement (Irish: Comhaontú Aoine an Chéasta or Comhaontú Bhéal Feirste; Ulster Scots: Guid Friday Greeance or Bilfawst Greeance) is a pair of agreements signed on 10 April (Good Friday) 1998 that ended most of the violence of the Troubles, an ethnic and national conflict in Northern Ireland since the late 1960s. It was a major development in the Northern Ireland peace process of the 1990s. It is made up of the Multi-Party Agreement between most of Northern Ireland's political parties, and the British–Irish Agreement between the British and Irish governments. Northern Ireland's present devolved system of government is based on the Agreement.

Gorlice–Tarnów offensive.headline: Ofenziva Gorlice–Tarnów
paragraphs: Ofenziva Gorlice–Tarnów v prvi svetovni vojni je bila sprva zamišljena kot manjša nemška ofenziva, ki naj bi zmanjšala ruski pritisk na avstro-ogrske sile južno od Nemcev na vzhodni fronti, prerasla pa je v glavni ofenzivni napor centralnih sil leta 1915: ruske črte so se popolnoma zrušile, Rusi pa so se umaknili globoko v Rusijo. Niz spopadov, ki je sledil, je trajal večji del vojaške sezone leta 1915: začel se je v začetku maja in se končal šele oktobra zaradi slabega vremena.
Mackensen je preboj videl kot prvo fazo operacije, ki bi nato privedla do ruskega umika z Dukelskega prelaza in s položajev severno od Visle.

source.title: Gorlice–Tarnów offensive
paragraphs: The Gorlice–Tarnów offensive during World War I was initially conceived as a minor German offensive to relieve Russian pressure on the Austro-Hungarians to their south on the Eastern Front, but resulted in the Central Powers' chief offensive effort of 1915, causing the total collapse of the Russian lines and their retreat far into Russia. The continued series of actions lasted the majority of the campaigning season for 1915, starting in early May and only ending due to bad weather in October.
Mackensen viewed securing a breakthrough as the first phase of an operation, which would then lead to a Russian retreat from the Dukla Pass, and their positions north of the Vistula.
Gotija lahko pomeni:
Gotija (rimska provinca), rimska provinca iz 4. stoletja na območju današnje Romunije;
Götaland, pokrajina na jugu Švedske.
notes: The record links to a disambiguation page; translated as the list it is.

source.title: Gothia
paragraphs: Gothia may refer to:
Gothia (Roman province), a fourth century Roman province in present-day Romania
Götaland, a region in southern Sweden

Gothic War (401–403).headline: Gotska vojna (401–403)
paragraphs: Gotska vojna 401–403 je bila vojna med Zahodnim rimskim cesarstvom in Vizigoti. Rimski vojski je poveljeval Flavij Stilihon, Vizigote pa je vodil Alarik. Vojna se je bojevala v severni Italiji in je poleg več manjših spopadov obsegala dve veliki bitki, ki sta se obe končali z rimsko zmago.

source.title: Gothic War (401–403)
paragraphs: The Gothic War of 401–403 fought between the Western Roman Empire and the Visigoths. The commander of the Roman army was Flavius Stilicho, the Visigoths were led by Alaric. The war was fought in the north of Italy and, in addition to a number of small fights, consisted of two major battles, both of which were won by the Romans.

Goudi coup.headline: Državni udar v Gudiju
paragraphs: Državni udar v Gudiju (grško: κίνημα στο Γουδί) je bil vojaški državni udar skupine častnikov v noči na 28. avgust [15. avgust po starem koledarju] 1909 v vojašnici v Gudiju na vzhodnem robu Aten. Bil je prelomnica v sodobni grški zgodovini, saj je končal stari politični sistem in odprl novo obdobje za Grčijo.

Do udara je prišlo ob vrelih napetostih v grški družbi, ki je trpela zaradi pomanjkanja nujnih reform in finančnih težav, ki jih je poglobil poraz v grško-turški vojni leta 1897. Po zgledu mladoturkov je več nižjih častnikov ustanovilo tajno društvo, Vojaško ligo. Vojaška liga je s polkovnikom Nikolaosom Zorbasom kot formalnim voditeljem v noči na 15. avgust zbrala čete v vojašnici v Gudiju in vladi poslala pronunciamiento z zahtevo po takojšnjem preobratu za državo in njene oborožene sile.

source.title: Goudi coup
paragraphs: The Goudi coup (Greek: κίνημα στο Γουδί, romanized: kinima sto Goudi) was a military coup d'état by a group of military officers that took place on the night of 28 August [O.S. 15 August] 1909, at the barracks in Goudi, located on the eastern outskirts of Athens, Greece. The coup was pivotal in modern Greek history, ending the old political system and ushering in a new period for Greece.

The coup occurred under simmering tensions in Greek society, which reeled under the effects of a lack of necessary reforms and financial troubles that had been exacerbated by the defeat in the Greco-Turkish War of 1897. Emulating the Young Turks, several junior army officers founded a secret society, the Military League. With Colonel Nikolaos Zorbas as their figurehead, on the night of 15 August, the Military League, having gathered its troops in the Goudi barracks, issued a pronunciamiento to the government, demanding an immediate turnaround for the country and its armed forces.
Velika vojvodina Baden (nemško: Großherzogtum Baden) je bila nemška država na vzhodnem bregu Rena. Sprva je bila suverena država od leta 1806 do 1871, nato pa do leta 1918 del Nemškega cesarstva.

Vojvodina je izvirala iz mejne grofije iz 12. stoletja, ki se je sčasoma razdelila na dve, Baden-Durlach in Baden-Baden, ponovno pa se je združila leta 1771. Ozemlje se je povečalo in po razpadu Svetega rimskega cesarstva dobilo vojvodski status, leta 1848 pa ga je pretresla revolucija, katere zahteve so bile leto prej oblikovane v Offenburgu na zborovanju, ki danes velja za prvi demokratični program v Nemčiji. Po propadu Nemškega cesarstva je Baden pod imenom Republika Baden postal del Weimarske republike.

source.title: Grand Duchy of Baden
paragraphs: The Grand Duchy of Baden (German: Großherzogtum Baden) was a German polity on the east bank of the Rhine. It originally existed as a sovereign state from 1806 to 1871 and later as part of the German Empire until 1918.

The duchy's 12th-century origins were as a margraviate that eventually split into two, Baden-Durlach and Baden-Baden, before being reunified in 1771. The territory grew and assumed its ducal status after the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire but suffered a revolution in 1848, whose demands had been formulated in Offenburg the previous year at a meeting now considered the first-ever democratic program in Germany. With the collapse of the German Empire it became part of the Weimar Republic under the name Republic of Baden.

Veliko vojvodstvo Berg (nemško: Großherzogtum Berg), znano tudi kot Veliko vojvodstvo Berg in Kleve, je bilo ozemeljsko veliko vojvodstvo, ki ga je leta 1806 po zmagi v bitki pri Slavkovu (1805) ustanovil Napoleon na ozemljih med Francoskim cesarstvom ob Renu in nemško Kraljevino Vestfalijo.

source.title: Grand Duchy of Berg
paragraphs: The Grand Duchy of Berg (German: Großherzogtum Berg), also known as the Grand Duchy of Berg and Cleves, was a territorial grand duchy established in 1806 by Napoleon after his victory at the Battle of Austerlitz (1805) on territories between the French Empire at the Rhine river and the German Kingdom of Westphalia.

Velika vojvodina Hessen in Porenje (nemško: Großherzogtum Hessen und bei Rhein) je bila velika vojvodina v zahodni Nemčiji, ki je obstajala od leta 1806 do 1918. Nastala je leta 1806 iz Deželne grofije Hessen-Darmstadt kot Velika vojvodina Hessen (nemško: Großherzogtum Hessen). Ime Hessen in Porenje je prevzela leta 1816, da bi se razlikovala od Volilne kneževine Hessen, ki je nastala iz sosednje Deželne grofije Hessen-Kassel. V pogovornem jeziku so veliko vojvodino še naprej imenovali s prejšnjim imenom Hessen-Darmstadt.

source.title: Grand Duchy of Hesse
paragraphs: The Grand Duchy of Hesse and by Rhine (German: Großherzogtum Hessen und bei Rhein) was a grand duchy in western Germany that existed from 1806 to 1918. The grand duchy originally formed from the Landgraviate of Hesse-Darmstadt in 1806 as the Grand Duchy of Hesse (German: Großherzogtum Hessen). It assumed the name Hesse and by Rhine in 1816 to distinguish itself from the Electorate of Hesse, which had formed from the neighbouring Landgraviate of Hesse-Kassel. Colloquially, the grand duchy continued to be known by its former name of Hesse-Darmstadt.

Grand Duchy of Kraków.headline: Velika vojvodina Krakov
paragraphs: Velika vojvodina Krakov (nemško: Großherzogtum Krakau; poljsko: Wielkie Księstwo Krakowskie) je nastala po priključitvi Svobodnega mesta Krakov Avstriji 16. novembra 1846. Od leta 1846 do 1918 je bil naslov veliki vojvoda Krakova del uradnega naslova avstrijskega cesarja.

source.title: Grand Duchy of Kraków
paragraphs: The Grand Duchy of Kraków (German: Großherzogtum Krakau; Polish: Wielkie Księstwo Krakowskie) was created after the incorporation of the Free City of Cracow into Austria on 16 November 1846. From 1846 to 1918 the title, Grand Duke of Kraków, was part of the official titulary of the Emperor of Austria.

Velika vojvodina Toskana (italijansko: Granducato di Toscana; latinsko: Magnus Ducatus Etruriae) je bila italijanska monarhija v osrednji Italiji, ki je z vmesnimi prekinitvami obstajala od leta 1569 do 1860 in nadomestila Florentinsko republiko. Prestolnica velike vojvodine so bile Firence. V 19. stoletju je imela velika vojvodina okoli 1.815.000 prebivalcev.

Cosimo I. Medičejski, ki je po osvojitvi Sienske republike pod svoj nadzor spravil skoraj vso Toskano, je 27. avgusta 1569 s papeško bulo papeža Pija V. postal veliki vojvoda Toskane. Velika vojvodina je bila pod vladavino Medičejcev, dokler ni leta 1737 izumrla njihova starejša veja. Čeprav ni bila tako mednarodno slavna kot nekdanja republika, je velika vojvodina pod Medičejci cvetela in pod Cosimom I. ter njegovimi sinovi doživela brez primere velik gospodarski in vojaški uspeh, do vladavine Ferdinanda II., ko se je začel dolgi gospodarski zaton države. Ta se je nadaljeval pod Cosimom III.

source.title: Grand Duchy of Tuscany
paragraphs: The Grand Duchy of Tuscany (Italian: Granducato di Toscana; Latin: Magnus Ducatus Etruriae) was an Italian monarchy located in Central Italy that existed, with interruptions, from 1569 to 1860, replacing the Republic of Florence. The grand duchy's capital was Florence. In the 19th century the population of the Grand Duchy was about 1,815,000 inhabitants.

Having brought nearly all Tuscany under his control after conquering the Republic of Siena, Cosimo I de' Medici, was elevated by a papal bull of Pope Pius V to Grand Duke of Tuscany on 27 August 1569. The Grand Duchy was ruled by the House of Medici until the extinction of its senior branch in 1737. While not as internationally renowned as the old republic, the grand duchy thrived under the Medici and it bore witness to unprecedented economic and military success under Cosimo I and his sons, until the reign of Ferdinando II, which saw the beginning of the state's long economic decline. That economic decline continued under Cosimo III.

Great Siege of Malta.headline: Veliko obleganje Malte
paragraphs: Veliko obleganje Malte (malteško: L-Assedju l-Kbir) je potekalo leta 1565, ko je Osmansko cesarstvo poskušalo osvojiti otok Malta, ki so ga takrat držali vitezi hospitalci. Obleganje je trajalo skoraj štiri mesece, od 18. maja do 8. septembra 1565.

Vitezi hospitalci so imeli sedež na Malti od leta 1530, potem ko so jih leta 1522 po obleganju Rodosa pregnali z Rodosa, prav tako Osmani. Osmani so Malto prvič poskušali zavzeti leta 1551, a niso uspeli. Leta 1565 je osmanski sultan Sulejman Veličastni Malto poskusil zavzeti drugič. Vitezi, ki jih je bilo okoli 500, skupaj z okoli 6000 pešaki, so obleganju kljubovali in napadalce odbili.

source.title: Great Siege of Malta
paragraphs: The Great Siege of Malta (Maltese: L-Assedju l-Kbir) occurred in 1565 when the Ottoman Empire attempted to conquer the island of Malta, then held by the Knights Hospitaller. The siege lasted nearly four months, from 18 May to 8 September 1565.

The Knights Hospitaller had been headquartered in Malta since 1530, after being driven out of Rhodes, also by the Ottomans, in 1522, following the siege of Rhodes. The Ottomans first attempted to take Malta in 1551 but failed. In 1565, Suleiman the Magnificent, the Ottoman Sultan, made a second attempt to take Malta. The Knights, who numbered around 500 together with approximately 6,000 footsoldiers, withstood the siege and repelled the invaders.

Great Stand on the Ugra River.headline: Veliko stanje na Ugri
paragraphs: Veliko stanje na Ugri (rusko: Великое стояние на Угре) ali stanje na Ugri, znano tudi kot bitka na Ugri, je bilo leta 1480 soočenje na bregovih reke Ugre med silami Ahmat-kana iz Velike horde in velikega kneza Ivana III. iz Moskovske velike kneževine.

Ko je Ivan III. prenehal plačevati davek hordi, je Ahmat-kan vojsko popeljal proti Moskvi in vojski sta se soočili na bregovih reke. Ahmat-kan je čakal na litovske okrepitve, ki pa niso prišle; ko je spodletel tudi en mongolski poskus prečkanja reke, se je umaknil. Obe vojski sta se po le malo bojih razšli. Izid pohoda je kljub temu ustrezal strateškemu načrtu Rusov, da obranijo prestolnico in mejo pred Tatari.

source.title: Great Stand on the Ugra River
paragraphs: The Great Stand on the Ugra River (Russian: Великое стояние на Угре) or the Standing on the Ugra River, also known as the Battle of the Ugra, was a standoff in 1480 on the banks of the Ugra River between the forces of Akhmat Khan of the Great Horde, and Grand Prince Ivan III of the Grand Duchy of Moscow.

After Ivan III stopped paying tribute to the Horde, Akhmat Khan led an army towards Moscow, leading to a standoff between the two armies on the banks of the river. Akhmat Khan waited for his Lithuanian reinforcements to arrive, but they never did, with one Mongol attempt to cross the river failing leading Akhmat Khan to retreat. Both armies departed after little fighting. Nevertheless, the outcome of the campaign corresponded to the strategic plan of the Russians to defend the capital and the border from the Tatars.

Greater Poland Uprising (1806).headline: Velikopoljska vstaja leta 1806
paragraphs: Velikopoljska vstaja leta 1806 je bila poljska vojaška vstaja v pokrajini Wielkopolska ali Velikopoljska proti pruskim okupacijskim silam po delitvah Republike obeh narodov (1772–1795).

Vstajo je organiziral general Jan Henryk Dąbrowski, da bi prodirajočim francoskim silam pod Napoleonom pomagal osvoboditi Poljsko pruske okupacije. Velikopoljska vstaja je bila odločilni dejavnik, ki je omogočil ustanovitev Varšavskega vojvodstva (1807) in vključitev Velikopoljske vanj.

source.title: Greater Poland Uprising (1806)
paragraphs: The Greater Poland uprising of 1806 was a Polish military insurrection which occurred in the region of Wielkopolska, also known as Greater Poland, against the occupying Prussian forces after the Partitions of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth (1772–1795).

The uprising was organized by General Jan Henryk Dąbrowski to help advancing French forces under Napoleon in liberating Poland from Prussian occupation. The Wielkopolska Uprising was a decisive factor that allowed the formation of the Duchy of Warsaw (1807) and the inclusion of Wielkopolska in the Duchy of Warsaw.

Greater Poland Uprising (1848).headline: Velikopoljska vstaja leta 1848
paragraphs: Velikopoljska vstaja leta 1848 ali poznanjska vstaja (poljsko: powstanie wielkopolskie 1848 roku / powstanie poznańskie) je bila neuspešna vojaška vstaja Poljakov proti silam Kraljevine Prusije med revolucijami leta 1848. Glavni boji v pruskem delu razdeljene Poljske so potekali v Velikopoljski, nekaj bojev pa je bilo tudi v Pomereliji. Protestirali so tudi na s Poljaki poseljenih območjih Šlezije.

source.title: Greater Poland Uprising (1848)
paragraphs: The Greater Poland uprising of 1848 or Poznań Uprising (Polish: powstanie wielkopolskie 1848 roku / powstanie poznańskie) was an unsuccessful military insurrection of Poles against forces of the Kingdom of Prussia during the Revolutions of 1848. The main fighting in the Prussian Partition of Poland was concentrated in the Greater Poland region but some fighting also occurred in Pomerelia. Protests were also held in Polish-inhabited regions of Silesia.

Greater Poland uprising (1918–1919).headline: Velikopoljska vstaja 1918–1919
paragraphs: Velikopoljska vstaja v letih 1918–1919 (poljsko: powstanie wielkopolskie 1918–1919 roku; nemško: Großpolnischer Aufstand), imenovana tudi poznanjska vojna, je bila vojaška vstaja Poljakov v Velikopoljski (v nemški rabi Veliko vojvodstvo Posen ali Provinz Posen) proti nemški oblasti. Vstaja je pomembno vplivala na versajsko mirovno pogodbo, ki je obnovljeni Drugi poljski republiki dodelila območje, ki so ga osvojili poljski uporniki. Pokrajina je pripadala Kraljevini Poljski in nato Republiki obeh narodov, dokler je ob drugi delitvi Poljske leta 1793 ni priključila nemška Kraljevina Prusija. Po velikopoljski vstaji leta 1806 je bila tudi del Varšavskega vojvodstva (1807–1815), francoske satelitske države v napoleonskih vojnah.
notes: The English gives two spellings of the same name, Greater Poland uprising and Wielkopolska uprising, which are one name in Slovenian; the English "German: Grand Duchy of Posen" is rendered as the Slovenian name with the German Provinz Posen.

source.title: Greater Poland uprising (1918–1919)
paragraphs: The Greater Poland uprising of 1918–1919, or Wielkopolska uprising of 1918–1919 (Polish: powstanie wielkopolskie 1918–1919 roku; German: Großpolnischer Aufstand) or Poznań War was a military insurrection of Poles in the Greater Poland region (German: Grand Duchy of Posen or Provinz Posen) against German rule. The uprising had a significant effect on the Treaty of Versailles, which granted a reconstituted Second Polish Republic the area won by the Polish insurrectionists. The region had been part of the Kingdom of Poland and then Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth before the 1793 Second Partition of Poland when it was annexed by the German Kingdom of Prussia. It had also, following the 1806 Greater Poland uprising, been part of the Duchy of Warsaw (1807–1815), a French client state during the Napoleonic Wars.

Grško-italijanska vojna, imenovana tudi italijansko-grška vojna, je potekala med Italijo in Grčijo od 28. oktobra 1940 do 23. aprila 1941. S tem spopadom se je začela balkanska kampanja druge svetovne vojne med silami osi in zavezniki, ki se je sčasoma razvila v bitko za Grčijo z britansko in nemško udeležbo. Italija je 10. junija 1940 napovedala vojno Franciji in Združenemu kraljestvu. Do septembra 1940 so Italijani vdrli v Francijo, Britansko Somalijo in Egipt. Sledila je sovražna tiskovna kampanja v Italiji proti Grčiji, ki so jo obtoževali, da je britanska zaveznica. Vrsta provokacij je dosegla vrhunec, ko so Italijani 15. avgusta potopili grško lahko križarko Elli. Mussolini je 28. oktobra Grčiji postavil ultimat z zahtevo po odstopu grškega ozemlja, ki ga je grški predsednik vlade Joanis Metaksas zavrnil.

source.title: Greco-Italian War
paragraphs: The Greco-Italian War, also called the Italo-Greek War, took place between Italy and Greece from 28 October 1940 to 23 April 1941. This conflict began the Balkans campaign of World War II between the Axis powers and the Allies, and eventually turned into the Battle of Greece with British and German involvement. On 10 June 1940, Italy declared war on France and the United Kingdom. By September 1940, the Italians had invaded France, British Somaliland and Egypt. This was followed by a hostile press campaign in Italy against Greece, accused of being a British ally. A number of provocations culminated in the sinking of the Greek light cruiser Elli by the Italians on 15 August. On 28 October, Mussolini issued an ultimatum to Greece demanding the cession of Greek territory, which the Prime Minister of Greece, Ioannis Metaxas, rejected.

Grško-turška vojna leta 1897 ali osmansko-grška vojna leta 1897 je potekala med Kraljevino Grčijo in Osmanskim cesarstvom. Neposredni povod je bil status osmanske province Krete, katere pretežno grško prebivalstvo si je že dolgo želelo združitve z Grčijo. Kljub osmanski zmagi na bojišču so naslednje leto (zaradi posredovanja velesil po vojni) ustanovili avtonomno Kretsko državo pod osmansko nadoblastjo, njen prvi visoki komisar pa je postal princ Jurij Grški in Danski.

Vojna je bila za grško vojaško in politično vodstvo prva preizkušnja v uradni odprti vojni po grški osamosvojitveni vojni leta 1821. Tudi za Osmansko cesarstvo je bila to prva vojna, v kateri je preizkusilo reorganizirani vojaški sistem. Osmanska vojska je delovala pod vodstvom nemške vojaške misije, ki jo je (1883–1895) vodil Colmar Freiherr von der Goltz, ta pa je osmansko vojsko reorganiziral po porazu v rusko-turški vojni 1877–1878.

source.title: Greco-Turkish War (1897)
paragraphs: The Greco-Turkish War of 1897 or the Ottoman-Greek War of 1897 was fought between the Kingdom of Greece and the Ottoman Empire. Its immediate cause involved the status of the Ottoman province of Crete, whose Greek-majority population had long desired union with Greece. Despite the Ottoman victory on the field, an autonomous Cretan State under Ottoman suzerainty was established the following year (as a result of the intervention of the Great Powers after the war), with Prince George of Greece and Denmark as its first High Commissioner.

The war put the military and political personnel of Greece to test in an official open war for the first time since the Greek War of Independence in 1821. For the Ottoman Empire, this was also the first war-effort to test a re-organized military system. The Ottoman army operated under the guidance of a German military mission led (1883–1895) by Colmar Freiherr von der Goltz, who had reorganized the Ottoman military after its defeat in the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878.

Grška državljanska vojna je potekala od leta 1946 do 1949. Spopad, ki je izbruhnil kmalu po koncu druge svetovne vojne, je bil vstaja pod komunističnim vodstvom proti uveljavljeni vladi Kraljevine Grčije. Uporniki so razglasili ljudsko republiko, Začasno demokratično vlado Grčije, ki sta jo vodili Komunistična partija Grčije (KKE) in njena vojaška veja, Demokratična vojska Grčije (DSE). Upornike sta podpirali Albanija in Jugoslavija. Sile grške kraljeve vlade so ob podpori Združenega kraljestva in Združenih držav nazadnje zmagale.

source.title: Greek Civil War
paragraphs: The Greek Civil War took place from 1946 to 1949. The conflict, which erupted shortly after the end of World War II, consisted of a Communist-led uprising against the established government of the Kingdom of Greece. The rebels declared a people's republic, the Provisional Democratic Government of Greece, which was governed by the Communist Party of Greece (KKE) and its military branch, the Democratic Army of Greece (DSE). The rebels were supported by Albania and Yugoslavia. With the support of the United Kingdom and the United States, the Greek royal government forces ultimately prevailed.

Greek civil wars of 1823–1825.headline: Grške državljanske vojne 1823–1825
paragraphs: Grške državljanske vojne v letih 1823–1825 so potekale hkrati z grško osamosvojitveno vojno. Spopad je imel politične in regionalne razsežnosti, saj so se v njem Rumelijci s celinske Grčije in ladjarji z otokov, predvsem s Hidre, spopadli s Peloponežani ali Morejci. Razdelil je narod in resno oslabil vojaško pripravljenost grških sil pred bližajočim se egipčanskim posegom v spopad.

source.title: Greek civil wars of 1823–1825
paragraphs: The Greek civil wars of 1823–1825 occurred alongside the Greek War of Independence. The conflict had both political and regional dimensions, as it pitted the Roumeliotes, who lived in mainland Greece, and shipowners from the Islands, primarily Hydra island, against the Peloponnesians or Moreotes. It divided the nation, and seriously weakened the military preparedness of the Greek forces in the face of the oncoming Egyptian intervention in the conflict.

Grška vojaška hunta ali režim polkovnikov je bila desničarska vojaška hunta, ki je Grčiji vladala od leta 1967 do 1974. Skupina polkovnikov je 21. aprila 1967 strmoglavila začasno vlado, mesec dni pred napovedanimi volitvami, na katerih je bila favoritinja Zveza sredine Georgiosa Papandreua.

Za diktaturo so bili značilni protikomunizem, omejevanje državljanskih svoboščin ter zapiranje, mučenje in izgon političnih nasprotnikov. Od leta 1967 do 1973 ji je vladal Georgios Papadopulos. Njegov poskus, da bi z referendumom o monarhiji leta 1973 in postopno demokratizacijo znova pridobil podporo ljudstva, je končal nov državni udar zagovornika trde linije Dimitriosa Joanidisa. Joanidis je vladal, dokler hunta 24. julija 1974 pod pritiskom turške invazije na Ciper ni padla; sledila je metapolitefsi (grško: Μεταπολίτευση, dobesedno »sprememba režima«), prehod v demokracijo in ustanovitev tretje helenske republike.

source.title: Greek junta
paragraphs: The Greek junta or Regime of the Colonels was a right-wing military junta that ruled Greece from 1967 to 1974. On 21 April 1967, a group of colonels overthrew a caretaker government a month before scheduled elections which Georgios Papandreou's Centre Union was favoured to win.

The dictatorship was characterised by policies such as anti-communism, restrictions on civil liberties, and the imprisonment, torture, and exile of political opponents. It was ruled by Georgios Papadopoulos from 1967 to 1973, but an attempt to renew popular support in a 1973 referendum on the monarchy and gradual democratisation by Papadopoulos was ended by another coup by the hardliner Dimitrios Ioannidis. Ioannidis ruled until it fell on 24 July 1974 under the pressure of the Turkish invasion of Cyprus, leading to the Metapolitefsi (Greek: Μεταπολίτευση, lit. 'regime change') to democracy and the establishment of the Third Hellenic Republic.

Gruber–De Gasperi Agreement.headline: Sporazum Gruber–De Gasperi
paragraphs: Sporazum Gruber–De Gasperi je bil dvostranska pogodba, ki sta jo 5. septembra 1946 podpisala avstrijski zunanji minister Karl Gruber in italijanski predsednik vlade Alcide De Gasperi. Pogodba, priznana v mednarodnem pravu, je nemško govorečemu prebivalstvu pokrajine Južna Tirolska zagotovila pravico do avtonomije ter do ohranjanja kulturne identitete in običajev. Priznala je tudi nemščino in italijanščino kot uradna jezika.
Ljudje so dobili pravico, da se vrnejo k prvotnim nemškim imenom in priimkom, ki so se jim mnogi odpovedali med fašističnim programom prisilne asimilacije.

source.title: Gruber–De Gasperi Agreement
paragraphs: The Gruber–De Gasperi Agreement was a bilateral treaty that was signed by the foreign minister of Austria, Karl Gruber, and the prime minister of Italy, Alcide De Gasperi, on 5 September 1946. Recognized by international law, it granted the German-speaking population of the Province of South Tyrol the right to autonomy and to preserve its cultural identity and customs. It also recognized German and Italian as official languages.
People were granted the right to return to their original German given and family names, which had been abandoned by many during the Fascists' programme of forced assimilation.

Habsburška Španija, znana tudi kot katoliška monarhija, je bila obdobje španske zgodovine in Španskega imperija od leta 1516 do 1700, ko so vladali kralji iz habsburške dinastije. Španski imperij je bil tedaj na vrhuncu moči in vpliva. Španija je imela številna ozemlja, med drugim celinske posesti v Ameriki in Zahodno Indijo; evropska ozemlja, kot so Nizke dežele, italijanska ozemlja, Portugalska in deli Francije; ter Filipine in druge posesti v jugovzhodni Aziji. To obdobje španske zgodovine imenujejo tudi »doba širitve«.

Člani rodbine imena Habsburg niso vedno uporabljali, pogosto so poudarjali svoje uglednejše kneževske naslove. Dinastija je bila dolgo znana kot »avstrijska hiša«. Poimenovanje tega obdobja kot »habsburškega« je do neke mere pripomoček zgodovinarjev.

source.title: Habsburg Spain
paragraphs: Habsburg Spain, also known as the Catholic Monarchy, was the period of Spanish history and Spanish Empire from 1516 to 1700 when it was ruled by kings from the House of Habsburg. In this period the Spanish Empire was at the zenith of its power and influence. During this period, Spain held many territories, including Pan-American continental holdings and the West Indies; European territories like the Low Countries, Italian territories, Portugal and parts of France; and the Philippines and other possessions in Southeast Asia. The period of Spanish history has also been referred to as the "Age of Expansion".

The Habsburg name was not always used by the family members, who often emphasized their more prestigious princely titles. The dynasty was long known as the "House of Austria". Calling this era "Habsburg", is, to some extent, a convenience for historians.

Hamburg Uprising.headline: Hamburška vstaja
paragraphs: Hamburška vstaja (nemško: Hamburger Aufstand) je bila komunistična vstaja, ki je 23. oktobra 1923 izbruhnila v Hamburgu v weimarski Nemčiji. Bojevito krilo hamburške organizacije Komunistične partije Nemčije je vstajo sprožilo v okviru tako imenovanega nemškega oktobra. Uporniki so napadli 24 policijskih postaj, 17 v Hamburgu in sedem v pruski provinci Schleswig-Holstein, ter okoli mesta postavili barikade. Komunistična vstaja v Hamburgu je bila jalova, saj ni imela podpore v preostali Nemčiji ali v Sovjetski zvezi, in je v enem dnevu razpadla. Med hamburško vstajo je umrlo okoli 100 ljudi, natančen potek dogodkov in ocena njihovega vpliva pa sta še vedno sporna.

source.title: Hamburg Uprising
paragraphs: The Hamburg Uprising (German: Hamburger Aufstand) was a communist insurrection that occurred in Hamburg in Weimar Germany on 23 October 1923. A militant section of the Hamburg Communist Party of Germany launched an uprising as part of the so-called German October. Rebels stormed 24 police stations, 17 in Hamburg and seven in Schleswig-Holstein Province in Prussia, and established barricades around the city. The communist insurgency in Hamburg was futile, lacking support from the rest of Germany or from the Soviet Union, and disintegrated within a day. Around 100 people died during the Hamburg Uprising and the exact details of the event, as well as the assessment of its impact, remain controversial.

Opustošenje severne Anglije je bilo vrsta vojaških pohodov, ki jih je Viljem Osvajalec pozimi 1069–1070 vodil, da bi podjarmil severno Anglijo, kjer je navzočnost zadnjega wessexškega pretendenta Edgarja Æthelinga spodbudila anglosaške northumbrijske, anglo-skandinavske in danske upore. Viljem je Dancem plačal, da so odšli domov, preostali uporniki pa se niso hoteli spopasti z njim v bitki, zato se je odločil, da jih bo izstradal: s taktiko požgane zemlje je opustošil severne grofije, zlasti zgodovinsko grofijo Yorkshire in mesto York, nato pa je krajevno aristokracijo odstavil s položajev in po vsej regiji postavil normanske plemiče.

source.title: Harrying of the North
paragraphs: The Harrying of the North was a series of military campaigns waged by William the Conqueror in the winter of 1069–1070 to subjugate Northern England, where the presence of the last Wessex claimant, Edgar Ætheling, had encouraged Anglo-Saxon Northumbrian, Anglo-Scandinavian and Danish rebellions. William paid the Danes to go home, but the remaining rebels refused to meet him in battle, and he decided to starve them out by laying waste to the northern shires using scorched earth tactics, especially in the historic county of Yorkshire and the city of York, before relieving the local aristocracy of their positions, and installing Norman aristocrats throughout the region.

Heligoland–Zanzibar Treaty.headline: Helgolandsko-zanzibarska pogodba
paragraphs: Helgolandsko-zanzibarska pogodba (nemško: Helgoland-Sansibar-Vertrag), znana tudi kot angleško-nemški sporazum iz leta 1890, je bila sporazum, ki sta ga 1. julija 1890 podpisali Nemčija in Združeno kraljestvo.

Z njim je Nemčija dobila nadzor nad Caprivijevim pasom (ozkim pasom ozemlja, ki je Nemški Jugozahodni Afriki odprl dostop do reke Zambezi), strateško pomembnim otočjem Helgoland v Severnem morju in osrednjim delom Nemške Vzhodne Afrike.
