V zameno je Nemčija priznala britansko oblast nad Zanzibarjem. Helgoland je potrebovala za nadzor novega Kielskega kanala in dostopov do svojih pristanišč ob Severnem morju. Britanija je Zanzibar uporabljala kot ključni člen britanskega nadzora nad Vzhodno Afriko.

source.title: Heligoland–Zanzibar Treaty
paragraphs: The Heligoland–Zanzibar Treaty (German: Helgoland-Sansibar-Vertrag; also known as the Anglo-German Agreement of 1890) was an agreement signed on 1 July 1890 between Germany and the United Kingdom.

The accord gave Germany control of the Caprivi Strip (a ribbon of land that gave German South-West Africa access to the Zambezi River), the strategically located archipelago of Heligoland in the North Sea, and the heartland of German East Africa. In return, Germany recognized British authority in Zanzibar. Heligoland was needed to control the new Kiel Canal and the approaches to Germany's North Sea ports. Britain used Zanzibar as a key link in the British control of East Africa.

Hercegovski upor (srbsko: Херцеговачки устанак) je bil upor krščanskih Srbov proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu, ki se je začel in najbolj razmahnil v Hercegovini, od tam pa se razširil v Bosno in Raško. Izbruhnil je poleti 1875, v nekaterih krajih pa je trajal do začetka leta 1878. Sledila mu je bolgarska aprilska vstaja leta 1876, časovno pa se je ujemal s srbsko-turškima vojnama (1876–1878); vsi ti dogodki so bili del velike vzhodne krize (1875–1878).

Glavni vzrok upora je bilo kruto ravnanje namestnikov in zemljiških posestnikov s kmeti v osmanski provinci Bosni; ti so se upirali uvajanju reform sultana Abdülmecida I. Reforme, ki so določale versko svobodo in enake državljanske pravice za vse, odpravo zakupa davkov in pravično obdavčitev, so v bolj oddaljenih delih cesarstva pogosto naletele na odpor. V Bosni so tako kmete še naprej močno obdavčevali, kristjane pa zatirali.

source.title: Herzegovina uprising (1875–1877)
paragraphs: The Herzegovina uprising (Serbian: Херцеговачки устанак, romanized: Hercegovački ustanak) was an uprising led by the Christian Serb population against the Ottoman Empire, firstly and predominantly in Herzegovina, from where it spread into Bosnia and Raška. It broke out in the summer of 1875, and in some regions lasted until the beginning of 1878. It was followed by the Bulgarian April Uprising of 1876, and coincided with the Serbian-Turkish wars (1876–1878); these events were each situated within the Great Eastern Crisis (1875–1878).

The primary cause of the uprising was the harsh treatment of peasants in the Ottoman province of Bosnia by its governors and landowners, who resisted the implementation of Sultan Abdülmecid I's reforming policies. The reforms, which provided that all should have religious liberty and equal civil rights; that tax farming be abolished; and that taxes be fairly imposed, were frequently opposed in more distant parts of the empire. As such, in Bosnia, peasants continued to be heavily taxed and Christians continued to be oppressed.

Bremen je bil večji del svoje 1200-letne zgodovine samostojno mesto v konfederalni pristojnosti Svetega rimskega cesarstva. V poznem srednjem veku so bili njegovi vladajoči trgovski cehi v središču Hanze, ki je skušala monopolizirati trgovino v Severnem in Baltskem morju. Da bi vzpostavilo in potrdilo svojo neodvisnost, se je moralo mesto najprej spopasti z bremenskim knezonadškofom, nato pa s Švedi, ki so po tridesetletni vojni postali gospodarji okoliških nekdanjih škofovskih vojvodin.

Konec 19. stoletja je Prusija Bremen pritegnila v Nemško cesarstvo. Z novimi pomorskimi pomoli in sidriščem v Bremerhavnu je mesto postalo glavno nemško izseljensko pristanišče za Ameriko in posredniško središče za pozno razvito nemško kolonialno trgovino. Leta 1857 je bil v Bremnu ustanovljen Norddeutscher Lloyd (NDL), ki je pozneje postal ena vodilnih ladjarskih družb na svetu.

source.title: History of Bremen (city)
paragraphs: For most of its 1,200 year history, Bremen was an independent city within the confederal jurisdiction of the Holy Roman Empire. In the late Middle Ages, its governing merchant guilds were at the centre of the Hanseatic League, which sought to monopolise the North Sea and Baltic trade. To establish and confirm its independence, the city had to contend first with the Prince-Archbishop of Bremen, and then with the Swedes, who had become the masters of the surrounding, former episcopal, duchies after the Thirty Years' War.

In the late nineteenth century Bremen was drawn by Prussia into the German Empire. Thanks to new sea wharves and anchorage at Bremerhaven, the city became Germany's main port of emigration to the Americas, and an entrepôt for her late developing colonial trade. The Norddeutscher Lloyd (NDL) was founded in Bremen in 1857 and it later became one of the world's leading shipping companies.

Kneževina Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen (nemško: Fürstentum Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen) je bila kneževina na jugozahodu Nemčije. Njeni vladarji so pripadali mlajši švabski veji rodbine Hohenzollern. Švabski Hohenzollerni so bili leta 1623 povzdignjeni v kneze. Majhna suverena država s prestolnico Sigmaringen je bila leta 1850, po odstopu vladarja ob revolucijah leta 1848, priključena Kraljevini Prusiji in je nato postala del novoustanovljene province Hohenzollern.

source.title: Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen
paragraphs: Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen (German: Fürstentum Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen) was a principality in southwestern Germany. Its rulers belonged to the junior Swabian branch of the House of Hohenzollern. The Swabian Hohenzollerns were elevated to princes in 1623. The small sovereign state with the capital city of Sigmaringen was annexed to the Kingdom of Prussia in 1850 following the abdication of its sovereign in the wake of the revolutions of 1848, then became part of the newly created Province of Hohenzollern.

Rodbina Luxembourg (luksemburško: D'Lëtzebuerger Haus; francosko: Maison de Luxembourg; nemško: Haus Luxemburg) ali luksemburška dinastija je bila kraljeva rodbina Svetega rimskega cesarstva v poznem srednjem veku, katere člani so med letoma 1308 in 1437 vladali kot nemški kralji in cesarji Svetega rimskega cesarstva ter kot kralji Češke, Ogrske in Hrvaške. Njihovo vladavino je dvakrat prekinila tekmovalna rodbina Wittelsbach. Rodbina je ime dobila po izvorni grofiji Luksemburg, ki je po izumrtju moške linije dinastije leta 1443 prešla na Habsburžane.

source.title: House of Luxembourg
paragraphs: The House of Luxembourg (Luxembourgish: D'Lëtzebuerger Haus; French: Maison de Luxembourg; German: Haus Luxemburg) or Luxembourg dynasty was a royal family of the Holy Roman Empire in the Late Middle Ages, whose members between 1308 and 1437 ruled as kings of Germany and Holy Roman emperors as well as kings of Bohemia, Hungary and Croatia. Their rule was twice interrupted by the rival House of Wittelsbach. The family takes its name from its ancestral county of Luxembourg, which passed to the House of Habsburg in 1443 following the extinction of the dynasty's male line.

House of Schwarzburg.headline: Rodbina Schwarzburg
paragraphs: Rodbina Schwarzburg je bila ena najstarejših plemiških rodbin Turingije, ki leži v današnji osrednji Nemčiji. Ko je leta 1971 umrl knez Friedrich Günther, je zahteva po vodstvu rodbine po polsalijskem prvorojenstvu prešla na njegovo starejšo sestro, princeso Marie Antoinette Schwarzburško, poročeno s Friedrichom Magnusom V., grofom Solms-Wildenfelsa. Rodbina, ki je vladala grofiji Schwarzburg in jo je ustanovil Sizzo I. Schwarzburški (umrl 1160), se je v 16. stoletju razcepila na veji Schwarzburg-Sondershausen in Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt; sondershausenska veja je izumrla leta 1909.

source.title: House of Schwarzburg
paragraphs: The House of Schwarzburg was one of the oldest noble families of Thuringia, which is located in modern-day Central Germany. Upon the death of Prince Friedrich Günther in 1971, a claim to the headship of the house passed under Semi-Salic primogeniture to his elder sister, Princess Marie Antoinette of Schwarzburg who married Friedrich Magnus V, Count of Solms-Wildenfels. Reigning over the County of Schwarzburg and founded by Sizzo I of Schwarzburg (died 1160), the family split in the 16th century into the lines of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen and Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt, with the Sondershausen line dying out in 1909.

House of Valois-Anjou.headline: Rodbina Valois-Anjou
paragraphs: Rodbina Valois-Anjou (francosko: Maison de Valois-Anjou, italijansko: Casa Valois-Angiò) je bila francoska plemiška rodbina in stranska veja rodbine Valois. Njeni člani so vladali Vojvodini Anžu v Kraljevini Franciji in grofiji Provansi v Svetem rimskem cesarstvu, bili so tudi vladarji Kraljevine Neapelj in gospodje več drugih ozemelj.

source.title: House of Valois-Anjou
paragraphs: The House of Valois-Anjou (French: Maison de Valois-Anjou, Italian: Casa Valois-Angiò) was a noble French family and a cadet branch of the House of Valois. Members of the house served as rulers of the Duchy of Anjou in the Kingdom of France, the County of Provence in the Holy Roman Empire, and also as monarchs of the Kingdom of Naples, as well as lords of several other territories.

Ljudska republika Madžarska je bila madžarska država od 20. avgusta 1949 do ustanovitve sedanje Republike Madžarske 23. oktobra 1989. Bila je samooklicana komunistična država, ki ji je najprej vladala Madžarska delavska ljudska stranka, po madžarski revoluciji leta 1956 pa Madžarska socialistična delavska stranka. Obe vladi sta bili kot del vzhodnega bloka tesno povezani s Sovjetsko zvezo.

Država se je imela za dedinjo Madžarske sovjetske republike, ki je nastala leta 1919 kot ena prvih komunističnih držav po Ruski sovjetski federativni socialistični republiki (Ruski SFSR). Sovjetska zveza jo je v 1940. letih označila za »ljudsko demokratično republiko«. Na vzhodu je mejila na Romunijo in Sovjetsko zvezo (prek Ukrajinske SSR), na jugozahodu na Jugoslavijo (prek SR Hrvaške, Srbije in Slovenije), na severu na Češkoslovaško, na zahodu pa na Avstrijo.

source.title: Hungarian People's Republic
paragraphs: The Hungarian People's Republic was the Hungarian state from 20 August 1949 until the establishment of the current Republic of Hungary on 23 October 1989. It was a professed communist state, governed first by the Hungarian Working People's Party and after the Hungarian Revolution of 1956, the Hungarian Socialist Workers' Party. Both governments were closely tied to the Soviet Union as part of the Eastern Bloc.

The state considered itself the heir to the Hungarian Soviet Republic, which was formed in 1919 as one of the first communist states created after the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (Russian SFSR). It was designated a "people's democratic republic" by the Soviet Union in the 1940s. Geographically, it bordered Romania and the Soviet Union (via the Ukrainian SSR) to the east; Yugoslavia (via SRs Croatia, Serbia, and Slovenia) to the southwest; Czechoslovakia to the north and Austria to the west.

Madžarska revolucija leta 1848, na Madžarskem znana tudi kot madžarska revolucija in osamosvojitvena vojna 1848–1849 (madžarsko: 1848–49-es forradalom és szabadságharc), je bila ena od številnih evropskih revolucij leta 1848 in je bila tesno povezana z drugimi revolucijami leta 1848 na habsburških ozemljih. Čeprav madžarska osamosvojitvena vojna ni uspela, je eden najpomembnejših dogodkov sodobne madžarske zgodovine in temelj sodobne madžarske narodne identitete: obletnica izbruha revolucije, 15. marec, je eden od treh madžarskih državnih praznikov.

Aprila 1848 je Madžarska kot tretja država celinske Evrope (za Francijo leta 1791 in Belgijo leta 1831) sprejela zakon o demokratičnih parlamentarnih volitvah. Novi volilni zakon (zakon V iz leta 1848) je stari fevdalni parlament (stanovski zbor) preoblikoval v demokratični predstavniški parlament. Zakon je dajal najširšo volilno pravico v tedanji Evropi. Aprilski zakoni so popolnoma odpravili vse privilegije madžarskega plemstva.

source.title: Hungarian Revolution of 1848
paragraphs: The Hungarian Revolution of 1848, also known in Hungary as Hungarian Revolution and War of Independence of 1848–1849 (Hungarian: 1848–49-es forradalom és szabadságharc) was one of a number of European Revolutions of 1848 and was closely linked to other revolutions of 1848 in the Habsburg areas. Although the Hungarian War of Independence failed, it is one of the most significant events in Hungary's modern history, forming the cornerstone of modern Hungarian national identity—the anniversary of the Revolution's outbreak, 15 March, is one of Hungary's three national holidays.

In April 1848, Hungary became the third country of Continental Europe (after France, in 1791, and Belgium, in 1831) to enact a law implementing democratic parliamentary elections. The new suffrage law (Act V of 1848) transformed the old feudal parliament (Estates General) into a democratic representative parliament. This law offered the widest right to vote in Europe at the time. The April laws utterly erased all privileges of the Hungarian nobility.

Madžarsko-romunska vojna (madžarsko: magyar–román háború; romunsko: războiul româno-ungar) je potekala med Madžarsko in Romunijo od 13. novembra 1918 do 3. avgusta 1919. Spopad je imel zapleteno ozadje, udeleženci pa so imeli pogosto nasprotujoče si motive.

V primerjavi z obsežnimi mobilizacijami prve svetovne vojne sta obe strani postavili izjemno majhni vojski, delež smrtnih žrtev pa je bil ves čas bojev izredno nizek: celotna devetmesečna kampanja je Romune stala le 3.670 padlih, madžarske izgube v padlih pa na splošno ocenjujejo na 2.000 do 6.000 vojakov.
notes: The English sentence on losses is garbled ("During the entire nine-month campaign cost the Romanians …"); the Slovenian gives its evident meaning.

source.title: Hungarian–Romanian War
paragraphs: The Hungarian–Romanian War (Hungarian: magyar–román háború; Romanian: războiul româno-ungar) was fought between Hungary and Romania from 13 November 1918 to 3 August 1919. The conflict had a complex background, with often contradictory motivations for the parties involved.

Compared with the vast mobilizations of the First World War, both sides fielded remarkably small armies, and the proportion of deaths remained extraordinarily low throughout the fighting: During the entire nine-month campaign cost the Romanians just 3,670 killed, meanwhile Hungarian KIA is widely estimated between 2.000 to 6.000 soldiers.

Hwicce.headline: Hwicce
paragraphs: Hwicce je bilo kraljestvo v anglosaški Angliji. Po Anglosaški kroniki je bilo ustanovljeno leta 577, po bitki pri Deorhamu. Po letu 628 je zaradi bitke pri Cirencestru postalo odvisno kraljestvo ali podkraljestvo Mercie.
V popisu Tribal Hidage je bilo Hwicce ocenjeno na 7000 hid, kar ustreza kmetijskemu gospodarstvu kraljestva Essex ali Sussex.

Natančne meje kraljestva niso znane, verjetno pa so se ujemale z mejami stare škofije Worcester, ustanovljene v letih 679–680, katere zgodnji škofje so nosili naslov Episcopus Hwicciorum. Kraljestvo bi torej obsegalo Worcestershire brez severozahodnega roba, Gloucestershire brez gozda Dean, jugozahodno polovico Warwickshira, okolico Batha severno od reke Avon, del zahodnega Oxfordshira ter majhne dele Herefordshira, Shropshira, Staffordshira in severozahodnega Wiltshira.
notes: The Old English pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Hwicce
paragraphs: Hwicce (Old English: [ˈʍittʃe]) was a kingdom in Anglo-Saxon England. According to the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle, the kingdom was established in 577, after the Battle of Deorham. After 628, the kingdom became a client or sub-kingdom of Mercia as a result of the Battle of Cirencester.
The Tribal Hidage assessed Hwicce at 7,000 hides, an agricultural economy akin to either the kingdom of Essex or Sussex.

The exact boundaries of the kingdom remain uncertain, though it is likely that they coincided with those of the old Diocese of Worcester, founded in 679–680, the early bishops of which bore the title Episcopus Hwicciorum. The kingdom would therefore have included Worcestershire except the northwestern tip, Gloucestershire except the Forest of Dean, the southwestern half of Warwickshire, the neighbourhood of Bath north of the Avon, part of west Oxfordshire and small parts of Herefordshire, Shropshire, Staffordshire and north-west Wiltshire.

Ilirsko kraljestvo je bilo ilirska politična tvorba, ki je v antiki obstajala v zahodnem delu Balkanskega polotoka. Ne glede na število dinastij, ki so se izmenjevale na oblasti, na njihovo plemensko pripadnost in na dejanski obseg kraljestva je šlo za zavezništvo ilirskih plemen, združenih pod oblastjo enega vladarja, ki ga antični zgodovinski viri (v stari grščini ali latinščini) izrecno imenujejo »kralj Ilirov«. Monarhična nadgradnja ilirske države je obstajala hkrati z ilirskimi plemenskimi skupnostmi in republikansko ureditvijo ilirskih koinonov.

source.title: Illyrian kingdom
paragraphs: The Illyrian kingdom was an Illyrian political entity that existed on the western part of the Balkan Peninsula in ancient times. Regardless of the number of the alternately ruling dynasties, of their tribal affiliation, and of the actual extension of their kingdom, it represented an alliance of Illyrian tribes that united under the rulership of a single leader, expressly referred to as "King of the Illyrians" in ancient historical records (whether in Ancient Greek or in Latin). The monarchic superstructure of the Illyrian state coexisted with the Illyrian tribal communities and the republican system of the Illyrian koina.

Ingrijska vojna (švedsko: Ingermanländska kriget) je bila spopad med Švedskim imperijem in Ruskim carstvom, ki je trajal od leta 1610 do 1617. Šteje se za del ruske dobe velikih nemirov, v spominu pa je ostala predvsem po poskusu, da bi na ruski prestol posadili švedskega vojvodo. Končala se je z mirom v Stolbovu, s katerim je Švedska pridobila veliko ozemlja (tudi Ingrijo), kar je postavilo pomemben temelj za švedsko obdobje velesile.

source.title: Ingrian War
paragraphs: The Ingrian War (Swedish: Ingermanländska kriget) was a conflict fought between the Swedish Empire and the Tsardom of Russia which lasted between 1610 and 1617. It can be seen as part of Russia's Time of Troubles, and is mainly remembered for the attempt to put a Swedish duke on the Russian throne. It ended with a large Swedish territorial gain (including Ingria) in the Treaty of Stolbovo, which laid an important foundation to Sweden's Age of Greatness.

Vojna v Ingušetiji (rusko: Война в Ингушетии) se je začela leta 2007, ko se je tedanji separatistični spopad v Čečeniji razširil v sosednjo Ingušetijo. Krajevni borci za človekove pravice in opozicijski politiki so spopad opisovali kot državljansko vojno, drugi pa kot vstajo. Do sredine leta 2009 je Ingušetija Čečenijo prehitela kot najbolj nasilna severnokavkaška republika. Do leta 2015 je upor v republiki močno oslabel, število žrtev pa se je v vmesnih letih precej zmanjšalo.

source.title: Insurgency in Ingushetia
paragraphs: The Insurgency in Ingushetia (Russian: Война в Ингушетии, romanized: Voyna v Ingushetii) began in 2007 as a spillover of then ongoing separatist conflict in Chechnya into neighbouring Ingushetia. The conflict has been described as a civil war by local human rights activists and opposition politicians; others have referred to it as an uprising. By mid-2009 Ingushetia had surpassed Chechnya as the most violent of the North Caucasus republics. However, by 2015 the insurgency in the Republic had greatly weakened, and the casualty toll declined substantially in the intervening years.

Mednarodna konvencija o varstvu rastlin (IPPC) je večstranska pogodba iz leta 1951 pod nadzorom Organizacije Združenih narodov za prehrano in kmetijstvo, katere cilj je zagotoviti usklajeno, učinkovito ukrepanje za preprečevanje in obvladovanje vnosa in širjenja škodljivcev rastlin in rastlinskih proizvodov. Konvencija ne zajema le varstva gojenih rastlin, temveč tudi varstvo naravne flore in rastlinskih proizvodov. Upošteva tudi neposredno in posredno škodo, ki jo povzročajo škodljivci, zato zajema tudi plevele. IPPC izdaja mednarodne standarde za fitosanitarne ukrepe (ISPM).

source.title: International Plant Protection Convention
paragraphs: The International Plant Protection Convention (IPPC) is a 1951 multilateral treaty overseen by the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization that aims to secure coordinated, effective action to prevent and to control the introduction and spread of pests of plants and plant products. The Convention extends beyond the protection of cultivated plants to the protection of natural flora and plant products. It also takes into consideration both direct and indirect damage by pests, so it includes weeds. IPPC promulgates International Standards for Phytosanitary Measures (ISPMs).

Invasion of Corsica (1553).headline: Invazija na Korziko (1553)
paragraphs: Invazija na Korziko leta 1553 je bila skupni pohod francoskih, osmanskih in korziških izgnanskih sil, ki so Genovski republiki odvzele otok Korziko.
Otok je imel v zahodnem Sredozemlju precejšen strateški pomen, saj je ležal v središču habsburškega omrežja povezav in je bil obvezen postanek za majhne ladje, ki so plule med Španijo in Italijo.
Otok je od leta 1453 upravljala genovska Banka svetega Jurija. Invazijo na Korziko so izvedli v korist Francije.

source.title: Invasion of Corsica (1553)
paragraphs: The Invasion of Corsica of 1553 occurred when French, Ottoman, and Corsican exile forces combined to capture the island of Corsica from the Republic of Genoa.

The island had considerable strategic importance in the western Mediterranean, being at the heart of the Habsburg communication network and serving as a forced stopover for small boats sailing between Spain and Italy.
The island had been administered since 1453 by the Genoese Bank of Saint George. The invasion of Corsica was accomplished for the benefit of France.

Invasion of Gozo (1551).headline: Napad na Gozo leta 1551
paragraphs: Napad na Gozo, imenovan tudi obleganje Goza (malteško: L-Assedju t'Għawdex), je bil osmanski vdor na otok Gozo, tedaj del hospitalske Malte, julija 1551. Napad so vodili Sinan paša, Dragut, Kambil beg in Salah Rais; zdi se, da so ga sprožili kot maščevanje za zavzetje Mahdije, ki so jo leto prej zavzeli Španci in hospitalci.

Osmanske sile so na kratko napadle Sicilijo, nato pa 18. julija pristale na glavnem otoku Malta, kjer so za kratek čas oblegale mesto Mdina in oplenile nekaj vasi. Nato so Malto zapustile in pristale na bližnjem Gozu, kjer so dva dni obstreljevale Castello, preden se je njegova posadka 26. julija vdala. Trdnjavo so izropali, med 5000 in 7000 ljudi – večino prebivalstva otoka – pa so zasužnjili in odpeljali v Severno Afriko ali Carigrad. Ista osmanska sila je nato 14. avgusta 1551 hospitalcem zavzela Tripoli.

source.title: Invasion of Gozo (1551)
paragraphs: The invasion of Gozo, also known as the siege of Gozo (Maltese: L-Assedju t'Għawdex), was an Ottoman invasion of the island of Gozo, then part of Hospitaller Malta, in July 1551. The attack, which was led by Sinan Pasha, Dragut, Kambil Bey and Salah Rais, appears to have been launched in retaliation for the capture of Mahdia by the Spanish and Hospitallers the previous year.

The Ottoman force briefly attacked Sicily before landing on the main island of Malta on 18 July, where the city of Mdina was briefly besieged and some villages were plundered. They then abandoned Malta and landed on nearby Gozo, where the Castello was bombarded for two days before its garrison capitulated on 26 July. The fortress was sacked and between 5,000 and 7,000 people – the majority of the island's population – were enslaved and taken to North Africa or Constantinople. The same Ottoman force went on to capture Tripoli from the Hospitallers on 14 August 1551.

Invasion of Portugal (1807).headline: Invazija na Portugalsko (1807)
paragraphs: Francoske in španske sile so od 19. do 30. novembra 1807 med napoleonskimi vojnami vdrle na Portugalsko, s čimer se je začela polotoška vojna. Francosko-špansko invazijsko vojsko je vodil general Jean-Andoche Junot, Portugalci pa so bili pod formalnim poveljstvom princa regenta Ivana, poznejšega portugalskega kralja Ivana VI. Francoske in španske enote so državo hitro zasedle, saj so zaradi slabega stanja portugalske vojske naletele na malo odpora.

source.title: Invasion of Portugal (1807)
paragraphs: French and Spanish forces invaded Portugal from 19–30 November 1807 during the Napoleonic Wars, sparking the Peninsular War. The Franco-Spanish invasion force was led by General Jean-Andoche Junot, while the Portuguese were under the nominal command of Prince Regent John, the future King John VI of Portugal. French and Spanish troops swiftly occupied the country in the face of little resistance due to the poor state of the Portuguese military.

Irska državljanska vojna (irsko: Cogadh Cathartha na hÉireann; 28. junija 1922 – 24. maja 1923) je bila spopad, ki je sledil irski osamosvojitveni vojni in spremljal ustanovitev Irske svobodne države, tvorbe, neodvisne od Združenega kraljestva, a znotraj Britanskega imperija.

V državljanski vojni sta se zaradi anglo-irske pogodbe spopadli začasna vlada Irske in IRA, ki je pogodbi nasprotovala. Začasna vlada (ki je decembra 1922 postala Svobodna država) je podpirala pogoje pogodbe, opozicija, nasprotna pogodbi, pa jo je imela za izdajo Irske republike, razglašene med velikonočno vstajo leta 1916. Mnogi borci so se med osamosvojitveno vojno skupaj bojevali proti Britancem v Irski republikanski armadi, po koncu tega spopada in začetku pogajanj o pogodbi pa so se razšli.

source.title: Irish Civil War
paragraphs: The Irish Civil War (Irish: Cogadh Cathartha na hÉireann; 28 June 1922 – 24 May 1923) was a conflict that followed the Irish War of Independence and accompanied the establishment of the Irish Free State, an entity independent from the United Kingdom but within the British Empire.

The civil war was waged between the Provisional Government of Ireland and the Anti-Treaty IRA over the Anglo-Irish Treaty. The Provisional Government (which became the Free State in December 1922) supported the terms of the treaty, while the anti-Treaty opposition saw it as a betrayal of the Irish Republic proclaimed during the Easter Rising of 1916. Many of the combatants had fought together against the British in the Irish Republican Army during the War of Independence and had divided after that conflict ended and the treaty negotiations began.

Irske konfederacijske vojne so potekale od leta 1641 do 1653. Spopad se je začel z irskim uporom leta 1641 in prerasel v dolgotrajen boj za prihodnost Irske, v katerem so irske sile skušale braniti svojo zemljo, politične pravice in avtonomijo pred tujim nadzorom, politiko kolonizacije (plantations) in nenehnimi posegi v irsko samoupravo. Čeprav je bila vojna na Irskem povezana s širšimi vojnami treh kraljestev, je imela svoje vzroke in cilje, ki so izhajali iz odpora proti angleški oblasti, vračanja zaplenjene zemlje in obrambe irskih interesov. V spopadu je po ocenah umrlo 200.000 ljudi zaradi bojev ter lakote in bolezni, povezanih z vojno.

source.title: Irish Confederate Wars
paragraphs: The Irish Confederate Wars took place from 1641 to 1653. The conflict began with the Irish rising of 1641 and evolved into a prolonged struggle over Ireland's future, as Irish forces sought to defend their land, political rights and autonomy against foreign control, plantation policies and continued encroachment on Irish self-government. Although linked to the wider Wars of the Three Kingdoms, the war in Ireland had its own distinct causes and objectives rooted in resistance to English rule, the recovery of confiscated lands and the defence of Irish interests. The conflict caused an estimated 200,000 deaths from fighting, as well as war-related famine and disease.

Irska svobodna država (6. decembra 1922 – 29. decembra 1937), znana tudi z irskim imenom Saorstát Éireann, je bila irska država, ustanovljena decembra 1922 na podlagi angleško-irske pogodbe iz decembra 1921, sprva kot dominion. Pogodba je končala triletno irsko osamosvojitveno vojno med silami Irske republike, Irsko republikansko armado (IRA), in silami britanske krone.

source.title: Irish Free State
paragraphs: The Irish Free State (6 December 1922 – 29 December 1937), also known by its Irish name Saorstát Éireann, was the Irish state established in December 1922 under the Anglo-Irish Treaty of December 1921, initially as a Dominion. The treaty ended the three-year Irish War of Independence between the forces of the Irish Republic—the Irish Republican Army (IRA)—and British Crown forces.

Irish Rebellion of 1641.headline: Irski upor leta 1641
paragraphs: Irski upor leta 1641 se je začel 23. oktobra 1641. Sprožili so ga irsko zemljiško plemstvo in vojaški častniki, njegov cilj pa je bil končati angleško prevlado nad Irsko, vrniti zemljo, zaplenjeno s kolonizacijo Irske, in zagotoviti irski nadzor nad vlado in zadevami države. Načrtovan je bil kot hiter državni udar za prevzem osrednje vlade, v kateri so prevladovali protestanti, namesto tega pa je prerasel v irske konfederacijske vojne v letih 1641–1653, del širših vojn treh kraljestev.

Uporniki pod Felimom O'Neillom dublinskega gradu sicer niso zavzeli, a so hitro preplavili večino Ulstra, središča najnovejših zaplemb zemlje. O'Neill je nato izdal razglas iz Dungannona, ponaredek, v katerem je trdil, da ga je angleški kralj Karel I. pooblastil, naj zavaruje Irsko pred njegovimi nasprotniki v Angliji in na Škotskem. Številni rojalistični anglo-irski katoličani so se nato pridružili vstaji in upor se je razširil po vsej Irski.

source.title: Irish Rebellion of 1641
paragraphs: The Irish Rebellion of 1641 began on 23 October 1641. Initiated by Irish gentry and military officers, the rebellion sought to end English domination of Ireland, restore lands confiscated through the plantations of Ireland, and secure Irish control over the country's government and affairs. Planned as a swift coup d'état to gain control of the Protestant-dominated central government, it instead developed into the 1641–1653 Irish Confederate Wars, part of the wider Wars of the Three Kingdoms.

Despite failing to seize Dublin Castle, rebels under Felim O'Neill quickly over-ran most of Ulster, centre of the most recent land confiscations. O'Neill then issued the Proclamation of Dungannon, a forgery claiming he had been authorised by Charles I of England to secure Ireland against his opponents in England and Scotland. Many Royalist Anglo-Irish Catholics responded by joining the uprising, and the rebellion spread throughout Ireland.

Irski upor leta 1798 (irsko: Éirí Amach 1798; ulstrsko škotsko: »The Turn Out«/»The Hurries«) je bil ljudska vstaja proti britanski kroni v tedanji ločeni, a podrejeni Kraljevini Irski. Glavna organizacijska sila je bilo Društvo združenih Ircev. Društvo, ki so ga v Belfastu prvi ustanovili prezbiterijanci, nasprotniki anglikanske zemljiške elite, je obupalo nad reformami in si prizadevalo za republiko z revolucionarno zvezo s katoliško večino v državi. Pristope so spodbujale pritožbe najemnikov z oderuškimi najemninami ter trgovcev v trških mestih, pomočnikov in tkalcev.

Medtem ko so iskali pomoč pri Francoski republiki in demokratičnih borcih v Britaniji, so zasegi in aretacije na podlagi vojnega stanja zarotnike prisilili, da so stopili na plano. Od konca maja 1798 je izbruhnila vrsta neusklajenih vstaj: v grofijah Carlow in Wexford na jugovzhodu, kjer so bili uporniki deloma uspešni; na severu okoli Belfasta v grofijah Antrim in Down; ter bližje prestolnici Dublinu v grofijah Meath in Kildare.

source.title: Irish Rebellion of 1798
paragraphs: The Irish Rebellion of 1798 (Irish: Éirí Amach 1798; Ulster Scots: "The Turn Out"/"The Hurries") was a popular insurrection against the British Crown in what was then the separate, but subordinate, Kingdom of Ireland. The main organising force was the Society of United Irishmen. First formed in Belfast by Presbyterians opposed to the landed Anglican establishment, the Society, despairing of reform, sought to secure a republic through a revolutionary union with the country's Catholic majority. The grievances of a rack-rented tenantry, and of market-town traders, journeymen and weavers drove recruitment.

While assistance was being sought from the French Republic and from democratic militants in Britain, martial-law seizures and arrests forced the conspirators into the open. Beginning in late May 1798, there were a series of uncoordinated risings: in the counties of Carlow and Wexford in the southeast where the rebels met with some success; in the north around Belfast in counties Antrim and Down; and closer to the capital, Dublin, in counties Meath and Kildare.

Irska vojna za neodvisnost (irsko: Cogadh na Saoirse), znana tudi kot angleško-irska vojna ali Tan War, je bila gverilska vojna, ki je od leta 1919 do 1921 potekala na Irskem med Irsko republikansko armado (IRA, vojsko Irske republike) in britanskimi silami: britansko vojsko, napolvojaškim Kraljevim irskim orožništvom (RIC) z njegovimi paravojaškimi pomožnimi enotami (Auxiliaries) in Ulstrskim posebnim orožništvom (USC). Bila je del irskega revolucionarnega obdobja.

source.title: Irish War of Independence
paragraphs: The Irish War of Independence (Irish: Cogadh na Saoirse), also known as the Anglo-Irish War or the Tan War, was a guerrilla war fought in Ireland from 1919 to 1921 between the Irish Republican Army (IRA, the army of the Irish Republic) and British forces: the British Army, along with the quasi-military Royal Irish Constabulary (RIC) and its paramilitary forces the Auxiliaries and Ulster Special Constabulary (USC). It was part of the Irish revolutionary period.

Italijanska kampanja 1796–1797 (italijansko: Campagna d'Italia), znana tudi kot prva italijanska kampanja, je bila vrsta vojaških operacij v Italiji med vojno prve koalicije. Pod vodstvom Napoleona Bonaparta se je italijanska armada Prve francoske republike spopadla z vojskami Kraljevine Sardinije, habsburške monarhije in Papeške države ter z različnimi upori, zlasti v Beneški republiki, in jih premagala.

source.title: Italian campaign of 1796–1797
paragraphs: The Italian campaign of 1796–1797 (Italian: Campagna d'Italia), also known as the First Italian Campaign, was a series of military operations in Italy during the War of the First Coalition. Led by Napoleon Bonaparte, the First French Republic's Army of Italy fought and defeated the armies of the Kingdom of Sardinia, the Habsburg monarchy, and the Papal States, as well as various revolts, notably in the Republic of Venice.

Italian campaigns of the French Revoluti.headline: Italijanske kampanje francoskih revolucionarnih vojn
paragraphs: Italijanske kampanje francoskih revolucionarnih vojn (1792–1801) so bile niz spopadov, ki so se bojevali predvsem v severni Italiji med francosko revolucionarno vojsko in koalicijo Avstrije, Rusije, Piemont-Sardinije in številnih drugih italijanskih držav.
Kampanja 1796–1797 je k slavi povzdignila Napoleona Bonaparta, mladega, večinoma neznanega poveljnika, ki je francoske sile popeljal do zmage nad številčno močnejšima avstrijsko in sardinsko vojsko.

source.title: Italian campaigns of the French Revolutionary Wars
paragraphs: The Italian campaigns of the French Revolutionary Wars (1792–1801) were a series of conflicts fought principally in Northern Italy between the French Revolutionary Army and a Coalition of Austria, Russia, Piedmont-Sardinia, and a number of other Italian states.
The campaign of 1796-1797 brought prominence to Napoleon Bonaparte, a young, largely unknown commander, who led French forces to victory over numerically superior Austrian and Sardinian armies.

Italian invasion of Albania.headline: Italijanska invazija na Albanijo
paragraphs: Italijanska invazija na Albanijo je bila kratka vojaška kampanja, ki jo je Italija leta 1939 začela proti Albaniji. Spopad je bil posledica imperialistične politike italijanskega predsednika vlade in diktatorja Benita Mussolinija. Albanijo so hitro zasedli, njen vladar kralj Zog I. je odšel v izgnanstvo v sosednjo Kraljevino Grčijo, država pa je postala del Italijanskega imperija kot protektorat v personalni uniji z italijansko krono.

source.title: Italian invasion of Albania
paragraphs: The Italian invasion of Albania was a brief military campaign which was launched by Italy against Albania in 1939. The conflict was a result of the imperialistic policies of the Italian prime minister and dictator Benito Mussolini. Albania was rapidly occupied, its ruler King Zog I went into exile in the neighboring Kingdom of Greece, and the country was made a part of the Italian Empire as a protectorate in personal union with the Italian Crown.

Italian Wars of 1499–1504.headline: Italijanske vojne 1499–1504
paragraphs: Italijanske vojne 1499–1504 so razdeljene na dve povezani, a ločeni fazi: drugo italijansko vojno (1499–1501), ki jo včasih imenujejo tudi italijanska vojna Ludvika XII., in tretjo italijansko vojno (1502–1504) ali vojno za Neapelj. Prva faza se je bojevala za nadzor nad Milansko vojvodino med zavezništvom Ludvika XII. Francoskega in Beneške republike ter Ludovicom Sforzo, druga med Ludvikom in Ferdinandom II. Aragonskim za posest Neapeljskega kraljestva.

Po italijanski vojni 1494–1498 je bil Ludvik odločen uveljaviti francoske zahtevke po Milanu in Neaplju, oktobra 1499 pa je zavzel Milan, ki je ostal v francoskih rokah naslednjih trinajst let. Njegov vdor v Neapelj leta 1501 je sčasoma privedel do vojne s Ferdinandom Aragonskim, ki je Francoze leta 1504 pregnal.

source.title: Italian Wars of 1499–1504
paragraphs: The Italian Wars of 1499–1504 are divided into two connected, but distinct, phases: the Second Italian War (1499–1501), sometimes known as Louis XII's Italian War, and the Third Italian War (1502–1504) or War over Naples. The first phase was fought for control of the Duchy of Milan by an alliance of Louis XII of France and the Republic of Venice against Ludovico Sforza, the second between Louis and Ferdinand II of Aragon for possession of the Kingdom of Naples.

In the aftermath of the Italian War of 1494–1498, Louis was determined to pursue French claims to Milan and Naples and in October 1499 he captured Milan, which remained in French hands for the next thirteen years. His invasion of Naples in 1501 eventually led to war with Ferdinand of Aragon, who expelled the French in 1504.

Jakobitska vstaja leta 1745 je bila poskus, da bi izgnani rodbini Stuart znova pridobili britanski prestol. Bila je zadnja v vrsti jakobitskih vstaj, ki so se začele marca 1689, in je pomenila konec jakobitstva kot pomembnega dejavnika v britanski politiki.

Vstajo je formalno sprožil Charles Edward Stuart 19. avgusta 1745 v Glenfinnanu v Škotskem višavju, uporniki pa so septembra zavzeli Edinburg in zmagali v bitki pri Prestonpansu. V začetku novembra je pretežno škotska jakobitska vojska vdrla v Anglijo v pričakovanju, da se ji bodo pridružili angleški somišljeniki in da se bodo na jugu Anglije izkrcali Francozi. Do tega ni prišlo, in ko so 4. decembra prišli do Derbyja, so voditelji glasovali za umik.

Čeprav je odločitev podpirala velika večina Škotov v Charlesovi vojski, je povzročila nepopravljiv razkol v jakobitskem vrhovnem poveljstvu. Jakobiti so januarja 1746 sicer tesno zmagali pri Falkirk Muirju, a je poraz pri Cullodnu aprila upor končal. Charles je pobegnil v Francijo, a ni dobil podpore za nov poskus; umrl je leta 1788 v Rimu.

source.title: Jacobite rising of 1745
paragraphs: The Jacobite rising of 1745 was an attempt to regain the British throne for the exiled House of Stuart. The last in a series of Jacobite risings that began in March 1689, it proved to be the end of Jacobitism as a major factor in British politics.

The uprising was formally launched by Charles Edward Stuart on 19 August 1745 at Glenfinnan in the Scottish Highlands, with the rebels capturing Edinburgh and winning the Battle of Prestonpans in September. In early November, the largely Scottish Jacobite army invaded England, expecting to be joined by English sympathisers and a French landing in Southern England. This failed to materialise, and after reaching Derby on 4 December, their leaders voted in favour of retreat.

Although supported by the vast majority of the Scots who formed Charles' army, the decision caused an irretrievable split within the Jacobite senior command. Despite winning a narrow victory at Falkirk Muir in January 1746, defeat at Culloden in April ended the rebellion. Charles escaped to France, but was unable to win support for another attempt, and died in Rome in 1788.

Pogodba o prijateljstvu, trgovini in plovbi med njegovim britanskim veličanstvom in Združenimi državami Amerike, splošno znana kot Jayeva pogodba, je bila pogodba med Združenimi državami in Veliko Britanijo iz leta 1794, ki je preprečila vojno, razrešila vprašanja, odprta od pariške pogodbe iz leta 1783 (s katero se je končala ameriška vojna za neodvisnost), in omogočila deset let mirne trgovine med Američani in Britanci sredi francoskih revolucionarnih vojn, ki so se začele leta 1792. Na ameriški strani je politiko pogodbe oblikoval finančni minister Alexander Hamilton s podporo predsednika Georgea Washingtona. Pogodba je razjezila Francijo in ostro razdelila ameriško javno mnenje, s čimer je spodbudila razvoj dveh nasprotnih ameriških političnih strank, federalistov, ki so pogodbo podpirali, in demokratskih republikancev, ki so ji nasprotovali.

source.title: Jay Treaty
paragraphs: The Treaty of Amity, Commerce, and Navigation, Between His Britannic Majesty and the United States of America, commonly known as the Jay Treaty, and also as Jay's Treaty, was a 1794 treaty between the United States and Great Britain that averted war, resolved issues remaining since the 1783 Treaty of Paris (which ended the American Revolutionary War), and facilitated ten years of peaceful trade between Americans and the British in the midst of the French Revolutionary Wars, which had begun in 1792. For the Americans, the treaty's policy was designed by Treasury secretary Alexander Hamilton, supported by President George Washington. It angered France and bitterly divided American public opinion, encouraging the growth of two opposing American political parties, the pro-Treaty Federalists and the anti-Treaty Democratic-Republicans.

Judicate of Arborea.headline: Judikat Arborea
paragraphs: Judikat Arborea (sardinsko: Judicadu de Arbaree; italijansko: Giudicato di Arborea; latinsko: Iudicatus Arborensis) ali Kraljevina Arborea (sardinsko: Rennu de Arbaree; italijansko: Regno di Arborea; latinsko: Regnum Arborensis) je bil eden od štirih neodvisnih judikatov, na katere je bil v srednjem veku razdeljen otok Sardinija. Zajemal je srednji zahodni del otoka, ukleščen med Logudoro na severu in vzhodu, Cagliari na jugu in vzhodu ter Sredozemskim morjem na zahodu. Severovzhodno od Logudora je ležala Gallura, s katero je imela Arborea precej manj stikov. Arborea je preživela svoje sosede in obstajala še globoko v 15. stoletje. Ob največjem ozemeljskem obsegu je zajemala ves otok razen mest Alghero in Cagliari. Najstarejši znani sodni sedež je bil Tharros, čeprav je bil večino obstoja prestolnica Oristano.

source.title: Judicate of Arborea
paragraphs: The Judicate of Arborea (Sardinian: Judicadu de Arbaree; Italian: Giudicato di Arborea; Latin: Iudicatus Arborensis) or the Kingdom of Arborea (Sardinian: Rennu de Arbaree; Italian: Regno di Arborea; Latin: Regnum Arborensis) was one of the four independent judicates into which the island of Sardinia was divided in the Middle Ages. It occupied the central-west portion of the island, wedged between Logudoro to the north and east, Cagliari to the south and east, and the Mediterranean Sea to the west. To the northeast of Logudoro was Gallura, with which Arborea had far less interaction. Arborea outlasted her neighbours, surviving well into the 15th century. At its greatest territorial extent it occupied the entire island except the cities of Alghero and Cagliari. The earliest known judicial seat was Tharros, though Oristano served as capital for most of its existence.

Judicate of Cagliari.headline: Judikat Cagliari
paragraphs: Judikat Cagliari (sardinsko: Judicadu de Càralis / Càlaris, italijansko: Giudicato di Cagliari) je bil eno od štirih kraljestev ali judikatov (iudicati, dobesedno »sodništvo«), na katere je bila Sardinija razdeljena v srednjem veku.

Judikat Cagliari je zajemal ves južni del otoka in je bil sestavljen iz trinajstih okrajev, imenovanih curatoriae. Na severozahodu je mejil na judikat Arborea, na severovzhodu pa na judikata Logudoro in Gallura.

source.title: Judicate of Cagliari
paragraphs: The Judicate of Cagliari (Sardinian: Judicadu de Càralis / Càlaris, Italian: Giudicato di Cagliari) was one of the four kingdoms or judicates (iudicati, literally "judgeship") into which Sardinia was divided during the Middle Ages.

The Judicate of Cagliari occupied the entire southern portion of the island and was composed of thirteen subdivisions called curatoriae. It bordered the judicates of Arborea to the northwest and Logudoro and Gallura to the northeast.

Judicate of Gallura.headline: Judikat Gallura
paragraphs: Judikat Gallura (latinsko: Iudicatus Gallurae, sardinsko: Judicadu de Gallura, italijansko: Giudicato di Gallura) je bil eden od štirih sardinskih judikatov v srednjem veku. To so bile neodvisne države, katerih vladarji so nosili naziv iudex, sodnik. Gallura, katere ime izhaja iz latinske besede gallus, kar pomeni petelin, je bila razdeljena na deset curatoriae, ki so jih pod sodnikom upravljali curatores. V 13. stoletju je bil v grbu Gallure petelin.

Gallura zajema severovzhodni del otoka z glavnim mestom Olbia. Prvi iudices Gallure se v zgodovinskih virih pojavijo šele konec enajstega stoletja, čeprav so znani nekateri vladarji iz zgodnejših obdobij. Gallura je tako kot vsa druga sardinska kraljestva sprva dolgovala zvestobo pisanski nadškofiji, vendar je za razliko od večine drugih razmeroma stanovitno podpirala Piso, verjetno zaradi bližine samega mesta Pisa. Zato je bila pogosto v zavezništvu s kraljestvom Cagliari na jugu.

source.title: Judicate of Gallura
paragraphs: The Judicate of Gallura (Latin: Iudicatus Gallurae, Sardinian: Judicadu de Gallura, Italian: Giudicato di Gallura) was one of four Sardinian judicates in the Middle Ages. These were independent states whose rulers bore the title iudex, judge. Gallura, a name which comes from gallus, meaning rooster (cock), was subdivided into ten curatoriae governed by curatores under the judge. In the 13th century, the arms of Gallura contained a rooster.

Gallura encompasses the northeast region of the island, with its main city at Olbia. The first iudices of Gallura only appear in the historical record late in the eleventh century, though certain rulers of earlier periods are known. Gallura, like all the other Sardinian kingdoms, initially owed allegiance to the Archdiocese of Pisa, but unlike most of the others it remained relatively steadfast in its support of Pisa, probably due to its proximity to the city of Pisa itself. For this reason, it was often in alliance with the Kingdom of Cagliari in the south.

Judicate of Logudoro.headline: Judikat Logudoro
paragraphs: Judikat Logudoro ali Torres (sardinsko: Judicadu de Logudoro ali Torres, Rennu de Logudoro ali Logu de Torres) je bil eno od štirih kraljestev ali iudicati, na katere je bila Sardinija razdeljena v srednjem veku. Od 11. do 13. stoletja je zajemal severozahodni del otoka in mejil na judikate Gallura na vzhodu, Arborea na jugu in Cagliari na jugovzhodu. Prvotna prestolnica je bila Porto Torres. Pokrajina se še danes imenuje Logudoro.
Logudoro je bil največji in najstarejši od judikatov, a tudi drugi, ki ga je podjarmila tuja sila. Bil je razdeljen na dvajset curatoriae, ki so jih upravljali curatores.

source.title: Judicate of Logudoro
paragraphs: The Judicate of Logudoro or Torres (Sardinian: Judicadu de Logudoro or Torres, Rennu de Logudoro or Logu de Torres) was one of the four kingdoms or iudicati into which Sardinia was divided during the Middle Ages. It occupied the northwest part of the island from the 11th through the 13th century, bordering the Gallura to the east, Arborea to the south, and Cagliari to the southeast. Its original capital was Porto Torres. The region is still called Logudoro today.
Logudoro was the largest and earliest of the iudicati but also the second to be subsumed by a foreign power. It was divided into twenty curatoriae, ruled by curatores.

Julijski dnevi (rusko: Июльские дни) so bili obdobje nemirov v Petrogradu v Rusiji od 16. do 20. julija [od 3. do 7. julija po starem koledarju] 1917. Zaznamovale so jih spontane oborožene demonstracije vojakov, mornarjev in industrijskih delavcev proti ruski začasni vladi. Demonstracije so bile bolj jezne in nasilne kot tiste med februarsko revolucijo nekaj mesecev prej.

Začasna vlada je za nasilje julijskih dni okrivila boljševike; v poznejšem obračunu so boljševiško stranko razgnali, mnoge njene voditelje pa aretirali. Vladimir Lenin je pobegnil na Finsko, Lev Trocki pa je bil med aretiranimi.
Izid julijskih dni je pomenil začasen zastoj v rasti boljševiške moči in vpliva v obdobju pred oktobrsko revolucijo.

source.title: July Days
paragraphs: The July Days (Russian: Июльские дни) were a period of unrest in Petrograd, Russia, between 16–20 July [O.S. 3–7 July] 1917. It was characterised by spontaneous armed demonstrations by soldiers, sailors, and industrial workers engaged against the Russian Provisional Government. The demonstrations were angrier and more violent than those during the February Revolution months earlier.

The Provisional Government blamed the Bolsheviks for the violence brought about by the July Days and in a subsequent crackdown on the Bolshevik Party, the party was dispersed, many of the leadership arrested. Vladimir Lenin fled to Finland, while Leon Trotsky was among those arrested.
The outcome of the July Days represented a temporary decline in the growth of Bolshevik power and influence in the period before the October Revolution.

July Revolt of 1927.headline: Julijski upor leta 1927
paragraphs: Julijski upor leta 1927 (znan tudi kot požar dunajske Justične palače, nemško: Wiener Justizpalastbrand) je bil velik izgred, ki se je 15. julija 1927 začel v avstrijski prestolnici Dunaju. Sprožila ga je oprostitev treh pripadnikov nacionalističnih paravojaških enot, obtoženih uboja dveh članov socialdemokratskega Republikanischer Schutzbunda, vrhunec pa je dosegel, ko je policija streljala v razjarjeno množico in ubila 89 protestnikov; umrlo je tudi pet policistov. Ranjenih je bilo več kot 600 protestnikov in okoli 600 policistov.

source.title: July Revolt of 1927
paragraphs: The July Revolt of 1927 (also known as the Vienna Palace of Justice fire, German: Wiener Justizpalastbrand) was a major riot starting on 15 July 1927 in the Austrian capital, Vienna. The revolt was sparked by the acquittal of three nationalist paramilitary members for the killing of two social democratic Republikanischer Schutzbund members and culminated with police forces firing into the outraged crowd and killing 89 protesters, and five policemen died. More than 600 protestors and around 600 policemen were injured.

June Rebellion.headline: Junijska vstaja
paragraphs: Junijska vstaja, imenovana tudi pariška vstaja leta 1832 (francosko: Insurrection républicaine à Paris en juin 1832), je bila protimonarhistična vstaja pariških republikancev 5. in 6. junija 1832.

Izvirala je iz poskusa republikancev, da bi odpravili julijsko monarhijo Ludvika Filipa, vzpostavljeno leta 1830, kmalu potem, ko sta za kolero umrla predsednik vlade Casimir Pierre Périer in general Jean Maximilien Lamarque, nekdanji vojaški poveljnik, ki je postal poslanec francoskega parlamenta in je bil kritičen do monarhije. Vstajo so sprožili nemiri po Lamarquovem pogrebu. To je bil zadnji izbruh nasilja, povezan z julijsko revolucijo leta 1830.
Francoski pisatelj Victor Hugo je vstajo ovekovečil v romanu Nesrečniki (Les Misérables) iz leta 1862, vidno mesto pa ima tudi v odrskem muzikalu in filmih po knjigi.

source.title: June Rebellion
paragraphs: The June Rebellion, also called the Paris Uprising of 1832 (French: Insurrection républicaine à Paris en juin 1832), was an anti-monarchist insurrection of Parisian republicans on 5 and 6 June 1832.

The rebellion originated in an attempt by republicans to reverse the establishment in 1830 of the July Monarchy of Louis Philippe, shortly after the deaths from cholera of Prime Minister Casimir Pierre Périer and General Jean Maximilien Lamarque, a former Army commander who became a member of the French parliament and was critical of the monarchy. The riots that followed Lamarque's funeral sparked the rebellion. This was the last outbreak of violence linked with the July Revolution of 1830.
The French author Victor Hugo memorialised the rebellion in his 1862 novel Les Misérables, and it features prominently in the stage musical and films that are based on the book.

Kamenets–Podolsky pocket.headline: Kamenec-podolski žep
paragraphs: Kamenec-podolski žep (nemško: Kessel von Kamenez-Podolsk) je bil ključni del velike sovjetske proskurovsko-černoviške operacije (rusko: Проскуровско-Черновицкая Операция), ki je na nemški strani znana pod več imeni. Izvedla jo je sovjetska 1. ukrajinska fronta proti nemški 1. in 4. tankovski armadi ter madžarskim silam skupine armad Jug marca in aprila 1944. Načrt je bil izvesti glavni udarec proti jugu, na stiku obeh nemških armad, in tako presekati železniško progo Lvov–Odesa, ključno za oskrbo skupine armad Jug. Nadaljnje prodiranje proti jugu do Dnestra naj bi skupini armad Jug odrezalo umikalne poti proti zahodu in jo prisililo, da bi za oskrbo uporabljala dolgo obvozno pot prek Romunije.

source.title: Kamenets–Podolsky pocket
paragraphs: The Kamenets-Podolsky pocket (German: Kessel von Kamenez-Podolsk) was a key part of a major Soviet Proskurov-Chernovtsy Operation (Russian: Проскуровско-Черновицкая Операция), known on the German side by several names. It was conducted by the Soviet 1st Ukrainian Front against the German 1st and 4th Panzer Armies, and Hungarian forces of Army Group South in March-April 1944. The plan was to launch the main strike south, at the junction of the two German armies, thus cutting off the Lvov-Odessa railway line, vital for supplying Army Group South. The subsequent southerly advance to the Dniester aimed to cut off westward retreat routes for Army Group South, forcing it to use the long roundabout route through Romania for supply.

Karposh's rebellion.headline: Karpošev upor
paragraphs: Karpošev upor ali Karpoševa vstaja (makedonsko: Карпошово востание; bolgarsko: Карпошово въстание) je bil krščanski protiosmanski upor na osrednjem Balkanu, ki je izbruhnil oktobra 1689 med veliko turško vojno 1683–1699. Vzdevek Karpoš verjetno izhaja iz paleobalkanske besede karpa »tuf (kamnina), apnenec«. Vodja upora se je rodil v Üsküpskem (Skopskem) sandžaku v tedanjem Rumelijskem ejaletu Osmanskega cesarstva, verjetno v vasi Vojnik (pri Kumanovem v današnji Severni Makedoniji), in se je imenoval Petar (makedonsko: Петар; bolgarsko: Петър, »Peter«). Zelo mlad je pobegnil v Vlaško (današnja Romunija), kjer je delal kot rudar. Pozneje se je Karpoš preselil v Rodope in se naselil v dolini Dospat (blizu današnje grško-bolgarske meje), kjer je postal zloglasen hajduk. Ko je vojska Svetega rimskega cesarstva prodrla na osmanski Balkan, se je Karpoš preselil na območje Znepolja (pri Tranu na današnji srbsko-bolgarski meji) in tam začel organizirati protiosmanske odporniške odrede.

source.title: Karposh's rebellion
paragraphs: Karposh's rebellion or Karposh's uprising (Macedonian: Карпошово востание, Karpošovo vostanie; Bulgarian: Карпошово въстание, Karposhovo vastanie) was a Christian anti-Ottoman uprising in the Central Balkans that took place in October 1689 during the Great Turkish War of 1683–1699. The nickname Karposh probably derives from the Paleo-Balkan term karpa 'tuff (rock), limestone'. The leader of the rebellion, was born in the Sanjak of Üsküp in the then Rumelia Eyalet of the Ottoman Empire, probably in the village of Vojnik (near Kumanovo, present-day North Macedonia), and named Petar (Macedonian: Петар, Bulgarian: Петър, lit. 'Peter'). At a very young age, he escaped to Wallachia (present-day Romania), where he worked as a miner. Later, Karposh moved to the Rhodope Mountains, where he settled in the Dospat valley (near today's Greek-Bulgarian border), becoming a notorious hajduk. After the army of the Holy Roman Empire advanced into the Ottoman Balkans, Karposh moved to the area of Znepole (near Tran, on today's Serbo-Bulgarian border), and began to organise anti-Ottoman resistance-detachments there.

Kellogg-Briandov pakt ali pariški pakt (uradno Splošna pogodba o odpovedi vojni kot sredstvu nacionalne politike) je mednarodni mirovni sporazum iz leta 1928, v katerem so se države podpisnice zavezale, da vojne ne bodo uporabljale za reševanje »sporov ali konfliktov kakršne koli narave ali kakršnega koli izvora, ki bi lahko nastali med njimi«. Pakt so 27. avgusta 1928 podpisale Nemčija, Francija in Združene države, kmalu zatem pa še večina drugih držav. Predlagali sta ga Francija in ZDA, ime pa je dobil po avtorjih, ameriškem državnem sekretarju Franku B. Kelloggu in francoskem zunanjem ministru Aristidu Briandu. Sklenjen je bil zunaj Društva narodov in še vedno velja.

source.title: Kellogg–Briand Pact
paragraphs: The Kellogg–Briand Pact or Pact of Paris (officially the General Treaty for Renunciation of War as an Instrument of National Policy) is a 1928 international agreement on peace in which signatory states promised not to use war to resolve "disputes or conflicts of whatever nature or of whatever origin they may be, which may arise among them". The pact was signed by Germany, France, and the United States on 27 August 1928, and by most other states soon after. Sponsored by France and the US, the Pact is named after its authors, United States Secretary of State Frank B. Kellogg and French foreign minister Aristide Briand. The pact was concluded outside the League of Nations and remains in effect.

Incident v Kerškem prelivu je bil mednarodni incident 25. novembra 2018 v Kerškem prelivu, v katerem je obalna straža ruske Zvezne varnostne službe (FSB) streljala na tri plovila ukrajinske vojne mornarice in jih zajela, ko so skušala skozi preliv pluti iz Črnega v Azovsko morje proti pristanišču Mariupol. Ruske sile so se takrat prvič odkrito spopadle z ukrajinskimi silami med rusko-ukrajinsko vojno.

source.title: Kerch Strait incident
paragraphs: The Kerch Strait incident was an international incident that occurred on 25 November 2018 in the Kerch Strait, during which the Russian Federal Security Service (FSB) coast guard fired upon and captured three Ukrainian Navy vessels after they attempted to transit from the Black Sea into the Sea of Azov through the strait on their way to the port of Mariupol. It was the first time that Russian forces had openly engaged Ukrainian forces during the Russo-Ukrainian War.

Kerch–Eltigen operation.headline: Kerško-eltigenska operacija
paragraphs: Kerško-eltigenska operacija je bila amfibijska ofenziva Rdeče armade novembra 1943 med drugo svetovno vojno, uvod v krimsko ofenzivo (8. aprila – 12. maja 1944), s ciljem poraziti nemške sile in jih prisiliti k umiku s Krima. Rdeča armada se je izkrcala na dveh krajih na vzhodni obali Krima; severno mostišče pri Jenikaleju je uspešno okrepila, ni pa mogla preprečiti protinapada sil osi, ki je uničil južno mostišče pri Eltigenu. Rdeča armada je nato mostišče pri Jenikaleju uporabila za nadaljnje ofenzivne operacije na Krimu maja 1944.

source.title: Kerch–Eltigen operation
paragraphs: The Kerch–Eltigen operation was a World War II amphibious offensive made in November 1943 by the Red Army as a precursor to the Crimean offensive (8 April-12 May 1944), with the object of defeating and forcing the withdrawal of the German forces from the Crimea. Landing at two locations on the Crimea's eastern coast, the Red Army successfully reinforced the northern beachhead of Yenikale but was unable to prevent an Axis counterattack that collapsed the southern beachhead at Eltigen. Subsequently, the Red Army used the beachhead at Yenikale to launch further offensive operations into the Crimea in May 1944.

Kerensky offensive.headline: Kerenskijeva ofenziva
paragraphs: Kerenskijeva ofenziva (rusko: Наступление Керенского), imenovana tudi poletna ofenziva, v Rusiji junijska ofenziva (rusko: Июньское наступление), v zahodnem zgodovinopisju pa julijska ofenziva, je potekala od 1. julija [18. junija po starem koledarju] do 19. julija [6. julija po starem koledarju] 1917 in je bila zadnja ruska ofenziva prve svetovne vojne; ime je dobila po vojnem ministru Aleksandru Kerenskem. Po abdikaciji cesarja Nikolaja II. med februarsko revolucijo se je ruska začasna vlada zavezala, da bo izpolnila obstoječe ruske obveznosti do antante, med katerimi je bila tudi ofenziva spomladi 1917. Cilj operacije je bil Avstro-Ogrski iztrgati Lemberg in preostalo Galicijo.

source.title: Kerensky offensive
paragraphs: The Kerensky offensive (Russian: Наступление Керенского), also called the summer offensive, the June offensive (Russian: Июньское наступление) in Russia, or the July offensive in Western historiography, took place from 1 July [O.S. 18 June] to 19 July [O.S. 6 July] 1917 and was the last Russian offensive of World War I, named after the minister of war, Alexander Kerensky. After the abdication of Emperor Nicholas II during the February Revolution, the Russian Provisional Government pledged to fulfill Russia's existing commitments to the Triple Entente, which included launching an offensive in the spring of 1917. The operation was directed at capturing Lemberg and the rest of Galicia from Austria-Hungary.

Kerensky–Krasnov uprising.headline: Upor Kerenskega in Krasnova
paragraphs: Upor Kerenskega in Krasnova je bil poskus Aleksandra Kerenskega, da bi strl oktobrsko revolucijo in znova prevzel oblast, potem ko so boljševiki v Petrogradu strmoglavili njegovo vlado. Potekal je od 8. do 13. novembra 1917 [od 26. do 31. oktobra po starem koledarju].

Po oktobrski revoluciji je Kerenski zbežal iz Petrograda, ki je padel v roke petrograjskega sovjeta pod boljševiškim nadzorom, in odšel v Pskov, sedež poveljstva severne fronte. Poveljnik fronte general Vladimir Čeremisov ga ni podprl in mu je preprečil zbiranje enot za pohod na Petrograd, podprl pa ga je general Pjotr Krasnov, ki je s približno 700 kozaki napredoval proti prestolnici. Nasprotniki oktobrske revolucije so v Petrogradu pripravljali upor, ki naj bi sovpadel z napadom sil Kerenskega na mesto.

source.title: Kerensky–Krasnov uprising
paragraphs: The Kerensky–Krasnov uprising was an attempt by Alexander Kerensky to crush the October Revolution and regain power after the Bolsheviks overthrew his government in Petrograd. It took place between 8 and 13 November 1917 [O.S. 26 and 31 October].

Following the October Revolution, Kerensky fled Petrograd, which fell to the Bolshevik-controlled Petrograd Soviet and went to Pskov, the headquarters of the Northern Front command. He did not get the support of its commander, General Vladimir Cheremisov, who prevented his attempts to gather units to march on Petrograd, but he did get the support of General Pyotr Krasnov, who advanced on the capital with about 700 Cossacks. In Petrograd, opponents of the October Revolution were preparing a revolt that would coincide with the attack on the city by Kerensky's forces.

Sibirski kanat (sibirskotatarsko: Себер ҡанныҡ; rusko: Сибирское ханство, Сибирский юрт) je bil sibirskotatarska država v zahodni Sibiriji. Nastal je konec 15. stoletja po razpadu Zlate horde. V vsej zgodovini kanata so se pripadniki dinastij Šajbanidov in Tajbugidov pogosto potegovali za oblast; obe tekmujoči plemeni sta bili po moški liniji neposredni potomki Džingiskana, prek njegovega najstarejšega sina Džočija in Džočijevega petega sina Šajbana (Šibana) (umrl 1266). Območje kanata je bilo nekoč sestavni del Mongolskega cesarstva; pozneje je prišlo pod nadzor Bele horde, od leta 1242 do 1468 pa pod Zlato hordo.

Sibirski kanat je imel etnično raznoliko prebivalstvo: turška ljudstva, sibirske Tatare, in različna uralska ljudstva, med njimi Hante, Mansije in Selkupe. Bil je najsevernejša muslimanska država v zapisani zgodovini.
notes: The romanizations are left out.

source.title: Khanate of Sibir
paragraphs: The Khanate of Sibir (Siberian Tatar: Себер ҡанныҡ, romanized: Seber qannïq; Russian: Сибирское ханство, Сибирский юрт, romanized: Sibirskoye khanstvo, Sibirsky yurt) was a Siberian Tatar state in western Siberia. It was founded at the end of the 15th century, following the break-up of the Golden Horde. Throughout its history, members of the Shaybanid and Taibugid dynasties often contested the rulership over the Khanate between each other; both of these competing tribes were direct patrilineal descendants of Genghis Khan through his eldest son Jochi and Jochi's fifth son Shayban (Shiban) (died 1266). The area of the Khanate had once formed an integral part of the Mongol Empire; it later came under the control of the White Horde, and under the Golden Horde from 1242 to 1468.

The Khanate of Sibir had an ethnically diverse population of Turkic peoples – Siberian Tatars and various Uralic peoples – including the Khanty, the Mansi, and the Selkup. The Sibir Khanate was the northernmost Muslim state in recorded history.

Sporazum med Ukrajino in Rusijo o Črnomorski floti v Ukrajini, splošno znan kot Harkovski pakt (ukrajinsko: Харківський пакт) ali harkovski sporazumi (rusko: Харьковские соглашения), je bil pogodba med Ukrajino in Rusijo, s katero so ruski najem pomorskih objektov na Krimu podaljšali čez leto 2017 do leta 2042, z možnostjo dodatnega petletnega podaljšanja, v zameno za večletno pogodbo o dobavi ruskega zemeljskega plina Ukrajini po znižani ceni.

Sporazum, ki sta ga 21. aprila 2010 v Harkovu v Ukrajini podpisala ukrajinski predsednik Viktor Janukovič in ruski predsednik Dmitrij Medvedjev, parlamenta obeh držav pa sta ga ratificirala 27. aprila 2010, je v Ukrajini sprožil veliko polemik. Pogodba je bila dejansko nadaljevanje določb o najemu iz pogodbe o delitvi Črnomorske flote, ki sta jo državi sklenili leta 1997. Kmalu po tem, ko je Ruska federacija marca 2014 priključila Krim, je Rusija 31. marca 2014 pogodbo enostransko odpovedala.

source.title: Kharkiv Pact
paragraphs: The Agreement between Ukraine and Russia on the Black Sea Fleet in Ukraine, widely referred to as the Kharkiv Pact (Ukrainian: Харківський пакт) or Kharkov Accords (Russian: Харьковские соглашения), was a treaty between Ukraine and Russia whereby the Russian lease on naval facilities in Crimea was extended beyond 2017 until 2042, with an additional five-year renewal option in exchange for a multiyear discounted contract to provide Ukraine with Russian natural gas.

The agreement, signed on 21 April 2010 in Kharkiv, Ukraine, by Ukrainian president Viktor Yanukovych and Russian president Dmitry Medvedev and ratified by the parliaments of the two countries on 27 April 2010, aroused much controversy in Ukraine. The treaty was effectively a continuation of the lease provisions that were part of the 1997 Black Sea Fleet Partition Treaty between the two states. Shortly after the annexation of Crimea by the Russian Federation in March 2014, Russia unilaterally terminated the treaty on 31 March 2014.

Vstaja Hmelnickega, znana tudi kot kozaško-poljska vojna, upor Hmelnickega, kozaška revolucija ali v Ukrajini narodnoosvobodilna vojna, je bila uspešen kozaški upor z elementi verske vojne, ki je med letoma 1648 in 1657 potekal na vzhodnih ozemljih Poljsko-litovske republike. Začela se je v Podnjeprju in se končala s kozaško zmago ter nastankom Kozaškega hetmanata. Zaporoški kozaki pod poveljstvom kozaškega hetmana Bohdana Hmelnickega so se ob podpori upornega rutenskega kmečkega prebivalstva in sprva v zavezništvu s Krimskim kanatom bojevali proti silam republike. Vojno so spremljala množična grozodejstva kozakov nad vojnimi ujetniki in civilnim prebivalstvom, zlasti Poljaki, Judi ter rimskokatoliško in rutensko unijatsko duhovščino, pa tudi povračilni ukrepi poljske šlahte in vojske, zlasti čet Jeremija Wiśniowieckega.

source.title: Khmelnytsky Uprising
paragraphs: The Khmelnytsky Uprising, also known as the Cossack–Polish War, Khmelnytsky insurrection, Cossack Revolution, or, in Ukraine, as the National Liberation War, was a successful Cossack rebellion with elements of a religious war that took place between 1648 and 1657 in the eastern territories of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Originating in Dnieper Ukraine, the uprising resulted in a Cossack victory and led to the creation of the Cossack Hetmanate. Under the command of Cossack Hetman Bohdan Khmelnytsky, the Zaporozhian Cossacks, supported by the rebelling Ruthenian peasantry and initially allied with the Crimean Khanate, fought against the Commonwealth's forces. The war was accompanied by mass atrocities committed by Cossacks against prisoners of war and the civilian population, especially Poles, Jews, Roman Catholic and Ruthenian Uniate clergy, as well as reprisals by the Polish szlachta and army, especially Jeremi Wiśniowiecki's troops.

Kholm Pocket.headline: Holmski žep
paragraphs: Holmski žep (nemško: Kessel von Cholm; rusko: Холмский котёл) je ime za obkolitev nemških čet, ki jo je Rdeča armada izvedla pri Holmu južno od Leningrada na vzhodni fronti druge svetovne vojne od 23. januarja do 5. maja 1942. Žep je nastal s sovjetsko toropecko-holmsko ofenzivo.
Precej večji žep je medtem nastal pri Demjansku, približno 100 km severovzhodno. Oba sta bila posledica nemškega umika po porazu v bitki za Moskvo.

Oskrba Holma in Demjanska po zraku je uspela, vendar je nemško vrhovno poveljstvo zaradi nje preveč zaupalo v zmožnost Luftwaffe, da po zraku oskrbuje obkoljene sile, kar je imelo usodne posledice v bitki za Stalingrad konec leta 1942 in v začetku leta 1943.
notes: The mile conversion is left out.

source.title: Kholm Pocket
paragraphs: The Kholm Pocket (German: Kessel von Cholm; Russian: Холмский котёл) was the name given for the encirclement of German troops by the Red Army around Kholm, south of Leningrad, in World War II's the Eastern Front, from 23 January 1942 to 5 May 1942. The pocket was created by the Soviet Toropets–Kholm offensive.
A much larger pocket was meanwhile surrounded in Demyansk, about 100 km (62 mi) to the northeast. Both were the results of the German retreat following the defeat during the Battle of Moscow.

The air supply of Kholm and Demyansk was successful but led to an overconfidence in the German High Command on the Luftwaffe's ability to supply encircled forces by air, which would lead to disastrous consequences at the Battle of Stalingrad in late 1942 and early 1943.

Kijevska ofenziva leta 1920 (ali kijevski pohod, poljsko: wyprawa kijowska) je bila pomemben del poljsko-sovjetske vojne. Bila je poskus oboroženih sil nedavno ustanovljene Druge poljske republike pod vodstvom Józefa Piłsudskega, da bi v zavezništvu z Ukrajinsko ljudsko republiko pod vodstvom Simona Petljure zavzele ozemlja današnje Ukrajine, ki so po oktobrski revoluciji večinoma prišla pod sovjetski nadzor kot Ruska sovjetska republika.

source.title: Kiev offensive (1920)
paragraphs: The 1920 Kiev offensive (or Kiev expedition, Polish: wyprawa kijowska) was a major part of the Polish–Soviet War. It was an attempt by the armed forces of the recently established Second Polish Republic led by Józef Piłsudski, in alliance with the Ukrainian People's Republic led by Symon Petliura, to seize the territories of modern-day Ukraine which mostly fell under Soviet control after the October Revolution as the Russian Soviet Republic.

Kimek-Kipchak confederation.headline: Kimaško-kipčaška konfederacija
paragraphs: Kimaško-kipčaška konfederacija je bila srednjeveška turška država, ki jo je sestavljalo sedem ljudstev, med njimi Kimaki in Kipčaki, na območju med rekama Ob in Irtiš.

source.title: Kimak–Kipchak confederation
paragraphs: The Kimak–Kipchak confederation was a medieval Turkic state formed by seven peoples, including the Kimaks and Kipchaks, in the area between the Ob and Irtysh rivers.

Kingdom of Alba.headline: Kraljestvo Alba
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Alba (latinsko: Scotia; škotsko gelsko: Alba) je bilo ime Kraljevine Škotske v obdobju od smrti Donalda II. leta 900 do smrti Aleksandra III. leta 1286. Aleksandrova smrt je posredno pripeljala do vdora angleškega kralja Edvarda I. na Škotsko leta 1296 in do prve škotske osamosvojitvene vojne.

Alba je vključevala Dalriado, sprva pa ni obsegala velikih delov današnjega Škotskega nižavja, ki sta si ga tedaj vse do zaliva Firth of Forth na severu delila Strathclyde in Northumbrija. Piktsko kraljestvo Fortriu na severu je bilo Albi priključeno v 10. stoletju.
Do začetka 13. stoletja Moraya niso šteli za del Albe, za katero so menili, da sega le od zaliva Firth of Forth do reke Spey.

source.title: Kingdom of Alba
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Alba (Latin: Scotia; Scottish Gaelic: Alba) was the Kingdom of Scotland between the deaths of Donald II in 900 and of Alexander III in 1286. The latter's death led indirectly to an invasion of Scotland by Edward I of England in 1296 and the First War of Scottish Independence.

Alba included Dalriada, but initially excluded large parts of the present-day Scottish Lowlands, which were then divided between Strathclyde and Northumbria as far north as the Firth of Forth. Fortriu, a Pictish kingdom in the north, was added to Alba in the tenth century.
Until the early 13th century, Moray was not considered part of Alba, which was seen as extending only between the Firth of Forth and the River Spey.

Kraljestvo Bretanja (bretonsko: Rouantelezh Breizh) je bilo kratkotrajna vazalna država Frankovskega cesarstva, ki je nastala med nordijskimi vpadi. Njegova zgodovina se začne leta 851, ko je Erispoe zahteval kraljevski naslov. Leta 856 so Erispoeja umorili, nasledil pa ga je bratranec Salomon.

Kraljestvo je zašlo v obdobje nemirov zaradi nordijskih vpadov in nasledstvenega spora med Salomonovima morilcema, Gurvandom in Pascwetenom. Pascwetenov brat Alan, imenovan Veliki, je bil tretji in zadnji priznani kralj Bretanje. Po njegovi smrti je Bretanja prišla pod nordijsko zasedbo.
Ko je Alan Krivobradi, vnuk Alana Velikega, leta 939 znova osvojil Bretanjo, je ta postala suverena vojvodina vse do zveze s Francijo leta 1532.

source.title: Kingdom of Brittany
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Brittany (Breton: Rouantelezh Breizh) was a short-lived vassal-state of the Frankish Empire that emerged during the Norse invasions. Its history begins in 851 with Erispoe's claim to kingship. In 856, Erispoe was murdered and succeeded by his cousin Salomon.

The kingdom fell into a period of turmoil caused by Norse invasions and a succession dispute between Salomon's murderers: Gurvand and Pascweten. Pascweten's brother, Alan, called the Great, was the third and last to be recognized as King of Brittany. After his death, Brittany fell under Norse occupation.
When Alan Twistedbeard, Alan the Great's grandson, reconquered Brittany in 939, Brittany became a sovereign duchy until its union with France in 1532.

Kraljestvo Kastilija je bilo srednjeveška država na Iberskem polotoku. Izvira iz grofije Kastilija iz 9. stoletja, vzhodnega obmejnega gospostva Kraljestva León. Kastiljski grofje so v 10. stoletju povečali svojo samostojnost, a šele leta 1065 se je Kastilija ločila od Kraljestva León in postala samostojno kraljestvo. Med letoma 1072 in 1157 je bila znova združena z Leónom, po letu 1230 pa je zveza postala trajna.

V tem obdobju so kastiljski kralji na jugu Iberskega polotoka na račun islamskih kneževin veliko osvojili. Kraljestvi Kastilija in León s svojimi južnimi pridobitvami sta postali znani kot Kastiljska krona, izraz, ki je pozneje zajemal tudi čezmorsko širitev.

source.title: Kingdom of Castile
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Castile was a polity in the Iberian Peninsula during the Middle Ages. It traces its origins to the 9th-century County of Castile, as an eastern frontier lordship of the Kingdom of León. During the 10th century, the Castilian counts increased their autonomy, but it was not until 1065 that it was separated from the Kingdom of León and became a kingdom in its own right. Between 1072 and 1157, it was again united with León, and after 1230, the union became permanent.

Throughout that period, the Castilian kings made extensive conquests in southern Iberia at the expense of the Islamic principalities. The Kingdoms of Castile and of León, with their southern acquisitions, came to be known collectively as the Crown of Castile, a term that also came to encompass overseas expansion.

Kraljestvo Vzhodnih Anglov (staroangleško: Ēastengla Rīċe; latinsko: Regnum Orientalium Anglorum), neuradno znano kot Kraljestvo Vzhodna Anglija ali Vzhodna Anglija, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo Anglov v anglosaškem obdobju, ki je obstajalo od 6. stoletja do leta 918 n. št. Obsegalo je ozemlje današnjih angleških grofij Norfolk in Suffolk ter morda vzhodni del Fens; območje se še danes imenuje Vzhodna Anglija.

Kraljestvo, ki je nastalo v 6. stoletju po anglosaški naselitvi Britanije, je bilo eno od kraljestev heptarhije. V 7. in 8. stoletju je vladala rodbina Wuffingas, leta 794 pa je ozemlje zavzel mercijski kralj Offa. Po Offovi smrti je mercijska oblast za kratek čas popustila, nato pa so jo znova vzpostavili. Danska velika poganska vojska se je leta 865 izkrcala v Vzhodni Angliji; po zavzetju Yorka se je vrnila, leta 869 ubila kralja Edmunda (»Mučenca«) in deželo spremenila v dansko. Ko je Alfred Veliki Dancem vsilil pogodbo, je Vzhodna Anglija ostala del danskega prava (Danelaw).
notes: The English pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Kingdom of East Anglia
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the East Angles (/ˈæŋ.ɡli.ə/; Old English: Ēastengla Rīċe; Latin: Regnum Orientalium Anglorum), informally known as the Kingdom of East Anglia or East Anglia, was an early medieval English kingdom of the Angles during the Anglo-Saxon period, existing from the 6th century to 918 CE. It comprised the territory which now constitutes the English counties of Norfolk and Suffolk and perhaps the eastern part of the Fens; the area is still known as East Anglia.

The kingdom formed in the 6th century in the wake of the Anglo-Saxon settlement of Britain was one of the kingdoms of the Heptarchy. It was ruled by the Wuffingas dynasty in the 7th and 8th centuries, but the territory was taken by Offa of Mercia in 794. Mercian control lapsed briefly following the death of Offa but was re-established. The Danish Great Heathen Army landed in East Anglia in 865; after taking York it returned to East Anglia, killing King Edmund ("the Martyr") and making it Danish land in 869. After Alfred the Great forced a treaty with the Danes, East Anglia was left as part of the Danelaw.

Kraljestvo Vzhodnih Sasov, imenovano Kraljestvo Essex, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo, eno od sedmih tradicionalnih kraljestev anglosaškega obdobja.
