Ustanovljeno je bilo v 6. stoletju in je obsegalo ozemlje poznejših grofij Essex in Middlesex, velikega dela Hertfordshira in (za kratek čas) zahodnega Kenta. Zadnji kralj Essexa je bil Sigered, ki je leta 825 kraljestvo prepustil wessexškemu kralju Ecgberhtu.

source.title: Kingdom of Essex
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the East Saxons, referred to as the Kingdom of Essex, was an early medieval English kingdom, constituting one of the seven traditional kingdoms of the Anglo-Saxon period. It was founded in the 6th century and covered the territory later occupied by the counties of Essex, Middlesex, much of Hertfordshire and (for a short while) west Kent. The last king of Essex was Sigered of Essex, who in 825 ceded the kingdom to Ecgberht, King of Wessex.

Kraljestvo Galicija je bilo politična tvorba v jugozahodni Evropi, ki je na vrhuncu ozemeljskega obsega zavzemala ves severozahod Iberskega polotoka. Nastalo je v začetku 10. stoletja z razdelitvijo Kraljestva Asturija po smrti Alfonza III. leta 910: njegovi sinovi so si kraljestvo razdelili in Galicijo je podedoval Ordoño II. Galicija je postala samostojna politična tvorba, a je z leonskim in asturijskim kraljestvom ostala tesno povezana z dinastičnimi vezmi. Ordoño II. jo je pozneje, ko je podedoval León, vključil v Kraljestvo León. Kraljestvo Galicija je bilo občasno napol neodvisno, navadno pa so ga imeli za del Kraljestva León. Santiago de Compostela je postal prestolnica Galicije v 11. stoletju, neodvisnost Portugalske (1128) pa je določila njeno južno mejo. Ko je kastiljski kralj Ferdinand III. leta 1230 nasledil leonski prestol, je Galicija prišla pod nadzor Kastiljske krone.

source.title: Kingdom of Galicia
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Galicia was a political entity located in southwestern Europe, which, at its territorial zenith, occupied the entire northwest of the Iberian Peninsula. In the early 10th century, the Kingdom of Galicia was formed following the division of the Kingdom of Asturias after the death of Alfonso III in 910. His sons split the kingdom, with Ordoño II inheriting Galicia. While Galicia became a distinct political entity, it remained closely tied to the Leonese and Asturian realms through dynastic connections. Later, Ordoño II integrated Galicia into the Kingdom of León when he inherited the latter. Though the Kingdom of Galicia had moments of semi-independence, it was typically seen as part of the Kingdom of León. Santiago de Compostela became the capital of Galicia in the 11th century, while the independence of Portugal (1128) determined its southern boundary. The accession of Castilian King Ferdinand III to the Leonese kingdom in 1230 brought Galicia under the control of the Crown of Castile.

Nemško kraljestvo (latinsko: Regnum Teutonicum) je bilo v srednjeveški zgodovini prvotno jedro Svetega rimskega cesarstva, ki so ga še naprej razlikovali od drugih delov cesarstva, kot sta bili Kraljevina Italija in Kraljevina Burgundija. Razvilo se je iz vzhodnofrankovskega kraljestva, nastalega z verdunsko pogodbo leta 843, ki je razdelila Karolinško cesarstvo. Nemško kraljestvo so sprva sestavljale različne prepoznavne pokrajine, iz katerih so nastala plemenska vojvodstva Saška, Frankovska, Turingija, Bavarska in Švabska, v 10. stoletju pa je utrdilo oblast nad Lotaringijo. V sodobnem geografskem smislu je sčasoma obsegalo današnjo Nemčijo, Avstrijo, Slovenijo, Luksemburg in Nizozemsko ter znatne dele današnje Švice, Belgije, Francije in Poljske.

source.title: Kingdom of Germany
paragraphs: In medieval history, the Kingdom of Germany (Latin: Regnum Teutonicum) was the original core of the Holy Roman Empire, which continued to be distinguished from other parts of the empire such as the Kingdom of Italy and the Kingdom of Burgundy. It evolved from the eastern Frankish kingdom formed by the Treaty of Verdun in 843, which split the Carolingian Empire. The Kingdom of Germany originally consisted of several identifiable regions which became the stem duchies of Saxony, Franconia, Thuringia, Bavaria, and Swabia, and in the 10th century it consolidated its hold on Lotharingia. In modern geographical terms, it eventually expanded to encompass present-day Germany, Austria, Slovenia, Luxembourg and the Netherlands, along with substantial parts of present-day Switzerland, Belgium, France and Poland.

Gwent (starovaližansko: Guent) je bil srednjeveško valižansko kraljestvo med rekama Wye in Usk. Obstajal je od konca rimske oblasti v Britaniji okoli 5. stoletja do normanske invazije na Wales v 11. stoletju. Skupaj s sosednjim Glywysingom je imel očitno veliko kulturne kontinuitete s starejšimi Siluri: kraljestvi sta ohranili svoje dvore in škofijo, ločeno od preostalega Walesa, dokler ju ni osvojil Gruffydd ap Llywelyn. Čeprav je po njegovi smrti leta 1063 znova postal neodvisen, je bil Gwent prvo valižansko kraljestvo, ki so ga po normanski osvojitvi pregazili.

source.title: Kingdom of Gwent
paragraphs: Gwent (Old Welsh: Guent) was a medieval Welsh kingdom, lying between the Rivers Wye and Usk. It existed from the end of Roman rule in Britain in about the 5th century until the Norman invasion of Wales in the 11th century. Along with its neighbour Glywysing, it seems to have had a great deal of cultural continuity with the earlier Silures, keeping their own courts and diocese separate from the rest of Wales until their conquest by Gruffydd ap Llywelyn. Although it recovered its independence after his death in 1063, Gwent was the first of the Welsh kingdoms to be overrun following the Norman conquest.

Kraljestvo Gwynedd je bilo valižansko kraljestvo, ki se je prvič pojavilo na prelomu 6. stoletja. Vladarji Gwynedda s središčem na severozahodu Walesa so se večkrat povzpeli do prevlade in bili razglašeni za »kralja Britov«, nato pa so oblast izgubili v državljanskih vojnah ali invazijah. Kraljestvo Gruffudda ap Llywelyna, kralja Walesa od leta 1055 do 1063, je leta 1063, tik pred normansko invazijo na Wales, razbila saška invazija. Rodbina Aberffraw, ki jo je obnovil Gruffudd ap Cynan, si je počasi opomogla, in Llywelyn Veliki iz Gwynedda je leta 1216 na zboru valižanskih knezov v Aberdyfiju razglasil Kneževino Wales. Pogodba iz Aberconwyja med angleškim kraljem Edvardom I. in Llywelynovim vnukom Llywelynom ap Gruffuddom je leta 1277 prinesla mir, hkrati pa je zagotovila, da se bo valižanska samouprava z Llywelynovo smrtjo končala, zato je pomenila konec prve faze Edvardove osvojitve Walesa.

source.title: Kingdom of Gwynedd
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Gwynedd was a Welsh kingdom which first appeared at the turn of the sixth century. Based in northwest Wales, the rulers of Gwynedd repeatedly rose to dominance and were acclaimed as "King of the Britons" before losing their power in civil wars or invasions. The kingdom of Gruffudd ap Llywelyn—the King of Wales from 1055 to 1063—was shattered by a Saxon invasion in 1063 just prior to the Norman invasion of Wales, but the House of Aberffraw restored by Gruffudd ap Cynan slowly recovered and Llywelyn the Great of Gwynedd was able to proclaim the Principality of Wales at the Aberdyfi gathering of Welsh princes in 1216. In 1277, the Treaty of Aberconwy between Edward I of England and Llywelyn's grandson Llywelyn ap Gruffudd granted peace between the two but would also guarantee that Welsh self-rule would end upon Llywelyn's death, and so it represented the completion of the first stage of the conquest of Wales by Edward I.

Kraljevina Hannover (nemško: Königreich Hannover) je bila ustanovljena oktobra 1814 na dunajskem kongresu, ko so Juriju III. po napoleonskem obdobju vrnili njegova hannovrska ozemlja. Prestolnica je bila v Hannovru, kraljevina pa je vladala tudi Göttingenu in Osnabrücku. Imela je dostop do Severnega morja in je mejila na Nizozemsko ter svobodni nemški mesti Hamburg in Bremen. Nasledila je nekdanjo Volilno kneževino Hannover in se junija 1815 z 38 drugimi suverenimi državami pridružila Nemški zvezi. Kraljevini je vladala rodbina Hannover, stranska veja rodbine Welf, ki je bila med letoma 1714 in 1837 v personalni uniji z Veliko Britanijo. Ker je monarh živel v Londonu, je kraljevino Hannover upravljal podkralj, navadno mlajši član britanske kraljeve družine.
notes: The glossary called the kingdom Hanoversko; an override now gives Kraljevina Hannover.

source.title: Kingdom of Hanover
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Hanover (German: Königreich Hannover) was established in October 1814 by the Congress of Vienna, with the restoration of George III to his Hanoverian territories after the Napoleonic era. Its capital was Hanover and it also ruled Gottingen and Osnabruck. It had access to the North Sea, and bordered on the Netherlands and the free German cities of Hamburg and Bremen. It succeeded the former Electorate of Hanover, and joined 38 other sovereign states in the German Confederation in June 1815. The kingdom was ruled by the House of Hanover, a cadet branch of the House of Welf, in personal union with Great Britain between 1714 and 1837. Since its monarch resided in London, a viceroy, usually a younger member of the British royal family, handled the administration of the Kingdom of Hanover.

Kraljestvo Kentčanov, danes imenovano Kraljestvo Kent, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo na območju današnje jugovzhodne Anglije. Obstajalo je od 5. ali 6. stoletja n. št., dokler ga sredi 9. stoletja ni v celoti vsrkalo Kraljestvo Wessex, v začetku 10. stoletja pa Kraljestvo Anglija.

source.title: Kingdom of Kent
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the Kentish, today referred to as the Kingdom of Kent, was an early medieval English kingdom in present-day South East England. It existed from either the fifth or the sixth century AD until it was fully absorbed into the Kingdom of Wessex in the mid-9th century and later into the Kingdom of England in the early 10th century.

Kraljestvo León je bilo srednjeveška država na severozahodu Iberskega polotoka. Ustanovljeno je bilo leta 910, ko so krščanski knezi Asturije ob severni obali polotoka prestolnico preselili iz Ovieda v mesto León. Leonski kralji so se v nemirnem času bojevali v državljanskih vojnah, vojnah s sosednjimi kraljestvi ter proti vpadom Mavrov in Vikingov, da bi ohranili svoje kraljestvo.

source.title: Kingdom of León
paragraphs: The Kingdom of León was a medieval state situated in the northwest region of the Iberian Peninsula. It was founded in 910, when the Christian princes of Asturias along the northern coast of the peninsula shifted their capital from Oviedo to the city of León. The kings of León fought civil wars, wars against neighbouring kingdoms, and invasions by the Moors and the Vikings, to sustain their kingdom through a turbulent age.

Kingdom of Lindsey.headline: Kraljestvo Lindsey
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Lindsey (staroangleško: Lindesege) je bilo manjše anglosaško kraljestvo na območju današnjega severnega Lincolnshira v 6. in 7. stoletju, morda pa je obstajalo še v začetku 8. stoletja. Ime Lindsey izhaja iz staroangleškega toponima Lindesege, »otok Lind«. Rimljani so naselje, ki je danes mesto Lincoln v Lincolnshiru, imenovali Lindum Colonia. (V stari angleščini se je Lindum Colonia skrajšalo v Lindocolina in nato v Lincylene.) Lindum je polatinjena oblika domačega britonskega imena, ki so ga rekonstruirali kot *Lindon (dobesedno »tolmun« ali »jezero«; prim. sodobno valižansko llyn).

source.title: Kingdom of Lindsey
paragraphs: The Lindsey (Old English: Lindesege) was a lesser Anglo-Saxon kingdom in what is now north Lincolnshire in the sixth and seventh centuries, possibly extending into the early eighth century. The name Lindsey derives from the Old English toponym Lindesege, meaning "Isle of Lind". Lindum Colonia was the Roman name of the settlement which is now the City of Lincoln in Lincolnshire. (Lindum Colonia was shortened in Old English to Lindocolina and then Lincylene.) Lindum was a Latinised form of a native Brittonic name which has been reconstructed as *Lindon (lit. 'pool' or 'lake'; cf. modern Welsh llyn).

Kraljestvo Majorka je bilo otoško kraljestvo ob vzhodni obali današnje Španije, ki je obsegalo otoke Majorka, Minorka, Ibiza in Formentera. Otoke je Almohadskemu kalifatu odvzel aragonski kralj Jakob I. in jih vključil v Aragonsko krono. Zaradi osvojitve Majorke je dobil vzdevek Jakob Osvajalec.

Jakob I. je ob smrti leta 1276 svoja ozemlja razdelil med tri preživele sinove. Najstarejši, Peter, je očeta nasledil na celini kot aragonski kralj Peter III. ali Peter Veliki. Kraljestvo Majorka je prešlo na mlajšega sina Jakoba, ki je vladal kot Jakob II. Majorški.

Peter III. Aragonski je po letu 1279 odredil, da mora biti majorški kralj vazal aragonskega kralja, kar je seveda pripeljalo do spora med bratoma. Nazadnje je leta 1344 Kraljestvo Majorko zasedel aragonski kralj Peter IV. in ga priključil Aragonski kroni. Ostalo je ločeno kraljestvo, a z istim kraljem, dokler ga leta 1715 niso odpravili dekreti Nueva Planta.

source.title: Kingdom of Majorca
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Majorca was an insular realm off the east coast of modern day Spain, which included the islands of Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza and Formentera. The islands were conquered from the Almohad Caliphate by James I of Aragon, and were integrated in the Crown of Aragon. The king became known as James the Conqueror due to the Conquest of Majorca.

When James I died in 1276, he divided his territories between his three surviving sons. Peter, the eldest, succeeded his father in the mainland as Peter III of Aragon or Peter the Great. The Kingdom of Majorca passed to the younger son James, who reigned as James II of Majorca.

After 1279, Peter III of Aragon decreed that the King of Majorca was to be a vassal of the King of Aragon. Naturally, this led to conflict between the two brothers. Finally, in 1344, the Kingdom of Mallorca was invaded by King Peter IV of Aragon and brought under the Crown of Aragon. It remained a separate Kingdom, but with the same King, until its dissolution in 1715 by the Nueva Planta decrees.

Kingdom of Morgannwg.headline: Kraljestvo Morgannwg
paragraphs: Morgannwg (danes Glamorgan) je bil kraljestvo na jugovzhodu Walesa. Tako so konec 10. stoletja začeli imenovati Kraljestvo Glywysing, ki je propadlo, ko so ga okoli leta 1091 osvojili Normani.

source.title: Kingdom of Morgannwg
paragraphs: Morgannwg (now Glamorgan) was a kingdom in south-east Wales. It was a name for the Kingdom of Glywysing which came into use at the end of the tenth century and ended with conquest by the Normans around 1091.

Kraljestvo Neapelj (italijansko: Regno di Napoli; neapeljsko: Regno 'e Napule) je bilo francoska satelitska država v južni Italiji, ki je obstajala od leta 1806 do 1815. Nastalo je, potem ko se je Burbonec Ferdinand IV. Neapeljski in III. Sicilski postavil na stran tretje koalicije proti Napoleonu in ga je francoski vdor zato pregnal iz njegove kraljevine. Na njegovo mesto so postavili Napoleonovega starejšega brata Jožefa Bonaparta, ki je naziv »neapeljski princ« podelil kot dedni naziv svojim otrokom in vnukom. Ko je Jožef leta 1808 postal španski kralj, je Napoleon namesto njega imenoval svojega svaka, maršala Joachima Murata. Murata je leta 1815 odstavil dunajski kongres, potem ko je v neapeljski vojni napadel Avstrijo in bil v bitki pri Tolentinu odločilno poražen.
notes: The glossary names this record Kraljestvo Neapelj and the earlier Kingdom of Naples Neapeljsko kraljestvo; the two forms are worth harmonising.

source.title: Kingdom of Naples (Napoleonic)
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Naples (Italian: Regno di Napoli; Neapolitan: Regno 'e Napule) was a French client state in southern Italy that existed from 1806 to 1815. It was founded after the Bourbon Ferdinand IV and III of Naples and Sicily sided with the Third Coalition against Napoleon, and was in return ousted from his kingdom by a French invasion. Joseph Bonaparte, elder brother of Napoleon, was installed in his stead: Joseph conferred the title "Prince of Naples" to be hereditary on his children and grandchildren. When Joseph became king of Spain in 1808, Napoleon appointed his brother-in-law Marshal Joachim Murat to take his place. Murat was later deposed by the Congress of Vienna in 1815 after striking at Austria in the Neapolitan War, in which he was decisively defeated at the Battle of Tolentino.
Kraljevina Poljska (poljsko: Królestwo Polskie; latinsko: Regnum Poloniae) je bila država v srednji Evropi v srednjem in zgodnjem novem veku, od leta 1025 do 1795.

source.title: Kingdom of Poland
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Poland (Polish: Królestwo Polskie; Latin: Regnum Poloniae) was a state in Central Europe during the medieval and early modern periods from 1025 until 1795.

Kraljestvo Powys (latinsko: Regnum Poysiae) je bilo valižanska država naslednica, majhno kraljestvo in kneževina, ki je nastalo v srednjem veku po koncu rimske oblasti v Britaniji. Zelo približno je obsegalo severni dve tretjini današnje grofije Powys in del današnjega angleškega West Midlandsa. Natančneje, njegove meje so temeljile na rimsko-britanskih plemenskih ozemljih Ordovikov na zahodu in Kornovijev na vzhodu ter so sprva segale od Kambrijskega gorovja na zahodu do današnje angleške regije West Midlands na vzhodu. Tam ležita rodovitni dolini rek Severn in Tern, to območje pa poznejša valižanska književnost imenuje »raj Powysa« (vzdevek, ki se je v valižanščini ohranil za današnjo britansko grofijo).
notes: The Welsh pronunciation in IPA and the reference to a map are dropped.

source.title: Kingdom of Powys
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Powys (Welsh pronunciation: [ˈpowɪs]; Latin: Regnum Poysiae) was a Welsh successor state, petty kingdom and principality that emerged during the Middle Ages following the end of Roman rule in Britain. It very roughly covered the northern two-thirds of the modern county of Powys and part of today's English West Midlands (see map). More precisely, and based on the Romano-British tribal lands of the Ordovices in the west and the Cornovii in the east, its boundaries originally extended from the Cambrian Mountains in the west to include the modern West Midlands region of England in the east. The fertile river valleys of the Severn and Tern are found there, and this region is referred to in later Welsh literature as "the Paradise of Powys" (an epithet retained in Welsh for the modern UK county).

Kraljevina Prusija (nemško: Königreich Preußen) je bila nemška država, ki je obstajala od leta 1701 do 1918. Imela je pomembno vlogo pri združitvi Nemčije leta 1871 in je bila glavni sestavni del Nemškega cesarstva do njegovega razpada leta 1918. Ime je dobila po zgodovinski pokrajini Prusiji, ki jo je večinoma nadzorovala, čeprav je imela središče v Brandenburški marki, njena prestolnica pa je bila v Berlinu.
notes: The German pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Kingdom of Prussia
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Prussia (German: Königreich Preußen, pronounced [ˈkøːnɪkʁaɪç ˈpʁɔʏsn̩] ) was a German state that existed from 1701 to 1918. It played a significant role in the unification of Germany in 1871 and was a major constituent of the German Empire until its dissolution in 1918. The Kingdom of Prussia took its name from the historical region of Prussia, and controlled most of said region, although it was based in the Margraviate of Brandenburg, and its capital was Berlin.

Kraljevina Romunija (romunsko: Regatul României) je bila ustavna monarhija, ki je obstajala od 25. marca [13. marca po starem koledarju] 1881, ko je bil knez Karl Hohenzollern-Sigmaringenški kronan za kralja Karla I. (s tem se je začela romunska kraljeva rodbina), do 30. decembra 1947, ko je kralj Mihael I. abdiciral in je romunski parlament razglasil Romunsko ljudsko republiko.

source.title: Kingdom of Romania
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Romania (Romanian: Regatul României) was a constitutional monarchy that existed from 25 March [O.S. 13 March] 1881 with the crowning of prince Karl of Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen as King Carol I (thus beginning the Romanian royal family), until 30 December 1947 with the abdication of King Michael I and the Romanian Parliament proclamation of the Romanian People's Republic.

Izraz Kraljevina Sardinija označuje savojsko državo od leta 1720 do 1861. Od leta 1720 do 1847 je h Kraljevini Sardiniji spadal le otok Sardinija, druge celinske posesti (predvsem Vojvodina Savoja, Kneževina Piemont, Grofija Nica, Vojvodina Genova in druge) pa je savojska hiša držala vsako zase. Tako je nastala sestavljena monarhija in osebna unija, ki so ji uradno rekli »dežele Njegovega Veličanstva kralja Sardinije«. To stanje je spremenil zakon o popolni združitvi (Fusione perfetta) iz leta 1847, ki je ustvaril enotno kraljevino. Kljub temu zgodovinarji pogosto uporabljajo »Sardinijo« kot sinekdoho za vso savojsko državo od leta 1720. Ker je bil Piemont sedež oblasti in najpomembnejši del države, ji pravijo tudi Sardinija-Piemont ali Piemont-Sardinija, včasih pa napačno tudi Kraljevina Piemont.

source.title: Kingdom of Sardinia (1720–1861)
paragraphs: The term Kingdom of Sardinia denotes the Savoyard state from 1720 to 1861. From 1720 to 1847, only the island of Sardinia proper was part of the Kingdom of Sardinia, while the other mainland possessions (principally the Duchy of Savoy, Principality of Piedmont, County of Nice, Duchy of Genoa, and others) were held by the House of Savoy in their own right, hence forming a composite monarchy and a personal union, which was formally referred to as the "States of His Majesty the King of Sardinia". This situation was changed by the Perfect Fusion act of 1847, which created a unitary kingdom. Regardless, historians often use "Sardinia" as a synecdoche to designate the whole Savoyard state from 1720. Because Piedmont was the seat of power and prominent part of the entity, the state is also referred to as Sardinia–Piedmont or Piedmont–Sardinia, and sometimes erroneously as the Kingdom of Piedmont.

Kraljevina Škotska je bila suverena država v severozahodni Evropi, ki naj bi bila po izročilu ustanovljena leta 843. Njeno ozemlje se je širilo in krčilo, sčasoma pa je zavzela severno tretjino otoka Velika Britanija in na jugu mejila na Kraljevino Anglijo. V srednjem veku se je Škotska občasno vojskovala z Anglijo, najbolj znane so škotske osamosvojitvene vojne, v katerih so Škoti ohranili in uveljavili svojo neodvisnost od Angležev. Ko si je Škotska leta 1266 od Norveške priključila Hebride in leta 1472 Severne otoke, Anglija pa leta 1482 zavzela Berwick, je ozemlje Kraljevine Škotske ustrezalo današnji Škotski, ki jo na vzhodu omejuje Severno morje, na severu in zahodu Atlantski ocean, na jugozahodu pa Severni preliv in Irsko morje.

source.title: Kingdom of Scotland
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Scotland was a sovereign state in northwest Europe, traditionally said to have been founded in 843. Its territories expanded and shrank, but it came to occupy the northern third of the island of Great Britain, sharing a land border to the south with the Kingdom of England. During the Middle Ages, Scotland engaged in intermittent conflict with England, most prominently the Wars of Scottish Independence, which saw the Scots maintain and assert their independence from the English. Following Scotland's annexation of the Hebrides and the Northern Isles from Norway in 1266 and 1472 respectively, and England's capture of Berwick in 1482, the territory of the Kingdom of Scotland corresponded to that of modern-day Scotland, bounded by the North Sea to the east, the Atlantic Ocean to the north and west, and the North Channel and Irish Sea to the southwest.

Kraljestvo Soissons je ime, ki so ga sodobni raziskovalci dali rimskemu »kraljestvu« iz 5. stoletja, ki mu je vladal Siagrij in je imelo središče v Soissonsu na severu današnje Francije. Raziskovalci se ne strinjajo o njegovem obsegu, trajanju in o tem, ali so ga sodobniki imeli za kraljestvo. V eni redkih omemb Siagrija ga zgodovinar Gregor iz Toursa iz 6. stoletja imenuje »kralj Rimljanov« (latinsko: rex Romanorum); tako on kot prebivalstvo, ki mu je vladal, navadno veljajo za galsko-rimske.

Leta 486 je Siagrij izgubil bitko pri Soissonsu proti frankovskemu kralju Klodviku I. in območje je nato prišlo pod nadzor Frankov. Siagrij je pobegnil v Toulouse pod zaščito Alarika II., vizigotskega kralja, ki je vladal rimskemu prebivalstvu na jugozahodu Galije. Ko je Alarik prejel Klodvikove grožnje, mu ga je izročil, Siagrija pa so v frankovskem ujetništvu nazadnje skrivaj ubili.
notes: The glossary headline is Galsko-romansko gospostvo (the Domain of Soissons); the text keeps the English article's Kraljestvo Soissons.

source.title: Kingdom of Soissons
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Soissons is the name given by modern scholars to the fifth-century "kingdom" of Romans ruled by Syagrius, which was based in Soissons in what is now northern France. There is disagreement among scholars as to both its extent, how long it existed, and whether it was considered a kingdom by contemporaries. In one of the only mentions of him, Syagrius was referred to as "king of the Romans" (Latin: rex Romanorum) by the 6th-century historian Gregory of Tours, and both he and the population he ruled are generally understood to have been Gallo-Roman.

In 486, Syagrius lost the Battle of Soissons to the Frankish king Clovis I and the domain was thereafter under the control of the Franks. Syagrius fled to Toulouse and the protection of Alaric II, the Visigothic king who ruled the Roman population in the southwest of Gaul. After receiving threats from Clovis Alaric handed him over and he was eventually killed secretly while in Frankish captivity.

Kraljestvo Južnih Sasov, danes imenovano Kraljestvo Sussex, je bilo zgodnjesrednjeveško angleško kraljestvo, eno od sedmih tradicionalnih kraljestev anglosaške Anglije. Na južni obali otoka Velika Britanija je bilo sprva saška kolonija iz 6. stoletja, pozneje pa samostojno kraljestvo.

Kraljestvo ostaja ena najmanj znanih anglosaških političnih tvorb: ohranjenega seznama kraljev ni, imelo je več krajevnih vladarjev in je bilo manj centralizirano od drugih anglosaških kraljestev. Južnim Sasom so vladali kralji Sussexa, dokler deželo verjetno leta 827, po bitki pri Ellendunu, ni priključil Wessex. Leta 860 so Sussexu vladali wessexški kralji, do leta 927 pa so vladali vsem preostalim anglosaškim kraljestvom kot delom novega Kraljestva Anglija.

source.title: Kingdom of Sussex
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the South Saxons, today referred to as the Kingdom of Sussex, was an early medieval English kingdom, constituting one of the seven traditional kingdoms of Anglo-Saxon England. On the south coast of the island of Great Britain, it was originally a sixth-century Saxon colony and later an independent kingdom.

The kingdom remains one of the least known of the Anglo-Saxon polities, with no surviving king-list, several local rulers and less centralisation than other Anglo-Saxon kingdoms. The South Saxons were ruled by the kings of Sussex until the country was annexed by Wessex, probably in 827, in the aftermath of the Battle of Ellendun. In 860 Sussex was ruled by the kings of Wessex, and by 927 all remaining Anglo-Saxon kingdoms were ruled by them as part of the new kingdom of England.

Kingdom of the Isles.headline: Kraljestvo otokov
paragraphs: Kraljestvo otokov je bilo nordijsko-gelsko kraljestvo, ki je od 9. do 13. stoletja obsegalo otok Man, Hebride in otoke v zalivu Clyde. Imenujejo ga tudi Sodor ali Sudreys, po staronordijskem imenu Suðreyjar, »južni otoki«, v nasprotju z Norðreyjar, severnimi otoki Orkney in Shetland. Nekatere poznejše vladarje so imenovali kralji Mana in otokov. Zgodovinski viri so nepopolni in kraljestvo v vsem obdobju ni bilo neprekinjena celota. Občasno je bilo neodvisno od zunanjega nadzora, čeprav so bili otoki večji del obdobja norveško odvisno ozemlje, njihovi vladarji pa so imeli nadoblastnike na Norveškem, Orkneyju ali Irskem. Kot kaže, so si občasno celotno ozemlje ali njegove dele lastili tudi tekmeci. Otoki imajo skupno več kot 8300 kvadratnih kilometrov kopnega in se raztezajo več kot 500 kilometrov od severa proti jugu.
notes: The square-mile and mile conversions are dropped.

source.title: Kingdom of the Isles
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the Isles was a Norse–Gaelic kingdom comprising the Isle of Man, the Hebrides and the islands of the Clyde from the 9th to the 13th centuries. It is also called Sodor or the Sudreys, from its Old Norse name Suðreyjar, or "Southern Isles"; as distinct from the Norðreyjar or Northern Isles of Orkney and Shetland. Some of its later rulers were referred to as kings of Mann and the Isles. The historical record is incomplete, and the kingdom was not a continuous entity throughout the whole period. At times it was independent of outside control, although for much of the period the Isles were a Norwegian dependency and its rulers had overlords in Norway, Orkney, or Ireland. At times there also appear to have been competing claims for all or parts of the territory. The islands have a total land area of over 8,300 square kilometres (3,205 sq mi) and extend for more than 500 kilometres (310 mi) from north to south.

Kraljestvo Suebov (latinsko: Regnum Suevorum), imenovano tudi Kraljestvo Galicija (latinsko: Regnum Galicia) ali suebsko kraljestvo Galicija (latinsko: Galicia suevorum regnum), je bilo germansko porimsko kraljestvo, eno prvih, ki so se odcepila od Rimskega cesarstva. Dejansko kraljestvo s središčem v nekdanjih rimskih provincah Galecija in severna Luzitanija so Suebi ustanovili okoli leta 409, v 6. stoletju pa je postalo formalno razglašeno kraljestvo, ki se je istovetilo z Galecijo. Neodvisnost je ohranilo do leta 585, ko so ga priključili Vizigoti in ga spremenili v šesto provinco Vizigotskega kraljestva v Hispaniji.

source.title: Kingdom of the Suebi
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the Suebi (Latin: Regnum Suevorum), also called the Kingdom of Galicia (Latin: Regnum Galicia) or Suebi Kingdom of Galicia (Latin: Galicia suevorum regnum), was a Germanic post-Roman kingdom that was one of the first to separate from the Roman Empire. Based in the former Roman provinces of Gallaecia and northern Lusitania, the de facto kingdom was established by the Suebi about 409, and during the 6th century it became a formally declared kingdom identifying with Gallaecia. It maintained its independence until 585, when it was annexed by the Visigoths, and was turned into the sixth province of the Visigothic Kingdom in Hispania.

Kraljevina Württemberg (nemško: Königreich Württemberg) je bila nemška država, ki je obstajala od leta 1806 do 1918 na ozemlju današnje južnonemške zvezne dežele Baden-Württemberg. Nastala je v obdobju ozemeljske preureditve po razpadu Svetega rimskega cesarstva leta 1806, ko je bila Volilna kneževina Württemberg v okviru Napoleonovega preurejanja nemških dežel povzdignjena v kraljevino.

Kraljevina Württemberg je bila pravna in politična naslednica Volilne kneževine Württemberg, ki je nastala leta 1803 med nemško mediatizacijo (Reichsdeputationshauptschluss), ko so številna cerkvena ozemlja in svobodna cesarska mesta sekularizirali in jih vključili v večje ozemeljske države. Württemberški vojvoda Friderik II. je bil leta 1803 povzdignjen v volilnega kneza (Kurfürst) in je s priključitvijo nekdanjih cesarskih mest in cerkvenih zemljišč precej povečal svoje ozemlje.
notes: The German pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Kingdom of Württemberg
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Württemberg (German: Königreich Württemberg [ˌkøːnɪkʁaɪç ˈvʏʁtəmbɛʁk]) was a German state that existed from 1806 to 1918, occupying territory in what is now the southern German federal state of Baden-Württemberg. The kingdom emerged during the period of territorial reorganisation that followed the dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire in 1806, when the Electorate of Württemberg was elevated to royal status as part of Napoleon’s restructuring of the German lands.

The Kingdom of Württemberg was the legal and political successor to the Electorate of Württemberg, which itself had been created in 1803 during the process of German mediatization (Reichsdeputationshauptschluss), when numerous ecclesiastical territories and free imperial cities were secularised and incorporated into larger territorial states. Duke Frederick II of Württemberg was raised to the dignity of Elector (Kurfürst) in 1803, substantially enlarging his territory through the annexation of former imperial cities and church lands.

Koliivshchyna.headline: Kolijivščina
paragraphs: Kolijivščina (ukrajinsko: Коліївщина; poljsko: koliszczyzna) je bila velika hajdamaška vstaja, ki je junija 1768 izbruhnila v desnobrežni Ukrajini zaradi nezadovoljstva kmetov z ravnanjem barske konfederacije s pravoslavnimi kristjani in s tlačanstvom ter zaradi sovražnosti kozakov in kmetov do krajevnega poloniziranega rutenskega plemstva in etničnih Poljakov. Vstajo so spremljali pogromi nad resničnimi in namišljenimi podporniki barske konfederacije, zlasti etničnimi Poljaki, Judi, rimokatoličani in posebej grkokatoliškimi duhovniki in verniki. Vrhunec je bil pokol v Umanu. Število žrtev ocenjujejo na 100.000 do 200.000. Številne skupnosti narodnih manjšin (na primer starovercev, Armencev, muslimanov in Grkov) so na območjih, ki jih je vstaja opustošila, povsem izginile.

source.title: Koliivshchyna
paragraphs: The Koliivshchyna (Ukrainian: Коліївщина; Polish: koliszczyzna) was a major haidamaky rebellion that broke out in Right-bank Ukraine in June 1768, caused by the dissatisfaction of peasants with the treatment of Orthodox Christians by the Bar Confederation and serfdom, as well as by hostility of Cossacks and peasants to the local Polonized Ruthenian nobility and ethnic Poles. The uprising was accompanied by pogroms against both real and imagined supporters of the Bar Confederation, particularly ethnic Poles, Jews, Roman Catholics, and especially Byzantine Catholic priests and laity. This culminated in the massacre of Uman. The number of victims is estimated from 100,000 to 200,000. Many communities of national minorities (such as Old Believers, Armenians, Muslims and Greeks) completely disappeared in the areas devastated by the uprising.

Vojna na Kosovu (albansko: Lufta e Kosovës; srbsko: Косовски рат, Kosovski rat) je bila oborožen spopad na Kosovu, ki je trajal od 28. februarja 1998 do 11. junija 1999. Bojevale so se sile Zvezne republike Jugoslavije (ZRJ), ki je pred vojno nadzorovala Kosovo, in kosovskoalbanska separatistična milica, znana kot Osvobodilna vojska Kosova (OVK). Spopad se je končal, ko je Organizacija Severnoatlantske pogodbe (Nato) posredovala z letalskimi napadi, ki jih je začela marca 1999, zaradi česar so se jugoslovanske sile umaknile s Kosova.

source.title: Kosovo War
paragraphs: The Kosovo War (Albanian: Lufta e Kosovës; Serbian: Косовски рат, Kosovski rat) was an armed conflict in Kosovo that lasted from 28 February 1998 until 11 June 1999. It was fought between the forces of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia (FRY), which controlled Kosovo before the war, and the Kosovo Albanian separatist militia known as the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA). The conflict ended when the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) intervened by beginning air strikes in March 1999 which resulted in Yugoslav forces withdrawing from Kosovo.

Kraków Uprising.headline: Krakovska vstaja
paragraphs: Krakovska vstaja leta 1846 (poljsko: powstanie krakowskie, rewolucja krakowska; nemško: Krakauer Aufstand; rusko: краковское восстание) je bila poskus poljskih upornikov pod vodstvom Jana Tyssowskega in Edwarda Dembowskega, da bi sprožili boj za narodno neodvisnost. Njeno središče je bil Krakov, prestolnica majhnega Svobodnega mesta Krakov. Usmerjena je bila proti silam, ki so si razdelile Poljsko, zlasti proti bližnjemu Avstrijskemu cesarstvu. Trajala je približno devet dni in se končala z avstrijsko zmago.
notes: The romanization of the Russian name is dropped; the Cyrillic stays.

source.title: Kraków Uprising
paragraphs: The Kraków Uprising (Polish: powstanie krakowskie, rewolucja krakowska; German: Krakauer Aufstand; Russian: краковское восстание, romanized: krakovskoye vosstaniye) of 1846 was an attempt, led by Polish insurgents such as Jan Tyssowski and Edward Dembowski, to incite a fight for national independence. The uprising was centered on the city of Kraków, the capital of the small Free City of Cracow. It was directed at the powers that partitioned Poland, especially the nearby Austrian Empire. The uprising lasted about nine days and ended with an Austrian victory.

Kresna–Razlog uprising.headline: Kresnensko-razloška vstaja
paragraphs: Kresnensko-razloška vstaja (bolgarsko: Кресненско-Разложко въстание), znana tudi kot kresnenska vstaja (makedonsko: Кресненско востание), je bila protiosmanska bolgarska vstaja v osmanski Makedoniji, predvsem na območju današnje Blagoevgrajske pokrajine v Bolgariji, konec leta 1878 in v začetku leta 1879. Uporniki so jo imenovali makedonska vstaja.

source.title: Kresna–Razlog uprising
paragraphs: The Kresna–Razlog uprising (Bulgarian: Кресненско-Разложко въстание, romanized: Kresnensko-Razlozhko vastanie), also known as the Kresna uprising (Macedonian: Кресненско востание, romanized: Kresnensko vostanie), was an anti-Ottoman Bulgarian uprising that took place in Ottoman Macedonia, predominantly in the areas of modern Blagoevgrad Province in Bulgaria in late 1878 and early 1879. It was named by the insurgents as the Macedonian uprising.

Kumanovo Agreement.headline: Kumanovski sporazum
paragraphs: Vojaško-tehnični sporazum, znan tudi kot kumanovski sporazum, ki so ga podpisale Mednarodne varnostne sile (KFOR) ter vladi Zvezne republike Jugoslavije in Republike Srbije, je bil dogovor, sklenjen 9. junija 1999 v Kumanovem v Makedoniji. Z njim se je končala vojna na Kosovu, vzpostavil pa je tudi nova temeljna razmerja med Jugoslavijo in silami za Kosovo, ki naj bi nadomestile enote jugoslovanske vojske na Kosovu.

source.title: Kumanovo Agreement
paragraphs: The Military Technical Agreement, also known as the Kumanovo Agreement, signed between the International Security Force (KFOR) and the Governments of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia and the Republic of Serbia, was an accord concluded on 9 June 1999 in Kumanovo, Macedonia. It resulted in the end of the Kosovo War, and established new basic relations between Yugoslavia and the Kosovo Force, which would replace units of the Yugoslav Army in Kosovo.

Lamijska vojna ali helenska vojna (323–322 pr. n. št.) je bila neuspešen poskus Aten in velike koalicije grških držav, da bi tik po smrti Aleksandra Velikega končale makedonsko hegemonijo nad Grčijo. Atene so takrat zadnjič imele pomembno vlogo kot samostojna sila.

source.title: Lamian War
paragraphs: The Lamian War or the Hellenic War (323–322 BC), was an unsuccessful attempt by Athens and a large coalition of Greek states to end the hegemony of Macedonia over Greece just after the death of Alexander the Great. It was the last time Athens played a significant role as an independent power.

Landgraviate of Brabant.headline: Deželna grofija Brabant
paragraphs: Deželna grofija Brabant (sodobno nizozemsko: Landgraafschap Brabant, sodobno francosko: Landgraviat de Brabant) je bila majhen cesarski fevd zahodno od Bruslja, ki je obsegal območje med rekama Dender in Zenne v Nizkih deželah, tedaj delu Svetega rimskega cesarstva.

Pred letom 1085 je zemlja pripadala Hermanu II., lotarinškemu palatinskemu grofu. Po njegovi smrti jo je cesar Henrik IV. dodelil Henriku III., grofu Leuvena in Bruslja, in mu podelil deželno grofijo Brabant. To je najzgodnejša znana raba izraza deželni grof.
Leta 1183 je cesar Friderik Barbarossa deželno grofijo Brabant ter grofiji Leuven in Bruselj formalno združil in povzdignil v Vojvodino Brabant; Henrik I. je postal prvi brabantski vojvoda.

source.title: Landgraviate of Brabant
paragraphs: The Landgraviate of Brabant (Modern Dutch: Landgraafschap Brabant, Modern French: Landgraviat de Brabant) was a small imperial fiefdom west of Brussels, consisting of the area between the Dender and Zenne rivers in the Low Countries, then part of the Holy Roman Empire.

Before 1085 the land had belonged to Hermann II, Count Palatine of Lotharingia. Upon his death, Emperor Henry IV assigned it to Henry III, Count of Louvain and Brussels, granting him the Landgraviate of Brabant. This is the earliest known use of the term landgrave.

In 1183 the landgraviate of Brabant and the counties of Louvain and Brussels were formally merged and elevated together into the Duchy of Brabant, by Emperor Frederick Barbarossa; Henry I became the first duke of Brabant.

Left SR uprising.headline: Upor levih eserjev
paragraphs: Upor levih eserjev je bil upor Stranke levih socialistov revolucionarjev proti boljševikom v Moskvi v Sovjetski Rusiji 6. in 7. julija 1918. Bil je eden od več levičarskih uporov proti boljševikom med rusko državljansko vojno.

Levi eserji so po oktobrski revoluciji leta 1917 vstopili v boljševiško vlado Sovjetske Rusije, a so marca 1918 v znak protesta proti brestlitovskemu miru izstopili iz Sveta ljudskih komisarjev. Še naprej so delovali v drugih organizacijah (zlasti v Čeki), hkrati pa obsojali pogodbo in politiko rekvizicije žita od kmetov.

source.title: Left SR uprising
paragraphs: The Left SR uprising, or Left SR revolt, was a rebellion against the Bolsheviks by the Left Socialist Revolutionary Party in Moscow, Soviet Russia, on 6–7 July 1918. It was one of a number of left-wing uprisings against the Bolsheviks that took place during the Russian Civil War.

The Left SRs had entered the Bolshevik government of Soviet Russia after the October Revolution of 1917, but resigned from the Council of People's Commissars in March 1918 in protest of the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk. Left SRs continued to work in other organizations (notably the Cheka) while denouncing the treaty and the policy of requisitioning grain from the peasants.

Legionnaires' rebellion and Bucharest po.headline: Upor legionarjev in bukareški pogrom
paragraphs: Od 21. do 23. januarja 1941 se je v Bukarešti v Romuniji uprla paravojaška organizacija Železna garda, katere člane so imenovali legionarji. Legionarji so se uprli, ker jim je conducător Ion Antonescu postopoma odvzemal privilegije. Med uporom in pogromom, ki je sledil, je Železna garda ubila 125 Judov, v spopadih z uporniki pa je umrlo 30 vojakov. Po tem so gibanje Železne garde prepovedali, 9000 njegovih članov pa zaprli.

source.title: Legionnaires' rebellion and Bucharest pogrom
paragraphs: Between 21 and 23 January 1941, a rebellion of the Iron Guard paramilitary organization, whose members were known as Legionnaires, occurred in Bucharest, Romania. As their privileges were being gradually removed by the Conducător Ion Antonescu, the Legionnaires revolted. During the rebellion and subsequent pogrom, the Iron Guard killed 125 Jews, and 30 soldiers died in the confrontation with the rebels. Following this, the Iron Guard movement was banned and 9,000 of its members were imprisoned.

Lelantine War.headline: Lelantska vojna
paragraphs: Lelantska vojna je bila vojaški spopad med starogrškima mestnima državama Halkido in Eretrijo na Evbeji v zgodnji arhaični dobi, med približno 710 in 650 pr. n. št. Po izročilu je bil povod boj za rodovitno Lelantsko ravnico na otoku Evbeja. Zaradi gospodarskega pomena obeh polisov se je spopad močno razširil: na eno ali drugo stran so se postavile še številne mestne države, tako da je bil v vojni velik del Grčije. Zgodovinar Tukidid opisuje lelantsko vojno kot izjemo, edino vojno v Grčiji med mitsko trojansko vojno in perzijskimi vojnami v začetku 5. stoletja pr. n. št., v kateri so sodelovala zavezništva mest in ne posamezna mesta.
Antični avtorji običajno govorijo o vojni med Halkidijci in Eretrijci (starogrško: πόλεμος Χαλκιδέων καὶ Ἐρετριῶν).
V vojni med Halkido in Eretrijo se je večina mest preostale Grčije razdelila v zavezništva z eno ali drugo stranjo.

source.title: Lelantine War
paragraphs: The Lelantine War was a military conflict between the two ancient Greek city states Chalcis and Eretria in Euboea which took place in the early Archaic period, between c. 710 and 650 BC. The reason for war was, according to tradition, the struggle for the fertile Lelantine Plain on the island of Euboea. Due to the economic importance of the two participating poleis, the conflict spread considerably, with multiple further city states joining either side, resulting in much of Greece being at war. The historian Thucydides describes the Lelantine War as exceptional, the only war in Greece between the mythical Trojan War and the Persian Wars of the early 5th century BC in which allied cities rather than single ones were involved.
Ancient authors normally refer to the War between Chalcidians and Eretrians (ancient Greek: πόλεμος Χαλκιδέων καὶ Ἐρετριῶν pólemos Chalkidéon kaì Eretriōn).
The war between Chalcis and Eretria was the one in which most cities belonging to the rest of Greece were divided up into alliances with one side or the other.

Li–Lobanov Treaty.headline: Pogodba Li-Lobanov
paragraphs: Pogodba Li-Lobanov ali kitajsko-ruska tajna pogodba (kitajsko: 中俄密約; rusko: Союзный договор между Российской империей и Китаем) je bila tajna in neenakopravna pogodba, ki sta jo 3. junija 1896 v Moskvi podpisala zunanji minister Aleksej Lobanov-Rostovski v imenu Ruskega cesarstva in podkralj Li Hongzhang v imenu kitajske dinastije Qing. Pogodba in njene posledice so na Kitajskem okrepile protitujska čustva, ki so dosegla vrhunec z boksarsko vstajo leta 1900.
Vsebino sporazuma so objavili šele leta 1922.

source.title: Li–Lobanov Treaty
paragraphs: The Li–Lobanov Treaty or the Sino-Russian Secret Treaty (Chinese: 中俄密約; Russian: Союзный договор между Российской империей и Китаем) was a secret and unequal treaty signed on June 3, 1896 in Moscow by foreign minister Alexey Lobanov-Rostovsky on behalf of the Russian Empire and viceroy Li Hongzhang on behalf of Qing China. The treaty and its consequences increased anti-foreign sentiment in China, which came to a head in the Boxer Uprising of 1900.
The contents of the agreement were made public only in 1922.

Liberalna revolucija leta 1820 (portugalsko: Revolução Liberal) je bila portugalska politična revolucija, ki je izbruhnila leta 1820. Začela se je z vojaško vstajo v mestu Porto na severu Portugalske, ki se je hitro in mirno razširila na preostanek države. Revolucija je privedla do tega, da se je portugalski dvor leta 1821 vrnil na Portugalsko iz Brazilije, kamor je pobegnil med polotoško vojno, in začela ustavno obdobje, v katerem so ratificirali in uveljavili ustavo iz leta 1822. Liberalne ideje gibanja so v 19. stoletju pomembno vplivale na portugalsko družbo in politično ureditev.

source.title: Liberal Revolution of 1820
paragraphs: The Liberal Revolution of 1820 (Portuguese: Revolução Liberal) was a Portuguese political revolution that erupted in 1820. It began with a military insurrection in the city of Porto, in northern Portugal, that quickly and peacefully spread to the rest of the country. The Revolution resulted in the return in 1821 of the Portuguese court to Portugal from Brazil, where it had fled during the Peninsular War, and initiated a constitutional period in which the 1822 Constitution was ratified and implemented. The movement's liberal ideas had an important influence on Portuguese society and political organization in the nineteenth century.

Liberalne vojne (portugalsko: Guerras Liberais), znane tudi kot portugalska državljanska vojna (Guerra Civil Portuguesa) in vojna dveh bratov (Guerra dos Dois Irmãos), so bile državljanska vojna na Portugalskem, ki je trajala od maja 1828 do maja 1834; v njej so se liberalni napredni konstitucionalisti (pod vodstvom nekdanjega kralja Pedra IV.) in konservativni tradicionalisti (pod vodstvom kralja Miguela I.) bojevali za državno ureditev in kraljevo nasledstvo. Vpletene so bile Kraljevina Portugalska, portugalski uporniki, Združeno kraljestvo, Francija, katoliška Cerkev, Španija in Rusija.

source.title: Liberal Wars
paragraphs: The Liberal Wars (Portuguese: Guerras Liberais), also known as the Portuguese Civil War (Guerra Civil Portuguesa) and the War of the Two Brothers (Guerra dos Dois Irmãos) was a civil war in Portugal that lasted from May 1828 to May 1834, fought between liberal progressive constitutionalists (led by former King Pedro IV) and conservative traditionalists (led by King Miguel I) over the country's system of government and royal succession. Embroiled parties included the Kingdom of Portugal, Portuguese rebels, the United Kingdom, France, the Catholic Church, Spain and Russia.

Liège Revolution.headline: Lieška revolucija
paragraphs: Lieška revolucija, včasih imenovana tudi srečna revolucija (francosko: Heureuse Révolution; valonsko: Binamêye revolucion), proti vladajočemu lieškemu knezu-škofu se je začela 18. avgusta 1789 in trajala do leta 1791, ko so avstrijske sile uničile Lieško republiko in obnovile Lieško knežjo škofijo. Potekala je hkrati s francosko revolucijo, njeni učinki pa so bili dolgotrajni in so nazadnje privedli do odprave Lieške knežje škofije, ki so jo francoske revolucionarne sile leta 1795 dokončno priključile.

source.title: Liège Revolution
paragraphs: The Liège Revolution, sometimes known as the Fortunate Revolution (French: Heureuse Révolution; Walloon: Binamêye revolucion), against the reigning prince-bishop of Liège, started on 18 August 1789 and lasted until the destruction of the Republic of Liège and re-establishment of the Prince-Bishopric of Liège by Austrian forces in 1791. The Liège Revolution was concurrent with the French Revolution and its effects were long-lasting and eventually led to the abolition of the Prince-Bishopric of Liège and its final annexation by French revolutionary forces in 1795.

Lisbon Recognition Convention.headline: Lizbonska konvencija o priznavanju
paragraphs: Lizbonska konvencija o priznavanju, uradno Konvencija o priznavanju kvalifikacij v visokem šolstvu v evropski regiji, je mednarodna konvencija, ki sta jo skupaj pripravila Svet Evrope in UNESCO. To je glavni pravni dogovor o vrednotenju kvalifikacij v Evropi.

Do leta 2026 je konvencijo ratificiralo 57 držav, med njimi vse države članice Sveta Evrope v Strasbourgu in 56 članic UNESCA. Ratificirale so jo tudi države nečlanice Sveta Evrope Avstralija, Belorusija, Kanada, Sveti sedež, Izrael, Kazahstan, Kirgizistan, Tadžikistan, Turkmenistan in Nova Zelandija. Združene države so konvencijo podpisale, niso pa je ratificirale. Lizbonska konvencija o priznavanju je edina mednarodna pravna pogodba evropskega visokošolskega prostora, ratificirale pa so jo vse države članice EHEA.
Konvencija in spremni dokumenti so mejniki pri izboljševanju poštenega priznavanja izobraževalnih dosežkov prek meja. Pomembni so tudi nekateri spremni dokumenti.
notes: The English excerpt ends with a colon before a list of subsidiary documents it leaves out; the Slovenian ends the sentence with a full stop.

source.title: Lisbon Recognition Convention
paragraphs: The Lisbon Recognition Convention, officially the Convention on the Recognition of Qualifications concerning Higher Education in the European Region, is an international convention jointly developed by the Council of Europe and UNESCO. This is the main legal agreement on credential evaluation in Europe.

As of 2026, the convention has been ratified by 57 states, including all member states the Council of Europe in Strasbourg and 56 members of UNESCO. It has also been ratified by the Council of Europe non-member states Australia, Belarus, Canada, the Holy See, Israel, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and New Zealand. The United States has signed but not ratified the convention. The Lisbon Recognition Convention is the only international legal treaty of the European Higher Education Area, and all EHEA member States have ratified the Convention.
The Convention and subsidiary documents are milestones in the enhancement of fair recognition of educational achievements across borders. Noteworthy subsidiary documents are:

Lithuanian–Muscovite War (1368–1372).headline: Litovsko-moskovska vojna (1368–1372)
paragraphs: Litovsko-moskovska vojna, v Rogoški kroniki imenovana Litovščina (rusko: Литовщина), je obsegala tri pohode litovskega velikega kneza Algirdasa nad Moskovsko kneževino v letih 1368, 1370 in 1372. Algirdas je pohode proti Dmitriju Donskemu organiziral v podporo Tverski kneževini, glavni tekmici Moskve. Litovci so leta 1368 in 1370 oblegali Moskvo in požgali posad, niso pa zavzeli mestnega kremlja. Leta 1372 so litovsko vojsko ustavili pri Ljubucku, kjer so po soočenju sklenili mir v Ljubucku. Litovci so se zavezali, da bodo prenehali pomagati Tveru, ki je bil leta 1375 poražen. Tverski knez Mihail II. je moral Dmitrija priznati za »starejšega brata«.

source.title: Lithuanian–Muscovite War (1368–1372)
paragraphs: The Lithuanian–Muscovite War, known in the Rogozh Chronicle as Litovschina (Russian: Литовщина), encompasses three raids by Algirdas, Grand Duke of Lithuania, to the Principality of Moscow in 1368, 1370, and 1372. Algirdas organized the raids against Dmitry Donskoy in support of the Principality of Tver, chief rival of Moscow. In 1368 and 1370, Lithuanians besieged Moscow and burned the posad, but did not succeed in taking the city's Kremlin. In 1372, the Lithuanian army was stopped near Lyubutsk where, after a standoff, the Treaty of Lyubutsk was concluded. Lithuanians agreed to cease their aid to Tver, which was defeated in 1375. Mikhail II of Tver had to acknowledge Dmitry as "elder brother".

Litvinov Protocol.headline: Litvinovov protokol
paragraphs: Litvinovov protokol je splošno ime mednarodne mirovne pogodbe, sklenjene 9. februarja 1929 v Moskvi. Ime je dobila po glavnem sovjetskem diplomatu, ki je vodil pogajanja, Maksimu Litvinovu; pogodba je določala, da podpisnice Kellogg-Briandov pakt uveljavijo takoj, s čimer so se formalno odpovedale vojni kot sredstvu nacionalne zunanje politike.

Uradno ime Litvinovovega protokola, kakor je bil vpisan pri Društvu narodov, je bilo »Protokol o takojšnji uveljavitvi Pariške pogodbe z dne 27. avgusta 1928 o odpovedi vojni kot sredstvu nacionalne politike«. Pogodbo včasih imenujejo tudi »moskovski protokol«.

Prve podpisnice Litvinovovega protokola so bile Zveza sovjetskih socialističnih republik (Sovjetska zveza), Poljska, Latvija, Estonija in Romunija. Štiri druge države so k protokolu pozneje formalno pristopile: Litva, Finska, Turčija in Perzija.

source.title: Litvinov Protocol
paragraphs: The Litvinov Protocol is the common name of an international peace treaty concluded in Moscow on February 9, 1929. Named after the chief Soviet diplomat moving the negotiations forward, Maxim Litvinov, the treaty provided for immediate implementation of the Kellogg-Briand Pact by its signatories, thereby formally renouncing war as a part of national foreign policy.

The formal name of the Litvinov Protocol as registered with the League of Nations was the "Protocol for the Immediate Entry into Force of the Treaty of Paris of August 27, 1928, Regarding Renunciation of War as an Instrument of National Policy." The treaty is also sometimes known as the "Moscow Protocol."

Initial signatories of the Litvinov Protocol included the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (Soviet Union), Poland, Latvia, Estonia, and Romania. Four other countries later formally adhered to the protocol: Lithuania, Finland, Turkey, and Persia.

Locarno Treaties.headline: Locarnske pogodbe
paragraphs: Locarnske pogodbe, s skupnim imenom locarnski pakt, so obsegale sedem sporazumov po prvi svetovni vojni, o katerih so se konec leta 1925 pogajale Nemčija, Francija, Združeno kraljestvo, Belgija, Italija, Poljska in Češkoslovaška. V glavni pogodbi se je pet zahodnoevropskih držav zavezalo, da bodo jamčile nedotakljivost nemško-francoske in nemško-belgijske meje, kot ju je določila versajska mirovna pogodba. Obljubile so tudi, da bodo spoštovale demilitarizirano območje nemškega Porenja in razlike reševale mirno pod okriljem Društva narodov. V dodatnih arbitražnih pogodbah s Poljsko in Češkoslovaško je Nemčija privolila v mirno reševanje sporov, pomenljivo pa ni bilo nobenega jamstva za njeno vzhodno mejo, zato je Nemčiji ostala odprta pot, da bi skušala revidirati versajsko pogodbo in si povrniti ozemlja, ki jih je po njej izgubila na vzhodu.

Locarnske pogodbe so v letih 1925–1930 občutno izboljšale politično ozračje v zahodni Evropi in vzbudile pričakovanja o nadaljnjem mirnem reševanju sporov, ki so jih pogosto imenovali »locarnski duh«.

source.title: Locarno Treaties
paragraphs: The Locarno Treaties, known collectively as the Locarno Pact, were seven post–World War I agreements negotiated amongst Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium, Italy, Poland and Czechoslovakia in late 1925. In the main treaty, the five western European nations pledged to guarantee the inviolability of the German-French and German-Belgian borders as defined in the Treaty of Versailles. They also promised to observe the demilitarized zone of the German Rhineland and to resolve differences peacefully under the auspices of the League of Nations. In the additional arbitration treaties with Poland and Czechoslovakia, Germany agreed to the peaceful settlement of disputes, but there was notably no guarantee of its eastern border, leaving the path open for Germany to attempt to revise the Versailles Treaty and regain territory it had lost in the east under its terms.

The Locarno Treaties significantly improved the political climate of western Europe from 1925 to 1930 and fostered expectations for continued peaceful settlements which were often referred to as the "spirit of Locarno".

London Agreement on German External Debt.headline: Londonski sporazum o nemških zunanjih dolgovih
paragraphs: Londonski sporazum o nemških zunanjih dolgovih, znan tudi kot londonski dolžniški sporazum (nemško: Londoner Schuldenabkommen), je bil pogodba o olajšanju dolgov med Zvezno republiko Nemčijo in državami upnicami. Sporazum je bil podpisan 27. februarja 1953 v Londonu, veljati pa je začel 16. septembra 1953.

source.title: London Agreement on German External Debts
paragraphs: The London Agreement on German External Debts, also known as the London Debt Agreement (German: Londoner Schuldenabkommen), was a debt relief treaty between the Federal Republic of Germany and creditor nations. The Agreement was signed in London on 27 February 1953, and came into force on 16 September 1953.

London Declaration.headline: Londonska deklaracija
paragraphs: Londonska deklaracija je izjava konference predsednikov vlad Commonwealtha leta 1949 o nadaljnjem članstvu Indije v Commonwealthu narodov, združenju neodvisnih držav, ki so bile nekoč del Britanskega imperija, ob pričakovanem prehodu Indije na republikansko ustavo.

Deklaracijo sta skupaj pripravila V. K. Krishna Menon, ustavni svetovalec predsednika vlade Džavaharlala Nehruja, in sir Norman Brook, tajnik britanske vlade. Deklaracija je navajala, da se predsedniki vlad strinjajo z nadaljnjim članstvom Indije v organizaciji tudi potem, ko postane republika. Z deklaracijo je indijska vlada izrazila, da sprejema kralja kot simbol svobodne zveze neodvisnih držav članic in vodjo Commonwealtha.

source.title: London Declaration
paragraphs: The London Declaration was issued by the 1949 Commonwealth Prime Ministers' Conference regarding India's continued membership of the Commonwealth of Nations, an association of independent states formerly part of the British Empire, in anticipation of India's transition to a republican constitution.

The declaration was drafted jointly by V. K. Krishna Menon, a constitutional advisor to Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru, and Sir Norman Brook, the British Cabinet secretary. The declaration stated the prime ministers' agreement to India's continued membership in the organization after it became a republic. By that declaration, the Government of India had expressed its acceptance of the King as a symbol of the free association of its independent member nations and head of the Commonwealth.

London Naval Treaty.headline: Londonska pomorska pogodba
paragraphs: Londonska pomorska pogodba, uradno Pogodba o omejitvi in zmanjšanju pomorske oborožitve, je bila sporazum med Združenim kraljestvom, Japonsko, Francijo, Italijo in Združenimi državami, podpisan 22. aprila 1930. Novi sporazum je obravnaval vprašanja, ki jih ni zajemala washingtonska pomorska pogodba iz leta 1922, ki je posameznim državam določila omejitve tonaže površinskih vojnih ladij: urejal je podmorniško vojskovanje, dodatno nadziral križarke in rušilce ter omejil gradnjo vojnih ladij.
Ratifikacijske listine so izmenjali 27. oktobra 1930 v Londonu in pogodba je začela veljati istega dne, vendar je bila večinoma neučinkovita.
Pogodba je bila 6. februarja 1931 registrirana v zbirki pogodb Društva narodov.

source.title: London Naval Treaty
paragraphs: The London Naval Treaty, officially the Treaty for the Limitation and Reduction of Naval Armament, was an agreement between the United Kingdom, Japan, France, Italy, and the United States that was signed on 22 April 1930. Seeking to address issues not covered in the 1922 Washington Naval Treaty, which had created tonnage limits for each nation's surface warships, the new agreement regulated submarine warfare, further controlled cruisers and destroyers, and limited naval shipbuilding.
Ratifications were exchanged in London on 27 October 1930, and the treaty went into effect on the same day, but it was largely ineffective.
The treaty was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 6 February 1931.

London Protocol (1852).headline: Londonski protokol (1852)
paragraphs: Po prvi schleswiški vojni je bil 8. maja 1852 podpisan sporazum, imenovan londonski protokol (nemško: Londoner Protokoll; dansko: Londonprotokollerne). Ta mednarodna pogodba je bila revizija prejšnjega protokola, ki sta ga 2. avgusta 1850 ratificirali veliki nemški sili Avstrija in Prusija.
Drugi londonski protokol je priznalo pet velikih evropskih sil – Avstrija, Francija, Prusija, Rusija in Združeno kraljestvo – ter baltski sili Danska in Švedska.
notes: The English source breaks its last sentence across the two paragraphs; the Slovenian moves the break to the sentence boundary.

source.title: London Protocol (1852)
paragraphs: On 8 May 1852, after the First War of Schleswig, an agreement called the London Protocol (German: Londoner Protokoll; Danish: Londonprotokollerne) was signed. This international treaty was the revision of an earlier protocol, which had been ratified on 2 August 1850, by the major German powers of Austria and Prussia. The second London Protocol was recognised by the five major European powers—Austria, France, Prussia, Russia, and the United Kingdom—as well as by the Baltic Sea powers of
Denmark and Sweden.

Louvre Accord.headline: Louvrski sporazum
paragraphs: Louvrski sporazum (uradno Izjava finančnih ministrov in guvernerjev centralnih bank skupine G6) je bil sporazum, podpisan 22. februarja 1987 v Parizu, katerega cilj je bil stabilizirati mednarodne valutne trge in ustaviti nadaljnje padanje ameriškega dolarja, ki se je začelo leta 1985 po sporazumu Plaza. Z vidika teorije relacijskih mednarodnih pogodb je veljal za racionalno kompromisno rešitev med dvema idealnotipskima skrajnostma mednarodnih denarnih ureditev: popolnoma prožnimi in popolnoma fiksnimi deviznimi tečaji.
Sporazum so podpisale Kanada, Francija, Zahodna Nemčija, Japonska, Združeno kraljestvo in Združene države. Italijanska vlada je bila povabljena k podpisu, a ga je zavrnila.

source.title: Louvre Accord
paragraphs: The Louvre Accord (formally, the Statement of the G6 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors) was an agreement, signed on February 22, 1987, in Paris, that aimed to stabilize international currency markets and halt the continued decline of the US dollar after 1985 following the Plaza Accord. It was considered, from a relational international contract viewpoint, as a rational compromise solution between two ideal-type extremes of international monetary regimes: the perfectly flexible and the perfectly fixed exchange rates.
The agreement was signed by Canada, France, West Germany, Japan, the United Kingdom, and the United States. The Italian government was invited to sign the agreement but declined.

Kampanja v Luganski oblasti je vojaška kampanja, ki od 19. septembra 2022 med rusko invazijo na Ukrajino poteka ob frontni črti v zahodnih delih Luganske oblasti in na skrajnem vzhodu Harkovske oblasti. Frontno črto imenujejo črta Svatove–Kremina ali črta Kupjansk–Svatove–Kremina–Bilohorivka, po večjih naseljih ob njej.
notes: The glossary had Kampanja v Luhanski oblasti; an override now gives Luganski, the form used in all the other summaries.

source.title: Luhansk Oblast campaign
paragraphs: Since 19 September 2022, a military campaign has taken place along a frontline in western parts of Luhansk Oblast and far-eastern parts of Kharkiv Oblast amid the Russian invasion of Ukraine. The frontline has been referred to as the Svatove–Kreminna line or the Kupiansk–Svatove–Kreminna–Bilohorivka line, after the major settlements that lie along it.

Luxembourg compromise.headline: Luksemburški kompromis
paragraphs: Luksemburški kompromis (ali luksemburški sporazum) je bil dogovor, dosežen januarja 1966, s katerim so razrešili »krizo praznega stola«, ki je povzročila zastoj v Evropski gospodarski skupnosti (EGS).

source.title: Luxembourg compromise
paragraphs: The Luxembourg compromise (or Luxembourg accord) was an agreement reached in January 1966 to resolve the "Empty Chair Crisis" which had caused a stalemate within the European Economic Community (EEC).

Madrid Accords.headline: Madridski sporazumi
paragraphs: Madridski sporazumi, uradno Deklaracija o načelih glede Zahodne Sahare, so bili pogodba med Španijo, Marokom in Mavretanijo, ki je določila šest načel za konec španske navzočnosti na ozemlju Španske Sahare in za začasno upravo območja do referenduma.

Ozemlje je bilo španska provinca in nekdanja kolonija. Sporazum je bil podpisan 14. novembra 1975 v Madridu, šest dni pred smrtjo španskega diktatorja Francisca Franca, vendar ni bil nikoli objavljen v uradnem listu Boletín Oficial del Estado. Bil je v nasprotju z zakonom o dekolonizaciji Sahare, ki ga je španski parlament (Cortes) ratificiral 18. novembra.

Po madridskem sporazumu naj bi si ozemlje razdelila Maroko in Mavretanija, pri čemer niti fronta Polisario niti saharsko ljudstvo nasploh nista imela nobene vloge. Po sporazumih se je Polisario z mavretanske meje preselil v Alžirijo.

source.title: Madrid Accords
paragraphs: The Madrid Accords, formally the Declaration of Principles on Western Sahara, was a treaty between Spain, Morocco, and Mauritania setting out six principles which would end the Spanish presence in the territory of Spanish Sahara and arrange a temporary administration in the area pending a referendum.

The territory had been a Spanish province and former colony. The agreement was signed in Madrid on November 14, 1975, six days before Spanish dictator Francisco Franco died, although it was never published on the Boletin Oficial del Estado. This agreement conflicted with the Law on decolonization of Sahara, ratified by the Spanish Parliament (Cortes) on November 18.

Under the Madrid agreement, the territory would then be divided between Morocco and Mauritania, with no role for either the Polisario Front or the Sahrawi people generally. Following the accords, the Polisario relocated from the Mauritanian border to Algeria.

Madrid Protocol.headline: Madridski protokol
paragraphs: Madridski sistem, znan tudi kot madridski protokol, je glavni mednarodni sistem za lažjo registracijo blagovnih znamk v več jurisdikcijah po svetu. Vzpostavljen je bil na podlagi večstranskih pogodb, Madridskega sporazuma o mednarodni registraciji znamk iz leta 1891 in Protokola k Madridskemu sporazumu (1989), ki je od leta 2016 edina veljavna pogodba sistema.

Madridski sistem omogoča centralno upravljano pridobivanje več registracij znamke v ločenih jurisdikcijah; ne ustvarja enotne registracije za različne jurisdikcije, kot jo na primer sistem blagovne znamke Evropske unije. Prijavitelji vložijo eno mednarodno prijavo znamke in plačajo en sklop pristojbin ter tako zaprosijo za varstvo v kateri koli ali vseh državah članicah sistema; vsaka država sama odloči, ali bo prijavi ugodila. Ko urad za znamke določene države podeli varstvo, je znamka v tej jurisdikciji varovana enako, kot če bi jo registriral ta urad.

source.title: Madrid Protocol
paragraphs: The Madrid System, also known as the Madrid Protocol, is the primary international system for facilitating the registration of trademarks in multiple jurisdictions around the world. It was established pursuant to the multilateral treaties Madrid Agreement Concerning the International Registration of Marks of 1891 and the Protocol Relating to the Madrid Agreement (1989), which has been the sole governing treaty since 2016.

The Madrid System provides a centrally administered system for obtaining multiple trademark registrations in separate jurisdictions; it does not create a single unified registration across different jurisdictions, as in the case of the European Union trademark system. Rather, applicants file a single international trademark application and pay one set of fees to apply for protection in any or all countries that are members of the system; each country has discretion to grant the application. Once the trademark authority of a designated country grants protection, the mark is protected in that jurisdiction just as if that office had registered it.

Mamertines.headline: Mamertinci
paragraphs: Mamertinci (latinsko: Mamertini, »Marsovi sinovi«, grško: Μαμερτίνοι) so bili grški najemniki italskega izvora, ki jih je iz njihovega doma v Kampaniji najel Agatokel (361–289 pr. n. št.), sirakuški tiran in samooklicani kralj Sicilije. Potem ko so Sirakuze sedmo sicilsko vojno izgubile, je bilo grško mesto Mesina leta 307 pr. n. št. odstopljeno Kartagini. Ko je Agatokel leta 289 pr. n. št. umrl, je veliko njegovih najemnikov na Siciliji ostalo brez dela. Večina se jih je vrnila domov, nekateri pa so ostali, ker jim je bilo všeč podnebje in so se veselili pustolovščin na tujem otoku. Imeli so pomembno vlogo pri izbruhu prve punske vojne.
Leta 280 pr. n. št. so Sirakužani prosili kralja Pira Epirskega za pomoč proti Mamertincem.

source.title: Mamertines
paragraphs: The Mamertines (Latin: Mamertini, "sons of Mars", Greek: Μαμερτίνοι) were Greek mercenaries of Italic origin who had been hired from their home in Campania by Agathocles (361–289 BC), Tyrant of Syracuse and self-proclaimed King of Sicily. After Syracuse lost the Seventh Sicilian War, the Greek city of Messina was ceded to Carthage in 307 BC. When Agathocles died in 289 BC it left many of his mercenaries idle and unemployed in Sicily. Most of them returned home but some, liking the climate and the prospect of adventure on a foreign island, remained. They played a major role in the lead-up to the First Punic War.
In 280 BC, the Syracusans appealed to King Pyrrhus of Epirus for help against the Mamertines.

Brandenburška marka (nemško: Markgrafschaft Brandenburg) je bila od leta 1157 do 1806 pomembna kneževina Svetega rimskega cesarstva. Čeprav je bila sprva nerazvito in gospodarsko skromno ozemlje, je imel Brandenburg v cesarstvu status volilne kneževine. Še sredi 16. stoletja se je soočal z delitvijo dežele (odcepitvijo Küstrina), nato pa se je hitro znova združil in po tem, ko je leta 1618 podedoval Vojvodino Prusijo, hitro pridobival pomen. Kot jedro pruskega kraljestva je Brandenburg odigral ključno vlogo v nemški in evropski zgodovini.

Brandenburg se je razvil iz Severne marke, ustanovljene na ozemlju slovanskih Vendov. Po tej dediščini je dobil eno od svojih imen, Brandenburška marka (Mark Brandenburg). Njegovi vladajoči mejni grofje so z zlato bulo leta 1356 postali ugledni volilni knezi, ki so lahko volili cesarja Svetega rimskega cesarstva. Država je bila zato znana tudi kot Volilni Brandenburg ali Brandenburška volilna kneževina (Kurbrandenburg ali Kurfürstentum Brandenburg).

source.title: Margraviate of Brandenburg
paragraphs: The Margraviate of Brandenburg (German: Markgrafschaft Brandenburg) was a major principality of the Holy Roman Empire from 1157 to 1806. Though initially an underdeveloped and economically modest territory, Brandenburg held electoral status within the Empire. Facing land division with Küstrin as recent as middle in the 16th century, it then quickly reunited and grew rapidly in importance after inheriting the Duchy of Prussia in 1618. Brandenburg came to play a pivotal role in both German and European history as the core of the Prussian kingdom.

Brandenburg developed out of the Northern March, founded in the territory of the Slavic Wends. It derived one of its names from this inheritance, the March of Brandenburg (Mark Brandenburg). Its ruling margraves were established as prestigious prince-electors in the Golden Bull of 1356, allowing them to vote in the election of the Holy Roman Emperor. The state thus became additionally known as Electoral Brandenburg or the Electorate of Brandenburg (Kurbrandenburg or Kurfürstentum Brandenburg).

Moravska mejna grofija (češko: Markrabství moravské; nemško: Markgrafschaft Mähren) je bila ena od dežel češke krone v Svetem rimskem cesarstvu, Avstrijskem cesarstvu in Avstro-Ogrski, ki je obstajala od leta 1182 do 1918. Uradno jo je upravljal mejni grof v sodelovanju z deželnim zborom. Bila je bodisi dejansko neodvisna država bodisi podrejena vojvodini, pozneje Kraljevini Češki. Obsegala je zgodovinsko pokrajino Moravsko, ki leži v današnji Češki republiki.

source.title: Margraviate of Moravia
paragraphs: The Margraviate of Moravia (Czech: Markrabství moravské; German: Markgrafschaft Mähren) was one of the Lands of the Bohemian Crown within the Holy Roman Empire, the Austrian Empire and Austria-Hungary, existing from 1182 to 1918. It was officially administered by a margrave in cooperation with a provincial diet. It was variously a de facto independent state, and also subject to the Duchy, later the Kingdom of Bohemia. It comprised the historical region called Moravia, which lies within the present-day Czech Republic.

Maritime Labour Convention.headline: Konvencija o delovnih standardih v pomorstvu
paragraphs: Konvencija o delovnih standardih v pomorstvu (MLC) je konvencija Mednarodne organizacije dela (MOD) s številko 186, sprejeta leta 2006 kot četrti steber mednarodnega pomorskega prava; zajema »vse sodobne standarde obstoječih mednarodnih konvencij in priporočil o delu v pomorstvu ter temeljna načela iz drugih mednarodnih konvencij o delu«. Drugi stebri so SOLAS, STCW in MARPOL. Pogodba velja za vse ladje, ki vplujejo v pristanišča pogodbenic (države pristanišča), in za vse ladje, ki plujejo pod zastavo pogodbenice (države zastave, ki so leta 2026 obsegale več kot 97 % svetovne bruto tonaže).
Po navedbah Mednarodne organizacije dela konvencija MLC ponuja širok pogled na pravice pomorščakov in njihovo zaščito pri delu.
notes: The headline uses the convention's official Slovenian name; the English abbreviation ILO becomes the Slovenian MOD.

source.title: Maritime Labour Convention
paragraphs: The Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) is an International Labour Organization (ILO) convention, number 186, established in 2006 as the fourth pillar of international maritime law and embodies "all up-to-date standards of existing international maritime labour Conventions and Recommendations, as well as the fundamental principles to be found in other international labour Conventions". The other pillars are the SOLAS, STCW and MARPOL. The treaties applies to all ships entering the harbours of parties to the treaty (port states), as well as to all ships flying the flag of state party (flag states, as of 2026: over 97 per cent by world gross shipping tonnage).
Maritime Labour Convention (MLC), according to International Labour Organization, provides a broad perspective to the seafarer's rights and fortification at work.

Massacre at Béziers.headline: Pokol v Béziersu
paragraphs: Pokol v Béziersu se je zgodil 22. julija 1209, ko so križarji oplenili Béziers. Bil je posledica obleganja Béziersa, prvega večjega vojaškega spopada albižanske križarske vojne.

source.title: Massacre at Béziers
paragraphs: The Massacre at Béziers occurred on 22 July 1209 during the sack of Béziers by Crusaders. It was the outcome of the Siege of Béziers, which was the first major military action of the Albigensian Crusade.

May Coup (Poland).headline: Majski prevrat
paragraphs: Majski prevrat (poljsko: przewrót majowy ali zamach majowy) je bil državni udar, ki ga je na Poljskem od 12. do 14. maja 1926 izvedel maršal Józef Piłsudski.

Napad Piłsudskijevih privržencev na vladne sile je strmoglavil demokratično izvoljeno vlado predsednika Stanisława Wojciechowskega in predsednika vlade Wincentyja Witosa ter terjal več sto smrtnih žrtev.
Novo vlado je vodil Kazimierz Bartel, predsednik pa je postal Ignacy Mościcki. Piłsudski je ostal najvplivnejši politik na Poljskem vse do svoje smrti leta 1935.

source.title: May Coup (Poland)
paragraphs: The May Coup (Polish: przewrót majowy or zamach majowy) was a coup d'état carried out in Poland by Marshal Józef Piłsudski from 12 to 14 May 1926.

The attack of Piłsudski's supporters on government forces resulted in the overthrow of the democratically-elected government of President Stanisław Wojciechowski and Prime Minister Wincenty Witos and caused hundreds of fatalities.
A new government was installed, headed by Kazimierz Bartel. Ignacy Mościcki became president. Piłsudski remained the dominant politician in Poland until his death in 1935.

May Coup (Serbia).headline: Majski prevrat
paragraphs: Majski prevrat (srbsko: Мајски преврат) je bil državni udar v Kraljevini Srbiji, v katerem so v noči z 10. na 11. junij [z 28. na 29. maj po starem koledarju] 1903 v Starem dvoru v Beogradu umorili kralja Aleksandra I. in njegovo soprogo kraljico Drago. S tem dejanjem se je končala dinastija Obrenovićev, ki je Srbiji vladala od sredine 19. stoletja. Umor je organizirala skupina častnikov srbske vojske pod vodstvom kapitana Dragutina Dimitrijevića (Apisa). Po majskem prevratu je prestol prevzel kralj Peter I. iz dinastije Karađorđevićev.

Zarotniki so poleg kraljevega para ubili tudi predsednika vlade Dimitrija Cincar-Markovića, vojnega ministra Milovana Pavlovića in generalnega adjutanta Lazarja Petrovića. Prevrat je močno vplival na odnose Srbije z drugimi evropskimi silami: Obrenovići so bili večinoma zavezniki Avstro-Ogrske, Karađorđevići pa so imeli tesne vezi z Rusijo in Francijo. Obe dinastiji sta od svojih mogočnih tujih pokroviteljev stalno prejemali finančno podporo.

source.title: May Coup (Serbia)
paragraphs: The May Coup (Serbian: Мајски преврат, romanized: Majski prevrat) was a coup d'état in the Kingdom of Serbia which resulted in the assassination of King Alexander I and his consort, Queen Draga, inside the Stari Dvor in Belgrade on the night of 10–11 June [O.S. 28–29 May] 1903. This act resulted in the end of the Obrenović dynasty that had ruled Serbia since the mid-19th century. A group of Serbian army officers led by Captain Dragutin Dimitrijević (Apis) organized the assassination. After the May Coup, the throne passed to King Peter I of the Karađorđević dynasty.

Along with the royal couple, the conspirators killed prime minister Dimitrije Cincar-Marković, minister of the army Milovan Pavlović, and general-adjutant Lazar Petrović.
