The coup had a significant influence on Serbia's relations with other European powers; the Obrenović dynasty had mostly allied with Austria-Hungary, while the Karađorđević dynasty had close ties with both Russia and France. Each dynasty received ongoing financial support from their powerful foreign sponsors.

May Days.headline: Majski dnevi
paragraphs: Majski dnevi, včasih imenovani tudi majski dogodki, so bili vrsta spopadov med 3. in 8. majem 1937, v katerih so se frakcije republikanske strani v španski državljanski vojni spopadale v uličnih bojih v različnih delih Katalonije, s središčem v Barceloni.

V teh dogodkih so se libertarni socialistični podporniki španske revolucije, kot sta bila anarhistična CNT in protistalinistični POUM, ki sta nasprotovala centralizirani vladi, spopadli z drugimi, kot so bili republikanska vlada, katalonska vlada in Komunistična partija Španije, ki so zagovarjali močno osrednjo vlado.
Dogodki so bili vrhunec spopada med predvojno republikansko zakonitostjo in špansko revolucijo, ki sta bili od začetka španske državljanske vojne v nenehnem sporu.

source.title: May Days
paragraphs: The May Days, sometimes also called May Events, were a series of clashes between 3 and 8 May 1937 during which factions on the Republican side of the Spanish Civil War engaged one another in street battles in various parts of Catalonia, centered on the city of Barcelona.

In those events, libertarian socialist supporters of the Spanish Revolution, such as the anarchist CNT and the anti-Stalinist POUM, which opposed a centralized government, faced others, such as the Republican government, Catalan government and the Communist Party of Spain, which believed in a strong central government.
The events were the culmination of the confrontation between prewar Republican legality and the Spanish Revolution, which had been in constant strife since the beginning of the Spanish Civil War.

Pogodba o združitvi, znana tudi kot bruseljska pogodba, je bila evropska pogodba, ki je poenotila izvršilne institucije Evropske skupnosti za premog in jeklo (ESPJ), Evropske skupnosti za atomsko energijo (Euratom) in Evropske gospodarske skupnosti (EGS). Podpisana je bila v Bruslju 8. aprila 1965 in je začela veljati 1. julija 1967. Določila je, da Komisija Evropskih skupnosti nadomesti Visoko oblast ESPJ, Komisijo EGS in Komisijo Euratoma, Svet Evropskih skupnosti pa Posebni svet ministrov ESPJ, Svet EGS in Svet Euratoma. Čeprav je vsaka skupnost ostala pravno samostojna, so si delile skupne institucije (že pred to pogodbo so imele skupno parlamentarno skupščino in sodišče) in so bile skupaj znane kot Evropske skupnosti. Nekateri to pogodbo štejejo za pravi začetek sodobne Evropske unije.
Pogodbo je razveljavila amsterdamska pogodba, podpisana leta 1997.
notes: The English excerpt ends with a colon before a list that is not included; the Slovenian ends with a full stop.

source.title: Merger Treaty
paragraphs: The Merger Treaty, also known as the Treaty of Brussels, was a European treaty which unified the executive institutions of the European Coal and Steel Community (ECSC), European Atomic Energy Community (Euratom) and the European Economic Community (EEC). The treaty was signed in Brussels on 8 April 1965 and came into force on 1 July 1967. It set out that the Commission of the European Communities should replace the High Authority of the ECSC, the Commission of the EEC and the Commission of Euratom, and that the Council of the European Communities should replace the Special Council of Ministers of the ECSC, the Council of the EEC and the Council of Euratom. Although each Community remained legally independent, they shared common institutions (prior to this treaty, they already shared a Parliamentary Assembly and Court of Justice) and were together known as the European Communities. This treaty is regarded by some as the real beginning of the modern European Union.
This treaty was abrogated by the Amsterdam Treaty signed in 1997:

Methuen Treaty.headline: Methuenova pogodba
paragraphs: Methuenova pogodba je bila vojaška in trgovinska pogodba med Anglijo in Portugalsko, podpisana leta 1703 v okviru vojne za špansko nasledstvo. Imenuje se po Johnu Methuenu, v resnici pa se nanaša na dve pogodbi, podpisani tistega leta.

Pogodba je določala, da portugalska vina, izvožena v Anglijo, ne smejo biti obdavčena višje od enake količine francoskih vin, angleške tekstilije pa bodo na Portugalsko sprejete vedno, ne glede na geopolitične razmere v obeh državah (da bi Anglija portugalsko vino sprejemala tudi v obdobjih, ko ni bila v vojni s Francijo).
notes: The cross-reference "(but see below)" points to text outside the excerpt and is dropped.

source.title: Methuen Treaty
paragraphs: The Methuen Treaty was a military and commercial treaty between England and Portugal signed in 1703 as part of the War of the Spanish Succession. Named after John Methuen, it actually refers to two treaties signed that year.

The treaty stipulated that no tax higher than the tax charged for an equal amount of French wines could be charged for Portuguese wines (but see below) exported to England, and that English textiles would be admitted to Portugal at all times, regardless of the geopolitical situation in each of the two nations (to ensure England would still accept Portuguese wine in periods when not at war with France).

Ofenziva Meuse-Argonne (znana tudi kot ofenziva ob reki Mozi in v Argonskem gozdu, bitke ob Mozi in v Argonih ter pohod Meuse-Argonne) je bila velik del zadnje zavezniške ofenzive prve svetovne vojne, ki se je raztezala vzdolž vse zahodne fronte. Potekala je od 26. septembra 1918 do premirja 11. novembra 1918, skupaj 47 dni. Bila je največja ofenziva v vojaški zgodovini Združenih držav: sodelovalo je 1,2 milijona ameriških vojakov, mornarjev in marincev ter 800.000 Francozov in 850 Siamcev. Velja tudi za najsmrtonosnejši pohod v zgodovini Kopenske vojske ZDA: izgub je bilo več kot 300.000, umrlo pa je 28.000 Nemcev, 26.277 Američanov in približno 35.000 Francozov. Ameriške izgube so povečali neizkušenost številnih vojakov, taktika v zgodnjih fazah operacije in obsežen izbruh španske gripe.

source.title: Meuse–Argonne offensive
paragraphs: The Meuse–Argonne offensive (also known as the Meuse River–Argonne Forest offensive, the Battles of the Meuse–Argonne, and the Meuse–Argonne campaign) was a major part of the final Allied offensive of World War I that stretched along the entire Western Front. It was fought from September 26, 1918, until the Armistice of November 11, 1918, a total of 47 days. The Meuse–Argonne offensive was the largest in United States military history, involving 1.2 million American soldiers, sailors and marines, along with 800,000 French and 850 Siamese personnel. It is also the deadliest campaign in the history of the United States Army, resulting in over 300,000 casualties, including 28,000 German lives, 26,277 American lives and about 35,000 French lives. American losses were worsened by the inexperience of many of the troops, the tactics used during the early phases of the operation, and the widespread onset of the Spanish flu.

Monarchy of the North.headline: Severna monarhija
paragraphs: Severna monarhija (portugalsko: Monarquia do Norte), uradno Kraljevina Portugalska (Reino de Portugal), je bila kratkotrajna protirevolucija proti prvi portugalski republiki in monarhistična vlada, ki je bila v začetku leta 1919 ustanovljena na severu Portugalske. Sedež je imela v Portu in je trajala od 19. januarja do 13. februarja 1919. Gibanje je znano tudi pod slabšalnim imenom Kraljestvo Traulitânia (Reino da Traulitânia).

Gibanje je vodil Henrique Mitchell de Paiva Couceiro, ugleden član portugalske imperialne vlade, brez kakršne koli odobritve odstavljenega portugalskega kralja Manuela II. Paiva Couceiro, ki je vodil številne prejšnje poskuse obnove portugalske monarhije in v njih sodeloval, je izjavil, da je revolucija nujna, ker »če se sever ne strinja z jugom, bom do konca na strani tistih, ki so zvesti izročilu«.

source.title: Monarchy of the North
paragraphs: The Monarchy of the North (Portuguese: Monarquia do Norte), officially the Kingdom of Portugal (Reino de Portugal), was a short-lived counter-revolution against the First Portuguese Republic and a monarchist government that was established in Northern Portugal in early 1919. It was based in Porto and lasted from 19 January to 13 February 1919. The movement is also known by the derogatory term Kingdom of Traulitânia (Reino da Traulitânia).

The movement was led by Henrique Mitchell de Paiva Couceiro, a prominent member of the Portuguese imperial government, without any sanction from the deposed King of Portugal, Manuel II. Paiva Couceiro, who had led and participated in many previous attempts at restoring the Portuguese monarchy, stated that the revolution was necessary because "if the North does not agree with the South, I will be, until the end, on the side of the faithful to tradition".

Monastir offensive.headline: Bitoljska ofenziva
paragraphs: Bitoljska ofenziva je bila vojaška operacija zaveznikov proti centralnim silam v prvi svetovni vojni, s katero so želeli prebiti zastoj na makedonski fronti, prisiliti Bolgarijo h kapitulaciji in razbremeniti Romunijo. Ofenziva je prerasla v veliko bitko, trajala tri mesece in se končala z zavzetjem mesta Monastir (Bitola). Bolgarska prva armada (od konca septembra nemška enajsta armada) je na povprečni globini 50 km šestkrat sprejela boj in se petkrat morala umakniti.

source.title: Monastir offensive
paragraphs: The Monastir offensive was an Allied military operation against the forces of the Central Powers during World War I, intended to break the deadlock on the Macedonian front by forcing the capitulation of Bulgaria and relieving the pressure on Romania. The offensive took the shape of a large battle and lasted for three months and ended with the capture of the town of Monastir. On an average depth of 50km, the Bulgarian First Army (from the end of September German Eleventh Army) gave battle on six occasions, being forced to retreat five times.

Upor Monmoutha (znan tudi kot upor vil, upor zahoda ali upor West Countryja) junija 1685 je bil poskus, da bi odstavili Jakoba II., ki je februarja nasledil brata Karla II. kot kralj Anglije, Škotske in Irske. Disidentski protestanti pod vodstvom Jamesa Scotta, 1. vojvode Monmoutha, najstarejšega nezakonskega sina Karla II., so Jakobu nasprotovali predvsem zaradi njegovega katolištva.

Neuspeh parlamentarnih prizadevanj, da bi Jakoba leta 1681 izključili iz nasledstva, je privedel do zarote Rye House leta 1683, domnevnega poskusa umora Karla II. in Jakoba. Monmouth, osumljen sozarotništva, je odšel v izgnanstvo v Nizozemsko republiko. V Anglijo se je vrnil 11. junija 1685, ko se je izkrcal v Lyme Regisu na jugozahodu, kjer je užival široko ljudsko podporo, z namenom, da prevzame nadzor nad območjem in krene proti Londonu.

source.title: Monmouth Rebellion
paragraphs: The Monmouth Rebellion (also known as the Pitchfork Rebellion, Revolt of the West or West Country rebellion) in June 1685 was an attempt to depose James II, who in February had succeeded his brother Charles II as king of England, Scotland and Ireland. Dissident Protestants led by James Scott, 1st Duke of Monmouth, eldest illegitimate son of Charles II, opposed James largely due to his Catholicism.

The failure of Parliamentary efforts to exclude James from the succession in 1681 resulted in the 1683 Rye House Plot, an alleged attempt to assassinate Charles II and James. Monmouth, implicated as a co-conspirator, went into exile in the Dutch Republic. He returned to England when on 11 June 1685, he landed at Lyme Regis in the South West where he had widespread popular support, planning to take control of the area and march on London.

Črnogorsko-turška vojna 1876–78 (srbska cirilica: Црногорско-турски рат), v Črni gori znana tudi kot velika vojna (Вељи рат, Velji rat), je potekala med Kneževino Črno goro in Osmanskim cesarstvom med letoma 1876 in 1878. Končala se je s črnogorsko zmago in osmanskim porazom v širši rusko-turški vojni 1877–1878. Bilo je šest večjih in 27 manjših bitk, med njimi odločilna bitka pri Vučjem Dolu.

source.title: Montenegrin–Ottoman War (1876–1878)
paragraphs: The Montenegrin–Ottoman War (Serbian Cyrillic: Црногорско-турски рат, romanized: Crnogorsko-turski rat, "Montenegrin-Turkish War"), also known in Montenegro as the Great War (Вељи рат, Velji rat), was fought between the Principality of Montenegro and the Ottoman Empire between 1876 and 1878. The war ended with Montenegrin victory and Ottoman defeat in the larger Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878. Six major and 27 smaller battles were fought, among which was the crucial Battle of Vučji Do.

Morea expedition.headline: Morejska odprava
paragraphs: Morejska odprava (francosko: Expédition de Morée) je ime za kopensko posredovanje francoske vojske na Peloponezu med letoma 1828 in 1833, v času grške osamosvojitvene vojne, s ciljem pregnati osmansko-egipčanske okupacijske sile iz regije. Spremljala jo je tudi znanstvena odprava, ki jo je naročila Francoska akademija.

source.title: Morea expedition
paragraphs: The Morea expedition (French: Expédition de Morée) is the name given to the land intervention of the French Army in the Peloponnese between 1828 and 1833, at the time of the Greek War of Independence, with the aim of expelling the Ottoman-Egyptian occupation forces from the region. It was also accompanied by a scientific expedition mandated by the French Academy.

Morejska vojna (italijansko: Guerra di Morea), znana tudi kot šesta osmansko-beneška vojna, je potekala v letih 1684–1699 med Beneško republiko in Osmanskim cesarstvom v okviru širšega spopada, znanega kot »velika turška vojna«. Vojaške operacije so segale od Dalmacije do Egejskega morja, glavni pohod vojne pa je bilo beneško osvajanje polotoka Moreje (Peloponeza) na jugu Grčije.

Benetke so se v vojni hotele maščevati za izgubo Krete v kandijski vojni (1645–1669). Vojna je potekala v času, ko so bili Osmani zapleteni v boj s Habsburžani na severu, ki se je začel z neuspelim osmanskim poskusom osvojitve Dunaja in končal s tem, da so Habsburžani pridobili Budim in vso Ogrsko; Osmansko cesarstvo zato svojih sil ni moglo zbrati proti Benečanom. Tako je bila morejska vojna edini osmansko-beneški spopad, iz katerega so Benetke izšle kot zmagovalke in pridobile precej ozemlja. Beneški osvajalni preporod pa je bil kratkotrajen, saj so Osmani te pridobitve leta 1718 izničili.
notes: The English Cretan War (1645–1669) is given by its glossary name, kandijska vojna.

source.title: Morean War
paragraphs: The Morean war (Italian: Guerra di Morea), also known as the Sixth Ottoman–Venetian War, was fought between 1684–1699 as part of the wider conflict known as the "Great Turkish War", between the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman Empire. Military operations ranged from Dalmatia to the Aegean Sea, but the war's major campaign was the Venetian conquest of the Morea (Peloponnese) peninsula in Southern Greece.

On the Venetian side, the war was fought to avenge the loss of Crete in the Cretan War (1645–1669). It happened while the Ottomans were entangled in their northern struggle against the Habsburgs – beginning with the failed Ottoman attempt to conquer Vienna and ending with the Habsburgs gaining Buda and the whole of Hungary, leaving the Ottoman Empire unable to concentrate its forces against the Venetians. As such, the Morean War was the only Ottoman–Venetian conflict from which Venice emerged victorious, gaining significant territory. Venice's expansionist revival would be short-lived, as its gains would be reversed by the Ottomans in 1718.

Morocco–Congo Treaty.headline: Maroško-kongovska pogodba
paragraphs: Maroško-kongovsko pogodbo sta Francija in Nemčija podpisali 4. novembra 1911 v Berlinu, z njo pa je bila priznana francoska prevlada nad Marokom. Pogodba je končala agadirsko krizo. Francija je z njo Nemčiji odstopila dele Francoskega Konga in Francoske ekvatorialne Afrike, ki so sestavljali Novi Kamerun (Neukamerun).

source.title: Morocco–Congo Treaty
paragraphs: The Morocco–Congo Treaty was signed on 4 November 1911 in Berlin between France and Germany to recognize French domination of Morocco. This event concluded the Agadir Crisis. In it, France ceded parts of the French Congo and French Equatorial Africa to Germany, comprising the Neukamerun.

Moscow Armistice.headline: Moskovsko premirje
paragraphs: Moskovsko premirje, ki so ga 19. septembra 1944 podpisale Finska na eni strani ter Sovjetska zveza in Združeno kraljestvo na drugi, je končalo nadaljevalno vojno. Premirje je z več spremembami obnovilo mir v Moskvi iz leta 1940.
Dokončno mirovno pogodbo med Finsko in mnogimi zavezniki so podpisali v Parizu leta 1947.

source.title: Moscow Armistice
paragraphs: The Moscow Armistice was signed between Finland on one side and the Soviet Union and United Kingdom on the other side on 19 September 1944, ending the Continuation War. The Armistice restored the Moscow Peace Treaty of 1940, with a number of modifications.
The final peace treaty between Finland and many of the Allies was signed in Paris in 1947.

Moscow Peace Treaty.headline: Mir v Moskvi (1940)
paragraphs: Mir v Moskvi sta Finska in Sovjetska zveza podpisali 12. marca 1940, ratifikacije pa so izmenjali 21. marca. Z njim se je končala 105 dni dolga zimska vojna, po kateri je Finska Sovjetski zvezi odstopila obmejna območja. Pogodbo so v imenu Sovjetske zveze podpisali Vjačeslav Molotov, Andrej Ždanov in Aleksandr Vasilevski, v imenu Finske pa Risto Ryti, Juho Kusti Paasikivi, Rudolf Walden in Väinö Voionmaa. Določila pogodbe po razpadu Sovjetske zveze niso bila razveljavljena. Karelijsko vprašanje označuje razpravo na Finskem o morebitni vrnitvi odstopljenega ozemlja.

source.title: Moscow Peace Treaty
paragraphs: The Moscow Peace Treaty was signed by Finland and the Soviet Union on 12 March 1940, and the ratifications were exchanged on 21 March. It marked the end of the 105-day Winter War, upon which Finland ceded border areas to the Soviet Union. The treaty was signed by Vyacheslav Molotov, Andrei Zhdanov and Aleksandr Vasilevsky for the Soviet Union, and Risto Ryti, Juho Kusti Paasikivi, Rudolf Walden and Väinö Voionmaa for Finland. The terms of the treaty were not reversed after the dissolution of the Soviet Union. The Karelian question refers to the debate within Finland over the possible reacquisition of this ceded territory.

Moscow uprising of 1648.headline: Moskovska vstaja leta 1648
paragraphs: Moskovska vstaja leta 1648 (rusko: Соляной бунт, Московское восстание 1648), včasih imenovana solni upor, se je začela, ker je vlada različne davke nadomestila z enotnim davkom na sol, da bi po dobi velikih nemirov napolnila državno blagajno. Cena soli se je zaradi tega zvišala, kar je povzročilo nasilne nemire na moskovskih ulicah. Upor je bil zgodnji izziv vladavini Alekseja I. in se je nazadnje končal z izgonom Aleksejevega svetovalca Borisa Morozova.

source.title: Moscow uprising of 1648
paragraphs: The Moscow uprising of 1648 (Russian: Соляной бунт, Московское восстание 1648), sometimes known as the salt riot, started because of the government's replacement of different taxes with a universal salt tax for the purpose of replenishing the state treasury after the Time of Troubles. This drove up the price of salt, leading to violent riots in the streets of Moscow. The riot was an early challenge to the reign of Alexei I, eventually resulting in the exile of Alexei's advisor Boris Morozov.

Moscow uprising of 1682.headline: Moskovska vstaja leta 1682
paragraphs: Moskovska vstaja leta 1682, znana tudi kot strelecki upor leta 1682 (rusko: Стрелецкий бунт), je bil upor moskovskih streleckih polkov, zaradi katerega je vrhovna oblast prešla na Sofijo Aleksejevno, hčer pokojnega carja Alekseja Mihajloviča in njegove prve žene Marije Miloslavske. Za vstajo se je skrivalo rivalstvo med sorodniki obeh žena pokojnega carja Alekseja, ki je umrl leta 1676, Miloslavskimi in Nariškini, za prevladujoč vpliv na upravo Ruskega carstva.

source.title: Moscow uprising of 1682
paragraphs: The Moscow uprising of 1682, also known as the Streltsy uprising of 1682 (Russian: Стрелецкий бунт), was an uprising of the Moscow Streltsy regiments that resulted in supreme power devolving on Sophia Alekseyevna, the daughter of the late Tsar Aleksey Mikhailovich and of his first wife Maria Miloslavskaya. Behind the uprising lurked the rivalry between the Miloslavsky and Naryshkin relatives of the two wives of the late Tsar Aleksey, who died in 1676, for dominant influence on the administration of the Tsardom of Russia.

Moskovska vstaja decembra 1905 s središčem v moskovskem Presnenskem okraju med 7. in 18. decembrom 1905 je bila vrhunec ruske revolucije leta 1905. Na tisoče delavcev se je pridružilo oboroženemu uporu proti cesarski vladi in se borilo za boljše družbene razmere. Vstaja se je končala s porazom revolucionarjev in sprožila hitro protirevolucijo, ki je trajala do leta 1907. Revolucija leta 1905 je bila prelomnica v ruski zgodovini, moskovska vstaja pa je pomembno prispevala k revolucionarnemu razpoloženju med ruskimi delavci. Moskovski revolucionarji so med vstajo pridobili izkušnje, ki so jim leta pozneje pomagale do uspeha v oktobrski revoluciji leta 1917.

source.title: Moscow uprising of 1905
paragraphs: The Moscow uprising, centered in Moscow's Presnensky district between 7 and 18 December 1905, was the climax of the Russian Revolution of 1905. Thousands of workers joined an armed rebellion against the imperial government fighting for better societal conditions. The uprising ended in defeat for the revolutionaries and provoked a swift counter-revolution that lasted until 1907. The revolution of 1905 was a turning point in Russian history, and the Moscow uprising played an important role in fostering revolutionary sentiment among Russian workers. The Moscow revolutionaries gained experience during the uprising that helped them succeed years later in the October Revolution of 1917.

Münster rebellion.headline: Münstrski upor
paragraphs: Münstrski upor (nemško: Täuferreich von Münster, dobesedno »prekrščevalsko gospostvo v Münstru«) je bil poskus radikalnih prekrščevalcev (anabaptistov), da bi v nemškem mestu Münster, ki je tedaj spadalo pod obsežno Münstrsko knezoškofijo v Svetem rimskem cesarstvu, vzpostavili skupnostno sektaško oblast.

Mesto je bilo pod oblastjo prekrščevalcev od februarja 1534, ko so zasedli mestno hišo in za župana postavili Bernharda Knipperdollinga, do padca junija 1535. Temelje za dogodke v Münstru v letih 1534–1535 sta pomagala postaviti Melchior Hoffman, ki je leta 1530 v Strasbourgu uvedel krst odraslih, in njegova smer eshatološkega prekrščevalstva.

source.title: Münster rebellion
paragraphs: The Münster rebellion (German: Täuferreich von Münster, lit. 'Anabaptist dominion of Münster') was an attempt by radical Anabaptists to establish a communal sectarian government in the German city of Münster – then under the large Prince-Bishopric of Münster in the Holy Roman Empire.

The city was under Anabaptist rule from February 1534, when the city hall was seized and Bernhard Knipperdolling installed as mayor, until its fall in June 1535. It was Melchior Hoffman, who initiated adult baptism in Strasbourg in 1530, and his line of eschatological Anabaptism, that helped lay the foundations for the events of 1534–35 in Münster.

Nalyvaiko Uprising.headline: Nalivajkova vstaja
paragraphs: Nalivajkova vstaja (poljsko: powstanie Nalewajki; ukrajinsko: повстання Наливайка) je bila kozaška vstaja proti Poljsko-litovski republiki. Vodil jo je Severin Nalivajko, trajala pa je od leta 1594 do 1596. Bila je druga v dolgi vrsti kozaških vstaj; zmagala je poljska krona, toda dve leti vojskovanja in taktika požgane zemlje, ki sta jo uporabljali obe strani, sta velik del desnobrežne Ukrajine pustili v ruševinah.

source.title: Nalyvaiko Uprising
paragraphs: The Nalyvaiko Uprising (Polish: powstanie Nalewajki, Ukrainian: повстання Наливайка) was a Cossack rebellion against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Headed by Severyn Nalyvaiko, it lasted from 1594 to 1596. The second in a long series of Cossack uprisings, the conflict was ultimately won by the Crown of Poland, but two years of warfare and scorched-earth tactics employed by both sides left much of Right-bank Ukraine in ruins.

Nacionalistična frakcija (špansko: Bando nacional), imenovana tudi uporniška frakcija (Bando sublevado) in frankistična frakcija (Bando franquista), je bila glavna stran v španski državljanski vojni v letih 1936–1939. Sestavljale so jo različne desničarske politične skupine, ki so podprle španski državni udar julija 1936 proti drugi španski republiki in republikanski strani ter hotele odstaviti Manuela Azaño. Vključevala je Falange Española de las JONS, CEDA (»Španska konfederacija avtonomne desnice«) in dve monarhistični skupini, ki sta podpirali tekmeca za prestol: alfonsistično Renovación Española (Španska prenova) in karlistično Comunión Tradicionalista (Tradicionalistično občestvo). Dekret o združitvi je leta 1937 vse te skupine združil v FET y de las JONS. Med vojno so se nacionalistične skupine, ki so kazale nekatere »fašizoidne« in »predfašistične« težnje, poenotile okoli novega ideološkega projekta, ki sta ga zaznamovala sodoben ultranacionalizem in cilj narod očistiti in preroditi v »grmadi« vojne ter po zgledu italijanskega fašizma ustvariti španskega »novega človeka«.

source.title: Nationalist faction (Spanish Civil War)
paragraphs: The Nationalist faction (Spanish: Bando nacional), also called the Rebel faction (Spanish: Bando sublevado) and Francoist faction (Spanish: Bando franquista), was a major faction in the Spanish Civil War of 1936 to 1939. It was composed of a variety of right-wing political groups that supported the Spanish coup of July 1936 against the Second Spanish Republic and Republican faction and sought to depose Manuel Azaña. It included the Falange Española de las JONS, the CEDA ('Spanish Confederation of the Autonomous Right'), and two rival monarchist claimants: the Alfonsist Spanish Renovation and the Carlist Traditionalist Communion. In 1937, the Unification Decree merged all these groups into the FET y de las JONS. In the course of the war, the Nationalist groups, which exhibited certain "fascisant" and "pre-fascist" tendencies, became unified around a new emerging ideological project marked by modern ultranationalism and the goal of purifying and reviving the nation in the "bonfire" of the war to achieve a Spanish "New Man" similarly to Italian Fascism.

Navarrese Civil War (1451–1455).headline: Navarska državljanska vojna (1451–1455)
paragraphs: V navarski državljanski vojni v letih 1451–1455 sta se spopadla navarski kralj Ivan II. in njegov sin in prestolonaslednik Karel IV.

Ob začetku vojne je bil Ivan II. navarski kralj že od leta 1425 po svoji prvi ženi Blanki I. Navarski, s katero se je poročil leta 1420. Po poročni pogodbi iz leta 1419 naj bi Navaro ob Blankini smrti nasledil najstarejši sin Ivana in Blanke. Ko je Blanka leta 1441 umrla, je Ivan obdržal oblast nad njenimi deželami in razdedinil lastnega najstarejšega sina Karla (rojenega leta 1421), ki ga je ded, navarski kralj Karel III., že leta 1423 imenoval za princa Viane. Ivan je skušal sina pomiriti z namestništvom v Navari, toda sinova francoska vzgoja in francoski zavezniki, beaumontejci, so ju pripeljali v spor. Ivana so podpirali agramontejci.

source.title: Navarrese Civil War (1451–1455)
paragraphs: The Navarrese Civil War of 1451–1455 pitted John II of the Kingdom of Navarre against his son and heir-apparent, Charles IV.

When the war started, John II had been King of Navarre since 1425 through his first wife, Blanche I of Navarre, who had married him in 1420. By the marriage pact of 1419, John and Blanche's eldest son was to succeed to Navarre on Blanche's death. When Blanche died in 1441, John retained the government of her lands and dispossessed his own eldest son, Charles (born 1421), who had already been made Prince of Viana by his grandfather Charles III of Navarre in 1423. John tried to assuage his son with the lieutenancy of Navarre, but his son's French upbringing and French allies, the Beaumonteses, brought the two into conflict. John was supported by the Agramonteses.

Neapolitan War.headline: Neapeljska vojna
paragraphs: Neapeljska vojna, imenovana tudi avstrijsko-neapeljska vojna, je bila spopad med napoleonskim Kraljestvom Neapelj in Avstrijskim cesarstvom. Začela se je 15. marca 1815, ko je kralj Joachim Murat napovedal vojno Avstriji, in končala 20. maja 1815 s podpisom pogodbe iz Casalanze. Vojna je potekala v obdobju sto dni, med Napoleonovo vrnitvijo iz izgnanstva in njegovim odhodom iz Pariza, ko ga je pri Waterlooju čakal odločilni poraz. Sprožil jo je upor v Neaplju, naklonjen Napoleonu, končala pa se je z odločilno avstrijsko zmago v bitki pri Tolentinu, po kateri so burbonskega vladarja Ferdinanda IV. ponovno postavili za kralja Neaplja in Sicilije. Mnogi menijo, da je bila Muratova vojna napoved neprevidna odločitev. Vendar je avstrijski poseg v Italiji vzbudil nejevoljo, ki je dodatno spodbudila prizadevanja za italijansko združitev.
notes: The English calls the same king Ferdinand I in the Tolentino summary and Ferdinand IV here; the Slovenian follows each source.

source.title: Neapolitan War
paragraphs: The Neapolitan War, also known as the Austro-Neapolitan War, was a conflict between the Napoleonic Kingdom of Naples and the Austrian Empire. It started on 15 March 1815, when King Joachim Murat declared war on Austria, and ended on 20 May 1815, with the signing of the Treaty of Casalanza. The war occurred during the Hundred Days between Napoleon's return from exile and before he left Paris to be decisively defeated at the Battle of Waterloo. The war was triggered by a pro-Napoleon uprising in Naples and ended with a decisive Austrian victory at the Battle of Tolentino, after which Bourbon monarch Ferdinand IV was reinstated as King of Naples and Sicily. Many say the declaration of war was a reckless decision by Murat. However, the intervention by Austria caused resentment in Italy, which further spurred the drive towards Italian unification.

New START.headline: Nova pogodba START
paragraphs: Nova pogodba START (New START) je bila pogodba med ZDA in Rusijo o zmanjšanju jedrskega orožja z uradnim imenom Ukrepi za nadaljnje zmanjšanje in omejitev strateškega ofenzivnega orožja. Podpisali so jo 8. aprila 2010 v Pragi, po ratifikaciji pa je začela veljati 5. februarja 2011.

Nova pogodba START je nadomestila moskovsko pogodbo (SORT), ki bi potekla decembra 2012. Sledila je pogodbi START I, ki je potekla decembra 2009, predlagani pogodbi START II, ki ni nikoli začela veljati, in pogodbi START III, o kateri pogajanja niso bila nikoli sklenjena.

Pogodba je predvidevala prepolovitev števila izstrelišč strateških jedrskih raket. Predvidevala je tudi nov režim inšpekcij in preverjanja, ki je nadomestil mehanizem SORT. Števila operativno nedejavnih jedrskih bojnih glav, ki jih je mogoče skladiščiti, pa ni omejevala.

source.title: New START
paragraphs: New START was a nuclear arms reduction treaty between the United States and Russia with the formal name of Measures for the Further Reduction and Limitation of Strategic Offensive Arms. It was signed on 8 April 2010 in Prague, and after ratification it entered into force on 5 February 2011.

New START replaced the Treaty of Moscow (SORT), which was to expire in December 2012. It followed the START I treaty, which expired in December 2009; the proposed START II treaty which never entered into force; and the START III treaty, for which negotiations were never concluded.

The treaty called for halving the number of strategic nuclear missile launchers. It also called for the establishment of a new inspection and verification regime, replacing the SORT mechanism. It did not limit the number of operationally inactive nuclear warheads that can be stockpiled.

Night attack at Târgoviște.headline: Nočni napad pri Târgoviștu
paragraphs: Nočni napad pri Târgoviștu (romunsko: Atacul de noapte de la Târgoviște) je bil spopad med silami vlaškega kneza Vlada III. in osmanskega sultana Mehmeda II. v četrtek, 17. junija 1462. Do spopada je prišlo, potem ko je Mehmed II., ki je bil z Vladom že v napetih odnosih, odkril njegovo zavezništvo z ogrskim kraljem Matijo Korvinom in svojim silam ukazal, naj ga napadejo iz zasede. Vlad je napad preprečil in vdrl v Bolgarijo. Mehmed je v odgovor zbral veliko vojsko, da bi osvojil Vlaško. Vladarja sta se spopadla v več praskah, najbolj znan pa je spopad, v katerem je Vlad ponoči napadel turški tabor, da bi ubil Mehmeda. Poskus atentata ni uspel in Mehmed je odkorakal proti vlaški prestolnici Târgoviște, kjer je našel le nekaj mož s topovi. Ko je zapustil prestolnico, je Mehmed odkril 23.844 nabodenih Turkov, ki jih je Vlad pobil med vdorom v Bolgarijo. To število navaja Vlad sam v pismu Matiji Korvinu. Sultan in njegove čete so nato odpluli do Brăile, jo požgali do tal in se umaknili v Odrin. Mehmedove sile so se vrnile domov z mnogimi ujetimi sužnji, konji in govedom.

source.title: Night attack at Târgoviște
paragraphs: The night attack at Târgoviște (Romanian: Atacul de noapte de la Târgoviște) was a battle fought between forces of Prince Vlad III of Wallachia and Sultan Mehmed II of the Ottoman Empire on Thursday, 17 June 1462. The battle started after Mehmed II, who already had tense relations with Vlad, discovered his alliance with Hungary's king Matthias Corvinus and ordered his forces to ambush him. Vlad foiled the attack and invaded Bulgaria. In response, Mehmed raised a great army with the objective to conquer Wallachia. The two leaders fought a series of skirmishes, the most notable one being the conflict where Vlad attacked the Turkish camp in the night in an attempt to kill Mehmed. The assassination attempt failed and Mehmed marched to the Wallachian capital of Târgoviște, where he found a few men with cannons. After leaving the capital, Mehmed discovered 23,844 impaled Turks whom Vlad had killed during his invasion of Bulgaria. The number is mentioned by Vlad himself in a letter to Matthias Corvinus. The sultan and his troops then sailed to Brăila and burned it to the ground before retreating to Adrianople. Mehmed's forces returned home with many captured slaves, horses, and cattle.

Nine Years' War (Ireland).headline: Devetletna vojna (Irska)
paragraphs: Devetletna vojna (maja 1593 – 30. marca 1603) je bila spopad na Irskem med konfederacijo irskih gospodov (s špansko podporo) in vlado pod angleškim vodstvom. Vojna je bila predvsem odziv na prodiranje angleške krone na ozemlja, ki so tradicionalno pripadala gelskemu plemstvu. Bila je tudi del širše angleško-španske vojne in evropskih verskih vojn.

Kraljevina Irska je bila ustanovljena leta 1542 kot angleška država vazalka, različni klani pa so po postopku »predaje in ponovne podelitve« (surrender and regrant) sprejeli angleško suverenost. Do začetka 1590. let se je med gelskim plemstvom razširila zamera do angleške oblasti zaradi usmrtitev gelskih gospodov, plenjenja naselij, ki so ga zagrešili imenovani šerifi, in preganjanja katoličanov.

source.title: Nine Years' War (Ireland)
paragraphs: The Nine Years' War (May 1593 – 30 March 1603) was a conflict in Ireland between a confederacy of Irish lords (with Spanish support) and the English-led government. The war was primarily a response to the English Crown's advances into territory traditionally owned by the Gaelic nobility. It was also part of the broader Anglo-Spanish War and the European wars of religion.

The Kingdom of Ireland was established as an English client state in 1542, with various clans accepting English sovereignty under "surrender and regrant". By the early 1590s, widespread resentment against English rule developed amongst the Gaelic nobility, due to the execution of Gaelic lords, the pillaging of settlements by appointed sheriffs and Catholic persecution.

Ninth Battle of the Isonzo.headline: Deveta soška bitka
paragraphs: Deveta soška bitka je bila italijanska ofenziva proti Avstro-Ogrski v prvi svetovni vojni. Bila je del trojice bitk, ki so jih Italijani začeli po uspešnem zavzetju Gorice avgusta 1916, da bi razširili mostišče levo od mesta, in se je za italijanskega načelnika generalštaba Luigija Cadorno končala z novim neuspehom.

Bitka se je začela z napadom na Vrtojbo ter na severni in osrednji del Krasa. Deveta bitka je potekala od 1. do 4. novembra 1916; skupne izgube vseh treh povezanih bitk so bile tako visoke, da je bil vsak napad kratek (vsak je trajal manj kot teden dni). Italijanske izgube so znašale 75.000 mož, avstro-ogrske pa 63.000.

Kot vedno ob Soči (Isonzu) je imela avstro-ogrska vojska v rokah gorati teren, ki je bil mogočna naravna ovira za italijanske poskuse preboja. Cadorna je nameraval tak preboj doseči po zavzetju Gorice v šesti soški bitki, namesto tega pa se je vojna izčrpavanja le še stopnjevala.

source.title: Ninth Battle of the Isonzo
paragraphs: The Ninth Battle of the Isonzo was an Italian offensive against Austria-Hungary in the course World War I. Including a triumvirate of battles launched after the Italians' successful seizure of Gorizia in August 1916 to extend their bridgehead to the left of the town, it ended in further failure for the Italian Chief of Staff Luigi Cadorna.

The battle started with an attack on Vrtojba and the northern and central areas of the Karst Plateau. With the ninth battle fought from 1 to 4 November 1916 the combined casualty total from the three linked battles proved sufficiently heavy to ensure that each attack was of short duration (each less than a week). The Italians suffered 75,000 casualties and the Austro-Hungarians 63,000.

As always along the Soča (Isonzo), the Austro-Hungarian Army's command of the mountainous terrain provided a formidable natural barrier to the Italians' attempts to achieve a breakthrough. Cadorna had intended to ensure such a breakthrough in the wake of the capture of Gorizia during the Sixth Battle of the Isonzo, but instead the war of attrition gathered pace.

Noemvriana.headline: Noemvriana
paragraphs: Noemvriana (grško: Νοεμβριανά, »novembrski dogodki«) je ime za oborožen spopad v Atenah decembra [novembra po starem koledarju] 1916 med Kraljevino Grčijo in zavezniškimi silami, ki je izbruhnil zaradi spora o grški nevtralnosti v prvi svetovni vojni; sledili so mu povračilni ukrepi in nemiri proti grškim podpornikom zaveznikov.

source.title: Noemvriana
paragraphs: The Noemvriana (Greek: Νοεμβριανά, "November Events") was an armed confrontation in Athens in December [O.S. November] 1916 between the Kingdom of Greece and the Allied Powers, arising from a dispute over Greece's neutrality in World War I, and followed by reprisals and riots against Greek supporters of the Allies.

Normansko zavzetje južne Italije je trajalo od leta 999 do 1194 in je obsegalo številne bitke in neodvisne osvajalce. Leta 1130 so se ozemlja v južni Italiji združila v Kraljevino Sicilijo, ki je obsegala otok Sicilijo, južno tretjino Apeninskega polotoka (vključno z Beneventom, ki so ga Normani dvakrat za kratek čas zasedli), malteško otočje in dele Severne Afrike.

Potujoče normanske čete so v južno Italijo prišle kot najemniki langobardskih in bizantinskih strank ter domov hitro sporočale novice o priložnostih v Sredozemlju. Zbrale so se na več krajih, ustanovile lastne fevde in države ter se v 50 letih po prihodu združile in dvignile na raven dejanske neodvisnosti.

source.title: Norman conquest of southern Italy
paragraphs: The Norman conquest of southern Italy lasted from 999 to 1194, involving many battles and independent conquerors. In 1130, the territories in southern Italy united as the Kingdom of Sicily, which included the island of Sicily, the southern third of the Italian Peninsula (including Benevento, which was briefly held twice), the archipelago of Malta, and parts of North Africa.

Itinerant Norman forces arrived in southern Italy as mercenaries in the service of Lombard and Byzantine factions, communicating swiftly back home news about opportunities in the Mediterranean. These groups gathered in several places, establishing fiefdoms and states of their own, uniting and elevating their status to de facto independence within 50 years of their arrival.

North Sea Empire.headline: Severnomorski imperij
paragraphs: Severnomorski imperij, znan tudi kot anglo-skandinavski imperij, je bil personalna unija kraljestev Anglije, Danske in Norveške v večjem delu obdobja med letoma 1013 in 1042, proti koncu vikinške dobe. Ta kratkotrajni imperij pod nordijsko oblastjo je bil talasokracija, katere dele je povezovalo le morje in so bili od njega odvisni.

Prvi kralj, ki je združil vsa tri kraljestva, je bil Sven Vilobradi, danski kralj od leta 986 in norveški od leta 1000: to mu je uspelo, ko je leta 1013 osvojil Anglijo. Umrl je naslednje leto in njegovo kraljestvo je bilo razdeljeno. Njegov sin Knut Veliki je leta 1016 pridobil Anglijo, leta 1018 Dansko in leta 1028 Norveško. Umrl je leta 1035 in kraljestvo je bilo znova razdeljeno, toda njegov naslednik na Danskem, Hardeknut, je leta 1040 podedoval Anglijo in ji vladal do svoje smrti leta 1042. Na vrhuncu moči, ko je vladal vsem trem kraljestvom (1028–1035), je bil Knut za cesarjem Svetega rimskega cesarstva najmočnejši vladar zahodne Evrope.

source.title: North Sea Empire
paragraphs: The North Sea Empire, also known as the Anglo-Scandinavian Empire, was the personal union of the kingdoms of England, Denmark and Norway for most of the period between 1013 and 1042 towards the end of the Viking Age. This ephemeral Norse-ruled empire was a thalassocracy, its components only connected by and dependent upon the sea.

The first king to unite all three kingdoms was Sweyn Forkbeard, king of Denmark since 986 and of Norway since 1000, when he conquered England in 1013. He died in the following year, and his realm was divided. His son Cnut the Great acquired England in 1016, Denmark in 1018 and Norway in 1028. He died in 1035 and his realm was again divided, but his successor in Denmark, Harthacnut, inherited England in 1040 and ruled it until his death in 1042. At the height of his power, when Cnut ruled all three kingdoms (1028–1035), he was the most powerful ruler in western Europe after the Holy Roman Emperor.

Operation Bodenplatte.headline: Operacija Bodenplatte
paragraphs: Operacija Bodenplatte (»talna plošča«), začeta 1. januarja 1945, je bila poskus nemške Luftwaffe, da bi med drugo svetovno vojno ohromila zavezniške letalske sile v Nizkih deželah. Cilj operacije je bil pridobiti premoč v zraku med zastojem v bitki v Ardenih, da bi lahko nemška kopenska vojska in sile Waffen-SS nadaljevale prodor. Operacija je bila načrtovana za 16. december 1944, a so jo zaradi slabega vremena večkrat preložili do novoletnega dne, prvega dne, ki je bil primeren. Uničili so skoraj 500 zavezniških letal.

Operacija je bila tako tajna, da niso bile obveščene vse nemške kopenske in pomorske sile, zato so nekatere enote utrpele izgube zaradi prijateljskega ognja. Britanska signalna obveščevalna služba je zaznala premike in zbiranje nemških letalskih sil v regiji, a ni spoznala, da je operacija neposredno pred vrati.
notes: The German pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Operation Bodenplatte
paragraphs: Operation Bodenplatte (German: [ˈboːdn̩ˌplatə]; "Baseplate"), launched on 1 January 1945, was an attempt by the German Luftwaffe to cripple Allied air forces in the Low Countries during the Second World War. The goal of Bodenplatte was to gain air superiority during the stagnant stage of the Battle of the Bulge so that the German Army and Waffen-SS forces could resume their advance. The operation was planned for 16 December 1944, but was delayed repeatedly due to bad weather until New Year's Day, the first day that happened to be suitable. It resulted in the destruction of almost 500 Allied airplanes.

Secrecy for the operation was so tight that not all German ground and naval forces had been informed of the operation and some units suffered casualties from friendly fire. British signals intelligence recorded the movement and buildup of German air forces in the region, but did not realise that an operation was imminent.

Operation Faustschlag.headline: Operacija Faustschlag
paragraphs: Operacija Faustschlag ali Unternehmen Faustschlag (dobesedno »operacija Udarec s pestjo«), znana tudi kot enajstdnevna vojna, je bila ofenziva centralnih sil v prvi svetovni vojni. Bila je zadnja velika ofenziva na vzhodni fronti.

Ruske sile se zaradi pretresov ruske revolucije in ruske državljanske vojne, ki je sledila, niso mogle resno upreti. Vojske centralnih sil so zato zavzele ogromna ozemlja v Estoniji, Latviji, Belorusiji in Ukrajini ter boljševiško vlado Rusije prisilile k podpisu brestlitovskega miru.

source.title: Operation Faustschlag
paragraphs: The Operation Faustschlag or Unternehmen Faustschlag (lit. 'Operation Fist Punch'), also known as the Eleven Days' War, was a Central Powers offensive in World War I. It was the last major offensive on the Eastern Front.

Russian forces were unable to put up any serious resistance due to the turmoil of the Russian Revolution and subsequent Russian Civil War. The armies of the Central Powers therefore captured huge territories in Estonia, Latvia, Belarus, and Ukraine, forcing the Bolshevik government of Russia to sign the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk.

Operation Fustian.headline: Operacija Fustian
paragraphs: Operacija Fustian (znana tudi kot bitka za most Primosole) je bila operacija zračnodesantnih sil med zavezniško invazijo na Sicilijo julija 1943 v drugi svetovni vojni. Nosila jo je 1. padalska brigada brigadirja Geralda Lathburyja, del britanske 1. zračnodesantne divizije. Njen cilj je bil most Primosole čez reko Simeto. Namen je bil, da bi brigada s podporo enot, ki bi pristale z jadralnimi letali, pristala na obeh straneh reke, nato zavzela most in zavarovala okolico, dokler je ne bi razbremenilo napredovanje britanskega XIII. korpusa, ki se je tri dni prej izkrcal na jugovzhodni obali. Ker je bil most edini prehod čez reko in bi britanski osmi armadi odprl dostop do Katanijske ravnine, naj bi njegovo zavzetje pospešilo napredovanje in privedlo do poraza sil osi na Siciliji.

source.title: Operation Fustian
paragraphs: Operation Fustian was an airborne forces operation undertaken during the Allied invasion of Sicily in July 1943 in the Second World War. Also known as the Battle of Primosole Bridge, the operation was carried out by Brigadier Gerald Lathbury's 1st Parachute Brigade, part of the British 1st Airborne Division. Their objective was the Primosole Bridge across the Simeto River. The intention was for the brigade, with glider-borne forces in support, to land on both sides of the river. They would then capture the bridge and secure the surrounding area until relieved by the advance of British XIII Corps, which had landed on the south eastern coast three days previously. Because the bridge was the only crossing on the river and would give the British Eighth Army access to the Catania plain, its capture was expected to speed the advance and lead to the defeat of the Axis forces in Sicily.

Operation Greif.headline: Operacija Greif
paragraphs: Operacija Greif (nemško: Unternehmen Greif, »grifon«) je bila posebna operacija pod poveljstvom komandosa Waffen-SS Otta Skorzenyja med bitko v Ardenih v drugi svetovni vojni. Zamislil si jo je Adolf Hitler, njen namen pa je bil zavzeti enega ali več mostov čez reko Mozo, preden bi jih uničili. Nemški vojaki, oblečeni v zaplenjene uniforme britanske in ameriške vojske in z zaplenjenimi zavezniškimi vozili, naj bi povzročali zmedo v zaledju zavezniških črt.

Pomanjkanje vozil, uniform in opreme je operacijo omejilo in nikoli ni dosegla prvotnega cilja, zavarovanja mostov čez Mozo. Skorzenyjevo povojno sojenje je postavilo precedens, ki je pojasnil 4. člen ženevske konvencije: ker so nemški vojaki pred začetkom boja slekli zavezniške uniforme, jih ni bilo mogoče šteti za franc-tireurje (neregularne borce). Isto ime je imela že prejšnja nacistična vojaška operacija, in sicer protipartizanska operacija nemške vojske, začeta 14. avgusta 1942 v okolici Orše in Vitebska v Sovjetski zvezi.

source.title: Operation Greif
paragraphs: Operation Greif (English: Griffin; German: Unternehmen Greif) was a special operation commanded by Waffen-SS commando Otto Skorzeny during the Battle of the Bulge in World War II. The operation was the brainchild of Adolf Hitler, and its purpose was to capture one or more of the bridges over the Meuse River before they could be destroyed. German soldiers, wearing captured British and U.S. Army uniforms and using captured Allied vehicles, were to cause confusion in the rear of the Allied lines.

A lack of vehicles, uniforms, and equipment limited the operation and it never achieved its original aim of securing the Meuse bridges. Skorzeny's post-war trial set a precedent clarifying article 4 of the Geneva Convention: as the German soldiers removed the Allied uniforms before engaging in combat, they were not to be considered francs-tireurs. There was an earlier Nazi military operation that used this name, namely an anti-partisan operation conducted by the German Army, begun on 14 August 1942, in the vicinity of Orsha and Vitebsk in the Soviet Union.

Operacija Iskra (rusko: операция Искра) je bila sovjetska vojaška operacija januarja 1943 med drugo svetovno vojno, s katero so hoteli prekiniti Wehrmachtovo obleganje Leningrada. Načrtovanje operacije se je začelo kmalu po neuspehu sinjavinske ofenzive. Nemški poraz v bitki za Stalingrad konec leta 1942 je oslabil nemško fronto. Do januarja 1943 so sovjetske sile načrtovale ali izvajale ofenzivne operacije po vsej nemško-sovjetski fronti, zlasti na jugu Rusije; Iskra je bila severni del širše sovjetske zimske protiofenzive 1942–1943.
notes: The English gloss "Operation Spark" is left out; iskra is the Slovenian word too.

source.title: Operation Iskra
paragraphs: Operation Iskra (Russian: операция Искра, lit. 'Operation Spark'), a Soviet military operation in January 1943 during World War II, aimed to break the Wehrmacht's siege of Leningrad. Planning for the operation began shortly after the failure of the Sinyavino Offensive. The German defeat in the Battle of Stalingrad in late 1942 had weakened the German front. By January 1943, Soviet forces were planning or conducting offensive operations across the entire German-Soviet Front, especially in southern Russia; Iskra formed the northern part of the wider Soviet 1942–1943 winter counteroffensive.

Operation Maslenica.headline: Operacija Maslenica
paragraphs: Operacija Maslenica je bila ofenziva hrvaške vojske, ki se je začela januarja 1993, da bi od sil krajinskih Srbov znova pridobila ozemlje v severni Dalmaciji in Liki; uradni vojaški cilj je bil potisniti Srbe z dostopov do Zadra, Maslenice in Karlobaga ter odpreti varno kopensko pot med Dalmacijo in severno Hrvaško. Operacija je bila nedvomno taktičen uspeh Hrvaške, strateško pa le zmerno uspešna, Varnostni svet ZN pa jo je obsodil.

source.title: Operation Maslenica
paragraphs: Operation Maslenica was a Croatian Army offensive launched in January 1993 to retake territory in northern Dalmatia and Lika from Krajina Serb forces, with the stated military objective of pushing the Serbs back from approaches to Zadar, Maslenica and Karlobag, allowing a secure land route between Dalmatia and northern Croatia to be opened. While an undoubted net Croatian tactical success, the operation was only a moderate strategic success, and was condemned by the UN Security Council.

Operation Medak Pocket.headline: Operacija Medaški žep
paragraphs: Operacija Medaški žep (srbohrvaško: Operacija Medački džep, Операција Медачки џеп), ki so jo Hrvati uradno imenovali operacija Žep-93 (Operacija Džep-93), je bila vojaška operacija hrvaške vojske od 9. do 17. septembra 1993, v kateri so hrvaške sile napadle izboklino, ki je segala do južnih predmestij Gospića v južnem osrednjem delu Like na Hrvaškem in je bila tedaj pod nadzorom samooklicane Republike Srbske Krajine. Žep je dobil ime po vasi Medak.

source.title: Operation Medak Pocket
paragraphs: Operation Medak Pocket (Serbo-Croatian: Operacija Medački džep, Операција Медачки џеп), officially called by Croatians Operation Pocket-93 (Operacija Džep-93) was a military operation undertaken by the Croatian Army between 9 – 17 September 1993, in which a salient reaching the south suburbs of Gospić, in the south-central Lika region of Croatia then under the control of the self-proclaimed Republic of Serbian Krajina, was attacked by Croatian forces. The pocket was named after the village of Medak.

Operacija Michael (nemško: Unternehmen Michael) je bila velika nemška vojaška ofenziva v prvi svetovni vojni, s katero se je 21. marca 1918 začela nemška pomladanska ofenziva. Začela se je s Hindenburgove linije v okolici Saint-Quentina v Franciji. Njen cilj je bil prebiti zavezniške (antantne) črte, prodreti proti severozahodu in zavzeti pristanišča ob Rokavskem prelivu, ki so oskrbovala britansko ekspedicijsko silo (BEF), ter BEF pognati v morje, vse to, preden bi Američani prispeli v polnem številu in obrnili potek vojne. Dva dni pozneje je general Erich Ludendorff, načelnik nemškega generalštaba, načrt prilagodil in se zavzel za ofenzivo naravnost proti zahodu, vzdolž vse britanske fronte severno od reke Somme. Tako naj bi najprej ločili francosko in britansko vojsko, nato pa nadaljevali s prvotnim načrtom, da BEF poženejo v morje. Ofenziva se je končala pri Villers-Bretonneuxu vzhodno od zavezniškega prometnega središča Amiens, kjer so zavezniki ustavili nemško prodiranje; nemška vojska je utrpela velike izgube in prodirajočih čet ni mogla več oskrbovati.

source.title: Operation Michael
paragraphs: Operation Michael (German: Unternehmen Michael) was a major German military offensive during World War I that began the German spring offensive on 21 March 1918. It was launched from the Hindenburg Line, in the vicinity of Saint-Quentin, France. Its goal was to break through the Allied (Entente) lines and advance in a north-westerly direction to seize the Channel Ports, which supplied the British Expeditionary Force (BEF), and to drive the BEF into the sea, all before the Americans could arrive in full numbers to turn the tide of the war. Two days later, General Erich Ludendorff, the chief of the German General Staff, adjusted his plan and pushed for an offensive due west, along the whole of the British front north of the River Somme. This was designed to first separate the French and British Armies before continuing with the original concept of pushing the BEF into the sea. The offensive ended at Villers-Bretonneux, to the east of the Allied communications centre at Amiens, where the Allies managed to halt the German advance; the German Army had suffered many casualties and was unable to maintain supplies to the advancing troops.

Operation Northwind (1944).headline: Operacija Nordwind
paragraphs: Operacija Nordwind (nemško: Unternehmen Nordwind) je bila zadnja velika nemška ofenziva druge svetovne vojne na zahodni fronti. Začeli so jo v podporo nemški ofenzivi v Ardenih (bitki v Ardenih), ki se je do konca decembra 1944 odločilno obrnila proti Nemcem. Začela se je 31. decembra 1944 v Porenju-Pfalškem, Alzaciji in Loreni na jugozahodu Nemčije in severovzhodu Francije, končala pa 25. januarja 1945. Nemška ofenziva je bila operativni neuspeh, saj ni dosegla glavnih ciljev, s tem pa je bila odprta pot zavezniški invaziji na Nemčijo.

source.title: Operation Northwind (1944)
paragraphs: Operation Northwind (German: Unternehmen Nordwind) was the last major German offensive of World War II on the Western Front. Northwind was launched to support the German Ardennes offensive campaign in the Battle of the Bulge, which by late December 1944 had decisively turned against the German forces. It began on 31 December 1944 in Rhineland-Palatinate, Alsace and Lorraine in southwestern Germany and northeastern France, and ended on 25 January 1945. The German offensive was an operational failure, with its main objectives not achieved, clearing the way for the Allied invasion of Germany.

Operation Panzerfaust.headline: Operacija Panzerfaust
paragraphs: Operacija Panzerfaust (nemško: Unternehmen Panzerfaust, dobesedno »operacija oklepna pest«) je bila vojaška operacija, ki jo je oktobra 1944 izvedel nemški Wehrmacht, da bi Kraljevina Madžarska v drugi svetovni vojni ostala nemška zaveznica. Ko je nemški voditelj Adolf Hitler izvedel, da se madžarski regent admiral Miklós Horthy na skrivaj pogaja o predaji svoje države prodirajoči Rdeči armadi, je na Madžarsko poslal vodjo komandosov Otta Skorzenyja iz Waffen-SS in nekdanjega poveljnika specialnih sil Adriana von Fölkersama. Hitler se je bal, da bi madžarska predaja razgalila njegov južni bok, kjer se je Romunija pravkar pridružila Sovjetom, in odrezala milijon nemških vojakov, ki so se na Balkanu še bojevali proti sovjetskemu napredovanju. Operaciji je marca 1944 predhodila operacija Margarethe, nemška zasedba Madžarske, s katero je Hitler upal zagotoviti mesto Madžarske med silami osi. Zasedba je ob mučnem sodelovanju madžarskih oblasti omogočila tudi deportacijo večine madžarskih Judov, ki so bili prej zunaj dosega nacistov. Ko so se sovjetske sile približale in je ameriško vojaško letalstvo (USAAF) iz oporišč v Italiji začelo bombardirati Madžarsko, tudi Budimpešto, pa so to politiko opustili.

source.title: Operation Panzerfaust
paragraphs: Operation Panzerfaust (German: Unternehmen Panzerfaust, lit. 'Operation Armored Fist') was a military operation undertaken in October 1944 by the German Wehrmacht to ensure the Kingdom of Hungary would remain a German ally in World War II. When German leader Adolf Hitler received word that Hungary's Regent, Admiral Miklós Horthy, was secretly negotiating his country's surrender to the advancing Red Army, he sent commando leader Otto Skorzeny of the Waffen-SS and former special forces commander Adrian von Fölkersam to Hungary. Hitler feared that Hungary's surrender would expose his southern flank, where Romania had just joined with the Soviets, and cut off a million German troops still fighting the Soviet advance in the Balkans. The operation was preceded by Operation Margarethe in March 1944, which was the occupation of Hungary by German forces, which Hitler had hoped would secure Hungary's place in the Axis powers. This had also enabled the deportation of the majority of Hungarian Jews, previously beyond the reach of the Nazis, through uneasy cooperation with Hungarian authorities. This policy was, however, terminated as Soviet forces drew closer and the USAAF, based in Italy, began bombing Hungary, including Budapest.

Operation Tonga.headline: Operacija Tonga
paragraphs: Operacija Tonga je bila zračnoprevozna operacija britanske 6. zračnoprevozne divizije med 5. in 7. junijem 1944, del operacije Overlord in izkrcanja na dan D med drugo svetovno vojno; njeno kodno ime je bilo Tonga.

source.title: Operation Tonga
paragraphs: Operation Tonga was the codename given to the airborne operation undertaken by the British 6th Airborne Division between 5 June and 7 June 1944 as a part of Operation Overlord and the D-Day landings during the Second World War.

Oranienbaum Bridgehead.headline: Oranienbaumsko mostišče
paragraphs: Oranienbaumsko mostišče (rusko: Ораниенбаумский плацдарм) je bilo osamljeno območje Leningrajske oblasti v Rusiji, ki je med obleganjem Leningrada v drugi svetovni vojni ostalo pod sovjetskim nadzorom. Pomembno je prispevalo k obrambi mesta.

source.title: Oranienbaum Bridgehead
paragraphs: The Oranienbaum Bridgehead (Ораниенбаумский плацдарм in Russian) was an isolated portion of the Leningrad Oblast in Russia, which was retained under Soviet control during the siege of Leningrad in World War II. It played a significant role in protecting the city.

Oster conspiracy.headline: Osterjeva zarota
paragraphs: Osterjeva zarota iz leta 1938, imenovana tudi septembrska zarota (nemško: Septemberverschwörung), je bila zamišljeni načrt za strmoglavljenje nemškega voditelja Adolfa Hitlerja in nacističnega režima, če bi Nemčija zaradi Sudetov začela vojno s Češkoslovaško. Vodil jo je podpolkovnik (Oberstleutnant) Hans Oster, namestnik vodje Abwehra, skupaj z visokimi konservativci v Wehrmachtu, ki so nasprotovali režimu, ker je grozil, da bo Nemčijo pahnil v vojno, za katero po njihovem mnenju ni bila pripravljena. Hitlerja in nacistični režim so nameravali strmoglaviti tako, da bi sile, zveste zaroti, napadle rajhovsko kanclerstvo in prevzele vlado ter Hitlerja aretirale ali ubile, nato pa bi obnovili monarhijo pod princem Viljemom Pruskim, vnukom Viljema II.

source.title: Oster conspiracy
paragraphs: The Oster Conspiracy of 1938, also called the September Conspiracy (German: Septemberverschwörung), was a proposed plan to overthrow German Führer Adolf Hitler and the Nazi regime if Germany went to war with Czechoslovakia over the Sudetenland. It was led by Oberstleutnant Hans Oster, deputy head of the Abwehr, and high-ranking conservatives within the Wehrmacht who opposed the regime for behavior that was threatening to bring Germany into a war that they believed it was not ready to fight. They planned to overthrow Hitler and the Nazi regime through a storming of the Reich Chancellery by forces loyal to the plot to take control of the government, who would either arrest or assassinate Hitler, and restore the Monarchy under Prince Wilhelm of Prussia, the grandson of Wilhelm II.

Ottoman conquest of Otranto.headline: Osmanska osvojitev Otranta
paragraphs: Poleti 1480 je Osmansko cesarstvo vdrlo v južno Italijo in oblegalo Otranto (Neapeljsko kraljestvo), ki ga je 11. avgusta nazadnje zavzelo. To je bilo njihovo prvo oporišče v Italiji. Po izročilu so po zavzetju mesta več kot 800 prebivalcem odsekali glavo, ker se niso hoteli odpovedati krščanski veri. Otrantske mučence še danes slavijo v Italiji. Leto pozneje so Osmani Otranto prepustili vojvodi Alfonzu Kalabrijskemu po obleganju neapeljskih čet, ki so jih podpirali papeška flota (pod poveljstvom Paola Fregosa iz Genove) in madžarske sile, in sicer v negotovosti po smrti sultana Mehmeda II.

source.title: Ottoman conquest of Otranto
paragraphs: In the summer of 1480, the Ottoman Empire invaded southern Italy, and laid siege to Otranto (Kingdom of Naples), finally capturing it on 11 August. This was their first outpost in Italy. According to a traditional account, more than 800 inhabitants were beheaded after the city had been captured, because they would not renounce their Christian faith. The Martyrs of Otranto are still celebrated in Italy. A year later, Otranto was surrendered by the Ottomans to Duke Alfonso of Calabria after a siege by Neapolitan troops, supported by a Papal fleet (under Paolo Fregoso of Genoa) and Hungarian forces, and amid uncertainty upon the death of sultan Mehmed II.

Ottoman–Venetian War (1463–1479).headline: Prva osmansko-beneška vojna
paragraphs: Prva osmansko-beneška vojna je potekala med Beneško republiko z zavezniki in Osmanskim cesarstvom od 1463 do 1479. Bojevala se je kmalu po tem, ko so Osmani zavzeli Carigrad in ostanke Bizantinskega cesarstva, in se je končala z izgubo več beneških posesti v Albaniji in Grčiji, predvsem otoka Negroponte (Evbeja), ki je bil več stoletij beneški protektorat. V vojni je prišlo tudi do hitre širitve osmanske mornarice, ki se je lahko merila z Benečani in vitezi hospitalci v boju za premoč v Egejskem morju. V zadnjih letih vojne pa je republika uspela nadoknaditi izgube z dejansko pridobitvijo križarskega Ciprskega kraljestva.

source.title: Ottoman–Venetian War (1463–1479)
paragraphs: The First Ottoman–Venetian War was fought between the Republic of Venice with its allies and the Ottoman Empire from 1463 to 1479. Fought shortly after the capture of Constantinople and the remnants of the Byzantine Empire by the Ottomans, it resulted in the loss of several Venetian holdings in Albania and Greece, most importantly the island of Negroponte (Euboea), which had been a Venetian protectorate for centuries. The war also saw the rapid expansion of the Ottoman navy, which became able to challenge the Venetians and the Knights Hospitaller for supremacy in the Aegean Sea. In the closing years of the war, however, the Republic managed to recoup its losses by the de facto acquisition of the Crusader Kingdom of Cyprus.

Ottoman–Venetian War (1714–1718).headline: Osmansko-beneška vojna (1714–1718)
paragraphs: Sedma osmansko-beneška vojna (imenovana tudi druga morejska vojna, mala vojna ali na Hrvaškem sinjska vojna) je potekala med Beneško republiko in Osmanskim cesarstvom med letoma 1714 in 1718. Bila je zadnji spopad med tema silama in se je končala z osmansko zmago ter izgubo največje beneške posesti na grškem polotoku, Peloponeza (Moreje). Osmane so podprle tudi berberske države. Benetke sta pred hujšim porazom rešila avstrijski poseg leta 1716 in nekaj pomorskih uspehov. Vojna se je končala s požarevskim mirom leta 1718.
notes: The English sentence on the Barbary States has no main verb; the Slovenian says what it plainly means.

source.title: Ottoman–Venetian War (1714–1718)
paragraphs: The Seventh Ottoman–Venetian War (also called the Second Morean War, the Small War or, in Croatia, the War of Sinj) was fought between the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman Empire between 1714 and 1718. It was the last conflict between the two powers, and ended with an Ottoman victory and the loss of Venice's major possession in the Greek peninsula, the Peloponnese (Morea). Where the Barbary States intervention to support the Ottomans. Venice was saved from a greater defeat by the intervention of Austria in 1716 and by some naval success. The war ended with Treaty of Passarowitz in 1718.

Pakrac clash.headline: Spopad v Pakracu
paragraphs: Spopad v Pakracu, na Hrvaškem znan kot bitka za Pakrac (hrvaško: Bitka za Pakrac), je bil nekrvav spopad v hrvaškem mestu Pakrac marca 1991. Bil je posledica naraščajočih etničnih napetosti na Hrvaškem med razpadom Jugoslavije in eden prvih resnih izbruhov nasilja v spopadu, ki je prerasel v hrvaško osamosvojitveno vojno.

Spopad se je začel, ko so uporniški Srbi zavzeli mestno policijsko postajo in občinsko stavbo ter nadlegovali predstavnike hrvaške oblasti. Hrvaška vlada je odgovorila s protiudarom in poslala posebno policijo notranjega ministrstva, da bi znova vzpostavila nadzor. Med stranema so izbruhnili boji. Kljub poskusu posredovanja Jugoslovanske ljudske armade (JLA; srbohrvaško: Jugoslovenska Narodna Armija – JNA) je hrvaška vlada znova prevzela nadzor nad mestom. Po zaostrenem soočenju z JLA so se dogovorili o umiku posebne policije in JLA, s čimer so v mestu obnovili razmere, kakršne so bile pred srbskim poskusom prevzema policije.

source.title: Pakrac clash
paragraphs: The Pakrac clash, known in Croatia as the Battle of Pakrac (Croatian: Bitka za Pakrac), was a bloodless skirmish that took place in the Croatian town of Pakrac in March 1991. The clash was a result of increasing ethnic tensions in Croatia during the breakup of Yugoslavia. It was one of the first serious outbreaks of violence in what became the Croatian War of Independence.

The clash began after rebel Serbs seized the town's police station and municipal building and harassed Croatian government officials. The Croatian government carried out a counterstrike against the rebels, sending Interior Ministry special police to re-establish control. Fighting broke out between the two sides. Despite an attempted intervention by the Yugoslav People's Army (Jugoslovenska Narodna Armija – JNA), the Croatian government reasserted its control over the town. After a standoff with the JNA, an agreement to pull out the special police and the JNA was reached, restoring the town to conditions before the Serb attempt to seize control of the police there.

Pallars Jussà je comarca (okraj) v pokrajini Alt Pirineu v Kataloniji v Španiji. Kot comarca je bila ustanovljena leta 1936 iz dela stare grofije Pallars. Ime je arhaizem in pomeni »spodnji Pallars«; severovzhodno od nje, v gorah, leži Pallars Sobirà. Glavno mesto in največja občina je Tremp.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is a medieval state, but its link points to the article on the modern comarca; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Pallars Jussà
paragraphs: Pallars Jussà (Western Catalan: [paˈʎa(ɾ)z ʒuˈsa]) is a comarca (county) in Alt Pirineu, Catalonia, Spain. It was established as a comarca in 1936, out of the old county of Pallars. The name is an archaism meaning "Lower Pallars"; to the northeast and into the mountains is Pallars Sobirà. Its capital and largest municipality is Tremp.

Pallars Sobirà je comarca (okraj) v severozahodnem delu pokrajine Alt Pirineu v Kataloniji v Španiji. Ime pomeni »zgornji Pallars« in jo loči od bolj naseljene (in manj gorate) comarce Pallars Jussà na jugozahodu. Glavno mesto in največja občina je Sort.

Pallars Sobirà leži v osrednjih Pirenejih in se razteza od juga proti severu, od soteske Collegats do vasi Alós d'Isil, ob toku reke Noguera Pallaresa. Po površini je četrta največja comarca v Kataloniji in ima eno najnižjih gostot prebivalstva v državi, okoli 5,1 prebivalca na km². Skupaj ima približno 7000 prebivalcev.
V Pallars Sobirà ležita največje jezero v Pirenejih, jezero Certascan, in najvišji vrh Katalonije, Pica d'Estats (3143 m).
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is a medieval state, but its link points to the article on the modern comarca; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Pallars Sobirà
paragraphs: Pallars Sobirà (Western Catalan: [paˈʎa(ɾ)s soβiˈɾa]) is a comarca (county) in the northwest region of Alt Pirineu, in Catalonia, Spain. The name means "Upper Pallars", distinguishing it from the more populous (and less mountainous) Pallars Jussà to its southwest. Its capital and largest municipality is Sort.

Located in the central Pyrenees, Pallars Sobirà stretches from south to north, starting at the gorge of Collegats to the village of Alós d'Isil, following the course of the river Noguera Pallaresa. It is the fourth biggest comarca in Catalonia in terms of surface area, and has one of the lowest densities of population in the country, about 5.1 inhabitants per km². All together, it has approximately 7,000 inhabitants.
Pallars Sobirà contains the largest lake in the Pyrenees, the lake of Certascan, and the highest peak in Catalonia, the Pica d'Estats (3,143 m).

Pariški sporazum (imenovan tudi pariški podnebni sporazum) je mednarodna pogodba o podnebnih spremembah, podpisana leta 2016. Pogodba zajema blaženje podnebnih sprememb, prilagajanje nanje in financiranje. Izpogajalo jo je 196 pogodbenic na konferenci Združenih narodov o podnebnih spremembah leta 2015 blizu Pariza v Franciji. Januarja 2026 je bilo pogodbenic sporazuma 194 članic Okvirne konvencije Združenih narodov o spremembi podnebja (UNFCCC). Med tremi državami članicami UNFCCC, ki sporazuma niso ratificirale, je edini večji vir izpustov Iran. Združene države, drugi največji vir izpustov, so iz sporazuma izstopile leta 2020, se mu znova pridružile leta 2021 in leta 2026 znova izstopile.

Dolgoročni temperaturni cilj Pariškega sporazuma je omejiti dvig povprečne temperature površja Zemlje na precej manj kot 2 °C nad predindustrijsko ravnjo. Pogodba navaja tudi, da naj bi bila meja dviga po možnosti le 1,5 °C. Meji sta opredeljeni kot povprečji svetovne temperature, merjene v dvajsetih letih.
notes: The Fahrenheit conversions are dropped.

source.title: Paris Agreement
paragraphs: The Paris Agreement (also called the Paris Accords or Paris Climate Accords) is an international treaty on climate change that was signed in 2016. The treaty covers climate change mitigation, adaptation, and finance. The Paris Agreement was negotiated by 196 parties at the 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference near Paris, France. As of January 2026, 194 members of the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) are parties to the agreement. Of the three UNFCCC member states which have not ratified the agreement, the only major emitter is Iran. The United States, the second largest emitter, withdrew from the agreement in 2020, rejoined in 2021, and withdrew again in 2026.

The Paris Agreement has a long-term temperature goal which is to keep the rise in global surface temperature to well below 2 °C (3.6 °F) above pre-industrial levels. The treaty also states that preferably the limit of the increase should only be 1.5 °C (2.7 °F). These limits are defined as averages of the global temperature measured over twenty years.

Paris Convention for the Protection of I.headline: Pariška konvencija za varstvo industrijske lastnine
paragraphs: Pariška konvencija za varstvo industrijske lastnine, podpisana 20. marca 1883 v Parizu v Franciji, je ena prvih pogodb o intelektualni lastnini. Ustanovila je Unijo za varstvo industrijske lastnine. Konvencija še velja, njene vsebinske določbe pa spadajo v tri glavne skupine: nacionalno obravnavo, prednostno pravico in skupna pravila.

source.title: Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property
paragraphs: The Paris Convention for the Protection of Industrial Property, signed in Paris, France, on 20 March 1883, is one of the first intellectual property treaties. It established a Union for the protection of industrial property. The convention is in force, with the substantive provisions of the Convention falling into three main categories: national treatment, priority right and common rules.

Paris Declaration Respecting Maritime La.headline: Pariška deklaracija o pomorskem pravu
paragraphs: Pariška deklaracija o pomorskem pravu z dne 16. aprila 1856 je bila mednarodna večstranska pogodba, ki so jo sprejele vojskujoče se strani v krimski vojni, zbrane na pariškem kongresu, potem ko je bil marca 1856 podpisan pariški mir. Kot pomembna novost v mednarodnem pravu je pogodba prvič omogočila, da so države, ki niso sodelovale pri oblikovanju sporazuma in ga niso podpisale, pozneje postale pogodbenice s pristopom k deklaraciji. To je storilo skupno 55 držav, kar bi bilo sicer v tako kratkem času nemogoče. To je bil velik korak v globalizaciji mednarodnega prava.

source.title: Paris Declaration Respecting Maritime Law
paragraphs: The Paris Declaration Respecting Maritime Law of 16 April 1856 was an international multilateral treaty agreed to by the warring parties in the Crimean War gathered at the Congress at Paris after the peace treaty of Paris had been signed in March 1856. As an important juridical novelty in international law, the treaty for the first time created the possibility for nations that were not involved in the establishment of the agreement and did not sign, to become a party by acceding the declaration afterwards. So did altogether 55 nations, which otherwise would have been impossible in such a short period. This represented a large step in the globalisation of international law.

Paris Peace Accords.headline: Pariški mirovni sporazumi (1973)
paragraphs: Pariški mirovni sporazumi (vietnamsko: Hiệp định Paris về Việt Nam, dobesedno »Pariški sporazum o Vietnamu«), uradno Sporazum o končanju vojne in ponovni vzpostavitvi miru v Vietnamu (Hiệp định về chấm dứt chiến tranh, lập lại hòa bình ở Việt Nam), so bili mirovni sporazum, podpisan 27. januarja 1973, da bi vzpostavili mir v Vietnamu in končali vietnamsko vojno. Sestavljali so ga glavna pogodba in spremljajoče priloge. Združene države Amerike so sporazum 13. maja 1974 registrirale pri Sekretariatu Združenih narodov. Vpisan je v Zbirko pogodb Združenih narodov (UNTS) v zvezku 935 pod številko 13295. Sporazum je začel veljati ob podpisu in je vključeval premirje, ki naj bi začelo veljati 27. januarja ob 24.00 po greenwiškem času. Podpisali so ga Demokratična republika Vietnam (Severni Vietnam), Republika Vietnam (Južni Vietnam), začasna revolucionarna vlada (PRG) in Združene države. PRG je zastopala Vietkong (VC, NLF), južnovietnamsko opozicijsko gibanje, ki ga je dejansko nadzoroval sever. Ameriške kopenske sile so se iz Vietnama začele umikati leta 1969, do začetka leta 1972 pa so bile preostale enote le še malo vpletene v boje. Zadnji ameriški pehotni bataljoni so se umaknili avgusta 1972. Do takrat je iz Južnega Vietnama odšla tudi večina letalskih in pomorskih sil ter večina svetovalcev, čeprav so imele letalske in pomorske sile, ki niso bile nameščene v Južnem Vietnamu, v vojni še vedno simbolno vlogo. Pariški sporazum je odstranil preostale ameriške sile in neposredno ameriško vojaško posredovanje se je končalo. Boji med tremi preostalimi silami se 28. januarja niso ustavili niti za uro. Sporazum ni bil formalno označen kot pogodba in predsednik Nixon senata ZDA ni prosil za ratifikacijo.

source.title: Paris Peace Accords
paragraphs: The Paris Peace Accords (Vietnamese: Hiệp định Paris về Việt Nam, lit. 'Paris Treaty about Vietnam'), officially the Agreement on ending the war and restoring peace in Viet-Nam (Hiệp định về chấm dứt chiến tranh, lập lại hòa bình ở Việt Nam), was a peace agreement signed on 27 January 1973 to establish peace in Vietnam and end the Vietnam War. It included a main treaty and accompanying annexes. The agreement was registered by the United States of America on May 13, 1974, with the United Nations Secretariat. It is recorded in the United Nations Treaty Series (UNTS) under Volume 935, Treaty No.13295. The agreement entered into force upon signature and included a cease-fire, which was scheduled to take effect at 24:00 GMT on 27 January. The agreement was signed by the Democratic Republic of Vietnam (North Vietnam), the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam), the Provisional Revolutionary Government (PRG), and the United States. The PRG represented the Viet Cong (VC, NLF), a South Vietnamese opposition movement de facto controlled by the North. US ground forces had begun to withdraw from Vietnam in 1969, and by the beginning of 1972 those that remained had very little involvement in combat. The last American infantry battalions withdrew in August 1972. Most air and naval forces, and most advisers, also were gone from South Vietnam by that time, though air and naval forces not based in South Vietnam were still playing a symbolic role in the war. The Paris Agreement removed the remaining US forces, and direct US military intervention ended. Fighting between the three remaining powers did not stop on 28 January, even for an hour. The agreement was not formally designated a treaty, and President Nixon did not ask the US Senate to ratify it.

Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty.headline: Pogodba o delni prepovedi jedrskih poskusov
paragraphs: Pogodba o delni prepovedi jedrskih poskusov (angleška kratica PTBT), uradno Pogodba o prepovedi poskusov z jedrskim orožjem v ozračju, vesoljskem prostoru in pod vodo iz leta 1963, je prepovedala vse poskusne eksplozije jedrskega orožja razen podzemnih. Okrajšano jo imenujejo tudi pogodba o omejeni prepovedi poskusov (LTBT) in pogodba o prepovedi jedrskih poskusov (NTBT), čeprav se lahko slednje ime nanaša tudi na Pogodbo o celoviti prepovedi jedrskih poskusov (CTBT), ki je za države, ki so jo ratificirale, nasledila PTBT.

source.title: Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty
