paragraphs: The Partial Test Ban Treaty (PTBT), formally known as the 1963 Treaty Banning Nuclear Weapon Tests in the Atmosphere, in Outer Space and Under Water, prohibited all test detonations of nuclear weapons except for those conducted underground. It is also abbreviated as the Limited Test Ban Treaty (LTBT) and Nuclear Test Ban Treaty (NTBT), though the latter may also refer to the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT), which succeeded the PTBT for ratifying parties.

Peace of Alès.headline: Mir iz Alèsa
paragraphs: Mir iz Alaisa, znan tudi kot edikt iz Alèsa ali edikt milosti, je bil pogodba, ki jo je kardinal Richelieu izpogajal z voditelji hugenotov, francoski kralj Ludvik XIII. pa jo je podpisal 28. junija 1629. Potrdil je temeljna verska načela nantskega edikta, razlikoval pa se je po dodatnih določilih, po katerih hugenoti niso imeli več političnih pravic in so morali takoj predati vsa mesta in utrdbe.

Z njim so se končale verske vojne, saj je hugenotom podelil amnestijo in jim zagotovil strpnost. Ni pa trajal večno: Ludvik XIV. je pozneje znova začel preganjati protestante, kar je doseglo vrhunec s preklicem nantskega edikta leta 1685.

source.title: Peace of Alès
paragraphs: The Peace of Alais, also known as the Edict of Alès or the Edict of Grace, was a treaty negotiated by Cardinal Richelieu with Huguenot leaders and signed by King Louis XIII of France on 28 June 1629. It confirmed the basic religious principles of the Edict of Nantes but differed in that it contained additional clauses that stated that the Huguenots no longer had political rights and further demanded for them to relinquish all cities and fortresses immediately.

It ended the religious warring by granting the Huguenots amnesty and guaranteed them tolerance. It did not last permanently, though, as Louis XIV would later resume the persecution of Protestants, culminating in the Revocation of the Edict of Nantes in 1685.

Peace of Bautzen.headline: Mir v Bautznu
paragraphs: Mir v Bautznu (nemško: Frieden von Bautzen; poljsko: Pokój w Budziszynie; gornjelužiško: Budyski měr) je bil mirovni sporazum, ki sta ga 30. januarja 1018 sklenila cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Henrik II. in poljski vladar Boleslav I. Z njim se je končal niz poljsko-nemških vojn za nadzor nad Lužico in Gornjo Lužico – Milzenerlandom ali Milskom, vzhodnim delom Meissenske mejne grofije (Miśnia) – ter nad Češko, Moravsko in Slovaško.

Boleslav je bil tesen prijatelj cesarja Otona III. in je po njegovi smrti za cesarski prestol podpiral enega od Otonovih privržencev, meissenskega mejnega grofa Ekkeharda I., proti zahtevam Henrika II. Ko sta leta 1002 umrla tako Oton III. kot Ekkehard, je Boleslav osvojil Ekkehardovo Meissensko mejno grofijo in Lužiško marko. Ko je Henrik utrdil svoj položaj v Nemčiji, so sklenili dogovor, s katerim sta Boleslavu ostali Lužica in Gornja Lužica, poljski vojvoda pa je Henrika priznal za cesarja Svetega rimskega cesarstva.
notes: The nested brackets on Upper Lusatia are resolved with dashes; Eckard is written in the established form Ekkehard.

source.title: Peace of Bautzen
paragraphs: The Peace of Bautzen (German: Frieden von Bautzen; Polish: Pokój w Budziszynie; Upper Sorbian: Budyski měr) was a treaty concluded on 30 January 1018, between Holy Roman Emperor Henry II and Bolesław I of Poland which ended a series of Polish-German wars over the control of Lusatia and Upper Lusatia (Milzenerland or Milsko, the eastern part of the margraviate of Meissen (Miśnia)) as well as Bohemia, Moravia and Slovakia.

Bolesław had enjoyed the close friendship of the emperor Otto III and after his death supported one of Otto's followers, Eckard I, Margrave of Meissen for the position of Holy Roman Emperor, against the claims of Henry II. After both emperor Otto III and Eckard's death in 1002, Bolesław conquered Eckard's domain of Meissen, as well as the march of Lusatia. Once Henry secured his position within Germany, an agreement was reached which left Bolesław with Lusatia and Upper Lusatia while the Polish duke in turn recognized Henry as Holy Roman Emperor.

Peace of Busza.headline: Mir v Buszi
paragraphs: Mir v Buszi (Buši, Bose), znan tudi kot pogodba iz Jaruge, je bil sporazum, ki sta ga 23. septembra 1617 v Buszi (Buši ali Bose) blizu rek Jaruga in Dnester izpogajala Stanisław Żółkiewski iz Poljsko-litovske republike in Iskender-paša iz Osmanskega cesarstva. Poljska in osmanska vojska sta se srečali, a sta se namesto boja odločili za pogajanja. Poljsko-litovska republika se je v tej mirovni pogodbi zavezala, da bo Osmanom odstopila Hotin in prenehala posegati v Moldavijo.

Pogodba iz leta 1617 je določala, da se Poljska ne bo vmešavala v notranje zadeve osmanskih vazalov v Transilvaniji, Moldaviji in Vlaški, da bo republika kozakom preprečevala vpade na ozemlje Osmanskega cesarstva in da bo odstopila Hotin. Osmansko cesarstvo je v zameno obljubilo, da bo ustavilo tatarske vpade. Dobilo je tudi pravico posegati v Transilvanijo, Moldavijo in Vlaško ter izbirati vladarje teh dežel.

source.title: Peace of Busza
paragraphs: The Peace of Busza (Busha, Bose) also known as the Treaty of Jaruga was negotiated by Stanisław Żółkiewski of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Iskender Pasha of the Ottoman Empire in Busza (Busha or Bose) near the Yaruha and Dniester rivers on 23 September 1617. Polish and Ottoman armies met, but decided to negotiate, instead of to fight. In this peace treaty Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth agreed to cede the Khotyn to the Ottomans and to stop its interference in Moldavia.

That 1617 treaty stated that Poland would not interfere in the internal affairs of Ottoman vassals in Transylvania, Moldavia and Wallachia, the Commonwealth was to prevent Cossacks from raiding lands in the Ottoman Empire, while ceding Khotyn. In return, the Ottoman Empire promised to stop Tatar raids. The Ottoman Empire also had the right to interfere in Transylvania, Moldavia and Wallachia and select the rulers of that region.

Peace of Constance.headline: Konstanški mir
paragraphs: Konstanški mir (25. junija 1183) je bil privilegij, ki sta ga cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Friderik I. in njegov sin in sovladar, rimski kralj Henrik VI., podelila članicam Lombardske lige, da bi končala stanje upora (vojne), ki je trajalo od leta 1167. Bil je trajen mir, ki je nadomestil šestletno premirje, določeno z beneškim mirom (22. julija 1177).

Ker se je bližal iztek premirja, so se cesar in liga v začetku leta 1183 začeli pogajati. Vrstili so se predlogi in protipredlogi, posebej so uredili sporni položaj Alessandrie, v Piacenzi pa so podpisali predhodni sporazum. Sporazum iz Piacenze je bil podlaga za dokončni mir, ki so ga izdali kot cesarski privilegij, ker cesar formalno ni mogel skleniti pogodbe s svojimi podložniki.

source.title: Peace of Constance
paragraphs: The Peace of Constance (25 June 1183) was a privilege granted by Frederick I, Holy Roman Emperor, and his son and co-ruler, Henry VI, King of the Romans, to the members of the Lombard League to end the state of rebellion (war) that had been ongoing since 1167. It was a permanent peace that superseded the six-year truce imposed by the Treaty of Venice (22 July 1177).

With the expiration of the truce approaching, negotiations between the emperor and the league were begun in early 1183. There were proposals and counter-proposals, a separate settlement of the disputed status of Alessandria and a preliminary agreement signed at Piacenza. The treaty of Piacenza formed the basis for the final peace, which was issued as an imperial privilege because formally the emperor could not sign a treaty with his subjects.

Peace of Leoben.headline: Leobenski mir
paragraphs: Leobenski mir je bil splošno premirje in predhodni mirovni sporazum med Svetim rimskim cesarstvom in Francosko prvo republiko, s katerim se je končala vojna prve koalicije. Podpisali so ga 18. aprila 1797 (29. germinala leta V po francoskem revolucionarnem koledarju) v vrtni hiši Eggenwaldsches Gartenhaus blizu Leobna: v imenu cesarja Franca II. sta ga podpisala general Maximilian von Merveldt in markiz di Gallo, v imenu francoskega direktorija pa general Napoléon Bonaparte. Ratifikacijske listine so izmenjali 24. maja v Montebellu in pogodba je takoj začela veljati.

source.title: Peace of Leoben
paragraphs: The Peace of Leoben was a general armistice and preliminary peace agreement between the Holy Roman Empire and the First French Republic that ended the War of the First Coalition. It was signed at Eggenwaldsches Gartenhaus, near Leoben, on 18 April 1797 (29 germinal V in the French revolutionary calendar) by General Maximilian von Merveldt and the Marquis of Gallo on behalf of the Emperor Francis II and by General Napoléon Bonaparte on behalf of the French Directory. Ratifications were exchanged in Montebello on 24 May, and the treaty came into effect immediately.

Peace of Paris (1783).headline: Pariški mir (1783)
paragraphs: Pariški mir iz leta 1783 je bil sklop pogodb, ki so končale ameriško vojno za neodvisnost. Predstavniki britanskega kralja Jurija III. so 3. septembra 1783 v Parizu podpisali pogodbo s predstavniki Združenih držav Amerike – navadno znano kot pariška pogodba (1783) –, v Versaillesu pa dve pogodbi s predstavniki francoskega kralja Ludvika XVI. in španskega kralja Karla III. – navadno znani kot versajski pogodbi (1783). Dan prej je bila podpisana predhodna pogodba s predstavniki generalnih stanov Nizozemske republike, končna pogodba, ki je končala četrto angleško-nizozemsko vojno, pa je bila podpisana šele 20. maja 1784.
notes: The closing clause "for convenience, however, it is included in the summaries below" refers to sections of the English article that the drawer does not show, so it is dropped.

source.title: Peace of Paris (1783)
paragraphs: The Peace of Paris of 1783 was the set of treaties that ended the American Revolutionary War. On 3 September 1783, representatives of King George III of Great Britain signed a treaty in Paris with representatives of the United States of America—commonly known as the Treaty of Paris (1783)—and two treaties at Versailles with representatives of King Louis XVI of France and King Charles III of Spain—commonly known as the Treaties of Versailles (1783). The previous day, a preliminary treaty had been signed with representatives of the States General of the Dutch Republic, but the final treaty which ended the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War was not signed until 20 May 1784; for convenience, however, it is included in the summaries below.

Peace of Philocrates.headline: Filokratov mir
paragraphs: Filokratov mir je ime mirovne pogodbe, ki so jo leta 346 pr. n. št. sklenile Atene in Makedonija pod Filipom II. Filokrat je bil glavni atenski pogajalec.

source.title: Peace of Philocrates
paragraphs: Peace of Philocrates is the name of the peace treaty concluded in 346 BCE between Athens and Macedon under Philip II. Philocrates was the name of the main Athenian negotiator of the Treaty.

Praški mir, datiran 30. maja 1635 po starem koledarju, je bil pomembna prelomnica tridesetletne vojne. Podpisala sta ga saški volilni knez Janez Jurij I. in cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Ferdinand II., njegova določila pa so končala saško podporo proticesarski koaliciji pod vodstvom Švedske.

Pogodbi so se pozneje pridružile še druge države Svetega rimskega cesarstva, njihov izstop iz vojne pa je bil ključni razlog, da je katoliška Francija vstopila v vojno kot zaveznica protestantske Švedske. Čeprav so se boji nadaljevali do leta 1648, na splošno velja, da vojna po praškem miru ni bila več predvsem verska.

source.title: Peace of Prague (1635)
paragraphs: The Peace of Prague, dated 30 May 1635 Old Style, was a significant turning point in the Thirty Years' War. Signed by John George I, Elector of Saxony, and Ferdinand II, Holy Roman Emperor, the terms ended Saxony's support for the anti-Imperial coalition led by Sweden.

Other states within the Holy Roman Empire subsequently joined the treaty, and their exit was a key factor in Catholic France entering the war as an ally of Protestant Sweden. Although fighting continued until 1648, it is generally agreed Prague ended the war as primarily one of religion.

Praški mir (nemško: Prager Frieden) je bil mirovni sporazum, ki sta ga 23. avgusta 1866 v Pragi podpisali Kraljevina Prusija in Avstrijsko cesarstvo. Skupaj s pogodbami med Prusijo in več južnonemškimi in srednjenemškimi državami je dejansko končal avstrijsko-prusko vojno.

Pogodba je bila do Avstrijskega cesarstva prizanesljiva, ker je Otto von Bismarck kralja Viljema I. prepričal, da bo za prihodnost Prusije bolje ohraniti mesto Avstrije v Evropi kot ji vsiliti stroge pogoje.

source.title: Peace of Prague (1866)
paragraphs: The Peace of Prague (German: Prager Frieden) was a peace treaty signed by the Kingdom of Prussia and the Austrian Empire at Prague on 23 August 1866. In combination with the treaties of Prussia and several south and central German states, it effectively ended the Austro-Prussian War.

The treaty was lenient toward the Austrian Empire because Otto von Bismarck had persuaded King Wilhelm I that maintaining Austria's place in Europe would be better for the future of Prussia than harsh terms.

Peace of Raciążek.headline: Mir v Raciążku
paragraphs: Mir v Raciążku je bil mirovni sporazum, ki so ga 22. maja 1404 sklenili Kraljevina Poljska, Velika litovska kneževina in tevtonski vitezi, zadeval pa je nadzor nad Dobrzyńsko deželo in Žemaitijo. Poljska je v bistvu potrdila kališki mir iz leta 1342, Litva pa pogodbo iz Salynasa iz leta 1398. Sporazum ni bil trden in razmere so se kmalu spremenile s poljsko-litovsko-tevtonsko vojno v letih 1409–1411.

Poljska je ob podpori papeštva okrepila vezi z Veliko kneževino, ko je leta 1401 podpisala vilensko-radomsko unijo. Istega leta so se Žemaiti uprli vitezom in požgali več tevtonskih gradov. Vitezi so se maščevali s pohodi na Kaunas in Grodno. Leta 1402 se je red povezal z litovskim knezom Švitrigailo, bratom Vladislava II. Jagiela, ki je obljubil, da bo spoštoval pogodbo iz Salynasa in vitezom odstopil Žemaitijo.
notes: The English dates the Treaty of Kalisz to 1342 (it is usually dated 1343); the Slovenian keeps the source's year.

source.title: Peace of Raciążek
paragraphs: Peace of Raciążek was a treaty signed on 22 May 1404 between Kingdom of Poland, Grand Duchy of Lithuania, and the Teutonic Knights, regarding the control of the Dobrzyń Land and Samogitia. Poland in essence confirmed the Treaty of Kalisz of 1342 and Lithuania – the Treaty of Salynas of 1398. The treaty was not stable and the situation soon changed with the Polish-Lithuanian–Teutonic War of 1409–1411.

Poland, with support of the papacy, was able to increase its ties with the Grand Duchy, by signing the Union of Vilnius and Radom in 1401. The same year Samogitians rebelled against the Knights. The rebels burnt several Teutonic castles. The Knights retaliated by raiding Kaunas and Grodno. In 1402 the Order allied with Lithuanian duke Švitrigaila, brother of Władysław II Jagiełło, who promised to follow the Treaty of Salynas and cede Samogitia to the Knights.

Mir iz Rijswijka (Ryswick) je bil niz pogodb, podpisanih v nizozemskem mestu Rijswijk med 20. septembrom in 30. oktobrom 1697. Končale so devetletno vojno (1688–1697) med Francijo in veliko alianso, v kateri so bile Nizozemska republika, Sveto rimsko cesarstvo, Anglija, Škotska in Španija.

V tej vojni, eni od vrste vojn, ki jih je francoski kralj Ludvik XIV. bojeval med letoma 1666 in 1714, nobena stran ni dosegla pomembnejših ozemeljskih pridobitev. Do leta 1695 sta zaradi ogromnih finančnih stroškov, razširjene lakote in gospodarskih pretresov obe strani potrebovali mir. Pogajanja je zavleklo vprašanje, kdo bo podedoval Špansko cesarstvo od brezdetnega in neozdravljivo bolnega španskega kralja Karla II.; najbližja dediča sta bila Ludvik in cesar Leopold I.

Ker Ludvik ni mogel vsiliti rešitve, ki bi mu bila najljubša, se o vprašanju ni hotel pogovarjati, Leopold pa brez njegove vključitve ni hotel podpisati. Nazadnje je to zelo nerad storil 30. oktobra 1697, vendar je mir na splošno veljal za premirje; Karlova smrt leta 1700 je privedla do vojne za špansko nasledstvo.

source.title: Peace of Ryswick
paragraphs: The Peace of Ryswick, or Rijswijk, were a series of treaties signed in the Dutch city of Rijswijk between 20 September and 30 October 1697. They ended the 1688 to 1697 Nine Years' War between France and the Grand Alliance, which included the Dutch Republic, the Holy Roman Empire, England, Scotland, and Spain.

One of a series of wars fought by Louis XIV of France between 1666 and 1714, neither side was able to make significant territorial gains. By 1695, the huge financial costs, coupled with widespread famine and economic dislocation, meant both sides needed peace. Negotiations were delayed by the question of who would inherit the Spanish Empire from the childless and terminally ill Charles II of Spain, the closest heirs being Louis and Emperor Leopold I.

Since Louis could not impose his preferred solution, he refused to discuss the issue, while Leopold refused to sign without its inclusion. He finally did so with great reluctance on 30 October 1697, but the Peace was generally viewed as a truce; Charles' death in 1700 led to the War of the Spanish Succession.

Peace of Travendal.headline: Travendalski mir
paragraphs: Travendalski mir je bil mirovni sporazum, ki so ga na začetku velike severne vojne 18. avgusta 1700 v Traventhalu sklenili Švedski imperij, Danska-Norveška in Holstein-Gottorp. Danska je morala Holstein-Gottorp vrniti njegovemu vojvodi, švedskemu zavezniku, in izstopiti iz protišvedskega zavezništva. Pogodbo so zajamčile Francija, Sveto rimsko cesarstvo, Republika Nizozemska in Kraljevina Anglija (od leta 1707 Kraljevina Velika Britanija).

Danci so ostali zunaj vojne, dokler jim hud švedski poraz v bitki pri Poltavi (julija 1709) ni dal priložnosti, da se vanjo vrnejo v ugodnejših razmerah; vmesni čas so izkoristili za reformo svoje vojske. Danski pohod v Skanijo in Blekinge v letih 1709–1710, ki se je začel novembra 1709, je pomenil konec travendalskega miru.
notes: The English gloss "(the Netherlands)" after the Dutch Republic is dropped, as the Slovenian name Republika Nizozemska already says it.

source.title: Peace of Travendal
paragraphs: The Peace of Travendal was a peace treaty concluded at the outset of the Great Northern War on 18 August 1700 between the Swedish Empire, Denmark–Norway and Holstein-Gottorp in Traventhal. Denmark had to return Holstein-Gottorp to its duke, a Swedish ally, and to leave the anti-Swedish alliance. The treaty was guaranteed by France, the Holy Roman Empire, the Dutch Republic (the Netherlands), and the Kingdom of England (from 1707 the Kingdom of Great Britain).

The Danes would stay out of the war until Sweden's major defeat in the Battle of Poltava (July 1709) gave them an opportunity to re-enter the war in more favourable conditions, having used the time in between to reform their army. The Danish Scania and Blekinge campaign 1709–1710, launched in November 1709, ended the Peace of Travendal.

Peace of Vervins.headline: Mir v Vervinsu
paragraphs: Mir v Vervinsu ali pogodbo iz Vervinsa so 2. maja 1598 v mestecu Vervins v Pikardiji na severu Francije, blizu ozemlja Habsburške Nizozemske, podpisali predstavniki francoskega kralja Henrika IV. in španskega kralja Filipa II. pod okriljem legatov papeža Klemena VIII.

source.title: Peace of Vervins
paragraphs: The Peace of Vervins or Treaty of Vervins was signed between the representatives of Henry IV of France and Philip II of Spain under the auspices of the papal legates of Clement VIII, on 2 May 1598 at the small town of Vervins in Picardy, northern France, close to the territory of the Habsburg Netherlands.

Ljudska republika Bolgarija (LRB; bolgarsko: Народна република България, НРБ) je bila bolgarska država, ki je obstajala od leta 1946 do 1990 in ji je vladala Bolgarska komunistična partija (BKP; bolgarsko: Българска комунистическа партия (БКП)) skupaj s koalicijsko partnerico, Bolgarsko kmečko ljudsko zvezo. Med hladno vojno je bila Bolgarija tesna zaveznica in ena najzvestejših satelitskih držav Sovjetske zveze; včasih so jo imenovali »16. sovjetska republika« in ne neodvisna država. Bila je tudi članica Sveta za medsebojno ekonomsko pomoč in Varšavskega pakta. Bolgarsko odporniško gibanje je med drugo svetovno vojno z bolgarskim državnim udarom leta 1944 odstavilo upravo Carstva Bolgarija, kar je končalo zavezništvo države s silami osi in leta 1946 pripeljalo do ljudske republike.
notes: The romanization and the IPA pronunciation of the Bulgarian name are left out; the Cyrillic stays.

source.title: People's Republic of Bulgaria
paragraphs: The People's Republic of Bulgaria (PRB; Bulgarian: Народна република България, НРБ, romanized: Narodna republika Bŭlgariya, NRB; pronounced [nɐˈrɔdnɐ rɛˈpublikɐ bɐɫˈɡarijɐ]) was the Bulgarian state that existed from 1946 to 1990, ruled by the Bulgarian Communist Party (BCP; Bulgarian: Българска комунистическа партия (БКП)) together with its coalition partner, the Bulgarian Agrarian People's Union. Bulgaria was a close ally and one of the most loyal satellite states of the Soviet Union during the Cold War, sometimes being called the 16th Soviet Republic rather than an independent country. Bulgaria was also part of Comecon as well as a member of the Warsaw Pact. The Bulgarian resistance movement during World War II deposed the Tsardom of Bulgaria administration in the Bulgarian coup d'état of 1944 which ended the country's alliance with the Axis powers and led to the People's Republic in 1946.

Ljudska socialistična republika Albanija (albansko: Republika Popullore Socialiste e Shqipërisë) je bila komunistična država, ki je v Albaniji obstajala od 11. januarja 1946 do 29. aprila 1991. Od leta 1946 do 1976 se je imenovala Ljudska republika Albanija. Vladala ji je Albanska partija dela (PPSh), ki je imela v ustavi zapisan monopol nad državno oblastjo.
PPSh je ta monopol uveljavljala z nadzorom nad državo in drugimi množičnimi organizacijami ter nad najvišjim organom državne oblasti v Albaniji, Ljudsko skupščino.

source.title: People's Socialist Republic of Albania
paragraphs: The People's Socialist Republic of Albania (Albanian: Republika Popullore Socialiste e Shqipërisë) was the communist state that existed in Albania from 11 January 1946 to 29 April 1991. Originally founded as the People's Republic of Albania from 1946 to 1976, it was governed by the Party of Labour of Albania (PPSh), which had a constitutionally enshrined monopoly on state power.
The PPSh enforced its monopoly on state power by controlling the state and other mass organizations, and by controlling Albania's supreme organ of state power, the People's Assembly.

Romanje Milosti je bilo angleški katoliški ljudski upor, ki se je začel oktobra 1536 v Yorkshiru in se nato razširil na druge dele severne Anglije, med njimi Cumberland, Northumberland, Durham in severni Lancashire. Protesti so potekali pod vodstvom Roberta Aska. Romanje, »najresnejši od vseh uporov tudorskega obdobja«, je bilo upor proti razkolu kralja Henrika VIII. s katoliško Cerkvijo, razpustitvi manjših samostanov in politiki kraljevega prvega ministra Thomasa Cromwella ter drugim posebnim političnim, družbenim in gospodarskim težavam.

Po zatrtju kratkotrajne lincolnshirske vstaje leta 1536 tradicionalni zgodovinski pogled romanje prikazuje kot »spontani množični protest konservativnih sil na severu Anglije, jeznih zaradi verskih pretresov, ki jih je sprožil kralj Henrik VIII.«. Zgodovinarji so ugotovili, da so k njemu prispevali tudi gospodarski dejavniki.

source.title: Pilgrimage of Grace
paragraphs: The Pilgrimage of Grace was an English Catholic popular revolt beginning in Yorkshire in October 1536 before spreading to other parts of Northern England, including Cumberland, Northumberland, Durham and north Lancashire. The protests occurred under the leadership of Robert Aske. The "most serious of all Tudor period rebellions", the Pilgrimage was a revolt against King Henry VIII's break with the Catholic Church, the dissolution of the lesser monasteries, and the policies of the King's chief minister, Thomas Cromwell, as well as other specific political, social, and economic grievances.

Following the suppression of the short-lived Lincolnshire Rising of 1536, the traditional historical view portrays the Pilgrimage as "a spontaneous mass protest of the conservative elements in the North of England angry with the religious upheavals instigated by King Henry VIII". Historians have observed that there were contributing economic factors.

Pinckney's Treaty.headline: Pinckneyjeva pogodba
paragraphs: Pinckneyjevo pogodbo, znano tudi kot pogodba iz San Lorenza ali madridska pogodba, so 27. oktobra 1795 podpisale Združene države in Španija.

Določila je mejo med Združenimi državami in Špansko Florido ter Združenim državam zagotovila pravico do plovbe po reki Misisipi. S tem sporazumom se je končala prva faza mejnega spora med državama na tem območju, splošno imenovanega spor o Zahodni Floridi.

Pogodbo je za Združene države izpogajal Thomas Pinckney, Španijo pa je zastopal don Manuel de Godoy. Senatu Združenih držav je bila predložena 26. februarja 1796 in po razpravi ratificirana 7. marca 1796. Španija jo je ratificirala 25. aprila 1796, ko so tudi izmenjali ratifikacijske listine. Pogodba je bila razglašena 2. avgusta 1796.

source.title: Pinckney's Treaty
paragraphs: Pinckney's Treaty, also known as the Treaty of San Lorenzo or the Treaty of Madrid, was signed on October 27, 1795, by the United States and Spain.

It defined the border between the United States and Spanish Florida, and guaranteed the United States navigation rights on the Mississippi River. With this agreement, the first phase of the ongoing border dispute between the two nations in this region, commonly called the West Florida Controversy, came to a close.

Thomas Pinckney negotiated the treaty for the United States and Don Manuel de Godoy represented Spain. It was presented to the United States Senate on February 26, 1796, and, after debate, was ratified on March 7, 1796. It was ratified by Spain on April 25, 1796, and ratifications were exchanged on that date. The treaty was proclaimed on August 2, 1796.

Plombières Agreement.headline: Dogovor iz Plombièresa
paragraphs: Dogovor iz Plombièresa (italijansko: Accordi di Plombières; francosko: Entrevue de Plombières) z dne 21. julija 1858 je bil tajni ustni dogovor, ki sta ga v Plombières-les-Bainsu sklenila predsednik vlade Piemonta-Sardinije Camillo Benso, grof Cavour, in francoski cesar Napoleon III. Nekateri starejši angleški viri ga imenujejo pogodba iz Plombièresa. Danes ga imenujejo zgolj »dogovor«, saj ni bilo nič podpisano.

Ker je dokazov malo, so se o podrobnostih dogovora na srečanju pojavljali spori, z leti pa je postalo jasno, da je dogovor odprl pot francosko-piemontskemu vojaškemu zavezništvu 28. januarja 1859 in drugi italijanski vojni za neodvisnost, ki je bila ključen korak k združitvi Italije, dosegli pa so jo v desetletju po dogovoru.

source.title: Plombières Agreement
paragraphs: The Plombières Agreement (Italian: Accordi di Plombières; French: Entrevue de Plombières) of 21 July 1858 was a secret verbal agreement that took place at Plombières-les-Bains between the chief minister of Piedmont-Sardinia, Camillo Benso, Count of Cavour, and the French Emperor, Napoleon III. Some older English sources refer to it as the Treaty of Plombières. In modern times, it is merely referred to as an "agreement", since nothing was signed.

Based on limited available evidence, there have been disputes on the details of what was agreed upon at the meeting, but as years passed it became apparent that the agreement had opened the way for the Franco-Piedmontese military alliance, on 28 January 1859, and for the Second Italian War of Independence that became a vital step towards Italian unification, which was achieved within a decade of the agreement.

Poljsko-kozaško-tatarska vojna (ukrajinsko: Польсько-козацько-татарська війна; poljsko: Wojna polsko-kozacko-tatarska) je potekala med Poljsko-litovsko republiko in zaporoškimi kozaki, zavezniki Poljske, na eni strani ter Kozaškim hetmanatom in Krimskim kanatom, zaveznikoma Osmanskega cesarstva, na drugi. Izbruhnila je po rusko-poljski vojni 1654–1667 in bila uvod v poljsko-osmansko vojno v letih 1672–1676.
notes: The spaced hyphen in the English rendering of the Polish name is closed up.

source.title: Polish–Cossack–Tatar War (1666–1671)
paragraphs: The Polish — Cossack–Tatar War (Ukrainian: Польсько-козацько-татарська війна, Polish: Wojna polsko - kozacko-tatarska) was fought between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, Polish-allied Zaporozhian Cossacks and the Ottoman-allied states of the Cossack Hetmanate and the Crimean Khanate. It occurred in the aftermath of the Russo–Polish War of 1654–1667 and was a prelude to the Ottoman–Polish War of 1672—1676.

Poljsko-češkoslovaška vojna, v čeških virih splošno znana kot sedemdnevna vojna (češko: Sedmidenní válka), je bila vojaški spopad med Češkoslovaško in Poljsko za ozemlje Tešinske Šlezije v začetku leta 1919.

Češkoslovaške sile so vdrle v poljski del Tešinske Šlezije, da bi na spornem ozemlju preprečile volitve v poljski zakonodajni sejm in prispevke tamkajšnjega prebivalstva poljski vojski. V poljskem delu je delovala začasna krajevna civilna vlada, velika večina prebivalcev pa je bila v skladu s prejšnjimi stališči naklonjena pripadnosti Poljski; izjema je bilo območje Frýdka, kjer so imeli Čehi večino zaradi naseljevanja v 19. stoletju in ki ga tedaj niso zahtevali ali nadzorovali niti domačini niti poljska stran ali kako poljsko politično gibanje. Češkoslovaška vojska je hitro napredovala in do konca januarja zavzela večji del Tešinske Šlezije. Glavnina poljske vojske je bila takrat vpletena v poljsko-ukrajinsko vojno, poljske sile pa so se v Tešinski Šleziji soočile s številčno močnejšo in bolje opremljeno češko vojsko.
notes: The English opens with "Czechoslovak-Polish War"; the Slovenian uses the glossary name.
The long English parenthesis on the Polish part of Cieszyn Silesia becomes a sentence of its own.

source.title: Polish–Czechoslovak War
paragraphs: The Czechoslovak-Polish War, widely known in Czech sources as the Seven-Day War (Czech: Sedmidenní válka) was a military confrontation between Czechoslovakia and Poland over the territory of Cieszyn Silesia in early 1919.

Czechoslovak forces invaded the Polish part (with an interim local civilian government, and with a strong majority support for allegiance to Poland, in reflection of earlier views, with the exception of the Frýdek, which had a Czech majority since 19th century settlement, and which had not at the time been claimed or controlled by the locals or the Polish side or a Polish political movement) of Cieszyn Silesia to prevent elections to the Polish Legislative Sejm in the disputed territory and to prevent the local population's contributions to the Polish army. The Czechoslovak army made rapid advancements, capturing most of Cieszyn Silesia by the end of January. The bulk of the Polish army was engaged in the Polish–Ukrainian War at the time, and the Polish forces faced a numerically superior and better equipped Czech Army in Cieszyn Silesia.

Poljsko-litovska vojna je bila nenapovedana vojna, ki sta jo po prvi svetovni vojni bojevali novo neodvisni Litva in Poljska, predvsem na območjih Vilne in Suwałk; bila je del litovskih vojn za neodvisnost in je trajala od maja 1919 do 29. novembra 1920. Od pomladi 1920 je spopad potekal hkrati s širšo poljsko-sovjetsko vojno in nanj je vplival njen potek. Mednarodno posredovanje na konferenci veleposlanikov in v Društvu narodov ni uspelo.

source.title: Polish–Lithuanian War
paragraphs: The Polish–Lithuanian War was an undeclared war fought in the aftermath of World War I between newly independent Lithuania and Poland, with fighting mainly in the Vilnius and Suwałki regions, which was part of the Lithuanian Wars of Independence and lasted from May 1919 to 29 November 1920. From the spring of 1920 onward, the conflict happened alongside the wider Polish–Soviet War and was affected by its progress. It was subject to unsuccessful international mediation at the Conference of Ambassadors and the League of Nations.

Poljsko-osmanska vojna v letih 1633–1634 je bila vojaški spopad med Poljsko-litovsko republiko in Osmanskim cesarstvom, v katerem so se bojevale predvsem sile poljske krone pod vodstvom velikega kronskega hetmana Stanisława Koniecpolskega.

Leta 1633 je vojska pod osmanskim vodstvom, ki ji je poveljeval Abaza Mehmed-paša, vdrla v Podolje, a 22. oktobra v bitki pri Paniowcih ni premagala sil velikega kronskega hetmana Stanisława Koniecpolskega. Leta 1634 je sultan Murat IV. ukazal priprave na večji vdor v republiko. Osmani so sicer zbrali precejšnje sile, vendar so pohod po diplomatskih pogajanjih s poljskimi, osmanskimi, habsburškimi in transilvanskimi predstavniki opustili. Sporazum, sklenjen pozneje istega leta, je potrdil obstoječi mir in določil medsebojne obveznosti glede kozaških in tatarskih vpadov.

source.title: Polish–Ottoman War (1633–1634)
paragraphs: The Polish–Ottoman War of 1633–1634 was a military conflict between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Ottoman Empire, fought primarily by the forces of the Polish Crown under Grand Crown Hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski.

In 1633, an Ottoman-led army commanded by Abaza Mehmed Pasha invaded Podolia but failed to defeat the forces of Grand Crown Hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski at the Battle of Paniowce on 22 October. In 1634, Sultan Murad IV ordered preparations for a larger invasion of the Commonwealth. Although substantial Ottoman forces were mobilised, the campaign was abandoned following diplomatic negotiations involving Polish, Ottoman, Habsburg and Transylvanian representatives. An agreement concluded later that year reaffirmed the existing peace and established mutual obligations concerning Cossack and Tatar raids.

Poljsko-osmanska vojna v letih 1672–1676 je potekala med Poljsko-litovsko republiko in Osmanskim cesarstvom. Končala se je z mirom v Żurawnu, s katerim je republika Osmanom prepustila nadzor nad večino svojih ozemelj v osrednji Ukrajini. Bila je uvod v veliko turško vojno.

source.title: Polish–Ottoman War (1672–1676)
paragraphs: The Polish–Ottoman War of 1672–1676 was fought by the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Ottoman Empire. It ended with the Treaty of Żurawno, by which the Commonwealth ceded control of most of its territories in Central Ukraine to the Ottomans. It was a prelude to the Great Turkish War.

Pomeranian War.headline: Pomorjanska vojna
paragraphs: Pomorjanska vojna je bila eno od prizorišč sedemletne vojne. Izraz označuje boje med Švedsko in Prusijo v letih 1757–1762 na švedskem in pruskem Pomorjanskem, v severnem Brandenburgu in vzhodnem Mecklenburg-Schwerinu.

Za vojno je bilo značilno premikanje švedske in pruske vojske sem ter tja, ne da bi katera dosegla odločilno zmago. Začela se je, ko so švedske sile leta 1757 vdrle na prusko ozemlje, a so jih odbili in zaprli v Stralsundu, dokler jih leta 1758 ni rešila ruska vojska. Ob naslednjem, ponovnem švedskem vpadu na prusko ozemlje so Švedi uničili majhno prusko ladjevje in zasedli ozemlja vse do Neuruppina na jugu, vendar se je pohod konec leta 1759 izjalovil, ker slabo oskrbovanim švedskim silam ni uspelo niti zavzeti velike pruske trdnjave Stettin (danes Szczecin) niti se združiti z ruskimi zavezniki.

source.title: Pomeranian War
paragraphs: The Pomeranian War was a theatre of the Seven Years' War. The term is used to describe the fighting between Sweden and Prussia between 1757 and 1762 in Swedish Pomerania, Prussian Pomerania, northern Brandenburg and eastern Mecklenburg-Schwerin.

The war was characterized by a back-and-forth movement of the Swedish and Prussian armies, neither of whom would score a decisive victory. It started when Swedish forces advanced into Prussian territory in 1757, but were repelled and blockaded at Stralsund until their relief by a Russian force in 1758. In the course of the following, renewed Swedish incursion into Prussian territory, the small Prussian fleet was destroyed and areas as far south as Neuruppin were occupied, yet the campaign was aborted in late 1759 when the undersupplied Swedish forces succeeded neither in taking the major Prussian fortress of Stettin (now Szczecin) nor in combining with their Russian allies.

Sporazum o portugalskem pravopisu leta 1990 (portugalsko: Acordo Ortográfico da Língua Portuguesa de 1990) je mednarodna pogodba, katere namen je ustvariti enoten pravopis portugalščine, ki naj bi ga uporabljale vse države s portugalščino kot uradnim jezikom. Podpisan je bil 16. decembra 1990 v Lizboni po pogajanjih, ki so se leta 1980 začela med Akademijo znanosti v Lizboni in Brazilsko akademijo književnosti. Med podpisniki so bili uradni predstavniki vseh portugalsko govorečih držav razen Vzhodnega Timorja, ki je bil tedaj pod indonezijsko zasedbo, a se je sporazumu pozneje, leta 2004, pridružil, in Ekvatorialne Gvineje, ki je portugalščino za uradni jezik sprejela šele leta 2010.

Galicija je bila povabljena k sodelovanju pri reformi, vendar je španska vlada povabilo prezrla, saj galicijščino in portugalščino uradno šteje za različna jezika. Sestankov pa se je kot opazovalka udeležila neuradna komisija galicijskih jezikoslovcev, ki zagovarjajo enotnost jezika.

source.title: Portuguese-Language Orthographic Agreement of 1990
paragraphs: The Portuguese-Language Orthographic Agreement of 1990 (Portuguese: Acordo Ortográfico da Língua Portuguesa de 1990) is an international treaty whose purpose is to create a unified orthography for the Portuguese language, to be used by all the countries that have Portuguese as their official language. It was signed in Lisbon, on 16 December 1990, at the end of a negotiation, begun in 1980, between the Sciences Academy of Lisbon and the Brazilian Academy of Letters. The signatories included official representatives from all of the Portuguese-language countries except East Timor, which was under Indonesian occupation at the time, but later adhered to the Agreement, in 2004, and Equatorial Guinea, which adopted Portuguese as an official language only in 2010.

Galicia was invited to take part in the reform but the Spanish government ignored the invitation, since it officially regards Galician and Portuguese as different languages. However, an unofficial commission formed by Galician linguists who support the unity of the language attended the meetings as observers.

Potsdam Declaration.headline: Potsdamska deklaracija
paragraphs: Potsdamska deklaracija ali Razglas o pogojih japonske kapitulacije je bila izjava, ki je med drugo svetovno vojno pozvala k vdaji vseh japonskih oboroženih sil. Predsednik ZDA Harry S. Truman, britanski predsednik vlade Winston Churchill in predsednik Kitajske Čang Kajšek so 26. julija 1945 objavili dokument, ki je določal pogoje kapitulacije Japonskega imperija, kot so jih dogovorili na potsdamski konferenci. Ultimat je napovedal, da bo Japonsko, če se ne vda, doletelo »hitro in popolno uničenje«.

source.title: Potsdam Declaration
paragraphs: The Potsdam Declaration, or the Proclamation Defining Terms for Japanese Surrender, was a statement that called for the surrender of all Japanese armed forces during World War II. On July 26, 1945, United States president Harry S. Truman, United Kingdom prime minister Winston Churchill, and President of China Chiang Kai-shek issued the document, which outlined the terms of surrender for the Empire of Japan, as agreed upon at the Potsdam Conference. The ultimatum stated that, if Japan did not surrender, it would face "prompt and utter destruction."

Powys Fadog.headline: Powys Fadog
paragraphs: Severni Powys ali Powys Fadog (valižansko »Madogov Powys«) je bil severni del Kraljestva Powys po njegovem razpadu leta 1160. Gospodje severnega Powysa so imeli kraljevi sedež v gradu Dinas Brân, versko središče pa v opatiji Valle Crucis. Med njegovimi gospostvi so bila Maelor, Mochnant, Glyndyfrdwy, Yale ter Bromfield in Yale.

Po razdelitvi Powysa je imela sorodna veja, knezi Powysa Wenwynwyn, sedež v gradu Powis. Prvi knez kneževine je bil Gruffydd Maelor I., zadnji suvereni knez pa Madog II. ap Gruffydd, nato je sledila osvojitev Walesa pod kraljem Edvardom Dolgonogim.

source.title: Northern Powys (medieval)
paragraphs: Northern Powys or Powys Fadog (Welsh for 'Madog's Powys'), was the northern portion of the Kingdom of Powys following that kingdom's dissolution in 1160. The lords of northern Powys had their royal seat at Castell Dinas Brân and their religious center at Valle Crucis Abbey. Some of its lordships included those of Maelor, Mochnant, Glyndyfrdwy, Yale, and Bromfield and Yale.

Following the division of Powys, their cousin branch, the princes of Powys Wenwynwyn, had their seat at Powis Castle. The principality's first prince was Gruffydd Maelor I, and its last sovereign prince was Madog II ap Gruffydd, following the Conquest of Wales by king Edward Longshanks.

Powys Wenwynwyn.headline: Powys Wenwynwyn
paragraphs: Južni Powys ali Powys Wenwynwyn (valižansko »Gwenwynwynov Powys«) je bil valižansko gospostvo v visokem srednjem veku. Obsegal je južni del nekdanje kneževine Powys, ki je razpadla po smrti Madoga ap Maredudda in umoru njegovega dediča Llywelyna leta 1160: severni del (Maelor) je dobil Gruffydd Maelor in sčasoma se je zanj uveljavilo ime Powys Fadog, južni del (Cyfeiliog) pa Owain Cyfeiliog in zanj se je sčasoma uveljavilo ime Powys Wenwynwyn, po knezu Gwenwynwynu ab Owainu, drugem vladarju.
Južni Powys in Gwynedd sta v naslednjih letih postala zagrizena tekmeca, pri čemer se je prvi pogosto povezoval z Anglijo, da bi oslabil drugega.

source.title: Southern Powys (medieval)
paragraphs: Southern Powys or Powys Wenwynwyn (Welsh for 'Gwenwynwyn's Powys'), was a Welsh lordship which existed during the high Middle Ages. The realm was the southern portion of the former princely state of Powys which split following the death of Madog ap Maredudd and the killing of his heir Llywelyn in 1160: the northern portion (Maelor) went to Gruffydd Maelor and eventually became known as Powys Fadog; while the southern portion (Cyfeiliog) going to Owain Cyfeiliog and becoming known, eventually, as Powys Wenwynwyn after Prince Gwenwynwyn ab Owain, its second ruler.
Southern Powys and Gwynedd became bitter rivals in the years that followed, with the former frequently allying itself with England to further its aims of weakening the latter.

Prague uprising.headline: Praška vstaja
paragraphs: Praška vstaja (češko: Pražské povstání) je bila delno uspešen poskus češkega odporniškega gibanja, da bi maja 1945, ob koncu druge svetovne vojne, osvobodilo Prago nemške okupacije. Šest let okupacije je podžgalo protinemško razpoloženje, hitro napredovanje zavezniških sil Rdeče armade in ameriške kopenske vojske pa je odporu ponudilo možnost uspeha.

source.title: Prague uprising
paragraphs: The Prague uprising (Czech: Pražské povstání) was a partially successful attempt by the Czech resistance movement to liberate the city of Prague from German occupation in May 1945, during the end of World War II. The preceding six years of occupation had fuelled anti-German sentiment and the rapid advance of Allied forces from the Red Army and the United States Army offered the resistance a chance of success.

Prayer Book Rebellion.headline: Upor zaradi molitvenika
paragraphs: Upor zaradi molitvenika ali zahodna vstaja je bil ljudski upor v Cornwallu in Devonu leta 1549. Tistega leta so uvedli prvi Book of Common Prayer (molitvenik), ki je predstavljal teologijo angleške reformacije. Sprememba je bila zelo nepriljubljena, zlasti na območjih, kjer je bila še vedno (tudi po zakonu o supremaciji leta 1534) trdna katoliška verska pripadnost, na primer v Lancashiru.

Nezadovoljstvo je povzročilo tudi uvajanje bogoslužja v angleščini (namesto latinščine) na kornijsko govorečih območjih. Skupaj s slabimi gospodarskimi razmerami je to v Cornwallu in Devonu povzročilo izbruh jeze in vstajo. Edward Seymour, 1. vojvoda Somerset, je v odgovor poslal Johna Russella, da bi upor zatrl; dva meseca po začetku sovražnosti so bili uporniki poraženi, njihovi voditelji pa usmrčeni. Ubitih je bilo do 5500 mož, večinoma katoličanov iz Cornwalla in Devona.

source.title: Prayer Book Rebellion
paragraphs: The Prayer Book Rebellion or Western Rising was a popular revolt in Cornwall and Devon in 1549. In that year, the first Book of Common Prayer, presenting the theology of the English Reformation, was introduced. The change was widely unpopular, particularly in areas where firm Catholic religious loyalty (even after the Act of Supremacy in 1534) still existed, such as Lancashire.

The enforcement of English-language (as opposed to Latin) church services in Cornish-speaking areas also provoked discontent. Coupled with poor economic conditions, this led to an explosion of anger in Cornwall and Devon, initiating an uprising. In response, Edward Seymour, 1st Duke of Somerset, sent John Russell to suppress the revolt, with the rebels being defeated and its leaders executed two months after the beginning of hostilities. Up to 5,500 men were killed, mainly Cornish and Devonian Catholics.

Prespanski sporazum, znan tudi kot pogodba iz Prespe, prespanski dogovor ali prespanska pogodba, je sporazum, ki sta ga leta 2018 pod okriljem Združenih narodov sklenili Grčija in tedanja Republika Makedonija in s katerim sta razrešili dolgoletni spor o imenu. Poleg razrešitve terminoloških razlik sporazum ureja tudi področja sodelovanja med državama, da bi vzpostavili strateško partnerstvo.

Sporazum, podpisan ob skupnem Prespanskem jezeru, po katerem je dobil ime, in ratificiran v parlamentih obeh držav, je začel veljati 12. februarja 2019, ko sta državi ZN obvestili o njegovi dopolnitvi, potem ko je bil 8. februarja ratificiran protokol o pristopu Severne Makedonije k Natu. Nadomestil je začasni sporazum iz leta 1995, ustavno ime Republike Makedonije pa je z njim postalo Republika Severna Makedonija erga omnes.

source.title: Prespa Agreement
paragraphs: The Prespa Agreement, also known as the Treaty of Prespa, the Prespes deal or the Prespa accord, is an agreement reached in 2018 between Greece and the then-Republic of Macedonia, under the auspices of the United Nations, resolving a long-standing naming dispute between the two countries. Apart from resolving the terminological differences, the agreement also covers areas of cooperation between the two countries in order to establish a strategic partnership.

Signed beside the shared Lake Prespa, from which it took its name, and ratified by the parliaments of both countries, the agreement went into force on 12 February 2019, when the two countries notified the UN of the deal's completion, following the ratification of the NATO accession protocol for North Macedonia on 8 February. It replaces the Interim Accord of 1995 and sees the Republic of Macedonia's constitutional name changed to the Republic of North Macedonia erga omnes.

Principality of Beloozero.headline: Kneževina Beloozero
paragraphs: Kneževina Beloozero (rusko: Белозерское княжество) je bila ruska kneževina, ki je med 13. in 15. stoletjem cvetela na ruskem severu.

Njena prestolnica je bil Beloozero (danes Belozersk), eno od petih prvotnih mest, ki jih omenja Povest minulih let. Po današnji upravni razdelitvi Rusije je kneževina ležala na zahodu Vologodske oblasti, okoli južnega dela Belega jezera.

Tesno je bila povezana z Rostovom, dokler se leta 1238 med mongolskimi vpadi ni osamosvojila. Dmitrij Donski si je zagotovil nadzor nad Beloozerom in ga prepustil potomcem; Moskvi jo je formalno priključil Ivan III.

source.title: Principality of Beloozero
paragraphs: The Principality of Beloozero (Russian: Белозерское княжество, romanized: Belozerskoye knyazhestvo) was a Russian principality which flourished between the 13th and 15th centuries in the Russian North.

Its capital was Beloozero (now Belozersk), one of the five original towns mentioned in the Primary Chronicle. In terms of the current administrative division of Russia, the principality was located in the west of Vologda Oblast, around the south of Lake Beloye.

It was closely associated with Rostov until it became independent in 1238 during the Mongol invasions. Dmitry Donskoy secured control over Beloozero and passed it to his descendants; it was formally annexed to Moscow by Ivan III.

Principality of Capua.headline: Kneževina Capua
paragraphs: Kneževina Capua (latinsko: Principatus Capuae ali Capue, sodobno italijansko: Principato di Capua) je bila država s središčem v Capui v južni Italiji, ki je trajala približno tri stoletja. Proti koncu 10. stoletja je kneževina dosegla vrhunec in zajemala večino območja Terra di Lavoro. Prvotno je bila gastaldat, nato grofija v Kneževini Salerno. Pod sicilsko monarhijo je nekdanja kneževina ostala ena od dveh glavnih celinskih sestavnih delov kraljeve oblasti, skupaj z Apulijo, viri iz 12. stoletja pa so njeno ozemlje pogosto označevali kot Terra di Lavoro.

source.title: Principality of Capua
paragraphs: The Principality of Capua (Latin: Principatus Capuae or Capue, Modern Italian: Principato di Capua) was a state centred on Capua in Southern Italy which lasted for about three centuries. Towards the end of the 10th century the Principality reached its apogee, occupying most of the Terra di Lavoro area. It was originally a gastaldate, then a county, within the principality of Salerno. Under the Sicilian monarchy, the former principality remained one of the two chief mainland components of royal rule alongside Apulia, and twelfth-century sources often identified its territory as the Terra di Lavoro.

Kneževina Černigov ali Černihiv je bila ena največjih in najmočnejših držav v Kijevski Rusiji. Nekaj časa je bila po moči druga, takoj za Kijevsko kneževino. Nastala je v 10. stoletju in nekaj svojih posebnosti ohranila do 16. stoletja. Obsegala je območja današnje Ukrajine, Belorusije in Rusije.

source.title: Principality of Chernigov
paragraphs: The Principality of Chernigov or Chernihiv was one of the largest and most powerful states within Kievan Rus'. For a time the principality was the second most powerful after the Principality of Kiev. The principality was formed in the 10th century and maintained some of its distinctiveness until the 16th century. The Principality of Chernigov consisted of regions of modern-day Ukraine, Belarus, and Russia.

Principality of Drutsk.headline: Kneževina Druck
paragraphs: Kneževina Druck (belorusko: Княства Друцкае) je bila majhna apanaža Polocke kneževine s središčem v mestu Druck. Ležala je na stičišču Vitebske, Minske in Mogiljovske regije v današnji Belorusiji.

Apanažna Kneževina Druck je nastala po smrti polockega kneza Vseslava leta 1101, ko so si Vseslavovi sinovi razdelili polocko ozemlje. Druck je dobil Rogvolod-Boris. Kmalu je njeno ozemlje prevzela druga polocka apanažna kneževina, Minska kneževina, ki ji je vladal Gleb Vseslavič. Leta 1116 je Kneževino Druck prevzela Kijevska velika kneževina pod Vladimirjem Monomahom, a jo je do 1150. let vrnila Minski kneževini. Nazadnje jo je v drugi polovici 13. stoletja v celoti prevzela Minska kneževina, v začetku 14. stoletja pa še ena polocka apanažna kneževina, Vitebska kneževina.
notes: The English obsolete spelling Druck is the Slovenian transcription itself and is not repeated. The garbled "three way stick" is read as the meeting point of the three regions.

source.title: Principality of Drutsk
paragraphs: The Principality of Drutsk (Belarusian: Княства Друцкае; obsolete spelling: Druck) was a small appanage of the Principality of Polotsk, centred in the city of Drutsk. It was located on a three way stick between Vitebsk, Minsk and Mogilev regions in modern Belarus.

The appanage principality of Drutsk was established after the death of Vseslav, the Prince of Polotsk, in 1101 and the division of the Polatsk territory between Vseslav's sons. Drutsk was given to Rogvolod-Boris. Soon its territory was taken over by another appanage duchy of Polotsk, Principality of Minsk governed by Gleb Vseslavich. In 1116, the Principality of Drutsk was taken over by the Grand Principality of Kiev governed by Volodymyr Monomakh, but by 1150s it was returned to Principality of Minsk. Eventually Drutsk was entirely taken over by the Principality of Minsk in the second half of the 13th century and in early 14th century by another appanage duchy of Polotsk, Principality of Vitebsk.

Kneževina Halič ali Galicija (ukrajinsko: Галицьке князівство; staro vzhodnoslovansko: Галицкоє кънѧжьство), znana tudi kot Kneževina hališke Rusije, je bila srednjeveška vzhodnoslovanska kneževina in ena glavnih regionalnih držav v političnem okviru Kijevske Rusije. Ustanovili so jo pripadniki starejše veje potomcev Jaroslava Modrega.

Posebnost kneževine je bila pomembna vloga plemstva in meščanov v političnem življenju, saj je bila knežja oblast v veliki meri odvisna od njihovega soglasja. Prestolnica Halič se prvič omenja okoli leta 1124 kot sedež Ivana Vasilkoviča, vnuka Rostislava Tmutarakanskega.

Mihajlo Hruševski navaja, da je posest Halič po smrti svojega očeta Vladimirja Jaroslaviča podedoval Rostislav. Toda stric ga je pozneje izgnal in Rostislav se je umaknil v Tmutarakan. Ozemlje je nato prešlo na Jaropolka Izjaslaviča, sina kijevskega velikega kneza Izjaslava I.
notes: The English opens with Principality of Galicia; the Slovenian leads with the glossary name Kneževina Halič and gives Galicija as the alternative. The romanizations are left out.

source.title: Principality of Galicia
paragraphs: The Principality of Galicia (Ukrainian: Галицьке князівство, romanized: Halytske kniazivstvo; Old East Slavic: Галицкоє кънѧжьство, romanized: Galickoje kǔnęžǐstvo), also known as the Principality of Halych or Principality of Halychian Rus', was a medieval East Slavic principality and one of the main regional states within the political framework of Kievan Rus'. It was established by members of the senior line of the descendants of Yaroslav the Wise.

A distinctive feature of the principality was the significant role of the nobility and townspeople in political life, with princely rule depending largely on their consent. Halych, the capital, was first mentioned around 1124 as the seat of Ivan Vasylkovych, grandson of Rostislav of Tmutarakan.

According to Mykhailo Hrushevsky, the domain of Halych was inherited by Rostyslav after the death of his father, Vladimir Yaroslavich. However, Rostyslav was later expelled by his uncle and moved to Tmutarakan. The territory was subsequently transferred to Yaropolk Iziaslavich, son of the Grand Prince Iziaslav I of Kiev.

Kneževina Lippe (pozneje Lippe-Detmold in nato znova Lippe) je bila država v Nemčiji, ki ji je vladala rodbina Lippe. Ležala je med reko Weser in jugovzhodnim delom Teutoburškega gozda. Kot država je nastala v času Svetega rimskega cesarstva, leta 1789 pa je bila povzdignjena v kneževino. V tem obdobju se je vladajoča rodbina razcepila na več vej, glavna veja pa je imela sedež v Detmoldu. Med reformacijo je kneževina leta 1538 prestopila v luteranstvo, leta 1604 pa v kalvinizem.

Po propadu cesarstva leta 1806 je bila kneževina samostojna, leta 1866 pa se je pridružila Severnonemški zvezi in leta 1871 postala ena od držav Nemškega cesarstva. V 19. stoletju se je postopoma razvila v ustavno monarhijo z zmerno udeležbo zemljiškega plemstva pri vladanju. Njeno gospodarstvo je bilo pretežno kmetijsko in med najšibkejšimi v Nemškem cesarstvu. Po odstopu zadnjega kneza leta 1918 je obstajala naprej kot nemška svobodna država, dokler je leta 1947 niso združili s Severnim Porenjem-Vestfalijo.

source.title: Principality of Lippe
paragraphs: Lippe (later Lippe-Detmold and then again Lippe) was a state in Germany, ruled by the House of Lippe. It was located between the Weser river and the southeast part of the Teutoburg Forest. It originated as a state during the Holy Roman Empire, and was promoted to the status of principality in 1789. During this period the ruling house split into a number of branches, with the main line residing at Detmold. During the Reformation, Lippe had converted to Lutheranism in 1538 and then to Calvinism in 1604.

From the demise of the empire in 1806, the principality was independent, but it joined the North German Confederation in 1866 and became one of the States of the German Empire in 1871. Over the course of the nineteenth century it gradually developed into a constitutional monarchy with moderate participation in government for the landed nobility. Its economy was overwhelmingly agrarian and among the weakest in the German Empire. After the last prince abdicated in 1918, it continued as a Free State of Germany until it was merged into North Rhine-Westphalia in 1947.

Kneževina Orange (francosko: Principauté d'Orange; okcitansko: Principat d'Aurenja) je bila od leta 1163 do 1713 fevdalna država v Provansi na jugu današnje Francije, na vzhodnem bregu reke Rone severno od mesta Avignon, obdana z neodvisno papeško državo Comtat Venaissin.

Nastala je leta 1163, ko je cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Friderik I. burgundsko grofijo Orange (mesto Orange z okolico) povzdignil v suvereno kneževino v okviru cesarstva. Kneževina je postala del razpršenih posesti rodbine Oranje-Nassau, odkar je Viljem Molčeči leta 1544 od bratranca podedoval naslov princa Oranskega, dokler ni bila leta 1713 z utrechtskim mirom dokončno prepuščena Franciji. Čeprav so jo Nassauji tedaj za vedno izgubili, je ta fevd dal ime še obstoječi nizozemski kraljevi hiši. Kneževina je bila dolga približno 19 kilometrov in široka 14 kilometrov, merila pa je 280 km².
notes: The miles and square miles are dropped; the kilometres are kept.

source.title: Principality of Orange
paragraphs: The Principality of Orange (French: Principauté d'Orange; Occitan: Principat d'Aurenja) was, from 1163 to 1713, a feudal state in Provence, in the south of modern-day France, on the east bank of the river Rhone, north of the city of Avignon, and surrounded by the independent papal state of Comtat Venaissin.

It was constituted in 1163, when Holy Roman Emperor Frederick I elevated the Burgundian County of Orange (consisting of the city of Orange and the land surrounding it) to a sovereign principality within the Empire. The principality became part of the scattered holdings of the House of Orange-Nassau from the time that William the Silent inherited the title of Prince of Orange from his cousin in 1544, until it was finally ceded to France in 1713 under the Treaty of Utrecht. Although permanently lost by the Nassaus then, this fief gave its name to the extant Royal House of the Netherlands. The area of the principality was approximately 12 miles (19 km) long by 9 miles (14 km) wide, or 108 square miles (280 km2).

Principality of Peremyshl.headline: Kneževina Peremišl
paragraphs: Kneževina Peremišl je bila srednjeveška kneževina s središčem v Peremišlu (staro vzhodnoslovansko: Перемышль; danes Przemyśl na Poljskem), ki je obsegala Przemyślsko deželo v zgodovinski pokrajini Rdeča Rusija (Červenska dežela ali Rdeča Rutenija). Bila je ena od več manjših kneževin v Haliču (srednjeveški Galiciji), na skrajnem zahodu pokrajine, in je zato mejila na srednjeveško poljsko državo. Od 11. do 13. stoletja so Peremišlu večinoma vladali krajevni knezi iz stranskih vej dinastije Rurikovičev (vladarske rodbine Kijevske Rusije), večkrat pa je prišel tudi pod vpliv sosednjih poljskih ali ogrskih vladarjev. Do 14. stoletja je regija prišla pod trden poljski nadzor.

source.title: Principality of Peremyshl
paragraphs: The Principality of Peremyshl was a medieval principality centered on Peremyshl (Old East Slavic: Перемышль; now Przemyśl, Poland), and encompassing the Przemyśl Land, in the historical region of Red Rus' (Cherven land, or Red Ruthenia). It was one of several minor principalities within Halychyna (medieval Galicia), situated in the most western part of the region, and thus bordering the medieval Polish state. From the 11th and up to the 13th century, Peremyshl was ruled mostly by local princes from collateral branches of the Riurikid dynasty (ruling house of the Kievan Rus'), but on several occasions it also came under influence of neighboring Polish or Hungarian rulers. By the 14th century, the region came under firm Polish control.

Kneževina Perejaslavl (ukrajinsko: Переяславське князівство; rusko: Переяславское княжество) je bila regionalna kneževina Kijevske Rusije od konca 9. stoletja do leta 1323 s središčem v mestu Perejaslavl (danes Perejaslav) ob reki Trubiž.

source.title: Principality of Pereyaslavl
paragraphs: The Principality of Pereyaslavl (Ukrainian: Переяславське князівство; Russian: Переяславское княжество) was a regional principality of Kievan Rus' from the end of 9th century until 1323, based in the city of Pereyaslavl (now Pereiaslav) on the river Trubizh.

Kneževina Reuss-Gera (nemško: Fürstentum Reuß-Gera), po letu 1848 uradno Kneževina Reuss mlajše linije (nemško: Fürstentum Reuß jüngerer Linie), je bila suverena država na ozemlju današnje Nemčije, ki so ji vladali člani rodbine Reuss. Bila je ena od naslednic cesarske grofije Reuss. Grofje Reuss s prestolnicami in rezidencami v Geri, Schleizu, Lobensteinu, Köstritzu in Ebersdorfu so bili leta 1806 vsi povzdignjeni v kneze (Fürst). Ta naslov so nosili poglavarji njihovih naslednjih vej, mlajši člani pa so bili vsak zase princi (Prinz). Vsi moški člani rodbine so se tako pravilno imenovali »princ Heinrich (rimska številka) Reuss, J. L.« brez plemiškega predloga, čeprav so imena vej zaradi priročnosti ostala v pogovorni rabi (na primer »princ Heinrich I. Reuss iz Köstritza«).

source.title: Principality of Reuss-Gera
paragraphs: The Principality of Reuss-Gera (German: Fürstentum Reuß-Gera), officially called the Principality of Reuss Junior Line (German: Fürstentum Reuß jüngerer Linie) after 1848, was a sovereign state in modern Germany, ruled by members of the House of Reuss. It was one of the successor states of the Imperial County of Reuss. The Counts Reuss, with their respective capitals and Residenzen at Gera, Schleiz, Lobenstein, Köstritz and Ebersdorf, were all elevated to the title of prince (Fürst) in 1806. Their successor branch heads shared that title, while their cadets were also each titled prince (Prinz). Thus all males of the family were properly "Prince Heinrich (Roman numeral) Reuss, J.L.", without use of a nobiliary particle, although for convenience their branch names remained in colloquial use (for example, "Prince Heinrich I Reuss of Köstritz").

Principality of Ryazan.headline: Kneževina Rjazan
paragraphs: Kneževina Rjazan, pozneje znana kot Velika kneževina Rjazan, je bila ruska kneževina od leta 1129 do 1521. Njena prestolnica je bilo mesto Rjazan, danes znano kot Stari Rjazan, ki so ga leta 1237 med mongolskimi vpadi uničili. Prestolnico so preselili v Perejaslavl Rjazanski, ki so ga pozneje preimenovali v Rjazan.

Sprva je bila del Muromske kneževine, od Kneževine Černigov pa se je kot Murom-Rjazan povsem odcepila do leta 1129. Murom je leta 1392 prevzela Moskva, Rjazan pa je pozneje postal od Moskve odvisen; leta 1521 ga je formalno prevzel Vasilij in ga vključil v centralizirano rusko državo. Formalno neodvisnost je ohranil dlje kot katera koli druga ruska kneževina.

source.title: Principality of Ryazan
paragraphs: The Principality of Ryazan, later known as the Grand Principality of Ryazan, was a Russian principality from 1129 to 1521. Its capital was the city of Ryazan, now known as Old Ryazan, which was destroyed in 1237 during the Mongol invasions. The capital was moved to Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky, later renamed Ryazan.

Initially a part of the Principality of Murom, it fully split off from the Principality of Chernigov by 1129 as Murom-Ryazan. Murom was taken by Moscow in 1392, while Ryazan later became dependent on Moscow and was formally taken over by Vasili in 1521, and incorporated into the centralized Russian state. It maintained its formal independence longer than any other Russian principality.

Principality of Salerno.headline: Kneževina Salerno
paragraphs: Kneževina Salerno (latinsko: Principatus Salerni) je bila srednjeveška država v južni Evropi, ki je leta 851 nastala iz Kneževine Benevento po desetletni državljanski vojni. Njeno središče je bilo pristaniško mesto Salerno. Čeprav je ob ustanovitvi priznavala oblast karolinškega cesarja, je bila ves čas svojega obstoja dejansko neodvisna in je svojo zvestobo izmenično usmerjala h Karolingom in njihovim naslednikom na zahodu ter k bizantinskim cesarjem na vzhodu.

source.title: Principality of Salerno
paragraphs: The Principality of Salerno (Latin: Principatus Salerni) was a medieval Southern European state, formed in 851 out of the Principality of Benevento after a decade-long civil war. It was centred on the port city of Salerno. Although it owed allegiance at its foundation to the Carolingian emperor, it was de facto independent throughout its history and alternated its allegiance between the Carolingians and their successors in the West and the Byzantine emperors in the east.

Principality of Terebovlia.headline: Kneževina Terebovlja
paragraphs: Kneževina Terebovlja (ukrajinsko: Теребовлянське князівство) je bila kneževina Kijevske Rusije, ustanovljena okoli leta 1084 kot apanaža, ki jo je dobil Vasilko Rostislavič.

source.title: Principality of Terebovlia
paragraphs: The Principality of Terebovlia (Ukrainian: Теребовлянське князівство) was a principality of Kievan Rus' established as an appanage around the year 1084 and given to Vasylko Rostyslavych.

Principality of Valona.headline: Kneževina Valona
paragraphs: Kneževina Valona in Kanina, znana tudi kot Despotat Valona in Kanina, Kneževina Valona ali Kneževina Vlorë (1346–1417), je bila srednjeveška kneževina v Albaniji, ki je približno obsegala ozemlje današnjih okrožij Vlorë (Valona), Fier in Berat. Sprva je bila vazalna država Srbskega cesarstva, po letu 1355 pa je postala neodvisno gospostvo, čeprav de facto pod beneškim vplivom, in je tako ostala, dokler je leta 1417 niso osvojili osmanski Turki.

source.title: Principality of Valona
paragraphs: The Principality of Valona and Kanina, also known as the Despotate of Valona and Kanina, Principality of Valona or Principality of Vlorë (1346–1417) was a medieval principality in Albania, roughly encompassing the territories of the modern counties of Vlorë (Valona), Fier, and Berat. Initially a vassal of the Serbian Empire, it became an independent lordship after 1355, although de facto under Venetian influence, and remained as such until it was conquered by the Ottoman Turks in 1417.‎

Kneževina Volinija (ukrajinsko: Волинське князівство) je bila zahodna kneževina Kijevske Rusije, ki jo je leta 987 ustanovil knez Vsevolod iz rodu Rurikovičev, s središčem v pokrajini Voliniji na meji današnje Ukrajine, Belorusije in Poljske. Od leta 1069 do 1118 je pripadala Izjaslavičem, ki so vladali predvsem iz Turova. Potem ko so leta 1105 Turov izgubili v korist Monomahovičev, so potomci Izjaslava Jaroslaviča še nekaj let vladali v Voliniji. Od leta 1154 do 1199 so kneževino imenovali Volodimirska kneževina (latinsko: Lodomeria), ko se je od nje odcepila Lucka kneževina (1154–1228).
notes: The cross-reference "(see Principality of Turov)" is dropped.

source.title: Principality of Volhynia
paragraphs: The Principality of Volhynia (Ukrainian: Волинське князівство) was a western Kievan Rus' principality founded by the Rurikid prince Vsevolod in 987 centered in the region of Volhynia, straddling the borders of modern-day Ukraine, Belarus, and Poland. From 1069 to 1118, it belonged to the Izyaslavichi who primarily ruled from Turov (see Principality of Turov). After losing Turov to the Monomakhovichi in 1105, the descendants of Iziaslav Yaroslavovich for a few years continued to rule in Volhynia. From 1154 to 1199, the Principality was referred to as the Principality of Volodymyr (Latin: Lodomeria) when the Principality of Lutsk (1154–1228) was separated.

Protocol on Environmental Protection to.headline: Protokol o varstvu okolja k Pogodbi o Antarktiki
paragraphs: Protokol o varstvu okolja k Pogodbi o Antarktiki, znan tudi kot madridski protokol, je dopolnilni pravni instrument k Pogodbi o Antarktiki, podpisan 4. oktobra 1991 v Madridu. Veljati je začel 14. januarja 1998.

Madridski protokol Antarktiko razglaša za »naravni rezervat, namenjen miru in znanosti« (2. člen). Dopolnjuje in krepi Pogodbo o Antarktiki, da bi povečal varstvo antarktičnega okolja ter odvisnih in povezanih ekosistemov.

source.title: Protocol on Environmental Protection to the Antarctic Treaty
paragraphs: The Protocol on Environmental Protection to the Antarctic Treaty, also known as the Madrid Protocol, is a complementary legal instrument to the Antarctic Treaty signed in Madrid on 4 October 1991. It entered into force on 14 January 1998.

The Madrid Protocol designates Antarctica as a "natural reserve, devoted to peace and science" (Art. 2). It complements and reinforces the Antarctic Treaty in order to increase the protection of the Antarctic environment and dependent and associated ecosystems.

Upor Pugačeva (rusko: Восстание Пугачёва; imenovan tudi kmečka vojna 1773–1775 ali kozaški upor) v letih 1773–1775 je bil najpomembnejši v vrsti ljudskih uporov v Ruskem cesarstvu, potem ko je Katarina II., danes znana kot Katarina Velika, leta 1762 prevzela oblast. Začel se je kot organizirana vstaja jaiških kozakov pod vodstvom Jemeljana Pugačeva, nezadovoljnega nekdanjega poročnika ruske cesarske vojske, v času globokih kmečkih nemirov in vojne z Osmanskim cesarstvom. Po začetnih uspehih je Pugačev prevzel vodstvo vzporedne vlade, se razglasil za Katarininega pokojnega moža carja Petra III. in napovedal odpravo tlačanstva. To organizirano vodstvo je bilo izziv za cesarsko upravo Katarine II.

source.title: Pugachev's Rebellion
paragraphs: Pugachev's Rebellion (Russian: Восстание Пугачёва, romanized: Vosstaniye Pugachyova; also called the Peasants' War 1773–1775 or Cossack Rebellion) of 1773–1775 was the principal revolt in a series of popular rebellions that took place in the Russian Empire after Catherine II, known today as Catherine the Great, seized power in 1762. It began as an organized insurrection of Yaik Cossacks headed by Yemelyan Pugachev, a disaffected ex-lieutenant of the Imperial Russian Army, against a background of profound peasant unrest and war with the Ottoman Empire. After initial success, Pugachev assumed leadership of an alternative government, claiming to be Catherine's late husband Tsar Peter III and proclaiming an end to serfdom. This organized leadership presented a challenge to the imperial administration of Catherine II.

Punctation of Olmütz.headline: Olomuška punktacija
paragraphs: Olomuška punktacija (nemško: Olmützer Punktation), imenovana tudi olomuški sporazum, je bila pogodba med Prusijo in Avstrijo z dne 29. novembra 1850, s katero se je Prusija odpovedala Erfurtski uniji in sprejela obnovo Nemške zveze pod avstrijskim vodstvom. Pogodba je končala jesensko krizo leta 1850 v Nemčiji.

Pogodba je bila sad konference v Olmützu v avstrijski Moravski grofiji (danes Olomouc na Češkem). Znana je tudi kot »olomuško ponižanje«, saj so jo mnogi videli kot kapitulacijo Prusov pred Avstrijci.

Vzrok za pogodbo je bil spor med Prusijo in Avstrijo za vodstvo v Nemški zvezi. Zveza, v kateri je prevladovala Avstrija, je med revolucijami leta 1848 razpadla, delno pa jo je nasledila frankfurtska skupščina. Ko je frankfurtska skupščina propadla, je Prusija v začetku leta 1850 prevzela pobudo za Erfurtsko unijo, federacijo večine nemških držav pod prusko vodstvom.

source.title: Punctation of Olmütz
paragraphs: The Punctation of Olmütz (German: Olmützer Punktation), also called the Agreement of Olmütz, was a treaty between Prussia and Austria, dated 29 November 1850, by which Prussia abandoned the Erfurt Union and accepted the revival of the German Confederation under Austrian leadership. The treaty concluded the Autumn Crisis of 1850 in Germany.

The treaty was the result of a conference held in Olmütz in the Austrian Margraviate of Moravia (now Olomouc, Czech Republic). It is also known as the "humiliation of Olmütz", as the treaty was seen by many as a capitulation of the Prussians to the Austrians.

The reason for the treaty was a conflict between Prussia and Austria about the leadership in the German Confederation. The confederation, dominated by Austria, had been dissolved in the Revolutions of 1848 and partially succeeded by the Frankfurt Assembly. After the Frankfurt Assembly failed, Prussia, in early 1850, took the initiative of the Erfurt Union, a Prussia-led federation of most of the German states.

Racconigi Bargain.headline: Dogovor v Racconigiju
paragraphs: Dogovor v Racconigiju (italijansko: L'accordo di Racconigi, rusko: сделка в Раккониджи, v Rusiji znan tudi kot rusko-italijanski sporazum, Русско-итальянское соглашение) je bil tajni sporazum med italijanskim kraljem Viktorjem Emanuelom III. in ruskim carjem Nikolajem II., sklenjen 24. oktobra 1909 v gradu Racconigi v Italiji.
Med njegovimi določbami so bile tudi naslednje.
Če bi katera od obeh, Rusija ali Italija, z drugo silo sklenila dogovore o vzhodni Evropi, bi v novem dogovoru sodelovala tudi druga pogodbenica.
notes: The English list of terms is cut off after the lead-in; the Slovenian closes the lead-in with a full stop and keeps the single term that follows.

source.title: Racconigi Bargain
paragraphs: The Racconigi Bargain (Italian: L'accordo di Racconigi, Russian: сделка в Раккониджи, also known in Russia as the Russo-Italian Agreement, Русско-итальянское соглашение) was a secret agreement between King Victor Emmanuel III of Italy and Tsar Nicholas II of the Russian Empire, concluded on 24 October 1909 at the Castle of Racconigi, in Italy.
Its terms included:
If Russia or Italy concluded agreements concerning Eastern Europe with another power, the other party of the agreement would also participate in such new agreement.

Dirka do morja (francosko: Course à la mer; nemško: Wettlauf zum Meer, nizozemsko: Race naar de Zee) je potekala od 17. septembra do 19. oktobra 1914 med prvo svetovno vojno, po bitki za meje (7. avgusta – 13. septembra) in nemškem prodoru v Francijo. Invazijo so ustavili v prvi bitki na Marni (5.–12. septembra), nato pa je sledila prva bitka na Aisni (13.–28. septembra), francosko-britanska protiofenziva. Izraz opisuje vzajemne poskuse francosko-britanske in nemške vojske, da bi prek pokrajin Pikardija, Artois in Flandrija obkolili severno krilo nasprotne vojske, ne pa poskusa prodreti proti severu do morja. »Dirka« se je končala na belgijski obali Severnega morja okoli 19. oktobra, ko so zadnje odprto območje od Diksmuideja do Severnega morja zasedle belgijske čete, ki so se umaknile po obleganju Antwerpna (28. septembra – 10. oktobra). Poskusi obhoda so privedli do več srečanjskih bitk, a nobena stran ni dosegla odločilne zmage.
notes: The glossary name Dirka do morja is now used in the other Western Front summaries too (they first said »tek k morju«).

source.title: Race to the Sea
paragraphs: The Race to the Sea (French: Course à la mer; German: Wettlauf zum Meer, Dutch: Race naar de Zee) took place from 17 September to 19 October 1914 during the First World War, after the Battle of the Frontiers (7 August – 13 September) and the German advance into France. The invasion had been stopped at the First Battle of the Marne (5–12 September) and was followed by the First Battle of the Aisne (13–28 September), a Franco-British counter-offensive. The term describes reciprocal attempts by the Franco-British and German armies to envelop the northern flank of the opposing army through the provinces of Picardy, Artois and Flanders, rather than an attempt to advance northwards to the sea. The "race" ended on the North Sea coast of Belgium around 19 October, when the last open area from Diksmuide to the North Sea was occupied by Belgian troops who had retreated after the Siege of Antwerp (28 September – 10 October). The outflanking attempts had resulted in a number of encounter battles but neither side was able to gain a decisive victory.

Raid on Pula.headline: Napad na Pulj
paragraphs: Napad na Pulj je bil podvig italijanske vojne mornarice v noči z 31. oktobra na 1. november 1918, ob koncu prve svetovne vojne. Izvedla sta ga potapljača podpolkovnik Raffaele Rossetti in Raffaele Paolucci, ki sta s človeškim torpedom Mignatta potopila nekdanjo admiralsko ladjo avstro-ogrske vojne mornarice SMS Viribus Unitis. Ladja je bila skupaj z več drugimi plovili zasidrana v jadranskem pristanišču Pulj, glavnem pomorskem oporišču Avstro-Ogrske. Napadalcema je uspelo potopiti admiralsko ladjo in zapuščeno potniško ladjo Wien, ki je do nekaj dni pred napadom služila kot plavajoča vojašnica. Ko je Viribus Unitis potonila, je umrlo približno 300–400 članov posadke.

source.title: Raid on Pula
paragraphs: The raid on Pula was an Italian Navy operation conducted during the night of 31 October – 1 November 1918, at the end of World War I. It was carried out by frogmen Lieutenant Colonel Raffaele Rossetti and Raffaele Paolucci, who used the Mignatta human torpedo to sink the former flagship of the Austro-Hungarian Navy, the SMS Viribus Unitis. She was anchored, with several other vessels, in the Adriatic port of Pula–the main naval base of Austria-Hungary. The raid succeeded in sinking the flagship and the abandoned passenger ship Wien, which had been used as a floating barracks until a few days before the raid. An estimated 300–400 crew members were killed when Viribus Unitis sank.

Raid on the Medway.headline: Napad na Medway
paragraphs: Napad na Medway od 12. do 14. junija 1667 (od 22. do 24. junija po sodobnem gregorijanskem koledarju) med drugo angleško-nizozemsko vojno je bil uspešen napad nizozemske mornarice na angleške vojne ladje, zasidrane na sidriščih ladjevja pred ladjedelnico Chatham in Gillinghamom v grofiji Kent. Angleške ladje naj bi tedaj varovala trdnjava Upnor Castle in zaporna veriga, imenovana »gillinghamska črta«.

Nizozemci pod formalnim poveljstvom Willema Josepha van Ghenta in poročnika admirala Michiela de Ruyterja so več dni obstreljevali in zavzeli mesto Sheerness, pripluli po estuariju Temze do Gravesenda, nato pa po reki Medway do Chathama in Gillinghama, kjer so s topovi obstreljevali utrdbe, požgali ali zajeli tri velike vojne ladje in še deset linijskih ladij ter zajeli in odvlekli admiralsko ladjo angleškega ladjevja HMS Royal Charles, katere krma je še danes razstavljena v Rijksmuseumu v Amsterdamu.

source.title: Raid on the Medway
paragraphs: The Raid on the Medway, during the Second Anglo-Dutch War between June 12 to 14 June 1667, (June 22 to June 24 Gregorian modern calendar) was a successful attack conducted by the Dutch navy on English warships laid up in the fleet anchorages off Chatham Dockyard and Gillingham in the county of Kent. At the time, the fortress of Upnor Castle and a barrier chain called the "Gillingham Line" were supposed to protect the English ships.
