The Dutch, under nominal command of Willem Joseph van Ghent and Lieutenant-Admiral Michiel de Ruyter, over several days bombarded and captured the town of Sheerness, sailed up the Thames Estuary to Gravesend, then sailed into the River Medway to Chatham and Gillingham, where they engaged fortifications with cannon fire, burned or captured three capital ships and ten more ships of the line, and captured and towed away the flagship of the English fleet, HMS Royal Charles, the stern of which is still on display at the Rijksmuseum in Amsterdam.

Vojna žanjcev (katalonsko: Guerra dels Segadors; špansko: Guerra de los Segadores; francosko: Guerre des faucheurs), znana tudi kot katalonski upor ali katalonska revolucija, je bila spopad, ki je med letoma 1640 in 1659 zajel Kneževino Katalonijo, v okviru francosko-španske vojne v letih 1635–1659. Vojna, ki so jo sprožili nemiri med katalonskim kmečkim prebivalstvom in ustanovami ter francoske diplomatske poteze, je privedla do ustanovitve kratkotrajne Katalonske republike in nato do več kot desetletje dolgega spopadanja španske in francoske vojske na katalonskih tleh.

Trajne posledice je imela v pirenejskem miru (1659), s katerim sta bili grofija Roussillon in severna polovica grofije Cerdanya prepuščeni Franciji, s čimer so bila ta severna katalonska ozemlja ločena od Kneževine Katalonije, meje Španije pa so se umaknile do Pirenejev.
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA and the cross-reference "(see French Cerdagne)" are dropped.
The glossary name was misspelt Vojna žajncev; corrected to Vojna žanjcev under overrides.

source.title: Reapers' War
paragraphs: The Reapers' War (Catalan: Guerra dels Segadors, Eastern Catalan: [ˈɡɛrə ðəls səɣəˈðos]; Spanish: Guerra de los Segadores, French: Guerre des faucheurs), also known as the Catalan Revolt or Catalan Revolution, was a conflict that affected the Principality of Catalonia between 1640 and 1659, in the context of the Franco-Spanish War of 1635–1659. Incited by an unrest among the Catalan peasantry and institutions, as well as French diplomatic movements, the war resulted in the establishment of the short-lived Catalan Republic and the subsequent clash of Spanish and French armies on Catalan soil for over a decade.

It had an enduring effect in the Treaty of the Pyrenees (1659), which ceded the County of Roussillon and the northern half of the County of Cerdanya to France (see French Cerdagne), splitting these northern Catalan territories off from the Principality of Catalonia, and thereby receding the borders of Spain to the Pyrenees.

Rebellion of the Alpujarras (1499–1501).headline: Vstaja v Alpujarrah (1499–1501)
paragraphs: Prva vstaja v Alpujarrah v letih 1499–1501 (arabsko: ثورة البشرات الأولى) je bila vrsta uporov muslimanskega prebivalstva Kraljestva Granada v Kastiljski kroni (nekdanjega Granadskega emirata) proti katoliškim vladarjem. Začeli so se leta 1499 v mestu Granada kot odziv na množično prisilno spreobračanje muslimanskega prebivalstva v katoliško vero, ki so ga razumeli kot kršitev granadske pogodbe iz leta 1491. Upor v mestu je hitro zamrl, sledili pa so mu resnejši upori v bližnjem goratem območju Alpujarras. Katoliške sile, ki jih je včasih osebno vodil kralj Ferdinand, so upore zatrle in muslimansko prebivalstvo hudo kaznovale.

source.title: Rebellion of the Alpujarras (1499–1501)
paragraphs: The first rebellion of the Alpujarras of 1499–1501 (Arabic: ثورة البشرات الأولى) was a series of uprisings by the Muslim population of the Kingdom of Granada, Crown of Castile (formerly, the Emirate of Granada) against their Catholic rulers. They began in 1499 in the city of Granada in response to mass forced conversions of the Muslim population to the Catholic faith, which were perceived as violations of the 1491 Treaty of Granada. The uprising in the city quickly died down, but it was followed by more serious revolts in the nearby mountainous area of the Alpujarras. The Catholic forces, on some occasions led personally by King Ferdinand, succeeded in suppressing the revolts and inflicted severe punishment on the Muslim population.

Druga vstaja v Alpujarrah (arabsko: ثورة البشرات الثانية; 1568–1571), včasih imenovana vojna v Alpujarrah ali upor moriskov, je izbruhnila zaradi pragmatične sankcije španskega kralja Filipa II. iz leta 1567 in je bila drugi upor moriskov proti kastiljski kroni v goratem območju Alpujarra in na planoti Granade severovzhodno od mesta Granada. Uporniki so bili moriski, formalno katoliški potomci mudéjarjev (muslimanov pod kastiljsko oblastjo) po prvi vstaji v Alpujarrah.

Do leta 1250 je katoliška rekonkvista muslimanom pustila le še Granadski emirat na jugu Španije. Leta 1492 je mesto Granada padlo v roke katoliških vladarjev, kastiljske kraljice Izabele I. in aragonskega kralja Ferdinanda II., po pogojih kapitulacije pa je vsa pretežno muslimanska regija prišla pod krščansko oblast.

source.title: Rebellion of the Alpujarras (1568–1571)
paragraphs: The second rebellion of the Alpujarras (Arabic: ثورة البشرات الثانية; 1568–1571), sometimes called the War of the Alpujarras or the Morisco Revolt, was triggered by Philip II of Spain's Pragmatic Sanction of 1567 and was the second Morisco revolt against the Castilian Crown in the mountainous Alpujarra region and on the Granada Altiplano region, northeast of the city of Granada. The rebels were Moriscos, the nominally Catholic descendants of the Mudéjares (Muslims under Castilian rule) following the first rebellion of the Alpujarras.

By 1250, the Reconquest of Spain by the Catholic powers had left only the Emirate of Granada, in southern Spain. In 1492, Granada city fell to the Catholic Monarchs—Isabella I of Castile and Ferdinand II of Aragon—and under the terms of capitulation the whole Muslim-majority region came under Christian rule.

Reichskonkordat.headline: Reichskonkordat
paragraphs: Reichskonkordat (»konkordat med Svetim sedežem in Nemškim rajhom«) je pogodba, o kateri sta se pogajala Vatikan in porajajoča se nacistična Nemčija. Podpisala sta jo 20. julija 1933 kardinal in državni sekretar Eugenio Pacelli, poznejši papež Pij XII., v imenu papeža Pija XI., ter podkancler Franz von Papen v imenu predsednika Paula von Hindenburga in nemške vlade. Ratificirali so jo 10. septembra 1933 in velja še danes. Pogodba zagotavlja pravice Katoliške cerkve v Nemčiji. 16. člen določa, da morajo škofje ob nastopu službe priseči zvestobo guvernerju ali predsedniku Nemškega rajha, ki sta ustanovljena po ustavi. Pogodba od vseh duhovnikov zahteva tudi, da se vzdržijo dela v političnih strankah in za politične stranke. Nacisti so začeli kršiti sporazum kmalu po podpisu in kršitve so se stopnjevale ves čas njihove vladavine. Cerkev je protestirala, tudi v encikliki Pija XI. Mit brennender Sorge (»S pekočo skrbjo«) iz leta 1937. Nacisti so načrtovali, da bodo vpliv Cerkve odpravili z omejitvijo njenih organizacij na zgolj verske dejavnosti. Konkordati so bili pomembni, ker se je velika večina nemških nacistov imela za kristjane. Popis prebivalstva maja 1939, šest let po začetku nacistične dobe in leto po priključitvi Avstrije in Češkoslovaške Nemčiji, kaže, da se je 54 % prebivalstva imelo za protestante in 41 % za katolike.

source.title: Reichskonkordat
paragraphs: The Reichskonkordat ("Concordat between the Holy See and the German Reich") is a treaty negotiated between the Vatican and the emergent Nazi Germany. It was signed on 20 July 1933 by Cardinal Secretary of State Eugenio Pacelli, who later became Pope Pius XII, on behalf of Pope Pius XI; and by Vice Chancellor Franz von Papen on behalf of President Paul von Hindenburg and the German government. It was ratified on 10 September 1933 and it remains in force. The treaty guarantees the rights of the Catholic Church in Germany. When bishops take office, Article 16 states that they are required to take an oath of loyalty to the Governor or President of the German Reich established according to the constitution. The treaty also requires all clergy to abstain from working in and for political parties. Breaches of the agreement by the Nazis began soon after it was signed, and escalated throughout their rule. The Church protested, including in the 1937 Mit brennender Sorge encyclical of Pope Pius XI. The Nazis planned to eliminate the Church's influence by restricting its organizations to purely religious activities. The concordants were important because the great majority of German Nazis considered themselves Christian. A census in May 1939, six years into the Nazi era and a year following the annexations of Austria and Czechoslovakia into Germany, indicates that 54% and 41% of the population considered itself Protestant and Catholic, respectively.

Reichstadt Agreement.headline: Reichstadtski sporazum
paragraphs: Ob balkanski krizi sta se avstro-ogrski cesar Franc Jožef I. in ruski car Aleksander II. 8. julija 1876 sestala na tajnih pogovorih, katerih izid so zgodovinarji pozneje zaradi kratkosti poimenovali reichstadtski sporazum (tudi reichstadtska konvencija). Cesarja sta bila povezana drug z drugim in z Nemškim cesarstvom v Zvezi treh cesarjev (Dreikaiserbund). Navzoča sta bila tudi ruski in avstro-ogrski zunanji minister, knez Aleksander Gorčakov in grof Gyula Andrássy. Zaprto srečanje je potekalo 8. julija v češkem mestu Reichstadt (danes Zákupy).

Teden dni po tem, ko je Črna gora napovedala vojno Osmanskemu cesarstvu, sta se vladarja ustno dogovorila o nevmešavanju v srbsko-turško vojno in vnaprej o nevtralnosti Avstro-Ogrske v morebitni vojni med Rusijo in Osmanskim cesarstvom. O tajnem ustnem dogovoru so na obeh straneh ohranjeni le zapisi, ki si deloma nasprotujejo.

source.title: Reichstadt Agreement
paragraphs: On the occasion of the Balkan crisis, Emperor Franz Joseph I of Austria-Hungary and Russian Tsar Alexander II met on 8 July 1876 for secret talks, the results of which were later termed the Reichstadt Agreement (also: Reichstadt Convention) by historians for the sake of brevity. Both emperors were in an alliance with each other and the German Empire in the League of the Three Emperors, or Dreikaiserbund. Present were also the Russian and Austro-Hungarian foreign ministers, Prince Alexander Gorchakov of Russia and Count Gyula Andrássy of Austria-Hungary. The closed meeting took place on July 8 in the Bohemian city of Reichstadt (now Zákupy).

One week after Montenegro's declaration of war on the Ottoman Empire, the monarchs verbally agreed on non-intervention in the Serbian-Ottoman war and in advance on the neutrality of Austria-Hungary in a possible war between Russia and the Ottoman Empire. There are only partially contradictory records of the secret verbal agreement on both sides.

Reinsurance Treaty.headline: Pozavarovalna pogodba
paragraphs: Pozavarovalna pogodba je bila diplomatski sporazum med Nemškim cesarstvom in Ruskim imperijem, ki je veljal od leta 1887 do 1890. Javnost za sporazum ni vedela, poznala ga je le peščica uradnikov v Berlinu in Sankt Peterburgu. Pogodba je bila ključni del mreže zavezništev in sporazumov nemškega kanclerja Otta von Bismarcka, ki naj bi ohranila mir v Evropi in nemško gospodarsko, diplomatsko in politično prevlado. Pomagala je pomiriti napetosti med Rusijo in Nemčijo.

source.title: Reinsurance Treaty
paragraphs: The Reinsurance Treaty was a diplomatic agreement between the German Empire and the Russian Empire that was in effect from 1887 to 1890. The existence of the agreement was not known to the general public, and as such, was only known to a handful of officials in Berlin and St. Petersburg. The treaty played a critical role in German Chancellor Otto von Bismarck's network of alliances and agreements, which aimed to keep the peace in Europe as well as maintaining Germany's economic, diplomatic and political dominance. It helped calm tensions between both Russia and Germany.

Reparations Agreement between Israel and.headline: Sporazum o reparacijah med Izraelom in Zvezno republiko Nemčijo
paragraphs: Sporazum o reparacijah med Izraelom in Zvezno republiko Nemčijo (nemško: Luxemburger Abkommen, dobesedno »luksemburški sporazum«, ali Wiedergutmachungsabkommen, »sporazum o poravnavi«; hebrejsko: הסכם השילומים, »sporazum o reparacijah«) je bil podpisan 10. septembra 1952 in je začel veljati 27. marca 1953. Po sporazumu naj bi Zahodna Nemčija Izraelu plačala stroške za »ponovno naselitev tako velikega števila izkoreninjenih in obubožanih judovskih beguncev« po vojni ter prek Konference o judovskih materialnih zahtevkih proti Nemčiji odškodovala posamezne Jude za izgubo preživetja in premoženja zaradi nacističnega preganjanja.
notes: The Hebrew romanization is dropped; the Hebrew script is kept.

source.title: Reparations Agreement between Israel and the Federal Republic of Germany
paragraphs: The Reparations Agreement between Israel and the Federal Republic of Germany (German: Luxemburger Abkommen, lit. 'Luxembourg Agreement', or Wiedergutmachungsabkommen, 'Wiedergutmachung Agreement'; Hebrew: הסכם השילומים, romanized: Heskem HaShillumim, lit. 'Reparations Agreement') was signed on September 10, 1952, and entered in force on March 27, 1953. According to the Agreement, West Germany was to pay Israel for the costs of "resettling so great a number of uprooted and destitute Jewish refugees" after the war, and to compensate individual Jews, via the Conference on Jewish Material Claims Against Germany, for losses in Jewish livelihood and property resulting from Nazi persecution.

Florentinska republika (starejše italijansko: Republica di Fiorenza; sodobno italijansko: Repubblica di Firenze; latinsko: Res publica Florentina; starejše italijansko: Republica Fiorentina; sodobno italijansko: Repubblica Fiorentina) je bila srednjeveška in zgodnjenovoveška država s središčem v italijanskem mestu Firence v Toskani. Republika je nastala leta 1115, ko so se Florentinci uprli Toskanski mejni grofiji po smrti Matilde Toskanske, ki je nadzirala obsežna ozemlja, med njimi Firence. Florentinci so namesto naslednikov Rabodoja, Matildinega naslednika, ustanovili komuno. Republiko je vodil svet, imenovan florentinska signoria. Signorio je izbiral gonfalonier (naslovni vladar mesta), ki so ga vsaka dva meseca volili člani florentinskih cehov.
notes: The English gives the name twice (Republic of Florence, Florentine Republic), one name in Slovenian, so the original-language forms are joined in one bracket; the IPA is dropped.

source.title: Republic of Florence
paragraphs: The Republic of Florence (Old Italian: Republica di Fiorenza; contemporary Italian: Repubblica di Firenze), also known as the Florentine Republic (Latin: Res publica Florentina; Old Italian: Republica Fiorentina; contemporary Italian: Repubblica Fiorentina [reˈpubblika fjorenˈtiːna]), was a medieval and early modern state that was centered on the Italian city of Florence in Tuscany. The republic originated in 1115, when the Florentine people rebelled against the Margraviate of Tuscany upon the death of Matilda of Tuscany, who controlled vast territories that included Florence. The Florentines formed a commune in Rabodo's (Matilda's successor) successors' place. The republic was ruled by a council known as the Signoria of Florence. The signoria was chosen by the gonfaloniere (titular ruler of the city), who was elected every two months by Florentine guild members.

Pisanska republika (italijansko: Repubblica di Pisa) je bila samostojna država od 11. do 15. stoletja s središčem v toskanskem mestu Pisa. Postala je gospodarska velesila, trgovsko središče, katerega trgovci so stoletje obvladovali sredozemsko in italijansko trgovino, preden jo je presegla in nadomestila Genovska republika.

Sodelovanje republike v križarskih vojnah je pisanskim trgovcem zagotovilo dragocene trgovske položaje, kar je povečalo njeno bogastvo in moč. Pisa je bila zgodovinska tekmica Genove na morju ter Firenc in Lucce na kopnem. Neodvisnost je izgubila leta 1406, ko so jo osvojile Firence.
Moč Pise kot mogočne pomorske sile je začela rasti in dosegla vrhunec v 11. stoletju, ko je zaslovela kot ena glavnih zgodovinskih pomorskih republik Italije.

source.title: Republic of Pisa
paragraphs: The Republic of Pisa (Italian: Repubblica di Pisa) was an independent state existing from the 11th to the 15th century, centered on the Tuscan city of Pisa. It rose to become an economic powerhouse, a commercial center whose merchants dominated Mediterranean and Italian trade for a century, before being surpassed and superseded by the Republic of Genoa.

The republic's participation in the Crusades secured valuable commercial positions for Pisan traders, leading to increased wealth and power. Pisa was a historical rival to Genoa at sea and to Florence and Lucca on land. It lost its independence to Florence in 1406.
The power of Pisa as a mighty maritime nation began to grow and reached its apex in the 11th century when it acquired traditional fame as one of the main historical maritime republics of Italy.

Zvezna republika (rusko: Сою́зная Респу́блика), neuradno republika ZSSR ali republika Sovjetske zveze, je bila v Sovjetski zvezi sestavna federalna politična enota s sovjetsko ureditvijo, ki jo je ustava iz leta 1977 uradno opredelila kot »suvereno sovjetsko socialistično državo, ki se je z drugimi sovjetskimi republikami združila v Zvezo sovjetskih socialističnih republik«; njeno suverenost je omejevalo članstvo v zvezi. Zaradi statusa suverene države je imela zvezna republika de iure pravico vzpostavljati odnose s tujimi državami, z njimi sklepati pogodbe, izmenjevati diplomatske in konzularne predstavnike ter sodelovati v dejavnostih mednarodnih organizacij (vključno s članstvom v njih). Zvezne republike so veljale za upravne enote Zveze sovjetskih socialističnih republik (ZSSR), oblikovane po narodnostnem načelu.

source.title: Republics of the Soviet Union
paragraphs: In the Soviet Union, a Union Republic (Russian: Сою́зная Респу́блика, romanized: Soyúznaya Respúblika) or unofficially a Republic of the USSR was a constituent federated political entity with a system of government called a Soviet republic, which was officially defined in the 1977 constitution as "a sovereign Soviet socialist state which has united with the other Soviet republics to form the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics" and whose sovereignty is limited by membership in the Union. As a result of its status as a sovereign state, the Union Republic de jure had the right to enter into relations with foreign states, conclude treaties with them and exchange diplomatic and consular representatives and participate in the activities of international organizations (including membership in international organizations). The Union Republics were perceived as national-based administrative units of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR).

Revolt of Horea, Cloșca, and Crișan.headline: Upor Horee, Cloșce in Crișana
paragraphs: Upor Horee, Cloșce in Crișana (romunsko: Răscoala lui Horea, Cloșca și Crișan; 31. oktober – 14. december 1784) je bil upor pod romunskim vodstvom, ki se je začel v gorovju Metaliferi v Transilvaniji, a se je kmalu razširil po vsej Transilvaniji in Apusenskem gorovju. Voditelji so bili Horea (Vasile Ursu Nicola, 1731–1785), Cloșca (Ion Oarga, 1747–1785) in Crișan (Marcu Giurgiu, 1733–1785).

source.title: Revolt of Horea, Cloșca, and Crișan
paragraphs: The revolt of Horea, Cloșca, and Crișan (Romanian: Răscoala lui Horea, Cloșca și Crișan; 31 October – 14 December, 1784) was a Romanian-led revolt that began in the Metaliferi Mountains, Transylvania, but it soon spread throughout all Transylvania and the Apuseni Mountains. The leaders were Horea (Vasile Ursu Nicola, 1731–1785), Cloșca (Ion Oarga, 1747–1785) and Crișan (Marcu Giurgiu, 1733–1785).

Upor comunerov (špansko: Guerra de las Comunidades de Castilla, »vojna kastiljskih skupnosti«) je bil upor kastiljskih meščanov proti vladavini Karla I. in njegove uprave v letih 1520–1521. Na vrhuncu so uporniki obvladovali osrčje Kastilje z mesti Valladolid, Tordesillas in Toledo.

Upor je izbruhnil zaradi politične nestabilnosti v Kastiljski kroni po smrti kraljice Izabele I. leta 1504. Prestol je nasledila Izabelina hči Ivana. Ker je bila Ivana duševno nestabilna, so Kastiljo vodili plemiči in njen oče, aragonski kralj Ferdinand II., kot regent, Ivana pa je bila zaprta. Po Ferdinandovi smrti leta 1516 so Ivaninega šestnajstletnega sina Karla razglasili za njenega sovladarja v Kastilji in Aragoniji; Ivana je sicer nasledila tudi aragonski prestol, a je med sovladanjem s sinom ostala zaprta.

source.title: Revolt of the Comuneros
paragraphs: The Revolt of the Comuneros (Spanish: Guerra de las Comunidades de Castilla, "War of the Communities of Castile") was an uprising by citizens of Castile against the rule of Charles I and his administration between 1520 and 1521. At its height, the rebels controlled the heart of Castile, ruling the cities of Valladolid, Tordesillas, and Toledo.

The revolt occurred in the wake of political instability in the Crown of Castile after the death of Queen Isabella I in 1504. Isabella's daughter Joanna succeeded to the throne. Due to Joanna's mental instability, Castile was ruled by the nobles and her father, King Ferdinand II of Aragon, as a regent, while Joanna was confined. After Ferdinand's death in 1516, Joanna's sixteen-year-old son Charles was proclaimed her co-monarch of both Castile and Aragon; while Joanna also succeeded as Queen of Aragon, during her co-regency with her own son, she remained confined.

Rheged je bil eno od kraljestev Hen Ogledd (»starega severa«), britonsko govorečega območja današnje severne Anglije in južne Škotske v porimskem obdobju in zgodnjem srednjem veku. Omenja ga več pesniških in bardskih virov, a nobeden ne opisuje njegovih meja. Arheološka izkopavanja na najdišču v Gallowayu na Škotskem, ki potekajo od leta 2012, izkopavalci razlagajo kot dokaz, da gre za kraljevo središče Rhegeda. Rheged je morda segal v Lancashire in druge dele severne Anglije. V nekaterih virih je tesno povezan s kraljem Urienom Rhegedom in njegovo družino. Prebivalci so govorili kumbrijsko, britonsko narečje, tesno sorodno stari valižanščini.
notes: The Welsh pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Rheged
paragraphs: Rheged (Welsh pronunciation: [ˈr̥ɛɡɛd]) was one of the kingdoms of the Hen Ogledd ('Old North'), the Brittonic-speaking region of what is now Northern England and southern Scotland, during the post-Roman era and Early Middle Ages. It is recorded in several poetic and bardic sources, although its borders are not described in any of them. Archaeological work from 2012 onwards on a site in Galloway in Scotland is interpreted by the excavators as showing that it is a royal centre of Rheged. Rheged possibly extended into Lancashire and other parts of northern England. In some sources, Rheged is intimately associated with the king Urien Rheged and his family. Its inhabitants spoke Cumbric, a Brittonic dialect closely related to Old Welsh.

Vstaja Severa leta 1569, imenovana tudi upor severnih grofov, severni upor ali upor grofov, je bila neuspešen poskus katoliških plemičev s severa Anglije, da bi odstavili kraljico Elizabeto I. in jo nadomestili z Marijo, škotsko kraljico.

source.title: Rising of the North
paragraphs: The Rising of the North of 1569, also called the Revolt of the Northern Earls, Northern Rebellion or the Rebellion of the Earls, was an unsuccessful attempt by Catholic nobles from Northern England to depose Queen Elizabeth I and replace her with Mary, Queen of Scots.

Rotterdamska konvencija (uradno Rotterdamska konvencija o postopku soglasja po predhodnem obveščanju za nekatere nevarne kemikalije in pesticide v mednarodni trgovini) je večstranska pogodba, ki spodbuja deljeno odgovornost pri uvozu nevarnih kemikalij. Konvencija spodbuja odprto izmenjavo informacij in od izvoznikov nevarnih kemikalij zahteva ustrezno označevanje, navodila za varno ravnanje in obveščanje kupcev o znanih omejitvah ali prepovedih. Države podpisnice lahko odločijo, ali bodo uvoz kemikalij s seznama pogodbe dovolile ali prepovedale, države izvoznice pa morajo zagotoviti, da proizvajalci pod njihovo pristojnostjo to spoštujejo.

Leta 2012 so se sekretariata baselske in stockholmske konvencije ter del sekretariata rotterdamske konvencije pri UNEP združili v enoten sekretariat z matrično strukturo, ki služi vsem trem konvencijam. Tri konvencije zdaj v okviru skupnih sinergijskih odločitev zaporedno izvajajo konference pogodbenic.

source.title: Rotterdam Convention
paragraphs: The Rotterdam Convention (formally, the Rotterdam Convention on the Prior Informed Consent Procedure for Certain Hazardous Chemicals and Pesticides in International Trade) is a multilateral treaty to promote shared responsibilities in relation to importation of hazardous chemicals. The convention promotes open exchange of information and calls on exporters of hazardous chemicals to use proper labeling, include directions on safe handling, and inform purchasers of any known restrictions or bans. Signatory nations can decide whether to allow or ban the importation of chemicals listed in the treaty, and exporting countries are obliged to make sure that producers within their jurisdiction comply.

In 2012, the Secretariats of the Basel and Stockholm conventions, as well as the UNEP-part of the Rotterdam Convention Secretariat, merged to a single Secretariat with a matrix structure serving the three conventions. The three conventions now hold back to back Conferences of the Parties as part of their joint synergies decisions.

Roussillon.headline: Roussillon
paragraphs: Roussillon (katalonsko: Rosselló; okcitansko: Rosselhon) je bil zgodovinska provinca Francije, ki je večinoma ustrezala grofiji Roussillon in delu grofije Cerdanya nekdanje Kneževine Katalonije. Danes je del pokrajine Severna Katalonija ali Francoska Katalonija (prvo ime uporabljajo govorci katalonščine, drugo govorci francoščine), ki približno ustreza današnjemu južnofrancoskemu departmaju Pyrénées-Orientales (z Roussillonom, Zgornjo Cerdanyo, Capcirjem, Vallespirjem, Conflentom in Fenouillèdesom) v nekdanji regiji Languedoc-Roussillon (danes Okcitanija).
notes: The pronunciation guides are dropped.

source.title: Roussillon
paragraphs: Roussillon (UK: ROO-see-yon, US: ROO-see-YOHN, French: [ʁusijɔ̃]; Catalan: Rosselló [rusəˈʎo], locally [rusiˈʎu]; Occitan: Rosselhon [ruseˈʎu]) was a historical province of France that largely corresponded to the County of Roussillon and part of the County of Cerdagne of the former Principality of Catalonia. It is part of the region of Northern Catalonia or French Catalonia (the former used by Catalan-speakers and the latter used by French-speakers), corresponding roughly to the present-day southern French département of Pyrénées-Orientales (with Roussillon, Upper Cerdagne, Capcir, Vallespir, Conflent, and Fenouillèdes) in the former region of Languedoc-Roussillon (today Occitanie).

Rout of Ludford Bridge.headline: Beg pri Ludfordskem mostu
paragraphs: Beg pri Ludfordskem mostu je bil pretežno nekrvav spopad v prvih letih vojne rož. Potekal je 12. oktobra 1459 in se končal z neuspehom Yorkov. Čeprav se je tedaj zdelo, da gre za zmagoslavje tekmovalnih Lancastrov, so ti svojo prednost v šestih mesecih zapravili.

source.title: Rout of Ludford Bridge
paragraphs: The Rout of Ludford Bridge was a largely bloodless confrontation fought in the early years of the Wars of the Roses. It took place on 12 October 1459, and resulted in a setback for the Yorkists. Although this seemed to be a triumph for the rival Lancastrians at the time, they had thrown away their advantage within six months.

Rugiland.headline: Rugiland
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Rugijcev ali Rugiland je bilo kraljestvo, ki so ga v 5. stoletju na ozemlju današnje Avstrije ustanovili germanski Rugijci.

source.title: Rugiland
paragraphs: The Kingdom of the Rugii or Rugiland was established by the Germanic Rugii in present-day Austria in the 5th century.

Ruhr pocket.headline: Porurski obroč
paragraphs: Porurski obroč je nastal v obkolitveni bitki, ki je aprila 1945 potekala na zahodni fronti proti koncu druge svetovne vojne v Evropi, v nemškem Porurju. Ujetih je bilo okoli 317.000 nemških vojakov in 24 generalov. Američani so imeli 10.000 žrtev, od tega 2.000 mrtvih ali pogrešanih.

Po zavzetju Ludendorffovega mostu pri Remagnu 7. marca 1945 je ameriška 12. armadna skupina (general Omar Bradley) hitro prodrla na nemško ozemlje južno od armadne skupine B (generalfeldmaršal Walter Model). Na severu je zavezniška 21. armadna skupina (feldmaršal Bernard Montgomery) 23. marca v operaciji Plunder prečkala Ren. Prednji enoti obeh zavezniških armadnih skupin sta se 1. aprila 1945 srečali vzhodno od Porurja in tako obkolili 317.000 nemških vojakov zahodno od sebe.
notes: The English gloss "(field marshal)" after Generalfeldmarschall is dropped; the Slovenian generalfeldmaršal needs none.

source.title: Ruhr pocket
paragraphs: The Ruhr pocket was a battle of encirclement that took place in April 1945, on the Western Front near the end of World War II in Europe, in the Ruhr Area of Germany. Some 317,000 German troops were taken prisoner along with 24 generals. The Americans suffered 10,000 casualties including 2,000 killed or missing.

Exploiting the capture of the Ludendorff Bridge at Remagen on 7 March 1945, the U.S. 12th Army Group (General Omar Bradley) advanced rapidly into German territory south of Army Group B (Generalfeldmarschall (field marshal) Walter Model). In the north, the Allied 21st Army Group (Field Marshal Bernard Montgomery) crossed the Rhine in Operation Plunder on 23 March. The lead elements of the two Allied army groups met on 1 April 1945, east of the Ruhr, to create the encirclement of 317,000 German troops to their west.

Porurska vstaja (nemško: Ruhraufstand) ali marčna vstaja (Märzaufstand) je bila vstaja, ki je od 13. marca do 6. aprila 1920 potekala v nemškem Porurju. Bila je levičarski delavski upor, ki ga je sprožil poziv k splošni stavki v odgovor na Kappov puč, nato pa je prerasel v oboroženo vstajo, ko so skrajno levi delavci stavko izkoristili za poskus ustanovitve republike svetov.

source.title: Ruhr uprising
paragraphs: The Ruhr uprising (German: Ruhraufstand) or March uprising (Märzaufstand) was an uprising that occurred in the Ruhr region of Germany from 13 March to 6 April 1920. It was a left-wing workers' revolt triggered by the call for a general strike in response to the Kapp Putsch, then became an armed rebellion when far-left workers used the strike as an opportunity to attempt the establishment of a council republic.

Russian invasion of East Prussia (1914).headline: Ruski vdor v Vzhodno Prusijo (1914)
paragraphs: Ruski vdor v Vzhodno Prusijo je potekal med prvo svetovno vojno od avgusta do septembra 1914. Bil je naravna poteza Ruskega cesarstva po vojni napovedi Nemškemu cesarstvu, hkrati pa poskus, da bi kot zaveznica nemško cesarsko vojsko preusmerilo na vzhodno fronto namesto na zahodno in Nemčijo prisililo v vojno na dveh frontah. Kljub številčni premoči nad Nemci je ruska cesarska vojska svoje sile preveč razpršila in bila poražena v bitkah pri Tannenbergu in Mazurskih jezerih, kar je povzročilo popoln strateški zlom ruskega vojnega načrta. Tudi Nemci so imeli, kot kaže, slabo sodelovanje med četami in nesoglasja med generali. Zmaga v Vzhodni Prusiji jim je vlila preveč samozavesti, kar je pripeljalo do porazov pri Varšavi in Lodžu.

source.title: Russian invasion of East Prussia (1914)
paragraphs: The Russian invasion of East Prussia occurred during World War I, lasting from August to September 1914. As well as being the natural course for the Russian Empire to take upon the declaration of war on the German Empire, it was also an attempt to focus the Imperial German Army on the Eastern Front, as opposed to the Western Front as part of the alliance and to force Germany to fight a two front war. Despite superiority over the Germans in numbers, the invading Imperial Russian Army spread its forces thin and was defeated in the battles of Tannenberg and the Masurian Lakes, resulting in a complete strategic collapse of the Russian plan of war. The Germans also seemed to have weak cooperation among the troops and disagreements in the generals. The victory in East Prussia inspired too much self-confidence, which led to defeats at Warsaw and Lodz.

Russo-Persian War (1651–1653).headline: Rusko-perzijska vojna (1651–1653)
paragraphs: Rusko-perzijska vojna v letih 1651–1653 je bila oborožen spopad na Severnem Kavkazu med Safavidskim cesarstvom in Ruskim carstvom, povezan s safavidskimi načrti, da bi okrepili svoj položaj v regiji in izrinili Rusijo. Glavno vprašanje je bila širitev ruske posadke ob reki Koj Su in gradnja več novih utrdb, zlasti tiste na iranski strani reke Terek. Safavidska vlada je nato poslala vojsko, ki je utrdbo porušila in pregnala rusko posadko. Leta 1653 sta car Aleksej in ruska vlada, ki je razmišljala o pošiljanju ruske zaporoške vojske, a ni hotela razpršiti sil, v Perzijo poslala poslanstvo za mirno rešitev spora. Šah Abas II. se je strinjal in izjavil, da se je spor začel brez njegove privolitve.

source.title: Russo-Persian War (1651–1653)
paragraphs: The Russo-Persian War of 1651–1653 was an armed conflict in the North Caucasus fought between the Safavid Empire and the Tsardom of Russia, associated with the Safavid plans to strengthen its position in the region and to exclude Russia. The main issue involved the expansion of a Russian garrison on the Koy Su River, as well as the construction of several new fortresses, in particular the one built on the Iranian side of the Terek River. The Safavid government then sent troops, and destroyed the fortress while expelling its Russian garrison. In 1653 Alexis of Russia and the Russian government, which thought about sending the Russian Zaporozhian Army, but did not want to disperse its forces, sent an embassy to Persia for a peaceful settlement of the conflict. Shah Abbas II agreed, stating that the conflict was initiated without his consent.

Russo-Swedish War (1554–1557).headline: Rusko-švedska vojna (1554–1557)
paragraphs: Rusko-švedska vojna v letih 1554–1557, ki velja za uvod v livonsko vojno 1558–1583, je nastala iz obmejnih prask. Strani sta se z novgorodsko pogodbo (1557) dogovorili za premirje; vojna se je končala neodločeno.

source.title: Russo-Swedish War (1554–1557)
paragraphs: The Russo-Swedish War of 1554–1557, considered a prelude to the Livonian War of 1558–1583, arose out of border skirmishes. It ended when the parties agreed on a truce in the Treaty of Novgorod (1557). The war ended inconclusively.

Saar Treaty.headline: Saarska pogodba
paragraphs: Saarska pogodba ali luksemburška pogodba (nemško: Vertrag von Luxemburg, francosko: accords de Luxembourg) je sporazum med Zahodno Nemčijo in Francijo o vrnitvi Saarskega protektorata Zahodni Nemčiji. Pogodbo sta 27. oktobra 1956 v Luxembourgu podpisala zunanja ministra Heinrich von Brentano za Zahodno Nemčijo in Christian Pineau za Francijo, potem ko je bila na referendumu o saarskem statutu 23. oktobra 1955 večina proti statutu.

Ko je deželni zbor (Landtag) razglasil pristop k Zvezni republiki Nemčiji (Zahodni Nemčiji), je bila priključitev Posarja 1. januarja 1957 dokončana. Obe strani sta se dogovorili za gospodarsko prehodno obdobje do leta 1959, v katerem je Posarje ostalo pod francoskim nadzorom.

source.title: Saar Treaty
paragraphs: The Saar Treaty, or Treaty of Luxembourg (German: Vertrag von Luxemburg, French: accords de Luxembourg) is an agreement between West Germany and France concerning the return of the Saar Protectorate to West Germany. The treaty was signed in Luxembourg on 27 October 1956, by foreign ministers Heinrich von Brentano of West Germany and Christian Pineau of France, following the Saar Statute referendum on 23 October 1955, which resulted in a majority vote against the Saar Statute.

After the Landtag declared its accession to the Federal Republic of Germany (West Germany), the incorporation of the Saarland was finalised on 1 January 1957. Both involved parties agreed on an economic transition period through 1959, during which the Saarland remained under French control.

Sack of Magdeburg.headline: Plenjenje Magdeburga
paragraphs: Plenjenje Magdeburga, imenovano tudi magdeburška svatba (nemško: Magdeburger Hochzeit) ali magdeburška žrtev (Magdeburgs Opfergang), je bilo uničenje protestantskega mesta Magdeburg od 20. do 24. maja 1631: razdejali so ga cesarska vojska in sile Katoliške lige, umrlo pa je okoli 20.000 ljudi, tako branilcev kot civilistov. Dogodek velja za najhujši pokol tridesetletne vojne. Magdeburg, tedaj eno največjih mest na ozemlju današnje Nemčije, ki je imelo leta 1630 precej več kot 25.000 prebivalcev, si je nekdanji pomen povrnil šele globoko v 18. stoletju.

source.title: Sack of Magdeburg
paragraphs: The Sack of Magdeburg, also called the Magdeburg Wedding (German: Magdeburger Hochzeit) or Magdeburg's Sacrifice (Magdeburgs Opfergang), was the destruction of the Protestant city of Magdeburg on 20–24 May 1631 by the Imperial Army and the forces of the Catholic League, resulting in the deaths of around 20,000, including both defenders and civilians. This event is considered the worst massacre of the Thirty Years' War. Magdeburg, then one of the largest cities within the borders of modern-day Germany, and having well over 25,000 inhabitants in 1630, did not recover its importance until well into the 18th century.

Sack of Rome (1084).headline: Plenitev Rima leta 1084
paragraphs: Maja 1084 so Italo-Normani izropali Rim, ker je papež Gregor VII. zaprosil za pomoč apulijskega vojvodo Roberta Guiscarda. Papeža je junija 1083 v Castel Sant'Angelu oblegal svetorimski cesar Henrik IV., zato je zaprosil za pomoč Guiscarda, ki se je tedaj na Balkanu bojeval z bizantinskim cesarjem Aleksijem I. Komnenom. Guiscard se je nato vrnil na Apeninski polotok in s 36.000 možmi krenil proti severu.

Ko je Guiscard vkorakal v Rim, je Henrika prisilil k umiku, vendar je upor meščanov pripeljal do tridnevnega plenjenja njegovih mož, nato pa je Guiscard papeža pospremil v Lateran. Normani so večinoma oplenili staro mesto, ki je bilo tedaj eno najbogatejših v Italiji. Po dneh neprestanega nasilja so se Rimljani uprli in Normane spravili do tega, da so mesto zažgali. Mnoge stavbe na Kapitolu in Palatinu ter na območju med Kolosejem in Lateranom so pogorele. Nazadnje je opustošeno rimsko prebivalstvo podleglo Normanom.

source.title: Sack of Rome (1084)
paragraphs: In May 1084, Italo-Normans sacked Rome, the result of the Pope Gregory VII's call for aid from the duke of Apulia, Robert Guiscard. The pope had been besieged in the Castel Sant'Angelo by Henry IV, Holy Roman Emperor, in June 1083 and called for aid from Guiscard, who was then fighting the Byzantine Emperor Alexios I Komnenos in the Balkans. Guiscard then returned to the Italian Peninsula and marched north with 36,000 men.

When Guiscard entered Rome, he forced Henry to retreat, but a riot of the citizens led to a three-day sack by his men, after which Guiscard escorted the pope to the Lateran. The Normans had mainly pillaged the old city, which was then one of the richest cities in Italy. After days of unending violence, the Romans rose up and caused the Normans to set fire to the city. Many of the buildings of Rome were gutted on the Capitoline and Palatine Hills along with the area between the Colosseum and the Lateran. In the end, the ravaged Roman populace succumbed to the Normans.

Sack of Thessalonica (904).headline: Oplenitev Soluna (904)
paragraphs: Oplenitev Soluna je bila zavzetje in nato oplenitev bizantinskega mesta Solun, ki so ju leta 904 izvedli Abasidski kalifat in Tulunidi pod vodstvom Leona iz Tripolija, korzarja in spreobrnjenca v islam.

source.title: Sack of Thessalonica (904)
paragraphs: The sack of Thessalonica was the capture and subsequent sack of the Byzantine city of Thessalonica by the Abbasid Caliphate and Tulunids in the year 904, led by Leo of Tripoli, a privateer and Muslim convert.

Saška-Altenburg (nemško: Sachsen-Altenburg) je bila ena od saških vojvodin, ki jih je imela ernestinska veja rodbine Wettin na območju današnje Turingije. Bila je ena najmanjših nemških držav: merila je 1323 kvadratnih kilometrov in imela 207.000 prebivalcev (1905), od katerih je približno petina živela v prestolnici Altenburg. Vojvodino sta sestavljali dve nepovezani ozemlji, ločeni z ozemljem Kneževine Reuss-Gera. Gospodarstvo je temeljilo na kmetijstvu, gozdarstvu in drobni industriji. Država je bila ustavna monarhija s parlamentom tridesetih članov, ki so jih volili moški davkoplačevalci, starejši od 25 let.

source.title: Saxe-Altenburg
paragraphs: Saxe-Altenburg (German: Sachsen-Altenburg) was one of the Saxon duchies held by the Ernestine branch of the House of Wettin in present-day Thuringia. It was one of the smallest of the German states with an area of 1323 square kilometers and a population of 207,000 (1905) of whom about one fifth resided in the capital, Altenburg. The territory of the duchy consisted of two non-contiguous territories separated by land belonging to the Principality of Reuss-Gera. Its economy was based on agriculture, forestry, and small industry. The state had a constitutional monarchical form of government with a parliament composed of thirty members chosen by male taxpayers over 25 years of age.
Vojvodina Saška-Meiningen (nemško: Sachsen-Meiningen) je bila ena od saških vojvodin ernestinske linije rodbine Wettin na jugozahodu današnje nemške zvezne dežele Turingija.

Meiningenska linija rodbine Wettin, ki je nastala leta 1681 z delitvijo ernestinske Vojvodine Saška-Gotha med sedem sinov pokojnega vojvode Ernesta Pobožnega, je obstajala do konca nemških monarhij leta 1918.
notes: The English and German pronunciations are dropped.

source.title: Saxe-Meiningen
paragraphs: Saxe-Meiningen ( SAKS MY-ning-ən; German: Sachsen-Meiningen [ˌzaksn̩ ˈmaɪnɪŋən]) was one of the Saxon duchies held by the Ernestine line of the House of Wettin, located in the southwest of the present-day German state of Thuringia.

Established in 1681, by partition of the Ernestine Duchy of Saxe-Gotha among the seven sons of deceased Duke Ernest the Pious, the Saxe-Meiningen line of the House of Wettin lasted until the end of the German monarchies in 1918.

Saška-Weimar-Eisenach (nemško: Sachsen-Weimar-Eisenach) je bila nemška država, ustanovljena leta 1809 kot vojvodina z združitvijo ernestinskih vojvodin Saška-Weimar in Saška-Eisenach, ki sta bili od leta 1741 v personalni uniji. Leta 1815 je bila s sklepom dunajskega kongresa povzdignjena v veliko vojvodino. Leta 1903 je uradno spremenila ime v Velika vojvodina Saška (nemško: Großherzogtum Sachsen), a so to ime redko uporabljali. Velika vojvodina je skupaj z drugimi monarhijami Nemškega cesarstva propadla v nemški revoluciji 1918–1919. Nasledila jo je Svobodna država Saška-Weimar-Eisenach, ki se je dve leti pozneje združila v novo deželo Turingijo.
Polni naslov velikega vojvode je bil veliki vojvoda Saške-Weimar-Eisenacha, deželni grof v Turingiji, mejni grof Meissna, kneževski grof Henneberga, gospod Blankenhayna, Neustadta in Tautenburga.
Veja Saška-Weimar-Eisenach je od leta 1672 genealoško najstarejša še živeča veja rodbine Wettin.
notes: The range 1918–19 is written in full (1918–1919).
The glossary writes the name with spaced hyphens (Saška - Weimar - Eisenach); the text uses the unspaced form.

source.title: Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach
paragraphs: Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach (German: Sachsen-Weimar-Eisenach) was a German state, created as a duchy in 1809 by the merger of the Ernestine duchies of Saxe-Weimar and Saxe-Eisenach, which had been in personal union since 1741. It was raised to a grand duchy in 1815 by resolution of the Congress of Vienna. In 1903, it officially changed its name to the Grand Duchy of Saxony (German: Großherzogtum Sachsen), but this name was rarely used. The grand duchy came to an end in the German Revolution of 1918–19 with the other monarchies of the German Empire. It was succeeded by the Free State of Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach, which was merged into the new State of Thuringia two years later.
The full grand ducal style was Grand Duke of Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach, Landgrave in Thuringia, Margrave of Meissen, Princely Count of Henneberg, Lord of Blankenhayn, Neustadt and Tautenburg.
The Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach branch has been the most genealogically senior extant branch of the House of Wettin since 1672.

Saxon Wars.headline: Saške vojne
paragraphs: Saške vojne so bile 32 let trajajoči pohodi in vstaje od leta 772, ko je Karel Veliki prvič vdrl na Saško z namenom, da jo osvoji, do leta 804, ko so zatrli zadnji upor plemen. Skupno je bilo 18 pohodov, predvsem na ozemlju današnje severne Nemčije. Z njimi so Saško priključili frankovski državi, Sase pa nasilno spreobrnili iz germanskega poganstva v krščanstvo.

Sasi so bili razdeljeni v štiri skupine v štirih pokrajinah. Frankovskemu kraljestvu Avstraziji je bila najbližja Vestfalija, najbolj oddaljena pa Ostfalija. Med njima je bila Engrija (Engern), na severu ob vznožju Jutlandskega polotoka pa Nordalbingija. Kljub ponavljajočim se neuspehom so se Sasi vztrajno upirali in znova vpadali na ozemlja Karla Velikega, brž ko se je ta posvetil čemu drugemu. Njihov glavni voditelj Vidukind je bil vzdržljiv in iznajdljiv nasprotnik, a so ga leta 785 premagali in krstili.
notes: The English "In between the two kingdoms" refers to Westphalia and Eastphalia, which were not kingdoms; the Slovenian says "between them".

source.title: Saxon Wars
paragraphs: The Saxon Wars were 32 years of campaigns and insurrections from 772, when Charlemagne first entered Saxony with the intent to conquer, to 804 when the last rebellion of tribesmen was defeated. In all, 18 campaigns were fought, primarily in what is now northern Germany. They resulted in the incorporation of Saxony into the Frankish realm and their forcible conversion from Germanic paganism to Christianity.

The Saxons were divided into four subgroups in four regions. Nearest to the Frankish kingdom of Austrasia was Westphalia, and farthest was Eastphalia. In between the two kingdoms was Engria (or Engern), and to the north at the base of the Jutland peninsula was Nordalbingia. Despite repeated setbacks, the Saxons resisted steadfastly, returning to raid Charlemagne's domains as soon as he turned his attention elsewhere. Their main leader Widukind was a resilient and resourceful opponent, but he was defeated and baptized in 785.

Scuttling of the German fleet at Scapa F.headline: Potopitev nemškega ladjevja v Scapa Flowu
paragraphs: Mornarji nemške cesarske mornarice so 21. junija 1919 potopili ladjevje odprtega morja (Hochseeflotte), ki je bilo zadržano pred pristaniščem oporišča britanske Kraljeve vojne mornarice v Scapa Flowu na Orkneyjskih otokih na Škotskem. Ladjevje so tam internirali ob koncu prve svetovne vojne po pogojih premirja z dne 11. novembra 1918, medtem ko so potekala pogajanja o njegovi usodi. Admiral Ludwig von Reuter se je odločil ladjevje potopiti, ker se je bal, da bodo Britanci ladje enostransko zasegli ali da bo tedanja nemška vlada zavrnila versajsko pogodbo in nadaljevala vojno (v tem primeru bi ladje lahko uporabili proti Nemčiji).

Britanske stražne ladje, ki so posredovale, so nekaj ladij nasukale na obalo, vendar se je od 74 interniranih ladij potopilo 52. Veliko razbitin so v naslednjih dveh desetletjih dvignili in odvlekli v razrez. Tiste, ki so ostale, so priljubljena potapljaška mesta in vir nizkoradioaktivnega jekla (low-background steel).

source.title: Scuttling of the German fleet at Scapa Flow
paragraphs: On 21 June 1919 the Imperial German Navy's High Seas Fleet was scuttled by its sailors while held off the harbour of the British Royal Navy base at Scapa Flow, in the Orkney Islands of Scotland. The fleet was interned there at the end of World War I under the terms of the Armistice of 11 November 1918 while negotiations took place over its fate. Fearing that either the British would seize the ships unilaterally or the German government at the time might reject the Treaty of Versailles and resume the war effort (in which case the ships could be used against Germany), Admiral Ludwig von Reuter decided to scuttle the fleet.

Intervening British guard ships were able to beach some of the ships, but 52 of the 74 interned vessels sank. Many of the wrecks were salvaged over the next two decades and were towed away for scrapping. Those that remain are popular diving sites and a source of low-background steel.

Second Athenian League.headline: Druga atenska zveza
paragraphs: Druga atenska zveza je bila pomorska konfederacija grških mestnih držav, ki je od leta 378 do 355 pr. n. št. obstajala pod atensko hegemonijo. Včasih jo imenujejo tudi drugo atensko cesarstvo, čeprav je delovala kot konfederacija. Simahija je deloma obnovila Delsko zvezo, ki so jo razpustili leta 404 pr. n. št. po porazu Aten v peloponeški vojni. Nova zveza je imela središče v Egejskem morju in je vključevala več kot 60 držav, med njimi Kos, Mitileno, Rodos in Bizantion. Nastala je predvsem kot obrambno zavezništvo proti Šparti, v drugi vrsti pa proti Perzijskemu cesarstvu. Njen glavni cilj je bil ohraniti mir v Grčiji in uravnotežiti vse večjo hegemonijo in napadalnost Šparte. Zveza je v veliki meri obnovila atenski vpliv v grškem svetu in Atene znova postavila za najmočnejšo pomorsko silo vzhodnega Sredozemlja. Tokrat so se Atene zavestno izogibale strogim pogojem, zaradi katerih je prejšnja Delska zveza sčasoma postala nepriljubljena. Zavezništvo je trajalo do leta 355 pr. n. št., ko se je po zavezniški vojni, ki je izbruhnila leta 357 pr. n. št., večina zavezniških mest osamosvojila.

source.title: Second Athenian League
paragraphs: The Second Athenian League was a maritime confederation of Greek city-states that existed from 378 to 355 BC under the hegemony of Athens. It is sometimes referenced as the second Athenian Empire, despite operating as a confederation. The symmachia represented a partial revival of the Delian League, which had been disbanded in 404 BC following the defeat of Athens in the Peloponnesian War. The new League was centered in the Aegean and included over 60 states, among which were Kos, Mytilene, Rhodes, and Byzantium. It was primarily formed as a defensive alliance against Sparta and secondly the Persian Empire. The new League's main objective was to preserve peace in Greece and counterbalance Sparta's growing hegemony and aggression. The League largely revived Athenian influence in the Greek world, reestablishing it as the strongest naval power in the eastern Mediterranean. This time, Athens made conscious efforts to avoid the strict terms that had eventually rendered the previous Delian League unpopular. The alliance lasted until 355 BC, when most of the allied cities became independent following the Social War that broke out in 357 BC.

Second Battle of Artois.headline: Druga bitka v Artoisu
paragraphs: Druga bitka v Artoisu (francosko: Deuxième bataille de l'Artois, nemško: Lorettoschlacht) je potekala od 9. maja do 18. junija 1915 na zahodni fronti med prvo svetovno vojno. Leta 1914 je nastalo nemško izbočenje od Reimsa do Amiensa, ki je ogrožalo povezave med Parizom in nezasedenimi deli severne Francije. Francoski prodor proti vzhodu v Artoisu bi lahko presekal železniške proge, ki so oskrbovale nemške vojske med Arrasom in Reimsom. Po francoskih operacijah v Artoisu, Šampanji in Alzaciji novembra in decembra 1914 se je general Joseph Joffre, vrhovni poveljnik (generalissimus) in vodja glavnega stana (Grand Quartier Général, GQG), odločil nadaljevati ofenzivo v Šampanji proti južni nemški železniški oskrbovalni poti in načrtovati ofenzivo v Artoisu proti progam, ki so iz Nemčije oskrbovale nemške vojske na severu.

source.title: Second Battle of Artois
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Artois (French: Deuxième bataille de l'Artois, German: Lorettoschlacht) from 9 May to 18 June 1915, took place on the Western Front during the First World War. A German-held salient from Reims to Amiens had been formed in 1914 which menaced communications between Paris and the unoccupied parts of northern France. A reciprocal French advance eastwards in Artois could cut the rail lines supplying the German armies between Arras and Reims. French operations in Artois, Champagne and Alsace from November–December 1914, led General Joseph Joffre, Generalissimo (Commander in Chief) and head of Grand Quartier Général (GQG), to continue the offensive in Champagne against the German southern rail supply route and to plan an offensive in Artois against the lines from Germany supplying the German armies in the north.

Second Battle of Cape Finisterre.headline: Druga bitka pri rtu Finisterre
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri rtu Finisterre je bila pomorski spopad v vojni za avstrijsko nasledstvo 25. oktobra 1747. Britansko ladjevje štirinajstih linijskih ladij pod poveljstvom kontraadmirala Edwarda Hawka je prestreglo francoski konvoj 250 trgovskih ladij, ki je iz sidrišča Basque Roads na zahodu Francije plul proti Zahodni Indiji, varovalo pa ga je osem linijskih ladij pod poveljstvom viceadmirala Henrija-Françoisa des Herbiersa.

Ko sta se sili zagledali, je Herbiers ukazal trgovskim ladjam, naj se razpršijo, vojne ladje postavil v bojno vrsto in britanske vojne ladje skušal zvabiti k sebi. To mu je uspelo: Britanci so napredovali proti francoskim vojnim ladjam, obkolili zadnji del francoske vrste in s premočjo napadali francoske ladje eno za drugo. Zajeli so šest francoskih vojnih ladij in 4000 njihovih mornarjev. Od 250 trgovskih ladij so jih zajeli le 7.

source.title: Second Battle of Cape Finisterre
paragraphs: The second battle of Cape Finisterre was a naval encounter fought during the War of the Austrian Succession on 25 October 1747. A British fleet of fourteen ships of the line commanded by Rear-Admiral Edward Hawke intercepted a French convoy of 250 merchant ships, sailing from the Basque Roads in western France to the West Indies and protected by eight ships of the line commanded by Vice Admiral Henri-François des Herbiers.

When the two forces sighted each other, Herbiers ordered the merchant ships to scatter, formed his warships into a line of battle and attempted to draw the British warships towards him. In this he was successful, the British advanced on the French warships, enveloped the rear of the French line and brought superior numbers to bear on the French vessels one at a time. Six of the French warships were captured, along with 4,000 of their seamen. Of the 250 merchant ships, only 7 were captured.

Second Battle of Champagne.headline: Druga bitka v Šampanji
paragraphs: Druga bitka v Šampanji (francosko: Bataille de Champagne, nemško: Herbstschlacht, »jesenska bitka«) v prvi svetovni vojni je bila francoska ofenziva proti nemški vojski v Šampanji, ki je sovpadla s tretjo bitko v Artoisu na severu in se končala z nemško zmago.

source.title: Second Battle of Champagne
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Champagne (French: Bataille de Champagne, German: Herbstschlacht, [Autumn Battle]) in the First World War was a French offensive against the German army in Champagne that coincided with the Third Battle of Artois in the north and ended in a German victory.

Druga bitka pri Choletu je potekala 17. oktobra 1793 v francoskih revolucionarnih vojnah: francoske republikanske sile pod vodstvom generalov Jeana Léchella (de iure) in Jean-Baptista Klébra (de facto) so se spopadle s francoskimi rojalističnimi silami pod vodstvom Mauricea d'Elbéeja. Bojevali so se v mestu Cholet v departmaju Maine-et-Loire v Franciji, zmagali pa so republikanci. D'Elbée je bil ranjen in ujet, pozneje pa so ga republikanske čete usmrtile v Noirmoutieru. Rojalistični upornik Charles Melchior Artus de Bonchamps je bil v bitki smrtno ranjen.

source.title: Second Battle of Cholet
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Cholet was fought on 17 October 1793 during the French Revolutionary Wars, between French Republican forces under generals Jean Léchelle (de jure) and Jean-Baptiste Kléber (de facto) and French Royalist Forces under Maurice d'Elbée. The battle was fought in the town of Cholet in the Maine-et-Loire department of France, and resulted in a Republican victory. D'Elbée was wounded and captured; he was later executed by Republican troops in Noirmoutier. The Royalist insurgent, Charles Melchior Artus de Bonchamps, was fatally wounded in the battle.

Second Battle of Dego.headline: Druga bitka pri Degu
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Degu je potekala 14. in 15. aprila 1796 v francoskih revolucionarnih vojnah med francoskimi silami in avstrijsko-sardinskimi silami. Bojevali so se blizu Dega, zaselka v severozahodni Italiji, in se je končala s francosko zmago.

source.title: Second Battle of Dego
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Dego was fought on 14 and 15 April 1796 during the French Revolutionary Wars between French forces and Austro-Sardinian forces. The battle was fought near Dego, a hamlet in northwestern Italy, and ended in a French victory.

Second Battle of Donetsk Airport.headline: Druga bitka za doneško letališče
paragraphs: Druga bitka za doneško letališče je bila spopad med ukrajinsko vojsko ter rusko vojsko in njenimi posredniškimi silami Doneške ljudske republike (DLR) med vojno v Donbasu. Prejšnja bitka maja 2014 je Mednarodno letališče Doneck pustila pod ukrajinskim nadzorom. Kljub sporazumu o prekinitvi ognja, minskemu protokolu, ki je veljal od 5. septembra 2014, so 28. septembra 2014 med sprtima stranema izbruhnili boji.

Ob začetku bitke je letališče ležalo med separatističnimi in ukrajinskimi nadzornimi črtami in je bilo zadnji del mesta Doneck v rokah ukrajinskih vladnih sil. Hudi boji za letališče so se nadaljevali v novo leto, nekateri najhujši pa so bili januarja 2015. Sile DLR so 21. januarja zavzele ukrajinske položaje na letališču. Preostale ukrajinske sile so padle, se morale umakniti ali so jih ujele sile DLR. Bitko so imenovali »mali Stalingrad«.

source.title: Second Battle of Donetsk Airport
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Donetsk Airport was an engagement between the Ukrainian military and Russian military and its proxy forces of the Donetsk People's Republic (DPR) during the war in Donbas. An earlier battle in May 2014 had left Donetsk International Airport in Ukrainian control. Despite a ceasefire agreement, the Minsk Protocol, in place since 5 September 2014, fighting broke out between the warring parties on 28 September 2014.

At the start of the battle, the airport lay between the separatist and Ukrainian lines of control, and was the last part of Donetsk city held by Ukrainian government forces. Heavy fighting over the airport continued into the new year, with some of the worst fighting taking place in January 2015. On 21 January, DPR forces overran the Ukrainian positions at the airport. The remaining Ukrainian forces were either killed, forced to retreat, or captured by DPR forces. The battle has been called the "Little Stalingrad".

Second Battle of Kharkov.headline: Druga bitka za Harkov
paragraphs: Druga bitka za Harkov ali operacija Fridericus je bila protiofenziva sil osi na območju Harkova proti ofenzivi Rdeče armade z izjumskega mostišča, ki je potekala od 12. do 28. maja 1942 na vzhodni fronti druge svetovne vojne. Njen cilj je bil odpraviti izjumsko mostišče čez Severski Donec ali »barvenkovsko izboklino« (rusko: Барвенковский выступ), ki je bila eno od izhodišč sovjetske ofenzive. Po zimski protiofenzivi, ki je nemške čete potisnila stran od Moskve, a izčrpala rezerve Rdeče armade, je bila harkovska ofenziva nov sovjetski poskus, da bi razširili strateško pobudo, vendar jim ni uspelo doseči pomembnejšega presenečenja.

source.title: Second Battle of Kharkov
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Kharkov or Operation Fredericus was an Axis counter-offensive in the region around Kharkov against the Red Army Izium bridgehead offensive conducted 12–28 May 1942, on the Eastern Front during World War II. Its objective was to eliminate the Izium bridgehead over Seversky Donets or the "Barvenkovo bulge" (Russian: Барвенковский выступ, romanized: Barvenkovsky vystup) which was one of the Soviet offensive's staging areas. After a winter counter-offensive that drove German troops away from Moscow but depleted the Red Army's reserves, the Kharkov offensive was a new Soviet attempt to expand upon their strategic initiative, although it failed to secure a significant element of surprise.

Second Battle of St Albans.headline: Druga bitka pri St Albansu
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri St Albansu je potekala 17. februarja 1461 v vojni rož v St Albansu v Hertfordshiru v Angliji (prva bitka pri St Albansu je potekala leta 1455).

Vojska yorške strani pod grofom Warwickom je skušala zapreti cesto proti Londonu severno od mesta. Tekmovalna lancastrska vojska je s širokim obhodnim manevrom Warwicka presenetila, ga odrezala od Londona in njegovo vojsko pregnala z bojišča. Zmagovalci so iz ujetništva osvobodili tudi slabotnega kralja Henrika VI., ki je bil Warwickov ujetnik, vendar zmage nazadnje niso izkoristili.

source.title: Second Battle of St Albans
paragraphs: The Second Battle of St Albans was fought on 17 February 1461 during the Wars of the Roses in St Albans, Hertfordshire, England (the First Battle of St Albans had been fought in 1455).

The army of the Yorkist faction, under the Earl of Warwick, attempted to bar the road to London north of the town. The rival Lancastrian army used a wide outflanking manoeuvre to take Warwick by surprise, cut him off from London and drive his army from the field. The victors also released the feeble King Henry VI, who had been Warwick's prisoner, from his captivity, but they ultimately failed to take advantage of their victory.

Second Battle of the Aisne.headline: Druga bitka na Aisni
paragraphs: Druga bitka na Aisni (Bataille du Chemin des Dames ali Seconde bataille de l'Aisne, od 16. aprila do sredine maja 1917) je bila glavni del Nivellove ofenzive, francosko-britanskega poskusa, da bi nemškim vojskam v Franciji zadali odločilen poraz. Strategija antante je predvidevala ofenzive od severa proti jugu, najprej z napadom britanske ekspedicijske sile (BEF), nato pa z glavnim napadom dveh francoskih armadnih skupin na Aisni. General Robert Nivelle je ofenzivo načrtoval decembra 1916, potem ko je Josepha Joffra zamenjal na mestu vrhovnega poveljnika francoske vojske.

source.title: Second Battle of the Aisne
paragraphs: The Second Battle of the Aisne (Bataille du Chemin des Dames or Seconde bataille de l'Aisne, 16 April – mid-May 1917) was the main part of the Nivelle Offensive, a Franco-British attempt to inflict a decisive defeat on the German armies in France. The Entente strategy was to conduct offensives from north to south, beginning with an attack by the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) then the main attack by two French army groups on the Aisne. General Robert Nivelle planned the offensive in December 1916, after he replaced Joseph Joffre as Commander-in-Chief of the French Army.

Druga bitka na Marni (francosko: Seconde Bataille de la Marne; 15.–18. julija 1918) je bila zadnja velika nemška ofenziva na zahodni fronti med prvo svetovno vojno. Napad je spodletel, ko je zavezniški protinapad, ki so ga vodile francoske sile ob podpori več sto tankov Renault FT, strl Nemce na njihovem desnem krilu in jim prizadejal hude izgube. Nemški poraz je pomenil začetek neustavljivega zavezniškega prodiranja, ki se je približno 100 dni pozneje končalo s premirjem z Nemčijo.

source.title: Second Battle of the Marne
paragraphs: The Second Battle of the Marne (French: Seconde Bataille de la Marne; 15 – 18 July 1918) was the last major German offensive on the Western Front during the First World War. The attack failed when an Allied counterattack, led by French forces and supported by several hundred Renault FT tanks, overwhelmed the Germans on their right flank, inflicting severe casualties. The German defeat marked the start of the relentless Allied advance which culminated in an armistice with Germany about 100 days later.

Second Battle of the Masurian Lakes.headline: Druga bitka pri Mazurskih jezerih
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Mazurskih jezerih ali zimska bitka pri Mazurskih jezerih, v Nemčiji znana kot zimska bitka v Mazuriji, v Rusiji pa kot bitka pri Augustowu, je bila severni del ofenzive centralnih sil na vzhodni fronti pozimi 1915 med prvo svetovno vojno. Z ofenzivo so želeli prodreti čez Vislo in po možnosti Rusijo izločiti iz vojne. Bila je zadnja velika bitka prve svetovne vojne na nemških tleh.

source.title: Second Battle of the Masurian Lakes
paragraphs: The Second Battle of the Masurian Lakes or Winter Battle of the Masurian Lakes, known in Germany as the Winter Battle in Masuria and in Russia as the Battle of Augustowo, was the northern part of the Central Powers' offensive on the Eastern Front in the winter of 1915 during World War I. The offensive was intended to advance beyond the Vistula River and potentially knock Russia out of the war. It was the last major battle fought on German soil during World War I.

Second Battle of the Piave River.headline: Druga bitka ob reki Piave
paragraphs: Druga bitka ob reki Piave (imenovana tudi bitka ob solsticiju), ki je potekala od 15. do 23. junija 1918, je bila odločilna zmaga italijanske vojske nad Avstro-Ogrsko v prvi svetovni vojni; Italija je bila del zaveznikov, Avstro-Ogrska pa del centralnih sil. Čeprav se je bitka izkazala za odločilen udarec za Avstro-Ogrsko in posledično tudi za centralne sile, v Italiji njenega polnega pomena sprva niso razumeli. Vendar naj bi Erich Ludendorff ob novici dejal, da je »prvič začutil poraz«. Pozneje se je pokazalo, da je bila bitka pravzaprav začetek konca Avstro-Ogrske.

source.title: Second Battle of the Piave River
paragraphs: The Second Battle of the Piave River (or Battle of the Solstice), fought between 15 and 23 June 1918, was a decisive victory for the Italian Army against the Austro-Hungarian Empire during World War I, as Italy was part of the Allied Forces, while Austria-Hungary was part of the Central Powers. Though the battle proved to be a decisive blow to the Austro-Hungarian Empire and by extension the Central Powers, its full significance was not initially appreciated in Italy. Yet Erich Ludendorff, on hearing the news, is reported to have said he 'had the sensation of defeat for the first time'. It would later become clear that the battle was in fact the beginning of the end of the Austro-Hungarian Empire.

Second Battle of the Somme.headline: Druga bitka na Sommi
paragraphs: Druga bitka na Sommi leta 1918 je potekala med prvo svetovno vojno na zahodni fronti od konca avgusta do začetka septembra v porečju reke Somme. Bila je del vrste uspešnih protiofenziv v odgovor na nemško pomladansko ofenzivo, ki so se začele po premoru za prerazporeditev in oskrbo.

Najpomembnejša značilnost obeh bitk na Sommi leta 1918 je bila, da je prva bitka na Sommi leta 1918 (ne gre je zamenjevati z bitko na Sommi leta 1916) s svojim neuspehom zaustavila sprva veliko nemško ofenzivo, druga pa je bila osrednji del zavezniškega prodiranja do premirja 11. novembra.

source.title: Second Battle of the Somme
paragraphs: The Second Battle of the Somme of 1918 was fought during the First World War on the Western Front from late August to early September, in the basin of the River Somme. It was part of a series of successful counter-offensives in response to the German Spring Offensive, after a pause for redeployment and supply.

The most significant feature of the two 1918 Somme battles was that with the failure of the first 1918 Somme Battle (not to be confused with the 1916 Battle of the Somme) having halted what had begun as a large German offensive, the second formed the central part of the Allies' advance to the Armistice of 11 November.

Second Battle of Zurich.headline: Druga bitka pri Zürichu
paragraphs: Druga bitka pri Zürichu (25.–26. septembra 1799) je bila ključna zmaga republikanske francoske vojske v Švici pod vodstvom Andréja Massène nad rusko vojsko Aleksandra Rimski-Korsakova pri Zürichu: prekinila je mrtvo točko, ki je nastala po prvi bitki pri Zürichu tri mesece prej, in privedla do izstopa Rusije iz druge koalicije. Masséna je v celoti izkoristil nesposobnost ruskega poveljnika, ki je po nesreči razpršil svoje sile, in drzno napadel. Večina bojev je potekala na obeh bregovih reke Limmat do vrat Züricha in v samem mestu. Bila je morda najpomembnejša francoska zmaga leta 1799.
V istih dneh je ob reki Linth potekala bitka med Hotzejevimi Avstrijci in Soultovimi Francozi.

source.title: Second Battle of Zurich
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Zurich (25–26 September 1799) was a key victory by the Republican French army in Switzerland led by André Masséna over a Russian force commanded by Alexander Rimsky-Korsakov near Zürich, as it broke the stalemate that had resulted from the First Battle of Zurich three months earlier and led to the withdrawal of Russia from the Second Coalition. Masséna took full advantage of the incompetence of the Russian commander who had accidentally scattered his forces, and launched a bold assault. Most of the fighting took place on both banks of the river Limmat up to the gates of Zürich, and within the city itself. It was arguably the most significant French victory of 1799.
The same days saw a battle between Hotze's Austrians and Soult's French at the River Linth.

Druga karlistična vojna ali vojna matinerjev (katalonsko »zgodnji vstajalci«, tako imenovana po napadih v najzgodnejših jutranjih urah) je bila državljanska vojna v Španiji. Nekateri zgodovinarji jo štejejo za neposreden katalonski upor proti Madridu, v katerem so se predvsem v Kataloniji karlisti pod generalom Ramónom Cabrero bojevali proti silam vlade Izabele II. Vstaja se je začela septembra 1846 in trajala do maja 1849, razširila pa se je tudi v Galicijo.

Teoretično je šlo za vojno, ki naj bi omogočila poroko Izabele II. s karlističnim pretendentom Carlosom Luisom de Borbónom (ali Carlosom VI.), ki so jo podpirali nekateri doktrinarni pripadniki zmerne stranke in karlisti. Do poroke ni prišlo, saj se je Izabela II. poročila s Franciscom de Borbónom.

source.title: Second Carlist War
paragraphs: The Second Carlist War, or the War of the Matiners (Catalan for "early-risers," so-called from the harassing action that took place at the earliest hours of the morning), was a civil war in Spain. Some historians consider it a direct Catalan revolt against Madrid, fought primarily in Catalonia by the Carlists under General Ramón Cabrera against the forces of the government of Isabella II. The uprising began in September 1846 and continued until May 1849, spreading to Galicia.

Theoretically, the war was fought to facilitate the marriage of Isabella II with the Carlist pretender, Carlos Luis de Borbón (or Carlos VI), which was supported by some doctrinaire elements from the moderate party and by the Carlists. The marriage never took place, as Isabella II was wed to Francisco de Borbón.

Druga angleška državljanska vojna je potekala med februarjem in avgustom 1648 v Angliji in Walesu. Vojna je del vrste spopadov, skupaj znanih kot vojne treh kraljestev (1639–1653), ki vključujejo irske konfederacijske vojne (1641–1653), vojne škofov (1639–1640) in Cromwellovo osvojitev Irske (1649–1653).

Po porazu v prvi angleški državljanski vojni se je Karel I. maja 1646 predal škotskim covenanterjem, ne parlamentu. S tem je upal izkoristiti razkol med angleškimi in škotskimi prezbiterijanci ter angleškimi independenti. V tej fazi so vse strani pričakovale, da bo Karel ostal kralj, kar mu je skupaj z njihovimi notranjimi razkoli omogočilo, da je zavrnil pomembne popuste. Ko prezbiterijanski večini v parlamentu konec leta 1647 ni uspelo razpustiti vojske novega kova, so se mnogi pridružili škotskim engagerjem v dogovoru, da bi Karla vrnili na angleški prestol.

source.title: Second English Civil War
paragraphs: The Second English Civil War took place between February and August 1648 in England and Wales. It forms part of the series of conflicts known collectively as the 1639–1653 Wars of the Three Kingdoms, which include the 1641–1653 Irish Confederate Wars, the 1639–1640 Bishops' Wars, and the 1649–1653 Cromwellian conquest of Ireland.

Following his defeat in the First English Civil War, in May 1646 Charles I surrendered to the Scots Covenanters, rather than Parliament. By doing so, he hoped to exploit divisions between English and Scots Presbyterians, and English Independents. At this stage, all parties expected Charles to continue as king which, combined with their internal divisions, allowed him to refuse significant concessions. When the Presbyterian majority in Parliament failed to disband the New Model Army in late 1647, many joined with the Scottish Engagers in an agreement to restore Charles to the English throne.

Ženevska konvencija (II) za izboljšanje položaja ranjencev, bolnikov in brodolomcev oboroženih sil na morju (francosko: Convention pour l'amélioration du sort des blessés, des malades et des naufragés des forces armées sur mer), pogosteje imenovana druga ženevska konvencija ali ženevska konvencija II, s kratico GCII, je ena od štirih pogodb ženevskih konvencij iz leta 1949. Prvič so jo sprejeli leta 1949, nadomestila pa je haaško konvencijo (X) iz leta 1907. Glavni zaščitni sistem prve ženevske konvencije prilagaja bojevanju na morju.

source.title: Second Geneva Convention
paragraphs: The Geneva Convention (II) for the Amelioration of the Condition of Wounded, Sick and Shipwrecked Members of Armed Forces at Sea (French: Convention pour l'amélioration du sort des blessés, des malades et des naufragés des forces armées sur mer), more commonly referred to as the Second Geneva Convention or Geneva Convention II and abbreviated as GCII, is one of the four treaties of the 1949 Geneva Conventions. It was first adopted in 1949, replacing the Hague Convention (X) of 1907. It adapts the main protective regime of the First Geneva Convention to combat at sea.

Druga italijanska vojna za neodvisnost je bila vojna, ki sta jo leta 1859 bojevala Drugo francosko cesarstvo in Kraljevina Sardinija proti Avstrijskemu cesarstvu in je imela odločilno vlogo v procesu združevanja Italije.

Leto pred vojno se je Francija s plombièrskim sporazumom zavezala, da bo podprla sardinska prizadevanja za izgon Avstrije iz Italije, v zameno pa je dobila ozemeljsko nadomestilo v obliki Savojske vojvodine in grofije Nica. Državi sta januarja 1859 podpisali vojaško zavezništvo. Sardinija je mobilizirala vojsko 9. marca 1859, Avstrija pa 9. aprila. Avstrija je 23. aprila Sardiniji poslala ultimat, v katerem je zahtevala demobilizacijo. Ko je Sardinija ultimat zavrnila, se je vojna začela 26. aprila. Avstrija je tri dni pozneje vdrla v Sardinijo, Francija pa je Avstriji 3. maja napovedala vojno.

source.title: Second Italian War of Independence
paragraphs: The Second Italian War of Independence was fought by the Second French Empire and the Kingdom of Sardinia against the Austrian Empire in 1859 and played a crucial part in the process of Italian Unification.

A year prior to the war, in the Plombières Agreement, France agreed to support Sardinia's efforts to expel Austria from Italy in return for territorial compensation in the form of the Duchy of Savoy and the County of Nice. The two states signed a military alliance in January 1859. Sardinia mobilised its army on 9 March 1859, and Austria mobilized on 9 April. On 23 April, Austria delivered an ultimatum to Sardinia demanding its demobilization. Upon Sardinia's refusal, the war began on 26 April. Austria invaded Sardinia three days later, and France declared war on Austria on 3 May.

Second London Naval Treaty.headline: Druga londonska pomorska pogodba
paragraphs: Druga londonska pomorska pogodba je bila mednarodna pogodba, ki naj bi pred drugo svetovno vojno omejila rast pomorske oborožitve. Podpisana je bila na podlagi druge londonske konference o pomorski razorožitvi v Londonu. Konferenca se je začela 9. decembra 1935, sodelujoče države pa so pogodbo podpisale 25. marca 1936.

source.title: Second London Naval Treaty
paragraphs: The Second London Naval Treaty was an international treaty intended to limit the growth in naval armaments prior to World War II. It was signed as a result of the Second London Naval Disarmament Conference held in London. The conference started on 9 December 1935 and the treaty was signed by the participating nations on 25 March 1936.

Druga perzijska invazija na Grčijo (480–479 pr. n. št.) je potekala med grško-perzijskimi vojnami, ko je perzijski kralj Kserks I. skušal osvojiti vso Grčijo. Invazija je bila neposreden, čeprav zapoznel odziv na poraz prve perzijske invazije na Grčijo (492–490 pr. n. št.) v bitki na Maratonskem polju, s katerim so se končali Darejevi poskusi podreditve Grčije. Po Darejevi smrti je njegov sin Kserks več let načrtoval drugo invazijo ter zbral ogromno vojsko in ladjevje. Grški odpor so vodili Atenci in Špartanci. »Zavezniškim« prizadevanjem se je pridružila približno desetina grških mestnih držav; večina je ostala nevtralna ali se je Kserksu podredila.

source.title: Second Persian invasion of Greece
paragraphs: The second Persian invasion of Greece (480–479 BC) occurred during the Greco-Persian Wars, as King Xerxes I of Persia sought to conquer all of Greece. The invasion was a direct, if delayed, response to the defeat of the first Persian invasion of Greece (492–490 BC) at the Battle of Marathon, which ended Darius I's attempts to subjugate Greece. After Darius's death, his son Xerxes spent several years planning for the second invasion, mustering an enormous army and navy. The Athenians and Spartans led the Greek resistance. About a tenth of the Greek city-states joined the 'Allied' effort; most remained neutral or submitted to Xerxes.

Druga poljska republika, takrat uradno Republika Poljska, je bila poljska država, ki je obstajala med 7. oktobrom 1918 in 6. oktobrom 1939, ustanovljena v zadnji fazi prve svetovne vojne. Leta 1939, na predvečer njene enaindvajsete obletnice, so jo zasedli, potem ko so vanjo vdrle nacistična Nemčija, Sovjetska zveza in Slovaška republika, s čimer se je začelo evropsko bojišče druge svetovne vojne. Poljska vlada v izgnanstvu je bila ustanovljena v Parizu, po padcu Francije leta 1940 pa v Londonu.

source.title: Second Polish Republic
paragraphs: The Second Polish Republic, officially known at the time as the Republic of Poland, was the Polish state that existed between 7 October 1918 and 6 October 1939 after being established in the final stage of World War I. The Second Republic was taken over in 1939 on the eve of its twenty-first anniversary, after it was invaded by Nazi Germany, the Soviet Union, and the Slovak Republic, marking the beginning of the European theatre of the Second World War. The Polish government-in-exile was established in Paris and later London after the fall of France in 1940.

Second Sacred War.headline: Druga sveta vojna
paragraphs: Druga sveta vojna je bila vojna, v kateri je Šparta pri Delfih porazila Fokidčane in obnovila delfsko samoupravo.

source.title: Second Sacred War
paragraphs: The Second Sacred War was the Spartan defeat of the Phocians at Delphi and the restoration of Delphian self-government.

Second Silesian War.headline: Druga šlezijska vojna
paragraphs: Druga šlezijska vojna (nemško: Zweiter Schlesischer Krieg) je bila vojna med Prusijo in Avstrijo, ki je trajala od leta 1744 do 1745 in potrdila prusko oblast nad Šlezijo (danes na jugozahodu Poljske).
