Bojevali so se večinoma v Šleziji, na Češkem in v Gornji Saški, vojna pa je bila eno od prizorišč širše avstrijske nasledstvene vojne. Bila je druga od treh šlezijskih vojn med Prusijo Friderika Velikega in Avstrijo Marije Terezije sredi 18. stoletja; vse tri so se končale s prusko oblastjo nad Šlezijo.

Spopad velja za nadaljevanje prve šlezijske vojne, ki se je končala le dve leti prej. Ko je berlinski mir leta 1742 končal sovražnosti med Avstrijo in Prusijo, se je habsburški monarhiji v nadaljevanju avstrijske nasledstvene vojne sreča močno obrnila na bolje. Ko je Avstrija z wormsko pogodbo leta 1743 razširila svoja zavezništva, je Prusija v Frankfurtski zvezi sklenila novo zavezništvo z avstrijskimi sovražniki in se znova vključila v vojno, da bi okrepljeni Avstriji preprečila, da bi si Šlezijo vzela nazaj.

source.title: Second Silesian War
paragraphs: The Second Silesian War (German: Zweiter Schlesischer Krieg) was a war between Prussia and Austria that lasted from 1744 to 1745 and confirmed Prussia's control of the region of Silesia (now in south-western Poland). The war was fought mainly in Silesia, Bohemia, and Upper Saxony and formed one theatre of the wider War of the Austrian Succession. It was the second of three Silesian Wars fought between Frederick the Great's Prussia and Maria Theresa's Austria in the mid-18th century, all three of which ended in Prussian control of Silesia.

The conflict has been viewed as a continuation of the First Silesian War, which had concluded only two years before. After the Treaty of Berlin ended hostilities between Austria and Prussia in 1742, the Habsburg monarchy's fortunes improved greatly in the continuing War of the Austrian Succession. As Austria expanded its alliances with the 1743 Treaty of Worms, Prussia entered a renewed alliance with Austria's enemies in the League of Frankfurt and rejoined the war, hoping to prevent a resurgent Austria from taking back Silesia.

Second Treaty of London.headline: Druga londonska pogodba (1359)
paragraphs: Druga londonska pogodba je bila formalno sklenjena 24. marca 1359 v Londonu v Angliji. Njeni pogoji bi končali tedaj 22 let trajajoči angleško-francoski spopad, danes znan kot stoletna vojna. Zapečatila sta jo angleški kralj Edvard III. in francoski kralj Ivan II.; slednji je bil ujetnik v Angliji, saj so ga z velikim delom njegovega sveta ujeli v bitki pri Poitiersu leta 1356.

Leta 1358 so izpogajali sporazum za konec vojne – prvo londonsko pogodbo. Njeni glavni pogoji so Ivanovo odkupnino določili na štiri milijone ekujev, kar je bilo 667.000 funtov – toliko kot ves mirnodobni dohodek angleške krone v približno 20 letih –, Francija pa naj bi Angliji prepustila približno četrtino svojega ozemlja, Edvard pa bi se odpovedal zahtevi po francoskem prestolu. Prvi obrok odkupnine – 600.000 ekujev (100.000 funtov) – bi morali plačati 1. novembra 1358, ker pa se je francoska vlada pogreznila v upor in anarhijo, ga ni bilo mogoče zbrati, in Edvard je razglasil, da je sporazum prenehal veljati.

source.title: Second Treaty of London
paragraphs: The Second Treaty of London was formally agreed on 24 March 1359 in London, England. Its terms would have ended the then 22-year-old Anglo-French conflict now known as the Hundred Years' War. It was sealed by Edward III, king of England, and John II, king of France; the latter was a prisoner in England, having been captured with much of his council at the battle of Poitiers in 1356.

An agreement was negotiated in 1358 to end the war – the First Treaty of London. Its main terms set John's ransom at four million écus: this was £667,000 – the equivalent of the entire peacetime income of the English Crown for about 20 years – and France was to transfer to England approximately a quarter of its territory, while Edward would give up his claim to the French throne. The first installment of the ransom – 600,000 écus (£100,000) – was due to be paid on 1 November 1358, but with the French government collapsing into insurrection and anarchy, it proved impossible to raise, and Edward declared that the agreement had lapsed.

Second Treaty of San Ildefonso.headline: Druga pogodba iz San Ildefonsa
paragraphs: Druga pogodba iz San Ildefonsa je bila podpisana 19. avgusta 1796 med Španskim imperijem in prvo Francosko republiko. Po pogojih sporazuma naj bi Francija in Španija postali zaveznici in združili sile proti Kraljevini Veliki Britaniji.

source.title: Second Treaty of San Ildefonso
paragraphs: The Second Treaty of San Ildefonso was signed on 19 August 1796 between the Spanish Empire and the First French Republic. Based on the terms of the agreement, France and Spain would become allies and combine their forces against the Kingdom of Great Britain.

Second Vienna Award.headline: Druga dunajska arbitraža
paragraphs: Z drugo dunajsko arbitražo sta nacistična Nemčija in fašistična Italija razsodili v drugem od dveh ozemeljskih sporov, o katerih sta odločali. 30. avgusta 1940 sta Kraljevini Romuniji odvzeli severno Transilvanijo, vključno z vsem Maramureșem in delom Crișane, ter jo dodelili Kraljevini Madžarski.

source.title: Second Vienna Award
paragraphs: The Second Vienna Award was the second of two territorial disputes that were arbitrated by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy. On 30 August 1940, they assigned the territory of Northern Transylvania, including all of Maramureș and part of Crișana, from the Kingdom of Romania to the Kingdom of Hungary.

Second War of Kappel.headline: Druga kappelska vojna
paragraphs: Druga kappelska vojna (nemško: Zweiter Kappelerkrieg) je bila oborožen spopad leta 1531 med katoliškimi in protestantskimi kantoni Stare švicarske konfederacije v času reformacije v Švici.

source.title: Second War of Kappel
paragraphs: The Second War of Kappel (German: Zweiter Kappelerkrieg) was an armed conflict in 1531 between the Catholic and the Protestant cantons of the Old Swiss Confederacy during the Reformation in Switzerland.

Druga vojna za škotsko neodvisnost je izbruhnila leta 1332, ko je Edvard Balliol vodil vdor na Škotsko s podporo Anglije. Balliol, sin nekdanjega škotskega kralja Ivana Balliola, je skušal uveljaviti svojo zahtevo po škotskem prestolu. Nasprotovali so mu Škoti, zvesti kralju na prestolu, osemletnemu Davidu II. V bitki pri Dupplin Mooru so Balliolove sile premagale desetkrat večjo škotsko vojsko in Balliol je bil kronan za kralja. V treh mesecih so se Davidovi privrženci znova zbrali in Balliola pregnali s Škotske. Ta se je obrnil na angleškega kralja Edvarda III., ki je leta 1333 vdrl na Škotsko in oblegal pomembno trgovsko mesto Berwick. Velika škotska vojska ga je skušala osvoboditi, a je bila hudo poražena v bitki pri Halidon Hillu. Balliol je vzpostavil oblast nad večino Škotske, Angliji prepustil osem grofij na jugovzhodu Škotske in se Edvardu za preostanek države poklonil kot za fevd.

source.title: Second War of Scottish Independence
paragraphs: The Second War of Scottish Independence broke out in 1332, when Edward Balliol led an English-backed invasion of Scotland. Balliol, the son of former Scottish king John Balliol, was attempting to make good his claim to the Scottish throne. He was opposed by Scots loyal to the occupant of the throne, eight-year-old David II. At the Battle of Dupplin Moor Balliol's force defeated a Scottish army ten times their size and Balliol was crowned king. Within three months David's partisans had regrouped and forced Balliol out of Scotland. He appealed to the English king, Edward III, who invaded Scotland in 1333 and besieged the important trading town of Berwick. A large Scottish army attempted to relieve it but was heavily defeated at the Battle of Halidon Hill. Balliol established his authority over most of Scotland, ceded to England the eight counties of south-east Scotland and did homage to Edward for the rest of the country as a fief.

Secret Treaty of Dover.headline: Tajna doverska pogodba
paragraphs: Doverska pogodba, znana tudi kot tajna doverska pogodba, je bila sporazum med francoskim kraljem Ludvikom XIV. in angleškim kraljem Karlom II., podpisan 1. junija 1670 v Dovru. Uradno je Anglijo zavezovala le k splošni diplomatski pomoči Franciji. Pomembnejše pa so bile tajne določbe, ki so ostale večinoma neznane, dokler jih zgodovinarji več kot stoletje pozneje niso objavili.

Po njih naj bi Karel vojaško podprl francoski vdor v Nizozemsko republiko in se zavezal, da bo nekoč prestopil v katoliško vero. Ludvik mu je v zameno obljubil tajno letno pokojnino 230.000 funtov in nagrado, ko bo njegov prestop javno razglašen. Karel je upal, da ga bodo ta plačila finančno osamosvojila od parlamenta.

Določba o spreobrnjenju nikoli ni začela veljati, pogodba pa je privedla do tretje angleško-nizozemske vojne, ki je trajala od leta 1672 do 1674 in je bila povezana s francosko-nizozemsko vojno v letih 1672–1678.

source.title: Secret Treaty of Dover
paragraphs: The Treaty of Dover, also known as the Secret Treaty of Dover, was an agreement between Louis XIV of France and Charles II of England signed at Dover on 1 June 1670. Officially, it only committed England to provide France with general diplomatic assistance. However, of greater significance were secret provisions which remained largely unknown until published by historians over a century later.

Under these, Charles would provide military backing for a French invasion of the Dutch Republic, and committed to convert to Catholicism at some future date. In return, Louis agreed to pay him a secret pension of £230,000 per year, as well as a bonus when his conversion was made public. Charles hoped these payments would help make him financially independent of Parliament.
Although the conversion clause was never activated, the treaty led to the Third Anglo-Dutch War, which lasted from 1672 until 1674 and was a related conflict of the 1672 to 1678 Franco-Dutch War.

Seisyllwg je bil majhno kraljestvo srednjeveškega Walesa. Ni jasno, kdaj je nastal kot samostojna enota, po poznejših virih pa ga je sestavljalo nekdanje Kraljestvo Ceredigion skupaj z območjem Ystrad Tywi. Obsegal je torej današnjo grofijo Ceredigion, del Carmarthenshira in polotok Gower. Ime je očitno dobil po Seisyllu, kralju Ceredigiona v 7. ali začetku 8. stoletja, ni pa znano, ali ga je neposredno ustanovil on. V 10. stoletju je Seisyllwg postal središče moči Hywela Dobrega, ki je zavladal večini Walesa. Leta 920 je Hywel združil Seisyllwg s Kraljestvom Dyfed v novo kraljestvo Deheubarth.
notes: The Welsh pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Seisyllwg
paragraphs: Seisyllwg (Welsh: [sɛiˈsəɬʊɡ]) was a petty kingdom of medieval Wales. It is unclear when it emerged as a distinct unit, but according to later sources it consisted of the former Kingdom of Ceredigion plus the region known as Ystrad Tywi. Thus it covered the modern county of Ceredigion, part of Carmarthenshire, and the Gower Peninsula. It is evidently named after Seisyll, king of Ceredigion in the 7th or early 8th century, but it is unknown if he was directly responsible for its establishment. In the 10th century Seisyllwg became the centre of power for Hywel Dda, who came to rule most of Wales. In 920 Hywel merged Seisyllwg with the Kingdom of Dyfed to form the new kingdom of Deheubarth.

September Uprising.headline: Septembrska vstaja
paragraphs: Septembrska vstaja (bolgarsko: Септемврийско въстание), imenovana tudi septembrski nemiri (Септемврийски бунтове), je bila komunistična vstaja v Bolgariji leta 1923. Bolgarska komunistična partija (BKP) je skušala strmoglaviti novo vlado Aleksandra Cankova, ki je nastala po državnem udaru 9. junija.

source.title: September Uprising
paragraphs: The September Uprising (Bulgarian: Септемврийско въстание, Septemvriysko vastanie), also called the September Riots (Септемврийски бунтове), was a 1923 communist insurgency in Bulgaria. The Bulgarian Communist Party (BCP) attempted to overthrow Alexandar Tsankov's new government established following the coup d'état of 9 June.

Septinsular Republic.headline: Republika sedmih otokov
paragraphs: Republika sedmih otokov (grško: Ἑπτάνησος Πολιτεία; italijansko: Repubblica Settinsulare), znana tudi kot Republika sedmih združenih otokov, je bila oligarhična republika, ki je od leta 1800 do 1807 pod nominalno rusko in osmansko suverenostjo obstajala na Jonskih otokih (Krf, Paksos, Lefkada, Kefalonija, Itaka, Zakintos ali Zante in Kitera).

source.title: Septinsular Republic
paragraphs: The Septinsular Republic (Greek: Ἑπτάνησος Πολιτεία, romanized: Heptanēsos Politeia; Italian: Repubblica Settinsulare), also known as the Republic of the Seven United Islands, was an oligarchic republic that existed from 1800 to 1807 under nominal Russian and Ottoman sovereignty in the Ionian Islands (Corfu, Paxoi, Lefkada, Cephalonia, Ithaca, Zakynthos or Zante, and Kythira).

Seventh Battle of the Isonzo.headline: Sedma soška bitka
paragraphs: Sedma soška bitka je potekala od 14. do 17. septembra 1916 med vojskami Kraljevine Italije in Avstro-Ogrske. Sledila je italijanskim uspehom v ofenzivi na Tridentinskem in v šesti soški bitki spomladi 1916.
notes: The English places the Sixth Battle of the Isonzo in the spring of 1916 (it was fought in August); kept as in the source.

source.title: Seventh Battle of the Isonzo
paragraphs: The Seventh Battle of the Isonzo was fought from 14 to 17 September 1916 between the armies of the Kingdom of Italy and those of Austria-Hungary. It followed the Italian successes during the Trentino Offensive and the Sixth Battle of the Isonzo in the spring of 1916.

Sicilian Expedition.headline: Sicilska odprava
paragraphs: Sicilska odprava je bila atenska vojaška kampanja na Siciliji od 415 do 413 pr. n. št. med peloponeško vojno. Atene in njihovi zavezniki so se spopadli s Sirakuzami, ki sta jih podpirali Sparta in Korint. Odprava se je končala z uničujočim porazom Atencev in močno oslabila njihov položaj v vojni.

source.title: Sicilian Expedition
paragraphs: The Sicilian Expedition was an Athenian military campaign in Sicily from 415 to 413 BC during the Peloponnesian War. It pitted Athens and its allies against Syracuse, supported by Sparta and Corinth. The expedition ended in a devastating defeat for the Athenians and severely weakened their position in the war.

Sicilian revolution of 1848.headline: Sicilska revolucija leta 1848
paragraphs: Sicilska revolucija leta 1848 je bila prva od številnih revolucij leta 1848, ki so zajele Evropo. Bila je ljudski upor proti vladavini Ferdinanda II. iz rodbine Burbonov, kralja dveh Sicilij. Na Siciliji so se od leta 1800 že zgodile tri revolucije proti burbonski Kraljevini dveh Sicilij: ta zadnja, ki se je začela 12. januarja 1848, je pripeljala do neodvisne države (samoproglašene Kraljevine Sicilije), ki je obstajala 16 mesecev. Sicilska ustava iz leta 1848, ki je veljala teh 16 mesecev, je bila za tiste čase napredna z liberalno-demokratičnega vidika, prav tako predlog o združeni italijanski konfederaciji držav. Dejansko je bila uvod v konec burbonske Kraljevine dveh Sicilij, ki so ga dokončali Garibaldijeva ekspedicija tisočev leta 1860, obleganje Gaete 1860–1861 in razglasitev združene Kraljevine Italije.

source.title: Sicilian revolution of 1848
paragraphs: The Sicilian revolution of 1848 was the first of the numerous Revolutions of 1848 which swept across Europe. It was a popular rebellion against the rule of Ferdinand II of the House of Bourbon, King of the Two Sicilies. Three revolutions against the Bourbon ruled Kingdom of the Two Sicilies had previously occurred on the island of Sicily starting from 1800: this final one, which commenced on 12 January 1848, resulted in an independent state (the self-proclaimed Kingdom of Sicily) which survived for 16 months. The Sicilian Constitution of 1848 which survived the 16 months was advanced for its time in liberal democratic terms, as was the proposal of a unified Italian confederation of states. It was in effect a curtain-raiser to the end of the Bourbon kingdom of the Two Sicilies, finally completed by Giuseppe Garibaldi's Expedition of the Thousand in 1860, the Siege of Gaeta of 1860–1861 and the proclamation of the unified Kingdom of Italy.

Sicilske vojne ali grško-punske vojne so bile niz spopadov med antično Kartagino in grškimi mestnimi državami pod vodstvom Sirakuz za nadzor nad Sicilijo in zahodnim Sredozemljem med letoma 580 in 265 pr. n. št.

Kartagina je zaradi gospodarskega uspeha in odvisnosti od pomorske trgovine ustvarila močno mornarico, ki je odvračala tako gusarje kot tekmovalne države. Pomorsko moč in izkušnje so Kartažani podedovali od svojih prednikov, Feničanov, a so jih povečali, ker se Punci, za razliko od Feničanov, niso hoteli zanašati na pomoč tuje države. To je skupaj z uspehom in naraščajočo hegemonijo Kartagino vse pogosteje spravljalo v spopade z Grki, drugo veliko silo, ki se je potegovala za nadzor nad osrednjim Sredozemljem.

source.title: Sicilian Wars
paragraphs: The Sicilian Wars, or Greco-Punic Wars, were a series of conflicts fought between ancient Carthage and the Greek city-states led by Syracuse over control of Sicily and the western Mediterranean between 580 and 265 BC.

Carthage's economic success and its dependence on seaborne trade led to the creation of a powerful navy to discourage both pirates and rival nations. They had inherited their naval strength and experience from their forebears, the Phoenicians, but had increased it because, unlike the Phoenicians, the Punics did not want to rely on a foreign nation's aid. This, coupled with its success and growing hegemony, brought Carthage into increasing conflict with the Greeks, the other major power contending for control of the central Mediterranean.

Siege of Akragas (406 BC).headline: Obleganje Akragasa leta 406 pr. n. št.
paragraphs: Obleganje Akragasa je potekalo leta 406 pr. n. št. na Siciliji; kartažanski podvig je skupaj trajal osem mesecev. Kartažanska vojska pod Hanibalom Magom je oblegala dorsko grško mesto Akragas kot maščevanje za grške plenilske pohode na punske kolonije na Siciliji. Mesto je odbijalo kartažanske napade, dokler ni reševalna vojska iz Sirakuz premagala dela kartažanske vojske, ki je oblegala mesto, in obleganja odpravila.

Med obleganjem so Hanibal in veliko kartažanskih vojakov umrli zaradi kuge, preživeli pa so bili v hudi stiski, potem ko so Grki uspeli prekiniti njihove oskrbovalne poti. Kartažani, ki jih je zdaj vodil Himilkon, Hanibalov sorodnik iz rodbine Magonidov, so s kartažansko floto uspeli zajeti grški oskrbovalni konvoj ladij, zaradi česar so se tokrat Grki soočili z grožnjo lakote. Zato so mesto najprej zapustili sicilski grški oddelek, nato pa večina prebivalcev Akragasa, tako da je Himilkon mesto lahko zavzel in izropal.

source.title: Siege of Akragas (406 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Akragas took place in 406 BC in Sicily; the Carthaginian enterprise ultimately lasted a total of eight months. The Carthaginian army under Hannibal Mago besieged the Dorian Greek city of Akragas in retaliation for the Greek raids on Punic colonies in Sicily. The city managed to repel Carthaginian attacks until a relief army from Syracuse defeated part of the besieging Carthaginian army and lifted the siege of the city.

During the siege, Hannibal and a large number of Carthaginian soldiers perished from the plague, and the survivors were in dire straits after the Greeks managed to cut their supply lines. The Carthaginians, now led by Himilco, a Magonid kinsman of Hannibal, managed to capture a Greek supply convoy of ships using the Carthaginian fleet, which forced the Greeks to face the threat of starvation in turn. This caused first the Sicilian Greek detachment, then most of the population of Akragas to leave the city, enabling Himilco to capture and sack the city.

Siege of Antwerp (1914).headline: Obleganje Antwerpna (1914)
paragraphs: Obleganje Antwerpna je bilo spopad med nemško ter belgijsko, britansko in francosko vojsko okoli utrjenega mesta Antwerpen med prvo svetovno vojno. Po nemški invaziji na Belgijo avgusta 1914 so nemške čete na območju Antwerpna oblegale posadko belgijskih trdnjavskih čet, belgijsko poljsko vojsko in britansko Kraljevo pomorsko divizijo. Mesto, ki ga je obdajal obroč utrdb, znan kot narodni reduit, so nemške sile oblegale z juga in vzhoda.

source.title: Siege of Antwerp (1914)
paragraphs: The siege of Antwerp was an engagement between the German and the Belgian, British and French armies around the fortified city of Antwerp during the First World War. German troops besieged a garrison of Belgian fortress troops, the Belgian field army and the British Royal Naval Division in the Antwerp area, after the German invasion of Belgium in August 1914. The city, which was ringed by forts known as the National Redoubt, was besieged to the south and east by German forces.

Siege of Asculum (90–89 BC).headline: Obleganje Askula (90–89 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Askulu je potekala leta 89 pr. n. št. v zavezniški vojni med Rimom in njegovimi nekdanjimi italijskimi zavezniki. Rimljane je vodil Gnej Pompej Strabon, ki je nad uporniki zmagal. Mnogi raziskovalci menijo, da je bila ta bitka prelomnica vojne.
notes: The English summary calls the 89 BC engagement the Battle of Asculum although the record is the siege of 90–89 BC; the name Bitka pri Askulu is also the glossary name of the 279 BC battle.

source.title: Siege of Asculum (90–89 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Asculum was fought in 89 BC during the Social War between Rome and its former Italian allies. The Romans were led by Gnaeus Pompeius Strabo, and were victorious over the rebels. Many scholars consider this battle to have been the turning point in the war.

Siege of Badajoz (1812).headline: Obleganje Badajoza (1812)
paragraphs: V obleganju Badajoza (16. marca – 6. aprila 1812), imenovanem tudi tretje obleganje Badajoza, je angleško-portugalska vojska pod poveljstvom Arthurja Wellesleyja, grofa Wellingtona (poznejšega vojvode Wellingtona), oblegala Badajoz v Španiji in prisilila francosko posadko k predaji. Obleganje je bilo eno najbolj krvavih v napoleonskih vojnah in so ga Britanci šteli za drago plačano zmago: v nekaj kratkih urah hudih bojev med naskokom na vrzeli ob koncu obleganja je bilo ubitih ali ranjenih okoli 4800 zavezniških vojakov. Vojaki, besni zaradi ogromnih izgub pri zavzetju mesta, so vdirali v hiše in trgovine ter popili ogromne količine alkohola, mnogi pa so nato divjali, grozili častnikom, se niso menili za njihove ukaze, naj nehajo, in nekatere celo ubili. Trajalo je tri dni, preden so vojake znova spravili v red. Ko je bil red vzpostavljen, je bilo po ocenah ubitih ali ranjenih 200–300 civilistov.

source.title: Siege of Badajoz (1812)
paragraphs: In the siege of Badajoz (16 March – 6 April 1812), also called the third siege of Badajoz, an Anglo-Portuguese Army under the command of the Arthur Wellesley, the Earl of Wellington (who was later made Duke of Wellington) besieged Badajoz, Spain, and forced the surrender of the French garrison. The siege was one of the bloodiest in the Napoleonic Wars and was considered a costly victory by the British, with some 4,800 Allied soldiers killed or wounded in a few short hours of intense fighting during the storming of the breaches as the siege drew to an end. Enraged at the huge number of casualties they suffered in seizing the city, the troops broke into houses and stores consuming vast quantities of alcohol with many of them then going on a rampage, threatening their officers and ignoring their commands to desist, and even killing several. It took three days before the men were brought back into order. When order was restored, an estimated 200–300 civilians had been killed or injured.

Obleganje Barcelone je potekalo med 14. septembrom in 19. oktobrom 1705 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo, ko je večnarodna vojska velike alianse pod vodstvom lorda Peterborougha, ki je podpirala habsburškega pretendenta za španski prestol, zavzela Barcelono in jo iztrgala španskim burbonskim branilcem.
Večina branilcev se je nato pridružila habsburški vojski.

Poskus izkrcanja pri Barceloni so odbili že prejšnje leto. Potem ko je Peterborough mesto zavzel, so ga Burbonci naslednje leto skušali odločno znova osvojiti v obleganju Barcelone leta 1706, a jim ni uspelo. Mesto in Katalonija sta ostala v zavezniških rokah, dokler ju Burbonci leta 1714 niso znova osvojili.
notes: The English source breaks its first sentence across the first two paragraphs; the Slovenian ends the first paragraph at the sentence boundary and starts a new sentence in the second.

source.title: Siege of Barcelona (1705)
paragraphs: The siege of Barcelona took place between 14 September and 19 October 1705 during the War of the Spanish Succession when a multinational Grand Alliance army led by Lord Peterborough, supporting the Habsburg pretender to the Spanish throne, captured the city of Barcelona from its Spanish Bourbonic defenders,
most of whom then joined the Habsburg army.

An attempted landing had been repulsed the previous year at the Landing at Barcelona. Following the city's capture by Peterborough, the Bourbons launched a concerted attempt to recapture it the following year during the 1706 siege of Barcelona, which failed. The city and Catalonia remained in Allied hands until reconquered by the Bourbons in 1714.

Obleganje Barcelone je potekalo med 3. in 27. aprilom 1706 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo, ko je francosko-španska vojska oblegala Barcelono, da bi znova zavzela mesto, ki ga je prejšnje leto osvojila zavezniška vojska pod angleškim vodstvom. Potem ko je grof Peterborough januarja 1706 zmagoslavno vkorakal v Valencijo, je bila Barcelona ranljiva. Francozi so zato spremenili načrt napada na Valencijo in namesto tega oblegali Barcelono, ki jo je z morske strani blokiral grof Toulouški. Španske sile je vodil Filip V., francoske kopenske sile pa med obleganjem René de Froulay, grof Tessé.

source.title: Siege of Barcelona (1706)
paragraphs: The siege of Barcelona took place between 3 and 27 April 1706 during the War of the Spanish Succession when a Franco-Spanish army laid siege to Barcelona in an attempt to recapture the city following its fall to an English-led Allied army the previous year. After the Earl of Peterborough entered Valencia in triumph in January 1706, Barcelona was left vulnerable. This led the French to change the plans of attacking Valencia and try to besiege Barcelona instead, while the city was blocked from the seaside by the Count of Toulouse. The Spanish forces were led by Philip V, while René de Froulay, Comte de Tessé was placed in charge of the French land forces during the siege.

Obleganje Barcelone (katalonsko: Setge de Barcelona) je bilo 13 mesecev trajajoč spopad ob koncu vojne za špansko nasledstvo, v katerem sta se za špansko krono spopadla nadvojvoda Karel Avstrijski (ki sta ga podpirali Velika Britanija in Nizozemska, torej velika aliansa) in španski kralj Filip V. ob podpori Francije. Kapitulacija Barcelone je pomenila padec zadnjega prohabsburškega oporišča na Iberskem polotoku in konec samostojnega političnega položaja Kneževine Katalonije (v okviru sestavljene monarhije).
notes: The Catalan pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Siege of Barcelona (1713–1714)
paragraphs: The siege of Barcelona (Catalan: Setge de Barcelona, IPA: [ˈsedʒə ðə βəɾsəˈlonə]) was a 13-month battle at the end of the War of Spanish Succession, which pitted Archduke Charles of Austria (backed by Great Britain and the Netherlands, i.e. the Grand Alliance) against Philip V of Spain, backed by France in a contest for the Spanish crown. The capitulation of Barcelona represented the fall of the last pro-Habsburg stronghold in the Iberian Peninsula, as well as the end of the independent political status (within the framework of a composite monarchy) of the Principality of Catalonia.

Siege of Bari.headline: Obleganje Barija
paragraphs: Obleganje Barija je potekalo od 1068 do 1071, v srednjem veku. Normanske sile pod poveljstvom Roberta Guiscarda so od 5. avgusta 1068 oblegale mesto Bari, pomembno bizantinsko trdnjavo v Italiji in prestolnico katepanata Italije. Bari je padel 16. aprila 1071, ko je Robert Guiscard vstopil v mesto, s čimer se je končala ne le več kot petstoletna bizantinska navzočnost v južni Italiji, ampak tudi antični rimski nadzor od rimskega širjenja po Italiji v 3. stoletju pr. n. št.

source.title: Siege of Bari
paragraphs: The siege of Bari took place 1068–1071, during the Middle Ages, when Norman forces, under the command of Robert Guiscard, laid siege to the city of Bari, a major stronghold of the Byzantines in Italy and the capital of the Catepanate of Italy, starting from 5 August 1068. Bari was captured on 16 April 1071 when Robert Guiscard entered the city, ending not only more than five centuries of Byzantine presence in Southern Italy but also ancient Roman control since the Roman expansion in Italy in the 3rd century BCE.

Obleganje Beograda ali obleganje Nándorfehérvára (madžarsko: Nándorfehérvár ostroma ali nándorfehérvári diadal, dobesedno »zmagoslavje pri Nándorfehérváru«; srbska cirilica: Опсада Београда) je potekalo od 4. do 22. julija 1456, ko so Osmani po padcu Carigrada leta 1453 Beograd blokirali in s tem nadaljevali poskuse širjenja v Evropo. Osmanske sile pod vodstvom sultana Mehmeda II. so hotele zavzeti strateško pomembni Beograd (madžarsko: Nándorfehérvár), ki je bil tedaj pod ogrskim nadzorom in ključen za obvladovanje Donave in Balkana.

source.title: Siege of Belgrade (1456)
paragraphs: The siege of Belgrade, or the siege of Nándorfehérvár (Hungarian: Nándorfehérvár ostroma or nándorfehérvári diadal, lit. "Triumph of Nándorfehérvár"; Serbian Cyrillic: Опсада Београда, romanized: Opsada Beograda) was a military blockade of Belgrade that occurred 4–22 July 1456 in the aftermath of the fall of Constantinople in 1453 marking the Ottomans' attempts to expand further into Europe. Led by Sultan Mehmed II, the Ottoman forces sought to capture the strategic city of Belgrade (Hungarian: Nándorfehérvár), which was then under Hungarian control and was crucial for maintaining control over the Danube River and the Balkans.

Obleganje Beograda (madžarsko: Nándorfehérvár ostroma) leta 1521 je sledilo kot posledica tretjega velikega osmanskega napada na to ogrsko trdnjavo v osmansko-ogrskih vojnah, v času največjega širjenja Osmanskega cesarstva proti zahodu. Osmanski sultan Sulejman Veličastni je vojsko na pohod poslal sredi maja 1521. Ogrska država je bila skoraj v razsulu in osmanski vojski ni mogla učinkovito nasprotovati.

source.title: Siege of Belgrade (1521)
paragraphs: The siege of Belgrade (Hungarian: Nándorfehérvár ostroma) in 1521 is an event that followed as a result of the third major Ottoman attack on this Hungarian stronghold in the Ottoman–Hungarian wars at the time of the greatest expansion of the Ottoman Empire to the west. Ottoman Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent launched his army in mid-May 1521. The Hungarian state was almost in disarray and unable to effectively counter the Ottoman army.

Obleganje Beograda je bilo uspešen poskus habsburških čet pod poveljstvom bavarskega volilnega kneza Maksimilijana II. Emanuela, da bi Osmanskemu cesarstvu iztrgale Beograd. Obleganje, del velike turške vojne (1683–1699), je trajalo mesec dni in se končalo z zavzetjem mesta 6. septembra 1688. Z osvojitvijo Beograda so habsburške sile pridobile pomembno strateško postojanko, saj je bilo mesto več kot stoletje in pol glavna osmanska trdnjava v Evropi. Osmani so mesto ponovno zavzeli dve leti pozneje, oktobra 1690. Leta 1693 so ga habsburške sile znova poskušale zavzeti, a niso uspele.

source.title: Siege of Belgrade (1688)
paragraphs: The siege of Belgrade was a successful attempt by Habsburg troops under the command of the Elector of Bavaria Maximilian II Emanuel to capture the city of Belgrade from the Ottoman Empire. Part of the Great Turkish War (1683–1699), the siege lasted a month and culminated in the capture of the city on 6 September 1688. By conquering Belgrade, Habsburg forces gained an important strategic outpost, as the city had been the Ottoman's chief fortress in Europe for more than a century and a half. The Ottomans recaptured the city two years later, in October 1690. In 1693, Habsburg forces attempted to capture the city again, but failed.

Obleganje Beograda je bilo zavzetje strateško pomembnega mesta Beograd, ki so ga habsburške sile pod poveljstvom princa Evgena Savojskega iztrgale Osmanskemu cesarstvu. Potekalo je med avstrijsko-turško vojno (1716–1718), komaj leto po habsburški zmagi v bitki pri Petrovaradinu (Peterwardein). Cesarska vojska je 16. avgusta pognala v beg osmansko reševalno vojsko pod vodstvom velikega vezirja Hacı Halil-paše. Beograjska posadka, ki je tako ostala brez pomoči, se je zato 21. avgusta predala habsburškim silam. Osmanski sultan Ahmed III. je zaprosil za mir, kar je leto pozneje pripeljalo do požarevskega miru, s katerim so v habsburške roke prešli preostanek Ogrske, Temišvarski banat s spodnjim Sremom ter mesto Beograd z osrednjo Srbijo.

source.title: Siege of Belgrade (1717)
paragraphs: The siege of Belgrade was the capture by the Habsburg forces under the command of Prince Eugene of Savoy of the strategically-important city of Belgrade from the Ottoman Empire. It took place during the Austro-Turkish War (1716–1718), barely a year after the Habsburg victory at the Battle of Petrovaradin (Peterwardein). The Imperial Army routed the Ottoman relief army under Grand Vizier Hacı Halil Pasha on 16 August. As a consequence, the Belgrade garrison, deprived of relief, surrendered to Habsburg forces on 21 August. Ottoman Sultan Ahmed III sued for peace, resulting in the Treaty of Passarowitz a year later, which completed the transfer of the remainder of Hungary, the Banat of Temeswar with lower Syrmia, and the city of Belgrade with central Serbia into Habsburg hands.

Obleganje Beograda (15. septembra – 8. oktobra 1789) je izvedla habsburška avstrijska vojska pod vodstvom feldmaršala Ernsta Gideona von Laudona proti osmanskim silam Osman-paše v beograjski trdnjavi. Po trotedenskem obleganju so Avstrijci trdnjavo prisilili k predaji. Med pohodom, ki je bil del avstrijsko-turške vojne, je avstrijsko vojsko močno ovirala bolezen. Avstrija je mesto obdržala do leta 1791, ko ga je po določilih mirovne pogodbe vrnila Osmanom. Več avstrijskih vojakov, ki so se med obleganjem izkazali, je pozneje dobilo pomembna poveljstva v francoskih revolucionarnih in napoleonskih vojnah. Beograd je prestolnica današnje Srbije.

source.title: Siege of Belgrade (1789)
paragraphs: In the siege of Belgrade (15 September – 8 October 1789) a Habsburg Austrian army led by feldmarschall Ernst Gideon von Laudon besieged an Ottoman force under Osman Pasha in the fortress of Belgrade. After a three-week leaguer, the Austrians forced the surrender of the fortress. During the campaign which was part of the Austro-Turkish War, the Austrian army was greatly hampered by illness. Austria held the city until 1791 when it handed Belgrade back to the Ottomans according to the terms of the peace treaty. Several Austrian soldiers who distinguished themselves during the siege later held important commands in the subsequent French Revolutionary Wars and Napoleonic Wars. Belgrade is the capital of modern Serbia.

Siege of Breslau.headline: Obleganje Breslaua
paragraphs: Obleganje Breslaua, znano tudi kot bitka za Breslau, je bilo trimesečno obleganje mesta Breslau v Spodnji Šleziji v Nemčiji (danes Vroclav na Poljskem), ki je trajalo do konca druge svetovne vojne v Evropi. Od 13. februarja do 6. maja 1945 so sovjetske sile, ki so mesto obkolile v spodnješlezijski ofenzivni operaciji, oblegale nemške enote v Breslauu. Predaji nemške posadke 6. maja je dva dni po bitki sledila predaja vseh nemških sil.

source.title: Siege of Breslau
paragraphs: The siege of Breslau, also known as the battle of Breslau, was a three-month-long siege of the city of Breslau in Lower Silesia, Germany (now Wrocław, Poland), lasting to the end of World War II in Europe. From 13 February 1945 to 6 May 1945, German troops in Breslau were besieged by the Soviet forces which encircled the city as part of the Lower Silesian Offensive Operation. The German garrison's surrender on 6 May was followed by the surrender of all German forces two days after the battle.
Obleganje Budima (14. julija – 30. oktobra 1684) je bilo obleganje osmanske trdnjave Budim, ki so ga vodile sile Svetega rimskega cesarstva. Po 109 dneh so ga opustili.
notes: The glossary gives the same name, Obleganje Budima, to two records (Q604587, Q3625456); the chart may need the year to tell them apart.

source.title: Siege of Buda (1684)
paragraphs: The siege of Buda (14 July – 30 October 1684) was a siege by the Holy Roman Empire of the Ottoman fortress of Buda. After 109 days, the siege was abandoned.

Siege of Buda (1686).headline: Obleganje Budima leta 1686
paragraphs: Obleganje Budima (madžarsko: Buda visszafoglalása, dobesedno »ponovno zavzetje Budima«) je bilo vojaški spopad v veliki turški vojni, v katerem so sile Svete lige pod vodstvom habsburške monarhije Osmanskemu cesarstvu iztrgale utrjeno mesto Budim (danes del Budimpešte). Obleganje je potekalo od 18. junija do 9. septembra 1686 in je končalo skoraj 150 let osmanske oblasti nad nekdanjo ogrsko prestolnico.

Pohod je sledil neuspelemu osmanskemu obleganju Dunaja leta 1683 in je bil del širše protiofenzive Svete lige. Koalicijska vojska z do 100.000 možmi je mesto oblegala več kot dva meseca, nato pa je naskočila obrambo. Padec Budima je bil odločilen korak k utrditvi habsburške oblasti nad osrednjo Ogrsko: ogrski državni zbor v Požunu je leta 1687 priznal dedno habsburško vladavino.

source.title: Siege of Buda (1686)
paragraphs: The siege of Buda (Hungarian: Buda visszafoglalása, lit. 'Recapture of Buda') was a military engagement during the Great Turkish War, in which forces of the Holy League, led by the Habsburg Monarchy, recaptured the fortified city of Buda (now part of modern-day Budapest) from the Ottoman Empire. The siege took place between 18 June and 9 September 1686, ending nearly 150 years of Ottoman sovereignty over the former Hungarian capital.

The campaign followed the failed Ottoman siege of Vienna in 1683 and was part of a broader counteroffensive launched by the Holy League. The coalition army of up to 100,000 men besieged the city for more than two months before storming the defences. The fall of Buda marked a decisive step in the Habsburg consolidation of central Hungary, leading to the recognition of hereditary Habsburg rule by the Hungarian Diet at Pressburg in 1687.

Obleganje Budimpešte ali bitka za Budimpešto je bilo velika bitka med sovjetskimi in romunskimi silami na eni ter madžarskimi in nemškimi silami na drugi strani za madžarsko prestolnico Budimpešto proti koncu druge svetovne vojne. Budimpeštanska ofenziva se je začela 29. oktobra 1944, obleganje pa je trajalo od 26. decembra 1944 do 13. februarja 1945. Sovjeti so novembra začeli prodirati v predmestja Pešte in 26. decembra obkolili Budimpešto. Obkoljeni branilci so se Sovjetom upirali približno petdeset dni, čeprav so večino zalog porabili že v prvih dneh bojev. Civilnega prebivalstva, 800.000 ljudi, niso evakuirali, zato je veliko civilistov postalo žrtev bojev, ki so jih sodobni opazovalci po silovitosti primerjali z bitko za Stalingrad. Med obleganjem je zaradi lakote, vojaških operacij in množičnih pobojev Judov v budimpeštanskem getu, ki jih je izvajala skrajno desna madžarska nacionalistična Stranka puščičastih križev, umrlo okoli 38.000 civilistov. Mesto se je brezpogojno predalo 13. februarja 1945. Za zaveznike je bila to velika strateška zmaga na poti proti Berlinu.

source.title: Siege of Budapest
paragraphs: The Siege of Budapest or Battle of Budapest, was a major battle fought between Soviet and Romanian forces and Hungarian and German forces for the Hungarian capital of Budapest, near the end of World War II. The Budapest Offensive began on October 29 1944, while the siege lasted from December 26 1944 to February 13, 1945. The Soviets began advancing into the suburbs of Pest in November and encircled Budapest on December 26. The besieged defenders resisted the Soviets for approximately fifty days, although they had already exhausted most of their supplies in the first days of the fighting. The civilian population, numbering 800,000, was not evacuated, and consequently many civilians fell victim to the fighting, the intensity of which contemporary observers compared to that of the Battle of Stalingrad. During the siege, about 38,000 civilians died through starvation, military action, and mass executions of Jews in the Budapest Ghetto by the far-right Hungarian nationalist Arrow Cross Party. The city unconditionally surrendered on February 13, 1945. It was a major strategic victory for the Allies in their push towards Berlin.

Obleganje Calaisa (4. septembra 1346 – 3. avgusta 1347) je potekalo ob koncu crécyjskega pohoda, ko je angleška vojska pod poveljstvom angleškega kralja Edvarda III. med edvardovsko fazo stoletne vojne uspešno oblegala francosko mesto Calais.

source.title: Siege of Calais (1346–1347)
paragraphs: The siege of Calais (4 September 1346 – 3 August 1347) occurred at the conclusion of the Crécy campaign, when an English army under the command of King Edward III of England successfully besieged the French town of Calais during the Edwardian phase of the Hundred Years' War.

Francosko obleganje Calaisa v začetku leta 1558 je bilo del italijanske vojne 1551–1559 med Francijo in Anglijo ter njunimi zavezniki. Končalo se je s tem, da je Francija zavzela mesto in njegovo okolico.

Calaiško ozemlje (Pale of Calais) je bilo od leta 1347, med stoletno vojno, pod angleško oblastjo. V 1550. letih sta Angliji vladala Marija I. in njen mož, španski kralj Filip II. Ko je Kraljevina Anglija podprla špansko invazijo na Francijo, je francoski kralj Henrik II. nad Calais, ki so ga držali Angleži in ga je branil Thomas Wentworth, 2. baron Wentworth, poslal Françoisa, vojvodo Guiškega. Po prvem neuspehu sredi leta 1557 so z novim napadom angleškim silam odvzeli zunanji utrdbi Nieullay in Risbank in Calais je bil oblegan.

source.title: Siege of Calais (1558)
paragraphs: The French siege of Calais in early 1558 was part of the Italian War of 1551–1559 between France and England and their respective allies. It resulted in the seizure of the town and its dependencies by France.

The Pale of Calais had been ruled by England since 1347, during the Hundred Years' War. By the 1550s, England was ruled by Mary I and her husband Philip II of Spain. When the Kingdom of England supported a Spanish invasion of France, Henry II of France sent François, Duke of Guise, against English-held Calais, defended by Thomas Wentworth, 2nd Baron Wentworth. Following an initial failure in mid-1557, a renewed attack captured the outlying forts of Nieullay and Risbank from the English forces and Calais was besieged.

Obleganje Calaisa (1940) je bilo boj za pristanišče Calais med bitko za Francijo. Potekalo je hkrati z bitko za Boulogne, tik pred operacijo Dynamo, evakuacijo britanske ekspedicijske sile (BEF) prek Dunkerqua. Po francosko-britanskem protinapadu v bitki pri Arrasu (21. maja) so nemške enote zadržali v pripravljenosti, da bi odbile morebitno ponovitev protinapada 22. maja, kljub protestom generala Heinza Guderiana, poveljnika XIX. armadnega korpusa, ki je hotel hitro prodreti na sever ob obali Rokavskega preliva in zavzeti Boulogne, Calais in Dunkerque. Napad dela XIX. armadnega korpusa je bil odobren šele v noči z 21. na 22. maj ob 0.40.
notes: 12:40 a.m. is written in the 24-hour form, 0.40. The Boulogne summary gives 12:40 p.m. on 22 May for the same order; the two English articles disagree.

source.title: Siege of Calais (1940)
paragraphs: The siege of Calais (1940) was a battle for the port of Calais during the Battle of France. The siege was fought at the same time as the Battle of Boulogne, just before Operation Dynamo, the evacuation of the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) through Dunkirk. After the Franco-British counter-attack at the Battle of Arras (21 May), German units were held back to be ready to resist a resumption of the counter-attack on 22 May, despite the protests of General Heinz Guderian, the commander of the XIX Armee Korps, who wanted to rush north up the Channel coast to capture Boulogne, Calais and Dunkirk. An attack by part of the XIX Armee Korps was not authorised until 12:40 a.m. on the night of 21/22 May.

Obleganje Kandije (danes Heraklion na Kreti) je bilo osmansko obleganje prestolnice Kraljevine Kandije, ki so ji vladale Benetke. Trajalo je od leta 1648 do 1669 (skupaj 21 let) in je eno najdaljših obleganj v zgodovini. Končalo se je z osmansko zmago, toda napori in stroški obleganja so prispevali k zatonu Osmanskega cesarstva, zlasti po veliki turški vojni.

source.title: Siege of Candia
paragraphs: In the siege of Candia (now Heraklion, Crete), Ottoman forces besieged the Venetian-ruled capital city of the Kingdom of Candia. It lasted from 1648 to 1669 (a total of 21 years) and is one of the longest sieges in history. It ended with an Ottoman victory, but the effort and cost of the siege contributed to the decline of the Ottoman Empire, especially after the Great Turkish War.

Siege of Capua (211 BC).headline: Obleganje Capue (211 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Obleganje Capue je potekalo leta 211 pr. n. št., ko so Rimljani oblegali Capuo. Opisujejo ga Polibij v 9.4–7, Livij v 26.4–6 in Apijan v 37–44 svojega dela Hanibalova vojna.

source.title: Siege of Capua (211 BC)
paragraphs: The Siege of Capua was fought in 211 BC, when the Romans besieged Capua. It is described by Polybius at 9.4–7, by Livy at 26.4–6, and by Appian at 37–44 of his Hannibalic War.

Siege of Castelnuovo.headline: Obleganje Castelnuova
paragraphs: Obleganje Castelnuova je potekalo julija 1539 pri obzidanem mestu Castelnuovo, današnjem Herceg Novem v Črni gori, v okviru osmansko-habsburškega boja za nadzor nad Sredozemljem. Castelnuovo so leto prej osvojili deli različnih španskih tercij med neuspelim pohodom Svete lige proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu v vzhodnem Sredozemlju. Mesto je s kopnega in morja oblegala močna osmanska vojska pod vodstvom Hajredina Barbarose, ki je branilcem ponudil častno predajo. Španski poveljnik Francisco de Sarmiento in njegovi kapitani so pogoje zavrnili, čeprav so vedeli, da jim ladjevje Svete lige, poraženo v bitki pri Prevezi, ne more priti na pomoč. Med obleganjem je Barbarosova vojska zaradi trdovratnega odpora Sarmientovih mož utrpela hude izgube. Celo Benečani so zavrnili obljubljeno pomorsko povezavo s Castelnuovom za zaloge in okrepitve; po splošnem zboru čet je poveljnik Francisco de Sarmiento kapitane vprašal, kako naj odgovori na Barbarosovo ponudbo za predajo. Kapitani so odgovorili: »Que vengan cuando quieran« (Naj pridejo, kadar hočejo). Castelnuovo je nazadnje vendarle padel v osmanske roke, skoraj vse španske branilce, tudi Sarmienta, pa so pobili. Z izgubo mesta so se končali krščanski poskusi, da bi znova prevzeli nadzor nad vzhodnim Sredozemljem. Pogum, ki ga je stari neapeljski tercio pokazal v tem zadnjem odporu, pa so občudovali po vsej Evropi in je postal tema številnih pesmi in napevov.

source.title: Siege of Castelnuovo
paragraphs: The siege of Castelnuovo was an engagement during the Ottoman-Habsburg struggle for control of the Mediterranean, which took place in July 1539 at the walled town of Castelnuovo, present-day Herceg Novi, Montenegro. Castelnuovo had been conquered by elements of various Spanish tercios the year before during the failed campaign of the Holy League against the Ottoman Empire in Eastern Mediterranean waters. The walled town was besieged by land and sea by a powerful Ottoman army under Hayreddin Barbarossa, who offered an honourable surrender to the defenders. These terms were rejected by the Spanish commanding officer Francisco de Sarmiento and his captains even though they knew that the Holy League's fleet, defeated at the Battle of Preveza, could not relieve them. During the siege, Barbarossa's army suffered heavy losses due to the stubborn resistance of Sarmiento's men. Even the Venetian refused the promised naval link to Castelnuovo with the supplies and reinforcements; after a general troop parliament, the commanding officer Francisco de Sarmiento asked his captains what his answer should be to Barbarossa's offer to surrender. The captains responded: "Que vengan cuando quieran" (Let them come whenever they want). However, Castelnuovo eventually fell into Ottoman hands and almost all the Spanish defenders, including Sarmiento, were killed. The loss of the town ended the Christian attempt to regain control of the Eastern Mediterranean. The courage displayed by the Old Tercio of Naples during this last stand, however, was praised and admired throughout Europe and was the subject of numerous poems and songs.

Obleganje Compiègna (1430) je vodil burgundski vojvoda Filip III., potem ko mesto Compiègne po določilih pogodbe s francoskim kraljem Karlom VII. ni hotelo prestopiti pod njegovo oblast. Obleganje je morda najbolj znano po tem, da so burgundske čete 23. maja 1430 med spopadom pred mestom ujele Ivano Orleansko, ki je spremljala armagnaško četo. Čeprav je bilo obleganje sicer politično in vojaško manj pomembno in se je nazadnje končalo z burgundskim porazom, je bilo zajetje Ivane Orleanske pomemben dogodek stoletne vojne.

source.title: Siege of Compiègne
paragraphs: The siege of Compiègne (1430) was conducted by Duke Philip III of Burgundy after the town of Compiègne had refused to transfer allegiance to him under the terms of a treaty with Charles VII of France. The siege is perhaps best known for Joan of Arc's capture by Burgundian troops while accompanying an Armagnac force during a skirmish outside the town on 23 May 1430. Although this was otherwise a minor siege, both politically and militarily, and ultimately ended in a defeat for the Burgundians, the capture of Joan of Arc was an important event of the Hundred Years' War.

Siege of Danzig (1734).headline: Obleganje Gdanska leta 1734
paragraphs: Obleganje Gdanska leta 1734 je bilo rusko obkoljenje (22. februarja – 30. junija) in zavzetje poljskega pristaniškega mesta Gdansk med poljsko nasledstveno vojno. Tedaj so se francoske in ruske čete prvič spopadle na bojišču kot sovražnice.
notes: Danzig is written in the Slovenian form Gdansk.

source.title: Siege of Danzig (1734)
paragraphs: The siege of Danzig of 1734 was the Russian encirclement (22 February – 30 June) and capture of the Polish city-port of Gdańsk, during the War of Polish Succession. It was the first time that troops of France and Russia had met as foes in the field.

Siege of Danzig (1807).headline: Obleganje Gdanska leta 1807
paragraphs: Obleganje Gdanska (19. marca – 24. maja 1807) je bilo francosko obkoljenje in zavzetje Gdanska (Danzig) med vojno četrte koalicije. Okoli 27.000 francoskih vojakov pod poveljstvom maršala Lefebvra je 19. marca 1807 obkolilo okoli 14.400 pruskih vojakov pod poveljstvom maršala Kalckreutha, ki so sestavljali posadko mesta.

source.title: Siege of Danzig (1807)
paragraphs: The siege of Danzig (19 March – 24 May 1807) was the French encirclement and capture of Danzig during the War of the Fourth Coalition. On 19 March 1807, around 27,000 French troops under Marshal Lefebvre besieged around 14,400 Prussian troops under Marshal Kalckreuth garrisoning the city of Danzig.

Bitka za Dubrovnik ali obleganje Dubrovnika (srbohrvaško: opsada Dubrovnika, опсада Дубровника) je bila vojaška kampanja med Jugoslovansko ljudsko armado (JLA) in hrvaškimi silami, ki so med hrvaško osamosvojitveno vojno branile Dubrovnik in okolico. JLA je začela napredovati 1. oktobra 1991 in do konca oktobra zavzela tako rekoč vse ozemlje med polotokoma Pelješac in Prevlaka na jadranski obali, razen samega Dubrovnika. Obleganje je spremljala blokada jugoslovanske vojne mornarice. Obstreljevanje Dubrovnika, tudi starega mestnega jedra, ki je na Unescovem seznamu svetovne dediščine, je doseglo vrhunec 6. decembra 1991. Sprožilo je mednarodne obsodbe in postalo propagandna katastrofa za Srbijo in Črno goro, kar je prispevalo k njuni diplomatski in gospodarski osamitvi ter mednarodnemu priznanju hrvaške neodvisnosti. Maja 1992 se je JLA umaknila v Bosno in Hercegovino, ponekod manj kot 1 kilometer od obale, in opremo predala novoustanovljeni Vojski Republike Srbske (VRS). Hrvaška vojska (HV) je medtem napadla z zahoda, potisnila JLA in VRS z območij vzhodno od Dubrovnika, tako na Hrvaškem kot v Bosni in Hercegovini, in se do konca maja povezala z enoto HV, ki je branila mesto. Boji med HV in jugoslovanskimi četami vzhodno od Dubrovnika so postopoma pojenjali.
notes: The mile conversion is left out. The glossary headline is Bitka za Dubrovnik, the Slovenian Wikipedia title; the English siege of Dubrovnik follows as the alternative name.

source.title: Siege of Dubrovnik
paragraphs: The siege of Dubrovnik (Serbo-Croatian: opsada Dubrovnika, опсада Дубровника) was a military campaign fought between the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) and Croatian forces defending the city of Dubrovnik and its surroundings during the Croatian War of Independence. The JNA started its advance on 1 October 1991, and by late October, it had captured virtually all the land between the Pelješac and Prevlaka peninsulas on the coast of the Adriatic Sea, with the exception of Dubrovnik itself. The siege was accompanied by a Yugoslav Navy blockade. The JNA's bombardment of Dubrovnik, including that of the Old Town—a UNESCO World Heritage Site—culminated on 6 December 1991. The bombardment provoked international condemnation, and became a public relations disaster for Serbia and Montenegro, contributing to their diplomatic and economic isolation, as well as the international recognition of Croatia's independence. In May 1992, the JNA retreated to Bosnia and Herzegovina, less than 1 kilometre (0.62 miles) from the coast in some places, and handed over its equipment to the newly formed Army of Republika Srpska (VRS). During this time, the Croatian Army (HV) attacked from the west and pushed back the JNA/VRS from the areas east of Dubrovnik, both in Croatia and in Bosnia and Herzegovina, and by the end of May linked up with the HV unit defending the city. Fighting between the HV and Yugoslav troops east of Dubrovnik gradually died down.

Siege of Dunkirk (1944–1945).headline: Obleganje Dunkerqua (1944–1945)
paragraphs: Obleganje Dunkerqua v drugi svetovni vojni (znano tudi kot druga bitka pri Dunkerqu) se je začelo septembra 1944, ko je 2. kanadska divizija obkolila utrjeno mesto in pristanišče Dunkerque. Obleganje je trajalo še po koncu vojne v Evropi. Nemške enote v trdnjavi so odbile izvidniške napade, in ker je bilo odprtje antwerpenskega pristanišča pomembnejše, se je poveljnik 21. armadne skupine feldmaršal Bernard Montgomery odločil, da bo Dunkerque s 1. češkoslovaško oklepno brigado le zajezil, ne pa zavzel. Trdnjava pod poveljstvom admirala Friedricha Frisiusa se je 9. maja 1945, dan po tem, ko je začela veljati predaja nacistične Nemčije, brezpogojno predala brigadnemu generalu Aloisu Liški, poveljniku češkoslovaške brigadne skupine.

source.title: Siege of Dunkirk (1944–1945)
paragraphs: The siege of Dunkirk in the Second World War (also known as the Second Battle of Dunkirk) began in September 1944, when the Second Canadian Division surrounded the fortified city and port of Dunkirk. The siege lasted until after the end of the European war in Europe. German units within the fortress withstood probing attacks and as the opening of the port of Antwerp was more important, the 21st Army Group commander, Field Marshal Bernard Montgomery, decided to contain but not capture Dunkirk with the 1st Czechoslovak Armoured Brigade. The fortress, commanded by Admiral Friedrich Frisius, eventually surrendered unconditionally to Brigadier General Alois Liška, the commander of the Czechoslovak brigade group, on 9 May 1945, a day after the surrender of Nazi Germany took effect.

Siege of Eger (1552).headline: Obleganje Egra leta 1552
paragraphs: Obleganje Egra (madžarsko: Eger ostroma) je potekalo med osmanskimi vojnami v Evropi v 16. stoletju. Leta 1552 so osmanske sile pod vodstvom Kara Ahmed paše oblegale egrski grad na severu Ogrske, vendar so branilci pod vodstvom Istvána Dobója odbili napade in grad ubranili, čeprav so jih napadalci prekašali v razmerju približno 17 : 1. Obleganje je postalo simbol narodne obrambe in domoljubnega junaštva na Madžarskem.

source.title: Siege of Eger (1552)
paragraphs: The siege of Eger (Hungarian: Eger ostroma) occurred during the 16th century Ottoman wars in Europe. In 1552, the forces of the Ottoman Empire led by Kara Ahmed Pasha laid siege to the Castle of Eger, located in the northern part of the Kingdom of Hungary, but the defenders led by István Dobó repelled the attacks and defended the castle, despite being outnumbered approximately 17 to 1. The siege has become an emblem of national defense and patriotic heroism in Hungary.

Siege of Eretria.headline: Obleganje Eretrije
paragraphs: Obleganje Eretrije je potekalo leta 490 pr. n. št. med prvo perzijsko invazijo na Grčijo. Mesto Eretrijo na Evbeji je oblegala močna perzijska vojska pod poveljstvom Datisa in Artaferna.

Prva perzijska invazija je bila odziv na grško vpletenost v jonsko vstajo, ko so Eretrijci in Atenci poslali vojsko na pomoč jonskim mestom, ki so skušala strmoglaviti perzijsko oblast. Eretrijsko-atenski vojski je uspelo zavzeti in požgati Sarde (regionalno prestolnico Perzije), nato pa se je morala s hudimi izgubami umakniti. V odgovor na ta pohod je perzijski kralj Darej I. prisegel, da se bo maščeval Atenam in Eretriji.

source.title: Siege of Eretria
paragraphs: The siege of Eretria took place in 490 BC, during the first Persian invasion of Greece. The city of Eretria, on Euboea, was besieged by a strong Persian force under the command of Datis and Artaphernes.

The first Persian invasion was a response to Greek involvement in the Ionian Revolt, when the Eretrians and Athenians had sent a force to support the cities of Ionia in their attempt to overthrow Persian rule. The Eretrian and Athenian force had succeeded in capturing and burning Sardis (the regional capital of Persia), but was then forced to retreat with heavy losses. In response to this raid, the Persian king Darius I swore to have revenge on Athens and Eretria.

Obleganje Esztergoma je potekalo od 25. julija do 10. avgusta 1543, ko je osmanska vojska pod vodstvom sultana Sulejmana Veličastnega oblegala mesto Esztergom (Ostrogon) v današnji Madžarski. Osmani so mesto zavzeli po dveh tednih.
notes: The traditional Slovenian exonym Ostrogon is given in brackets, as in the Battle of Párkány summary.

source.title: Siege of Esztergom (1543)
paragraphs: The siege of Esztergom occurred between 25 July and 10 August 1543, when the Ottoman army, led by Sultan Suleiman the Magnificent, besieged the city of Esztergom in modern Hungary. The city was captured by the Ottomans after two weeks.

Obleganje Firenc je potekalo od 24. oktobra 1529 do 10. avgusta 1530, ob koncu vojne kognaške lige. Na kongresu v Bologni sta se medičejski papež Klemen VII. in cesar Karel V. dogovorila, da bosta Medičejce vrnila na oblast v Firencah. Velika cesarska in španska vojska pod Filibertom Châlonskim, princem Oranskim, in Pierjem Marijo III. de' Rossijem je mesto obkolila in ga po skoraj desetih mesecih obleganja zavzela. Strmoglavila je Florentinsko republiko in za vladarja mesta postavila Alessandra Medičejskega.

source.title: Siege of Florence (1529–1530)
paragraphs: The siege of Florence took place from 24 October 1529 to 10 August 1530, at the end of the War of the League of Cognac. At the Congress of Bologna, the Medici Pope Clement VII and Emperor Charles V agreed to restore the Medici family in Florence. A large Imperial and Spanish army under Philibert of Châlon, Prince of Orange and Pier Maria III de' Rossi surrounded the city and after a siege of nearly ten months, captured it. They overthrew the Republic of Florence and installed Alessandro de' Medici as the ruler of the city.

Siege of Genoa (1800).headline: Obleganje Genove (1800)
paragraphs: Obleganje Genove je potekalo od 19. aprila do 4. junija 1800: avstrijska vojska Michaela von Melasa je oblegala pristanišče Genovo, ki ga je zasedala francoska posadka pod poveljstvom Andréja Massene. Bilo je del širše marengoške kampanje v vojni druge koalicije. Avstrijska vojska je Masseno in polovico francoske vojske izolirala v Genovi, drugo polovico pa pregnala s tega območja. Ko je bila Genova oblegana, je Massena vodil zelo aktivno obrambo s pogostimi izpadi. Mesto je z kopnega oblegalo 24.000 avstrijskih vojakov pod vodstvom Petra Karla Otta von Bátorkéza, z morja pa eskadra britanske kraljeve vojne mornarice pod podadmiralom rdeče eskadre lordom Keithom; lakota je branilce pripeljala do stradanja. Ko je Massena 4. junija mesto predal, so tisoči prebivalcev Genove že umrli od lakote ali bolezni. Medtem ko je bila avstrijska vojska osredotočena na obleganje, je francoska vojska pod Napoleonom vdrla v Italijo s severozahoda in dosegla veliko zmago v bitki pri Marengu.

source.title: Siege of Genoa (1800)
paragraphs: The siege of Genoa saw an Austrian army led by Michael von Melas besiege the port of Genoa, which was occupied by a French garrison under the command of André Massena, from 19 April to 4 June 1800. It formed part of the larger Marengo campaign during the War of the Second Coalition. The Austrian army isolated Massena and half of the French army in Genoa, while driving the other half from the area. Once Genoa was under siege, Massena conducted a very active defense with frequent sorties. Besieged on land by 24,000 Austrian troops led by Peter Karl Ott von Bátorkéz and at sea by a Royal Navy squadron under Vice-Admiral of the Red Lord Keith, famine reduced the defenders to starvation. By the time Massena surrendered the city on 4 June, thousands of Genoa's inhabitants had died of starvation or disease. While the Austrian army was focused on the siege, a French army under Napoleon invaded Italy from the northwest, winning a major victory at the Battle of Marengo.

Siege of Głogów.headline: Obleganje Głogówa
paragraphs: Obleganje Głogówa ali obramba Głogówa (nemško: Schlacht bei Glogau, poljsko: Obrona Głogowa) je potekalo 24. avgusta 1109 pri šlezijskem mestu Głogów med Kraljevino Poljsko in Svetim rimskim cesarstvom. Dogodek, ki ga je kronist Gal Anonim zapisal v delu Gesta principum Polonorum (Dejanja poljskih knezov), je ena najbolj znanih epizod zgodnje poljske srednjeveške zgodovine. Poljsko vojsko je vodil vojvoda Boleslav III. Krivousti, napadalnim cesarskim silam, v katerih je bil tudi češki oddelek pod vodstvom češkega vojvode Svatopluka, pa je poveljeval nemški kralj Henrik V. Poljska obramba se je končala z zmago, ko se je obleganje izkazalo za jalovo in so ga opustili, epizoda pa je pozneje v poljskem zgodovinopisju dobila legendarne razsežnosti.

source.title: Siege of Głogów
paragraphs: The Siege of Głogów or Defense of Głogów (German: Schlacht bei Glogau, Polish: Obrona Głogowa) took place on 24 August 1109 at the Silesian town of Głogów, between the Kingdom of Poland and the Holy Roman Empire. The event, recorded by the chronicler Gallus Anonymus in his Gesta principum Polonorum, is one of the most well-known episodes of early Polish medieval history. The Polish army was led by Duke Bolesław III Wrymouth, while the invading Imperial forces were commanded by King Henry V of Germany and included a Bohemian contingent under Duke Svatopluk of Bohemia. The Polish defense ended in a victory after the siege proved fruitless and was abandoned, and the episode later attained legendary status in Polish historiography.

Siege of Groningen (1672).headline: Obleganje Groningna (1672)
paragraphs: Obleganje Groningna je potekalo leta 1672 med francosko-nizozemsko vojno. Končalo se je z nizozemsko zmago, ki je münstrskemu škofu odvzela vsako upanje, da bi prodrl globlje na Nizozemsko. Poraz je münstrsko vojsko tako oslabil, da je nizozemska vojska uspešno znova osvojila velik del ozemlja, ki ga je Münster osvojil le nekaj tednov prej. Mesto Groningen vsako leto 28. avgusta praznuje zmago kot lokalni praznik.

Münstrski škof je 28. avgusta tistega leta po komaj mesec dni dolgem obleganju ukazal umik svojih čet. Ljudje so ga imenovali »Berend Bombe« zaradi pogoste uporabe bomb, izstreljenih iz topov, tedaj najsodobnejšega orožja, ki so znotraj mestnega obzidja povzročile precejšnjo škodo.

source.title: Siege of Groningen (1672)
paragraphs: The siege of Groningen was a battle that took place in 1672 during the Franco-Dutch War. It was a Dutch victory that ended all hope of the Bishop of Münster to push deeper into the Netherlands. The Münster army was so weakened by the defeat that the Dutch army successfully reconquered much of the land that Münster had conquered just weeks earlier. Every year, the city of Groningen celebrates its victory as a local holiday on 28 August.

On August 28 of that year, after a siege of only a month, the Bishop of Münster ordered the withdrawal of his troops. He was popularly called “Berend Bombs” due to the frequent use of bombs fired from cannons, the most modern weaponry of the time, which caused considerable damage within the city walls.

Siege of Harfleur.headline: Obleganje Harfleurja
paragraphs: Obleganje Harfleurja (18. avgusta – 22. septembra 1415) v Normandiji v Franciji je med stoletno vojno vodila angleška vojska kralja Henrika V. Branilci Harfleurja so se Angležem predali pod dogovorjenimi pogoji in z njimi so ravnali kot z vojnimi ujetniki. Angleška vojska je takrat prvič v večjem obsegu uporabila smodniško topništvo pri obleganju velikega mestnega naselja.

Angleška vojska se je med obleganjem zaradi izgub in izbruha griže močno zmanjšala, a je krenila proti Calaisu in v pristanišču pustila posadko. Angleže so na poti prestregli in 25. oktobra so se bojevali v bitki pri Agincourtu, v kateri so Francozom zadali hud poraz.

source.title: Siege of Harfleur
paragraphs: The siege of Harfleur (18 August – 22 September 1415) was conducted by the English army of King Henry V in Normandy, France, during the Hundred Years' War. The defenders of Harfleur surrendered to the English on terms and were treated as prisoners of war. It was the first time that an English army made significant use of gunpowder artillery in the siege of a large urban settlement.

The English army was considerably reduced by casualties and an outbreak of dysentery during the siege but marched towards Calais, leaving a garrison behind at the port. The English were intercepted en route and fought the Battle of Agincourt (25 October), inflicting a huge defeat on the French.

Obleganje Izmaila (turško: İzmail Kuşatması), imenovano tudi naskok na Izmail (rusko: Штурм Измаила), je potekalo leta 1790 ob Donavi blizu Črnega morja med rusko-turško vojno (1787–1792) in hkrati avstrijsko-turško vojno (1788–1791). Ruse je vodil Aleksander Suvorov, ki je osmanske turške sile pred tem premagal pri Kinburnu, Focșaniju in Rimniku ter sodeloval pri obleganju Očakova. Črnomorski veslaški flotilji je poveljeval španski admiral José de Ribas (Iosif Deribas), ki je služil Ruskemu cesarstvu. Suvorov je za naskok osebno uril vojake in višjim častnikom, ko se je trdnjavi Izmail približal na strel puške, razložil, kako in kje naj med napadom ukrepajo. Velja za eno najlepših Suvorovih zmag in enega največjih podvigov v svetovni vojaški zgodovini.

source.title: Siege of Izmail
paragraphs: The siege of Izmail (Turkish: İzmail Kuşatması), also called the storming of Izmail (Russian: Штурм Измаила), was a military action fought in 1790 on the Danube near the Black Sea during the Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792) and simultaneously the Austro-Turkish War (1788–1791). The Russians were led by Alexander Suvorov, who had defeated the Ottoman Turkish forces at Kinburn, Focsani, and Rymnik, as well as participating in the siege of Ochakov. The Black Sea rowing flotilla was commanded by the Spanish admiral José de Ribas (Iosif Deribas) who was in the service of the Russian Empire. In preparation for the storming, Suvorov personally trained his soldiers and, approaching Izmail Fortress at a distance of a gunshot, explained to senior officers how and where to act during the assault. It is regarded as one of Suvorov's finest victories and one of the greatest deeds in world military history.

Siege of Jasna Góra.headline: Obleganje Jasne Góre
paragraphs: Obleganje Jasne Góre (manj natančno tudi bitka pri Čenstohovi, poljsko: Oblężenie Jasnej Góry) je potekalo pozimi 1655 med drugo severno vojno oziroma »potopom«, kot imenujejo švedski vdor v Republiko obeh narodov. Švedi so skušali zavzeti samostan na Jasni Góri v Čenstohovi. Njihovo mesec dni dolgo obleganje pa ni uspelo, saj je majhna skupina menihov iz samostana pod vodstvom priorja ob podpori krajevnih prostovoljcev, večinoma iz vrst šlahte (poljskega plemstva), odbila številčno močnejše Nemce (najemnike Švedske), rešila svojo sveto ikono, Črno Madono iz Čenstohove, in po nekaterih virih obrnila potek vojne.

source.title: Siege of Jasna Góra
paragraphs: The siege of Jasna Góra (also known less accurately as the battle of Częstochowa, Polish: Oblężenie Jasnej Góry) took place in the winter of 1655 during the Second Northern War, or 'The Deluge' – as the Swedish invasion of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth is known. The Swedes were attempting to capture the Jasna Góra monastery in Częstochowa. Their month-long siege, however, was unsuccessful, as a small force consisting of monks from the Jasna Góra monastery led by their Prior and supported by local volunteers, mostly from the szlachta (Polish nobility), fought off the numerically superior Germans (who were hired by Sweden), saved their sacred icon, the Black Madonna of Częstochowa, and, according to some accounts, turned the course of the war.

Siege of Kiev (1240).headline: Obleganje Kijeva (1240)
paragraphs: Mongolsko obleganje Kijeva je potekalo med 28. novembrom in 6. decembrom 1240 in se končalo z mongolsko zmago. Bilo je hud moralni in vojaški udarec za Galicijsko-volinsko kneževino, ki se je morala podrediti mongolski nadoblasti, Batu-kanu pa je omogočilo, da je prodiral naprej proti zahodu v srednjo Evropo.

source.title: Siege of Kiev (1240)
paragraphs: The Siege of Kiev by the Mongols took place between 28 November and 6 December 1240, and resulted in a Mongol victory. It was a heavy morale and military blow to the Principality of Galicia–Volhynia, which was forced to submit to Mongol suzerainty, and allowed Batu Khan to proceed westward into Central Europe.

Siege of Kinsale.headline: Obleganje Kinsala
paragraphs: Obleganje Kinsala (irsko: Léigear Chionn tSáile), znano tudi kot bitka pri Kinsalu, je bilo zadnja bitka angleške osvojitve gelske Irske; začelo se je oktobra 1601, proti koncu vladavine kraljice Elizabete I., na vrhuncu devetletne vojne – pohoda Hugha O'Neilla, Hugha Roeja O'Donnella in drugih irskih gospodov proti angleški oblasti.
Zaradi španskega sodelovanja in strateških prednosti, ki jih je bilo mogoče pridobiti, je bila bitka tudi del angleško-španske vojne, širšega spopada protestantske Anglije s katoliško Španijo.

source.title: Siege of Kinsale
paragraphs: The siege of Kinsale (Irish: Léigear Chionn tSáile), also known as the battle of Kinsale, was the ultimate battle in England's conquest of Gaelic Ireland, commencing in October 1601, near the end of the reign of Queen Elizabeth I, and at the climax of the Nine Years' War—a campaign by Hugh O'Neill, Hugh Roe O'Donnell and other Irish lords against English rule.
Owing to Spanish involvement and the strategic advantages to be gained, the battle also formed part of the Anglo-Spanish War, the wider conflict of Protestant England against Catholic Spain.

Siege of Kolberg (1807).headline: Obleganje Kolberga leta 1807
paragraphs: Obleganje Kolberga (tudi Colberg ali Kołobrzeg) je potekalo od marca do 2. julija 1807 med vojno četrte koalicije v napoleonskih vojnah. Vojska Prvega francoskega cesarstva in več tujih enot v francoski službi (med njimi poljski uporniki) je oblegala utrjeno mesto Kolberg, edino trdnjavo v provinci Pomorjanski, ki so jo Prusi še držali. Obleganje ni uspelo in so ga odpravili ob razglasitvi tilsitskega miru.

Ko je Prusija konec leta 1806 izgubila bitko pri Jeni in Auerstedtu, so francoske enote odkorakale na sever na Prusko Pomorjansko. Utrjeni Stettin (Szczecin) se je predal brez boja, provinco pa so zasedle francoske sile. Kolberg se je upiral, francosko obleganje pa se je zavleklo do marca 1807, ker je okoli trdnjave deloval prostovoljski korpus (Freikorps) Ferdinanda von Schilla, ki je ujel imenovanega francoskega poveljnika obleganja Victorja-Perrina. V teh mesecih sta vojaški poveljnik Kolberga Lucadou in predstavnik meščanov Nettelbeck pripravila obrambne naprave trdnjave.

source.title: Siege of Kolberg (1807)
paragraphs: The siege of Kolberg (also spelled Colberg or Kołobrzeg) took place from March to 2 July 1807 during the War of the Fourth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. An army of the First French Empire and several foreign troops (including Polish insurgents) of France besieged the fortified town of Kolberg, the only remaining Prussian-held fortress in the Province of Pomerania. The siege was unsuccessful and was lifted upon the announcement of the Peace of Tilsit.

After Prussia lost the Battle of Jena–Auerstedt in late 1806, French troops marched north into Prussian Pomerania. Fortified Stettin (Szczecin) surrendered without battle, and the province became occupied by the French forces. Kolberg resisted, and the implementation of a French siege was delayed until March 1807 by the freikorps of Ferdinand von Schill operating around the fortress and capturing the assigned French commander of the siege, Victor-Perrin. During these months, the military commander of Kolberg, Lucadou, and the representative of the local populace, Nettelbeck, prepared the fortress's defensive structures.

Siege of Kolberg (Seven Years' War).headline: Obleganje Kolberga v sedemletni vojni
paragraphs: Med sedemletno vojno so ruske sile trikrat oblegale Kolberg (danes Kołobrzeg), mesto na brandenburško-pruskem Pomorjanskem, ki so ga držali Prusi. Prvi obleganji, konec leta 1758 in od 26. avgusta do 18. septembra 1760, nista uspeli. Zadnje, uspešno obleganje je potekalo od avgusta do decembra 1761. Pri obleganjih v letih 1760 in 1761 so ruske sile podpirale švedske pomožne enote.

Prusija je s padcem mesta izgubila svoje zadnje večje pristanišče ob Baltskem morju, ruske sile pa so lahko prezimile na Pomorjanskem. Ko pa je le nekaj tednov po ruski zmagi umrla ruska carica Elizabeta, je njen naslednik Peter III. sklenil mir in Prusiji vrnil Kolberg.

source.title: Siege of Kolberg (Seven Years' War)
paragraphs: During the Seven Years' War, the Prussian-held town of Kolberg in Brandenburg-Prussian Pomerania (now Kołobrzeg) was besieged by Russian forces three times. The first two sieges, in late 1758 and from 26 August to 18 September 1760, were unsuccessful. A final and successful siege took place from August to December 1761. In the sieges of 1760 and 1761, the Russian forces were supported by Swedish auxiliaries.

As a consequence of the fall of the city, Prussia lost its last major port on the Baltic Coast, while at the same time the Russian forces were able to take winter quarters in Pomerania. However, when Empress Elizabeth of Russia died only weeks after the Russian victory, her successor, Peter III of Russia, made peace and returned Kolberg to Prussia.

Siege of Krujë (1450).headline: Obleganje Kruje (1450)
paragraphs: Prvo obleganje Kruje (albansko: Rrethimi i parë i Krujës) se je zgodilo leta 1450, ko je osmanska vojska pod vodstvom sultana Murata II. in njegovega prestolonaslednika Mehmeda II. skušala oblegati albansko mesto Krujo. Morala Lješke lige pod Skenderbegovim vodstvom je bila po izgubi Svetigrada in Berata med letoma 1448 in 1450 nizka. Kljub temu so Skenderbegovi pozivi in podpora duhovščine, ki je trdila, da je imela videnja angelov in zmage, Albance spodbudili, da so prestolnico lige, Krujo, branili za vsako ceno. Skenderbeg je v mestu pustil 4000 mož pod poveljstvom zaupnega namestnika Vrane Kontija (znanega tudi kot Kont Urani), sam pa je nadlegoval osmanske tabore okoli Kruje in napadal oskrbovalne karavane vojske sultana Murata II. Do septembra je v osmanskem taboru zavladala zmeda, saj je morala padala, bolezni pa so se širile. Osmanska vojska je spoznala, da grad Kruja z orožjem ne bo padel, opustila obleganje in se odpravila proti Odrinu. Kmalu zatem, pozimi 1450–1451, je Murat v Odrinu umrl, nasledil pa ga je sin Mehmed II.

source.title: Siege of Krujë (1450)
paragraphs: The first siege of Krujë (Albanian: Rrethimi i parë i Krujës) occurred in 1450 when an Ottoman army led by Sultan Murad II and his crown prince Mehmed II tried to besiege the Albanian town of Krujë. The League of Lezhë, led by Skanderbeg, experienced low morale after losing Svetigrad and Berat between 1448 and 1450. Nevertheless, Skanderbeg's exhortations and the support of the clergy, who claimed to have had visions of angels and victory, motivated the Albanians to defend the capital of the League, Krujë, at all costs. After leaving a protective garrison of 4,000 men under his trusted lieutenant Vrana Konti (also known as Kont Urani), Skanderbeg harassed the Ottoman camps around Krujë and attacked the supply caravans of Sultan Murad II's army. By September, the Ottoman camp was in disarray as morale sank and disease ran rampant. The Ottoman army acknowledged that the castle of Krujë would not fall by strength of arms, lifted the siege, and made its way to Edirne. Soon thereafter, in the winter of 1450–51, Murad died in Edirne and was succeeded by his son, Mehmed II.

Siege of Krujë (1466–1467).headline: Obleganje Kruje (1466–1467)
paragraphs: Drugo obleganje Kruje (albansko: Rrethimi i dytë i Krujës) je potekalo od junija 1466 do 23. aprila 1467. Osmanski sultan Mehmed II. je vojsko popeljal v Albanijo, da bi premagal Skenderbega, voditelja Lješke lige, ki je nastala leta 1444, ko je ta začel vojno proti Osmanom. Med skoraj enoletnim obleganjem je Skenderbegova glavna trdnjava Kruja zdržala, Skenderbeg pa je medtem obhodil Albanijo, zbiral sile in pomagal beguncem z območij, ki so jih napadli Osmani. Kruja je vzdržala obleganje Ballabana Badere, sandžakbega Ohridskega sandžaka, Albanca, ki je bil prek devširme vzgojen v osmanski vojski. Do 23. aprila 1467 je bila osmanska vojska premagana in Skenderbeg je vstopil v Krujo.

source.title: Siege of Krujë (1466–1467)
paragraphs: The second siege of Krujë (Albanian: Rrethimi i dytë i Krujës) took place from June 1466 to 23 April 1467. Sultan Mehmed II of the Ottoman Empire led an army into Albania to defeat Skanderbeg, the leader of the League of Lezhë, which was created in 1444 after he began his war against the Ottomans. During the almost year-long siege, Skanderbeg's main fortress, Krujë, withstood the siege while Skanderbeg roamed Albania to gather forces and facilitate the flight of refugees from the civilian areas that were attacked by the Ottomans. Krujë managed to withstand the siege laid on it by Ballaban Badera, sanjakbey of the Sanjak of Ohrid, an Albanian brought up in the Ottoman army through the devşirme. By 23 April 1467, the Ottoman army had been defeated and Skanderbeg entered Krujë.
