Obleganje La Rochelle (francosko: le siège de La Rochelle ali včasih le grand siège de La Rochelle) je bilo posledica vojne med francoskimi kraljevimi silami kralja Ludvika XIII. in hugenoti iz La Rochelle v letih 1627–1628. Obleganje je pomenilo vrhunec boja med katoličani in protestanti v Franciji in na francoskih ozemljih in se je končalo s popolno zmago Ludvika XIII. in katoličanov.

source.title: Siege of La Rochelle
paragraphs: The siege of La Rochelle (French: le siège de La Rochelle, or sometimes le grand siège de La Rochelle) was a result of a war between the French royal forces of King Louis XIII and the Huguenots of La Rochelle in 1627–1628. The siege marked the height of the struggle between the Catholics and the Protestants in France and French territories, and ended with a complete victory for Louis XIII and the Catholics.

Obleganje Leidna je potekalo med osemdesetletno vojno v letih 1573 in 1574, ko so Španci pod vodstvom Francisca de Valdeza skušali zavzeti uporno mesto Leiden v Južni Holandiji na Nizozemskem. Obleganje je spodletelo, ko so mesto oktobra 1574 uspešno osvobodili.

source.title: Siege of Leiden
paragraphs: The siege of Leiden occurred during the Eighty Years' War in 1573 and 1574, when the Spanish under Francisco de Valdez attempted to capture the rebellious city of Leiden, South Holland, the Netherlands. The siege failed when the city was successfully relieved in October 1574.

Siege of Lille (1708).headline: Obleganje Lilla (1708)
paragraphs: Obleganje Lilla (12. avgusta – 10. decembra 1708) je bilo glavna operacija vojne sezone 1708 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo. Po zmagi v bitki pri Oudenaardu so se zavezniki odločili oblegati Lille, pomembno francosko mesto in morda najmočnejšo trdnjavo v Evropi. Po trdovratni 120-dnevni obrambi je francoska posadka pod poveljstvom maršala Boufflersa mesto in citadelo Lille predala silam vojvode Marlborougha in princa Evgena Savojskega.

source.title: Siege of Lille (1708)
paragraphs: The siege of Lille (12 August – 10 December 1708) was the main operation of the 1708 campaign season during the War of the Spanish Succession. Following their victory in the Battle of Oudenaarde, the Allies decided to besiege Lille, an important French city and perhaps the strongest fortress in Europe. After an obstinate defence of 120 days, the French garrison surrendered the city and citadel of Lille, commanded by Marshal Boufflers, to the forces of the Duke of Marlborough and Prince Eugene of Savoy.

Siege of Lille (1940).headline: Obleganje Lilla (1940)
paragraphs: Obleganje Lilla ali lilski žep (28.–31. maja 1940) je potekalo med bitko za Francijo v drugi svetovni vojni. Štiri nemške pehotne divizije ob podpori treh tankovskih divizij so oblegale francoski IV. in V. korpus (okoli 40.000 mož) 1. armade (general René Prioux).

III. korpusu 1. armade se je uspelo umakniti do reke Lys, v bližini katere so bile divizije britanske ekspedicijske sile (BEF). Obkoljena francoska korpusa sta se upirala nemškim napadom, dokler se nista morala predati ob polnoči z 31. maja na 1. junij. Obramba lilskega žepa je omogočila, da se je več zavezniških čet umaknilo v obrambni obroč Dunkerqua in sodelovalo v bitki pri Dunkerqu.

source.title: Siege of Lille (1940)
paragraphs: The siege of Lille or Lille pocket (28–31 May 1940) took place during the Battle of France in the Second World War. The siege of the French IV Corps and V Corps (about 40,000 men) of the First Army (General René Prioux) was conducted by four German infantry divisions supported by three panzer divisions.

The III Corps of the First Army had managed to retreat to the Lys river with the British Expeditionary Force (BEF) divisions nearby. The two surrounded French corps resisted German attacks until forced to surrender at midnight on 31 May/1 June. The defence of the Lille Pocket enabled more Allied troops to retreat into the Dunkirk perimeter and take part in the Battle of Dunkirk.

Siege of Lilybaeum (250–241 BC).headline: Obleganje Lilibeja (250–241 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Obleganje Lilibeja je trajalo devet let, od 250 do 241 pr. n. št., ko je rimska vojska v prvi punski vojni oblegala kartažansko sicilsko mesto Lilibej (današnja Marsala). Rim in Kartagina sta bila v vojni od leta 264 pr. n. št., bojevala sta se večinoma na Siciliji ali v okoliških vodah, Rimljani pa so Kartažane počasi potiskali nazaj. Do leta 250 pr. n. št. so Kartažani držali le še mesti Lilibej in Drepana; bili sta dobro utrjeni in ležali na zahodni obali, kjer ju je bilo mogoče oskrbovati in okrepiti po morju, ne da bi lahko Rimljani s svojo močnejšo kopensko vojsko posegli vmes.

source.title: Siege of Lilybaeum (250–241 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Lilybaeum lasted for nine years, from 250 to 241 BC, as the Roman army laid siege to the Carthaginian-held Sicilian city of Lilybaeum (modern Marsala) during the First Punic War. Rome and Carthage had been at war since 264 BC, fighting mostly on the island of Sicily or in the waters around it, and the Romans were slowly pushing the Carthaginians back. By 250 BC, the Carthaginians held only the cities of Lilybaeum and Drepana; these were well-fortified and situated on the west coast, where they could be supplied and reinforced by sea without the Romans being able to use their superior army to interfere.

Siege of Lisbon.headline: Obleganje Lizbone
paragraphs: Obleganje Lizbone od 1. julija do 25. oktobra 1147 je bilo vojaško dejanje proti almoravidski dinastiji, s katerim je mesto Lizbona prišlo pod dokončni nadzor nove krščanske sile, Kraljevine Portugalske.

Obleganje Lizbone je bilo ena redkih krščanskih zmag druge križarske vojne – po besedah skoraj sočasnega zgodovinarja Helmolda »edini uspeh vesoljne operacije, ki se je je lotila romarska vojska«, torej druge križarske vojne, čeprav so nekateri dvomili, ali je bilo res del te križarske vojne. Velja za prelomno bitko širše rekonkviste.

source.title: Siege of Lisbon
paragraphs: The siege of Lisbon, from 1 July to 25 October 1147, was the military action against the Almoravid dynasty that brought the city of Lisbon under the definitive control of the new Christian power, the Kingdom of Portugal.

The siege of Lisbon was one of the few Christian victories of the Second Crusade—it was "the only success of the universal operation undertaken by the pilgrim army", i.e., the Second Crusade, according to the near contemporary historian Helmold, although others have questioned whether it was really part of that crusade. It is seen as a pivotal battle of the wider Reconquista.

Siege of Luxembourg (1794–1795).headline: Obleganje Luksemburga (1794–1795)
paragraphs: Obleganje Luksemburga je bilo francosko obleganje habsburške trdnjave Luksemburg, ki je med francoskimi revolucionarnimi vojnami trajalo od leta 1794 do 7. junija 1795. Francoska vojska sicer ni prebila mestnega obzidja, ki je slovelo kot eno najboljših na svetu, a se je morala trdnjava po več kot sedmih mesecih predati.
Zaradi dolge obrambe je Lazare Carnot Luksemburg imenoval »najboljšo [trdnjavo] na svetu, razen Gibraltarja«, od tod vzdevek mesta »severni Gibraltar«.

Posledica zavzetja Luksemburga je bila priključitev Južne Nizozemske Franciji 1. oktobra 1795. Večina Luksemburga (vključno z vsem današnjim velikim vojvodstvom) je postala del departmaja Forêts, ustanovljenega 24. oktobra 1795.

source.title: Siege of Luxembourg (1794–1795)
paragraphs: The siege of Luxembourg was a siege by France of the Habsburg-held Fortress of Luxembourg that lasted from 1794 until 7 June 1795, during the French Revolutionary Wars. Although the French army failed to breach the walls of the city, which were renowned as amongst the best in the world, the fortress was forced to surrender after more than seven months.
Luxembourg's long defence led Lazare Carnot to call Luxembourg "the best [fortress] in the world, except Gibraltar", giving rise to the city's nickname 'the Gibraltar of the North'.

The result of the capture of Luxembourg was the annexation of the Southern Netherlands into France on 1 October 1795. Most of Luxembourg (including all of the modern Grand Duchy), became a part of the département of Forêts, which was created on 24 October 1795.
Obleganje Maastrichta od 13. do 30. junija 1673 je potekalo med francosko-nizozemsko vojno, ko je francoska vojska zavzela strateško nizozemsko trdnjavo Maastricht ob reki Mozi.
Obleganje je vodil Vauban in velja za prvo uporabo tehnike, znane kot »oblegovalne vzporednice«, ki so jo uporabljali do sredine 20. stoletja.
Nizozemcem leta 1676 mesta sicer ni uspelo znova zavzeti, a jim je bilo vrnjeno po določilih nijmegenskega miru leta 1678.

source.title: Siege of Maastricht (1673)
paragraphs: The Siege of Maastricht, 13 to 30 June 1673, took place during the Franco-Dutch War, when a French army captured the strategic Dutch fortress of Maastricht on the Meuse river.
Siege operations were conducted by Vauban, and is thought to be the first use of a technique known as the "siege parallel", a concept that remained in use until the mid-20th century.
Although the Dutch failed to retake the city in 1676, it was returned under the terms of the 1678 Treaty of Nijmegen.

Obleganje Madrida je bilo dve leti in pol dolgo obleganje španske prestolnice Madrid pod republikanskim nadzorom, ki so ga v španski državljanski vojni (1936–1939) vodile nacionalistične vojske generala Francisca Franca. Mesto, oblegano od oktobra 1936, je nacionalističnim vojskam padlo 28. marca 1939. V bitki za Madrid novembra 1936 so v mestu in okolici potekali najhujši boji, ko so nacionalisti najodločneje poskušali zavzeti republikansko prestolnico.

Najvišji vojaški odlikovanji Španske republike, lavreatna plaketa Madrida (špansko: Placa Laureada de Madrid) in madridsko odlikovanje (špansko: Distintivo de Madrid), ki ju je republikanska vlada uvedla za nagrajevanje poguma, sta bili poimenovani po španski prestolnici, ker je mesto med dolgim obleganjem v vsej vojni simboliziralo pogum in republikanski odpor.

source.title: Siege of Madrid
paragraphs: The siege of Madrid was a two-and-a-half-year siege of the Republican-controlled Spanish capital city of Madrid by the Nationalist armies, under General Francisco Franco, during the Spanish Civil War (1936–1939). The city, besieged from October 1936, fell to the Nationalist armies on 28 March 1939. The Battle of Madrid in November 1936 saw the most intense fighting in and around the city when the Nationalists made their most determined attempt to take the Republican capital.

The highest military awards of the Spanish Republic, the Laureate Plate of Madrid (Spanish: Placa Laureada de Madrid), and the Madrid Distinction (Spanish: Distintivo de Madrid), established by the Republican government to reward courage, were named after the capital of Spain because the city symbolised valour and Republican resistance during the long siege throughout the war.

Obleganje Mainza (nemško: Belagerung von Mainz) je potekalo od 14. aprila do 23. julija 1793: koalicija Prusije, Avstrije in drugih nemških držav pod vodstvom Svetega rimskega cesarstva je oblegala Mainz in ga iztrgala francoskim revolucionarnim silam. Zavezniki, zlasti Prusi, so se najprej poskusili pogajati, a jim ni uspelo, bombardiranje mesta pa se je začelo v noči na 17. junija.

source.title: Siege of Mainz (1793)
paragraphs: In the siege of Mainz (German: Belagerung von Mainz), from 14 April to 23 July 1793, a coalition of Prussia, Austria, and other German states led by the Holy Roman Empire besieged and captured Mainz from revolutionary French forces. The allies, especially the Prussians, first tried negotiations, but this failed, and the bombardment of the city began on the night of 17 June.

Obleganje Malte, imenovano tudi obleganje Vallette ali francoska blokada (malteško: L-Imblokk tal-Franċiżi), je bilo dveletno obleganje in blokada francoske posadke v Valletti in Treh mestih, največjih naselbinah in glavnem pristanišču na sredozemskem otoku Malta, med letoma 1798 in 1800. Malto je francoska ekspedicijska sila zavzela med sredozemsko kampanjo leta 1798 in jo zasedla s 3000 vojaki pod poveljstvom Clauda-Henrija Belgranda de Vauboisa. Potem ko je britanska kraljeva vojna mornarica 1. avgusta 1798 v bitki pri Nilu uničila francosko sredozemsko floto, so Britanci ob sodelovanju portugalske pomorske eskadre lahko začeli blokado Malte, ob pomoči upora domačega malteškega prebivalstva proti francoski oblasti. Po umiku v Valletto je francoska posadka trpela hudo pomanjkanje hrane, ki ga je še poslabšala učinkovitost britanske blokade. Čeprav je v začetku leta 1799 prispelo nekaj majhnih količin zalog, ni bilo več nobenega prometa do začetka leta 1800, ko sta lakota in bolezni že katastrofalno vplivali na zdravje, moralo in bojno zmogljivost francoskih čet.

source.title: Siege of Malta (1798–1800)
paragraphs: The siege of Malta, also known as the siege of Valletta or the French blockade (Maltese: L-Imblokk tal-Franċiżi), was a two-year siege and blockade of the French garrison in Valletta and the Three Cities, the largest settlements and main port on the Mediterranean island of Malta, between 1798 and 1800. Malta had been captured by a French expeditionary force during the Mediterranean campaign of 1798, and garrisoned with 3,000 soldiers under the command of Claude-Henri Belgrand de Vaubois. After the British Royal Navy destroyed the French Mediterranean Fleet at the Battle of the Nile on 1 August 1798, the British with the cooperation of a Portuguese naval squadron were able to initiate a blockade of Malta, assisted by an uprising among the native Maltese population against French rule. After its retreat to Valletta, the French garrison faced severe food shortages, exacerbated by the effectiveness of the British blockade. Although small quantities of supplies arrived in early 1799, there was no further traffic until early 1800, by which time starvation and disease were having a disastrous effect on the health, morale, and combat capability of the French troops.

Obleganje Malte (ali bitka za Malto) v drugi svetovni vojni je potekalo kot vojaška kampanja na sredozemskem bojišču. Od junija 1940 do novembra 1942 so se zračne in pomorske sile Kraljevine Italije in nacistične Nemčije v boju za nadzor nad strateško pomembnim otokom Malta, britansko kronsko kolonijo, spopadali z Kraljevimi zračnimi silami (RAF) in kraljevo vojno mornarico.

Odprtje nove fronte v Severni Afriki junija 1940 je še povečalo že tako veliko vrednost Malte. Britanske zračne in pomorske sile, ki so bile nastanjene na otoku, so lahko napadale ladje osi, ki so prevažale zaloge in okrepitve iz Evrope. General Erwin Rommel, dejanski poljski poveljnik Panzerarmee Afrika v Severni Afriki, je njen pomen hitro spoznal. Maja 1941 je opozoril: »Brez Malte bo os končala z izgubo nadzora nad Severno Afriko.«

source.title: Siege of Malta (World War II)
paragraphs: The Siege of Malta (or Battle of Malta) in World War II was a military campaign in the Mediterranean theatre. From June 1940 to November 1942, the fight for the control of the strategically important island of the British Crown Colony of Malta pitted the air and naval forces of the Kingdom of Italy and Nazi Germany against the Royal Air Force (RAF) and the Royal Navy.

The opening of a new front in North Africa in June 1940 increased Malta's already considerable value. British air and sea forces based on the island could attack Axis ships transporting supplies and reinforcements from Europe. General Erwin Rommel, de facto field commander of Panzerarmee Afrika in North Africa, recognised its importance quickly. In May 1941, he warned that "Without Malta the Axis will end by losing control of North Africa".

Siege of Mantua (1796–1797).headline: Obleganje Mantove (1796–1797)
paragraphs: Obleganje Mantove je trajalo od 4. junija 1796 do 2. februarja 1797, s kratkim premorom. Francoske sile pod vrhovnim poveljstvom Napoleona Bonaparta so mnogo mesecev oblegale in blokirale veliko avstrijsko posadko v Mantovi, dokler se ni vdala. Obleganje je bilo žarišče italijanske kampanje 1796–1797, saj je trajalo večino kampanje in je bilo prelomna točka, ki je odločala, katera stran bo nadzorovala severno Italijo. Vdaja in hude izgube pri štirih neuspelih poskusih reševanja so privedle do tega, da je Napoleon vdrl v Avstrijo in leta 1797 pripravil Avstrijce do prošnje za mir. Obleganje je potekalo v vojni prve koalicije, delu francoskih revolucionarnih vojn. Mantova, mesto v italijanski deželi Lombardija, leži ob reki Mincio.

source.title: Siege of Mantua (1796–1797)
paragraphs: The siege of Mantua lasted from 4 June 1796 to 2 February 1797 with a short break where French forces under the overall command of Napoleon Bonaparte besieged and blockaded a large Austrian garrison at Mantua for many months until it surrendered. The siege was the focal point of the Italian Campaign of 1796-1797, lasting the vast majority of the campaign and being the hinge point that would determine which side would control Northern Italy. The eventual surrender, together with the heavy losses incurred during four unsuccessful relief attempts, led to Napoleon invading Austria and convincing the Austrians to sue for peace in 1797. The siege occurred during the War of the First Coalition, which is part of the French Revolutionary Wars. Mantua, a city in the Lombardy region of Italy, lies on the Mincio River.

Siege of Marienburg (1410).headline: Obleganje Marienburga leta 1410
paragraphs: Obleganje Marienburga je bilo neuspešno dvomesečno obleganje gradu v Marienburgu (Malbork), prestolnice redovne države tevtonskih vitezov. Združene poljske in litovske sile pod poveljstvom kralja Vladislava II. Jagiela in velikega kneza Vytautasa so grad oblegale od 26. julija do 19. septembra 1410, da bi po veliki zmagi v bitki pri Grunwaldu (Tannenbergu) povsem osvojile Prusijo. Grad pa je obleganje vzdržal in vitezi so v miru v Toruńu (1411) privolili le v manjše ozemeljske izgube. Branilcu Marienburga Heinrichu von Plauenu pripisujejo, da je viteze rešil pred popolnim uničenjem.

source.title: Siege of Marienburg (1410)
paragraphs: The siege of Marienburg was an unsuccessful two-month siege of the castle in Marienburg (Malbork), the capital of the monastic state of the Teutonic Knights. The joint Polish and Lithuanian forces, under command of King Władysław II Jagiełło and Grand Duke Vytautas, besieged the castle between 26 July and 19 September 1410 in a bid for complete conquest of Prussia after the great victory in the Battle of Grunwald (Tannenberg). However, the castle withstood the siege and the Knights conceded only to minor territorial losses in the Peace of Thorn (1411). Marienburg defender Heinrich von Plauen is credited as the savior of the Knights from complete annihilation.

Siege of Massilia.headline: Obleganje Massilie
paragraphs: Obleganje Massilie, ki je vključevalo tudi dva pomorska spopada, je bilo epizoda Cezarjeve državljanske vojne, ki je potekala leta 49 pr. n. št. med silami, zvestimi optimatom, in odredom Cezarjeve vojske. Obleganje je vodil Gaj Trebonij, eden Cezarjevih višjih legatov, pomorske operacije pa so bile v sposobnih rokah Decima Bruta, Cezarjevega strokovnjaka za pomorstvo.

source.title: Siege of Massilia
paragraphs: The siege of Massilia, including two naval engagements, was an episode of Caesar's Civil War, fought in 49 BC between forces loyal to the Optimates and a detachment of Caesar's army. The siege was conducted by Gaius Trebonius, one of Caesar's senior legates, while the naval operations were in the capable hands of Decimus Brutus, Caesar's naval expert.

Siege of Maubeuge.headline: Obleganje Maubeuga
paragraphs: Obleganje Maubeuga je potekalo od 24. avgusta do 7. septembra 1914 v utrjenem taboru Maubeuge (le camp retranché de Maubeuge) na začetku prve svetovne vojne na zahodni fronti. Železniška proga od Thionvilla (Diedenhofen, 1871–1919) do mesta Luxembourg, Arlona in Namurja v Belgiji je bila prekinjena, ker so porušili železniški most čez Mozo pri Namurju. Med obleganjem so lahko nemške vojske na severu uporabljale le enotirno progo od Trierja do Liègea, Bruslja, Valenciennesa in Cambraija, ki je zmogla največ štirideset vlakov na dan.

Konec avgusta je posadka naredila več izpadov, a tretji se je drago izjalovil, nato pa so se Francozi pripravili na nemški napad. Nemško obstreljevanje se je začelo 29. avgusta ob 13.00, pomagali pa so mu agenti v utrjenem položaju, ki so sporočali, kam padajo izstrelki, in tako močno povečali natančnost nemških topov. Nemške in avstrijske supertežke havbice so uničile utrdbe in pehotna zaklonišča (ouvrages); nemško srednje topništvo se je izkazalo za nepričakovano učinkovito.
notes: 1:00 p.m. is written in the 24-hour form, 13.00.

source.title: Siege of Maubeuge
paragraphs: The siege of Maubeuge took place from 24 August – 7 September 1914, at the Entrenched Camp of Maubeuge (le camp retranché de Maubeuge) the start of the First World War on the Western Front. The railway from Thionville (Diedenhofen, 1871–1919) to Luxembourg City, Arlon and Namur into Belgium had been cut by the demolition of the rail bridge over the Meuse at Namur in Belgium. During the siege, the German armies in the north could use only the single-track line from Trier to Liège, Brussels, Valenciennes and Cambrai, which could accommodate a maximum of forty trains a day.

At the end of August the garrison made several sorties but the third was a costly failure, after which the French prepared to receive the German attack. The German bombardment began at 1:00 p.m. on 29 August, assisted by agents in the Entrenched Position who passed reports on the fall of shot, greatly increasing the accuracy of the German guns. The forts and infantry shelters (ouvrages) were wrecked by the German and Austrian super-heavy howitzers; German medium artillery proved unexpectedly effective.

Siege of Melos.headline: Obleganje Melosa
paragraphs: Obleganje Melosa je potekalo leta 416 pr. n. št. med peloponeško vojno med Atenami in Šparto, ko so Atenci napadli Melos, otok v Egejskem morju približno 110 kilometrov vzhodno od grške celine. Čeprav so imeli Melijci rodovne vezi s Šparto, so bili v vojni nevtralni. Atene so poleti 416 pr. n. št. vdrle na Melos in od Melijcev zahtevale, naj se predajo in jim plačujejo davek, sicer jih čaka uničenje. Melijci so to zavrnili, zato so Atenci oblegali njihovo mesto. Melos se je pozimi predal, Atenci pa so moške usmrtili, ženske in otroke pa zasužnjili.

Obleganje je najbolj znano po Melijskem dialogu, dramatizaciji pogajanj med Atenci in Melijci pred obleganjem, ki jo je napisal klasični atenski zgodovinar Tukidid. Atenci v pogajanjih ne ponudijo nobene moralne utemeljitve za vdor, temveč Melijcem naravnost povedo, da Atene Melos potrebujejo za svoje namene in da je edino, kar lahko Melijci pridobijo s predajo brez boja, preživetje.
notes: The mile conversion is left out.

source.title: Siege of Melos
paragraphs: The siege of Melos occurred in 416 BC, during the Peloponnesian War between Athens and Sparta, when the Athenians attacked Melos, an island in the Aegean Sea roughly 110 kilometres (68 miles) east of mainland Greece. Though the Melians had ancestral ties to Sparta, they were neutral in the war. Athens invaded Melos in the summer of 416 BC and demanded that the Melians surrender and pay tribute to Athens or face annihilation. The Melians refused, so the Athenians laid siege to their city. Melos surrendered in the winter, and the Athenians executed the men of Melos and enslaved the women and children.

This siege is best remembered for the Melian Dialogue, a dramatization of the negotiations between the Athenians and the Melians before the siege, written by the classical Athenian historian Thucydides. In the negotiations, the Athenians offer no moral justification for their invasion, but instead bluntly tell the Melians that Athens needs Melos for its own ends and that the only thing Melians stand to gain in submitting without a fight was self-preservation.

Siege of Metz (1870).headline: Obleganje Metza (1870)
paragraphs: Obleganje Metza je potekalo med francosko-prusko vojno od 19. avgusta do 27. oktobra 1870 in se končalo z odločilno zmago zavezniških nemških sil.

Francoska renska armada pod poveljstvom Françoisa Bazaina se je po porazu v bitki pri Gravelottu 18. avgusta 1870 umaknila v trdnjavo Metz. Nemške sile pod poveljstvom pruskega princa Friderika Karla so trdnjavo takoj obkolile. Châlonsko armado so poslali na pomoč renski armadi, a so jo nemške vojske v bitki pri Sedanu 1. in 2. septembra same obkolile in uničile.

Oblegovalci trdnjave niso mogli zavzeti z obstreljevanjem ali naskokom, zato so se odločili Francoze izstradati do predaje. Francoski poskusi prodora so se končali s porazi v bitkah pri Noissevillu 31. avgusta in 1. septembra ter pri Bellevueju 7. oktobra. Francozom je hrana pošla 20. oktobra in François Achille Bazaine je 27. oktobra trdnjavo in vso rensko armado, okoli 193.000 mož, predal Nemcem.

source.title: Siege of Metz (1870)
paragraphs: The Siege of Metz was a siege fought during the Franco-Prussian War from 19 August to 27 October 1870, and ended in a decisive allied German victory.

The French Army of the Rhine under François Bazaine retreated into the Metz fortress after its defeat by the Germans at the Battle of Gravelotte on 18 August 1870. The fortress was promptly surrounded by German forces under Prince Friedrich Karl of Prussia. The French Army of Châlons was sent to relieve the Army of the Rhine but was itself encircled and annihilated by the German armies at the Battle of Sedan on 1–2 September.

Unable to capture the fortress by bombardment or storm, the besieging Germans resorted to starving the French to submission. French attempts to break out ended in defeat at the battles of Noisseville on 31 August – 1 September and Bellevue on 7 October. French food supplies ran out on 20 October and François Achille Bazaine surrendered the fortress and the entire Army of the Rhine, some 193,000 men, into German hands on 27 October.

Siege of Moscow (1382).headline: Obleganje Moskve (1382)
paragraphs: Obleganje Moskve leta 1382 je bilo spopad med Moskovsko kneževino in Tohtamišem, kanom Zlate horde.

Avgusta 1382 je Tohtamiš popeljal veliko vojsko proti Moskvi. Knez Dmitrij Donski tedaj ni bil v mestu, ker je iskal pomoč pri drugih ruskih deželah. Obramba Moskve je bila zato prepuščena prebivalcem in majhni posadki. Tohtamiš je moskovsko obrambo prebil z zvijačo. Pretvarjal se je, da prihaja v miru, in obljubil, da bo prebivalcem Moskve prizanesel, če se predajo. Ko pa so mestna vrata odprli, so mongolsko-tatarske sile vdrle v mesto in zagrešile krut pokol.

source.title: Siege of Moscow (1382)
paragraphs: The siege of Moscow in 1382 was a battle between the Principality of Moscow and Tokhtamysh, khan of the Golden Horde.

In August 1382, Tokhtamysh led a large army toward Moscow. At that time, Prince Dmitry Donskoy was not in the city as he was seeking assistance from other Russian territories. As a result, Moscow's defense was left in the hands of the people and a small garrison. Tokhtamysh used deception to breach Moscow’s defenses. He pretended to come in peace and promised that if the people of Moscow surrendered, they would be spared. However, once the city gates were opened, the Mongol-Tatar forces stormed in and carried out a brutal massacre.

Siege of Mostar.headline: Obleganje Mostarja
paragraphs: Obleganje Mostarja je potekalo med bosansko vojno, najprej leta 1992, nato pa znova v letih 1993–1994. Prva faza je trajala od aprila do junija 1992; v njej sta se Hrvaški svet obrambe (HVO) in Armada Republike Bosne in Hercegovine (ARBiH) bojevala proti Jugoslovanski ljudski armadi (JLA), v kateri so prevladovali Srbi, potem ko je Bosna in Hercegovina razglasila neodvisnost od Jugoslavije. Ta faza se je končala junija 1992 po uspešni operaciji Šakal, ki sta jo začeli Hrvaška vojska (HV) in HVO. Zaradi prvega obleganja je iz Mostarja zbežalo okoli 90.000 prebivalcev, številne verske stavbe, kulturne ustanove in mostovi pa so bili poškodovani ali uničeni.

source.title: Siege of Mostar
paragraphs: The siege of Mostar was fought during the Bosnian War first in 1992 and then again later in 1993 to 1994. Initially lasting between April 1992 and June 1992, it involved the Croatian Defence Council (HVO) and the Army of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina (ARBiH) fighting against the Serb-dominated Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) after Bosnia and Herzegovina declared its independence from Yugoslavia. That phase ended in June 1992 after the success of Operation Jackal, launched by the Croatian Army (HV) and HVO. As a result of the first siege around 90,000 residents of Mostar fled and numerous religious buildings, cultural institutions, and bridges were damaged or destroyed.

Siege of Motya.headline: Obleganje Motye
paragraphs: Obleganje Motye je potekalo poleti 398 pr. n. št. v zahodni Siciliji. Dionizij je po sklenitvi miru s Kartagino leta 405 pr. n. št. vztrajno krepil svojo vojaško moč in utrdil oblast nad Sirakuzami. Sirakuze je utrdil proti obleganjem in ustvaril veliko vojsko najemnikov ter veliko floto, poleg tega pa je kot prvi v zgodovini uporabil katapult in kvinkereme. Leta 398 pr. n. št. je napadel in izropal feničansko mesto Motya, čeprav je Himilkon vodil kartažansko reševalno akcijo. Kartagina je izgubila tudi večino ozemeljskih pridobitev iz leta 405 pr. n. št., potem ko ji je Dionizij leta 398 pr. n. št. napovedal vojno.

source.title: Siege of Motya
paragraphs: The siege of Motya took place in summer 398 BC in western Sicily. Dionysius, after securing peace with Carthage in 405 BC, had steadily increased his military power and had tightened his grip on Syracuse. He had fortified Syracuse against sieges and had created a large army of mercenaries and a large fleet, in addition to employing the catapult and quinqueremes for the first time in history. In 398 BC, he attacked and sacked the Phoenician city of Motya despite the Carthaginian relief effort led by Himilco. Carthage also lost most of her territorial gains secured in 405 BC after Dionysius declared war on Carthage in 398 BC.

Siege of Namur (1692).headline: Obleganje Namurja (1692)
paragraphs: Obleganje Namurja od 25. maja do 30. junija 1692 je bilo velik spopad devetletne vojne in del velikega francoskega načrta (zasnovanega pozimi 1691/92), da bi premagali sile velike aliance in vojno hitro končali. Namur ob sotočju Moze in Sambre je bil mogočna trdnjava ter pomembna politična in vojaška pridobitev. Francoske sile pod Vaubanovim vodstvom so 5. junija prisilile mesto k predaji, citadela, ki jo je odločno branil Menno van Coehoorn, pa se je držala do 30. junija, ko je kapitulirala, s čimer se je 36-dnevno obleganje končalo. Ker se je kralj Ludvik XIV. bal, da namerava kralj Viljem III. trdnjavo znova zavzeti, je svojemu vrhovnemu poveljniku, vojvodi Luxembourgu, ukazal, naj se z zavezniki spopade na odprtem polju, kar je 3. avgusta privedlo do krvave bitke pri Steenkerqu.

source.title: Siege of Namur (1692)
paragraphs: The siege of Namur, 25 May–30 June 1692, was a major engagement of the Nine Years' War, and was part of the French grand plan (devised over the winter of 1691–92) to defeat the forces of the Grand Alliance and bring a swift conclusion to the war. Namur, sitting on the confluence of the Meuse and Sambre rivers, was a considerable fortress, and was a significant political and military asset. French forces, guided by Vauban, forced the town's surrender on 5 June, but the citadel, staunchly defended by Menno van Coehoorn, managed to hold on until 30 June before capitulating, bringing an end to the 36-day siege. Concerned that King William III planned to recapture the stronghold, King Louis XIV subsequently ordered his commander-in-chief, the duc de Luxembourg, to join battle with the Allies in the field, resulting in the bloody Battle of Steenkerque on 3 August.

Siege of Namur (1695).headline: Obleganje Namurja (1695)
paragraphs: Obleganje Namurja (znano tudi kot drugo obleganje Namurja) je potekalo med devetletno vojno med 2. julijem in 4. septembrom 1695. To, da so Namur pri obleganju leta 1692 zavzeli Francozi, leta 1695 pa ga je znova zavzela velika aliansa, pogosto velja za ključna dogodka vojne; drugo obleganje velja za največji vojaški uspeh Viljema III. v tej vojni.

source.title: Siege of Namur (1695)
paragraphs: The siege of Namur (also known as the second siege of Namur) took place during the Nine Years' War between 2 July and 4 September 1695. Its capture by the French in the 1692 siege and recapture by the Grand Alliance in 1695 are often viewed as the defining events of the war; the second siege is considered to be William III's most significant military success during the war.

Siege of Narva (1704).headline: Obleganje Narve (1704)
paragraphs: Obleganje Narve (rusko: Осада Нарвы; švedsko: Belägringen av Narva), znano tudi kot druga bitka pri Narvi, je bilo drugo rusko obleganje švedske Narve med veliko severno vojno, od 8. julija do 20. avgusta 1704.

source.title: Siege of Narva (1704)
paragraphs: The siege of Narva (Russian: Осада Нарвы, Swedish: Belägringen av Narva), also known as the second battle of Narva, was the second Russian siege of Swedish Narva during the Great Northern War from 8 July to 20 August 1704.

Obleganje Naksosa (499 pr. n. št.) je bilo neuspel poskus miletskega tirana Aristagore, ki je deloval s podporo in v imenu Perzijskega cesarstva Dareja Velikega, da bi osvojil otok Naksos. Bilo je uvodno dejanje grško-perzijskih vojn, ki so nazadnje trajale 50 let.

Na Aristagoro so se obrnili izgnani naksoški aristokrati, ki so se želeli vrniti na otok. Aristagora je v tem videl priložnost, da okrepi svoj položaj v Miletu, zato je za pomoč pri osvojitvi Naksosa prosil svojega gospodarja, perzijskega kralja Dareja Velikega, in krajevnega satrapa Artaferna. Perzijci so se s pohodom strinjali in zbrali 200 trirem pod poveljstvom Megabata.

source.title: Siege of Naxos (499 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Naxos (499 BC) was a failed attempt by the Milesian tyrant Aristagoras, operating with support from, and in the name of the Persian Empire of Darius the Great, to conquer the island of Naxos. It was the opening act of the Greco-Persian Wars, which would ultimately last for 50 years.

Aristagoras had been approached by exiled Naxian aristocrats, who were seeking to return to their island. Seeing an opportunity to bolster his position in Miletus, Aristagoras sought the help of his overlord, the Persian king Darius the Great, and the local satrap, Artaphernes to conquer Naxos. Consenting to the expedition, the Persians assembled a force of 200 triremes under the command of Megabates.

Siege of Negroponte (1470).headline: Obleganje Negroponteja (1470)
paragraphs: Obleganje Negroponteja je potekalo med silami Osmanskega cesarstva, ki jih je osebno vodil sultan Mehmed II., in posadko beneške kolonije Negroponte (Halkida), prestolnice beneške posesti Evbeje v osrednji Grčiji. Osmanski sultan Mehmed II. je oblegal trdnjavo v Negroponteju. Obleganje je trajalo skoraj mesec dni in se kljub velikim osmanskim izgubam končalo s tem, da so Osmani zavzeli mesto in otok Evbejo.

source.title: Siege of Negroponte (1470)
paragraphs: The siege of Negroponte was fought between the forces of the Ottoman Empire, led by Sultan Mehmed II in person, and the garrison of the Venetian colony of Negroponte (Chalcis), the capital of the Venetian possession of Euboea in Central Greece. The Ottoman sultan Mehmed II laid siege to the fortress at Negroponte. The siege lasted for almost a month, and, despite great Ottoman casualties, ended in the capture of the city and the island of Euboea by the Ottomans.

Siege of Neuss.headline: Obleganje Neussa
paragraphs: Obleganje Neussa v letih 1474–1475 je bilo povezano s kölnskim škofijskim sporom in je bilo del burgundskih vojn. Obleganje cesarskega mesta Neuss pod vodstvom Karla Drznega ni uspelo. Ko se je približala močna cesarska vojska, je moral Karel obleganje opustiti.

source.title: Siege of Neuss
paragraphs: The siege of Neuss, from 1474–75, was linked to the Cologne Diocesan Feud and part of the Burgundian Wars. The siege, led by Charles the Bold against the Imperial City of Neuss, was unsuccessful. Charles was compelled by the approach of a powerful Imperial army to raise the siege.

Obleganje Nice se je zgodilo leta 1543 in je bilo del italijanske vojne 1542–1546, v kateri sta Franc I. in Sulejman Veličastni v okviru francosko-osmanskega zavezništva sodelovala proti cesarju Svetega rimskega cesarstva Karlu V. in angleškemu kralju Henriku VIII. Nica je bila tedaj pod oblastjo savojskega vojvode Karla III., zaveznika Karla V.

Obleganje je bilo del sredozemskega pohoda Hajredina Barbarose v letih 1543–1544. Francosko-osmanska vojska je oblegala Nico, prebila obzidje in zavzela dele mesta, a se je nazadnje umaknila, preden je zavzela citadelo, ker je na pomoč prispela cesarsko-savojska flota pod vodstvom Andrea Dorie. Nica je tako ostala v savojskih rokah.
notes: The year range 1542–46 is written in full (1542–1546), as the Pravopis asks.

source.title: Siege of Nice
paragraphs: The siege of Nice occurred in 1543 and was part of the Italian War of 1542–46 in which Francis I and Suleiman the Magnificent collaborated as part of the Franco-Ottoman alliance against the Holy Roman Emperor Charles V, and Henry VIII of England. At that time, Nice was under the control of Charles III, Duke of Savoy, an ally of Charles V.

The siege was part of the 1543–1544 Mediterranean campaign of Hayreddin Barbarossa. A Franco-Ottoman army besieged Nice, breaching the walls and conquering sections of the city, but ultimately retired before taking the citadel due to the arrival of a Imperial-Savoyard relief fleet under Andrea Doria. Nice remained thus in Savoyard hands.

Siege of Nöteborg (1702).headline: Obleganje Nöteborga (1702)
paragraphs: Obleganje Nöteborga je bilo eno prvih obleganj velike severne vojne, v katerem so ruske sile oktobra 1702 zavzele švedsko trdnjavo Nöteborg (pozneje preimenovano v Šlisselburg). Peter Veliki je za to nalogo zbral 20.000 mož in deset dni korakal do cilja. Okoli 12.000 teh mož so namestili na bregovih Neve, kjer so taborili do 6. oktobra (po novem koledarju). Tistega dne je Peter poveljstvo nad glavnino prepustil Borisu Šeremetjevu in se odpravil proti Nöteborgu. Ker švedski poveljnik Wilhelm von Schlippenbach trdnjave ni hotel takoj predati, so jo Rusi začeli obstreljevati. Zadnji ruski naskok na trdnjavo taktično ni uspel in je povzročil hude izgube, vendar je branilce 22. oktobra 1702 prisilil k predaji. Peter je po zavzetju trdnjavo takoj začel prenavljati za svoje potrebe in jo preimenoval v Šlisselburg.

source.title: Siege of Nöteborg (1702)
paragraphs: The siege of Nöteborg was one of the first sieges of the Great Northern War, when Russian forces captured the Swedish fortress of Nöteborg (later renamed Shlisselburg) in October 1702. Peter the Great had assembled a force of 20,000 men for this task, and marched for ten days to his destination. About 12,000 of these men were positioned on the banks of the Neva river, where they camped until 6 October (N.S.). On that day, after giving command of the main force to Boris Sheremetev, he moved toward Nöteborg. After the Swedish commander, Wilhelm von Schlippenbach, refused to give up the fort immediately, the Russians began bombarding it. A final Russian assault on the fort was tactically unsuccessful, resulting in heavy casualties, but forced the fort's defenders to surrender on 22 October 1702. After taking control, Peter immediately began reconstructing the fort for his own purposes, renaming it Shlisselburg.

Siege of Olomouc.headline: Obleganje Olomouca
paragraphs: Obleganje Olomouca je potekalo leta 1758, ko je pruska vojska pod vodstvom Friderika Velikega med pruskim vdorom na Moravsko v tretji šlezijski vojni (sedemletni vojni) oblegala avstrijsko mesto Olmütz (danes Olomouc na Češkem). Poskus je zastal, ker so oblegovalci naleteli na močnejši odpor, kot ga je pričakoval Friderik. Ker je primanjkovalo zalog in se je po bitki pri Domstadtlu bližala avstrijska vojska na pomoč, je Friderik obleganje opustil in se umaknil z Moravske.

source.title: Siege of Olomouc
paragraphs: The Siege of Olomouc took place in 1758 when a Prussian army led by Frederick the Great besieged the Austrian city of Olmütz (now Olomouc, Czech Republic) during the Prussian invasion of Moravia in the Third Silesian War (Seven Years' War). The attempt stalled as the besiegers faced stronger resistance than Frederick had expected. With a lack of supplies and the approach of an Austrian relief force following the Battle of Domstadtl, Frederick abandoned the siege and withdrew from Moravia.

Obleganje Orléansa (12. oktobra 1428 – 8. maja 1429) je pomenilo prelomnico stoletne vojne med Francijo in Anglijo. Potekalo je na vrhuncu angleške moči v poznejših fazah vojne, a so ga odbile francoske sile, ki jih je navdihnil prihod Ivane Orleanske. Francozi so nato znova prevzeli pobudo v spopadu in začeli osvajati ozemlja, ki so jih prej zasedli Angleži.

Mesto je imelo za obe strani strateški in simbolni pomen. Sodobniki so se strinjali, da bi angleški regent Ivan Lancastrski, če bi Orléans padel, uresničil sanje svojega brata, angleškega kralja Henrika V., o osvojitvi vse Francije. Pol leta se je zdelo, da so Angleži in njihovi burgundski zavezniki tik pred zavzetjem mesta, a obleganje se je sesulo devet dni po prihodu Ivane Orleanske.

source.title: Siege of Orléans (1428–1429)
paragraphs: The siege of Orléans (12 October 1428 – 8 May 1429) marked a turning point of the Hundred Years' War between France and England. The siege took place at the pinnacle of English power during the later stages of the war, but was repulsed by French forces inspired by the arrival of Joan of Arc. The French would then regain the initiative in the conflict and begin to recapture territories previously occupied by the English.

The city held strategic and symbolic significance to both sides of the conflict. The consensus among contemporaries was that the English regent, John of Lancaster, would have succeeded in realising his brother the English king Henry V's dream of conquering all of France if Orléans fell. For half a year the English and their Burgundian allies appeared to be on the verge of capturing the city, but the siege collapsed nine days after Joan of Arc arrived.

Siege of Ostend.headline: Obleganje Ostenda
paragraphs: Obleganje Ostenda je bilo triletno obleganje mesta Ostende med osemdesetletno vojno in angleško-špansko vojno. Španske sile pod vodstvom nadvojvode Albrehta so oblegale trdnjavo, ki jo je sprva držala nizozemska posadka, okrepljena z angleškimi četami pod poveljstvom Francisa Vera, ki je postal guverner mesta. Govorili so: »Španci so napadali nenapadljivo, Nizozemci so branili neubranljivo.« Ker sta se obe strani tako zavzeto borili za edino območje pokrajine Flandrije pod nizozemsko oblastjo, je pohod trajal dlje kot kateri koli drug v tej vojni. To je bilo eno najdaljših in najkrvavejših obleganj v svetovni zgodovini: med obleganjem je bilo ubitih ali ranjenih ali je za boleznimi umrlo več kot 100.000 ljudi.

source.title: Siege of Ostend
paragraphs: The siege of Ostend was a three-year siege of the city of Ostend during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. A Spanish force under Archduke Albrecht besieged the fortress being held initially by a Dutch force which was reinforced by English troops under Francis Vere, who became the town's governor. It was said "the Spanish assailed the unassailable; the Dutch defended the indefensible." The commitment of both sides in the dispute over the only Dutch-ruled area in the province of Flanders made the campaign continue for longer than any other during the war. This resulted in one of the longest and bloodiest sieges in world history: more than 100,000 people were killed, wounded, or succumbed to disease during the siege.

Obleganje Pariza je bilo septembra 1429 med stoletno vojno napad čet nedavno kronanega francoskega kralja Karla VII., pri katerem je bila vidno navzoča tudi Ivana Orleanska; z njim so hoteli zavzeti mesto, ki so ga držali Angleži in Burgundci. Francoske čete kralja Karla niso vdrle v Pariz, ki sta ga ob podpori velikega dela meščanov branila guverner Jean de Villiers de L'Isle-Adam in prošt Simon Morhier.

source.title: Siege of Paris (1429)
paragraphs: The siege of Paris was an assault undertaken in September 1429 during the Hundred Years' War by the troops of the recently crowned King Charles VII of France, with the notable presence of Joan of Arc, to take the city held by the English and Burgundians. King Charles's French troops failed to enter Paris, defended by the governor Jean de Villiers de L'Isle-Adam and the provost Simon Morhier, with the support of much of the city's population.

Obleganje Pariza je potekalo od 19. septembra 1870 do 28. januarja 1871 in se končalo, ko so mesto zavzele sile različnih držav Severnonemške zveze pod vodstvom Kraljevine Prusije. Obleganje je bilo vrhunec francosko-pruske vojne, v kateri je drugo francosko cesarstvo z napovedjo vojne Severnonemški zvezi skušalo znova uveljaviti svojo prevlado v celinski Evropi. Severnonemška zveza, v kateri je prevladovala Prusija, je nedavno zmagala v avstrijsko-pruski vojni leta 1866, kar je postavilo pod vprašaj položaj Francije kot vodilne sile celinske Evrope. Po napovedi vojne v francoskem parlamentu 16. julija 1870 je cesarska Francija v naslednjih mesecih doživela vrsto porazov proti Nemcem, ki so privedli do bitke pri Sedanu, v kateri so bile 2. septembra 1870 francoske sile odločilno poražene, francoski cesar Napoleon III. pa ujet.

source.title: Siege of Paris (1870–1871)
paragraphs: The Siege of Paris took place from 19 September 1870 to 28 January 1871 and ended in the capture of the city by forces of the various states of the North German Confederation, led by the Kingdom of Prussia. The siege was the culmination of the Franco-Prussian War, which saw the Second French Empire attempt to reassert its dominance over continental Europe by declaring war on the North German Confederation. The Prussian-dominated North German Confederation had recently emerged victorious in the Austro-Prussian War of 1866, which led to the questioning of France's status as the dominant power of continental Europe. With a declaration of war by the French parliament on 16 July 1870, Imperial France soon faced a series of defeats at German hands over the following months, leading to the Battle of Sedan, which, on 2 September 1870, saw a decisive defeat of French forces and the capture of the French emperor, Napoleon III.

Obleganje Pariza leta 845 je bilo vrhunec vikinškega vpada v Zahodno Frankovsko. Vikinške sile je vodil nordijski poglavar z imenom »Reginherus« ali Ragnar, ki ga previdno enačijo z legendarnim junakom sag Ragnarjem Lodbrokom. Reginherusova flota 120 vikinških ladij s tisoči bojevnikov je marca vplula v Seno in plula navzgor po reki.

Kralj Karel Plešasti je v odgovor zbral manjšo vojsko, a ko so Vikingi premagali en njen oddelek, ki je obsegal polovico vojske, so se preostale sile umaknile. Vikingi so Pariz dosegli konec meseca, ob veliki noči. Mesto so oplenili in zasedli, umaknili pa so se, ko jim je Karel plačal odkupnino 7000 francoskih liver (2570 kg) v zlatu in srebru.
notes: The long-ton conversion is dropped; the kilograms are kept.

source.title: Siege of Paris (845)
paragraphs: The siege of Paris of 845 was the culmination of a Viking invasion of West Francia. The Viking forces were led by a Norse chieftain named "Reginherus", or Ragnar, who has been tentatively identified with the legendary saga character Ragnar Lodbrok. Reginherus's fleet of 120 Viking ships, carrying thousands of warriors, entered the Seine in March and sailed up the river.

King Charles the Bald assembled a smaller army in response, but after the Vikings defeated one division, comprising half of the army, the remaining forces retreated. The Vikings reached Paris at the end of the month, during Easter. They plundered and occupied the city, withdrawing after Charles paid a ransom of 7,000 French livres [2,570 kg (2.53 long tons)] in gold and silver.

Obleganje Pariza v letih 885–886 je bilo del vikinškega roparskega pohoda ob Seni v zahodnem delu Frankovskega cesarstva. Bilo je najpomembnejši dogodek vladavine Karla Debelega in prelomnica v usodi karolinške dinastije in v zgodovini Francije. Frankom je dokazalo tudi strateški pomen Pariza v času, ko je bil to eno največjih mest Zahodne Frankovske. O obleganju poroča očividec Abo Cernuus v latinski pesnitvi Bella Parisiacae urbis (»Vojne mesta Pariza«).

source.title: Siege of Paris (885–886)
paragraphs: The siege of Paris of 885–886 was part of a Viking raid on the Seine, in the western part of the Frankish Empire. The siege was the most important event of the reign of Charles the Fat and a turning point in the fortunes of the Carolingian dynasty and the history of France. It also proved for the Franks the strategic importance of Paris at a time when it also was one of the largest cities in West Francia. The siege is the subject of an eyewitness account in the Latin poem Bella Parisiacae urbis of Abbo Cernuus.

Obleganje ali bitka pri Pavii je potekalo v letih 773–774 v severni Italiji, blizu Ticinuma (današnja Pavia), in se je končalo z zmago Frankov pod Karlom Velikim nad Langobardi pod kraljem Desiderijem.

source.title: Siege of Pavia (773–774)
paragraphs: The siege or battle of Pavia was fought in 773–774 in northern Italy, near Ticinum (modern Pavia), and resulted in the victory of the Franks under Charlemagne against the Lombards under King Desiderius.

Siege of Pelium.headline: Obleganje Peliona
paragraphs: Obleganje Peliona je izvedel Aleksander Veliki proti ilirskim plemenom v delih današnje Albanije. Za Aleksandra je bilo ključno, da zavzame ta prelaz, saj je omogočal lahek dostop v Ilirijo in Makedonijo, ta pa je bil nujen, da bi zatrl tedanje nemire v Grčiji, v Atenah in Tebah. To je bila pomembna prelomnica v začetku Aleksandrove vladavine, saj ga je med podonavskimi plemeni na severu uveljavila kot resnega vladarja, s katerim je treba računati, tako kot se je pozneje na enak način uveljavil pri grških mestnih državah pod svojo hegemonijo. Zavzetje prelaza je Aleksandru omogočilo, da je vojsko hitro pripeljal v južno Grčijo, kar je nazadnje privedlo do popolnega uničenja Teb.

source.title: Siege of Pelium
paragraphs: The siege of Pelium was undertaken by Alexander the Great against the Illyrian tribes in parts of what is modern-day Albania. It was critical for Alexander to take this pass as it provided easy access to Illyria and Macedonia, which was urgently needed in order to quell the unrest in Greece at this time in Athens and Thebes. This was an important point of demarcation in Alexander's early reign, as it established him among the Danubian tribes to the north as a serious monarch to be reckoned with, just as he would later establish this precedent for the Greek city states under his hegemony. Taking this pass allowed Alexander to march his army to southern Greece quickly, which would eventually result in the total destruction of Thebes.

Siege of Philippsburg (1734).headline: Obleganje Philippsburga leta 1734
paragraphs: Obleganje Philippsburga je potekalo med poljsko nasledstveno vojno: francoske sile so oblegale enote Svetega rimskega cesarstva v trdnjavi Philippsburg v dolini Rena. Vojvoda Berwick je s 100.000 možmi prodiral navzgor po dolini Rena, 60.000 pa jih je odposlal, da so od 26. maja 1734 obkolili trdnjavo v Philippsburgu. Cesarska vojska 70.000 mož, ki je pod poveljstvom ostarelega princa Evgena Savojskega (spremljal ga je pruski prestolonaslednik Friderik) prišla na pomoč, obleganja ni uspela prekiniti. Berwicka je 12. junija med pregledovanjem jarkov ubila topovska krogla, poveljstvo nad oblegovalci pa sta prevzela maršala d'Asfeld in Noailles. Trdnjava se je predala mesec dni pozneje, posadka pa se je z vojaškimi častmi umaknila v trdnjavo Mainz.
D'Asfeld je za svojo vlogo v pohodu postal maršal Francije, Wuttgenau pa je za pogumno obrambo trdnjave napredoval v generalporočnika.

source.title: Siege of Philippsburg (1734)
paragraphs: The siege of Philippsburg was conducted by French forces against troops of the Holy Roman Empire in the fortress of Philippsburg in the Rhine River valley during the War of the Polish Succession. The Duke of Berwick led 100,000 men up the Rhine Valley, of which 60,000 were detached to invest the fortress at Philippsburg, beginning on 26 May 1734. An Imperial relief army of 70,000 under the aging Prince Eugene of Savoy (accompanied by Crown Prince Frederick of Prussia) was unsuccessful in actually relieving the siege. On 12 June Berwick was killed by a cannonball while inspecting the trenches, and command of the besiegers fell to Marshals d'Asfeld and Noailles. The fortress surrendered one month later, and the garrison withdrew to the fortress of Mainz with the honours of war.
D'Asfeld was promoted to Marshal of France for his role in the campaign; Wuttgenau was promoted to lieutenant general for his spirited defense of the fortress.

Siege of Pilsen.headline: Obleganje Plzna
paragraphs: Obleganje Plzna od 19. septembra do 21. novembra 1618 je bilo prvi pomembnejši spopad tridesetletne vojne. Po češkem stanovskem uporu je češka vojska pod poveljstvom Ernsta von Mansfelda zavzela Plzen.

source.title: Siege of Pilsen
paragraphs: The Siege of Pilsen, 19 September to 21 November 1618, was the first significant action of the Thirty Years' War. Following the Bohemian Revolt, a Bohemian army under Ernst von Mansfeld captured Plzeň.

Siege of Pirna.headline: Obleganje Pirne
paragraphs: Obleganje Pirne, včasih imenovano tudi obkolitev Pirne, je potekalo od 10. septembra do 14. oktobra 1756 v okviru pruskega vdora na Saško v tretji šlezijski vojni (delu sedemletne vojne).

Ko je Friderik Veliki 9. septembra 1756 zasedel Dresden, se je saška vojska pod poveljstvom Friderika von Rutowskega umaknila proti jugovzhodu in zasedla položaj v utrjenem taboru pri Pirni. Položaj je bil taktično močan, saj so ga ščitili strmo zemljišče, trdnjave in obrambne naprave, zato Frideriku ni preostalo drugega, kot da saško vojsko osami in jo z lakoto prisili k predaji. Friderik je tako obkolil tabor in preprečil vsako pomoč od zunaj. Sasi so upali, da jim bo na pomoč priskočila avstrijska vojska pod poveljstvom maršala Browna, ki je stala onkraj meje na sosednjem Češkem.

source.title: Siege of Pirna
paragraphs: The Siege of Pirna, sometimes referred to as the Investment of Pirna, took place from 10 September to 14 October 1756 as part of the Prussian invasion of Saxony during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War).

Following the occupation of Dresden by Frederick the Great on 9 September 1756, the Saxon army under Frederick von Rutowski had withdrawn southeast and taken up position at the fortified camp of Pirna. The position was tactically strong, as the steep terrain, fortresses, and defensive works added protection, leaving Frederick with no option but to isolate and starve the Saxon army into surrendering. As a result, Frederick encircled the camp and blocked outside support. The Saxons hoped to receive relief from the Austrian army, which was across the border in neighbouring Bohemia under Marshal Browne.

Siege of Plevna.headline: Obleganje Plevne
paragraphs: Obleganje Plevne ali Plevena, ena velikih bitk rusko-turške vojne 1877–1878, je potekalo med združeno vojsko Ruskega cesarstva in Kraljevine Romunije na eni strani ter Osmanskim cesarstvom na drugi. Ko je ruska vojska pri Svištovu prečkala Donavo, je začela napredovati proti središču današnje Bolgarije, da bi prečkala Balkansko gorovje in prodrla do Carigrada ter se izognila utrjenim turškim trdnjavam na črnomorski obali. Osmanska vojska pod vodstvom Osman-paše, ki se je vračala iz Srbije po spopadu s to državo, se je zbrala v utrjenem mestu Plevna, ki so ga obdajale številne redute in je ležalo na pomembnem cestnem križišču.

source.title: Siege of Plevna
paragraphs: The siege of Plevna or Pleven, was a major battle of the Russo-Turkish War of 1877–1878, fought by the joint army of the Russian Empire and the Kingdom of Romania against the Ottoman Empire. After the Russian army crossed the Danube at Svishtov, it began advancing towards the centre of modern Bulgaria, with the aim of crossing the Balkan Mountains to Constantinople, avoiding the fortified Turkish fortresses on the Black Sea coast. The Ottoman army led by Osman Pasha, returning from Serbia after a conflict with that country, was massed in the fortified city of Pleven, a city surrounded by numerous redoubts, located at an important road intersection.

Obleganje Dubrovnika (tedaj Raguze), ki so ga izvedli Aglabidi iz Ifrikije, je trajalo petnajst mesecev: začelo se je leta 866, opustili pa so ga leta 868, ko se je približalo bizantinsko ladjevje. Neuspeh obleganja in ponovna navzočnost Bizantincev v Dalmaciji sta pomenila začetek nove napadalne zahodne politike novega bizantinskega cesarja Bazilija I. Neposredni posledici sta bili obnova bizantinske oblasti v obliki teme Dalmacija in začetek pokristjanjevanja Slovanov na zahodnem Balkanu, v nekaj letih pa je ta politika pripeljala tudi do ponovne bizantinske vpletenosti in navzočnosti v južni Italiji.

source.title: Siege of Ragusa (866–868)
paragraphs: The siege of Ragusa (modern Dubrovnik in Croatia) by the Aghlabids of Ifriqiya lasted for fifteen months, beginning in 866 until the lifting of the siege upon the approach of a Byzantine fleet in 868. The failure of the siege and the re-appearance of the Byzantines in the region of Dalmatia signalled the beginning of new aggressive western policy by the new Byzantine emperor, Basil I. Its immediate effects were the re-establishment of Byzantine authority there in the form of the Theme of Dalmatia, and the beginning of the Christianization of the Slavs of the western Balkans, but within a few years it led to renewed Byzantine involvement and presence in southern Italy as well.

Obleganje Rodosa leta 1480 je bilo prvi in neuspešni poskus Osmanskega cesarstva, da bi rodoškim vitezom iztrgalo otoško trdnjavo Rodos; kljub približno 70.000 osmanskim vojakom so vitezi otok uspešno ubranili.
notes: The English sentence is garbled ("from Rhodes, despite about 70,000 troops, they"); the Slovenian reads it as the Ottomans' 70,000 troops against the knights.

source.title: Siege of Rhodes (1480)
paragraphs: The Siege of Rhodes of 1480 was the first and failed attempt by the Ottoman Empire to seize the island stronghold of the Knights of Rhodes from Rhodes, despite about 70,000 troops, they successfully defended the island.

Siege of Rhodes (1522).headline: Obleganje Rodosa (1522)
paragraphs: Obleganje Rodosa leta 1522 je bilo drugi in nazadnje uspešni poskus Osmanskega cesarstva, da bi rodoške viteze pregnalo z njihove otoške trdnjave in si s tem zagotovilo nadzor nad vzhodnim Sredozemljem. Prvo obleganje leta 1480 ni uspelo. Kljub zelo močni obrambi so turško topništvo in mine v šestih mesecih porušili obzidje.

source.title: Siege of Rhodes (1522)
paragraphs: The siege of Rhodes of 1522 was the second and ultimately successful attempt by the Ottoman Empire to expel the Knights of Rhodes from their island stronghold and thereby secure Ottoman control of the Eastern Mediterranean. The first siege in 1480 had been unsuccessful. Despite very strong defenses, the walls were demolished over the course of six months by Turkish artillery and mines.

Siege of Rhodes (305–304 BC).headline: Obleganje Rodosa (305–304 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Obleganje Rodosa v letih 305–304 pr. n. št. je bilo eno najznamenitejših obleganj antike: Demetrij Poliorket, sin Antigona I., je oblegal Rodos, da bi ga prisilil k opustitvi nevtralnosti in pretrganju tesnih vezi s Ptolemajem I.

Poskus se je nazadnje izjalovil, toda obseg obleganja ter logistična, strateška in inženirska prizadevanja Demetrija Poliorketa so utrdili njegov sloves vojaškega inženirja in osvajalca mest. Viri so poudarili tudi odločno obrambo Rodošanov, zato se je obleganje v grški in rimski antiki postopoma uveljavilo kot eno najznamenitejših obleganj njune skupne preteklosti.
Rodošani so v proslavo zmage postavili Rodoški kolos, ki ga običajno štejejo med sedem čudes antičnega sveta.

source.title: Siege of Rhodes (305–304 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Rhodes in 305–304 BC was one of the most notable sieges of antiquity, when Demetrius Poliorcetes, son of Antigonus I, besieged Rhodes in an attempt to make it abandon its neutrality and end its close relationship with Ptolemy I.

The attempt ultimately proved unsuccessful, but the scale of the siege, along with the logistical, strategic, and engineering efforts of Demetrius Poliorcetes, cemented his reputation as a military engineer and city conqueror. The significant defence mounted by the Rhodians was also noted by the sources, and thus the siege gradually established itself, within Greek and Roman antiquity, as one of the most notable sieges of their shared past.
To celebrate their victory, the Rhodians erected the Colossus of Rhodes, usually considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

Obleganje Rouena (29. julija 1418 – 19. januarja 1419) je bilo pomemben dogodek stoletne vojne, v katerem so angleške sile, zveste Henriku V., normanskim Francozom odvzele Rouen, glavno mesto Normandije.

source.title: Siege of Rouen (1418–1419)
paragraphs: The siege of Rouen (29 July 1418 – 19 January 1419) was a major event in the Hundred Years' War, in which English forces loyal to Henry V captured Rouen, the capital of Normandy, from the Norman French.

Siege of Saguntum.headline: Obleganje Sagunta
paragraphs: Obleganje Sagunta je potekalo leta 219 pr. n. št. med Kartažani in Saguntinci pri mestu Saguntum blizu današnjega mesta Sagunto v provinci Valencia v Španiji. Bitke se danes spominjamo predvsem zato, ker je sprožila eno najpomembnejših vojn antike, drugo punsko vojno.

source.title: Siege of Saguntum
paragraphs: The siege of Saguntum took place in 219 BC between the Carthaginians and the Saguntines at the town of Saguntum, near the modern town of Sagunto in the province of Valencia, Spain. The battle is mainly remembered today because it triggered one of the most important wars of antiquity, the Second Punic War.

Siege of Scutari (1912–1913).headline: Obleganje Skadra (1912–1913)
paragraphs: Obleganje Skadra, imenovano tudi obleganje Shkodre (albansko: Rrethimi i Shkodrës; srbsko: Опсада Скадра), v turščini znano kot İşkodra Müdafaası ali İşkodra Savunması, je potekalo od 28. oktobra 1912 do 23. aprila 1913, ko je vojska Kraljevine Črne gore premagala sile Osmanskega cesarstva in zavzela Skadar.

source.title: Siege of Scutari (1912–1913)
paragraphs: The siege of Scutari, also referred to as the siege of Shkodër (Albanian: Rrethimi i Shkodrës, Serbian: Опсада Скадра), known in Turkish as İşkodra Müdafaası (in Turkish) or İşkodra Savunması, took place from 28 October 1912 to 23 April 1913 when the army of the Kingdom of Montenegro defeated the forces of the Ottoman Empire and captured Shkodër.
Obleganje Sevastopola, znano tudi kot obramba Sevastopola (rusko: Оборона Севастополя) ali bitka za Sevastopol (nemško: Schlacht um Sewastopol).
notes: The English source is cut off in its first sentence, inside a bracket; the Slovenian gives the names it has and closes the sentence.

source.title: Siege of Sevastopol (1941–1942)
paragraphs: The siege of Sevastopol, also known as the defence of Sevastopol (Russian: Оборона Севастополя, romanized: Oborona Sevastopolya) or the Battle for Sevastopol (German: Schlacht um Sewastopol;

Obleganje Seville (julija 1247 – novembra 1248) je bilo 16 mesecev trajajoče uspešno obleganje Seville med rekonkvisto, ki so ga vodile sile kastiljskega kralja Ferdinanda III. Čeprav ga je po geopolitičnem pomenu morda zasenčilo hitro zavzetje Córdobe leta 1236, ki je pretreslo muslimanski svet, je bilo obleganje Seville kljub temu najzahtevnejša vojaška operacija Ferdinanda III. Bila je tudi zadnja velika operacija zgodnje rekonkviste. Operacija je pomenila tudi pojav domačih pomorskih sil Kastilje in Leóna z vojaškim pomenom. Ramón de Bonifaz je bil dejansko prvi kastiljski admiral, čeprav takega uradnega naslova ni nikoli nosil.

source.title: Siege of Seville
paragraphs: The siege of Seville (July 1247 – November 1248) was a 16-month successful investment during the Reconquista of Seville by forces of Ferdinand III of Castile. Although perhaps eclipsed in geopolitical importance by the rapid capture of Córdoba in 1236, which sent a shockwave through the Muslim world, the siege of Seville was nonetheless the most complex military operation undertaken by Fernando III. It is also the last major operation of the Early Reconquista. The operation also marked the appearance of indigenous naval forces of Castile-León of military significance. In effect, Ramón de Bonifaz was the first admiral of Castile, although he never held an official title of that kind.

Siege of Sidney Street.headline: Obleganje Sidney Streeta
paragraphs: Obleganje Sidney Streeta januarja 1911, znano tudi kot bitka za Stepney, je bilo strelsko obračunavanje v londonskem East Endu med združenimi policijskimi in vojaškimi silami ter dvema latvijskima revolucionarjema. Obleganje je bilo vrhunec vrste dogodkov, ki so se začeli decembra 1910 s poskusom ropa draguljarne v Houndsditchu v londonskem Cityju, ki ga je zagrešila tolpa latvijskih priseljencev; pri tem so bili umorjeni trije policisti, dva ranjena, umrl pa je tudi George Gardstein, ključni član latvijske tolpe.

source.title: Siege of Sidney Street
paragraphs: The siege of Sidney Street of January 1911, also known as the Battle of Stepney, was a gunfight in the East End of London between a combined police and army force and two Latvian revolutionaries. The siege was the culmination of a series of events that began in December 1910, with an attempted jewellery robbery at Houndsditch in the City of London by a gang of Latvian immigrants which resulted in the murder of three policemen, the wounding of two others, and the death of George Gardstein, a key member of the Latvian gang.

Siege of Silistria (1854).headline: Obleganje Silistrije (1854)
paragraphs: Obleganje Silistrije ali Silistre, ključni spopad krimske vojne, je potekalo od 11. maja do 23. junija 1854 med Ruskim cesarstvom in Osmanskim cesarstvom na ozemlju današnje Bolgarije. Ruska vojska z do 90.000 možmi in 266 topovi je skušala zavzeti podonavsko trdnjavo Silistrijo v okviru širše strategije, da bi obšla osmansko obrambo in prehitela pričakovano zavezniško izkrcanje pri Varni. Posadko, 12.000 do 18.000 osmanskih vojakov in egipčanskih pomožnih čet, so okrepili britanski vojaški svetovalci; šest tednov dolgo obleganje je uspešno vzdržala.

source.title: Siege of Silistria (1854)
paragraphs: The siege of Silistria, or siege of Silistra, was a key engagement in the Crimean War, fought from 11 May to 23 June 1854 between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire in present-day Bulgaria. The Russian army, numbering up to 90,000 men with 266 guns, attempted to capture the Danubian fortress of Silistria as part of a broader strategy to outflank Ottoman defences and pre-empt an expected Allied landing at Varna. The garrison, 12,000 to 18,000 Ottoman troops and Egyptian auxiliaries, was bolstered by British military advisers and successfully withstood a six-week siege.

Obleganje Slovjanska je izvajala Ukrajina med 12. aprilom in 5. julijem 2014. Začelo se je, ko je Slovjansk zavzela petdesetčlanska enota težko oboroženih ruskih borcev pod vodstvom ruskega državljana Igorja Girkina. Po treh mesecih hudih bojev med oboroženimi silami Ukrajine ter separatističnimi in ruskimi silami je ukrajinska vlada mesto znova zavzela, proruski uporniki pa so se umaknili v Doneck. Spopad v Slovjansku je bil prvi vojaški spopad vojne v Donbasu.

source.title: Siege of Sloviansk
paragraphs: The siege of Sloviansk was conducted by Ukraine between 12 April 2014 and 5 July 2014. It began when Sloviansk was seized by the fifty-strong unit of heavily armed Russian militants led by Russian citizen Igor Girkin. Following three months of heavy fighting between the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the separatist and Russian forces, the Ukrainian government retook the city as the pro-Russia rebels retreated to Donetsk. The engagement in Sloviansk marked the first military engagement of the War in Donbas.

Obleganje Smolenska (poljsko: oblężenie Smoleńska), v Rusiji znano kot smolenska obramba (rusko: Смоленская оборона), je trajalo 20 mesecev, od 29. septembra 1609 do 13. junija 1611: poljska vojska je tedaj med poljsko-rusko vojno 1609–1618 oblegala rusko mesto Smolensk.

source.title: Siege of Smolensk (1609–1611)
paragraphs: The siege of Smolensk (Polish: oblężenie Smoleńska), also known as the Smolensk Defense in Russia (Russian: Смоленская оборона), lasted 20 months between 29 September 1609 to 13 June 1611, when the Polish army besieged the Russian city of Smolensk during the Polish–Russian War of 1609–1618.

Siege of Stralsund (1628).headline: Obleganje Stralsunda leta 1628
paragraphs: Obleganje Stralsunda od 13. maja do 4. avgusta 1628 je potekalo med tridesetletno vojno, ko je cesarska vojska pod poveljstvom Albrechta von Wallensteina skušala zavzeti ključno baltsko pristanišče Stralsund. Stralsund, tedaj samostojno mesto in član Hanze, so sprva okrepile manjše skupine škotskih najemnikov v danski službi, nato pa je švedski kralj Gustav Adolf poslal večjo vojsko pod poveljstvom Alexandra Leslieja.

Neuspeh obleganja je prekinil Wallensteinov niz zmag, Stralsund pa so Švedi držali večino naslednjih dvesto let. Gustavu je mesto dalo mostišče v Svetem rimskem cesarstvu, ki je leta 1630 olajšalo švedski poseg v tridesetletno vojno.

source.title: Siege of Stralsund (1628)
paragraphs: The Siege of Stralsund, 13 May to 4 August 1628, took place during the Thirty Years' War when an Imperial Army under Albrecht von Wallenstein attempted to capture the key Baltic Sea port of Stralsund. Then an independent city and part of the Hanseatic League, Stralsund was initially reinforced by small numbers of Scots mercenaries in Danish service, before Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden sent a larger force under Alexander Leslie.

The failure of the siege ended Wallenstein's series of victories, while Stralsund was held by the Swedes for most of the next two hundred years. It provided Gustavus a bridgehead within the Holy Roman Empire that in 1630 facilitated Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years' War.

Siege of Strasbourg.headline: Obleganje Strasbourga
paragraphs: Obleganje Strasbourga je potekalo med francosko-prusko vojno in se je končalo 28. septembra 1870, ko so Francozi trdnjavo predali.

source.title: Siege of Strasbourg
paragraphs: The siege of Strasbourg took place during the Franco-Prussian War, and resulted in the French surrender of the fortress on 28 September 1870.

Siege of Syracuse (213–212 BC).headline: Obleganje Sirakuz (213–212 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Rimska republika je Sirakuze oblegala v letih 213–212 pr. n. št. Po dolgem obleganju so Rimljani helenistično mesto Sirakuze uspešno zavzeli z naskokom in tako dobili nadzor nad vso Sicilijo. Med obleganjem so mesto varovala orožja, ki jih je razvil znameniti izumitelj in polihistor Arhimed, na koncu obleganja pa ga je ubil rimski vojak, v nasprotju z navodili rimskega prokonzula Marcela, naj mu prizanesejo življenje.

source.title: Siege of Syracuse (213–212 BC)
paragraphs: The siege of Syracuse by the Roman Republic took place in 213–212 BC. The Romans successfully stormed the Hellenistic city of Syracuse after a protracted siege, giving them control of the entire island of Sicily. During the siege, the city was protected by weapons developed by the prominent inventor and polymath Archimedes, who was slain at the conclusion of the siege by a Roman soldier, in contravention of the Roman proconsul Marcellus's instructions to spare his life.

Siege of Syracuse (827–828).headline: Obleganje Sirakuz (827–828)
paragraphs: Obleganje Sirakuz v letih 827–828 je bilo prvi poskus Aglabidov, da bi osvojili mesto Sirakuze na Siciliji, ki je bila tedaj bizantinska provinca. Aglabidska vojska je le nekaj mesecev prej pristala na Siciliji, domnevno v podporo upornemu bizantinskemu generalu Evfemiju. Potem ko je premagala krajevne sile in zavzela trdnjavo Mazara, je odkorakala na Sirakuze, ki so bile pod rimsko in bizantinsko oblastjo prestolnica otoka. Obleganje je trajalo čez zimo 827–828 in do poletja, oblegovalci pa so med tem hudo trpeli zaradi pomanjkanja hrane in izbruha epidemije, ki je zahtevala življenje njihovega poveljnika Asada ibn al-Furata. Ker so Bizantincem prispele okrepitve, je novi arabski vodja Muhammad ibn Abi al-Džavari obleganje opustil in se umaknil v jugozahodni del otoka, ki je ostal v njihovih rokah. Od tam so počasi osvajali Sicilijo, kar je privedlo do padca Sirakuz po novem dolgem obleganju 877–878 in vrhunec doseglo s padcem Taormine leta 902.

source.title: Siege of Syracuse (827–828)
paragraphs: The siege of Syracuse in 827–828 marks the first attempt by the Aghlabids to conquer the city of Syracuse in Sicily, then a Byzantine province. The Aghlabid army had only months before landed on Sicily, ostensibly in support of the rebel Byzantine general Euphemius. After defeating local forces and taking the fortress of Mazara, they marched on Syracuse, which was the capital of the island under Roman and Byzantine rule. The siege lasted through the winter of 827–828 and until summer, during which time the besieging forces suffered greatly from lack of food and an outbreak of an epidemic, which claimed the life of their commander, Asad ibn al-Furat. In the face of Byzantine reinforcements, the new Arab leader, Muhammad ibn Abi'l-Jawari, abandoned the siege and withdrew to the southwestern part of the island, which remained in their hands. From there they pursued the slow conquest of Sicily, which led to the fall of Syracuse after another long siege in 877–878, and culminated in the fall of Taormina in 902.

Siege of Syracuse (877–878).headline: Obleganje Sirakuz (877–878)
paragraphs: Obleganje Sirakuz od 877 do 878 je privedlo do padca mesta Sirakuze, bizantinske prestolnice Sicilije, v roke Aglabidov. Obleganje je trajalo od avgusta 877 do 21. maja 878, ko so aglabidske sile zavzele mesto, ki ga je osrednja bizantinska vlada dejansko prepustila lastni usodi.

Po prvem izkrcanju na Siciliji v poznih 820. letih so Aglabidi večkrat neuspešno poskušali zavzeti Sirakuze; vendar so postopoma osvojili zahodno polovico otoka. Leta 875 so za guvernerja imenovali novega, energičnega Džafarja ibn Muhammada, ki je bil odločen zavzeti mesto. Džafar je obleganje začel avgusta 877, a ga je kmalu prepustil sinu Abu Išaku, sam pa se je umaknil v Palermo.

source.title: Siege of Syracuse (877–878)
paragraphs: The siege of Syracuse from 877 to 878 led to the fall of the city of Syracuse, the Byzantine capital of Sicily, to the Aghlabids. The siege lasted from August 877 to 21 May 878 when the city, effectively left without assistance by the central Byzantine government, was taken by the Aghlabid forces.

Following their first landing in Sicily in the late 820s, the Aghlabids had tried several times, without success, to capture Syracuse; they were, however, able to gradually take over the western half of the island. In 875, a new and energetic governor, Ja'far ibn Muhammad, was appointed, determined to capture the city. Ja'far began the siege in August 877 but soon left it in charge of his son Abu Ishaq, while he retired to Palermo.

Siege of Taganrog.headline: Obleganje Taganroga
paragraphs: Obleganje Taganroga je ime, ki ga nekatera ruska zgodovinska dela dajejo angleško-francoskim pomorskim operacijam v Azovskem morju med junijem in novembrom 1855 med krimsko vojno. Britanske in francoske sile so izvajale strategijo uničevanja oskrbovalnih poti glavne ruske vojske, ki so potekale čez Azovsko morje. Taganrog je bil eno glavnih logističnih vozlišč ruske vojske; 3. junija 1855 so ga napadli in uničili njegovo vojaško skladišče v okviru vrste napadov na vsa večja ruska oskrbovalna oporišča na tem območju, razen Rostova na Donu, do katerega zaradi velikih plitvin ni mogla priti nobena razpoložljiva vojna ladja.

source.title: Siege of Taganrog
paragraphs: The siege of Taganrog is a name given in some Russian histories to Anglo-French naval operations in the Sea of Azov between June and November 1855 during the Crimean War. British and French forces were implementing a strategy of destroying the supply lines for the main Russian army which ran through the Sea of Azov. Taganrog was one of the major logistical hubs of the Russian army and was attacked and its military depot destroyed on 3 June 1855 as part of a series of attacks on all major Russian supply bases in the area, except Rostov-on-Don, which could not be reached due to the large shoals not admitting any available warship.

Siege of Tarnovo.headline: Obleganje Tarnova
paragraphs: Obleganje Tarnovgrada (Tarnova) se je zgodilo spomladi 1393 in se končalo z odločilno osmansko zmago. Po padcu prestolnice se je Bolgarsko cesarstvo skrčilo na nekaj trdnjav ob Donavi.

source.title: Siege of Tarnovo
paragraphs: The siege of Tarnovgrad occurred in the spring of 1393 and resulted in a decisive Ottoman victory. With the fall of its capital, the Bulgarian Empire was reduced to a few fortresses along the Danube.

Obleganje Alcázarja je bilo izjemno simbolična zmaga nacionalistov v Toledu v začetni fazi španske državljanske vojne. Toledski Alcázar so držale različne vojaške sile, naklonjene nacionalistom. Milice strank Ljudske fronte so ga začele oblegati 21. julija 1936. Obleganje se je končalo 27. septembra s prihodom Afriške armade pod Franciscom Francom.

source.title: Siege of the Alcázar
paragraphs: The siege of the Alcázar was a highly symbolic Nationalist victory in Toledo in the opening stages of the Spanish Civil War. The Alcázar of Toledo was held by a variety of military forces in favor of the Nationalists. Militias of the parties in the Popular Front began their siege on July 21, 1936. The siege ended on September 27 with the arrival of the Army of Africa under Francisco Franco.

Siege of Thessalonica (1422–1430).headline: Obleganje Soluna (1422–1430)
paragraphs: Obleganje Soluna v letih 1422–1430 se je končalo z zavzetjem mesta Solun, ki ga je osvojilo Osmansko cesarstvo pod sultanom Muratom II. Mesto je nato naslednjih pet stoletij ostalo v osmanskih rokah, dokler ni leta 1912 postalo del Kraljevine Grčije.

source.title: Siege of Thessalonica (1422–1430)
paragraphs: The siege of Thessalonica between 1422 and 1430 saw the Ottoman Empire, under Sultan Murad II, capture the city of Thessalonica. Afterwards, the city remained in Ottoman hands for the next five centuries until it became part of the Kingdom of Greece in 1912.

Siege of Toulon (1707).headline: Obleganje Toulona (1707)
paragraphs: Obleganje Toulona je potekalo med 29. julijem in 21. avgustom 1707 v vojni za špansko nasledstvo, ko je združena savojsko-cesarska vojska ob podpori anglo-nizozemskih pomorskih sil napadla francosko oporišče v Toulonu.

Zavezniki niso imeli dovolj mož za pravo obleganje, francoske kopenske sile pa so bile številčnejše; potem ko so izgubili okoli 13.000 mož, večinoma zaradi bolezni, so se umaknili v Piemont.
