Francosko floto v pristanišču, med njo 46 linijskih ladij, so potopili, da bi preprečili njeno uničenje; ladij niso dvignili vse do konca vojne, kar je utrdilo anglo-nizozemski nadzor nad zahodnim Sredozemljem.

Zavezniški poraz pa je pokopal upanje na napad na Francijo prek njene ranljive južne meje, zato so bili zavezniki prisiljeni v izčrpavalno vojno na njeni veliko močneje branjeni severni meji. Izid bitke je dejansko končal tudi večje operacije v Italiji.

source.title: Siege of Toulon (1707)
paragraphs: The siege of Toulon took place between 29 July and 21 August 1707 during the War of the Spanish Succession, when a combined Savoyard-Imperial army supported by a Anglo-Dutch naval force, attacked the French base at Toulon.

The Allies had insufficient men to institute a formal siege, while they were outnumbered by French land forces; after losing around 13,000 men, mostly from disease, they retreated to Piedmont. The French fleet inside the harbour, including 46 ships of the line, was sunk to prevent its destruction; the fleet would not be re-floated until after the war ended, cementing Anglo-Dutch control of the western Mediterranean.

However, the Allied defeat ended hopes of attacking France through its vulnerable southern border, forcing the Allies into a war of attrition on its much more strongly held northern frontier. The battle's outcome also effectively brought an end to major operations in Italy.

Obleganje Toulona je potekalo med vojno prve koalicije. Po vstaji od 31. maja do 2. junija 1793 je v mestu Toulon v Franciji izbruhnil federalistični upor proti prvi francoski republiki. Federaliste so kmalu izpodrinili številčnejši francoski rojalisti, ki jih je podprla prva koalicija in poslala sile, da bi mesto obdržali. Anglo-španska flota je 28. avgusta pripeljala 13.000 britanskih, španskih, neapeljskih in sardinskih vojakov. Ker je bil Toulon strateško ključen kot veliko vojaško pristanišče, v katerem je bila tedaj tretjina linijskih ladij francoske mornarice, je francoska republikanska vlada hitro ukrepala, da bi mesto znova zavzela.

source.title: Siege of Toulon (1793)
paragraphs: The siege of Toulon took place during the War of the First Coalition. Following the insurrection of 31 May – 2 June 1793, a Federalist revolt against the French First Republic broke out in the city of Toulon, France. The Federalists were soon supplanted by more numerous French Royalists, aided by the First Coalition, which sent forces to help them hold the city. An Anglo-Spanish fleet arrived on 28 August transporting 13,000 British, Spanish, Neapolitan and Sardinian troops. As Toulon was strategically vital, being a major naval port which was then host to a third of the French Navy's ships of the line, the French Republican government quickly moved to recapture the city.

Siege of Tripolitsa.headline: Obleganje Tripolice
paragraphs: Obleganje Tripolice ali padec Tripolice (grško: Άλωση της Τριπολιτσάς), znano tudi kot pokol v Tripolici (turško: Tripoliçe katliamı), je grškim revolucionarnim silam poleti 1821 prineslo zgodnjo zmago nad Osmanskim cesarstvom, med grško osamosvojitveno vojno, ki se je začela v začetku istega leta. Tripolica je bila pomemben cilj, saj je bila upravno središče Osmanov na Peloponezu.
Ko so grške revolucionarne sile zavzele mesto, so muslimansko in judovsko prebivalstvo pobili.
notes: The romanization and the IPA pronunciation of the Greek name are left out.

source.title: Siege of Tripolitsa
paragraphs: The siege of Tripolitsa or fall of Tripolitsa (Greek: Άλωση της Τριπολιτσάς, romanized: Álosi tis Tripolitsás, Greek pronunciation: [ˈalosi tis tripoliˈt͡sas]), also known as the Tripolitsa massacre (Turkish: Tripoliçe katliamı), was an early victory of the revolutionary Greek forces in the summer of 1821 during the Greek War of Independence, which had begun earlier that year, against the Ottoman Empire. Tripolitsa was an important target, because it was the administrative center of the Ottomans in the Peloponnese.
Following the capture of the city by Greek revolutionary forces, the Muslim and Jewish population was massacred.

Siege of Turin.headline: Obleganje Torina
paragraphs: Obleganje Torina, od junija do septembra 1706, je potekalo v španski nasledstveni vojni. Francoska vojska pod vodstvom Louisa de la Feuillade je oblegala savojsko prestolnico Torino; princ Evgen Savojski jo je rešil z akcijo, ki so jo poimenovali najsijajnejša kampanja vojne v Italiji. Obleganje je znano tudi po smrti piemontskega junaka Pietra Miccae.

Do leta 1706 je Francija zasedla večino Savojske vojvodine, razen njene prestolnice Torino. Louis Joseph, vojvoda de Vendôme, je 19. aprila z zmago pri Calcinatu utrdil francoski položaj v Lombardiji. Kmalu zatem je princ Evgen spet prevzel poveljstvo nad cesarskimi četami v severni Italiji, Vendôma pa so julija odpoklicali v Francijo, nadomestil ga je orleanski vojvoda.

source.title: Siege of Turin
paragraphs: The Siege of Turin, June to September 1706, took place during the War of the Spanish Succession. A French army led by Louis de la Feuillade besieged the Savoyard capital of Turin, whose relief by Prince Eugene of Savoy has been called the most brilliant campaign of the war in Italy. The siege is also famous for the death of Piedmontese hero Pietro Micca.

By 1706, France occupied most of the Duchy of Savoy, with the exception of its capital Turin. On 19 April, Louis Joseph, Duke of Vendôme, consolidated the French position in Lombardy by victory at Calcinato. Shortly afterwards, Prince Eugene resumed command of Imperial troops in Northern Italy, while Vendôme was recalled to France in July, and replaced by the Duke of Orleans.

Siege of Zara.headline: Obleganje Zadra
paragraphs: Obleganje Zadra ali Zare (hrvaško: opsada Zadra; madžarsko: Zára ostroma; 10.–24. novembra 1202) je bilo prvo večje dejanje četrte križarske vojne in prvi napad katoliških križarjev na katoliško mesto. Križarji so imeli z Benetkami dogovor o prevozu čez morje, a je bila cena precej višja, kot so jo lahko plačali. Benetke so postavile pogoj, da jim križarji pomagajo zavzeti Zadar (ali Zaro), nenehno bojišče med Benetkami na eni strani ter Kraljevino Hrvaško in Dalmacijo (Sklavonijo) in Ogrsko na drugi; ogrski kralj Emerik pa se je zavezal, da se bo pridružil križarski vojni. Čeprav nekateri križarji niso hoteli sodelovati pri obleganju, se je napad na Zadar začel novembra 1202, kljub pismom papeža Inocenca III., ki je takšno dejanje prepovedal in grozil z izobčenjem. Zadar je padel 24. novembra, Benečani in križarji pa so mesto izropali. Po prezimovanju v Zadru je četrta križarska vojna nadaljevala pohod, ki je pripeljal do obleganja Carigrada.

source.title: Siege of Zara
paragraphs: The siege of Zara or siege of Zadar (Croatian: opsada Zadra; Hungarian: Zára ostroma; 10–24 November 1202) was the first major action of the Fourth Crusade and the first attack against a Catholic city by Catholic crusaders. The crusaders had an agreement with Venice for transport across the sea, but the price far exceeded what they were able to pay. Venice set the condition that the crusaders help them capture Zadar (or Zara), a constant battleground between Venice on one side and the Kingdom of Croatia and Dalmatia (Sclavonia) and Hungary on the other, whose king, Emeric, pledged himself to join the Crusade. Although some of the crusaders refused to take part in the siege, the attack on Zadar began in November 1202 despite letters from Pope Innocent III forbidding such an action and threatening excommunication. Zadar fell on 24 November and the Venetians and the crusaders sacked the city. After wintering in Zadar, the Fourth Crusade continued its campaign, which led to the siege of Constantinople.

Prvo obleganje Zaragoze je bilo krvav spopad v polotoški vojni. Francoska vojska pod generalom Lefebvrom-Desnouettesom, pozneje pod poveljstvom generala Jeana-Antoina Verdierja, je poleti 1808 oblegala špansko mesto Zaragoza in ga večkrat naskočila, a so jo branilci odbili.
notes: The English alternative name (siege of Saragossa) is left out.

source.title: Siege of Zaragoza (1808)
paragraphs: The siege of Zaragoza (also known as the siege of Saragossa) was a bloody struggle in the Peninsular War. A French army under General Lefebvre-Desnouettes and subsequently commanded by General Jean-Antoine Verdier besieged, repeatedly stormed, and was repulsed from the Spanish city of Zaragoza in the summer of 1808.

Drugo obleganje Zaragoze je bilo francosko zavzetje španskega mesta Zaragoza leta 1809 med polotoško vojno. Posebej je bilo znano po svoji brutalnosti. Branilci mesta so bili v veliki številčni manjšini. Po obleganju je bil velik del mesta v ruševinah, posadka je izgubila 24.000 mož, umrlo pa je tudi 30.000 civilistov.

source.title: Siege of Zaragoza (1809)
paragraphs: The siege of Zaragoza was the French capture of the Spanish city of Zaragoza in 1809 during the Peninsular War. It was particularly noted for its brutality. The city was heavily outnumbered against the French. Afterwards, a great part of the city lay in ruins, and the garrison had suffered 24,000 deaths along with 30,000 civilians deaths.
Kampanja Siegfriedove linije je bila faza zahodnoevropskega pohoda v drugi svetovni vojni, ki je zajemala spopade blizu nemške obrambne Siegfriedove linije.
Kampanja je trajala od konca operacije Overlord in prodora čez severno Francijo, ki se je končal 15. septembra 1944, do začetka nemške ardenske protiofenzive, bolj znane kot bitka v Ardenih.

source.title: Siegfried Line campaign
paragraphs: The Siegfried Line campaign was a phase in the Western European campaign of World War II, which involved engagements near the German defensive Siegfried Line.

This campaign spanned from the end of Operation Overlord and the push across northern France, which ended on 15 September 1944, and concluded with the opening of the German Ardennes counteroffensive, better known as the Battle of the Bulge.

Sikorski–Mayski agreement.headline: Sporazum Sikorski–Majski
paragraphs: Sporazum Sikorski–Majski je bil pogodba med Sovjetsko zvezo in poljsko vlado v izgnanstvu, podpisana 30. julija 1941 v Londonu. Ime je dobil po svojih dveh najvidnejših podpisnikih, poljskem predsedniku vlade Władysławu Sikorskem in sovjetskem veleposlaniku v Združenem kraljestvu Ivanu Majskem.

source.title: Sikorski–Mayski agreement
paragraphs: The Sikorski–Mayski agreement was a treaty between the Soviet Union and Polish government-in-exile that was signed in London on 30 July 1941. Its name is taken from its two most notable signatories: the prime minister of Poland, Władysław Sikorski, and the Soviet ambassador to the United Kingdom, Ivan Mayski.

Silesian Uprisings.headline: Šlezijske vstaje
paragraphs: Šlezijske vstaje so bile niz treh vstaj od avgusta 1919 do julija 1921 v Gornji Šleziji, ki je bila tedaj del Weimarske republike. Etnično poljski in poljsko-šlezijski uporniki, ki so želeli, da bi območje pripadlo novoustanovljeni Poljski republiki, so se bojevali proti nemški policiji in paravojaškim silam, ki so želele območje obdržati v novi nemški državi, nastali po prvi svetovni vojni in revolucijah v Nemčiji, ki so ji sledile. Po spopadih so območje razdelili med državi. V sodobni Poljski se vstaj spominjajo kot zgleda poljskega nacionalizma. Čeprav je bila v spopad vpletena osrednja vlada, poljsko zgodovinopisje dogodke prikazuje kot vstaje, ki so izražale voljo navadnih Gornješlezijcev, ne pa kot vojno.

V oboroženih spopadih v Gornji Šleziji med letoma 1919 in 1921 je nasilne smrti umrlo morda več tisoč ljudi. Približno štiri petine žrtev je umrlo v treh šlezijskih vstajah, tri petine samo v tretji šlezijski vstaji leta 1921.

source.title: Silesian Uprisings
paragraphs: The Silesian Uprisings were a series of three uprisings from August 1919 to July 1921 in Upper Silesia, which was part of the Weimar Republic at the time. Ethnic Polish and Polish-Silesian insurrectionists, seeking to have the area transferred to the newly founded Polish Republic, fought German police and paramilitary forces, which sought to keep the area part of the new German state founded after World War I and the subsequent revolutions in Germany. Following the conflict, the area was divided between the two countries. The rebellions have subsequently been commemorated in modern Poland as an example of Polish nationalism. Despite central government involvement in the conflict, Polish historiography renders the events as uprisings reflecting the will of ordinary Upper Silesians rather than a war.

In total, several thousand people may have died violently in the militant clashes in Upper Silesia between 1919 and 1921. About four fifths of the victims were killed during the three Silesian uprisings, three fifths alone during the Third Silesian uprising in 1921.

Enotni evropski akt (EEA) je bil prva večja revizija rimske pogodbe iz leta 1957. Akt je Evropski skupnosti zastavil cilj, da do 31. decembra 1992 vzpostavi enotni trg, kot predhodnik skupne zunanje in varnostne politike Evropske unije (SZVP) pa je pomagal kodificirati evropsko politično sodelovanje. Pogodba o spremembah je bila podpisana v Luxembourgu 17. februarja 1986 in v Haagu 28. februarja 1986. Veljati je začela 1. julija 1987, v času Delorsove komisije.

source.title: Single European Act
paragraphs: The Single European Act (SEA) was the first major revision of the 1957 Treaty of Rome. The Act set the European Community an objective of establishing a single market by 31 December 1992, and as a forerunner of the European Union's Common Foreign and Security Policy (CFSP), it helped codify European Political Co-operation. The amending treaty was signed at Luxembourg City on 17 February 1986 and at The Hague on 28 February 1986. It came into effect on 1 July 1987, under the Delors Commission.

Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Allian.headline: Kitajsko-sovjetska pogodba o prijateljstvu, zavezništvu in medsebojni pomoči
paragraphs: Kitajsko-sovjetska pogodba o prijateljstvu, zavezništvu in medsebojni pomoči (rusko: Советско-китайский договор о дружбе, союзе и взаимной помощи; poenostavljeno kitajsko: 中苏友好同盟互助条约; tradicionalno kitajsko: 中蘇友好同盟互助條約; pinjin: Zhōng-Sū Yǒuhǎo Tóngméng Hùzhù Tiáoyuē), na kratko kitajsko-sovjetska pogodba o prijateljstvu in zavezništvu, je bila dvostranska pogodba o zavezništvu, kolektivni varnosti, pomoči in sodelovanju, ki sta jo 14. februarja 1950 sklenili Ljudska republika Kitajska in Zveza sovjetskih socialističnih republik. Nadomestila je prejšnjo kitajsko-sovjetsko pogodbo, ki jo je podpisala vlada Kuomintanga.

source.title: Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance
paragraphs: The Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship, Alliance and Mutual Assistance (Russian: Советско-китайский договор о дружбе, союзе и взаимной помощи, simplified Chinese: 中苏友好同盟互助条约; traditional Chinese: 中蘇友好同盟互助條約; pinyin: Zhōng-Sū Yǒuhǎo Tóngméng Hùzhù Tiáoyuē), or Sino-Soviet Treaty of Friendship and Alliance for short, was a bilateral treaty of alliance, collective security, aid and cooperation concluded between the People's Republic of China and the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics on February 14, 1950. It superseded the previous Sino-Soviet treaty signed by the Kuomintang government.

Skirmish at Bender.headline: Spopad pri Benderju
paragraphs: Spopad pri Benderju (švedsko: Kalabaliken i Bender; finsko: Benderin kalabaliikki; rusko: Перестрелка в Бендерах) je bil spopad, s katerim so hoteli švedskega kralja Karla XII. po njegovih vojaških porazih v Rusiji odstraniti iz Osmanskega cesarstva. Zgodil se je 1. februarja 1713 (po starem koledarju) oziroma 12. februarja 1713 (po novem koledarju) na osmanskem ozemlju, v današnjem mestu Bender v Moldaviji (separatistična regija Pridnestrje).

source.title: Skirmish at Bender
paragraphs: The Skirmish at Bender (Swedish: Kalabaliken i Bender; Finnish: Benderin kalabaliikki; Russian: Перестрелка в Бендерах, romanized: Perestrelka v Benderakh) was devised to remove Charles XII of Sweden from the Ottoman Empire after his military defeats in Russia. It took place on 1 February 1713 (O.S.) or 12 February 1713 (N.S.) on Ottoman territory, in what is now the town of Bender, Moldova (separatist region of Transnistria).

Skirmish of Pastrengo (1848).headline: Spopad pri Pastrengu
paragraphs: Spopad pri Pastrengu, znan tudi kot bitka pri Pastrengu ali juriš pri Pastrengu, je potekal 30. aprila 1848 med piemontsko in avstrijsko vojsko v prvi italijanski vojni za neodvisnost. Najbolj se ga spominjajo po juršu karabinjerjev, ki je upodobljen v številnih italijanskih umetniških delih.

source.title: Skirmish of Pastrengo (1848)
paragraphs: The Skirmish of Pastrengo, also known as Battle of Pastrengo or Charge of Pastrengo, was fought between the Piedmontese and Austrian army on 30 April 1848, in the course of the First Italian War of Independence. The engagement is mostly remembered for the cavalry charge of the Carabinieri, depicted in numerous Italian artworks.

Sloboda Ukraine.headline: Slobodska Ukrajina
paragraphs: Slobodska Ukrajina, v krajevni rabi tudi Slobožanščina, je zgodovinska pokrajina na severovzhodu Ukrajine in jugozahodu Rusije. Razvila se je iz belgorodskega razrjada in cvetela v 17. in 18. stoletju na jugozahodni meji Ruskega carstva. Leta 1765 so jo preoblikovali v Slobodskoukrajinsko gubernijo.

source.title: Sloboda Ukraine
paragraphs: Sloboda Ukraine, also known locally as Slobozhanshchyna or Slobozhanshchina, is a historical region in northeastern Ukraine and southwestern Russia. It developed from Belgorod Razriad and flourished in the 17th and 18th centuries on the southwestern frontier of the Tsardom of Russia. In 1765, it was converted into the Sloboda Ukraine Governorate.

Slovaška invazija na Poljsko je potekala med napadom nacistične Nemčije na Poljsko septembra 1939. V napad se je vključila nedavno ustanovljena Slovaška republika, terenska armada Bernolák pa je prispevala več kot 50.000 vojakov v treh divizijah. Ker se je večina poljskih sil bojevala z nemškimi armadami, ki so bile bolj severno od južne meje, je slovaški vdor naletel le na šibak odpor in imel zelo majhne izgube.

source.title: Slovak invasion of Poland
paragraphs: The Slovak invasion of Poland occurred during Nazi Germany's invasion of Poland in September 1939. The recently created Slovak Republic joined the attack, and Field Army Bernolák contributed over 50,000 soldiers in three divisions. Since most of the Polish forces were engaged with the German armies, which were more to the north of the southern border, the Slovak invasion met only weak resistance and suffered minimal losses.

Slovak Volunteer Campaigns.headline: Slovaški prostovoljski pohodi
paragraphs: Slovaški prostovoljski pohodi, imenovani tudi slovaška vstaja 1848–1849, slovaški upor ali slovaška revolucija, so potekali v zahodnih delih Gornje Ogrske (danes večinoma zahodna Slovaška) z namenom, da bi Slovakom zagotovili enakopravnost, demokratizirali politično življenje in dosegli socialno pravičnost v okviru revolucij v habsburški monarhiji v letih 1848–1849. Trajali so od septembra 1848 do novembra 1849. Oktobra 1848 so slovaški voditelji svoj prvotni ogrsko-federalni program nadomestili z avstrijsko-federalnim ter zahtevali izločitev slovaškega okrožja (slovaško: Slovenské Okolie) iz Ogrske in oblikovanje novega avtonomnega okrožja v okviru habsburške monarhije.
Slovaška legija ni štela več kot 1000 mož, po nekaterih ocenah pa se je v madžarski vojski honvédov proti Avstrijcem v madžarski osamosvojitveni vojni 1848–1849 borilo vsaj 20.000 slovaških vojakov.

source.title: Anti-Hungarian Slovak Armed Actions in 1848–1849
paragraphs: The Slovak Volunteer Campaigns, Slovak uprising of 1848–1849, Slovak Revolt or the Slovak Revolution occurred in Western parts of Upper Hungary (today mostly Western Slovakia) with the aim of equalizing Slovaks, democratizing political life and achieving social justice within the 1848–49 revolutions in the Habsburg Monarchy. It lasted from September 1848 to November 1849. In October 1848, Slovak leaders replaced their original Hungaro-federal program by Austro-federal, called for the separation of a Slovak district (Slovak: Slovenské Okolie) from the Kingdom of Hungary and for the formation of a new autonomous district within the framework of the Habsburg Monarchy.

The Slovak Legion did not exceed 1,000 men in strength, while according to some estimates, at least 20,000 Slovak soldiers fought in the Hungarian Honvéd Army against the Austrians in the Hungarian War of Independence of 1848–1849.

Smolensk operation.headline: Smolenska operacija (1943)
paragraphs: Druga smolenska operacija (kodno ime »Suvorov«; 7. avgusta – 2. oktobra 1943) je bila sovjetska strateška ofenzivna operacija Rdeče armade v okviru poletno-jesenske kampanje leta 1943. Potekala je skoraj hkrati s spodnjedneprsko ofenzivo (13. avgusta – 22. septembra), trajala dva meseca, vodila pa sta jo general Andrej Jeremenko, poveljnik kalininske fronte, in Vasilij Sokolovski, poveljnik zahodne fronte. Njen cilj je bil pregnati Nemce iz Smolenske in Brjanske regije. Smolensk je bil pod nemško okupacijo od prve bitke pri Smolensku leta 1941.

Kljub impresivni nemški obrambi je Rdeči armadi uspelo več prebojev in osvobodila je več večjih mest, med njimi Smolensk in Roslavl. Zaradi te operacije je Rdeča armada lahko začela načrtovati osvoboditev Belorusije. Vendar je bilo napredovanje pred močnim nemškim odporom razmeroma skromno in počasno, zato je operacija potekala v treh fazah: od 7. do 20. avgusta, od 21. avgusta do 6. septembra in od 7. septembra do 2. oktobra.

source.title: Smolensk operation
paragraphs: The second Smolensk operation (code naming "Suvorov"; 7 August – 2 October 1943) was a Soviet strategic offensive operation conducted by the Red Army as part of the Summer-Autumn Campaign of 1943. Staged almost simultaneously with the Lower Dnieper Offensive (13 August – 22 September), the offensive lasted two months and was led by General Andrei Yeremenko, commanding the Kalinin Front, and Vasily Sokolovsky, commanding the Western Front. Its goal was to clear the German presence from the Smolensk and Bryansk regions. Smolensk had been under German occupation since the first Battle of Smolensk in 1941.

Despite an impressive German defense, the Red Army was able to stage several breakthroughs, liberating several major cities, including Smolensk and Roslavl. As a result of this operation, the Red Army was able to start planning for the liberation of Belarus. However, the overall advance was quite modest and slow in the face of heavy German resistance, and the operation was therefore accomplished in three stages: 7–20 August, 21 August – 6 September, and 7 September – 2 October.
Smolenska vojna (1632–1634) je potekala med Republiko obeh narodov in Rusijo.

Sovražnosti so se začele oktobra 1632, ko so ruske sile skušale zavzeti mesto Smolensk. Manjši spopadi so obema stranema prinesli mešane izide, predaja glavnine ruske vojske februarja 1634 pa je privedla do poljanovskega miru. Rusija je priznala poljsko-litovski nadzor nad Smolensko pokrajino, ki je trajal še 20 let.

source.title: Smolensk War
paragraphs: The Smolensk War (1632–1634) was fought between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Russia.

Hostilities began in October 1632 when Russian forces tried to capture the city of Smolensk. Small military engagements produced mixed results for both sides, but the surrender of the main Russian force in February 1634 led to the Treaty of Polyanovka. Russia accepted Polish–Lithuanian control over the Smolensk region, which lasted for another 20 years.

Social War (220–217 BC).headline: Zavezniška vojna (220–217 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Zavezniška vojna, imenovana tudi vojna zaveznikov in etolska vojna, je potekala od leta 220 do 217 pr. n. št. med Helensko zvezo pod vodstvom Filipa V. Makedonskega ter Etolsko zvezo, Šparto in Elido. Končala se je z mirom v Navpaktu.

source.title: Social War (220–217 BC)
paragraphs: The Social War, also War of the Allies and the Aetolian War, was fought from 220 BC to 217 BC between the Hellenic League under Philip V of Macedon and the Aetolian League, Sparta and Elis. It was ended with the Peace of Naupactus.

Socialistična republika Romunija (romunsko: Republica Socialistă România, RSR) je bila komunistična država, ki je obstajala od leta 1947 do romunske revolucije leta 1989. Od leta 1947 do 1965 se je imenovala Romunska ljudska republika (Republica Populară Romînă, RPR). RSR je bila država vzhodnega bloka in članica Varšavskega pakta, v njenih ustavah pa je bila zapisana prevladujoča vloga Romunske komunistične partije. Na vzhodu je mejila na Črno morje, na severu in vzhodu na Sovjetsko zvezo (Ukrajinsko in Moldavsko SSR), na zahodu na Madžarsko in Jugoslavijo (SR Srbijo), na jugu pa na Bolgarijo.

source.title: Socialist Republic of Romania
paragraphs: The Socialist Republic of Romania (Romanian: Republica Socialistă România, RSR) was a communist state that existed from 1947 to the Romanian revolution in 1989. From 1947 to 1965, the state was known as the Romanian People's Republic (Republica Populară Romînă, RPR). The RSR was an Eastern Bloc state and a member of the Warsaw Pact with a dominant role for the Romanian Communist Party enshrined in its constitutions. Geographically, RSR was bordered by the Black Sea to the east, the Soviet Union (via the Ukrainian and Moldavian SSRs) to the north and east, Hungary and Yugoslavia (via SR Serbia) to the west, and Bulgaria to the south.

Sonderbund War.headline: Sonderbundska vojna
paragraphs: Sonderbundska vojna (nemško: Sonderbundskrieg, francosko: Guerre du Sonderbund, italijansko: Guerra del Sonderbund) je bila državljanska vojna novembra 1847 v Švici, ki je bila tedaj še razmeroma ohlapna zveza kantonov. Izbruhnila je, potem ko je sedem katoliških kantonov leta 1845 ustanovilo Sonderbund (»posebno zvezo«), da bi zaščitili svoje interese pred centralizacijo oblasti. Vojna se je končala s porazom Sonderbunda. Z njo je Švica postala zvezna država, končalo pa se je obdobje politične »restavracije in regeneracije« v Švici.

Sonderbund so sestavljali kantoni Luzern, Fribourg, Valais, Uri, Schwyz, Unterwalden in Zug, vsi pretežno katoliški in pod konservativnimi oblastmi. Kantona Ticino in Solothurn, prav tako pretežno katoliška, a pod liberalnimi oblastmi, se zvezi nista pridružila.

source.title: Sonderbund War
paragraphs: The Sonderbund War (German: Sonderbundskrieg, French: Guerre du Sonderbund, Italian: Guerra del Sonderbund) of November 1847 was a civil war in Switzerland, then still a relatively loose confederacy of cantons. It ensued after seven Catholic cantons formed the Sonderbund ("separate alliance") in 1845 to protect their interests against a centralization of power. The war concluded with the defeat of the Sonderbund. It resulted in the emergence of Switzerland as a federal state, concluding the period of political "restoration and regeneration" in Switzerland.

The Sonderbund consisted of the cantons of Lucerne, Fribourg, Valais, Uri, Schwyz, Unterwalden and Zug, all predominantly Catholic and governed by conservative administrations. The cantons of Ticino and Solothurn, also predominantly Catholic but governed by liberal administrations, did not join the alliance.

Suverena kneževina Združena Nizozemska (nizozemsko, stari zapis: Souverein Vorstendom der Vereenigde Nederlanden) je bila kratkotrajna suverena kneževina in predhodnica Združenega kraljestva Nizozemske, v katerem se je leta 1815 znova združila z Južno Nizozemsko. Kneževina je bila razglašena leta 1813, ko so zmagovalci napoleonskih vojn začeli politično preurejati Evropo, kar je nazadnje določil dunajski kongres. Kneževina je neposredna pravna prednica sodobne nizozemske države.

source.title: Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands
paragraphs: The Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands (Dutch, old spelling: Souverein Vorstendom der Vereenigde Nederlanden) was a short-lived sovereign principality and the precursor of the United Kingdom of the Netherlands, in which it was reunited with the Southern Netherlands in 1815. The principality was proclaimed in 1813 when the victors of the Napoleonic Wars established a political reorganisation of Europe, which would eventually be defined by the Congress of Vienna. It is the direct legal ancestor of the modern Dutch state.

Sovjetska invazija na Poljsko se je začela 17. septembra 1939, ko je Sovjetska zveza brez formalne vojne napovedi vdrla na Poljsko z vzhoda, 16 dni po tem, ko je nacistična Nemčija nanjo vdrla z zahoda. Vojaške operacije so trajale naslednjih 20 dni in se končale 6. oktobra 1939, ko sta nacistična Nemčija in Sovjetska zveza celotno ozemlje Druge poljske republike razdelili na dva dela in si ga priključili. Delitev včasih imenujejo četrta delitev Poljske. Sovjetsko (in nemško) invazijo na Poljsko je posredno napovedoval »tajni protokol« pakta Ribbentrop-Molotov, podpisanega 23. avgusta 1939, ki je Poljsko razdelil na »vplivni sferi« obeh sil. Nemško in sovjetsko sodelovanje pri invaziji na Poljsko so opisali kot sobojevništvo.

source.title: Soviet invasion of Poland
paragraphs: The Soviet Union invaded Poland from the east, without a formal declaration of war, on 17 September 1939, 16 days after Nazi Germany invaded Poland from the west. Subsequent military operations lasted for the following 20 days and ended on 6 October 1939 with the two-way division and annexation of the entire territory of the Second Polish Republic by Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union. This division is sometimes called the Fourth Partition of Poland. The Soviet (as well as German) invasion of Poland was indirectly indicated in the "secret protocol" of the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact signed on 23 August 1939, which divided Poland into "spheres of influence" of the two powers. German and Soviet cooperation in the invasion of Poland has been described as co-belligerence.

Soviet–Estonian Mutual Assistance Treaty.headline: Sovjetsko-estonska pogodba o medsebojni pomoči
paragraphs: Sovjetsko-estonska pogodba o medsebojni pomoči (estonsko: Eesti Vabariigi ja NSV Liidu vaheline vastastikuse abistamise pakt; rusko: Пакт о взаимопомощи между СССР и Эстонией), znana tudi kot pogodba o oporiščih (estonsko: baaside leping), je bila dvostranska pogodba med Sovjetsko zvezo in Estonijo, podpisana 28. septembra 1939 v Moskvi. Pogodba je obe strani zavezovala k spoštovanju suverenosti in neodvisnosti druga druge, sovjetski vladi pa je dovolila postaviti vojaška oporišča v Estoniji. Ta oporišča so junija 1940 olajšala sovjetski prevzem države.

Podpisala sta jo estonski zunanji minister Karl Selter in sovjetski ljudski komisar za zunanje zadeve Vjačeslav Molotov. Ratifikacije so izmenjali 4. oktobra 1939 v Talinu in pogodba je začela veljati isti dan. V zbirko pogodb Društva narodov so jo vpisali 13. oktobra 1939.

source.title: Soviet–Estonian Mutual Assistance Treaty
paragraphs: The Soviet–Estonian Mutual Assistance Treaty (Estonian: Eesti Vabariigi ja NSV Liidu vaheline vastastikuse abistamise pakt, Russian: Пакт о взаимопомощи между СССР и Эстонией, romanized: Pakt o vzaimopomoshchi mezhdu SSSR i Estoniyey), also known as the Bases Treaty (Estonian: baaside leping) was a bilateral treaty between the Soviet Union and Estonia, signed in Moscow on 28 September 1939. The treaty obliged both parties to respect each other's sovereignty and independence, and allowed the Soviet government to establish military bases in Estonia. These bases facilitated the Soviet takeover of the country in June 1940.

It was signed by Estonian Minister of Foreign Affairs Karl Selter and Soviet Commissar of Foreign Affairs Vyacheslav Molotov. Ratifications were exchanged in Tallinn on 4 October 1939 and the treaty became effective on the same day. It was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 13 October 1939.

Soviet–Japanese Joint Declaration of 195.headline: Sovjetsko-japonska skupna deklaracija iz leta 1956
paragraphs: Sovjetska zveza ni podpisala mirovne pogodbe z Japonsko iz leta 1951, ki je obnovila mirne odnose med večino drugih zavezniških sil in Japonsko. Japonska in Sovjetska zveza sta 19. oktobra 1956 podpisali skupno deklaracijo, ki je določala konec vojnega stanja in obnovo diplomatskih odnosov med državama. Dogovorili sta se tudi, da bosta nadaljevali pogajanja o mirovni pogodbi. Sovjetska zveza se je poleg tega zavezala, da bo podprla članstvo Japonske v ZN in se odpovedala vsem odškodninskim zahtevkom iz druge svetovne vojne. Skupno deklaracijo je spremljal trgovinski protokol, ki je državama podelil vzajemni status države z največjimi ugodnostmi in predvidel razvoj trgovine. Japonska je z normalizacijo diplomatskih odnosov pridobila le malo vidnih koristi. V drugi polovici 1950. let se je povečala kulturna izmenjava.
notes: The English opens without a definition sentence; kept as in the source.

source.title: Soviet–Japanese Joint Declaration of 1956
paragraphs: The Soviet Union did not sign the 1951 Treaty of Peace with Japan, which had re‑established peaceful relations between most other Allied Powers and Japan. On 19 October 1956, Japan and the Soviet Union signed a Joint Declaration providing for the end of the state of war and for the restoration of diplomatic relations between both countries. They also agreed to continue negotiations for a peace treaty. In addition, the Soviet Union pledged to support Japan for UN membership and to waive all World War II reparations claims. The joint declaration was accompanied by a trade protocol, which granted reciprocal most favored nation status and provided for the development of trade. Japan derived few apparent gains from the normalization of diplomatic relations. The second half of the 1950s saw an increase in cultural exchanges.

Soviet–Japanese Neutrality Pact.headline: Sovjetsko-japonski pakt o nevtralnosti
paragraphs: Sovjetsko-japonski pakt o nevtralnosti (日ソ中立条約, Nisso Chūritsu Jōyaku), znan tudi kot japonsko-sovjetski pakt o nenapadanju (日ソ不可侵条約, Nisso Fukashin Jōyaku), je bil pakt o nenapadanju med Sovjetsko zvezo in Japonskim cesarstvom, podpisan 13. aprila 1941, dve leti po koncu sovjetsko-japonske obmejne vojne. Zaradi sporazuma sta se državi večji del druge svetovne vojne bojevali proti zaveznicam druga druge, ne pa druga proti drugi. Leta 1945, proti koncu vojne, so Sovjeti pakt razveljavili in se pridružili zavezniškemu pohodu proti Japonski.

source.title: Soviet–Japanese Neutrality Pact
paragraphs: The Soviet–Japanese Neutrality Pact (日ソ中立条約, Nisso Chūritsu Jōyaku), also known as the Japanese–Soviet Non-aggression Pact (日ソ不可侵条約, Nisso Fukashin Jōyaku), was a non-aggression pact between the Soviet Union and the Empire of Japan signed on April 13, 1941, two years after the conclusion of the Soviet-Japanese Border War. The agreement meant that for most of World War II, the two nations fought against each other's allies but not against each other. In 1945, late in the war, the Soviets scrapped the pact and joined the Allied campaign against Japan.

Soviet–Lithuanian Mutual Assistance Trea.headline: Sovjetsko-litovska pogodba o medsebojni pomoči
paragraphs: Sovjetsko-litovska pogodba o medsebojni pomoči (litovsko: Lietuvos-Sovietų Sąjungos savitarpio pagalbos sutartis; rusko: советско-литовский договор о взаимопомощи) je bila dvostranska pogodba med Sovjetsko zvezo in Litvo, podpisana 10. oktobra 1939. Po njenih določbah je Litva dobila približno petino Vilenske regije, vključno z zgodovinsko litovsko prestolnico Vilno, v zameno pa je morala dovoliti, da po vsej Litvi postavijo pet sovjetskih vojaških oporišč z 20.000 vojaki. Pogodba z Litvo je bila v bistvu zelo podobna pogodbama, ki ju je Sovjetska zveza podpisala z Estonijo 28. septembra in z Latvijo 5. oktobra. Po uradnih sovjetskih virih je sovjetska vojska krepila obrambo šibke države pred morebitnimi napadi nacistične Nemčije. Pogodba je določala, da litovska suverenost ne bo prizadeta. V resnici pa je odprla vrata prvi sovjetski okupaciji Litve, The New York Times pa jo je označil za »dejansko žrtvovanje neodvisnosti«.

source.title: Soviet–Lithuanian Mutual Assistance Treaty
paragraphs: The Soviet–Lithuanian Mutual Assistance Treaty (Lithuanian: Lietuvos-Sovietų Sąjungos savitarpio pagalbos sutartis, Russian: советско-литовский договор о взаимопомощи, romanized: sovetsko-litovskiy dogovor o vzaimopomoshchi) was a bilateral treaty signed between the Soviet Union and Lithuania on October 10, 1939. According to provisions outlined in the treaty, Lithuania would acquire about one fifth of the Vilnius Region, including Lithuania's historical capital, Vilnius, and in exchange would allow five Soviet military bases with 20,000 troops to be established across Lithuania. In essence, the treaty with Lithuania was very similar to the treaties that the Soviet Union signed with Estonia on September 28, and with Latvia on October 5. According to official Soviet sources, the Soviet military was strengthening the defenses of a weak nation against possible attacks by Nazi Germany. The treaty provided that Lithuania's sovereignty would not be affected. However, in reality, the treaty opened the door for the first Soviet occupation of Lithuania and was described by The New York Times as "virtual sacrifice of independence."

Soviet–Lithuanian Peace Treaty.headline: Sovjetsko-litovska mirovna pogodba
paragraphs: Sovjetsko-litovska mirovna pogodba, znana tudi kot moskovski mir, je bila pogodba med Litvo in Sovjetsko Rusijo, podpisana 12. julija 1920. Sovjetska Rusija je v zameno za litovsko nevtralnost in dovoljenje, da med vojno proti Poljski premika čete po ozemlju, ki ga je priznala Litvi, priznala suverenost Litve. Pogodba je bila pomemben mejnik v litovskem boju za mednarodno priznanje in je priznala vzhodne meje Litve. Medvojna Litva je uradno vztrajala, da so njene de iure meje tiste, ki jih je začrtala pogodba, čeprav je veliko ozemlje, Vilensko regijo, dejansko nadzorovala Poljska.
Ratifikacijske listine so izmenjali v Moskvi 14. oktobra 1920. V zbirko pogodb Društva narodov so pogodbo vpisali 8. marca 1921.

source.title: Soviet–Lithuanian Peace Treaty
paragraphs: The Soviet–Lithuanian Peace Treaty, also known as the Moscow Peace Treaty, was signed between Lithuania and Soviet Russia on July 12, 1920. In exchange for Lithuania's neutrality and permission to move its troops in the territory that was recognised during its war against Poland, Soviet Russia recognized the sovereignty of Lithuania. The treaty was a major milestone in Lithuania's struggle for international recognition and recognised Lithuania's eastern borders. Interwar Lithuania officially maintained that its de jure borders were those delineated by the treaty although a large territory, the Vilnius Region, was actually controlled by Poland.
Ratification documents were exchanged in Moscow on October 14, 1920. The treaty was registered in the League of Nations Treaty Series on March 8, 1921.

Soviet–Polish Non-Aggression Pact.headline: Sovjetsko-poljski pakt o nenapadanju
paragraphs: Sovjetsko-poljski pakt o nenapadanju (poljsko: Polsko-radziecki pakt o nieagresji; rusko: Договор о ненападении между СССР и Польшей) je bil pakt o nenapadanju, ki so ga leta 1932 podpisali predstavniki Poljske in Sovjetske zveze. Pakt je 17. septembra 1939 enostransko prekršila sovjetska invazija na Poljsko.

source.title: Soviet–Polish Non-Aggression Pact
paragraphs: The Soviet–Polish Non-Aggression Pact (Polish: Polsko-radziecki pakt o nieagresji, Russian: Договор о ненападении между СССР и Польшей, transliterated as Dogovor o nenapadenii mezhdu SSSR i Pol'shey) was a non-aggression pact signed in 1932 by representatives of Poland and the Soviet Union. The pact was unilaterally broken on September 17, 1939, by the Soviet invasion of Poland.

Spithead and Nore mutinies.headline: Upora v Spitheadu in Noru
paragraphs: Upora v Spitheadu in Noru sta bila velika upora mornarjev Kraljeve vojne mornarice leta 1797. Bila sta prva v vse daljši vrsti izbruhov pomorskega radikalizma v atlantskem svetu. Čeprav sta si bila časovno blizu, sta se po značaju razlikovala. Upor v Spitheadu je bil preprosta, mirna in uspešna stavka zaradi gospodarskih pritožb, upor v Noru pa je bil bolj radikalno dejanje, ki je izražalo tudi politične ideale, in je spodletel.

Upora sta Britanijo izjemno zaskrbela, saj je bila država tedaj v vojni z revolucionarno Francijo in je bila mornarica glavni del vojnih prizadevanj. Vlada se je bala tudi, da sta upora morda del širših poskusov revolucionarnega hujskanja, ki so jih spodbujala društva, kot sta bila Londonsko korespondenčno društvo in Združeni Irci.

source.title: Spithead and Nore mutinies
paragraphs: The Spithead and Nore mutinies were two major mutinies by sailors of the Royal Navy in 1797. They were the first in an increasing series of outbreaks of maritime radicalism in the Atlantic World. Despite their temporal proximity, the mutinies differed in character. The Spithead mutiny was a simple, peaceful, successful strike action to address economic grievances, while the Nore mutiny was a more radical action, articulating political ideals as well, which failed.

The mutinies were extremely concerning for Britain, because at the time the country was at war with Revolutionary France, and the Navy was the main component of the war effort. There were also concerns among the government that the mutinies might be part of wider attempts at revolutionary sedition instigated by societies such as the London Corresponding Society and the United Irishmen.

Ofenziva na italijanski fronti spomladi 1945, s kodnim imenom operacija Grapeshot, je bila zadnji zavezniški napad v italijanski kampanji v sklepnih fazah druge svetovne vojne. Napad na Lombardski nižini je 15. zavezniška armadna skupina začela 6. aprila 1945 in se je končal 2. maja s kapitulacijo vseh sil osi v Italiji.

source.title: Spring 1945 offensive in Italy
paragraphs: The Spring 1945 offensive in Italy, codenamed Operation Grapeshot, was the final Allied attack during the Italian Campaign in the final stages of the Second World War. The attack in the Lombard Plain by the 15th Allied Army Group started on 6 April 1945 and ended on 2 May with the surrender of all Axis forces in Italy.

St. James' Day Battle.headline: Bitka na dan sv. Jakoba
paragraphs: Bitka na dan sv. Jakoba je potekala 25. julija 1666 (4. avgusta 1666 po gregorijanskem koledarju) v drugi angleško-nizozemski vojni. V njej sta se spopadla angleško ladjevje pod skupnim poveljstvom princa Ruperta Renskega in Georgea Moncka ter nizozemsko ladjevje pod poročnikom admiralom Michielom de Ruyterjem.

source.title: St. James' Day Battle
paragraphs: The St James' Day Battle took place on 25 July 1666 (4 August 1666 in the Gregorian calendar), during the Second Anglo-Dutch War. It was fought between an English fleet commanded jointly by Prince Rupert of the Rhine and George Monck, and a Dutch force under Lieutenant-Admiral Michiel de Ruyter.

START I.headline: START I
paragraphs: START I (Pogodba o zmanjšanju strateške oborožitve) je bila dvostranska pogodba med Združenimi državami in Sovjetsko zvezo o zmanjšanju in omejitvi strateškega ofenzivnega orožja. Podpisali so jo 31. julija 1991, veljati pa je začela 5. decembra 1994. Podpisnicama je prepovedovala namestiti več kot 6000 jedrskih bojnih glav in skupaj več kot 1600 medcelinskih balističnih raket (ICBM) in bombnikov.

S pogajanji o START so dosegli največjo in najbolj zapleteno pogodbo o nadzoru oborožitve v zgodovini, njena dokončna izvedba konec leta 2001 pa je odstranila približno 80 % vsega tedaj obstoječega strateškega jedrskega orožja. Predlagal jo je ameriški predsednik Ronald Reagan, preimenovali pa so jo v START I, ko so se začela pogajanja o START II.

Po razpadu Sovjetske zveze leta 1991 je lizbonski protokol države naslednice Rusijo, Belorusijo, Ukrajino in Kazahstan zavezal k določilom START, saj so imele vse štiri v posesti nekdanje sovjetsko strateško jedrsko orožje. Protokol so podpisali maja 1992, veljati pa je začel decembra 1994.

source.title: START I
paragraphs: START I (Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty) was a bilateral treaty between the United States and the Soviet Union on the reduction and the limitation of strategic offensive arms. The treaty was signed on 31 July 1991 and entered into force on 5 December 1994. The treaty barred its signatories from deploying more than 6,000 nuclear warheads and a total of 1,600 intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs) and bombers.

START negotiated the largest and most complex arms control treaty in history, and its final implementation in late 2001 resulted in the removal of about 80% of all strategic nuclear weapons then in existence. Proposed by U.S. president Ronald Reagan, it was renamed START I after negotiations began on START II.

Following the 1991 dissolution of the Soviet Union, the Lisbon Protocol bound the successor states Russia, Belarus, Ukraine, and Kazakhstan, to the terms of START, as all four were in possession of former Soviet strategic nuclear weapons. The protocol was signed in May 1992 and effective December 1994.

START II.headline: START II
paragraphs: START II (Pogodba o zmanjšanju strateške oborožitve) je bila dvostranska pogodba med Združenimi državami in Rusijo o zmanjšanju in omejitvi strateškega ofenzivnega orožja. Podpisala sta jo ameriški predsednik George H. W. Bush in ruski predsednik Boris Jelcin 3. januarja 1993; prepovedovala je uporabo več neodvisno vodljivih bojnih glav (MIRV) na medcelinskih balističnih raketah (ICBM). Zato jo pogosto imenujejo sporazum o odpravi MIRV.

Ameriški senat jo je ratificiral 26. januarja 1996 z 87 glasovi proti 4. Rusija je START II ratificirala 14. aprila 2000, pod pogojem, da se ohrani pogodba o protibalističnih raketah (ABM) in da ZDA ratificirajo dodatek. Ameriški senat dodatka ni nikoli ratificiral, in ko so se ZDA 13. junija 2002 umaknile iz pogodbe ABM, se je Rusija dan pozneje umaknila iz START II. START II tako ni nikoli začela veljati.
Namesto nje je začela veljati pogodba SORT, ki je število strateških bojnih glav na državo zmanjšala na 1700–2200.

source.title: START II
paragraphs: START II (Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty) was a bilateral treaty between the United States and Russia on the Reduction and Limitation of Strategic Offensive Arms. It was signed by US president George H. W. Bush and Russian president Boris Yeltsin on 3 January 1993, banning the use of multiple independently targetable re-entry vehicles (MIRVs) on intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs). Hence, it is often cited as the De-MIRV-ing Agreement.

It was ratified by the US Senate on 26 January 1996 with a vote of 87–4. Russia ratified START II on 14 April 2000, making it conditional on preserving the ABM Treaty and on US ratification of an addendum. The US Senate never ratified the addenum and, when the US withdrew from the ABM Treaty on 13 June 2002, Russia withdrew from START II one day later. Thus, START II never entered into effect.
Instead, SORT came into effect, which reduced the strategic warheads count per country to 1,700–2,200.

Statute of the Council of Europe.headline: Statut Sveta Evrope
paragraphs: Statut Sveta Evrope (znan tudi kot londonska pogodba iz leta 1949), podpisan 5. maja 1949, je ustanovil Svet Evrope, mednarodno organizacijo, odprto za vse evropske države, ki se posveča »prizadevanju za mir, ki temelji na pravičnosti in mednarodnem sodelovanju«. Statut določa vodilna načela organizacije – varstvo človekovih pravic, demokracije in pravne države – ter pristojnosti in delovanje njenih dveh statutarnih organov, Odbora ministrov in Parlamentarne skupščine.

source.title: Statute of the Council of Europe
paragraphs: The Statute of the Council of Europe (also known as the Treaty of London (1949)), signed on 5 May 1949, brought into existence the Council of Europe, an international organisation open to all European states devoted to "the pursuit of peace based on justice and international co-operation". The Statute sets out the guiding principles of the organisation - to uphold human rights, democracy and the rule of law - as well as the mandates and functioning of its two statutory bodies, the Committee of Ministers and the Parliamentary Assembly.

Strategic Arms Limitation Talks.headline: Pogovori o omejitvi strateškega orožja
paragraphs: Pogovori o omejitvi strateškega orožja (SALT) so bili dva kroga dvostranskih konferenc in ustreznih mednarodnih pogodb med ZDA in Sovjetsko zvezo. Velesili hladne vojne sta se z nadzorom oborožitve ukvarjali v dveh krogih pogovorov in sporazumov: SALT I in SALT II.
Pogajanja so se začela novembra 1969 v Helsinkih. SALT I je privedel do pogodbe o protibalističnih raketah (ABM) in začasnega sporazuma med državama.

Čeprav je SALT II leta 1979 na Dunaju privedel do sporazuma, se je ameriški senat v odgovor na sovjetsko invazijo na Afganistan leta 1980 odločil, da pogodbe ne bo ratificiral. Tudi vrhovni sovjet je ni ratificiral. Sporazum je potekel 31. decembra 1985 in ga niso obnovili, čeprav sta ga obe strani še naprej spoštovali.

source.title: Strategic Arms Limitation Talks
paragraphs: The Strategic Arms Limitation Talks (SALT) were two rounds of bilateral conferences and corresponding international treaties involving the United States and the Soviet Union. The Cold War superpowers dealt with arms control in two rounds of talks and agreements: SALT I and SALT II.
Negotiations commenced in Helsinki, in November 1969. SALT I led to the Anti-Ballistic Missile Treaty and an interim agreement between the two countries.

Although SALT II resulted in an agreement in 1979 in Vienna, in response to the 1980 Soviet invasion of Afghanistan the US Senate chose not to ratify the treaty. The Supreme Soviet did not ratify it either. The agreement expired on December 31, 1985, and was not renewed, although both sides continued to respect it.

Strathclyde.headline: Strathclyde
paragraphs: Strathclyde (gelsko: Srath Chluaidh, »dolina reke Clyde«) je bila ena od devetih nekdanjih lokalnih upravnih regij Škotske. Ustanovljena je bila leta 1975 na podlagi zakona o lokalni upravi na Škotskem iz leta 1973 in odpravljena leta 1996 na podlagi zakona o lokalni upravi na Škotskem iz leta 1994. Regija Strathclyde je imela 19 okrožij. Ime je dobila po zgodnjesrednjeveškem Kraljestvu Strathclyde s središčem v Govanu, a je obsegala širše območje od svoje soimenjakinje, saj je poleg jugozahodnega jedra vključevala še Argyll in različne zahodne otoke.
notes: The Gaelic pronunciation in IPA is dropped.
The record is the medieval Kingdom of Strathclyde, but its link points to the article on the modern local government region; the data link is worth checking.

source.title: Strathclyde
paragraphs: Strathclyde (Srath Chluaidh [s̪t̪ɾa ˈxl̪ˠɯi] in Gaelic, meaning 'strath [valley] of the River Clyde') was one of nine former local government regions of Scotland created in 1975 by the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973 and abolished in 1996 by the Local Government etc. (Scotland) Act 1994. The Strathclyde region had 19 districts. The region was named after the early medieval Kingdom of Strathclyde centred on Govan, but covered a broader geographic area than its namesake by including Argyll and various Western islands in addition to its Southwestern core.

Supplementary Convention on the Abolitio.headline: Dopolnilna konvencija o odpravi suženjstva
paragraphs: Dopolnilna konvencija o odpravi suženjstva, s polnim naslovom Dopolnilna konvencija o odpravi suženjstva, trgovine s sužnji ter ustanov in praks, podobnih suženjstvu, je pogodba Združenih narodov iz leta 1956. Nadgrajuje konvencijo o suženjstvu iz leta 1926, ki še velja in je bila namenjena odpravi suženjstva in trgovine s sužnji, ter konvencijo o prisilnem delu iz leta 1930, ki je prepovedala prisilno ali obvezno delo, tako da prepoveduje dolžniško suženjstvo, tlačanstvo, otroške poroke, prisilne poroke in služabništvo otrok.

source.title: Supplementary Convention on the Abolition of Slavery
paragraphs: The Supplementary Convention on the Abolition of Slavery, the full title of which is the Supplementary Convention on the Abolition of Slavery, the Slave Trade, and Institutions and Practices Similar to Slavery, is a 1956 United Nations treaty which builds upon the 1926 Slavery Convention, which is still operative and which proposed to secure the abolition of slavery and of the slave trade, and the Forced Labour Convention of 1930, which banned forced or compulsory labour, by banning debt bondage, serfdom, child marriage, servile marriage, and child servitude.

Svalbard Treaty.headline: Svalbardska pogodba
paragraphs: Svalbardska pogodba (prvotno Spitsbergenska pogodba) priznava suverenost Norveške nad arktičnim otočjem Svalbard, ki se je tedaj imenovalo Spitsbergen. Izvajanje suverenosti pa je podvrženo nekaterim določilom in na otočju ne velja vse norveško pravo. Pogodba omejuje vojaško rabo otočja, ki pa ni demilitarizirano. Podpisnice so dobile enake pravice do opravljanja gospodarskih dejavnosti (predvsem rudarjenja premoga) na otokih. To pravico izvajata Norveška in Rusija.
Otočje je po določilih svalbardske pogodbe edinstveno, saj je v celoti brezvizumsko območje.

source.title: Svalbard Treaty
paragraphs: The Svalbard Treaty (originally the Spitsbergen Treaty) recognises the sovereignty of Norway over the Arctic archipelago of Svalbard, at the time called Spitsbergen. The exercise of sovereignty is, however, subject to certain stipulations, and not all Norwegian law applies. The treaty restricts military uses of the archipelago, but it is not demilitarized. The signatories were given equal rights to engage in commercial activities (mainly coal mining) on the islands. Norway and Russia have exercised this right.
Uniquely, the archipelago is an entirely visa-free zone under the terms of the Svalbard Treaty.

Swabian War.headline: Švabska vojna
paragraphs: Švabska vojna leta 1499 (alemansko: Schwoobechrieg; zapis je odvisen od narečja), v Nemčiji imenovana Schwabenkrieg ali Schweizerkrieg (»švicarska vojna«), v Avstriji pa Engadiner Krieg (»engadinska vojna«), je bila zadnji večji oboroženi spopad med Staro švicarsko konfederacijo in Habsburžani. Kar se je začelo kot krajevni spor za nadzor nad dolino Val Müstair in prelazom Umbrail v Graubündnu, je kmalu ušlo izpod nadzora, ko sta obe strani zaprosili za pomoč svoje zaveznike: Habsburžani so zahtevali podporo Švabske zveze, Zveza treh lig iz Graubündna pa se je obrnila na švicarsko Eidgenossenschaft. Sovražnosti so se hitro razširile iz Graubündna po dolini Rena do Bodenskega jezera in celo v Sundgau v južni Alzaciji, najzahodnejši del habsburške Prednje Avstrije.

source.title: Swabian War
paragraphs: The Swabian War of 1499 (Alemannic German: Schwoobechrieg; spelling depending on dialect), called Schwabenkrieg or Schweizerkrieg ("Swiss War") in Germany and Engadiner Krieg ("War of the Engadin") in Austria, was the last major armed conflict between the Old Swiss Confederacy and the House of Habsburg. What had begun as a local conflict over the control of the Val Müstair and the Umbrail Pass in the Grisons soon got out of hand when both parties called upon their allies for help; the Habsburgs demanding the support of the Swabian League, while the Federation of the Three Leagues of the Grisons turned to the Swiss Eidgenossenschaft. Hostilities quickly spread from the Grisons through the Rhine valley to Lake Constance and even to the Sundgau in southern Alsace, the westernmost part of the Habsburg region of Further Austria.

Švedski imperij, na Švedskem imenovan obdobje velesile (švedsko: stormaktstiden), je bil obdobje švedske zgodovine, ki je obsegalo velik del 17. in začetek 18. stoletja, ko je bila Švedska evropska velesila in je nadzorovala velik del baltskega območja. V tem času je imela tudi ozemlja ob Severnem morju in čezmorske kolonije, kot je bila Nova Švedska. Za začetek obdobja navadno štejejo vladavino Gustava II. Adolfa, ki je prestol zasedel leta 1611, za konec pa izgubo ozemelj leta 1721 po veliki severni vojni.
Po smrti Gustava II. Adolfa leta 1632 je imperij dolga obdobja nadzoroval del visokega plemstva, na primer rodbina Oxenstierna, ki je vladala kot regent za mladoletne vladarje.

source.title: Swedish Empire
paragraphs: The Swedish Empire, referred to in Sweden as the Great Power Era (Swedish: stormaktstiden), was the period in Swedish history spanning much of the 17th and early 18th centuries during which Sweden was a European great power that exercised territorial control over much of the Baltic region. During this period, it also held territories on the North Sea including overseas colonies, such as New Sweden. The beginning of the period is usually taken as the reign of Gustavus Adolphus, who ascended the throne in 1611, and its end as the loss of territories in 1721 following the Great Northern War.
After the death of Gustavus Adolphus in 1632, the empire was controlled for lengthy periods by part of the high nobility, such as the Oxenstierna family, acting as regents for under-aged monarchs.

Swedish invasion of Poland (1701-1706).headline: Švedska invazija na Poljsko (1701–1706)
paragraphs: Švedska invazija na Poljsko (1701–1706), znana tudi kot invazija Karla XII. na Poljsko ali poljska fronta velike severne vojne, je bila spopad v vzhodni Evropi, ki ga je zasenčila velika severna vojna med Švedsko na eni strani ter Rusijo, Dansko-Norveško, Saško in Republiko obeh narodov na drugi. Poljska fronta je bila pomemben del širšega spopada in je obsegala nekaj odločilnih bitk v korist Švedov, ki so prispevale k dolžini vojne (21 let).

source.title: Swedish invasion of Poland (1701–1706)
paragraphs: The Swedish invasion of Poland (1701–1706), also known as Charles XII's invasion of Poland or the Polish front of the Great Northern War, was a conflict in eastern Europe overshadowed by the ongoing Great Northern War fought between Sweden, on the one side, and Russia, Denmark-Norway, Saxony and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth on the other side. The Polish front was a major part of the greater conflict, and it included some decisive battles in favor of the Swedes that contributed to the length of the war (21 years).

Taifa of Albarracín.headline: Taifa Albarracín
paragraphs: Taifa Albarracín (arabsko: طائفة بني رزين) je bila srednjeveško berbersko taifsko kraljestvo. Obstajala je od leta 1012 do 1104 s središčem v mestu Albarracín. Vodila jo je berberska dinastija plemena Banu Razin, ki je na polotok prišlo po osvojitvi Španije pod Tarikom ibn Zijadom.

source.title: Taifa of Albarracín
paragraphs: The Taifa of Albarracín (Arabic: طائفة بني رزين) was a medieval Berber taifa kingdom. The polity existed from 1012 to 1104, and was centered at the city of Albarracín. It was led by the Berber dynasty of the Banu Razin tribe, which arrived in the peninsula after the conquest of Spain by Tariq ibn Ziyad.
Algeciraška taifa (arabsko: طائفة الجزيرة) je bila srednjeveško muslimansko taifsko kraljestvo na območju današnje južne Španije in Gibraltarja, ki je obstajalo od leta 1035 do 1058.

source.title: Taifa of Algeciras
paragraphs: The Taifa of Algeciras (Arabic: طائفة الجزيرة) was a medieval Muslim taifa kingdom in what is now southern Spain and Gibraltar, that existed from 1035 to 1058.

Taifa of Almería.headline: Taifa Almería
paragraphs: Taifa Almería (arabsko: طائفة المرية) je bila muslimansko srednjeveško arabsko kraljestvo na območju današnje province Almería v Španiji. Nastala je leta 1012 in obstajala do leta 1091.

V tem obdobju je mesto Almería doživelo zgodovinski razcvet pod mogočnimi krajevnimi emirji, kot sta bila Hajran, prvi popolnoma neodvisni emir Almeríe in Cartagene, in Abu Jahja Mohamed ibn Man. Almería je okoli leta 1012 razglasila neodvisnost svoje province od Kordobskega kalifata. Ostala je neodvisno kraljestvo, čeprav so ji pohodi seviljske taife zmanjšali ozemlje na severu.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Taifa of Almería
paragraphs: The Taifa of Almería (Arabic: طائفة المرية, Ta'ifa al-Mariyah) was a Muslim medieval Arab kingdom located in what is now the province of Almería in Spain. The taifa originated in 1012 and lasted until 1091.

In this period the city of Almería reached its historical splendour under powerful local emirs like Khayran, the first fully independent Emir of Almería and Cartagena, and Abu Yahyà Muhammad ibn Ma'n. Almería declared independence of its province from Caliphate of Cordoba around 1012. It remained as an independent kingdom, although several campaigns of the Taifa of Seville diminished its territory in the north.

Taifa of Alpuente.headline: Taifa Alpuente
paragraphs: Taifa Alpuente (arabsko: طائفة ألبونت) je bila srednjeveško taifsko kraljestvo berberskega izvora, ki je obstajalo od okoli leta 1009 do 1106 in je nastalo po koncu Kordobskega kalifata na Iberskem polotoku leta 1010. Središče je imela v mestu Alpuente, vladala pa ji je berberska rodbina iz plemena Banu Kasim.

source.title: Taifa of Alpuente
paragraphs: The Taifa of Alpuente (Arabic: طائفة ألبونت) was a medieval taifa kingdom, of Berber origin, that existed from around 1009 to 1106 created following the end of the Caliphate of Córdoba in the Iberian Peninsula in 1010. It was centered at the city of Alpuente. It was ruled by a Berber family of the Banu Qasim tribe.

Taifa of Arcos.headline: Taifa Arcos
paragraphs: Taifa Arcos (arabsko: طائفة أركش) je bila berbersko srednjeveško taifsko kraljestvo, ki je obstajalo v dveh obdobjih. Prvič je obstajala od leta 1011 do 1068, ko ji je vladala zenatska berberska rodbina Banu Džizrun. Od leta 1068 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom Sevilje pod Abadom II. al Mutadidom. Neodvisna je bila znova od leta 1143 do 1145, ko jo je dokončno osvojil Almohadski kalifat.

Banu Džizrun iz berberske zenatske konfederacije so pod vodstvom Mohameda I. zavzeli koro (okraj) Sidonia, potem ko so izgnali umajadskega upravitelja, ki ji je vladal. Dinastija je razglasila neodvisnost in leta 1011 ustanovila kraljestvo taifo Arcos s prestolnico v današnjem mestu Arcos de la Frontera.

source.title: Taifa of Arcos
paragraphs: The Taifa of Arcos (Arabic: طائفة أركش) was a Berber medieval taifa kingdom that existed in two periods; first from 1011 to 1068. Ruled by the Zanata Berber family of the Banū Jizrūn. From 1068 until 1091 it was under the forcible control of Seville, by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid. It regained its independence from 1143 to 1145 when it was finally conquered by the Almohad Caliphate.

The Banū Jizrūn, belonging to the Berber Zanata confederation, led by Muhammad I, seized the cora of Sidonia after expelling the Umayyad governor that ruled. The dynasty proclaimed its independence, giving rise to the kingdom Taifa of Arcos in 1011, with its capital in the present city of Arcos de la Frontera.

Taifa of Badajoz.headline: Taifa Badajoz
paragraphs: Taifa Badajoz (arabsko: طائفة بطليوس) je bila srednjeveško islamsko mavrsko kraljestvo na ozemlju današnje Portugalske in Španije. Središče je imela v mestu Badajoz, ki je danes največje mesto Extremadure v Španiji.

source.title: Taifa of Badajoz
paragraphs: The Taifa of Badajoz (from Arabic: طائفة بطليوس) was a medieval Islamic Moorish kingdom located in what is now parts of Portugal and Spain. It was centred on the city of Badajoz which exists today as the first city of Extremadura, in Spain.

Taifa of Carmona.headline: Taifa Carmona
paragraphs: Taifa Carmona (arabsko: طائفة قرمونة) je bila srednjeveško berbersko taifsko kraljestvo. Obstajala je v dveh ločenih obdobjih: prvič od leta 1013 do 1066, ko jo je osvojila seviljska taifa, in drugič od okoli leta 1143 do 1150, ko jo je dokončno osvojil Almohadski kalifat. Taifo je ustanovila in ji vladala zenatska berberska dinastija Birzalidov.

source.title: Taifa of Carmona
paragraphs: The Taifa of Carmona (Arabic: طائفة قرمونة) was a medieval Berber taifa kingdom. It existed for two distinct periods: first from 1013 to 1066 when it was conquered by the Taifa of Seville, and secondly from around 1143 to 1150 when it was finally conquered by the Almohad Caliphate. The taifa was established and ruled by the Zenata Berber Birzalid dynasty.

Taifa of Córdoba.headline: Taifa Córdoba
paragraphs: Taifa Córdoba (arabsko: طائفة قرطبة) je bila arabska taifa, ki ji je vladala rodbina Banu Džahvar, ta pa je leta 1031 nadomestila umajadskega kalifa kot oblast v Córdobi in okolici.

source.title: Taifa of Córdoba
paragraphs: The Taifa of Córdoba (Arabic: طائفة قرطبة) was an Arab taifa which was ruled by the Banu Jahwar that replaced the Umayyad Caliph as the government of Córdoba and its vicinity in 1031.

Taifa of Dénia.headline: Taifa Dénia
paragraphs: Taifa Dénia (arabsko: طائفة دانية) je bila islamsko kraljestvo v srednjeveški Španiji, ki je vladalo delu valencijske obale in Ibizi. Taifa s prestolnico v Déniji je obsegala Balearske otoke in dele španske celine. Leta 1010 jo je ustanovil slovanski muslimanski vojskovodja Mudžahid al Amiri.

source.title: Taifa of Dénia
paragraphs: The taifa of Dénia (Arabic: طائفة دانية) was an Islamic kingdom in medieval Spain, ruling over part of the Valencian coast and Ibiza. With Dénia as its capital, the taifa included the Balearic Islands and parts of the Spanish mainland. It was founded in 1010 by the Slavic Muslim warlord Mujāhid al-ʿĀmirī.

Taifa Granade (arabsko: طائفة غرناطة) ali Ziridsko kraljestvo Granada je bila muslimansko kraljestvo, ki je nastalo v Al Andalusu (na ozemlju današnje Španije) leta 1013, potem ko je bil leta 1009 odstavljen umajadski kalif Hišam II. Središče kraljestva je bila prestolnica Granada, nekaj časa pa je nadzorovalo tudi Málago. V skoraj 80 letih obstoja so se zvrstili štirje kralji, vsi iz veje ziridske dinastije iz severne Afrike, berberskega klana Sanhadža. Taifa Granade je veljala za najbogatejšo od vseh taifskih kraljestev. Leta 1090 so jo osvojili Almoravidi in s tem končali ziridsko oblast v Granadi.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Taifa of Granada
paragraphs: The Taifa of Granada (Arabic: طائفة غرناطة, Ta'ifat Gharnata) or Zirid Kingdom of Granada was a Muslim kingdom that was formed in al-Andalus (in present-day Spain) in 1013 following the deposition of Umayyad Caliph Hisham II in 1009. The kingdom was centered on Granada, its capital, and it also extended its control to Málaga for a period. Four kings succeeded each other during its nearly 80 years of existence, all of them belonging to an offshoot of the Zirid dynasty of North Africa, a Sanhaja Berber clan. The Taifa of Granada was considered to be the wealthiest out of all of the taifa kingdoms. It was eventually conquered by the Almoravids in 1090, putting an end to Zirid rule in Granada.

Taifa of Morón.headline: Taifa Morón
paragraphs: Taifa Morón (arabsko: طائفة مورور) je bila srednjeveško berbersko taifsko kraljestvo, ki je obstajalo od okoli leta 1010 do 1066. Od leta 1066 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom Sevilje, ki ji je vladal Abad II. al Mutadid.

source.title: Taifa of Morón
paragraphs: The Taifa of Morón (Arabic: طائفة مورور) was a medieval Berber taifa kingdom that existed from around 1010 to 1066. From 1066 until 1091 it was under the forcible control of Seville, ruled by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid.

Taifa of Murcia.headline: Taifa Murcia
paragraphs: Taifa Murcia (arabsko: طائفة مرسية) je bila arabska taifa srednjeveškega Al Andalusa na območju današnje južne Španije. Kot taifa s središčem v mavrskem mestu Murcia je postala neodvisna po padcu Umajadskega kalifata v Córdobi (11. stoletje). Mavrska taifa Murcia je obsegala tudi Albacete in del Almeríe.

Ta taifa je, kot kaže, obstajala v največ ločenih obdobjih (petih): od leta 1011 do 1014, od 1065 do 1078, leta 1145, od 1147 do 1172 in nazadnje od 1228 do 1266, ko jo je vsrkala Kastilija in je postala Kraljestvo Murcia, eno od kraljestev Kastiljske krone.

source.title: Taifa of Murcia
paragraphs: The Taifa of Murcia (Arabic: طائفة مرسية) was an Arab taifa of medieval Al-Andalus, in what is now southern Spain. It became independent as a taifa centered on the Moorish city of Murcia after the fall of the Umayyad Caliphate of Córdoba (11th century). The Moorish Taifa of Murcia included Albacete and part of Almería as well.

The taifa is apparently the one that existed the greatest number of separate time periods (five): from 1011 to 1014, from 1065 to 1078, in 1145, from 1147 to 1172 and finally from 1228 to 1266 when it was absorbed by Castile, becoming the Kingdom of Murcia, one of the constituent kingdoms of the Crown of Castile.

Taifa of Niebla.headline: Taifa Niebla
paragraphs: Taifa Niebla (arabsko: طائفة لبلة) je bila arabsko taifsko kraljestvo, ki je obstajalo v treh ločenih obdobjih: od leta 1023 do 1053, od 1145 do 1150 in od 1234 do 1262.
Od leta 1053 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom seviljske taife pod Abadom II. al Mutadidom. Nazadnje jo je osvojila Kastiljska krona, ki si jo je leta 1262 dokončno priključila.

source.title: Taifa of Niebla
paragraphs: The Taifa of Niebla (Arabic: طائفة لبلة) was an Arab taifa kingdom that existed during three distinct time periods: from 1023 to 1053, from 1145 to 1150 and from 1234 to 1262.
From 1053 until 1091 it was under the forcible control of Taifa of Seville, by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid. It was finally conquered by the Crown of Castile. In 1262 it was eventually absorbed by Castile.

Taifa of Ronda.headline: Taifa Ronda
paragraphs: Taifa Ronda (arabsko: طائفة رندة) je bila srednjeveško berbersko taifsko kraljestvo v mavrskem Al Andalusu na območju današnje južne Španije. Obstajala je od leta 1039 do 1065. Vladala ji je rodbina iz berberskega plemena Banu Ifran iz severne Afrike, prestolnica pa je bilo mesto Ronda. Od leta 1065 do 1091 je bila pod nadzorom seviljske taife, ki jo je vodil Abad II. al Mutadid.

source.title: Taifa of Ronda
paragraphs: The Taifa of Ronda (Arabic: طائفة رندة) was a medieval Berber taifa kingdom centered in Moorish al-Andalus in what is now southern Spain. It existed from 1039 to 1065. The taifa was ruled by a family from the Berber Banu Ifran tribe of North Africa. Its capital was the city of Ronda. From 1065 until 1091, the taifa was under the control of the Taifa of Seville, led by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid.

Taifa Saltés in Huelva (arabsko: طائفة ولبة وشلطيش) je bila srednjeveško arabsko taifsko kraljestvo na jugu Iberskega polotoka, ki je obstajalo od okoli leta 1012 do 1051. Od leta 1051 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom Sevilje pod Abadom II. al Mutadidom.
V taifi Saltés in Huelva se je rodil geograf al Bakri (u. 1094).

source.title: Taifa of Saltés and Huelva
paragraphs: The Taifa of Saltés and Huelva (Arabic: طائفة ولبة وشلطيش) was a medieval Arab taifa kingdom that existed in southern Iberia from around 1012 to 1051. From 1051 until 1091 it was under the forcible control of Seville, by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid.
The geographer al-Bakri (d. 1094) was born in the taifa of Saltés and Huelva.

Taifa Santa Maria do Algarve (arabsko: شنتمرية الغرب, Šantamarija al Garb) je bila srednjeveško islamsko taifsko mavrsko kraljestvo ali emirat na območju današnje južne Portugalske, ki je obstajalo od leta 1018 do 1051. Od leta 1051 do 1091 je bila pod prisilnim nadzorom Sevilje pod Abadom II. al Mutadidom. Potomci vladarjev, znanih kot Banu Harun, so ostali kadiji mesta, dokler ga leta 1249 ni znova osvojila Portugalska; zadnji med njimi je bil Aloandro Ben Bekar.

source.title: Taifa of Santa Maria do Algarve
paragraphs: The Taifa of Santa Maria do Algarve (Arabic: شنتمرية الغرب, romanized: Shantamariyya al-Gharb) was a medieval Islamic taifa Moorish kingdom or emirate located in what is now southern Portugal, that existed from 1018 to 1051. From 1051 until 1091, it was under the forcible control of Seville via Abbad II al-Mu'tadid. Known as the Banu Harun, their descendants remained as Qadis of the city until its reconquest by Portugal in 1249, the last of whom being Aloandro Ben Bekar.

Seviljska taifa (arabsko: طائفة إشبيليّة) je bila arabsko kraljestvo, ki mu je vladala dinastija Abadidov. Nastala je leta 1023 in obstajala do leta 1091 na območju današnje južne Španije in Portugalske. Neodvisnost je pridobila od Kordobskega kalifata in sredi 11. stoletja razširila svoje ozemlje. Zaradi vzpona Kastilije je Sevilja zaprosila za vojaško pomoč Almoravide, ki so nato zasedli Seviljo.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Taifa of Seville
paragraphs: The Taifa of Seville (Arabic: طائفة إشبيليّة Ta'ifat-u Ishbiliyyah) was an Arab kingdom which was ruled by the Abbadid dynasty. It was established in 1023 and lasted until 1091, in what is today southern Spain and Portugal. It gained independence from the Caliphate of Cordoba and it expanded the territory it ruled in the mid-11th century. The emerging power of Castile led Seville to ask military assistance from the Almoravids, who then occupied Seville.

Taifa Silves (arabsko: طائفة شلب, Taifa Šilb) je bila arabsko taifsko kraljestvo na območju današnje južne Portugalske, ki je obstajalo v dveh ločenih obdobjih: od leta 1027 do 1063 in znova od 1145 do 1150, ko ga je dokončno osvojil Almohadski kalifat.

Taifa je obsegala najzahodnejši del današnje portugalske pokrajine Algarve blizu rta São Vicente, prestolnica pa je bil Silves. Taifa Silves je nastala v začetku 11. stoletja, od leta 1048 pa je imela oblast rodbina Banu Muzain s tremi emirji: Isa II. al Muzafar (1048–1053), Mohamed II. al Nasir (1053–1058) in Isa III. al Muzafar (1058–1063). Pod zadnjim je kraljestvo osvojila močnejša seviljska taifa pod vodstvom Abada II. al Mutadida.
V tako imenovanem drugem taifskem obdobju po padcu almoravidske dinastije je bil Silves sedež druge, kratkotrajne taife, ki je trajala od leta 1145 do 1150, ko so jo osvojili Almohadi.

source.title: Taifa of Silves
paragraphs: The Taifa of Silves (Arabic: طائفة شلب, Ṭā'ifa Šilb) was an Arab taifa kingdom that existed in what is now southern Portugal for two distinct periods: from 1027 to 1063, and again from 1145 to 1150, when it was finally conquered by the Almohad Caliphate.

The taifa occupied the westernmost part of the presently Portuguese region of Algarve, near Cape St. Vincent, with its capital in Silves. The Taifa of Silves was constituted in the early 11th century and starting from 1048, the power was held by the family of the Banu Muzayn, including three emirs: Isa II al-Muzaffar (1048–1053), Muhammad II al-Nasir (1053–1058), and Isa III al-Muzaffar (1058–1063). Under the latter the kingdom was conquered by the more powerful taifa of Seville, led by Abbad II al-Mu'tadid.

During the so-called second taifa period, which followed the fall of the Almoravid dynasty, Silves was the seat of a second, ephemeral taifa, which lasted from 1145 to 1150, when it was conquered by the Almohads.

Toledska taifa (arabsko: طائفة طليطلة) je bila islamska politična tvorba (taifa) v osrednjem delu Iberskega polotoka v visokem srednjem veku. Vladali so ji Dununidi, berberski klan Havara. Nastala je po letu 1018 ob razpadu Kordobskega kalifata, ko so Dununidi, ki so bili že močni v deželah Santaver, Cuenca, Huete in Uclés, prevzeli nadzor nad mestom Toledo, prestolnico srednje marke Al Andalusa. S poznejšimi osvojitvami se je taifa razširila še na deželo Calatrava. Obstajala je do krščanske osvojitve Toleda leta 1085.
notes: The romanization of the Arabic name is dropped.

source.title: Taifa of Toledo
paragraphs: The Taifa of Toledo (Arabic: طائفة طليطلة, romanized: ṭa'ifat ṭulayṭula) was an Islamic polity (taifa) located in the centre of the Iberian Peninsula in the High Middle Ages. It was ruled by the Dhunnunids, a Hawwara Berber clan. It emerged after 1018 upon the fracturing of the Caliphate of Córdoba, when the Dhunnunids, already strong in the lands of Santaver, Cuenca, Huete and Uclés, seized control over the city of Toledo, the capital of the Middle March of Al-Andalus. Upon later territorial conquest, the taifa also expanded to the land of Calatrava. It lasted until the Christian conquest of Toledo in 1085.

Taifa of Tortosa.headline: Taifa Tortosa
paragraphs: Taifa Tortosa (arabsko: طائفة طرطوشة) je bila srednjeveško islamsko taifsko kraljestvo. Obstajala je v dveh ločenih obdobjih, od leta 1010 do 1060 in od 1081 do 1099. Ustanovil jo je slovanski vojskovodja Labib al Fata al Saklabi.

source.title: Taifa of Tortosa
paragraphs: The Taifa of Tortosa (Arabic: طائفة طرطوشة) was a medieval Islamic taifa kingdom. It existed for two separate periods, from 1010 to 1060 and 1081 to 1099. It was founded by the Slavic warlord Labib al-Fata al-Saqlabi.

Valencijska taifa je bila srednjeveško muslimansko kraljestvo v Valenciji in okolici v Španiji. Okoli leta 1010 se je osamosvojila od Kordobskega kalifata in je bila večino 11. stoletja samostojno majhno kraljestvo ali taifa. Leta 1065 jo je vsrkala toledska taifa, ki jo je leta 1085 osvojil leonsko-kastiljski kralj Alfonz VI. Od leta 1094 do 1099 je kraljestvu neposredno vladal kastiljski vojskovodja, znan kot El Cid, po njegovi smrti pa njegova žena Jimena, dokler ga leta 1102 niso priključili Almoravidi.

Po propadu almoravidske oblasti je Valencija leta 1145 znova postala neodvisna. Od leta 1147 do 1172 jo je nadzoroval Ibn Mardaniš, nato so jo priključili Almohadi. Ko so se Almohadi umaknili iz Al Andalusa, je bila Valencija znova neodvisna od okoli leta 1229 do 1238 pod vladavino Zajana ibn Mardaniša. Leta 1238 jo je dokončno osvojila Aragonska krona.

source.title: Taifa of Valencia
paragraphs: The Taifa of Valencia was a medieval Muslim kingdom which existed in and around Valencia, Spain. It gained independence from the Caliphate of Córdoba circa 1010 and became its own small kingdom, or Taifa, for most of the 11th century. It was absorbed by the Taifa of Toledo in 1065, which in turn fell to Alfonso VI of León and Castile in 1085. From 1094 to 1099, the kingdom was ruled directly by the Castilian military commander known as El Cid, then by his wife Jimena after his death, until being annexed by the Almoravids in 1102.

Following the collapse of Almoravid power, Valencia became independent again in 1145. From 1147 to 1172, it was under the control of Ibn Mardanish, after which it was annexed by the Almohads. When the Almohads retreated from al-Andalus, Valencia became independent once again from around 1229 to 1238 under the rule of Zayyan ibn Mardanish. It was finally conquered by the Crown of Aragon in 1238.

Taifa Sarakuste (arabsko: طائفة سرقسطة) je bila neodvisna arabska muslimanska država na vzhodu Al Andalusa (današnje Španije) s prestolnico v mestu Sarakusta (Zaragoza). Nastala je v začetku 11. stoletja kot eno od številnih taifskih kraljestev po tedanjem razpadu Kordobskega kalifata. Obstajala je do leta 1110, ko so jo priključili Almoravidi.

source.title: Taifa of Zaragoza
paragraphs: The taifa of Zaragoza (Arabic: طائفة سرقسطة) was an independent Arab Muslim state in the east of Al-Andalus (present-day Spain) with its capital in Saraqusta (Zaragoza) city. It was established in the early 11th century as one of the many Taifa kingdoms that followed the collapse of the Caliphate of Córdoba around this time. It survived until 1110, when it was annexed by the Almoravids.

Ten Days of Brescia.headline: Deset dni Brescie
paragraphs: Deset dni Brescie (italijansko: Dieci giornate di Brescia) je bil upor, ki je izbruhnil 23. marca 1849 v italijanskem mestu Brescia, tedaj delu Lombardsko-beneškega kraljestva, avstrijske kronske dežele.
