Upor, ki ga je vodil domoljub Tito Speri, se je začel istega dne, kot se je končala bitka pri Novari (čeprav novica o avstrijski zmagi tam še ni dosegla Brescie), in se je končal 1. aprila po 10 dneh ostrih bojev z avstrijskimi silami.
Kljub porazu italijanskih upornikov je njihov pogum mestu prinesel vzdevek Leonessa d'Italia (»Levinja Italije«).

source.title: Ten Days of Brescia
paragraphs: The Ten Days of Brescia (Italian: Dieci giornate di Brescia) was a revolt which broke out on 23 March 1849 in the Italian city of Brescia, then part of the Kingdom of Lombardy–Venetia, a Crown land of the Austrian Empire.

The revolt, headed by the patriot Tito Speri, began on the same day as the Battle of Novara ended (though news of Austria's victory there had not yet reached Brescia) and ended on 1 April after 10 days of fierce fighting with the Austrian forces.
In spite of the loss of the Italian rebels, their bravery earned the city the surname of Leonessa d'Italia (Lioness of Italy).

Ten Days' Campaign.headline: Desetdnevni pohod
paragraphs: Desetdnevni pohod (nizozemsko: Tiendaagse veldtocht, francosko: campagne des Dix-Jours) je bil neuspešen vojaški pohod Združenega kraljestva Nizozemske proti odcepljeni Kraljevini Belgiji med 2. in 12. avgustom 1831. Nizozemski kralj Viljem I. je s pohodom skušal ustaviti belgijsko revolucijo, ki je izbruhnila avgusta 1830.

Nizozemska vojska je 2. avgusta 1831 vdrla v Belgijo in v naslednjih dneh v več bitkah premagala belgijske sile ter prodrla globoko na belgijsko ozemlje. Belgijska vlada je 8. avgusta zaprosila Francijo za vojaško pomoč. Francozi so se strinjali, da Belgijcem pošljejo okrepitve pod poveljstvom maršala Étienna Gérarda. Nizozemci se s Francozi niso hoteli bojevati in so se iz Belgije umaknili, ne da bi dosegli svoje cilje. Novembra 1832 so Francozi oblegali in zavzeli Antwerpen, zadnje nizozemsko oporišče v Belgiji, s čimer se je vojaški spopad med Nizozemci in Belgijci dejansko končal.

source.title: Ten Days' Campaign
paragraphs: The Ten Days' Campaign (Dutch: Tiendaagse veldtocht, French: campagne des Dix-Jours) was a failed military expedition by the United Kingdom of the Netherlands against the secessionist Kingdom of Belgium between 2 and 12 August 1831. The campaign was an attempt by the Dutch King William I to halt the course of the Belgian Revolution which had broken out in August 1830.

The Dutch army invaded Belgium on 2 August 1831 and defeated Belgian forces in several battles over the course of the next few days, advancing deep into Belgian territory. On 8 August, the Belgian government appealed to France for military support. The French agreed to send reinforcements to assist the Belgians under Marshal Étienne Gérard. Rather than fight the French, the Dutch withdrew from Belgium without achieving their objectives. In November 1832, the French besieged and captured Antwerp, the last Dutch stronghold in Belgium, effectively ending the military confrontation between the Dutch and Belgians.

Tenth Battle of the Isonzo.headline: Deseta soška bitka
paragraphs: Deseta soška bitka je bila italijanska ofenziva proti Avstro-Ogrski med prvo svetovno vojno.

source.title: Tenth Battle of the Isonzo
paragraphs: The Tenth Battle of the Isonzo was an Italian offensive against Austria-Hungary during World War I.

Testament of Bolesław III Wrymouth.headline: Oporoka Boleslava III. Krivoustega
paragraphs: Oporoka piastovskega vojvode Boleslava III. Krivoustega je določila pravila, po katerih naj bi po njegovi smrti Poljskemu kraljestvu vladali njegovi štirje preživeli sinovi. Boleslav je z njo hotel zagotoviti, da se dediči ne bi bojevali med seboj in bi ohranili enotnost njegovih dežel pod piastovsko dinastijo. Kmalu po njegovi smrti pa so se sinovi spopadli med seboj in Poljska je vstopila v obdobje razdrobljenosti, ki je trajalo približno 200 let.

source.title: Testament of Bolesław III Wrymouth
paragraphs: The last will and testament of the Piast duke Bolesław III Wrymouth of Poland, established rules for governance of the Polish kingdom by his four surviving sons after his death. By issuing it, Bolesław planned to guarantee that his heirs would not fight among themselves, and would preserve the unity of his lands under the Piast dynasty. However, soon after his death his sons fought each other, and Poland entered a period of fragmentation lasting about 200 years.
Tebanski (angleško Theban) lahko pomeni:
kar je iz mesta Tebe v Grčiji ali kdor je od tam;
kar je iz mesta Tebe v Egiptu ali kdor je od tam.
notes: The record links to a disambiguation page; translated as the list it is. The glossary had the English Theban for this polity; an override now names it Tebe.

source.title: Theban
paragraphs: Theban can refer to:
A thing or person of or from the city of Thebes, Greece
A thing or person of or from the city of Thebes, Egypt

Tesalija (grško: Θεσσαλία) je tradicionalna geografska in sodobna upravna regija Grčije, ki obsega večji del istoimenske antične pokrajine. Pred grško temno dobo se je imenovala Eolija (starogrško: Αἰολία) in se pojavlja v Homerjevi Odiseji.

Tesalija je postala del sodobne grške države leta 1881, po štirih stoletjih in pol osmanske oblasti. Od leta 1987 je ena od 13 grških regij, od reforme Kalikratis leta 2011 pa se deli na pet regionalnih enot in 25 občin. Glavno mesto regije je Larisa. Tesalija leži v severni osrednji Grčiji in meji na regije Makedonija na severu, Epir na zahodu in Osrednja Grčija na jugu ter na Egejsko morje na vzhodu. Regija obsega tudi Sporade.

source.title: Thessaly
paragraphs: Thessaly (Greek: Θεσσαλία, romanized: Thessalía) is a traditional geographic and modern administrative region of Greece, comprising most of the ancient region of the same name. Before the Greek Dark Ages, Thessaly was known as Aeolia (Ancient Greek: Αἰολία, Aiolía), and appears in Homer's Odyssey.

Thessaly became part of the modern Greek state in 1881, after four and a half centuries of Ottoman rule. Since 1987 it has formed one of the country's 13 regions and is further (since the Kallikratis reform of 2011) sub-divided into five regional units and 25 municipalities. The capital of the region is Larissa. Thessaly lies in northern central Greece and borders the regions of Macedonia to the north, Epirus to the west, Central Greece to the south, and the Aegean Sea to the east. The Thessaly region also includes the Sporades islands.

Third Battle of Artois.headline: Tretja bitka v Artoisu
paragraphs: Tretja bitka v Artoisu (25. septembra – 4. novembra 1915, tudi ofenziva Loos–Artois) je bila spopad francoske 10. armade z nemško 6. armado na zahodni fronti prve svetovne vojne. Obsegala je tudi bitko pri Loosu, v kateri se je bojevala britanska 1. armada. Ofenziva, ki naj bi dopolnjevala drugo bitko v Šampanji, je bila tistega leta zadnji poskus francoskega vrhovnega poveljnika Josepha Joffra, da bi izkoristil številčno premoč zaveznikov nad Nemčijo. Načrtovani so bili hkratni napadi v Champagne-Ardenni, da bi zavzeli železnico pri Attignyju, in v Artoisu, da bi zavzeli železniško progo skozi Douai, s čimer bi Nemce prisilili k umiku iz noyonskega izbočenja.

source.title: Third Battle of Artois
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Artois (25 September – 4 November 1915, also the Loos–Artois Offensive) was fought by the French Tenth Army against the German 6th Army on the Western Front of the First World War. The battle included the Battle of Loos by the British First Army. The offensive, meant to complement the Second Battle of Champagne, was the last attempt that year by Joseph Joffre, the French commander-in-chief, to exploit an Allied numerical advantage over Germany. Simultaneous attacks were planned in Champagne-Ardenne to capture the railway at Attigny and in Artois to take the railway line through Douai, to force a German withdrawal from the Noyon salient.

Third Battle of Tapae.headline: Tretja bitka pri Tapah
paragraphs: Tretja bitka pri Tapah (101) je bila odločilna bitka prve Trajanove dačanske vojne, v kateri je rimski cesar premagal vojsko dačanskega kralja Decebala. Zaradi drugih nevšečnosti se je pohod zavlekel do leta 102. Bitka je najverjetneje upodobljena na plošči 22 Trajanovega stebra.
Sledila je prejšnjim bitkam na istem kraju med Domicijanovo dačansko vojno.

source.title: Third Battle of Tapae
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Tapae (101) was the decisive battle of the first of Trajan's Dacian Wars, in which the Roman Emperor defeated the Dacian King Decebalus's army. Other setbacks in the campaign delayed its completion until 102. The battle is most likely the battle-scene depicted on Plate 22 of Trajan's column.
It followed the earlier battles at the same place during Domitian's Dacian War.

Tretja bitka na Aisni (francosko: 3e Bataille de l'Aisne) je bila del nemške pomladanske ofenzive v prvi svetovni vojni, katere cilj je bil zavzeti greben Chemin des Dames, preden bi ameriške ekspedicijske sile v celoti prispele v Francijo. Bila je ena v vrsti ofenziv, znanih kot Kaiserschlacht (cesarjeva bitka), ki so jih Nemci sprožili spomladi in poleti 1918.

source.title: Third Battle of the Aisne
paragraphs: The Third Battle of the Aisne (French: 3e Bataille de l'Aisne) was part of the German spring offensive during World War I that focused on capturing the Chemin des Dames Ridge before the American Expeditionary Forces arrived completely in France. It was one of a series of offensives, known as the Kaiserschlacht, launched by the Germans in the spring and summer of 1918.

Tretja karlistična vojna (špansko: Tercera Guerra Carlista), ki je potekala od leta 1872 do 1876, je bila zadnja karlistična vojna v Španiji. Včasih jo imenujejo »druga karlistična vojna«, saj je bila prejšnja »druga« vojna (1847–1849) manjšega obsega in politično razmeroma nepomembna.

Pred vojno se je kraljica Izabela II. leta 1868 odpovedala prestolu, leta 1870 pa je bil za španskega kralja razglašen nepriljubljeni Amadej I., sin italijanskega kralja Viktorja Emanuela II. Karlistični pretendent Carlos VII. je v odgovor skušal pridobiti podporo različnih španskih pokrajin z obljubo, da bo znova uvedel različne krajevne običaje in zakone. Karlisti so razglasili obnovitev katalonskih, valencijskih in aragonskih fuerosov (privilegijev), ki jih je v začetku 18. stoletja z enostranskimi dekreti Nueva Planta odpravil kralj Filip V.

source.title: Third Carlist War
paragraphs: The Third Carlist War (Spanish: Tercera Guerra Carlista), which occurred from 1872 to 1876, was the last Carlist War in Spain. It is sometimes referred to as the "Second Carlist War", as the earlier "Second" War (1847–1849) was smaller in scale and relatively trivial in political consequence.

Leading up to the war, Queen Isabella II abdicated the throne in 1868, and the unpopular Amadeo I, son of King Victor Emmanuel II of Italy, was proclaimed King of Spain in 1870. In response, the Carlist pretender, Carlos VII, tried to earn the support of various Spanish regions by promising to reintroduce various area-specific customs and laws. The Carlists proclaimed the restoration of Catalan, Valencian and Aragonese fueros (charters) which had been abolished at the beginning of the 18th century by King Philip V in his unilateral Nueva Planta decrees.

Ženevska konvencija (III) o ravnanju z vojnimi ujetniki, pogosteje imenovana tretja ženevska konvencija ali ženevska konvencija III, s kratico GCIII, je ena od štirih pogodb ženevskih konvencij iz leta 1949. Prvič so jo sprejeli leta 1929, na konferenci leta 1949 pa so jo 12. avgusta 1949 bistveno spremenili. GCIII opredeljuje humanitarno zaščito vojnih ujetnikov. Konvencija ima 196 pogodbenic.

source.title: Third Geneva Convention
paragraphs: The Geneva Convention (III) relative to the Treatment of Prisoners of War, more commonly referred to as the Third Geneva Convention or Geneva Convention III and abbreviated as GCIII, is one of the four treaties of the 1949 Geneva Conventions. It was first adopted in 1929, but was significantly revised at the 1949 conference on 12 August 1949. GCIII defines humanitarian protections for prisoners of war. There are 196 state parties to the convention.

Tretja helenska republika (grško: Γ΄ Ελληνική Δημοκρατία) je obdobje sodobne grške zgodovine od leta 1974, ko je padla grška vojaška hunta in je bila monarhija dokončno odpravljena, do danes. Danes je to sedanja državna ureditev Grčije.
Velja za tretje obdobje republikanske ureditve v Grčiji, po prvi republiki med grško osamosvojitveno vojno (1821–1832) in drugi republiki med začasno odpravo monarhije v letih 1924–1935.

Izraz metapolitefsi (μεταπολίτευση, sprememba ureditve) se pogosto uporablja za vse obdobje, v ožjem pomenu pa označuje njegov začetek, od padca hunte do demokratične preobrazbe države. Izraza prva in druga helenska republika se uporabljata le v zgodovinopisju, izraz tretja helenska republika pa je v pogosti rabi.

source.title: Third Hellenic Republic
paragraphs: The Third Hellenic Republic (Greek: Γ΄ Ελληνική Δημοκρατία, romanized: Triti Elliniki Dimokratia) is the period in modern Greek history that stretches from 1974, with the fall of the Greek military junta and the final confirmation of the abolition of the Greek monarchy, to the present day. Today, it is the current government of Greece.

It is considered the third period of republican rule in Greece, following the First Republic during the Greek War of Independence (1821–1832) and the Second Republic during the temporary abolition of the monarchy in 1924–1935.

The term metapolitefsi (μεταπολίτευση, polity change) is commonly used for the entire period, but when used more strictly, this term refers to the early part of the period, beginning with the fall of the junta and culminating in the democratic transformation of the country. While the First and Second Hellenic Republics are not in common use except in a historiographic context, the term Third Hellenic Republic is used frequently.

Tretja italijanska vojna za neodvisnost (italijansko: Terza guerra d'indipendenza italiana) je bila vojna med Kraljevino Italijo in Avstrijskim cesarstvom, ki je potekala od junija do avgusta 1866. Spopad je potekal vzporedno z avstrijsko-prusko vojno in se je končal tako, da je Avstrija pokrajino Benečijo (današnji Veneto, Furlanijo in mesto Mantovo, zadnji ostanek trdnjavskega četverokotnika Quadrilatero) predala Drugemu francoskemu cesarstvu, ki je bilo posrednik v pogajanjih in jo je formalno predalo Italiji. Pridobitev tega bogatega in gosto poseljenega ozemlja, ki ga je Italija priključila s plebiscitom, je bila velik korak v združitvi Italije.

source.title: Third Italian War of Independence
paragraphs: The Third Italian War of Independence (Italian: Terza guerra d'indipendenza italiana) was a war between the Kingdom of Italy and the Austrian Empire fought between June and August 1866. The conflict paralleled the Austro-Prussian War and resulted in Austria giving the region of Venetia (present-day Veneto, Friuli and the city of Mantua, the last remnant of the Quadrilatero) to the Second French Empire (acting as intermediary in negotiations), which formally gave it to Italy. Italy's acquisition of this wealthy and populous territory, annexed with a plebiscite, represented a major step in the Unification of Italy.

Third Sacred War.headline: Tretja sveta vojna
paragraphs: Tretja sveta vojna (356–346 pr. n. št.) je potekala med silami delfske in amfiktionske zveze, ki so jih zastopale predvsem Tebe, pozneje pa Filip II. Makedonski, ter Fokidčani. Vojno je povzročila visoka globa, ki jo je amfiktionska zveza (tedaj pod prevlado Teb) leta 357 pr. n. št. naložila Fokidčanom zaradi obdelovanja svete zemlje. Fokidčani je niso hoteli plačati, temveč so zavzeli Apolonov tempelj v Delfih in z nakopičenimi zakladi plačevali velike najemniške vojske. Zato so Fokidčani kljub več hudim porazom lahko vojno nadaljevali mnogo let, dokler niso bile vse strani blizu izčrpanosti. Filip II. je zaposlenost drugih držav izkoristil za krepitev svoje moči v osrednji Grčiji in pri tem postal vladar Tesalije. Nazadnje sta mu vse večja moč in izčrpanost drugih držav omogočili, da je vojno končal z mirovno ureditvijo, kar je bil pomemben korak pri vzponu Makedonije do prevlade v antični Grčiji.

source.title: Third Sacred War
paragraphs: The Third Sacred War (356–346 BC) was fought between the forces of the Delphic and Amphictyonic Leagues, principally represented by Thebes, and latterly by Philip II of Macedon, and the Phocians. The war was caused by a large fine imposed in 357 BC on the Phocians by the Amphictyonic League (dominated at that moment by Thebes), for the offense of cultivating sacred land; refusing to pay, the Phocians instead seized the Temple of Apollo in Delphi, and used the accumulated treasures to fund large mercenary armies. Thus, although the Phocians suffered several major defeats, they were able to continue the war for many years, until eventually all parties were nearing exhaustion. Philip II used the distraction of the other states to increase his power in central Greece, in the process becoming ruler of Thessaly. In the end, Philip's growing power, and the exhaustion of the other states, allowed him to impose a peaceful settlement of the war, marking a major step in the rise of Macedon to pre-eminence in Ancient Greece.

Tretje obleganje Mesolongija (grško: Τρίτη Πολιορκία του Μεσολογγίου, pogosto napačno imenovano drugo obleganje) je potekalo med grško osamosvojitveno vojno med Osmanskim cesarstvom in grškimi uporniki od 15. aprila 1825 do 10. aprila 1826. Osmani so mesto neuspešno skušali zavzeti že v letih 1822 in 1823, leta 1825 pa so se vrnili z močnejšo pehoto in močnejšo mornarico, ki jo je podpirala. Grki so zdržali skoraj leto dni, nato pa jim je zmanjkalo hrane in poskusili so množičen preboj, ki se je končal katastrofalno: večina Grkov je padla. Poraz je bil ključni dejavnik za posredovanje velesil, ki so ob novicah o grozodejstvih postale naklonjene grški stvari. Njihova podpora se je izkazala za odločilno pri tem, da so Grki zmagali v vojni in si izborili neodvisnost.

source.title: Third siege of Missolonghi
paragraphs: The third siege of Missolonghi (Greek: Τρίτη Πολιορκία του Μεσολογγίου, often erroneously referred to as the second siege) was fought in the Greek War of Independence, between the Ottoman Empire and the Greek rebels, from 15 April 1825 to 10 April 1826. The Ottomans had already tried and failed to capture the city in 1822 and 1823, but returned in 1825 with a stronger force of infantry and a stronger navy supporting the infantry. The Greeks held out for almost a year before they ran out of food and attempted a mass breakout, which however resulted in a disaster, with the larger part of the Greeks slain. This defeat was a key factor leading to intervention by the Great Powers who, hearing about the atrocities, felt sympathetic to the Greek cause. Their support would prove decisive in helping the Greeks win the war and gain independence.

Tretja pogodba iz San Ildefonsa je bila tajni sporazum, ki sta ga 1. oktobra 1800 podpisali Španija in Francoska republika in s katerim se je Španija načeloma strinjala, da bo svojo severnoameriško kolonijo Louisiano zamenjala za ozemlja v Toskani. Pogoje je pozneje potrdila pogodba iz Aranjueza marca 1801.

source.title: Third Treaty of San Ildefonso
paragraphs: The Third Treaty of San Ildefonso was a secret agreement signed on 1 October 1800 between Spain and the French Republic by which Spain agreed in principle to exchange its North American colony of Louisiana for territories in Tuscany. The terms were later confirmed by the March 1801 Treaty of Aranjuez.

Thracian kingdom.headline: Traško kraljestvo
paragraphs: Traško kraljestvo lahko pomeni:
Odriško kraljestvo (ok. 480 pr. n. št. – 30 pr. n. št.);
Lizimahovo kraljestvo (ok. 306 pr. n. št. – 281 pr. n. št.).
notes: The record links to a disambiguation page; translated as the list it is.

source.title: Thracian kingdom
paragraphs: Thracian kingdom may refer to:
Odrysian kingdom (c. 480 BC – 30 BC)
kingdom of Lysimachus (c. 306 BC – 281 BC)

Toggenburg War.headline: Toggenburška vojna
paragraphs: Toggenburška vojna, znana tudi kot druga villmergenska vojna ali švicarska državljanska vojna leta 1712, je bila švicarska državljanska vojna v času Stare švicarske konfederacije, ki je trajala od 12. aprila do 11. avgusta 1712. Katoliški »notranji kantoni« in cesarska opatija Sankt Gallen so se bojevali proti protestantskima kantonoma Bern in Zürich ter opatovim podložnikom iz Toggenburga. Spopad je bil verska vojna, vojna za prevlado v konfederaciji in upor podložnikov. Vojna se je končala s protestantsko zmago in porušila ravnotežje politične moči v konfederaciji.

source.title: Toggenburg War
paragraphs: The Toggenburg War, also known as the Second War of Villmergen or the Swiss Civil War of 1712, was a Swiss civil war during the Old Swiss Confederacy from 12 April to 11 August 1712. The Catholic "inner cantons" and the Imperial Abbey of Saint Gall fought the Protestant cantons of Bern and Zürich as well as the abbatial subjects of Toggenburg. The conflict was a religious war, a war for hegemony in the Confederacy and an uprising of subjects. The war ended in a Protestant victory and upset the balance of political power within the Confederacy.

Tollense valley battlefield.headline: Bojišče v dolini Tollense
paragraphs: Bojišče v dolini Tollense je bronastodobno arheološko najdišče v severnonemški zvezni deželi Mecklenburg-Predpomorjanska na severnem robu Meklenburškega pojezerja. Najdišče, odkrito leta 1996 in sistematično izkopavano od leta 2007, se razteza vzdolž doline majhne reke Tollense vzhodno od vasi Weltzin, na ozemlju občin Burow in Werder. Konec leta 2024 so izkopavanja še potekala.

Odkrili so na tisoče drobcev kosti številnih ljudi in druge dokaze, ki potrjujejo bitko; po sedanjih ocenah se je na najdišču v 13. stoletju pr. n. št. v bitki spopadlo morda 4.000 bojevnikov iz srednje in severne Evrope. Ker je bila gostota prebivalstva približno 5 ljudi na kvadratni kilometer, bi bila to doslej največja znana bitka v bronastodobni srednji Evropi, dolina Tollense pa največje izkopano in arheološko preverljivo bojišče iz tega obdobja na svetu.
notes: The German pronunciation in IPA and the conversion to people per square mile are dropped.

source.title: Tollense valley battlefield
paragraphs: The battlefield of the Tollense valley (German pronunciation: [tʰɔˈlɛnzə]) is a Bronze Age archaeological site in the northern German state of Mecklenburg-Vorpommern at the northern edge of the Mecklenburg Lake District. The site, discovered in 1996 and systematically excavated since 2007, extends along the valley of the small Tollense river, to the east of Weltzin village, on the municipal territories of Burow and Werder. As of late 2024, excavation was ongoing.

Thousands of bone fragments belonging to many people have been discovered, along with further corroborative evidence of battle; current estimates indicate that perhaps 4,000 warriors from Central and Northern Europe fought in a battle on the site in the 13th century BC. As the population density was approximately 5 people per square kilometer (13 people per square mile), this would have been the most significant battle in Bronze Age Central Europe known so far, making the Tollense valley the largest excavated and archaeologically verifiable battle site of this age in the world.

Vojna v Pridnestrju (romunsko: Războiul din Transnistria; rusko: Война в Приднестровье) je bila oborožen spopad, ki je 2. novembra 1990 izbruhnil v Dubăsariju med proseparatističnimi silami (Pridnestrske moldavske republike, PMR; Pridnestrja), med njimi pridnestrsko republiško gardo, milico in novokozaškimi enotami, ki so jih podpirali deli ruske 14. armade, ter vladnimi silami, med njimi moldavskimi vojaki in policijo.

Boji so se okrepili 1. marca 1992 in ob vmesnih priložnostnih premirjih trajali vso pomlad in v začetku poletja 1992, dokler ni bilo 21. julija 1992 razglašeno premirje, ki velja še danes. V Moldaviji in Romuniji spopad včasih imenujejo tudi dnestrska vojna (romunsko: Războiul de la Nistru) ali moldavsko-ruska vojna (romunsko: Războiul moldo-rus). Po mnenju moldavskega zgodovinarja Gheorgheja E. Cojocaruja je moldavski poraz v tej vojni neposredno pripeljal do uvedbe moldavske nevtralnosti.

source.title: Transnistrian War
paragraphs: The Transnistrian War (Romanian: Războiul din Transnistria; Russian: Война в Приднестровье, romanized: Voyna v Pridnestrovye) was an armed conflict that broke out on 2 November 1990 in Dubăsari between pro-separatist (Pridnestrovian Moldavian Republic, PMR; Transnistria) forces, including the Transnistrian Republican Guard, militia and neo-Cossack units, which were supported by elements of the Russian 14th Army, and pro-government forces, including Moldovan troops and police.

Fighting intensified on 1 March 1992 and, alternating with ad hoc ceasefires, lasted throughout the spring and early summer of 1992 until a ceasefire was declared on 21 July 1992, which has held. The conflict is sometimes known as the Dniester War (Romanian: Războiul de la Nistru) or the Moldovan–Russian war (Romanian: Războiul moldo-rus) in Moldova and Romania. According to Moldovan historian Gheorghe E. Cojocaru, the Moldovan defeat in this war directly led to the implementation of Moldovan neutrality.

Treaties of Rome (1941).headline: Rimske pogodbe leta 1941
paragraphs: Rimske pogodbe iz leta 1941 so bile niz pogodb, ki sta jih 18. maja 1941 po napadu sil osi na Jugoslavijo med drugo svetovno vojno sklenili Kraljevina Italija in kolaboracionistična Neodvisna država Hrvaška (Nezavisna Država Hrvatska, NDH). Pogodbe so določile mejo med NDH in Italijo ter ozemlje, večinoma organizirano kot Dalmatinski guvernat, dejansko prepustile slednji. NDH so tudi prepovedale, da bi na Jadranskem morju razporejala pomorske sile, in omejile gibanje njenih čet v italijansko nadzorovanem delu NDH.

source.title: Treaties of Rome (1941)
paragraphs: The 1941 Treaties of Rome were a series of treaties concluded by the Kingdom of Italy and the collaborationist Independent State of Croatia (Nezavisna Država Hrvatska, NDH) on 18 May 1941, following the Axis Invasion of Yugoslavia during World War II. The treaties determined the borders between the NDH and Italy, effectively ceding territory largely organised as the Governorate of Dalmatia to the latter. They also prohibited the NDH from deploying naval forces to the Adriatic Sea, and restricted movement of its troops in the Italian-controlled part of the NDH.

Pogodba o Ustavi za Evropo (angleška kratica TCE; običajno ji pravijo evropska ustava ali ustavna pogodba) je bila neratificirana mednarodna pogodba, ki naj bi ustvarila enotno ustavo Evropske unije (EU). Nadomestila bi obstoječe pogodbe Evropske unije z enim samim besedilom, dala pravno veljavo Listini o temeljnih pravicah in razširila glasovanje s kvalificirano večino na področja politik, o katerih so države članice prej odločale soglasno.

Pogodbo so 29. oktobra 2004 podpisali predstavniki tedanjih 25 držav članic Evropske unije. Pozneje jo je ratificiralo 18 držav članic, med njimi tudi s referendumoma, na katerih so jo potrdili v Španiji in Luksemburgu. Vendar je zavrnitev dokumenta, ki so jo maja in junija 2005 izrekli francoski in nizozemski volivci, ratifikacijski postopek končala.

source.title: Treaty establishing a Constitution for Europe
paragraphs: The Treaty establishing a Constitution for Europe (TCE; commonly referred to as the European Constitution or as the Constitutional Treaty) was an unratified international treaty intended to create a consolidated constitution for the European Union (EU). It would have replaced the existing European Union treaties with a single text, given legal force to the Charter of Fundamental Rights, and expanded qualified majority voting into policy areas which had previously been decided by unanimity among member states.

The Treaty was signed on 29 October 2004 by representatives of the then 25 member states of the European Union. It was later ratified by 18 member states, which included referendums endorsing it in Spain and Luxembourg. However, the rejection of the document by French and Dutch voters in May and June 2005 brought the ratification process to an end.

Treaty of 1818.headline: Pogodba iz leta 1818
paragraphs: Konvencija o ribištvu, meji in vračanju sužnjev, znana tudi kot londonska konvencija, angleško-ameriška konvencija iz leta 1818, konvencija iz leta 1818 ali preprosto pogodba iz leta 1818, je mednarodna pogodba, ki so jo leta 1818 podpisale Združene države in Združeno kraljestvo. Pogodba je razrešila dolgotrajna mejna vprašanja med podpisnicama. Omogočila je skupno zasedbo in naseljevanje Oregonske dežele, ki so jo Britanci in kanadsko zgodovinopisje poznali kot okrožje Columbia Družbe Hudsonovega zaliva, vključno z južnim delom sosednjega okrožja Nova Kaledonija.

source.title: Treaty of 1818
paragraphs: The Convention respecting fisheries, boundary and the restoration of slaves, also known as the London Convention, Anglo-American Convention of 1818, Convention of 1818, or simply the Treaty of 1818, is an international treaty signed in 1818 between the United States and the United Kingdom. This treaty resolved long-standing boundary issues between the two signatories. The treaty allowed for joint occupation and settlement of the Oregon Country, known to the British and in Canadian history as the Columbia District of the Hudson's Bay Company, and including the southern portion of its sister district New Caledonia.

Treaty of Aberconwy.headline: Pogodba iz Aberconwyja
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Aberconwyja je bila podpisana 10. novembra 1277 med angleškim kraljem Edvardom I. in Llywelynom ap Gruffuddom, valižanskim princem. Sledila je Edvardovemu vdoru na Llywelynova ozemlja prej istega leta. Pogodba je med njima znova vzpostavila mir, hkrati pa v bistvu zagotovila, da se bo valižanska samouprava z Llywelynovo smrtjo končala, in pomenila konec prve faze Edvardove osvojitve Walesa.

source.title: Treaty of Aberconwy
paragraphs: The Treaty of Aberconwy was signed on the 10th of November 1277, and was made between King Edward I of England and Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, Prince of Wales. It followed Edward's invasion of Llywelyn's territories earlier that year. The treaty re-established peace between the two but also essentially guaranteed that Welsh self-rule would end upon Llywelyn's death and represented the completion of the first stage of the Conquest of Wales by Edward I.

Treaty of Accession 1994.headline: Pristopna pogodba iz leta 1994
paragraphs: Pristopna pogodba iz leta 1994 je bila sporazum med državami članicami Evropske unije in štirimi državami (Norveško, Avstrijo, Finsko in Švedsko) o pristopu teh držav k EU. Veljati je začela 1. januarja 1995. Pogodba je uredila pristop Avstrije, Finske in Švedske k EU in spremenila prejšnje pogodbe Evropske unije. Zato je sestavni del ustavne podlage Evropske unije. Norveška se EU ni pridružila, ker na referendumu pristop ni bil potrjen.

source.title: Treaty of Accession 1994
paragraphs: The Treaty of Accession 1994 was the agreement between the member states of the European Union and four countries (Norway, Austria, Finland and Sweden), concerning these countries' accession into the EU. It entered into force on 1 January 1995. The Treaty arranged accession of Austria, Finland and Sweden to the EU and amended earlier Treaties of the European Union. As such it is an integral part of the constitutional basis of the European Union. Norway failed to join the EU because its referendum did not pass.

Treaty of Accession 2003.headline: Pogodba o pristopu 2003
paragraphs: Pogodba o pristopu 2003 je bila sporazum med državami članicami Evropske unije in desetimi državami (Češko, Estonijo, Ciprom, Latvijo, Litvo, Madžarsko, Malto, Poljsko, Slovenijo in Slovaško) o pristopu teh držav k EU (gl. širitev Evropske unije leta 2004). Hkrati je spremenila več določb, ki jih je prvotno postavila Pogodba iz Nice.
Pogodbo so podpisali 16. aprila 2003 v Atenah v Grčiji, veljati pa je začela 1. maja 2004, ko se je Evropska unija razširila za 10 držav.

source.title: Treaty of Accession 2003
paragraphs: The Treaty of Accession 2003 was the agreement between the member states of the European Union and ten countries (Czech Republic, Estonia, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania, Hungary, Malta, Poland, Slovenia, Slovakia), concerning these countries' accession into the EU (see 2004 enlargement of the European Union). At the same time it changed a number of points which were originally laid down in the Treaty of Nice.
The treaty was signed on 16 April 2003 in Athens, Greece and it entered into force on 1 May 2004, resulting in enlargement of the European Union with 10 states.

Treaty of Accession 2005.headline: Pristopna pogodba iz leta 2005
paragraphs: Pristopna pogodba iz leta 2005 je sporazum med državami članicami Evropske unije ter Bolgarijo in Romunijo. Veljati je začela 1. januarja 2007. Pogodba je uredila pristop Bolgarije in Romunije k EU in spremenila prejšnje pogodbe Evropske unije. Zato je sestavni del ustavne podlage Evropske unije.

source.title: Treaty of Accession 2005
paragraphs: The Treaty of Accession 2005 is an agreement between the member states of European Union and Bulgaria and Romania. It entered into force on 1 January 2007. The Treaty arranged accession of Bulgaria and Romania to the EU and amended earlier Treaties of the European Union. As such it is an integral part of the constitutional basis of the European Union.

Treaty of Accession 2011.headline: Pristopna pogodba iz leta 2011
paragraphs: Pristopna pogodba iz leta 2011 je sporazum med državami članicami Evropske unije in Hrvaško o pristopu Hrvaške k EU. Podpisali so jo 9. decembra 2011 v Bruslju voditelji držav ali vlad 27 držav članic ter hrvaški predsednik Ivo Josipović in predsednica vlade Jadranka Kosor. Pogodba je začela veljati 1. julija 2013 in Hrvaška je tako postala 28. država članica Evropske unije.

source.title: Treaty of Accession 2011
paragraphs: The Treaty of Accession 2011 is an agreement between the member states of the European Union and Croatia concerning Croatia's accession to the EU. It was signed on 9 December 2011 in Brussels by the heads of state or government of the 27 member states and by the president of Croatia, Ivo Josipović, and Prime Minister Jadranka Kosor. The Treaty entered into force on 1 July 2013, making Croatia the 28th country to join the European Union.

Pogodba iz Alcáçovasa (znana tudi kot pogodba ali mir iz Alcáçovasa in Toleda) je bila podpisana 4. septembra 1479 med katoliškima vladarjema Kastilje in Aragonije na eni strani ter Afonsom V. in njegovim sinom, portugalskim princem Ivanom, na drugi.

Končala je vojno za kastiljsko nasledstvo, v kateri so na kopnem zmagali Kastiljci, na morju pa Portugalci. Štiri mirovne pogodbe, podpisane v Alcáçovasu, so odražale ta izid: Izabela je bila priznana za kastiljsko kraljico, Portugalska pa je dosegla prevlado v Atlantskem oceanu.
Pogodba naj bi uredila več vprašanj.
notes: The English excerpt ends with a colon before a list it leaves out; the Slovenian ends the sentence with a full stop.

source.title: Treaty of Alcáçovas
paragraphs: The Treaty of Alcáçovas (also known as Treaty or Peace of Alcáçovas-Toledo) was signed on 4 September 1479 between the Catholic Monarchs of Castile and Aragon on one side and Afonso V and his son, Prince John of Portugal, on the other side.

It put an end to the War of the Castilian Succession, which ended with a victory of the Castilians on land and a Portuguese victory on the sea. The four peace treaties signed at Alcáçovas reflected that outcome: Isabella was recognized as Queen of Castile while Portugal reached hegemony in the Atlantic Ocean.
The treaty intended to regulate:

Treaty of Alcañices.headline: Pogodba iz Alcañicesa
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Alcañicesa ali Alcanisesa sta leta 1297 v Alcañicesu podpisala portugalski kralj Dinis in kastiljski kralj Ferdinand IV.

Dinis je bil vnuk kastiljskega kralja Alfonza X. in predvsem upravitelj, ne kralj bojevnik. Leta 1295 se je vojskoval s Kraljestvom Kastilija, pri čemer je izgubil vasi Serpa in Moura, pridobil pa Olivenço, znova potrdil portugalsko posest Algarve in določil sodobno mejo med iberskima državama. Pogodba je vzpostavila tudi zavezništvo prijateljstva in medsebojne obrambe, ki je državama prineslo 40 let miru.
Ferdinand se je nato poročil z Dinisovo hčerjo, infantinjo Konstanco Portugalsko, ki je tako postala kastiljska kraljica.

source.title: Treaty of Alcañices
paragraphs: The Treaty of Alcañices or Treaty of Alcanises was signed in Alcañices between King Denis of Portugal and King Fernando IV of Castile in 1297.

Denis was the grandson of King Alfonso X of Castile and essentially an administrator and not a warrior king. He went to war with the kingdom of Castile in 1295, relinquishing the villages of Serpa and Moura, but gained Olivença and reaffirmed Portugal's possession of the Algarve and defined the modern borders between the two Iberian countries. The treaty also established an alliance of friendship and mutual defense, leading to a peace of 40 years between the two nations.
Fernando then married Denis's daughter, Infanta Constance of Portugal, making her Queen of Castile.

Treaty of Aranjuez (1801).headline: Pogodba iz Aranjueza (1801)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Aranjueza (1801) je bila podpisana 21. marca 1801 med Francijo in Španijo. Potrdila je prejšnji tajni sporazum, s katerim se je Španija strinjala, da Louisiano zamenja za ozemlja v Toskani. Pogodba je tudi določila, da je odstop Louisiane »vrnitev« (restoration), ne retrocesija.

Napoleon je hotel Louisiano kot središče novega francoskega imperija v Severni Ameriki, ki bi nadomestil tistega, izgubljenega po pariški pogodbi leta 1763. Španski prvi minister Manuel Godoy je ozemlje rad prepustil, a je zahteval šest francoskih linijskih ladij in odškodnino v Italiji, da bi bilo to politično sprejemljivo za španskega kralja Karla IV.

source.title: Treaty of Aranjuez (1801)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Aranjuez (1801) was signed on 21 March 1801 between France and Spain. It confirmed a previous secret agreement in which Spain agreed to exchange Louisiana for territories in Tuscany. The treaty also stipulated Spain's cession of Louisiana to be a "restoration", not a retrocession.

Napoleon wanted Louisiana as the hub of a new French empire in North America, to replace that lost after the 1763 Treaty of Paris. While Spanish chief minister Manuel Godoy was happy to transfer the territory, he demanded six French ships of the line and compensation in Italy to make it politically acceptable to Charles IV of Spain.

Treaty of Arras (1482).headline: Arraška pogodba (1482)
paragraphs: Arraška pogodba je mirovna pogodba, ki sta jo 23. decembra 1482 v Arrasu sklenila francoski kralj Ludvik XI. in avstrijski nadvojvoda Maksimilijan I. Končala je prvo fazo vojne za burgundsko nasledstvo, ki je leta 1477 izbruhnila zaradi burgundske dediščine, zbirke posesti rodbine Valois-Burgundija, ki je obsegala Burgundsko Nizozemsko in več drugih posesti te rodbine.

source.title: Treaty of Arras (1482)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Arras was concluded at Arras on 23 December 1482 between King Louis XI of France and Archduke Maximilian I of Austria. It ended the first phase of the War of the Burgundian Succession, which had broken out in 1477 over the Burgundian inheritance, a collection of Valois-Burgundy domains that included the Burgundian Netherlands and several other possessions of the House of Valois-Burgundy.

Treaty of Athens.headline: Mir v Atenah
paragraphs: Mir v Atenah, pogodba med Osmanskim cesarstvom in Kraljevino Grčijo, podpisana 14. novembra 1913, je po obeh balkanskih vojnah formalno končal sovražnosti med državama in Grčiji prepustil Makedonijo – vključno z velikim mestom Solun –, večji del Epira in številne egejske otoke.

source.title: Treaty of Athens
paragraphs: The Treaty of Athens between the Ottoman Empire and the Kingdom of Greece, signed on 14 November 1913, formally ended hostilities between them after the two Balkan Wars and ceded Macedonia—including the major city of Thessaloniki— most of Epirus, and many Aegean islands to Greece.

Badenska pogodba, podpisana 7. septembra 1714 v Badnu v Švici, je sklenila mir med Francijo in Svetim rimskim cesarstvom. Skupaj z utrechtskim mirom in rastattskim mirom je bila ena od vrste pogodb, ki so končale špansko nasledstveno vojno v letih 1701–1713.

source.title: Treaty of Baden (1714)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Baden, signed 7 September 1714 in Baden, Switzerland, made peace between France and the Holy Roman Empire. Together with the Treaties of Utrecht and Rastatt, it was one in a series of agreements ending the 1701 to 1713 War of the Spanish Succession.

Treaty of Basel (1499).headline: Baselski mir leta 1499
paragraphs: Baselski mir z dne 22. septembra 1499 je bil premirje po bitki pri Dornachu, s katerim se je končala švabska vojna med Švabsko zvezo in Staro švicarsko konfederacijo.

Čeprav se je vojna končala z več švicarskimi zmagami, sta bili tako Švica kot Švabska zveza izčrpani, voditelji obeh strani pa so si želeli miru. Strani sta se sestali v Baslu, da bi se dogovorili o mirovnih pogojih.

Pogodba je ozemeljsko obnovila prejšnje stanje (status quo ante). Osem od desetih članic Zveze desetih sodnih okrožij so potrdili kot nominalno podložne Habsburžanom, njihovo članstvo v zvezi in zavezništvo s Švicarsko konfederacijo pa sta ostala v veljavi.

source.title: Treaty of Basel (1499)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Basel of 22 September 1499 was an armistice following the Battle of Dornach, concluding the Swabian War, fought between the Swabian League and the Old Swiss Confederacy.

Though the war had concluded in multiple Swiss victories, both Switzerland and the Swabian League were exhausted, and the leaders of both sides desired peace. The two sides would meet in Basel to agree to terms of peace.

The treaty restored the status quo ante territorially. Eight out of the ten members in the League of the Ten Jurisdictions were confirmed as nominally subject to the Habsburgs, but their membership in the league and their alliance with the Swiss Confederacy was to remain in place.

Treaty of Berlin (1742).headline: Berlinski mir leta 1742
paragraphs: Berlinski mir je bil mirovni sporazum med habsburško nadvojvodinjo Marijo Terezijo Avstrijsko, ki je bila tudi češka kraljica, in pruskim kraljem Friderikom Velikim, podpisan 28. julija 1742 v Berlinu. Bil je formalni mirovni sporazum, ki je potrdil predhodni dogovor, dosežen z angleškim posredovanjem v vroclavskem miru 11. junija, in uradno končal prvo šlezijsko vojno.

Na podlagi 5. člena pogodbe in zato, da bi se izognili nadaljnjim mejnim sporom, Njeno Veličanstvo ogrska in češka kraljica s to pogodbo za vso večnost ter z vso suverenostjo in neodvisnostjo iz dežel češke krone odstopa Njegovemu Veličanstvu pruskemu kralju tako Spodnjo kot Gornjo Šlezijo, notabene razen Tešinske kneževine in mesta Opava (…)
notes: The second paragraph paraphrases article 5 of the treaty and breaks off with an ellipsis in the English; the Slovenian keeps the ellipsis. Troppau is written in the Czech form Opava.

source.title: Treaty of Berlin (1742)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Berlin was a treaty between the Habsburg archduchess Maria Theresa of Austria, who was also Queen of Bohemia, and the Prussian king Frederick the Great, signed on 28 July 1742 in Berlin. It was the formal peace treaty that confirmed the preliminary agreement achieved with English mediation by the 11 June Treaty of Breslau, and officially ended the First Silesian War.

Based on article 5 of the treaty, to avoid further border disputes, Her Majesty the Queen of Hungary and Bohemia by the present treaty for all eternity and with all sovereignty and independence cedes from the Lands of the Bohemian Crown both Lower and Upper Silesia to His Majesty the King of Prussia, notabene except for the Principality of Teschen and the City of Troppau (...)

Berlinska pogodba (nemško-sovjetski pakt o nevtralnosti in nenapadanju) je bila pogodba, podpisana 24. aprila 1926, s katero sta se Nemčija in Sovjetska zveza za pet let zavezali k nevtralnosti, če bi tretja stran napadla eno od njiju. Pogodba je ponovno potrdila nemško-sovjetsko rapalsko pogodbo (1922).

Ratifikacijske listine so izmenjali v Berlinu 29. junija 1926 in pogodba je začela veljati istega dne. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov so jo registrirali 3. avgusta 1926. Podaljšali so jo z dodatnim protokolom, podpisanim 24. junija 1931 in ratificiranim 5. maja 1933. Dodatni protokol so v zbirki pogodb Društva narodov registrirali 15. februarja 1935.

source.title: Treaty of Berlin (1926)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Berlin (German–Soviet Neutrality and Nonaggression Pact) was a treaty signed on 24 April 1926 under which Germany and the Soviet Union pledged neutrality in the event of an attack on the other by a third party for five years. The treaty reaffirmed the German–Soviet Treaty of Rapallo (1922).

Ratifications for the treaty were exchanged in Berlin on 29 June 1926, and it went into effect on the same day. The treaty was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 3 August 1926. It was renewed by additional protocol signed on 24 June 1931, ratified on 5 May 1933. The additional protocol was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 15 February 1935.

Treaty of Bern.headline: Bernska pogodba
paragraphs: Bernska pogodba (uradno Pogodba o ustanovitvi Splošne poštne zveze), podpisana 9. oktobra 1874, je ustanovila Splošno poštno zvezo, danes znano kot Svetovna poštna zveza. Pogodba, imenovana po švicarskem mestu Bern, kjer so jo podpisali, je bila sad mednarodne konference, ki jo je švicarska vlada sklicala 15. septembra 1874. Udeležili so se je predstavniki 22 držav. Načrte za konferenco je pripravil Heinrich von Stephan, generalni poštni direktor nemške državne pošte (Reichspost), ki je po koncu francosko-pruske vojne v letih 1870–1871 od nevtralne Švice zahteval, naj organizira mednarodni poštni kongres.
notes: The English "French-German war" is the Franco-Prussian War; the Slovenian uses the glossary name francosko-pruska vojna.

source.title: Treaty of Bern
paragraphs: The Treaty of Bern (formally the Treaty concerning the formation of a General Postal Union), signed on 9 October 1874, established the General Postal Union, which is today known as the Universal Postal Union. Named for the Swiss city of Bern, where it was signed, the treaty was the result of an international conference convened by the Swiss Government on 15 September 1874. It was attended by representatives of 22 nations. Plans for the conference had been drawn up by Heinrich von Stephan, Postmaster-General of the German Reichspost who demanded from the neutral Switzerland the organization of an International Postal Congress following the end of the French-German war of 1870–1871.

Treaty of Breda (1667).headline: Bredski mir (1667)
paragraphs: Bredski mir ali bredska pogodba je bil podpisan v nizozemskem mestu Breda 31. julija 1667. Obsegal je tri ločene pogodbe med Anglijo in vsako od njenih nasprotnic v drugi angleško-nizozemski vojni: Nizozemsko republiko, Francijo in Dansko-Norveško. Vključeval je tudi ločen angleško-nizozemski trgovinski sporazum.

Pogajanja so potekala od konca leta 1666, a počasi, saj sta obe strani skušali izboljšati svoj položaj. To se je spremenilo po francoski invaziji na Špansko Nizozemsko konec maja, ki so jo Nizozemci videli kot resnejšo grožnjo. Junijski napad na Medway je v Angliji še povečal utrujenost od vojne. Oba dejavnika sta pripeljala do hitrega dogovora o pogojih. Med pogoji je bila potrditev kolonialnih ozemelj, osvojenih v vojni, med drugim Surinama Nizozemcem in Nove Nizozemske (New Yorka) Angležem.

source.title: Treaty of Breda (1667)
paragraphs: The Peace of Breda, or Treaty of Breda was signed in the Dutch city of Breda, on 31 July 1667. It consisted of three separate treaties between England and each of its opponents in the Second Anglo-Dutch War: the Dutch Republic, France, and Denmark–Norway. It also included a separate Anglo-Dutch commercial agreement.

Negotiations had been in progress since late 1666 but were slow, as both sides tried to improve their positions. This changed after the French invasion of the Spanish Netherlands in late May, which the Dutch viewed as a more serious threat. War-weariness in England was increased by the June Raid on the Medway. Both factors led to a rapid agreement of terms. Among the terms was confirmation of colonial territories taken in the War, including Suriname to the Dutch and New Netherland (New York) to the English.

Treaty of Breslau.headline: Vroclavski mir
paragraphs: Vroclavski mir je bil predhodni mirovni sporazum, ki so ga po dolgih pogajanjih 11. junija 1742 v šlezijski prestolnici Breslau (danes Vroclav na Poljskem) podpisali odposlanci avstrijske nadvojvodinje Marije Terezije in pruskega kralja Friderika II.; z njim se je končala prva šlezijska vojna.

source.title: Treaty of Breslau
paragraphs: The Treaty of Breslau was a preliminary peace agreement signed on 11 June 1742 following long negotiations at the Silesian capital Breslau (now Wrocław, Poland) by emissaries of Archduchess Maria Theresa of Austria and King Frederick II of Prussia ending the First Silesian War.

Treaty of Brétigny.headline: Pogodba iz Brétignyja
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Brétignyja je mirovna pogodba med angleškim kraljem Edvardom III. in francoskim kraljem Ivanom II.; sestavljena je bila 8. maja 1360, ratificirana pa 24. oktobra 1360. Z današnjega vidika velja, da je pomenila konec prve faze stoletne vojne (1337–1453).
Podpisana je bila v Brétignyju, vasi blizu Chartresa, pozneje pa so jo 24. oktobra 1360 ratificirali kot pogodbo iz Calaisa.

source.title: Treaty of Brétigny
paragraphs: The Treaty of Brétigny was a treaty, drafted on 8 May 1360 and ratified on 24 October 1360, between Kings Edward III of England and John II of France. In retrospect, it is seen as having marked the end of the first phase of the Hundred Years' War (1337–1453).
It was signed at Brétigny, a village near Chartres, and was later ratified as the Treaty of Calais on 24 October 1360.

Treaty of Brussels.headline: Bruseljska pogodba (1948)
paragraphs: Bruseljska pogodba, imenovana tudi bruseljski pakt, je bila med letoma 1948 in 1954 ustanovna pogodba Zahodne unije (WU); tedaj so jo dopolnili kot spremenjeno bruseljsko pogodbo (MTB), ki je bila do prenehanja leta 2010 ustanovna pogodba Zahodnoevropske unije (ZEU). Pogodba je predvidevala organizacijo vojaškega, gospodarskega, socialnega in kulturnega sodelovanja med državami članicami ter klavzulo o vzajemni obrambi.

Pogodbo so 17. marca 1948 podpisale Belgija, Francija, Luksemburg, Nizozemska in Združeno kraljestvo, članice Zahodne unije, kot razširitev dunkerške pogodbe, ki sta jo prejšnje leto podpisali Velika Britanija in Francija za zaščito pred morebitno nemško ali sovjetsko agresijo po koncu druge svetovne vojne.

source.title: Treaty of Brussels
paragraphs: The Treaty of Brussels, also referred to as the Brussels Pact, was the founding treaty of the Western Union (WU) between 1948 and 1954, when it was amended as the Modified Brussels Treaty (MTB) and served as the founding treaty of the Western European Union (WEU) until its termination in 2010. The treaty provided for the organisation of military, economic, social and cultural cooperation among member states as well as a mutual defence clause.

The treaty was signed on 17 March 1948 by Belgium, France, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom, the members of the Western Union, as an expansion to the Treaty of Dunkirk, which had been signed between Britain and France the previous year to guard against possible German or Soviet aggression after the end of World War II.

Treaty of Bucharest (1886).headline: Mir v Bukarešti (1886)
paragraphs: Mir v Bukarešti sta Srbija in Bolgarija podpisali 3. marca [19. februarja po starem koledarju] 1886 v Bukarešti, prestolnici Romunije, in z njim končali srbsko-bolgarsko vojno. Pogodba je imela en sam člen, ki je določal, da je mir med državama obnovljen. Utrla je pot političnemu načelu, da je lahko guverner Vzhodne Rumelije le bolgarski knez.

source.title: Treaty of Bucharest (1886)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Bucharest was signed by Serbia and Bulgaria on 3 March [O.S. 19 February] 1886 in Bucharest, the capital of Romania, and marked the end of the Serbo-Bulgarian War. The treaty contained a single article, stating that peace between the two countries was restored. The treaty paved the way for the political imperative whereby only the Bulgarian prince could be a governor of Eastern Rumelia.

Treaty of Bucharest (1913).headline: Mir v Bukarešti (1913)
paragraphs: Mir v Bukarešti (romunsko: Tratatul de la București; srbsko: Букурештански мир; bolgarsko: Букурещки договор; grško: Συνθήκη του Βουκουρεστίου) so 10. avgusta 1913 sklenili odposlanci Bolgarije, Romunije, Srbije, Črne gore in Grčije. Sklenjen je bil po drugi balkanski vojni in je spremenil prejšnjo londonsko pogodbo, ki je končala prvo balkansko vojno. Približno mesec dni pozneje so Bolgari z Osmani podpisali ločeno pogodbo o meji (carigrajsko pogodbo); Osmani so v drugi vojni znova pridobili nekaj ozemlja zahodno od črte Enos–Midia.

source.title: Treaty of Bucharest (1913)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Bucharest (Romanian: Tratatul de la București; Serbian: Букурештански мир; Bulgarian: Букурещки договор; Greek: Συνθήκη του Βουκουρεστίου) was concluded on 10 August 1913, by the delegates of Bulgaria, Romania, Serbia, Montenegro and Greece. The Treaty was concluded in the aftermath of the Second Balkan War and amended the previous Treaty of London, which ended the First Balkan War. About one month later, the Bulgarians signed a separate border treaty (the Treaty of Constantinople) with the Ottomans, who had regained some territory west of the Enos-Midia Line during the second war.

Treaty of Bucharest (1916).headline: Bukareška pogodba (1916)
paragraphs: Bukareška pogodba iz leta 1916 je bila pogodba med Romunijo in silami antante, podpisana 4. (po starem koledarju) oziroma 17. avgusta (po novem koledarju) 1916 v Bukarešti. Določala je pogoje, pod katerimi se je Romunija strinjala, da vstopi v vojno na strani antante, zlasti ozemeljske obljube na račun Avstro-Ogrske. Podpisnice so se zavezale, da bodo vsebino pogodbe hranile v tajnosti do sklenitve splošnega miru.

source.title: Treaty of Bucharest (1916)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Bucharest of 1916 was signed between Romania and the Entente Powers on 4 (Old Style)/17 (New Style) August 1916 in Bucharest. The treaty stipulated the conditions under which Romania agreed to join the war on the side of the Entente, particularly territorial promises in Austria-Hungary. The signatories bound themselves to keep secret the contents of the treaty until a general peace was concluded.

Treaty of Cambrai.headline: Cambraiška pogodba
paragraphs: Cambraiška pogodba, znana tudi kot Paz de las Damas ali Paix des Dames (»mir dam«), je bila sporazum, sklenjen 5. avgusta 1529, ki je končal francosko udeležbo v vojni lige iz Cognaca med francoskim kraljem Francem I. in cesarjem Karlom V., ki je bil tudi španski kralj. Pogodba je potrdila dejansko habsburško prevlado v Milanski vojvodini in Kraljevini Neapelj.
Mir sta v Cambraiju izpogajali in podpisali dve dami: Margareta Avstrijska v imenu cesarja in Ludovika Savojska v imenu kralja.

Pogodba je obnovila madridsko pogodbo (1526), uvedla pa je tudi nekaj novih določil, s katerimi so hoteli razrešiti več dolgotrajnih vprašanj, ki jih prejšnje pogodbe niso rešile, predvsem tistih v zvezi s spori o burgundski dediščini.

source.title: Treaty of Cambrai
paragraphs: The Treaty of Cambrai, also known as the Paz de las Damas or Paix des Dames ('Ladies' Peace'), was an agreement made on 5 August 1529 that ended the French involvement in the War of the League of Cognac between French King Francis I and Emperor Charles V, who was also the King of Spain. The treaty confirmed the effective Habsburg hegemony in the Duchy of Milan and in the Kingdom of Naples.
The peace was negotiated and signed at Cambrai by two ladies: Margaret of Austria for the Emperor and Louise of Savoy for the King.

The treaty renewed the Treaty of Madrid (1526) but also introduced some new clauses, which were aimed to resolve several long-standing issues that remained unresolved by previous treaties, mainly those related to disputes over the Burgundian inheritance.

Treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis.headline: Pogodba iz Cateau-Cambrésisa
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Cateau-Cambrésisa aprila 1559 je končala italijanske vojne (1494–1559). Sestavljali sta jo dve ločeni pogodbi: ena med Anglijo in Francijo 2. aprila, druga med Francijo in Španijo 3. aprila. Čeprav ni bil podpisnik, je obe odobril cesar Ferdinand I., saj je veliko ozemeljskih zamenjav zadevalo države znotraj Svetega rimskega cesarstva.

Francoski kralj Henrik II. se je odpovedal zahtevam do italijanskih držav, ki jim je vladal španski kralj Filip II. (južnih kraljestev Neapelj, Sicilija in Sardinija ter Milanske vojvodine na severu), obnovil neodvisno Savojo, Genovi vrnil Korziko in formalno priznal protestantko Elizabeto I. za angleško kraljico namesto njene katoliške sestrične, škotske kraljice Marije. V zameno je Francija okrepila svoje južne, vzhodne in severne meje ter potrdila zasedbo treh škofij in ponovno zavzetje Calaisa od Anglije.

source.title: Treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis
paragraphs: The Treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis in April 1559 ended the Italian Wars (1494–1559). It consisted of two separate treaties, one between England and France on 2 April, and another between France and Spain on 3 April. Although he was not a signatory, both were approved by Emperor Ferdinand I, since many of the territorial exchanges concerned states within the Holy Roman Empire.

Henry II of France abandoned claims on the Italian states ruled by Philip II of Spain (the southern kingdoms of Naples, Sicily, and Sardinia, along with the Duchy of Milan in the north), restored an independent Savoy, returned Corsica to Genoa, and formally recognised the Protestant Elizabeth I as queen of England, rather than her Catholic cousin, Mary, Queen of Scots. In exchange, France strengthened its southern, eastern and northern borders, confirming the occupation of the Three Bishoprics and the recapture of Calais from England.

Treaty of Craiova.headline: Pogodba iz Craiove
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Craiove (bolgarsko: Крайовска спогодба; romunsko: Tratatul de la Craiova) je bila pogodba med Kraljevino Bolgarijo in Kraljevino Romunijo, podpisana 7. septembra 1940 in ratificirana 13. septembra 1940. Romunija je z njo Bolgariji vrnila Južno Dobrudžo, ki jo je pridobila po drugi balkanski vojni leta 1913. Bolgarija je morala plačati 1 milijon lejev odškodnine za naložbe, ki jih je Romunija vložila v regijo.

Pogodba je določala izmenjavo prebivalstva med Bolgarijo in Romunijo. Tako se je moralo 103.711 Romunov, Aromunov in Meglenoromunov iz Južne Dobrudže preseliti v Severno Dobrudžo (del Romunije), 62.278 Bolgarov s severa pa so prisilno preselili na jug. Dobrudžanske Nemce, ki so jih te preselitve prizadele, so nazadnje preselili v nacistično Nemčijo.
Za razliko od vseh drugih ozemeljskih pogodb s posredovanjem nacistične Nemčije zavezniki po drugi svetovni vojni pogodbe iz Craiove niso razveljavili in Južna Dobrudža je ostala bolgarska.

source.title: Treaty of Craiova
paragraphs: The Treaty of Craiova (Bulgarian: Крайовска спогодба, romanized: Krayovska spogodba; Romanian: Tratatul de la Craiova) was signed on 7 September 1940 and ratified on 13 September 1940 by the Kingdom of Bulgaria and the Kingdom of Romania. Under its terms, Romania ceded Southern Dobruja back to Bulgaria, which Romania had gained after the 1913 Second Balkan War. Bulgaria had to pay 1 million lei as compensation for the investment provided to the region by Romania.

The treaty stipulated that a population exchange between Bulgaria and Romania had to be made. Thus, 103,711 Romanians, Aromanians and Megleno-Romanians living in Southern Dobruja were forced to move to Northern Dobruja (part of Romania), and 62,278 Bulgarians located in the north were forcibly moved to the south. The Dobrujan Germans, who were affected by these relocations, would eventually be transferred to Nazi Germany.
Unlike all other territorial treaties mediated by Nazi Germany, the Treaty of Craiova was not reversed by the Allies after World War II, and Southern Dobruja remained Bulgarian.

Treaty of Dresden.headline: Dresdenski mir
paragraphs: Dresdenski mir so 25. decembra 1745 v saški prestolnici Dresdnu podpisale Avstrija, Saška in Prusija; z njim se je končala druga šlezijska vojna.

Z vroclavskim mirom leta 1742 je morala Marija Terezija Avstrijska, ki se je po pragmatični sankciji iz leta 1713 borila za nasledstvo svojega očeta cesarja Karla VI., napadalnemu pruskemu kralju Frideriku II. odstopiti večji del češke dežele Šlezije. V naslednjih letih pa je svoj položaj okrepila. Napadla je Bavarsko volilno kneževino in januarja 1745 dobila podporo Velike Britanije, Republike Nizozemske in Saške za ponovno osvojitev Šlezije. Poleg tega je nekaj dni pozneje umrl njen tekmec cesar Karel VII., 22. aprila 1745 pa je njegov sin in naslednik, bavarski volilni knez Maksimilijan III. Jožef, z njo sklenil füssenski mir.

source.title: Treaty of Dresden
paragraphs: The Treaty of Dresden was signed on 25 December 1745 at the Saxon capital of Dresden between Austria, Saxony and Prussia, ending the Second Silesian War.

In the 1742 Treaty of Breslau, Maria Theresa of Austria, struggling for the succession after her father Emperor Charles VI according to the Pragmatic Sanction of 1713, had to cede most of the Bohemian province of Silesia to the attacking King Frederick II of Prussia. In the following years, however, she was able to strengthen her position. She attacked the Electorate of Bavaria and in January 1745 achieved the support of Great Britain, the Dutch Republic and Saxony to reconquer Silesia. Furthermore, her rival, Emperor Charles VII, died a few days later, and on 22 April 1745 his son and successor, Elector Maximilian III Joseph of Bavaria, concluded the Treaty of Füssen with her.

Treaty of Edinburgh.headline: Edinburška pogodba
paragraphs: Edinburška pogodba (znana tudi kot pogodba iz Leitha) je bila pogodba, sestavljena 5. julija 1560 med odposlanci angleške kraljice Elizabete I. s privolitvijo škotskih Lordov kongregacije in francoskimi predstavniki francoskega kralja Franca II. (moža škotske kraljice Marije), da bi formalno končali obleganje Leitha in staro zvezo s Francijo (Auld Alliance) nadomestili z novim angleško-škotskim dogovorom, hkrati pa ohranili mir med Anglijo in Francijo, dogovorjen s pogodbo iz Cateau-Cambrésisa.

source.title: Treaty of Edinburgh
paragraphs: The Treaty of Edinburgh (also known as the Treaty of Leith) was a treaty drawn up on 5 July 1560 between the Commissioners of Queen Elizabeth I of England with the assent of the Scottish Lords of the Congregation, and the French representatives of King Francis II of France (husband of Mary, Queen of Scots) to formally conclude the siege of Leith and replace the Auld Alliance with France with a new Anglo-Scottish accord, while maintaining the peace between England and France agreed by the Treaty of Cateau-Cambrésis.

Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton.headline: Edinburško-northamptonska pogodba
paragraphs: Edinburško-northamptonska pogodba je bila mirovna pogodba, ki sta jo leta 1328 sklenili Kraljevina Anglija in Kraljevina Škotska. Končala je prvo vojno za škotsko neodvisnost, ki se je začela z angleškim vdorom na Škotsko leta 1296. Pogodbo je 17. marca 1328 v Edinburgu podpisal škotski kralj Robert Bruce, angleški parlament, zbran v Northamptonu, pa jo je ratificiral 1. maja.
Po pogojih pogodbe naj bi angleška krona v zameno za 20.000 funtov šterlingov priznala več stvari.
Med drugim naj bi priznala Kraljevino Škotsko kot povsem neodvisno.
notes: The English excerpt is the start of a list ("would recognise:" / "The Kingdom of Scotland as fully independent;"); the Slovenian turns it into two complete sentences.

source.title: Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton
paragraphs: The Treaty of Edinburgh–Northampton was a peace treaty signed in 1328 between the Kingdoms of England and Scotland. It brought an end to the First War of Scottish Independence, which had begun with the English invasion of Scotland in 1296. The treaty was signed in Edinburgh by Robert the Bruce, King of Scots, on 17 March 1328, and was ratified by the Parliament of England meeting in Northampton on 1 May.
The terms of the treaty stipulated that in exchange for £20,000 sterling, the English Crown would recognise:
The Kingdom of Scotland as fully independent;

Treaty of El Pardo (1778).headline: Pogodba iz El Parda (1778)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz El Parda, podpisana 11. marca 1778, naj bi končala spor med Španijo in Portugalsko na območju Río de la Plata, ob današnji meji med Argentino in Urugvajem. Potrdila je špansko posest Colonie del Sacramento, danes v Urugvaju, Portugalska pa je prepustila strateško pomembna ozemlja v Afriki, danes država Ekvatorialna Gvineja. Španija se je v zameno umaknila z ozemelj na severu, ki večinoma ležijo v južni brazilski zvezni državi Rio Grande do Sul.

source.title: Treaty of El Pardo (1778)
paragraphs: The Treaty of El Pardo signed on 11 March 1778 sought to end conflict between Spain and Portugal in the Río de la Plata region, along the modern boundary between Argentina and Uruguay. It confirmed Spanish ownership of Colonia del Sacramento, now in Uruguay, while Portugal ceded possession of strategically important territories in Africa, now the modern state of Equatorial Guinea. In return, Spain withdrew from lands to the north, most of which are in the southern Brazilian state of Rio Grande do Sul.

Treaty of Finckenstein.headline: Finckensteinska pogodba
paragraphs: Finckensteinska pogodba (perzijsko: عهدنامه فین‌کنشتاین), pogosto zapisana tudi kot Finkenstein, je bila pogodba med Francijo in Iranom (Perzijo), sklenjena 4. maja 1807 v gradu Finckenstein (danes Kamieniec na Poljskem), s katero sta državi formalizirali francosko-perzijsko zavezništvo.

Napoleon I. je jamčil celovitost Perzije, priznal del Gruzije in druge dele Zakavkazja ter del Severnega Kavkaza (Dagestan) za posest Fath Ali šaha in se zavezal, da si bo po svojih močeh prizadeval, da mu ta ozemlja vrne. Napoleon je obljubil tudi, da bo šahu priskrbel orožje, častnike in delavce. Francija pa je od šaha zahtevala, da napove vojno Združenemu kraljestvu, iz Perzije izžene vse Britance in Franciji pusti odprto pot, če bi želela napasti britanske posesti na Daljnem vzhodu.

source.title: Treaty of Finckenstein
paragraphs: The Treaty of Finckenstein (Persian: عهدنامه فین‌کنشتاین), often spelled Finkenstein, was a treaty concluded between France and Iran (Persia) in the Finckenstein Palace (now Kamieniec, Poland) on 4 May 1807 and formalised the Franco-Persian alliance.

Napoleon I guaranteed the integrity of Persia, recognized part of Georgia and the other parts of Transcaucasia and a part of the North Caucasus (Dagestan) as Fath Ali Shah's possession, and was to make all possible efforts for restoring those territories to him. Napoleon also promised to furnish the Shah with arms, officers and workmen. France on its side required the Shah to declare war against the United Kingdom, to expel all British people from Persia, and to maintain an open way if France wanted to attack British possessions in the Far East.

Treaty of Fontainebleau (1762).headline: Fontainebleaujska pogodba (1762)
paragraphs: Fontainebleaujska pogodba, podpisana 3. novembra 1762, je bila tajni sporazum, s katerim je Kraljevina Francija Louisiano odstopila Španiji. Sledila je zadnji bitki francosko-indijanske vojne v Severni Ameriki, bitki pri Signal Hillu septembra 1762, ki je potrdila britanski nadzor nad Kanado. V Evropi je povezana sedemletna vojna še divjala. Francoski kralj Ludvik XV. je po izgubi Kanade (Nove Francije) španskemu kralju Karlu III. predlagal, naj Francija Španiji da »deželo, znano kot Louisiana, pa tudi New Orleans in otok, na katerem mesto stoji«.
Karel je pogodbo ratificiral 13. novembra 1762, Ludvik pa deset dni pozneje.

source.title: Treaty of Fontainebleau (1762)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Fontainebleau, signed on November 3, 1762, was a secret agreement of 1762 in which the Kingdom of France ceded Louisiana to Spain. The treaty followed the last battle in the French and Indian War in North America, the Battle of Signal Hill in September 1762, which confirmed British control of Canada. In Europe, the associated Seven Years' War continued to rage. Having lost Canada (New France), King Louis XV of France proposed to King Charles III of Spain that France should give Spain "the country known as Louisiana, as well as New Orleans and the island in which the city is situated."
Charles ratified the treaty on November 13, 1762, and Louis ratified it ten days later.

Fontainebleaujska pogodba je bila sporazum, sklenjen v Fontainebleauju v Franciji 11. aprila 1814 med Napoleonom ter predstavniki Avstrije, Rusije in Prusije. Pooblaščenci obeh strani so jo 11. aprila podpisali v Parizu, Napoleon pa jo je ratificiral 13. aprila. S to pogodbo so zavezniki končali Napoleonovo vladavino kot cesarja Francozov in ga poslali v izgnanstvo na Elbo.

source.title: Treaty of Fontainebleau (1814)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Fontainebleau was an agreement concluded in Fontainebleau, France, on 11 April 1814 between Napoleon and representatives of Austria, Russia and Prussia. The treaty was signed in Paris on 11 April by the plenipotentiaries of both sides and ratified by Napoleon on 13 April. With this treaty, the allies ended Napoleon's rule as emperor of the French and sent him into exile on Elba.

Treaty of Fontainebleau (October 1807).headline: Fontainebleaujska pogodba (1807)
paragraphs: Fontainebleaujska pogodba je bila tajni sporazum, ki sta ga 27. oktobra 1807 v Fontainebleauju v Franciji podpisala španski kralj Karel IV. in francoski cesar Napoleon. Po pogodbi naj bi Braganško dinastijo pregnali iz Kraljevine Portugalske, državo pa nato razdelili na tri dele: severu naj bi vladal etrurijski kralj Ludvik II., jugu pa španski minister Manuel Godoy, provinci Beira in Trás-os-Montes ter portugalska Estremadura pa naj bi ostale nerazrešene do poznejšega miru. V sedmih mesecih je španska vlada propadla, dva španska kralja pa sta odstopila. Avgusta 1808 je Napoleon za španskega kralja postavil svojega brata Jožefa.

source.title: Treaty of Fontainebleau (October 1807)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Fontainebleau was a secret agreement signed on 27 October 1807 in Fontainebleau, France between King Charles IV of Spain and the French Emperor Napoleon. Under the treaty, the House of Braganza was to be driven from the Kingdom of Portugal with the country subsequently divided into three regions, the north and south to be ruled by Louis II, King of Etruria and Spanish minister Manuel Godoy respectively, while the provinces of Beira, Tras-os-Montes and Portuguese Estremadura would remain in abeyance until a later peace. Within seven months the government of Spain had collapsed and two Spanish kings abdicated. In August 1808 Napoleon imposed his brother Joseph as King of Spain.

Treaty of Füssen.headline: Füssenski mir
paragraphs: Füssenski mir (nemško: Frieden von Füssen) je bil mirovni sporazum, ki sta ga v Füssnu podpisali Bavarska volilna kneževina in habsburška Avstrija. Sklenili so ga 22. aprila 1745, z njim pa je Bavarska izstopila iz avstrijske nasledstvene vojne, v kateri se je bojevala na francoski strani.

source.title: Treaty of Füssen
paragraphs: The Peace of Füssen (German: Frieden von Füssen) was a peace treaty signed at Füssen, between the Electorate of Bavaria and Habsburg Austria. Signed on 22 April 1745, it ended the participation of Bavaria on the French side in the War of the Austrian Succession.

Treaty of Ghent.headline: Gentska pogodba
paragraphs: Gentska pogodba (8 Stat. 218) je bila mirovna pogodba, ki je končala vojno leta 1812 med Združenimi državami in Združenim kraljestvom. Veljati je začela februarja 1815. Obe strani sta jo podpisali 24. decembra 1814 v mestu Gent v Združeni Nizozemski (danes v Belgiji). Pogodba je odnose med stranema vrnila v stanje pred vojno (status quo ante bellum) in obnovila predvojne meje iz junija 1812. Obe strani sta si želeli vojno končati. Vojna se je končala, ko je pogodba prispela v Washington: senat ZDA jo je takoj soglasno ratificiral, naslednji dan pa so jo izmenjali z britanskimi uradniki.

Pogodbo je odobril britanski parlament, princ regent (poznejši kralj Jurij IV.) pa jo je 30. decembra 1814 podpisal kot zakon. Novica o pogodbi je v Združene države potovala mesec dni; v tem času so ameriške sile pod vodstvom Andrewa Jacksona 8. januarja 1815 zmagale v bitki pri New Orleansu. Ameriški predsednik James Madison je pogodbo podpisal in 17. februarja 1815 z britanskim veleposlanikom izmenjal končna ratificirana izvoda.

source.title: Treaty of Ghent
paragraphs: The Treaty of Ghent (8 Stat. 218) was the peace treaty that ended the War of 1812 between the United States and the United Kingdom. It took effect in February 1815. Both sides signed it on December 24, 1814, in the city of Ghent, United Netherlands (now in Belgium). The treaty restored relations between the two parties to status quo ante bellum by restoring the pre-war borders of June 1812. Both sides were eager to end the war. It ended when the treaty arrived in Washington and was immediately ratified unanimously by the United States Senate and exchanged with British officials the next day.

The treaty was approved by the British Parliament and signed into law by the Prince Regent (the future King George IV) on December 30, 1814. It took a month for news of the treaty to reach the United States, during which American forces under Andrew Jackson won the Battle of New Orleans on January 8, 1815. U.S. President James Madison signed the treaty and exchanged final ratified copies with the British ambassador on February 17, 1815.

Granadska pogodba, znana tudi kot predaja Granade ali kapitulacije, je bila podpisana in ratificirana 25. novembra 1491 med Boabdilom, granadskim sultanom, ter Ferdinandom in Izabelo, kraljem in kraljico Kastilje, Leóna, Aragonije in Sicilije. Končala je granadsko vojno, ki se je začela leta 1482 in dosegla vrhunec z obleganjem in bitko za Granado, ki se je začela spomladi 1491.

source.title: Treaty of Granada (1491)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Granada, also known as the Surrender of Granada or the Capitulations, was signed and ratified on November 25, 1491, between Boabdil, the sultan of Granada, and Ferdinand and Isabella, the King and Queen of Castile, León, Aragon, and Sicily. It ended the Granada War, which had started in 1482 and culminated in the siege and battle of Granada, which began in spring 1491.

Treaty of Hamburg (1762).headline: Hamburški mir leta 1762
paragraphs: Hamburški mir sta 22. maja 1762 v Hamburgu med pomorjansko vojno, enim od prizorišč sedemletne vojne, sklenili Švedska in Prusija.

Do pogodbe je prišlo, ko se je Rusija 5. maja povezala s Prusijo, zato Švedska ni mogla nadaljevati vojne, v katero je vstopila, da bi si povrnila prej izgubljena ozemlja na Pomorjanskem. Pogodba je potrdila predvojno stanje.

source.title: Treaty of Hamburg (1762)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Hamburg was signed on 22 May 1762 in Hamburg between Sweden and Prussia during the Pomeranian War, a theater of the Seven Years' War.

The treaty came into being after Russia had allied to Prussia on 5 May, making it impossible for Sweden to continue the war which they had entered to regain territories in Pomerania, which they had previously lost. The treaty reaffirmed the pre-war status quo.

Hubertusburški mir (nemško: Frieden von Hubertusburg) so 15. februarja 1763 na gradu Hubertusburg podpisale Prusija, Avstrija in Saška in z njim končale tretjo šlezijsko vojno. Skupaj s pariškim mirom, podpisanim pet dni prej, je pomenil konec sedemletne vojne. Pogodba je spopad na celini končala brez pomembnejših sprememb predvojnih meja. Avstrija in Saška sta se odpovedali vsem zahtevam do šlezijskih ozemelj, ki jih je Prusija dobila z berlinskim mirom leta 1742 in dresdenskim mirom leta 1745. Prusija se je jasno uvrstila med evropske velesile, pogodba pa je zaostrila tekmovanje z Avstrijo.

source.title: Treaty of Hubertusburg
paragraphs: The Treaty of Hubertusburg (German: Frieden von Hubertusburg) was signed on 15 February 1763 at Hubertusburg Castle by Prussia, Austria and Saxony to end the Third Silesian War. Together with the Treaty of Paris, signed five days earlier, it marked the end of the Seven Years' War. The treaty ended the continental conflict with no significant changes in prewar borders. Austria and Saxony renounced all claims to the Silesian territories ceded to Prussia in the 1742 Treaty of Berlin and the 1745 Treaty of Dresden. Prussia clearly stood among the ranks of the European great powers, while the treaty enhanced the rivalry with Austria.

Treaty of Kalisz (1343).headline: Kališki mir
paragraphs: Kališki mir (poljsko: Pokój kaliski, nemško: Vertrag von Kalisch) je bil mirovni sporazum, podpisan 8. julija 1343 v Kaliszu. Sklenili sta ga Kraljevina Poljska pod kraljem Kazimirom III. Velikim in Država tevtonskega reda pod velikim mojstrom Ludolfom Königom von Wattzau.

source.title: Treaty of Kalisz (1343)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Kalisz (Polish: Pokój kaliski, German: Vertrag von Kalisch) was a peace treaty signed on 8 July 1343 in Kalisz. It was concluded by the Kingdom of Poland under King Casimir III the Great and the State of the Teutonic Order under Grand Master of the Teutonic Order Ludolf König von Wattzau.

Treaty of Leipzig.headline: Leipziška pogodba
paragraphs: Leipziško pogodbo ali leipziško delitev (nemško: Leipziger Teilung) sta 11. novembra 1485 v Leipzigu podpisala saški volilni knez Ernest in njegov mlajši brat Albert III., sinova in dediča saškega volilnega kneza Friderika II. (u. 1464) iz rodbine Wettin. Pogodba je končala obdobje skupne vladavine obeh bratov, ki je trajalo od leta 1464 do 1485. Po določilih leipziške pogodbe je Ernest obdržal saški volilni naslov (vezan na vojvodino Saška-Wittenberg) in več posesti v južnih delih Turingije, Albert pa je dobil naslov saškega vojvode in oblast nad staro Meissensko mejno grofijo ter različne posesti v severnih delih Turingije. Leipziška pogodba in njene ureditve so utrdile delitev wettinskih dežel na dve ločeni posesti, ki so ju ločeno upravljali vladarji iz ernestinske in albertinske veje dinastije.

source.title: Treaty of Leipzig
paragraphs: The Treaty of Leipzig or Partition of Leipzig (German: Leipziger Teilung) was signed on 11 November 1485 in the city of Leipzig, between Ernest, Elector of Saxony and his younger brother Albert III, the sons and heirs of Frederick II, Elector of Saxony (d. 1464) from the House of Wettin. The treaty ended the period of joint rule by two brothers, that lasted from 1464 to 1485. Under the Leipzig treaty provisions, Ernest kept the Saxon electoral title (attached to the Duchy of Saxe-Wittenberg) and several domains in southern parts of Thuringia, while Albert received the Saxon ducal title and rule over the old Margraviate of Meissen, together with various domains in northern parts of Thuringia.
