The Leipzig treaty and its arrangements perpetuated the division of Wettin lands in two distinctive domains, administered separately, by rulers from Ernestine and Albertine branches of the dynasty.

Treaty of Lisbon (1668).headline: Lizbonska pogodba (1668)
paragraphs: Lizbonska pogodba iz leta 1668 je bila mirovna pogodba med Portugalsko in Španijo, sklenjena 13. februarja 1668 v Lizboni ob angleškem posredovanju, s katero je Španija priznala suverenost nove portugalske vladajoče dinastije Braganza.
Španska regentka, kraljica Marijana Avstrijska, druga žena pokojnega kralja Filipa IV., je delovala v imenu mladoletnega sina Karla II. in v imenu Španije nadzorovala pogajanja.
Portugalsko je zastopal princ regent Pedro, poznejši portugalski kralj Peter II., v imenu svojega nesposobnega brata Afonsa VI.

source.title: Treaty of Lisbon (1668)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Lisbon of 1668 was a peace treaty between Portugal and Spain that was concluded at Lisbon on 13 February 1668 with the mediation of England in which Spain recognised the sovereignty of Portugal's new ruling dynasty, the House of Braganza.
The regent of Spain, Queen Mariana of Austria, the second wife of the late King Philip IV, acted in the name of her young son, Charles II and oversaw the negotiations on the behalf of Spain.
The prince-regent of Portugal, Pedro, the future King Peter II of Portugal, in the name of his incapacitated brother, Afonso VI, represented Portugal.

Treaty of Lodi.headline: Mir v Lodiju
paragraphs: Mir v Lodiju ali pogodba iz Lodija je bil mirovni sporazum, ki je končal vojne v Lombardiji med Beneško republiko in Milansko vojvodino, podpisan v mestu Lodi 9. aprila 1454.

source.title: Treaty of Lodi
paragraphs: The Treaty of Lodi, or Peace of Lodi, was a peace agreement which brought to an end the Wars in Lombardy between the Venetian Republic and the Duchy of Milan, signed in the city of Lodi on 9 April 1454.

Treaty of London (1604).headline: Londonska pogodba (1604)
paragraphs: Londonska pogodba (špansko: Tratado de Londres), podpisana 18. avgusta 1604 po julijanskem koledarju (28. avgusta po gregorijanskem), je končala devetnajstletno angleško-špansko vojno kmalu po smrti angleške kraljice Elizabete I., ki ni imela otrok, in nastopu škotskega kralja Jakoba VI. na angleški prestol leta 1603 kot Jakoba I. Pogodba je med državama obnovila stanje pred vojno. Pogajanja so verjetno potekala v Somerset Housu v Westminstru, zato jih včasih imenujejo konferenca v Somerset Housu.

source.title: Treaty of London (1604)
paragraphs: The Treaty of London (Spanish: Tratado de Londres), signed on 18 August O.S. (28 August N.S.) 1604, concluded the nineteen-year Anglo-Spanish War soon after the death of the childless Elizabeth I of England and the accession of James VI of Scotland to the throne of England in 1603 as James I. The treaty restored the status quo between the two nations prior to the war. The negotiations probably took place at Somerset House in Westminster and are sometimes known as the Somerset House Conference.

Treaty of London (1700).headline: Londonska pogodba (1700)
paragraphs: Londonska pogodba (1700) (nizozemsko: Verdrag van Londen, francosko: Traités de Londres) ali druga delitvena pogodba je bila drugi poskus francoskega kralja Ludvika XIV. in angleškega kralja Viljema III., da bi z diplomacijo rešila vprašanja, ki so privedla do vojne za špansko nasledstvo v letih 1701–1714. Obe pogodbi sta brez predhodnega posvetovanja razdelili Španski imperij, in ker Španci nerazdeljenega imperija niso imeli za predmet pogajanj, ju zgodovinarji večinoma štejejo za neizvedljivi.

Karel II. je pri petih letih leta 1665 postal zadnji vladar habsburške Španije. Večino življenja je bil bolehen, in čeprav se je dvakrat poročil, je bilo do leta 1698 jasno, da bo umrl brez otrok in vprašanje naslednika ostalo nerešeno. Imperij sicer ni bil več vodilna evropska sila, a je ostal močan svetovni dejavnik, in ker so bili najbližji dediči iz avstrijske habsburške in francoske burbonske rodbine, bi prevzem katere koli od njiju močno vplival na evropsko ravnovesje moči.

source.title: Treaty of London (1700)
paragraphs: The Treaty of London (1700) (Dutch: Verdrag van Londen, French: Traités de Londres) or Second Partition Treaty was the second attempt by Louis XIV of France and William III of England to impose a diplomatic solution to the issues that led to the 1701-1714 War of the Spanish Succession. Both divided the Spanish Empire without prior consultation and since the Spanish viewed an undivided Empire as non-negotiable, historians generally view them as largely unenforceable.

Charles II of Spain became the last ruler of Habsburg Spain at the age of five in 1665. He suffered from ill health most of his life and despite marrying twice, by 1698 it was clear he would die without children, leaving the question of his successor unresolved. Although no longer the leading European power, the Empire remained a strong global presence and as the closest heirs were from the Austrian Habsburg and French Bourbon families, acquisition by either would significantly impact the European balance of power.

Treaty of London (1827).headline: Londonska pogodba (1827)
paragraphs: Londonsko pogodbo (francosko: Traités de Londres, rusko: Лондонская конвенция) so 6. julija 1827 v Londonu podpisali Združeno kraljestvo Velike Britanije in Irske, Francija v času burbonske restavracije in Ruski imperij. Tri glavne evropske sile so Grčijo in Osmansko cesarstvo pozvale, naj prenehajo sovražnosti, ki so trajale, odkar so se Grki 17. marca 1821 uprli osmanski oblasti. Po letih pogajanj so se evropske zavezniške sile nazadnje odločile, da v vojno posežejo na strani Grkov. Zavezniške sile so s pogodbo predvsem hotele doseči, da bi Osmansko cesarstvo ustanovilo neodvisno grško državo.

source.title: Treaty of London (1827)
paragraphs: The Treaty of London (French: Traités de Londres, Russian: Лондонская конвенция) was signed in London on 6 July, 1827 by the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, Bourbon Restoration France and the Russian Empire. The three main European powers had called upon Greece and the Ottoman Empire to cease hostilities that had been going on since the Greeks revolted against the Ottoman rule on 17 March 1821. After years of negotiation, the European allied powers had finally decided to intervene in the war on the side of the Greeks. The Allied powers wanted the treaty mainly to cause the Ottoman Empire to create an independent Greek state.

Treaty of London (1864).headline: Londonska pogodba (1864)
paragraphs: Z londonsko pogodbo leta 1864 je Združeno kraljestvo Grčiji prepustilo Združene države Jonskih otokov. Britanija je imela nad otoki prijateljski protektorat od pariške pogodbe leta 1815.

Zvezne Združene države Jonskih otokov so obsegale sedem otokov ob obalah Epira in Peloponeza, ki so do leta 1797 ostali v beneških rokah in se izognili osmanski oblasti. Od sedmih jih je šest ležalo v Jonskem morju ob zahodni obali grške celine. Teh šest držav je bilo Krf (Kerkira), Itaka (Itaki), Paxos (Paksi), Kefalonija, Zakintos (Zante) in Lefkada (Santa Maura). Članica zveze je bila tudi Kitera (Cerigo), čeprav leži jugovzhodno od Peloponeza.

Prebivalci Jonskih otokov so si že od grške osamosvojitvene vojne proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu prizadevali za združitev (enosis) z Grčijo. Na seji britanske vlade leta 1862 se je zunanji minister Henry John Temple, 3. vikont Palmerston, odločil otoke prepustiti Grčiji. To politiko je podpirala tudi kraljica Viktorija.
notes: The English calls Palmerston Foreign Secretary in 1862, when he was prime minister; kept as in the source.

source.title: Treaty of London (1864)
paragraphs: The Treaty of London in 1864 resulted in the United Kingdom ceding the United States of the Ionian Islands to Greece. Britain had held an amical protectorate over the islands since the 1815 Treaty of Paris.

The federated United States of the Ionian Islands included seven islands off the coasts of Epirus and the Peloponnese, that had remained in Venetian hands until 1797 and escaped Ottoman rule. Of the seven, six lay in the Ionian Sea, off the western coast of the Greek mainland. These six states were Corfù (Kerkyra), Ithaca(Ithaki), Paxò(paxoi/paxos), Cephalonia, Zante (Zakynthos) and Santa Maura (Lefkas). Cerigo (Kythera) was also a state of the federation, although it is situated southeast of the Peloponnese.

Ever since the Greek War of Independence against the Ottoman Empire, the people of the Ionian Islands had pressed for union, or enosis, with Greece. At a meeting of the British Cabinet in 1862, Foreign Secretary Henry John Temple, 3rd Viscount Palmerston decided to cede the islands to Greece. This policy was also favoured by Queen Victoria.

Londonska pogodba (francosko: Traité de Londres), pogosto imenovana druga londonska pogodba po pogodbi iz leta 1839, je Luksemburgu podelila popolno neodvisnost in nevtralnost. Podpisana je bila 11. maja 1867 po avstrijsko-pruski vojni in luksemburški krizi. Imela je daljnosežne posledice za Luksemburg in odnose med evropskimi velesilami.

source.title: Treaty of London (1867)
paragraphs: The Treaty of London (French: Traité de Londres), often called the Second Treaty of London after the 1839 Treaty, granted Luxembourg full independence and neutrality. It was signed on 11 May 1867 in the aftermath of the Austro-Prussian War and the Luxembourg Crisis. It had wide-reaching consequences for Luxembourg and for relations among Europe's great powers.

Londonska pogodba (1913) je bila podpisana 30. maja po londonski konferenci v letih 1912–1913. Obravnavala je ozemeljske spremembe po koncu prve balkanske vojne. Londonska konferenca se je končala 23. januarja 1913, ko je prišlo do osmanskega državnega udara leta 1913 in je moral osmanski veliki vezir Kâmil paša odstopiti. Vodja udara Enver paša je Osmansko cesarstvo umaknil s konference, zato je bila londonska pogodba podpisana brez osmanske delegacije.
Nadaljnje mejne spremembe so bile potrjene z bukareško pogodbo avgusta 1913, po koncu druge balkanske vojne.

source.title: Treaty of London (1913)
paragraphs: The Treaty of London (1913) was signed on 30 May following the London Conference of 1912–1913. It dealt with the territorial adjustments arising out of the conclusion of the First Balkan War. The London Conference had ended on 23 January 1913, when the 1913 Ottoman coup d'état took place and Ottoman Grand Vizier Kâmil Pasha was forced to resign. Coup leader Enver Pasha withdrew the Ottoman Empire from the Conference, and the Treaty of London was signed without the presence of the Ottoman delegation.
Further border changes were ratified in the Treaty of Bucharest in August 1913, following the conclusion of the Second Balkan War.

Treaty of Lübeck.headline: Lübeški mir
paragraphs: Lübeški mir (dansko: Freden i Lübeck, nemško: Lübecker Frieden) je končal danski poseg v tridesetletno vojno (spodnjesaško ali cesarsko vojno, Kejserkrigen). Podpisala sta ga 22. maja 1629 v Lübecku Albrecht von Wallenstein in kralj Danske-Norveške Kristijan IV., 7. junija pa še cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Ferdinand II. Kot pogodbeno stranko so formalno vključili tudi Katoliško ligo. Pogodba je Danski-Norveški vrnila predvojno ozemlje, ta pa se je morala v zameno dokončno umakniti iz cesarskih zadev.
notes: The English "Treaty or Peace of Lübeck" gives one name in Slovenian.

source.title: Treaty of Lübeck
paragraphs: The Treaty or Peace of Lübeck (Danish: Freden i Lübeck, German: Lübecker Frieden) ended the Danish intervention in the Thirty Years' War (Low Saxon or Emperor's War, Kejserkrigen). It was signed in Lübeck on 22 May 1629 by Albrecht von Wallenstein and Christian IV of Denmark-Norway, and on 7 June by Ferdinand II, Holy Roman Emperor. The Catholic League was formally included as a party. It restored to Denmark–Norway its pre-war territory at the cost of final disengagement from imperial affairs.

Treaty of Madrid (13 January 1750).headline: Madridska pogodba (1750)
paragraphs: Madridska pogodba (znana tudi kot pogodba o mejah osvojitev) je bila sporazum, ki sta ga 13. januarja 1750 sklenili Španija in Portugalska. Da bi končali desetletja spopadov na območju današnjega Urugvaja, je pogodba podrobno določila ozemeljske meje med portugalsko Brazilijo ter španskimi kolonialnimi ozemlji na jugu in zahodu. Portugalska je priznala tudi špansko zahtevo po Filipinih, Španija pa je privolila v širjenje Brazilije proti zahodu. Pogodba je vključevala medsebojno jamstvo podpore, če bi ameriške kolonije katere koli od držav napadla tretja sila.
Predvsem pa sta Španija in Portugalska izrecno opustili papeško bulo Inter caetera ter pogodbi iz Tordesillasa in Zaragoze kot pravno podlago za delitev kolonij.

source.title: Treaty of Madrid (13 January 1750)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Madrid (also known as the Treaty of Limits of the Conquests) was an agreement concluded between Spain and Portugal on 13 January 1750. In an effort to end decades of conflict in the region of present-day Uruguay, the treaty established detailed territorial boundaries between Portuguese Brazil and the Spanish colonial territories to the south and west. Portugal also recognized Spain's claim to the Philippines while Spain acceded to the westward expansion of Brazil. The treaty included a mutual guarantee of support in case either state's American colonies were attacked by a third power.
Most notably, Spain and Portugal expressly abandoned the papal bull, Inter caetera, and the treaties of Tordesillas and Zaragoza as the legal basis for colonial division.

Treaty of Madrid (1670).headline: Madridska pogodba (1670)
paragraphs: Madridska pogodba, znana tudi kot Godolphinova pogodba, je bila pogodba med Anglijo in Španijo, dogovorjena julija 1670 »za ureditev vseh sporov v Ameriki«. Pogodba je uradno končala vojno na Karibih, ki se je začela leta 1654 in v kateri je Anglija osvojila Jamajko.

Madridska pogodba iz leta 1670 je bila za Anglijo zelo ugodna, saj je Španija potrdila in uzakonila angleške posesti na Karibih in v preostali Ameriki. Pred letom 1670 je Španija Ameriko štela izključno za špansko ozemlje, z izjemo Brazilije, ki je bila portugalska po pogodbi iz Tordesillasa iz leta 1494, ta pa je potrdila zahtevo Krištofa Kolumba po Novem svetu za Španijo od 12. oktobra 1494.
notes: The English dates Columbus's claim to 12 October 1494 (his landfall was 12 October 1492); kept as in the source.

source.title: Treaty of Madrid (1670)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Madrid, also known as the Godolphin Treaty, was a treaty between England and Spain that was agreed to in July 1670 "for the settlement of all disputes in America". The treaty officially ended the war begun in 1654 in the Caribbean in which England had conquered Jamaica.

The 1670 Treaty of Madrid was highly favourable to England, as its adverse possession in the Caribbean Sea and the rest of the Americas was confirmed and made legal by Spain. Before 1670, Spain had exclusively regarded the Americas as Spanish territory with the exception of Brazil, which was Portuguese according to the 1494 Treaty of Tordesillas that had confirmed Christopher Columbus' claim of the New World for Spain since 12 October 1494.

Treaty of Melno.headline: Mir v Melnu
paragraphs: Mir v Melnu (litovsko: Melno taika; poljsko: Pokój melneński) ali mir ob Melnskem jezeru (nemško: Friede von Melnosee) je bil mirovni sporazum, ki je končal golubsko vojno. Podpisali so ga 27. septembra 1422 tevtonski vitezi in zavezništvo Kraljevine Poljske in Velike litovske kneževine ob jezeru Melno (nemško: Melnosee, Meldensee; poljsko: Jezioro Mełno) vzhodno od Graudenza (Grudziądz). Razrešil je ozemeljske spore med vitezi in Litvo glede Male Litve in Žemaitije, ki so se vlekli od leta 1382, in določil prusko-litovsko mejo, ki je nato ostala nespremenjena približno 500 let. Del prvotne meje se je ohranil kot del sodobne meje med Republiko Litvo in rusko Kaliningrajsko oblastjo, zato je to ena najstarejših in najstabilnejših meja v Evropi.
notes: The English dates the start of the disputes to 1382, while the Golub War summary says 1398; the Slovenian follows each source.

source.title: Treaty of Melno
paragraphs: The Treaty of Melno (Lithuanian: Melno taika; Polish: Pokój melneński) or Treaty of Lake Melno (German: Friede von Melnosee) was a peace treaty ending the Gollub War. It was signed on 27 September 1422, between the Teutonic Knights and an alliance of the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania at Lake Melno (German: Melnosee, Meldensee; Polish: Jezioro Mełno), east of Graudenz (Grudziądz). The treaty resolved territorial disputes between the Knights and Lithuania regarding Lithuania Minor and Samogitia, which had dragged on since 1382, and determined the Prussian–Lithuanian border, which afterwards remained unchanged for about 500 years. A portion of the original border survives as a portion of the modern border between the Republic of Lithuania and Kaliningrad Oblast, Russia, making it one of the oldest and most stable borders in Europe.

Treaty of Montgomery.headline: Pogodba iz Montgomeryja
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Montgomeryja je bila angleško-valižanska pogodba, podpisana 29. septembra 1267 v Montgomeryshiru, s katero je angleški kralj Henrik III. (vladal 1216–1272) Llywelyna ap Gruffudda priznal za valižanskega princa. To je bilo edinkrat, da je angleški vladar priznal pravico gwyneddskega vladarja nad Walesom. Llywelynov ded Llywelyn Veliki si je že prej, v 1230. letih, ko je podredil vse druge valižanske dinastije, lastil položaj dejanskega valižanskega princa z naslovom »princ Aberffrawa, gospod Snowdona«. Prav tako si je Llywelynov stric Dafydd ap Llywelyn med svojo vladavino od leta 1240 do 1246 lastil naslov valižanskega princa. Llywelynova prevlada konec 1260. let pa je angleško krono, oslabljeno zaradi notranjih razkolov, prisilila, da je priznala njegovo oblast v Walesu.

source.title: Treaty of Montgomery
paragraphs: The Treaty of Montgomery was an Anglo-Welsh treaty signed on 29 September 1267 in Montgomeryshire by which Llywelyn ap Gruffudd was acknowledged as Prince of Wales by King Henry III of England (r. 1216–1272). It was the only time an English ruler recognised the right of a ruler of Gwynedd over Wales. Llywelyn's grandfather Llywelyn the Great had previously laid claim to be the effective prince of Wales by using the title "Prince of Aberffraw, Lord of Snowdon" in the 1230s, after subduing all the other Welsh dynasties. Likewise Llywelyn's uncle, Dafydd ap Llywelyn, claimed the title of Prince of Wales during his reign from 1240 to 1246. However, Llywelyn's supremacy in the late 1260s forced recognition of his authority in Wales by an English Crown weakened by internal division.

Treaty of Neuberg.headline: Neuberška pogodba
paragraphs: Neuberška pogodba, ki sta jo avstrijski vojvoda Albert III. in njegov brat Leopold III. sklenila 25. septembra 1379 v samostanu Neuberg, je določila delitev habsburških dednih dežel med albertinsko in leopoldinsko linijo.

source.title: Treaty of Neuberg
paragraphs: The Treaty of Neuberg, concluded between the Austrian duke Albert III and his brother Leopold III at Neuberg Abbey on 25 September 1379, determined the division of the Habsburg hereditary lands into the Albertinian line and the Leopoldian line.

Pogodba iz Nice je preoblikovala institucionalno strukturo Evropske unije, da bi zdržala širitev proti vzhodu; to nalogo naj bi prvotno opravila amsterdamska pogodba, a takrat ni bila rešena. Evropski voditelji so jo podpisali 26. februarja 2001, veljati pa je začela 1. februarja 2003.

Spremenila je maastrichtsko pogodbo (Pogodbo o Evropski uniji) in rimsko pogodbo (Pogodbo o ustanovitvi Evropske skupnosti, ki je bila pred maastrichtsko pogodbo Pogodba o ustanovitvi Evropske gospodarske skupnosti).
Začetek veljavnosti pogodbe je bil nekaj časa negotov, potem ko so jo irski volivci junija 2001 na referendumu sprva zavrnili. Ta izid so na poznejšem referendumu dobro leto pozneje obrnili.

source.title: Treaty of Nice
paragraphs: The Treaty of Nice reformed the institutional structure of the European Union to withstand eastward expansion, a task which was originally intended to have been done by the Amsterdam Treaty, but failed to be addressed at the time. It was signed by European leaders on 26 February 2001 and came into force on 1 February 2003.

It amended the Maastricht Treaty (or the Treaty on European Union) and the Treaty of Rome (or the Treaty establishing the European Community which, before the Maastricht Treaty, was the Treaty establishing the European Economic Community).

The entry into force of the treaty was in doubt for a time, after its initial rejection by Irish voters in a referendum in June 2001. This referendum result was reversed in a subsequent referendum held a little over a year later.

Treaty of Oliva.headline: Olivski mir
paragraphs: Olivski mir (poljsko: Pokój Oliwski; švedsko: Freden i Oliva; nemško: Vertrag von Oliva) je bil eden od mirovnih sporazumov, ki so končali drugo severno vojno (1655–1660). Podpisali so ga 3. maja (po starem koledarju 23. aprila) 1660. Olivski mir, kopenhagenski mir istega leta in mir v Kardisu naslednje leto so pomenili vrhunec Švedskega imperija.

V Olivi (Oliwa) na Poljskem so mir sklenili Švedska, Republika obeh narodov, Habsburžani in Brandenburška Prusija. Švedsko so priznali za suvereno v Švedski Livoniji, Brandenburg v Vojvodini Prusiji, Janez II. Kazimir Vasa pa se je odpovedal zahtevam po švedskem prestolu. Vsa zasedena ozemlja so vrnili predvojnim vladarjem. Katoličani v Livoniji in Prusiji so dobili versko svobodo.

source.title: Treaty of Oliva
paragraphs: The Treaty or Peace of Oliva (Polish: Pokój Oliwski; Swedish: Freden i Oliva; German: Vertrag von Oliva) was one of the peace treaties ending the Second Northern War (1655–1660). It was signed on 3 May [O.S. 23 April] 1660. The Treaty of Oliva, the Treaty of Copenhagen in the same year, and the Treaty of Cardis in the following year marked the high point of the Swedish Empire.

At Oliwa (Oliva), Poland, peace was made between Sweden, the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, the Habsburgs and Brandenburg-Prussia. Sweden was accepted as sovereign in Swedish Livonia, Brandenburg was accepted as sovereign in Ducal Prussia and John II Casimir Vasa withdrew his claims to the Swedish throne. All occupied territories were restored to their prewar sovereigns. Catholics in Livonia and Prussia were granted religious freedom.

Treaty of Paris (1229).headline: Pariška pogodba (1229)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba, znana tudi kot pogodba iz Meauxa, je bila podpisana 12. aprila 1229 v Meauxu blizu Pariza med toulouškim grofom Rajmondom VII. in francoskim kraljem Ludvikom IX. Ludvik je bil še mladoleten, zato je imela pri sklenitvi pogodbe ključno vlogo njegova mati Blanka Kastiljska kot regentka. Sporazum je uradno končal albižansko križarsko vojno; po njegovih določilih naj bi se Rajmondova hči Ivana poročila z Ludvikovim bratom Alfonzom. Rajmond je poleg tega Ludviku odstopil vzhodne province svojih dežel, Katoliški cerkvi pa provansalsko markizo (Marquisat de Provence). Pogodba je inkviziciji dala tudi absolutno oblast pri iskanju in prijemanju heretikov v imenu Katoliške cerkve.

Rajmond je francoski kroni odstopil več kot polovico svojih dežel, preostanek pa obdržal le do smrti; nato naj bi ga podedoval njegov zet Alfonz, Ludvikov brat, ali, če Alfonz ne bi imel dediča, francoska krona. Papeštvo je dobilo Comtat Venaissin.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1229)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris, also known as Treaty of Meaux, was signed on 12 April 1229 between Raymond VII of Toulouse and Louis IX of France in Meaux near Paris. Louis was still a minor, and it was his mother Blanche of Castile, as regent, who was instrumental in forging the treaty. The agreement officially ended the Albigensian Crusade, and according to the terms of the treaty, Raymond's daughter Joan was to be married to Louis' brother Alphonse. Moreover, Raymond ceded the eastern provinces of his lands to Louis and the Marquisat de Provence to the Catholic Church. The treaty also gave the Inquisition absolute power regarding searching for, and seizing of heretics by the Catholic Church.

Raymond ceded more than half his land to the French crown and retained the remainder only during his life, and it would then be inherited by his son-in-law Alphonse, Louis's brother or, if Alphonse had no heir, by the French crown. The Papacy gained the Comtat Venaissin.

Treaty of Paris (1259).headline: Pariška pogodba (1259)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba, znana tudi kot pogodba iz Abbevilla, je bila mirovna pogodba, ki sta jo 4. decembra 1259 podpisala francoski kralj Ludvik IX. in angleški kralj Henrik III. Pomenila je prelomnico v evropski politiki in privedla do nove politične dinamike, kulturnih izmenjav in družbenih sprememb.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1259)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris, also known as the Treaty of Abbeville, was signed on 4 December 1259 by King Louis IX of France and King Henry III of England. It marked a turning point in European politics, leading to new political dynamics, cultural exchanges, and social changes.

Treaty of Paris (1303).headline: Pariška pogodba (1303)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba iz leta 1303 je bila mirovna pogodba med angleškim kraljem Edvardom I. in francoskim kraljem Filipom IV., ki je končala gaskonjsko vojno 1294–1303. Podpisana je bila v Parizu 20. maja 1303, predvidevala je predvsem vrnitev v prejšnje stanje (status quo ante) in je med kraljestvoma ohranila mir do vojne za Saint-Sardos leta 1324.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1303)
paragraphs: The 1303 Treaty of Paris was a peace treaty between King Edward I of England and Philip IV of France that ended the 1294–1303 Gascon War. It was signed at Paris on 20 May 1303, largely provided for a return to the status quo ante, and maintained peace between the two realms until the 1324 War of Saint-Sardos.

Treaty of Paris (1763).headline: Pariška pogodba (1763)
paragraphs: Pariško pogodbo, znano tudi kot pogodba iz leta 1763, so 10. februarja 1763 ob soglasju Portugalske podpisale kraljevine Velika Britanija, Francija in Španija, potem ko sta Velika Britanija in Prusija v sedemletni vojni premagali Francijo in Španijo.

S podpisom pogodbe se je formalno končal spopad med Francijo in Veliko Britanijo za nadzor nad Severno Ameriko (sedemletna vojna, v Združenih državah znana kot francosko-indijanska vojna), začelo pa se je obdobje britanske prevlade zunaj Evrope. Velika Britanija in Francija sta vrnili velik del ozemelj, ki sta jih osvojili med vojno, Velika Britanija pa je pridobila velik del francoskih posesti v Severni Ameriki. Poleg tega se je Velika Britanija zavezala, da v Novem svetu ne bo skušala izkoreniniti rimskokatoliške vere. Pogodba ni vključevala Prusije in Avstrije, saj sta pet dni pozneje podpisali ločen sporazum, hubertusburški mir.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1763)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris, also known as the Treaty of 1763, was signed on 10 February 1763 by the kingdoms of Great Britain, France and Spain, with Portugal in agreement, following Great Britain and Prussia's victory over France and Spain during the Seven Years' War.

The signing of the treaty formally ended the conflict between France and Great Britain over control of North America (the Seven Years' War, known as the French and Indian War in the United States), and marked the beginning of an era of British dominance outside Europe. Great Britain and France each returned much of the territory that they had captured during the war, but Great Britain gained much of France's possessions in North America. Additionally, Great Britain agreed not to seek to eradicate Roman Catholicism in the New World. The treaty did not involve Prussia and Austria, as they signed a separate agreement, the Treaty of Hubertusburg, five days later.

Treaty of Paris (1783).headline: Pariška pogodba (1783)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba, ki so jo 3. septembra 1783 podpisali predstavniki britanskega kralja Jurija III. in predstavniki Združenih držav, je uradno končala ameriško vojno za neodvisnost in priznala trinajst kolonij, ki so bile del britanske kolonialne Amerike, za svobodne, suverene in neodvisne združene države. Spada med številne pogodbe, ki jih skupaj imenujejo »pariški mir«.

Pogodba je določila meje med Britansko Severno Ameriko, pozneje imenovano Kanada, in Združenimi državami po črtah, ki so jih Britanci označili kot »izjemno velikodušne«, čeprav so bile natančne opredelitve meja na skrajnem severozahodu in na jugu še naprej deloma sporne. Podrobnosti so obsegale ribolovne pravice ter vrnitev premoženja in vojnih ujetnikov.
Še vedno velja le 1. člen pogodbe, ki priznava obstoj Združenih držav kot svobodnih, suverenih in neodvisnih držav.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1783)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris, signed by representatives of King George III of Great Britain and representatives of the United States on September 3, 1783, officially ended the War of American Independence and recognized the Thirteen Colonies, which had been part of colonial British America, to be free, sovereign, and independent unified states. It forms one treaty out of many that are collectively named the "Peace of Paris".

The treaty set the boundaries between British North America, later called Canada, and the United States, on lines the British labeled as "exceedingly generous", although exact boundary definitions in the far-northwest and to the south continued to be subject to some controversy. Details included fishing rights and restoration of property and prisoners of war.
Only Article 1 of the treaty, which acknowledges the United States' existence as free, sovereign, and independent states, remains in force.

Treaty of Paris (1802).headline: Pariška pogodba (1802)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba je bila podpisana 25. junija 1802 med prvo francosko republiko, ki jo je tedaj vodil prvi konzul Napoleon Bonaparte, in Osmanskim cesarstvom, ki mu je tedaj vladal sultan Selim III. Bila je končna oblika predhodne pogodbe, podpisane v Parizu 9. oktobra 1801, ki je končala francoski pohod v Egipt in Sirijo ter francosko-osmanske odnose vrnila v predvojno stanje (status quo ante bellum). Osmansko cesarstvo je s pogodbo pristalo tudi na amienski mir (25. marca 1802), mirovno pogodbo med Francijo in Združenim kraljestvom, ki je sledila predaji francoskih čet v Egiptu Britancem z aleksandrijsko kapitulacijo.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1802)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris was signed on 25 June 1802 between the First French Republic, then under First Consul Napoleon Bonaparte, and the Ottoman Empire, then ruled by Sultan Selim III. It was the final form of a preliminary treaty signed at Paris on 9 October 1801 that brought to an end the French campaign in Egypt and Syria and restored Franco-Ottoman relations to their status quo ante bellum. In the treaty, the Ottoman Empire also assented to the Treaty of Amiens (25 March 1802), a peace treaty between France and the United Kingdom, which had followed the surrender of French troops in Egypt to the British at the Capitulation of Alexandria.

Treaty of Paris (1810).headline: Pariška pogodba (1810)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba, podpisana 6. januarja 1810, je končala francosko-švedsko vojno, potem ko je Rusija, zaveznica Francije, Švedsko premagala v finski vojni 1808–1809.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1810)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris, signed on 6 January 1810, ended the Franco-Swedish War after Sweden's defeat by Russia, an ally of France, in the Finnish War of 1808–1809.

Treaty of Paris (1815).headline: Pariška pogodba (1815)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba iz leta 1815, znana tudi kot druga pariška pogodba, je bila podpisana 20. novembra 1815, po porazu in drugem odstopu Napoleona Bonaparta. Napoleon je februarja pobegnil iz izgnanstva na Elbi, 20. marca vstopil v Pariz in začel sto dni obnovljene vladavine. Po porazu Francije proti sedmi koaliciji v bitki pri Waterlooju je moral Napoleon 22. junija znova odstopiti. Kralj Ludvik XVIII., ki je ob Napoleonovem prihodu v Pariz pobegnil iz države, je 8. julija drugič zasedel prestol.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1815)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris of 1815, also known as the Second Treaty of Paris, was signed on 20 November 1815, after the defeat and the second abdication of Napoleon Bonaparte. In February, Napoleon had escaped from his exile on Elba, entered Paris on 20 March and began the Hundred Days of his restored rule. After France's defeat at the hands of the Seventh Coalition at the Battle of Waterloo, Napoleon was forced to abdicate again, on 22 June. King Louis XVIII, who had fled the country when Napoleon arrived in Paris, took the throne for a second time on 8 July.

Treaty of Paris (1856).headline: Pariška pogodba (1856)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba iz leta 1856, podpisana 30. marca 1856 na pariškem kongresu, je končala krimsko vojno (1853–1856) med Ruskim cesarstvom in zavezništvom Osmanskega cesarstva, Združenega kraljestva, drugega francoskega cesarstva in Kraljevine Sardinije.

Pogodba je zmanjšala ruski vpliv v regiji. Rusiji je vrnila Sevastopol ter druga mesta in kraje na jugu Krima, prepovedala pa ji je postavljati pomorske ali vojaške arzenale na obali Črnega morja, ki je postalo nevtralno ozemlje: zaprli so ga za vse vojne ladje ter na njegovih obalah prepovedali utrdbe in orožje. Leta 1871 so se teh prepovedi odpovedali z londonsko pogodbo.

Rusija je morala Moldaviji vrniti tudi del ozemlja, ki si ga je priključila leta 1812 (do ustja Donave v južni Besarabiji). Izgubila je vsako pravico do vpliva v podonavskih kneževinah in Kneževini Srbiji ter do zaščite kristjanov v Osmanskem cesarstvu.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1856)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris of 1856, signed on 30 March 1856 at the Congress of Paris, brought an end to the Crimean War (1853–1856) between the Russian Empire and an alliance of the Ottoman Empire, the United Kingdom, the Second French Empire and the Kingdom of Sardinia.

The treaty diminished Russian influence in the region. It returned Sevastopol and other towns and cities in the south of Crimea to Russia, but prohibited Russia from establishing naval or military arsenal on the coast of the Black Sea, which was made neutral territory, closing it to all warships and prohibiting fortifications and the presence of armaments on its shores. In 1871, these prohibitions were renounced in the Treaty of London.

The treaty also had Russia return to Moldavia part of its territory it had annexed in 1812 (to the mouth of the Danube, in southern Bessarabia). Russia lost any claim to influence the Danubian principalities and the Principality of Serbia, or to protect Christians in the Ottoman Empire.

Treaty of Paris (1857).headline: Pariška pogodba (1857)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba (1857) (perzijsko: عهدنامه پاریس ۱۸۵۷) je pomenila konec sovražnosti angleško-perzijske vojne. Na perzijski strani je pogajanja vodil veleposlanik Farroh Kan. Strani sta mirovno pogodbo podpisali 4. marca 1857.

Perzijci so se s pogodbo zavezali, da se umaknejo iz Herata, ki ga je pozneje lahko zasedel afganistanski Dost Mohamed Kan. Zavezali so se tudi, da se britanskemu odposlancu ob vrnitvi opravičijo in podpišejo trgovinsko pogodbo; Britanci pa so se zavezali, da na veleposlaništvu ne bodo dajali zatočišča šahovim nasprotnikom, in odstopili od zahteve, da se zamenja veliki vezir Mirza Aga Kan Nuri, ter od zahteve po ozemeljskih koncesijah omanskemu imamu, britanskemu zavezniku.
notes: The Persian romanization is dropped; the Persian script is kept.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1857)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris (1857) (Persian: عهدنامه پاریس ۱۸۵۷, romanized: Ahdnāme-ye Paris 1857) marked the end of the hostilities of the Anglo-Persian War. On the Persian side, negotiations were handled by ambassador Farrokh Khan. The two sides signed the peace treaty on 4 March 1857.

In the Treaty, the Persians agreed to withdraw from Herat, later allowing Dost Mohammad Khan of Afghanistan to occupy it. They also agreed to apologise to the British envoy on his return, and to sign a commercial treaty; the British agreed not to shelter opponents of the Shah in the embassy, and they abandoned the demand to replace the grand vizier Mirza Aqa Khan Nuri, as well as one requiring territorial concessions to the Imam of Oman, a British ally.

Treaty of Paris (1898).headline: Pariška pogodba (1898)
paragraphs: Mirovno pogodbo med Združenimi državami Amerike in Kraljevino Španijo, splošno znano kot pariška pogodba iz leta 1898, sta 10. decembra 1898 podpisali Španija in Združene države; pomenila je uradni konec špansko-ameriške vojne. Španija se je z njo v korist Združenih držav odpovedala vsem zahtevam po suverenosti nad otočji in otoki Zahodne Indije Kuba in Portoriko v Karibih, otokom Guam na Marianskih otokih v Mikroneziji v zahodnem Tihem oceanu in otočjem Filipini v jugovzhodni Aziji. Za prepustitev Filipinov so Združene države Španiji plačale 20 milijonov dolarjev odškodnine.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1898)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Peace between the United States of America and the Kingdom of Spain, commonly known as the Treaty of Paris of 1898, was signed by Spain and the United States on December 10, 1898, and marked the official end of the Spanish–American War. Under it, Spain relinquished all claim of sovereignty over the West Indies archipelagos and islands of Cuba and Puerto Rico in the Caribbean, the Western Pacific island of Guam in the Mariana Islands in Micronesia, and the Western Pacific archipelago of the Philippines in Southeast Asia to the United States. The cession of the Philippines involved a compensation of $20 million from the United States to Spain.

Treaty of Paris (1900).headline: Pariška pogodba (1900)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba, objavljena v španskem uradnem listu Gaceta 30. marca 1901 z naslovom Konvencija med Španijo in Francijo o razmejitvi posesti obeh držav na obali Sahare in Gvinejskega zaliva, je bila podpisana 27. junija 1900 med predstavniki Kraljevine Španije (pod vlado regentke kraljice Marije Kristine Avstrijske) in tretje francoske republike (ki ji je predsedoval Émile Loubet).
Pogodba je razmejila meje španskih kolonij v puščavi Sahari (Río de Oro, del Španske Sahare) in v Ekvatorialni Afriki (Španska Gvineja) glede na sosednje francoske kolonije v Afriki.
Za namene pogodbe sta svoji vladi zastopala Fernando León y Castillo, tedanji španski veleposlanik v Franciji, in Théophile Delcassé, francoski poslanec in zunanji minister.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1900)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Paris, published in the Spanish Gaceta on 30 March 1901 under the title Convention between Spain and France for the delimitation of the possessions of both countries on the coast of the Sahara and on that of the Gulf of Guinea, was signed on 27 June 1900 between representatives of the Kingdom of Spain (under the government of the regent Queen Maria Christina of Austria) and the French Third Republic (presided over by Émile Loubet).

The Treaty delimited the borders of the Spanish colonies in the Sahara desert (Río de Oro, part of Spanish Sahara) and Equatorial Africa (Spanish Guinea) with respect to the adjoining French colonies on Africa.

Fernando León y Castillo, the then Spanish ambassador to France, and Theophile Delcasse, French deputy and Minister of Foreign Affairs, acted as representatives of their respective governments for the purposes of the Treaty.

Treaty of Paris (1920).headline: Pariška pogodba (1920)
paragraphs: Pariška pogodba iz leta 1920 je bila akt, ki so ga podpisale Romunija in tedanje glavne zavezniške sile (Francija, Združeno kraljestvo, Italija in Japonska) in s katerim naj bi priznali romunsko suverenost nad Besarabijo. Pogodba pa ni nikoli začela veljati, ker je Japonska ni ratificirala.

Besarabski zakonodajni zbor (Sfatul Țării) je 9. aprila 1918 (po starem koledarju 27. marca 1918), v kaosu ruske državljanske vojne in po romunskem vojaškem posredovanju, s 86 glasovi za, tremi proti in 36 vzdržanimi izglasoval združitev Besarabije z Romunijo, kar so Rusi imeli za romunsko invazijo.

Tako kot versajska pogodba je tudi pogodba iz leta 1920 vsebovala Pakt Društva narodov, zato je Združene države niso ratificirale. Združene države je sprva niso hotele podpisati, ker Rusija na mirovni konferenci ni bila zastopana.

source.title: Treaty of Paris (1920)
paragraphs: The 1920 Treaty of Paris was an act signed by Romania and the principal Allied Powers of the time (France, United Kingdom, Italy and Japan) whose purpose was the recognition of Romanian sovereignty over Bessarabia. The treaty, however, never came into force because Japan failed to ratify it.

On 9 April 1918 (old style 27 March 1918), during the chaos of the Russian Civil War and following Romanian military intervention, the Bessarabian legislature (Sfatul Țării) voted in favor of the union of Bessarabia with Romania with 86 votes in favor, three against, and 36 abstentions, an act regarded by the Russians as a Romanian invasion.

As with the Treaty of Versailles, the 1920 treaty contained the Covenant of the League of Nations, and, as a result, it was not ratified by the United States. The United States refused initially to sign the Treaty on the grounds that Russia was not represented at the treaty conference.

Treaty of Perth.headline: Pogodba iz Pertha
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Pertha, podpisana 2. julija 1266, je končala vojaški spopad med norveškim kraljem Magnusom Zakonodajalcem in škotskim kraljem Aleksandrom III. za posest Hebridov in otoka Man.

Hebridi in otok Man so postali norveško ozemlje v stoletjih, ko sta se Škotska in Norveška šele oblikovali v povezani narodni državi, norveški nadzor pa je bil formaliziran leta 1098, ko je škotski kralj Edgar otoke prepustil norveškemu kralju Magnusu III. V norveščini so otoke imenovali Sudreys, kar pomeni »južni otoki«.

Pogodba je bila sklenjena tri leta po bitki pri Largsu leta 1263. Michael Lynch je njen pomen primerjal s pomenom yorške pogodbe iz leta 1237. Yorška pogodba je določila mejo med Škotsko in Anglijo, ki je skoraj enaka današnji.

source.title: Treaty of Perth
paragraphs: The Treaty of Perth, signed 2 July 1266, ended military conflict between Magnus the Lawmender of Norway and Alexander III of Scotland over possession of the Hebrides and the Isle of Man.

The Hebrides and the Isle of Man had become Norwegian territory during centuries when both Scotland and Norway were still forming themselves as coherent nation-states, and Norwegian control had been formalised in 1098, when Edgar of Scotland signed the islands over to Magnus III of Norway. In Norwegian terms, the islands were the Sudreys, meaning Southern Isles.

The treaty was agreed three years after the Battle of Largs in 1263. Michael Lynch has compared the treaty's importance with that of the Treaty of York of 1237. The Treaty of York defined a border between Scotland and England that is almost identical to the modern border.

Treaty of Picquigny.headline: Pogodba iz Picquignyja
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Picquignyja je bila mirovna pogodba, izpogajana 29. avgusta 1475 med Kraljevino Anglijo in Kraljevino Francijo. Sledila je invaziji angleškega kralja Edvarda IV. na Francijo v zavezništvu z Burgundijo in Bretanjo. Francoskemu kralju Ludviku XI. je omogočila, da se je posvetil nevarnosti, ki jo je predstavljal burgundski vojvoda Karel Drzni. Pogodba je tudi formalno končala stoletno vojno, ki se je neformalno končala že leta 1453.

source.title: Treaty of Picquigny
paragraphs: The Treaty of Picquigny was a peace treaty negotiated on 29 August 1475 between the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of France. It followed from an invasion of France by Edward IV of England in alliance with Burgundy and Brittany. It left Louis XI of France free to solve the threat posed by Charles the Bold, Duke of Burgundy. The treaty also formally ended the Hundred Years' War, which had been informally finished since 1453.

Treaty of Polyanovka.headline: Poljanovski mir
paragraphs: Poljanovski mir (poljsko: Pokój w Polanowie; litovsko: Polianovkos taika) je bil mirovni sporazum, ki sta ga 14. junija 1634 v vasi Semljovo ob reki Poljanovki med Vjazmo in Dorogobužem sklenili Republika obeh narodov in Rusko carstvo.
notes: The English "Treaty of Polyanovka, also known as the Peace of Polyanovka" gives one name in Slovenian; the Russian place names are transcribed by the Pravopis rules.

source.title: Treaty of Polyanovka
paragraphs: The Treaty of Polyanovka, also known as the Peace of Polyanovka (Polish: Pokój w Polanowie; Lithuanian: Polianovkos taika) was a peace treaty signed on 14 June 1634 between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Tsardom of Russia in the village of Semlyovo located near the Polyanovka river between Vyazma and Dorogobuzh.

Treaty of Rapallo (1922).headline: Rapalska pogodba iz leta 1922
paragraphs: Rapalska pogodba je bila sporazum, podpisan 16. aprila 1922 med Nemčijo in Rusijo, s katerim sta se obe državi odrekli vsem ozemeljskim in finančnim zahtevkom druga proti drugi in vzpostavili prijateljske diplomatske odnose. O pogodbi sta se pogajala ruski zunanji minister Georgij Čičerin in nemški zunanji minister Walther Rathenau. Bila je velika zmaga zlasti za Rusijo, pa tudi za Nemčijo, in veliko razočaranje za Francijo in Združeno kraljestvo. Izraz »duh Rapalla« so uporabljali za izboljšanje prijateljskih odnosov med Nemčijo in Rusijo.

Pogodbo so podpisali v Rapallu v Italiji. Ratifikacije so izmenjali 31. januarja 1923 v Berlinu, 19. septembra 1923 pa so jo vpisali v zbirko pogodb Društva narodov. Pogodba ni vsebovala vojaških določb, vendar je bilo tajno vojaško sodelovanje med Nemčijo in Rusijo že načrtovano, kar je bilo kršitev versajske pogodbe.

source.title: Treaty of Rapallo (1922)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Rapallo was an agreement signed on 16 April 1922 between Germany and Russia under which both renounced all territorial and financial claims against each other and opened friendly diplomatic relations. The treaty was negotiated by Russian foreign minister Georgi Chicherin and German foreign minister Walther Rathenau. It was a major victory for Russia especially and also Germany, and a major disappointment to France and the United Kingdom. The term "spirit of Rapallo" was used for an improvement in friendly relations between Germany and Russia.

The treaty was signed in Rapallo, Italy. Ratifications were exchanged in Berlin on 31 January 1923, and registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on 19 September 1923. The treaty did not include any military provisions, but secret military co-operation was already scheduled between Germany and Russia, which was a violation of the Treaty of Versailles.

Treaty of Rastatt.headline: Rastattski mir
paragraphs: Rastattski mir je bil mirovni sporazum med Francijo in Avstrijo, sklenjen 7. marca 1714 v badenskem mestu Rastatt, s katerim se je končala španska nasledstvena vojna med državama. Sledil je utrechtskemu miru z 11. aprila 1713, ki je končal sovražnosti med Francijo in Španijo na eni ter Veliko Britanijo in Republiko Nizozemsko na drugi strani. Za konec sovražnosti med Francijo in Svetim rimskim cesarstvom je bila potrebna še tretja pogodba v Badnu v Švici.

Do leta 1713 so bile vse vojskujoče se strani vojaško izčrpane in malo verjetno je bilo, da bi nadaljevanje spopada v doglednem času prineslo kakršne koli rezultate. Novembra 1713 se je med Francijo in Avstrijo začel prvi kongres v Rastattu. Pogajanja so se končala z rastattskim mirom 7. marca 1714, ki je ustavil sovražnosti in dopolnil utrechtski mir, podpisan leto prej.
Rastattski mir sta izpogajala maršal Francije Claude Louis Hector de Villars in avstrijski princ Evgen Savojski.

source.title: Treaty of Rastatt
paragraphs: The Treaty of Rastatt was a peace treaty between France and Austria that was concluded on 7 March 1714 in the Baden city of Rastatt to end the War of the Spanish Succession between both countries. The treaty followed the Treaty of Utrecht of 11 April 1713, which had ended hostilities between France and Spain, on the one hand, and Great Britain and the Dutch Republic, on the other. A third treaty at Baden, Switzerland, was required to end the hostilities between France and the Holy Roman Empire.

By 1713, all parties to the war had been militarily depleted, and it was unlikely that continuing the conflict would bring about any results in the foreseeable future. The First Congress of Rastatt opened in November 1713 between France and Austria. The negotiations culminated in the Treaty of Rastatt on 7 March 1714, which ended hostilities and complemented the Treaty of Utrecht, which had been signed the previous year.
The Treaty of Rastatt was negotiated by Marshal of France, Claude Louis Hector de Villars, and the Austrian Prince Eugene of Savoy.

Treaty of Rome (1924).headline: Rimska pogodba iz leta 1924
paragraphs: Rimska pogodba je bila sklenjena 27. januarja 1924, ko sta se Italija in Kraljevina Srbov, Hrvatov in Slovencev dogovorili, da bo Reka (Fiume) priključena Italiji kot Reška pokrajina, mesto Sušak pa bo del Kraljevine Srbov, Hrvatov in Slovencev.
Reka in Sušak bi imela skupno upravo pristaniških naprav. Obe mesti sta danes del mesta Reka (hrvaško Rijeka) na Hrvaškem.
notes: The English uses Fiume and Rijeka; the Slovenian uses the exonym Reka for both and gives the Italian and Croatian forms once.

source.title: Treaty of Rome (1924)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Rome was agreed on 27 January 1924, when Italy and the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes agreed that Fiume would be annexed to Italy as the Province of Fiume, and the town of Sušak would be part of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes.
Fiume and Sušak would have a joint administration of the port facilities. Both towns are now in the city of Rijeka, Croatia.

Treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte.headline: Pogodba iz Saint-Clair-sur-Epte
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Saint-Clair-sur-Epte (911) je ustanovna pogodba Vojvodine Normandije, s katero je Rollon, nordijski vojskovodja in vikinški voditelj, postal prvi normandijski vojvoda v zameno za zvestobo zahodnofrankovskemu kralju Karlu III. po obleganju Chartresa. Pogodba je vključevala Karlov dar obdelovalne obalne zemlje Rollonu v zameno za Rollonovo zvestobo in pomoč proti drugim vikinškim skupinam, ki so redno pustošile severno obalo. Z njo se je dejansko spremenilo, kako je celinska Evropa reševala nenehne vikinške vpade.

source.title: Treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte
paragraphs: The treaty of Saint-Clair-sur-Epte (911) is the foundational treaty of the Duchy of Normandy, establishing Rollo, a Norse warlord and Viking leader, as the first Duke of Normandy in exchange for his loyalty to Charles III, the king of West Francia, following the Siege of Chartres. This treaty included a land grant of farmable coastal land from Charles to Rollo in return for Rollo's fealty and help against other Viking groups that had been regularly raiding the northern coastline. This treaty effectively changed how mainland Europe resolved ongoing raids from the Vikings.

Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye (1679).headline: Pogodba iz Saint-Germain-en-Laye (1679)
paragraphs: Pogodba ali mir iz Saint-Germain-en-Laye z dne 19. junija (po starem) oziroma 29. junija (po novem koledarju) 1679 je bila mirovna pogodba med Francijo in Brandenburško volilno kneževino. Švedski, francoski zaveznici, je vrnila njene posesti Bremen-Verden in Švedsko Pomorjansko, ki jih je izgubila proti Brandenburgu v skanijski vojni. Švedska je pogodbo ratificirala 28. julija 1679.

Nekateri pogodbo štejejo za »najhujši politični poraz« volilnega kneza Friderika Viljema I. Francija ga je prisilila, da se je odpovedal švedskemu delu pomorjanske dediščine, ki jo je imel za svojo zakonito, čeprav ga je osvojil v štiriletnem pohodu.

source.title: Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye (1679)
paragraphs: The Treaty or Peace of Saint-Germain-en-Laye of 19 June (OS) or 29 June (NS) 1679 was a peace treaty between France and the Electorate of Brandenburg. It restored to France's ally Sweden her dominions Bremen-Verden and Swedish Pomerania, lost to Brandenburg in the Scanian War. Sweden ratified the treaty on 28 July 1679.

The treaty is by some considered "the worst political defeat" of Elector Frederick William I. He was forced by France to give away the Swedish portion of what he considered his rightful Pomeranian inheritance, despite having conquered it in a four-year campaign.

Treaty of Seville.headline: Seviljska pogodba
paragraphs: Seviljska pogodba je bila podpisana 9. novembra 1729 med Britanijo, Francijo in Španijo in je formalno končala angleško-špansko vojno v letih 1727–1729; Nizozemska republika se je pogodbi pridružila 29. novembra.
Pogodba pa ni razrešila temeljnih napetosti, ki so leta 1739 privedle najprej do vojne za Jenkinsovo uho, leta 1740 pa do širše vojne za avstrijsko nasledstvo.

source.title: Treaty of Seville
paragraphs: The Treaty of Seville was signed on 9 November 1729 between Britain, France, and Spain, formally ending the 1727–1729 Anglo-Spanish War; the Dutch Republic joined the Treaty on 29 November.
However, the Treaty failed to resolve underlying tensions that led first to the War of Jenkins' Ear in 1739, then the wider War of the Austrian Succession in 1740.

Treaty of Stuhmsdorf.headline: Pogodba iz Stuhmsdorfa
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Stuhmsdorfa sta 12. septembra 1635 v kraju Sztumska Wieś na Poljskem podpisali Republika obeh narodov in Švedska. Ker je bila Švedska oslabljena zaradi udeležbe v tridesetletni vojni, je pogodba altmarško premirje iz leta 1629 podaljšala za 26 let in pol, Švedska pa je pristala na pomembne popuste.

Čeprav je Republika obeh narodov dobila nazaj številna ozemlja, izgubljena v poljsko-švedski vojni (1600–1629), si je Švedska v zameno zagotovila pridobitve ob Baltskem morju. To ji je omogočilo, da se je posvetila Svetemu rimskemu cesarstvu, ne da bi jo skrbela morebitna nova fronta. Premirje je trajalo do izbruha druge severne vojne leta 1655.

source.title: Treaty of Stuhmsdorf
paragraphs: The Treaty of Stuhmsdorf, was signed on 12 September 1635 in Sztumska Wieś, Poland, between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Sweden. With the latter weakened by its involvement in the Thirty Years' War, it extended the 1629 Truce of Altmark for 26+1⁄2 years, with Sweden making significant concessions.

Although the Commonwealth regained many territories lost during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1629), in return Sweden secured its acquisitions in the Baltic Sea. This allowed them to focus on the Holy Roman Empire without worrying about a possible new front. The truce lasted until the outbreak of the Second Northern War in 1655.

Treaty of Szatmár.headline: Mir v Szatmárju
paragraphs: Mir v Szatmárju (ali szatmárska pogodba) je bil mirovni sporazum, sklenjen 29. aprila 1711 v Szatmárju (današnji Satu Mare v Romuniji) med habsburškim cesarjem Karlom VI., ogrskimi stanovi in uporniki kuruci. Formalno je končal Rákóczijevo osamosvojitveno vojno, ki je trajala od leta 1703.

V veliki turški vojni so sile Habsburške monarhije osvojile velik del osmanske Ogrske. Novi vladarji pa so kmalu naleteli na odpor ogrskih magnatov pod vodstvom Franca II. Rákóczija, ki je prerasel v upor pod Rákóczijevim vodstvom; ta se je od leta 1703 razširil po Gornji Ogrski (danes večinoma Slovaška), Transilvaniji in Podkarpatski Rusiji. Upornike je leta 1708 v bitki pri Trenčinu odločilno porazila habsburška vojska pod vodstvom feldmaršala Sigberta Heisterja, ki so jo podpirale raške (srbske) sile. Ko se je spopad vlekel naprej, je predsednik dvornega vojnega sveta (Hofkriegsrat) princ Evgen Savojski za glavnega pogajalca imenoval lojalnega ogrskega feldmaršala Jánosa Pálffyja. Pálffy je novembra 1710 navezal stik s poveljnikom kurucev Sándorjem Károlyijem in 13. januarja 1711 dosegel premirje.

source.title: Treaty of Szatmár
paragraphs: The Treaty of Szatmár (or the Peace of Szatmár) was a peace treaty concluded at Szatmár (present-day Satu Mare, Romania) on 29 April 1711 between the House of Habsburg emperor Charles VI, the Hungarian estates and the Kuruc rebels. It formally ended Rákóczi's War of Independence, which had endured since 1703.

In the Great Turkish War, the forces of the Habsburg monarchy conquered large parts of Ottoman Hungary. However, the new rulers soon met with resistance by the Hungarian magnates led by Francis II Rákóczi, culminating in the rebellion led by Rákóczi, which from 1703 onwards spread throughout Upper Hungary (today mostly Slovakia), Transylvania and Carpathian Ruthenia. The rebels were decisively defeated by a Habsburg army under Field marshal Sigbert Heister, backed by Rascian forces, in the 1708 Battle of Trencsén. As the conflict rumbled on, the Hofkriegsrat president Prince Eugene of Savoy appointed the loyal Hungarian Field Marshal János Pálffy chief negotiator. In November 1710, Pálffy contacted the Kuruc commander Sándor Károlyi and achieved a truce on 13 January 1711.

Treaty of Teschen.headline: Tešinski mir
paragraphs: Tešinski mir (nemško: Frieden von Teschen; francosko: Traité de Teschen) sta 13. maja 1779 v Tešinu (Teschen), tedaj v Avstrijski Šleziji, podpisali avstrijska habsburška monarhija in Kraljevina Prusija; z njim se je uradno končala bavarska nasledstvena vojna.
notes: The literal gloss "lit. 'Peace of Teschen'" is dropped, as it is the Slovenian name itself.

source.title: Treaty of Teschen
paragraphs: The Treaty of Teschen (German: Frieden von Teschen, lit. 'Peace of Teschen'; French: Traité de Teschen) was signed on 13 May 1779 in Teschen, then in Austrian Silesia, between the Austrian Habsburg monarchy and the Kingdom of Prussia, which officially ended the War of the Bavarian Succession.

Treaty of the Bulls of Guisando.headline: Pogodba iz Toros de Guisando
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Toros de Guisando (špansko: Tratado de los Toros de Guisando) je ime pogodbe, sklenjene 19. septembra 1468 na vrhu griča Guisando blizu kamnitih bikov iz Guisanda (v provinci Ávila v Španiji) med kastiljskim kraljem Henrikom IV. in njegovo polsestro Izabelo Kastiljsko. Pogodba je Izabeli podelila naslov asturijske princese, s čimer je postala domnevna dedinja kastiljske krone.

Leta 1464 je v Kastilji izbruhnila državljanska vojna, ko se je skupina plemičev uprla, da bi Henrika IV. prisilila k odstopu. Do leta 1465 so kralja simbolično odstavili in ga nadomestili z njegovim polbratom Alfonzom. Ko je Alfonz leta 1468 umrl, je nova kandidatka upornikov postala Izabela, polsestra Henrika IV. Izabela se je namesto nadaljevanja državljanske vojne raje pogajala s Henrikom IV. in kot posrednika poslala Giacopa Antonia Veniera.

source.title: Treaty of the Bulls of Guisando
paragraphs: The Treaty of the Bulls of Guisando (Spanish: Tratado de los Toros de Guisando) is the name of a treaty agreed on top of the hill of Guisando near the Bulls of Guisando (located in Ávila, Spain) on 19 September 1468, between Henry IV of Castile and his half-sister Isabella of Castile. The treaty granted Isabella the title of Princess of Asturias and so she became heiress presumptive to the Crown of Castile.

A civil war began in Castile in 1464 when a group of noblemen rebelled in an attempt to force the abdication of Henry IV. By 1465 they had symbolically dethroned the King and replace him with his half-brother Alfonso. With the death of Alfonso, in 1468, Isabella the half-sister of Henry IV, became the new candidate of the rebels. Rather than continuing the civil war, Isabella preferred to negotiate with Henry IV sending Giacopo Antonio Venier as mediator.

Treaty of The Hague (1698).headline: Haaška pogodba (1698)
paragraphs: Haaška pogodba iz leta 1698, znana tudi kot prva delitvena pogodba, je bila eden od dveh poskusov Francije, Velike Britanije in Nizozemske republike, da bi diplomatsko razrešile vprašanja, ki so privedla do vojne za špansko nasledstvo 1701–1714.

Smrt Karla II. so pričakovali že od njegovega nastopa vladavine leta 1665, do leta 1697 pa se je zdela neizogibna in blizu. Ker je bil brez otrok, so bili najbližji dediči iz avstrijske habsburške monarhije ali francoske dinastije Burbonov. Če bi katera od njiju pridobila nerazdeljeno Špansko cesarstvo, bi se spremenilo evropsko ravnotežje moči.

Pogajanja so potekala takoj po finančno uničujoči devetletni vojni (1688–1697), da bi vprašanje razrešili brez nove drage vojne. Pogodba, podpisana 11. oktobra 1698, je za dediča španskega prestola določila šestletnega Jožefa Ferdinanda Bavarskega, evropske posesti Španije pa naj bi si razdelili Francija in Avstrija.
notes: The English variant name (1698 Treaty of Den Haag) is dropped, since Slovenian has one name for the city.
The range 1688-97 is written in full (1688–1697).

source.title: Treaty of The Hague (1698)
paragraphs: The 1698 Treaty of The Hague, also known as the 1698 Treaty of Den Haag or First Partition Treaty was one of two attempts by France, Great Britain, and the Dutch Republic to achieve a diplomatic solution to the issues that led to the 1701–1714 War of the Spanish Succession.

The death of Charles II had been anticipated from his succession in 1665, but by 1697 appeared clearly imminent. As he was childless, the closest heirs were of the Austrian Habsburg monarchy or the French House of Bourbon. The acquisition by either of the undivided Spanish Empire would change the European balance of power.

Negotiations took place immediately after the financially crippling Nine Years' War (1688-97) to attempt to resolve the issue without another expensive war. Signed on 11 October 1698, the treaty made the six-year-old Joseph Ferdinand of Bavaria heir to the Spanish throne, with Spain's European possessions divided between France and Austria.

Treaty of The Hague (1701).headline: Haaška pogodba (1701)
paragraphs: Haaška pogodba je bila podpisana 7. septembra 1701 med Anglijo, cesarjem Svetega rimskega cesarstva Leopoldom I. in Združenimi provincami. Z njo so v odziv na vprašanja, ki so privedla do vojne za špansko nasledstvo, obnovili protifrancosko veliko alianso iz leta 1689.

source.title: Treaty of The Hague (1701)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Den Haag, or Treaty of The Hague, was signed on 7 September 1701 between England, the Holy Roman Emperor Leopold I, and the United Provinces. It reconstituted the 1689 anti-French Grand Alliance in response to the issues that resulted in the War of the Spanish Succession.

Haaški mir je bil podpisan 17. februarja 1720 med Španijo in četverno alianso, ustanovljeno z londonsko pogodbo leta 1718. Njene članice so bile Velika Britanija, Francija, Nizozemska republika in Avstrija.

S podpisom se je Španija pridružila zavezništvu, končala vojno četverne aliance in sprejela pogoje londonske pogodbe. Kot je bilo dogovorjeno že v Utrechtu leta 1713, je Filip V. potrdil, da se odpoveduje francoskemu prestolu, Španija pa zahtevam po nekdanjih italijanskih posestih. V zameno se je cesar Karel VI. odpovedal zahtevi po španskem prestolu, štiriletni Karel Španski pa je bil priznan za dediča vojvodin Parma in Toskana.
Z drugim določilom sta Savoja in Avstrija zamenjali Sicilijo za Sardinijo.

source.title: Treaty of The Hague (1720)
paragraphs: The Treaty of The Hague was signed on 17 February 1720 between Spain and the Quadruple Alliance, established by the 1718 Treaty of London. Its members included Britain, France, the Dutch Republic and Austria.

By signing, Spain joined the Alliance, ending the War of the Quadruple Alliance and accepting the terms of the Treaty of London. As previously agreed at Utrecht in 1713, Philip V confirmed his renunciation of the French throne and Spanish claims to their former Italian possessions. In exchange, Emperor Charles VI renounced his claim on the Spanish throne and four-year-old Charles of Spain was recognised as heir to the Duchies of Parma and Tuscany.
In another clause, Savoy and Austria exchanged Sicily for Sardinia.

Treaty of the Pyrenees.headline: Pirenejski mir
paragraphs: Pirenejski mir je bil podpisan 7. novembra 1659 in je končal francosko-špansko vojno, ki se je začela leta 1635.

Pogajanja so potekala, pogodba pa je bila podpisana na Fazanjem otoku sredi reke Bidasoe na meji med državama, ki je od tedaj francosko-španski kondominij. Podpisali so jo francoski kralj Ludvik XIV. in španski kralj Filip IV. ter njuna glavna ministra, kardinal Mazarin in don Luis Méndez de Haro.

source.title: Treaty of the Pyrenees
paragraphs: The Treaty of the Pyrenees was signed on 7 November 1659 and ended the Franco–Spanish War that had begun in 1635.

Negotiations were conducted and the treaty was signed on Pheasant Island, situated in the middle of the Bidasoa River on the border between the two countries, which has remained a French-Spanish condominium ever since. It was signed by Louis XIV of France and Philip IV of Spain, as well as their chief ministers, Cardinal Mazarin and Don Luis Méndez de Haro.

Torinska pogodba (italijansko: Trattato di Torino; francosko: Traité de Turin), sklenjena 24. marca 1860 med Francijo in Piemont-Sardinijo, je pogodba, s katero je Francija priključila Savojsko vojvodino in grofijo Nica ter tako končala več stoletij dolgo savojsko oblast nad tema območjema.

source.title: Treaty of Turin (1860)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Turin (Italian: Trattato di Torino; French: Traité de Turin) concluded between France and Piedmont-Sardinia on 24 March 1860 is the instrument by which the Duchy of Savoy and the County of Nice were annexed to France, ending the centuries-old Savoyard rule over these regions.

Treaty of Valençay.headline: Pogodba iz Valençaya
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Valençaya je bila predlagani mirovni sporazum med Francijo in Španijo, podpisan 8. decembra 1813, s katerim naj bi končali polotoško vojno. Za Francosko cesarstvo jo je sestavil Antoine René Mathurin, za špansko krono pa José Miguel de Carvajal y Manrique. Imenovana je po dvorcu Valençay v lasti nekdanjega francoskega zunanjega ministra Charlesa Mauricea de Talleyranda, z njo pa so hoteli na španski prestol, ki ga je zasedal Jožef Bonaparte, vrniti španskega kralja Ferdinanda VII., ki ga je Napoleon od leta 1808 držal v ujetništvu.

source.title: Treaty of Valençay
paragraphs: The Treaty of Valençay was a proposed peace agreement between France and Spain, signed on 8 December 1813, aimed at ending the Peninsular War. It was drafted by Antoine René Mathurin for the French Empire and José Miguel de Carvajal y Manrique for the Spanish Crown. Named after the Château de Valençay, owned by former French foreign minister Charles Maurice de Talleyrand, the treaty sought to restore Ferdinand VII of Spain, who had been imprisoned by Napoleon since 1808, to the Spanish throne, which had been occupied by Joseph Bonaparte.

Treaty of Venice.headline: Mir v Benetkah
paragraphs: Mir ali pogodba v Benetkah iz leta 1177 je bil mirovni sporazum med papeštvom in njegovimi zavezniki, severnoitalijanskimi mestnimi državami Lombardske lige, ter svetorimskim cesarjem Friderikom I. Barbarosa. Pogajanj se je udeležila tudi normanska Kraljevina Sicilija, zato je pogodba določila politično smer vse Italije za naslednjih nekaj let.

Pogodba je sledila neposredno po bitki pri Legnanu 29. maja 1176, porazu za Friderika, ki je kmalu zatem poslal odposlance k papežu Aleksandru III. v Anagni in prosil za konec razkola med seboj in Friderikovim protipapežem Kalikstom III. Po sklenitvi predhodnega dogovora so konferenco napovedali za julij 1177. Friderik je v vmesnem času nekaj časa posegal v beneška rivalstva v upanju, da bo ob soočenju na oblasti cesarju naklonjena skupina.

source.title: Treaty of Venice
paragraphs: The Treaty or Peace of Venice, 1177, was a peace treaty between the papacy and its allies, the north Italian city-states of the Lombard League, and Frederick I ”Barbarossa,” Holy Roman Emperor. The Norman Kingdom of Sicily also took part in negotiations and the treaty thereby determined the political course of all Italy for the next several years.

The treaty followed on the heels of the Battle of Legnano of 29 May 1176, a defeat for Frederick, who quickly thereafter sent envoys to Pope Alexander III at Anagni, asking for an end to the schism between him and Frederick's antipope, Callixtus III. After a preliminary agreement was reached, a conference was scheduled for July 1177. Frederick spent some time in the interim interfering in Venetian rivalries in hopes of securing a pro-Imperial group in power at the time of the confrontation.

Treaty of Versailles (1871).headline: Versajska pogodba (1871)
paragraphs: Versajska pogodba iz leta 1871 je končala francosko-prusko vojno; 26. februarja 1871 sta jo podpisala Adolphe Thiers za tretjo francosko republiko in Otto von Bismarck za novoustanovljeno Nemško cesarstvo. Kot predhodna pogodba je utrdila prvotno premirje med silama z dne 28. januarja. Dokončno jo je uveljavila frankfurtska pogodba 10. maja istega leta, ki je potrdila prevlado Nemškega cesarstva: to je Francijo nadomestilo kot vodilno vojaško silo na evropski celini.

Pariški upravni organ, vlada narodne obrambe, je premirje, ki je veljalo od 28. januarja, sklenila s predajo Nemcem, da bi končala obleganje Pariza; to je storil vidni francoski politik Jules Favre, ki se je z Bismarckom sestal v Versaillesu in podpisal premirje. Ko je prišlo do formalne pogodbe, se je kot novi francoski voditelj uveljavil Adolphe Thiers, država pa je začela obnavljati vlado.

source.title: Treaty of Versailles (1871)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Versailles of 1871 ended the Franco-Prussian War and was signed by Adolphe Thiers of the Third French Republic and Otto von Bismarck of the newly formed German Empire on 26 February 1871. A preliminary treaty, it was used to solidify the initial armistice of 28 January between the powers. It was ratified by the Treaty of Frankfurt on 10 May of the same year which confirmed the supremacy of the German Empire, replacing France as the dominant military power on the European continent.

Paris's governing body, the Government of National Defense had made an armistice, effective from 28 January, by surrendering to the Germans to end the siege of Paris; Jules Favre, a prominent French politician, did so, meeting with Bismarck in Versailles to sign the armistice. Adolphe Thiers emerged by the time of a formal treaty as the new French leader as the country began reconstructing its government.

Treaty of Vienna (1606).headline: Dunajski mir leta 1606
paragraphs: Dunajski mir sta 23. junija 1606 sklenila transilvanski knez Štefan Bocskai in cesar Svetega rimskega cesarstva Rudolf II. Po določilih pogodbe so Madžari tako v Transilvaniji kot v Kraljevi Ogrski dobili vse ustavne in verske pravice ter privilegije. V Šopronu je sporazum na primer priznal samoupravo madžarskih luteranov, v Transilvaniji pa so versko strpnost dobili kalvinci. Sporazum je Bocskaija priznal tudi za transilvanskega kneza in Transilvancem zagotovil pravico, da bodo v prihodnje sami volili svoje neodvisne kneze.

Zaradi pomena pogodbe za kalvince na Ogrskem in v Transilvaniji so njene prve stavke in podpis upodobili na reformacijskem zidu v Ženevi, spomeniku pomembnim osebnostim protestantske reformacije, ob kipu Štefana Bocskaija.
notes: The English "Treaty of Vienna (also known as the Peace of Vienna)" gives one name in Slovenian.
The English "autocracy of Hungarian Lutherans" evidently means their self-government; the Slovenian says samouprava.

source.title: Treaty of Vienna (1606)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Vienna (also known as the Peace of Vienna) was signed on 23 June 1606 between Stephen Bocskai, Prince of Transylvania, and Rudolf II, Holy Roman Emperor. Based on the terms of the treaty, all constitutional and religious rights and privileges were granted to the Hungarians in both Transylvania and Royal Hungary. In Sopron, for instance, the agreement recognized the autocracy of Hungarian Lutherans; in Transylvania, the Calvinists gained religious tolerance. The accord also recognized Bocskai as the Prince of Transylvania and guaranteed the right of Transylvanians to elect their own independent princes in the future.

Due to its importance for the Calvinists in Hungary and Transylvania, the first sentences of the treaty and its signing are depicted on the Reformation Wall in Geneva, a monument that honours important figures of the Protestant Reformation, next to the statue of Stephen Bocskay.

Treaty of Vienna (1725).headline: Dunajski mir leta 1725
paragraphs: Dunajski mir, znan tudi kot prva dunajska pogodba, je bil niz štirih pogodb, podpisanih med 30. aprilom in 5. novembrom 1725, v katerih so sodelovali habsburška monarhija, Sveto rimsko cesarstvo (v imenu Avstrije) in burbonska Španija. Nastalo je novo vojaško zavezništvo, ki se mu je pozneje, leta 1726, pridružil Ruski imperij. Zaradi dunajskega zavezništva je Avstrija izstopila iz četverne zveze, kar je povzročilo diplomatski preobrat: druge velesile so se nekaj mesecev pozneje, septembra, povezale v hannovrsko zavezništvo. Nasprotni zavezništvi se nista vojaško spopadli, napetosti pa so leta 1727 privedle do omejene četrte angleško-španske vojne.

source.title: Treaty of Vienna (1725)
paragraphs: The Peace of Vienna, also known as the First Treaty of Vienna, was a series of four treaties signed between 30 April 1725 and 5 November 1725 involving the Habsburg Monarchy, the Holy Roman Empire (on behalf of Austria), and Bourbon Spain. A new military alliance was formed, with the Russian Empire joining later in 1726. This Viennese alliance caused Austria to withdraw from the Quadruple Alliance, resulting in a diplomatic shift which led other great powers to coalesce into the Hanoverian Alliance months later in September. The rival alliances did not clash militarily, although tensions led to the limited Fourth Anglo-Spanish War in 1727.

Treaty of Vienna (1738).headline: Dunajski mir leta 1738
paragraphs: Dunajski mir leta 1738 je končal poljsko nasledstveno vojno. Po njegovih določilih se je Stanisław Leszczyński odpovedal zahtevi po poljskem prestolu in priznal saškega vojvodo Avgusta III. V zameno je dobil vojvodini Loreno in Bar, ki naj bi po njegovi smrti pripadli njegovi hčeri Mariji, ženi francoskega kralja Ludvika XV. Stanisław je umrl leta 1766, njegova hči pa leta 1768.

Lorenski vojvoda Franc Štefan je v odškodnino dobil izpraznjeni prestol Velike vojvodine Toskane, saj je zadnji Medici umrl leta 1737. Francija je v dunajskem miru pristala tudi na pragmatično sankcijo. Po drugem določilu pogodbe je Avstrija Neapeljsko kraljestvo in Kraljevino Sicilijo odstopila parmskemu in piacenškemu vojvodi Karlu, mlajšemu sinu španskega kralja Filipa V. Karel pa je moral Avstriji odstopiti Parmo in se odpovedati zahtevam po toskanskem prestolu v korist Franca Štefana.
notes: The English "Treaty of Vienna or Peace of Vienna" gives one name in Slovenian.

source.title: Treaty of Vienna (1738)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Vienna or Peace of Vienna of 1738 ended the War of the Polish Succession. By the terms of the treaty, Stanisław Leszczyński renounced his claim on the Polish throne and recognized Augustus III, Duke of Saxony. As compensation he received instead the duchies of Lorraine and Bar, which were to pass to his daughter, Maria, the wife of King Louis XV of France, upon his death. Stanisław died in 1766 and his daughter in 1768.

Francis Stephen, who was the Duke of Lorraine, was indemnified with the vacant throne of the Grand Duchy of Tuscany, the last Medici having died in 1737. France also agreed to the Pragmatic Sanction in the Treaty of Vienna. In another provision of the treaty, the kingdoms of Naples and Sicily were ceded by Austria to Duke Charles of Parma and Piacenza, the younger son of King Philip V of Spain. Charles, in turn, had to cede Parma to Austria, and to give up his claims to the throne of Tuscany in favor of Francis Stephen.

Treaty of Vienna (1864).headline: Dunajski mir leta 1864
paragraphs: Dunajski mir (dansko: Freden i Wien; nemško: Frieden von Wien) je bil mirovni sporazum, ki so ga 30. oktobra 1864 na Dunaju podpisali Avstrijsko cesarstvo, Kraljevina Prusija in Kraljevina Danska. Z njim se je končala druga šlezviška vojna. Danska je odstopila Vojvodino Schleswig (razen otoka Ærø, ki je ostal danski), Vojvodino Holstein in Vojvodino Lauenburg, ki sta jih nato Prusija in Avstrija skupaj upravljali kot kondominij. Poznejša pogodba med Avstrijo in Prusijo s 14. avgusta 1865, znana kot gasteinska konvencija, je določila, da bo Prusija upravljala Schleswig, Avstrija pa Holstein. Avstrija je Prusiji prodala tudi svoje pravice nad Lauenburgom. Spori o upravljanju Schleswiga in Holsteina so leta 1866 pripeljali do avstrijsko-pruske vojne. Po koncu te vojne je Prusija priključila Schleswig in Holstein.

source.title: Treaty of Vienna (1864)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Vienna (Danish: Freden i Wien; German: Frieden von Wien) was a peace treaty signed on 30 October 1864 in Vienna between the Austrian Empire, the Kingdom of Prussia, and the Kingdom of Denmark. The treaty ended the Second War of Schleswig. Denmark ceded the Duchy of Schleswig (except for the island of Ærø, which remained Danish) the Duchy of Holstein and the Duchy of Lauenburg. They would be jointly governed by Prussia and Austria in a condominium. A subsequent treaty between Austria and Prussia on August 14, 1865 known as the Gastein Convention provided that Prussia would administer Schleswig and Austria would similarly govern Holstein. Austria also sold its rights over Lauenburg to Prussia. Disputes over the administration of Schleswig and Holstein would lead to the 1866 Austro-Prussian War. When that war was over, Prussia annexed Schleswig and Holstein.

Treaty of Warsaw (1920).headline: Varšavska pogodba leta 1920
paragraphs: Varšavska pogodba (tudi poljsko-ukrajinsko zavezništvo ali sporazum oziroma zavezništvo Petljura–Piłsudski) iz aprila 1920 je bila vojaško-gospodarska zveza med Drugo poljsko republiko, ki jo je zastopal Józef Piłsudski, in Ukrajinsko ljudsko republiko, ki jo je zastopal Simon Petljura, proti boljševiški Rusiji. Pogodbo so podpisali 21. aprila 1920, vojaški dodatek pa 24. aprila.

Zavezništvo so sklenili med poljsko-sovjetsko vojno, tik pred poljsko kijevsko ofenzivo. Piłsudski je iskal zaveznike proti boljševikom in upal, da bo ustvaril zvezo Międzymorze (Medmorje), Petljura pa je v zavezništvu videl zadnjo priložnost za ustanovitev neodvisne Ukrajine.

Pogodba ni imela trajnega učinka. Poljsko-sovjetska vojna se je nadaljevala, sporna ozemlja pa sta si z riškim mirovnim sporazumom leta 1921 razdelili Rusija in Poljska. Ozemlja, ki jih je zahtevalo ukrajinsko narodno gibanje, so razdelili med Ukrajinsko SSR na vzhodu in Poljsko na zahodu (Galicija in del Volinije).
notes: The glossary calls the ukrainian-people-s-republic polity Ukrajinska država (the name of the 1918 Hetmanate); the text uses the accurate Ukrajinska ljudska republika, and the glossary entry needs a look.

source.title: Treaty of Warsaw (1920)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Warsaw (also the Polish–Ukrainian or Petliura–Piłsudski Alliance or Agreement) of April 1920 was a military-economical alliance between the Second Polish Republic, represented by Józef Piłsudski, and the Ukrainian People's Republic, represented by Symon Petliura, against Bolshevik Russia. The treaty was signed on 21 April 1920, with a military addendum on 24 April.

The alliance was signed during the Polish-Soviet War, just before the Polish Kiev offensive. Piłsudski was looking for allies against the Bolsheviks and hoped to create a Międzymorze alliance; Petliura saw the alliance as the last chance to create an independent Ukraine.
