The treaty had no permanent impact. The Polish-Soviet War continued and the territories in question were distributed between Russia and Poland in accordance with the 1921 Peace of Riga. Territories claimed by the Ukrainian national movement were split between the Ukrainian SSR in the east and Poland in the west (Galicia and part of Volhynia).

Treaty of Warsaw (1970).headline: Varšavska pogodba leta 1970
paragraphs: Varšavska pogodba (nemško: Warschauer Vertrag, poljsko: Traktat warszawski) je bila pogodba med Zvezno republiko Nemčijo (Zahodno Nemčijo) in Ljudsko republiko Poljsko. Podpisala sta jo kancler Willy Brandt in predsednik vlade Józef Cyrankiewicz 7. decembra 1970 v Predsedniški palači, zahodnonemški bundestag pa jo je ratificiral 17. maja 1972.

S pogodbo sta se obe strani zavezali k nenasilju in sprejeli obstoječo mejo na Odri in Nisi, ki jo je Nemčiji leta 1945 po koncu druge svetovne vojne vsilila Sovjetska zveza. To je bila od tedaj zelo občutljiva tema, saj se je Poljska bala, da bi nemška vlada utegnila zahtevati nazaj nekatera nekdanja vzhodna ozemlja. S poljskega stališča je bil prenos teh pokrajin nadomestilo za nekdanje poljsko ozemlje vzhodno od Curzonove črte (»Kresy«), ki ga je leta 1939 priključila Sovjetska zveza.

source.title: Treaty of Warsaw (1970)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Warsaw (German: Warschauer Vertrag, Polish: Traktat warszawski) was a treaty between the Federal Republic of Germany (West Germany) and the Polish People’s Republic. It was signed by Chancellor Willy Brandt and Prime Minister Józef Cyrankiewicz at the Presidential Palace on 7 December 1970, and it was ratified by the West German Bundestag on 17 May 1972.

In the treaty, both sides committed themselves to nonviolence and accepted the existing border—the Oder–Neisse line, imposed on Germany by the Soviet Union in 1945 following the end of World War II. This had been a quite sensitive topic since then, as Poland was concerned that a German government might seek to reclaim some of the former eastern territories. From the Polish perspective, the transfer of these regions was considered to be a compensation for the former Polish territory east of the Curzon Line ("Kresy"), which had been annexed by the Soviet Union in 1939.

Treaty of Westminster (1674).headline: Westminstrska pogodba (1674)
paragraphs: Westminstrska pogodba iz leta 1674 je bila mirovna pogodba, ki je končala tretjo angleško-nizozemsko vojno. Podpisali sta jo Nizozemska republika in Kraljevina Anglija, določala pa je vrnitev kolonije Nova Nizozemska (danes New York) Angliji in obnovila bredsko pogodbo iz leta 1667. Predvidela je tudi mešano komisijo za urejanje trgovine, zlasti v Vzhodni Indiji.

Angleški kralj Karel II. jo je podpisal 9. februarja 1674 po starem koledarju (19. februarja 1674 po novem), generalni stanovi Nizozemske pa so jo ratificirali 5. marca 1674. Anglija je morala pogodbo podpisati, ker parlament ni dovolil porabiti več denarja za vojno in je izvedel za tajno doversko pogodbo, v kateri je Karel francoskemu kralju Ludviku XIV. obljubil, da bo ob primernem trenutku prestopil v katoliško vero. Angleže je potrlo nepričakovano dejstvo, da so nizozemski kaperji zajeli več angleških ladij kot obratno in da so Nizozemci leta 1673 znova zavzeli Novi Amsterdam.

source.title: Treaty of Westminster (1674)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Westminster of 1674 was the peace treaty that ended the Third Anglo-Dutch War. Signed by the Dutch Republic and the Kingdom of England, the treaty provided for the return of the colony of New Netherland (now New York) to England and renewed the Treaty of Breda of 1667. The treaty also provided for a mixed commission for the regulation of commerce, particularly in the East Indies.

It was signed on 9 February 1674 Old Style (19 February 1674 New Style) by Charles II of England and ratified by the States General of the Netherlands on 5 March 1674. England was forced to sign the treaty since Parliament would not allow more money to be spent on the war and had become aware of the secret Treaty of Dover in which Charles had promised Louis XIV of France to convert to Catholicism at an opportune moment. The English were dismayed by the unexpected fact that Dutch raiders had managed to capture more English ships than vice versa and that New Amsterdam had been retaken by the Dutch in 1673.

Treaty of Xanten.headline: Xantenska pogodba
paragraphs: Xantensko pogodbo (nemško: Vertrag von Xanten) sta 12. novembra 1614 v spodnjerenskem mestu Xanten ob posredovanju predstavnikov Anglije in Francije podpisala neuburški pfalški grof Wolfgang Wilhelm in brandenburški volilni knez Janez Sigismund. Sporazum je uradno končal vojno za jülichško nasledstvo in Združene vojvodine Jülich-Kleve-Berg razdelil med Wilhelma in Sigismunda.

source.title: Treaty of Xanten
paragraphs: The Treaty of Xanten (German: Vertrag von Xanten) was signed in the Lower Rhenish town of Xanten on 12 November 1614 between Wolfgang Wilhelm, Count Palatine of Neuburg and John Sigismund, Elector of Brandenburg, with representatives from England and France serving as mediators. The accord officially ended the War of the Jülich Succession and divided the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg between Wilhelm and Sigismund.

Treaty of York.headline: Yorška pogodba
paragraphs: Yorška pogodba je bila sporazum med angleškim kraljem Henrikom III. in škotskim kraljem Aleksandrom II., podpisan 25. septembra 1237 v Yorku, ki je potrdil, da so Northumberland (ki je tedaj obsegal tudi grofijo Durham), Cumberland in Westmorland pod angleško suverenostjo. S tem je bila določena angleško-škotska meja v obliki, ki je do danes ostala skoraj nespremenjena (spremembe so zadevale le sporna ozemlja Debatable Lands in Berwick-upon-Tweed). Pogodba je podrobno določila prihodnji status več fevdalnih posesti in obravnavala druga vprašanja med kraljema, zgodovinsko pa je pomenila konec poskusov Kraljevine Škotske, da bi mejo pomaknila proti jugu.

source.title: Treaty of York
paragraphs: The Treaty of York was an agreement between the kings Henry III of England and Alexander II of Scotland, signed at York on 25 September 1237, which affirmed that Northumberland (which at the time also encompassed County Durham), Cumberland, and Westmorland were subject to English sovereignty. This established the Anglo-Scottish border in a form that remains almost unchanged to modern times (the only modifications have been regarding the Debatable Lands and Berwick-upon-Tweed). The treaty detailed the future status of several feudal properties and addressed other issues between the two kings, and historically marked the end of the Kingdom of Scotland's attempts to extend its frontier southward.

Treaty of Zadar.headline: Zadrski mir
paragraphs: Zadrski mir, imenovan tudi mir v Zari, je bil mirovni sporazum, podpisan 18. februarja 1358 v Zadru v Dalmaciji. Beneška republika je z njim izgubila vpliv nad svojimi dalmatinskimi posestmi, v zameno pa je ogrski kralj Ludvik I. končal sovražnosti z njo. Oba sta se potegovala za nadzor nad vrsto ozemelj na vzhodni jadranski obali, na območju današnje Hrvaške.
notes: Headline after the established Slovenian name zadrski mir rather than the pattern mir v X.

source.title: Treaty of Zadar
paragraphs: The Treaty of Zadar, also known as the Treaty of Zara, was a peace treaty signed in Zadar, Dalmatia on February 18, 1358. Under the treaty, the Venetian Republic lost influence over its Dalmatian holdings in exchange for ending hostilities with Louis I of Hungary. Both had been contesting control of a series of territories along the eastern Adriatic coastline in what is now Croatia.

Treaty of Zaragoza.headline: Zaragoška pogodba
paragraphs: Zaragoška pogodba ali kapitulacija iz Zaragoze je bila mirovna pogodba med Kastiljo in Portugalsko, ki sta jo 22. aprila 1529 v aragonskem mestu Zaragoza podpisala portugalski kralj Ivan III. in habsburški cesar Karel V. Pogodba je določila območji kastiljskega in portugalskega vpliva v Aziji, da bi razrešila »moluško vprašanje«, ki je nastalo, ker sta obe kraljestvi zase zahtevali donosne Otoke začimb (danes indonezijske Moluke) in trdili, da ležijo na njunem vplivnem območju, kot ga je leta 1494 določila pogodba iz Tordesillasa. Spor se je začel leta 1520, ko so odprave obeh kraljestev dosegle Tihi ocean, saj na Daljnem vzhodu ni bilo dogovorjenega poldnevnika.

source.title: Treaty of Zaragoza
paragraphs: The Treaty of Zaragoza or Saragossa, also called the Capitulation of Zaragoza or Saragossa, was a peace treaty between Castile and Portugal, signed on 22 April 1529 by King John III of Portugal and the Habsburg Emperor Charles V in the Aragonese city of Zaragoza. The treaty defined the areas of Castilian and Portuguese influence in Asia in order to resolve the "Moluccas issue", which had arisen because both kingdoms claimed the lucrative Spice Islands (now Indonesia's Malukus) for themselves, asserting that they were within their area of influence as specified in 1494 by the Treaty of Tordesillas. The conflict began in 1520, when expeditions from both kingdoms reached the Pacific Ocean, because no agreed meridian of longitude had been established in the far east.

Treaty of Zgorzelec.headline: Pogodba iz Zgorzelca
paragraphs: Pogodbo iz Zgorzelca, uradno Sporazum o razmejitvi določene in obstoječe poljsko-nemške državne meje, znano tudi kot pogodba iz Görlitza, sta 6. julija 1950 v Zgorzelcu na Poljskem podpisali Republika Poljska in Vzhodna Nemčija (NDR).
notes: The variant spelling "Treaty of Zgorzelic" in the English is dropped.

source.title: Treaty of Zgorzelec
paragraphs: The Treaty of Zgorzelec, officially the The Agreement Concerning the Demarcation of the Established and the Existing Polish-German State Frontier, also known as the Treaty of Görlitz and Treaty of Zgorzelic between the Republic of Poland and East Germany (GDR) was signed on 6 July 1950 in Zgorzelec, Poland.

Treaty on Conventional Armed Forces in E.headline: Pogodba o konvencionalnih oboroženih silah v Evropi
paragraphs: Prvotna Pogodba o konvencionalnih oboroženih silah v Evropi (CFE) je bila izpogajana in sklenjena v zadnjih letih hladne vojne; določila je celovite omejitve ključnih kategorij konvencionalne vojaške opreme v Evropi (od Atlantika do Urala) in zahtevala uničenje presežnega orožja. Pogodba je predlagala enake omejitve za obe »skupini držav pogodbenic«, Organizacijo Severnoatlantske pogodbe (Nato) in Varšavski pakt. Leta 1999 so podpisali prilagojeno pogodbo CFE, da bi upoštevali spremenjene geopolitične razmere in razpad Varšavskega pakta, a je Nato ni hotel ratificirati, ker Rusija ni izpolnjevala istanbulskih zavez. Leta 2007 je Rusija »suspendirala« sodelovanje v pogodbi, pri čemer se je sklicevala na navzočnost ZDA v vzhodni Evropi in na to, da Nato ni ratificiral prilagojene pogodbe CFE. Rusija je 10. marca 2015 ob sklicevanju na to, da naj bi Nato pogodbo dejansko kršil, uradno sporočila, da s prihodnjim dnem »povsem« preneha sodelovati. Rusija je 7. novembra 2023 izstopila iz pogodbe, v odgovor pa so Združene države in njihove zaveznice v Natu suspendirale svoje sodelovanje. Od tedaj so sodelovanje suspendirale skoraj vse druge pogodbenice.

source.title: Treaty on Conventional Armed Forces in Europe
paragraphs: The original Treaty on Conventional Armed Forces in Europe (CFE) was negotiated and concluded during the last years of the Cold War and established comprehensive limits on key categories of conventional military equipment in Europe (from the Atlantic to the Urals) and mandated the destruction of excess weaponry. The treaty proposed equal limits for the two "groups of states-parties", the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) and the Warsaw Pact. In 1999, the Adapted CFE was signed to take in consideration the changed geopolitical realities and the disbanding of the Warsaw Pact, but NATO refused to ratify it, citing Russian failure to comply to the Istanbul Commitments. In 2007, Russia "suspended" its participation in the treaty, citing the US presence in Eastern Europe and NATO's refusal to ratify the Adapted CFE treaty. On 10 March 2015, citing NATO's alleged de facto breach of the Treaty, Russia formally announced it was "completely" halting its participation as of the next day. On 7 November 2023, Russia withdrew from the treaty, and in response the United States and its NATO allies suspended their participation in the treaty. Almost all other parties have since suspended their participation.

Truce of Altmark.headline: Altmarško premirje
paragraphs: Šestletno altmarško premirje (ali pogodbo iz Starega Targa, poljsko: Rozejm w Altmarku, švedsko: Stillståndet i Altmark) sta 26. septembra (po starem koledarju 16. septembra) 1629 v vasi Altmark (Stary Targ) na Poljskem ob pomoči Richelieujevega odposlanca Charnacéja podpisali Republika obeh narodov in Švedska. Z njim se je končala poljsko-švedska vojna (1626–1629), švedski kralj Gustav Adolf pa je dobil proste roke za vstop v tridesetletno vojno.

source.title: Truce of Altmark
paragraphs: The six-year Truce of Altmark (or Treaty of Stary Targ, Polish: Rozejm w Altmarku, Swedish: Stillståndet i Altmark) was signed on 26 September [O.S. 16 September] 1629 in the village of Altmark (Stary Targ), in Poland, by the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Sweden, with help from Richelieu's envoy Charnacé, ending the Polish–Swedish War (1626–1629), and freeing King Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden to enter the Thirty Years' War.

Truce of Ulm (1647).headline: Ulmsko premirje
paragraphs: Ulmsko premirje (nemško: Waffenstillstand von Ulm), znano tudi kot ulmska pogodba, so 14. marca 1647 v Ulmu podpisale Francija, Švedska in Bavarska. Do premirja je prišlo, potem ko sta Francija in Švedska med tridesetletno vojno vdrli na Bavarsko. Napadalki sta bavarskega volilnega kneza Maksimilijana I. prisilili, da je sklenil premirje in se odpovedal zavezništvu s cesarjem Ferdinandom III. Maksimilijan pa je 14. septembra premirje prekršil in se vrnil v zavezništvo s Ferdinandom.

source.title: Truce of Ulm (1647)
paragraphs: The Truce of Ulm (German: Waffenstillstand von Ulm) (also known as the Treaty of Ulm) was signed in Ulm on 14 March 1647 between France, Sweden, and Bavaria. This truce was developed after France and Sweden invaded Bavaria during the Thirty Years' War. Both invading nations forced Maximilian I, Elector of Bavaria, to conclude the truce and renounce his alliance with Emperor Ferdinand III. However, Maximilian broke the truce on 14 September and returned to his alliance with Ferdinand.

Tsardom of Vidin.headline: Vidinsko carstvo
paragraphs: Vidinsko carstvo (bolgarsko: Видинско Царство) je bilo srednjeveška bolgarska država s središčem v mestu Vidin, ki je obstajala v letih 1369–1396.

source.title: Tsardom of Vidin
paragraphs: The Tsardom of Vidin (Bulgarian: Видинско Царство, romanized: Vidinsko Tsarstvo) was a medieval Bulgarian state centred in the city of Vidin from 1369–1396.

Tumult of Aranjuez.headline: Upor v Aranjuezu
paragraphs: Upor v Aranjuezu (špansko: Motín de Aranjuez), znan tudi kot punt v Aranjuezu, je bil vstaja proti predsedniku vlade Manuelu Godoyu in španskemu kralju Karlu IV., ki je potekala 17.–19. marca 1808 v mestu Aranjuez. Spodbudili so jo nezadovoljni meščani in privrženci Karlovega sina Ferdinanda VII. Dogodek, ki ga vsako leto praznujejo v prvem tednu septembra, je privedel do Godoyevega padca, odstopa Karla IV. in nato nastopa Ferdinanda VII. Praznujejo ga septembra in ne marca, ker so obnovljeno praznovanje v Aranjuezu, ki se je začelo leta 1988, pridružili že obstoječim septembrskim slovesnostim.

source.title: Tumult of Aranjuez
paragraphs: The Tumult of Aranjuez (Spanish: Motín de Aranjuez), also known as the Mutiny of Aranjuez, was an uprising against Prime Minister Manuel Godoy and Charles IV of Spain that took place in the town of Aranjuez on 17–19 March 1808. It was instigated by disgruntled citizens and the supporters of Charles's son Ferdinand VII. Celebrated annually in the first week of September, the event led to the fall of Godoy and abdication of Charles IV and the subsequent accession of Ferdinand VII. It is celebrated in September rather than in March as the revived celebrations in Aranjuez that began in 1988 were added on top of pre-existing September festivals.

U.S.–Austrian Peace Treaty (1921).headline: Ameriško-avstrijska mirovna pogodba
paragraphs: Ameriško-avstrijska mirovna pogodba je mirovni sporazum med ZDA in Avstrijo, podpisan 24. avgusta 1921 na Dunaju po prvi svetovni vojni. Ločena mirovna pogodba je bila potrebna, ker senat ZDA ni dal soglasja k ratifikaciji večstranske mirovne pogodbe iz Saint-Germain-en-Laya iz leta 1919.
Ratifikacijske listine so izmenjali na Dunaju 8. novembra 1921 in pogodba je začela veljati istega dne. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov so jo registrirali 22. novembra 1921.

source.title: U.S.–Austrian Peace Treaty (1921)
paragraphs: The U.S.–Austrian Peace Treaty is a peace treaty between the United States and Austria, signed in Vienna on August 24, 1921, in the aftermath of the First World War. This separate peace treaty was required because the United States Senate refused to advise and consent to the ratification of the multilateral Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye of 1919.
Ratifications were exchanged in Vienna on November 8, 1921, and the treaty became effective on the same day. The treaty was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on November 22, 1921.

U.S.–German Peace Treaty (1921).headline: Ameriško-nemška mirovna pogodba
paragraphs: Ameriško-nemška mirovna pogodba je bila mirovni sporazum med ameriško in nemško vlado. Podpisali so jo v Berlinu 25. avgusta 1921 po prvi svetovni vojni. Glavni razlog zanjo je bil, da senat ZDA ni privolil v ratifikacijo večstranske mirovne pogodbe, podpisane v Versaillesu, zato je bila potrebna ločena mirovna pogodba. Ratifikacijske listine so izmenjali v Berlinu 11. novembra 1921 in pogodba je začela veljati istega dne. V zbirki pogodb Društva narodov so jo registrirali 12. avgusta 1922.

source.title: U.S.–German Peace Treaty (1921)
paragraphs: The U.S.–German Peace Treaty was a peace treaty between the U.S. and the German governments. It was signed in Berlin on August 25, 1921 in the aftermath of World War I. The main reason for the conclusion of that treaty was that the U.S. Senate did not consent to ratification of the multilateral peace treaty signed in Versailles, thus leading to a separate peace treaty. Ratifications were exchanged in Berlin on November 11, 1921, and the treaty became effective on the same day. The treaty was registered in League of Nations Treaty Series on August 12, 1922.

United Nations Convention Against Transn.headline: Konvencija ZN proti mednarodnemu organiziranemu kriminalu
paragraphs: Konvencija Združenih narodov proti mednarodnemu organiziranemu kriminalu (angleška kratica UNTOC, imenovana tudi palermska konvencija) je večstranska pogodba iz leta 2000 pod okriljem Združenih narodov proti mednarodnemu organiziranemu kriminalu.

source.title: United Nations Convention Against Transnational Organized Crime
paragraphs: The United Nations Convention Against Transnational Organized Crime (UNTOC, also called the Palermo Convention) is a 2000 United Nations-sponsored multilateral treaty against transnational organized crime.

United Nations Convention on Contracts f.headline: Konvencija ZN o pogodbah o mednarodni prodaji blaga
paragraphs: Konvencija Združenih narodov o pogodbah o mednarodni prodaji blaga (CISG), včasih imenovana tudi dunajska konvencija, je večstranska pogodba, ki določa enoten okvir za mednarodno trgovino. Septembra 2023 jo je ratificiralo ali k njej pristopilo 97 držav, ki predstavljajo dve tretjini svetovne trgovine.

CISG olajšuje mednarodno trgovino, saj odpravlja pravne ovire med pogodbenicami (»državami pogodbenicami«) in določa enotna pravila za večino vidikov trgovinskega posla, kot so sklenitev pogodbe, način dobave, obveznosti strank in pravna sredstva ob kršitvi pogodbe. Če je pogodba izrecno ne izključi, je konvencija samodejno del notranjega prava držav pogodbenic in se neposredno uporablja za posle z blagom med njihovimi državljani.

source.title: United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods
paragraphs: The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG), sometimes known as the Vienna Convention, is a multilateral treaty that establishes a uniform framework for international commerce. As of September 2023, it has been ratified or acceded to by 97 countries, representing two-thirds of world trade.

The CISG facilitates international trade by removing legal barriers among state parties (known as "Contracting States") and providing uniform rules that govern most aspects of a commercial transaction, such as contract formation, the means of delivery, parties' obligations, and remedies for breach of contract. Unless expressly excluded by the contract, the convention is automatically incorporated into the domestic laws of Contracting States and applies directly to a transaction of goods between their nationals.

Združeni kneževini Moldavije in Vlaške (romunsko: Principatele Unite ale Moldovei și Țării Românești), ki ju običajno imenujejo kar Združeni kneževini ali Vlaška in Moldavija, sta bili v personalni uniji povezani Kneževina Moldavija in Kneževina Vlaška. Unija je nastala 5. februarja [24. januarja po starem koledarju] 1859, ko je bil Alexandru Ioan Cuza izvoljen za domnitorja (vladajočega kneza) obeh kneževin. Kljub združitvi sta kneževini ostali vsaka zase avtonomni vazalni državi Osmanskega cesarstva. Moldavija in Vlaška sta se 3. februarja [22. januarja po starem koledarju] 1862 formalno združili v Romunske združene kneževine oziroma Romunijo, jedro romunske nacionalne države.

source.title: United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia
paragraphs: The United Principalities of Moldavia and Wallachia (Romanian: Principatele Unite ale Moldovei și Țării Românești), commonly called United Principalities or Wallachia and Moldavia, was the personal union of the Principality of Moldavia and the Principality of Wallachia. The union was formed on 5 February [O.S. 24 January] 1859 when Alexandru Ioan Cuza was elected as the Domnitor (Ruling Prince) of both principalities. Their separate autonomous vassalage in the Ottoman Empire continued with the unification of both principalities. On 3 February [O.S. 22 January] 1862, Moldavia and Wallachia formally united to create the Romanian United Principalities or Romania the core of the Romanian nation state.

Univerzalna konvencija o avtorski pravici (UCC) je mednarodni instrument, ki so ga leta 1952 pripravili pod okriljem Unesca. Sprejeli so jo leta 1952 v Ženevi v Švici, veljati pa je začela leta 1955. Skupaj z bernsko konvencijo je ena od dveh glavnih mednarodnih konvencij za varstvo avtorske pravice.

source.title: Universal Copyright Convention
paragraphs: Universal Copyright Convention (UCC) is an international instrument which was drawn up in 1952 under the auspices of UNESCO. The UCC was adopted in Geneva, Switzerland, in 1952, and enforced in 1955. It is one of the two principal international conventions protecting copyright; the other is the Berne Convention.

Vermandois.headline: Vermandois
paragraphs: Vermandois je bil francoska grofija, ki se je pojavila v merovinškem obdobju. Ime izhaja iz imena starodavnega plemena Viromandujev. V 10. stoletju je bila organizirana okoli dveh kastelanij: Saint-Quentina (Aisne) in Péronna (Somme). Danes bi grofija Vermandois spadala v pokrajino Pikardija na severu Francije.

Pipin I. Vermandoiški, najzgodnejši dedni grof, je bil v neposredni moški liniji potomec cesarja Karla Velikega. Bolj znan je bil njegov vnuk Herbert II. (902–943), ki je precej povečal ozemeljsko moč rodbine Vermandois in šest let držal v ujetništvu zakonitega francoskega kralja, nesrečnega Karla Preprostega. Herbert II. je bil sin Herberta I., gospoda Péronna in Saint-Quentina, ki ga je leta 902 ubil morilec, ki ga je plačal flandrijski grof Balduin II. Njegovi nasledniki Albert I., Herbert III., Albert II., Oton in Herbert IV. zgodovinsko niso bili tako pomembni.
notes: The French pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Vermandois
paragraphs: Vermandois (French pronunciation: [vɛʁmɑ̃dwa]) was a French county that appeared in the Merovingian period. Its name derives from that of an ancient tribe, the Viromandui. In the 10th century, it was organised around two castellan domains: St Quentin (Aisne) and Péronne (Somme). In today's times, the Vermandois county would fall in the Picardy region of northern France.

Pepin I of Vermandois, the earliest of its hereditary counts, was descended in direct male line from the emperor Charlemagne. More famous was his grandson Herbert II (902–943), who considerably increased the territorial power of the house of Vermandois, and kept the lawful king of France, the unlucky Charles the Simple, prisoner for six years. Herbert II was son of Herbert I, lord of Péronne and St Quentin, who was killed in 902 by an assassin in the pay of Baldwin II, Count of Flanders. His successors, Albert I, Herbert III, Albert II, Otto and Herbert IV, were not as historically significant.

Veronese Easter.headline: Veronska velika noč
paragraphs: Veronska velika noč (italijansko: Pasque Veronesi, ednina Pasqua Veronese; francosko: Pâques véronaises) je bila vstaja med italijansko kampanjo leta 1797, v kateri so se prebivalci Verone in okolice uprli francoskim okupacijskim silam pod poveljstvom Antoina Ballanda, medtem ko se je Napoleon Bonaparte (francoski vrhovni poveljnik v italijanski kampanji) bojeval v Avstriji. Vstaja je ime dobila po zvezi s protifrancoskim uporom sicilske večernice iz 13. stoletja. Sprožilo jo je zatiralsko vedenje Francozov (zaplemba premoženja veronskih meščanov in spletkarjenje za strmoglavljenje mestne oblasti): začela se je zjutraj 17. aprila 1797, na drugi dan velike noči, razjarjeno prebivalstvo pa je v prvi uri bojev premagalo več kot tisoč francoskih vojakov in jih prisililo, da so se zatekli v mestne utrdbe, ki jih je množica nato zavzela s silo. Upor se je končal 25. aprila 1797, ko je mesto obkolilo in zavzelo 15.000 vojakov, ki so mu nato naložili ogromno denarno kazen in ga prisilili, da je izročilo različno premoženje, tudi umetnine.

source.title: Veronese Easter
paragraphs: The Veronese Easter (Italian: Pasque Veronesi, or singular Pasqua Veronese; French: Pâques véronaises) was a rebellion during the Italian campaign of 1797, in which inhabitants of Verona and the surrounding areas revolted against the French occupying forces under Antoine Balland, while Napoleon Bonaparte (the French supreme commander in the Italian campaign) was fighting in Austria. The uprising received its name through association with the anti-French uprising of the Sicilian Vespers of the 13th century. Incited by oppressive behaviour by the French (confiscating the assets of Verona's citizens and plotting to overthrow the city's local government), it began on the morning of 17 April 1797, the second day of Easter: the enraged population succeeded in defeating more than a thousand French soldiers in the first hour of fighting, forcing them to take refuge in the town's fortifications, which the mob then captured by force. The revolt ended on 25 April 1797 with the encirclement and capture of the town by 15,000 soldiers, who then forced it to pay a huge fine and hand over various assets, including artwork.

Vexin.headline: Vexin
paragraphs: Vexin je zgodovinska grofija na severu Francije. Obsega zeleno planoto na desnem (severnem) bregu Sene, ki se od vzhoda proti zahodu razteza približno med Pontoisom in Romilly-sur-Andelle (okoli 20 km od Rouena), od severa proti jugu pa med Auneuilom in Seno pri Vernonu. Planoto prečkata dolini rek Epte in Andelle.
notes: The French pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Vexin
paragraphs: Vexin (French pronunciation: [vɛksɛ̃]) is a historical county of northern France. It covers a verdant plateau on the right bank (north) of the Seine running roughly east to west between Pontoise and Romilly-sur-Andelle (about 20 km from Rouen), and north to south between Auneuil and the Seine near Vernon. The plateau is crossed by the Epte and the Andelle river valleys.

Dunajska konvencija o zaščiti ozonskega plašča je večstranski okoljski sporazum, podpisan leta 1985, ki je postavil okvire za mednarodno zmanjšanje proizvodnje klorofluoroogljikovodikov, ker ti prispevajo k uničevanju ozonskega plašča, to pa povečuje nevarnost kožnega raka.

source.title: Vienna Convention for the Protection of the Ozone Layer
paragraphs: The Vienna Convention for the Protection of the Ozone Layer is a multilateral environmental agreement signed in 1985 that provided frameworks for international reductions in the production of chlorofluorocarbons due to their contribution to the destruction of the ozone layer, resulting in an increased threat of skin cancer.

Vienna Convention on Consular Relations.headline: Dunajska konvencija o konzularnih odnosih
paragraphs: Dunajska konvencija o konzularnih odnosih je mednarodna pogodba, ki določa okvir konzularnih odnosov med suverenimi državami. Kodificira številne konzularne prakse, ki so izšle iz državnih običajev in različnih dvostranskih sporazumov med državami.

Konzuli tradicionalno zastopajo interese držav ali njihovih državljanov v veleposlaništvu ali konzulatu v drugi državi. Konvencija opredeljuje naloge, pravice in imunitete konzularnih uradnikov in njihovih uradov ter pravice in dolžnosti »držav sprejemnic« (kjer konzul deluje) in »držav pošiljateljic« (držav, ki jih konzul zastopa).
Pogodbo, sprejeto leta 1963 in veljavno od leta 1967, je ratificiralo 182 držav.

source.title: Vienna Convention on Consular Relations
paragraphs: The Vienna Convention on Consular Relations is an international treaty that defines a framework for consular relations between sovereign states. It codifies many consular practices that originated from state custom and various bilateral agreements between states.

Consuls have traditionally been employed to represent the interests of states or their nationals at an embassy or consulate in another country. The Convention defines and articulates the functions, rights, and immunities accorded to consular officers and their offices, as well as the rights and duties of "receiving States" (where the consul is based) and "sending States" (the state the consul represents).
Adopted in 1963, and in force since 1967, the treaty has been ratified by 182 states.

Dunajska konvencija o diplomatskih odnosih iz leta 1961 je mednarodna pogodba, ki določa okvir diplomatskih odnosov med neodvisnimi državami. Njen namen je z enotnimi praksami in načeli olajšati »razvoj prijateljskih odnosov« med vladami; predvsem kodificira dolgo uveljavljeni običaj diplomatske imunitete, po katerem diplomatska predstavništva uživajo privilegije, ki diplomatom omogočajo, da opravljajo svoje naloge brez strahu pred prisilo ali nadlegovanjem države gostiteljice. Dunajska konvencija je temelj sodobnih mednarodnih odnosov in mednarodnega prava, ratificirale in spoštujejo jo skoraj vse države, velja pa za enega najuspešnejših pravnih instrumentov, pripravljenih v okviru Združenih narodov.

source.title: Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations
paragraphs: The Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations of 1961 is an international treaty that defines a framework for diplomatic relations between independent countries. Its aim is to facilitate "the development of friendly relations" among governments through a uniform set of practices and principles; most notably, it codifies the longstanding custom of diplomatic immunity, in which diplomatic missions are granted privileges that enable diplomats to perform their functions without fear of coercion or harassment by the host country. The Vienna Convention is a cornerstone of modern international relations and international law and is almost universally ratified and observed; it is considered one of the most successful legal instruments drafted under the United Nations.

Konvencija o prometnih znakih in signalizaciji, splošno znana kot Dunajska konvencija o prometnih znakih in signalizaciji, je večstranska pogodba, ki določa mednarodni standard za sisteme označevanja v cestnem prometu, kot so prometni znaki, semaforji in talne označbe.

O konvenciji se je dogovoril Ekonomsko-socialni svet Združenih narodov na konferenci o cestnem prometu na Dunaju v Avstriji od 7. oktobra do 8. novembra 1968. Zadnji dan konference jo je podpisalo enaintrideset držav, veljati pa je začela 6. junija 1978. Na tej konferenci so sprejeli tudi Dunajsko konvencijo o cestnem prometu, ki dopolnjuje poenotenje mednarodnih prometnih predpisov.

source.title: Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals
paragraphs: The Convention on Road Signs and Signals, commonly known as the Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals, is a multilateral treaty that establishes an international standard for signing systems for road traffic, such as road signs, traffic lights and road markings.

The Convention was agreed upon by the United Nations Economic and Social Council at its Conference on Road Traffic in Vienna, Austria from 7 October to 8 November 1968. Thirty-one countries signed the Convention on the final day of the conference, and it entered into force on 6 June 1978. This conference also produced the Vienna Convention on Road Traffic, which provides complementary standardising of international traffic laws.

Dunajska konvencija o cestnem prometu je mednarodna pogodba, katere namen je olajšati mednarodni cestni promet in povečati prometno varnost z enotnimi prometnimi pravili med pogodbenicami. O konvenciji so se dogovorili na konferenci Ekonomsko-socialnega sveta Združenih narodov o cestnem prometu (7. oktobra – 8. novembra 1968), sklenili pa so jo na Dunaju 8. novembra 1968. Na isti konferenci so sprejeli tudi Konvencijo o prometnih znakih in signalizaciji. Konvencijo so spremenili 3. septembra 1993 in 28. marca 2006. Konvencijo o cestnem prometu (1968) dopolnjuje evropski sporazum, sklenjen 1. maja 1971 v Ženevi.

source.title: Vienna Convention on Road Traffic
paragraphs: The Vienna Convention on Road Traffic is an international treaty designed to facilitate international road traffic and to increase road safety by establishing standard traffic rules among the contracting parties. The convention was agreed upon at the United Nations Economic and Social Council's Conference on Road Traffic (7 October – 8 November 1968) and concluded in Vienna on 8 November 1968. This conference also produced the Convention on Road Signs and Signals. The convention had amendments on 3 September 1993 and 28 March 2006. There is a European Agreement supplementing the Convention on Road Traffic (1968), which was concluded in Geneva on 1 May 1971.

Vienna Convention on Succession of State.headline: Dunajska konvencija o nasledstvu držav glede pogodb
paragraphs: Dunajska konvencija o nasledstvu držav glede pogodb je mednarodna pogodba, ki so jo leta 1978 odprli za podpis, da bi določila pravila o nasledstvu držav. Sprejeli so jo deloma kot odgovor na »globoko preobrazbo mednarodne skupnosti, ki jo je povzročila dekolonizacija«. Veljati je začela 6. novembra 1996, ko je k pogodbi kot naslednica pristopila Republika Severna Makedonija in s tem zagotovila potrebnih 15 pogodbenic.
Pogodba je sporna predvsem zato, ker razlikuje med »novimi neodvisnimi državami« (evfemizem za nekdanje kolonije) in »primeri odcepitve delov države« (evfemizem za vse druge nove države).

source.title: Vienna Convention on Succession of States in Respect of Treaties
paragraphs: The Vienna Convention on Succession of States in Respect of Treaties is an international treaty opened for signature in 1978 to set rules on succession of states. It was adopted partly in response to the "profound transformation of the international community brought about by the decolonization process". It entered into force on 6 November 1996, which was triggered by the succession of the Republic of North Macedonia to the treaty giving it the requisite 15 parties.

The treaty has proven to be controversial largely because it distinguishes between "newly independent states" (a euphemism for former colonies) and "cases of separation of parts of a state" (a euphemism for all other new states).
Dunajska konvencija o pravu mednarodnih pogodb (VCLT) je mednarodni sporazum, ki ureja pogodbe med suverenimi državami.

VCLT, znana kot »pogodba o pogodbah«, določa celovite, uporabne smernice, pravila in postopke za pripravo, opredelitev, spreminjanje in razlago pogodb. Pogodbo opredeljuje kot pisni mednarodni sporazum, sklenjen med državami, ki ga ureja mednarodno pravo.

Dunajsko konvencijo o pravu mednarodnih pogodb so sprejeli in odprli za podpis 23. maja 1969, veljati je začela 27. januarja 1980, do maja 2026 pa jo je ratificiralo 119 suverenih držav. Države, ki je niso ratificirale, kot so ZDA, so dele VCLT priznale kot ponovitev mednarodnega običajnega prava. V pogodbenem pravu je VCLT merodajna za reševanje sporov o razlagi pogodb.

source.title: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties
paragraphs: The Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (VCLT) is an international agreement that regulates treaties among sovereign states.

Known as the "treaty on treaties", the VCLT establishes comprehensive, operational guidelines, rules, and procedures for how treaties are drafted, defined, amended, and interpreted. The VCLT defines a treaty as an international agreement in writing concluded between states governed by international law.

The Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties was adopted and opened to signature on 23 May 1969, became effective on 27 January 1980, and has been ratified by 119 sovereign states as of May 2026. Non-ratifying parties, such as the U.S., have recognized parts of the VCLT as a restatement of customary international law. In treaty law, the VCLT is the authority for resolving disputes about the interpretation of a treaty.

Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties.headline: Dunajska konvencija o pravu pogodb med državami in mednarodnimi organizacijami ali med mednarodnimi organizacijami
paragraphs: Dunajska konvencija o pravu pogodb med državami in mednarodnimi organizacijami ali med mednarodnimi organizacijami (VCLTIO) je razširitev Dunajske konvencije o pravu mednarodnih pogodb, ki ureja pogodbe med državami. Pripravila jo je Komisija za mednarodno pravo, za podpis pa so jo odprli 21. marca 1986.
Po 85. členu konvencija začne veljati, ko jo ratificira ali k njej pristopi 35 držav. Junija 2025 jo je ratificiralo ali k njej pristopilo 33 držav, zato še ne velja.

source.title: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties Between States and International Organizations or Between International Organizations
paragraphs: The Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties Between States and International Organizations or Between International Organizations (VCLTIO) is an extension of the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties which deals with treaties between states. It was developed by the International Law Commission and opened for signature on 21 March 1986.

Article 85 of the Convention provides that it enters into force after ratification or accession by 35 states. As of June 2025, the treaty has been ratified or acceded to by 33 states. As a result, the convention is not yet in force.

Vlora War.headline: Valonska vojna
paragraphs: Valonska vojna (albansko: Lufta e Vlorës ali Lufta e Njëzetës) ali valonska kriza (italijansko: Crisi di Valona) je bila vojaški spopad v regiji Vlorë v Albaniji med Kraljevino Italijo in albanskimi nacionalisti. Albanski nacionalisti so štirikrat napadli Vlorë, ki jo je Italija zasedla konec leta 1914 (šest mesecev preden se je pridružila zaveznikom in vstopila v prvo svetovno vojno). Italijanske čete so napade odbijale, a jih je prizadel izbruh malarije, okrepitev pa niso dobile, ker so bersaljeri iz Ancone v času nemirov rdečega dvoletja (Biennio Rosso) zavrnili napotitev v Albanijo. Italijanski predsednik vlade Giovanni Giolitti je imel zasedbo Vlorë za nesmiselno in nepriljubljeno, zato se je z Albanci pogodil za kompromisno pogodbo. Italija se je tako odpovedala načrtom, da bi pridobila mandat Društva narodov za upravljanje Albanije, in končala zasedbo Vlorë, obdržala pa je diplomatsko zaščito nad Albanijo, da bi zagotovila njeno neodvisnost, in si priključila otok Saseno. Sporazum o premirju je leto pozneje potrdila Konferenca veleposlanikov Društva narodov, ki je potrdila albansko suverenost in posebne interese Italije v državi.

source.title: Vlora War
paragraphs: The Vlora War (Albanian: Lufta e Vlorës or Lufta e Njëzetës) or Vlora crisis (Italian: Crisi di Valona) was a military conflict in the Vlorë region of Albania between the Kingdom of Italy and Albanian nationalists. Vlorë, occupied by Italy since late 1914 (six months before it joined the Allied Powers and entered World War I), was attacked four times by Albanian nationalists. While repelling the attacks, the Italian troops suffered from an outbreak of malaria and could not receive support as the Bersaglieri of Ancona refused to be sent to Albania, in the context of the Biennio Rosso agitations. Italian prime minister Giovanni Giolitti, considering the occupation of Vlorë pointless and unpopular, negotiated a treaty of compromise with the Albanians. This resulted in Italy abandoning its plans to gain a League of Nations mandate to rule Albania and ending its occupation of Vlorë, while it retained diplomatic protection over Albania to ensure its independence and annexed the island of Saseno. The armistice agreement was confirmed a year later by the Conference of Ambassadors of the League of Nations, confirming Albanian sovereignty and Italy's special interests in the country.

Walcherenska ekspedicija je bila neuspešen britanski pohod v Kraljevino Holandijo leta 1809, s katerim naj bi med vojno pete koalicije odprli novo fronto v boju Avstrijskega cesarstva s Francijo. Poveljnik pohoda John Pitt, 2. grof Chathama, je dobil ukaz, naj zavzame mesti Flushing (Vlissingen) in Antwerpen ter tako britanskim ladjam omogoči varno plovbo po reki Šeldi.
notes: The Dutch pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: Walcheren Campaign
paragraphs: The Walcheren Campaign (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈʋɑlxərə(n)]) was an unsuccessful British expedition to the Kingdom of Holland in 1809 intended to open another front in the Austrian Empire's struggle with France during the War of the Fifth Coalition. John Pitt, 2nd Earl of Chatham, the commander of the expedition, was ordered to capture the towns of Flushing (Vlissingen) and Antwerp and thus enable British ships to safely traverse the Scheldt River.

Vlaška je geografska pokrajina v današnji Romuniji in ena od dveh zgodovinskih romunskih kneževin, ki sta postavili temelje sodobne romunske države. Leži severno od spodnje Donave in južno od Južnih Karpatov. Tradicionalno se deli na dva dela, Muntenijo (Veliko Vlaško) in Oltenijo (Malo Vlaško). Dobrudžo so včasih šteli za tretji del, ker leži blizu in ji je Vlaška nekaj časa vladala. Vlaško kot celoto včasih imenujejo tudi Muntenija, po večjem od obeh tradicionalnih delov.

source.title: Wallachia
paragraphs: Wallachia is a geographical region of modern-day Romania, as well as one of the two historical Romanian principalities that laid the foundation for the establishment of the modern Romanian state. It is situated north of the Lower Danube and south of the Southern Carpathians. Wallachia was traditionally divided into two sections, Muntenia (Greater Wallachia) and Oltenia (Lesser Wallachia). Dobruja could sometimes be considered a third section due to its proximity and brief rule over it. Wallachia as a whole is sometimes referred to as Muntenia through identification with the larger of the two traditional sections.

Wallachian Revolution of 1848.headline: Vlaška revolucija leta 1848
paragraphs: Vlaška revolucija leta 1848 je bila romunska liberalna in nacionalistična vstaja v Kneževini Vlaški. Bila je del revolucij leta 1848 in tesno povezana z neuspelim uporom v Kneževini Moldaviji; skušala je odpraviti upravo, ki so jo ruske cesarske oblasti uvedle z režimom Regulamentul Organic, mnogi njeni voditelji pa so zahtevali odpravo bojarskih privilegijev. Gibanje, ki ga je vodila skupina mladih izobražencev in častnikov vlaške milice, je strmoglavilo vladajočega kneza Gheorgheja Bibesca, ga nadomestilo z začasno vlado in regentstvom ter sprejelo vrsto pomembnih naprednih reform, razglašenih v razglasu iz Islaza.

source.title: Wallachian Revolution of 1848
paragraphs: The Wallachian Revolution of 1848 was a Romanian liberal and nationalist uprising in the Principality of Wallachia. Part of the Revolutions of 1848, and closely connected with the unsuccessful revolt in the Principality of Moldavia, it sought to overturn the administration imposed by Imperial Russian authorities under the Regulamentul Organic regime, and, through many of its leaders, demanded the abolition of boyar privilege. Led by a group of young intellectuals and officers in the Wallachian Militia, the movement succeeded in toppling the ruling Prince Gheorghe Bibescu, whom it replaced with a provisional government and a regency, and in passing a series of major progressive reforms, announced in the Proclamation of Islaz.

Wallachian uprising of 1821.headline: Vlaška vstaja leta 1821
paragraphs: Vstaja leta 1821 je bila družbeni in politični upor v Vlaški, ki je bila tedaj tributarna država Osmanskega cesarstva. Začela se je kot gibanje proti fanariotski upravi s podporo bolj konservativnih bojarjev, nato pa se je sprevrgla v poskus odprave bojarskega sloja. Čeprav ni bila naperjena proti osmanski oblasti, je zagovarjala zgodnjo obliko romunskega nacionalizma in jo zgodovinarji opisujejo kot prvi pomembni dogodek narodnega prebujenja. Jedro revolucionarnih sil je bila skupina neregularnih pandurov (lahke pehote) pod vodstvom Tudorja Vladimirescuja. Središče vstaje je bila vlaška pokrajina Oltenija, kjer je Vladimirescu februarja ustanovil svojo »Ljudsko skupščino«.

source.title: Wallachian uprising of 1821
paragraphs: The uprising of 1821 was a social and political rebellion in Wallachia, which was at the time a tributary state of the Ottoman Empire. It originated as a movement against the Phanariote administration, with backing from the more conservative boyars, but mutated into an attempted removal of the boyar class. Though not directed against Ottoman rule, the revolt espoused an early version of Romanian nationalism, and is described by historians as the first major event of a national awakening. The revolutionary force was centered on a group of Pandur (light infantry) irregulars, whose leader was Tudor Vladimirescu. The center of the uprising was the Wallachian subregion of Oltenia, where Vladimirescu established his "Assembly of the People" in February.

War against Nabis.headline: Vojna proti Nabisu
paragraphs: Lakonska vojna leta 195 pr. n. št. je potekala med grško mestno državo Šparto in koalicijo Rima, Ahajske zveze, Pergama, Rodosa in Makedonije.

Med drugo makedonsko vojno (200–196 pr. n. št.) je Makedonija Šparti prepustila nadzor nad Argosom, pomembnim mestom na egejski obali Peloponeza. Ker je Šparta Argos zasedala tudi po koncu vojne, so Rim in njegovi zavezniki to izkoristili kot pretvezo za vojno napoved. Protišpartanska koalicija je oblegala Argos, zavzela špartansko pomorsko oporišče Gitej in kmalu obkolila in oblegala tudi samo Šparto. Pogajanja so nazadnje pripeljala do miru po rimskih pogojih: Argos in obalna mesta Lakonije so ločili od Šparte, Špartanci pa so morali Rimu naslednjih osem let plačevati vojno odškodnino. Argos se je pridružil Ahajski zvezi, lakonska mesta pa so prišla pod ahajsko zaščito.
notes: The record is named War against Nabis; the English summary calls it the Laconian War, and the Slovenian follows the summary in running text.

source.title: War against Nabis
paragraphs: The Laconian War of 195 BC was fought between the Greek city-state of Sparta and a coalition composed of Rome, the Achaean League, Pergamon, Rhodes, and Macedon.

During the Second Macedonian War (200–196 BC), Macedon had given Sparta control over Argos, an important city on the Aegean coast of Peloponnese. Sparta's continued occupation of Argos at the end of war was used as a pretext for Rome and its allies to declare war. The anti-Spartan coalition laid siege to Argos, captured the Spartan naval base at Gythium, and soon invested and besieged Sparta itself. Eventually, negotiations led to peace on Rome's terms, under which Argos and the coastal towns of Laconia were separated from Sparta and the Spartans were compelled to pay a war indemnity to Rome over the next eight years. Argos joined the Achaean League, and the Laconian towns were placed under Achaean protection.

Vojna v Vendéeju (francosko: Guerre de Vendée) je bila protirevolucionarna vstaja v francoski pokrajini Vendée od leta 1793 do 1796, med francosko revolucijo. Vendée je obalna pokrajina tik južno od reke Loare na zahodu Francije. Upor je bil sprva podoben kmečki vstaji žakeriji iz 14. stoletja, a je Vendée hitro postal protirevolucionaren in rojalističen. Upor je bil primerljiv s chouannerie, ki je hkrati (1794–1800) potekala na območju severno od Loare.
notes: The French pronunciation in IPA is dropped.

source.title: War in the Vendée
paragraphs: The War in the Vendée (French: Guerre de Vendée [ɡɛʁ də vɑ̃de]) was a counter-revolutionary insurrection that took place in the Vendée region of France from 1793 to 1796, during the French Revolution. The Vendée is a coastal region, located immediately south of the river Loire in western France. Initially, the revolt was similar to the 14th-century Jacquerie peasant uprising, but the Vendée quickly became counter-revolutionary and Royalist. The revolt was comparable to the Chouannerie, which took place concurrently (1794–1800) in the area north of the Loire.

War of Ferrara (1482–1484).headline: Ferrarska vojna (1482–1484)
paragraphs: Ferrarska vojna (imenovana tudi vojna za sol, italijansko: Guerra del Sale) se je bojevala v letih 1482–1484 med ferrarskim vojvodo Ercolejem I. d'Este in silami, ki jih je zbral Ercolejev osebni sovražnik papež Sikst IV. s svojimi beneškimi zavezniki. Sovražnosti so se končale z mirom v Bagnolu, podpisanim 7. avgusta 1484.

source.title: War of Ferrara (1482–1484)
paragraphs: The War of Ferrara (also known as the Salt War, Italian: Guerra del Sale) was fought in 1482–1484 between Ercole I d'Este, Duke of Ferrara, and the forces mustered by Ercole's personal nemesis, Pope Sixtus IV and his Venetian allies. Hostilities ended with the Treaty of Bagnolo, signed on 7 August 1484.

Bretonska nasledstvena vojna ali bretonska državljanska vojna je bila spopad med grofi Bloisa in bretonskimi Montforti za nadzor nad Vojvodino Bretanjo. Potekala je med letom 1341 in 12. aprilom 1365. Znana je tudi kot vojna dveh Ivan (francosko: guerre des deux Jeannes), ker sta v njej sodelovali tekmici, vojvodinji s tem imenom, Ivana Flandrijska in Ivana Penthièvrska.

Vojna je bila sestavni del zgodnje stoletne vojne, saj sta francoski in angleški kralj v spopadu sodelovala posredno: Francozi so podpirali Bloise (dedinjo po ženski liniji), Angleži pa Montforte (dediča po moški liniji). Kralja tekmeca sta podpirala vojvodo po načelu, ki je bilo nasprotno od njunih lastnih zahtev do francoskega prestola: Plantageneti so ga zahtevali po ženskem nasledstvu, Valoisi pa po moškem. Montfort je nazadnje uspel po bitki pri Aurayju leta 1364, a se je montfortovski vojvoda presenetljivo zaobljubil zvestobo francoskemu kralju, ne pa plantagenetskemu angleškemu kralju, ki ga je podpiral.

source.title: War of the Breton Succession
paragraphs: The War of the Breton Succession or Breton Civil War was a conflict between the Counts of Blois and the Montforts of Brittany for control of the Duchy of Brittany. It was fought between 1341 and 12 April 1365. It is also known as the War of the Two Joans (French: guerre des deux Jeannes) due to the involvement of two rival duchesses of that name, Joan of Flanders and Joan of Penthièvre.

The war formed an integral part of the early Hundred Years' War due to the proxy involvement of the French and English monarchs in the conflict; the French supported the Blois (female heir) whilst the English backed the Montforts (male heir). The rival kings supported the duke of the principle opposite to their own claims to the French throne—the Plantagenets having claimed it by female succession, and the Valois by male succession. Montfort was ultimately successful following the Battle of Auray in 1364 but, in a surprising turn of events, the Montfortist duke pledged his loyalty to the king of France and not to the Plantagenet king of England who had supported him.
Kastiljski kralj Henrik IV. je umrl konec leta 1474.

Nato so se privrženci njegove domnevne hčere Juane »la Beltraneja« vojskovali za nasledstvo kastiljske krone proti privržencem njegove polsestre Izabele, ki je do leta 1479 zmagala. Vojna je imela izrazit mednarodni značaj, saj je bila Izabela poročena s Ferdinandom, prestolonaslednikom Aragonske krone, Juana pa se je na predlog svojih privržencev poročila s stricem, portugalskim kraljem Afonsom V. Francija je posegla na strani Portugalske, saj je z Aragonijo tekmovala za ozemlja v Italiji in Roussillonu.

Kljub nekaj začetnim uspehom Juaninih privržencev sta pomanjkanje vojaške odločnosti Afonsa V. in neodločen izid bitke pri Toru (1476) privedla do razpada Juaninega zavezništva in priznanja Izabele na cortes v Madrigalu in Segovii (april–oktober 1476).
notes: The English source breaks its first sentence across the first two paragraphs and ends with a colon before text it leaves out; the Slovenian keeps three complete paragraphs.

source.title: War of the Castilian Succession
paragraphs: After the death of King Henry IV of Castile in late 1474,

the supporters of his reputed daughter, Joanna 'la Beltraneja', waged a war for the succession to the Crown of Castile against the supporters of his half-sister, Isabella, who prevailed by 1479. The war had a marked international character, as Isabella was married to Ferdinand, heir apparent to the Crown of Aragon, while Joanna married her uncle King Afonso V of Portugal at the suggestion of her supporters. France intervened in support of Portugal, as they were rivals with Aragon for territory in Italy and Roussillon.

Despite a few initial successes by the supporters of Joanna, a lack of military aggressiveness by Afonso V and the stalemate in the Battle of Toro (1476) led to the disintegration of Joanna's alliance and the recognition of Isabella in the Courts of Madrigal-Segovia (April–October 1476):
Vojna osmih svetnikov (1375–1378) je bila vojna med papežem Gregorjem XI. in koalicijo italijanskih mestnih držav pod vodstvom Firenc, ki je prispevala h koncu avignonskega papeštva.

source.title: War of the Eight Saints
paragraphs: The War of the Eight Saints (1375–1378) was a war between Pope Gregory XI and a coalition of Italian city-states led by Florence that contributed to the end of the Avignon Papacy.

War of the Mantuan Succession.headline: Vojna za mantovsko nasledstvo
paragraphs: Vojna za mantovsko nasledstvo, od 1628 do 1631, je izbruhnila zaradi smrti Vincenza II., zadnjega Gonzaga, vladarja Mantove in Montferrata, decembra 1627. Pripeljala je do posredniške vojne med vojvodo Neversa, ki ga je podpirala Francija, in vojvodo Guastalle, ki ga je podpirala Španija. Šteje se za povezan spopad tridesetletne vojne 1618–1648.

Boji so se osredotočili na francosko trdnjavo Casale Monferrato, ki so jo Španci dvakrat oblegali. Francoski poseg v prid Neversu aprila 1629 je cesarja Ferdinanda II. spodbudil, da je Španiji priskočil na pomoč s premestitvijo čet iz severne Nemčije. Cesarske čete so julija 1630 zavzele Mantovo, vendar Casala niso uspele zavzeti. Ferdinand je čete umaknil zaradi švedskega posega v tridesetletno vojno in obe strani sta se oktobra 1630 dogovorili o premirju.

source.title: War of the Mantuan Succession
paragraphs: The War of the Mantuan Succession, 1628 to 1631, was caused by the death in December 1627 of Vincenzo II, last Gonzaga ruler of Mantua and Montferrat. This led to a proxy war between the French-backed Duke of Nevers and the Duke of Guastalla, supported by Spain. It is considered a related conflict of the 1618 to 1648 Thirty Years' War.

Fighting centred on the French-held fortress of Casale Monferrato, which the Spanish besieged twice. French intervention on behalf of Nevers in April 1629 led Emperor Ferdinand II to support Spain by transferring troops from Northern Germany. They captured Mantua in July 1630, but failed to take Casale. Ferdinand withdrew his troops in response to Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years' War, and both sides agreed a truce in October 1630.

Vojna za portugalsko nasledstvo, posledica grozečega izumrtja portugalske kraljeve rodbine po bitki pri Alcácer Quibirju in nasledstvene krize leta 1580, ki je sledila, je potekala od leta 1580 do 1583 med glavnima pretendentoma za portugalski prestol: Antóniom, priorjem Crata, ki so ga v več mestih razglasili za portugalskega kralja, in njegovim bratrancem, španskim kraljem Filipom II., ki si je krono nazadnje pridobil in vladal kot portugalski kralj Filip I.

source.title: War of the Portuguese Succession
paragraphs: The War of the Portuguese Succession, a result of the impending extinction of the Portuguese royal line after the Battle of Alcácer Quibir and the ensuing Portuguese succession crisis of 1580, was fought from 1580 to 1583 between the two main claimants to the Portuguese throne: António, Prior of Crato, proclaimed in several towns as King of Portugal, and his first cousin Philip II of Spain, who eventually succeeded in claiming the crown, reigning as Philip I of Portugal.

Pirenejska vojna, znana tudi kot vojna za Roussillon ali vojna konventa, je bila pirenejska fronta vojne prve koalicije proti prvi francoski republiki. V njej se je revolucionarna Francija med francoskimi revolucionarnimi vojnami od marca 1793 do julija 1795 bojevala proti kraljevinama Španiji in Portugalski.

Bojevali so se v vzhodnih in zahodnih Pirenejih, v francoskem pristanišču Toulon in na morju. Leta 1793 je španska vojska vdrla v Roussillon v vzhodnih Pirenejih in se na francoskih tleh obdržala do aprila 1794. Francoska revolucionarna vojska je špansko vojsko potisnila nazaj v Katalonijo in ji novembra 1794 zadala hud poraz. Po februarju 1795 je vojna v vzhodnih Pirenejih zastala. V zahodnih Pirenejih so Francozi začeli zmagovati leta 1794. Do leta 1795 je francoska vojska nadzorovala del severovzhodne Španije.

source.title: War of the Pyrenees
paragraphs: The War of the Pyrenees, also known as War of Roussillon or War of the Convention, was the Pyrenean front of the First Coalition's war against the First French Republic. It pitted Revolutionary France against the kingdoms of Spain and Portugal from March 1793 to July 1795 during the French Revolutionary Wars.

The war was fought in the eastern and western Pyrenees, at the French port of Toulon, and at sea. In 1793, a Spanish army invaded Roussillon in the eastern Pyrenees and maintained itself on French soil through April 1794. The French Revolutionary Army drove the Spanish Army back into Catalonia and inflicted a serious defeat in November 1794. After February 1795, the war in the eastern Pyrenees became a stalemate. In the western Pyrenees, the French began to win in 1794. By 1795, the French army controlled a portion of northeast Spain.

Vojna Réunionov (1683–1684) je bila spopad med Francijo, Španijo in Svetim rimskim cesarstvom, v katerem je omejeno sodelovala tudi Genova. Lahko jo vidimo kot nadaljevanje devolucijske vojne (1667–1668) in francosko-nizozemske vojne (1672–1678), ki ju je gnala odločenost Ludvika XIV., da vzpostavi obranljive meje ob severni in vzhodni meji Francije.

Kljub nijmegenskemu miru iz leta 1678 je Ludvik obdržal veliko vojsko, kar je bilo za tisti čas zelo nenavadno. Leta 1681 so njegove čete zavzele Strasbourg, leta 1682 pa zasedle Kneževino Orange, tedaj posest Viljema Oranskega. Ko so se leta 1683 začele sovražnosti, je francoska podpora Osmanom v njihovi vojni z Avstrijo Ludviku omogočila, da je zavzel Luksemburg in utrdil svoj položaj v Alzaciji.
notes: The range 1683–84 is written in full (1683–1684).

source.title: War of the Reunions
paragraphs: The War of the Reunions (1683–84) was a conflict between France, Spain and the Holy Roman Empire, with limited involvement by Genoa. It can be seen as a continuation of the War of Devolution (1667–1668) and the Franco-Dutch War (1672–1678), which were driven by Louis XIV's determination to establish defensible boundaries along France's northern and eastern borders.

Despite the peace established by the 1678 Treaty of Nijmegen, Louis retained a large army, an action extremely unusual in the period. In 1681, his troops seized Strasbourg and in 1682 occupied the Principality of Orange, then a possession of William of Orange. When hostilities began in 1683, French support for the Ottomans in their war with Austria allowed Louis to capture Luxembourg and consolidate his position in Alsace.

Wars in Lombardy.headline: Vojne v Lombardiji
paragraphs: Vojne v Lombardiji so bile niz spopadov med Beneško republiko in Milansko vojvodino ter njunimi zavezniki, ki so se bojevali v štirih kampanjah v boju za hegemonijo v severni Italiji in opustošili lombardsko gospodarstvo. Trajale so od leta 1423 do podpisa miru v Lodiju leta 1454. V tem času se je politična struktura Italije preoblikovala: iz tekmovalne zbirke komun in mestnih držav je nastalo pet velikih italijanskih ozemeljskih sil, ki so do konca 15. stoletja oblikovale zemljevid Italije, vse do začetka italijanskih vojn na prelomu v 16. stoletje. To so bile Benetke, Milan, Firence, Papeška država in Neapelj. Pomembna kulturna središča Toskane in severne Italije – Siena, Pisa, Urbino, Mantova, Ferrara – so postala politično obrobna.

source.title: Wars in Lombardy
paragraphs: The Wars in Lombardy were a series of conflicts between the Republic of Venice and the Duchy of Milan and their respective allies, fought in four campaigns in a struggle for hegemony in Northern Italy that ravaged the economy of Lombardy. They lasted from 1423 until the signing of the Treaty of Lodi in 1454. During their course, the political structure of Italy was transformed: out of a competitive congeries of communes and city-states emerged the five major Italian territorial powers that would make up the map of Italy for the remainder of the 15th century and the beginning of the Italian Wars at the turn of the 16th century. They were Venice, Milan, Florence, the Papal States and Naples. Important cultural centers of Tuscany and Northern Italy—Siena, Pisa, Urbino, Mantua, Ferrara—became politically marginalized.

Vojne za škotsko neodvisnost (1296–1357) so obsegale dva dolgotrajna vojaška spopada, v katerih je Kraljevina Anglija skušala vzpostaviti popoln nadzor nad Kraljevino Škotsko. Kljub pomembnim začasnim uspehom so angleška prizadevanja v obeh vojnah zaradi škotskega odpora nazadnje propadla in Škotska je ostala neodvisna država. Vojne so bile del velike krize Škotske, to obdobje pa je postalo eno najodločilnejših v njeni zgodovini.

source.title: Wars of Scottish Independence
paragraphs: The Scottish wars (1296–1357) were two extended military conflicts in which the Kingdom of England attempted to establish full control over the Kingdom of Scotland. In spite of significant temporary successes, the English efforts in both wars ultimately failed due to Scottish resistance and Scotland remained an independent country. The wars were part of a great crisis for Scotland, and the period became one of the most defining times in its history.

Wars of the Delian League.headline: Vojne Delske zveze
paragraphs: Vojne Delske zveze (477–449 pr. n. št.) so bile vrsta pohodov med Delsko zvezo pod vodstvom Aten in njenih zaveznikov ter Ahemenidskim cesarstvom. Ti spopadi so bili nadaljevanje grško-perzijskih vojn po drugi perzijski invaziji na Grčijo.

Grško zavezništvo pod vodstvom Šparte in Aten je drugo perzijsko invazijo odbilo, ta uspeh pa je sprva nadgradilo z zavzetjem perzijskih posadk v Sestu in Bizantionu, obeh v Trakiji, v letih 479 in 478 pr. n. št. Po zavzetju Bizantiona so se Špartanci odločili, da v vojni ne bodo več sodelovali, in nastalo je novo zavezništvo, splošno znano kot Delska zveza, v katerem so imele Atene izrazito prevladujočo vlogo. V naslednjih 30 letih so Atene postopoma prevzele vse bolj hegemonski položaj v zvezi, ki se je sčasoma razvila v atenski imperij.

source.title: Wars of the Delian League
paragraphs: The Wars of the Delian League (477–449 BC) were a series of campaigns fought between the Delian League led by Athens and her allies, and the Achaemenid Empire. These conflicts represent the continuation of the Greco-Persian Wars, after the second Persian invasion of Greece.

The Greek alliance, led by Sparta and Athens, had defeated the second Persian invasion and initially followed up this success by capturing the Persian garrisons of Sestos and Byzantium, both in Thrace, in 479 and 478 BC, respectively. After the capture of Byzantium, the Spartans elected not to continue the war effort, and a new alliance, commonly known as the Delian League, was formed, with Athens very much the dominant power. Over the next 30 years, Athens would gradually assume a more hegemonic position over the league, which gradually evolved into the Athenian Empire.

Vojne diadohov (starogrško: Πόλεμοι τῶν Διαδόχων, dobesedno »vojna prestolonaslednikov«) ali vojne Aleksandrovih naslednikov v letih 322–272 pr. n. št. so bile vrsta spopadov med vojskovodji Aleksandra Velikega, znanimi kot diadohi, za oblast nad njegovim cesarstvom po njegovi smrti. Boji so se začeli skoraj takoj po njegovi smrti leta 323 pr. n. št. Odločilna bitka pri Ipsusu leta 301 pr. n. št. je Ptolemajce in Selevkide uveljavila kot glavni dinastiji helenističnega sveta. Po bitki pri Kurupediju leta 281 pr. n. št. je Selevk I. ostal edini živi naslednik med prvotnimi diadohi. Boj za Makedonijo in prevlado nad Grčijo pa se je v korist Antigonidov končal šele leta 272 pr. n. št. s smrtjo Pira Epirskega.

source.title: Wars of the Diadochi
paragraphs: The Wars of the Diadochi (Ancient Greek: Πόλεμοι τῶν Διαδόχων, romanized: Pólemoi tōn Diadóchōn, lit. 'War of the Crown Princes') or Wars of Alexander's Successors of 322–272 BC were a series of conflicts fought between the generals of Alexander the Great, known as the Diadochi, over who would rule his empire following his death. The fighting started almost immediately after his death in 323 BC. The crucial battle of Ipsus fought in 301 BC, established Ptolemies and Seleucids as the two major dynasties of the Hellenistic world. The battle of Corupedium in 281 BC, left Seleucus I as the only living successor among the original Diadochi. However, the struggle over Macedon and hegemony over Greece was concluded in favour of the Antigonids only in 272 BC with the death of Pyrrhus of Epirus.

Vojne treh kraljestev so skupno ime za vrsto spopadov, ki so med letoma 1639 in 1653 potekali v Angliji, na Škotskem in Irskem, tedaj ločenih tvorbah v personalni uniji pod Karlom I. Vključujejo vojne škofov v letih 1639–1640, prvo in drugo angleško državljansko vojno, irske konfederacijske vojne, Cromwellovo osvojitev Irske in angleško-škotsko vojno v letih 1650–1652. Končale so se z usmrtitvijo Karla I., odpravo monarhije in ustanovitvijo Angleške republike, enotne države, ki je nadzorovala Britanske otoke do restavracije Stuartov leta 1660.

source.title: Wars of the Three Kingdoms
paragraphs: The Wars of the Three Kingdoms is the collective term for a series of conflicts fought between 1639 and 1653 in England, Scotland, and Ireland, then separate entities in a personal union under Charles I. They include the 1639 to 1640 Bishops' Wars, the First and Second English Civil Wars, the Irish Confederate Wars, the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland, and the Anglo-Scottish War of 1650–1652. They resulted in the execution of Charles I, the abolition of monarchy, and founding of the Commonwealth of England, a unitary state which controlled the British Isles until the Stuart Restoration in 1660.

Konvencija o poenotenju nekaterih pravil v mednarodnem letalskem prevozu, splošno znana kot varšavska konvencija, je mednarodna konvencija, ki ureja odgovornost za mednarodni prevoz oseb, prtljage ali blaga z letali proti plačilu.

Prvotno so jo podpisali leta 1929 v Varšavi (od tod ime), spremenili pa so jo leta 1955 v Haagu na Nizozemskem in leta 1971 v Ciudad de Guatemali v Gvatemali. Sodišča ZDA so razsodila, da je vsaj za nekatere namene varšavska konvencija drugačen instrument od varšavske konvencije, kot jo je spremenil haaški protokol.
Montrealska konvencija, podpisana leta 1999, je v državah, ki so jo ratificirale, nadomestila sistem varšavske konvencije.

source.title: Warsaw Convention
paragraphs: The Convention for the Unification of certain rules relating to international carriage by air, commonly known as the Warsaw Convention, is an international convention which regulates liability for international carriage of persons, luggage, or goods performed by aircraft for reward.

Originally signed in 1929 in Warsaw (hence the name), it was amended in 1955 at The Hague, Netherlands, and in 1971 in Guatemala City, Guatemala. United States courts have held that, at least for some purposes, the Warsaw Convention is a different instrument from the Warsaw Convention as amended by the Hague Protocol.
The Montreal Convention, signed in 1999, replaced the Warsaw Convention system in countries ratifying it.

Vstaja v Varšavskem getu je bila vstaja judovskega odpora v Varšavskem getu na Poljskem pod nemško okupacijo med drugo svetovno vojno; z njo so se uprli zadnjemu poskusu nacistične Nemčije, da bi preostale prebivalce geta leta 1943 odpeljala v plinske celice taborišč smrti Majdanek in Treblinka. Bila je največji posamični upor Judov proti nacistom med drugo svetovno vojno.

Po veliki akciji v Varšavi (Grossaktion Warschau) poleti 1942, v kateri so iz geta v Treblinko odpeljali in umorili več kot četrt milijona Judov, so preostali Judje začeli graditi bunkerje ter v geto tihotapiti orožje in razstrelivo. Nastali sta levičarska Judovska bojna organizacija (ŻOB) in desničarska Judovska vojaška zveza (ŻZW), ki sta se začeli uriti. Manjši odpor ob novi raciji januarja 1943 je bil delno uspešen in je poljske odporniške skupine spodbudil, da so Jude začele resno podpirati.

source.title: Warsaw Ghetto Uprising
paragraphs: The Warsaw Ghetto Uprising was an uprising by the Jewish resistance in the Warsaw Ghetto in German-occupied Poland during World War II to oppose Nazi Germany's final effort to transport the remaining ghetto population to the gas chambers of the Majdanek and Treblinka extermination camps in 1943. It was the largest single revolt by Jews against the Nazis during World War II.

After the Grossaktion Warsaw of summer 1942, in which more than a quarter of a million Jews were deported from the ghetto to Treblinka and murdered, the remaining Jews began to build bunkers and smuggle weapons and explosives into the ghetto. The left-wing Jewish Combat Organization (ŻOB) and right-wing Jewish Military Union (ŻZW) formed and began to train. A small resistance effort to another roundup in January 1943 was partially successful and spurred Polish resistance groups to support the Jews in earnest.

Warsaw Uprising (1794).headline: Varšavska vstaja leta 1794
paragraphs: Varšavska vstaja leta 1794 ali varšavska insurekcija (poljsko: insurekcja warszawska) je bila oborožena vstaja prebivalcev Varšave na začetku Kościuszkove vstaje. S podporo poljske vojske so uporniki skušali poljsko prestolnico osvoboditi nadzora Ruskega imperija. Vstaja se je začela 17. aprila 1794, kmalu po zmagi Tadeusza Kościuszka v bitki pri Racławicah.

Čeprav so imele ruske sile več vojakov in boljšo opremo, so poljske redne enote in milica, oborožene s puškami in sabljami iz varšavskega arzenala, presenečeni sovražni posadki prizadejale hude izgube. Ruski vojaki so se znašli pod navzkrižnim ognjem z vseh strani in iz stavb, več enot je že zgodaj razpadlo in pri umiku utrpelo hude izgube.

source.title: Warsaw Uprising (1794)
paragraphs: The Warsaw Uprising of 1794 or Warsaw Insurrection (Polish: insurekcja warszawska) was an armed insurrection by the people of Warsaw early in the Kościuszko Uprising. Supported by the Polish Army, the uprising aimed to throw off control by the Russian Empire of the Polish capital city (Warsaw). It began on 17 April 1794, soon after Tadeusz Kościuszko's victory at the Battle of Racławice.

Although the Russian forces had more soldiers and better equipment, the Polish regular forces and militia, armed with rifles and sabres from the Warsaw Arsenal, inflicted heavy losses on the surprised enemy garrison. Russian soldiers found themselves under crossfire from all sides and from buildings, and several units broke early and suffered heavy casualties in their retreat.

Western Allied invasion of Germany.headline: Zahodnozavezniška invazija na Nemčijo
paragraphs: Zahodnozavezniška invazija na Nemčijo je bila usklajena operacija zahodnih zaveznikov v zadnjih mesecih sovražnosti na evropskem bojišču druge svetovne vojne. Kot pripravo na zavezniško invazijo na Nemčijo vzhodno od Rena so zasnovali vrsto ofenzivnih operacij, s katerimi naj bi zavzeli njegov vzhodni in zahodni breg: operaciji Veritable in Grenade februarja 1945 ter operaciji Lumberjack in Undertone marca 1945; te štejejo za ločene od glavne invazijske operacije. Zavezniška invazija na Nemčijo vzhodno od Rena se je začela 22. marca 1945, ko so zahodni zavezniki prečkali reko, nato pa so se razširili in preplavili vso zahodno Nemčijo od Baltika na severu do alpskih prelazov na jugu.
Potem ko so 25. aprila 1945 prvič vzpostavili stik z Rdečo armado z vzhoda in tako Nemčijo presekali na dvoje (dan, znan kot dan na Labi), so se povezali s četami ameriške 5. armade v Italiji.

source.title: Western Allied invasion of Germany
paragraphs: The Western Allied invasion of Germany was coordinated by the Western Allies during the final months of hostilities in the European theatre of World War II. In preparation for the Allied invasion of Germany east of the Rhine, a series of offensive operations were designed to seize and capture its east and west banks: Operation Veritable and Operation Grenade in February 1945, and Operation Lumberjack and Operation Undertone in March 1945; these are considered separate from the main invasion operation. The Allied invasion of Germany east of the Rhine started with the Western Allies crossing the river on 22 March 1945 before fanning out and overrunning all of western Germany from the Baltic in the north to the Alpine passes in the south.
After making first contact with the Red Army from the east, thereby cutting Germany in two on 25 April 1945 (known as Elbe Day), they linked up with troops of the U.S. Fifth Army in Italy.

Wihtwara.headline: Wihtwara
paragraphs: Wihtwara (staroangleško: Wihtware ali Wihtsætan) so bili zgodnjesrednjeveški prebivalci otoka Wight, ki meri 380 km² in leži ob južni obali Anglije. Pisci, kot je Beda, njihov izvor pripisujejo Jutom, ki so se na otok preselili med anglosaško naselitvijo Britanije. V zgodnjem srednjem veku so občasno tvorili samostojno kraljestvo; njihov zadnji kralj Arwald je umrl kot zadnji poganski anglosaški kralj. Nato je otok postal del Wessexa in pozneje Anglije.
notes: The square-mile conversion is dropped.

source.title: Wihtwara
paragraphs: Wihtwara (Old English: Wihtware or Wihtsætan) were the Early Medieval inhabitants of the Isle of Wight, a 147-square-mile (380 km2) island off the south coast of England. Writers such as Bede attribute their origin to Jutes who migrated to the island during the Anglo-Saxon settlement of Britain. They formed an independent kingdom at points in the Early Middle Ages, with their last king Arwald dying as the last heathen Anglo-Saxon king. After this point, the island became a part of Wessex and later England.

Viljemovska vojna na Irskem je potekala od marca 1689 do oktobra 1691 med jakobitskimi privrženci Jakoba II. in privrženci njegovega naslednika Viljema III. ter se končala z zmago Viljemovih privržencev. Navadno jo štejejo za spopad, povezan z devetletno vojno v letih 1688–1697.

Slavna revolucija novembra 1688 je katoliškega Jakoba nadomestila z njegovo protestantsko hčerjo Marijo II. in njenim možem Viljemom, ki sta kot sovladarja vladala Angliji, Irski in Škotski. Jakob pa je ohranil precejšnjo podporo na pretežno katoliškem Irskem, kjer so upali, da bo razrešil dolgoletne pritožbe irskih katoličanov glede lastništva zemlje, vere in državljanskih pravic.

source.title: Williamite War in Ireland
paragraphs: The Williamite War in Ireland took place from March 1689 to October 1691. Fought between Jacobite supporters of James II and those of his successor, William III, it resulted in a Williamite victory. It is generally viewed as a related conflict of the 1688 to 1697 Nine Years' War.

The November 1688 Glorious Revolution replaced the Catholic James with his Protestant daughter Mary II and her husband William, who ruled as joint monarchs of England, Ireland, and Scotland. However, James retained considerable support in largely Catholic Ireland, where it was hoped he would address long-standing Irish Catholic grievances on land ownership, religion and civic rights.

WIPO Copyright Treaty.headline: Pogodba WIPO o avtorski pravici
paragraphs: Pogodba Svetovne organizacije za intelektualno lastnino o avtorski pravici (pogodba WIPO o avtorski pravici ali WCT) je mednarodna pogodba o avtorskem pravu, ki so jo leta 1996 sprejele države članice Svetovne organizacije za intelektualno lastnino (WIPO). Avtorski pravici zagotavlja dodatno varstvo kot odziv na napredek informacijske tehnologije od nastanka prejšnjih pogodb o avtorski pravici. Avgusta 2026 je imela pogodba 119 pogodbenic. WCT in Pogodbo WIPO o izvedbah in fonogramih skupaj imenujejo internetni pogodbi WIPO.

source.title: WIPO Copyright Treaty
paragraphs: The World Intellectual Property Organization Copyright Treaty (WIPO Copyright Treaty or WCT) is an international treaty on copyright law adopted by the member states of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) in 1996. It provides additional protections for copyright to respond to advances in information technology since the formation of previous copyright treaties before it. As of August 2026, the treaty has 119 contracting parties. The WCT and WIPO Performances and Phonograms Treaty, are together termed WIPO Internet Treaties.

WIPO Performances and Phonograms Treaty.headline: Pogodba WIPO o izvedbah in fonogramih
paragraphs: Pogodba WIPO o izvedbah in fonogramih (WPPT) je mednarodna pogodba, sprejeta 20. decembra 1996 v Ženevi. Veljati je začela 20. maja 2002. Ureja pravice dveh vrst upravičencev, zlasti v digitalnem okolju: izvajalcev (igralcev, pevcev, glasbenikov ipd.) in proizvajalcev fonogramov (oseb ali pravnih subjektov, ki dajo pobudo za posnetek zvokov in zanj odgovarjajo).

Julija 2026 je imela pogodba 115 pogodbenic. Odprta je za države članice Svetovne organizacije za intelektualno lastnino (WIPO) in za Evropsko skupnost. Upravlja jo WIPO. WPPT in Pogodbo WIPO o avtorski pravici skupaj imenujejo internetni pogodbi WIPO.
